papers.title: Question-Aware Evidence Ledgers for Video Relational Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The VRR-QA challenge evaluates visual relational reasoning in videos, where answers often depend on implicit spatial relations, event boundaries, target identity, and dialogue context rather than a single salient frame. We present a test-time reasoning pipeline built around a strong GPT-5.5 video QA solver and a set of question-aware evidence ledgers. The initial solver answers each question from a uniform video representation, while routed ledgers are prompted to make the required targets, count units, reference frames, and temporal or spatial scope explicit for counting, spatial, endpoint, viewpoint, and dialogue reasoning. External tools such as open-vocabulary detection, depth cues, pair crops, ASR, and scene-graph ledgers are used only as evidence sources. A conservative gate keeps the current answer unless independent evidence uniquely supports a different option. The final evidence-gated pipeline achieves 92.95% overall accuracy and 93.79% macro accuracy on the challenge test split.
papers.comment: Technical report for the VRR Challenge at the VideoLLMs Workshop, CVPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于问题感知证据账本（question-aware evidence ledgers）的测试时推理流水线，用于视频关系推理（VRR-QA）任务。该系统使用GPT-5.5作为视频QA求解器，结合多种证据来源（如开放词汇检测、深度线索、成对裁剪、ASR、场景图账本）和保守门控机制，在挑战测试集上达到92.95%总体准确率和93.79%宏平均准确率。
Motivation: 视频关系推理中，答案常依赖于隐式空间关系、事件边界、目标身份和对话上下文，而非单一显著帧，现有方法难以处理这类复杂推理。
Method: 构建测试时推理流水线：以强GPT-5.5视频QA求解器为基础，设计问题感知证据账本，针对计数、空间、端点、视角和对话推理，显式提取所需目标、计数单元、参考帧及时空范围；利用外部工具（开放词汇检测、深度线索、成对裁剪、ASR、场景图账本）作为证据源；采用保守门控机制，仅在独立证据唯一支持不同选项时才更改初始答案。
Result: 该证据门控流水线在挑战测试集上达到92.95%总体准确率和93.79%宏平均准确率。
Conclusion: 问题感知证据账本和保守门控机制能有效提升视频关系推理的准确性。

papers.title: GloResNet: A lightweight 3D CNN with global topological features for preterm brain injury prediction
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces an automated deep learning framework for predicting brain injury (BI) in preterm infants from T2-weighted MRI (dHCP dataset). We propose GloResNet, a lightweight 3D CNN based on ResNet-10, pretrained on MedicalNet to address data scarcity. A global manifold mapping strategy first resamples each 3D volume to 128x128x128 and then applies subject-wise z-score intensity normalization, thereby preserving global topology while standardizing appearance. Training integrates mixup, class weighting, and test-time augmentation for robustness. In 5-fold cross-validation, GloResNet achieved 75.18% average accuracy (peak 81.82%), with specificity 0.81 and sensitivity 0.76. Results demonstrate that a topology-aware lightweight CNN has the capability to effectively predict neonatal BI, offering a non-invasive screening tool. The source code of this paper can be obtained from the GitHub repository: https://github.com/ICL-SUST/GloResNet-Preterm-Brain
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GloResNet，一种基于 ResNet-10 的轻量级 3D CNN，用于从 T2 加权 MRI 预测早产儿脑损伤。模型采用全局流形映射重采样和 z-score 归一化保留全局拓扑，并结合 mixup、类别加权和测试时增强。在 dHCP 数据集上 5 折交叉验证平均准确率 75.18%，峰值 81.82%，特异性 0.81，敏感性 0.76。
Motivation: 早产儿脑损伤的自动筛查工具缺乏，现有方法难以在数据有限的情况下兼顾轻量化与全局拓扑信息。
Method: 提出 GloResNet，基于 ResNet-10 的 3D CNN，预训练于 MedicalNet；引入全局流形映射将体积重采样至 128x128x128 并逐主体 z-score 归一化；训练使用 mixup、类别加权和测试时增强。
Result: 在 dHCP 数据集 5 折交叉验证中平均准确率 75.18%（峰值 81.82%），特异性 0.81，敏感性 0.76。
Conclusion: 拓扑感知的轻量级 CNN 能有效预测新生儿脑损伤，提供非侵入性筛查工具。

papers.title: Bridging the Last Mile of Time Series Forecasting with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting has advanced rapidly, especially with the emergence of foundation models that show strong zero-shot performance on numerical extrapolation. However, in real-world forecasting settings, a statistically plausible baseline is rarely the final forecast used in practice. Before a forecast becomes decision-ready, it often needs to be revised using weakly structured business context such as holiday effects, campaign plans, external events, historical analogs, and expert feedback. This practical stage remains underexplored in the forecasting literature. In this paper, we formulate this stage as the \textbf{last-mile forecasting} problem and present an LLM-agent framework that sits on top of a forecasting backbone. Our system maintains a unified forecast workspace, invokes tools to retrieve contextual evidence, and converts reasoning trajectories into explicit forecast revision actions under structural safety constraints. It also supports long-horizon forecasting through map-reduce-style decomposition and post-hoc reflection through a memory bank. The resulting system is designed to be controllable and auditable. Through real-world case studies, we show how LLM agents can bridge the gap between statistical prediction and business-ready forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“最后一英里预测”问题，即统计预测在成为决策可用之前需要结合业务上下文（如节假日、活动、专家反馈）进行修正。作者构建了一个基于LLM agent的框架，该框架位于预测骨干模型之上，通过统一工作空间、工具调用和结构安全约束，将推理轨迹转化为显式预测修订动作，并支持长期预测的map-reduce分解和事后反思。案例研究表明该框架能弥合统计预测与业务就绪预测之间的差距。
Motivation: 实际预测中，统计基线通常需要根据业务上下文（如事件、专家意见）进行修订才能投入决策，但现有文献对此阶段研究不足。
Method: 提出LLM agent框架，包含统一预测工作空间、工具调用（检索上下文证据）、基于结构安全约束的预测修订动作，以及通过map-reduce分解实现长程预测和记忆库支持事后反思。
Result: 通过真实案例展示了LLM agent能有效结合统计预测与业务上下文生成决策可用预测，但未提供定量基准对比。
Conclusion: 该方法为可控、可审计的最后一英里预测提供了可行方案，强调业务上下文整合的重要性，但当前工作以定性为主。

papers.title: Monitoring Agentic Systems Before They're Reliable
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems entering production typically operate as partially integrated assemblies where structural defects, not task-level errors, dominate the failure landscape. At this maturity level, task-level error detection may be infeasible: structural failure modes mask the signal that task-level monitors are designed to detect.We present a monitoring and triage methodology that decomposes agentic system evaluation into three dimensions (quality, suitability, efficiency) at three monitoring scopes (within-run, cross-run, structural), using variance as a characterization signal. Findings are routed through severity classification adapted from FMEA, concentrating human attention on the subset that warrants investigation. We evaluate on a synthetic testbed of 220 runs across 120 document bundles with controlled error injection.Three results emerge. Monitor scope determines failure type: within-run monitors surface deterministic stage defects (CV = 0.02), cross-run monitors surface stochastic integration consequences (CV = 1.25, 24% at L2), and a structural monitor identifies an integration gap with perfect consistency (CV = 0.00). Injected task-level errors are indistinguishable from clean baselines, confirming structural defects mask task-level signal. Deterministic triage routes 97% of findings to automated tracking, leaving the 2% reflecting variable behavior for human investigation.We propose, on Stage 1 evidence, a maturity-staging model in which monitoring transitions from structural characterization to error detection to reliability tracking as integration defects resolve. The taxonomy, CV-based scope characterization, and severity model transfer architecturally to document-driven, multi-stage agentic workflows in regulated industries; specific calibrations are domain-specific. Deploy monitoring early: the first thing it finds is the most important thing to fix.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the Workshop on Agentic Software Engineering (AgenticSE), co-located with ACM CAIS 2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生产环境中代理系统（agentic systems）的结构缺陷占主导地位、任务级错误检测不可行的问题，提出一种监控与分类方法。该方法将代理系统评估分解为三个维度（质量、适用性、效率）和三个监控范围（运行内、跨运行、结构），利用方差作为表征信号，并基于FMEA改编的严重性分类进行结果路由。在220次运行的合成测试平台上评估，结果表明监控范围决定失败类型：运行内监控暴露确定性阶段缺陷（CV=0.02），跨运行监控暴露随机集成后果（CV=1.25，24%为L2），结构监控以完美一致性（CV=0.00）识别集成缺口。注入的任务级错误与清洁基线无法区分。确定性分类将97%的结果路由至自动跟踪，仅2%的可变行为留给人审。基于第一阶段证据，提出成熟度阶段模型，随集成缺陷解决，监控从结构表征过渡到错误检测再到可靠性跟踪。
Motivation: 代理系统进入生产时通常为部分集成的组装体，结构缺陷而非任务级错误主导失败模式。在此成熟度下，任务级错误检测不可行，因为结构失效模式掩盖了任务级监控设计的信号。
Method: 提出一种监控与分类方法，将代理系统评估分解为三个维度（质量、适用性、效率）和三个监控范围（运行内、跨运行、结构），使用方差作为表征信号，并通过改编自FMEA的严重性分类将发现结果路由至自动化跟踪或人工审查。
Result: 在220次运行、120个文档束的合成测试平台上，运行内监控暴露确定性阶段缺陷（CV=0.02），跨运行监控暴露随机集成后果（CV=1.25，24%为L2），结构监控以完美一致性（CV=0.00）识别集成缺口。注入的任务级错误与清洁基线无法区分。确定性分类将97%的结果路由至自动跟踪，仅2%的可变行为留给人审。
Conclusion: 基于第一阶段证据，提出成熟度阶段模型：随集成缺陷解决，监控从结构表征过渡到错误检测再到可靠性跟踪。该分类、基于CV的监控范围表征和严重性模型在架构上可迁移至文档驱动的多阶段代理工作流，但具体校准需领域特定。强调应尽早部署监控，其第一个发现通常是最需要修复的问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MORPHOS: Autoregressive 4D Generation with Temporal Structured Latents
papers.abstract_en: We present MORPHOS, a novel autoregressive framework that generates dynamic 3D assets from videos across diverse representations, including meshes, 3D Gaussians, and radiance fields. Existing methods are typically limited to a single representation, struggle to model topological changes, or fail to maintain temporal consistency over long videos. To address these limitations, we introduce the Temporal Structured Latents (T-SLAT), a unified 4D representation that jointly encodes geometry and appearance along the temporal dimension. Leveraging T-SLAT, MORPHOS autoregressively generates dynamic 3D assets via causal attention, conditioning each frame on its preceding history to ensure temporal consistency while handling evolving topologies. We also propose a temporal-structural augmentation to mitigate error accumulation in autoregressive generation. MORPHOS achieves state-of-the-art performance in appearance and competitive results in geometry across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating superior generalization across various representations and robustness in long-horizon generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MORPHOS是一个自回归框架，能从视频生成动态3D资产，支持网格、3D高斯和辐射场等多种表示。它通过引入时间结构潜变量（T-SLAT）联合编码几何与外观，并利用因果注意力确保时序一致性。摘要声称在多个基准上达到了外观的SOTA和几何的竞争性结果。
Motivation: 现有方法通常限于单一表示、难以建模拓扑变化或无法在长视频中保持时序一致性，MORPHOS旨在解决这些问题。
Method: 提出时间结构潜变量（T-SLAT）统一4D表示，通过因果注意力自回归生成动态3D资产，并引入时序结构增强以减少自回归生成的误差累积。
Result: 在多个基准上，MORPHOS在外观上达到SOTA，在几何上取得竞争性结果，并展示了跨多种表示的泛化能力和长时序生成的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: MORPHOS为动态3D生成提供了一种统一的表示和自回归框架，克服了单一表示和时序一致性的限制。

papers.title: Expressivity of congruence-based architectures for DNNs on positive-definite matrices
papers.abstract_en: This work studies neural architectures for classifying symmetric positive-definite matrices, focusing on congruence-like layers, in which the input matrix is multiplied on the left and right by a (possibly rectangular) weight matrix $W$ and its transpose. Such layers lie at the core of the celebrated SPDNet and have also been employed independently for dimensionality reduction on positive-definite data. We show that the (semi)-orthogonality constraint commonly imposed on $W$ limits the expressivity of these layers: for certain activation functions, the resulting architecture collapses to a one-hidden-layer equivalent. This lack of expressivity follows from a loss of spectral diversity in congruence-like layers for semi-orthogonal $W$ and is a direct consequence of Poincaré's separation theorem. We then examine the choice of the final classifier, comparing several Riemannian classifiers and discussing their compatibility with the feature maps produced by congruence-like layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用于对称正定矩阵分类的神经网络架构，重点关注同余层（congruence-like layers）——即输入矩阵左右乘以权重矩阵W及其转置。作者证明，对W施加的半正交约束会限制这些层的表达能力：对于某些激活函数，整个架构退化为单隐藏层等价。这种表达能力的丧失源于半正交W导致同余层丢失谱多样性，是Poincaré分离定理的直接结果。文章还比较了多种黎曼分类器，讨论其与同余层特征图的兼容性。
Motivation: 现有工作在正定矩阵分类中广泛使用半正交约束的同余层，但该约束对网络表达能力的理论影响尚不明确。
Method: 通过理论分析，利用Poincaré分离定理证明半正交约束会导致同余层的输出谱多样性丧失，从而使深层网络退化为单隐藏层等价。
Result: 证明对于某些激活函数，半正交约束下的同余层架构在表达能力上等价于单隐藏层网络。
Conclusion: 指出半正交约束是同余层架构表达能力受限的根本原因，并对最终分类器的选择（黎曼分类器）与特征图的兼容性进行了讨论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RASER: Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop question-answering systems often use expensive retrieval on every question. They may decompose the question, run several retrieval rounds, or search through bridge entities before answering. All of these strategies rely on repeated LLM calls to rewrite or decompose the question, which increases extra token cost, and it is not fitting when the LLM budget is tight. However, our analysis shows that lots of multi-hop questions are already answered correctly by a single one-shot RAG, so running an extra retrieval on every question wastes the budget. We introduce RASER (Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router), a family of cheap routers built on one-shot RAG and six features from it. RASER-2 decides whether to stop or escalate to the extra-retrieval action PRUNE. RASER-3 chooses among one-shot RAG, PRUNE, and iterative retrieval IRCoT, using the same features but adding an explicit cost-accuracy trade-off. Neither router makes an extra LLM call to decide. Across six LLMs and three multi-hop QA benchmarks, both routers stay competitive with the other state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines in F1 while spending only 41-49% of always-prune's tokens and also less than the iterative and decomposition retrieval baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多跳问答中不必要的昂贵检索问题，提出基于一次性RAG和六个特征的廉价路由器RASER，决定是否升级为额外检索（PRUNE或IRCoT）。实验表明，RASER系列在六个LLM和三个基准上F1与SOTA持平，但令牌消耗仅为always-prune的41-49%，且低于迭代检索和分解检索基线。
Motivation: 现有多跳问答系统对每个问题都执行昂贵检索，导致令牌浪费。作者发现很多问题仅通过一次性RAG即可正确回答，因此需要一种低成本路由策略来避免不必要的额外检索。
Method: 提出RASER（Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router），包含两种变体：RASER-2决定是否升级至PRUNE；RASER-3在一次性RAG、PRUNE和迭代检索IRCoT中选择。路由器基于一次性RAG的六个特征做出决策，无需额外LLM调用。
Result: 在六个LLM和三个多跳QA基准上，RASER-2和RASER-3在F1上与SOTA基线竞争，同时令牌消耗仅为always-prune的41-49%，并低于其他迭代/分解检索基线。
Conclusion: RASER通过显式的成本-准确性权衡，在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理代价，适用于LLM预算紧张的场景。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对多跳问答中不必要的昂贵检索问题，提出基于一次性RAG和六个特征的廉价路由器RASER，决定是否升级为额外检索（PRUNE或IRCoT）。实验表明，RASER系列在六个LLM和三个基准上F1与SOTA持平，但令牌消耗仅为always-prune的41-49%，且低于迭代检索和分解检索基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有多跳问答系统对每个问题都执行昂贵检索，导致令牌浪费。作者发现很多问题仅通过一次性RAG即可正确回答，因此需要一种低成本路由策略来避免不必要的额外检索。
summary_sections.method: 提出RASER（Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router），包含两种变体：RASER-2决定是否升级至PRUNE；RASER-3在一次性RAG、PRUNE和迭代检索IRCoT中选择。路由器基于一次性RAG的六个特征做出决策，无需额外LLM调用。
summary_sections.result: 在六个LLM和三个多跳QA基准上，RASER-2和RASER-3在F1上与SOTA基线竞争，同时令牌消耗仅为always-prune的41-49%，并低于其他迭代/分解检索基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: RASER通过显式的成本-准确性权衡，在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理代价，适用于LLM预算紧张的场景。

papers.title: Iteris: Agentic Research Loops for Computational Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models and agentic AI systems have enabled significant progress in mathematical discovery, from solving competition problems to tackling research-level conjectures. However, open problems in computational mathematics have received comparatively less attention: research in this area often requires not only proofs but also numerical experimentation, adversarial constructions, and algorithm design. In this paper, we introduce an agentic research system, Iteris, designed for open problems in computational mathematics. We apply Iteris to two open problems from a recent Simons Workshop collection (arXiv:2602.05394). In these case studies, Iteris generated numerical evidence, constructions, and proof drafts that led, after expert review and correction, to verified results. The first result is a phase diagram for the asymptotic comparison between conjugate gradient and randomized coordinate descent on power-law spectra; the second is a counterexample showing that QR factorization with column pivoting can fail to select well-conditioned submatrices even under low coherence. These case studies suggest that agentic AI systems can participate meaningfully in research workflows for open problems in computational mathematics, while human validation remains essential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Iteris 是一个面向计算数学开放问题的智能体研究系统。通过在两个来自 Simons Workshop 的开放问题上的案例研究，Iteris 生成了数值证据、构造和证明草稿，经专家审核后得到了验证的结果：一是共轭梯度法与随机坐标下降法在幂律谱上的渐近比较相图；二是展示了列主元 QR 分解在低相干性下也可能无法选取良态子矩阵的反例。研究表明，智能体 AI 系统可以有意义地参与计算数学开放问题研究，但人类验证仍不可或缺。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型和智能体 AI 在数学发现上取得了进展，但计算数学中的开放问题研究往往需要数值实验、对抗构造和算法设计，受到的关注较少。
Method: 提出 Iteris 智能体研究系统，通过多轮代理循环（agentic loops）自动生成数值证据、构造和证明草稿，再由领域专家校正和验证。
Result: 成功解决了两个计算数学开放问题：1) 共轭梯度与随机坐标下降在幂律谱上的渐近相图；2) 列主元 QR 分解在低相干性下可能选取病态子矩阵的反例。
Conclusion: 智能体 AI 系统能够辅助计算数学开放问题的研究流程，但人类验证仍然是必要的。

papers.title: Ghost Tool Calls: Issue-Time Privacy for Speculative Agent Tools
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented language agents speculatively issue likely future tool calls to hide latency, but those calls leak inferred user intent to external services before the agent commits to the branch. Every external observer that received the call retains the disclosure after the agent abandons the branch. Timing is the issue, not authorization: no commit-time cleanup, read-only restriction, or access-control allow-list unsends what an observer already holds. We call these invocations ghost tool calls and propose Speculative Tool Privacy Contracts, a runtime abstraction that treats observation before commitment as a first-class effect, distinct from state mutation. We implement the contracts in a prototype runtime and evaluate twelve policies across three corpora. Speculative dispatch increases what an observer can infer about user intent; post-hoc filters, read-only restrictions, and access-control allow-lists leave that inference intact; only issue-time policies that change or suppress the speculative call's argument or destination projection before dispatch reduce it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了工具增强语言代理中投机性工具调用（ghost tool calls）导致的隐私泄露问题，并提出Speculative Tool Privacy Contracts这一运行时抽象，将提交前的观察视为一等效应。原型实验评估了12种策略，发现只有发出时策略（如改变或抑制调用参数或目标）能有效减少推断，而事后过滤、只读限制或访问控制均无效。
Motivation: 投机性调度提前发出未来可能使用的工具调用以隐藏延迟，但这些调用会泄露用户意图给外部服务，且事后无法撤回，构成隐私问题。
Method: 提出Speculative Tool Privacy Contracts，一种运行时抽象，将观察视为与状态变更分离的一等效应，并在原型中实现，评估了12种不同策略。
Result: 实验表明：投机性调度增加外部观察者推断用户意图的能力；事后过滤器、只读限制、访问控制允许列表均无法减少推断；只有发出时改变或抑制调用的参数或目标的策略才能减少。
Conclusion: 时间性是关键问题，需要发出时的隐私保护机制而非提交后的补救措施。

papers.title: Places in the Wild: A Large, High-Resolution RAW Photograph Dataset for Ecologically Valid Vision Research
papers.abstract_en: Large image datasets have accelerated progress in cognitive neuroscience and computer vision. However, most datasets are low-resolution, internet-sourced JPEGs with unknown capture conditions and limited spatial context. Places in the Wild is a dataset of 67,574 high-resolution photographs collected in situ across 810 physical locations spanning 260 basic-level scene categories, including indoor, urban, and natural environments. At each location, a 45-megapixel Canon EOS R5 mounted on a panoramic tripod captured 72 images at 5-degree horizontal intervals plus 12 images at varying elevations, yielding dense 360-degree viewpoint sampling. All images were recorded simultaneously as 14-bit RAW (CR3) files and compressed JPEGs, preserving sensor-level detail for analyses of luminance, contrast, color, and other image statistics. The dataset is accompanied by complete EXIF metadata and a suite of image-quality metrics. Places in the Wild supports research on viewpoint-dependent recognition in humans and models, training and evaluation of scene-understanding systems under realistic conditions, characterization of natural scene statistics, and experiments requiring near-full-field visual displays.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为 Places in the Wild 的高分辨率 RAW 照片数据集，包含67574张在810个真实地点拍摄的图像，覆盖260个场景类别，提供14-bit RAW和JPEG格式，支持视觉认知、场景统计和模型评估研究。
Motivation: 现有图像数据集多为低分辨率、互联网来源的JPEG，缺乏真实捕获条件和空间上下文，限制了生态效度。
Method: 在810个物理地点使用45百万像素相机以5度水平间隔和不同仰角拍摄，共67574张图像，同时记录RAW和JPEG格式，并附带完整EXIF元数据和质量指标。
Result: 数据集提供了高分辨率、360度视角采样的场景图像，保留了传感器级细节，可用于分析亮度、对比度、颜色等图像统计量。
Conclusion: 该数据集支持视角依赖的识别研究、真实条件下场景理解系统的训练与评估，以及自然场景统计特征分析。

papers.title: Retrieve What's Missing: Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval for Consistent Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining long-term geometric consistency remains challenging for long-horizon autoregressive video generation. Memory-augmented generative models address this by retrieving historical frames, but their effectiveness depends on two key design choices: what 3D-geometric evidence should represent past observations, and how memory frames should be selected from this evidence. Existing methods often rely on camera poses or field-of-view overlap, which are lightweight but too coarse to reason about pixel-wise visibility, or use explicit 3D reconstruction, which provides fine-grained evidence but is costly to maintain over long rollouts. We propose Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (COVRAG), a depth-based memory retrieval framework that uses pretrained 3D priors to construct a target-view coverage map as lightweight 3D memory evidence. For frame selection, COVRAG maximizes residual coverage gain, iteratively retrieving frames that explain target-view regions not covered by the current context or previously selected memories. To improve scalability in long-video generation, we introduce sliding-window depth caching for efficient geometry estimation. Experiments on RealEstate10K and DL3DV10K show that COVRAG improves long-horizon geometric consistency while maintaining low latency compared to baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COVRAG，一种基于深度图的检索增强生成框架，用于长视频生成中保持几何一致性。该方法使用预训练3D先验构建目标视角覆盖图作为轻量级记忆证据，并通过最大化残差覆盖增益来迭代选取记忆帧。在 RealEstate10K 和 DL3DV10K 数据集上，COVRAG 在保持低延迟的同时改善了长程几何一致性。
Motivation: 现有长视频生成方法在维持长时间几何一致性方面存在挑战，内存增强模型依赖于粗糙的相机姿态或昂贵的3D重建，难以在像素级别有效选择记忆帧。
Method: 提出 Coverage-Maximizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (COVRAG)，使用预训练3D先验构建目标视角覆盖图作为轻量级证据，通过最大化残差覆盖增益迭代选取记忆帧，并引入滑动窗口深度缓存以提高长视频生成的效率。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K 和 DL3DV10K 上，COVRAG 改善了长程几何一致性，同时与基线相比保持了低延迟。
Conclusion: 基于深度的覆盖最大化检索可有效提升长视频生成的几何一致性，同时保持计算效率。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Residuals for Adaptive Mesh Refinement in Finite-Difference PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Classical finite-difference solvers remain reliable tools for partial differential equations, but their efficiency depends on where mesh resolution is placed. Uniform refinement can waste degrees of freedom when solution difficulty is localised near sharp gradients, fronts, oscillations, or constraint-sensitive regions. This paper studies a hybrid strategy in which a physics-informed neural network (PINN) is used not as the final solver, but as an off-grid residual probe for adaptive mesh refinement. The PINN residual is sampled over the domain, converted into cellwise indicators, and used to guide refinement before the final approximation is computed by a finite-difference solver. The method is evaluated on three benchmarks. The main full-solver validation uses the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation with a nonuniform finite-difference solve on the adapted meshes. PINN-threshold refinement attains final relative $L^2$ error $0.021067$ with $60$ degrees of freedom, compared with $0.022617$ for uniform refinement with $192$ degrees of freedom. At matched mesh size, PINN-threshold reduces the error by about $67.5\%$. PINN-D"orfler refinement gives similar performance, with error $0.021264$ using $58$ degrees of freedom. A gradient indicator remains slightly more accurate, so the result supports usefulness rather than universal superiority. Manufactured 2D and 3D proxy tests, based on a nonlinear Schr"odinger equation and an incompressible Navier--Stokes system, show that PINN residuals can organise structured refinement and improve over random refinement, although they do not consistently outperform gradient or uniform baselines. The results support PINN-guided AMR as a residual-indicator strategy for transferring physics-informed diagnostic information into finite-difference mesh adaptation while preserving the classical solver as the final approximation engine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将物理信息神经网络（PINN）作为离网格残差探测器，为有限差分求解器生成自适应网格细化（AMR）指示器。PINN残差被采样并转换为单元指标，引导网格细化，最终由有限差分求解器计算近似解。在一维粘性Burgers方程上，PINN阈值细化在60个自由度下达到相对L2误差0.021067，而均匀细化在192个自由度下为0.022617；在匹配网格大小时误差降低约67.5%。二维和三维代理测试（非线性薛定谔方程、不可压Navier-Stokes系统）显示PINN残差能组织结构化细化并优于随机细化，但未一致超越梯度或均匀基线。
Motivation: 均匀网格细化在解具有局部陡梯度、锋面或约束敏感区域时浪费自由度，需要高效的适应性网格策略。
Method: 使用PINN作为离网格残差探测器，采样PINN残差并转换为单元细化指示器，替代传统基于梯度或残差的AMR指示器，最终由有限差分求解器完成计算。
Result: 一维Burgers方程：PINN阈值细化在60自由度下误差0.021067，均匀细化192自由度下误差0.022617；匹配网格大小时误差降低67.5%。PINN-Dörfler细化在58自由度下误差0.021264。二维和三维代理测试中，PINN残差优于随机细化，但未超过梯度指示器。
Conclusion: PINN指导的AMR可作为传递物理信息诊断信息的残差指示器策略，将PINN用于网格细化而非最终求解，保持经典求解器的精度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MCP-Persona: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Real-World Personal Applications via Environment Simulation
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as a transformative standard for connecting large language models (LLMs) with external data sources and tools, and has been rapidly adopted across personal applications and development platforms. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on generic information-seeking tools and fail to capture the practical challenges posed by personal social applications, where tools interact with individual accounts or local databases. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce MCP-Persona, the first benchmark specifically designed for evaluating agent performance on real-world, personalized MCP tools. MCP-Persona encompasses a diverse set of widely-used applications, ranging from social media platforms like Reddit and Xiaohongshu (Rednote) to enterprise collaboration suites such as Lark (Feishu) and Slack. Our extensive experiments on various state-of-the-art (SOTA) agents demonstrate their significant struggles with personalized tool use, thereby highlighting the benchmark's crucial role in identifying and addressing these limitations. MCP-Persona is publicly available at https://github.com/wwh0411/MCP-Persona}{https://github.com/wwh0411/MCP-Persona.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 构建了包含多种实际应用的基准测试集，涵盖社交平台和企业协作套件，并对多种SOTA代理进行实验评估。
Result: 实验显示SOTA代理在个性化工具使用上存在显著困难，表现不佳。
Conclusion: 强调该基准测试在识别和解决LLM代理在个性化工具使用中的限制方面具有关键作用，并公开了代码和数据集。

papers.title: Learning When to Translate for Multilingual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models (RLMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, but still exhibit substantial multilingual reasoning gaps, largely due to language-understanding failures in non-English inputs. English translation can mitigate these failures by expressing non-English inputs in a form that RLMs can more reliably interpret, yet translating every input is unnecessary when the model can reason reliably from the original query. To address this challenge, we propose Luar, a Language Understanding Boundary-aware Reinforcement Learning framework that trains RLMs to selectively invoke translation when direct understanding is unreliable. Luar trains the model to choose between solving the original input directly and reasoning over its English translation, encouraging translation only when translator-augmented reasoning is expected to substantially outperform direct reasoning. Across multilingual reasoning benchmarks, Luar outperforms standard GRPO and other training-based baselines, with particularly large gains on low-resource languages. Further analysis shows that Luar avoids unnecessary translation in cases where direct reasoning is sufficient, while extending its translator-call behavior to unseen low-resource languages. Together, our work suggests a selective approach to multilingual reasoning: RLMs can learn to invoke translation only when their direct understanding is unreliable. The project will be made publicly available at https://github.com/deokhk/LUAR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Luar框架，通过强化学习训练推理语言模型选择性调用英语翻译，仅在直接理解不可靠时进行翻译，以改善多语言推理性能。实验表明Luar在多项基准上优于标准GRPO，尤其对低资源语言提升显著。
Motivation: 推理语言模型在多语言推理中因非英语输入的语言理解失败而表现不佳，但全量翻译不必要且低效，需要模型自主判断何时应调用翻译。
Method: 提出Language Understanding Boundary-aware Reinforcement Learning (Luar)框架，训练模型在直接推理与翻译后推理之间做选择，奖励函数鼓励仅在翻译能显著提升推理效果时调用翻译。
Result: 实验显示Luar在多语言推理基准上超越标准GRPO等基线，低资源语言增益最大，且能避免不必要的翻译，并将翻译调用行为泛化到未见过的低资源语言。
Conclusion: 研究表明推理语言模型可以学习选择性调用翻译，仅当自身直接理解不可靠时使用翻译，这是一种高效的多语言推理策略。

papers.title: MASER: Modality-Adaptive Specialist Routing for Embodied 3D Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: In 3D environments, Embodied Agents answer spatially relevant questions through reasoning from a mixture of modalities including natural language, RGB images, point clouds, depth maps and camera poses. Existing Vision-Language models (VLMs) are fine-tuned over a single modality. This completely ignores the question semantics which may favor a different modality than the finetuned modality. To address this, we propose MASER (Modality-Adaptive SpEcialist Routing), a lightweight framework that trains five different modality adapters of a shared VLM backbone and learns a neural routing policy that selects the best adapter based on the question during inference. We encode each question with a frozen sentence transformer and pass the embedding through a small Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) trained on oracle adapter-accuracy labels. We evaluate our methodology over the Open3D-VQA benchmark and our evaluations show that no single modality is universally optimal -- point-cloud answers are best in 51.5% of cases. MASER routes with 51.3% oracle agreement, outperforming a Random-Forest ablation (43.5%), with only a single adapter call per question.
papers.comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Foundation Models Meet Embodied Agents Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D空间智能中具身代理回答空间问题时模态选择的问题，提出MASER框架。该框架训练五个共享VLM骨干的模态适配器，并通过一个基于问题嵌入的轻量级MLP路由策略在推理时选择最优适配器。在Open3D-VQA基准上，点云模态在51.5%的情况下最佳，MASER达到51.3%的oracle一致率，优于随机森林方法。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型通常仅针对单一模态进行微调，忽略了问题语义可能偏好不同模态的事实，导致在3D空间问答中对模态信息的利用不足。
Method: MASER使用一个共享的VLM骨干，训练五个分别对应不同模态（自然语言、RGB图像、点云、深度图、相机位姿）的适配器；同时训练一个小型MLP，以冻结的句子编码器生成的问题嵌入为输入，输出每个适配器的选择概率，实现神经路由。
Result: 在Open3D-VQA基准上，点云模态在51.5%的问题上表现最佳；MASER的路由选择与oracle一致率为51.3%，超过随机森林方法的43.5%，且每次推理仅调用一个适配器。
Conclusion: 没有单一模态在所有问题上普遍最优，MASER提供了一种轻量级、有效的自适应路由方案，能够根据问题动态选择最合适的模态适配器。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Active Exploring like a Pigeon: Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning via Agentic Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Enabling Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to perform spatial reasoning remains challenging. Existing approaches treat VLMs as passive observers, which is difficult for real-world applications. Moreover, reinforcement learning methods rely on sparse rewards, limiting their effectiveness for complex reasoning tasks. Inspired by pigeons' building and exploiting cognitive maps for navigation, we propose a novel agentic pipeline for spatial reasoning. First, we introduce a new \emph{dynamic cognitive map} parameterizing scene layout as object positions and orientations, serving as persistent memory for new observations. Second, we propose a novel \emph{Spatial Assertion Codes (SAC)}, Python expressions programmatically describing spatial relationships. By collaborating with the dynamic cognitive map, SAC enables verification of intermediate reasoning steps, providing dense reward signals. We optimize the model via supervised and reinforcement finetuning. Experiments on the MindCube benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art performance with \emph{80.5\%} overall accuracy, outperforming the best current method by \emph{29.5} accuracy points (a relative improvement of \emph{53.2\%}) on the challenging \textsc{Rotation} subset. Our code and data are open-sourced at https://github.com/dw-dengwei/active-spatial-reasoning.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受鸽子导航时构建并利用认知地图的启发，提出一个基于主动探索的视觉语言模型（VLM）空间推理管线。通过动态认知地图参数化场景布局，并引入空间断言代码（Spatial Assertion Codes, SAC）提供稠密奖励信号，结合监督与强化微调，在MindCube基准上取得80.5%的整体准确率，在Rotation子集上相对提升53.2%。
Motivation: 现有VLM作为被动观察者难以完成真实世界的空间推理任务，且强化学习方法依赖稀疏奖励，限制了复杂推理的有效性。
Method: 提出动态认知地图作为持久记忆以编码物体位置和朝向，并设计Spatial Assertion Codes（SAC）作为描述空间关系的Python表达式，与地图协作产生稠密奖励；模型通过监督学习和强化学习联合优化。
Result: 在MindCube基准上整体准确率80.5%，在最具挑战的Rotation子集上比当前最优方法高29.5个百分点（相对提升53.2%）。
Conclusion: 动态认知地图与SAC的结合有效提升了VLM的空间推理能力，代码和数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond One-shot: AI Agents for Learning in Field Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Organizations routinely run experiments for A/B testing, yet the data generated from one experiment is underutilized to inform subsequent intervention design. Significant barriers exist to extracting actionable knowledge from prior experimental data to inform new interventions. We study whether tool-augmented agentic AI can automatically learn from experimental data to generate new interventions in subsequent experiments. Through two-stage field experiments in healthcare prescription messaging (693,139 patient visits), we compare a Human + Chatbot method (Stage 1: behavioral experts with conversational AI co-designing 13 message variants, 444,691 patient visits) against a Tool-Augmented Agentic AI method (Stage 2: AI autonomously extracting principles from Stage 1 data to generate 17 new variants, 248,448 patient visits). The Agentic AI method, equipped with analytical tools, structured Data-Information-Knowledge-Wisdom (DIKW) reasoning agents, and transparent evidence chains, produces superior interventions: the best AI-generated message achieved a 69.8% CTR (+6.5 percentage points over baseline). Critically, our results suggest that the value comes from domain-specific experimental data, not from general reasoning ability: frontier LLMs operating without experimental data failed to predict which interventions would succeed. The field experiments also revealed that general-purpose behavioral theories used for intervention design do not extend uniformly to specific healthcare contexts, motivating an agentic AI approach to theory audits at field-experiment scale. Our research shows that tool-augmented AI can learn from experimental data and generate improved domain-relevant interventions, transforming behavioral experimentation from one-shot evaluation into a scalable system for cumulative design learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究工具增强的智能体AI能否从实地实验数据中自动学习以生成新的干预措施。通过医疗处方消息的两阶段实地实验（共693,139次患者就诊），比较人类+聊天机器人与工具增强智能体AI的方法。结果显示，智能体AI生成的最佳消息实现了69.8%的点击率（比基线高6.5个百分点），且价值来自领域特定的实验数据而非通用推理能力。
Motivation: 组织常规进行A/B测试，但一次实验产生的数据未被充分利用来指导后续干预设计，从先前实验数据中提取可操作知识存在显著障碍。
Method: 采用两阶段实地实验：第一阶段由行为专家与对话AI共同设计13种消息变体；第二阶段由配备分析工具、结构化DIKW推理代理和透明证据链的智能体AI从第一阶段数据中自主提取原则，生成17种新变体。
Result: 智能体AI生成的最佳消息点击率达69.8%，比基线高6.5个百分点；没有实验数据的通用LLM无法预测哪些干预会成功；通用行为理论在特定医疗情境中并非均匀适用。
Conclusion: 工具增强的AI能够从实验数据中学习并生成改进的领域相关干预，将行为实验从一次性评估转变为可扩展的累积设计学习系统。

papers.title: Speculative Sampling For Faster Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics (MD) is a key tool for simulating the dynamical behavior of atomic systems. However, MD is inherently serial, which makes it difficult to increase single-system throughput with concurrent compute. To address this, we introduce Langevin Speculative Dynamics (LSD), a distributed and model-agnostic speculative sampler for accelerating MD without adding relative error. Inspired by speculative methods in language and diffusion modeling, LSD uses a draft model to propose fast simulation steps and verifies them in parallel with a slower target model, applying a transport map from the draft to the target distribution. We extend speculative sampling to second-order Langevin dynamics, derive the achievable speedup as a function of physical parameters, show that LSD generalizes across different systems and draft-target combinations with a 3-9x speedup, and confirm theoretically and empirically that LSD samples trajectories from its target model distribution.
papers.comment: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 32 pages, 14 figures, 8 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Langevin Speculative Dynamics (LSD)，一种用于加速分子动力学模拟的分布式、模型无关的推测性采样方法，灵感来自语言和扩散模型中的推测性采样。LSD使用草稿模型快速提出模拟步骤，并用较慢的目标模型并行验证，通过传输映射从草稿分布到目标分布。实验表明在多种系统和草稿-目标组合下获得3-9倍加速，且理论上和实验上验证了从目标模型分布中采样轨迹。
Motivation: 分子动力学模拟本质上是串行的，难以利用并行计算提高单系统吞吐量。
Method: 将推测性采样扩展到二阶Langevin动力学，使用草稿模型提出快速模拟步骤，并用目标模型并行验证，通过传输映射从草稿分布校正到目标分布。
Result: 在多种系统和草稿-目标组合下实现3-9倍加速，不引入额外相对误差，理论推导了加速比与物理参数的关系。
Conclusion: LSD能够从目标模型分布中采样轨迹，且加速效果随系统规模增大而提升。

papers.title: Initialization is Half the Battle: Generating Diverse Images from a Guidance Potential Posterior
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable fidelity of generative models, they frequently suffer from mode collapse. Existing strategies for enhancing diversity predominantly focus on intervening during the generation trajectory. We identify a critical oversight that the standard Gaussian initialization often causes trajectories to collapse into dominant modes because it is agnostic to the guidance potential landscape. In this work, we formulate selecting the initial noise from a guidance potential posterior, which effectively re-weights the prior towards diversity-rich regions. To sample from this distribution efficiently, we introduce Diversity-inducing Initialization (DivIn), which leverages Langevin dynamics to actively navigate the initialization landscape, steering initial noise away from collapsing regions while anchoring them to the valid data manifold. Our method serves as an inference-time diversity enhancement compatible with both diffusion and flow matching models. Extensive experiments show that DivIn exhibits a superior performance in both class-to-image and text-to-image scenarios. Furthermore, we highlight that as DivIn is orthogonal to trajectory-based methods, combining them significantly expands the diversity-quality Pareto frontier beyond what either achieves in isolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成模型（扩散模型和流匹配模型）的模式崩溃问题，提出从引导势后验中选取初始噪声的DivIn方法，使用Langevin动力学引导初始化，提高生成多样性；实验证明在类到图像和文本到图像任务上优于现有方法，且与轨迹级方法正交，可以联合扩大多样性-质量帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 标准高斯初始化忽略了引导势景观，导致生成轨迹落入主导模式，造成模式崩溃；现有多样性提升方法主要干预生成轨迹，忽视了初始化的重要性。
Method: 提出DivIn方法，从引导势后验中采样初始噪声，利用Langevin动力学主动导航初始化景观，使初始噪声远离崩溃区域并锚定在有效数据流形上；可作为推理时的多样性增强模块，兼容扩散模型和流匹配模型。
Result: 在类到图像和文本到图像生成任务上，DivIn在多样性-质量帕累托前沿上显著优于现有方法；与轨迹级方法结合可获得更大的前沿扩展。
Conclusion: 初始化是生成多样性的关键，DivIn通过后验初始化有效提升多样性，且与现有方法互补。

papers.title: Reason-Then-Retrieve for CoVR-R with Structured Edit Prompts and Dense-Sparse Fusion
papers.abstract_en: CoVR-R studies reason-aware composed video retrieval: given a reference video and an edit instruction, the system must retrieve the target video that satisfies the edit. The main difficulty is that the target is not described directly; it must be inferred from fine-grained changes in object identity, action order, final state, hand interaction, and scene transition. We build a zero-shot reason-then-retrieve pipeline around Qwen3.5-27B. For each gallery video, the model generates a retrieval-oriented structured description and a dense embedding by pooling generated-token hidden states with token-dependent weights. For each query, the model first performs edit reasoning over the reference video and instruction, then generates a target-video description whose hidden states serve as the query embedding. We complement dense retrieval with a TF-IDF branch over the generated texts and fuse the two rankings with split-specific weights. On validation, the current best submission reaches 80.81 at R@1, 94.86 at R@5, 97.11 at R@10, and 98.59 at R@50. On the blind test split, it reaches 89.73 at R@1, 95.79 at R@5, 96.63 at R@10, and 97.98 at R@50.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本的“先推理后检索”流水线用于推理感知的组合视频检索（CoVR-R），利用 Qwen3.5-27B 生成结构化描述和密集-稀疏融合的双路检索，在验证集和测试集上取得了高召回率。
Motivation: 组合视频检索的难点在于目标视频未被直接描述，需要从对象身份、动作顺序、最终状态等细粒度变化中推理出编辑结果。
Method: 构建零样本的 reason-then-retrieve 流水线，对每个视频库视频生成检索导向的结构化描述和基于 token 隐藏状态池化的密集嵌入，对查询则先进行编辑推理再生成目标视频描述作为查询嵌入，并结合 TF-IDF 稀疏检索进行排序融合。
Result: 验证集上 R@1 80.81, R@5 94.86, R@10 97.11, R@50 98.59；测试集上 R@1 89.73, R@5 95.79, R@10 96.63, R@50 97.98。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确提及局限性，但强调该零样本流水线的有效性。

papers.title: HLL: Can Agents Cross Humanity's Last Line of Verification?
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents are increasingly expected to operate interfaces on behalf of users, raising a central deployment question: can they truly substitute for humans in workflows that services deliberately protect against automation? CAPTCHA verification makes this question concrete. It is not merely a visual puzzle, but a human-verification boundary placed before account creation, content access, form submission, and other protected actions. We introduce \textbf{Humanity's Last Line of Verification (HLL)}, a controlled benchmark that uses interactive CAPTCHA verification to evaluate whether agents can cross this boundary through grounded, human-like interaction rather than recognition alone. HLL covers diverse CAPTCHA interactions and exposes agents to controlled realism stressors, including cluttered webpages, harder task variants, and trace-conditioned validation of the solving process. We evaluate eight frontier multimodal agents in a closed-loop GUI environment. The results show that current agents remain brittle at this human-substitution boundary: performance varies sharply across verification types, degrades under realistic interface conditions, and drops further when correct answers must be supported by valid action traces. By exposing gaps in localization, action calibration, state tracking, and process consistency, HLL provides a concrete testbed for measuring how close multimodal agents are to acting as human substitutes in protected real-world workflows. Our code is available at https://github.com/XinhaoS0101/HLL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HLL（Humanity's Last Line of Verification）基准，用于评估多模态智能体能否像人类一样通过交互式 CAPTCHA 验证，而不仅仅是视觉识别。HLL 涵盖多种 CAPTCHA 交互，并引入界面杂乱、变体难度和痕迹验证等现实压力。实验显示当前前沿智能体在 localization、action calibration、state tracking 等方面存在不足，性能在不同验证类型间差异大且易受真实界面影响。
Motivation: 多模态智能体被期望替代人类操作受保护的在线服务，但 CAPTCHA 作为故意防止自动化的验证边界，使得这一替代问题具体化。现有评估缺乏专门针对 CAPTCHA 交互的基准，无法衡量智能体能否通过类人交互而非仅识别来跨越这一界限。
Method: 构建 HLL 基准，包含多种 CAPTCHA 交互类型，并设计三种压力因素：杂乱网页界面、困难任务变体、基于痕迹的解决过程验证。在闭环 GUI 环境中评估八个前沿多模态智能体，测量它们在不同条件下的成功率。
Result: 当前智能体在人类替代边界上表现脆弱：性能因验证类型而异，在真实界面条件下显著下降，且当正确答案需由有效动作痕迹支持时进一步降低。暴露了 localization、action calibration、state tracking 和 process consistency 方面的缺陷。
Conclusion: HLL 为衡量多模态智能体在受保护真实工作流中替代人类的接近程度提供了具体测试平台，但未提出新方法以改善性能，仅作为评估基准。

papers.title: Food Noise & False Safety: A Systematic Evaluation of How LLMs Fail to Adapt to Eating Disorder Queries with Clinician Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Recent evidence shows that people with eating disorders (EDs) are increasingly seeking guidance, advice, and emotional support from Large Language Model (LLM)-based chat systems. Although these systems are not designed to provide clinical advice, their perceived expertise, neutrality and accessibility make them a frequent, albeit risky, source of support. This paper investigates potential patterns of interaction between users with EDs and LLMs, focusing on the potential harms arising from models that uncritically adapt to, and facilitate unsafe or self-harming user requests. We find, in consultation with clinical ED experts, that specific linguistic cues in prompts increase the likelihood of unsafe responses and, through systematically varying the degree of potential risk present in the user prompt, report the extent to which LLMs uncritically adapt to problematic, and potentially dangerous user inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大语言模型（LLM）在处理饮食失调（ED）用户查询时的安全风险，发现模型会不加批判地适应可能有害的输入。通过与临床ED专家合作，论文识别出提示中的特定语言线索会增加不安全响应，并报告了模型在多大程度上适应存在风险的用户请求。
Motivation: 饮食失调患者越来越多地从LLM寻求指导和支持，但这些系统并非为临床建议设计，可能提供有害响应。现有研究缺乏对LLM如何适应危险用户输入的系统性评估。
Method: 结合临床ED专家的意见，通过系统变化用户提示中的潜在风险程度，分析LLM响应中不安全内容的出现模式。
Result: 识别出提示中的特定语言线索会显著增加不安全响应的概率，并量化了LLM不加批判地适应问题输入的倾向。
Conclusion: LLM在处理饮食失调相关查询时存在安全漏洞，需要更好的防护机制，但论文未提出具体解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PaSBench-Video: A Streaming Video Benchmark for Proactive Safety Warning
papers.abstract_en: Between the first visible sign of danger and the moment an accident occurs, there is often a window where intervention remains possible. Video-capable multimodal large language models (MLLMs) could serve as always-on safety monitors that issue warnings during this window. Yet current benchmarks do not test this ability: they rely on static inputs, ignore timing precision, and omit false-positive measurement on safe scenes. We present PaSBench-Video, a 740-video benchmark with 481 risk and 259 no-risk videos across four domains: driving, healthcare, daily life, and industrial production. Risk videos are annotated with frame-level risk onset and accident boundaries. A model must observe the video causally and produce a warning that is both temporally calibrated and content-correct. Testing 13 MLLMs, we find that no model exceeds 20.0% on our strictest metric, and recall is tightly coupled with false-positive rate, with Pearson correlation 0.64: higher detection comes only at the cost of triggering warnings on the majority of safe clips. Performance splits sharply by domain: models achieve moderate recall at low false-positive rates in daily life, where risks are inherently anomalous, yet fire indiscriminately in driving, where routine and hazardous scenes look alike. These results indicate that current models rely on scene-level activity cues rather than reasoning about emerging harm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaSBench-Video是一个包含740个视频的流式视频基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在主动安全预警中的能力。视频涵盖驾驶、医疗、日常生活和工业四个领域，并标注了帧级风险起始和事故边界。测试13个模型发现，最严格指标下得分不超过20%，且召回率与假阳性率强相关（皮尔逊相关系数0.64），表明模型依赖于场景活动线索而非推理潜在危害。
Motivation: 现有基准无法测试视频多模态模型在危险干预窗口内发出及时准确警告的能力，缺乏时间精度和假阳性测量。
Method: 构建740个视频（481个风险，259个无风险），标注帧级风险起始和事故边界，要求模型因果观察视频并输出时间校准、内容准确的警告。
Result: 所有模型在严格指标下得分均低于20%；召回率与假阳性率强相关（皮尔逊相关系数0.64）；不同领域表现差异大，日常领域低假阳性率下召回率中等，驾驶领域则高假阳性。
Conclusion: 当前模型依赖场景活动线索而非危害推理，在安全预警任务上远未达到实用水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatial-Temporal Decoupled Reference Conditioning for Identity-Preserving Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Identity-preserving video generation (IPVG) aims to synthesize high-fidelity videos that follow text prompts while faithfully preserving a reference identity. Despite recent progress, existing IPVG methods still struggle to balance high-level semantic control and low-level identity fidelity. To bridge this gap, we propose ST-DRC, an effective Spatial-Temporal Decoupled Reference Conditioning framework for identity-preserving text-to-video generation. At the framework level, ST-DRC performs latent in-context feature injection by encoding the reference image with the video VAE and concatenating it with noisy video latents, enabling rich low-level identity details to be accessed without additional adapters. To separate identity-aware reference retrieval from appearance copying, we introduce TASS-RoPE, a Temporal-Adjacent Spatial-Shifted RoPE scheme that places reference tokens near the video sequence in time but shifts them in space, allowing reference information to flow through spatio-temporal attention while suppressing pixel-level copy-paste shortcuts. To further prevent shortcut learning and strengthen the otherwise diluted identity supervision in the diffusion objective, we combine appearance-invariant reference augmentation with face-guided identity objectives, encouraging the model to preserve identity under variations in color, pose, and layout. At inference time, we introduce a three-stream reference classifier-free guidance strategy that independently controls text adherence and reference fidelity. Experiments demonstrate that ST-DRC achieves strong identity preservation, prompt alignment, temporal consistency, and video quality with a lightweight design built on LTX-2.3. Our method ranks among the top submissions in the facial identity-preserving video generation track, validating the effectiveness of spatial-temporal decoupled reference conditioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ST-DRC框架，用于身份保持的文本到视频生成。该框架通过隐空间上下文特征注入、时间临近-空间偏移的RoPE机制、外观不变参考增强和人脸导向身份目标，以及三流参考无分类器引导策略，在保持身份的同时实现文本对齐和时间一致性。在LTX-2.3基础上构建的轻量级设计在面部身份保持视频生成任务中取得了领先效果。
Motivation: 现有身份保持视频生成方法难以同时平衡高层语义控制和低层身份保真度，存在身份信息丢失或过度复制问题。
Method: 提出ST-DRC框架：1) 隐空间上下文特征注入，将参考图像经VAE编码后与噪声潜变量拼接；2) TASS-RoPE机制，参考token在时间上靠近视频序列但在空间上偏移，抑制像素级复制；3) 外观不变参考增强与人脸导向身份目标；4) 三流参考无分类器引导策略。
Result: 实验表明ST-DRC在身份保持、提示对齐、时间一致性和视频质量上均取得优异表现，在面部身份保持视频生成任务中排名前列。
Conclusion: 时空解耦参考条件化是平衡身份保持与文本控制的有效方式，未来可探索扩展到更多通用场景。

summary_sections.conclusion: 时空解耦参考条件化是平衡身份保持与文本控制的有效方式，未来可探索扩展到更多通用场景。

papers.title: LLM-Evolved Pattern Generators for Optimal Classical Planning
papers.abstract_en: Learned heuristics have recently become a competitive alternative to traditional domain-independent heuristics for satisficing planning. Existing approaches, however, focus on improving search guidance rather than guaranteeing admissibility, which makes them unsuitable for optimal classical planning. We present the first method for learning domain-dependent heuristics that are admissible by design and thus preserve the optimality guarantees of A* search. Instead of learning a direct mapping from states to heuristic values, we learn to construct abstractions that induce admissible heuristics. We use an LLM-driven evolutionary program-synthesis framework to obtain, for each domain, a program that produces a pattern collection for any task in that domain, and we combine the resulting patterns admissibly via saturated cost partitioning. Empirically, the learned programs encode interpretable domain-specific insights, run with negligible overhead at test time and yield heuristics that match the coverage of state-of-the-art domain-independent baselines on several domains while evaluating each state substantially faster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个可证明可采纳的领域相关启发式学习方法，用于最优经典规划。方法利用LLM驱动的进化程序合成框架，为每个领域生成产生模式集合的程序，并通过饱和代价划分融合模式得到可采纳启发式。实验表明，学习到的程序编码了可解释的领域特定知识，在测试时开销可忽略，在多个领域上匹配最先进的领域无关基线方法的覆盖率，且状态评估速度更快。
Motivation: 现有学习启发式方法主要面向满意规划（satisficing planning），无法保证可采纳性（admissibility），因此不适用于最优规划。需要一种能自动学习可采纳启发式的方法，以兼顾最优性保证与领域适应性。
Method: 使用LLM驱动的进化程序合成框架，为每个规划领域生成一个程序，该程序能根据领域任务自动构造模式的集合（pattern collection），然后通过饱和代价划分（saturated cost partitioning）将各模式对应的可采纳启发式组合成全局启发式。启发式由抽象（abstraction）导出，因此天然可采纳。
Result: 学习到的程序编码了可解释的领域特定知识，测试时运行开销极低。在多个基准领域上，覆盖率达到最先进的领域无关可采纳启发式（如LM-Cut）的水平，且每个状态的启发式计算速度显著更快。
Conclusion: 方法是领域相关可采纳启发式学习的首次成功尝试，证明了通过程序合成生成模式集合是一条可行路径。局限性可能在于依赖LLM进化合成的稳定性及对未见领域的泛化能力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Implicit Memory for Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Video world models aim to simulate controllable visual environments, but long-horizon rollouts depend on what the model remembers after observations leave its native context window. Explicit memories retain frames or online 3D reconstructions, which can suffer from heuristic retrieval errors, redundant appearance storage, or reconstruction artifacts. Implicit memories compress history into a compact state, but existing designs are not explicitly constrained to encode cross-view scene geometry. We propose GIM-World, a geometry-aware implicit memory framework for video world models. A lightweight transformer encoder compresses variable-length history into fixed-size memory tokens, a camera-queryable geometry head distills 3D scene structure from a frozen foundation model into the memory during training, and an information-guided pruning rule keeps encoding cost bounded as history grows. The geometry teacher is discarded at inference, leaving a lightweight memory module. Experiments on MIND show that GIM-World better preserves long-horizon geometric and visual consistency than both explicit- and implicit-memory baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GIM-World，一种几何感知隐式记忆框架，用于视频世界模型。通过轻量Transformer编码器将可变长度历史压缩为固定大小记忆令牌，使用相机可查询的几何头在训练中从冻结基础模型提取3D场景结构，并结合信息引导剪枝规则控制编码成本。实验表明，GIM-World在MIND数据集上比显式和隐式记忆基线更好地保持了长程几何和视觉一致性。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型在长程推演中面临记忆问题：显式记忆（帧或在线3D重建）存在检索错误、冗余外观存储或重建伪影；隐式记忆虽压缩历史但缺乏对跨视角场景几何的显式约束。
Method: 提出几何感知隐式记忆框架，包括：轻量Transformer编码器压缩历史为固定大小记忆令牌；相机可查询几何头在训练中从冻结基础模型蒸馏3D场景结构；信息引导剪枝规则确保编码成本随历史增长而可控。推理时丢弃几何教师模块，仅保留轻量记忆模块。
Result: 在MIND数据集上，GIM-World在长程几何和视觉一致性方面优于显式和隐式记忆基线。
Conclusion: GIM-World通过几何感知的隐式记忆有效提升了视频世界模型的长程推演能力，且推理时保持轻量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Semiconductor Visual Program Synthesis via Input Binarization
papers.abstract_en: Precise parametric control over circuit geometry is essential for semiconductor inspection, yet obtaining sufficient real training data remains costly. Although generative models such as diffusion models and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) can augment training data, they cannot guarantee the nanometer-scale geometric accuracy required for metrology tasks. We propose a visual program synthesis framework in which a Vision-Language Model (VLM) converts inspection images into editable Domain-Specific Language (DSL) code describing circuit geometries, enabling controlled generation of training data with exact parameter manipulation. Because the VLM is trained solely on synthetic DSL-rendered data, a domain gap arises when processing real Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) images. We bridge this gap with an input binarization strategy that strips SEM-specific texture and noise, letting the model focus on geometric structure. On the MIIC dataset, binarized inputs improve the mean Dice coefficient from 0.4393 to 0.5256 over the raw-input baseline, demonstrating that simple texture abstraction substantially mitigates the sim-to-real gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对半导体检测中真实训练数据不足且生成模型无法保证纳米级几何精度的问题，提出一种视觉程序合成框架。该框架利用视觉-语言模型将检测图像转换为可编辑的领域特定语言代码，并通过输入二值化策略消除扫描电镜图像中的纹理和噪声，缩小合成数据与真实数据之间的域差距。在MIIC数据集上，二值化输入将平均Dice系数从0.4393提升至0.5256。
Motivation: 半导体检测需要精确的电路几何参数控制，但获取足够的真实训练数据成本高昂。现有生成模型（如扩散模型、GAN）无法满足计量任务所需的纳米级几何精度。
Method: 提出视觉程序合成框架：使用视觉-语言模型将检测图像转换为可编辑的领域特定语言代码，实现带精确参数操控的受控训练数据生成。为缩小合成域与真实域的差距，采用输入二值化策略，剥离扫描电镜图像特有的纹理和噪声，使模型专注于几何结构。
Result: 在MIIC数据集上，二值化输入相比原始输入基线将平均Dice系数从0.4393提升至0.5256。
Conclusion: 简单的纹理抽象（输入二值化）能有效缓解半导体视觉程序合成中的模拟到真实域差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ODTQA-FoRe: An Open-Domain Tabular Question Answering Dataset for Future Data Forecasting and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of LLMs has significantly advanced tabular question answering, but most systems cannot perform future-oriented numerical prediction. To address this gap, we introduce a novel task, Open-Domain Tabular Question Answering for Future Data Forecasting and Reasoning, and propose the first dataset to cover time-series forecasting and forecast-based reasoning scenarios using real estate data. This task poses challenges in retrieving precise historical data, overcoming the forecasting limitations of LLMs, and standardizing responses for diverse queries. To solve the above challenges, we propose TimeFore, an LLM agent-based framework that decomposes the problem into three collaborative roles: a Retriever autonomously generates SQL to fetch data, a Forecaster invokes external time-series models for higher accuracy, and an Analyzer synthesizes the results to construct a precise and consistent final answer. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our TimeFore.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by Findings of ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出开放域表格问答中的未来数据预测和推理任务（ODTQA-FoRe），并构建首个基于房地产数据的时间序列预测和推理数据集。提出LLM代理框架TimeFore，通过检索器、预测器和分析器协作完成查询回答。实验表明其有效性。
Motivation: 现有LLM表格问答系统无法进行未来导向的数值预测，缺乏相关数据集和推理能力。
Method: 提出TimeFore框架，将问题分解为三个协作角色：Retriever生成SQL获取历史数据，Forecaster调用外部时间序列模型进行预测，Analyzer整合结果生成一致答案。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值，仅称大量实验证明了TimeFore的有效性。
Conclusion: 该任务和框架填补了LLM在时序预测和推理方面的空白。

papers.title: Not All Errors Are Equal: A Systematic Study of Error Propagation in Large Language Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into high-performance computing (HPC) workflows, accelerating scientific discovery through diverse perspectives such as code generation and domain-specific decision-making. Yet, how soft errors propagate and affect LLM inference remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we present a comprehensive study on error propagation in LLM inference, enabled by our proposed LLMFI, a configurable and deterministic fault-injection framework. Using LLMFI, we systematically inject faults across three open-weighted LLMs and thirteen representative tasks, covering reasoning, multilingual, mathematical, and coding domains. In addition, we conduct fine-grained case studies that reveal critical vulnerability patterns. Overall, our study yields 17 takeaways that advance the understanding of error propagation in LLM inference and introduces four low-overhead directions to improve reliability through software-only modification, offering practical guidance for future error detection and mitigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型推理过程中软错误的传播行为，提出了可配置的确定性故障注入框架LLMFI，在三个开源模型和十三项代表性任务上注入故障，涵盖推理、多语言、数学和代码领域，总结出17条关键发现，并提出了四种低开销的软件级可靠性改进方向。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在高性能计算工作流中的部署日益增多，但软错误对其推理的影响尚未被系统研究，缺乏对错误传播模式的理解。
Method: 提出了LLMFI故障注入框架，能够进行可配置和确定性的错误注入，用于系统评估LLM推理中的错误传播。
Result: 通过系统性实验获得17条发现，揭示了关键脆弱性模式，并提出了四种低开销的纯软件可靠性改进方向。
Conclusion: 本研究推动了对LLM推理错误传播的理解，并为未来错误检测与缓解提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Spectral Audit of In-Context Operator Networks
papers.abstract_en: Existing evaluations of neural operators and in-context operator learning rely primarily on prediction error, but accurate output prediction does not guarantee the correct local dynamical structure. A model may match solutions while exhibiting incorrect sensitivities, distorted frequency response, spurious mode coupling, or unstable tangent behavior. We introduce a Jacobian-based spectral audit for in-context operator learning. For a fixed prompt, we differentiate the network output with respect to the query function and view the resulting Jacobian as a learned tangent operator. Projecting it onto Fourier modes, we obtain a local spectral characterization of the inferred operator, including frequency-dependent gains, phase structure, and cross-mode coupling. The audit complements standard prediction metrics by testing whether the model reproduces local mechanisms of the underlying PDE operator rather than only outputs. Across benchmarks, the audit reveals distinct operator-level phenomena, including phase transport, viscosity-dependent damping, nonlinear mode coupling, and reaction--diffusion stability structure. It also detects failures partially hidden by prediction-error metrics, including high-frequency degradation, incorrect phase recovery, and prompt--operator inconsistencies. Corrupted or internally inconsistent prompts lead to degraded tangent-operator structure even when pointwise predictions remain partially accurate. Our results suggest that prediction accuracy and local operator fidelity are distinct properties of learned neural operators. Our framework also provides a diagnostic for stability, sensitivity, and operator consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Jacobian的频谱审计方法，用于评估上下文算子学习（in-context operator learning）中学到的算子是否准确刻画了底层PDE的局部动态结构，而不仅仅是预测误差。审计通过将网络输出对查询函数求导得到Jacobian，并投影到Fourier模式上，获取频率相关的增益、相位和跨模式耦合等频谱特征。在多个基准上，审计揭示了相位传输、黏性阻尼、非线性模式耦合和反应-扩散稳定性结构等现象，并且能检测到预测误差指标部分隐藏的失败，如高频退化、错误相位恢复和提示-算子不一致。结果表明，预测精度和局部算子保真度是神经算子学习的不同属性。
Motivation: 现有神经算子和上下文算子学习的评估主要依赖预测误差，但准确的输出预测并不能保证正确的局部动态结构（如灵敏度、频率响应、模式耦合等），需要更深入的诊断工具。
Method: 提出Jacobian频谱审计：对于固定提示（prompt），对网络输出关于查询函数求导，得到Jacobian作为学习的切算子（tangent operator），然后将其投影到Fourier模式上，从而获得局部频谱表征，包括频率相关增益、相位结构和跨模式耦合。
Result: 审计在多个基准上发现了不同的算子级现象：相位传输、黏性依赖阻尼、非线性模式耦合和反应-扩散稳定性结构。同时，审计能检测到预测误差指标部分隐藏的失败（如高频退化、错误相位恢复、提示-算子不一致），并且当提示被破坏或内部不一致时，切算子结构也会退化。

papers.title: GC-MoE: Genomics-Guided Cell-Type-Specific Mixture of Experts for Histology-Based Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.abstract_en: Histology-based single-cell spatial transcriptomics (ST) estimation aims to predict gene expression for individual cells from histopathological images and cell locations, reducing the need for costly single-cell ST measurements. Unlike existing histology-to-ST methods that mainly predict spot-level profiles for local regions containing multiple cells, this task requires modeling cell-to-cell expression variability, which is strongly structured by cell type. We propose Genomics-Guided Cell-Type-Specific Mixture-of-Experts (GC-MoE), which estimates cell-type probabilities with a routing network and softly combines cell-type-specific experts for gene expression prediction. To further encode cell-type-dependent gene programs, we introduce the Cell-Type-Specific Co-Expression-Aware Predictor (CAP), together with a lightweight Cell-to-Cell Interaction Attention (C2CA) module for neighboring-cell context. Experiments and ablations on public single-cell ST datasets show consistent improvements over existing single-cell and adapted spot-level baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GC-MoE，一种基于组织学图像和细胞位置预测单细胞基因表达的方法。通过路由网络估计细胞类型概率并组合细胞类型特异性专家，结合共表达感知预测器和细胞间交互注意力模块，在公开数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法主要预测局部区域的整体基因表达，无法捕捉细胞间由细胞类型驱动的表达变异性，而单细胞级预测需要建模这种变异性。
Method: 提出GC-MoE框架，包含路由网络估计细胞类型概率、细胞类型特异性专家组合、共表达感知预测器（CAP）和轻量级细胞间交互注意力（C2CA）模块，以编码细胞类型依赖的基因程序和邻域上下文。
Result: 在公开单细胞空间转录组数据集上的实验和消融研究显示，该方法在单细胞预测任务上一致优于现有单细胞方法和适配的斑点级基线。
Conclusion: GC-MoE通过细胞类型特异性专家和上下文建模有效提升了基于组织学的单细胞基因表达预测精度，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Investigating and Alleviating Harm Amplification in LLM Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can serve as helpful assistants, yet they can equally function as harm amplifiers that enable malicious users to achieve harmful outcomes beyond their capabilities through extended interactions. This risk manifests along two axes, i.e., democratizing domain expertise that allows novices to produce specialized harmful content, and scaling harmful operations at volumes that manual effort cannot match. Existing works, however, often overlook how LLMs compound harm across multi-turn conversations. We introduce HarmAmp, a new benchmark for multi-turn harm amplification scenarios spanning twelve risk categories. Each scenario is grounded in real-world threats and satisfies rigorous criteria, i.e., substantive amplification, operational specificity, and multi-turn necessity. We further propose TrajSafe, a proactive monitor that anticipates harmful trajectories and intervenes through actions such as probing users' genuine intents and steering the models towards safer completion. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that TrajSafe significantly reduces the harmfulness incurred in multi-turn interactions while preserving a low over-refusal rate and the target model's general capabilities. Our work offers a promising paradigm to alleviate the nuanced safety risks in LLM interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HarmAmp 基准和 TrajSafe 监控器，用于研究和减轻大语言模型在多轮交互中的有害放大风险。HarmAmp 覆盖12个风险类别，每个场景满足实质性放大、操作具体性和多轮必要性三个标准。TrajSafe 通过主动探测用户意图并引导模型走向安全完成，显著降低多轮交互的危害性，同时保持低过度拒绝率和模型通用能力。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注单轮交互中的危害，忽略了大语言模型在多轮对话中可能放大危害，使恶意用户能够实现超出其自身能力的危害结果。
Method: 引入 HarmAmp 基准，基于真实威胁构建多轮危害放大场景；提出 TrajSafe 主动监控器，预测有害轨迹并通过探测用户意图和引导安全完成进行干预。
Result: 实验表明 TrajSafe 显著降低多轮交互中的危害，同时保持低过度拒绝率和目标模型的通用能力。
Conclusion: 该工作为缓解大语言模型交互中的细微安全风险提供了一个有前景的范式。

papers.title: Evolutionary Discovery of Bivariate Bicycle Codes with LLM-Guided Search
papers.abstract_en: Quantum LDPC code discovery requires searching large algebraic design spaces while reliably certifying the parameters and equivalence classes of any candidates found. We introduce an LLM-guided evolutionary workflow in which language models mutate Python programs that generate bivariate-bicycle and perturbed bivariate-bicycle code ansätze. Across five campaigns, the system performed approximately 1{,}650 evolutionary iterations, screened about $2 \times 10^5$ candidate codes, and required ${\sim}140$ hours of computation and ${\sim}$US\$400 in LLM inference cost. Candidate codes are evaluated through a staged validation pipeline combining $\mathrm{GF}(2)$ rank computation, distance estimation and certification, mixed-integer linear programming, BLISS Tanner-graph deduplication, decomposability analysis, and local-Clifford equivalence checks. At block length $n \leq 360$, the workflow identifies 465 distinct candidate codes: 97 CSS bivariate-bicycle codes and 368 non-CSS perturbed variants. The CSS search recovers known high-performing codes and finds new finite-length representatives, including an indecomposable [[288,16,12]] code and higher-weight codes with up to $k = 50$ at distance $d = 8$. The non-CSS search produces perturbed codes matching the gross-code figure of merit at [[144,12,12]], along with additional high-distance candidates reported as certified values or upper bounds according to MILP status. Overall, these results show that LLM-guided program evolution can serve as a practical tool for structured quantum-code discovery when paired with independent evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种LLM引导的进化工作流，通过语言模型变异生成双变量自行车码（bivariate-bicycle codes）的Python程序。经过约1650次进化迭代，筛选约20万个候选码，耗时约140小时，LLM推理成本约400美元。在块长度n≤360时，发现465个候选码，包括CSS和非CSS变种，其中包含不可分解的[[288,16,12]]码等。结果显示LLM引导的程序进化可作为结构化量子码发现的有效工具。
Motivation: 量子LDPC码发现需要搜索大型代数设计空间并可靠认证参数和等价类，现有方法搜索效率有限。
Method: 提出LLM引导的进化工作流，使用语言模型变异生成双变量自行车码及扰动变体的Python程序，结合逐步验证流水线：GF(2)秩计算、距离估计与认证、混合整数线性规划、BLISS Tanner图去重、可分解性分析和局部Clifford等价检查。
Result: 在n≤360时发现465个候选码：97个CSS码和368个非CSS扰动变体。CSS搜索恢复已知高性能码并发现新有限长代表，包括不可分解[[288,16,12]]码和更高权重的k=50,d=8码。非CSS搜索在[[144,12,12]]处匹配总码品质因数，并报告高距离候选的认证值或上界。
Conclusion: 结果表明，与独立评估相结合时，LLM引导的程序进化可作为结构化量子码发现的实用工具。

papers.title: Edge Prediction for Roof Wireframe Reconstruction with Transformers
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a competitive solution to the S23DR Challenge 2026, which aims to reconstruct 3D house roof wireframe models from sparse SfM point clouds and ground-level semantic segmentations and depth maps. Our proposed method utilizes an end-to-end Transformer encoder-decoder architecture inspired by DETR. To effectively process the geometric and semantic data, the sparse SfM point cloud input is dynamically subsampled based on semantic priority and augmented with Gestalt and ADE20k class features. To further increase segmentation context, we fuse the point features with additional Gestalt feature encodings which are obtained by projecting the points into latent feature maps produced by a frozen autoencoder. Learned query embeddings are then decoded directly into 3D wireframe edges via cross-attention mechanisms. Evaluated on the "HoHo 22k" dataset, our approach significantly outperforms both handcrafted and learned baselines, achieving a Hybrid Structure Score (HSS) of 0.6476 and securing the second-highest position on the challenge's private leaderboard.
papers.comment: Presented at the 3rd Urban Scene Modeling (USM3D) Workshop at CVPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Transformer编码器-解码器架构的端到端方法，用于从稀疏SfM点云和地面级语义分割及深度图重建3D房屋屋顶线框模型。该方法动态下采样点云并融合Gestalt与ADE20k特征，通过交叉注意力机制直接解码出3D线框边缘。在HoHo 22k数据集上，该方法取得Hybrid Structure Score (HSS) 0.6476，在S23DR Challenge 2026私有排行榜上位列第二。
Motivation: S23DR Challenge 2026要求从稀疏SfM点云和地面语义数据中重建3D屋顶线框，现有方法精度不足，需要更有效的融合几何与语义信息的手段。
Method: 采用类似DETR的Transformer编码器-解码器架构。输入点云根据语义优先级动态下采样，并附加Gestalt和ADE20k类别特征；同时将点投影到冻结自编码器生成的潜在特征图以获取额外Gestalt编码；可学习查询嵌入通过交叉注意力直接解码为3D线框边缘。
Result: 在HoHo 22k数据集上，该方法HSS达到0.6476，显著优于手工和学习的基线方法，在挑战私有排行榜上获得第二名。
Conclusion: 所提Transformer架构有效结合几何与语义信息，在屋顶线框重建任务上取得竞争性结果。

papers.title: AutoForest: Automatically Generating Forest Plots from Biomedical Studies with End-to-End Evidence Extraction and Synthesis
authors: Rui Bebiano Da Providencia E Costa
papers.abstract_en: Systematic reviews rely on forest plots to synthesise quantitative evidence across biomedical studies, but generating them remains a fragmented and labour-intensive process. Researchers must interpret complex clinical texts, manually extract outcome data from trials, define appropriate interventions and comparators, harmonise inconsistent study designs, and carry out meta-analytic computations-typically using specialised software that demands structured inputs and domain expertise. While recent work has demonstrated that large language models can extract study-level data from unstructured text, no existing system automates the complete pipeline from raw documents to synthesised forest plots. To address this gap, we introduce AutoForest, the first end-to-end system that generates publication-ready forest plots directly from biomedical papers. Given one or more study papers, AutoForest automatically suggests ICO (Intervention, Comparator, Outcome) elements, extracts outcome data, performs statistical synthesis, and renders the final forest plot. We describe the system architecture, user interface and demonstrate its effectiveness on real-world examples through a user study involving clinicians, showing how AutoForest can accelerate evidence synthesis and substantially lower the barrier to conducting meta-analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoForest，首个端到端系统，直接从生物医学论文生成可发表的森林图 (forest plots)。系统自动建议 ICO (Intervention, Comparator, Outcome) 元素，提取结果数据，执行统计合成，并渲染最终图形。用户研究表明 AutoForest 可加速证据合成并降低 meta 分析门槛。
Motivation: 系统综述中生成森林图的过程繁琐且碎片化，需要手动提取数据、协调研究设计并进行 meta 分析计算，现有系统无法自动化完整流程。
Method: AutoForest 使用大语言模型从原始文档中提取研究数据，自动建议 ICO 元素，并进行统计合成与图形渲染，形成端到端自动化流水线。
Result: 通过包含临床医生的用户研究，在真实世界示例上展示了系统有效性，表明能加速证据合成并降低 meta 分析门槛。
Conclusion: AutoForest 是首个实现从原始文献到森林图全自动生成的系统，有潜力显著提升系统综述效率。

papers.title: Explainable Forensics of Manipulated Segments in Untrimmed Long Videos
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of AI-driven video generation has transformed content creation, while simultaneously increasing the risk of misinformation through localized manipulations in long-form videos. Existing video forensic methods predominantly operate on short, independent clips, and thus fail to capture realistic scenarios where AI-generated content is sparsely embedded within otherwise authentic footage. To bridge this gap, we formulate the task of Temporal AI-Generated Segment Localization and Explanation, which targets authenticity detection, temporal localization, and interpretable analysis of manipulated segments in untrimmed long videos. We further introduce TASLE, a large-scale benchmark comprising 12,472 untrimmed videos with diverse manipulation patterns and rich annotation signals, including temporal boundaries, authenticity labels, and segment-level rationales. In addition, we propose MSLoc, a coarse-to-fine forensic baseline that combines a boundary-sensitive proposal generation module for efficient long-video scanning with an MLLM-based refinement module for precise boundary localization and interpretable reasoning. Experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed baseline, highlighting the importance of segment-level explainable forensics for long-form AI-generated video analysis. Our dataset and code are publicly available at https://debby-0527.github.io/TASLE.

Conclusion: 论文强调片段级可解释取证对于长视频AI生成内容分析的重要性，并公开数据集和代码以推动该方向研究。

papers.title: A Local Perturbation Theory for Cross-Domain Interference and Recovery in Multi-Domain RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves large language models (LLMs) on individual domains such as mathematical reasoning, code generation, question answering, and creative writing (CW), but training on one domain often degrades performance on others. Existing explanations based on catastrophic forgetting or global gradient conflict are incomplete: substantial interference can occur even when full-model gradients are nearly orthogonal. We show that single-domain RL produces sparse, small-magnitude parameter edits with weak overlap among top-changed neurons, while different domains still share substantial active computation routes on which update directions determine whether they act synergistically or conflict. Guided by this observation, we prove under a local perturbation model of multi-domain RL that later-domain training harms an earlier domain mainly through a second-order damage term, which under the observed sparse route structure concentrates in a low-dimensional shared conflict subspace. Moreover, a short domain refresh contracts the harmful component on this subspace, enabling selective recovery with limited collateral damage. Consistent with the theory, a brief Re-Math refresh after Code $\rightarrow$ Math $\rightarrow$ QA $\rightarrow$ CW recovers Math from 57.66 to 66.04 while largely preserving performance on the other domains, yielding the best average score of 66.39. Beyond refresh, a training-free rollback on a sparse proxy conflict coordinate set for the Math-QA pair partially restores Math, providing direct proxy-level evidence for localized damage. These results provide a localized mechanistic account of interference and recovery in multi-domain RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多领域强化学习（RL）后训练中单领域训练会降低其他领域性能的问题，提出局部扰动理论。通过观察发现单领域RL产生的参数编辑稀疏且幅度小，不同领域共享活跃计算路径，更新方向决定协同或冲突。理论证明后续领域训练通过二阶损伤项损害先前领域，该损伤集中在低维共享冲突子空间；短时领域刷新可收缩该子空间上的有害分量，实现选择性恢复。实验表明，Code→Math→QA→CW序列后，对Math的短暂刷新将其从57.66恢复至66.04，同时保持其他领域表现，平均分66.39。此外，无训练的稀疏代理冲突坐标回滚也部分恢复Math。结果为多领域RL中的干扰与恢复提供了局部机制解释。
Motivation: 多领域RL后训练中，单领域训练常导致其他领域性能下降，现有解释（灾难性遗忘或全局梯度冲突）不完整，因为即使全模型梯度近乎正交时仍会发生显著干扰。
Method: 提出局部扰动理论模型，分析多领域RL中参数编辑的稀疏性和共享计算路径；证明二阶损伤项的存在及其在低维共享冲突子空间上的集中；引入短时领域刷新以减少该子空间上的有害分量。
Result: 在Code→Math→QA→CW序列后，对Math的短暂刷新将其从57.66恢复至66.04，同时其他领域性能基本保持，平均分达66.39；无训练的稀疏代理冲突坐标回滚也部分恢复Math。
Conclusion: 本文为多领域RL中的干扰与恢复提供了局部机制层面的解释，强调共享冲突子空间和短时刷新的作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Policy and World Modeling Co-Training for Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model (LLM) agents by teaching them which actions lead to high rewards, but provides little supervision on what those actions do to the environment. World modeling (WM) can fill this gap, yet existing approaches often require separate simulators, extra training stages, or additional inference-time computation. We observe that on-policy RL rollouts already contain the needed signal: each transition pairs an action with its resulting next observation. Based on this observation, we propose PaW, a Policy and World modeling co-training framework that adds auxiliary WM supervision to the same policy during RL, without changing the inference paradigm. To make auxiliary WM supervision informative and stable, PaW introduces three components: action-entropy-based WM data selection, noise-tolerant WM loss, and reward-adaptive loss balancing. Experiments on three agentic task benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong RL baselines across models and RL algorithms. These results suggest that standard RL rollouts are a practical source of WM supervision for language-agent training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PaW框架，在强化学习过程中为语言智能体添加辅助世界模型监督，利用在线策略rollout中的动作-下一观测对作为训练信号，无需额外模拟器或推理开销。三个关键组件（基于动作熵的数据选择、噪声容忍损失、自适应损失平衡）使训练稳定有效。实验表明PaW在多个任务上一致优于纯RL基线。
Motivation: 强化学习虽能教会语言智能体哪些动作获得高奖励，但对动作如何影响环境提供很少监督；已有的世界模型方法需要独立模拟器、额外训练阶段或推理计算。
Method: 提出策略与世界模型协同训练（PaW），在RL rollout上引入辅助世界模型监督，包含三个组件：基于动作熵的世界模型训练数据选择、噪声容忍损失函数、奖励自适应损失平衡。
Result: 在三个智能体任务基准上，PaW跨模型和RL算法一致优于强RL基线。
Conclusion: 标准RL rollout可作为语言智能体训练中世界模型监督的实用来源，无需改变推理范式。

papers.title: AgentPLM: Agentic Protein Language Models with Reasoning-Augmented Decoding for Protein Sequence Design
papers.abstract_en: Protein language models (PLMs) are passive oracles: they generate sequences in a single forward pass with no mechanism to consult external biophysical feedback or redirect generation when a candidate violates thermodynamic or structural constraints. We introduce AgentPLM, which addresses this by equipping a pre-trained PLM with i) Reasoning-Augmented Decoding (RAD), which interleaves autoregressive generation with tool calls (ESMFold, FoldX, AutoDock Vina), and ii) Contrastive Agent Policy Optimisation (CAPO), a trajectory-level extension of direct preference optimisation that trains the policy end-to-end to learn when oracle feedback is informative rather than merely imitating high-fitness sequences. We evaluate AgentPLM on benchmark tasks spanning de novo enzyme design, antibody optimisation, thermostability, PPI interface design, and zero-shot fitness prediction with standardised oracle APIs and controlled sequence-identity splits. AgentPLM achieves state-of-the-art results with a gain in antibody top-10% hit rate over the strongest passive baseline, providing mechanistic evidence of online error correction without explicit backtracking.
papers.journal_ref: Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology, 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentPLM 是一种将预训练蛋白质语言模型与推理增强解码 (RAD) 和对比智能体策略优化 (CAPO) 相结合的框架，使其能够调用外部工具 (如 ESMFold、FoldX、AutoDock Vina) 并学习何时利用反馈。在从头酶设计、抗体优化、热稳定性等基准任务上，AgentPLM 达到了最优结果，抗体 top-10% 命中率显著超过最强被动基线。
Motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型 (PLMs) 是 passive oracles，仅通过单次前向传播生成序列，缺乏机制来咨询外部生物物理反馈或在候选违背热力学或结构约束时重定向生成。
Method: AgentPLM 包含两个核心组件：i) 推理增强解码 (RAD)，在自回归生成中间歇调用工具；ii) 对比智能体策略优化 (CAPO)，一种轨迹级别的直接偏好优化扩展，端到端训练策略以学习何时 oracle 反馈具有信息性，而非简单模仿高适应度序列。
Result: 在从头酶设计、抗体优化、热稳定性、PPI 界面设计和零样本适应度预测等基准任务上，AgentPLM 取得了最先进的结果，抗体 top-10% 命中率优于最强被动基线，并提供了在线错误纠正的机制证据，无需显式回溯。
Conclusion: AgentPLM 证明了将外部工具集成到 PLM 解码过程中可以有效纠正生成错误，提升序列设计性能。

papers.title: How Optimality Structures Sparse Dictionaries: A Theory for Understanding SAE Representations
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have found success parsing neural representations into interpretable concepts, providing a basis for understanding and control. However, what exactly SAEs extract, and, correspondingly, the scientific conclusions we can draw from them, are not obvious. Empirically, the proof is in the pudding: SAEs learn interpretable features. Theoretically, we lack a clear account of what properties a 'concept' must satisfy for an SAE to extract it. There has been extensive identifiability work studying the conditions under which sparse coding recovers ground-truth features; however, these approaches tends to focus on simple data-generating models (e.g. sparse independent features) which poorly approximate the internet-swallowing language-model representations on which SAEs are trained. Here, avoiding data-generating models, we ask simply what properties any dictionary learning optimum must satisfy. Concretely, we extend local optimality analyses (Gribonval & Schnass, 2010) to the nonnegative joint-optimisation problem that vanilla SAEs approximate, and derive constraints relating optimal SAE features to their distributions. We use these constraints to explain a range of observed SAE behaviours - hierarchical splitting & absorption, the structure of residuals, and dense antipodal features - each reflecting how L1+nonnegativity interact with data to structure optimal dictionaries. Finally, we construct a novel large-dictionary convex problem and explore the wide atom-per-datapoint limit. In sum, we hope to tease model assumptions from unexpected observations, letting us learn more from SAEs' successes and provide principles for designing their successors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏自编码器（SAE）在神经网络表示中提取可解释概念的成功，但缺乏理论解释的问题，扩展局部最优性分析到非负联合优化问题，推导出SAE最优特征与数据分布的约束关系。这些约束解释了SAE的层次分裂与吸收、残差结构、密集对立特征等行为，并构造大字典凸问题探索极限。
Motivation: SAE虽然能提取可解释特征，但缺乏清晰的理论说明什么样的‘概念’才能被SAE提取；现有可识别性工作基于简单数据生成模型，无法应用于大规模语言模型表示。
Method: 将局部最优性分析（Gribonval & Schnass, 2010）扩展到非负联合优化问题，推导最优SAE特征及其分布的约束；构造大字典凸问题探索每个数据点原子数极多的极限。
Result: 导出的约束解释了层次分裂、吸收、残差结构、密集对立特征等现象，展示了L1正则化与非负性如何与数据交互塑造最优字典。
Conclusion: 希望区分模型假设与意外观察，从而从SAE成功中学习更多，并为设计下一代稀疏字典提供原则。
Relevance: 0
