papers.title: RL-ACRGNet: Reinforcement Learning-Based Chest Radiology Report Generation Network
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging interpretation is a foundational pillar of modern clinical diagnostics, yet the manual generation of radiology reports remains a time-consuming process prone to interpretation inconsistencies. Within the field of medical AI, automating these descriptions through deep learning promises to streamline clinical workflows and standardise diagnostic output. However, accurate disease detection and precise report generation remain significant challenges due to limitations in capturing fine-grained visual features and ensuring clinical coherence. To address these issues, we propose RL-ACRGNet, an improved encoder-decoder model that integrates a pre-trained DenseNet encoder with a multilevel LSTM decoder within an off-policy reinforcement learning framework. Using a dual-network approach to refine visual-semantic embeddings through a metric-based reward mechanism, we demonstrate that RL-ACRGNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the IU-Xray dataset, achieving quantitative improvements in BLEU-4 (0.47%), METEOR (0.17%) and ROUGE-L (0.518). Furthermore, comprehensive evaluations on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR data set confirm the robust generalisation of the model and its ability to generate high-quality, clinically relevant reports
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RL-ACRGNet，一种基于离线强化学习的编码器-解码器模型，用于胸部X光报告自动生成。该模型整合预训练DenseNet编码器和多级LSTM解码器，通过度量奖励机制优化视觉-语义嵌入，在IU-Xray和MIMIC-CXR数据集上超越现有基线，BLEU-4、METEOR和ROUGE-L分别提升0.47%、0.17%和0.518。
Motivation: 手动生成放射学报告耗时且易受解读不一致影响，现有深度学习方法在捕捉细粒度视觉特征和确保临床连贯性方面仍存在挑战。
Method: 采用离线强化学习框架，使用双网络方法通过度量奖励机制细化视觉-语义嵌入，编码器为预训练DenseNet，解码器为多级LSTM。

papers.title: OpenWebRL: Demystifying Online Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning for Visual Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Building capable visual web agents requires long-horizon reasoning, precise grounding, and robust interaction with dynamic real-world websites. Despite rapid progress, the strongest systems remain largely proprietary, while open agents still depend heavily on supervised post-training over large collections of curated web trajectories. This dependence creates a major scalability bottleneck: high-quality demonstrations are expensive to collect, and static datasets offer limited coverage of the diverse, ever-changing open web. Although online RL has shown promise for text-based agents, its potential for training visual web agents directly on live websites remains largely underexplored. In this paper, we introduce OpenWebRL, an open framework for training visual web agents with online multi-turn RL on real websites. OpenWebRL covers the full training pipeline, including scalable live-browser infrastructure, supervised initialization, multimodal context management, trajectory-level success judging, and efficient multi-turn policy optimization. Using this framework, we train OpenWebRL-4B, which establishes a new open-source state of the art on challenging live-web benchmarks. With only 0.4K initialization trajectories and 2.2K open-ended RL training tasks, OpenWebRL-4B achieves 67.0% success on Online-Mind2Web and 64.0% on DeepShop, outperforming prior open agents of similar or larger scale and remaining competitive with proprietary systems including OpenAI CUA and Gemini CUA. Beyond strong benchmark performance, we systematically study the key design choices that make online RL effective for visual web agents, and analyze how RL improves agentic reasoning. Overall, our work offers a practical path toward building more capable, reproducible, and cost-efficient open web agents. We will release our training data, models, and code to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpenWebRL，一个用于在真实网站上训练视觉网页代理的在线多轮强化学习开源框架。框架涵盖可扩展的实时浏览器基础设施、监督初始化、多模态上下文管理、轨迹级成功判断和高效的多轮策略优化。使用该框架训练的OpenWebRL-4B模型，仅用0.4K初始化轨迹和2.2K开放RL训练任务，就在Online-Mind2Web和DeepShop基准上分别达到67.0%和64.0%的成功率，超越了同类或更大规模的开源代理，并与OpenAI CUA和Gemini CUA等专有系统竞争。
Motivation: 当前最强视觉网页代理多为专有系统，而开源代理严重依赖大量精心收集的网页轨迹进行监督后训练，这导致可扩展性瓶颈：高质量演示收集成本高，静态数据集无法覆盖多样且动态变化的开放网页。在线RL对文本代理有效，但直接用于训练视觉网页代理的潜力尚未充分探索。
Method: OpenWebRL是一个完整的训练框架，包括：可扩展的实时浏览器基础设施，用于在真实网站上交互；监督初始化阶段；多模态上下文管理；轨迹级成功判断机制；以及高效的多轮策略优化算法。论文还系统研究了使在线RL对视觉网页代理有效的关键设计选择。
Result: OpenWebRL-4B在Online-Mind2Web上达到67.0%成功率，在DeepShop上达到64.0%，优于之前开源代理，并与专有系统竞争力相当。仅使用0.4K初始化轨迹和2.2K开放RL训练任务。
Conclusion: 该工作为构建更强大、可复现且成本效益高的开源网页代理提供了实用路径，并分析了RL如何改进代理推理。将发布训练数据、模型和代码。

papers.title: World-Task Factorization for Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robot learning must produce policies that generalize to new combinations of constraints, teammates, and environments. To achieve this, we must structurally factor the policy, which is a choice that dictates what generalizes, what requires retraining, and what remains entangled. Existing methods span a wide spectrum, from expecting structure to emerge from data scaling, to hand-designing it via hierarchies, skill libraries or learned specializations. In this paper, we study what we argue is the most fundamental factorization in robotics: separating the world from the task. We investigate the conditions under which this factorization is principled. World factors are properties of the embodied system and the environment; they exist independently of intent. Task factors are defined by the task's logic over what the world admits. We formalize this asymmetry through Bayesian model evidence: it aligns with the data-generating process, maintains high likelihood through an analytical world model, and reduces the Occam razor's penalty on task parameters. We instantiate this factorization by pairing AICON, a differentiable graph of recursive estimators and interconnections that is compositional, operates without task-specific data, and propagates cost gradients to actuators, with a compact, learned policy that modulates gradient paths. Gradients serve as the interface between the two factors: they carry world structure through the graph and task structure through costs, enabling low-dimensional learning while preserving structural generalization. We test the world/task factorization across three problems that encompass heterogeneous robots, environments, task logic and sensorimotor modalities. Our framework outperforms end-to-end baselines and analytical heuristics in all settings, generalizes zero-shot to out-of-distribution configurations, and transfers to real hardware without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出机器人学习中的世界-任务分解（world-task factorization），将策略解耦为世界因子（体现系统和环境属性）和任务因子（基于任务逻辑）。通过贝叶斯模型证据形式化分解，并利用AICON可微分图与学习策略结合，以梯度作为接口。实验在多种机器人、环境和任务中优于基线和启发式方法，实现零样本泛化和真实硬件迁移。
Motivation: 机器人学习需要泛化到新环境与任务组合，现有方法依赖数据规模或手工设计结构，缺乏对世界与任务分离这一基础分解的研究。
Method: 形式化世界-任务分解为贝叶斯模型证据；采用AICON（可微分的递归估计器图，无需任务特定数据）与学习策略配对，梯度作为世界与任务的接口。
Result: 在三个涵盖异构机器人、环境、任务逻辑和感觉运动模态的问题上，方法优于端到端基线和分析启发式方法，零样本泛化到分布外配置，并无需重训练迁移到真实硬件。
Conclusion: 分离世界与任务是机器人学习的基础分解，框架实现结构泛化和低维学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ranking vs. Assignment: The Metric Mismatch in Multi-View Object Association
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view object association is an important computer vision problem that underlies many multi-camera perception tasks. While this task is naturally formulated as a constrained one-to-one matching problem, recent works heavily rely on pairwise ranking metrics like AP and FPR-95 for model evaluation. We highlight a fundamental mismatch between these metrics and the actual assignment objective. Theoretically, we show that AP and FPR-95 can be imperfect even when the assignment is already correct, and that Sinkhorn-based normalization can make them perfect. Conversely, optimal pairwise ranking can still lead to incorrect assignments. We validate this mismatch in practice by using our Sinkhorn-based normalization as a controlled post-processing stress test. We show that optimizing just a few post-processing parameters significantly boosts AP and FPR-95 without corresponding improvements in assignment-level metrics such as ACC and IPAA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出多视角目标关联任务中，常用的排序指标（AP、FPR-95）与实际分配目标存在根本性不匹配。理论表明即使分配正确，这些指标仍可能不完美；而通过Sinkhorn归一化可迫使指标完美，但最优排序仍可能导致错误分配。实验表明，仅优化后处理参数可显著提升排序指标，却未改善分配级指标（ACC、IPAA）。
Motivation: 多视角目标关联自然是一个约束的一对一匹配问题，但近年工作依赖排序指标评估模型，导致评估与真实目标脱节。
Method: 提出Sinkhorn归一化作为后处理方法，通过调整少量参数控制排序指标，用于检验指标不匹配问题。
Result: Sinkhorn归一化显著提升AP和FPR-95，但分配级指标（ACC、IPAA）未相应改善，验证了指标不匹配。
Conclusion: 现有排序指标不适于评估关联任务，应转向分配级指标或修正评估协议。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: PerBite: A Curated Diagnostic Workflow for Bite-Aware Food Volume Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Can a visually plausible food mesh be trusted to estimate the volume of consumed food? \method investigates this question using selected paired before- and after-consumption states from the MetaFood CVPR 2026 Continuous 3D Reconstruction While Eating Challenge. The submitted workflow follows a curated reconstruction protocol: SAM~3 segments the food and plate regions; Hunyuan3D/SAM~3D generates a dimensionless food mesh; the plate diameter provides the metric scale; the plate geometry is removed in Blender; and the remaining mesh is hole-filled, made watertight, and integrated to estimate volume. MoGe-2 is used only as an auxiliary cue for initial dish-diameter estimation when direct plate measurement is uncertain; it is not the primary scale source for the reported challenge result. \method ranks first, with an average Chamfer distance of 8.31 across 34 meshes using rigid ICP without scale correction. On 17 before- and after-pairs, it achieves 33.87\% state-level volume MAPE and zero monotonicity violations, while consumed-volume MAPE remains 53.74\%. The results show that surface reconstruction, metric scale, controlled mesh cleanup, watertight volume integration, and physical depletion consistency should be evaluated separately for dietary assessment. Source code and evaluation scripts will be available at \href{https://github.com/GCVCG/PerBite-CVPR-MetaFood-2026}{github.com/GCVCG/PerBite-CVPR-MetaFood-2026}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对食物体积估计问题，提出一种诊断性工作流PerBite，利用餐前餐后状态配对数据，通过SAM3分割、Hunyuan3D生成网格、利用餐盘直径定标、去除餐盘几何后补洞和整合计算体积。在MetaFood CVPR 2026挑战赛中获得第一名，平均Chamfer距离8.31，状态级体积MAPE 33.87%，消耗体积MAPE 53.74%。
Motivation: 视觉上合理的食物网格是否可用于准确估计食物体积？现有方法缺乏对重建、尺度、清理、体积积分和消耗一致性的单独评估。
Method: 提出PerBite工作流：SAM3分割食物和餐盘区域，Hunyuan3D/SAM3D生成无尺度网格，餐盘直径提供公制尺度，Blender去除餐盘几何，网格补洞并水密化以积分体积。MoGe-2仅作为辅助提示。
Result: 在挑战赛中排名第一，34个网格平均Chamfer距离8.31；17对餐前餐后状态级体积MAPE 33.87%，无单调性违反；消耗体积MAPE 53.74%。
Conclusion: 结果表明表面重建、公制尺度、网格清理、水密体积积分和物理消耗一致性应分别评估。代码已开源。

papers.title: Unveiling the Entropy Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the entropy dynamics of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and uncovers a consistent two-phase structure: an Uncertainty Region of exploration transitioning sharply to a Confidence Region of convergence. We demonstrate that the Confidence Region possesses two critical properties: 1) High Reliability -- answers in the confidence region become highly accurate and stable, and 2) High Redundancy -- models generate unnecessary tokens long after reaching the correct answer. These properties unlock more efficient and reliable inference strategies: 1) Early Exit leverages reliability and redundancy to terminate computation safely when returns diminish, and 2)Test-Time Scaling uses the Confidence Region signal to prioritize converged trajectories. To operationalize these insights, we formulate Confidence Region detection as a sequential change-point detection problem, being the first to apply classical change-point methods to monitor CoT reasoning. Using the Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) algorithm, a statistically optimal change-point detector, we develop a training-free framework for real-time inference control. Experiments show our approach establishes a superior Pareto-frontier for early exit. CUSUM achieves 63.06% accuracy with 11.1% token reduction, outperforming DEER and Dynasor by 3.28% and 4.36% in accuracy respectively. For test-time scaling, CUSUM-weighted voting consistently outperforms self-consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究链式推理（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）中的熵动态，发现一致的两阶段结构：探索性不确定性区域（Uncertainty Region）到收敛性置信区域（Confidence Region）的突变。置信区域具有高可靠性和高冗余性两个关键属性，据此提出早期退出（Early Exit）和测试时缩放（Test-Time Scaling）两种高效推理策略。通过将置信区域检测建模为序列变点检测问题，采用累积和（CUSUM）算法实现无训练推理控制，在早期退出任务中达到63.06%准确率与11.1% token减少的帕累托前沿。
Motivation: CoT推理中模型的输出不确定性动态未被充分理解，缺乏可解释的、高效的推理控制机制。
Method: 将置信区域检测转化为序列变点检测问题，采用CUSUM算法实时监测CoT推理过程中的熵变化，实现无训练的推理控制，包括早期退出和加权投票。
Result: CUSUM早期退出在减少11.1% token的同时达到63.06%准确率，优于DEER和Dynasor 3.28%和4.36%；CUSUM加权投票在测试时缩放中持续优于自一致性方法。
Conclusion: 论文揭示的CoT熵动态结构和变点检测框架为高效可靠的推理策略提供了理论基础，并展示了在无训练条件下的实际效果。

summary_sections.method: 将置信区域检测转化为序列变点检测问题，采用CUSUM算法实时监测CoT推理过程中的熵变化，实现无训练的推理控制，包括早期退出和加权投票。
summary_sections.result: CUSUM早期退出在减少11.1% token的同时达到63.06%准确率，优于DEER和Dynasor 3.28%和4.36%；CUSUM加权投票在测试时缩放中持续优于自一致性方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文揭示的CoT熵动态结构和变点检测框架为高效可靠的推理策略提供了理论基础，并展示了在无训练条件下的实际效果。

papers.title: PliableBVS: A flexible Bayesian variable selection method for modeling interactions with mandatory modifying variables
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional interaction models are useful for studying, for example, how a large set of variables of interest, such as gene expression or other omics features, interact with a smaller set of modifying variables, such as clinical covariates. In this context, the pliable lasso has recently been proposed as an efficient method for screening large numbers of potential interaction terms under an asymmetric weak hierarchical constraint. In this work, we extend this framework by introducing PliableBVS, a Bayesian variable selection approach that preserves the hierarchical structure of the pliable lasso while inducing sparsity through spike-and-slab priors. The proposed model combines the continuous shrinkage effect of Bayesian lasso with a hierarchical spike-and-slab prior formulation that has two layers of decision variables: one governing the inclusion of main effects and another controlling the inclusion of interaction effects which is conditional on the inclusion of the corresponding main effects. This structure enables simultaneous selection of high-dimensional main and interaction effects within a coherent probabilistic framework. In simulation studies the proposed method outperforms the original pliable lasso in identifying active main and interaction effects, reducing false discoveries, and improving prediction accuracy in most scenarios. Applications with data from a labor onset study and a preeclampsia study demonstrate that PliableBVS selects biologically meaningful features and interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PliableBVS，一种贝叶斯变量选择方法，在不对称弱层次约束下进行高维交互建模，使用spike-and-slab先验诱导稀疏性，包含两层决策变量分别控制主效应和交互效应的纳入。模拟研究表明其在识别活跃主效应和交互效应、减少假阳性、提高预测精度方面优于pliable lasso，并在实际数据中选择了有生物学意义的特征。
Motivation: 现有pliable lasso是高效筛选交互项的方法，但缺乏概率框架和不确定性量化。本文旨在引入贝叶斯方法，保留层次结构的同时提供后验推断。
Method: 提出PliableBVS，结合贝叶斯lasso的连续收缩和层次spike-and-slab先验，包含两层决策变量：主效应纳入和交互效应纳入（条件于主效应），实现高维主效应和交互效应的同时选择。
Result: 模拟研究中PliableBVS在大多数场景下优于pliable lasso，体现在识别活跃效应、减少假阳性、提高预测精度。实际劳工启动研究和子痫前期研究中选择出生物学有意义的特征和交互。
Conclusion: PliableBVS是pliable lasso的贝叶斯扩展，提供更灵活的变量选择和不确定性量化，适用于高维交互建模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Real-World Generalizability of Algorithm Selection Models
papers.abstract_en: Algorithm Selection (AS) aims to automatically identify the most suitable optimization algorithm for a given problem instance by leveraging measurable problem characteristics and historical performance data. In this study, we investigate the generalization ability of AS models across both synthetic and real-world optimization landscapes. We consider two widely used academic benchmark suites (BBOB and CEC) and two real-world problem sets (robotics trajectory optimization tasks and unmanned aerial vehicle path-planning problems). Through a systematic cross-benchmark evaluation, we analyze how AS models transfer between domains, identify where generalization succeeds or breaks down, and highlight the challenges that arise when applying AS in realistic, domain-specific contexts. Our findings provide insights into the robustness of current AS approaches and inform the development of more reliable, broadly applicable AS systems for real-world optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究算法选择（AS）模型在合成与真实世界优化问题上的泛化能力，使用BBOB和CEC基准测试以及机器人轨迹优化和无人机路径规划两类真实问题。通过跨基准系统评估，分析了AS模型在不同领域间的迁移表现，指出当前方法在真实场景中面临的挑战，并提出了提高鲁棒性和通用性的方向。
Motivation: 现有算法选择研究多依赖于合成基准，缺乏对真实世界优化问题泛化能力的系统评估。
Method: 采用跨基准评估框架，在两个合成基准（BBOB、CEC）和两个真实问题集（机器人轨迹优化、无人机路径规划）上测试AS模型的迁移性能。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值，仅报告了泛化成功与失效的模式以及真实场景中的挑战。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了当前AS方法在真实领域应用中的局限性，并为开发更可靠的通用AS系统提供指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Extreme Low-Bit Inference in Reasoning Models: Failure Modes and Targeted Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) rely on long reasoning traces, making inference expensive. While low-bit quantization reduces per-token decoding cost, we show that aggressive 2-bit inference can fail to deliver end-to-end speedup because instability in the generation process inflates total token count. Instead of merely lowering answer accuracy, 2-bit quantization often produces much longer traces with repetitive loops, budget exhaustion, delayed commitment, and unclosed reasoning segments. We analyze full reasoning traces of Qwen3 reasoning models across mathematical and commonsense benchmarks and show that accuracy degradation is tightly linked to these process-level failures. To address them, we introduce two lightweight controls: FP16 planning, which gives the 2-bit model a short high-precision outline, and loop rescue, which detects repetitive traces and either commits to an earlier answer or falls back to FP16. On MATH-500, loop rescue improves Qwen3-8B accuracy from 17.2% to 74.2%, while planning plus loop rescue improves Qwen3-32B from 65.0% to 87.2%. Overall, our results show that extreme low-bit reasoning becomes practical when its failures are treated as controllable generation pathologies: with lightweight detection and selective FP16 support, 2-bit inference can recover accuracy while preserving real end-to-end speed. Our code is available at: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/quantized-reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了极低比特（2比特）量化在大推理模型（如Qwen3）中的失效模式，发现2比特推理虽降低每token成本，但会导致生成轨迹变长、重复循环等问题，反而降低端到端效率。作者提出两种轻量级控制方法：FP16规划（高精度大纲）和循环救援（检测重复并回退），在MATH-500上显著提升了准确率。结果表明，通过可检测的生成病理和选择性FP16支持，2比特推理可以恢复准确性并保持实际速度。
Motivation: 大推理模型依赖长推理轨迹，推理成本高；低比特量化虽可降低每token成本，但极低比特（2比特）会导致推理不稳定，产生更长的轨迹和重复循环，反而降低端到端效率，且准确率下降与这些过程级故障紧密相关。
Method: 分析了Qwen3推理模型在数学和常识基准上的完整推理轨迹，识别出循环、预算耗尽、延迟决策等故障模式。提出两种轻量控制：FP16规划（给2比特模型一个短的高精度大纲）和循环救援（检测重复轨迹，要么提交早期答案，要么回退到FP16）。
Result: 在MATH-500上，loop rescue将Qwen3-8B准确率从17.2%提升到74.2%，planning加loop rescue将Qwen3-32B从65.0%提升到87.2%。代码开源。
Conclusion: 极端低比特推理在将失效视为可控生成病理时变得实用；通过轻量检测和选择性FP16支持，2比特推理可以恢复准确率同时保持实际端到端速度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PlanarBench: Evaluating LLM Spatial Reasoning via Planar Graph Drawing
papers.abstract_en: PlanarBench tests whether LLMs can draw planar graphs as ASCII art given only an edge list -- a spatial reasoning task that resists memorization because edge order, edge orientation, and node labels are all permutable. We evaluate 91 models on the 199 simplest non-isomorphic connected planar graphs (2 - 7 vertices). Edge count is the dominant difficulty predictor ($r = -0.85$) -- a finding not reported in prior LLM graph benchmarks, which use only node count as the difficulty axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PlanarBench，一个评估 LLM 空间推理能力的基准，要求模型根据边列表以 ASCII 艺术形式绘制平面图。该任务通过置换边顺序、方向和节点标签来防止记忆化。在 91 个模型上评估了 199 个最简非同构连通平面图（2-7 节点），发现边数是主导难度预测因子（r=-0.85），这是此前图基准未报告的发现。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 图基准仅使用节点数作为难度轴，且任务容易被记忆化。本文旨在构建一个不可记忆化的空间推理基准，并揭示边数作为更精确的难度指标。
Method: 构建 PlanarBench 数据集，包含 199 个最简非同构连通平面图（2-7 节点），要求 LLM 将边列表绘制为 ASCII 平面图。边顺序、边方向和节点标签均可随机置换，防止记忆。评估了 91 个不同 LLM。
Result: 边数（edge count）与任务正确率呈强负相关（r=-0.85），表明边数是比节点数更有效的难度预测因子。
Conclusion: PlanarBench 提供了 LLM 空间推理的细粒度评估，并强调了边数作为难度轴的重要性。该基准可服务于未来图形理解研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Provable Data Scaling Law for Meta Learning via Complexity Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training has become a fundamental paradigm in modern machine learning, with one of its key empirical benefits being reduced downstream sample complexity as the scale of pre-training data increases. However, existing theoretical frameworks for pre-training do not fully explain this phenomenon. In this paper, we introduce complexity minimization, a novel meta-representation learning framework designed to enable theoretical analysis of this scaling behavior, which learns representations by evaluating the downstream model complexity best suited to each domain and minimizing the worst-case such complexity across source domains. Our end-to-end theoretical analysis, spanning pre-training through downstream regression, shows that this framework provably captures this scaling behavior; in particular, we show that the error rate of few-shot adaptation improves as the amount of meta-training data grows. Empirically, we demonstrate that incorporating complexity regularization into existing meta-learning methods consistently improves downstream sample efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为复杂最小化（complexity minimization）的元表示学习框架，用于理论分析预训练数据规模与下游样本复杂度之间的缩放行为。作者通过端到端理论分析证明，随着元训练数据量增长，少样本适应的误差率会下降，并在实证中验证了将复杂正则化引入现有元学习方法能一致提升下游样本效率。
Motivation: 现有预训练理论框架无法完全解释预训练数据规模增大如何导致下游样本复杂度降低这一关键经验现象。
Method: 提出复杂最小化框架，通过评估每个领域最适合的下游模型复杂度，并最小化跨源领域的最坏情况复杂度来学习表示。
Result: 理论分析表明少样本适应的误差率随元训练数据量增加而改善；实证结果显示，在现有元学习方法中加入复杂正则化能一致提升下游样本效率。
Conclusion: 该框架从理论上捕捉到了预训练数据的缩放行为，并提供了可实现的改进途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multiscale Dynamics of Heatwave Persistence and Intensity Under Climate Change
papers.abstract_en: Climate change is expected to increase heatwave risk, but exceedance frequency alone cannot explain why some regions show stronger amplification in event persistence. This study develops an integrated event-dynamical workflow to diagnose changes in warm-season heatwaves and link them to coherent, multiscale structures of temperature variability. Heatwaves are identified over southern Canada using a fixed historical 90th percentile threshold (2001-2010 reference, 15-day moving window) and a minimum-duration criterion. Events are summarized using frequency (HWF, HWN), persistence (HWMD, HWD), and intensity (HWI, HWM) metrics. The daily mean temperature field is analyzed using multiresolution dynamic mode decomposition (mrDMD). Event and dynamical perspectives are connected through heatwave-conditioned mode participation ratios and spatial alignment analyses between mode-energy footprints and gridded heatwave metrics using hotspot overlap and Spearman rank association. The workflow is applied to CORDEX-NAM12 regional simulations (CRCM5 downscaling of CanESM5) under SSP5-8.5 for 2016-2025, 2051-2060, and 2091-2100. Results show a clear shift toward persistence-dominated heatwave regimes in the continental interior. By the late century, increases in seasonal heatwave days are accompanied by much longer events, with regional HWMD reaching about 26.66 days/event and HWD about 69 days, together with stronger above-threshold intensity, with HWI reaching about 6.88 K. Dynamical diagnostics indicate a redistribution of dominant activity toward lower-frequency levels and weaker effective damping in interior regions, while coastal and maritime regions show smaller changes. Heatwave-relevant low-frequency modes remain active during long events and align with persistence and intensity hotspots, supporting a process-informed interpretation of regional heatwave amplification under climate change.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究气候变化下热浪持续时间和强度的多尺度动力学。利用多分辨率动态模式分解（mrDMD）分析加拿大南部的热浪事件，发现向持续性主导的热浪体制转变，内陆地区事件持续时间更长、强度更大。动力学诊断表明低频活动增强，有效阻尼减弱。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注热浪的超过频率，但无法解释某些地区事件持续性增强的原因。
Method: 提出一个集成的事件-动力学工作流，结合固定阈值热浪识别、多分辨率动态模式分解（mrDMD）和热浪条件模式参与比、空间对齐分析。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了热浪增幅的过程驱动解释，支持低频模式与持续性、强度热点的一致。

papers.title: Machine Learning for Coding Retail Product Names to Consumer-Price Categories: A Rule-plus-Bag-of-Words Pipeline with Reliability-Weighted Human-in-the-Loop Labeling
papers.abstract_en: Consumer-price measurement increasingly draws on alternative data sources -- scanner, web-scraped, and transaction/receipt data. A recurring obstacle is that product descriptions in such sources are short, noisy, and abbreviated, with no standard product code, so each item must first be mapped to a consumption classification (e.g., the UN COICOP scheme) before prices can be compared. This paper studies that mapping as a general, reproducible method. The pipeline is: (i) text normalization and tokenization of noisy item names; (ii) a prefix-tree (trie) rule-based pre-classifier driven by per-category key-phrases and stop-phrases; and (iii) a per-category binary confirmation model deciding whether an item belongs to a tentatively assigned category. For labels at scale we use a human-in-the-loop protocol in which annotators give a binary valid/reject judgment, aggregated by a dynamically updated reliability weight; the model joins the same rule, enabling continual fine-tuning. Our empirical finding is deflationary: in a controlled, leakage-free study (one category, real positives vs. hard negatives, five seeds), bag-of-words models essentially saturate the task (F1 about 0.99) -- a linear classifier matches a multilayer perceptron, explicit word-order (n-gram) features add nothing, and about 67 labeled examples already suffice. A Monte-Carlo study of the labeling protocol shows the reliability-weighted vote barely beats plain majority (its additive weights saturate) while Dawid-Skene recovers labels markedly better. We also discuss price-level quality control and design lessons for statistical offices considering transaction data. All figures are illustrative; no confidential data, code, or documentation is reproduced.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 tables. Methodology paper; illustrative experiments only, no proprietary data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对替代数据源（扫描、网页抓取、交易/收据数据）中产品名称映射到消费价格类别（如UN COICOP）的问题，提出一个可复现的流水线：文本规范化与分词、基于前缀树的规则预分类、每个类别的二元确认模型，以及基于动态更新可靠性权重的人工标注循环。实验表明，在受控无泄露设置下，词袋模型已基本饱和任务（F1约0.99），线性分类器与多层感知机性能相当，n-gram特征无增益，约67个标注样本即足够；标注协议中可靠性加权投票仅略优于多数投票，而Dawid-Skene模型恢复标签效果更佳。研究还讨论了价格层面的质量控制和统计机构的设计启示。
Motivation: 消费者价格测量越来越多依赖替代数据源，但这些数据中的产品描述简短、有噪声且无标准编码，必须先映射到消费分类（如COICOP）才能进行价格比较。现有方法缺乏通用性和可复现性。
Method: 提出一个三阶段流水线：(i)文本规范化与分词；(ii)基于每个类别关键词和停用词的前缀树规则预分类器；(iii)每个类别的二元确认模型，决定物品是否属于暂定类别。标签获取采用人类在环协议，标注者给出二元有效/拒绝判断，通过动态更新的可靠性权重聚合；模型可加入同一规则以实现持续微调。
Result: 在受控无泄露实验（一个类别、真实正例vs硬负例、五个随机种子）中，词袋模型基本饱和任务（F1约0.99），线性分类器与MLP性能相当，显式词序（n-gram）特征无额外收益，约67个标注样本即足够。蒙特卡洛模拟显示，可靠性加权投票仅勉强优于简单多数投票（其附加权重饱和），而Dawid-Skene模型恢复标签的效果显著更好。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了词袋模型在该映射任务上的充分性，并指出可靠性加权标注协议相比多数投票优势有限；建议统计机构考虑更复杂的标注聚合方法（如Dawid-Skene）用于标签质量控制。所有结果均为说明性，未涉及专有数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distortion-Aware Fusion of Statistical and Vision-Language Features for Blind Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) aims to predict perceived image quality without access to a reference image. Classical natural scene statistics (NSS) descriptors and modern vision-language model (VLM) embeddings address this problem from fundamentally different perspectives, yet whether combining them yields complementary benefits and how to weight their contributions per input image remains unexplored. We propose a distortion-aware fusion framework that integrates a 138-dimensional NSS descriptor with two complementary VLM embeddings, SigLIP and CLIP-H, through a multiplicative gating mechanism that learns per-input stream weights conditioned on image content. Unlike static concatenation fusion, the proposed gating network suppresses or amplifies each stream's contribution based on the input, producing weights that correlate positively (Spearman rank correlation rho=0.33) with the per-distortion NSS contribution measured by independent ablation on KADID-10k. The framework requires no end-to-end fine-tuning of the VLM backbones and is trained with a hybrid loss combining mean squared error, Pearson linear correlation, and pairwise ranking objectives. We evaluate on three standard benchmarks: KonIQ-10k (SROCC=0.9142, PLCC=0.9279), KADID-10k (SROCC=0.9715, PLCC=0.9733, surpassing recent state-of-the-art methods), and LIVE Challenge in-the-Wild (SROCC=0.8527, PLCC=0.8802 with cross-dataset pretraining and fine-tuning). A per-distortion analysis on KADID-10k reveals that NSS features contribute most on noise and color-shift distortions where pixel statistics are directly affected, and least on perceptual distortions such as color saturation changes. The learned gate values validate these findings, confirming that the model autonomously discovers distortion-stream affinity patterns consistent with the manual per-distortion study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种扭曲感知融合框架，用于盲图像质量评估（BIQA）。该框架将138维自然场景统计（NSS）描述符与SigLIP和CLIP-H两种视觉-语言模型（VLM）嵌入相结合，通过乘法门控机制根据输入内容学习每个流的权重，无需微调VLM主干。在KonIQ-10k（SROCC=0.9142，PLCC=0.9279）、KADID-10k（SROCC=0.9715，PLCC=0.9733，超越当前最优方法）和LIVE Challenge（SROCC=0.8527，PLCC=0.8802）三个基准上进行了评估。每失真分析表明，NSS特征对噪声和色移失真贡献最大，门控权重与NSS贡献呈正相关（Spearman ρ=0.33），验证了模型自动发现失真-流亲和模式的能力。
Motivation: 经典NSS描述符和现代VLM嵌入从不同角度解决BIQA问题，但两者是否互补以及如何针对每个输入自适应加权其贡献尚未被探索。
Method: 提出一种扭曲感知融合框架，集成138维NSS描述符与SigLIP和CLIP-H两种VLM嵌入，通过乘法门控机制学习每个输入的流权重，并采用混合损失（均方误差、皮尔逊线性相关和成对排序目标）训练，无需端到端微调VLM主干。
Result: 在KonIQ-10k上SROCC=0.9142，PLCC=0.9279；在KADID-10k上SROCC=0.9715，PLCC=0.9733，超越近期最优方法；在LIVE Challenge上通过跨数据集预训练和微调达到SROCC=0.8527，PLCC=0.8802。门控权重与每失真NSS贡献的Spearman相关系数为0.33。KADID-10k上的每失真分析显示，NSS对噪声和色移失真贡献最大，对色彩饱和度变化等感知失真贡献最小。
Conclusion: 模型自主学习的门控权重与手动每失真分析结果一致，表明门控机制能够发现失真-流亲和模式，验证了动态融合的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards 3D-Aware Video Diffusion Models: Render-Free Human Motion Control with Mesh Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have shown remarkable success in video generation. However, whether such models are truly aware of the 3D structure underlying visual observations, rather than simply reproducing plausible 2D projections, remains an open question. In this work, we investigate this question through human motion control, a task that requires precise modelling of 3D human geometry, motion, camera viewpoint, and scene context. Unlike prior methods that rely on rendered 2D motion guidance videos, we propose a render-free framework that conditions video generation directly on compressed 3D human mesh tokens. This representation preserves full 3D geometric information while enabling a unified token-based generation pipeline that processes video tokens jointly with motion tokens in a DiT-based architecture. This design requires the model to reason jointly about appearance, 3D structure, and camera viewpoint during video generation. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance on human motion control benchmarks, while reducing artifacts induced by view-dependent 2D guidance and trajectory-pose mismatches during editing. These findings suggest that video diffusion models, when equipped with mesh tokenization, can better capture complex 3D human structures and their interactions with the surrounding environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨视频扩散模型是否真正具备3D结构感知能力，通过人体运动控制任务进行验证。提出一种无渲染框架，直接用压缩的3D人体网格令牌（mesh tokens）条件化视频生成，在DiT架构中联合处理视频令牌和运动令牌。实验表明该方法在人体运动控制基准上表现强，减少了视图相关2D引导和轨迹-姿态不匹配产生的伪影。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型可能只是重现合理的2D投影，而非真正理解3D结构。人体运动控制需要精确建模3D人体几何、运动、相机视角和场景上下文，是检验3D感知能力的合适任务。
Method: 提出无渲染框架，将3D人体网格压缩为令牌，与视频令牌在DiT架构中联合生成，无需渲染2D运动引导视频。
Result: 在人体运动控制基准上取得强性能，减少了由视图相关2D引导和轨迹-姿态不匹配导致的伪影。
Conclusion: 视频扩散模型配备网格令牌化后能更好地捕捉复杂3D人体结构及其与环境的交互，表明模型具备更强的3D感知能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why Do Time Series Models Need Long Context Windows?
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning models for forecasting groups of time series rely on increasingly longer observation windows. However, the benefit of increasing the window size is often simply attributed to capturing long-range dependencies, and broader discussion on how global forecasting models leverage input observations has been limited. In this paper, we show that forecasting groups of time series involves two objectives: (i) generative process identification (GPI), i.e., inferring the specific process generating the input sequence, and (ii) conditional forecasting (CF), i.e., predicting future values given input observations. From this perspective, optimal predictions can be interpreted as an average over plausible data-generating processes, weighted by their likelihood given the input window. This suggests another explanation for the benefits of long context windows: they reduce the uncertainty about which specific process is generating the input time series during operation. We prove that even for processes with memory length $P$, an input window size strictly larger than $P$ is necessary to achieve the minimum attainable error. Finally, we show how decoupling GPI and CF can improve computational scalability without compromising accuracy. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data validate our insights and their relevance for designing forecasting architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论角度解释时间序列预测模型需要长上下文窗口的原因，提出生成过程识别（GPI）和条件预测（CF）两个目标，证明即使过程记忆长度为P，也需要窗口大于P才能达到最小误差。实验验证了该见解。
Motivation: 现有研究通常将长窗口的好处简单归因于捕获长程依赖，缺乏对全局预测模型如何利用输入观测的深入讨论。本文旨在提供更严格的理论解释。
Method: 将时间序列预测分解为GPI和CF，从贝叶斯角度解释长窗口降低关于数据生成过程的不确定性。通过理论证明和实验验证。
Result: 证明对于记忆长度为P的过程，需要窗口大小严格大于P才能达到最小误差；解耦GPI和CF可提升计算可扩展性而不损失精度。实验在合成和真实数据上验证。
Conclusion: 长上下文窗口的好处在于减少过程不确定性，而非仅仅捕获长程依赖；该见解可用于设计更高效的预测架构。

papers.title: MMG2Skill: Can Agents Distill In-the-Wild Guides into Self-Evolving Skills?
papers.abstract_en: Abundant procedural knowledge on the Web holds great potential for helping agents solve long-horizon tasks. However, such knowledge is often multimodal, heterogeneous, noisy, and implicitly assumes human executors, making it difficult to use directly as the skills required by agents. To bridge the gap between human-oriented guides and agent-executable skills, we formalize this problem as guide-to-skill learning: converting in-the-wild guides into executable skills and continuously improving them from trajectories observable to the agent. To evaluate the capability of existing agents on this task, we introduce MMG2Skill-Bench, the first benchmark designed for this problem. We further propose MMG2Skill, a closed-loop framework that compiles guides into editable skills, conditions a fixed vision-language model (VLM) agent on these skills during execution, and revises the skills from trajectory-level root-cause feedback without using benchmark scores. Across GUI control, open-ended gameplay, and strategic card play with six VLM backbones, MMG2Skill consistently outperforms vanilla baseline agents in every model-domain setting, achieving macro-average gains of +12.8 to +25.3 percentage points across backbones. Ablation studies show that directly prompting agents with raw guides can degrade performance, while both structured skill construction and trajectory-driven revision are necessary for the observed improvements. On success-inferable tasks, analyzer-based early stopping further prevents late-stage performance regressions and saves 25%-53% of attempts when the success signal is properly calibrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 guide-to-skill 学习问题，将网络上的多模态指南转换为智能体可执行的技能，并构建了 MMG2Skill-Bench 基准。提出 MMG2Skill 闭环框架，将指南编译为可编辑技能，引导 VLM 智能体执行，并通过轨迹级根因反馈修正技能。在 GUI 控制、开放游戏和策略卡牌等六种 VLM 骨干上，MMG2Skill 相比基线获得宏观平均 +12.8 到 +25.3 个百分点的提升。消融实验表明原始指南直接提示会降低性能，结构化技能构建和轨迹驱动修正均不可或缺。
Motivation: 网络上的程序性知识（如指南）具有潜力，但多模态、异构、噪声且隐含人类执行假设，难以直接用作智能体技能，需要 bridge 人类导向指南和智能体可执行技能之间的 gap。
Method: 提出 closed-loop 框架 MMG2Skill：将指南编译为可编辑技能，固定 VLM 智能体在执行时依赖这些技能，并从轨迹级根因反馈中修正技能，无需使用基准分数。
Result: 在 GUI 控制、开放游戏和策略卡牌上，使用六种 VLM 骨干，MMG2Skill 始终优于基线，宏观平均提升 12.8 到 25.3 个百分点。消融表明原始指南直接提示会降低性能，结构化构建和轨迹驱动修正都必要。
Conclusion: 该框架有效将野生指南转化为可进化技能，并在多种领域取得一致提升。在可推断成功的任务中，基于分析器的早停可防止后期性能退化并节省尝试。

papers.title: A Structured Benchmark for Text-Guided Anomaly Detection: When Language Stops Conditioning the Decision
papers.abstract_en: Industrial anomaly detection has historically been a unimodal task. Recent multimodal vision-language models have produced systems that admit textual input alongside the image and are presented as enabling text-guided zero- and few-shot inspection. Yet these methods are evaluated with protocols inherited from unimodal benchmarks that hold the textual condition constant and therefore cannot measure whether language conditions the decision; whether reported gains reflect text guidance or strong pretrained visual features remains open. We introduce Text-Guided Anomaly Detection (TGAD), a structured benchmark that progressively increases the functional role of language across three scenarios: a controlled prompt-sensitivity setting on MVTec AD; a component-tagged extension of MVTec AD that requires the model to restrict its assessment to an instructed part; and the new Assembled Panel Dataset (APD), a realistic industrial setting that requires both defect-type and component-location knowledge. We evaluate one representative model per paradigm: generative large vision-language, training-free discriminative, and embedding-adaptive discriminative. In all three, the textual interface conditions the decision only superficially: prompt content is absorbed unless the object noun is removed (the generative model's I-AUROC drops from 97.4 to 82.6); component-level instructions do not constrain the decision once defects outside the instructed part are admitted as normal (from 90.3 to 66.3); and when both combine on APD, image-level discrimination collapses below the MVTec level, in one case below chance (71.2, 50.5, 31.5). These results suggest that standard benchmarks overstate the text-guided capabilities of current multimodal anomaly detection systems, and that a protocol of this kind is a prerequisite for models that can be reliably controlled through language for industrial deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出文本引导异常检测（TGAD）基准，逐步增加语言功能角色，评估现有模型发现语言仅表面影响决策，标准基准高估了文本引导能力。
Motivation: 现有多模态异常检测系统声称支持文本引导，但评估协议继承自单模态基准，无法测量语言是否真正影响决策，报告的性能提升可能来自预训练视觉特征而非文本引导。
Method: 提出TGAD基准，包含三个场景：MVTec AD上的受控提示敏感性；组件标注的MVTec AD扩展；新提出的Assembled Panel Dataset (APD)。评估每个范式的代表模型：生成式大视觉语言模型、无训练判别式、嵌入自适应判别式。
Result: 所有模型中文本接口仅表面影响决策：生成模型I-AUROC从97.4降至82.6；组件级指令不约束决策（90.3至66.3）；APD上图像级鉴别崩溃至71.2、50.5、31.5，有时低于随机。
Conclusion: 标准基准高估了当前多模态异常检测系统的文本引导能力，此类协议是可靠语言控制模型工业部署的前提。

papers.title: SafeMCP: Proactive Power Regulation for LLM Agent Defense via Environment-Grounded Look-Ahead Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to operate in complex environments, the expansion of their action spaces offers agents unsafe capabilities and underscores the risk of power-seeking. While broad action space and greater environment influence are essential for task fulfillment, they create a fragile risk surface where minor errors or hallucinations are magnified into catastrophic failures. In response, we propose SafeMCP, a {server-side} defense plugin that constrains tool acquisition via predictive reasoning regarding future safety risks. SafeMCP utilizes an internal world model for look-ahead reasoning to implement a two-tier defense: proactive tool filtering to constrain hazardous power expansion and immediate intervention as a fail-safe. To train SafeMCP, we introduce a three-stage pipeline comprising environmental dynamic grounding, safe policy initialization, and reinforcement learning (RL) with dual verifiable rewards. Experiments on PowerSeeking Bench, ToolEmu, and AgentHarm show that SafeMCP achieves a safe equilibrium, effectively mitigating risks while preserving agent utility.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026), Main Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM代理使用MCP协议时动作空间扩展带来的安全风险，提出SafeMCP，一个服务端防御插件，通过基于未来安全风险的预测推理来约束工具获取。采用内部世界模型进行前瞻推理，实现两层防御：主动工具过滤和即时干预。使用三阶段训练管道：环境动态基础、安全策略初始化、带双重可验证奖励的强化学习。在PowerSeeking Bench等基准上实验表明SafeMCP实现了安全均衡。
Motivation: LLM代理利用MCP协议在复杂环境中操作，导致动作空间扩张带来不安全能力和权力寻求风险，微小错误或幻觉可能放大为灾难性失败。
Method: 提出SafeMCP服务端防御插件，利用内部世界模型进行前瞻推理，实施两层防御：主动工具过滤以约束危险权力扩张，以及即时干预作为故障安全。训练采用三阶段管道：环境动态基础、安全策略初始化、带双重可验证奖励的强化学习。
Result: 在PowerSeeking Bench、ToolEmu和AgentHarm上的实验表明，SafeMCP实现了安全均衡，有效缓解了风险，同时保持了代理效用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SafeMCP通过前瞻推理和分层防御机制，在约束危险权力扩张的同时保持代理效用，是一种有效的安全防护方案。

papers.title: Graph Edit Distance Formulation for the Vehicle Routing Problem: Theory and Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We show that the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) can be reformulated as a Graph Edit Distance (GED) maximization problem. Under a simple edge-deletion cost model, minimizing total route cost is equivalent to maximizing the total weight of edges deleted from the complete instance graph. This formulation models VRP at the edge level, where solutions are defined by selected edges rather than route sequences, enabling structural analyses that are difficult in classical formulations: per-edge attribution of solution quality, decomposition of the optimality gap, characterization of solution sparsity, and identification of edges that are hard to reach by greedy construction. Theoretically, we establish a merge-decomposition theorem showing that Clarke-Wright savings equal per-merge GED increments, and an approximation-transfer theorem that turns GED approximation ratios into VRP cost bounds. Using this reformulation, we analyze 90 CVRP benchmark instances with known optimal solutions. We find that optimal routing graphs use only 5.5% of available edges, that approximately 3.0% of optimal edges are consistently not found by Clarke-Wright heuristics under repeated restarts, and that the cost gap decomposes into missed optimal edges and substituted non-optimal edges of comparable total weight. The edge-additive objective provides a natural per-edge supervision signal for future graph neural network approaches to edge prediction, suggesting a potential connection to graph neural network approaches that we leave for follow-up work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将车辆路径问题（VRP）重新表述为图编辑距离（GED）最大化问题。在简单边删除成本模型下，最小化总路径成本等价于从完全实例图中删除边的总权重最大化。该公式在边级别建模VRP，支持每边解质量归因、最优性间隙分解、稀疏性表征以及识别贪婪构造难以达到的边。理论上建立了合并分解定理和近似转移定理。在90个已知最优解的CVRP基准实例上分析发现，最优路由图仅使用5.5%的可用边，约3.0%的最优边在重复重启的Clarke-Wright启发式中始终未被找到，成本间隙分解为遗漏的最优边和替代的非最优边，两者总权重相当。
Motivation: 现有VRP公式难以进行边级别的结构分析，如每边解质量归因和最优性间隙分解。
Method: 提出将VRP重新表述为GED最大化问题，采用边删除成本模型，并通过合并分解定理和近似转移定理建立理论联系。
Result: 在90个CVRP基准实例上，最优路由图仅用5.5%的边，约3.0%的最优边始终未被Clarke-Wright启发式找到，成本间隙由遗漏最优边和替代非最优边组成。
Conclusion: 边可加目标为未来的图神经网络方法提供了自然的每边监督信号，但具体的GNN实现留待后续工作。

papers.title: MT-EditFlow: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing with Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs in instruction-based image editing have captured significant attention, as models are now capable of handling real-world editing demands with the practicality required by everyday users. However, editing models trained primarily for single-turn edits often break down in multi-turn editing--the natural interactive setting where a user iteratively refines an image based on the model's own previous outputs. This failure stems from the all-or-nothing requirement, where a single failed turn compromises the entire sequence, and error propagation, where exposure bias leads to compounding editing errors. To address these challenges, we introduce MT-EditFlow, a flow-matching reinforcement learning framework designed to optimize reward signals for sequential image editing. MT-EditFlow integrates a multi-turn perspective with a multi-reward formulation to provide a unified structure applicable to both GRPO and NFT-based reinforcement learning methods. We systematically analyze and optimize the reward signal by investigating effective scoring strategies for turn-level aggregation, VLM reasoning modes to trade off reward bias and variance, and advantage fusion levels to prevent reward hacking. Our findings reveal that broadcasting the aggregated advantage across the entire editing trajectory effectively bridges the gap between local planning and global multi-turn task success. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MT-EditFlow significantly improves performance across diverse base models. Notably, it boosts FLUX.1-Kontext-dev by 6.85 points in turn-3 overall performance, surpassing state-of-the-art open-source models such as Qwen-Image-Edit. By maintaining high marginal success rates and reducing exposure bias, MT-EditFlow provides a foundation for more reliable and natural human-AI collaboration in visual content creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MT-EditFlow，一个基于流匹配强化学习的多轮图像编辑框架，旨在解决单轮编辑模型在多轮交互中因单次失败和误差累积导致性能下降的问题。通过多奖励信号优化、回合级聚合策略、VLM推理模式权衡以及优势融合，MT-EditFlow显著提升多轮编辑的总体性能，例如在FLUX.1-Kontext-dev上使第三轮总体性能提升6.85分，超越现有开源模型。
Motivation: 现有指令式图像编辑模型主要针对单轮编辑训练，在多轮交互中因单次失败导致整个序列失效，且曝光偏差引发误差累积，无法满足实际用户迭代编辑的需求。
Method: 提出MT-EditFlow框架，集成多轮视角与多奖励公式，支持GRPO和基于NFT的强化学习方法；通过策略梯度优化奖励信号，重点研究了回合级评分聚合策略、VLM推理模式对奖励偏差与方差的影响，以及优势融合层级以防止奖励破解。
Result: 实验表明MT-EditFlow显著提升多种基础模型的多轮编辑性能，在FLUX.1-Kontext-dev上第三轮总体性能提高6.85分，超过Qwen-Image-Edit等开源模型，并保持高边际成功率和降低曝光偏差。
Conclusion: MT-EditFlow为更可靠、自然的人机协作视觉内容创作奠定了基础，揭示了跨整个编辑轨迹广播聚合优势能弥合局部规划与全局多轮任务成功之间的差距。

summary_sections.method: 提出MT-EditFlow框架，集成多轮视角与多奖励公式，支持GRPO和基于NFT的强化学习方法；通过策略梯度优化奖励信号，重点研究了回合级评分聚合策略、VLM推理模式对奖励偏差与方差的影响，以及优势融合层级以防止奖励破解。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明MT-EditFlow显著提升多种基础模型的多轮编辑性能，在FLUX.1-Kontext-dev上第三轮总体性能提高6.85分，超过Qwen-Image-Edit等开源模型，并保持高边际成功率和降低曝光偏差。
summary_sections.conclusion: MT-EditFlow为更可靠、自然的人机协作视觉内容创作奠定了基础，揭示了跨整个编辑轨迹广播聚合优势能弥合局部规划与全局多轮任务成功之间的差距。

papers.title: An NLP-Driven Framework for Curriculum-Labor Market Alignment: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction, ESCO-Anchored Semantic Matching, and Multi-Dimensional Gap Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Schema-constrained information extraction from diverse educational and labor-market corpora remains an open challenge in natural language processing because existing pipelines rely primarily on lexical-surface methods that cannot recover implicit competencies, lack grounding in shared taxonomies, and provide no formal measures of extraction reliability or document-level completeness. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a four-stage NLP framework that combines (i) schema-constrained prompting of a two-model frontier-LLM ensemble against a JSON Schema-enforced seven-slot competency formalism, (ii) Sentence-BERT (SBERT) alignment of the extracted records against an eleven-domain ESCO v1.2.1 controlled vocabulary, (iii) a two-tier adjudication protocol that resolves inter-model disagreements, and (iv) a verification mechanism that combines per-slot Cohen's kappa, schema conformance, and document-level completeness audits. The framework is instantiated for a critical application in higher-education quality assurance, namely curriculum-labor market alignment for the ABET-accredited BSc Computer Science program at the United Arab Emirates University. The pipeline extracts 400 competency records from the 85-course 2025-2026 study plan and aligns them, under a five-scope analysis ranging from the computing core to a probability-weighted student trajectory, with 30 job postings (483 requirement clauses) at an SBERT cosine threshold of 0.50. The extractor achieves Cohen's kappa of 0.79 on the skill slot, with 100% schema conformance and 100% document-level completeness. The alignment surfaces interpretable supply-demand gaps of 25.0% in general and transversal skills, 13.8% in algorithms and computational theory, and 12.2% in software engineering and project management, with a near-zero 1.8% gap in artificial intelligence and data science despite 38.6% supply coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个四阶段NLP框架，结合模式约束的大语言模型提取、ESCO锚定的语义匹配和多维度差距量化，用于课程与劳动力市场的对齐。在阿联酋大学的计算机科学项目中应用，提取400条能力记录并与30个职位描述对齐，在技能槽上达到Cohen's kappa 0.79，发现了可解释的供需差距。
Motivation: 现有教育-劳动力市场对齐方法依赖词汇表面匹配，无法恢复隐含能力，缺乏共享分类法，且没有提取可靠性或文档完整性的正式度量。
Method: 采用四阶段框架：(i) 基于JSON Schema的七槽能力形式化，使用双模型前沿LLM集成进行模式约束提示提取；(ii) Sentence-BERT将提取记录与ESCO v1.2.1受控词汇对齐；(iii) 两阶段裁决协议解决模型间分歧；(iv) 结合每槽Cohen's kappa、模式一致性和文档完整性审计的验证机制。
Result: 在85门课程的2025-2026学习计划和30份职位发布（483条要求子句）上测试，技能槽Cohen's kappa为0.79，模式一致性和文档完整性均为100%。对齐显示通用和横向技能供需差距25.0%，算法和计算理论13.8%，软件工程和项目管理12.2%，人工智能和数据科学仅1.8%。
Conclusion: 该框架能够有效量化课程与劳动力市场之间的多维差距，为高等教育质量保障提供可解释的分析工具。

papers.title: Generalization Limits in Vehicle Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle re-identification focuses on retrieving images of the same vehicle from a gallery given a query image. Upon closer inspection of commonly used datasets, we observe that vehicles with few visual differences-e.g., the same make, model, and color-appear in both the training and test sets. As a result, methods that effectively memorize the training data tend to perform well on these test sets but struggle to generalize to other datasets. In this paper, we address this issue by proposing a novel evaluation approach that more effectively measures generalization capability to unseen vehicle types. To further study generalization performance, we also propose splitting the evaluation based on view, allowing us to differentiate the effect of viewpoint robustness from that of same-view re-identification. Our findings reveal that most state-of-the-art methods struggle with unseen vehicle types, and that their robustness to viewpoint changes and attention to detail are limited to vehicle types seen during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究车辆重识别（vehicle re-identification）中的泛化极限。通过分析常用数据集，发现训练和测试集中存在视觉差异极小的车辆（相同品牌、型号、颜色），导致记忆训练数据的方法在测试集上表现良好但难以泛化到其他数据集。作者提出一种新的评估方法以更有效地衡量对未见车型的泛化能力，并基于视角拆分评估。结果表明，大多数最先进方法对未见车型表现不佳，对视角变化和细节的关注仅限于训练中见过的车型。
Motivation: 现有车辆重识别数据集存在训练集和测试集车辆视觉差异过小的问题，导致模型通过记忆而非泛化获得高分数，从而高估了实际泛化能力。需要更准确的评估方法衡量模型对未见车型的泛化能力。
Method: 提出一种新的评估方法，通过确保测试集中的车辆类型在训练集中未出现来测量泛化能力；同时基于视角拆分评估，区分视角鲁棒性与同视角重识别的影响。
Result: 大多数最先进方法在未见车型上表现不佳，对视角变化和细节的鲁棒性仅限于训练中见过的车型。
Conclusion: 当前车辆重识别方法的泛化能力有限，尤其对未见车型和视角变化，需要更强调泛化性能的评估方法和模型设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Algorithmic algorithm development with LLMs: A Case Study on LLM-Usage for Contraction Order Optimization in Tensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: We consider LLM-based algorithm development through a case study on contractionorder optimisation for tensor networks with OpenEvolve. We pay particular attention to the choice of the LLM as well as design choices such as evaluation metric and test instances. Our results highlight both the promise of verifier-guided evolutionary coding agents for algorithm development/improvement and the continuing importance of evaluation, validation, and interpretation -- and corresponding challenges -- by the human scientist.
papers.comment: Submitted to the proceedings of the deRSE26 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过张量网络收缩顺序优化案例，研究如何使用LLM辅助算法开发。重点关注LLM选择、评估指标和测试实例设计。结果表明验证者引导的进化编码智能体在算法开发/改进方面有潜力，同时强调人类科学家在评估、验证和解释方面的持续重要性。
Motivation: 探索LLM在算法开发中的应用潜力，特别是对于传统上需要大量人工设计的组合优化问题（如张量网络收缩顺序优化）。
Method: 采用基于LLM的进化编码智能体（verifier-guided evolutionary coding agents），在OpenEvolve框架下进行案例研究，并分析LLM类型、评估指标和测试实例等设计选择的影响。
Result: 验证者引导的进化编码方法在改善张量网络收缩顺序方面显示出潜力，但结果也揭示了依赖LLM时评估、验证和人工解释的重要性。
Conclusion: LLM可以辅助算法开发，但人类科学家的监督和判断仍然不可或缺。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Closer Look at In-Distribution vs. Out-of-Distribution Accuracy for Open-Set Test-time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Open-set test-time adaptation (TTA) updates models on new data in the presence of input shifts and unknown output classes. While recent methods have made progress on improving in-distribution (InD) accuracy for known classes, their ability to accurately detect out-of-distribution (OOD) unknown classes remains underexplored. We benchmark robust and open-set TTA methods (SAR, OSTTA, UniEnt, and SoTTA) on the standard corruption benchmarks of CIFAR-10-C at the small scale and ImageNet-C at the large scale. For CIFAR-10-C, we use OOD data from SVHN and CIFAR-100 in their respective corrupted forms of SVHN-C and CIFAR-100-C. For ImageNet-C, we use OOD data from ImageNet-O and Textures in their respective corrupted forms of ImageNet-O-C and Textures-C. ImageNet-O is nearer to ImageNet, as unknown but related object classes (like ''garlic bread'' vs. ''hot dog'' for food, or ''highway'' vs. ''dam'' for infrastructure), while Textures is farther from ImageNet, as non-object patterns (like ''cracked'' mud, ''porous'' sponge, ''veined'' leaves). We evaluate the accuracy and confidence of TTA methods for InD vs. OOD recognition on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C. We verify the accuracy of each method's own OOD detection technique on CIFAR-10-C. We also evaluate on ImageNet-C and report both accuracy and standard OOD detection metrics. We further examine more realistic settings, in which the proportions and rates of OOD data can vary. To explore the trade-off between InD recognition and OOD rejection, we propose a new baseline that replaces softmax/multi-class output with sigmoid/multi-label output. Our analysis shows for the first time that current open-set TTA methods struggle to balance InD and OOD accuracy and that they only imperfectly filter OOD data for their own adaptation updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了开放集测试时自适应（Open-set TTA）方法在分布内（InD）准确率与分布外（OOD）检测能力之间的权衡。通过在CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C上的基准测试，评估了SAR、OSTTA、UniEnt和SoTTA等方法，并引入多标签输出基线以探索权衡。结果表明现有方法难以同时平衡InD和OOD准确率，且对OOD数据的过滤不完善。
Motivation: 现有开放集TTA方法主要改进已知类别的分布内准确率，但缺乏对未知类别检测能力的深入分析，尤其在不同OOD数据分布下InD与OOD准确率的权衡尚未明确。
Method: 基准测试四种开放集TTA方法（SAR、OSTTA、UniEnt、SoTTA）在CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C上，使用SVHN-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-O-C和Textures-C作为OOD数据。提出一种使用sigmoid/多标签输出替代softmax/多类输出的新基线，以显式分析InD与OOD的权衡。
Result: 实验表明，当前方法难以同时保持高InD准确率和OOD检测能力，且对OOD数据的过滤不完全，导致自适应更新受污染。多标签基线在权衡中提供了更直接的调节。
Conclusion: 开放集TTA方法在平衡InD和OOD准确率方面存在根本性挑战，现有OOD检测技术不足以过滤数据，需要新的设计来同时满足两种目标。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AutoMedBench: Towards Medical AutoResearch with Agentic AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents are increasingly expected to support end-to-end medical-AI research workflows, moving beyond isolated prediction tasks or short-form clinical question answering. However, existing medical agent benchmarks primarily evaluate final outputs, providing limited visibility into agent behavior within the research process. To address this gap, we present AutoMedBench, a workflow-aware benchmark for autonomous medical-AI research across diverse medical imaging and multimodal inference tasks, organizing agent execution into a unified five-stage workflow (S1-S5): Plan, Setup, Validate, Inference, and Submit. It comprises long-horizon tasks with each run averaging 33 agent turns, spanning five research tracks: segmentation, image enhancement, visual question answering (VQA), report generation, and lesion detection. Each task is evaluated under two difficulty tiers, Lite and Standard, which use the same data and metrics but differ in the amount of task-brief scaffolding, and each run is scored using both final task performance and S1-S5 stage scores, enabling stage-level analysis from the initial task brief to the final submitted artifact. Across thousands of recorded runs, stage-level scoring reveals that Validate is the weakest workflow stage on average, whereas Setup is the strongest, suggesting that current agents are better at making pipelines executable than at verifying their reliability. Post-run error analysis further shows that verification and submission failures dominate tagged errors, accounting for 37.7% and 38.1% of fired codes respectively, whereas task-understanding errors are rare at 0.9%, and runs with one fired error code have a 48% lower overall score than runs with no error code on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoMedBench 是一个面向自主医疗AI研究的工作流感知基准，将代理执行组织为统一的五阶段流程（计划、设置、验证、推理、提交），涵盖分割、图像增强、视觉问答、报告生成和病变检测五个研究轨道的长时任务。通过数千次运行，阶段级评分显示验证阶段最弱，设置阶段最强，代理在执行流水线方面优于验证可靠性。
Motivation: 现有医疗代理基准主要评估最终输出，缺乏对代理在研究过程中行为的可见性，因此需要工作流感知的基准来深入分析代理行为。
Method: 提出 AutoMedBench，包含五个研究轨道，每个任务分为 Lite 和 Standard 两个难度等级，使用相同数据和指标但任务简报脚手架不同，并通过最终任务性能和 S1-S5 阶段评分进行双重评估。
Result: 验证阶段是平均最弱的环节，设置阶段最强；验证和提交失败占错误代码的 37.7% 和 38.1%，而任务理解错误仅占 0.9%。
Conclusion: 当前自主代理在使流水线可执行方面表现良好，但在验证可靠性方面存在明显不足，未来需改进代理的验证能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 验证阶段是平均最弱的环节，设置阶段最强；验证和提交失败占错误代码的 37.7% 和 38.1%，而任务理解错误仅占 0.9%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前自主代理在使流水线可执行方面表现良好，但在验证可靠性方面存在明显不足，未来需改进代理的验证能力。

papers.title: WALL-WM: Carving World Action Modeling at the Event Joints
papers.abstract_en: WALL-WM is a World Action Model that shifts video-action learning from chunk-centric optimization to event-grounded Vision-Language-Action pretraining, using semantically coherent action events as the atomic unit of learning. Existing WAMs commonly initialize from multimodal or video foundation models and then optimize fixed-length action chunks conditioned directly on the current observation and instruction. Although convenient, this chunk-centric formulation creates a fundamental granularity mismatch. Language describes semantic goals and events, vision evolves through continuous scene dynamics, and actions operate at control-level timescales; forcing all three into the same fixed-length prediction window turns VLA training into short-horizon correlation fitting. WALL-WM addresses this mismatch by organizing both supervision and data around semantic events. Specifically, it pairs event-grounded VLA pretraining with a data ecosystem built from event-level captions and cluster-balanced sampling, enabling scalable learning over diverse behaviors, scenes, and task structures. From the same event-pretrained backbone, WALL-WM supports two complementary inference modes. The event mode consumes next-event descriptions and enables variable-length execution chunks, while the unified mode uses a VLM with Staircase Decoding to condition conventional fixed-length chunk inference while preserving a gradient-continuous VLA path. Together with Muon-optimizer-based large-scale pretraining infrastructure, WALL-WM provides a practical scale-up recipe for general-purpose WAMs. Experiments show that WALL-WM generalizes broadly across language, scenes, and tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance in large-scale real-world generalization evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WALL-WM 是一种世界行动模型 (World Action Model)，它将视频-动作学习从基于固定长度块 (chunk) 的优化转变为基于语义事件 (event) 的视觉-语言-动作预训练。现有模型将语言、视觉和动作强制对齐到固定窗口，导致粒度不匹配；WALL-WM 通过事件级标注和聚类平衡采样构建数据生态，并支持事件模式（变长执行）和统一模式（结合 VLM 与阶梯解码）。实验表明该方法在真实世界大规模泛化评估中达到当前最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 以固定长度块为优化单元，但语言描述语义事件、视觉反映连续场景、动作运行于控制时间尺度，三者的粒度不匹配使 VLA 训练退化为短视的相关性拟合。
Method: 以语义事件为原子学习单位，设计事件驱动的 VLA 预训练流程，配套事件级描述与聚类平衡采样的数据生态；推理时提供事件模式（变长执行）与统一模式（VLM 加阶梯解码）。
Result: 摘要报告 WALL-WM 在多个真实世界场景下超越基线，实现了跨语言、场景和任务的广泛泛化，达到大规模评估中的 SOTA 性能。
Conclusion: WALL-WM 将事件结构融入 VLA 预训练，为通用世界行动模型提供了可规模化的训练方案。

papers.title: Flow-Transformed Implicit Processes for Function-Space Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: Implicit-process priors define distributions over functions through flexible generative mechanisms, making them attractive for Bayesian function-space modelling. However, performing posterior inference with such priors is challenging because their induced function-space distributions are typically not available in closed form. One practical strategy is to approximate the prior using a finite collection of sampled functions, and then represent posterior functions as learned combinations of these samples. Existing approaches commonly place a Gaussian variational distribution over the combination weights. While tractable, this choice limits the shapes of posterior uncertainty that can be represented, especially when the true posterior is asymmetric, heavy-tailed, or multimodal. We propose Flow-Transformed Implicit Processes (FTIP), a variational inference method that makes this finite-dimensional function-space approximation more expressive. Instead of using a Gaussian distribution over the combination weights, FTIP uses a normalizing flow to define a richer variational distribution. This induces a flexible posterior distribution over functions while preserving tractable optimization. We train the model using a Black-Box α objective, allowing us to compare mass-covering and mode-seeking variational behaviour. Experiments show that FTIP captures asymmetric and multimodal posterior structure in function space that Gaussian coefficient approximations tend to smooth or collapse.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Pre-print submitted for revision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flow-Transformed Implicit Processes (FTIP)，一种用于函数空间变分推断的新方法。通过在有限函数基展开的组合权重上应用归一化流 (normalizing flow) 而非传统高斯分布，FTIP 能够表示非对称、重尾或多模态的后验不确定性。实验表明，FTIP 在捕捉函数空间复杂后验结构上优于高斯系数近似，避免后验平滑或坍塌。
Motivation: 隐过程先验 (implicit-process priors) 在函数空间贝叶斯建模中有吸引力，但后验推断困难。现有方法将先验近似为有限采样函数的组合，并对组合权重施加高斯变分分布，这限制了后验不确定性的形状，尤其是当真实后验非对称、重尾或多模态时。
Method: 提出 FTIP，使用归一化流定义组合权重的变分分布，代替传统的高斯分布，从而诱导更灵活的函数空间后验。优化目标采用黑盒 α 散度 (Black-Box α objective)，可在质量覆盖 (mass-covering) 和模式寻找 (mode-seeking) 行为间权衡。
Result: 实验中，FTIP 在合成和真实数据集上捕捉到函数空间的非对称和多模态后验结构，而高斯系数近似导致后验平滑或坍塌。
Conclusion: FTIP 通过归一化流增强了有限维函数空间变分近似的表达能力，为贝叶斯函数空间建模提供了一种更灵活的推断方法。

papers.title: Randomized Least Squares Value Iteration itself is Joint Differentially Private
papers.abstract_en: As reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly applies to sensitive domains, such as health care and recommendation systems, privacy-preserving techniques have become essential to protect users' sensitive information. We investigate privacy-preserving RL under an episodic setting, focusing on algorithms based on randomized exploration, such as Randomized Least Squares Value Iteration (RLSVI). The overall goal is to study how randomized exploration interacts with the injected noise required by privacy mechanisms. In this work, we show a new privacy analysis that characterizes how the noise in RLSVI set for exploration simultaneously provides privacy protection. Specifically, we prove that RLSVI is $(\varepsilon(δ),δ)$-joint differentially private in tabular MDP as is with $\varepsilon(δ) = \frac{2AK}{H^2\log(2HSA)} + 2\sqrt{\frac{2AK\log(1/δ)}{H^2\log(2HSA)}}$, where $S$ and $A$ are the number of states and actions respectively, $H$ is the length of an episode and $K$ is the number of episodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习中的隐私保护，证明基于随机探索的算法RLSVI（随机最小二乘值迭代）本身即满足联合差分隐私，无需额外噪声注入。作者在表格型MDP下给出了隐私参数的具体表达式。
Motivation: 强化学习在敏感领域的应用需要隐私保护，现有方法通常依赖额外噪声，但随机探索算法本身产生的噪声是否足够提供隐私保障尚未明确。
Method: 通过新的隐私分析，证明RLSVI在探索过程中引入的噪声本身即可提供联合差分隐私，推导出隐私参数界。
Result: 证明RLSVI在表格MDP中自然满足(ε(δ),δ)-联合差分隐私，其中ε(δ) = 2AK/(H^2 log(2HSA)) + 2√(2AK log(1/δ)/(H^2 log(2HSA)))。
Conclusion: RLSVI的随机探索噪声同时提供了隐私保护，无需额外机制，为隐私保护强化学习提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Action-Conditional and Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting World Models for Rigid Objects
papers.abstract_en: World models enable intelligent agents to predict the consequences of their actions on the environment. In this paper, we propose Multi Rigid Object Gaussian World Model (MRO-GWM), a novel model that learns action-conditional dynamics of rigid objects in 3D. By representing the scene by object-centric Gaussians, we can represent arbitrary object shapes and multi-object scenes. We develop a novel spatio-temporal transformer architecture that predicts future rigid body motion from a history of object Gaussians and future actions. Objects are represented by their Gaussians in a canonical frame, which allows for describing object motion as rigid body transformation. Our model is trained on reconstructions from multiple viewpoints, which requires the model to handle partial observations of objects due to occlusions. We analyze prediction performance of our approach on synthetic datasets composed of typical household objects with multi-object dynamics and interactions by a robot end effector. We also evaluate our model in model-predictive control for non-prehensile manipulation in simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多刚体对象高斯世界模型 (MRO-GWM)，利用对象中心高斯表示场景，通过时空 transformer 从历史高斯和未来动作预测刚体对象的未来运动。模型在合成数据集上评估预测性能，并用于模拟中的非抓取操作模型预测控制。
Motivation: 世界模型需要预测动作对环境的影响，现有方法在表示任意形状的刚体对象和多对象场景方面存在局限。
Method: 采用对象中心高斯表示，每个对象在规范帧中以高斯表征，运动描述为刚体变换。构建时空 transformer 架构，输入历史对象高斯和未来动作，输出未来刚体运动。模型通过多视角重建训练，处理遮挡下的部分观测。
Result: 在包含典型家居对象、多对象动力学和机器人末端执行器交互的合成数据集上分析了预测性能，并在仿真中用于非抓取操作的模型预测控制评估。
Conclusion: 对象中心高斯世界模型能有效学习刚体动力学，为机器人操作规划提供一种新方案。

papers.title: Rank-Constrained Deep Matrix Completion for Group Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: The growing popularity of group activities has increased the need for methods that provide recommendations to groups of users given their individual preferences. Many existing group recommender systems rely on aggregating individual user preferences, but they often struggle with high-dimensional and highly sparse rating data commonly found in real-world scenarios. We propose Group Rank-Constrained Deep Matrix Completion (Group RC-DMC), a novel framework that extends RC-DMC by integrating group-level representation learning via a Set-Transformer aggregator, jointly leveraging low-rank structure and attention-based nonlinear modeling. Unlike most existing group recommender systems, Group RC-DMC unifies explicit low-rank regularization, linear encoder-decoder architectures, and attention-based nonlinear group modeling within a single framework, yielding accurate predictions at both the individual and group levels. Group RC-DMC addresses data sparsity through low-rank matrix completion, computing per-user latent representations from observed ratings only, and enforcing a rank constraint on the latent space using a nuclear-norm proximal step based on periodic singular value thresholding. The decoder is parametrized as a low-rank factorization, enabling efficient inference. Experimental results on the MovieLens and Goodbooks datasets demonstrate that Group RC-DMC achieves superior reconstruction accuracy, measured by lower group RMSE, while remaining computationally efficient and competitive in group-level performance in terms of precision, recall, and F1 score compared with weighted-before-factorization (WBF) and after-factorization (AF) baselines. The results highlight the model's ability to recover the underlying low-rank structure of user-item interactions and provide robust group recommendations across small, medium, and large user groups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Group Rank-Constrained Deep Matrix Completion (Group RC-DMC) 框架，通过低秩矩阵补全和 Set-Transformer 注意力聚合器实现群组推荐，在 MovieLens 和 Goodbooks 数据集上取得了优于基线方法的群组 RMSE、精确率、召回率和 F1 分数。
Motivation: 现有群组推荐系统在处理高维稀疏评分数据时性能下降，且缺乏同时利用低秩结构和非线性建模的统一框架。
Method: 将 RC-DMC 扩展为群组版本，引入 Set-Transformer 聚合器进行群组表示学习，通过核范数近端步 (proximal step) 施加秩约束，使用低秩因子化解码器进行高效推理。
Result: 在 MovieLens 和 Goodbooks 数据集上，Group RC-DMC 在群组 RMSE 上低于加权前分解 (WBF) 和加权后分解 (AF) 基线，并在精确率、召回率和 F1 上达到竞争水平。
Conclusion: 该模型能有效恢复用户-物品交互的低秩结构，对小、中、大群组均提供鲁棒的推荐性能，且计算高效。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Pretrained Models for Instance Segmentation Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Research and applications in artificial intelligence have recently shifted with the rise of large pretrained models, which deliver state-of-the-art results across numerous tasks. However, the substantial increase in parameters introduces a need for parameter-efficient training strategies. Despite significant advancements, limited research has explored parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods in the context of transformer-based models for instance segmentation. Addressing this gap, this study investigates the effectiveness of PEFT methods, specifically adapters and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), applied to two models across four benchmark datasets. Integrating sequentially arranged adapter modules and applying LoRA to deformable attention--explored here for the first time--achieves competitive performance while fine-tuning only about 1-6% of model parameters, a marked improvement over the 40-55% required in traditional fine-tuning. Key findings indicate that using 2-3 adapters per transformer block offers an optimal balance of performance and efficiency. Furthermore, LoRA, exhibits strong parameter efficiency when applied to deformable attention, and in certain cases surpasses adapter configurations. These results show that the impact of PEFT techniques varies based on dataset complexity and model architecture, underscoring the importance of context-specific tuning. Overall, this work demonstrates the potential of PEFT to enable scalable, customizable, and computationally efficient transfer learning for instance segmentation tasks.
papers.comment: Published by the Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction Journal
papers.journal_ref: Abou Baker N, Rohrschneider D, Handmann U. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Pretrained Models for Instance Segmentation Tasks. Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction. 2024; 6(4):2783-2807
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了参数高效微调（PEFT）方法（适配器和LoRA）在大型预训练Transformer模型上的实例分割任务中的应用。通过在可变形注意力上首次应用LoRA，并在每个Transformer块中集成2-3个适配器，仅微调1-6%的参数即可达到与全参数微调（40-55%参数）竞争的性能。实验在四个基准数据集上进行，结果表明PEFT的效果依赖于数据集复杂度和模型架构。
Motivation: 大型预训练模型的参数规模激增，使得参数高效训练策略变得必要。然而，针对基于Transformer的实例分割任务，PEFT方法的研究仍然有限。
Method: 研究了适配器和LoRA两种PEFT方法，其中对可变形注意力（deformable attention）应用LoRA是首次尝试；适配器以序列方式插入每个Transformer块中。
Result: 仅微调1-6%的参数即可达到与全参数微调（40-55%）相当的性能；每个Transformer块使用2-3个适配器达到最佳平衡；LoRA在可变形注意力上展现出更强的参数效率，某些情况下优于适配器配置。
Conclusion: PEFT方法在实例分割中具有实现可扩展、可定制和计算高效迁移学习的潜力，但效果因数据集复杂度和模型架构而异。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究了参数高效微调（PEFT）方法（适配器和LoRA）在大型预训练Transformer模型上的实例分割任务中的应用。通过在可变形注意力上首次应用LoRA，并在每个Transformer块中集成2-3个适配器，仅微调1-6%的参数即可达到与全参数微调（40-55%参数）竞争的性能。实验在四个基准数据集上进行，结果表明PEFT的效果依赖于数据集复杂度和模型架构。
summary_sections.motivation: 大型预训练模型的参数规模激增，使得参数高效训练策略变得必要。然而，针对基于Transformer的实例分割任务，PEFT方法的研究仍然有限。
summary_sections.method: 研究了适配器和LoRA两种PEFT方法，其中对可变形注意力（deformable attention）应用LoRA是首次尝试；适配器以序列方式插入每个Transformer块中。
summary_sections.result: 仅微调1-6%的参数即可达到与全参数微调（40-55%）相当的性能；每个Transformer块使用2-3个适配器达到最佳平衡；LoRA在可变形注意力上展现出更强的参数效率，某些情况下优于适配器配置。
summary_sections.conclusion: PEFT方法在实例分割中具有实现可扩展、可定制和计算高效迁移学习的潜力，但效果因数据集复杂度和模型架构而异。

papers.title: Beyond Low-Rank: Low-Rank Sparse Prompting via Spiking Neural Network and Prompt Factorization
papers.abstract_en: Visual Prompting (VP) has emerged as an efficient paradigm for adapting large-scale pre-trained vision models to downstream tasks by incorporating learnable prompts at the input level. However, existing VP methods typically employ dense pixel-level prompts, which often suffer from redundant perturbations, limited generalization and energy inefficiency. To overcome these limitations, we propose to integrate brain-inspired spiking learning into visual prompt learning tasks. As we know that spiking neuron can perform inexpensive information processing by transmitting the input data into discrete spike trains and return sparse outputs. Inspired by this, we propose \textbf{Lo}w-\textbf{R}ank visual \textbf{S}pike \textbf{P}rompting (LoRSP), a novel framework that learns dynamic low-rank sparse visual prompts naturally via a Spiking neuron learning mechanism. The core idea of LoRSP is to exploit the brain-inspired sparse firing mechanism of spiking neurons to generate pixel-level sparse prompt for each instance. To be specific, we first construct a series of prompt factors via low-rank factorization to capture distinct prompt subspaces. These prompt factors are then fed into an SNN architecture, which performs the integrate-and-fire process to emit spikes. As a result, our LoRSP generates a \emph{sparse} visual prompt while maintaining the low-rank constraint. This design enables instance-specific selective prompting, leading to more compact and robust adaptation across diverse downstream tasks. Extensive experiments on five heterogeneous vision backbones and multiple benchmarks demonstrate that LoRSP achieves competitive performance while requiring fewer tunable parameters compared to existing VP methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LoRSP（Low-Rank visual Spike Prompting）框架，利用脉冲神经网络的稀疏发放机制生成低秩稀疏视觉提示，替代传统的密集像素提示。该方法通过低秩分解构建提示因子，再经SNN的整合与发放过程产生稀疏提示，实现实例级选择性提示，在多个视觉骨干和基准上以更少参数达到竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉提示方法通常使用密集像素提示，存在冗余扰动、泛化有限和能效低的问题。
Method: 提出LoRSP框架，先通过低秩分解构建一组提示因子，再将其输入脉冲神经网络（SNN）执行整合-发放过程，生成稀疏的视觉提示，同时保持低秩约束。
Result: 在五个异构视觉骨干和多个基准上的实验表明，LoRSP以更少的可调参数达到与现有方法竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该设计实现了实例级选择性提示，带来更紧凑、更鲁棒的视觉提示适应。

papers.title: SCAPO: Self-Supervised Category-Level Articulated Pose Estimation from a Single 3D Observation
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for category-level object articulation from a single 3D observation often rely on dense supervision, multi-frame inputs, or CAD templates, and still struggle to disentangle geometry from articulation or to recover explicit joint parameters. We propose SCAPO, a self-supervised framework that estimates canonical geometry, rigid part segmentation, and joint pivots, axes, and articulation states from a single RGB-D observation without ground-truth labels or category-specific models. Our SCAPO first uses an SE(3)-equivariant vector-neuron autoencoder to factor out global pose and align diverse instances into a shared canonical space. On this aligned shape, a joint-aware blend-skinning module is then designed to model part motion. We learn this representation through cycle reconstruction between observed and canonical shapes and cross-space alignment with a learnable canonical template that decouples shared category geometry from instance-specific residual shape. Experiments on synthetic and real articulated-object datasets show that our SCAPO recovers consistent part structure and accurate articulation parameters and outperforms all self-supervised baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCAPO是一个自监督框架，从单次RGB-D观测中估计类别级铰接物体的规范几何、刚性部件分割、关节枢轴、轴和关节状态，无需真实标签或类别特定模型。它利用SE(3)-等变向量神经元自编码器消除全局姿态，通过关节感知混合蒙皮模块建模部件运动，并通过循环重建和跨空间对齐学习表示。在合成和真实数据集上，SCAPO恢复了一致的部件结构和准确的关节参数，超越了所有自监督基线。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖密集监督、多帧输入或CAD模板，难以从单次观测中解缠几何与关节，或恢复显式关节参数。
Method: 提出自监督框架SCAPO，包含SE(3)-等变向量神经元自编码器对齐规范空间，以及关节感知混合蒙皮模块建模部件运动；通过观测-规范形状的循环重建和可学习规范模板的跨空间对齐进行学习。
Result: 在合成和真实铰接物体数据集上，SCAPO恢复一致的部件结构和准确的关节参数，性能优于所有自监督基线。
Conclusion: SCAPO证明了无需监督即可从单视点RGB-D恢复类别级关节参数的有效性。

papers.title: SAVMap: Structure-Aided Visual Mapping of Large-Scale 2.5D Manhattan Wireframes from Panoramic Video
papers.abstract_en: Precise 3D representations of industrial environments enable tasks such as robot localization and digital twin generation. We propose SAVMap, a method for generating a semantic wireframe map of warehouse shelf and light structures using only a panoramic video camera as the sensor input. Sequences of rectified images with shelf and ceiling-facing views are extracted from a panoramic video captured along the warehouse aisles. Using a semantic segmentation network front end, a set of sparse, semantic structure feature points (e.g., corners of shelf structures, centers of lights) are extracted from each image and tracked across the sequences. By accounting for real-world geometric relationships among the points such as Manhattan grids, a constrained structure-from-motion algorithm yields the 3D points that form a wireframe map. We demonstrate the scalability and accuracy of our proposal in a warehouse with 46 shelving rows, each with faces spanning 55\,m by 7\,m. From an hour of panoramic video content, we create wireframe maps for over 5000 shelf elements across the rows, achieving an aggregate mean absolute error of 4.8\,cm with respect to ground-truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAVMap方法，仅使用全景视频相机生成仓库货架和灯光的语义线框地图。通过从全景视频中提取货架和天花板视图序列，利用语义分割网络提取稀疏语义特征点（如货架角点、灯光中心）并进行跟踪，结合曼哈顿网格几何约束的结构从运动算法得到3D点云线框地图。在包含46排货架的仓库中（每排55m×7m），从一小时全景视频中生成超5000个货架元素的线框地图，平均绝对误差4.8cm。
Motivation: 工业环境需要精确3D表示用于机器人定位和数字孪生，现有方法通常需要激光雷达或深度相机，成本高。本文目标仅用全景视频相机实现低成本、高精度的结构映射。
Method: 从全景视频中提取矫正图像序列，使用语义分割网络提取稀疏语义特征点（货架角点、灯光中心），跨帧跟踪，并利用曼哈顿网格几何约束的结构从运动算法生成3D线框地图。
Result: 在46排货架仓库中，从一小时全景视频生成超5000个货架元素的线框地图，平均绝对误差4.8cm。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限性，但方法展示了仅用全景视频即可实现高精度、可扩展的工业环境语义映射，适用于仓库等结构化场景。

papers.title: Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning
papers.abstract_en: Discrete visual tokens should provide a compact representation for both token-based world modeling and planning in autonomous driving. However, most tokenizers are inherited from image generation and are optimized mainly for pixel reconstruction, which may leave a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for driving decisions. We present a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced tokenizer that learns discrete tokens under joint supervision. The tokenizer aligns its discrete bottleneck with a frozen DINO feature space through feature decoding, while preserving appearance via RGB reconstruction with perceptual and adversarial losses. To inject geometric state-related cues, we add adjacent-frame depth and relative-pose supervision during training and stabilize joint objectives with multi-codebook quantization. We evaluate the same learned tokens with a lightweight planning readout and a GPT-style next-token world model. Experiments on NAVSIM show improved reconstruction fidelity and representation consistency, competitive planning performance under a fixed decoder, and better generative quality under matched settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种表示引导与几何增强的离散分词器（tokenizer），用于自动驾驶中的世界建模与规划。该分词器通过联合监督学习离散token，包括特征解码对齐DINO特征空间、RGB重建、深度和相对姿态监督，以及多码本量化。实验在NAVSIM上显示重建保真度和表示一致性提升，规划性能有竞争力，生成质量更好。
Motivation: 现有的视觉tokenizer多继承自图像生成，主要优化像素重建，导致生成的token与驾驶决策所需的信息之间存在差距。
Method: 提出表示引导与几何增强的分词器，联合监督包括：特征解码对齐冻结的DINO特征空间、RGB重建（感知和对抗损失）、相邻帧深度和相对姿态监督，以及多码本量化（multi-codebook quantization）以稳定联合目标。
Result: 在NAVSIM上，该方法在重建保真度和表示一致性上取得改进，在固定解码器下规划性能具有竞争力，在相同设置下生成质量更好。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过引入几何监督和表示对齐，可以学习到更适用于驾驶世界模型和规划的离散视觉token。

papers.title: HMPO: Hybrid Median-length Policy Optimization for Chain-of-Thought Compression
papers.abstract_en: Large language models achieve remarkable performance via extended chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, yet this lengthy process incurs substantial inference overhead. Existing CoT compression methods struggle with inflexible manual length budgets, computationally expensive multi-stage training pipelines, and fragile scalability restricted to small models. We propose HMPO (Hybrid Median-length Policy Optimization), a cost-effective, single-stage reinforcement learning framework. HMPO efficiently compresses CoT via three synergistic components: an adaptive median-based budget derived from successful rollouts to eliminate manual tuning, a cosine-decay token reward for smooth length penalization, and a multiplicative reward formulation that substantially mitigates trivial reward hacking by strictly prioritizing answer correctness. Trained exclusively on mathematical data, HMPO generalizes seamlessly across math, code, science, and instruction-following tasks. Extensive experiments scaling from 9B to 122B parameters across dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures demonstrate that HMPO achieves 19%--46% token compression with negligible accuracy degradation, all while drastically reducing training costs compared to existing multi-stage baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HMPO（混合中位长度策略优化），一种单阶段强化学习框架，用于压缩大语言模型的链式思维（CoT）推理。通过自适应中位数预算、余弦衰减令牌奖励和乘法奖励公式，HMPO 在数学数据上训练后，可推广到数学、代码、科学和指令遵循任务。在 9B 到 122B 参数的密集和 MoE 架构上，实现 19%-46% 的令牌压缩，准确率下降可忽略，且训练成本远低于多阶段基线。
Motivation: 现有 CoT 推理过长导致推理开销大，压缩方法存在手动长度预算不灵活、多阶段训练成本高、扩展性差等问题。
Method: 提出 HMPO，基于强化学习的单阶段框架，包含三个组件：基于成功轨迹的自适应中位数预算（免除手动调参）、余弦衰减令牌奖励（平滑长度惩罚）、乘法奖励公式（优先保证答案正确性，抑制奖励黑客）。
Result: 在 9B 到 122B 参数的密集和 MoE 模型上，HMPO 实现 19%-46% 的令牌压缩，准确率几乎无下降，且训练成本显著低于现有方法。
Conclusion: HMPO 是一种高效、可推广的 CoT 压缩方法，但仅基于数学数据训练，对更复杂或领域特定推理的适用性有待验证。
