papers.title: 3rd Place at CVPR 2026 CASTLE Challenge: Agentic Multi-View Long-Context Video Understanding via Hierarchical Knowledge Graph Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents our winning methodology for the CASTLE 2026 Challenge at the CVPR 2026 EgoVis Workshop, where our team secured third place globally. The challenge tasks participants with answering highly complex visual, spatiotemporal, and verbal questions, including visual counting, action localization, multi-view tracking and speaker temporal reasoning, within massive, multimodal video streams. The underlying dataset consists of over 600 hours synchronized footage captured by 15 ego and exo camera sources. To tackle the extreme scale and long-context demands of this environment, we introduce a training-free agentic framework optimized for long-form video understanding. Our framework introduces two core architectural components: i) a Video Knowledge Graph that maps static and dynamic entities, their temporal relationships, and intersecting events to enable multi-hop relational reasoning, and ii) an adaptive agentic workflow that resolves complex queries through a hierarchical retrieval and indexing. Empirical results demonstrate that our framework achieves high zero-shot reasoning accuracy on long-context multi-view streams. Our code will be released at https://github.com/RaghadKhaled/CASTLE-Challenge-Framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了在CVPR 2026 CASTLE挑战中获得第三名的方法，针对大规模多视角长上下文视频理解问题，提出了一种无训练的代理框架，包含视频知识图谱和层次化检索工作流，在零样本推理中取得高准确率。
Motivation: 现有方法难以处理超过600小时同步多视角视频中的复杂时空和语义问题，如视觉计数、动作定位、多视角跟踪等。
Method: 提出无训练代理框架，包含视频知识图谱（映射静态和动态实体及其时序关系）和自适应代理工作流（通过层次化检索和索引解决复杂查询）。
Result: 在零样本设置下，长上下文多视角流上实现了高推理准确率。
Conclusion: 该框架有效应对极端规模和长上下文视频理解挑战，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VET: A Framework for Analyzing AI Discourse
papers.abstract_en: Public discourse on AI has become polarized; exaggerated positions on AI in traditional and social media threaten the development of AI Literacy among the general public. In this article, I introduce the VET Framework, a method for categorizing AI discourse along the dimensions of valence, effectiveness, and trajectory. I show how this framework can be used to identify, compare, and critique prevalent narratives of AI Hype, AI Doom, AI Denial, and AI Normalcy. Using VET, I analyze how each of these four stances exaggerates some aspects of the current state and/or likely evolution of AI, and illustrate how the VET framework can serve as an AI Literacy tool by supporting the ``vetting'' of polarized AI discourse.
papers.journal_ref: Morris, M.R. (2026). VET: A Framework for Analyzing AI Discourse. In Proceedings of the Paris Institute for Advanced Study (Vol. 21)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VET 框架，用于按效价、有效性和轨迹三个维度对 AI 话语进行分类。该框架可识别和批判 AI 炒作、AI 厄运、AI 否认和 AI 常态四种立场，并作为 AI 素养工具帮助公众识别夸大言论。
Motivation: 公众对 AI 的话语两极分化，夸大立场威胁公众 AI 素养，需要系统性的分析框架。
Method: 提出 VET 框架，包含三个维度：valence（效价）、effectiveness（有效性）、trajectory（轨迹），用以分类和分析 AI 话语中的四种常见叙事。
Result: 分析了 AI 炒作、AI 厄运、AI 否认、AI 常态四种立场如何夸大某些方面，并展示了 VET 框架作为 AI 素养工具的应用。
Conclusion: VET 框架可以用于“审查”（vetting）两极分化的 AI 话语，提升公众 AI 素养。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Resonant Context Anchoring: Decoupling Attention Routing and Signal Gain at Inference Time
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit "contextual disregard" when faced with input evidence that conflicts with their internal parametric memory, leading to persistent factual hallucinations. Existing mitigation strategies primarily rely on suppressing specific neuron activations or employing computationally expensive contrastive decoding mechanisms, which often result in increased perplexity or significantly elevated inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose Resonant Context Anchoring (RCA), a lightweight inference-time intervention method grounded in the perspective of residual stream signal dynamics. RCA aims to resolve the signal attenuation of external evidence during its propagation through deep networks. The core mechanism involves the orthogonal decoupling of routing logic and information magnitude within the self-attention module. By utilizing raw pre-softmax attention scores as an instantaneous metric of semantic alignment, we construct a dynamic gain field via non-linear rectification to selectively amplify the norms of value vectors corresponding to context tokens, without altering the attention probability distribution. This mechanism effectively elevates the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of input evidence within the residual stream mixture, thereby robustly anchoring the generation trajectory to the truthful context during inference. Extensive experiments on the Llama-3 model series demonstrate that RCA significantly improves contextual faithfulness across multiple factual consistency and strong knowledge-conflict tasks, effectively suppressing parametric hallucinations. Furthermore, results confirm that as a training-free and computationally negligible plug-and-play module, RCA achieves a Pareto improvement in faithfulness and fluency while maintaining the model's general language understanding capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Resonant Context Anchoring (RCA)，一种轻量级推理时干预方法，通过正交解耦注意力路由和信息增益，放大上下文token的value向量范数，提高信号噪声比，从而抑制LLM的事实幻觉。实验在Llama-3系列上显示，RCA提高了上下文忠实性，且无需训练，计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: LLM在面对与内部参数记忆冲突的输入证据时经常出现“上下文忽视”，导致事实幻觉。现有方法依赖抑制神经元激活或昂贵的对比解码，导致困惑度增加或推理延迟。
Method: RCA基于残差流信号动态，在自注意力模块中将路由逻辑和信息幅度正交解耦。利用原始预softmax注意力分数作为语义对齐的即时指标，通过非线性整流构建动态增益场，选择性放大上下文token对应的值向量范数，但不改变注意力概率分布。
Result: 在Llama-3模型系列上的实验表明，RCA在多个事实一致性和强知识冲突任务上显著提高了上下文忠实性，有效抑制参数幻觉。作为免训练、计算可忽略的即插即用模块，RCA在忠实性和流畅性上实现了帕累托改进，同时保持通用语言理解能力。
Conclusion: RCA是一种轻量级、免训练、计算可忽略的推理时干预方法，能在不影响模型能力的前提下提升上下文忠实性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pool-Select-Refine: Allocation-Aware Generative Dataset Distillation with Soft-Label-Guided Latent Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based dataset distillation has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for condensing large-scale datasets into compact synthetic sets. By leveraging pretrained generative priors, these methods can produce realistic class-conditional samples more efficiently than traditional matching-based approaches. However, most existing diffusion-based methods still adopt a rigid ``Generate-and-Use'' strategy, where the generated samples are directly treated as the final distilled set under a fixed images-per-class budget. Such a design tightly couples candidate generation with final budget allocation, which may result in redundant waste of the limited budget or insufficiently informative samples. In this paper, we propose ``Pool-Select-Refine'', a two-stage framework for allocation-aware generative dataset distillation. First, instead of directly using a fixed number of generated samples, we construct an over-complete candidate pool and select a compact subset under the target budget. Second, we refine the selected samples in latent space using soft-label supervision derived from the teacher model, improving semantic alignment while preserving the generative prior. This design explicitly decouples generation, selection, and refinement, enabling more effective use of the distillation budget. Experiments on large-scale and fine-grained image classification benchmarks show that the proposed framework delivers consistent gains over diffusion-based baselines. The results suggest that introducing a curation stage before refinement is a simple yet effective way to improve diffusion-based dataset distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为“Pool-Select-Refine”的两阶段框架，用于面向分配感知的生成式数据集蒸馏。该方法通过构建过度完备的候选池、在其中选择紧凑子集，并在潜在空间中使用教师模型的软标签监督进行精炼，从而解耦生成、选择和精炼过程，更有效地利用蒸馏预算。实验在大型和细粒度图像分类基准上展示了相较于基于扩散的基线的改进。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的数据集蒸馏方法采用固定的“生成-使用”策略，将生成样本直接作为最终蒸馏集，这导致候选生成与预算分配紧密耦合，可能造成预算浪费或信息不充分。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段构建过度完备的候选池并选择紧凑子集；第二阶段在潜在空间中使用教师模型的软标签监督进行精炼，以改善语义对齐并保持生成先验。
Result: 在大型和细粒度图像分类基准上，该方法相较于基于扩散的基线取得了一致的性能提升。
Conclusion: 在精炼之前引入筛选阶段是改进基于扩散的数据集蒸馏的一种简单而有效的方法。

papers.title: Mechanistic Diagnostics of Spatial Lexical Bias in Multimodal Large Language Model Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain unreliable on spatial multiple-choice questions, and their failures are often attributed to poorly attended visual information. In this work, we identify a complementary failure mode, spatial lexical bias: adding a spatial relation word to the answer options can attract the model's decision and make the newly added option likely to be selected. Using nine open-weight MLLMs, we show that this phenomenon is widely observed. In particular, models can answer a binary spatial question correctly, yet consistently select an incorrect third spatial option once it is added to the answer set. We isolate such binary-stable but ternary-fragile cases as diagnostic examples and leverage mechanistic interpretability tools, revealing that a substantial part of the failure instead originates on the language side rather than the visual side: visual attention analyses and residual-stream probes show the correct spatial relation remains internally available on these failures, while irrelevant-option controls, activation patching, and sparse component interventions trace the bias to specific LLM-side channels and neurons. Based on this finding, we show that a lightweight LLM-only DPO update on tiny single-object-pair synthetic data mitigates the bias, lifting four-way robust accuracy by up to 100 points on synthetic data, and by 68.0, 32.6, and 20.1 points on broader evaluation datasets WhatsUp, SpatialMQA-Direct, and VSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在空间多选题中存在一种新的失败模式——空间词汇偏置：向答案选项中添加一个空间关系词会吸引模型的选择，使新添加的选项容易被选中。使用九个开源MLLM验证了该现象的普遍性，并利用机制可解释性工具揭示偏置主要源于语言侧而非视觉侧：视觉注意力分析和残差流探针显示正确的空间关系在内部仍可用，而无关选项控制、激活修补和稀疏组件干预将偏置追溯到特定的LLM侧通道和神经元。基于此，轻量LLM-only DPO更新在合成数据上消除偏置，在更广的评估数据集上提升四路鲁棒准确率。
Motivation: 现有研究将MLLM在空间多选题上的失败归因于视觉信息关注不足，但本文识别出一种互补的失败模式——空间词汇偏置，即答案选项中空间关系词的存在会干扰模型决策。
Method: 通过构建binary-stable但ternary-fragile的诊断案例，结合视觉注意力分析、残差流探针、激活修补和稀疏组件干预等机制可解释性工具，定位偏置源自语言侧；并采用轻量LLM-only DPO更新在单对象对合成数据上进行缓解。
Result: 九个开源MLLM上观察到空间词汇偏置现象；轻量LLM-only DPO更新使合成数据上四路准确率提升最多100点，在WhatsUp、SpatialMQA-Direct和VSR上分别提升68.0、32.6和20.1点。
Conclusion: 论文强调MLLM的空间推理失败不仅来自视觉处理，更来自语言侧偏置，并证明仅对语言模型进行轻量微调即可有效缓解该偏置。

papers.title: SMH-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Environment-Grounded Reasoning and Action in Smart Homes
papers.abstract_en: Smart homes are evolving toward complex state-dependent living environments, requiring Large Language Models (LLMs) to reason over user intent, preferences, and multi-device interactions. However, existing smart-home benchmarks often focus on static instruction-to-API mapping or limited simulations, failing to evaluate whether LLMs can reason, interact, and act reliably in realistic household scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce SMH-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs in smart-home environments. Built upon HomeEnv, an executable and verifiable smart-home simulator, SMH-Bench contains 1,100 high-quality tasks spanning 7 categories and 22 fine-grained subcategories. It further stratifies tasks across simple, medium and complex homes, ranging from small apartments to dense multi-room environments with 135 devices. Experiments show that although frontier LLMs achieve strong performance on explicit control and query tasks, they still exhibit significant weaknesses in automation task scheduling, ambiguity handling and personalized reasoning, especially as home complexity increases. We hope SMH-Bench will facilitate the development of more reliable, context-aware, and practically deployable smart-home agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMH-Bench是一个用于评估大语言模型在智能家居环境中推理、交互和行动能力的基准测试，包含1100个高质量任务，覆盖7大类别和22个子类别，并在从简单公寓到拥有135个设备的多房间环境中进行分层测试。实验表明，先进LLM在显式控制和查询任务上表现强劲，但在自动化任务调度、歧义处理和个人化推理方面仍有明显不足。
Motivation: 现有智能家居基准多集中于静态指令到API的映射或有限模拟，无法评估LLM在真实家庭场景中的推理、交互和可靠行动能力。
Method: 基于可执行且可验证的智能家居模拟器HomeEnv，构建SMH-Bench，包括1100个高质量任务，按简单、中等、复杂家庭分层，涵盖7大类别和22个子类别。
Result: 前沿LLM在显式控制和查询任务上表现优异，但在自动化任务调度、歧义处理和个人化推理方面随着家庭复杂度增加而显著下降。
Conclusion: SMH-Bench旨在促进更可靠、上下文感知且可实际部署的智能家居智能体开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Residual Decoder Adapter: ID-Preserving Tokenizer Adaption for Autoregressive Text Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Visual Autoregressive (AR) models generate images by predicting discrete tokens that are decoded by a visual tokenizer. Despite demonstrating strong overall image generation ability, they still underperform on text rendering with blur strokes and disrupt letter shapes. In this work, we trace this limitation to the visual tokenizer, which struggles to reconstruct fine-grained detail. Improving the tokenizer is straightforward but expensive, as it necessitates retraining both the tokenizer and the AR model. Can we improve text rendering performance of AR models without retraining the existing tokenizer and AR model? To achieve this, we propose the Residual Decoder Adapter(RDA) that upgrades an existing tokenizer post-hoc without changing its token space. Specifically, it refines the decoder output of the visual tokenizer by introducing two novel components: (i) a paired codebook that shares the token distribution with the original one; (ii) a parallel branch to learn the tiny differences (residual) between the reconstructed image and the ground-truth images in the pixel space. This residual design allows us to enhance the tokenizer non-invasively while preserving compatibility with prior AR models. RDA substantially improves text rendering significantly by a large margin. For instance, we boost finetuned Janus-Pro OCR accuracy rises from 24.52% to 58.26% (TextVisionBlend), from 12.75% to 36.81% (StyledTextSynth) on competitive TextAtlas benchmark. The code is available at https://github.com/CSU-JPG/RDA

papers.title: Single-Line Drawing Generation via Semantics-Driven Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Line drawings are a highly expressive art form that requires the artist to abstract and distill the essence of their subject. We present the first semantics-driven method for automatically generating single-line drawings in vector format, guided either by a text prompt describing the concept or an input image depicting it. Our approach leverages score distillation sampling to optimize the parameters of a uniform rational B-spline (URBS) curve, ensuring that the drawing consists of a single continuous stroke by design. This representation provides fine-grained control over the level of detail, while additional loss terms allow us to steer the final artistic style. We demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art text-to-image models and optimization pipelines for this task, producing results that are both more aesthetically pleasing and more faithful to the style of continuous line drawing artists. Furthermore, because our method generates a vectorized curve, it directly supports downstream fabrication processes such as embroidery, laser engraving and wire bending. Our code and results are available at https://github.com/tanguymagne/SLDgen.

papers.title: Echo: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Speaker Diarization and Speech Recognition in a Shared Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: We present Echo, a proof-of-concept audio system built around a single 25 M-parameter ViT encoder. The encoder is pretrained with a JEPA objective and then specialised by stages to carry speaker identity, phonetic content, and dynamic source routing in the same 512-dimensional latent space, with no per-task fine-tuning at deployment. Light heads handle diarization (ArcFace + VBx) and dynamic source separation (null-target K-set prediction). On synthetic VoxCeleb2 mixtures with unknown K, the canonical stack reaches 15.00% blind DER, 97.80% PIT separation accuracy with +9.52 dB latent SI-SDR, and a +53.50-point speaker/content factorisation gap on a held-out k-NN probe. The point of Echo is not a new SOTA on any single task but the joint coexistence of three tasks on one encoder at this footprint. We document the design stage by stage, report the dead-ends, and identify the structural wall on end-to-end ASR through the VQ bottleneck that still bounds the PoC.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 17 tables, 1 figure. Proof-of-concept, independent research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Echo，一个概念验证音频系统，使用单个25M参数的ViT编码器，通过JEPA预训练和分阶段专门化，在相同512维潜在空间中同时编码说话人身份、语音内容和动态源路由，无需部署时针对每个任务微调。在合成的VoxCeleb2混合上，该系统在盲说话人日志化（DER）上达到15.00%，在置换不变训练（PIT）分离准确率上达到97.80%，并实现了+9.52 dB的潜在尺度不变信噪比（SI-SDR）和+53.50点的说话人/内容因子化差距。作者强调此工作并非在单一任务上达到新SOTA，而是展示三个任务在单一编码器上的共存。
Motivation: 现有音频系统通常需要为每个任务单独微调模型，缺乏在多任务间共享表示的能力。Echo旨在通过一个统一的潜在空间同时处理说话人日志化、语音识别和源分离，减少部署成本。
Method: 采用JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）预训练一个25M参数的ViT编码器，然后分阶段专门化以在512维潜在空间中嵌入说话人身份、语音内容和动态源路由。轻量级头部包括用于日志化的ArcFace + VBx和用于动态源分离的null-target K-set预测。
Result: 在合成的VoxCeleb2混合数据集上，达到15.00%的盲说话人日志化错误率（DER），97.80%的PIT分离准确率，+9.52 dB的潜在SI-SDR，以及+53.50点的说话人/内容因子化差距（通过held-out k-NN探针测量）。
Conclusion: Echo是概念验证，并非在单一任务上达到新SOTA，但展示了在较小模型规模下三个任务（日志化、分离、语音内容）在共享潜在空间中的共存可能。作者指出端到端ASR仍受VQ瓶颈限制，是该证明的边界。

papers.title: Private and Stable Test-Time Adaptation with Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) can reduce error on new and different data by updating the model on these inputs during inference. However, these updates raise the issue of privacy w.r.t. the testing data, because the model parameters now depend on all past inputs. To control this privacy risk, we cast multiple popular TTA methods (Tent, EATA, SAR, DeYO, and COME) into differential privacy (DP) forms that apply per-sample gradient clipping and Gaussian noise for all updates. On ImageNet-C, our DP-TTA methods provide adequate privacy at small cost to accuracy, and in the low-privacy regime the clipping mechanism of DP can even improve the accuracy and stability of adaptation in the continual setting. These improvements to privacy and accuracy come at only modest computational overhead. These first results on private TTA raise awareness of the issue, inform the development of more private test-time updates, and identify per-sample clipping as an effective technique for improving the accuracy and stability of adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了测试时自适应（TTA）中的隐私风险，并提出将差分隐私（DP）应用于多种TTA方法（Tent、EATA、SAR、DeYO、COME），通过每样本梯度裁剪和高斯噪声实现隐私保护。在ImageNet-C上，DP-TTA方法在较小精度损失下提供了充分的隐私，且在低隐私预算下裁剪机制甚至能提升连续自适应场景下的精度和稳定性。
Motivation: 测试时自适应在推理时更新模型参数，导致模型参数依赖于所有过去测试输入，引发测试数据的隐私泄露风险。现有TTA方法未考虑隐私保护，本文旨在首次系统性地将差分隐私引入TTA。
Method: 将多种流行TTA方法（Tent、EATA、SAR、DeYO、COME）转化为差分隐私形式，对每次更新应用每样本梯度裁剪（per-sample gradient clipping）和高斯噪声。
Result: 在ImageNet-C上，DP-TTA方法在合理隐私预算下维持了较高精度；在低隐私预算区域，梯度裁剪机制反而提高了连续自适应中的精度和稳定性，且计算开销仅适度增加。
Conclusion: 本文首次揭示了测试时自适应的隐私问题，并提出差分隐私解决方案，同时发现每样本裁剪可提升自适应的精度和稳定性，为未来私密测试时更新提供了方向。

papers.title: Bayesian Spectral Emotion Transition Discovery from Multi-Annotator Disagreement
papers.abstract_en: Emotions evolve through the dynamics of conversation, and understanding their transition structure is foundational to applications ranging from mental-health screening to dialogue systems. However, existing studies typically compress multi-rater judgments into a single hard label by majority voting, discarding the uncertainty signal needed to understand turn-to-turn transitions. In this article, we propose Bayesian Spectral Emotion Transition Discovery (BSETD), a two-stage framework that discovers emotion-transition structure from multi-rater soft labels. In the first stage, a hierarchical Dirichlet-Multinomial posterior is constructed through the outer product of soft labels, equipping each cell of the K x K transition matrix with a credible interval and Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) false discovery rate (FDR)-controlled significance. In the second stage, the symmetrized graph Laplacian is spectrally decomposed to separate a low-frequency (inertia) component from a high-frequency (contagion) component. On EmotionLines, BSETD simultaneously recovers the signatures of two distinct affective spaces: the Plutchik-adjacent transitions disgust to anger (log2 lift +0.94) and anger to disgust (+0.86) are over-represented, while the Russell-valence-reversed transitions joy to anger (-0.90) and anger to joy (-0.89) are under-represented. A five-source cross-corpus validation yields pairwise Pearson correlations in 0.91-0.98 within English, 0.79-0.85 against Chinese M3ED, and 0.979 between the human hard labels and the LLM virtual soft labels on the same utterance set, demonstrating that a pipeline preserving annotator uncertainty bridges the computational study of emotion dynamics with established psychological theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯谱情感转换发现（BSETD）框架，从多标注者不一致中挖掘对话情感转换结构。通过两阶段方法——先构建层次狄利克雷-多项后验为转换矩阵提供可信区间，再对对称图拉普拉斯谱分解分离惯性与传染成分——在EmotionLines数据集上恢复了普拉奇克情感空间的转换模式。
Motivation: 现有研究通常将多标注者判断压缩为单一硬标签，丢失了理解逐轮情感转换所需的不确定性信号。
Method: BSETD 分两阶段：第一阶段通过软标签外积构建层次狄利克雷-多项后验，为 K×K 转换矩阵每个单元提供 BH FDR 控制的显著性和可信区间；第二阶段对对称图拉普拉斯谱分解，分离低频（惯性）与高频（传染）成分。
Result: 在 EmotionLines 上，厌恶→愤怒（log2 lift +0.94）和愤怒→厌恶（+0.86）过度表达，喜悦→愤怒（-0.90）和愤怒→喜悦（-0.89）表达不足。五源跨语料验证中，英文内 Pearson 相关 0.91-0.98，与中文 M3ED 对比 0.79-0.85，人类硬标签与 LLM 虚拟软标签同一话语集上达 0.979。
Conclusion: 保留标注者不确定性的管道弥合了情感动力学计算研究与心理学理论之间的鸿沟。

papers.title: The Image Reconstruction Game: Drawing Common Ground Through Iterative Multimodal Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Image Reconstruction Game, a fully automated benchmark in which a vision-language model issues corrective instructions to an image generator across multiple turns, making accumulated common ground directly observable as a rendered image. Benchmarking two Describer models crossed with two Generator models across seven image categories, we find that the describer is the dominant factor in reconstruction quality, while the generator determines whether iterative refinement helps or hurts. Mathematical and geometric images pose the greatest challenge. The describer's token budget strongly affects convergence: shorter budgets yield sparser first renderings with more room for visible improvement, while longer budgets raise absolute quality but leave less to fix. Stronger describers use a richer correction vocabulary spanning spatial, numeric, and structural categories, while weaker describers concentrate on surface properties and tend to stop after a few turns. Human validation shows that the best automated judge reaches only slight-to-fair agreement with human preferences, and automated scores require human recalibration to be used reliably.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图像重建游戏（Image Reconstruction Game），一个全自动基准测试，通过多轮对话让视觉语言模型向图像生成器发出纠正指令，并将累积的共同基础直接可视化为渲染图像。实验发现描述器（describer）是重建质量的主导因素，而生成器（generator）决定迭代改进是否有益；数学和几何图像最具挑战性；描述器的令牌预算强烈影响收敛，较短预算产生更稀疏的首次渲染，留有更多改进空间，较长预算提高绝对质量但可修复空间更少；更强的描述器使用更丰富的校正词汇，而较弱的描述器集中于表面属性并倾向于早期停止。人类验证显示最佳自动评判器与人类偏好仅达到轻微到中等一致，自动分数需要人工校准才能可靠使用。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言交互缺乏对共同基础（common ground）形成过程的可观察度量，本文旨在通过多轮图像重建任务使共同基础直接可见。
Method: 设计一个全自动基准测试，由描述器（vision-language model）和生成器（image generator）通过多轮对话进行图像重建；每次对话中描述器基于当前图像和目标图像输出文本指令，生成器据此更新图像，迭代直至收敛。使用两个描述器模型和两个生成器模型在七个图像类别上进行测试。
Result: 描述器是重建质量的主导因素，生成器决定迭代改进的效果；数学和几何图像最难重建；较短令牌预算（token budget）导致首次渲染更稀疏但后续改进更明显，较长预算绝对质量更高但改进空间小；强描述器使用空间、数字和结构等丰富的校正词汇，弱描述器集中在表面属性并倾向于在少数轮次后停止。自动评判器与人类偏好只有轻微到中等一致性，自动分数需人工校准。
Conclusion: 图像重建游戏提供了一个评估多模态对话中共同基础建立过程的新基准，揭示了描述器与生成器角色差异以及令牌预算等关键因素，同时指出自动评估仍需人工校准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auteur: Language-Driven Cinematographic Framing for Human-Centric Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative video models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and temporal coherence, yet intentional camera control remains elusive. Existing frameworks treat camera motion as a byproduct of pixel synthesis, producing trajectories that are stochastic, spatially inconsistent, and indifferent to the human subject driving the scene. In this work, we present Auteur, a method for language-driven, human-centric camera framing in generative video. Our core insight is that professional filmmakers conceive shots not as world-space trajectories but as framings defined relative to the actor, encoding shot size, angle, and composition as functions of human pose and motion. We formalize this intuition as a human-centric camera parameterization and introduce a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that is convertible to standard 6-DoF camera parameters. A fine-tuned multimodal large language model then acts as a virtual director, mapping natural language descriptions and coarse human motion to sparse DSL keyframes that are deterministically interpolated into continuous camera trajectories, which are then provided as input to video generators. We train and evaluate Auteur on a new dataset of 34K aligned text, human motion, and DSL-annotated camera trajectories drawn from procedural synthesis and real-world movie footage from the CondensedMovies dataset. Auteur enables cinematographic framing of human-centered scenes, a capability largely absent in prior generative models. To assess this behavior, we propose new framing-focused metrics, and our experiments show that Auteur consistently outperforms existing methods
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Auteur方法，通过语言驱动、以人为中心的摄像机构图，实现生成视频中的可控摄像机运动。该方法将电影拍摄专业知识形式化为以人为中心的摄像机参数化，并设计领域特定语言（DSL）将其转换为标准6自由度参数。通过微调多模态大语言模型作为虚拟导演，将自然语言描述和粗略人体运动映射为稀疏DSL关键帧，插值生成连续摄像机轨迹，输入视频生成器。在34K对齐文本、人体运动和DSL标注摄像机轨迹的新数据集上训练和评估，Auteur在面向构图的指标上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有生成视频模型缺乏有意的摄像机控制，摄像机运动随机、空间不一致且忽略场景中的人类主体。
Method: 提出以人为中心的摄像机参数化，定义基于人体姿态和运动的镜头尺寸、角度和构图；设计可转换为标准6自由度参数的领域特定语言（DSL）；微调多模态大语言模型将自然语言描述和粗略人体运动映射为稀疏DSL关键帧，经确定性插值生成连续摄像机轨迹。
Result: 在包含真实电影片段和程序合成的34K数据集上，Auteur在提出的构图聚焦指标上持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: Auteur实现了以人为中心的电影化构图，这是先前生成模型缺乏的能力。

papers.title: RA-LWLM: Retrieval-Augmented In-Context Localization with Wireless Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Wireless localization is a fundamental capability of sixth-generation (6G) networks. Conventional model-based methods require accurate modeling of the propagation environment and degrade in complex multipath and non-line-of-sight scenarios, while learning-based methods couple model parameters tightly to the training scene, requiring costly retraining whenever the base station (BS) configuration or propagation environment changes. In this paper, we propose RA-LWLM, a retrieval-augmented in-context localization framework that achieves training-free cross-scene adaptation by externalizing scene-specific information into a per-scene fingerprint database rather than encoding it in model weights. The framework consists of three components: a frozen wireless foundation model (FM) encoder that maps raw channel state information into a scene-agnostic representation; a retrieval module that selects the most informative references from the per-scene database via similarity search in the representation space; and a transformer-based in-context learning (ICL) module that fuses the query with the retrieved references to predict the user equipment (UE) position. To accommodate varying retrieval quality and propagation complexity across queries, the ICL module adopts a mixture-of-experts design in which experts specialize in different context sizes and are softly combined by a learnable selector. Extensive ray-tracing-based experiments across heterogeneous scenes with diverse BS configurations show that RA-LWLM achieves nearly identical accuracy on seen and unseen scenes without any per-scene retraining, substantially outperforming end-to-end and FM-based baselines. These results validate the proposed retrieval-augmented in-context paradigm as a scalable solution for cross-scene localization in 6G networks.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 9 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RA-LWLM，一种检索增强的上下文学习（retrieval-augmented in-context learning）框架，用于6G网络中的无线定位。该方法通过将场景特定信息外部化为每场景指纹数据库，避免了跨场景重训练。框架包括冻结的无线基础模型编码器、检索模块和基于Transformer的上下文学习模块（采用混合专家设计）。实验表明，在异构场景下，RA-LWLM在未见场景上达到与已见场景几乎相同的定位精度，无需重新训练。
Motivation: 传统模型方法在复杂多径和非视距场景中性能下降；基于学习的方法参数与训练场景紧耦合，场景变化时需昂贵重训练。目标是在无训练代价下实现跨场景无线定位。
Method: 框架三部分：冻结的无线基础模型编码器将原始信道状态信息映射为场景无关表示；检索模块通过表示空间相似性搜索从每场景指纹库选择最相关参考；Transformer上下文学习模块（混合专家设计，专家专攻不同上下文大小，由可学习选择器软组合）融合查询与参考预测用户设备位置。
Result: 基于射线跟踪的跨异构场景实验（含不同基站配置）显示，RA-LWLM在已见和未见场景上精度几乎相同，无需每场景重训练，显著优于端到端和基于无线基础模型的基线方法。
Conclusion: 验证了检索增强上下文学习范式作为6G网络跨场景定位的可扩展解决方案，实现了无需重训练的高精度跨场景适应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Train, Test, Re-evaluate: Schedule-Sensitive Evaluation of Generative Data for Hand Detection
papers.abstract_en: Generated (or synthetic) image data is increasingly used to augment or replace real training datasets when target imagery is scarce, expensive, or biased. For hand detection, particularly in occupational safety settings, public datasets mostly contain bare hands. This under-represents the variation in hand appearance introduced by gloves, tattoos, jewelry, and other personal protective equipment, creating a distribution shift that safety-critical applications encounter at deployment. We test whether generative inpainting, editing only the hand region of a real photograph to introduce accessories, can close this shift gap. On a paired dataset of real images and their synthetic counterparts, we train YOLOv8n hand detectors under six training-and-scheduling regimes (Experiments A-F, three random seeds each), evaluate every detector on a real test set and on a real-gloves-only test split, and report the mean average precision (mAP) at two overlap thresholds (mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95) along with paired statistical tests. A two-stage experiment: train on real U synthetic data, then fine-tune the resulting weights on real-only at a lower learning rate, increases mAP@0.5 compared to the real-only baseline model on the standard real test set, and improves the real-gloves out-of-distribution gap. Another three-stage experiment preserves box-tightness best, reaching the highest mAP@0.5:0.95 of any other experiment in the study. The synthetic-data utility for safety-critical hand detection is determined by the training procedure, and simple multi-stage experiments extract substantial real-deployment benefit from inpainted accessory data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成性图像数据（合成数据）在手部检测任务中的效用，特别是在职业安全场景中手套等配件造成分布偏移的问题。作者使用生成式修补（generative inpainting）在真实照片的手部区域添加配件，构建配对数据集，并在六种训练调度方案下训练YOLOv8n检测器，评估其性能。实验表明，多阶段训练策略可以提升mAP，缩小分布偏移。
Motivation: 现有手部检测数据集多包含裸手，缺乏手套、纹身等配件变体，导致安全关键应用部署时的分布偏移。需要探索生成数据能否弥补这一差距。
Method: 使用生成式修补编辑真实照片的手部区域以引入配件；在配对数据集上训练YOLOv8n检测器，采用六种不同的训练与调度方案（包括两阶段和三阶段实验），并在真实测试集和仅戴手套的子集上评估mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95。
Result: 两阶段实验（先训练真实+合成数据，再以低学习率微调仅真实数据）在标准真实测试集上相比真实基线提高了mAP@0.5，并改善了真实-手套分布偏移。三阶段实验在边界框紧密度上最佳，达到了研究中的最高mAP@0.5:0.95。
Conclusion: 合成数据在手部检测中的效用取决于训练过程，简单的多阶段实验可以从修补的配件数据中提取实质性的真实部署收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Collaborative Space Object Detection with Multi-Satellite Viewpoints in LEO Constellations
papers.abstract_en: With the growing number of satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) constellations, the near-Earth space environment has become increasingly congested, making space object detection (SOD) a pressing challenge for space safety and sustainability. To mitigate collision risks and ensure the continuity of space operations, SOD systems must deliver fast and accurate detection under stringent onboard constraints. In this paper, we investigate the potential of multi-viewpoint observation fusion within a deep learning (DL) framework to enhance SOD performance. We design a practical multi-view pipeline and several input representations for feeding multi-view data into YOLO-based detectors. Our experiments show that using multi-view inputs is feasible in most cases and typically produces better results for mAP50 and mAP50-95. For example, in model YOLOv9-m, single-view compared to a three-view fused RGB setting, mAP50 increases from 0.638 to 0.732, while mAP50-95 improves from 0.227 to 0.276. Compared with the single-view setting, the best three-view grayscale configuration improves mAP50 by 36.3% and mAP50-95 by 46.5%. These findings establish multi-view fusion as a viable and effective strategy for SOD, with broad implications for space situational awareness in LEO constellation deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低地球轨道（LEO）星座中利用多卫星视角融合进行空间物体检测（SOD）。实验表明，基于YOLO的检测器在融合多视角输入后，mAP50和mAP50-95显著提升，例如YOLOv9-m在三视角RGB设置下mAP50从0.638提高到0.732。多视角融合被证明是一种可行且有效的SOD策略。
Motivation: LEO卫星数量激增导致空间环境拥挤，空间物体检测对安全与可持续性至关重要，但需在星上严格约束下实现快速准确检测。
Method: 设计多视角观测融合的深度学习管道，提出多种输入表示方式将多视角数据馈入YOLO检测器。
Result: 在YOLOv9-m上，三视角融合RGB相比单视角，mAP50从0.638升至0.732，mAP50-95从0.227升至0.276；最佳三视角灰度配置相比单视角mAP50提升36.3%，mAP50-95提升46.5%。
Conclusion: 多视角融合在LEO空间物体检测中有效，对星座部署中的空间态势感知有广泛意义。

summary_sections.motivation: LEO卫星数量激增导致空间环境拥挤，空间物体检测对安全与可持续性至关重要，但需在星上严格约束下实现快速准确检测。
summary_sections.method: 设计多视角观测融合的深度学习管道，提出多种输入表示方式将多视角数据馈入YOLO检测器。
summary_sections.result: 在YOLOv9-m上，三视角融合RGB相比单视角，mAP50从0.638升至0.732，mAP50-95从0.227升至0.276；最佳三视角灰度配置相比单视角mAP50提升36.3%，mAP50-95提升46.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多视角融合在LEO空间物体检测中有效，对星座部署中的空间态势感知有广泛意义。

papers.title: Physically-Constrained Mamba-SDE for Remaining Useful Life Prediction under Irregular Observations
papers.abstract_en: Accurate Remaining Useful Life prediction is critical for industrial predictive maintenance. However, real-world deployment is challenging due to the irregular nature of sensor observations, characterized by asynchronous sampling, burst missingness, and temporal jitter. Compounding this issue, purely data-driven models often generate physically implausible degradation trajectories that violate the irreversible nature of damage accumulation. To address this, we propose PC-MambaSDE, a unified continuous-time framework for robust RUL prediction under irregular observations. Specifically, we design a Mask-Aware Continuous Mamba Encoder that explicitly leverages observation masks to extract context-rich control signals. Furthermore, we introduce a Physics-Guided Latent SDE with parametrically rectified hybrid drift, superimposing a global physical bias to enforce monotonic degradation even amid severe observation gaps. Additionally, we formulate RUL prediction as a boundary value problem via a Terminal Degradation Penalty, which decouples a Health Index dimension and applies a penalty loss to guide trajectories toward the failure state. Theoretically, we prove that our variational objective is mathematically equivalent to minimizing the KL divergence via Girsanov's theorem, and we guarantee the global asymptotic stability of the learned dynamics through Lyapunov analysis. To enable rigorous evaluation, we develop a Hybrid Irregularity Generation Scheme that simulates realistic industrial imperfections. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that PC-MambaSDE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under extreme observation scarcity, validating the efficacy of embedding physical priors into continuous-time latent dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PC-MambaSDE，一个统一的连续时间框架，用于在不规则观测下进行鲁棒的剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测。该方法包括掩码感知的连续Mamba编码器、物理引导的潜在SDE以及终端退化惩罚，通过将物理先验嵌入连续时间潜在动力学来确保退化轨迹的单调性。实验表明，该方法在极端观测稀疏情况下显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 实际工业中的传感器观测具有不规则性（异步采样、突发缺失、时间抖动），且纯数据驱动模型容易生成物理上不合理的退化轨迹（违反损伤累积不可逆性）。
Method: 提出PC-MambaSDE框架，包含Mask-Aware Continuous Mamba Encoder利用观测掩码提取控制信号；Physics-Guided Latent SDE使用参数化修正混合漂移，叠加全局物理偏置强制单调退化；Terminal Degradation Penalty将RUL预测建模为边界值问题，引导轨迹朝向失效状态。理论上通过Girsanov定理证明变分目标等价于最小化KL散度，并通过Lyapunov分析保证全局渐进稳定性。
Result: 在公开基准上显著优于最先进方法，尤其在极端观测稀疏条件下。提出了混合不规则生成方案模拟现实工业缺陷以进行严格评估。
Conclusion: 将物理先验嵌入连续时间潜在动力学可以有效提升不规则观测下的RUL预测鲁棒性和物理合理性。

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks on Robot Localization Systems via Deep Feature Perturbation
papers.abstract_en: Robot localization systems are critical for autonomous navigation and safety. Adversarial perturbations can mislead these systems, resulting in mislocalization, navigation errors, or unsafe interactions, especially in mission-critical scenarios. This paper investigates the vulnerability of deep learning based localization pipelines to adversarial attacks. We propose a novel framework for generating adversarial queries that specifically target Product Quantization (PQ) in visual localization systems. Our method employs a Lightweight Product Quantization Network (LPQN) to perturb query feature encodings, misleading the retrieval process by returning semantically irrelevant database entries. Adversarial queries are generated via a two-phase procedure: a forward pass that perturbs feature distributions and a backward pass that refines the perturbation through optimization. The lightweight design of LPQN allows the creation of subtle yet highly effective perturbations with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments in both controlled and real-world robotic environments demonstrate that our approach substantially degrades PQN performance, exposing critical vulnerabilities in practical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于深度学习的机器人视觉定位系统在对抗攻击下的脆弱性，提出一种针对乘积量化（Product Quantization）的对抗攻击框架。通过轻量级乘积量化网络（LPQN）扰动查询特征编码，以最小计算开销生成有效对抗样本。实验表明该方法显著降低定位系统性能，暴露实际应用中的关键安全漏洞。
Motivation: 机器人定位系统易受对抗攻击导致导航错误和安全隐患，但现有研究较少关注针对乘积量化检索过程的对抗攻击方法。
Method: 提出轻量级乘积量化网络（LPQN），采用两阶段过程：前向传播扰动特征分布，反向传播通过优化细化扰动，生成能误导乘积量化检索的对抗查询。
Result: 在受控和真实机器人环境中的实验表明，该方法能显著降低乘积量化网络（PQN）的性能，暴露系统在实战场景中的脆弱性。
Conclusion: 当前基于深度学习的视觉定位系统存在易被对抗攻击的漏洞，亟需开发相应的防御机制。

papers.title: MidSurfNet: Learnable Face Pairing and Interference Implicit Fields for Generalized Mid-surface Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Mid-surface abstraction is essential for finite element analysis of thin-walled CAD models. Existing face pairing-based methods rely on handcrafted geometric heuristics, yet real-world industrial models frequently exhibit multi-wall-thickness regions, self-matching face configurations, and demand for non-center offset surfaces--scenarios where rule-based approaches consistently fail. We present MidSurfNet, a learning-augmented framework that addresses these limitations through two novel components: (1) a neural face pairing module that learns to predict face pair confidence from geometric and topological features, handling complex pairing scenarios beyond rule-based methods; and (2) an interference implicit field that represents mid-surfaces as the interference of two signed distance functions, enabling generalized offset control for flexible positioning in downstream CAE/FEA-oriented workflows. We construct a large-scale mid-surface dataset containing over 1,500 manually annotated CAD models. Experiments demonstrate that MidSurfNet achieves 87.32% face pairing accuracy and successfully handles multi-wall-thickness (61.90% completion) and self-matching (52.94% completion) scenarios that confound all existing methods. Furthermore, MidSurfNet provides a learning-based approach to generalized mid-surface abstraction with arbitrary offset control for CAE-oriented applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MidSurfNet，一种学习增强的中面提取框架，包含神经面对面配对模块和干涉隐式场，用于处理多壁厚、自匹配等复杂场景，并在 1,500 余个手工标注 CAD 模型上实现高准确率。
Motivation: 现有基于几何启发式的面对面配对方法在处理多壁厚区域、自匹配面配置以及非中心偏移表面时经常失败，限制了工业薄壁 CAD 模型的中面抽象在有限元分析中的应用。
Method: 提出两个新组件：(1) 神经面对面配对模块，从几何和拓扑特征学习预测面对置信度；(2) 干涉隐式场，通过两个有符号距离函数的干涉表示中面，支持任意偏移控制。
Result: 对面配对准确率达 87.32%，多壁厚场景完成度 61.90%，自匹配场景完成度 52.94%，均超越现有方法。
Conclusion: MidSurfNet 提供了面向 CAE 应用的学习型中面抽象方法，支持灵活偏移控制，但抽象未提及其在降水预测等气象领域的适用性。

papers.title: Segment-driven Structural Induction and Semantic Alignment for Heterogeneous Tabular Representation
papers.abstract_en: Real-world domains often contain heterogeneous tables whose headers vary while their underlying attribute semantics are shared, making it difficult to induce domain-specialized semantics from table-local evidence alone. Existing encoders model parts of this problem, but often underuse column-level value distributions and apply uniform objectives across attributes with different semantic roles. We propose NAVI, a segment-centric pretraining framework that treats each header-value pair as the unit for aggregating schema-level structural evidence and column-level distributional evidence. We realize this design through Masked Segment Modeling and Entropy-driven Segment Alignment, which jointly enforce structured header-value coupling and semantic alignment across stable and instance-specific attributes. Experiments on heterogeneous in-domain tables show improved reconstruction, semantic consistency, and downstream utility across evaluation settings overall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异构表格中列标题变化而底层语义共享的问题，提出NAVI预训练框架。该框架以每个header-value对为单元，通过Masked Segment Modeling和Entropy-driven Segment Alignment联合学习结构证据和分布证据。实验表明，在异构域内表格上，该方法在重建、语义一致性和下游任务方面均表现更优。
Motivation: 现实世界中的异构表格尽管列标题不同，但底层属性语义常被共享。现有编码器未充分利用列值分布，且对不同语义角色属性使用统一目标，导致难以从局部证据中归纳领域专用语义。
Method: 提出NAVI框架，采用Masked Segment Modeling和Entropy-driven Segment Alignment，以每个header-value对为单元聚合模式级别的结构证据和列级别分布证据。
Result: 在异构域内表格的实验显示，NAVI在重建质量、语义一致性和下游任务有效性方面均优于基线。
Conclusion: 该工作表明以段为中心的预训练范式能有效捕捉异构表格中的结构耦合与语义对齐。

papers.title: Absorbing Complexity: An Interaction-Native Knowledge Harness for Financial LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Financial AI agents often fail for a simple reason: they make users carry the complexity. A user must repeatedly restate goals, risk preferences, portfolio context, past judgments, and shifting market assumptions, while the agent answers, retrieves, acts, and forgets. In finance, this is not just inconvenient. In tasks such as market analysis, copy-trading review, and trade preparation, forgotten context and stale memory can create latency, repeated errors, weak auditability, and unsafe decisions. We propose the interaction-native knowledge harness (InKH), an architecture for financial LLM agents that absorbs complexity into the system. InKH converts user, market, portfolio, and tool events into structured operational knowledge. It uses passive knowledge injection to assemble a bounded working context buffer before the main model step, temporal graph memory for low-latency retrieval, a wiki audit surface for human-readable governance, and background extraction with maturity, decay, and write-time invalidation. We evaluate InKH on a reproducible controlled synthetic benchmark with 24 random seeds, 4 rounds, 80 episodes per round, and 6 baselines, producing 46,080 baseline-conditioned evaluations. InKH achieves mean task quality of 0.815 at 900 ms latency. Compared with agent-driven wiki-walk memory, it reduces latency by 82.95 percent, token cost by 82.29 percent, and stale-knowledge usage by 96.58 percent, while improving quality by 0.108 and traceability by 0.461. Compared with a temporal-graph system without invalidation, it improves quality by 0.050 and reduces stale-memory usage by 96.58 percent with comparable serving cost. The results support a design thesis for financial AI: adoption happens when complexity is absorbed by the system rather than transferred to the user. The benchmark validates architecture-level behavior, not live trading performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向金融LLM代理的交互原生知识整理器（InKH），将用户、市场、投资组合和工具事件转化为结构化知识，通过被动知识注入、时态图记忆、wiki审计表面和背景提取等技术吸收复杂性。在合成基准上，InKH相比基线实现了更低延迟、更少令牌消耗和更少过期知识使用，同时提高任务质量和可追溯性。
Motivation: 现有金融AI代理常常将复杂性转移给用户，导致上下文遗忘、延迟、错误和缺乏可审计性，因此需要一种将复杂性吸收进系统的架构。
Method: 提出InKH架构，包括被动知识注入（组装工作上下文缓冲区）、时态图记忆（低延迟检索）、wiki审计表面（可读治理）、以及背景提取（带成熟度、衰减和写入失效）。在合成基准上评估。
Result: 在46,080次评估中，InKH达到平均任务质量0.815（延迟900 ms）。与agent-driven wiki-walk记忆相比延迟降低82.95%，令牌成本降低82.29%，过期知识使用减少96.58%，质量提升0.108，可追溯性提升0.461。与无失效的时态图系统相比，质量提升0.050，过期内存使用减少96.58%，服务成本相当。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在金融AI中，当复杂性被系统吸收而非转移给用户时，采用率会提高。该基准验证的是架构级行为，而非实盘交易性能。

papers.title: Divide and Conquer: Reliable Multi-View Evidential Learning for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: With the evolution of generative models, deepfakes have achieved near-perfect semantic realism, leaving forensic traces only in subtle structural anomalies. However, existing single-view paradigms often fail to generalize, as dominant semantic features overwhelm subtle artifact cues within entangled representations. This imbalance leads to overconfident yet brittle predictions -- a phenomenon we term the Semantic Masking Effect. To address this challenge, we propose a reliable framework called Divide-and-Conquer Multi-View Evidential Learning (DiCoME) for Deepfake Detection. In the "Divide" phase, we employ Geometric View Purification to decompose the entangled representation space through principled geometric projection. This process suppresses semantic interference within artifact-sensitive representations, forming the foundation for decorrelated yet complementary semantic and artifact views. In the "Conquer" phase, we leverage Uncertainty-Aware Evidential Learning to synthesize these distinct views. By explicitly modeling the "epistemic conflict" between semantic and artifact cues, this mechanism provides calibrated uncertainty estimates instead of forcing rigid deterministic decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches in generalization performance, while providing reliable uncertainty estimation for trustworthy deepfake detection. Code is available at https://github.com/kxl0825/DiCoME.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Divide-and-Conquer Multi-View Evidential Learning (DiCoME) 框架用于深度伪造检测。通过几何视图净化分解纠缠的表示空间，抑制语义干扰，然后利用不确定性感知的证据学习合成语义和伪造线索视图，提供校准的不确定性估计。实验表明该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有单视图范式难以泛化，因为主导语义特征淹没细微伪造痕迹，导致过度自信且脆弱的预测（语义掩蔽效应）。
Method: 分两阶段：分阶段使用几何视图净化通过几何投影分解纠缠表示空间，抑制语义干扰；治阶段使用不确定性感知的证据学习合成不同视图，显式建模语义和伪造线索之间的认知冲突，提供校准的不确定性估计。
Result: 在多个基准上持续优于现有方法的泛化性能，并提供可靠的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: 该方法通过分治策略和不确定性建模实现了可靠的深度伪造检测。

papers.title: EVA-Net: Subject-Independent EEG Motor Decoding with Video-Derived Motor Priors
papers.abstract_en: Practical non-invasive Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems require EEG decoders with strong cross-subject generalization and minimal calibration. However, inter-subject variability and signal non-stationarity often entangle motor semantics with subject-specific noise, limiting subject-independent decoding. Recent multimodal approaches use text as a semantic anchor, yet text provides sparse and static supervision for inherently dynamic motor processes. To address this issue, we propose EVA-Net, a two-stage framework that uses action videos as semantic priors for subject-independent EEG motor decoding. In the first stage, EEG and video features are aligned in a shared space using cross-modal and supervised contrastive objectives to reduce subject-specific variation. In the second stage, video category prototypes and knowledge distillation transfer video-derived priors to an EEG-only classifier without adding inference overhead. Experiments on two public datasets show that EVA-Net achieves strong subject-independent decoding performance, including an 8.66% LOSO accuracy gain on EEGMMI. Ablation results further suggest that video provides a more effective semantic anchor than the text baseline considered in this work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EVA-Net，一种两阶段框架，利用动作视频作为语义先验进行跨被试EEG运动解码。第一阶段通过跨模态和监督对比学习对齐EEG和视频特征以减少个体差异；第二阶段通过视频类别原型和知识蒸馏将视频先验迁移到仅需EEG的分类器，且不增加推理开销。两个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在跨被试解码上取得了显著提升，包括在EEGMMI数据集上LOSO准确率提高8.66%。
Motivation: 实际非侵入式BCI系统需要跨被试泛化且最小校准的EEG解码器，但个体差异和信号非平稳性使运动语义与被试特定噪声纠缠，限制了跨被试解码。现有使用文本作为语义锚的多模态方法对动态运动过程的监督稀疏且静态。
Method: 提出EVA-Net两阶段框架：第一阶段使用跨模态对比学习和监督对比学习对齐EEG和视频特征；第二阶段利用视频类别原型和知识蒸馏将视频先验迁移到EEG-only分类器，不增加推理开销。
Result: 两个公开数据集上的跨被试解码取得优异性能，包括在EEGMMI上LOSO准确率提升8.66%。消融实验表明视频比文本基线提供更有效的语义锚。
Conclusion: 摘要强调视频作为语义先验的有效性，并展示EVA-Net在跨被试EEG运动解码中的优势，未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Beyond the Simplex: Balanced Prototype Geometry for Scorer-Agnostic Open-Set Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Open-set recognition (OSR) requires a classifier to reject inputs from unseen classes which is essential in safety-critical settings such as medical imaging. Simplex based methods, which fix class prototypes at the vertices of a regular simplex and then reject via a distance-ratio score, perform well empirically but lack theoretical justification, and existing analysis applies only when the embedding dimension d is at least C-1, which is the regime in which a regular simplex exists. We give a theoretical account of simplex-ratio OSR that holds in every embedding dimension, including d < C-1. Our analysis centers on balanced equal-norm codes: prototype configurations with equal lengths and zero sum, which exist for all d >= 2 and include the regular simplex as a special case. For these codes we show that an auxiliary squared ratio score has sublevel sets that are exact unions of Euclidean balls, which in turn bracket the acceptance region of the operational score; and we prove a sharp dichotomy: the prototypes attain one-distance symmetry, behaving like a regular simplex, if and only if d >= C-1, with controlled degradation governed by an explicit defect parameter below that threshold. We further show the false-acceptance rate decays exponentially in d under natural isotropy assumptions, and that the operational score is globally Lipschitz with compact acceptance regions. Empirically, we study balanced prototype geometry as both an analytic tool and a representation-learning prior, rather than as a stand-alone state-of-the-art detector. Across CIFAR and MedMNIST open-set splits, the geometry provides useful structure, but OSR performance remains strongly dependent on the scoring rule: raw ratio scores typically underperform nearest-neighbor and logit-based alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为开放集识别（OSR）中的单纯形比率方法提供理论分析，提出平衡等范数原型（balanced equal-norm codes）的几何框架，证明其在不同嵌入维度下的性质，并指出OSR性能强烈依赖于评分规则而非单纯的几何结构。
Motivation: 现有基于单纯形的OSR方法缺乏理论支撑，且分析仅适用于嵌入维度d≥C-1（存在正则单纯形的条件），无法解释低维情况下的行为。
Method: 引入平衡等范数原型（平衡长度相等、和为零的配置），证明其辅助平方比率分数的子集是欧几里得球的并集，并建立维度阈值d≥C-1时原型具有单距离对称性的二分定理，以及误接受率的指数衰减和Lipschitz性质。
Result: 在CIFAR和MedMNIST开放集划分上，平衡原型几何提供有益结构，但原始比率分数通常不如最近邻和基于logit的替代方案。
Conclusion: 平衡原型几何可作分析工具和表示学习先验，但OSR性能的关键在于评分规则的选择，而非单纯几何。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: G2LoRA: Gradient Orthogonal Low-Rank Adaptation Framework for Graph Continual Learning on Text-Attributed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-Aligner has emerged as a prevalent pre-training paradigm for Text-Attributed Graphs(TAGS), aligning graph and text modalities into a shared embedding space via CLIP-style contrastive learning. While effective on individual downstream tasks, we observe severe catastrophic forgetting when such models are sequentially fine-tuned on streaming tasks. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning alleviates forgetting to some extent, it remains insufficient to resolve task interference and ineffective knowledge transfer. In this work, we study graph continual learning for LLM-as-Aligner models on TAGs, with the goal of mitigating interference while promoting positive transfer across tasks. This setting introduces two fundamental challenges: (1) heterogeneous downstream tasks induce shifting optimization objectives, hindering unified fine-tuning; and (2) graph and text encoders exhibit different sensitivities to adaptation, making uncoordinated updates prone to misalignment. To address these challenges, we propose G2LoRA, a continual learning framework for TAGs. G2LoRA unifies node-, link-, and graph-level tasks under a single graph--text alignment objective, and enables consistent optimization across domain/class/task incremental modes. To reduce task interference while encouraging positive transfer, G2LoRA performs category-aware gradient projection in structured subspaces, resolving conflicting updates and enabling conditional backward transfer to balance forward and backward knowledge flow. To further prevent cross-modal drift, G2LoRA introduces gradient magnitude modulation to coordinate update rates between graph and text encoders. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that G2LoRA consistently outperforms strong baselines across different backbone architectures, achieving superior continual performance and transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM-as-Aligner在文本属性图上的持续学习问题，提出G2LoRA框架。该框架通过统一图-文本对齐目标、类别感知梯度投影和梯度幅度调制，解决了任务干扰和跨模态漂移，在多个基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态对齐模型在连续微调时遭受严重灾难性遗忘，参数高效微调仍不足以处理异构下游任务带来的优化目标冲突以及图编码器与文本编码器之间的不协调更新。
Method: 提出G2LoRA：1) 将节点、边、图级任务统一为单图-文本对齐目标；2) 在结构化子空间中进行类别感知梯度投影，解决冲突更新并实现条件后向迁移；3) 引入梯度幅度调制协调图与文本编码器的更新速率。
Result: 在基准数据集上，G2LoRA在不同骨干架构下均优于强基线，持续学习性能与迁移性显著提升。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过统一目标、梯度投影和幅度调制可有效缓解任务干扰与跨模态漂移，促进正迁移，适用于多种增量学习模式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Deep Learning for Generating Computational PIN-4 Immunohistochemistry Staining from Prostate Biopsy H&E Images
papers.abstract_en: Immunohistochemistry (IHC)is frequently used to resolve diagnostically ambiguous prostate cancer biopsy findings on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained tissue. However, PIN-4 IHC staining is typically performed on adjacent tissue sections, limiting direct spatial comparison between the H&E morphology and the corresponding immunophenotypic signal. A paired, registered H&E/PIN-4 dataset was constructed from routine clinical prostate biopsy whole-slide images (WSIs), and a conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) was trained to synthesize PIN-4 staining patterns directly from native H&E image patches. The final dataset comprised 172 paired WSIs from 93 patients and 27,298 registered 1024x1024 patch pairs, spanning adenocarcinoma-positive and benign cases with representation across age, race, and ethnicity groups. The model was evaluated on a held-out test set of 1,814 patch pairs from 17 WSIs, achieving a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 21.88 dB, structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.667, Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) of 0.684, and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) of 0.417. Qualitative review by a board-certified pathologist showed that generated images captured diagnostically relevant PIN-4 staining patterns, including AMACR/racemase expression and basal-cell-associated staining, while preserving spatial correspondence with the source H&E morphology. Accuracy of synthesis varied across morphologically complex regions, including high-grade carcinoma and intraductal carcinoma. These results support the feasibility of supervised PIN-4 synthesis from routinely acquired brightfield H&E prostate biopsy images. The approach enables direct interpretation of predicted PIN-4 marker patterns in the context of the source prostate H&E architecture, addressing a current spatial limitation of conventional adjacent-section IHC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个配准的前列腺活检H&E与PIN-4 IHC全切片图像对数据集，使用条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）从H&E图像块合成PIN-4染色模式。模型在测试集上达到PSNR 21.88 dB、SSIM 0.667、PCC 0.684、LPIPS 0.417，病理学专家评估认为生成的图像保留了诊断相关的染色模式，但在高分级癌和导管内癌等复杂区域合成精度有所变化。该方法支持从常规H&E图像直接合成PIN-4标记，克服了传统相邻切片IHC的空间局限性。
Motivation: PIN-4 IHC通常用于辅助诊断前列腺癌，但常规做法是在相邻组织切片上进行，限制了H&E形态与免疫表型信号之间的直接空间对比。本文旨在通过深度学习从H&E图像直接合成PIN-4染色，实现同一组织切片上的空间对应。
Method: 构建了一个包含172对配准WSI（来自93例患者，27,298个1024x1024图像块对）的数据集，训练条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）从H&E图像块生成对应的PIN-4染色模式。
Result: 在17张WSI的1,814个测试块对上，模型达到PSNR 21.88 dB、SSIM 0.667、PCC 0.684、LPIPS 0.417。病理学家定性评估表明生成的PIN-4染色捕获了AMACR/racemase表达和基底细胞相关染色，且与H&E形态空间对应良好，但在高分级癌和导管内癌等复杂区域精度下降。
Conclusion: 研究表明从常规H&E图像监督合成PIN-4 IHC是可行的，能够直接解释预测的PIN-4标记模式与源H&E结构的关系，解决了传统相邻切片IHC的空间局限性。

papers.title: WorldCoder-Bench: Benchmarking Physically Grounded 3D World Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked not only to write static interfaces, but to construct executable interactive worlds from natural language. Browser-native 3D, commonly built with Three.js, is a natural next frontier: generated programs must integrate assets, obey spatial and physical constraints, and keep user-facing controls synchronized with hidden runtime state. Existing web-generation benchmarks and evaluators, however, largely observe only pixels or DOM nodes, while the mechanics of a Three.js world unfold inside an opaque <canvas>. We introduce WorldCoder-Bench, a benchmark for autonomous, physically grounded 3D world synthesis. WorldCoder-Bench contains 2,026 expert-curated tasks across Simulation, Rendering, and Application scenarios, with optional .glb assets and hidden behavioral contracts. We further propose StateProbe, an execution-based protocol that probes generated programs in a sandboxed browser and verifies hidden, mutation-hardened contracts over runtime states and transitions. Beyond verification coverage, we report Return on Automation and Time Efficiency Multiplier to measure correctness-adjusted cost and time savings. Across nine frontier models, the best system reaches only 27.8% verification coverage on WorldCoder-Core and 19.9% on WorldCoder-Robust, with failures dominated by state-schema drift and broken interaction chains rather than missing scene elements. Utility metrics further show that cheap or fast models can still provide substantial value on easier domains. WorldCoder-Bench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WorldCoder-Bench/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldCoder-Bench 是一个用于自主、物理基础3D世界合成的基准测试，包含2,026个专家策划的任务，涵盖模拟、渲染和应用场景。该基准通过 StateProbe 协议在沙盒浏览器中探测生成程序，验证隐藏的运行时状态和转换。当前最强模型仅达到27.8%的验证覆盖率，失败主要由状态模式漂移和交互链断裂导致。
Motivation: 现有 web 生成基准主要观测像素或 DOM 节点，无法评估 Three.js 构建的 3D 世界的物理约束和运行时状态同步。
Method: 提出 WorldCoder-Bench 基准和 StateProbe 执行协议，通过沙盒浏览器探测生成程序，并验证隐藏的、抗变异的状态契约。
Result: 最佳模型在 WorldCoder-Core 上验证覆盖率为27.8%，在 WorldCoder-Robust 上为19.9%，失败主因是状态模式漂移和交互链断裂。

papers.title: Task-Induced Representational Invariances Depend on Learning Objective in Deep RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has long served as a model for goal-directed animal behavior in neuroscience. Modern deep RL has shown remarkable success across many domains, further strengthening this connection. The ability to learn abstract representations of high-dimensional state spaces underlies much of this success. However, theoretical understanding of these learned representations remains limited, hindering direct comparisons between models and animal learning. We address this gap by analyzing deep RL representations through the lens of MDP reduction theory. Investigating canonical RL algorithms in a navigation task, we find that even when performance is comparable, the value-based method (DQN) learns representations that are invariant to MDP homomorphism symmetries, while the policy-gradient method (PPO) learns representations invariant to action symmetries. These differences emerge consistently across domains, have downstream consequences for transfer learning, and appear in LLMs in a prompt-dependent manner. Our findings provide a principled approach to comparing learned representations across RL algorithms, with demonstrated practical implications and possible insights for neural coding in the brain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过MDP归约理论分析深度强化学习中的表示学习，发现基于值的方法（DQN）学习对MDP同态对称性不变的表示，而策略梯度方法（PPO）学习对动作对称性不变的表示。这些差异在多个领域一致出现，影响迁移学习，并在大语言模型中以提示依赖方式显现。
Motivation: 深度强化学习作为神经科学中目标导向行为的模型，但其学到的表示缺乏理论理解，阻碍了与动物学习的直接比较。
Method: 利用MDP归约理论，在导航任务中分析经典深度强化学习算法（DQN和PPO）所学表示的不变性。
Result: 即使性能相当，DQN的表示对MDP同态对称性不变，PPO的表示对动作对称性不变；该差异跨领域稳定，影响迁移学习，并在LLM中观察到提示依赖效应。
Conclusion: 该工作为比较不同强化学习算法的表示提供了原则性框架，具有实践意义，并可能启发对大脑神经编码的理解。

papers.title: Continual Learning as a Multiphase Moving-Boundary Problem
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning struggles to balance retaining past knowledge with absorbing new tasks. Stefan-CL elegantly resolves this stability-plasticity dilemma through the physics of melting. It frames consolidated knowledge as a protected "solid" and unused capacity as an adaptable "liquid." As the network learns, this boundary expands, governed by a "latent heat" tuning dial. By mathematically freezing the learned interior, Stefan-CL cuts forgetting to near zero, matching memory-heavy baselines without storing raw data, forging a beautiful, physics-grounded path for AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stefan-CL 方法，将持续学习中的稳定性-可塑性困境类比为物理中的熔化过程，通过“潜热”调节来扩展学习边界，使已学知识冻结为“固体”，未用容量保持为“液体”，从而在不存储原始数据的情况下几乎消除遗忘，匹配记忆密集型基线。
Motivation: 持续学习面临保留旧知识与吸收新任务的平衡难题，现有方法难以优雅解决稳定性-可塑性困境。
Method: Stefan-CL 将知识类比为受保护的“固体”区域，未用容量为可适应的“液体”区域，网络学习时边界扩展，由“潜热”参数控制，并通过数学冻结已学区域来阻止遗忘。
Result: 摘要声称该方法将遗忘降至接近零，且在不存储原始数据的情况下达到与记忆密集型基线相当的性能。
Conclusion: 该方法为持续学习提供了基于物理理论的优雅路径，但其在非图像任务或大规模序列场景下的泛化性尚待验证。

papers.title: RadioMaster: Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Radio Signal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Translating user intents into physical radio signals represents the critical yet notoriously tedious final step in wireless prototyping, as it requires intricate knowledge of physical layer details and presents immense implementation challenges. Large Language Models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems have revolutionized conventional software engineering, raising the compelling question of whether they can resolve these formidable difficulties. However, our investigations reveal that current models experience significant limitations and fail to accomplish this task when applied to radio signal generation. This performance degradation primarily stems from severe domain ignorance and a fundamental insensitivity to physical hardware constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce RadioMaster, a fully autonomous multi-agent framework designed to seamlessly translate user input into real-world wireless emissions. RadioMaster operates on three synergistic pillars: RadioWiki for domain-specific knowledge retrieval, RadioAgent for collaborative I/Q sample generation alongside hardware configuration, and RadioEmulator for closed-loop physical layer verification. Furthermore, we construct RadioBench, the first comprehensive benchmark tailored specifically for the radio signal generation domain. Extensive real-world evaluations demonstrate that RadioMaster significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines regarding configuration viability and signal fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RadioMaster，一个基于多智能体系统的全自主框架，用于将用户意图自动转换为真实的无线电信号。该框架包含三个核心模块：RadioWiki（领域知识检索）、RadioAgent（协作生成I/Q样本与硬件配置）和RadioEmulator（闭环物理层验证）。同时构建了第一个无线电信号生成领域综合基准RadioBench。真实世界评估表明RadioMaster在配置可行性和信号保真度上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 将用户意图转化为物理无线电信号是无线原型设计中繁琐且关键的最后一步，需要深层物理层知识和复杂实现。现有大语言模型和多智能体系统在软件工程中取得突破，但在无线电信号生成任务上表现严重不足，主要源于领域知识匮乏和对硬件约束不敏感。
Method: 提出三支柱架构：RadioWiki提供领域专用知识检索；RadioAgent实现协作I/Q样本生成与硬件配置；RadioEmulator进行闭环物理层验证。构建了首个综合基准RadioBench。
Result: 在真实世界测试中，RadioMaster在配置可行性和信号保真度上显著超越当前最优基线。
Conclusion: RadioMaster作为全自主多智能体框架，有效弥合了用户意图与真实无线发射之间的鸿沟，证明了LLM多智能体系统在无线信号生成领域的潜力。

papers.title: A Theoretical Framework for Self-Play Theorem Proving Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Self-play, a type of training algorithm that enables a model to self-improve, has recently shown promising empirical results in the context of formal theorem proving using Large Language Models (LLMs). (Dong & Ma, 2025) instantiate self-play with two cooperating agents: a prover, which proves theorems, and a conjecturer, which generates new theorems as a curriculum to the prover. In this paper, we provide a theoretical framework for understanding the self-improvement capabilities of self-play algorithms for theorem proving. First, we formalize the set of theorems as a graph, with nodes as theorems and edges between pairs of theorems with similar semantics. We introduce a set of primitive assumptions that characterize the guarantees of a trained prover and how a conjecturer can access the structure of the graph. Second, we show that if the underlying graph of theorems is well-connected, then a prover-conjecturer system, where the conjecturing algorithm is based on a reversible random walk, is sufficient to grow the set of proved theorems exponentially. Third, motivated by an issue encountered empirically by self-play algorithms, where the conjecturer tends to generate artificially complex and non-fundamental theorems, we propose a diversity measure for a training distribution of theorems generated by a conjecturer and an improved conjecturing algorithm that locally maximizes this diversity measure, by computing the diffusion similarity between neighboring theorems in the theorem graph. Finally, we describe a method to compute the diffusion similarity by using contrastive learning to embed nodes into Euclidean space and then computing the inner-product between embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为定理证明中的自我博弈算法提供了理论框架。将定理集形式化为图结构，假设图是良好连通的，则基于可逆随机游走的猜想者-证明者系统能够指数级扩大已证明定理集。针对猜想者生成复杂非基础定理的问题，提出基于扩散相似度的多样性度量及局部最大化该度量的改进算法，并用对比学习嵌入计算扩散相似度。
Motivation: 自我博弈在形式定理证明中已显示出实证有效性，但缺乏理论理解；且实践中猜想者易生成过于复杂、非基础的定理，影响训练效果。
Method: 将定理集建模为图，节点为定理，边连接语义相似的定理；提出可逆随机游走的猜想者算法，证明在连通图下可指数级扩张；引入基于扩散相似度的多样性度量，并设计局部最大化该度量的猜想算法；用对比学习将节点嵌入欧氏空间，通过内积计算扩散相似度。
Result: 理论上证明了在良好连通定理图下，可逆随机游走猜想者可使已证明定理集指数增长；提出的多样性度量与改进算法有望缓解猜想者生成非基础定理的问题。
Conclusion: 本文为自我博弈定理证明提供了理论基础，并针对实际缺陷提出了改进方向。

papers.title: Polaris: Scaling Up Instruction-Guided Image Generation Towards Millions of Personalized Style Needs
papers.abstract_en: Users increasingly expect image generation models to quickly adapt to highly diverse and personalized requirements, such as producing images with distinctive styles or characteristics. Traditional approaches rely on fine-tuning, which is costly and difficult to scale. To cope with these limitations, the community has accumulated a growing library of fine-tuned modules and adapters, where each component targets specific generation needs and collectively serves as a foundation for handling new demands. This naturally raises a question: instead of repeatedly training new models, can we systematically exploit this expanding ecosystem to better fulfill user instructions? To this end, we present Polaris, an intelligent retrieval framework that automatically selects and integrates suitable models from the model library based on a user's instructions. The key insight is that harnessing such a massive and heterogeneous pool requires not only finding the most relevant modules among thousands of candidates, but also aligning them effectively for instruction-driven generation and editing. Polaris addresses this challenge by indexing over 6,500 checkpoints and 75,000 adapters, and retrieving the most relevant components given a user's input and instruction. In doing so, it delivers scalable, controllable, and well-aligned generation -- without any additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 Polaris，一个智能检索框架，能够根据用户指令从包含超过 6,500 个检查点和 75,000 个适配器的模型库中自动选择和集成合适的模型，实现可扩展、可控且对齐的图像生成，无需额外训练。
Motivation: 现有图像生成模型为了适应多样化的个性化需求通常需要微调，成本高且难以扩展。社区积累了大量微调模块和适配器，如何系统性地利用这些现有资源来更好地满足用户指令是一个关键问题。
Method: Polaris 通过索引大量检查点和适配器，并根据用户输入和指令检索最相关的组件，从而自动选择和集成合适的模型，无需额外训练。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数值，但声称该方法能够实现可扩展、可控且对齐的图像生成。
Conclusion: Polaris 展示了利用大规模模型库进行零训练指令引导图像生成的可行性，但需要进一步验证其在更多场景下的效果。

papers.title: Boosting Multimodal Federated Learning via Chained Modality Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Federated Learning (MMFL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative learning across decentralized clients with heterogeneous data and modality availability. However, most existing MMFL methods cast multimodal training as a joint optimization problem, overlooking a key bottleneck: modality competition, where dominant modalities suppress weaker ones and lead to suboptimal global models. To address this, we propose FedMChain, a balanced MMFL framework that structures federated multimodal training as a chain of modality-wise phases. This phase-wise design gives each modality a dedicated local optimization window on multimodal clients to mitigate modality competition, and further promotes cross-modal complementarity via an error-compensated regularizer. On the server side, we employ a sparse sign-guided aggregation strategy that leverages directional sign agreement for robust intra-modality aggregation, avoids destructive averaging, and supports less frequent synchronization to reduce communication overhead. Extensive experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that FedMChain consistently improves predictive performance while requiring less frequent communication than baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多模态联邦学习中模态竞争导致弱模态被抑制的问题，提出FedMChain框架，将联合优化分解为按模态分阶段的链式结构，每个模态有专属局部优化窗口，并通过误差补偿正则化促进跨模态互补。服务器端采用稀疏符号引导聚合策略，减少通信开销。实验表明，FedMChain在多个多模态基准上持续提升预测性能并降低通信频率。
Motivation: 现有MMFL方法将多模态训练视为联合优化问题，忽略了模态竞争——主导模态抑制弱模态，导致全局模型次优。
Method: 提出FedMChain框架，将联邦多模态训练组织为按模态分阶段的链式优化，每个模态在客户端有独立优化窗口，并通过误差补偿正则化促进模态互补；服务器端采用稀疏符号引导聚合策略，利用方向符号一致性进行稳健的模态内聚合，减少破坏性平均，并支持低频率同步以降低通信开销。
Result: 在多模态基准上的大量实验表明，FedMChain在降低通信频率的同时持续提升了预测性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过模态分阶段优化和误差补偿正则化可以有效缓解模态竞争，而稀疏符号引导聚合则兼顾了鲁棒性和通信效率。

papers.title: Does Compression Preserve Uncertainty? A Unified Benchmark for Quantized and Sparse LLMs via Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Model compression techniques such as quantization and pruning are widely used to reduce the deployment cost of large language models (LLMs), with existing evaluations focusing almost exclusively on accuracy preservation. However, in safety-critical applications, a model's ability to reliably quantify its own uncertainty is equally important. We ask: does compression preserve this ability? To answer this question, we benchmark 12 LLMs under various compression configurations across five NLP tasks, using conformal prediction to provide a rigorous, distribution-free measure of uncertainty. Our experiments reveal that: (I) compression frequently decouples accuracy from uncertainty; (II) larger models absorb compression-induced uncertainty far more effectively than smaller ones; and (III) uncertainty inflation is often threshold-like rather than gradual. These results suggest that accuracy-only evaluation is insufficient for assessing the deployment readiness of compressed LLMs, and that uncertainty-aware benchmarking should be a standard component of model compression pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过共形预测（conformal prediction）方法，系统评估了量化与剪枝等压缩技术对大型语言模型（LLM）不确定性量化能力的影响。在12个LLM和5个NLP任务上的实验表明：压缩常导致准确率与不确定性解耦；大模型能更有效地吸收压缩带来的不确定性；不确定性膨胀往往是阈值式的而非渐进的。
Motivation: 现有压缩评估几乎只关注准确率保持，但在安全关键应用中，模型可靠量化自身不确定性的能力同样重要，而该能力是否被压缩保留下尚未被研究。
Method: 使用共形预测（conformal prediction）作为严格、分布自由的不确定性度量，在12个LLM上施加不同压缩配置（量化与剪枝），跨越5个NLP任务进行基准测试。
Result: 实验发现：(I) 压缩频繁导致准确率与不确定性解耦；(II) 大模型吸收压缩引入不确定性的能力远优于小模型；(III) 不确定性膨胀常呈阈值式而非渐进式。
Conclusion: 仅用准确率评估不足以判断压缩后LLM的部署就绪性，不确定性感知的基准测试应成为模型压缩管线的标准组件。

papers.title: RescueBench: Can Embodied Agents Save Lives in the Wild ?
papers.abstract_en: Search-and-rescue (SAR) requires embodied agents to explore unfamiliar environments under multimodal uncertainty, perform multi-stage interactions, and retrieve spatial memory over long horizons. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear how failures compound when they must be composed in realistic workflows. We introduce RescueBench, a photo-realistic diagnostic benchmark that instantiates SAR as a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. By combining sequential task composition with stage-level evaluation, RescueBench enables analysis of how exploration and memory failures propagate through embodied rescue workflows. It contains five progressive difficulty levels that vary in environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy, along with an automatic episode generation and annotation pipeline for scalable evaluation and training. We evaluate seven baselines, an oracle reference, and human players, showing that no baselines complete the full task at the greatest difficulty. Stage-level diagnosis identifies autonomous exploration as the dominant failure mode and spatial memory as a second, independent bottleneck, suggesting that these limitations are not resolved by current topological visual-language navigation or map-based methods. Code is available in https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RescueBench 是一个面向具身智能体 (embodied agent) 的搜救 (search-and-rescue) 诊断基准，将任务分解为多模态探索、目标救援、记忆引导返回和最终移交四个阶段。通过组合任务与阶段评估，揭示探索失败与记忆失败如何在完整工作流中累积。基准包含五个难度等级，并配备自动化场景生成流水线。评估七个基线模型、一个 oracle 参考和人类玩家，结果显示所有基线在最高难度下均无法完成完整任务，阶段诊断表明自主探索是主要失败模式，空间记忆是次要独立瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有基准通常孤立评估探索、交互或记忆能力，未考虑这些能力在现实搜救工作流中组合时的失败累积效应，导致对具身智能体系统局限性的理解不全面。
Method: RescueBench 将搜救任务形式化为四阶段流水线：多模态探索、目标救援、记忆引导返回和最终移交。通过自动化场景生成器构建五个逐步递增的难度等级，并支持阶段级评估以分析失败传播。
Result: 在最高难度下，所有七个基线模型均无法完成完整任务。阶段级诊断量化显示自主探索是最主要的失败模式，空间记忆是第二个独立瓶颈，当前基于拓扑视觉-语言导航或地图的方法尚不能解决这些问题。
Conclusion: RescueBench 证明当前具身智能体在综合搜救任务中的能力严重不足，尤其在探索与空间记忆方面，为未来研究指明了改进方向。

papers.title: The Lie We Tell: Correcting the Euclidean Fallacy in Vision Language Action Policies via Score Matching on Tangent Space
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action policies achieve remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet commit a fundamental geometric error we term the $\textbf{Euclidean Fallacy}$: representing SE(3) poses as flat $\mathbb{R}^{12}$ vectors. This approximation induces (1) manifold drift violating SO(3) constraints, (2) broken equivariance under coordinate transformations, and (3) non-geodesic trajectories with excessive kinematic cost. We introduce $\textbf{Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)}$, a diffusion framework operating intrinsically on SE(3). Our method injects noise through left-invariant SDEs, predicts scores in the tangent space, and retracts samples via the exponential map. This formulation eliminates manifold drift by construction while guaranteeing coordinate-frame equivariance and geodesic optimality. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, LDA improves average task length from $3.27$ to $3.51$ ($+7.3\%$). We further validate our method on real robot and the results show that our methodology outperforms the baseline on majority tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭露了扩散视觉-语言-动作策略中常见的欧几里得谬误：将SE(3)位姿表示为平坦的R^12向量，导致流形漂移、坐标变换下的等变性破坏以及非测地轨迹。作者提出李扩散器动作器(LDA)，在SE(3)上直接进行扩散，通过左不变SDE注入噪声，在切空间中预测分数，并通过指数映射拉回样本，从构造上消除流形漂移，保证等变性和测地最优性。在CALVIN ABC→D上，平均任务长度从3.27提升至3.51(+7.3%)，真实机器人实验也验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作策略将SE(3)位姿近似为平坦欧几里得向量，导致流形约束被违反、等变性丧失及轨迹非最优，限制了机器人操作的物理真实性和性能。
Method: 提出Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)，在SE(3)流形上定义左不变随机微分方程(SDE)作为前向扩散，在切空间中学习分数函数，并通过指数映射将噪声样本拉回流形，实现内在一致的扩散过程。
Result: 在CALVIN ABC→D仿真任务中，LDA将平均任务长度从3.27提升至3.51（+7.3%）；在真实机器人实验中，LDA在多数任务上优于基线。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了在机器人策略中保持SE(3)几何结构的重要性，所提方法在仿真和真实场景中均有效，但摘要未讨论可扩展性或高维场景的性能。

papers.title: Mos-Gen: A Generative Molecular Framework for Mosquito Insecticide Design
papers.abstract_en: Mosquito-borne infectious diseases cause more than 700000 deaths worldwide each year. The long-term use of conventional chemical insecticides has induced serious resistance problems, creating an urgent need to develop novel, highly effective, and ecologically sustainable alternatives. While existing artificial intelligence approaches in this domain have focused primarily on activity prediction and classification, they leave a critical gap in the de~novo generation of novel molecular scaffolds. In this study, we propose Mos-Gen, a motif-aware generative collaborative framework that couples the pretrained molecular representation model Uni-Mol with a variational autoencoder (VAE), specifically tailored for the design of disulfide-containing allicin derivatives as mosquito insecticides. Among the generated candidates, fourteen compounds -- comprising nine predicted positives and five predicted negatives -- were selected for chemical synthesis and experimental validation. The hit rate among the predicted positives reached 78%, whereas none of the predicted negatives exhibited mosquitocidal activity. These experimental results fully validated the high-precision screening capability of the Mos-Gen framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mos-Gen，一个结合预训练分子表示模型 Uni-Mol 和变分自编码器（VAE）的基元感知生成协作框架，专门用于设计含二硫键的大蒜素衍生物作为蚊虫杀虫剂。实验验证了14个候选化合物，预测阳性命中率达78%，预测阴性均无活性，验证了框架的高精度筛选能力。
Motivation: 传统化学杀虫剂长期使用导致严重抗药性问题，亟需开发新型高效生态友好的替代品，而现有AI方法仅关注活性预测与分类，缺乏从头生成新分子骨架的能力。
Method: 提出 Mos-Gen 框架，采用预训练分子表征模型 Uni-Mol 结合变分自编码器（VAE），以基元感知方式生成含二硫键的大蒜素衍生物。
Result: 从生成候选物中选取14个化合物合成测试，预测阳性中78%具有灭蚊活性，预测阴性均无活性。
Conclusion: 实验充分验证了 Mos-Gen 框架的高精度筛选能力，为蚊虫杀虫剂设计提供了有效的从头生成方案。

papers.title: Unveiling the Limits of Large Language Models in Inferring Pragmatic Meaning from Non-Verbal Responses
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable progress in pragmatic language understanding, prior research has focused mainly on their comprehension of verbal behavior. Nonetheless, non-verbal behavior remains a fundamental component of human communication, especially when deliberately utilized in isolation to convey indirect meanings. In this work, we present the first systematic evaluation of LLMs' ability to infer pragmatic meaning in dialogue consisting solely of non-verbal responses. We explore three research questions: (1) Can LLMs recognize indirect intent conveyed through non-verbal responses? (2) When and how do LLMs fail to capture non-verbal intent? (3) How can we improve LLMs' ability to interpret non-verbal intent?. Through the evaluation, we observe that LLMs struggle to infer underlying meaning from non-verbal responses, with accuracy dropping by up to 60% points compared to verbal ones. Further extensive analysis reveals a behavioral pattern in LLMs' interpretations of non-verbal behavior and demonstrates that in-context learning facilitates pragmatic inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估大语言模型（LLM）从纯非语言回复中推断语用含义的能力。通过三个研究问题发现，LLM在非语言回复上的准确率相比语言回复下降高达60个百分点，并分析了其行为模式，表明上下文学习（in-context learning）有助于语用推理。
Motivation: 先前研究主要关注LLM对语言行为的理解，但非语言行为在人类交流中至关重要，尤其是故意单独使用以传达间接含义时，而LLM在这方面的能力尚未被系统评估。
Method: 提出三个研究问题，通过评估LLM在仅包含非语言回复的对话中推断语用含义的能力，并进行广泛分析以揭示行为模式。
Result: LLM从非语言回复中推断含义的准确率相比语言回复下降高达60个百分点；进一步分析表明上下文学习可以促进语用推理。
Conclusion: LLM在理解非语言行为方面存在显著局限，上下文学习可部分改善其表现。

papers.title: Suppressing Forgery-Specific Shortcuts for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake detection suffers from poor generalization across forgery methods, as existing models tend to rely on spurious method-specific shortcuts that fail to transfer to unseen manipulations. While recent approaches attempt to improve generalization, they lack an explicit mechanism to identify and suppress such shortcuts in learned representations. In this work, we propose Shortcut Subspace Suppression (S^3) framework that explicitly characterizes and suppresses method-specific shortcuts via subspace modeling. Our key insight is that variations distinguishing different forgery methods capture method-specific artifacts and thus serve as an effective proxy for method-specific shortcuts. To this end, we train a lightweight linear probe for forgery method classification and perform Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to extract the dominant shortcut subspace. Building on this formulation, we develop two complementary strategies to reduce shortcut reliance. During training, we softly suppress the shortcut subspace in feature representations, encouraging the model to rely on more generalizable cues for real/fake discrimination. At inference time, we introduce a training-free counterpart that attenuates neurons aligned with the identified shortcut directions, enabling plug-and-play generalization enhancement with improved interpretability. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves cross-method generalization while maintaining strong in-domain performance. The code will be released upon acceptance of the submission.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Shortcut Subspace Suppression (S^3) 框架，通过显式建模和抑制伪造方法特定的捷径子空间，提升深度伪造检测的跨方法泛化能力。该方法利用线性探针对伪造方法分类，并通过奇异值分解（SVD）提取主导捷径方向，在训练时软抑制特征表示中的该子空间，在推理时通过衰减对齐神经元实现即插即用的泛化增强。在多个基准上的实验表明，该方法在保持域内性能的同时显著提升了跨方法泛化。

Result: 在多个基准上，该方法显著提升了跨伪造方法的泛化性能，同时保持了强域内性能。
Conclusion: 通过显式子空间建模和抑制方法特定捷径，有效提升了深度伪造检测的泛化性，且推理阶段的增强方案具有即插即用和可解释性优势。
