papers.title: Evaluation of Baseline Methods for IDD-based SSD External Memory Search
papers.abstract_en: Many difficult search problems cannot be solved by algorithms such as A* using only RAM. Search algorithms which use external memory such as SSDs and HDDs with much higher capacity than RAM have been proposed in previous work, but previous work has focused on delayed duplicate detection approaches, as well as complex immediate duplicate detection (IDD) methods, and relatively simple methods for IDD have not been systematically studied. In addition, the effect of OS-level mechanisms for managing and speeding up accesses to external memory, such as page caches, has not been studied. This paper addresses these gaps in the literature by evaluating and analyzing the performance of simple baseline approaches for IDD-based A*.
papers.comment: accepted to The 19th International Symposium on Combinatorial Search (SoCS2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于SSD外部存储的A*搜索中，简单立即重复检测（IDD）方法缺乏系统评估的空白，实验分析了多种基线方法的性能，并考察了操作系统页缓存等机制的影响。研究表明，简单基线方法在不同场景下表现差异显著，OS缓存对性能有重要影响。
Motivation: 现有外部存储搜索研究多聚焦于复杂IDD方法或延迟重复检测，简单基线方法未被系统研究，且操作系统级缓存机制的影响尚不明确。
Method: 在A*框架下实现了多种简单IDD基线方法，包括基于哈希表、排序文件和位图等的重复检测策略，并通过实验对比其在不同搜索问题上的性能，同时控制OS页缓存状态。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但报告了不同基线方法的性能差异以及OS页缓存对搜索速度的影响。
Conclusion: 填补了简单IDD方法评估的空白，为实际应用中选择合适的外部内存搜索基线提供了实验依据。

papers.title: Observation, Not Prediction: Conversation-Level Disaggregated Scheduling for Agentic Serving
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents resolve a user task through many turns of dependent inference and tool calls, producing a workload whose total cost is unknown when the task arrives. Existing multi-turn systems keep the turn as the scheduling unit and decide, turn by turn, whether to disaggregate prefill from decode. That decision rests on the turn's decode length, tool behavior, and KV growth, quantities that are not observable when the scheduler must act, forcing the system to predict them. We show this dependence on prediction is imposed by the scheduling unit, not the workload. Raising the scheduling unit from the turn to the conversation converts turn-level irregularity into a stable, two-phase structure: 1) a compute-bound turn-1 prefill followed by 2) a long, memory-bound tail. Thus, with the conversation as the scheduling unit, placement reduces to reading the first-turn input length and per-decoder KV occupancy, both directly observable. We instantiate this principle in ConServe, which routes the first-turn prefill to a high-throughput prefiller, transfers the KV cache exactly once, and pins the conversation to a single decoder for its entire tail, with no learned model of decode-side cost. Against a per-turn prediction baseline, ConServe reduces p95 time-to-first-effective-token (the latency of a conversation's first user-visible output) by 51.08% and improves energy efficiency by 7.51% while preserving last-turn TBT and SLOs; mapping the two phases onto heterogeneous GPU tiers adds a further 22.75% in energy efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM agent多轮服务中调度单元（turn）导致需要预测不可观测量（如decode长度、工具行为、KV增长）的问题，提出将调度单元从turn提升到conversation，从而将turn级不规则性转化为稳定的两阶段结构：计算密集型turn-1 prefill和内存密集型的后续tail。基于此实现ConServe系统，通过直接观测第一轮输入长度和decoder KV占用率进行调度，无需预测decode成本。
Motivation: 现有多轮LLM agent系统以turn为调度单元，需要在不可观测时预测decode长度、工具行为和KV增长，导致调度不准确和效率低下。
Method: 提出以conversation为调度单元，将第一轮prefill分配给高吞吐量预填充器，随后将KV缓存一次性传输并固定到单个decoder处理整个tail；无需学习模型预测decode成本。
Result: 与基于turn的预测基线相比，ConServe将p95 time-to-first-effective-token（对话首个用户可见输出的延迟）降低51.08%，能效提升7.51%；将两阶段映射到异构GPU层级进一步使能效提升22.75%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过将调度单元从turn提高至conversation，可将调度决策从预测依赖转变为直接可观测量，从而提升延迟和能效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LayerRoute: Input-Conditioned Adaptive Layer Skipping via LoRA Fine-Tuning for Agentic Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Agentic language model systems alternate between two structurally distinct step types: structured tool calls (short, deterministic, low perplexity) and open-ended planning/reasoning steps (long, complex, high perplexity). Despite this heterogeneity, current inference systems apply identical compute to every step. We introduce LayerRoute, a lightweight adapter that learns to selectively skip transformer blocks on a per-input basis. LayerRoute augments each of the 24 transformer blocks in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with: (1) a per-layer router (~897 parameters, Linear(896,1)) that outputs a hard binary gate via the straight-through estimator, and (2) LoRA adapters (rank 8, ~1.08M parameters) on the Q/K/V/O attention projections. The backbone weights remain frozen. A single end-to-end training pass on agentic data (Hermes, Glaive, GSM8K, Turing) with a gate regularisation term forces the system to discover which blocks are skippable per input type. After 3,000 steps (6.4 minutes on an A100 40GB), LayerRoute achieves a 12.91% skip differential: tool calls skip 15.25% of FLOPs while planning steps skip only 2.34%, using only 1.10M trainable parameters (0.22% of the 494M backbone). Quality improves over the base model due to LoRA adaptation, with perplexity delta of -1.29 on tool calls and -1.30 on planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LayerRoute，一种轻量级适配器，通过在每个 Transformer 块上添加路由器和 LoRA 适配器，实现基于输入的层跳过。在 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct 上，经过 3000 步微调（6.4 分钟），工具调用步骤跳过 15.25% FLOPs，规划步骤跳过 2.34%，同时因 LoRA 适应提升了质量（困惑度分别下降 1.29 和 1.30）。
Motivation: 当前智能语言模型推理系统对所有步骤（工具调用和规划推理）分配相同计算量，忽略了这两种步骤在结构和复杂度上的异质性，导致效率低下。
Method: 在 24 层 Transformer 的每层添加一个 per-layer 路由器（约 897 参数）输出硬门控，以及注意力 Q/K/V/O 上的 LoRA 适配器（秩 8，约 1.08M 参数）。冻结骨干网络权重，在智能体数据（Hermes、Glaive、GSM8K、Turing）上单次端到端训练，加入门控正则化项，使模型发现每个输入类型下可跳过的块。
Result: 训练 3000 步（A100 40GB 上 6.4 分钟）后，工具调用步骤跳过 15.25% FLOPs，规划步骤跳过 2.34%，跳过差分达 12.91%；仅使用 1.10M 可训练参数（占骨干 494M 的 0.22%），且因 LoRA 适应，工具调用和规划步骤的困惑度分别下降 1.29 和 1.30。
Conclusion: LayerRoute 能够基于输入类型自适应跳过 Transformer 块，在几乎不增加参数的前提下显著降低计算量并保持或提升质量。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Attention in a Lightweight TCN for Efficient WiFi CSI-Based Human Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Human Action Recognition (HAR) using WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has gained increasing attention due to its non-contact, low-cost, and privacy-preserving nature. However, existing learning-based approaches largely rely on deep, computationally intensive architectures to implicitly capture motion dynamics from CSI measurements, thereby increasing model complexity and reducing efficiency. Instead, we argue that incorporating appropriate inductive biases tailored to the physical characteristics of CSI signals enables more efficient and effective learning. In this work, we propose a compact temporal convolutional network (TCN)-based framework that explicitly incorporates motion-aware inductive biases into feature learning. Specifically, we introduce a Doppler-energy-guided temporal attention mechanism in feature space to emphasize motion-salient time segments, and a variance-driven channel attention module to weight informative subcarriers based on temporal motion statistics adaptively. By integrating these domain-specific priors, the proposed model effectively captures motion dynamics without increasing architectural depth. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to deeper baselines, while significantly reducing parameter count and computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级时序卷积网络（TCN）用于基于WiFi信道状态信息（CSI）的人体活动识别。通过引入物理引导的注意力机制，包括多普勒能量引导的时间注意力和方差驱动的通道注意力，模型在保持低参数量的同时捕获运动动态。在多个基准数据集上，该方法优于更深的基线模型，并显著降低计算成本。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的方法通常依赖深层、计算密集的架构来隐式捕获CSI信号中的运动信息，导致模型复杂度和效率低下。本文认为引入符合CSI信号物理特性的归纳偏置可以实现更高效的学习。
Method: 提出一个紧凑的TCN框架，集成两种物理引导的注意力模块：基于多普勒能量的时间注意力，强调运动显著的时间段；基于方差驱动的通道注意力，根据时间运动统计自适应加权子载波。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法以更少的参数和计算成本达到优于深层基线的性能。
Conclusion: 通过显式注入运动相关的归纳偏置，轻量级TCN能有效捕获CSI中的运动动态，为高效人体活动识别提供新思路。

papers.title: Learning Implicit Bias in Generative Spaces for Accelerating Protein Dynamics Emulation
papers.abstract_en: Generative emulators of protein dynamics produce plausible trajectories at a fraction of the cost of molecular dynamics, but they inherit their training distribution and tend to revisit known states rather than reach rare ones under long-horizon extrapolation. Inspired by classical enhanced sampling, we introduce an implicit, history-dependent bias in the generative space of a pretrained emulator. Specifically, a history-aware score estimator augments the frozen emulator with a distance-weighted bias that steers reverse-time sampling away from previously generated structures, regularized by an environment-support term. To preserve structural validity at long horizons, a score-based refinement step re-projects drifted samples onto the data manifold using the frozen emulator. Our experiments demonstrate that the method (i) raises diversity by $35\%$ on DynamicPDB-80; (ii) on $12$ zero-shot Fast-Folding proteins, the learned bias alone reaches the unbiased emulator's coverage up to ${\sim}15\times$ faster, and pairing it with refinement reaches the coverage up to ${\sim}37\times$ faster while covering ${\sim}3\times$ as many low-energy states. Code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受经典增强采样启发，在生成式蛋白质动力学模拟器中引入隐式历史依赖偏置，通过历史感知评分估计器对反向时间采样施加距离加权偏置，并配合基于评分的精炼步骤保持结构有效性。实验表明该方法在DynamicPDB-80上多样性提升35%，在零样本Fast-Folding蛋白上达到无偏模拟器覆盖速度提升约15倍，结合精炼后提升约37倍且覆盖约3倍的低能态。
Motivation: 生成式蛋白质动力学模拟器继承了训练分布，在长时外推时倾向于重访已知状态而难以到达稀有状态，限制了其探索能力。
Method: 提出在预训练生成模拟器的隐空间中引入隐式历史依赖偏置：用历史感知评分估计器计算距离加权偏置来引导反向时间采样远离已生成结构，并通过环境支持项正则化；随后用冻结生成模拟器的评分精炼步骤将漂移样本重新投影到数据流形。
Result: 在DynamicPDB-80上多样性提升35%；对12个零样本Fast-Folding蛋白，单独使用偏置达到无偏模拟器覆盖速度提升约15倍，结合精炼后提升约37倍且覆盖约3倍的低能态。
Conclusion: 该方法通过引入历史依赖偏置和精炼步骤，有效提升了生成式模拟器对稀有状态的探索效率，同时保持结构有效性。

papers.title: CAPF: Guiding Search-Agent Rollouts with Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Recent LLM search agents use reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to learn search-augmented reasoning from outcome rewards. On hard problems, these agents rarely sample end-to-end successful rollouts, leaving outcome-only RLVR with few positive-reward trajectories. We argue that improving learning on such problems requires additional guidance during training, and RLVR already contains verifier-side information that can provide it. This information can identify errors or omissions in the agent's submitted answer and guide revision within the rollout. We propose a training-time mechanism called \textbf{Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback} (CAPF), which makes this verifier-side information available through a Privileged Feedback call during training. CAPF lets the policy revise zero-reward attempts into positive-reward repair trajectories and attenuates credit for the feedback call and earlier actions to accommodate deployment without this call. Empirical research demonstrates that CAPF improves Qwen3-4B's average exact-match score from 44.7% under outcome-only RLVR to 48.5% on seven open-domain QA benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种名为Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback (CAPF)的训练机制，用于改善LLM搜索代理在硬问题上的强化学习效果。通过利用验证器侧信息将零奖励尝试转化为正奖励修复轨迹，并衰减反馈调用和早期动作的信用以适配无此调用的部署。在七个开放域QA基准上，CAPF将Qwen3-4B的平均精确匹配分数从44.7%提升至48.5%。
Motivation: 现有LLM搜索代理在硬问题上很少采样到端到端成功的轨迹，导致只有结果奖励的强化学习只能获得少量正奖励轨迹，学习困难。需要额外的训练指导。
Method: 提出CAPF，在训练时通过特权反馈调用将验证器侧信息提供给策略，使策略能够将零奖励尝试修复为正奖励轨迹，并对反馈调用和早期动作进行信用衰减，以匹配部署时无此调用的场景。
Result: 在七个开放域QA基准上，CAPF使Qwen3-4B的平均精确匹配分数从44.7%提升至48.5%。
Conclusion: 论文强调CAPF是一种有效的训练机制，能够利用验证器信息改善搜索代理在硬问题上的学习。

papers.title: Dynamic Trust-Aware Sparse Communication Topology for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Consensus
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-driven multi-agent systems enhance the reliability of complex reasoning tasks through multi-round deliberation, role specialization, and cross-validation. However, existing multi-agent debate and collaboration frameworks typically adopt fully connected communication, causing the number of messages, token costs, and end-to-end latency to grow approximately quadratically with the number of agents; although fixed sparse topologies reduce overhead, they cannot adapt communication relationships to different task instances or intermediate reasoning states, making them prone either to preserving low-value interactions or to losing critical error-correction information. To address this problem, this paper proposes DySCo (Dynamic Sparse Consensus), a dynamic trust-aware sparse consensus mechanism. In each round of reasoning, DySCo estimates the value of communication edges based on agent reliability, answer divergence, and task relevance, and selects a small number of high-value edges for message exchange under budget constraints; it then aggregates the answers of different agents through dynamic trust weights and terminates the discussion early once consensus stabilizes. This mechanism replaces universal broadcasting with on-demand communication, thereby reducing communication overhead while preserving essential cross-validation information. We further present analyses of communication complexity and consensus stability, and evaluate the performance of DySCo on mathematical reasoning, logical reasoning, and factual question-answering tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中全连接通信带来的消息量、token成本和延迟随智能体数量二次增长的问题，提出动态信任感知稀疏共识机制DySCo。该机制在每个推理轮次中根据智能体可靠性、答案分歧和任务相关性估计通信边价值，在预算约束下选择少量高价值边进行消息交换，并通过动态信任权重聚合答案，共识稳定后提前终止讨论。在数学推理、逻辑推理和事实问答任务上进行了评估。
Motivation: 现有全连接通信开销随智能体数量二次增长，而固定稀疏拓扑无法适应不同任务实例或中间推理状态，可能保留低价值交互或丢失关键纠错信息。
Method: 提出DySCo（Dynamic Sparse Consensus），一种动态信任感知稀疏共识机制：每轮推理基于智能体可靠性、答案分歧和任务相关性估计通信边价值，在预算约束下选择高价值边交换消息，用动态信任权重聚合答案，并在共识稳定时提前终止。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅在数学推理、逻辑推理和事实问答任务上评估了DySCo的性能。
Conclusion: 该机制以按需通信替代通用广播，在降低通信开销的同时保留必要的交叉验证信息，并给出了通信复杂度和共识稳定性分析。

papers.title: Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization with a Polyak-type Step size: A Theory-Grounded Scheduler
papers.abstract_en: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) has established itself as a powerful and widely adopted optimizer for training machine learning models. By explicitly minimizing the sharpness of the loss landscape, SAM often improves generalization while delivering strong empirical performance. However, SAM and its variants, like most training algorithms, are sensitive to the choice of learning rate, which is typically selected through extensive hyperparameter tuning or predefined schedulers. In this work, motivated by recent advances on the effectiveness of stochastic Polyak step sizes for Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), we derive Polyak schedulers tailored to SAM-style updates, yielding novel adaptive algorithms in both deterministic and stochastic settings. In the smooth setting, we prove linear convergence for strongly convex objectives and an $\mathcal{O}(1/T)$ convergence rate for convex objectives in the deterministic case. In the stochastic setting, we establish analogous convergence guarantees up to a neighborhood of the optimum. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Polyak schedulers achieve performance comparable to or better than carefully tuned SAM baselines, while substantially reducing the need for learning-rate tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM)优化器对学习率敏感的缺陷，受随机Polyak步长启发，推导了适用于SAM的Polyak调度器，提出自适应算法。在确定性光滑环境下证明了强凸目标的线性收敛和凸目标的O(1/T)收敛率；随机环境下证明了到最优解邻域的收敛保证。实验表明该调度器性能与精心调参的SAM相当或更优，同时大幅减少学习率调参需求。
Motivation: SAM及其变体对学习率选择高度敏感，通常需要大量超参数调优或预定义调度器，限制了其实用性。
Method: 基于随机Polyak步长在SGD中的有效理论，推导适用于SAM风格的Polyak调度器，得到确定性和随机环境下的自适应算法。
Result: 在光滑确定性环境下提出线性收敛（强凸）和O(1/T)收敛（凸）的理论保证；随机环境下证明收敛到最优解邻域。数值实验显示性能与精心调参的SAM基线相当或更优，且显著减少调参工作量。
Conclusion: Polyak调度器能有效缓解SAM对学习率的敏感性，提供理论支撑的自适应步长，提升实用性。

papers.title: ROGLE: Robust Global-Local Alignment with Automated Region Supervision for Text-Based Person Search
papers.abstract_en: Text-Based Person Search (TBPS) aims to retrieve pedestrian images using natural language queries. However, existing TBPS models, especially those based on CLIP, struggle with fine-grained understanding due to global representational bias and semantic sparsity inherited from training on short captions. This results in weak fine-grained alignment, exacerbated by the scarcity of region-level annotations. To address this, we propose ROGLE (Robust Global-Local Embedding), a unified framework that overcomes reliance on costly manual annotations through an automated Region-to-Sentence Matching (RSM) strategy. RSM automatically mines pseudo region-sentence pairs for scalable fine-grained supervision. Furthermore, ROGLE employs a multi-granular learning strategy that fuses global contrastive learning with region-level local alignment. We also introduce the P-VLG Benchmark, a large-scale dataset constructed by curating and enriching images from established public benchmarks. It features over 100,000 annotated regions and rich long-form captions, making it the first TBPS benchmark to support both global and local assessment protocols. Extensive experiments show that ROGLE significantly outperforms existing approaches, particularly on challenging long-form queries. Code and the P-VLG benchmark will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ROGLE框架，通过自动区域-句子匹配策略生成伪标注，避免了昂贵的人工标注，并引入包含10万个标注区域和长描述的P-VLG基准数据集。实验表明，该方法在文本基础人物搜索任务上显著优于现有方法，尤其是在挑战性的长查询上。
Motivation: 现有基于CLIP的TBPS模型存在全局表示偏差和语义稀疏性，导致细粒度对齐弱，且区域级标注稀缺。
Method: 提出ROGLE框架，包括自动区域-句子匹配策略（RSM）生成伪区域-句子对，以及多粒度学习策略融合全局对比学习和区域级别局部对齐。同时构建了P-VLG基准数据集。
Result: 在多个基准上实验显示，ROGLE显著优于现有方法，尤其在长查询上表现出色。
Conclusion: 通过自动标注和多粒度学习，ROGLE提升了细粒度对齐性能；P-VLG基准为全局和局部评估提供了支持。

papers.title: Hierarchically Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Traffic Sign Recognition in Complex Driving Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Traffic sign detection is a fundamental component of environmental perception in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. However, most existing detectors rely on static inference with globally shared parameters, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse and unstructured traffic scenarios. As a result, a single static model often struggles to simultaneously handle both clear near-range samples and challenging conditions such as distant small targets or adverse weather environments. To address this limitation, we propose CBDES MoE TSR, a hierarchically decoupled heterogeneous mixture-of-experts(MoE) framework for traffic sign recognition. The proposed framework departs from the conventional globally shared parameter paradigm by introducing a heterogeneous You Only Look Once (YOLO) expert pool together with a lightweight gating network, enabling an image-level dynamic routing mechanism. Based on the semantic characteristics of the input image, the gating module selectively activates the most suitable expert model from the expert pool, enabling a shift from fixed parameter fitting to on-demand dynamic representation. This design enhances feature extraction capability for specific scenarios while maintaining controlled inference overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a remarkable balance between detection accuracy and efficiency on the composite traffic sign dataset. Specifically, our method attains an mAP50-95 of 76.8%, yielding a 2.3% improvement over the baseline method (74.5%) while simultaneously reducing computational overhead by approximately 39.4%. These findings robustly validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CBDES MoE TSR，一种层次解耦的异构混合专家（MoE）框架，用于复杂驾驶场景下的交通标志识别。通过异质YOLO专家池和轻量级门控网络实现图像级动态路由，根据输入语义特征选择最合适的专家模型。在复合交通标志数据集上达到76.8%的mAP50-95，较基线提升2.3%，计算开销降低约39.4%。
Motivation: 现有交通标志检测器依赖全局共享参数的静态推理，难以同时适应清晰近距样本和远距小目标、恶劣天气等挑战场景。
Method: 提出CBDES MoE TSR框架，包含异质YOLO专家池和轻量级门控网络，实现图像级动态路由，从固定参数拟合转向按需动态表征。
Result: 在复合交通标志数据集上，mAP50-95达到76.8%，较基线（74.5%）提升2.3%，计算开销降低约39.4%。
Conclusion: 验证了层次解耦MoE框架能在保持可控推理开销的同时提升检测精度，适用于复杂驾驶场景。

papers.title: Hist2Style: Histogram-Guided Stylization with Bilateral Grids
papers.abstract_en: Photorealistic style transfer aims to match the color and tone of an input image to that of a style target while preserving the content and details of the original scene. Although existing large image models can facilitate these kinds of appearance edits, their high computational demands, potential for hallucinations, and limited user control make them unsuitable for high-resolution, real-time workflows. We introduce Hist2Style, a bilateral-grid formulation for fast, edge-aware stylization that preserves visual fidelity by constraining operations to locally affine transforms in bilateral space. Our model distills a large image editing model into a lightweight network by training on a large supervised corpus generated with language and vision-language models, targeting spatially varying color edits. The network conditions on a histogram-based embedding of the style target to provide an interpretable interface for adjusting the output style by modifying the target color distribution. Overall, Hist2Style maintains content structure by construction, avoids hallucinations, and supports real-time, high-resolution photorealistic stylization with interactive user-controllable color and tone adjustments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hist2Style，一种基于双边网格 (bilateral grid) 的光照风格迁移方法，通过将操作限制在双边空间中的局部仿射变换，实现快速、边缘感知且保持内容结构的风格化。该方法从大型图像编辑模型中蒸馏出轻量网络，并通过直方图嵌入对风格目标进行条件控制，支持实时高分辨率交互式色调调整。
Motivation: 现有大型图像模型在照片级风格迁移中计算成本高、易产生幻觉且用户控制有限，难以用于高分辨率实时工作流。
Method: 提出双边网格公式，将颜色编辑视为双边空间中的局部仿射变换；利用大型语言和视觉语言模型生成的监督语料蒸馏出轻量网络，网络以风格目标的直方图嵌入为条件进行预测。
Result: 方法在保持内容结构、避免幻觉的同时，支持实时高分辨率风格迁移，并允许用户通过调整目标颜色分布交互控制输出风格。
Conclusion: Hist2Style 通过构造保证内容结构，避免幻觉，并支持实时高分辨率照片级风格化与用户可控的色调调整。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised Collaborative Domain Adaptation for Driving Scene Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Reliable driving scene parsing is a fundamental capability for autonomous vehicles operating in open and dynamic driving environments. However, adapting perception models to new deployment domains remains challenging because pixel-level annotations are expensive to obtain, while source-domain data are often inaccessible due to privacy, security, or ownership constraints. Existing source-free unsupervised domain adaptation methods typically rely on a single pre-trained source model, which makes the adapted perception system vulnerable to source-specific biases and limits its robustness under diverse road layouts, illumination conditions, weather patterns, and traffic conditions. This article presents an unsupervised collaborative domain adaptation (UCDA) framework for driving scene parsing in a source-free setting, which transfers complementary knowledge from multiple pre-trained source models to a unified target model without accessing any original source samples. To compare predictions from independently trained models, UCDA constructs a class-level prototype memory bank and estimates cross-model prediction reliability through prototype similarity, reducing the effect of inconsistent confidence scales across source models. Based on the resulting complementary supervision, UCDA adopts a two-stage transfer strategy: multiple source models are first refined on unlabeled target-domain driving data through collaborative optimization with positive and negative consistency constraints, and their validated expertise is then distilled into a single deployable target model. Comprehensive evaluations on public driving-scene datasets and real-world data collected from an autonomous vehicle platform demonstrate that UCDA effectively consolidates complementary multi-source knowledge, improving target-domain scene parsing reliability and generalization across diverse driving environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无监督协同域适应（UCDA）框架，用于无源域数据（source-free）的驾驶场景解析。UCDA 利用多个预训练源模型，通过构建类级原型记忆库和预测可靠性估计，实现多源知识互补，并采用两阶段迁移策略，最终蒸馏到一个目标模型。在公共数据集和真实自动驾驶平台上验证了可靠性和泛化性。
Motivation: 现有无源域适应方法依赖单源模型，易受源特定偏差影响，鲁棒性不足；且像素级标注昂贵，源数据因隐私等不可得。
Method: 提出 UCDA 框架，包括构建类级原型记忆库估计跨模型预测可靠性；两阶段策略：多源模型在无标签目标域数据上通过正负一致性约束协同优化，然后蒸馏为一个目标模型。
Result: 在公共驾驶场景数据集和真实自动驾驶平台数据上，UCDA 有效整合多源互补知识，提升了目标域场景解析的可靠性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 UCDA 在无源设定下利用多源模型互补知识改善驾驶场景解析的鲁棒性，适用于多样化驾驶环境。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Site4Drug: Predicting Drug-Binding Target Sites with an AI Agent
papers.abstract_en: Selecting where to intervene on a protein (i.e., choosing a targetable site) is often a more ambiguous and failure-prone bottleneck than selecting what binds, especially for membrane proteins where accessibility, topology, and post-translational modifications (PTMs) constrain actionable regions. We present Site4Drug, a modality-aware site-finding agent that outputs a ranked list of targetable regions with explicit constraints, evidence summaries, risk flags, and a traceable decision log. Rather than requiring users to specify the drug modality upfront, Site4Drug can recommend a binding modality (e.g., antibody/peptide-like vs small-molecule) from the same evidence used for site discovery, including topology, hydropathy, PTM propensity, disulfides, domain context, and sequence. Importantly, this evidence is applied consistently across modalities, including small-molecule pocket discovery, to avoid selecting chemically plausible but biologically occluded sites.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology (GenBio)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Site4Drug，一个模态感知的靶点发现AI Agent，能够输出可靶向区域的排名列表，并基于拓扑、亲水性、PTM倾向等证据推荐结合模态（如抗体/小分子）。该方法旨在避免选择化学可行但生物上被遮挡的位点，尤其针对膜蛋白。
Motivation: 在蛋白质上选择可干预的靶点往往是比选择结合物更模糊、更容易失败的瓶颈，尤其是膜蛋白，其可及性、拓扑和PTM限制了可用区域。
Method: Site4Drug是一个模态感知的靶点发现智能体，利用拓扑、亲水性、PTM倾向、二硫键、结构域上下文和序列等证据，生成带约束、证据摘要、风险标志和可追溯决策日志的排名列表，并能从同一证据中推荐结合模态。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但描述该方法能够输出排名列表并推荐结合模态，避免选择化学可行但生物遮挡的位点。
Conclusion: 该方法通过一致应用证据跨模态，包括小分子口袋发现，来解决生物遮挡问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: "I've Seen How This Goes": Characterizing Diversity via Progressive Conditional Surprise
papers.abstract_en: Measuring the diversity of creative outputs is central to evaluating post-training mode collapse, comparing decoding strategies, and quantifying creative behavior in both AI and human writing. We propose a new approach to measuring diversity using in-context learning, of which the ``Decan'' metric, $D_{Ca_n} = C \times a_n$, is the working instance we evaluate: a per-byte score read off the per-token log-probabilities of a base model $θ$ in a \emph{single forward pass} per permutation, with no embedding model, no reference corpus, and no human labels. This approach is grounded in information theory, makes use of language model in-context learning to detect a wide range of similarities between any number of inputs, and obviates the need to train a special-purpose model. The same pipeline scores AI samples and human-written response sets, with diversity treated as a property of (responses, prompt, scoring model). On Tevet and Berant's human-grounded McDiv benchmark, $D_{Ca_n}$ reaches OCA 0.846 on the McDiv prompt\_gen set where it performs best, behind the strongest neural baseline reported in Tevet and Berant (SentBERT, 0.897). On the OLMo-2-7B post-training pipeline, $D_{Ca_n}$ drops monotonically across the base $\to$ SFT $\to$ DPO $\to$ RLVR stages, detecting the type of diversity loss that creative-writing applications care about.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 18 figures, 9 tables. Accepted to the Workshop on Generative AI, Creativity, and Human-AI Co-Creation @ ICML 2026 (non-archival). Code and data: https://github.com/AMindToThink/icl-diversity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于上下文学习（in-context learning）来衡量创造性输出多样性的新方法，实例化为Decan度量（D_{Ca_n}），通过单次前向传播从基础模型的token对数概率中计算每字节得分，无需嵌入模型或参考语料。在McDiv基准上达到OCA 0.846，并在OLMo-2-7B后训练流程（base→SFT→DPO→RLVR）中单调下降，有效检测到创作应用关注的多样性损失。
Motivation: 评估创造性输出的多样性对于衡量后训练模式崩溃、比较解码策略以及量化AI和人类写作的创造性行为至关重要。
Method: 提出基于上下文学习（in-context learning）的多样性度量方法，实例为Decan度量D_{Ca_n} = C × a_n，在单次前向传播中从每个排列的token对数概率中读取per-byte得分，无需嵌入模型、参考语料或人类标签。
Result: 在Tevet和Berant的McDiv基准上，D_{Ca_n}在prompt_gen集上达到OCA 0.846，弱于最强神经基线SentBERT的0.897；在OLMo-2-7B后训练流程（base→SFT→DPO→RLVR）中单调下降，检测到创作应用关注的多样性损失类型。
Conclusion: 该方法能够有效检测创作应用关心的多样性损失，无需额外模型或标签，且对后训练过程中的多样性退化敏感。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Token Predictors Are Not Planners: Building Physically Grounded Causal Reasoners
papers.abstract_en: Current benchmarks for embodied vision-language planning often favor linguistic next-token prediction over physically grounded next-state reasoning. This rewards models that mimic statistical language priors rather than track causal dependencies, reducing physical planning to shallow sequence modeling. We argue that reliable physical autonomy requires a shift from linguistically grounded token prediction toward physically grounded causal reasoning. To this end, we introduce Causal-Plan-Bench, a high-fidelity diagnostic suite curated through multi-stage verification to evaluate embodied planning across four causal dimensions. We also construct Causal-Plan-1M, a million-scale corpus of explicit reasoning traces produced by a four-stage annotation pipeline over egocentric videos. Extensive evaluation shows that leading models still struggle to demonstrate genuine physical agency, with Gemini 3 Pro reaching only 38.18 on our benchmark. In contrast, our training recipe enables Causal Planner, built on Qwen3-VL-8B, to internalize physical logic for more accurate next-state estimation. The model achieves strong in-domain performance and cross-benchmark generalization, and reveals a Causal Scaling Law: scaling causal training data to one million instances yields a 36.3% relative gain, from 33.22 to 45.28. Overall, our work provides a concrete step toward turning agents from superficial token predictors into physically grounded causal reasoners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前具身视觉-语言规划基准往往奖励语言上的下一个词预测而非物理上的下一状态推理，导致模型依赖统计语言先验而非因果依赖。为此，作者提出Causal-Plan-Bench，一个通过多阶段验证构建的高保真诊断套件，用于评估具身规划的四个因果维度，并构建百万级推理轨迹语料库Causal-Plan-1M。基于Qwen3-VL-8B的Causal Planner在训练后实现了领域内和跨基准泛化，并揭示因果缩放定律：将因果训练数据扩展至百万实例可获得36.3%的相对提升。
Motivation: 现有具身规划基准倾向于奖励语言上的标记预测而非物理状态推理，导致模型仅模拟统计语言先验而无法跟踪因果依赖，阻碍了物理自主性的实现。
Method: 引入Causal-Plan-Bench高保真诊断套件和Causal-Plan-1M百万级推理轨迹语料库，并提出基于Qwen3-VL-8B的Causal Planner训练方法，使模型内化物理逻辑以进行更准确的下一状态估计。
Result: Gemini 3 Pro在基准上仅达38.18分，而Causal Planner在领域内表现强劲，并展现交叉基准泛化能力；因果缩放定律显示，训练数据从无增加到一百万时，相对提升36.3%（从33.22到45.28）。
Conclusion: 该工作为将智能体从表面上的标记预测器转变为物理上可理解的因果推理者提供了具体步骤，强调物理因果推理优于语言先验。

papers.title: Personalized 3D Myocardial Infarct Geometry Reconstruction from Cine MRI for Cardiac Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D geometric characterization of myocardial infarction (MI) is essential for building cardiac digital twins (CDTs) to precisely simulate infarct-related electrophysiology. Late gadolinium enhancement magnetic resonance imaging (LGE MRI) is the clinical reference for locating MI, yet its reliance on contrast agents restricts use in renally impaired patients and limits longitudinal follow-ups. As an alternative, contrast-free cine MRI visualizes abnormal ventricular wall motion, which is highly indicative of the infarcted area. In this study, we propose a novel explicit geometry-motion embedded model to fully automatically reconstruct personalized, simulation-ready 3D MI geometries directly from multi-view cine MRIs. Specifically, we construct a 4D (3D + t) biventricular mesh to explicitly extract and decouple geometry-aware and motion-aware features. We further design a dual-branch module for adaptive geometry-motion fusion to capture spatiotemporal dependencies for mapping infarcted region. Furthermore, we introduce multi-scale supervision utilizing an AHA-17 segment-guided cross-attention mechanism to steer the prediction, ensuring biophysically consistent reconstruction. Experimental results on 225 cine MRIs demonstrated that the proposed 3D MI reconstruction achieved high performance with an average Dice score of 0.678 $\pm$ 0.011. In the downstream in-silico electrophysiological simulation evaluations, the results were highly consistent with the LGE-derived ground truth, highlighting the great potential of the proposed model for contrast-free scar characterization and seamless integration into CDT modeling. The code will be released publicly upon acceptance of the manuscript for publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从无对比剂的多视角cine MRI自动重建个性化3D心肌梗死几何结构的方法，用于构建心脏数字孪生。该方法通过构建4D双心室网格，提取并解耦几何与运动特征，设计双分支融合模块捕获时空依赖关系，并引入基于AHA-17节段的多尺度监督。在225组cine MRI上达到平均Dice 0.678，下游电生理模拟结果与LGE MRI导出的金标准高度一致。
Motivation: LGE MRI是心肌梗死定位的临床金标准，但依赖对比剂，不适用于肾功能不全患者且难以长期随访。无对比剂的cine MRI可反映异常室壁运动，但缺乏精确重建梗死几何的方法，限制了其在心脏数字孪生中的应用。
Method: 提出显式几何-运动嵌入模型：构建4D双心室网格以解耦几何与运动特征；设计双分支模块自适应融合特征；引入AHA-17节段引导的交叉注意力机制进行多尺度监督，确保重建的生理一致性。
Result: 在225个cine MRI上，方法取得平均Dice 0.678 ± 0.011。下游电生理模拟显示，重建结果与LGE导出的金标准高度一致。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了无对比剂心肌梗死3D几何的自动重建，有潜力无缝集成到心脏数字孪生建模中。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种从无对比剂的多视角cine MRI自动重建个性化3D心肌梗死几何结构的方法，用于构建心脏数字孪生。该方法通过构建4D双心室网格，提取并解耦几何与运动特征，设计双分支融合模块捕获时空依赖关系，并引入基于AHA-17节段的多尺度监督。在225组cine MRI上达到平均Dice 0.678，下游电生理模拟结果与LGE MRI导出的金标准高度一致。
summary_sections.motivation: LGE MRI是心肌梗死定位的临床金标准，但依赖对比剂，不适用于肾功能不全患者且难以长期随访。无对比剂的cine MRI可反映异常室壁运动，但缺乏精确重建梗死几何的方法，限制了其在心脏数字孪生中的应用。

papers.title: ProbeScale: Probing Analysis to Optimize Neural Scaling Laws for Efficient Small Language Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a balance between capability and computational feasibility. Neural scaling laws inform their optimal training, suggesting that they possess rich internal representations that scale with their size. However, deploying even these SLMs can be challenging under strict resource constraints. Language model probing provides methods for analyzing the linguistic knowledge encoded in a model's internals. We propose ProbScale, a framework that unifies insights from scaling laws and probing to identify parameter-efficient subnetworks within pre-trained SLMs. ProbScale utilizes the high-quality representations of well-scaled SLMs and uses task-specific probes to mathematically quantify the relevance of each layer for target downstream capabilities. This allows selecting subnetworks that optimally trade off performance against parameter size. We formulate the subnetwork selection as finding a layer subset maximizing aggregated, task-weighted probe performance under a parameter budget. Experiments on representative SLMs such as RoBERTa-Large and T5-Base demonstrate that ProbScale identifies subnetworks achieving significant parameter reduction, from 5 to 10 times, while maintaining high performance (95% to 98% of the original SLMs) on targeted tasks, outperforming heuristic baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProbScale 框架，结合神经缩放定律和语言模型探针分析，从预训练的小语言模型（如 RoBERTa-Large、T5-Base）中识别参数高效的子网络。通过任务特定探针量化每层对下游能力的贡献，并在参数预算约束下选择最优层子集。实验表明，该方法在参数减少 5-10 倍的情况下，仍能保持原模型 95%-98% 的性能，优于启发式基线。
Motivation: 小语言模型在严格资源约束下部署仍有挑战，需要找到在参数效率和性能之间取得最佳平衡的子网络。
Method: 利用缩放定律训练的 SLM 的高质量表征，通过任务特定探针（probes）数学量化每层对目标下游能力的重要性，将子网络选择形式化为在参数预算下最大化聚合任务加权探针性能的层子集搜索问题。
Result: 在 RoBERTa-Large 和 T5-Base 上，ProbScale 筛选的子网络实现了 5-10 倍的参数缩减，同时在目标任务上保持原模型 95%-98% 的性能，超越启发式基线方法。
Conclusion: ProbScale 框架能够有效识别 SLM 中的参数高效子网络，为资源受限场景下的模型部署提供实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OctoT2I: A Self-Evolving Agentic Text-to-Image Router
papers.abstract_en: The explosive growth of Text-to-Image (T2I) models, from large-scale versions to lightweight, real-time ones, now faces diminishing marginal returns from single-model scaling. Agentic T2I methods emerged to alleviate this bottleneck by using multiple models. However, existing agentic T2I methods suffer from three key challenges: reliance on expensive handcrafted priors or human annotations, rigid single-path decision mechanisms, and a neglect of inference efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce OctoT2I, a novel agentic framework that reformulates the T2I task as a joint optimization of generation quality and inference efficiency. OctoT2I implements a stateful, multi-round routing strategy that adaptively selects the most suitable tool based on its knowledge and memory. This strategy is enabled by a knowledge base built from scratch by our novel Self-Evolving Mechanism. This mechanism, which requires no human supervision, first autonomously defines foundational Conceptual Dimensions (eg, style, color, count) and then intelligently explores their combinations via an iterative" Propose--Solve--Evaluate--Learn"(PSEL) loop. The PSEL loop efficiently discovers each tool's capability frontier, driving continuous improvement without external guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OctoT2I achieves competitive performance (0.96) on GenEval while delivering a 90.3% inference speedup and a 56.6% energy-efficiency gain over the leading baseline (Flow-GRPO), striking an exceptional balance between performance and efficiency. Code and models will be made available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OctoT2I，一种自进化的代理文本到图像（T2I）路由框架。它通过无监督的自进化机制自动构建知识库，并采用有状态的多轮路由策略，联合优化生成质量与推理效率。实验表明，OctoT2I 在 GenEval 上达到 0.96 的竞争性能，同时相比领先基线 Flow-GRPO 实现 90.3% 的推理加速和 56.6% 的能效提升。
Motivation: 现有单一 T2I 模型缩放面临边际收益递减，而代理 T2I 方法依赖昂贵的人工先验或注释、采用刚性单路径决策机制，且忽视推理效率。
Method: OctoT2I 框架包含一个自进化机制，该机制首先自主定义基础概念维度（如风格、颜色、数量），然后通过迭代的“提出-解决-评估-学习”（PSEL）循环智能探索组合，构建每个工具的能力边界知识库，实现有状态的多轮自适应路由。
Result: 在 GenEval 基准上达到 0.96 性能，相比 Flow-GRPO 实现 90.3% 的推理速度提升和 56.6% 的能效提升。
Conclusion: OctoT2I 在生成质量与推理效率之间取得了出色的平衡，且无需人工监督。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multilinguality of Large Language Models From a Structural Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have excelled in processing multiple languages through pre- and post-training on multilingual data, even though English dominates the training data. Prior work focusing on token representations has revealed how those LLMs process non-English text. Although these analyses have provided insightful findings, they fail to capture a structural view, which is an inherent property of language. In this study, we explore the multilinguality of LLMs through representational structural analysis. Our findings reveal that low-resource languages are structurally more different from English than high- and mid-resource languages, and that language-specific post-training alters their structures while preserving inter-language relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从表示结构分析的角度研究大型语言模型的多语言性，发现低资源语言与英语的结构差异大于高/中资源语言，且语言特定的后训练会改变结构但保持语言间关系。
Motivation: 以往研究仅关注token表示，未能捕捉语言的结构视角，而结构是语言的固有属性。
Method: 采用表示结构分析（representational structural analysis）来探索多语言性。
Result: 低资源语言与英语的结构差异更大，语言特定的后训练会改变结构但保持语言间关系。
Conclusion: 强调了从结构视角理解多语言性的重要性，并指出语言特定后训练对结构的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tree-Guided Identify-Then-Exploit: A Unified Framework of Best Arm Identification and Regret Minimization for Dueling Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study $N$-armed stochastic dueling bandits under the Condorcet-winner assumption, where three widely adopted objectives are considered: best-arm identification (BAI), weak regret, and strong regret. We propose Tree-Guided Identify-Then-Exploit (TG-ITE), the first unified framework to tackle all these objectives to our knowledge. Without requiring stronger assumptions, we propose a shared tree-guided identification approach to find a high-confidence incumbent within $O(N)$ comparisons. We further propose varied exploitation strategies to utilize this warm-start stage to optimize the specific objectives at hand. This methodology enables our approach to (1) achieve $O(N)$ sample complexity in BAI without commonly adopted stronger assumptions; (2) build the first winner-stays-style algorithm to achieve $O(N)$ weak regret; (3) enjoy the same $O(N \log T)$ guarantee as specialized strong-regret approaches; (4) realize the joint optimization of BAI and weak regret with $O(N)$ guarantees for both, eliminating the sub-optimal gap of $O(\log N)$ in the existing approach. Our results provide evidence that the trade-off between BAI and regret minimization is relatively benign in dueling bandits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tree-Guided Identify-Then-Exploit (TG-ITE) 框架，统一处理 N 臂随机决斗老虎机（dueling bandits）下的最佳臂识别（BAI）、弱遗憾和强遗憾三个目标。该框架使用树引导识别方法以 O(N) 次比较找到高置信度 incumbent，并针对不同目标采用不同的利用策略，实现了 BAI 的 O(N) 样本复杂度、弱遗憾的 O(N) 界限、强遗憾的 O(N log T) 界限，以及 BAI 和弱遗憾的联合优化 O(N) 保证。
Motivation: 现有工作分别处理 BAI、弱遗憾和强遗憾，缺乏统一框架且需要更强的假设。
Method: 提出树引导识别（tree-guided identification）来快速找到高置信度 incumbent，然后根据具体目标采用不同的利用策略。
Result: 在 Condorcet 赢家假设下，BAI 样本复杂度 O(N)，弱遗憾 O(N)，强遗憾 O(N log T)，联合优化 BAI 和弱遗憾均达到 O(N)。
Conclusion: 表明决斗老虎机中 BAI 和遗憾最小化之间的权衡相对温和。

papers.title: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-model-based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown broad automation capabilities, yet deployment is bottlenecked by a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with interaction steps. For instance, UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76 GB of GPU memory on merely five screenshots, approaching the capacity of mainstream 80 GB accelerators. Existing KV compression methods share two structural assumptions: aggregating visual-token importance into a single shared saliency map, and applying a fixed top-B cutoff to the fused score distribution. Pilot measurements refute both: spatial specialization lives at the attention-subspace level and migrates across layers, while the score distribution drifts in shape along a trajectory. We propose STaR-KV (Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting), a training-free KV cache compression framework that calibrates token importance along three axes: (i) subspace-aware scoring driven by online spatial mutual information; (ii) a temporal stability discount that suppresses redundant cache entries from persistently attended subspaces; and (iii) an entropy-derived temperature that adaptively reshapes the score distribution. Across four GUI benchmarks, STaR-KV achieves the strongest average accuracy among state-of-the-art KV compression methods (e.g., GUIKV, SnapKV) at matched budgets, with no compression-stage FLOPs overhead (-0.07%) and cutting peak GPU memory by nearly 40% at a 20% KV-cache budget. Code is available at https://github.com/kawhiiiileo/STaR-KV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STaR-KV，一种无训练的KV缓存压缩框架，针对GUI视觉语言模型中的KV缓存线性增长问题。STaR-KV通过三个自适应维度校准token重要性：子空间感知评分、时间稳定性折扣和熵驱动的温度重塑。在四个GUI基准上，STaR-KV在同等预算下实现了最高的平均准确率，无压缩阶段FLOPs开销，峰值GPU内存减少近40%。
Motivation: GUI视觉语言模型部署受限于KV缓存随交互步骤线性增长，例如UI-TARS-1.5-7B在仅五个截图时消耗76GB GPU内存。现有KV压缩方法存在两个结构假设错误：将视觉token重要性聚合为单一共用显著性图，以及对融合分数分布应用固定top-B截断。
Method: 提出STaR-KV框架，沿三个轴校准token重要性：子空间感知评分（通过在线空间互信息驱动）、时间稳定性折扣（抑制来自持续关注子空间的冗余缓存条目）、熵推导温度（自适应重塑分数分布）。
Result: 在四个GUI基准上，STaR-KV在同等预算下达到最强平均准确率，压缩阶段无FLOPs开销（-0.07%），在20% KV缓存预算下峰值GPU内存减少近40%。
Conclusion: STaR-KV是一种有效的无训练KV缓存压缩方法，通过自适应校准token重要性解决了GUI VLM中的KV缓存瓶颈，且不增加计算开销。

papers.title: Consistency evaluation of benchmarks used for causal discovery
papers.abstract_en: In graphical causal model, causal discovery aims to construct a causal graph based on numerical data and domain knowledge in plain text. However, the evaluation of causal discovery methods remains a challenge in the area as the progress of domain researches often makes benchmark causal graphs contain mis-aligned knowledge. This problem especially affects the evaluation of large language model (LLM) based causal discovery methods as they are sensitive to the new discoveries in the literature. This work is the first to systematically study the quality of benchmark causal graphs. Specifically, we design a pipeline that automatically retrieves relevant research papers from scientific databases, and prompts LLMs to check the consistency between the benchmark causal graphs and domain research papers. We evaluate 11 popular real-world benchmarks, for which our pipeline in total proceeds 38,081 domain papers. Our results show that popular benchmarks vary significantly in their consistency with domain research, with clear implications for causal discovery research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究因果发现领域中被用作基准的因果图的质量问题，设计了一个自动检索相关领域论文并利用大语言模型（LLM）检查基准因果图与领域研究一致性的流水线。在11个流行真实世界基准上评估，总共处理了38081篇领域论文，结果显示不同基准与领域研究的一致性差异显著，这对因果发现研究有明确的影响。
Motivation: 因果发现方法的评估面临挑战，因为领域研究的进展常导致基准因果图中包含不一致的知识，这一问题尤其影响基于大语言模型的因果发现方法，因为它们对文献中的新发现敏感。
Method: 设计了一个自动流水线，从科学数据库检索相关研究论文，并利用大语言模型检查基准因果图与领域研究论文之间的一致性。
Result: 对11个流行真实世界基准进行评估，共处理38081篇领域论文，发现不同基准与领域研究的一致性差异显著。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基准一致性对因果发现研究的重要性，但未具体说明局限性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文首次系统研究因果发现领域中被用作基准的因果图的质量问题，设计了一个自动检索相关领域论文并利用大语言模型（LLM）检查基准因果图与领域研究一致性的流水线。在11个流行真实世界基准上评估，总共处理了38081篇领域论文，结果显示不同基准与领域研究的一致性差异显著，这对因果发现研究有明确的影响。

papers.title: PlatonicNav: Unveiling Semantic Correspondence in Navigation with Platonic Topological Maps
papers.abstract_en: Embodied visual navigation, where an agent perceives a complex environment and acts to reach a goal from raw sensory input, underpins a wide range of applications such as household service robotics, assistive robotics, and large-scale autonomous exploration. However, recent attempts to unify vision-and-language navigation (VLN) and object goal navigation (ObjNav) remain at the level of architectural fusion, mixed-task training, and large vision-language pretraining, without examining whether independently trained vision and language encoders may already share a common semantic structure. Moreover, even object-centric topological maps still ground language goals through explicit cross-modal supervision such as CLIP or large vision-language models, leaving open whether such grounding is possible from a purely vision-built map. To address these challenges, we extend the Platonic Representation Hypothesis to embodied navigation and recast vision-only ObjNav, cross-modal ObjNav, and VLN as three different interfaces to the same object-centric semantic manifold. We further introduce PlatonicNav, a training-free framework whose Platonic Topological Map fuses geometric and semantic node distances from a self-supervised visual encoder, and grounds language goals via blind matching without any paired vision-language data. Extensive experiments on simulation benchmarks including HM3D-IIN, OVON, and R2R-CE on MP3D, together with deployment on Unitree Go2, demonstrate that PlatonicNav generalizes across tasks, modalities, and embodiments without explicit cross-modal training. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/PlatonicNav. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/PlatonicNav.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PlatonicNav，一种无需训练的视觉导航框架，核心是Platonic拓扑地图（Platonic Topological Map），它融合自监督视觉编码器的几何与语义节点距离，并通过盲匹配实现语言目标，无需任何配对视觉-语言数据。在HM3D-IIN、OVON、R2R-CE等仿真基准以及Unitree Go2实体机器人上的实验表明，该方法能够跨任务、跨模态和跨本体泛化。
Motivation: 现有方法在统一视觉导航任务（如VLN和ObjNav）时依赖跨模态监督或架构融合，尚未检验独立训练的视觉与语言编码器是否已隐含共享的语义结构。本文扩展柏拉图表征假说，将不同导航任务视为同一物体中心语义流形的不同接口。
Method: 提出PlatonicNav框架，其核心是Platonic拓扑地图，该地图将自监督视觉编码器提取的几何距离与语义距离融合，并通过盲匹配将语言目标直接映射到地图节点，完全不需要视觉-语言配对数据。
Result: 在HM3D-IIN、OVON和R2R-CE等多个仿真基准以及Unitree Go2机器人部署中，PlatonicNav展示了跨任务、跨模态和跨本体的泛化能力，无需任何跨模态训练。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，仅通过自监督视觉构建的拓扑地图即可实现视觉任务中的语言目标定位，无需显式的跨模态对齐，为统一导航任务提供了新的思路。

papers.title: Stochastic convergence of parallel asynchronous adaptive first-order methods
papers.abstract_en: A new class of asynchronous adaptive first-order optimization methods is introduced, comprising asynchronous variants of several popular algorithms. Versions of these methods using momentum and/or inexact normalization are also considered. The convergence of methods in the class on non-convex functions is analyzed in a fully stochastic setting, and is shown to be (up to logarithmic factors) of order O(1/sqrt{t}) under reasonable assumptions. Numerical experiments suggest that such asynchronous adaptive algorithms are very relevant in heterogeneous large-scale machine learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类新的异步自适应一阶优化方法，包括多种流行算法的异步变体，并考虑了使用动量和/或不精确归一化的版本。在非凸函数上分析了方法的随机收敛性，证明在合理假设下收敛阶为O(1/sqrt{t})（忽略对数因子）。数值实验表明此类异步自适应算法在异构大规模机器学习系统中具有相关性。
Motivation: 现有异步优化方法在自适应算法和随机非凸场景下的收敛性分析尚不充分，特别是对于结合动量和近似归一化的变体。作者旨在为异步自适应一阶方法提供严格的理论保证，以支持其在异构大规模机器学习中的应用。
Method: 定义了一类广泛的异步自适应一阶方法，涵盖AdaGrad、RMSProp等算法的异步版本，并允许使用动量和/或不精确的归一化算子。在标准随机非凸假设下，利用Lyapunov分析推导收敛速率。
Result: 证明了该类方法在非凸随机优化中的收敛阶为O(1/sqrt{t})（忽略对数因子），与同步方法的已知最优速率一致。数值实验验证了算法在实际异构系统上的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作为异步自适应优化提供了统一的收敛性分析框架，表明异步计算不会损害自适应方法的理论收敛速度，对大规模分布式学习有重要指导意义。

papers.title: Breaking the Information Silo: Semantic Personas for Cross-Domain Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Digital platforms increasingly operate as isolated information silos, limiting their ability to construct comprehensive user representations across domains. Cross-domain recommender systems seek to overcome this limitation by transferring knowledge from a source domain to a target domain, yet most existing approaches depend on shared users, shared items, or structurally similar interaction graphs. These assumptions are often unrealistic across independent platforms. We propose SPHERE (Semantic Personas for Heterogeneous cross-domain Recommendation), a design artifact that enables recommendation knowledge transfer across strictly disjoint domains with no shared users or items. Rather than aligning domains through identity or graph structure, SPHERE uses large language models to induce a shared behavioral vocabulary, generate structured semantic personas for users, and retrieve behaviorally similar source-domain communities that form a Community Source Persona. This semantic signal is integrated with collaborative signals through a dual-tower architecture and dynamic fusion gate, allowing SPHERE to augment standard recommender backbones. Empirical evaluation across Amazon Books, Goodreads, and Steam demonstrates consistent improvements over NCF, SVD++, and LightGCN baselines under full-ranking evaluation. The results show that cross-domain transfer effectiveness is not determined solely by semantic proximity between domains; rather, it depends critically on the structural density and native predictive strength of the target domain. The study contributes to information systems research by reframing cross-domain personalization as behavior-based semantic alignment, offering a practical mechanism for overcoming information silos while preserving interpretability and modularity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPHERE 框架，利用大语言模型生成语义人物画像，实现无共享用户或物品的严格跨域推荐。在 Amazon Books、Goodreads 和 Steam 数据集上，SPHERE 优于 NCF、SVD++ 和 LightGCN 基线，且跨域迁移效果取决于目标域的结构密度和预测强度。
Motivation: 数字平台常作为信息孤岛，现有跨域推荐依赖共享用户/物品或相似交互图，这在独立平台间不现实。
Method: SPHERE 使用大语言模型诱导共享行为词汇、生成结构化语义人物画像，并检索行为相似的源域社区作为社区源画像，通过双塔架构和动态融合门与协同信号集成。
Result: 在 Amazon Books、Goodreads 和 Steam 上，SPHERE 在全排序评估中一致优于 NCF、SVD++ 和 LightGCN 基线。
Conclusion: 跨域个性化可视为基于行为的语义对齐，SPHERE 在保持可解释性和模块化同时，提供克服信息孤岛的实用机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure-Guided Adaptive Propagation for Protein-Protein Interaction Site Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interaction sites (PPIS) is essential for understanding cellular processes, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic target discovery. Graph-based deep learning has advanced PPIS prediction by incorporating residue-level structural context. However, most graph-based models still rely on fixed propagation schemes that treat all residues similarly, despite the structural and functional heterogeneity of protein interfaces. Such propagation may limit the ability to adapt information diffusion to local geometric environments, making it difficult to distinguish true interaction sites from structurally similar non-interacting neighbors. We present SGAP-PPIS, a structure-guided adaptive propagation model for PPIS prediction. Rather than using a fixed propagation mechanism, SGAP-PPIS leverages multi-scale geometric states from an equivariant graph neural network to generate residue-wise propagation coefficients. This design allows each residue to adaptively balance local feature preservation and neighborhood diffusion according to its geometric microenvironment. Experimental results show that SGAP-PPIS achieves competitive performance among the state-of-the-art methods on Test\_60. Ablation studies show that geometry-conditioned adaptive propagation, scale-aligned geometric guidance, and multi-step propagation-state representation jointly drive these improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SGAP-PPIS模型，利用结构引导的自适应传播机制预测蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用位点（PPIS）。不同于固定传播方案，该模型通过等变图神经网络生成多尺度几何状态，为每个残基自适应调整局部特征保留与邻域扩散的平衡。在Test_60基准上取得与最先进方法竞争的性能，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
Motivation: 现有基于图的PPIS模型依赖固定传播方案，无法适应界面残基的几何异质性，难以区分真实相互作用位点与结构相似的非相互作用邻居。
Method: 提出结构引导的自适应传播模型SGAP-PPIS，利用等变图神经网络的多尺度几何状态生成残基级传播系数，实现局部特征保留与邻域扩散的自适应平衡。
Result: 在Test_60基准上取得与最先进方法竞争的性能；消融实验证实几何条件自适应传播、尺度对齐几何引导和多步传播状态表示共同驱动性能提升。
Conclusion: 自适应传播机制能有效利用蛋白质界面的几何异质性提升PPIS预测准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FLARE: Diffusion for Hybrid Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) large language models (LLMs) have achieved broad practical success, but sequential decoding remains a key bottleneck for low-latency deployment. Recent efficient-inference work has progressed along two axes: reducing the cost of each model invocation through efficient architectures, and reducing serial decoding steps through parallel generation. Hybrid attention backbones address the former, while diffusion language models (dLLMs) pursue the latter via iterative parallel denoising. Combining these advantages remains challenging: AR-to-dLLM conversion often fails to preserve seed-checkpoint capability, and hybrid-attention recurrent states and masking constraints make diffusion training and serving nontrivial. We present FLARE, a systematic conversion framework for hybrid-attention LLMs. Our analysis identifies transfer data quality as the primary determinant of capability preservation, outweighing loss formulation and attention-mask design. The resulting framework combines a token-equal AR-and-diffusion objective, hardware-aware kernels, and unified inference, enabling one checkpoint to support both AR-style verified decoding and diffusion-style parallel denoising. Starting from strong AR checkpoints with limited post-training data, FLARE is competitive with leading open-source dLLMs across model scales and delivers consistent throughput gains over open-source dLLM baselines in single-GPU concurrent serving. Our results further suggest that practical dLLMs are limited not only by decoding algorithms, but also by transfer data quality and the training inefficiency of current block-diffusion objectives, motivating joint design of data, objectives, architectures, and inference systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FLARE，一个系统转换框架，用于将混合注意力大语言模型（LLM）转换为同时支持自回归（AR）验证解码和扩散并行去噪的统一检查点。通过分析发现，迁移数据质量是保持能力的关键因素，优于损失函数和注意力掩码设计。FLARE在多个模型规模上与领先的开源扩散语言模型（dLLM）竞争，并在单GPU并发服务中实现一致的吞吐量提升。实验还指出，实际dLLM的性能瓶颈不仅来自解码算法，还包括迁移数据质量和当前块扩散目标的训练效率。
Motivation: 自回归LLM的顺序解码是低延迟部署的瓶颈，现有工作分别通过高效架构减少单次调用成本和并行生成减少解码步数，但将混合注意力（减少成本）和扩散模型（并行生成）结合仍然困难：AR到dLLM转换易丢失种子检查点能力，混合注意力的循环状态和掩码约束使扩散训练和服务复杂。
Method: 提出FLARE系统转换框架，包含三个关键部分：token等价的AR与扩散联合目标（token-equal AR-and-diffusion objective）、考虑硬件的核（hardware-aware kernels）和统一推理流程。该框架使得单一检查点既可进行AR验证解码，也可进行扩散并行去噪，并从强AR检查点出发，仅需有限后训练数据。
Result: FLARE在多个模型尺度上与领先开源dLLM性能相当，并在单GPU并发服务场景下相对于开源dLLM基线取得一致吞吐量提升。实验表明迁移数据质量是保留能力的主要决定因素，其重要性超过损失公式和注意力掩码设计。
Conclusion: 实际dLLM不仅受限于解码算法，还受限于迁移数据质量和当前块扩散目标（block-diffusion objectives）的训练效率，因此需要联合设计数据、目标、架构和推理系统。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: FLARE在多个模型尺度上与领先开源dLLM性能相当，并在单GPU并发服务场景下相对于开源dLLM基线取得一致吞吐量提升。实验表明迁移数据质量是保留能力的主要决定因素，其重要性超过损失公式和注意力掩码设计。
summary_sections.conclusion: 实际dLLM不仅受限于解码算法，还受限于迁移数据质量和当前块扩散目标（block-diffusion objectives）的训练效率，因此需要联合设计数据、目标、架构和推理系统。

papers.title: Adaptive Auto-Harness: Sustained Self-Improvement for Agentic System Deployment on Open-Ended Task Streams
papers.abstract_en: Auto-harness systems such as A-Evolve, GEPA, and Meta-Harness improve LLM agents by optimizing prompts, skills, tools, memories, and supporting infrastructure from execution feedback, but they are typically evaluated on fixed offline benchmarks. Real deployments instead present open-ended task streams: histories grow without a fixed endpoint, heterogeneous tasks require different harnesses, and problem distributions shift over time. These challenges make a single repeatedly and densely updated harness brittle, causing performance degradation as accuracy peaks early and then declines. This motivates sustained harness construction with task-wise adaptation. We introduce Adaptive Auto-Harness, a framework and system for such streams. The framework decomposes the gap to an oracle harness into evolution loss and adaptation loss. The system addresses these losses with a stateful multi-agent evolver, a harness tree with solve-time routing, and human-steering hooks for cases where history lacks the needed signal. Across prediction-market, security-competition, and event-forecasting streams, Adaptive Auto-Harness outperforms five existing auto-harness baselines and ablations attribute gains to better construction, routing, or targeted human steering. Code is available in https://github.com/A-EVO-Lab/AdaptiveHarness .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Adaptive Auto-Harness 框架，针对开放任务流中 LLM 智能体的自动部署问题，通过持续自改进的演化器和任务感知路由，解决传统自动部署系统（如 A-Evolve、GEPA）在非固定基准上性能退化的问题。实验覆盖预测市场、安全竞赛和事件预测等多种任务流，证明该方法优于五个基线，并归因于更好的构件构建、路由或人工干预。
Motivation: 现有自动部署系统（auto-harness）通常基于固定离线基准评估，但实际部署面临开放任务流：历史无限增长、任务异构、分布偏移，导致反复密集更新的单一部署变得脆弱，准确率早期达到峰值后下降。
Method: 提出 Adaptive Auto-Harness 框架，将与 oracle 部署的差距分解为演化损失和适应损失；系统包含有状态多智能体演化器、带求解时路由的部署树，以及在历史信号不足时提供人工干预接口。
Result: 在预测市场、安全竞赛和事件预测等任务流上，Adaptive Auto-Harness 优于五种现有自动部署基线，消融实验验证了构件构建、路由和人工干预的贡献。
Conclusion: 该框架为开放任务流中的 LLM 智能体持续自改进提供了有效方案，但摘要未提及对长尾或极端分布偏移的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Algebraic View of the Expressivity of Recurrent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: What formal languages can a recurrent neural language model recognize? Formal results in the literature conflict: some authors report Turing-completeness, while others show equivalence to regular languages. The reason for this discrepancy is that the underlying arithmetic model differs. The paper develops a unified algebraic account of the expressivity of recurrent neural networks, starting with a formal account of various arithmetic models. This account reduces expressivity to an algebraic question, e.g., whether a network's syntactic monoid divides a certain wreath product. As a case study, the paper revisits diagonal state-space models: the same architecture cannot implement an even-modulus counter once floating-point recurrences are enforced, yet realizes every even-modulus counter under unsigned-integer quantization.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 2 figures, to be published at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从代数角度统一分析循环神经网络语言模型的形式语言表达能力，指出已有结果矛盾的原因是底层的算术模型不同。论文将表达能力归约为代数问题，如网络的语法幺半群是否整除某个缠绕积。作为案例，重新审视对角状态空间模型：在浮点递归约束下无法实现偶数模计数器，但在无符号整数量化下能实现所有偶数模计数器。
Motivation: 现有文献关于RNN语言模型识别形式语言的能力存在矛盾（图灵完备 vs 等价于正则语言），原因在于采用的算术模型不同，需要统一框架厘清。
Method: 提出统一代数视角：通过形式化不同算术模型，将表达能力归约为语法幺半群与缠绕积的整除关系，并对角状态空间模型进行案例研究。
Result: 对角状态空间模型在浮点递归下不能实现偶数模计数器，但在无符号整数量化下能实现所有偶数模计数器。
Conclusion: 神经网络的形式语言表达能力高度依赖于底层算术模型，代数方法为理解这种依赖性提供了统一框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Accelerating Min-Max Optimization via Power-Law Stepsizes
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the convergence guarantees of the Extragradient (EG) method for unconstrained biaffine min-max optimization. It is known that EG with a fixed stepsize achieves a $Θ(T^{-1/2})$ last-iterate convergence rate, which is slower than the optimal $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1})$ rate attainable by incorporating additional mechanisms such as anchoring. Motivated by recent advances showing that dynamic stepsizes alone can significantly accelerate gradient descent, we ask whether dynamic stepsizes can similarly accelerate the last-iterate convergence of EG. We present the first positive result in this direction. Specifically, we provide a deterministic dynamic stepsize schedule that accelerates the convergence rate of EG to $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2/3+\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon > 0$. We also show that this rate is tight when the extrapolation and update steps of EG use the same stepsize. We then show that allowing different stepsizes for the extrapolation and update steps further improves the convergence rate to the near-optimal $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1+\varepsilon})$. Our analysis reduces stepsize scheduling to an optimization problem, whose solution leads to a stepsize schedule that follows (a discretization of) a power-law distribution. Our proposed stepsize schedules and analysis extend to other methods, such as Optimistic Gradient (OG), and suggest broader applicability to general min-max optimization problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了Extragradient (EG)方法在无约束双仿射极小极大优化中的收敛性，提出了一种基于幂律分布的动态步长调度，将EG的最后迭代收敛速度从Θ(T^{-1/2})提升到O(T^{-2/3+ε})，并通过分别调整外推步长和更新步长进一步达到近最优的O(T^{-1+ε})。分析通过将步长调度转化为优化问题实现，并扩展到乐观梯度等方法。
Motivation: 固定步长的EG方法最后迭代收敛速度仅为Θ(T^{-1/2})，慢于通过额外机制（如锚定）可达到的最优O(T^{-1})。本文探索动态步长能否单独加速EG的收敛，填补了这一空白。
Method: 提出一种确定性动态步长调度，其步长遵循幂律分布（power-law distribution）的离散化。通过将步长调度简化为一个优化问题来求解，并进一步允许外推步长和更新步长不同，以改进收敛率。
Result: 作者证明该调度使EG的收敛率提升到O(T^{-2/3+ε})，且该界是紧的；允许不同步长后收敛率改进到近最优O(T^{-1+ε})。
Conclusion: 本文表明动态步长本身可以显著加速极小极大优化中的EG方法，且步长调度的最优设计遵循幂律分布。该分析框架可推广到OG等其他算法，展现出对一般极小极大优化问题的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PillarDETR: YOLO-Backbone and RT-DETR Head for Real-Time 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Real-time 3D object detection is a critical component for the safe operation of autonomous driving systems and robotics. While LiDAR point clouds provide accurate spatial information, processing them efficiently remains a significant challenge. Traditional methods rely on complex 3D convolutions or anchor-based paradigms that struggle to balance detection accuracy with inference speed. In this paper, we propose PillarDETR, a novel end-to-end 3D object detection architecture that combines the efficiency of pillar-based LiDAR encoding with the representational power of modern 2D vision models. Specifically, PillarDETR replaces standard convolutional backbones with a Cross Stage Partial (CSP) network derived from YOLOv8, enabling richer feature extraction from pseudoimages. Furthermore, we discard conventional anchor-based or center-based detection heads in favor of a Real-Time Detection Transformer (RT-DETR) decoder. This hybrid design allows the network to capture global context and directly predict 3D bounding boxes without relying on non-maximum suppression (NMS). Extensive experiments on the KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate that PillarDETR achieves a compelling trade-off between mean Average Precision (mAP) and inference latency. Our ablation studies confirm that integrating the YOLOv8 backbone and RT-DETR head yields substantial improvements over the PointPillars baseline, establishing PillarDETR as a highly effective solution for real-time 3D perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PillarDETR，一种结合基于柱体（pillar）的LiDAR编码与YOLOv8骨干网络（CSP）及RT-DETR解码器的端到端3D目标检测架构，无需非极大值抑制（NMS）。在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，该方法在平均精度（mAP）与推理延迟之间取得了良好平衡，消融实验证实了各组件相比PointPillars基线的提升。
Motivation: 实时3D目标检测对自动驾驶和机器人安全运行至关重要，但LiDAR点云的高效处理仍是挑战；传统方法依赖复杂3D卷积或锚点范式，难以兼顾检测精度与推理速度。
Method: 提出PillarDETR架构，以YOLOv8中的Cross Stage Partial（CSP）网络替换标准卷积骨干，从伪图像中提取更丰富的特征；采用Real-Time Detection Transformer（RT-DETR）解码器替代传统锚点或中心检测头，直接预测3D边界框并无需NMS。
Result: 在KITTI和nuScenes基准上，该方法实现了平均精度（mAP）与推理延迟之间的有效权衡；消融实验表明集成YOLOv8骨干和RT-DETR头相比PointPillars基线的显著提升。
Conclusion: PillarDETR作为实时3D感知的高效解决方案，在精度与速度之间取得了有竞争力的折中。

papers.title: EvoCut: Multi-Layer Evolution-Aware Visual Token Compression for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance on image and video understanding tasks, but their inference efficiency is constrained by the large number of visual tokens produced by vision encoders. Most existing visual token compression methods estimate token importance from attention scores or representation properties at specific layers, overlooking how visual tokens evolve across the vision encoder. Such layer-specific criteria may provide incomplete importance estimates and limit performance preservation after compression. To address this issue, we analyze layer-wise visual token evolution directions and observe that tokens form multiple group evolution directions across vision-encoder layers. Our analysis further shows that informative tokens tend to exhibit persistent deviations from common group evolution directions. Based on this observation, we propose EvoCut, a training-free and attention-free visual token compression method that estimates token importance from multi-layer evolution deviation. Experimental results show that EvoCut can retain only 11.1\% of the visual tokens on LLaVA-1.5-7B while preserving 94.4\% of the average performance, demonstrating its effectiveness in balancing efficiency and accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EvoCut，一种无需训练和无需注意力的视觉令牌压缩方法，通过分析视觉编码器中多层令牌演化方向来估计令牌重要性。实验表明，在LLaVA-1.5-7B上仅保留11.1%的视觉令牌即可保持94.4%的平均性能，有效平衡效率与准确性。
Motivation: 现有视觉令牌压缩方法仅从特定层的注意力分数或表示属性估计令牌重要性，忽略了令牌在编码器各层间的演化，导致重要性估计不完整，压缩后性能损失较大。
Method: EvoCut通过分析视觉编码器各层中令牌的演化方向，发现令牌形成多个群体演化方向，且信息丰富的令牌倾向于偏离公共群体方向。基于此，利用多层演化偏差（multi-layer evolution deviation）来估计令牌重要性，无需训练和注意力计算。
Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，仅保留11.1%的视觉令牌即可保持94.4%的平均性能，展示了在效率与精度之间的平衡效果。
Conclusion: EvoCut是一种有效的训练无关视觉令牌压缩方法，利用多层令牌演化方向信息，在不依赖注意力的前提下实现了高性能保留。

papers.title: TriAlign: Towards Universal Truth Consistency in Personalized LLM Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Personalized large language models adapt responses to users' preferences and social attributes, but can introduce substantial universal truth inconsistencies across social groups, where some groups systematically receive less accurate responses on objective tasks. Existing alignment methods either ignore personalization or mainly focus on subjective preference alignment, largely overlooking fairness and consistency in universal truths. To address this gap, we study Truth-Invariant Alignment (TIA), an alignment problem for personalized LLMs that aims to ensure universal truths remain consistent across social groups while preserving personalization. We propose TriAlign, the first offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for TIA, where each social group is modeled as an agent interacting. TriAlign jointly optimizes universal truth accuracy, cross-group truth consistency, and personalization through a fairness-aware objective and an explicit inconsistency penalty. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that TriAlign achieves a stronger balance among these three objectives than strong baselines, reducing universal truth disparities across social groups while improving both objective task performance and personalization quality.

papers.title: Quality-Guided Semi-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Training accurate medical image segmentation models requires large amounts of densely annotated data, which is costly and time-consuming to obtain. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) alleviates this by learning from both abundant unlabeled data and limited labeled data. However, most modern SSL methods rely on pseudolabels for unlabeled data, and typically assess their reliability through model confidence or uncertainty, measures that are self-referential and lack explicit grounding in segmentation quality. Instead, we propose a quality-guided SSL framework that trains a dedicated network to estimate segmentation quality from image-mask pairs. The predictor is trained on variable-quality masks generated through synthetic corruptions augmented with imperfect outputs from partially trained segmentation models, capturing realistic error patterns encountered during training. We integrate the quality predictor into SSL through two complementary mechanisms: a quality-aware regularization loss and a quality-based pseudolabel sample reweighting scheme. We show that our method serves as a drop-in enhancement to existing SSL frameworks. Extensive experiments across five datasets and multiple architectures demonstrate consistent improvements over competing SSL methods, advancing the state-of-the-art in semi-supervised medical image segmentation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种质量引导的半监督学习框架，用于医学图像分割。该方法训练一个专用网络从图像-掩模对中估计分割质量，并通过质量感知正则化和基于质量的伪标签重加权机制将其整合到半监督学习中。实验表明该方法可提升现有半监督框架的性能。
Motivation: 现有半监督学习方法通常通过模型置信度或不确定性评估伪标签的可靠性，但这些指标缺乏对分割质量的实际衡量。
Method: 训练一个质量预测网络，该网络使用合成退化生成的可变质量掩模和部分训练模型的不完美输出进行训练，学习评估分割质量；通过质量感知正则化损失和基于质量的伪标签样本重加权，将质量预测集成到半监督学习中。
Result: 在五个数据集和多种架构上的实验表明，该方法一致优于其他半监督方法，提升了现有技术。
Conclusion: 该质量引导框架可作为现有半监督医学图像分割的即插即用增强方法。

papers.title: Construction of Historical Knowledge Graphs Based on BERT and Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Through digital humanities research and scale-up historical data analysis, a significant amount of traditional historical text is converted into structured knowledge graphs. This paper provides a high-level architecture that combines bidirectional encoder representations of transformers (BERT) and graph neural networks (GNN) to extract the entities and relationships from various types of historical texts. The texts of traditional history resolve linguistic ambiguities, references limited by context, and a lack of established grammatical norms in a systematic way. This study develops a new image retrieval system based on FastRQNet and pre-trained vision-language model Vilt-qaformer+RoBInet in accordance with the aforementioned recommendations. The experiments make full use of a comprehensive collection of municipal records, parliamentary documents, and historical correspondence. When compared to conventional rule-based techniques and other popular deep-learning baselines, the joint BERT-GNN system obtains greater Precision, Recall, and F1-score (Table 2). Complex nested structures and implicit reference issues can be handled by this structure with sufficient accuracy and thoroughness when creating knowledge graphs. The aforementioned experiments show that combining relational graph learning algorithms with context-sensitive semantic representation techniques can automatically extract historical data to add accumulated wisdom to the knowledge repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对历史文本中语言歧义、上下文引用受限及语法规范缺失等问题，提出一种结合BERT和图神经网络（GNN）的高层架构，用于从历史文本中抽取实体和关系以构建知识图谱。同时，基于FastRQNet和预训练视觉语言模型Vilt-qaformer+RoBInet开发了图像检索系统。实验使用市政记录、议会文件和历史信函等数据集，相比基于规则的方法和主流深度学习基线，该联合系统在精确率、召回率和F1-score上表现更优，并能够有效处理复杂嵌套结构和隐式引用。
Motivation: 传统历史文本存在语言歧义、上下文引用受限和缺乏语法规范等问题，导致现有方法难以准确提取结构化知识。
Method: 提出BERT与GNN的联合架构：BERT用于上下文敏感的语义表示，GNN用于关系图学习；同时开发基于FastRQNet和Vilt-qaformer+RoBInet的图像检索系统。
Result: 在市政记录、议会文件和历史信函数据集上，该系统相比规则方法和主流深度学习基线，取得了更高的Precision、Recall和F1-score，并能准确处理复杂嵌套结构和隐式引用。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，结合上下文敏感的语义表示（BERT）与关系图学习（GNN）可以自动从历史数据中提取知识，有效构建知识图谱，为数字人文研究提供支持。

papers.title: Sensitivity as a Double-Edged Sword: A Trade-off Between Discriminability and Adversarial Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Modern neural networks are highly susceptible to adversarial perturbations. In this work, we identify that part of this vulnerability stems from the sensitivity of the widely used fully connected (FC) classifiers to such perturbations. In contrast, simple $\ell_2$ distance-based classifiers exhibit significantly greater robustness. We provide thorough theoretical and empirical analysis showing that while FC classifiers' high sensitivity makes them discriminative, it also makes them vulnerable. Conversely, $\ell_2$-classifiers' insensitivity grants robustness but limits performance. Motivated by this trade-off, we propose a novel $\ell_2$-reclassifier based on a Hybrid Prototype Mixing (HPM) framework. This method retains the discriminative power of FC classifiers while leveraging the robustness of $\ell_2$ distance. It yields $\ell_2$-distance-based predictions by fusing two prototype types: (1) stable, dataset-level prototypes updated via EMA, and (2) dynamic, batch-level prototypes generated from the FC classifier's predictions using a Straight-Through Estimator (STE). However, this dynamic, STE-based architecture introduces significant challenges for evaluation, such as gradient obfuscation and forward discontinuity. To address this, we propose a new, rigorous evaluation protocol, the Mixed Surrogate Attack (MSA), which uses multiple surrogates along with powerful AutoAttack to ensure a fair and robust assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our lightweight, plug-and-play module, with minimal fine-tuning, effectively enhances the adversarial robustness of various existing SOTA adversarially trained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出现代神经网络的全连接分类器的高敏感性使其具有判别性但也易受对抗扰动，而简单的ℓ2距离分类器鲁棒但性能受限。为此提出基于混合原型混合（HPM）框架的ℓ2重分类器，融合稳定数据集级别原型和动态批次级别原型，并引入混合代理攻击（MSA）评估协议。实验表明该轻量模块可增强现有对抗训练模型的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 识别全连接分类器的敏感性在提供判别性的同时带来对抗脆弱性，而ℓ2分类器虽鲁棒但性能不足，需要平衡这一权衡。
Method: 提出HPM框架，结合EMA更新的稳定数据集原型和基于直通估计器（STE）从FC分类器预测生成的动态批次原型，实现ℓ2距离预测；同时提出MSA评估协议使用多个代理和AutoAttack确保公平评估。
Result: 实验表明所提轻量即插即用模块通过少量微调能有效增强多种现有SOTA对抗训练模型的对抗鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在保持FC分类器判别能力的同时利用ℓ2距离的鲁棒性，并解决了STE架构带来的评估挑战。

papers.title: SECUREVENT: Hybrid AI/ML Security Monitoring for Distributed Event-Based Systems
papers.abstract_en: Distributed event-based systems have become a common substrate for Internet-scale publish/subscribe services, IoT telemetry, cloud-native microservices, and security operations pipelines. Their loose coupling and asynchronous delivery improve scalability, but they also expand the attack surface: publishers, brokers, subscribers, topics, schemas, and temporal ordering can each be abused without a single component observing the whole behavior. This paper proposes SECUREVENT, a hybrid AI/ML security-monitoring architecture for distributed event-based systems. The architecture combines traditional protections such as authenticated transport, topic-level authorization, and signed events with online anomaly detection, graph-aware behavioral features, complex-event policy rules, federated learning, and adversarial-ML governance. A deterministic prototype study over synthetic event-stream attacks illustrates how a hybrid AI/CEP monitor can improve recall over static rules while retaining a low false-positive rate. The central claim is not that machine learning replaces cryptographic and access-control mechanisms, but that model-based security monitoring is necessary when event flows, identities, schemas, and timing relationships are too dynamic for static controls alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SECUREVENT架构，用于分布式事件系统的混合AI/ML安全监控。该架构结合传统保护（认证传输、主题级授权、签名事件）与在线异常检测、图感知行为特征、复合事件策略规则、联邦学习和对抗ML治理。在合成事件流攻击上的原型研究表明，混合AI/CEP监控比静态规则提高召回率并保持低误报率。
Motivation: 分布式事件系统的松耦合和异步交付扩大了攻击面，但静态控制机制难以应对动态变化的事件流、身份、模式和时序关系。
Method: 提出混合AI/ML安全监控架构，融合传统安全机制（认证、授权、签名）与在线异常检测、图感知特征、复合事件策略规则、联邦学习及对抗ML治理。
Result: 在合成事件流攻击上，混合AI/CEP监控相比静态规则提升了召回率，同时维持较低的假阳性率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，基于模型的安全监控在事件流高度动态时是必要的，但并不能取代加密和访问控制等基础机制。

papers.title: THRD: A Training-Free Multi-Turn Defense Framework for Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks pose a growing threat to LLMs by exploiting conversational dynamics such as gradual escalation and cross-turn coordination. Existing defenses either rely on costly retraining -- often degrading model utility -- or apply single-turn analysis independently at each turn, failing to capture how risk accumulates along interaction trajectories. We observe that safety behavior in multi-turn interaction is trajectory-dependent: dialogue history continuously reshapes the model's conditioning context, making it insufficient to evaluate each turn in isolation. Motivated by this insight, we present THRD, the first training-free framework that explicitly models temporal risk accumulation for multi-turn jailbreak defense. THRD integrates four modules: a Turn-level Risk Assessor (TRA) for instantaneous risk estimation, a Historical Context Analyzer (HCA) for cross-turn intent escalation detection, a Response Evaluator (RE) for identifying facilitative outputs, and a Decision Module that combines these signals through a time-evolving scoring mechanism with attenuation-based modulation and trend-aware adjustment. Experiments against state-of-the-art multi-turn attacks -- including tree-search-based and multi-agent collaborative methods -- across two target models show that THRD reduces ASR to 0.2--4.0% while preserving model utility within 1.5% degradation on MMLU and GSM8K. Ablation studies confirm non-redundant module contributions and stable cross-architecture generalization. Analysis of first rejection triggers reveals that over 70% of multi-turn attacks require Turn~2 or later to detect, validating the necessity of explicit temporal aggregation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出THRD，第一个无训练的多轮越狱攻击防御框架，通过显式建模时间上的风险累积来检测多轮对话中的攻击。THRD包含四个模块：回合级风险评估器、历史上下文分析器、响应评估器和决策模块。实验表明，在多种先进多轮攻击下，能将攻击成功率降至0.2-4.0%，同时保持模型效用退化在1.5%以内。消融研究确认了各模块的非冗余贡献和跨架构泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有防御要么依赖昂贵的重训练并损害模型效用，要么仅对每轮独立分析，无法捕捉跨轮的风险累积。多轮越狱攻击利用对话动态，如逐渐升级和跨轮协调，构成日益严重的威胁。
Method: 提出THRD框架，包含Turn-level Risk Assessor (TRA) 用于即时风险评估，Historical Context Analyzer (HCA) 用于跨轮意图升级检测，Response Evaluator (RE) 用于识别促进攻击的输出，以及通过时间演化评分机制结合这些信号的决策模块，采用衰减调制和趋势感知调整。
Result: 在两种目标模型上，针对包括树搜索和多智能体协作方法在内的最先进多轮攻击，THRD将ASR降低至0.2-4.0%，同时在MMLU和GSM8K上保持模型效用退化在1.5%以内。超过70%的多轮攻击需要到第2轮或更晚才能检测，验证了显式时间聚合的必要性。
Conclusion: THRD是一种无训练的多轮防御框架，通过显式建模时间风险累积有效防御多轮越狱攻击，且不损害模型效用。消融实验证实了各组件的贡献和泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出THRD框架，包含Turn-level Risk Assessor (TRA) 用于即时风险评估，Historical Context Analyzer (HCA) 用于跨轮意图升级检测，Response Evaluator (RE) 用于识别促进攻击的输出，以及通过时间演化评分机制结合这些信号的决策模块，采用衰减调制和趋势感知调整。
summary_sections.result: 在两种目标模型上，针对包括树搜索和多智能体协作方法在内的最先进多轮攻击，THRD将ASR降低至0.2-4.0%，同时在MMLU和GSM8K上保持模型效用退化在1.5%以内。超过70%的多轮攻击需要到第2轮或更晚才能检测，验证了显式时间聚合的必要性。
summary_sections.conclusion: THRD是一种无训练的多轮防御框架，通过显式建模时间风险累积有效防御多轮越狱攻击，且不损害模型效用。消融实验证实了各组件的贡献和泛化能力。

papers.title: TrafficRAG: A Multimodal RAG Framework for Traffic Accident Liability Determination
papers.abstract_en: Traffic accident liability analysis is a critical yet challenging task in intelligent transportation and legal assistance. Existing methods often suffer from low efficiency, subjective judgment, and inconsistent analysis results. Meanwhile, large language models are constrained by noisy video inputs and insufficient legal domain knowledge. To address these issues, this work presents TrafficRAG, a multimodal retrieval-augmented framework for automated traffic accident analysis and report generation. Specifically, the proposed framework first adopts a vision-language model to produce structured textual descriptions of accident scenarios, which serve as accurate retrieval queries. Based on these textual queries, a hybrid retrieval strategy integrating BM25 sparse retrieval and dense embedding retrieval is employed to fetch relevant traffic regulations and similar historical cases. Finally, the large language model incorporates retrieved legal knowledge and multimodal accident evidence for comprehensive reasoning, and generates standardized, legally grounded liability analysis reports. Extensive experiments show that TrafficRAG consistently outperforms baseline methods, achieving 77.32% Legal Norm Adaptation Accuracy, 81.71% Factual Faithfulness, and a Liability Ratio MAE of 5.48%. The results validate that integrating multimodal factual evidence with legal clauses via retrieval augmentation can effectively improve the reliability and accuracy of traffic accident liability determination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TrafficRAG，一个多模态检索增强框架，用于交通事故责任自动分析与报告生成。该框架先使用视觉语言模型生成结构化文本描述作为检索查询，再通过BM25与稠密检索的混合策略获取交通法规和历史案例，最后让大语言模型结合检索到的法律知识与多模态事故证据生成具有法律依据的责任分析报告。实验表明，该方法在法律规范适配准确率、事实忠实度和责任比例MAE上均优于基线。
Motivation: 现有交通事故责任分析方法效率低、主观性强、结果不一致，且大语言模型受限于噪声视频输入和不足的法律领域知识，需要一种更可靠、自动化的解决方案。
Method: 提出三步流程：1) 使用视觉语言模型将事故视频/图像转换为结构化文本描述；2) 采用BM25稀疏检索与稠密嵌入检索的混合策略，检索相关交通法规和相似历史案例；3) 大语言模型融合检索结果和多模态证据进行推理，生成标准化责任分析报告。
Result: TrafficRAG在测试中达到77.32%的法律规范适配准确率、81.71%的事实忠实度，以及5.48%的责任比例MAE，一致优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 通过检索增强整合多模态事实证据与法律条文，可有效提升交通事故责任判定的可靠性与准确性。
