papers.title: Probabilistic Data-Driven Modelling of Astrophysical Transients: The Neural Process Family for Ultrafast and Class-Agnostic Light Curve Reconstruction with NightLANP
papers.abstract_en: Astrophysical observations from Earth are subject to weather, environmental, and scientific constraints that lead to sparse, irregular light curves. On the eve of the Vera C. Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time, its dataset offers unprecedented opportunities for transient science. Yet a key challenge remains its cadence, sparse and irregular across six bands, limiting inference. Interpolation helps mitigate this, with Gaussian Processes the standard, but they struggle with cross-band correlations, require a priori kernel specification, and must be fit to each light curve individually, hence scaling poorly. Here, we introduce the neural process family for light curve reconstruction, combining the probabilistic framework of Gaussian Processes with the scalability of deep learning. By meta-learning on diverse simulated transients, Attentive Neural Processes shift the bulk of computation to training, enabling rapid, amortized inference with a class-agnostic model. Evaluated on realistic Rubin cadences across 15 transient classes, we show that even an unoptimized, out-of-the-box Attentive Neural Process consistently outperforms all benchmarks -- a suite of Gaussian Processes and neural networks -- on every tested metric, spanning regression quality, astrophysical feature recovery, and probabilistic calibration. Our model interpolates all bands simultaneously in microseconds, over four orders of magnitude faster than the next-best neural benchmark and five faster than Gaussian Processes, demonstrating the potential of neural processes for the nightly Rubin alert stream. Attentive Neural Processes avoid the overconfidence of standard neural networks and the underconfidence of Gaussian Processes, delivering sharp, well-calibrated uncertainties. This work establishes the neural process family as a scalable, probabilistic foundation for real-time transient science in the Rubin era.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对天体物理学观测中光变曲线稀疏、不规则且跨波段相关的问题，引入神经过程家族（Neural Process Family）用于光变曲线重建。通过元学习（meta-learning）在多种模拟瞬变上训练，Attentive Neural Process 实现了快速、类别无关的推断，在真实Rubin巡天节奏的15类瞬变基准测试中，在回归质量、天体物理特征恢复和概率校准等指标上一致优于高斯过程和神经网络基线。模型同时插值所有波段仅需微秒，比次优神经网络基线快四个数量级，比高斯过程快五个数量级，并避免了神经网络的过度自信和高斯过程的置信不足，为Rubin时代的实时瞬变科学提供了可扩展的概率基础。
Motivation: 现存光变曲线插值方法（如高斯过程）难以处理跨波段相关性、需要先验核函数指定，且对每条曲线单独拟合，扩展性差；在Vera C. Rubin天文台大规模巡天数据到来之际，亟需一种快速、类别无关且概率校准良好的重建方法。
Method: 采用神经过程家族中的Attentive Neural Process，通过元学习在模拟瞬变数据上训练，将计算负担转移到训练阶段，实现快速摊销推断；模型基于注意力机制同时处理多波段光变曲线，输出概率分布。
Result: 在15类瞬变类别的现实Rubin节奏数据上，Attentive Neural Process在所有测试指标（回归质量、特征恢复、概率校准）上一致优于高斯过程和神经网络基线；推理速度比次优神经网络快四个数量级，比高斯过程快五个数量级；不确定度校准优于两者。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了神经过程家族作为Rubin时代实时瞬变科学中可扩展的概率基础，但仅在仿真数据上验证，未来需在真实观测数据中进一步测试。

papers.title: Adversarial Dual On-Policy Distillation from Expressive Teacher
papers.abstract_en: Learning from demonstrations in embodied control is often cast as behavioral cloning, and recent diffusion or flow-matching policies improve this paradigm by modeling multi-modal expert actions. Yet these methods remain offline supervised learners: the policy is trained only on expert states and receives no corrective signal on the states it actually visits. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy, but standard OPD assumes a strong fixed teacher, which is unavailable in demonstration-only control. We propose \textbf{FA-OPD}, an \emph{adversarial dual on-policy distillation} method in which a Flow Matching (FM) teacher is learned from demonstrations and co-trained with a lightweight MLP student. The teacher provides two complementary signals on student rollouts. The reward channel learns an expert-likeness objective over state-action pairs and drives online exploration through long-horizon policy optimization. The action channel supplies dense local targets at student-visited states, stabilizing exploitation. FA-OPD couples them so that reward distillation enables generalization beyond point-wise demonstrations, while action distillation keeps exploration anchored near expert-like behavior. Across six robot navigation, manipulation, and locomotion benchmarks, FA-OPD beats strong baselines and shows much stronger robustness under noisy or limited demonstrations. Source code: https://github.com/vanzll/FA-OPD.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FA-OPD 提出一种对抗性双策略蒸馏方法，从演示中学习流匹配（Flow Matching）教师策略，并与轻量 MLP 学生策略协同训练。教师提供奖励通道和动作通道两种互补信号，前者学习专家似然目标以驱动长期探索，后者在学生访问状态提供稠密局部目标以稳定利用。在六种机器人导航、操作和运动基准上，FA-OPD 超越强基线，并在噪声或有限演示下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有从演示中学习的模仿方法（如扩散或流匹配策略）本质上是离线监督学习，策略仅在专家状态上训练，无法在自身访问的状态上获得纠正信号。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）可缓解此问题，但标准 OPD 依赖强固定教师，这在仅含演示的控制任务中不可得。
Method: 提出 FA-OPD，一种对抗性双策略蒸馏方法。首先从演示中学习流匹配教师策略，然后与轻量 MLP 学生策略协同训练。教师通过奖励通道提供专家似然目标以驱动在线探索，通过动作通道在学生访问状态提供稠密局部目标以稳定利用。两个通道耦合，使得奖励蒸馏能泛化到点状演示之外，动作蒸馏将探索锚定在专家行为附近。
Result: 在六种机器人导航、操作和运动基准上，FA-OPD 超越强基线，并在噪声或有限演示下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: FA-OPD 通过对抗性双策略蒸馏，有效利用演示学习中的在线探索与局部优化，提升了策略的性能和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Cast a Wider Net: Coordinated Pass@K Policy Optimization for Code Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Repeated sampling with a verifier is the standard way to allocate test-time compute for code generation, with pass@$K$ as the canonical metric. Yet the standard policy class draws $K$ independent samples from a single answer distribution, so attempts often collapse onto near-duplicate reasoning paths and waste the budget on redundant rollouts. This failure is costly in competitive programming, where many problems admit multiple distinct algorithmic strategies and pass@$K$ requires only one correct attempt. We propose Coordinated Pass@$K$ Policy Optimization (CPPO), which turns pass@$K$ generation into joint exploration over strategies: a planner emits a tuple of $K{=}4$ alternative high-level methods, and a shared solver attempts one solution per method. CPPO trains this joint policy with a multiplicative planner reward, $R_{\mathrm{plan}} = J_ψ\cdot R_{\mathrm{out}}$, assigning credit only to valid strategy tuples that lead to verifier-confirmed pass@$K$ success. Across APPS, CodeContests, and LiveCodeBench-v6, CPPO improves pass@$4$ over direct sampling, planning baselines, planner-only SFT, and pass@$K$-oriented RL under the same $K{=}4$ solver-attempt budget, with statistically significant gains on six of nine model--benchmark cells. The largest single gain is $+0.16$ on Qwen3.5-9B LiveCodeBench-v6 over the strongest baseline, PKPO ($0.588 \rightarrow 0.748$; paired bootstrap, $p < 0.05$).
papers.comment: Code reasoning; pass@K optimization; coordinated planning; verifiable rewards; strategy diversity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Coordinated Pass@K Policy Optimization (CPPO)，针对代码生成中标准 pass@K 采样常产生重复推理路径的问题，将生成过程转化为策略上的联合探索：一个计划器输出 K=4 种替代高级方法，共享求解器为每种方法尝试一个解。CPPO 使用乘法计划器奖励训练，仅在有效策略组合导致验证器确认的 pass@K 成功时赋予奖励。在 APPS、CodeContests 和 LiveCodeBench-v6 上，CPPO 在相同 K=4 求解尝试预算下，相比直接采样、规划基线、计划器 SFT 和面向 pass@K 的 RL 均取得统计显著提升，最大增益为 Qwen3.5-9B 在 LiveCodeBench-v6 上提升 0.16。
Motivation: 标准 pass@K 采样从单一答案分布独立采样 K 次，常导致推理路径近重复，浪费预算于冗余 rollout，在需要多种算法策略的竞赛编程中尤为低效。
Method: CPPO 将 pass@K 生成视为策略上的联合探索：计划器输出 K=4 个替代高级方法，共享求解器各尝试一个解。训练使用乘法计划器奖励 R_plan = J_ψ · R_out，仅对导致验证器确认 pass@K 成功的有效策略元组赋予 credit。
Result: 在 APPS、CodeContests 和 LiveCodeBench-v6 上，CPPO 在 pass@4 上优于所有基线，在九个模型-基准组合中的六个取得统计显著增益，最大单点提升为 +0.16（Qwen3.5-9B 在 LiveCodeBench-v6 上从 0.588 到 0.748）。
Conclusion: CPPO 通过协调策略探索有效提升了 pass@K 性能，在预算相同下显著减少冗余采样。

papers.title: Agile Online Model Selection: Resolving Adaptation Lag via Safeguarded Large Learning Rates
papers.abstract_en: Maintaining predictive accuracy in non-stationary environments requires online model selection to adapt autonomously to unknown distribution shifts. However, existing tuning-free algorithms face a fundamental trade-off between robustness and agility. Specifically, to ensure dynamic regret bounds, they must restrict learning rates to small constants (e.g., $O(1)$). This restriction inevitably causes significant adaptation lag during abrupt changes. To resolve this, we propose a novel optimistic online mirror descent that utilizes safeguarded large learning rates up to $Θ(T)$, where $T$ is the number of rounds. Our key technical contribution is a post-hoc penalty mechanism that dynamically monitors unstable updates and excludes learning rates incurring excessive regret, eliminating the need for restrictive a priori constraints. We show that the cumulative penalty remains $O(\log T)$, allowing our algorithm to match near-optimal worst-case guarantees while achieving superior rates in benign cases. Empirical evaluations on three synthetic and eleven diverse real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach reduces the adaptation lag from hundreds of rounds to a few rounds, consistently outperforming tuning-free baselines.

Conclusion: 所提出的方法通过事后惩罚机制解耦了鲁棒性与敏捷性之间的权衡，在不牺牲最坏情况性能的前提下显著提升了在线模型选择对急剧变化的响应速度。

papers.title: Beyond Trajectory-Level Attribution: Graph-Based Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods have achieved remarkable success in improving the performance of large language models (LLMs) and have been rapidly extended to agentic tasks. However, their credit assignment relies heavily on coarse-grained trajectory-level attribution according to final outcomes, making it difficult to capture the contribution of individual steps, such as valuable steps obscured within failed trajectories. To uncover latent information and enable more faithful step-level credit assignment, we propose Graph-based Group Policy Optimization (GraphGPO), which first aggregates all rollout trajectories into a unified state-transition graph and then estimates the distance from each state to the task goal using the global information encoded in the graph. Finally, GraphGPO assigns credit to each edge by estimating a graph-based advantage, based on how much the transition reduces the distance to the task goal. In this way, GraphGPO significantly improves training efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of challenging benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GraphGPO，一种基于图的信用分配方法，用于智能体强化学习。它将所有轨迹聚合为状态转移图，通过全局信息估计状态到任务目标的距离，并基于边减少距离的程度分配信用。该方法在多个基准上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有基于组的RL方法依赖粗粒度的轨迹级信用分配，难以捕获单个步骤的贡献，如失败轨迹中被遮蔽的有价值步骤。
Method: 提出GraphGPO：1) 将所有轨迹聚合为统一的状态转移图；2) 利用图编码的全局信息估计每个状态到任务目标的距离；3) 基于边减少距离的程度计算图优势函数，分配信用。
Result: 在多个具有挑战性的基准上达到SOTA性能，显著提升训练效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过更细粒度的步骤级信用分配提升了训练效率和性能。

papers.title: RT-Lynx: Putting the GEMM Sparsity In a Right Way for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve strong performance in image generation but incur substantial inference costs. While prior work has reduced this cost via quantization and distillation, semi-structured sparsity, which can nearly halve FLOPs, remains underexplored. A key reason is that most existing approaches focus on weight sparsification, and pruning 50% of the weights can remove critical model capacity and degrade generation quality. Our study, however, shows that DiT activations are intrinsically sparse and significantly more robust to N:M semi-structured sparsification than weights. Motivated by this observation, we advocate a paradigm shift from weight sparsification to activation sparsification. We propose RT-Lynx, which applies N:M sparsification to activations and incorporates error-compensation techniques to mitigate accuracy loss. We further implement highly optimized CUDA kernels tailored to this setting, achieving up to a 1.55x speedup on average in linear layers. Extensive experiments across multiple diffusion models demonstrate that our method preserves the generation quality of the original models while substantially accelerating inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RT-Lynx，将半结构化稀疏性应用于扩散Transformer的激活值而非权重，实现推理加速。研究发现DiT激活值天生稀疏，对N:M稀疏化更鲁棒，因此采用激活稀疏化并配合误差补偿，开发了优化CUDA内核，在线性层上实现平均1.55倍加速，且不降低生成质量。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型推理优化多依赖量化和蒸馏，而半结构化稀疏性可大幅减少FLOPs但未被充分利用，因为权重稀疏化会损害生成质量。
Method: 从权重稀疏化转向激活稀疏化，对激活值应用N:M半结构化稀疏化，并引入误差补偿技术缓解精度损失；同时实现高度优化的CUDA内核以适配该模式。
Result: 在线性层上实现平均1.55倍加速，在多个扩散模型上保持原有生成质量。
Conclusion: 激活稀疏化是比权重稀疏化更有效的扩散模型加速途径，RT-Lynx验证了该范式的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Algorithmic Fragility and Persona Bias in LLM-Generated Autistic Communication
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment reduces explicitly harmful outputs but inadvertently encodes a sanitized, neuronormative representation of marginalized communication. We investigate this encoding using a dual-persona rewrite paradigm, prompting ten large language models (LLMs) to rewrite naturally occurring autistic discourse from either an autistic or neurotypical persona. We uncover autistic-persona rewrites diverge significantly more in lexical form and affective register than neurotypical rewrites, despite equivalent semantic similarity. Furthermore, most models collapse cross-persona generations into near-identical outputs. To uncover the mechanisms behind this generative breakdown, we introduce a multi-agent qualitative analysis framework. Our results reveal systemic output erasure, stereotyped hallucination, and task-evasive meta-commentary are pervasive failure modes for this task that cluster by alignment strategy rather than parameter scale. Finally, our targeted comparison with autistic human annotators demonstrates that community-insider knowledge produces systematic label reversals relative to LLM classifications. Our findings indicate that current alignment training causes persona-specific generative breakdown visible only through qualitative analysis, confirming a deep representational gap that prompt engineering cannot resolve.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM安全对齐对自闭症沟通表征的影响，发现对齐训练导致模型对自闭症话语的双身份重写（自闭症 vs 神经典型）产生系统性失败：自闭症身份重写在词汇和情感上差异更大但语义相似，且多数模型跨身份输出趋同；通过多智能体定性分析，揭示了输出擦除、刻板幻觉和逃避任务元评论等普遍模式，这些模式与对齐策略聚类；与自闭症人类标注者对比发现社区知识导致标签反转。作者认为当前对齐训练造成身份特定生成崩溃，且提示工程无法修复。
Motivation: 安全对齐虽减少有害输出，但无意中编码了神经典型（neuronormative）的表示，掩盖了边缘化群体的沟通特征。
Method: 采用双身份重写范式，提示10个LLM以自闭症或神经典型人格重写自然自闭症话语；并引入多智能体定性分析框架来识别生成失败模式。
Result: 自闭症身份重写的词汇形式和情感语调差异显著大于神经典型重写，但语义相似度相当；多数模型坍塌为近相同输出；系统性输出擦除、刻板幻觉和任务回避元评论普遍存在，且与对齐策略聚类而非参数规模相关；自闭症人类标注者的判断与LLM标签系统性相反。
Conclusion: 当前对齐训练导致人格特定的生成崩溃，该缺陷仅通过定性分析可察觉，且提示工程无法解决。

papers.title: Generic Interpretation Approach for Transformer Models Incorporating Heterogenous Attention Structures
papers.abstract_en: Transformer has significantly propelled the development of artificial intelligence, and certainly the development of agents as well. We categorize attention structures of Transformer into two types based on the source of the input information: homogenous and heterogenous attention structures. Heterogenous attention structures, with co-attention as a typical example, process information from different sources. Heterogenous attention structure is the foundation for Transformer models to achieve more complex functions and integrate more modal information. Whether for research purposes or policy requirements, the interpretation of Transformer models with heterogenous attention structures is an important task. The fusion of information from different sources brings new challenges. Our work mainly includes two parts: method and experimentation. In terms of method, we propose an interpretation method for Transformer models with heterogenous attention structures. In terms of experimentation, based on our experimental analysis paradigm, we interpret the operating mechanisms of representative models, conduct semantic interpretation and logical interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对具有异构注意力结构（heterogenous attention structures）的Transformer模型的通用解释方法。异构注意力（如co-attention）处理来自不同来源的信息，是多模态和复杂功能的基础。方法包括基于注意力机制的解释框架，实验部分对代表性模型进行了语义和逻辑层面的解释。
Motivation: 异构注意力结构在Transformer中广泛应用，但其信息融合特性导致现有解释方法难以适用。为满足研究和政策对可解释性的需求，需要专门针对异构注意力模型的解释方法。
Method: 提出一种通用的解释方法，区分同质与异构注意力结构，通过分析注意力权重和跨模态交互进行语义和逻辑层面的解释，并在实验范式下对代表性模型进行机制分析。
Result: 摘要未报告定量结果，仅说明通过实验分析范式实现了对异构注意力模型运行机制的语义解释和逻辑解释。
Conclusion: 该工作为异构注意力Transformer提供了系统性的解释方法，有助于理解多源信息融合的机制，但未讨论具体任务或局限性。

papers.title: Channel-wise Vector Quantization
papers.abstract_en: We present Channel-wise Vector Quantization (CVQ), a novel image tokenization paradigm that replaces patch-wise tokens with channel-wise tokens. Unlike conventional vector quantization, which assigns a discrete token to each patch feature vector, CVQ quantizes each channel of the feature map. This formulation represents an image as discrete levels of visual details, rather than as a grid of spatial patches. Based on CVQ, we introduce a new visual autoregressive framework with "next-channel prediction". Instead of rendering images patch by patch in raster order, our Channel-wise Autoregressive (CAR) model predicts image channels sequentially, producing progressively enriched visual details. Specifically, it first sketches global structure and then refines fine-grained attributes, akin to a human artist's workflow. Empirically, we show that: (1) CVQ achieves 100% codebook utilization with a 16K+ codebook size without any bells and whistles, and substantially improves reconstruction quality over conventional VQ; and (2) CAR attains a DPG score of 86.7 and a GenEval score of 0.79, demonstrating strong effectiveness for text-to-image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通道级向量量化（Channel-wise Vector Quantization, CVQ），一种新的图像分词范式，用通道级token代替传统的块级token。CVQ将特征图的每个通道量化为离散token，从而将图像表示为视觉细节的离散层次，而非空间块的网格。基于CVQ，作者引入“下一通道预测”的视觉自回归框架CAR，依次预测图像通道，先勾勒全局结构再细化细节。实验表明CVQ在16K+码本下实现100%码本利用率，显著提升重建质量；CAR在文本到图像生成任务上DPG得分为86.7，GenEval得分为0.79。
Motivation: 传统向量量化将每个图像块特征向量分配一个离散token，限制了图像表示为空间网格。CVQ旨在通过通道级量化更自然地表示图像的离散细节层次，并改进码本利用率。
Method: 提出通道级向量量化（CVQ），对特征图每个通道分别量化，并以“下一通道预测”作为自回归框架（CAR）的预测目标。
Result: CVQ实现16K以上码本大小下100%码本利用率，重建质量显著优于传统VQ；CAR在文本到图像生成上DPG 86.7，GenEval 0.79。
Conclusion: CVQ和CAR展示了通道级量化在图像表示和生成中的潜力，有效利用了大码本并提高了生成质量。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: CVQ和CAR展示了通道级量化在图像表示和生成中的潜力，有效利用了大码本并提高了生成质量。

papers.title: Baton: Explicit Semantic Blueprints for Joint Video-Audio Generation
papers.abstract_en: Current open-source diffusion models struggle to generate stable and synchronized audio-visual content, particularly in scenarios demanding complex semantic reasoning. The root cause is that existing methods rely on coarse text embeddings from off-the-shelf encoders to guide audio-video denoising, which discards fine-grained semantics and, critically, lacks a shared long-horizon plan, leading to uncoordinated denoising trajectories and fragile cross-modal alignment. We propose Baton, the first framework that introduces explicit semantic planning into joint video-audio generation. Our key insight is that complementing coarse text guidance with semantically rich, modality-aware planned tokens, jointly reasoned and mutually aligned before denoising, can simultaneously restore fine-grained semantic detail and establish a shared blueprint that coordinates both audio and video denoising trajectories. Concretely, Baton first introduces the VA-Planner, a multimodal language model equipped with dual semantic alignment towers, where learnable queries cross-attend to both video and audio features to produce a pair of semantically aligned video and audio planned tokens as keyframe-level blueprints. These planned tokens are injected into the diffusion backbone via cross-attention layers, providing temporally grounded guidance complementary to coarse text embeddings. Since planned tokens do not share one-to-one spatial-temporal correspondence with diffusion latents, we further propose Relative Semantic RoPE, a relative positional encoding that maps planned tokens and latents into a shared spatial-temporal coordinate frame, enabling each latent to accurately attend to its positionally corresponding semantic cues. Experiments on benchmarks show the effectiveness of Baton both qualitatively and quantitatively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Baton，首个引入显式语义规划的视频-音频联合生成框架。通过VA-Planner生成语义对齐的规划令牌作为蓝图，并设计相对语义RoPE实现位置对齐，在基准上取得定性定量改进。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型生成音视频内容时缺乏共享的长期规划，导致去噪轨迹不协调和跨模态对齐脆弱。

Result: 在基准上定性定量验证了有效性。
Conclusion: Baton通过显式语义蓝图实现更同步稳定的视频-音频生成。

papers.title: Treatment Effect Estimation with Differentiated Networked Effect on Graph Data
papers.abstract_en: Estimating individual treatment effect (ITE) from observational graph data is crucial for decision-making in the fields such as commerce and medicine. This task is challenging due to interference, where individual outcomes can be influenced by the treatments and covariates of their neighbors. Existing methods attempt to model such interference for accurate ITE estimation. However, a critical issue is often overlooked: differentiated networked effect (DNE), an effect caused by local networks consisting of neighbors with varying importance and scales. Capturing DNE is vital; otherwise, we will end up with imprecise ITE estimation due to an erroneous characterization of interference, which can result in misguided decisions. To address this challenge, we propose a novel interference modeling mechanism that incorporates two partial attention mechanisms and a message amplifier. The partial attention mechanisms automatically estimate the importance of different neighbors in contributing to interference, while the message amplifier adjusts the results of the interference modeling mechanism based on the scale of neighbors, all of which enables the model to capture DNE. Experiments on three real-world graphs demonstrate that our methods outperform existing approaches for ITE estimation from graph data, which corroborates the importance of explicitly capturing DNE.
papers.comment: Accepted by the research track of the KDD 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图数据上个体治疗效应（ITE）估计中的干扰问题，提出一种考虑差异化网络效应（DNE）的机制。通过部分注意力机制估计邻居重要性，消息放大器根据邻居规模调整干扰建模，从而捕获DNE。在三个真实图数据集上，该方法优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法忽略了邻居重要性和规模差异导致的差异化网络效应（DNE），导致ITE估计不精确，可能造成错误决策。
Method: 提出两个部分注意力机制自动估计不同邻居对干扰的贡献重要性，以及一个消息放大器根据邻居规模调整干扰建模结果，共同捕获DNE。
Result: 在三个真实世界图数据集上，所提方法在ITE估计上优于现有基线方法，验证了显式捕获DNE的重要性。
Conclusion: 明确捕获差异化网络效应对于从图数据中准确估计个体治疗效应至关重要。

papers.title: Attested Tool-Server Admission: A Security Extension to the Model Context Protocol
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how a large-language-model (LLM) agent and an external tool server exchange messages, but not trust: a host reads a server's self-declared tool list and dispatches calls, with no notion of which servers it may use, at what sensitivity, or which of a server's tools are in bounds. This work grew out of a concrete need -- letting the Enclawed agent use Google's externally-operated MCP servers (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) safely, admitting the server and bounding the tools it may drive, without changing MCP or Enclawed's own tool application-programming interface (API). The mechanism we built, mcp-attested (shipped in both the open enclawed-oss distribution and the enclaved flavor), generalizes: the gap that makes an unmediated third-party connection unsafe for one user makes a regulated deployment impossible to accredit. We close it with three additive mechanisms: (1) a small, offline-signed clearance assertion a server publishes at a well-known Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) and a host verifies against a pinned trust root before any tool dispatch; (2) a deny-by-default per-server tool allowlist, so admitting a server is not trusting its every tool; and (3) a flavor-gated enforcement mode that turns the checks from warnings into hard denials, with every decision written to a tamper-evident audit log. We give the wire format, the verification algorithm, a security analysis, and an LLM-driven adversarial evaluation; we then state the design in normative Request-for-Comments (RFC 2119) form -- schema, verification rules, error registry, well-known registration, and machine-checkable conformance vectors -- so it can be adopted as an MCP addendum rather than reinvented. An unextended host ignores the well-known document and behaves exactly as today.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模型上下文协议（MCP）中缺乏信任机制的问题，提出了一种扩展方案 mcp-attested，通过离线签名的许可断言、默认拒绝的每服务器工具允许列表和分门控制的强制模式，确保LLM agent在调用外部工具服务器时能够验证服务器身份并限制其工具使用范围。该机制已在Enclawed agent中实现，并给出了形式化的RFC风格规范。
Motivation: MCP标准化了LLM agent与工具服务器的消息交换，但未建立信任：主机仅依赖服务器自我声明的工具列表，缺乏对服务器使用范围、敏感度和工具权限的约束，导致第三方连接不安全且部署无法认证。
Method: 提出三个可叠加机制：(1) 服务器在知名URI发布离线签名的许可断言，主机在工具调度前验证固定信任根；(2) 默认拒绝的每服务器工具允许列表；(3) 分门控制的强制模式，将检查从警告转为硬性拒绝，并写入防篡改审计日志。同时给出了线路格式、验证算法、安全分析和LLM驱动的对抗评估。
Result: 给出了完整的RFC 2119格式规范，包括模式、验证规则、错误注册表、知名URI注册和机器可检查的一致性向量，使得该扩展可作为MCP增补被采用。
Conclusion: 该机制可以安全地让LLM agent使用外部MCP服务器（如Gmail、Calendar、Drive），且未经扩展的主机可忽略该知名文档，保持现有行为。

papers.title: B-GRTO: Bootstrapped Group Relative Tool Optimization for Referring Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Segmentation is a fundamental task in computer vision, underpinning pixel-level scene understanding and serving as a cornerstone for applications ranging from autonomous perception to medical image analysis. For complex referring segmentation, recent methods pair large vision-language models with segmentation decoders: the former analyzes the image and prompt, while the latter predicts the target mask. Although reinforcement learning improves reasoning-intensive vision-language systems, trainable tools such as segmentation decoders are typically optimized separately with differentiable objectives, and the principled integration of such objectives into reinforcement learning remains underexplored. Thus, we introduce group relative tool optimization (GRTO), a mathematically grounded framework for jointly optimizing a policy with differentiable tool use. GRTO reuses group relative policy optimization (GRPO) rollouts to optimize the auxiliary tool objective, letting decoder gradients complement policy rewards. Further, we derive Bootstrapped-GRTO (B-GRTO), a pre-training method that cheaply bootstraps the tool, leading to faster convergence and superior performance. Across three challenging referring segmentation settings, B-GRTO results in substantial improvements over plain GRPO, matching or surpassing domain-specific state-of-the-art methods. This demonstrates the value of unifying reinforcement learning with differentiable auxiliary objectives for reasoning-intensive segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bootstrapped-GRTO (B-GRTO)，一种基于群体相对工具优化的框架，用于指称分割任务。该方法通过复用 GRPO 的 rollout 来优化可微分分割解码器的辅助目标，实现策略与工具的联合优化。B-GRTO 进一步引入预训练策略，加速收敛并在三个挑战性指称分割基准上取得显著提升，匹配或超越领域内专用方法。
Motivation: 现有指称分割方法通常将大视觉语言模型与分割解码器组合，但解码器作为可训练工具通常使用可微目标单独优化，缺乏与强化学习的统一集成，导致推理密集型分割任务中优化不一致。
Method: 提出 GRTO，一个数学上严格的框架，在 GRPO 的 rollouts 中同时优化辅助工具目标（分割解码器的梯度），使解码器梯度与策略奖励互补。进一步提出 B-GRTO，通过低成本预训练引导工具，加速训练收敛。
Result: 在三个指称分割设置上，B-GRTO 相比普通 GRPO 带来显著改进，匹配或超越了领域内最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了将强化学习与可微辅助目标统一用于推理密集型分割任务的价值。

papers.title: The Attribution Contract: Feature Attribution for Generative Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Feature attribution methods promise to identify which input features matter for a model output. In generative language models, however, it is often unclear what should count as a feature in the first place. In autoregressive language models, earlier generated tokens are both outputs of the model and inputs to later predictions. In diffusion language models, generation proceeds through iterative denoising or unmasking rather than fixed left-to-right prediction, so local explanation may target a state of diffusion rather than a next token. We argue that this ambiguity is not merely an implementation detail, but a conceptual limitation of carrying classifier-era feature attribution directly into generative language modeling. We introduce the Attribution Contract, a specification for feature-attribution claims that names what output is being explained, which features are eligible to receive attribution, what generative process is assumed, what is held fixed, and what model score is being attributed. The contract clarifies why the same attribution method can answer different questions depending on how it is instantiated. We argue that many disagreements about feature attribution in generative language models are not disagreements about attribution algorithms, but about unstated explanatory contracts. Using autoregressive and diffusion language models as case studies, we show when attribution to earlier generated tokens, intermediate states, or denoising stages is informative, when it is misleading, and why feature-attribution methods in generative language models should be evaluated as method-contract pairs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出，将分类时代的特征归因方法直接迁移到生成语言模型存在概念上的局限，因为生成过程中输入特征的定义不明确（例如自回归模型中早期生成的token既是输出也是后续输入，扩散模型中间状态等）。为此，论文提出“归因契约”（Attribution Contract）规范，要求明确解释的对象、可归因的特征、假定的生成过程、固定因素以及被归因的模型分数，从而将归因方法-契约对作为评估单元。
Motivation: 现有特征归因方法在生成语言模型中因输入特征定义模糊而缺乏一致性，导致解释结果分歧；这种分歧常源于未显式说明的归因假设，而非算法本身。
Method: 提出Attribution Contract规范，明确列出五个要素：被解释的输出、可归因的特征、假定的生成过程、固定因素、被归因的模型分数。并以自回归和扩散语言模型为例展示不同契约下的归因结果。
Result: 通过案例研究说明，归因于早期生成token、中间状态或去噪阶段在不同契约下可能有用或误导；强调归因方法应作为方法-契约对进行评估。
Conclusion: 特征归因在生成语言模型中的许多争议源于未说明的解释契约，而非归因算法；规范契约可提高解释的清晰度和可比较性。

papers.title: Chebyshev Policies and the Mountain Car Problem: Reinforcement Learning for Low-Dimensional Control Tasks
papers.abstract_en: We analytically solve the Mountain Car problem, a canonical benchmark in RL, and derive an optimal control solution, closing a gap after 36 years. This enables us to reveal two surprising insights: The optimal control is quite simple, yet modern RL agents display a large gap to optimality. Motivated by the analysis of the optimal control, we introduce Chebyshev policies as a universal (i.e. dense) class of RL policies from first principles. They can be trained as drop-in replacements of neural nets, reducing the regret by a factor of 4.18, while requiring 277 times fewer parameters, fostering sample efficiency, explainability and realtime capability. Chebyshev policies are evaluated on further RL tasks, including a real-world nonlinear motion control testbed. They consistently improve performance over neural nets with PPO, ARS and REINFORCE. Our results demonstrate how Chebyshev policies offer a compelling and lightweight alternative or addition to neural nets for low-dimensional control tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从解析上求解了Mountain Car问题，得到了最优控制解，填补了36年的空白。发现最优控制简单但现代RL智能体与最优差距大。受此启发，提出了Chebyshev策略作为通用RL策略类，可替代神经网络，在多个低维控制任务上优于PPO、ARS和REINFORCE，参数减少277倍，遗憾降低4.18倍。
Motivation: 经典RL基准Mountain Car长期缺乏解析解，导致无法衡量RL智能体的最优性差距；同时神经网络策略在低维控制任务中参数过多，缺乏可解释性和实时性。
Method: 从Mountain Car问题的最优控制解中获取灵感，引入Chebyshev多项式作为策略函数的基础，构建Chebyshev策略，可直接替换神经网络策略，并兼容PPO、ARS、REINFORCE等算法。
Result: Mountain Car问题上遗憾降低4.18倍，参数减少277倍；在多个低维RL任务（包括真实非线性运动控制测试）上，Chebyshev策略一致优于神经网络策略。
Conclusion: Chebyshev策略为低维控制任务提供了轻量级、可解释、实时性强的替代方案，可显著提升样本效率和收敛性能。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从解析上求解了Mountain Car问题，得到了最优控制解，填补了36年的空白。发现最优控制简单但现代RL智能体与最优差距大。受此启发，提出了Chebyshev策略作为通用RL策略类，可替代神经网络，在多个低维控制任务上优于PPO、ARS和REINFORCE，参数减少277倍，遗憾降低4.18倍。

papers.title: AIGaitor: Privacy-preserving and cloud-free motion analysis for everyone, using edge computing
papers.abstract_en: Motion capture is the gold standard for measuring human movement, but clinical use remains limited by cost, technical complexity, and privacy concerns. AIGaitor is a privacy-preserving, cloud-free motion analysis system that runs markerless monocular motion-capture pipelines and downstream deep-learning analysis entirely on a consumer smartphone using on-device neural accelerators. To motivate its design, we surveyed 74 rehabilitation clinicians: 92 percent said they would adopt an accurate, cost-effective, easy-to-use AI gait analysis tool, while 79.7 percent cited operating cost, 68.9 percent insufficient training, and 64.9 percent privacy concerns as leading barriers. We then optimized and benchmarked mobile iOS implementations of current monocular pipeline components, including 2D and 3D pose estimation, pose optimization, skeleton-based deep-learning analysis, and a vision-language model. A Time-Priority end-to-end on-device pipeline processes a 10 s 4K 60 fps video clip in 77 s on an iPhone 14, matching or beating the same pipeline on a high-end NVIDIA H200 cloud server when network transfer is included: 94 s at global mobile-average uplink and 66 s at developed-world Wi-Fi. Lightweight models such as ViTPose-s achieve real-time keypoint extraction, and skeleton-based action-recognition models provide sub-millisecond gait classification on the same clip. To our knowledge, AIGaitor is the first monocular system to demonstrate end-to-end on-device motion capture and downstream deep-learning analysis, supporting clinically applicable movement analysis that is low-cost, private, and accessible to smartphone users.

TL;DR: 本文提出AIGaitor，一个运行在消费级智能手机上的隐私保护无云步态分析系统。通过优化单目运动捕捉管线（包括2D/3D姿态估计、姿态优化、基于骨架的深度学习分析及视觉语言模型）并利用设备端神经加速器，在iPhone 14上处理10秒4K 60fps视频仅需77秒，性能与高端云服务器相当。临床医生调查表明92%受访者愿意采用此类工具，主要障碍为成本和隐私。

Conclusion: 本文声称是首个单目系统展示端到端设备内运动捕捉和下游深度学习分析，支持低成本、隐私保护且对智能手机用户可及的临床适用运动分析。

papers.title: Co-Fusion4D: Spatio-temporal Collaborative Fusion for Robust 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: In autonomous driving, 3D object detection is essential for accurate perception and reliable decision-making. However, object motion and ego-motion often induce cross-frame spatiotemporal inconsistencies in BEV-based detectors, leading to temporal BEV feature misalignment and degraded spatiotemporal consistency. To address these challenges, we propose Co-Fusion4D, a unified framework that explicitly preserves cross-frame spatiotemporal consistency and suppresses temporal feature drift. Co-Fusion4D adopts a current-frame-centric strategy, treating the current frame as the primary source of information while selectively incorporating historical frames after spatiotemporal filtering and alignment. This dominant-complementary mechanism effectively mitigates cumulative alignment errors, suppresses noisy feature propagation, and exploits reliable temporal cues for a more consistent BEV representation. In addition, Co-Fusion4D integrates a Dual Attention Fusion (DAF) module to further enhance spatiotemporal feature interaction. DAF jointly leverages intra-frame spatial attention and inter-frame temporal attention to adaptively align and fuse multi-frame features, emphasizing motion-consistent regions while suppressing spurious correlations. By departing from conventional uniform fusion paradigms, this design substantially improves the temporal stability and discriminative capability of BEV representations. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that Co-Fusion4D achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 74.9% mAP and 75.6% NDS, without relying on test-time augmentation or external data.

Motivation: 现有BEV检测器在物体运动和自运动下出现跨帧时空不一致，导致特征错位和时序漂移。

Conclusion: 通过显式保持跨帧时空一致性和抑制特征漂移，提升了BEV表示的稳定性和判别能力。

papers.title: Can Vision Models Truly Forget? Mirage: Representation-Level Certification of Visual Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning in Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) has attracted growing interest, yet existing methods certify forgetting solely using output-level metrics. We challenge these claims by introducing Mirage, a representation-level auditing framework comprising four complementary diagnostics: Linear Probe Recovery (LPR), Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), Feature Separability Scoring, and Layer-Wise Recovery Analysis. Through experiments across seven datasets and seven baseline methods following recent VFL unlearning protocols, Mirage reveals three key findings: (i) Forgetting gap: methods that pass output-level certification still retain substantial class structure in their representations, with LPR exceeding the retrained baseline by up to 15.4 points; CKA shows these models remain structurally closer to the original than to the retrained reference, while separability scores indicate persistent geometric discrimination. (ii) Unlearning trilemma: no existing method simultaneously achieves high utility, output-level forgetting, and representation-level forgetting. (iii) Class-sample asymmetry: class-level forgetting leaves strong representational traces (LPR up to 97%), whereas sample-level forgetting is indistinguishable from chance (LPR approx. 50%); layer-wise analysis further shows residual class information persists across network depths. These findings call for representation-aware evaluation standards in federated unlearning research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Mirage 框架，通过线性探针恢复（LPR）、中心核对齐（CKA）、特征可分离性评分和逐层恢复分析四种互补诊断，从表示层评估视觉联邦学习中的机器遗忘效果。实验发现：现有方法在输出层通过遗忘认证，但表示层仍保留大量类别结构信息；存在“遗忘三难”：无法同时实现高效用、输出层遗忘和表示层遗忘；类别级遗忘留下强表示痕迹（LPR 高达 97%），而样本级遗忘可视为随机（LPR 约 50%）。
Motivation: 现有垂直联邦学习（VFL）中的机器遗忘认证仅依赖输出层指标，可能无法真正保证模型已遗忘特定数据。论文旨在揭示这种局限性，并建立表示层评估标准。
Method: 提出 Mirage 框架，包含四种表示层诊断方法：线性探针恢复（LPR）、中心核对齐（CKA）、特征可分离性评分和逐层恢复分析。在七个数据集和七种基线方法上，遵循最新 VFL 遗忘协议进行实验。
Result: 发现三个关键结果：（i）遗忘差距：通过输出层认证的方法在表示层仍保留类别结构，LPR 比重新训练基线高 15.4 个百分点；（ii）遗忘三难：现有方法无法同时实现高效用、输出层遗忘和表示层遗忘；（iii）类别-样本不对称：类别级遗忘留下强表示痕迹（LPR 高达 97%），样本级遗忘则与随机无异（LPR 约 50%）。
Conclusion: 研究呼吁联邦遗忘研究采用表示层感知的评估标准，因为仅依赖输出层指标可能产生虚假的遗忘保证。

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Structured Flow Modeling: From Continuous Fields to Data-Driven Representations
papers.abstract_en: Many dynamical systems can be described in terms of structured flows combining source/sink behavior, cyclic dynamics, and topology-constrained transport. These features arise across a wide range of domains, including physical, engineered, and data-driven systems. This work provides a unified perspective on such systems by connecting continuous formulations based on the Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition with discrete and data-driven representations. We review the recently proposed Graph Vector Field (GVF) framework, which enables a decomposition of complex dynamics into gradient, curl, and harmonic components on simplicial complexes, offering both expressivity and interpretability. We then introduce a hierarchy of alternative modeling approaches, including parametric conditional models, linear graph dynamical systems, and reduced Hodge representations, which trade expressive power for computational tractability and reduced data requirements. A key contribution of this work is a cross-domain validation strategy that leverages datasets from well-understood physical systems to verify model correctness and assess robustness independently of the target application domain. This approach enables a systematic evaluation of the trade-offs between model complexity, interpretability, and predictive performance. The resulting framework supports an iterative modeling methodology in which highly expressive models are used as diagnostic tools to identify dominant mechanisms, guiding the construction of simplified models tailored to practical constraints. This work highlights the broad applicability of structured flow modeling and provides a foundation for scalable and interpretable analysis of complex dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个结构化流建模的统一框架，将基于Helmholtz-Hodge分解的连续形式与离散和数据驱动表示联系起来。该框架包括图向量场（GVF）及其层次化替代模型（如参数条件模型、线性图动力系统和约化Hodge表示），并在已知物理系统数据集上进行跨域验证以评估模型复杂性、可解释性和预测性能之间的权衡。
Motivation: 许多动力系统可描述为源/汇行为、循环动力学和拓扑约束传输相结合的结构化流，但缺乏统一的建模视角来连接连续、离散和数据驱动表示，并系统评估不同模型的权衡。
Method: 提出一个层次化建模框架，包括图向量场（GVF）分解为梯度、旋度和调和分量，以及参数条件模型、线性图动力系统和约化Hodge表示，并通过跨域验证策略（利用已知物理系统数据集）进行模型正确性和鲁棒性测试。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明该框架支持迭代建模方法论，高表达性模型作为诊断工具识别主导机制，指导构建适合实际约束的简化模型。
Conclusion: 该工作突出了结构化流建模的广泛适用性，并为复杂动力系统的可扩展和可解释分析提供了基础。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Communication for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Communication is a key component in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for mitigating partial observability, yet prior approaches often rely on inefficient information exchange or fail to transmit sufficient state information. To address this, we propose LLM-driven Multi-Agent Communication (LMAC), which leverages an LLM's reasoning capability to design a communication protocol that enables all agents to reconstruct the underlying state as accurately and uniformly as possible. LMAC iteratively refines the protocol using an explicit state-awareness criterion, improving state recovery while narrowing differences in agents' knowledge. Experiments on diverse MARL benchmarks show that LMAC improves state reconstruction across agents and yields substantial performance gains over prior communication baselines.
papers.comment: 9 pages for main, 32 pages for total, Accepted to ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-driven Multi-Agent Communication (LMAC)，利用大语言模型的推理能力设计通信协议，使多智能体系统能更准确、一致地重建全局状态。LMAC 基于显式状态感知准则迭代优化协议，缩小智能体间的知识差异。实验表明，LMAC 在多种 MARL 基准上优于之前的通信方法。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习中，通信是缓解部分可观测性的关键，但现有方法要么信息交换低效，要么无法传递足够的状态信息。
Method: LMAC 利用 LLM 的推理能力设计通信协议，通过显式状态感知准则迭代优化，使各智能体尽可能准确且一致地重建底层状态。
Result: 在多个 MARL 基准上，LMAC 改善了智能体间的状态重建，并相比先前通信基线取得了显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: LLM 的推理能力可有效指导多智能体通信协议的设计，提升状态重建效果与协作性能。

papers.title: An Efficient Streaming Video Understanding Framework with Agentic Control
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video requires handling dynamic information density under strict latency budgets. Yet, existing methods typically employ static strategies, such as fixed memory compression or reliance on a single model, forcing a trade-off: fast models fail on complex queries, while always-on heavy models violate real-time constraints and overcomplicate simple queries. Rather than fixing these decisions upfront, we propose R3-Streaming (Remember, Respond, Reason), which formulates streaming video understanding as a cascaded control problem: for each query, the system compresses memory, judges response readiness, and routes computation sequentially, so that each downstream decision builds on progressively refined information states. To optimize this pipeline, we introduce an age-aware forgetting policy for memory compression, as aggressively compressing historical frames can yield substantial performance gains. For compute routing, we propose TB-GRPO, a target-balanced reinforcement learning objective that routes hard queries to a stronger model while preventing mode collapse. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that R3-Streaming achieves state-of-the-art results among streaming MLLMs, reaching 57.92 on OVO-Bench and 76.36 on StreamingBench, while reducing visual token usage by 95 to 96 percent.

papers.title: Capturing LLM Capabilities via Evidence-Calibrated Query Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Query clustering organizes queries into groups that reflect shared latent capability demands, enabling capability-aware LLM evaluation. Existing clustering methods, which primarily rely on semantic taxonomies or embeddings, often fail to capture such latent capability requirements due to a misalignment between surface-level semantics and actual model performance. We propose ECC, an algorithm that calibrates prior semantic embeddings using limited posterior model comparisons to bridge the gap between surface-level semantics and latent capability requirements. ECC characterizes each cluster through a capability profile parameterized by a Bradley-Terry model and uses trainable mixture weights to accommodate queries with mixed capability demands, jointly learning a flexible, capability-aware clustering structure that supports query-specific inference of LLM capabilities. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that ECC significantly improves LLM capability ranking quality, outperforming human-labeled and embedding-based baselines by an average of 17.64 and 18.02 percentage points, respectively, and proves effective in downstream tasks such as query routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ECC 算法，通过有限的后验模型比较校准先验语义嵌入，以桥接表面语义与潜在能力需求之间的鸿沟，实现能力感知的查询聚类，用于LLM评估。
Motivation: 现有查询聚类方法依赖语义分类或嵌入，无法捕捉与模型性能对齐的潜在能力需求，导致聚类结果与实际能力评估不匹配。
Method: ECC 算法利用 Bradley-Terry 模型参数化每个簇的能力轮廓，并通过可训练的混合权重处理混合能力需求的查询，联合学习灵活的聚类结构以支持查询特定的能力推断。
Result: 在LLM能力排序任务中，ECC 相比人工标注和基于嵌入的基线平均提升 17.64 和 18.02 个百分点，在查询路由等下游任务中也有效。
Conclusion: 校准语义嵌入与模型比较可显著提升聚类质量，为能力感知的LLM评估提供新方法。

papers.title: DynMuon: A Dynamic Spectral Shaping View of Muon
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, Muon has emerged as the dominant method for training large language models, and transformers more broadly. The essential difference, when compared to standard gradient descent methods, is to replace the usual update matrix $M=UΣV^\top$ with its polar factor $UV^\top$. In this work, we consider a class of Muon-like updates, where we replace the update $M$ with $UΣ^p V^\top$ for some parameter $p$. We call this a "spectral-shaping" operation, and develop a theory of how to pick $p$ which depends on (a) local curvature of the loss function, (b) noise stemming from stochastic gradients and label noise, and (c) training stage. Our theory and experimentation reveal a previously overlooked behavior: positive $p$ helps early by emphasizing high-curvature directions and accelerating signal contraction, while mildly negative $p$ helps later by reallocating update strength toward low-curvature directions that still contain useful training signals. Building on the insight, we propose DynMuon, an efficient dynamic spectral shaping method that schedules $p$ from positive to mildly negative over training. Extensive experiments across model sizes, architectures, and training settings show that DynMuon consistently achieves lower validation loss than Muon, while requiring 10.6-26.5% fewer steps to reach the same target loss. Our code is available at https://github.com/fzwark/DynMuon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynMuon，一种动态谱整形方法，通过调整 Muon 优化器中的谱指数 p 从正到微负，以在训练早期强调高曲率方向、后期利用低曲率方向，加速大语言模型训练。实验表明，DynMuon 相比 Muon 可在 10.6-26.5% 更少的步数内达到相同验证损失。
Motivation: Muon 优化器通过将更新矩阵替换为极分解的酉因子 UV^T 来加速训练，但其固定形式未充分利用损失曲率和噪声信息，导致收敛效率仍有提升空间。
Method: 提出一类 Muon 风格的更新，将更新矩阵 M 替换为 UΣ^p V^T，其中 p 根据局部曲率、随机梯度噪声和训练阶段动态调整；并设计 DynMuon 调度策略，使 p 从正值逐渐过渡到微负值。
Result: 在多种模型规模、架构和训练设置下，DynMuon 一致地降低了验证损失，并在达到相同目标损失时节省 10.6-26.5% 的训练步数。
Conclusion: 动态谱整形（从正 p 到微负 p）有效平衡了早期信号收缩和后期有用信号利用，为改进 Muon 优化器提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE: Evidence Grounding-Guided Multi-Video Event Understanding and Claim Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-video event understanding demands models that can locate and attribute query-relevant evidence scattered across long, heterogeneous video corpora. Existing large vision-language models (LVLMs) often underperform in this regime because they quickly exhaust their context budget and struggle to precisely localize evidentially important segments, frequently missing dense informational cues such as broadcast graphics, subtitles, and scoreboards. We introduce TRACE, an evidence grounding-guided framework that follows a ground-before-reasoning strategy for multi-video event reasoning. Our approach first builds a structured, text-searchable timeline for each video using OCR and object detection. A text-only LLM then conducts query-aware evidence localization, selecting relevant moments prior to any downstream visual reasoning. The retrieved frames and their grounding summaries are subsequently used to steer LVLM-based claim generation and cross-video citation consolidation. Experiments on MAGMaR 2026 and WikiVideo demonstrate that structured grounding markedly boosts factual completeness and attribution fidelity. On the MAGMaR validation split, TRACE raises macro-average MiRAGE F1 from 0.705 to 0.811 compared to an unguided Qwen3-VL-30B baseline, with especially strong improvements in citation recall from 0.440 to 0.628. The method also attains state-of-the-art results on the official MAGMaR 2026 leaderboard. Code is released at https://github.com/pengyu965/TRACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE框架，采用先定位证据再推理的策略，通过OCR和目标检测构建可搜索的视频时间线，用文本LLM定位查询相关时刻，再引导LVLM生成声明并跨视频融合引用。在MAGMaR 2026验证集上，相比未引导的Qwen3-VL-30B基线，宏平均MiRAGE F1从0.705提升至0.811，引用召回率从0.440提升至0.628。
Motivation: 现有大型视觉语言模型处理多视频事件理解时，易耗尽上下文预算且难以精确定位证据丰富的片段（如广播图形、字幕、记分板），导致事实完整性和归因精度不足。
Method: TRACE框架：1) 对每个视频用OCR和目标检测构建结构化、可文本搜索的时间线；2) 用纯文本LLM进行查询感知的证据定位，筛选相关时刻；3) 将检索到的帧及其定位摘要输入LVLM生成声明，并跨视频整合引用。
Result: 在MAGMaR 2026验证集上，宏平均MiRAGE F1从0.705提升至0.811，引用召回率从0.440提升至0.628；在WikiVideo上也取得提升，并在MAGMaR 2026官方排行榜上达到最优。
Conclusion: 结构化证据定位能显著提升多视频事件理解的事实完整性和归因忠实度。

papers.title: Avoiding Structural Failure Modes in Tabular Fair SSL: Online Primal-Dual Allocation under Confidence Gating
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) enables prediction with limited labels, but high-stakes tabular applications (medical, credit, recidivism) require statistical fairness guarantees. We identify a structural conflict in tabular fair SSL through a diagnostic stress test: under confidence-gated pseudo-labeling, moment-matching fairness regularizers can trigger two failure modes -- Masking Collapse (fairness erodes confidence, starving pseudo-labels) and Trivial Saturation (drift to constant predictors). We propose Online Primal-Dual Allocation (OPDA), an online controller that schedules fairness and entropy-based stability penalties using violation, risk, and pseudo-label health signals, avoiding per-dataset selection of a fixed fairness weight within this diagnostic regime. On the evaluated tabular benchmarks (Adult, ACSIncome, COMPAS), OPDA mitigates the degenerate regimes observed under static weighting and simple single-signal adaptive baselines. On Adult and COMPAS, it yields non-degenerate operating points competitive with the empirical static-$λ$ frontier; on ACSIncome, it preserves utility with a wider fairness-utility spread. Relative to OPDA-lite, the full controller mainly shifts the operating point toward higher utility on ACSIncome, while Adult highlights the fairness-utility trade-off between the two variants. These results position OPDA as a calibration-free controller for non-degenerate operating points in tabular fair SSL without per-dataset tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别了表格公平半监督学习中在置信门控伪标记下的结构冲突，导致两种失效模式：掩码坍塌（Masking Collapse）和平凡饱和（Trivial Saturation）。提出在线原对偶分配（OPDA）控制器，利用违规、风险和伪标签健康信号调度公平性和熵稳定性惩罚，避免退化。在Adult、ACSIncome、COMPAS基准上，OPDA取得了非退化的操作点，无需每个数据集调参。
Motivation: 现有公平性正则化方法在置信门控伪标记下可能引发结构失效模式，导致模型退化，且需要手动调整公平性权重。
Method: 提出在线原对偶分配（OPDA），一个在线控制器，通过监测违规、风险和伪标签健康信号，动态调度公平性和熵稳定性惩罚，避免固定权重带来的退化。
Result: 在Adult和COMPAS上，OPDA达到与静态最优前沿竞争的非退化操作点；在ACSIncome上，保持效用且扩大公平-效用跨度。
Conclusion: OPDA可作为无需校准的控制器，为表格公平SSL提供非退化操作点，避免每个数据集的手动调参。

papers.title: Beyond AI as Assistants: Toward Autonomous Discovery in Cosmology
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) agents are pushing AI beyond tools toward autonomous scientific discovery. We discuss two complementary agentic systems for cosmology: \texttt{CMBEvolve}, which targets tasks with explicit quantitative objectives through LLM-guided code evolution and tree search, and \texttt{CosmoEvolve}, which targets open-ended scientific workflows through a virtual multi-agent research laboratory. As preliminary demonstrations, we apply \texttt{CMBEvolve} to out-of-distribution detection in weak-lensing maps, where it iteratively improves the benchmark score through code evolution, and \texttt{CosmoEvolve} to autonomous ACT DR6 data analysis, where it identifies non-trivial pair- and scale-dependent behaviour and produces analysis-grade diagnostics. These examples show how cosmology can provide both controlled benchmark tasks and realistic open-ended research problems for the development of AI scientist systems.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, Contribution to the 2026 Cosmology session of the 60th Rencontres de Moriond
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两个用于宇宙学自主科学发现的 AI 代理系统：CMBEvolve 和 CosmoEvolve。CMBEvolve 通过 LLM 引导的代码演化和树搜索处理有明确量化目标的任务，CosmoEvolve 通过虚拟多智能体研究实验室处理开放科学工作流。初步演示显示，CMBEvolve 在弱透镜地图的异常检测上迭代提升基准得分，CosmoEvolve 在 ACT DR6 数据分析中自主识别非平凡的尺度依赖行为并生成分析级诊断。
Motivation: 当前 AI 主要作为辅助工具，论文致力于推动 AI 向自主科学发现发展，为宇宙学提供自动化研究能力。
Method: 提出了两款互补的代理系统：CMBEvolve（基于 LLM 的代码演化与树搜索）用于有明确量化目标的任务；CosmoEvolve（虚拟多智能体研究实验室）用于开放端科学工作流。
Result: CMBEvolve 在弱透镜地图的分布外检测任务上通过代码演化逐步提升基准分数；CosmoEvolve 在 ACT DR6 数据分析中自主发现非平凡的对与尺度依赖行为，并生成诊断级分析结果。
Conclusion: 宇宙学既能提供受控的基准测试任务，也能提供现实的开放式研究问题，为 AI 科学家系统的发展提供了理想试验场。

papers.title: Diffusion Models, Denoiser Architecture and Creativity
papers.abstract_en: The creativity of diffusion models refers to their ability to generate highly realistic images that are different from their training data. Creativity is somewhat surprising since it is known that if the denoiser used in the diffusion model is the Bayes optimal denoiser for a given training set, then the model will simply copy the training samples. In this paper we present empirical and theoretical results that suggest that creativity in diffusion models is due to an interaction between the denoiser architecture and the target distribution. Theoretically, we give explicit forms for the distribution of generated samples as a function of the target distribution and the denoiser architecture for three different denoiser architectures (linear, polynomial, bottleneck). Empirically, we show that small changes in the popular UNET denoiser architecture leads to very different forms of creativity, and these small changes often yield samples that are highly nonrealistic. Taken together, our results show that diffusion models will only be successful if the inductive bias of the denoiser architecture is in strong alignment with the true target distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散模型中创造力的来源，发现创造力来自去噪器架构与目标分布的相互作用。理论分析了三种去噪器架构下的生成样本分布，实验表明UNET架构的小改动会导致不同的创造力形式，甚至产生非真实样本。结论是扩散模型成功依赖于去噪器架构的归纳偏差与真实目标分布的对齐。
Motivation: 扩散模型能够生成不同于训练样本的高真实感图像（即创造力），但已知若使用贝叶斯最优去噪器，模型只会复制训练样本。本文旨在解释这一矛盾，探索创造力产生的原因。
Method: 通过理论分析三种去噪器（线性、多项式、瓶颈）下的生成分布形式，以及实验观察UNET架构微小改动对创造力样本的影响。
Result: 理论上给出了三种去噪器架构下生成样本分布的显式形式；实验上显示UNET架构的微小改动会导致截然不同的创造力，且常产生非真实样本。
Conclusion: 扩散模型只有在去噪器架构的归纳偏差与真实目标分布强对齐时才能成功。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AttenA+: Rectifying Action Inequality in Robotic Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing robotic foundation models, while powerful, are predicated on an implicit assumption of temporal homogeneity: treating all actions as equally informative during optimization. This "flat" training paradigm, inherited from language modeling, remains indifferent to the underlying physical hierarchy of manipulation. In reality, robot trajectories are fundamentally heterogeneous, where low-velocity segments often dictate task success through precision-demanding interactions, while high-velocity motions serve as error-tolerant transitions. Such a misalignment between uniform loss weighting and physical criticality fundamentally limits the performance of current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World-Action Models (WAM) in complex, long-horizon tasks. To rectify this, we introduce AttenA+, an architecture-agnostic framework that prioritizes kinematically critical segments via velocity-driven action attention. By reweighting the training objective based on the inverse velocity field, AttenA+ naturally aligns the model's learning capacity with the physical demands of manipulation. As a plug-and-play enhancement, AttenA+ can be integrated into existing backbones without structural modifications or additional parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AttenA+ significantly elevates the ceilings of current state-of-the-art models. Specifically, it improves OpenVLA-OFT to 98.6% (+1.5%) on the Libero benchmark and pushes FastWAM to 92.4% (+0.6%) on RoboTwin 2.0. Real-world validation on a Franka manipulator further showcases its robustness and cross-task generalization. Our work suggests that mining the intrinsic structural priors of action sequences offers a highly efficient, physics-aware complement to standard scaling laws, paving a new path for general-purpose robotic control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有的机器人基础模型假设动作在时间上同质，所有动作在优化中权重相同，但实际机器人轨迹中低速段通常需要高精度，高速段容错性强。本文提出AttenA+，一个与架构无关的框架，通过速度驱动的动作注意力机制重新加权训练目标，优先考虑运动学关键片段。实验表明，AttenA+显著提升了现有模型的性能，例如在Libero基准上将OpenVLA-OFT提升至98.6%（+1.5%），在Franka机械臂上验证了鲁棒性和跨任务泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有机器人基础模型隐含地假设动作在时间上同质，对所有动作同等加权，忽略了物理操作中的层次结构（如低速段要求高精度，高速段容错性强），导致在复杂长周期任务中性能受限。
Method: 提出AttenA+框架，通过逆速度场重新加权训练目标，使模型学习能力与操作的物理需求对齐。该框架无需修改模型结构或增加参数，可集成到现有骨干网络中。
Result: 在Libero基准上，OpenVLA-OFT达到98.6%（+1.5%）；在RoboTwin 2.0上，FastWAM达到92.4%（+0.6%）。在Franka机械臂上的真实世界实验验证了鲁棒性和跨任务泛化能力。
Conclusion: 挖掘动作序列的内在结构先验是一种高效且物理感知的补充，可替代标准缩放法则，为通用机器人控制开辟新路径。

papers.title: MMSkills: Towards Multimodal Skills for General Visual Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reusable skills have become a core substrate for improving agent capabilities, yet most existing skill packages encode reusable behavior primarily as textual prompts, executable code, or learned routines. For visual agents, however, procedural knowledge is inherently multimodal: reuse depends not only on what operation to perform, but also on recognizing the relevant state, interpreting visual evidence of progress or failure, and deciding what to do next. We formalize this requirement as multimodal procedural knowledge and address three practical challenges: (I) what a multimodal skill package should contain; (II) where such packages can be derived from public interaction experience; and (III) how agents can consult multimodal evidence at inference time without excessive image context or over-anchoring to reference screenshots. We introduce MMSkills, a framework for representing, generating, and using reusable multimodal procedures for runtime visual decision making. Each MMSkill is a compact, state-conditioned package that couples a textual procedure with runtime state cards and multi-view keyframes. To construct these packages, we develop an agentic trajectory-to-skill Generator that transforms public non-evaluation trajectories into reusable multimodal skills through workflow grouping, procedure induction, visual grounding, and meta-skill-guided auditing. To use them, we introduce a branch-loaded multimodal skill agent: selected state cards and keyframes are inspected in a temporary branch, aligned with the live environment, and distilled into structured guidance for the main agent. Experiments across GUI and game-based visual-agent benchmarks show that MMSkills consistently improve both frontier and smaller multimodal agents, suggesting that external multimodal procedural knowledge complements model-internal priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMSkills 框架，用于表示、生成和使用可重用的多模态程序（multimodal procedures），以增强视觉智能体（visual agents）的运行时决策能力。每个 MMSkill 包含文本程序、运行时状态卡和多视角关键帧。作者从公开的非评估轨迹中通过工作流分组、程序归纳、视觉定位等步骤生成技能，并通过分支加载机制在推理时利用这些技能。实验在 GUI 和游戏基准上显示 MMSkills 能一致提升前沿和较小多模态智能体的性能。
Motivation: 现有技能包大多编码为文本提示、可执行代码或学习例程，但视觉智能体的程序性知识本质上是多模态的：重用不仅依赖于执行什么操作，还需要识别相关状态、解释视觉证据以判断进展或失败，并决定下一步行动。作者形式化了这一需求为多模态程序性知识，并解决三个实际挑战：技能包应包含什么、从何处获取、以及如何在推理时咨询多模态证据而不引入过多图像上下文或过度依赖参考截图。
Method: 提出 MMSkills 框架：每个技能是紧凑的状态条件包，包含文本程序、运行时状态卡和多视角关键帧。构建时使用 agentic trajectory-to-skill Generator，通过工作流分组、程序归纳、视觉定位和元技能指导审计，将非评估轨迹转化为可重用的多模态技能。使用时引入分支加载多模态技能智能体：在临时分支中检查选中的状态卡和关键帧，与实时环境对齐，并提炼为结构化指导给主智能体。
Result: 在 GUI 和游戏视觉智能体基准上的实验表明，MMSkills 持续提升了前沿和较小多模态智能体的性能。
Conclusion: 外部多模态程序性知识能补充模型内部先验，提升视觉智能体的能力。

papers.title: CLIP Tricks You: Training-free Token Pruning for Efficient Pixel Grounding in Large VIsion-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In large vision-language models, visual tokens typically constitute the majority of input tokens, leading to substantial computational overhead. To address this, recent studies have explored pruning redundant or less informative visual tokens for image understanding tasks. However, these methods struggle with pixel grounding tasks, where token importance is highly contingent on the input text. Through an in-depth analysis of CLIP, we observe that visual tokens within referent regions often exhibit low similarity to their textual representation. Motivated by this insight, we introduce LiteLVLM, a training-free, text-guided token pruning strategy for efficient pixel grounding inference. By reversing the ranking of CLIP's visual-text similarity, LiteLVLM effectively retains visual tokens covering the referent regions, while recovering context tokens to enable clear foreground-background separation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiteLVLM significantly outperforms existing methods by over 5% across diverse token budgets. Without any training or fine-tuning, LiteLVLM maintains 90% of the original performance with a 22% speedup and a 2.3X memory reduction. Our code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/LiteLVLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LiteLVLM，一种无需训练、基于文本引导的视觉token剪枝策略，用于高效像素级定位推理。通过反转CLIP视觉-文本相似度排序，该方法有效保留覆盖所指区域的视觉token并恢复上下文token，实现前后景分离。实验表明，在多种token预算下，该方法性能优于现有方法超过5%，且无需训练即可保持90%原始性能，同时获得22%加速和2.3倍内存减少。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型处理大量视觉token导致计算开销大，而针对像素级定位任务，token重要性高度依赖输入文本，现有剪枝方法在此类任务上表现不佳。
Method: 提出LiteLVLM，一种基于CLIP相似度分析的训练无关token剪枝策略。通过反转视觉-文本相似度排序，优先保留与所指区域低相似度（但实际重要）的token，并恢复上下文token以增强前后景分离。
Result: 在多种token预算下，LiteLVLM比现有方法性能提升超过5%；无需微调即可达到原始性能的90%，同时实现22%速度提升和2.3倍内存减少。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过简单反转CLIP相似度排序可有效为像素级定位任务实现高效token剪枝，且无需额外训练，为大规模视觉语言模型的部署提供了实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Heavy Tails Help Diffusion? On the Subtle Trade-off Between Initialization and Training
papers.abstract_en: Recent works have proposed incorporating heavy-tailed (HT) noise into diffusion- and flow-based generative models, with the goals of better recovering the tails of target distributions and improving generative diversity. This motivation is intuitive: if the data are heavy-tailed, HT noise may appear better matched than light-tailed (LT) Gaussian noise. However, replacing Gaussian noise by HT noise also changes the underlying estimation problem. In this paper, we revisit this paradigm through a combined theoretical and empirical study, establishing sampling-error bounds for two representative diffusion models driven by HT and LT noise. We show that HT noise makes the statistical estimation problem harder, leading to less favorable sampling-error bounds. We support these findings with experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, empirically recovering the predicted error trade-off. Our results call into question a growing design trend in generative modeling and challenge the use of HT noise to improve rare-region exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验研究重尾噪声（HT）与轻尾噪声（LT）在扩散模型中的表现。结果表明，尽管HT噪声在直观上更适合重尾数据，但它实际上使统计估计问题更难，导致更差的采样误差边界。实验在合成和真实数据集上验证了误差权衡，质疑了使用HT噪声改进生成模型稀有区域探索的趋势。
Motivation: 近期工作引入重尾噪声到扩散模型以改善尾部恢复和生成多样性，但本文指出这种替换改变了估计问题本身，需重新审视其有效性。
Method: 建立了HT和LT噪声驱动的两种扩散模型的采样误差边界，通过理论分析和合成/真实数据集实验对比其性能。
Result: HT噪声导致更不利的采样误差边界，实验证实了预测的误差权衡，表明HT噪声并不优于LT噪声。
Conclusion: 论文挑战了在生成模型中广泛使用重尾噪声的趋势，认为其不能有效改善稀有区域探索。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Multi-Rollout On-Policy Distillation via Peer Successes and Failures
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are often post-trained with sparse verifier rewards, which indicate whether a sampled trajectory succeeds but provide limited guidance about where reasoning succeeds or fails. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers denser token-level supervision by training on student-generated trajectories, yet existing methods typically distill each rollout independently and ignore the other attempts sampled for the same prompt. We introduce Multi-Rollout On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), a peer-conditioned distillation framework that uses the student's local rollout group to construct more informative teacher signals. MOPD conditions the teacher on both successful and failed peer rollouts: successes provide positive evidence for valid reasoning patterns, while failures provide structured negative evidence about plausible mistakes to avoid. We study two peer-context constructions: positive peer imitation and contrastive success-failure conditioning. Experiments on competitive programming, mathematical reasoning, scientific question answering, and tool-use benchmarks show that MOPD consistently improves over standard on-policy baselines. Further teacher-signal analysis shows that mixed success-failure contexts better align teacher scores with verifier rewards, indicating that the gains arise from more faithful, instance-adaptive supervision. These results indicate that effective on-policy distillation should exploit the student's multi-rollout trial-and-error behavior rather than treating rollouts as isolated samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型后训练中稀疏验证奖励监督不足的问题，提出多展开在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）框架。MOPD利用同一提示下学生的多个采样轨迹（包括成功与失败的同伴展开）构建更密集的教师信号，包含正例模仿和对比成功-失败条件两种上下文构造。实验表明，在编程、数学推理、科学问答和工具使用基准上，MOPD一致优于标准在线策略基线，且混合成功-失败上下文能更好地对齐教师分数与验证奖励。
Motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏将每个展开独立处理，忽略了同一提示下的其他尝试，未能充分利用学生试错行为中的密集监督信号。

Result: 在竞争性编程、数学推理、科学问答和工具使用基准上，MOPD一致提升性能；教师信号分析表明混合成功-失败上下文使教师分数与验证奖励更接近。
Conclusion: 有效的在线策略蒸馏应利用学生的多展开试错行为，而非将展开视为孤立样本。

papers.title: Fast Image Super-Resolution via Consistency Rectified Flow
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models (DMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in real-world image super-resolution (SR), yet their reliance on time-consuming multi-step sampling largely hinders their practical applications. While recent efforts have introduced few- or single-step solutions, existing methods either inefficiently model the process from noisy input or fail to fully exploit iterative generative priors, compromising the fidelity and quality of the reconstructed images. To address this issue, we propose FlowSR, a novel approach that reformulates the SR problem as a rectified flow from low-resolution (LR) to high-resolution (HR) images. Our method leverages an improved consistency learning strategy to enable high-quality SR in a single step. Specifically, we refine the original consistency distillation process by incorporating HR regularization, ensuring that the learned SR flow not only enforces self-consistency but also converges precisely to the ground-truth HR target. Furthermore, we introduce a fast-slow scheduling strategy, where adjacent timesteps for consistency learning are sampled from two distinct schedulers: a fast scheduler with fewer timesteps to improve efficiency, and a slow scheduler with more timesteps to capture fine-grained texture details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlowSR achieves outstanding performance in both efficiency and image quality. Code: \href{https://github.com/jiaqixuac/FlowSR}{this https URL}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowSR 提出将图像超分辨率问题重新表述为从低分辨率到高分辨率的校正流（rectified flow），通过改进的一致性学习策略（加入 HR 正则化）实现单步高质量超分，并引入快慢调度（fast-slow scheduling）以兼顾效率与纹理细节。实验表明 FlowSR 在速度和图像质量上均取得优异表现。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型超分辨率方法依赖多步采样，效率低下；近期少步或单步方案要么从噪声输入建模效率不高，要么未能充分利用迭代生成先验，导致重建图像的保真度和质量受损。
Method: 提出 FlowSR，将 SR 建模为从 LR 到 HR 的校正流；改进一致性蒸馏，加入 HR 正则化确保流不仅自一致且收敛到真实 HR 目标；引入快慢调度，相邻时间步分别从快慢两个调度器采样，以平衡效率与细粒度纹理捕获。
Result: 大量实验表明 FlowSR 在效率和图像质量上均达到出色性能。
Conclusion: FlowSR 通过校正流和一致性学习实现了单步高保真超分辨率，并验证了快慢调度策略的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CVEvolve: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery for Unstructured Scientific Data Processing
papers.abstract_en: Scientific data processing often requires task-specific algorithms or AI models, creating a barrier for domain scientists who need to analyze their data but may not have extensive computing or image-processing expertise. This barrier is especially pronounced when data are noisy, have a high dynamic range, are sparsely labeled, or are only loosely specified. We introduce CVEvolve, an autonomous agentic harness with a zero-code interface for scientific data-processing algorithm discovery. CVEvolve combines a multi-round search strategy with tools for code execution, evaluation implementation, history management, holdout testing, and optional inspection of scientific data and visual outputs. The search alternates between discovery and improvement actions, and uses lineage-aware stochastic candidate sampling to balance exploration and exploitation. We demonstrate CVEvolve on X-ray fluorescence microscopy image registration, Bragg peak detection, high-energy diffraction microscopy image segmentation, and hybrid analytical-learning-based affine registration. Across these tasks, CVEvolve discovers algorithms that improve over baseline methods, while holdout test tracking helps identify candidates that generalize better than later over-optimized alternatives. These results show that zero-code, autonomous LLM-powered algorithm development can help domain scientists turn unstructured scientific image data into practical algorithms and downstream scientific discoveries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CVEvolve 是一个自主智能体框架，提供零代码接口，用于科学数据处理算法的自动发现。它通过多轮搜索策略，结合代码执行、评估实现、历史管理和保留测试等工具，在 X 射线荧光显微镜图像配准、Bragg 峰检测、高能衍射显微镜图像分割等任务中，发现优于基线方法的算法，且保留测试有助于识别泛化能力更强的候选。
Motivation: 科学数据处理常需要任务特定的算法或 AI 模型，这对缺乏计算或图像处理专长的领域科学家构成障碍，尤其当数据噪声大、动态范围高、标签稀疏或仅松散指定时。
Method: CVEvolve 采用零代码接口，结合多轮搜索策略，交替进行发现和改进动作，并使用谱系感知的随机候选采样来平衡探索与利用，同时集成代码执行、评估实现、历史管理和可选的数据与视觉输出检查工具。
Result: 在 X 射线荧光显微镜图像配准、Bragg 峰检测、高能衍射显微镜图像分割以及混合分析学习仿射配准等任务上，CVEvolve 发现的算法优于基线方法，且保留测试跟踪有助于避免后期过度优化的候选。
Conclusion: 零代码、自主 LLM 驱动的算法开发可以帮助领域科学家将非结构化科学图像数据转化为实用算法，推动下游科学发现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Language Modeling with Hyperspherical Flows
papers.abstract_en: Discrete Diffusion Language Models progressed rapidly as an alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, motivated by their parallel generation abilities. However, for tractability, discrete diffusion models sample from a factorized distribution, which is less expressive than AR. Recent Flow Language Models (FLMs) apply continuous flows to language, transporting noise to data with a deterministic ODE that avoids factorized sampling. FLMs operate on one-hot vectors whose dimension scales with the vocabulary size, making FLMs costly to train. Moreover, since all distinct one-hot embeddings are equidistant in $\ell_2$, adding Gaussian noise does not have a clear semantic interpretation (unlike images, where Gaussian noise progressively degrades structure). We introduce $\mathbb{S}$-FLM, a latent FLM in the hypersphere. $\mathbb{S}$-FLM generates sequences by rotating vectors in $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$ along a velocity field learned with cross-entropy, avoiding the overhead of materializing one-hot vectors. Previous FLMs match AR in Generative Perplexity (Gen.\ PPL), but samples with high likelihood are not necessarily correct in verifiable domains such as math and code. $\mathbb{S}$-FLM substantially improves continuous flow language models on large-vocabulary reasoning and closes the gap to masked diffusion under standard-temperature sampling ($T=1$), while a gap remains under optimized low-temperature ($T=0.1$) decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出S-FLM，一种在超球面上操作的潜在连续流语言模型，通过旋转向量生成序列，避免one-hot向量的高维开销。实验表明，S-FLM在大词汇推理任务上显著优于先前的连续流语言模型，并在标准温度采样下缩小了与掩码扩散模型的差距。
Motivation: 现有连续流语言模型（FLM）在处理one-hot向量时计算成本高，且高斯噪声在语言域缺乏语义解释。离散扩散模型因因子化采样表达能力受限。
Method: S-FLM将语言建模置于超球面潜在空间中，通过交叉熵学习速度场来旋转向量，从而生成序列，避免直接处理高维one-hot向量。
Result: S-FLM在大词汇推理任务上显著改善了连续流语言模型的性能，在标准温度（T=1）采样下接近于掩码扩散模型，但在优化低温（T=0.1）解码下仍有差距。
Conclusion: 超球面潜在流为语言建模提供了一种高效且表达能力强的连续生成框架，尤其适用于大词汇推理，但低温解码下的性能差距仍需进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RADAR: Redundancy-Aware Diffusion for Multi-Agent Communication Structure Generation
papers.abstract_en: Compared with individual agents, large language model based multi-agent systems have shown great capabilities consistently across diverse tasks, including code generation, mathematical reasoning, and planning, etc. Despite their impressive performance, the effectiveness and robustness of these systems heavily rely on their communication topology, which is often fixed or generated in a single step. This restricts fine-grained structural exploration and flexible composition, resulting in excessive token utilization on simple tasks while limiting capability on complicated tasks. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce RADAR, a redundancy-aware and query-adaptive generative framework that actively reduce communication overhead. Motivated by recent progress in conditional discrete graph diffusion models, we formulate communication topology design as a step-by-step generation process, guided by the effective size of the graph. Comprehensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that RADAR consistently outperforms recent baselines, achieving higher accuracy, lower token consumption, and greater robustness across diverse scenarios. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/cszhangzhen/RADAR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中通信拓扑结构固定或单步生成导致的问题，提出冗余感知自适应扩散框架RADAR，将通信拓扑设计建模为条件离散图扩散过程，逐步生成结构。实验表明RADAR在六个基准上提升了准确性、降低了token消耗并增强了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统的通信拓扑通常是固定或单步生成的，限制了细粒度结构探索和灵活组合，导致简单任务上token消耗过高而复杂任务上能力受限。
Method: 受条件离散图扩散模型进展启发，RADAR将通信拓扑设计建模为逐步生成过程，并由图的有效大小引导，实现冗余感知和查询自适应的通信结构生成。
Result: 在六个基准上，RADAR一致优于近期基线，取得更高准确性、更低token消耗和更强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过冗余感知的自适应生成框架可以有效降低多智能体通信开销，提升系统性能。

papers.title: Causal state binding predicts action control in language agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous language agents increasingly expose traces, memories, plans and constraints, but existing evaluations rarely test whether these state variables are bound to final actions. We introduce causal state binding, an intervention-coupled evaluation framework that measures whether actions change with the event-specific decisive state while remaining invariant to irrelevant cues. The primary readout is a hidden-target finite-action benchmark in which scorer-side intervention targets are assigned before generation and withheld from the model-visible prompt. Across 57,816 scored records in seven corpus-level units, structured-agent conditions exceeded high-randomness controls and targeted component removals on reason, memory, veto and self-continuity responsiveness. Open-weight validation across Qwen2.5 7B, 14B and 32B plus Mistral-7B showed that action priors, no-field prompts and scrambled decisive context did not recover the structured-control signature. In diagnostic finite-action probes, the minimal decisive-field readout recovered the prescribed action pattern whereas surface-only, action-prior-only and scrambled-field controls did not. Across 300 SWE-bench Lite issue records and six API models, adding an oracle-free causal state-binding composite to a full non-CSB baseline increased constraint-clean issue-to-file hit@3 AUC from 0.873 to 0.935. This validation concerns issue-to-file localization, not patch application or SWE-bench issue resolution. These results support a measurement principle for agent evaluation: action control is predicted by event-specific state-action binding, not by output entropy, action-prior matching or rationale format alone.
papers.comment: 85 pages, 5 main figures; supplementary information included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因果状态绑定 (causal state binding) 框架，通过干预耦合评估语言代理的行动是否由事件特定决定性状态驱动，而非随机或表面线索。在57,816条评分记录和SWE-bench Lite基准上，结构化代理条件显著优于高随机控制，且开放权重模型验证了该方法的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有语言代理评估很少检验内部状态变量（如记忆、计划）是否真正与最终行动绑定，导致无法区分因果驱动与表面相关性。
Method: 引入因果状态绑定框架：在生成前分配干预目标并隐藏于模型可见提示之外，通过 scorer-side 干预测量行动对决定性状态的敏感性，同时保持对无关线索不变。
Result: 在七个语料单元中，结构化代理条件优于高随机控制和目标组件移除；在SWE-bench Lite上，添加因果状态绑定复合指标将 issue-to-file hit@3 AUC 从0.873提升至0.935。
Conclusion: 行动控制由事件特定状态-行动绑定预测，而非输出熵、行动先验或推理格式本身，为代理评估提供了新测量原则。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 行动控制由事件特定状态-行动绑定预测，而非输出熵、行动先验或推理格式本身，为代理评估提供了新测量原则。

papers.title: Prune-OPD: Efficient and Reliable On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) leverages dense teacher rewards to enhance reasoning models. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon tasks exposes a critical flaw: as the student's generated prefix inevitably diverges from the teacher's thought process, the teacher's dense reward loses local exploitability. Continuing to generate and evaluate tokens on these ``drifted'' trajectories not only degrades reward quality but also incurs massive computational waste. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Prune-OPD}, a framework that dynamically aligns training budgets with supervision quality. By continuously monitoring the local compatibility between student and teacher predictions (e.g., via top-$k$ overlap), Prune-OPD detects prefix-drift events in real time. Upon detecting severe drift, it monotonically down-weights subsequent unreliable rewards and triggers dynamic rollout truncation. This allows the training process to halt futile generation and reallocate compute strictly to reliable teacher supervision. Across diverse teacher-student combinations, Prune-OPD consistently aligns computation with supervision reliability. When prefix drift makes dense teacher rewards unreliable, it reduces training time by 37.6\%--68.0\% while preserving, and often improving, performance on challenging benchmarks (AMC, AIME, HMMT). When student-teacher compatibility remains high, it automatically preserves long-context supervision by expanding the training window. These results suggest that Prune-OPD improves OPD not by blindly shortening rollouts, but by reallocating computation toward locally exploitable teacher rewards.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Prune-OPD 框架，通过实时检测学生与教师推理过程中的前缀漂移 (prefix drift)，动态截断无效 rollouts 并降低不可靠奖励的权重，从而在保持或提升性能的同时显著减少 on-policy distillation 的训练时间。在 AMC、AIME、HMMT 等挑战性基准上，训练时间减少 37.6%-68.0%，性能持平或改善。
Motivation: On-policy distillation 在长程任务中，学生生成的前缀会偏离教师的推理轨迹，导致密集奖励失去局部可开采性，且后续计算产生巨大浪费。需要一种机制将训练预算分配给可靠的教师监督。
Method: Prune-OPD 持续监控学生与教师预测的局部兼容性（如 top-k 重叠），实时检测前缀漂移事件；一旦检测到严重漂移，单调地降低后续不可靠奖励的权重，并触发动态 rollout 截断，将计算重新分配给可靠监督。
Result: 在多种教师-学生组合下，Prune-OPD 减少训练时间 37.6%-68.0%，同时保持或提升在 AMC、AIME、HMMT 等基准上的性能。当学生-教师兼容性高时，自动扩展训练窗口以保留长上下文监督。
Conclusion: Prune-OPD 通过动态分配计算到局部可开采的教师奖励，有效提升了 on-policy distillation 在长程推理任务中的效率与可靠性，而非盲目缩短 rollouts。

papers.title: Unsat Core Prediction through Polarity-Aware Representation Learning over Clause-Literal Hypergraphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks have been widely used in Boolean satisfiability (SAT) tasks to learn structural information from SAT formulas. The goal of these studies is to solve SAT instances or to enhance SAT solvers, including tasks such as unsat-core prediction. However, most existing approaches model a SAT formula as a bipartite graph or a directed acyclic graph, which are less direct in capturing clause-level and higher-order interactions among literals and clauses. Moreover, these approaches are limited in modeling intrinsic polarity-related properties of SAT, such as the complementary relationship between the positive and negative literals of a variable. To address these limitations, we propose a polarity-aware representation learning framework over clause-literal hypergraphs. We model SAT formulas as clause-literal hypergraphs augmented with a clause incidence graph to capture higher-order structural interactions. We then introduce a polarity-aware decomposition mechanism that separates variable representations into polarity invariant and equivariant components, explicitly modeling the relationship between positive and negative literals, with the resulting literal representations propagated along the hypergraph structure. We further incorporate a polarity-inversion consistency regularization to reinforce polarity-consistent representations during training. Experimental results on multiple SAT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对SAT公式的不可满足核心预测任务，提出一种极性感知的表示学习框架，将SAT公式建模为子句-文字超图，并引入极性感知分解机制来显式建模正负文字的关系。实验在多个SAT数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有图神经网络方法将SAT公式建模为二部图或有向无环图，难以捕获子句级和高阶交互，且未能有效建模SAT中变量的正负极性互补关系。
Method: 将SAT公式建模为子句-文字超图，并附加子句关联图以捕获高阶结构；提出极性感知分解机制，将变量表示分离为极性不变和等变分量，沿超图结构传播文字表示；引入极性反转一致性正则化以强化极性一致表示。
Result: 在多个SAT数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在不可满足核心预测任务上优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 论文强调极性感知超图建模能够更有效地捕获SAT公式的结构和极性信息，提升不可满足核心预测性能。
