papers.title: Gradients with Respect to Semantics Preserving Embeddings Tell the Uncertainty of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is an important technique for ensuring the trustworthiness of LLMs, given their tendency to hallucinate. Existing state-of-the-art UQ approaches for free-form generation rely heavily on sampling, which incurs high computational cost and variance. In this work, we propose the first gradient-based UQ method for free-form generation, SemGrad, which is sampling-free and computationally efficient. Unlike prior gradient-based methods developed for classification tasks that operates in parameter space, we propose to consider gradients in semantic space. Our method builds on the key intuition that a confident LLM should maintain stable output distributions under semantically equivalent input perturbations. We interpret the stability as the gradients in semantic space and introduce a Semantic Preservation Score (SPS) to identify embeddings that best capture semantics, with respect to which gradients are computed. We further propose HybridGrad, which combines the strengths of SemGrad and parameter gradients. Experiments demonstrate that both of our methods provide efficient and effective uncertainty estimates, achieving superior performance than state-of-the-art methods, particularly in settings with multiple valid responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于梯度的不确定性量化方法SemGrad，用于大语言模型的自由文本生成，无需采样且计算高效。该方法利用语义空间中的梯度来衡量模型对语义等价输入扰动的输出稳定性，并引入语义保持分数（SPS）选择最佳语义嵌入。进一步提出HybridGrad，结合SemGrad与参数梯度。实验表明，在多种有效响应场景中，该方法优于现有最先进的不确定性估计方法。
Motivation: 现有基于采样的不确定性量化方法计算成本高且方差大，需要一种无需采样、计算高效的替代方案。
Method: 提出SemGrad，计算语义空间中的梯度，利用语义保持分数（SPS）筛选最能捕捉语义的嵌入；同时提出HybridGrad，融合语义梯度与参数梯度。
Result: 在自由文本生成任务上，所提方法在多个有效响应场景中表现出更优的不确定性估计性能，且计算效率更高。
Conclusion: 梯度方法为LLM不确定性量化提供了高效新途径，特别适用于自由文本生成。

papers.title: GRPO-TTA: Test-Time Visual Tuning for Vision-Language Models via GRPO-Driven Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has recently shown strong performance in post-training large language models and vision-language models. It raises a question of whether the GRPO also significantly promotes the test-time adaptation (TTA) of vision language models. In this paper, we propose Group Relative Policy Optimization for Test-Time Adaptation (GRPO-TTA), which adapts GRPO to the TTA setting by reformulating class-specific prompt prediction as a group-wise policy optimization problem. Specifically, we construct output groups by sampling top-K class candidates from CLIP similarity distributions, enabling probability-driven optimization without access to ground-truth labels. Moreover, we design reward functions tailored to test-time adaptation, including alignment rewards and dispersion rewards, to guide effective visual encoder tuning. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GRPO-TTA consistently outperforms existing test-time adaptation methods, with notably larger performance gains under natural distribution shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRPO-TTA，将组相对策略优化（GRPO）应用于测试时适应（TTA）场景，通过将类特定提示预测重构为组策略优化问题，并在无需真实标签的情况下使用CLIP相似度分布采样输出组，设计对齐奖励和分散奖励来指导视觉编码器调优。实验表明该方法在多个基准上优于现有TTA方法，尤其在自然分布偏移下性能提升更显著。
Motivation: 现有TTA方法在视觉语言模型上通常需要标签或启发式规则，GRPO在后期训练中表现优异，但尚未被探索用于TTA。本文旨在验证GRPO能否显著促进视觉语言模型的测试时适应。
Method: 将类特定提示预测重构为组策略优化问题，通过从CLIP相似度分布中采样top-K类别来构建输出组，实现无真实标签的概率驱动优化；设计针对TTA的奖励函数（对齐奖励和分散奖励）来指导视觉编码器调优。
Result: 在多个基准上，GRPO-TTA一致优于现有TTA方法，尤其在自然分布偏移下性能增益更大。
Conclusion: GRPO-TTA证明了GRPO框架在视觉语言模型测试时适应中的有效性，为无标签适应提供了一种新思路。

papers.title: Trustworthy AI Suffers from Invariance Conflicts and Causality is The Solution
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning (ML) models and foundation models (FMs), are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, ensuring their trustworthiness has become a central challenge. However, the core trustworthy AI objectives, such as fairness, robustness, privacy, and explainability, are hard to achieve simultaneously, especially while preserving utility. This position paper argues that causality is necessary to understand and balance trade-offs in performance and multiple objectives of trustworthy AI. We ground our arguments in re-interpreting trustworthy AI trade-offs as incompatible invariance requirements under different changes to the data-generating process. We then illustrate this argument through case-study analyses from the literature and a stylized synthetic-data simulation, showing that causality provides a unifying framework for understanding how trade-offs in trustworthy AI arise and how they can be softened or resolved through selective invariance. This perspective applies to both classical ML models and large-scale FMs. Finally, we outline open challenges and opportunities for using causality to build both trustworthy and high-performing AI.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为，可信AI（包括公平性、鲁棒性、隐私、可解释性等目标）面临内在的权衡，这些权衡可被重新解释为在不同数据生成过程变化下的不兼容不变性要求。通过案例分析和合成数据模拟，作者论证因果关系为理解和缓解这些权衡提供了统一框架，并讨论了在经典ML和大规模基础模型中的应用。
Motivation: 可信AI的多个目标（公平、鲁棒、隐私、可解释等）难以同时实现，且与性能之间存在冲突；现有方法缺乏对权衡根源的统一理解。
Method: 提出将可信AI权衡重新概念化为不同干预下的不变性冲突，并通过因果视角分析权衡的起因；使用文献案例和合成数据模拟进行说明。
Result: 分析表明，因果框架可以解释不同信任目标之间的权衡，并可通过选择性不变性来缓解冲突。
Conclusion: 因果关系是理解和平衡可信AI中多种目标与性能权衡的关键，为构建既可信又高性能的AI系统提供了方向。

papers.title: STABLEVAL: Disagreement-Aware and Stable Evaluation of AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Human evaluation remains the primary standard for assessing modern AI systems, yet annotator disagreement, bias, and variability make system rankings fragile under standard majority vote aggregation. Majority vote discards annotator reliability and item-level ambiguity, often yielding unstable comparisons across annotator subsets. We introduce STABLEVAL, a disagreement-aware evaluation framework that models latent item correctness and annotator-specific confusion patterns to produce posterior expected item credit and calibrated agent-level scores. Unlike label-denoising approaches such as Dawid-Skene, STABLEVAL is explicitly designed for stable and uncertainty-aware system evaluation rather than hard label recovery. We formalize ranking stability as a first-class evaluation objective and analyze how aggregation methods preserve or distort underlying annotator behavior. Across controlled synthetic experiments and multiple real-world human-annotated benchmarks, majority vote exhibits increasing score error and ranking instability under annotator heterogeneity and adversarial noise, while STABLEVAL yields more stable and statistically grounded system rankings. These results demonstrate that modeling disagreement is essential for robust and reproducible AI evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STABLEVAL 是一个面向 AI 系统评估的争议感知框架，通过对项目正确性和标注者混淆模式建模，生成后验期望项目分数和校准的智能体级别分数，从而在标注者异质性和对抗噪声下提供比多数投票更稳定、更统计可靠的系统排名。
Motivation: 人类评估是 AI 系统的主要标准，但标注者分歧、偏差和变异性使得基于多数投票的系统排名不稳定，且多数投票忽略了标注者可靠性和项目级模糊性。
Method: STABLEVAL 框架建模潜在项目正确性和标注者特定混淆模式，计算后验期望项目分数和校准的智能体分数，将排名稳定性作为一级评估目标，并分析聚合方法如何保留或扭曲标注者行为。
Result: 在合成实验和多个真实世界人工标注基准上，多数投票在标注者异质性和对抗噪声下表现出分数误差和排名不稳定，而 STABLEVAL 产生更稳定和统计基础更强的系统排名。
Conclusion: 建模分歧对于鲁棒和可复现的 AI 评估至关重要。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在合成实验和多个真实世界人工标注基准上，多数投票在标注者异质性和对抗噪声下表现出分数误差和排名不稳定，而 STABLEVAL 产生更稳定和统计基础更强的系统排名。
summary_sections.conclusion: 建模分歧对于鲁棒和可复现的 AI 评估至关重要。

papers.title: Continuous Temporal Representations of Event-Based Signals via Interference-Based Wave Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal signals arising from event-driven biological processes, such as surface electromyography (sEMG), exhibit asynchronous and highly structured activation patterns that are challenging to model using conventional discrete or purely real-valued representations. In this work, we propose a continuous temporal modeling framework based on interference-based wave representations. The approach maps event-like input signals into a complex-valued latent wave field, where temporal structure is encoded through phase modulation and interactions between latent components. By projecting the resulting wave field onto an energy domain, the model induces structured activation patterns that capture both temporal localization and relational dependencies within finite observation windows, without relying on explicit recurrence or causal state propagation. The proposed formulation is particularly suited for event-driven biosignals, where continuous representations enable efficient gradient-based optimization and robust feature extraction. In particular, the method is designed to support learning from sEMG data for downstream control tasks in biomechanical systems, such as prosthetic devices and exoskeletons. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed interference-based wave model provides improved representation quality compared to purely real-valued representations, while maintaining computational efficiency suitable for practical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对事件驱动生物信号（如表面肌电图sEMG）的连续时间表示问题，提出基于干涉波建模的框架，将事件信号映射到复值潜伏波场，通过相位调制和组件交互编码时间结构，并投影到能量域以捕获时间定位和关系依赖，无需显式递归或因果状态传播。实验表明该模型相比纯实值表示提高了表示质量，且计算效率适合实际部署。
Motivation: 传统离散或纯实值表示难以建模事件驱动生物信号中异步且高度结构化的激活模式。
Method: 提出干涉波表示框架：将事件输入映射为复值潜伏波场，利用相位调制和潜在组件之间的交互编码时间结构，再将波场投影到能量域以诱导结构化激活模式。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在sEMG数据上的表示质量优于纯实值表示，且计算效率适合实际部署。
Conclusion: 该干涉波模型为事件驱动生物信号提供了一种连续的、可微的表示方法，特别适用于生物力学系统中的下游控制任务（如假肢和外骨骼）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Possibilistic Predictive Uncertainty for Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks achieve impressive results across diverse applications, yet their overconfidence on unseen inputs necessitates reliable epistemic uncertainty modeling. Existing methods for uncertainty modeling face a fundamental dilemma: Bayesian approaches provide principled estimates but remain computationally prohibitive, while efficient second-order predictors lack rigorous connections between their specific objectives and epistemic uncertainty quantification. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce Dirichlet-approximated possibilistic posterior predictions (DAPPr), a principled framework grounded in possibility theory. We define a possibilistic posterior over parameters, project it to the prediction space via supremum operators, and approximate the projected posterior using learnable Dirichlet possibility functions. This projection-and-approximation strategy yields a simple training objective with closed-form solutions. Despite its simplicity, extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks show that DAPPr achieves competitive or superior uncertainty quantification performance over state-of-the-art second-order predictors while maintaining both principled derivation and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/MaxwellYaoNi/DAPPr.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dirichlet-近似可能性后验预测（DAPPr），一种基于可能性理论（possibility theory）的深度学习不确定性量化框架。通过定义参数上的可能性后验，利用上确界算子投影到预测空间，并用可学习的 Dirichlet 可能性函数近似，得到简单且闭式解的训练目标。实验表明，DAPPr 在多个基准上达到或优于最先进的二阶预测器（second-order predictors），同时保持原理严谨和计算高效。
Motivation: 现有深度神经网络在未见输入上过度自信，需要可靠的认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）建模。贝叶斯方法原理充分但计算昂贵，而高效的二阶预测器缺乏其特定目标与不确定性量化之间的严格联系。
Method: 提出 DAPPr 框架：定义参数上的可能性后验，通过上确界算子将其投影到预测空间，再使用可学习的 Dirichlet 可能性函数近似投影后的后验。训练目标具有闭式解，无需复杂近似。
Result: 在多个基准上，DAPPr 在不确定性量化性能上达到或优于现有最先进的二阶预测器，同时保持计算效率。
Conclusion: DAPPr 成功融合了可能性理论的严谨性和实际部署的简单性，为深度学习不确定性建模提供了一种新的有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Benchmarking Super-Resolution Models for Large-Scale Remote Sensing Imagery via Downstream Task Integration
papers.abstract_en: Super-resolution (SR) techniques have made major advances in reconstructing high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs. The increased resolution provides visual enhancement and utility for monitoring tasks. In particular, SR has been increasingly developed for satellite-based Earth observation, with applications in urban planning, agriculture, ecology, and disaster response. However, existing SR studies and benchmarks typically use fidelity metrics such as PSNR or SSIM, whereas the true utility of super-resolved images lies in supporting downstream tasks such as land cover classification, biomass estimation, and change detection. To bridge this gap, we introduce GeoSR-Bench, a downstream task-integrated SR benchmark dataset to evaluate SR models beyond fidelity metrics. GeoSR-Bench comprises spatially co-located, temporally aligned, and quality-controlled image pairs from about 36,000 locations across diverse land covers, spanning resolutions from 500m to 0.6m. To the best of our knowledge, GeoSR-Bench is the first SR benchmark that directly connects improved image resolution from SR models with downstream Earth monitoring tasks, including land cover segmentation, infrastructure mapping, and biophysical variable estimation. Using GeoSR-Bench, we benchmark GAN, transformer, neural operator, and diffusion-based SR models on perceptual quality and downstream task performance. We conduct experiments with 270 settings, covering 2 cross-platform SR tasks, 9 SR models, 3 downstream task models, and 5 downstream tasks for each SR task. The results show that improvements in traditional SR metrics often do not correlate with gains in task performance, and the correlations can be negative, indicating that these metrics provide limited guidance for selecting superior models for downstream tasks. This reveals the need to integrate downstream tasks into SR model development and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoSR-Bench，一个面向遥感图像超分辨率(SR)的下游任务集成基准数据集，包含来自约36000个地点的多尺度图像对。基准测试了GAN、Transformer、神经算子和扩散模型，涉及270种设置。结果表明传统SR指标(PSNR/SSIM)与下游任务性能相关性弱甚至为负，强调了在SR模型开发中集成下游任务的必要性。
Motivation: 现有SR研究仅关注保真度指标(PSNR/SSIM)，但这些指标不能反映超分图像在下游任务(如土地覆盖分类、生物量估计)中的实际效用，亟需建立联系分辨率增强与任务性能的基准。
Method: 构建GeoSR-Bench数据集，包含空间共位、时间对齐、质量控制的多尺度遥感图像对(从500m到0.6m分辨率)。设计实验评估9种SR模型在3个下游任务(土地覆盖分割、基础设施映射、生物物理变量估计)上的表现，共270种设置。
Result: 传统SR指标(PSNR/SSIM)与下游任务性能相关性弱，甚至出现负相关，表明仅依赖这些指标无法有效选择适用于实际任务的SR模型。
Conclusion: 超分模型的开发与评估应集成下游任务，单纯提高保真度可能对实际应用无益，甚至有害。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Action Motifs: Self-Supervised Hierarchical Representation of Human Body Movements
papers.abstract_en: Effective human behavior modeling requires a representation of the human body movement that capitalizes on its compositionality. We propose a hierarchical representation consisting of Action Atoms that capture the atomic joint movements and Action Motifs that are formed by their temporal compositions and encode similar body movements found across different overall human actions. We derive A4Mer, a nested latent Transformer to learn this hierarchical representation from human pose data in a fully self-supervised manner. A4Mer splits a 3D pose sequence into variable-length segments and represents each segment as a single latent token (Action Atoms). Through bottom-up representation learning, temporal patterns composed of these Action Atoms, which capture meaningful temporal spans of reusable, semantic segments of body movements, naturally emerge (Action Motifs). A4Mer achieves this with a unified pretext task of masked token prediction in their respective latent spaces. We also introduce Action Motif Dataset (AMD), a large-scale dataset of multi-view human behavior videos with full SMPL annotations. We introduce a novel use of cameras by mounting them on the feet to achieve their frame-wise annotations despite frequent and heavy body occlusions. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of A4Mer for extracting meaningful Action Motifs, which significantly benefit human behavior modeling tasks including action recognition, motion prediction, and motion interpolation.
papers.comment: Accepted as Highlight at CVPR2024. Project page: https://vision.ist.i.kyoto-u.ac.jp/research/action-motifs/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督层次化人体运动表示方法，包括捕获原子关节运动的Action Atoms和由其时间组合形成的Action Motifs。提出了A4Mer，一种嵌套潜在Transformer，通过掩码令牌预测从3D姿态序列中学习该表示。还引入了带有完整SMPL注释的多视角人体行为视频数据集AMD，并展示了在动作识别、运动预测和运动插值任务上的有效性。
Motivation: 有效的人体行为建模需要利用人体运动的组合性，现有方法缺乏能够同时捕捉原子运动和可复用语义片段的层次化表示。
Method: 提出A4Mer，一个嵌套的潜在Transformer，将3D姿态序列分割为可变长度片段并编码为潜在令牌（Action Atoms），通过自监督掩码令牌预测在潜在空间中学习底层表示，使时间模式（Action Motifs）自然涌现。
Result: 实验表明A4Mer能提取有意义的Action Motifs，并在动作识别、运动预测和运动插值等任务上显著提升性能。
Conclusion: 该层次化表示为理解人体运动组合性提供了有效框架，A4Mer的自监督学习方式避免了人工标注，且AMD数据集为多视角人体行为研究提供新资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedSynapse-V: Bridging Visual Perception and Clinical Intuition via Latent Memory Evolution
papers.abstract_en: High-precision medical diagnosis relies not only on static imaging features but also on the implicit diagnostic memory experts instantly invoke during image interpretation. We pinpoint a fundamental cognitive misalignment in medical VLMs caused by discrete tokenization, leading to quantization loss, long-range information dissipation, and missing case-adaptive expertise. To bridge this gap, we propose ours, a framework for latent diagnostic memory evolution that simulates the experiential invocation of clinicians by dynamically synthesizing implicit diagnostic memories within the model's hidden stream. Specifically, it begins with a Meta Query for Prior Memorization mechanism, where learnable probes retrieve structured priors from an anatomical prior encoder to generate condensed implicit memories. To ensure clinical fidelity, we introduce Causal Counterfactual Refinement (CCR), which leverages reinforcement learning and counterfactual rewards derived from region-level feature masking to quantify the causal contribution of each memory, thereby pruning redundancies and aligning latent representations with diagnostic logic. This evolutionary process culminates in Intrinsic Memory Transition (IMT), a privileged-autonomous dual-branch paradigm that internalizes teacher-branch diagnostic patterns into the student-branch via full-vocabulary divergence alignment. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that ours, by transferring external expertise into endogenous parameters, significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly chain-of-thought paradigms, in diagnostic accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/zhcz328/MedSynapse-V.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedSynapse-V 框架，通过隐式诊断记忆演化弥合医学视觉语言模型（VLM）中的认知错位问题。该框架包括元查询先验记忆（Meta Query for Prior Memorization）、因果反事实细化（CCR）和内在记忆迁移（IMT）三个模块，在多个数据集上超越现有方法，特别是思维链范式。
Motivation: 现有医学VLM因离散分词导致量化损失、长程信息消散和缺乏病例自适应专家知识，无法模拟临床医生在解读图像时瞬间调用的隐式诊断记忆。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：1) Meta Query for Prior Memorization：通过学习探针从解剖先验编码器检索结构化先验以生成隐式记忆；2) Causal Counterfactual Refinement (CCR)：利用强化学习和基于区域特征掩码的反事实奖励量化每个记忆的因果贡献，修剪冗余；3) Intrinsic Memory Transition (IMT)：通过全词汇发散对齐将教师分支诊断模式内化到学生分支。
Result: 摘要报告在多个医学数据集上优于现有最先进方法，尤其超越链式思维范式，在诊断准确性上显著提升。
Conclusion: 通过将外部专家知识转化为内生参数，隐式记忆演化框架可有效提升医学VLM的诊断准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Defeasible Conditional Obligation in a Two-tiered Preference-based Semantics (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: In response to a concern raised by Horty, this paper develops a two-tiered, preference-based semantic framework for modeling defeasible conditional obligations. The paper extends a Hansson-Lewis style preference semantics for dyadic deontic logic by incorporating a nonmonotonic reasoning mechanism that enables previously derived obligations to be withdrawn when new, potentially conflicting information comes in. The account is bi-preferential: two orderings--ideality and normality--on worlds are employed to address shortcomings in earlier approaches, with a separate ranking method for each. At the nonmonotonic layer, a number of postulates are considered, including antecedent strengthening, inclusion and no-drowning. A connection is established with so-called constrained input/output (I/O) logic--an existing standard for normative reasoning based on a different methodology.
papers.comment: 13 pages. Extended version of a paper presented at KR 2926
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Horty提出的问题，开发了一个双层偏好语义框架来建模可废止条件义务。该框架扩展了Hansson-Lewis风格的偏好语义用于二元道义逻辑，通过融入非单调推理机制，使得当新信息冲突时可撤销先前推导的义务。该理论是双偏好的：使用理想性和常态性两个排序，并为每个排序提供独立的分级方法。在非单调层，考虑了一系列公设，包括前件强化、包含和不被淹没，并与约束输入/输出逻辑建立了联系。
Motivation: 现有道义逻辑在处理义务的动态性和可废止性方面存在不足，特别是当新信息导致先前义务失效时缺乏明确的机制。
Method: 提出一个双层偏好语义：第一层使用理想性排序处理义务，第二层使用常态性排序处理可废止推理；采用非单调推理机制，并检验多个理性公设。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，主要贡献是理论框架的构建以及与约束I/O逻辑的联系建立。
Conclusion: 该框架为可废止条件义务提供了一个一致的理论基础，并可与现有规范推理标准进行桥接。

papers.title: How Can Reinforcement Learning Achieve Expert-level Placement?
papers.abstract_en: Chip placement is a critical step in physical design. While reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods have recently emerged, their training primarily focuses on wirelength optimization, and therefore often fail to achieve expert-quality layouts. We identify the reward design as the primary cause for the performance gap with experts, and instead of formalizing intricate processes, we circumvent this by directly learning from expert layouts to derive a reward model. Our approach starts from the final expert layouts to infer step-by-step expert trajectories. Using these trajectories as demonstrations or preferences, we train a model that captures the latent implicit rewards in expert results. Experiments show that our framework can efficiently learn from even a single design and generalize well to unseen cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对芯片布局中强化学习方法难以达到专家级质量的问题，指出奖励设计是性能差距的主要原因。作者提出通过直接学习专家布局来推导奖励模型，从最终的专家布局推断逐步的专家轨迹，并利用这些轨迹作为示范或偏好来训练模型，从而捕获专家结果中的潜在隐含奖励。实验表明该方法能高效地从单个设计学习并泛化到未见过的案例。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的芯片布局方法主要优化线长，常达不到专家级布局质量。识别出奖励设计是与专家性能差距的主要原因。
Method: 从最终专家布局推断逐步专家轨迹，利用这些轨迹作为示范或偏好训练模型，捕获专家结果中的潜在隐含奖励。
Result: 实验表明框架能高效地从单个设计学习并泛化到未见过的案例。

papers.title: Agentic AI for Remote Sensing: Technical Challenges and Research Directions
papers.abstract_en: Earth Observation (EO) is moving beyond static prediction toward multi-step analytical workflows that require coordinated reasoning over data, tools, and geospatial state. While foundation models and vision-language models have advanced representation learning and language-grounded interaction in remote sensing, and agentic AI has shown strong potential for long-horizon reasoning and tool use, EO is not a straightforward extension of generic agentic AI. EO workflows operate on georeferenced, multi-modal, and temporally structured data, where operations such as reprojection, resampling, compositing, and aggregation transform the underlying state and can constrain later analysis. As a result, errors may propagate silently across steps, and correctness depends not only on internal coherence but also on geospatial consistency, temporally valid comparisons, and physical validity. This position paper argues that these challenges are structural rather than incidental. We examine the assumptions commonly made in generic agentic systems, analyze how they break in geospatial workflows, and characterize failure modes in multi-step EO pipelines. We then outline design principles for EO-native agents centered on structured geospatial state, tool-aware reasoning, verifier-guided execution, and validity-aware learning and evaluation. Building reliable geospatial agents, therefore, requires rethinking agent design around the physical, geospatial, and workflow constraints that govern EO analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，系统分析了将通用智能体AI应用于地球观测（EO）时所面临的独特挑战。作者指出EO工作流涉及地理参考、多模态和时间结构化数据，通用智能体的假设在多步骤处理中会因重投影、重采样、合成和聚合等操作导致错误传播。论文提出了面向EO的智能体设计原则，强调结构化地理空间状态、工具感知推理、验证器引导执行以及有效性感知的学习与评估。
Motivation: 通用智能体AI在自然语言和通用计算机任务中表现优异，但直接迁移到地球观测时会因数据的地理时空特性（如重投影、合成等操作改变底层状态）出现结构性的错误传播和验证困难。目前缺乏针对EO工作流多步骤推理的系统性分析与设计指导。
Method: 通过对比通用智能体假设与EO工作流实际约束，分析典型故障模式，并在此基础上提出面向EO的智能体设计原则：结构化地理空间状态表示、工具感知推理、验证器引导执行以及考虑物理和地理有效性的学习与评估框架。
Result: 论文未提供实验或定量结果，但通过论证指出通用智能体在EO中会产生三类主要故障：地理空间不一致、时间比较无效和物理有效性缺失。
Conclusion: 构建可靠的地理空间智能体需要重新围绕EO分析中的物理、地理和工作流约束来设计，而非简单扩展通用智能体架构。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: FlowPlace: Flow Matching for Chip Placement
papers.abstract_en: Chip placement plays an important role in physical design. While generative models like diffusion models offer promising learning-based solutions, current methods have the following limitations: they use random synthetic data for pre-training, require long sampling times, and often result in overlaps due to their dependence on gradient-based solvers during the sampling process. To overcome these issues, we propose FlowPlace, which features mask-guided synthetic data generation, flow-based efficient training with flexible prior injection, and hard constraint sampling for overlap-free layouts. Experiments on OpenROAD and ICCAD 2015 benchmarks show FlowPlace achieves better PPA metrics, 10-50$\times$ faster sampling efficiency, and zero overlaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowPlace 提出基于流匹配（flow matching）的芯片布局方法，针对现有生成模型（如扩散模型）在芯片布局中预训练数据随机、采样时间长、布局重叠等问题，引入掩码引导的合成数据生成、流模型高效训练（灵活注入先验）以及硬约束采样（hard constraint sampling）以保证无重叠布局。在 OpenROAD 和 ICCAD 2015 基准上，FlowPlace 获得更好的 PPA 指标，采样效率提升 10-50 倍，且零重叠。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的芯片布局方法存在预训练数据随机（依赖随机合成数据）、采样时间长、以及因依赖梯度求解器导致布局重叠等问题，FlowPlace 旨在克服这些局限。
Method: FlowPlace 包含三个关键技术：掩码引导的合成数据生成（mask-guided synthetic data generation）、基于流匹配的高效训练（可灵活注入先验），以及硬约束采样（hard constraint sampling）以直接避免布局重叠。
Result: 在 OpenROAD 和 ICCAD 2015 基准测试上，FlowPlace 实现了更好的 PPA（功耗、性能、面积）指标，采样效率提升 10-50 倍，且生成布局零重叠。
Conclusion: FlowPlace 通过掩码引导合成数据和硬约束采样，有效解决了芯片布局中重叠和低效问题，为基于生成模型的物理设计提供了更实用的方案。

papers.title: Magnetic Indoor Localization through CNN Regression and Rotation Invariance
papers.abstract_en: Indoor positioning is an essential technology for a wide range of applications in GNSS-denied environments, including indoor navigation and IoT systems. Combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and magnetic field-based features offers a low-cost, infrastructure-free solution for precise positioning. While magnetic fingerprints are a promising approach for indoor positioning, models trained on raw 3D magnetometer data are highly sensitive to device orientation. We address this by using two rotation invariant features derived from the 3D magnetic field: the norm (Mn) and the projection onto the gravity axis (Mg). We train a lightweight 7-layer dilated CNN (MagNetS/XL) on magnetic sequences to directly regress (x, y) positions. Using the MagPie dataset (three buildings, handheld trajectories), we systematically evaluate fixed and random rotations of test and/or train data. Raw 3D inputs (Mx, My , Mz) exhibit isotropic error increases under fixed 90° rotations and further degrade with growing random rotations. In contrast, 2D (Mn, Mg) inputs maintain rotation invariant accuracy and surpass the 3D inputs once rotation exceeds building-specific thresholds for three reference buildings: 0° for Loomis (large), 5° for Talbot (medium), and 6° for CSL (small). MagNetXL achieves or exceeds state-of-the-art accuracy on the MagPie dataset, and MagNetS delivers similar performance with roughly one third of the parameters, favoring mobile deployment. These results show that the robustness gained from rotation invariant inputs outweighs the loss of input dimensionality in realistic usage, allowing mapping and localization without orientation alignment or added infrastructure.
papers.comment: Published and presented at the 2026 4th International Conference on Mechatronics, Control and Robotics (ICMCR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于CNN回归和旋转不变性特征的磁室内定位方法。通过使用磁场的范数（Mn）和重力轴投影（Mg）作为旋转不变特征，训练轻量级7层膨胀卷积网络MagNetS/XL直接回归二维位置。在MagPie数据集上的实验表明，旋转不变特征在存在设备旋转时显著优于原始3D磁数据，且MagNetS以约三分之一的参数达到与MagNetXL相当的性能。
Motivation: 传统基于原始3D磁数据的定位模型对设备方向高度敏感，需要额外的方向校准或基础设施支持。
Method: 使用旋转不变特征（磁场范数Mn和重力轴投影Mg）替代原始3D磁场分量，训练轻量级7层膨胀卷积网络MagNetS/XL进行(x,y)坐标回归。
Result: 在MagPie数据集三个建筑物上，2D旋转不变特征在旋转超过一定阈值后精度超过3D输入；MagNetXL达到或超越现有最佳精度，MagNetS以约三分之一参数实现相似性能。
Conclusion: 旋转不变特征带来的鲁棒性足以弥补输入维度降低的损失，可实现无需方向对齐或额外基础设施的室内定位。

papers.title: BEAT: Tokenizing and Generating Symbolic Music by Uniform Temporal Steps
papers.abstract_en: Tokenizing music to fit the general framework of language models is a compelling challenge, especially considering the diverse symbolic structures in which music can be represented (e.g., sequences, grids, and graphs). To date, most approaches tokenize symbolic music as sequences of musical events, such as onsets, pitches, time shifts, or compound note events. This strategy is intuitive and has proven effective in Transformer-based models, but it treats the regularity of musical time implicitly: individual tokens may span different durations, resulting in non-uniform time progression. In this paper, we instead consider whether an alternative tokenization is possible, where a uniform-length musical step (e.g., a beat) serves as the basic unit. Specifically, we encode all events within a single time step at the same pitch as one token, and group tokens explicitly by time step, which resembles a sparse encoding of a piano-roll representation. We evaluate the proposed tokenization on music continuation and accompaniment generation tasks, comparing it with mainstream event-based methods. Results show improved musical quality and structural coherence, while additional analyses confirm higher efficiency and more effective capture of long-range patterns with the proposed tokenization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的符号音乐分词方法 BEAT，以均匀时间步（beat）为基本单元，将同一时间步内相同音高的所有事件编码为一个 token，并按时间步显式分组，形成类似钢琴卷帘的稀疏编码。相比主流的事件序列分词，在音乐续写和伴奏生成任务上提升了音乐质量和结构连贯性，且更高效地捕获长程模式。
Motivation: 现有基于事件的符号音乐分词方法隐式处理音乐时间规律性，token 可能跨越不同时长，导致非均匀的时间推进，限制了模型对节奏和长程结构的建模能力。本文探索是否可以采用均匀时间步长作为基本单位来克服这一局限。
Method: 提出 BEAT 分词：以固定节拍时长为步长，将同一时间步内相同音高的所有音符编码为一个 token，不同时间步的 token 显式分组，类似于钢琴卷帘的稀疏编码表示。
Result: 在音乐续写和伴奏生成任务上，与主流事件基方法相比，BEAT 分词提升了音乐质量和结构连贯性，同时效率更高，并能更有效地捕获长程模式。
Conclusion: 均匀时间步的分词方法有望改善符号音乐生成中对节奏规律性和结构一致性的建模，尤其适合需要长期依赖的任务。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在音乐续写和伴奏生成任务上，与主流事件基方法相比，BEAT 分词提升了音乐质量和结构连贯性，同时效率更高，并能更有效地捕获长程模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 均匀时间步的分词方法有望改善符号音乐生成中对节奏规律性和结构一致性的建模，尤其适合需要长期依赖的任务。

papers.title: KnowledgeBerg: Evaluating Systematic Knowledge Coverage and Compositional Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world questions appear deceptively simple yet implicitly demand two capabilities: (i) systematic coverage of a bounded knowledge universe and (ii) compositional set-based reasoning over that universe, a phenomenon we term "the tip of the iceberg." We formalize this challenge through two orthogonal dimensions: knowledge width, the cardinality of the required universe, and reasoning depth, the number of compositional set operations. We introduce KnowledgeBerg, a benchmark of 4,800 multiple-choice questions derived from 1,183 enumeration seeds spanning 10 domains and 17 languages, with universes grounded in authoritative sources to ensure reproducibility. Representative open-source LLMs demonstrate severe limitations, achieving only 5.26-36.88 F1 on universe enumeration and 16.00-44.19 accuracy on knowledge-grounded reasoning. Diagnostic analyses reveal three stages of failure: completeness, or missing knowledge; awareness, or failure to identify requirements; and application, or incorrect reasoning execution. This pattern persists across languages and model scales. Although test-time compute and retrieval augmentation yield measurable gains -- up to 4.35 and 3.78 points, respectively -- substantial gaps remain, exposing limitations in how current LLMs organize structured knowledge and execute compositional reasoning over bounded domains. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2npc/KnowledgeBerg
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出许多看似简单的问题实际上需要系统知识覆盖和组合推理能力，称为“冰山一角”效应。为此构建了KnowledgeBerg基准，包含4800道选择题，涵盖10个领域和17种语言。评估表明当前开源LLM表现严重不足，F1仅为5.26-36.88，准确率16.00-44.19。诊断发现三个失败阶段：完整性缺失、需求识别失败和推理执行错误。尽管测试时计算和检索增强可带来一定提升（分别达4.35和3.78个百分点），但仍存在显著差距。
Motivation: “冰山一角”现象：实际问题和评估中的问题在表面简单下隐含了系统知识覆盖和组合推理的双重需求，现有基准未能充分分离这两个维度。
Method: 提出KnowledgeBerg基准，从1183个枚举种子生成4800道选择题，覆盖10个领域、17种语言，知识来源基于权威资料以确保可重复性。从知识宽度（所需宇宙的基数）和推理深度（组合集合运算的步数）两个正交维度进行形式化。
Result: 代表性开源LLM在宇宙枚举任务上F1仅为5.26-36.88，在知识驱动推理任务上准确率仅为16.00-44.19。诊断显示三个失败阶段：完整性缺失、识别不足和应用错误。测试时计算和检索增强分别带来最多4.35和3.78个百分点的提升。
Conclusion: 当前LLM在结构化知识组织和有界领域上的组合推理存在根本性局限，即使结合额外计算和检索增强，差距仍然显著。数据集公开。

papers.title: TrafficClaw: A Generalizable LLM Agent in the Unified Physical Environment for Urban Traffic Control
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong capabilities in long-horizon reasoning, tool use, and decision-making in digital environments, yet extending them to physically grounded systems remains challenging. Unlike web, code, or game environments, where objectives are often weakly coupled, physical systems evolve through tightly coupled dynamics in which local interventions propagate across interacting subsystems over time. Urban traffic control exemplifies this challenge, as traffic signals, freeways, public transit, and taxi systems continuously interact through shared spatial infrastructure and temporal mobility demand. Existing optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), and LLM-based approaches are largely designed for isolated subsystems, limiting coordinated reasoning and system-level optimization. We propose TrafficClaw, a LLM-based generalizable traffic control agent for physical urban systems. TrafficClaw operates within a unified traffic environment that exposes coupled urban dynamics and feedback, performs executable spatiotemporal reasoning with persistent memory for long-horizon adaptation, and leverages multi-stage agentic RL for coordinated system-level optimization. Experiments across three metropolitan regions and six traffic-control tasks demonstrate strong generalization, robustness, and cross-subsystem coordination. Our project is available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/TrafficClaw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TrafficClaw，一种基于大语言模型的通用交通控制智能体，运行在统一交通环境中，暴露耦合的城市动态和反馈，使用持久记忆进行可执行的时空推理，并利用多阶段智能体强化学习进行系统级优化。摘要声称在三个大都市区域的六个交通控制任务上展示了强泛化、鲁棒性和跨子系统协调能力。
Motivation: 现有优化、强化学习和基于LLM的方法大多针对孤立子系统，缺乏协调推理和系统级优化，而城市交通中各子系统（信号、高速公路、公交、出租车）通过共享空间和出行需求紧密耦合。
Method: TrafficClaw包含三个关键部分：统一交通环境（暴露耦合动态和反馈）、可执行时空推理（带持久记忆的长时适应）和多阶段智能体强化学习（用于协调系统级优化）。
Result: 在三个大都市区域、六个交通控制任务上，该方法展示了强泛化、鲁棒性和跨子系统协调能力。
Conclusion: TrafficClaw作为基于LLM的通用智能体，能够处理物理城市系统的紧密耦合动态，实现跨子系统的协调控制。

papers.title: RadAgent: A tool-using AI agent for stepwise interpretation of chest computed tomography
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLM) have markedly advanced AI-driven interpretation and reporting of complex medical imaging, such as computed tomography (CT). Yet, existing methods largely relegate clinicians to passive observers of final outputs, offering no interpretable reasoning trace for them to inspect, validate, or refine. To address this, we introduce RadAgent, a tool-using AI agent that generates CT reports through a stepwise and interpretable process. Each resulting report is accompanied by a fully inspectable trace of intermediate decisions and tool interactions, allowing clinicians to examine how the reported findings are derived. In our experiments, we observe that RadAgent improves chest CT report generation over its 3D VLM counterpart, CT-Chat, across three dimensions. Clinical accuracy improves by 5.8 points (35.4% relative) in macro-F1 and 5.1 points (18.6% relative) in micro-F1. Robustness under adversarial conditions improves by 24.7 points (41.9% relative). Furthermore, RadAgent achieves 37.0% in faithfulness, a new capability entirely absent in its 3D VLM counterpart. By structuring the interpretation of chest CT as an explicit, tool-augmented and iterative reasoning trace, RadAgent brings us closer toward transparent and reliable AI for radiology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RadAgent，一种基于工具使用的 AI 智能体，通过逐步、可解释的推理过程生成胸部CT报告。实验表明，相比基线模型 CT-Chat，它在临床准确性（macro-F1提高5.8分）、鲁棒性和忠实性方面均有提升。
Motivation: 现有方法将临床医生视为被动观察者，无法检查或验证推理过程，缺乏可解释性。
Method: 引入 RadAgent，一个使用工具的 AI 智能体，生成CT报告时包含完全可检查的中间决策和工具交互痕迹。
Result: 在胸部CT报告生成任务上，RadAgent 相比 CT-Chat，临床准确性 macro-F1 提高5.8分（相对35.4%），micro-F1 提高5.1分（相对18.6%）；对抗条件下鲁棒性提高24.7分（相对41.9%）；忠实性达到37.0%，这是基线模型完全没有的能力。
Conclusion: 通过将胸部CT解释结构化为显式、工具增强的迭代推理轨迹，RadAgent 推动放射学 AI 向透明和可靠方向发展。

papers.title: Multimodal Large Language Model-Enabled Video Translation: A Role-Oriented Survey
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is reshaping video translation from a cascaded pipeline of automatic speech recognition, machine translation, text-to-speech, and lip synchronization into a unified multimodal reasoning and generation problem. High-quality video translation requires not only semantic fidelity, but also temporal alignment, speaker consistency, and emotional expressiveness across visual, acoustic, and linguistic streams. This survey provides a focused review of MLLM-enabled video translation through a role-oriented taxonomy. We organize MLLM-enabled and MLLM-relevant studies into three functional roles: Semantic Reasoner, which grounds translation in video understanding, temporal reasoning, and multimodal fusion; Expressive Performer, which supports controllable and context-aware speech generation; and Visual Synthesizer, which enables lip synchronization and visually coherent speaker rendering. We further summarize representative datasets, benchmarks, and metrics for each role, and discuss how current evaluation protocols fall short of end-to-end video translation requirements. Finally, we identify open challenges in long-form video understanding, temporal modeling, multimodal alignment, multilingual robustness, and responsible deployment, outlining future directions for natural and trustworthy cross-lingual video communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过角色导向的分类法综述了多模态大模型（MLLMs）在视频翻译中的应用。将相关研究分为三个功能角色：语义推理器（Semantic Reasoner）、表达表演者（Expressive Performer）和视觉合成器（Visual Synthesizer），并讨论了数据集、基准、评估协议以及开放挑战。
Motivation: 现有视频翻译采用级联管道（ASR、MT、TTS、唇同步），而MLLMs有望将其统一为多模态推理和生成问题。高质量视频翻译需要跨视觉、听觉和语言流的语义保真度、时间对齐、说话人一致性和情感表达。
Method: 提出角色导向的分类法，将MLLM支持的视频翻译研究组织为三个功能角色：语义推理器（基于视频理解、时间推理和多模态融合进行翻译）、表达表演者（支持可控和上下文感知的语音生成）、视觉合成器（实现唇同步和视觉连贯的说话人渲染）。
Result: 总结了每个角色的代表性数据集、基准和指标，并指出现有评估协议不足以满足端到端视频翻译的要求。
Conclusion: 指出了长视频理解、时间建模、多模态对齐、多语言鲁棒性和负责任部署等方面的开放挑战，展望了自然可信的跨语言视频通信的未来方向。

papers.title: Process Reward Agents for Steering Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning in knowledge-intensive domains remains challenging as intermediate steps are often not locally verifiable: unlike math or code, evaluating step correctness may require synthesizing clues across large external knowledge sources. As a result, subtle errors can propagate through reasoning traces, potentially never to be detected. Prior work has proposed process reward models (PRMs), including retrieval-augmented variants, but these methods operate post hoc, scoring completed trajectories, which prevents their integration into dynamic inference procedures. Here, we introduce Process Reward Agents (PRA), an inference-time method for providing domain-grounded, online, step-wise rewards to a frozen policy. In contrast to prior retrieval-augmented PRMs, PRA enables search-based decoding to rank and prune candidate trajectories at every generation step. Experiments on multiple medical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PRA consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving 81.9% accuracy on MedQA with Qwen3-4B, a new state of the art at the 4B scale. Importantly, PRA generalizes to unseen frozen policy models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters, improving their accuracy by up to 25.7% without any policy model updates. More broadly, PRA suggests a paradigm in which frozen reasoners are decoupled from domain-specific reward modules, allowing the deployment of new backbones in complex domains without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出过程奖励智能体（PRA），一种推理时方法，为冻结策略模型提供基于领域知识的在线逐步骤奖励，支持搜索式解码以在每一步排序和剪枝候选轨迹。在多个医学推理基准上，PRA 在 MedQA 上使用 Qwen3-4B 达到 81.9% 准确率，创下 4B 规模的新纪录，并泛化到 0.5B 至 8B 的未见模型，无需更新策略模型。
Motivation: 知识密集型领域的推理中间步骤难以本地验证，错误可能传播整个推理链。现有方法如过程奖励模型（PRM）仅事后评分完整轨迹，无法融入动态推理过程。
Method: 引入过程奖励智能体（PRA），在推理时为冻结策略模型提供在线、逐步骤的领域接地奖励，结合搜索式解码在每个生成步骤对候选轨迹进行排序和剪枝。
Result: 在医学推理基准上优于强基线，MedQA 上 Qwen3-4B 达到 81.9% 准确率（4B 规模新 SOTA），并将 0.5B-8B 未见模型准确率提升最多 25.7%。
Conclusion: PRA 将冻结推理器与领域特定奖励模块解耦，允许在不重新训练策略模型的情况下在复杂领域部署新骨干网络。

papers.title: A Direct Approach for Handling Contextual Bandits with Latent State Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We consider a linear contextual bandit model where contexts and rewards are governed by a finite hidden Markov chain. We first revisit the simplified model by Nelson et al. (2022), in which rewards are linear functions of the posterior probabilities over the hidden states given the observed contexts (called beliefs), rather than functions of the hidden states themselves. This simplified model may be handled through a direct reduction to standard linear contextual bandits. We extend the theoretical analysis of this reduction to take into account the estimation of the parameters of the hidden Markov model [HMM] in the regret bound and to provide high-probability bounds not depending anymore on the reward functions and only depending on the model through the estimation of the HMM parameters. Second, and most importantly, we instead study the more natural and more complex model incorporating direct dependencies in the hidden states (on top of dependencies on the observed contexts, as is natural for contextual bandits). Under a classic HMM forgetting condition, the main algorithmic tool introduced to cope with the various statistical dependencies that the reward structure introduces is to only periodically update reward-model parameters.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究线性上下文赌博机模型，其中上下文和奖励由有限隐马尔可夫链控制。首先重新审视了将奖励视为隐状态后验概率线性函数的简化模型，并将其归约为标准线性上下文赌博机，扩展了理论分析以包含HMM参数估计的后悔界和高概率界。其次研究了更复杂的模型，其中奖励直接依赖隐状态，并在遗忘条件下提出周期性更新奖励模型参数的算法。
Motivation: 上下文赌博机中隐状态动态导致奖励结构依赖，现有简化模型未考虑参数估计影响，而更自然的直接依赖隐状态的模型缺乏理论处理。
Method: 将简化模型通过归约到标准线性上下文赌博机处理，并扩展理论分析以纳入HMM参数估计；对直接依赖隐状态的模型，在HMM遗忘条件下采用周期性更新奖励模型参数的算法。
Result: 扩展后的理论分析给出了考虑HMM参数估计的后悔界和高概率界，且界不再依赖奖励函数本身，仅通过模型依赖参数估计。
Conclusion: 在HMM遗忘条件下，周期性更新参数可有效处理隐状态依赖的上下文赌博机问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Theoretical Framework for Statistical Evaluability of Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Statistical evaluation aims to estimate the generalization performance of a model using held-out i.i.d. test data sampled from the ground-truth distribution. In supervised learning settings such as classification, performance metrics such as error rate are well-defined, and test error reliably approximates population error given sufficiently large datasets. In contrast, evaluation is more challenging for generative models due to their open-ended nature: it is unclear which metrics are appropriate and whether such metrics can be reliably evaluated from finite samples. In this work, we introduce a theoretical framework for evaluating generative models and establish evaluability results for commonly used metrics. We study two categories of metrics: test-based metrics, including integral probability metrics (IPMs), and Rényi divergences. We show that IPMs with respect to any bounded test class can be evaluated from finite samples up to multiplicative and additive approximation errors. Moreover, when the test class has finite fat-shattering dimension, IPMs can be evaluated with arbitrary precision. In contrast, Rényi and KL divergences are not evaluable from finite samples, as their values can be critically determined by rare events. We also analyze the potential and limitations of perplexity as an evaluation method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估生成模型的理论框架，研究常用度量的统计可评估性。证明了对有界测试类的积分概率度量（IPM）可以从有限样本中以乘性和加性近似误差进行估计，当测试类具有有限fat-shattering维数时可达任意精度。相反，Rényi散度和KL散度无法从有限样本中评估，因其值可能由罕见事件决定。还分析了困惑度（perplexity）作为评估方法的潜力与局限。
Motivation: 生成模型的评估比有监督学习更具挑战性，因其开放性质导致合适度量不明确，且从有限样本评估这些度量的可行性未知。
Method: 将生成模型评估度量分为基于测试的度量（如IPM）和基于散度的度量（Rényi散度、KL散度），通过理论分析给出可评估的充分条件和有限样本误差界限。
Result: IPM对于有界测试类可从有限样本中估计，若测试类具有有限fat-shattering维数则可任意精度评估；Rényi散度和KL散度不可评估；困惑度具有一定评估能力但有限。
Conclusion: 强调不同度量的可评估性差异，指出IPM的实用价值和散度度量的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FeynmanBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs on Diagrammatic Physics Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Current multimodal benchmarks for scientific reasoning primarily evaluate local information extraction -- models recognize symbols and values and then perform textual inference. They do not assess whether models can reason over the global structural properties of formal diagrams, such as topology, conservation constraints, and the consistent mapping between visual patterns and algebraic expressions. We introduce FeynmanBench, a benchmark of over 2,000 tasks centered on Feynman diagrams spanning the electromagnetic, weak, and strong interactions of the Standard Model. Each instance couples a diagram image with minimal textual conventions and requires models to recover the full physical content -- vertex inventory, propagator types, topological connectivity, momentum routing, and the complete scattering amplitude. An automated generation and verification pipeline produces the diagrams, annotations, and reference answers under standardized rules. Evaluating 19 state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs, we find a consistent failure pattern: models achieve 70--95\% on local recognition (vertex and propagator identification) but collapse to 13--17\% on topological reconstruction (CP3), and near zero on full algebraic derivation (CP5). FeynmanBench offers a controlled testbed for multimodal reasoning over formal scientific diagrams and highlights fundamental limitations of current architectures in topology-sensitive scientific reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出FeynmanBench，一个包含2000多个费曼图任务的基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型在标准模型电磁、弱、强相互作用图上的物理推理能力。自动生成和验证管道确保标准化。评估19个模型发现：局部识别（顶点、传播子）准确率达70-95%，但拓扑重建（CP3）仅13-17%，完整代数推导（CP5）接近零。
Motivation: 现有科学推理多模态基准主要评估局部信息提取（符号、数值）和文本推理，无法检验模型对形式化图表全局结构属性（拓扑、守恒约束、视觉模式与代数表达式的一致映射）的推理能力。
Method: 构建FeynmanBench，包含2000多个费曼图任务，每个实例耦合图表图像与最小文本约定，要求模型恢复完整物理内容（顶点清单、传播子类型、拓扑连接、动量路由、散射振幅）。采用自动生成与验证流程产生图表、注释和参考答案。
Result: 对19个SOTA多模态LLM评估显示：局部识别（顶点和传播子）准确率70-95%，但拓扑重建（CP3）仅13-17%，完整代数推导（CP5）几乎为零。
Conclusion: FeynmanBench为多模态形式化科学图表推理提供了受控测试床，揭示了当前架构在拓扑敏感科学推理中的根本局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CalM: A Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Population Dynamics in Calcium Imaging Data
papers.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that large-scale, multi-animal modeling can significantly improve neural recording analysis. However, for functional calcium traces, existing approaches remain task-specific, limiting transfer across common neuroscience objectives. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{CalM}, a self-supervised neural foundation model trained solely on neuronal calcium traces and adaptable to multiple downstream tasks, including forecasting and decoding. Our key contribution is a pretraining framework, composed of a high-performance tokenizer mapping single-neuron traces into a shared discrete vocabulary, and a dual-axis autoregressive transformer modeling dependencies along both the neural and the temporal axis. We evaluate CalM on a large-scale, multi-animal, multi-session dataset. On the neural population dynamics forecasting task, CalM achieves competitive performance against strong specialized baselines after pretraining. With a task-specific head, CalM further adapts to the behavior decoding task and achieves superior results compared with supervised decoding models. Moreover, linear analyses of CalM representations reveal interpretable functional structures beyond predictive accuracy. Taken together, we propose a novel and effective self-supervised pretraining paradigm for foundation models based on calcium traces, paving the way for scalable pretraining and broad applications in functional neural analysis. Code is released at https://github.com/TSuXinH/CalM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CalM，一种自监督神经基础模型，仅基于钙成像数据训练，可适用于预测和解码等下游任务。核心是一个高性能分词器将单神经元轨迹映射到共享离散词汇，以及一个双轴自回归Transformer建模神经元和时间轴依赖。在大规模多动物多session数据集上，CalM在神经群体动态预测任务上达到与专用基线相当的性能，在行为解码任务上超越监督模型，且线性分析揭示可解释的功能结构。
Motivation: 现有钙成像数据分析方法多为任务特定，缺乏跨任务迁移能力，限制了大规模多动物建模的优势。
Method: 提出CalM，包含一个高性能分词器将单神经元轨迹离散化，以及一个双轴自回归Transformer沿神经元和时间两轴建模依赖关系。
Result: 在神经群体动态预测任务上，CalM与强专用基线性能相当；在行为解码任务上，加上任务特定头后超越监督解码模型；线性分析显示表征具有可解释的功能结构。
Conclusion: CalM提供了一种有效的自监督预训练范式，为钙成像数据的基础模型规模化预训练和广泛应用铺平道路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Acoustic and perceptual differences between standard and accented speech and their voice clones
papers.abstract_en: Voice cloning is often evaluated in terms of overall quality, but less is known about accent preservation and its perceptual consequences. We compare standard and heavily accented Mandarin speech and their voice clones using a combined computational and perceptual design. Embedding-based analyses showed larger original-clone distances for accented speakers in several speaker-discriminative embedding spaces, but this difference disappeared after normalizing against each speaker's within-original baseline variability. In the perception study, clones are rated as more similar to their originals for standard than for accented speakers, and intelligibility increases from original to clone, with a larger gain for accented speech. These results show that accent variation can shape perceived identity match and intelligibility in voice cloning even when it is not reflected in baseline-normalized speaker-embedding distance, and they motivate treating accent preservation as an explicit component of speaker identity preservation, rather than assuming that it is fully captured by off-the-shelf speaker-discriminative embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了标准普通话和带浓厚口音的普通话及其语音克隆在声学和感知上的差异。嵌入分析显示口音说话人的原始-克隆距离更大，但归一化后差异消失；感知实验中克隆相似度评分标准口音更高，且克隆可懂度高于原始，口音语音增益更大。结论认为口音变化影响身份匹配和可懂度，应作为身份保留的显式成分。
Motivation: 现有语音克隆评估侧重于整体质量，较少关注口音保留及其感知后果，需要系统分析口音差异对克隆相似度和可懂度的影响。
Method: 采用计算与感知结合的设计：利用多种说话人判别性嵌入空间分析原始-克隆距离，并进行感知实验让听者评价相似度和可懂度。
Result: 嵌入距离未归一化时口音说话人差异更大，归一化后消失；感知上标准口音克隆相似度更高，但口音语音克隆的可懂度提升更大。
Conclusion: 研究结果表明口音变化可影响身份匹配和可懂度，即使归一化嵌入距离不反映该差异，因此需将口音保留作为身份保留的显式组成部分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Cosine Similarity of Label Representations Can and Cannot Tell us
papers.abstract_en: Cosine similarity is often used to measure the similarity of vector representations of neural network models. However, the cosine similarity of representations is not guaranteed to tell us anything about model probabilities. In this paper we show that for a softmax classifier, be it an image classifier or an autoregressive language model, the cosine similarity between label representations (called unembeddings in the paper) does not give any information on the probabilities assigned by the model. Specifically, we prove that given two unembeddings, it is possible to create another model which assigns the same probabilities for all inputs, but where the cosine similarity between the representations is now either 1 or -1. We also show that for a sigmoid classifier (where each input can be assigned multiple labels), all pairwise cosine similarities between the unembeddings define the set of possible label combinations. However, for softmax classifiers (where each input is assigned a ranking of the labels from most to least likely), we need all pairwise cosine similarities between all differences of unembeddings to know which rankings the model can predict. We conclude that it is misleading to interpret the cosine similarity between unembeddings without reference to the classifier that produced them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文理论证明了对于 softmax 分类器（包括图像分类器和自回归语言模型），标签表示（unembeddings）之间的余弦相似度无法提供任何关于模型概率的信息；对于 sigmoid 分类器，余弦相似度可以定义可能的标签组合集，但 softmax 分类器需要所有 unembedding 差值的余弦相似度才能确定可能的标签排序。
Motivation: 余弦相似度常被用于衡量神经网络模型向量表示的相似性，但未必能反映模型概率，本文旨在澄清其实际含义并指出常见误解。
Method: 通过理论证明和构造反例，展示对于 softmax 分类器，可以改变 unembeddings 使余弦相似度变为 ±1 而模型概率不变；对于 sigmoid 分类器分析其与标签组合的关系。
Result: 证明 softmax 分类器中 unembeddings 的余弦相似度与模型概率无关；sigmoid 分类器中所有成对余弦相似度定义可能的标签组合，但 softmax 需要所有成对差值余弦相似度。
Conclusion: 在没有参考产生这些表示的分类器的情况下，直接解释 unembeddings 之间的余弦相似度会误导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EuraGovExam: A Multilingual Multimodal Benchmark from Real-World Civil Service Exams
papers.abstract_en: We present EuraGovExam, a multilingual and multimodal benchmark sourced from real-world civil service examinations across five representative Eurasian regions: South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, India, and the European Union. Designed to reflect the authentic complexity of public-sector assessments, the dataset contains over 8,000 high-resolution scanned multiple-choice questions covering 17 diverse academic and administrative domains. Unlike existing benchmarks, EuraGovExam embeds all question content--including problem statements, answer choices, and visual elements--within a single image, providing only a minimal standardized instruction for answer formatting. This design demands that models perform layout-aware, cross-lingual reasoning directly from visual input. All items are drawn from real exam documents, preserving rich visual structures such as tables, multilingual typography, and form-like layouts. Evaluation results show that even state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs) achieve only 86% accuracy, underscoring the benchmark's difficulty and its power to diagnose the limitations of current models. By emphasizing cultural realism, visual complexity, and linguistic diversity, EuraGovExam establishes a new standard for evaluating VLMs in high-stakes, multilingual, image-grounded settings. It also supports practical applications in e-governance, public-sector document analysis, and equitable exam preparation.

papers.title: λSplit: Self-Supervised Content-Aware Spectral Unmixing for Fluorescence Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: In fluorescence microscopy, spectral unmixing aims to recover individual fluorophore concentrations from spectral images that capture mixed fluorophore emissions. Since classical methods operate pixel-wise and rely on least-squares fitting, their performance degrades with increasingly overlapping emission spectra and higher levels of noise, suggesting that a data-driven approach that can learn and utilize a structural prior might lead to improved results. Learning-based approaches for spectral imaging do exist, but they are either not optimized for microscopy data or are developed for very specific cases that are not applicable to fluorescence microscopy settings. To address this, we propose λSplit, a physics-informed deep generative model that learns a conditional distribution over concentration maps using a hierarchical Variational Autoencoder. A fully differentiable Spectral Mixer enforces consistency with the image formation process, while the learned structural priors enable state-of-the-art unmixing and implicit noise removal. We demonstrate λSplit on 3 real-world datasets that we synthetically cast into a total of 66 challenging spectral unmixing benchmarks. We compare our results against a total of 10 baseline methods, including classical methods and a range of learning-based methods. Our results consistently show competitive performance and improved robustness in high noise regimes, when spectra overlap considerably, or when the spectral dimensionality is lowered, making λSplit a new state-of-the-art for spectral unmixing of fluorescent microscopy data. Importantly, λSplit is compatible with spectral data produced by standard confocal microscopes, enabling immediate adoption without specialized hardware modifications.

papers.title: Failure of contextual invariance in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Standard evaluation practices assume that large language model (LLM) outputs are stable when prompts are embedded in contextually equivalent discourses. Here, we test this assumption in the setting of gender inference. Using a controlled pronoun selection task, we introduce minimal, theoretically uninformative discourse context and find that this induces large, systematic shifts in model outputs. Correlations with cultural gender stereotypes, present in decontextualized settings, weaken or disappear once context is introduced, while theoretically irrelevant features, such as the gender of a pronoun for an unrelated referent, become the most informative predictors of model behavior. A Contextuality-by-Default analysis reveals that, in 19--52\% of cases across models, this dependence persists after accounting for all marginal effects of context on individual outputs and cannot be attributed to simple pronoun repetition. These findings show that LLM outputs violate contextual invariance even under near-identical syntactic formulations, with implications for bias benchmarking and deployment in high-stakes settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控代词选择任务发现，在大语言模型 (LLM) 的性别推断中，即使引入最短且理论上无信息的语篇上下文，也会导致模型输出出现大幅系统性偏移。与文化性别刻板印象的相关性在去上下文化设置中存在，但引入上下文后减弱或消失，而理论上无关的特征（如无关指代者的代词性别）成为最具预测性的因素。Contextuality-by-Default 分析表明，19-52% 的案例中这种依赖无法归因于简单的代词重复，表明 LLM 输出违背了上下文不变性。
Motivation: 标准评估假设 LLM 输出在上下文等价的提示下保持稳定，但该假设未经验证。本文旨在测试这一假设在性别推断任务中的有效性。
Method: 采用受控代词选择任务，为提示嵌入最小且理论上无信息的语篇上下文，并通过 Contextuality-by-Default 分析评估输出对上下文的依赖是否超出边际效应。
Result: 引入最小上下文导致模型输出发生大而系统的偏移；文化性别刻板印象的相关性减弱或消失，而无关特征成为最显著的预测因子；19-52% 的案例中依赖无法由代词重复解释。
Conclusion: LLM 输出即使在近乎相同的句法结构下也违反上下文不变性，这对偏差基准测试和高风险部署场景具有启示意义。

papers.title: LagerNVS: Latent Geometry for Fully Neural Real-time Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that neural networks can perform 3D tasks such as Novel View Synthesis (NVS) without explicit 3D reconstruction. Even so, we argue that strong 3D inductive biases are still helpful in the design of such networks. We show this point by introducing LagerNVS, an encoder-decoder neural network for NVS that builds on `3D-aware' latent features. The encoder is initialized from a 3D reconstruction network pre-trained using explicit 3D supervision. This is paired with a lightweight decoder, and trained end-to-end with photometric losses. LagerNVS achieves state-of-the-art deterministic feed-forward Novel View Synthesis (including 31.4 PSNR on Re10k), with and without known cameras, renders in real time, generalizes to in-the-wild data, and can be paired with a diffusion decoder for generative extrapolation.
papers.comment: IEEE CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026. Project page with code, models and examples: szymanowiczs.github.io/lagernvs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LagerNVS 是一种全神经实时新视图合成方法，它利用从3D重建网络预初始化的编码器和轻量解码器，通过端到端光度损失训练，在Re10k上达到31.4 PSNR，支持已知/未知相机、实时渲染，并可与扩散解码器结合用于生成外推。
Motivation: 近期工作表明神经网络无需显式3D重建即可完成NVS，但本文认为强3D归纳偏置仍对网络设计有益。
Method: 提出编码器-解码器网络，编码器从预训练的3D重建网络初始化，解码器轻量，整体以光度损失端到端训练。
Result: 在Re10k上达到31.4 PSNR，实现实时渲染，泛化到野外数据，并支持生成外推。
Conclusion: 强3D归纳偏置结合端到端训练可提升NVS性能，且方法在实时性、泛化性上表现优越。

papers.title: Beyond String Matching: Semantic Evaluation of PDF Table Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Reliably extracting tables from PDFs is essential for large-scale scientific data mining and knowledge base construction, yet existing evaluation approaches rely on rule-based metrics that fail to capture semantic equivalence of table content. We present a benchmarking framework based on synthetically generated PDFs with precise LaTeX ground truth, using tables sourced from arXiv to ensure realistic complexity and diversity. As our central methodological contribution, we apply LLM-as-a-judge for semantic table evaluation, integrated into a matching pipeline that accommodates inconsistencies in parser outputs. Through a human validation study comprising over 1,500 quality judgments on extracted table pairs, we show that LLM-based evaluation achieves substantially higher correlation with human judgment (Pearson r=0.93) compared to currently used Tree Edit Distance-based Similarity (TEDS, r=0.68) and Grid Table Similarity (GriTS, r=0.70). Evaluating 21 contemporary PDF parsers across 100 synthetic documents containing 451 tables reveals significant performance disparities. Our results offer practical guidance for selecting parsers for tabular data extraction and establish a reproducible, scalable evaluation methodology for this critical task. Code and data: https://github.com/phorn1/pdf-parse-bench Metric study and human evaluation: https://github.com/phorn1/table-metric-study
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对PDF表格提取的评估问题，提出基于LLM的语义评估方法，并与人类判断进行对比验证。方法包括合成PDF生成、LLM-as-a-judge评估、与TEDS和GriTS的对比。结果：LLM评估与人类判断的Pearson相关系数r=0.93，高于TEDS (0.68)和GriTS (0.70)。在21个解析器上评估显示性能差异，提供了可复现的基准。
Motivation: 现有PDF表格提取评估依赖于基于规则的指标，未能捕捉表格内容的语义等价性。
Method: 提出基于合成PDF的基准框架，使用arXiv表格确保复杂性，核心方法是LLM-as-a-judge进行语义评估，并与人类判断对比。
Result: LLM评估与人类判断的Pearson相关系数r=0.93，显著高于TEDS (0.68)和GriTS (0.70)。评估了21个PDF解析器。
Conclusion: 该方法建立了可复现、可扩展的表格提取评估方法，为选择解析器提供了实用指导。

papers.title: To See or To Please: Uncovering Visual Sycophancy and Split Beliefs in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: When VLMs answer correctly, do they genuinely rely on visual information? We introduce a Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework with three per-sample metrics: Latent Anomaly Detection, Visual Necessity Score, and Competition Score, which disentangle perception, dependency, and alignment failures. Across 9 VLMs and 9,000 model-sample pairs under counterfactual blind, noise, and conflict interventions, 72.9% of samples exhibit Visual Sycophancy, a Split Beliefs pattern in which internal evidence is preserved yet a hallucinated answer is decoded, while zero samples show Robust Refusal, indicating that current alignment training has eliminated refusal as a decoding outcome. Scaling within the Qwen-VL family, both within- and across-generation, monotonically reduces Language Shortcuts but amplifies Visual Sycophancy, showing that scale and newer post-training alone cannot resolve the grounding problem. Diagnostic scores further enable a training-free selective-prediction strategy yielding up to +9.5 percentage points accuracy at 50% coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三层诊断框架（Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework），通过潜异常检测、视觉必要性分数和竞争分数三个指标，分析视觉语言模型（VLM）在回答时是否真正依赖视觉信息。在9个VLM和9000个样本上，发现72.9%的样本表现出视觉谄媚（Visual Sycophancy）——内部证据正确但解码出幻觉答案，而零样本表现出鲁棒拒绝（Robust Refusal）。扩展Qwen-VL家族模型时，语言捷径减少但视觉谄媚增加，表明规模和训练后处理不能解决基础问题。诊断分数还可用于无训练的选择性预测策略，在50%覆盖率下准确率提升最多9.5个百分点。
Motivation: 现有VLM在回答正确时，难以判断模型是否真正依赖视觉信息还是仅使用语言捷径。作者旨在通过细粒度诊断揭示视觉谄媚和分裂信念现象。
Method: 提出三层诊断框架，包含三个每样本指标：潜异常检测（Latent Anomaly Detection）、视觉必要性分数（Visual Necessity Score）和竞争分数（Competition Score），以区分感知、依赖和对齐失败。在反事实盲视、噪声和冲突干预下进行评估。
Result: 在9个VLM和9000个样本中，72.9%的样本显示视觉谄媚（内部证据保留但解码出幻觉答案），零样本显示鲁棒拒绝。Qwen-VL家族内和跨代扩展单调减少语言捷径但放大视觉谄媚。诊断分数实现无训练的选择性预测，50%覆盖率下准确率提升最多9.5个百分点。
Conclusion: 当前VLM的对齐训练消除了拒绝解码结果，但并未解决视觉基础问题。规模扩大和新型后训练方法无法独自解决落地问题，诊断框架可辅助改进。

papers.title: scicode-lint: Detecting Methodology Bugs in Scientific Python Code with LLM-Generated Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Methodology bugs in scientific Python code produce plausible but incorrect results that traditional linters and static analysis tools cannot detect. Several research groups have built ML-specific linters, demonstrating that detection is feasible. Yet these tools share a sustainability problem: dependency on specific pylint or Python versions, limited packaging, and reliance on manual engineering for every new pattern. As AI-generated code increases the volume of scientific software, the need for automated methodology checking (such as detecting data leakage, incorrect cross-validation, and missing random seeds) grows. We present scicode-lint, whose two-tier architecture separates pattern design (frontier models at build time) from execution (small local model at runtime). Patterns are generated, not hand-coded; adapting to new library versions costs tokens, not engineering hours. On Kaggle notebooks with human-labeled ground truth, preprocessing leakage detection reaches 65% precision at 100% recall; on 38 published scientific papers applying AI/ML, precision is 62% (LLM-judged) with substantial variation across pattern categories; on a held-out paper set, precision is 54%. On controlled tests, scicode-lint achieves 97.7% accuracy across 66 patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: scicode-lint 是一个针对科学 Python 代码中方法论错误（如数据泄漏、错误交叉验证、缺失随机种子）的检测工具。其两阶段架构在建立时用前沿大模型自动生成检测模式，运行时用轻量本地模型执行，解决了传统静态分析工具无法检测此类错误以及手动维护模式不可持续的问题。在 Kaggle 笔记本上，预处理泄漏检测达到 65% 精确率和 100% 召回率；在 38 篇已发表论文上，LLM 评判的精确率为 62%，但不同模式类别间差异显著；在 66 个受控测试模式上准确率达 97.7%。
Motivation: 传统 linter 和静态分析工具无法检测科学 Python 代码中产生看似合理但实际错误的方法论问题（如数据泄漏、不当交叉验证），且现有专有 linter 依赖手动编码模式，维护成本高，难以适应 AI 生成代码带来的规模增长。
Method: 提出两阶段架构：设计阶段利用前沿大语言模型自动生成检测模式，无需人工编码；运行时使用小型本地模型执行检测，降低部署依赖。模式适应新库版本仅需消耗 token，无需工程投入。
Result: 在 Kaggle 笔记本上，预处理泄漏检测达到 65% 精确率和 100% 召回率；在 38 篇已发表论文上，LLM 评判的精确率为 62%，但不同模式类别间差异显著；在 66 个受控测试模式上准确率达 97.7%。
Conclusion: scicode-lint 展示了使用 LLM 生成模式来检测科学代码方法论错误的可行性，但模式类别间的性能差异表明仍需进一步优化。

papers.title: Context Matters: Repository-Aware Security Analysis of the Agent Skill Ecosystem
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills extend local AI agents, such as Claude Code and OpenClaw, with additional functionality. Their growing popularity has led to dedicated marketplaces resembling mobile app stores, as well as automated scanners that assess whether skills are benign or malicious. However, scanner reports from individual marketplaces classify up to 46.8% of skills as malicious, raising concerns about false positives. We present the largest empirical security analysis of the AI agent skill ecosystem to date. We collect 238,180 unique skills from three major distribution platforms and GitHub, and analyze their contents, behavior, and repository context. Unlike existing scanner-based assessments, which evaluate skills largely in isolation, our repository-aware analysis checks whether a flagged skill is consistent with its surrounding GitHub project. This context substantially reduces the number of suspicious skills: only 0.52% remain suspicious after repository-aware analysis. Our results show that existing scanners can substantially overestimate maliciousness when repository context is ignored. At the same time, we identify previously undocumented real-world attack vectors, including the hijacking of skills hosted in abandoned GitHub repositories. Overall, our findings provide a more robust view of the agent-skill ecosystem's current risk surface and highlight the need for context-aware security evaluation.
papers.comment: AgentSkills '26 Workshop: ACM Conference on AI and Agentic Systems (CAIS), Best Paper Award
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是迄今为止最大规模的AI agent技能生态系统安全实证分析。收集了来自三个主要分发平台和GitHub的238,180个独特技能，并分析了其内容、行为和仓库上下文。现有扫描器在忽略仓库上下文时会严重高估恶意比例（高达46.8%），而作者提出的仓库感知分析将可疑技能比例降至0.52%。同时发现了利用废弃GitHub仓库劫持技能等新攻击向量。
Motivation: 现有自动扫描器评估技能时孤立分析，导致误报率极高（高达46.8%被判定为恶意），需要更鲁棒的上下文感知安全评估方法。
Method: 提出仓库感知分析方法，检查被标记技能是否与其所在GitHub项目上下文一致，从而减少误报。收集了238,180个技能并进行大规模实证分析。
Result: 仓库感知分析后，仅0.52%的技能保持可疑，远低于孤立分析时的46.8%。同时发现了真实世界中利用废弃仓库劫持技能的未记载攻击向量。
Conclusion: 研究强调上下文感知安全评估的必要性，提供了agent技能生态系统当前风险面的更鲁棒视图。

papers.title: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs are globally deployed, aligning their cultural value orientations is critical for safety and user engagement. However, existing benchmarks face the Construct-Composition-Context ($C^3$) challenge: relying on discriminative, multiple-choice formats that probe value knowledge rather than true orientations, overlook subcultural heterogeneity, and mismatch with real-world open-ended generation. We introduce DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework that directly compares human-written text distributions with LLM-generated outputs. DOVE utilizes a rate-distortion variational optimization objective to construct a compact value codebook from 10K documents, mapping text into a structured value space to filter semantic noise. Alignment is measured using unbalanced optimal transport, capturing intra-cultural distributional structures and subgroup diversity. Experiments across 12 LLMs show that DOVE achieves superior predictive validity, attaining a 31.56% correlation with downstream tasks, while maintaining high reliability with as few as 500 samples per culture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DOVE，一种基于价值码本的分布性评估框架，用于直接比较人类文本分布与LLM生成文本分布，以衡量文化价值对齐。DOVE利用率-失真变分优化从1万文档构建紧凑的值空间，并通过非平衡最优传输测量对齐度，在12个LLM上的实验表明其预测效度达31.56%相关性，且只需每文化500样本即可保持高可靠性。
Motivation: 现有文化价值对齐基准面临构造-组成-上下文（$C^3$）挑战：使用判别式多项选择格式仅探测价值知识而非真实取向，忽略亚文化异质性，且与真实开放生成场景脱节。
Method: 提出分布性评估框架DOVE，包含两步：1）通过率-失真变分优化从10K文档构建紧凑值码本，将文本映射到结构化值空间以过滤语义噪声；2）使用非平衡最优运输（unbalanced optimal transport）测量对齐度，捕捉文化内分布结构和子群体多样性。
Result: 在12个LLM上的实验表明，DOVE的下游任务预测相关性达到31.56%，且每文化仅需500样本即可保持高可靠性。
Conclusion: DOVE通过直接比较文本分布并提供高预测效度和低样本需求，为评估LLM文化价值对齐提供了有效工具。

papers.title: ExpertGen: Scalable Sim-to-Real Expert Policy Learning from Imperfect Behavior Priors
papers.abstract_en: Learning generalizable and robust behavior cloning policies requires large volumes of high-quality robotics data. While human demonstrations (e.g., through teleoperation) serve as the standard source for expert behaviors, acquiring such data at scale in the real world is prohibitively expensive. This paper introduces ExpertGen, a framework that automates expert policy learning in simulation to enable scalable sim-to-real transfer. ExpertGen first initializes a behavior prior using a diffusion policy trained on imperfect demonstrations, which may be synthesized by large language models or provided by humans. Reinforcement learning is then used to steer this prior toward high task success by optimizing the diffusion model's initial noise while keep original policy frozen. By keeping the pretrained diffusion policy frozen, ExpertGen regularizes exploration to remain within safe, human-like behavior manifolds, while also enabling effective learning with only sparse rewards. Empirical evaluations on challenging manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that ExpertGen reliably produces high-quality expert policies with no reward engineering. On industrial assembly tasks, ExpertGen achieves a 90.5% overall success rate, while on long-horizon manipulation tasks it attains 85% overall success, outperforming all baseline methods. The resulting policies exhibit dexterous control and remain robust across diverse initial configurations and failure states. To validate sim-to-real transfer, the learned state-based expert policies are further distilled into visuomotor policies via DAgger and successfully deployed on real robotic hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ExpertGen框架，通过在模拟中自动化专家策略学习来实现可扩展的仿真到现实迁移。该框架首先利用基于次优演示（由大语言模型合成或人类提供）训练的扩散策略初始化行为先验，然后通过强化学习优化扩散模型的初始噪声来引导该先验实现高任务成功率，同时保持原始策略冻结。在工业组装任务上达到90.5%的总成功率，在长时域操作任务上达到85%，优于所有基线方法，并成功通过DAgger蒸馏为视觉运动策略部署到真实机器人硬件。
Motivation: 获取大规模高质量的人类演示数据（如通过遥操作）在现实世界中成本过高，限制了行为克隆策略的泛化和鲁棒性。
Method: 先利用次优演示（可来自大语言模型或人类）训练扩散策略作为行为先验，然后在保持该策略冻结的条件下，通过强化学习优化其初始噪声来引导策略向高成功率探索，并利用冻结的先验约束探索保持在安全、类人行为流形内，且仅需稀疏奖励。
Result: 在工业组装任务上总成功率为90.5%，在长时域操作任务上为85%，均优于所有基线方法；学习到的策略展现出灵巧控制并对不同初始配置和失败状态具有鲁棒性；通过DAgger蒸馏后的视觉运动策略成功部署在真实机器人硬件上。
Conclusion: ExpertGen框架能够在不需奖励工程的情况下可靠地生成高质量专家策略，并通过仿真到现实迁移验证了其有效性。

papers.title: AgentProcessBench: Diagnosing Step-Level Process Quality in Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have evolved into tool-using agents, they remain brittle in long-horizon interactions. Unlike mathematical reasoning where errors are often rectifiable via backtracking, tool-use failures frequently induce irreversible side effects, making accurate step-level verification critical. However, existing process-level benchmarks are predominantly confined to closed-world mathematical domains, failing to capture the dynamic and open-ended nature of tool execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentProcessBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating step-level effectiveness in realistic, tool-augmented trajectories. The benchmark comprises 1,000 diverse trajectories and 8,509 human-labeled step annotations with 89.1% inter-annotator agreement. It features a ternary labeling scheme to capture exploration and an error propagation rule to reduce labeling ambiguity. Extensive experiments reveal key insights: (1) weaker policy models exhibit inflated ratios of correct steps due to early termination; (2) distinguishing neutral and erroneous actions remains a significant challenge for current models; and (3) process-derived signals provide complementary value to outcome supervision, significantly enhancing test-time scaling. We hope AgentProcessBench can foster future research in reward models and pave the way toward general agents. The code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/AgentProcessBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 AgentProcessBench，首个专门评估工具增强型智能体在真实轨迹中步骤级有效性的基准。包含 1000 条多样化轨迹和 8509 个人工标注（标注者间一致性 89.1%），采用三元标注方案（正确/中性/错误）和错误传播规则以减少歧义。实验揭示：弱策略模型因提前终止导致正确步骤比例虚高；区分中性动作与错误动作仍是当前模型的重大挑战；过程信号与结果监督互补，能显著增强测试时扩展。
Motivation: 现有过程级基准局限于封闭世界的数学推理领域，无法捕捉工具执行环境的动态和开放特性，而工具使用失败常导致不可逆副作用，亟需准确的步骤级验证。
Method: 构建 AgentProcessBench，包含 1000 条人工收集的多样化轨迹、8509 个步骤级标注，采用三元标注（correct/neutral/error）和错误传播规则来减少标签歧义。
Result: 实验表明：(1) 较弱策略模型因早停导致正确步骤比例虚高；(2) 区分中性动作和错误动作对现有模型仍是显著挑战；(3) 过程信号与结果监督互补，可增强测试时扩展。

papers.title: DAPD: Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding via Attention for Diffusion LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Parallel decoding for Diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) is difficult because each denoising step provides only token-wise marginal distributions, while unmasking multiple tokens simultaneously requires accounting for inter-token dependencies. We propose Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding (DAPD), a simple, training-free decoding method that uses self-attention to induce a conditional dependency graph over masked tokens. At each iteration, edges in this graph capture strong token interactions, while non-edges indicate weak dependence. Parallel decoding is then reduced to selecting an independent set on the graph and unmasking the selected tokens in parallel. This avoids co-updating strongly coupled tokens without auxiliary models or retraining. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream show that DAPD improves the accuracy-steps trade-off over existing methods and enables more globally distributed parallel updates that better exploit the any-order generation capability of dLLMs. The project is available at https://ai-isl.github.io/dapd
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DAPD (Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding)，一种无需训练的并行解码方法，针对扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 中逐 token 去噪难以建模 token 间依赖的问题。利用自注意力构建遮蔽 token 的条件依赖图，选择独立集并行解码，避免同时更新强耦合 token。在 LLaDA 和 Dream 上实验表明，该方法改善了准确率-步数权衡，并更充分地利用了 dLLM 的任意顺序生成能力。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型并行解码困难，因为每个去噪步骤仅提供 token 级别的边缘分布，而同时解遮蔽多个 token 需要建模 token 间依赖。
Method: 提出训练自由的方法，通过自注意力机制在遮蔽 token 上诱导条件依赖图：边表示强交互，非边表示弱依赖。随后将并行解码转化为在图上选择独立集，并行解遮蔽所选 token。
Result: 在 LLaDA 和 Dream 模型上的实验表明，DAPD 在准确率-步数权衡上优于现有方法，且能实现更全局分布的并行更新。
Conclusion: 强调该方法无需辅助模型或重新训练，通过避免同时更新强耦合 token，有效利用了扩散语言模型的任意顺序生成能力。

papers.title: Frequentist Consistency of Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models based on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have shown strong empirical performance in causal inference by framing the task as an in-context learning problem. However, it is unclear whether PFN-based causal estimators provide uncertainty quantification that is consistent with classical frequentist estimators. In this work, we address this gap by analyzing the frequentist consistency of PFN-based estimators for the average treatment effect (ATE). (1) We show that existing PFNs, when interpreted as Bayesian ATE estimators, can exhibit prior-induced confounding bias: the prior is not asymptotically overwritten by data, which, in turn, prevents frequentist consistency. (2) As a remedy, we suggest employing a calibration procedure based on a one-step posterior correction (OSPC). We show that the OSPC helps to restore frequentist consistency and can yield a semi-parametric Bernstein-von Mises theorem for calibrated PFNs (i.e., both the calibrated PFN-based estimators and the classical semi-parametric efficient estimators converge in distribution with growing data size). (3) Finally, we implement OSPC through tailoring martingale posteriors on top of the PFNs. In this way, we are able to recover functional nuisance posteriors from PFNs, required by the OSPC. In multiple (semi-)synthetic experiments, PFNs calibrated with our martingale posterior OSPC produce ATE uncertainty that (i) asymptotically matches frequentist uncertainty and (ii) is well calibrated in finite samples in comparison to other Bayesian ATE estimators.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43-rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea, PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）的因果估计量的频率一致性。指出现有PFN作为贝叶斯平均处理效应（ATE）估计器时，由于先验不会被数据渐近覆盖而导致混淆偏差，阻碍频率一致性。提出基于一步后验校正（OSPC）的校准方法，通过鞅后验从PFN恢复功能nuisance后验，恢复频率一致性并实现半参数Bernstein-von Mises定理。实验表明校准后的PFN产生的ATE不确定性渐近匹配频率不确定性，且在有限样本下校准优于其他贝叶斯ATE估计器。
Motivation: PFN在因果推断中表现出色，但其不确定性量化是否与经典频率估计器一致尚不清楚，缺乏频率一致性保证。
Method: 提出一步后验校正（OSPC）校准程序，通过鞅后验从PFN恢复功能nuisance后验，从而校正先验偏差并恢复频率一致性。
Result: 校准后的PFN产生的ATE不确定性渐近匹配频率不确定性，有限样本校准优于其他贝叶斯ATE估计器。
Conclusion: OSPC能够修复PFN的频率一致性，并使得校准后的PFN估计量满足半参数Bernstein-von Mises定理。

papers.title: Simple Recipe Works: Vision-Language-Action Models are Natural Continual Learners with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is a promising direction toward self-improving embodied agents that can adapt in openended, evolving environments. However, conventional wisdom from continual learning suggests that naive Sequential Fine-Tuning (Seq. FT) leads to catastrophic forgetting, necessitating complex CRL strategies. In this work, we take a step back and conduct a systematic study of CRL for large pretrained VLAs across diverse lifelong RL benchmarks. We find that, contrary to established belief, simple Seq. FT with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is remarkably strong: it achieves high plasticity, exhibits little to no forgetting, and retains strong zero-shot generalization, frequently outperforming more sophisticated CRL methods. Through detailed analysis, we show that this robustness arises from a synergy between the large pretrained model, parameter-efficient adaptation, and on-policy RL. Together, these components reshape the stability-plasticity trade-off, making continual adaptation both stable and scalable. Our results position Sequential Fine-Tuning as a powerful method for continual RL with VLAs and provide new insights into lifelong learning in the large model era. Code is available at github.com/UT-Austin-RobIn/continual-vla-rl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在持续强化学习（CRL）中的表现，发现简单的顺序微调（Seq. FT）加上低秩适应（LoRA）即可实现高可塑性和低遗忘，优于复杂的CRL方法。分析表明，预训练模型、参数高效微调和在线策略强化学习共同作用，重塑了稳定性-可塑性权衡。
Motivation: 传统观念认为持续学习中的顺序微调会导致灾难性遗忘，需要复杂CRL策略。本文质疑这一观点，系统研究预训练VLA模型在CRL中的表现。
Method: 对大规模预训练VLA模型进行系统CRL研究，采用顺序微调（Seq. FT）结合低秩适应（LoRA）作为简单基线，并在多种终身强化学习基准上评估。
Result: 简单的Seq. FT+LoRA在大多数基准上超越更复杂的CRL方法，表现出高可塑性、低遗忘，并保持零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 顺序微调是用于VLA模型持续强化学习的强大方法，为大规模模型时代的终身学习提供了新见解。
