papers.title: ActiveUltraFeedback: Efficient Preference Data Generation using Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has become the standard for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its efficacy is bottlenecked by the high cost of acquiring preference data, especially in low-resource and expert domains. To address this, we introduce ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK, a modular active learning pipeline that leverages uncertainty estimates to dynamically identify the most informative responses for annotation. Our pipeline facilitates the systematic evaluation of standard response selection methods alongside DOUBLE REVERSE THOMPSON SAMPLING (DRTS) and DELTAUCB, two novel methods prioritizing response pairs with large predicted quality gaps, leveraging recent results showing that such pairs provide good signals for fine-tuning. Our experiments demonstrate that ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK yields high-quality datasets that lead to significant improvements in downstream performance, notably achieving comparable or superior results with as little as one-sixth of the annotated data relative to static baselines. Our pipeline is available at https://github.com/lasgroup/ActiveUltraFeedback and our preference datasets at https://huggingface.co/ActiveUltraFeedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK，一种基于主动学习的偏好数据生成管线，用于降低RLHF中偏好数据的标注成本。该管线利用不确定性估计动态选择最具信息量的响应进行标注，并引入两种新方法：DOUBLE REVERSE THOMPSON SAMPLING (DRTS) 和 DELTAUCB，它们优先选择预测质量差距大的响应对。实验表明，仅需静态基线六分之一的数据量即可达到相当或更优的下游性能。
Motivation: RLHF中偏好数据获取成本高昂，尤其在低资源和专家领域，当前方法受限于标注成本。
Method: 模块化主动学习管线，使用不确定性估计选择信息量最大的响应；包含DRTS和DELTAUCB两种新采样方法，优先选择质量差距大的响应对以提供更好的微调信号。
Result: 在仅使用静态基线六分之一标注数据的情况下，下游性能相当或更优。
Conclusion: 主动学习能高效生成偏好数据集，显著降低标注成本，且开源了管线与数据集。

papers.title: Training-Free Coverless Multi-Image Steganography with Access Control
papers.abstract_en: Coverless Image Steganography (CIS) hides information without explicitly modifying a cover image, providing strong imperceptibility and inherent robustness to steganalysis. However, existing CIS methods largely lack robust access control, making it difficult to selectively reveal different hidden contents to different authorized users. Such access control is critical for scalable and privacy-sensitive information hiding in multi-user settings. We propose MIDAS (Multi-Image Diffusion-based Access-controlled Steganography), a training-free diffusion-based CIS framework that enables multi-image hiding with user-specific access control via latent-level fusion. MIDAS introduces a Random Basis mechanism to suppress residual structural information, together with a theoretical analysis of information leakage, and a Latent Vector Fusion module that reshapes aggregated latents to better align with the diffusion process. Experimental results demonstrate that MIDAS consistently outperforms existing training-free CIS baselines in access control functionality, stego image quality and diversity, robustness to noise, and resistance to steganalysis, establishing a practical and scalable approach to access-controlled coverless steganography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIDAS，一种无需训练的扩散模型框架，用于多图像隐写并实现用户特定的访问控制。通过随机基机制抑制结构信息泄漏，并利用潜在向量融合模块改进扩散过程，在隐写图像质量、多样性和鲁棒性上超越现有无训练基线。
Motivation: 现有无载体图像隐写方法缺乏鲁棒的访问控制，难以在多人场景中选择性向不同授权用户揭示不同隐藏内容。
Method: 提出 MIDAS 框架，基于预训练扩散模型且无需额外训练；引入随机基机制消除残差结构信息，并结合潜在向量融合模块重塑聚合潜在表示以适配扩散过程。
Result: 实验表明，MIDAS 在访问控制功能、隐写图像质量和多样性、对噪声的鲁棒性以及抗隐写分析能力上均一致优于现有无训练基线方法。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了一种实用且可扩展的无载体隐写方案，支持多图像隐藏与细粒度访问控制，适用于隐私敏感的多用户场景。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Decentralized Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Training frontier-scale diffusion models often requires substantial computational resources concentrated in tightly-coupled clusters, limiting participation to well-resourced institutions. While Decentralized Diffusion Models (DDM) enable training multiple experts in isolation, existing approaches require 1176 GPU-days and homogeneous training objectives across all experts. We present an efficient framework that dramatically reduces resource requirements while supporting heterogeneous training objectives. Our approach combines three key contributions: (1) a heterogeneous decentralized training paradigm that allows experts to use different objectives (DDPM and Flow Matching), unified at inference time without any retraining; (2) pretrained checkpoint conversion from ImageNet-DDPM to Flow Matching objectives, accelerating convergence and enabling initialization without objective-specific pretraining; and (3) PixArt-$α$'s efficient AdaLN-Single architecture, reducing parameters while maintaining quality. Experiments on LAION-Aesthetics show that, relative to the training scale reported for prior DDM work, our approach reduces the compute by 16$\times$ and data by 14$\times$. Under aligned inference settings, our heterogeneous configuration achieves better FID and higher intra-prompt diversity than the homogeneous baseline. By eliminating synchronization requirements and enabling mixed DDPM/FM objectives, our framework makes decentralized generative model training accessible to contributors with single GPUs requiring only 24--48GB VRAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个高效的异构去中心化扩散模型框架，支持不同训练目标（DDPM和Flow Matching）的专家在推理时统一，无需重新训练。通过预训练检查点转换和PixArt-α的高效架构，在LAION-Aesthetics数据集上相比先前工作减少16倍计算和14倍数据，同时实现更好的FID和更高的样本内多样性。
Motivation: 现有去中心化扩散模型需要大量计算资源和同质训练目标，限制了参与机构。本文旨在降低资源需求并支持异构训练目标，使单GPU（24-48GB VRAM）贡献者也能参与训练。
Method: 提出三个贡献：1) 异构去中心化训练范式，允许专家使用不同目标（DDPM和Flow Matching）并在推理时统一；2) 从ImageNet-DDPM到Flow Matching的预训练检查点转换，加速收敛；3) 采用PixArt-α的高效AdaLN-Single架构，减少参数量。
Result: 在LAION-Aesthetics上相比先前DDM工作减少16倍计算和14倍数据；在一致推理设置下，异构配置比同质基线获得更好的FID和更高的样本内多样性。
Conclusion: 该框架消除了同步需求并允许混合DDPM/FM目标，使去中心化生成模型训练对单GPU贡献者可行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pinterest Canvas: Large-Scale Image Generation at Pinterest
papers.abstract_en: While recent image generation models demonstrate a remarkable ability to handle a wide variety of image generation tasks, this flexibility makes them hard to control via prompting or simple inference adaptation alone, rendering them unsuitable for use cases with strict product requirements. In this paper, we introduce Pinterest Canvas, our large-scale image generation system built to support image editing and enhancement use cases at Pinterest. Canvas is first trained on a diverse, multimodal dataset to produce a foundational diffusion model with broad image-editing capabilities. However, rather than relying on one generic model to handle every downstream task, we instead rapidly fine-tune variants of this base model on task-specific datasets, producing specialized models for individual use cases. We describe key components of Canvas and summarize our best practices for dataset curation, training, and inference. We also showcase task-specific variants through case studies on background enhancement and aspect-ratio outpainting, highlighting how we tackle their specific product requirements. Online A/B experiments demonstrate that our enhanced images receive a significant 18.0% and 12.5% engagement lift, respectively, and comparisons with human raters further validate that our models outperform third-party models on these tasks. Finally, we showcase other Canvas variants, including multi-image scene synthesis and image-to-video generation, demonstrating that our approach can generalize to a wide variety of potential downstream tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted by KDD 2026 Applied Data Science Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了Pinterest Canvas，一个大规模图像生成系统，基于扩散模型，通过多模态数据集训练基础模型，然后针对特定任务快速微调出专用模型。在背景增强和宽高比外绘等任务上，在线A/B实验显示参与度分别提升18.0%和12.5%，且优于第三方模型。
Motivation: 现有图像生成模型灵活性高但难以通过提示或简单推理适配来满足严格的产品需求，因此需要专门的生成系统来支持Pinterest的图像编辑和增强用例。
Method: 先用多模态数据集训练基础扩散模型，然后对每个下游任务使用任务特定数据集快速微调出专用模型。描述了数据集整理、训练和推理的最佳实践，并通过案例研究展示背景增强和宽高比外绘。
Result: 在线A/B实验显示增强图像分别获得18.0%和12.5%的参与度提升；与人类评估者对比，模型优于第三方模型。
Conclusion: 该方法可以泛化到多种下游任务，包括多图像场景合成和图像到视频生成。

papers.title: WorldCache: Accelerating World Models for Free via Heterogeneous Token Caching
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based world models have shown strong potential for unified world simulation, but the iterative denoising remains too costly for interactive use and long-horizon rollouts. While feature caching can accelerate inference without training, we find that policies designed for single-modal diffusion transfer poorly to world models due to two world-model-specific obstacles: \emph{token heterogeneity} from multi-modal coupling and spatial variation, and \emph{non-uniform temporal dynamics} where a small set of hard tokens drives error growth, making uniform skipping either unstable or overly conservative. We propose \textbf{WorldCache}, a caching framework tailored to diffusion world models. We introduce \textit{Curvature-guided Heterogeneous Token Prediction}, which uses a physics-grounded curvature score to estimate token predictability and applies a Hermite-guided damped predictor for chaotic tokens with abrupt direction changes. We also design \textit{Chaotic-prioritized Adaptive Skipping}, which accumulates a curvature-normalized, dimensionless drift signal and recomputes only when bottleneck tokens begin to drift. Experiments on diffusion world models show that WorldCache delivers up to \textbf{3.7$\times$} end-to-end speedups while maintaining \textbf{98\%} rollout quality, demonstrating the vast advantages and practicality of WorldCache in resource-constrained scenarios. Our code is released in https://github.com/FofGofx/WorldCache.

papers.title: Med-V1: Small Language Models for Zero-shot and Scalable Biomedical Evidence Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Assessing whether an article supports an assertion is essential for hallucination detection and claim verification. While large language models (LLMs) have the potential to automate this task, achieving strong performance requires frontier models such as GPT-5 that are prohibitively expensive to deploy at scale. To efficiently perform biomedical evidence attribution, we present Med-V1, a family of small language models with only three billion parameters. Trained on high-quality synthetic data newly developed in this study, Med-V1 substantially outperforms (+27.0% to +71.3%) its base models on five biomedical benchmarks unified into a verification format. Despite its smaller size, Med-V1 performs comparably to frontier LLMs such as GPT-5, along with high-quality explanations for its predictions. We use Med-V1 to conduct a first-of-its-kind use case study that quantifies hallucinations in LLM-generated answers under different citation instructions. Results show that the format instruction strongly affects citation validity and hallucination, with GPT-5 generating more claims but exhibiting hallucination rates similar to GPT-4o. Additionally, we present a second use case showing that Med-V1 can automatically identify high-stakes evidence misattributions in clinical practice guidelines, revealing potentially negative public health impacts that are otherwise challenging to identify at scale. Overall, Med-V1 provides an efficient and accurate lightweight alternative to frontier LLMs for practical and real-world applications in biomedical evidence attribution and verification tasks. Med-V1 is available at https://github.com/ncbi-nlp/Med-V1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Med-V1，一个仅有 30 亿参数的小语言模型，用于零样本且可扩展的生物医学证据归因。通过高质量合成数据训练，Med-V1 在五个生物医学基准上大幅超越其基座模型（提升 27.0% 至 71.3%），性能媲美 GPT-5 等前沿大模型，并生成高质量解释。应用案例显示，Med-V1 可量化 LLM 回答中的幻觉，并自动识别临床实践指南中的高危证据错误归因。
Motivation: 大型语言模型虽能自动化证据归因，但部署成本高昂，难以大规模应用；现有小模型性能不足。需要一种高效、准确的轻量级替代方案。
Method: 基于仅有 30 亿参数的小语言模型，使用本研究新开发的高质量合成数据进行训练，建立统一的验证格式，并在多个生物医学基准上评估。
Result: Med-V1 在五个生物医学基准上相对基座模型提升 27.0% 至 71.3%，性能与 GPT-5 相当；应用案例表明，引用格式指令显著影响 LLM 的引用有效性和幻觉率，GPT-5 生成更多声明但幻觉率与 GPT-4o 相近。
Conclusion: Med-V1 为实际生物医学证据归因任务提供了高效、准确的轻量级替代方案，可大规模用于幻觉检测和声明验证。

papers.title: Deep Interest Mining for Intent-Enriched Semantic IDs in Multimodal Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic IDs (SIDs) provide the discrete item vocabulary used by generative recommendation, but their quality depends on what item evidence is preserved before quantization. In product recommendation, surface metadata often misses latent usage intent, visual evidence may be only weakly reflected in text, and downstream policy learning provides sparse feedback about whether a generated SID corresponds to a semantically useful item. We introduce \textbf{DeepInterestGR}, an intent-enriched SID framework for generative recommendation. Before SID quantization, \textbf{CMSA} enriches item representations through two complementary evidence paths: recommendation-oriented VLM captions and projected image embeddings. \textbf{DCIM} then uses an LLM to mine item-side intent descriptors -- latent usage motivations implied by product content rather than personalized user states. During policy training over the constructed SIDs, \textbf{QARM} adds a relevance-gated semantic-quality bonus on top of standard SID rewards, applying the bonus only when the generated SID decodes to the target item. Thus, semantic quality cannot reward a fluent but irrelevant item prediction. Experiments on three Amazon Product Review categories (Beauty, Sports, and Instruments) show that DeepInterestGR improves over competitive generative and RL-based baselines, with relative gains of up to \textbf{15.1\%} in NDCG@5 and \textbf{13.9\%} in NDCG@10 over the strongest per-metric baseline. Component ablations, CMSA branch analyses, reward variants, and SID-level case studies support a bounded claim: enriching pre-quantization item evidence with visual cues and item-side intent descriptors, together with relevance-gated semantic rewards, improves SID-based generative recommendation under the evaluated settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeepInterestGR框架，通过引入视觉线索和物品侧意图描述来增强生成式推荐中的语义ID（SID）质量。包含三个组件：CMSA利用VLM标题和图像嵌入丰富物品表示；DCIM通过LLM挖掘物品侧意图描述；QARM在SID奖励上添加基于相关性的语义质量奖励。在Amazon三个产品类别上，该方法在NDCG@5和NDCG@10上分别提升15.1%和13.9%。
Motivation: 生成式推荐中的语义ID质量依赖于量化前保留的物品证据，但产品元数据常缺失潜在使用意图和视觉信息，且下游策略学习对语义有用性反馈稀疏。
Method: 提出DeepInterestGR框架：CMSA通过两条互补路径（推荐导向的VLM标题和投影图像嵌入）丰富物品表示；DCIM用LLM挖掘物品侧意图描述（隐含的使用动机）；QARM在SID训练中添加相关性门控语义质量奖励，仅当生成SID解码为目标物品时应用。
Result: 在Beauty、Sports和Instruments三个Amazon产品类别上，DeepInterestGR相对最强基线在NDCG@5和NDCG@10上分别提升15.1%和13.9%。
Conclusion: 在评估设置下，通过视觉线索和物品侧意图描述丰富预量化物品证据，并结合相关性门控语义奖励，可以改进基于SID的生成式推荐。

papers.title: Step-Level Sparse Autoencoder for Reasoning Process Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong complex reasoning capabilities through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, their reasoning patterns remain too complicated to analyze. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a powerful tool for interpretability, existing approaches predominantly operate at the token level, creating a granularity mismatch when capturing more critical step-level information, such as reasoning direction and semantic transitions. In this work, we propose step-level sparse autoencoder (SSAE), which serves as an analytical tool to disentangle different aspects of LLMs' reasoning steps into sparse features. Specifically, by precisely controlling the sparsity of a step feature conditioned on its context, we form an information bottleneck in step reconstruction, which splits incremental information from background information and disentangles it into several sparsely activated dimensions. Experiments on multiple base models and reasoning tasks show the effectiveness of the extracted features. By linear probing, we can easily predict surface-level information, such as generation length and first token distribution, as well as more complicated properties, such as the correctness and logicality of the step. These observations indicate that LLMs should already at least partly know about these properties during generation, which provides the foundation for the self-verification ability of LLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/SSAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出步骤级稀疏自编码器（SSAE），用于解释大语言模型在链式思维推理中的步骤级语义信息。通过条件稀疏化形成信息瓶颈，将推理步骤中的增量信息与背景信息分离为稀疏特征。实验表明，通过线性探测可预测步骤的长度、首词分布、正确性和逻辑性。
Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）主要基于token级别，无法捕捉推理步骤中更关键的语义转换和逻辑方向信息，导致粒度不匹配。
Method: 提出步骤级稀疏自编码器（SSAE），通过上下文条件控制步骤特征的稀疏度，形成信息瓶颈，将增量信息与背景信息分离到稀疏激活的维度中。
Result: 在多个基础模型和推理任务上，利用线性探测可有效预测步骤的表面信息（如生成长度、首词分布）和复杂属性（如正确性、逻辑性），证明LLM在生成时已部分掌握这些属性。
Conclusion: SSAE为理解推理步骤提供了细粒度分析工具，并为LLM的自我验证能力提供了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPARC: Spatial-Aware Path Planning via Attentive Agent Communication
papers.abstract_en: Efficient communication is critical for decentralized Multi-Robot Path Planning (MRPP), yet existing learned communication methods treat all neighboring robots equally regardless of their spatial proximity, leading to diluted attention in congested regions where coordination matters most. We propose Relation enhanced Multi Head Attention (RMHA), a communication mechanism that explicitly embeds pairwise Manhattan distances into the attention weight computation, enabling each robot to dynamically prioritize messages from spatially relevant neighbors. Combined with a distance-constrained attention mask and GRU gated message fusion, RMHA integrates seamlessly with MAPPO for stable end-to-end training. In zero-shot generalization from 8 training robots to 128 test robots on 40x40 grids, RMHA achieves approximately 75 percent success rate at 30 percent obstacle density outperforming the best baseline by over 25 percentage points. Ablation studies confirm that distance-relation encoding is the key contributor to success rate improvement in high-density environments. Index Terms-Multi-robot path planning, graph attention mechanism, multi-head attention, communication optimization, cooperative decision-making

papers.title: Large Electron Model: A Universal Ground State Predictor
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Large Electron Model, a single neural network model that produces variational wavefunctions of interacting electrons over the entire Hamiltonian parameter manifold. Our model employs the Fermi Sets architecture, a universal representation of many-body fermionic wavefunctions, which is further conditioned on Hamiltonian parameter and particle number. For interacting electrons in a two-dimensional harmonic potential, a single trained model accurately predicts the ground state wavefunction while generalizing across unseen coupling strengths and particle-number sectors, producing both accurate real-space charge densities and ground state energies, even up to $50$ particles. Our results establish a foundation model method for material discovery that is grounded in the variational principle, while accurately treating strong electron correlation beyond the capacity of density functional theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Large Electron Model，一种能够对整个哈密顿参数流形上的相互作用电子产生变分波函数的单一神经网络模型。该模型基于Fermi Sets架构，并进一步以哈密顿参数和粒子数为条件。在二维简谐势阱中的相互作用电子系统上，单个训练好的模型能准确预测基态波函数并泛化到未见过的耦合强度和粒子数区域，最多支持50个粒子。结果表明，该方法建立了一种基于变分原理的、能够准确处理强电子关联的基态预测方法，超越了密度泛函理论的能力。
Motivation: 当前密度泛函理论在处理强电子关联时存在局限，而从头算变分蒙特卡洛等方法计算成本高且难以泛化到不同哈密顿参数。本文旨在开发一种可泛化的神经波函数模型，能够预测多个耦合强度和粒子数下的基态。
Method: 采用Fermi Sets架构作为多体费米子波函数的通用表示，并通过对哈密顿参数和粒子数进行条件化，训练单个模型覆盖整个参数空间。模型通过变分原理优化能量期望值。
Result: 在二维简谐势阱的相互作用电子系统中，单个模型准确预测基态波函数，泛化到未见的耦合强度和粒子数（最高50个粒子），给出精确的实空间电荷密度和基态能量。
Conclusion: 该工作为基于变分原理的材料发现建立了一种基础模型方法，能准确处理强电子关联，弥补DFT的不足。

papers.title: AutoFFS: Adversarial Deformations for Facial Feminization Surgery Planning
papers.abstract_en: Facial feminization surgery (FFS) is a key component of gender affirmation for transgender and gender diverse patients, aiming to reshape craniofacial structures toward a female morphology. Current surgical planning procedures largely rely on subjective clinical assessment, lacking quantitative and reproducible anatomical guidance. We therefore propose AutoFFS, a novel data-driven framework that generates counterfactual skull morphologies through adversarial free-form deformations. Our method performs a deformation-based targeted adversarial attack on an ensemble of pre-trained binary sex classifiers that learned sexual dimorphism, effectively transforming individual skull shapes toward the target sex. The generated counterfactual skull morphologies provide a quantitative foundation for preoperative planning in FFS, driving advances in this largely overlooked patient group. We validate our approach through classifier-based evaluation, propose Morphological Fréchet Distance (MFD) and Morphological Kernel Distance (MKD) to evaluate distributional alignment of generated and real populations, and perform a human perceptual study, confirming that the generated morphologies exhibit target sex characteristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoFFS，一个数据驱动的框架，通过对抗自由变形生成反事实颅骨形态，用于面部女性化手术(FFS)的术前规划。该方法对集成预训练二元性别分类器执行基于变形的对抗攻击，将个体颅骨形状向目标性别转化。通过分类器评估、提出的形态学弗雷歇距离(MFD)和形态学核距离(MKD)以及人类感知研究验证了生成形态具备目标性别特征。
Motivation: 当前FFS手术规划主要依赖主观临床评估，缺乏定量和可重复的解剖学指导，而该病人群体在研究中被忽视。
Method: 利用基于变形的对抗攻击，对一组学习到性别二态性的预训练二元性别分类器进行集成攻击，通过自由变形生成反事实颅骨形态。
Result: 通过分类器评估确认生成形态的有效性；提出MFD和MKD用于评估生成与真实人群的分布对齐；人类感知研究证实生成形态呈现出目标性别特征。
Conclusion: AutoFFS为FFS的术前规划提供了定量基础，有望推动这一被忽视患者群体的治疗进展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding LoRA as Knowledge Memory: An Empirical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Continuous knowledge updating for pre-trained large language models (LLMs) is increasingly necessary yet remains challenging. Although inference-time methods like In-Context Learning (ICL) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) are popular, they face constraints in context budgets, costs, and retrieval fragmentation. Departing from these context-dependent paradigms, this work investigates a parametric approach using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a modular knowledge memory. Although few recent works examine this concept, the fundamental mechanics governing its capacity and composability remain largely unexplored. We bridge this gap through the first systematic empirical study mapping the design space of LoRA-based memory, ranging from characterizing storage capacity and optimizing internalization to scaling multi-module systems and evaluating long-context reasoning. Rather than proposing a single architecture, we provide practical guidance on the operational boundaries of LoRA memory. Overall, our findings position LoRA as the complementary axis of memory alongside RAG and ICL, offering distinct advantages. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ahn-ml/Understanding-LoRA-as-Knowledge-Memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统实验研究将低秩适应（LoRA）作为大语言模型（LLM）的模块化知识记忆的机制，包括存储容量、内化优化、多模块扩展和长上下文推理。研究提供LoRA记忆的操作边界指导，认为LoRA可作为RAG和ICL之外的补充记忆轴。
Motivation: LLM持续知识更新需求增加，而现有上下文依赖方法（如ICL、RAG）受限于上下文预算、成本和检索碎片化。LoRA作为参数化记忆的潜力未被充分理解，其容量和组合性的基本机制尚不明确。
Method: 通过首个系统性实证研究，映射基于LoRA记忆的设计空间，包括存储容量表征、内化优化、多模块系统扩展和长上下文推理评估。
Result: 提供了LoRA记忆的操作边界实用指南，证明LoRA作为记忆轴与RAG和ICL互补，具有独特优势。
Conclusion: LoRA记忆可有效用于LLM知识更新，但需注意容量和组合限制；研究为实际部署提供了设计原则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stabilizing Policy Optimization via Logits Convexity
papers.abstract_en: While reinforcement learning (RL) has been central to the recent success of large language models (LLMs), RL optimization is notoriously unstable, especially when compared to supervised fine-tuning (SFT). In this work, we investigate the stability gap between SFT and RL from a gradient-based perspective, and show that the convexity of the SFT loss with respect to model logits plays a key role in enabling stable training. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that this property induces favorable gradient directionality during optimization. In contrast, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), a widely adopted policy gradient algorithm utilizing a clipped surrogate objective, lacks this stabilizing property. Motivated by this observation, we propose Logits Convex Optimization (LCO), a simple yet effective policy optimization framework that aligns the learned policy with an optimal target derived from the original RL objective, thereby emulating the stabilizing effects of logits-level convexity. Extensive experiments across multiple model families show that our LCO framework consistently improves training stability and outperforms conventional RL methods on a broad range of benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从梯度视角研究强化学习（RL）在大型语言模型（LLM）训练中不如监督微调（SFT）稳定的原因，发现SFT损失关于模型logits的凸性是其稳定训练的关键，而近端策略优化（PPO）缺乏此性质。为此提出Logits凸优化（LCO）框架，通过将学习策略对齐到原始RL目标的最优策略来模拟logits凸性效应。实验表明LCO能在多个模型家族上提升训练稳定性并在多种基准上优于传统RL方法。
Motivation: RL优化在LLM中常不稳定，与SFT形成鲜明对比，需要揭示不稳定性根源并设计更稳定的策略优化方法。
Method: 理论分析SFT损失对logits的凸性如何带来有利梯度方向性，指出PPO缺乏此凸性；提出Logits凸优化（LCO）框架，从原始RL目标导出最优目标并用于策略对齐，从而模拟凸性稳定效果。
Result: 在多个模型家族上的大量实验表明，LCO一致提升训练稳定性，并在广泛基准上超越传统RL方法（如PPO）。
Conclusion: LCO通过模拟logits级凸性有效稳定策略优化，为RL在LLM中的实际应用提供了一种简单且有效的替代方案。

papers.title: LK Losses: Direct Acceptance Rate Optimization for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens that are then verified in parallel by the target model. The speedup is significantly determined by the acceptance rate, yet standard training minimizes Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as a proxy objective. While KL divergence and acceptance rate share the same global optimum, small draft models, having limited capacity, typically converge to suboptimal solutions where minimizing KL does not guarantee maximizing acceptance rate. To address this issue, we propose LK losses, special training objectives that directly target acceptance rate. Comprehensive experiments across four draft architectures and six target models, ranging from 8B to 685B parameters, demonstrate consistent improvements in acceptance metrics across all configurations compared to the standard KL-based training. We evaluate our approach on general, coding and math domains and report gains of up to 8-10% in average acceptance length. LK losses are easy to implement, introduce no computational overhead and can be directly integrated into any existing speculator training framework, making them a compelling alternative to the existing draft training objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对投机解码（Speculative Decoding）中标准训练使用 KL 散度作为代理目标，但小型草稿模型收敛到次优解的问题，提出直接优化接受率的 LK losses。实验表明，在多种草稿架构和目标模型上，相比 KL 训练，平均接受长度提升 8-10%，且实现简单无额外计算开销。
Motivation: 标准投机解码训练最小化 KL 散度，但小容量草稿模型往往收敛到次优解，即最小化 KL 不保证最大化接受率。
Method: 提出 LK losses，直接以接受率为优化目标的训练损失函数。
Result: 在 4 种草稿架构和 6 个目标模型（8B-685B）上的实验显示，所有配置下接受指标一致提升，平均接受长度提升 8-10%，涵盖通用、编码和数学领域。
Conclusion: LK losses 易于实现，无计算开销，可直接集成到现有投机器训练框架，是现有草稿训练目标的强有力替代。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Search Relevance: Augmenting App Store Ranking with LLM-Generated Judgments
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale commercial search systems optimize for relevance to drive successful sessions that help users find what they are looking for. To maximize relevance, we leverage two complementary objectives: behavioral relevance (results users tend to click or download) and textual relevance (a result's semantic fit to the query). A persistent challenge is the scarcity of expert-provided textual relevance labels relative to abundant behavioral relevance labels. We first address this by systematically evaluating LLM configurations, finding that a specialized, fine-tuned model significantly outperforms a much larger pre-trained one in providing highly relevant labels. Using this optimal model as a force multiplier, we generate millions of textual relevance labels to overcome the data scarcity. We show that augmenting our production ranker with these textual relevance labels leads to a significant outward shift of the Pareto frontier: offline NDCG improves for behavioral relevance while simultaneously increasing for textual relevance. These offline gains were validated by a worldwide A/B test on the App Store ranker, which demonstrated a statistically significant +0.24% increase in conversion rate, with the most substantial performance gains occurring in tail queries, where the new textual relevance labels provide a robust signal in the absence of reliable behavioral relevance labels.

Method: 系统评估多种LLM配置（包括预训练与微调），选择最优的专用微调模型作为“力量倍增器”，生成数百万文本相关性标签，并将其作为训练信号增强生产排序器。
Result: 离线测评中NDCG在行为相关性和文本相关性上同时提高，Pareto前沿外移；全球A/B测试显示App Store排名器转化率显著提升+0.24%，尾部查询表现尤为突出。
Conclusion: 证明LLM生成的文本相关性标签能有效缓解标签稀缺问题，在缺乏行为信号时提供鲁棒信号，从而提升搜索相关性。

papers.title: Motion-aware Event Suppression for Event Cameras
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce the first framework for Motion-aware Event Suppression, which learns to filter events triggered by IMOs and ego-motion in real time. Our model jointly segments IMOs in the current event stream while predicting their future motion, enabling anticipatory suppression of dynamic events before they occur. Our lightweight architecture achieves 173 Hz inference on consumer-grade GPUs with less than 1 GB of memory usage, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods on the challenging EVIMO benchmark by 67\% in segmentation accuracy while operating at a 53\% higher inference rate. Moreover, we demonstrate significant benefits for downstream applications: our method accelerates Vision Transformer inference by 83\% via token pruning and improves event-based visual odometry accuracy, reducing Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) by 13\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个运动感知事件抑制框架，通过学习实时过滤由独立运动物体（IMO）和自身运动触发的事件。模型同时分割当前事件流中的IMO并预测其未来运动，实现预期性动态事件抑制。轻量级架构在消费级GPU上达到173 Hz推理速度，内存占用低于1 GB，在EVIMO基准上分割准确率提升67%，推理速度提高53%。下游应用中，通过token剪枝加速Vision Transformer推理83%，并降低事件视觉里程计的绝对轨迹误差（ATE）13%。
Motivation: 现有事件相机处理方法难以在实时条件下有效区分由IMO和自身运动触发的事件，导致下游任务性能受限。
Method: 提出一个轻量级网络，联合学习事件流中的IMO分割和未来运动预测，实现对即将发生的动态事件的预期抑制。
Result: 在EVIMO基准上分割准确率优于先前方法67%，推理速度高53%（173 Hz）；加速Vision Transformer推理83%，降低视觉里程计ATE 13%。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效实时抑制IMO和自身运动事件，显著提升下游任务效率与精度，但未提及在极端运动或高动态场景下的泛化性。

papers.title: PATRA: Pattern-Aware Alignment and Balanced Reasoning for Time Series Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Time series reasoning demands both the perception of complex dynamics and logical depth. However, existing LLM-based approaches exhibit two limitations: they often treat time series merely as text or images, failing to capture the patterns like trends and seasonalities needed to answer specific questions; and when trained on a mix of simple and complex tasks, simpler objectives often dominate the learning process, hindering the development of deep reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose the Pattern-Aware Alignment and Balanced Reasoning model (PATRA), introducing a pattern-aware mechanism that extracts trend and seasonality patterns from time series to achieve deep alignment. Furthermore, we design a task-aware balanced reward to harmonize learning across tasks of varying difficulty, incentivizing the generation of coherent Chains of Thought. Extensive experiments show that PATRA outperforms strong baselines across diverse Time Series Question Answering (TSQA) tasks, demonstrating superior cross-modal understanding and reasoning capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PATRA模型，通过模式感知机制提取时间序列中的趋势和季节模式，并结合任务感知的平衡奖励，提升大语言模型在时间序列问答中的跨模态理解和推理能力。实验表明，该方法在多个TSQA任务上优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有LLM方法将时间序列视为文本或图像，难以捕获回答具体问题所需的趋势和季节性模式；同时，混合简单与复杂任务的训练中，简单目标主导学习过程，阻碍深度推理能力发展。
Method: 引入模式感知机制，提取时间序列的趋势和季节模式以实现深度对齐；设计任务感知的平衡奖励，协调不同难度任务的学习，鼓励生成连贯的思维链（CoT）。
Result: 在多样化时间序列问答任务上，PATRA优于强基线，展现了卓越的跨模态理解和推理能力。
Conclusion: 模式感知对齐与平衡奖励能有效提升LLM在时间序列推理上的表现，但未涉及特定领域（如天气）的验证。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: On Imbalanced Regression with Hoeffding Trees
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world applications generate continuous data streams for regression. Hoeffding trees and their variants have a long-standing tradition due to their effectiveness, either alone or as base models in broader ensembles. Recent batch-learning work shows that kernel density estimation (KDE) improves smoothed predictions in imbalanced regression [Yang et al., 2021], while hierarchical shrinkage (HS) provides post-hoc regularization for decision trees without modifying their structure [Agarwal et al., 2022]. We extend KDE to streaming settings via a telescoping formulation and integrate HS into incremental decision trees. Empirical evaluation on standard online regression benchmarks shows that KDE consistently improves early-stream performance, whereas HS provides limited gains. Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/marinaAlchirch/DSFA_2026.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, 2 algorithms, authors' version of paper accepted in PAKDD 2026 special session on Data Science: Foundations and Applications (DSFA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续数据流中的不平衡回归问题，将核密度估计（KDE）通过望远镜公式扩展到流式设置，并将层次收缩（HS）集成到增量决策树中。实验表明，KDE 一致提升了早期流性能，而 HS 提供的增益有限。
Motivation: 现有流式回归方法在处理不平衡数据时性能受限，而批处理中的 KDE 和 HS 方法尚未适应流式场景。
Method: 提出一种望远镜形式的 KDE 用于流式设置，并将 HS 作为增量决策树的后验正则化。
Result: 在标准在线回归基准上，KDE 一致提升早期流性能，HS 仅带来有限改进。
Conclusion: KDE 对流式不平衡回归有效，HS 在流式环境下效果有限。

papers.title: MineDraft: A Framework for Batch Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by using a smaller draft model to propose draft tokens that are subsequently verified by a larger target model. However, the performance of standard SD is often limited by the strictly sequential execution of these drafting and verification stages. To address this, this paper proposes MineDraft, a batch parallel speculative decoding (PSD) framework designed to effectively hide drafting latency by overlapping it with verification. Our theoretical analysis shows that PSD is substantially more efficient than standard SD. MineDraft realizes the PSD through a novel batch-parallel design that maintains two batches of requests, overlapping drafting for one batch with verification for the other. Our experimental results show significant improvements of MineDraft in both throughput (up to 75%) and end-to-end latency (up to 39%) over standard SD. Furthermore, we have implemented MineDraft as a plugin for vLLM, demonstrating its practicality for production-ready inference systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MineDraft，一种批并行推测解码（PSD）框架，通过将小模型起草与大模型验证阶段重叠执行，隐藏起草延迟。理论分析表明PSD比标准推测解码更高效，实验显示吞吐量提升高达75%，端到端延迟降低最多39%。该框架已作为vLLM插件实现。
Motivation: 标准推测解码（SD）中起草和验证阶段严格串行执行，限制了推理性能。本文旨在通过并行化这两个阶段来减少延迟、提高吞吐量。
Method: 提出批并行设计，维护两个请求批次，将一个批次的起草与另一个批次的验证重叠进行。理论分析证明了PSD的效率优势。
Result: 与标准SD相比，吞吐量提升高达75%，端到端延迟降低最多39%。在vLLM中作为插件实现，展示了生产就绪的实用性。
Conclusion: 批并行推测解码能有效隐藏起草延迟，显著提升推理效率，且易于集成到现有推理系统中。

papers.title: RU4D-SLAM: Reweighting Uncertainty in Gaussian Splatting SLAM for 4D Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Combining 3D Gaussian splatting with Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) has gained popularity as it enables continuous 3D environment reconstruction during motion. However, existing methods struggle in dynamic environments, particularly moving objects complicate 3D reconstruction and, in turn, hinder reliable tracking. The emergence of 4D reconstruction, especially 4D Gaussian splatting, offers a promising direction for addressing these challenges, yet its potential for 4D-aware SLAM remains largely underexplored. Along this direction, we propose a robust and efficient framework, namely Reweighting Uncertainty in Gaussian Splatting SLAM (RU4D-SLAM) for 4D scene reconstruction, that introduces temporal factors into spatial 3D representation while incorporating uncertainty-aware perception of scene changes, blurred image synthesis, and dynamic scene reconstruction. We enhance dynamic scene representation by integrating motion blur rendering, and improve uncertainty-aware tracking by extending per-pixel uncertainty modeling, which is originally designed for static scenarios, to handle blurred images. Furthermore, we propose a semantic-guided reweighting mechanism for per-pixel uncertainty estimation in dynamic scenes, and introduce a learnable opacity weight to support adaptive 4D mapping. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both trajectory accuracy and 4D scene reconstruction, particularly in dynamic environments with moving objects and low-quality inputs. Code available: https://ru4d-slam.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RU4D-SLAM框架，将时间因子引入3D高斯泼溅SLAM，通过不确定性重加权实现4D场景重建。该方法在动态场景中结合运动模糊渲染、每像素不确定性建模和语义引导的重加权机制，提升轨迹精度和4D重建质量。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅SLAM方法在动态环境中对移动物体处理不佳，导致跟踪不稳定；4D重建潜力未被充分探索。
Method: 提出包含时间因子的4D高斯泼溅表示，集成运动模糊渲染与扩展的每像素不确定性建模（从静态场景推广到模糊图像），并设计语义引导的每像素不确定性重加权机制和可学习不透明度权重，实现自适应4D建图。
Result: 在标准基准上，轨迹精度和4D场景重建质量显著优于现有方法，尤其在动态环境和低质量输入下。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知与语义重加权有效提升了SLAM在动态场景中的鲁棒性和重建效果，代码已开源。

papers.title: You Don't Need All That Attention: Surgical Memorization Mitigation in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have been shown to "memorize" certain training data, leading to verbatim or near-verbatim generating images, which may cause privacy concerns or copyright infringement. We introduce Guidance Using Attractive-Repulsive Dynamics (GUARD), a novel framework for memorization mitigation in text-to-image diffusion models. GUARD adjusts the image denoising process to guide the generation away from an original training image and towards one that is distinct from training data while remaining aligned with the prompt, guarding against reproducing training data, without hurting image generation quality. We propose a concrete instantiation of this framework, where the positive target that we steer towards is given by a novel method for (cross) attention attenuation based on (i) a novel statistical mechanism that automatically identifies the prompt positions where cross attention must be attenuated and (ii) attenuating cross-attention in these per-prompt locations. The resulting GUARD offers a surgical, dynamic per-prompt inference-time approach that, we find, is by far the most robust method in terms of consistently producing state-of-the-art results for memorization mitigation across two architectures and for both verbatim and template memorization, while also improving upon or yielding comparable results in terms of image quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GUARD框架，用于缓解文本到图像扩散模型中的记忆问题。GUARD通过吸引-排斥动态调整去噪过程，引导生成远离训练数据，同时保持提示对齐。具体实现基于统计机制自动识别需要衰减的提示位置，并在此处进行交叉注意力衰减。实验表明该方法在两个架构上对逐字和模板记忆均实现最先进的缓解效果，且不损害图像质量。
Motivation: 生成模型会记忆训练数据，导致生成图片与训练样本高度相似，引发隐私和版权问题。需要一种在不影响生成质量的前提下缓解记忆的方法。
Method: 提出GUARD框架，包含两个关键组件：1) 统计机制自动识别提示中需要衰减交叉注意力的位置；2) 在这些位置进行交叉注意力衰减，引导生成远离原始训练图像。
Result: 在两个架构上，对逐字记忆和模板记忆两种类型，GUARD一致地取得了最先进的记忆缓解效果，同时图像质量相比现有方法有提升或相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GUARD是一种手术式的、动态的、每个提示的推理时方法，是最鲁棒的记忆缓解方法。

papers.title: Contrastive meta-domain adaptation for robust skin lesion classification across clinical and acquisition conditions
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for dermatological image analysis remain sensitive to acquisition variability and domain-specific visual characteristics, leading to performance degradation when deployed in clinical settings. We investigate how visual artifacts and domain shifts affect deep learning-based skin lesion classification. We propose an adaptation strategy, grounded in the idea of visual meta-domains, that transfers visual representations from larger dermoscopic datasets into clinical image domains, thereby improving generalization robustness. Experiments across multiple dermatology datasets show consistent gains in classification performance and reduced gaps between dermoscopic and clinical images. These results emphasize the importance of domain-aware training for deployable systems.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, Published in: 2026 IEEE 23rd International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过视觉元域（meta-domain）自适应策略，将大尺度皮肤镜数据集上的视觉表示迁移到临床图像域，从而提升皮肤病变分类的鲁棒性。实验表明该方法在多个皮肤科数据集上一致提高了分类性能，缩小了皮肤镜与临床图像之间的性能差距。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在皮肤病学图像分析中受采集变异和域特定视觉特征影响，部署到临床环境时性能下降。现有方法缺乏对视觉伪影和域偏移的系统应对。
Method: 提出基于视觉元域（visual meta-domains）的自适应策略，将大型皮肤镜数据集学到的表示迁移到临床图像域，通过对比学习（contrastive learning）增强泛化鲁棒性。
Result: 在多个皮肤科数据集上的实验显示分类性能一致提升，并且皮肤镜图像与临床图像之间的性能差距显著缩小。
Conclusion: 域感知训练（domain-aware training）对于可部署的皮肤病变分类系统至关重要，该自适应策略能有效缓解域偏移问题。

papers.title: DerMAE: Improving skin lesion classification through conditioned latent diffusion and MAE distillation
papers.abstract_en: Skin lesion classification datasets often suffer from severe class imbalance, with malignant cases significantly underrepresented, leading to biased decision boundaries during deep learning training. We address this challenge using class-conditioned diffusion models to generate synthetic dermatological images, followed by self-supervised MAE pretraining to enable huge ViT models to learn robust, domain-relevant features. To support deployment in practical clinical settings, where lightweight models are required, we apply knowledge distillation to transfer these representations to a smaller ViT student suitable for mobile devices. Our results show that MAE pretraining on synthetic data, combined with distillation, improves classification performance while enabling efficient on-device inference for practical clinical use.

papers.title: Robust Predictive Uncertainty and Double Descent in Contaminated Bayesian Random Features
papers.abstract_en: We propose a robust Bayesian formulation of random feature (RF) regression that accounts explicitly for prior and likelihood misspecification via Huber-style contamination sets. Starting from the classical equivalence between ridge-regularized RF training and Bayesian inference with Gaussian priors and likelihoods, we replace the single prior and likelihood with $ε$- and $η$-contaminated credal sets, respectively, and perform inference using pessimistic generalized Bayesian updating. We derive explicit and tractable bounds for the resulting lower and upper posterior predictive densities. These bounds show that, when contamination is moderate, prior and likelihood ambiguity effectively acts as a direct contamination of the posterior predictive distribution, yielding uncertainty envelopes around the classical Gaussian predictive. We introduce an Imprecise Highest Density Region (IHDR) for robust predictive uncertainty quantification and show that it admits an efficient approximation via an adjusted Gaussian credible interval. We further obtain predictive variance bounds (under a mild truncation approximation for the upper bound) and prove that they preserve the leading-order proportional-growth asymptotics known for RF models. Together, these results establish a robustness theory for Bayesian random features: predictive uncertainty remains computationally tractable, inherits the classical double-descent phase structure, and is improved by explicit worst-case guarantees under bounded prior and likelihood misspecification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机特征回归中先验和似然设定错误的问题，提出基于Huber式污染集的鲁棒贝叶斯公式。通过将标准的高斯先验和似然替换为ε-和η-污染credal集，并使用悲观广义贝叶斯更新进行推断，推导出后验预测密度的上下界。引入不精确最高密度区域（IHDR）进行鲁棒不确定性量化，并证明其可近似为调整的高斯可信区间。同时，预测方差界保留了随机特征模型的渐进增长特性。结果建立了贝叶斯随机特征的鲁棒性理论，表明预测不确定性计算可行，继承双重下降结构，并在有界错误下具有最坏情况保证。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯随机特征回归假设先验和似然设定正确，但实际中常存在错误设定，导致预测不确定性不可靠。
Method: 采用Huber式污染集，用ε-污染credal集替代先验，η-污染credal集替代似然，通过悲观广义贝叶斯更新得到后验预测密度的上下界，并构建不精确最高密度区域（IHDR）作为鲁棒不确定性度量。
Result: 推导了后验预测密度的显式可处理界，证明污染较小时，先验和似然模糊性等效于直接污染后验预测分布；IHDR可近似为调整的高斯置信区间；预测方差界保留了随机特征模型的渐近增长特性。
Conclusion: 本文建立了贝叶斯随机特征的鲁棒性理论，表明在有限先验和似然错误下，预测不确定性仍可高效计算，并继承了经典的双重下降相变结构。

papers.title: NestRL: A Nested Training Regime for Mutual Adaptation in Human-AI Teaming
papers.abstract_en: Mutual adaptation is a central challenge in human-AI teaming, as humans naturally adjust their strategies in response to an AI agent's behavior. Existing approaches attempt to approximate human behavior by diversifying training partners; however, these partners are typically static and fail to capture the adaptive nature of human teammates. When agents are trained jointly in standard multi-agent settings, they often converge to opaque coordination strategies that work only with their co-trained partners, leading to poor generalization. To model adaptive human behavior, we formulate human-AI teaming as an Interactive Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (I-POMDP). We propose NestRL, a nested training regime that learns the solution to a finite-level I-POMDP by training agents at each level against adaptive agents from the level below. This exposes agents to adaptive behavior while preventing emergence of opaque coordination strategies. We provide theoretical analysis showing that NestRL agents avoid convergence to partner-specific strategies, and validate this empirically in the Overcooked domain against state-of-the-art baselines. NestRL achieves higher task performance with both unseen adaptive agents and real human teammates, while exhibiting significantly greater adaptability over the course of interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NestRL，一种用于人机团队相互适应的嵌套训练机制。基于I-POMDP形式化，通过分层训练防止收敛至特定伙伴策略，在Overcooked域上取得优于基线的方法，并在与未见自适应代理和真实人类队友合作时表现更好。
Motivation: 现有方法用静态训练伙伴无法捕捉人类的适应性，而标准多智能体训练易产生仅与共同训练的伙伴协作的特定策略，泛化性差。
Method: 将人机协作建模为交互式部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（I-POMDP），并设计嵌套训练架构：每层智能体与下一层的自适应智能体共同训练，从低到高逐层学习，避免产生仅适用于固定伙伴的策略。
Result: 在Overcook领域，NestRL在与未见自适应智能体和真实人类队友的任务绩效上优于现有基线，并在交互过程中表现出显著更高的适应性。
Conclusion: NestRL通过分层暴露自适应行为，有效防止收敛到伙伴特定策略，提升了人机团队中的相互适应能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Procedure: Substantive Fairness in Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction (CP) offers distribution-free uncertainty quantification for machine learning models, yet its interplay with fairness in downstream decision-making remains underexplored. Moving beyond CP as a standalone operation (procedural fairness), we analyze the holistic decision-making pipeline to evaluate substantive fairness-the equity of downstream outcomes. Theoretically, we derive an upper bound that decomposes prediction-set size disparity into interpretable components, clarifying how label-clustered CP helps control method-driven contributions to unfairness. To facilitate scalable empirical analysis, we introduce an LLM-in-the-loop evaluator that approximates human assessment of substantive fairness across diverse modalities. Our experiments show that label-clustered CP often provides a favorable balance between utility and substantive fairness, while reducing set-size disparities in line with our theory. Finally, we empirically show that equalized set sizes, rather than coverage, strongly correlate with improved substantive fairness, enabling practitioners to design more fair CP systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/llm-in-the-loop-conformal-fairness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将保形预测（conformal prediction）的公平性分析从程序公平扩展到实质性公平——即下游决策结果的公平性。理论上推导了预测集大小差异的上界，并将其分解为可解释成分，证明标签聚类CP有助于控制方法驱动的公平偏差。为便于大规模实证，引入LLM评估器近似人类对实质性公平的判断。实验表明标签聚类CP在效用与实质性公平之间取得良好平衡，且等化预测集大小（而非覆盖度）与实质性公平改善强相关。
Motivation: 现有保形预测研究主要关注其自身操作的程序公平性，但未深入分析其在下游决策中对实质性公平的影响，缺乏对决策全链条公平性的理论和实证工具。
Method: 理论推导预测集大小差异的上界分解公式，揭示标签聚类CP（label-clustered CP）对方法驱动不公平性的控制机制；并设计LLM-in-the-loop评估器，用于跨模态近似人类对实质性公平的判断。
Result: 实验显示标签聚类CP在效用与实质性公平间取得较好平衡，且等化预测集大小与实质性公平改善的相关性远强于等化覆盖度。
Conclusion: 本文为设计更公平的保形预测系统提供了理论框架和实用工具，指出通过调整预测集大小分布而非覆盖度可更有效地提升实质性公平。

papers.title: Flowers: A Warp Drive for Neural PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Flowers, a neural architecture for learning PDE solution operators built entirely from multihead warps. Aside from pointwise channel mixing and a multiscale scaffold, Flowers use no Fourier multipliers, no dot-product attention, and no convolutional mixing. Each head predicts a displacement field and warps the mixed input features. Motivated by physics and computational efficiency, displacements are predicted pointwise, without any spatial aggregation, and nonlocality enters only through sparse sampling at source coordinates, one per head. Stacking warps in multiscale residual blocks yields Flowers, which implement adaptive, global interactions at linear cost. We theoretically motivate this design through three complementary lenses: flow maps for conservation laws, waves in inhomogeneous media, and a kinetic-theoretic continuum limit. Flowers achieve excellent performance on a broad suite of 2D and 3D time-dependent PDE benchmarks, particularly flows and waves. A compact 17M-parameter model consistently outperforms Fourier, convolution, and attention-based baselines of similar size, while a 150M-parameter variant improves over recent transformer-based foundation models with much more parameters, data, and training compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Flowers，一种完全基于多头位移场Warp的神经网络架构，用于学习偏微分方程(PDE)的解算子。该架构避免使用傅里叶乘子、点积注意力和卷积混合，通过每个头独立预测位移场并稀疏采样实现全局交互，计算复杂度为线性。理论方面从守恒律流映射、非均匀介质波动和动力学极限三个角度提供动机。在多个2D和3D时变PDE基准上，17M参数模型一致优于同等规模的傅里叶、卷积和注意力基线，150M参数变体甚至超越更大规模的Transformer基础模型。
Motivation: 现有神经PDE求解器多依赖傅里叶乘子、注意力或卷积操作，这些方法在处理长程依赖或非线性问题时存在计算效率或表达能力的限制。本文旨在设计一种高效且具有物理动机的架构，实现自适应的全局交互，同时保持线性计算成本。
Method: 提出Flowers架构，核心是多头Warp操作：每个头预测一个位移场，将混合后的输入特征进行空间Warp。位移场仅通过逐点预测获得，无需空间聚合；非局部性仅通过每个头在源坐标处的稀疏采样引入。通过多层残差Warp块堆叠构成整体网络。理论动机包括守恒律流的流映射、非均匀介质的波动方程以及动力学极限。
Result: 在2D和3D时变PDE基准测试中，Flowers取得优异性能。17M参数模型一致超越同尺寸的傅里叶神经网络、卷积网络和注意力网络基线；150M参数变体进一步超越近期更大参数规模、更多数据和训练计算量的Transformer基础模型。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过精心设计基于位移场的Warp操作，可以在不依赖傅里叶或注意力机制的情况下实现高效的全局交互，为神经PDE求解器提供了一种新的强基线。目前方法在时间依赖的流动和波动问题上表现突出，但未直接探讨稳态问题或更广泛的PDE类别。
Relevance: 65

papers.title: Benchmarking at the Edge of Comprehension
papers.abstract_en: As frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly saturate new benchmarks shortly after they are published, benchmarking itself is at a juncture: if frontier models keep improving, it will become increasingly hard for humans to generate discriminative tasks, provide accurate ground-truth answers, or evaluate complex solutions. If benchmarking becomes infeasible, our ability to measure any progress in AI is at stake. We refer to this scenario as the post-comprehension regime. In this work, we propose Critique-Resilient Benchmarking, an adversarial framework designed to compare models even when full human understanding is infeasible. Our technique relies on the notion of critique-resilient correctness: an answer is deemed correct if no adversary has convincingly proved otherwise. Unlike standard benchmarking, humans serve as bounded verifiers and focus on localized claims, which preserves evaluation integrity beyond full comprehension of the task. Using an itemized bipartite Bradley-Terry model, we jointly rank LLMs by their ability to solve challenging tasks and to generate difficult yet solvable questions. We showcase the effectiveness of our method in the mathematical domain across eight frontier LLMs, showing that the resulting scores are stable and correlate with external capability measures. Our framework reformulates benchmarking as an adversarial generation-evaluation game in which humans serve as final adjudicators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前沿大语言模型迅速饱和新基准时，人类可能难以生成有区分度的任务、提供准确答案或评估复杂解法，进入“后理解”时代。为此提出“批判弹性基准测试”，通过对抗框架比较模型：答案正确性定义为无对手能令人信服地证伪，人类作为有限验证者聚焦局部论断。利用分项二分Bradley-Terry模型联合排名模型解题和出题能力，在数学领域八个前沿LLM上验证了稳定性并与外部能力指标相关。
Motivation: 前沿LLM快速饱和新基准，人类难以生成有区分度的任务、提供准确答案或评估复杂解法，导致基准测试可能失效，进而威胁对AI进展的测量能力。
Method: 提出Critique-Resilient Benchmarking：基于对抗框架，以“无对手能令人信服地证伪”作为答案正确标准；人类作为有限验证者，聚焦局部论断；采用分项二分Bradley-Terry模型联合排名模型的解题和出题能力。
Result: 在数学领域八个前沿LLM上，该方法导出的得分稳定且与外部能力指标相关。
Conclusion: 该框架将基准测试重构为对抗生成-评估游戏，人类作为最终裁决者，旨在保持超越人类完全理解时的评估完整性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DenseMLLM: Standard Multimodal LLMs for Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in high-level visual understanding. However, extending these models to fine-grained dense prediction tasks, such as semantic segmentation and depth estimation, typically necessitates the incorporation of complex, task-specific decoders and other customizations. This architectural fragmentation increases model complexity and deviates from the generalist design of MLLMs, ultimately limiting their practicality. In this work, we challenge this paradigm by accommodating standard MLLMs to perform dense predictions without requiring additional task-specific decoders. The proposed model is called DenseMLLM, grounded in the standard architecture with a novel vision token supervision strategy for multiple labels and tasks. Despite its minimalist design, our model achieves highly competitive performance across a wide range of dense prediction and vision-language benchmarks, demonstrating that a standard, general-purpose MLLM can effectively support dense perception without architectural specialization. This project is available at github.com/Eli-YiLi/DenseMLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DenseMLLM，将标准多模态大语言模型（MLLM）直接用于密集预测任务（如语义分割、深度估计），无需额外任务特定解码器。通过新颖的视觉token监督策略，模型在多个密集预测和视觉语言基准上取得有竞争力的性能，证明通用MLLM可有效支持密集感知。
Motivation: 现有MLLM扩展至密集预测需要复杂任务特定解码器和定制化设计，增加了模型复杂度并偏离通用设计理念，限制了实用性。本文旨在消除这种架构碎片化。
Method: 基于标准MLLM架构，引入视觉token监督策略，支持多标签和多任务训练，无需添加任务特定解码器。
Result: 在密集预测和视觉语言基准上取得高度竞争性能，表明标准通用MLLM能有效支持密集预测。
Conclusion: DenseMLLM挑战了密集预测需要专用解码器的范式，展示了标准MLLM的通用性潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WISE: A Multimodal Search Engine for Visual Scenes, Audio, Objects, Faces, Speech, and Metadata
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present WISE, an open-source audiovisual search engine which integrates a range of multimodal retrieval capabilities into a single, practical tool accessible to users without machine learning expertise. WISE supports natural-language and reverse-image queries at both the scene level (e.g. empty street) and object level (e.g. horse) across images and videos; face-based search for specific individuals; audio retrieval of acoustic events using text (e.g. wood creak) or an audio file; search over automatically transcribed speech; and filtering by user-provided metadata. Rich insights can be obtained by combining queries across modalities -- for example, retrieving German trains from a historical archive by applying the object query "train" and the metadata query "Germany", or searching for a face in a place. By employing vector search techniques, WISE can scale to support efficient retrieval over millions of images or thousands of hours of video. Its modular architecture facilitates the integration of new models. WISE can be deployed locally for private or sensitive collections, and has been applied to various real-world use cases. Our code is open-source and available at https://gitlab.com/vgg/wise/wise.
papers.journal_ref: International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 WISE，一个开源的多模态视听搜索引擎，整合了自然语言与反向图像搜索、人脸搜索、音频事件检索、自动语音转录搜索以及元数据过滤等功能。通过向量搜索技术，系统可扩展至数百万图像或数千小时视频的高效检索，支持本地部署以保护隐私，并已应用于多个实际场景。
Motivation: 现有检索工具通常仅支持单一模态或需要机器学习专业知识，缺乏一个整合多种模态（视觉、音频、人脸、语音、元数据）且易于使用的通用搜索引擎。
Method: 采用模块化架构，集成多种预训练模型（如视觉、人脸、音频嵌入），通过向量搜索实现跨模态查询（如文本-图像、音频-文本、混合查询）。支持场景级与目标级搜索，以及基于用户元数据的过滤。
Result: 系统可高效检索百万级图像或数千小时视频，并在实际用例（如历史档案检索、特定场所人脸搜索）中验证了其跨模态查询的实用性。
Conclusion: WISE 作为一个开源工具，降低了多模态检索的使用门槛，其模块化设计便于扩展，且本地部署能力适用于敏感数据场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PathCRF: Ball-Free Soccer Event Detection via Possession Path Inference from Player Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances in AI, event data collection in soccer still relies heavily on labor-intensive manual annotation. Although prior work has explored automatic event detection using player and ball trajectories, ball tracking also remains difficult to scale due to high infrastructural and operational costs. As a result, comprehensive data collection in soccer is largely confined to top-tier competitions, limiting the broader adoption of data-driven analysis in this domain. To address this challenge, this paper proposes PathCRF, a framework for detecting on-ball soccer events using only player tracking data. We model player trajectories as a fully connected dynamic graph and formulate event detection as the problem of selecting exactly one edge corresponding to the current possession state at each time step. To ensure logical consistency of the resulting edge sequence, we employ a Conditional Random Field (CRF) that forbids impossible transitions between consecutive edges, where emission and transition scores are dynamically computed from edge embeddings produced by a socio-temporal backbone architecture. During inference, the most probable edge sequence is obtained via Viterbi decoding, and events such as ball controls or passes are detected whenever the selected edge changes between adjacent time steps. Experiments show that PathCRF produces accurate, logically consistent possession paths, enabling reliable downstream analyses while substantially reducing the need for manual event annotation. The source code is available at https://github.com/hyunsungkim-ds/pathcrf.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PathCRF，一种仅利用球员追踪数据检测足球事件（如控球、传球）的框架。通过将球员轨迹建模为全连接动态图，并使用条件随机场（CRF）在时间步上选择表示当前控球状态的边，同时禁止逻辑上不可能的边过渡，从而实现无需球追踪数据的事件检测。实验表明，该方法能产生准确且逻辑一致的控球路径，显著减少手动事件标注的需求。
Motivation: 足球事件数据收集依赖昂贵的人工标注，而球追踪数据难以规模化获取，导致数据分析局限于顶级赛事。为此，需要一种仅使用球员追踪数据的低成本自动事件检测方法。
Method: 将球员轨迹构建为全连接动态图，每个时间步从图中选择一条边表示控球状态。使用条件随机场（CRF）建模边序列，通过从边嵌入动态计算的发射和转移分数，禁止不可能的状态转移，并通过维特比解码得到最优边序列。事件检测通过相邻时间步边变化实现。
Result: 实验产生准确且逻辑一致的控球路径，支持可靠的下游分析，同时大幅减少对手动事件标注的依赖。
Conclusion: PathCRF有效利用球员轨迹推断控球状态，为无球追踪数据的足球事件检测提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Prototype Transformer: Towards Language Model Architectures Interpretable by Design
papers.abstract_en: While state-of-the-art language models (LMs) surpass most humans in certain domains, their reasoning remains largely opaque, reducing trust and increasing the risk of deception and hallucination. We introduce the Prototype Transformer (ProtoT), an autoregressive LM architecture that replaces the quadratic-cost self-attention module of the Transformer with a linear-cost module based on prototypes, which are learned parameter vectors. In ProtoT, prototypes create communication channels that aggregate contextual information at different time scales. We show that this structure leads prototypes to automatically capture nameable concepts, such as "woman", during training, offering a path toward interpreting model reasoning and making targeted edits to model behavior. Compared with baselines, ProtoT scales well with model and data size, is robust to input perturbations, and performs well on text generation and downstream tasks, including GLUE. These results suggest that ProtoT is a promising step toward autoregressive language models that are more interpretable by design.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Equal contribution: Yordan Yordanov and Matteo Forasassi. 40 pages, 28 figures, 22 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出原型Transformer（ProtoT），一种自回归语言模型架构，用线性复杂度的原型模块替代二次复杂度的自注意力模块。原型作为通信通道聚合不同时间尺度的上下文信息，训练后自动捕获可命名概念（如“女人”），为模型推理解释和行为编辑提供路径。实验表明ProtoT在模型规模扩展性、输入鲁棒性、文本生成及GLUE等下游任务上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有语言模型推理过程不透明，导致信任缺失以及欺骗和幻觉风险增加。
Method: ProtoT用原型向量替代Transformer的自注意力机制，原型在不同时间尺度上聚合上下文信息，形成线性的通信通道。
Result: ProtoT在扩展性、鲁棒性、文本生成和GLUE任务上均达到良好表现，且原型自动学习到可解释的概念。
Conclusion: ProtoT是迈向设计上更可解释的自回归语言模型的有前景的一步。

papers.title: Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Bayesian Non-negative Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Reward models learned from human preferences are central to aligning large language models (LLMs) via reinforcement learning from human feedback, yet they are often vulnerable to reward hacking due to noisy annotations and systematic biases such as response length or style. We propose Bayesian Non-Negative Reward Model (BNRM), a principled reward modeling framework that integrates non-negative factor analysis into Bradley-Terry (BT) preference model. BNRM represents rewards through a sparse, non-negative latent factor generative process that operates at two complementary levels: instance-specific latent variables induce disentangled reward representations, while sparsity over global latent factors acts as an implicit debiasing mechanism that suppresses spurious correlations. Together, this disentanglement-then-debiasing structure enables robust uncertainty-aware reward learning. To scale BNRM to modern LLMs, we develop an amortized variational inference network conditioned on deep model representations, allowing efficient end-to-end training. Extensive empirical results demonstrate that BNRM substantially mitigates reward over-optimization, improves robustness under distribution shifts, and yields more interpretable reward decompositions than strong baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted as an Oral presentation at ICML 2026. The code is available at https://github.com/GuoweiRong/Bayesian-Non-negative-Reward-Model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯非负奖励模型（BNRM），将非负因子分析融入Bradley-Terry偏好模型，通过实例特定潜在变量和全局稀疏性实现奖励表示的解缠与去偏，从而缓解RLHF中的奖励黑客问题。实验表明BNRM能有效减轻奖励过度优化、提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性，并得到更可解释的奖励分解。
Motivation: 人类偏好学习的奖励模型因噪声标注和系统偏差（如响应长度或风格）容易受到奖励黑客攻击，影响大语言模型的对齐效果。
Method: 提出BNRM，将非负因子分析与Bradley-Terry模型结合，通过实例特定潜在变量生成解缠的奖励表示，并利用全局因子稀疏性作为隐式去偏机制，同时使用条件于深度模型表示的摊销变分推理网络实现高效端到端训练。
Result: 实验表明BNRM显著缓解奖励过度优化，提高分布偏移下的鲁棒性，并比强基线提供更可解释的奖励分解。
Conclusion: BNRM通过解缠-去偏结构实现鲁棒的不确定性感知奖励学习，有效缓解奖励黑客问题，适用于现代大语言模型。

papers.title: WildCat: Near-Linear Attention in Theory and Practice
papers.abstract_en: We introduce WildCat, a high-accuracy, low-cost approach to compressing the attention mechanism in neural networks. While attention is a staple of modern network architectures, it is also notoriously expensive to deploy due to resource requirements that scale quadratically with the input sequence length $n$. WildCat avoids these quadratic costs by only attending over a small weighted coreset. Crucially, we select the coreset using a fast but spectrally-accurate subsampling algorithm -- randomly pivoted Cholesky -- and weight the elements optimally to minimise reconstruction error. Remarkably, given bounded inputs, WildCat approximates exact attention with super-polynomial $O(n^{-\sqrt{\log(\log(n))}})$ error decay while running in near-linear $O(n^{1+o(1)})$ time. In contrast, prior practical approximations either lack error guarantees or require quadratic runtime to guarantee such high fidelity. We couple this advance with a GPU-optimized PyTorch implementation and a suite of benchmark experiments demonstrating the benefits of WildCat for image generation, image classification, and language model KV cache compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WildCat 是一种高精度、低成本的注意力机制压缩方法，通过随机 pivoted Cholesky 算法快速选择加权核心集（weighted coreset）来近似标准注意力。理论上，对于有界输入，WildCat 实现超多项式误差衰减 O(n^{-√(log log n)}) 和近线性时间 O(n^{1+o(1)})。实验表明，WildCat 在图像生成、图像分类和语言模型 KV 缓存压缩任务中均取得良好效果。
Motivation: 标准注意力机制的复杂度随序列长度二次增长，限制了其在长序列上的实际部署。现有近似方法要么缺乏误差保证，要么为保证高保真度仍需二次时间。
Method: 提出使用随机 pivoted Cholesky 算法快速选择少量核心元素并赋予最优权重，以最小化重构误差，从而在线性时间内近似精确注意力。同时提供 GPU 优化的 PyTorch 实现。
Result: 理论保证：有界输入下误差衰减为 O(n^{-√(log log n)})，运行时间为 O(n^{1+o(1)})。实验证明：在图像生成、分类任务以及语言模型 KV 缓存压缩中，WildCat 显著降低计算开销同时保持模型性能。
Conclusion: WildCat 在理论和实践上实现了近乎线性的注意力机制压缩，为长序列 Transformer 的高效部署提供了新方案。

papers.title: The Entropic Signature of Class Speciation in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models do not recover semantic structure uniformly over time. Instead, samples transition from semantic ambiguity to class commitment within a narrow regime. Recent theoretical work attributes this transition to dynamical instabilities along class-separating directions, but practical methods to detect and exploit these windows in trained models are still limited. We show that tracking the class-conditional entropy of a latent semantic variable given the noisy state provides a reliable signature of these transition regimes. By restricting the entropy to semantic partitions, the entropy can furthermore resolve semantic decisions at different levels of abstraction. We analyze this behavior in high-dimensional Gaussian mixture models and show that the entropy rate concentrates on the same logarithmic time scale as the speciation symmetry-breaking instability previously identified in variance-preserving diffusion. We validate our method on EDM2-XS and Stable Diffusion 1.5, where class-conditional entropy consistently isolates the noise regimes critical for semantic structure formation. Finally, we use our framework to quantify how guidance redistributes semantic information over time. Together, these results connect information-theoretic and statistical physics perspectives on diffusion and provide a principled basis for time-localized control.
papers.comment: Accepted at International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散模型中语义结构形成的时间窗口，提出通过跟踪潜在语义变量的类条件熵来检测从语义模糊到类别承诺的转变。在高斯混合模型中分析熵率与对称破缺不稳定性的时间尺度一致性，并在EDM2-XS和Stable Diffusion 1.5上验证该方法能隔离关键噪声区间，最后量化引导（guidance）如何随时间重分配语义信息。
Motivation: 扩散模型恢复语义结构的时间不均匀，现有理论归因于动力不稳定性，但缺少实用的检测和利用这些窗口的方法。
Method: 通过跟踪给定噪声状态下潜语义变量的类条件熵，并限制熵到语义分区以解析不同抽象层次的语义决策。在高斯混合模型中分析熵率行为，并在实际扩散模型上验证。
Result: 类条件熵在方差保持扩散中与对称破缺不稳定性相同的对数时间尺度上集中；在EDM2-XS和Stable Diffusion 1.5上能一致隔离语义结构形成的关键噪声区间；量化了引导对语义信息时间分布的影响。
Conclusion: 本文连接了信息论和统计物理视角，为扩散模型的时间局部控制提供了原理性基础。

papers.title: Beware of the Batch Size: Hyperparameter Bias in Evaluating LoRA
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a standard approach for fine-tuning large language models, yet its many variants report conflicting empirical gains, often on the same benchmarks. We show that these contradictions arise from a single overlooked factor: the batch size. When properly tuned, vanilla LoRA often matches the performance of more complex variants. We further propose a proxy-based, cost-efficient strategy for batch size tuning, revealing the impact of rank, dataset size, and model capacity on the optimal batch size. Our findings elevate batch size from a minor implementation detail to a first-order design parameter, reconciling prior inconsistencies and enabling more reliable evaluations of LoRA variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现低秩适配（LoRA）变体之间的性能矛盾很大程度上源于被忽视的超参数——批次大小。通过适当调整批次大小，原始LoRA通常能与更复杂的变体匹配。论文提出一种基于代理的成本高效批次大小调优策略，揭示了秩、数据集规模及模型容量对最优批次大小的影响。
Motivation: LoRA及其众多变体在相同基准上报告了相互矛盾的实证结果，原因不明。
Method: 提出基于代理（proxy-based）的成本高效批次大小调优策略，并系统分析批次大小对LoRA性能的影响。
Result: 当批次大小被适当调整后，原始LoRA常常匹配甚至超过更复杂变体的表现；最优批次大小受秩、数据集规模和模型容量影响。
Conclusion: 批次大小应被视为LoRA调优中的一阶设计参数，而非实现细节，这有助于统一此前不一致的评估结果。

papers.title: Online Learning in MDPs with Partially Adversarial Transitions and Losses
papers.abstract_en: We study reinforcement learning in MDPs whose transition function is stochastic at most steps but may behave adversarially at a fixed subset of $Λ$ steps per episode. This model captures environments that are stable except at a few vulnerable points. We introduce \emph{conditioned occupancy measures}, which remain stable across episodes even with adversarial transitions, and use them to design two algorithms. The first handles arbitrary adversarial steps and achieves regret $\tilde{O}(H S^Λ\sqrt{K S A^{Λ+1}})$, where $K$ is the number of episodes, $S$ is the number of state, $A$ is the number of actions and $H$ is the episode's horizon. The second, assuming the adversarial steps are consecutive, improves the dependence on $S$ to $\tilde{O}(H\sqrt{K S^{3} A^{Λ+1}})$. We further give a $K^{2/3}$-regret reduction that removes the need to know which steps are the $Λ$ adversarial steps. We also characterize the regret of adversarial MDPs in the \emph{fully adversarial} setting ($Λ=H-1$) both for full-information and bandit feedback, and provide almost matching upper and lower bounds (slightly strengthen existing lower bounds, and clarify how different feedback structures affect the hardness of learning).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在大部分步骤转移函数随机、但每回合固定Λ个步骤具有对抗性的MDP中的强化学习。提出“条件占用度量”概念，并设计两种算法：第一种处理任意对抗步骤，实现regret ~O(H S^Λ√(KS A^{Λ+1}))；第二种假设对抗步骤连续，将S的依赖改进至~O(H√(K S^3 A^{Λ+1}))。还给出K^{2/3} regret reduction以消除已知对抗步集的需求，并分析了完全对抗设置下的regret边界。
Motivation: 现有MDP模型要么完全随机，要么完全对抗，但实际环境往往在大部分步骤稳定、仅在少数脆弱点受对抗干扰，缺乏对此类混合模型的系统分析。
Method: 引入条件占用度量（conditioned occupancy measures），该度量在对抗转移下仍保持回合间稳定；基于此设计两种算法，分别针对任意对抗步和连续对抗步场景，并给出无需预知对抗步的regret reduction方法。
Result: 算法在部分对抗MDP中取得与Λ指数相关的regret上界；完全对抗设置下给出了匹配的上下界，并强化了现有下界。
Conclusion: 本文刻画了部分对抗转移与损失MDP的可学习性，表明对抗步数Λ是核心难度参数，且反馈结构（全信息vs. bandit）对regret有本质影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning To Sample From Diffusion Models Via Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generate samples through an iterative denoising process guided by a pretrained neural network. Once the denoiser is fixed, the sampling algorithm itself (noise schedules, guidance scales, stochasticity profiles) still requires careful tuning, a process typically carried out through costly empirical grid search. In this work, we introduce an inverse reinforcement learning framework for learning sampling strategies without retraining the denoiser. We formulate the diffusion sampling procedure as a discrete-time finite-horizon Markov Decision Process, where actions correspond to optional modifications of the sampling dynamics. To optimize action scheduling, we avoid defining an explicit reward function and instead directly match the target behavior expected from the sampler using policy gradient techniques. We provide experimental evidence that this approach matches fine-tuned samplers and comes at a modest cost compared to grid search: on ImageNet-64, a single training run replaces exhaustive search at up to 9x lower cost, with only 16% overhead at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个逆强化学习框架来学习扩散模型的采样策略，无需重新训练去噪器。将采样过程建模为离散时间有限步马尔可夫决策过程，通过策略梯度直接匹配目标采样行为，避免了显式奖励函数定义。在ImageNet-64上的实验表明，该方法能以较低成本匹配调优后的采样器，替代穷举网格搜索。
Motivation: 扩散模型采样过程中噪声调度、引导尺度、随机性曲线等超参数需要手动调优，通常依赖昂贵的网格搜索，缺乏自动化采样策略学习方法。
Method: 将扩散采样过程构建为离散时间有限步MDP，动作对应采样动力学的可选修改；使用逆强化学习中的策略梯度方法直接匹配目标采样行为，无需定义显式奖励函数。
Result: 在ImageNet-64上，单次训练运行替代了穷举网格搜索，成本降低至原来的1/9以下，推理时仅增加16%开销。
Conclusion: 该方法能够自动学习高效采样策略，避免手动调优且计算成本可控，但摘要未提及局限性与更广泛适用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Predicting Future Utility: Global Combinatorial Optimization for Task-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract_en: Given the quadratic complexity of attention, KV cache eviction is vital to accelerate model inference. Current KV cache eviction methods typically rely on instantaneous heuristic metrics, implicitly assuming that score magnitudes are consistent proxies for importance across all heads. However, this overlooks the heterogeneity in predictive fidelity across attention heads. While certain heads prioritize the instantaneous contribution of tokens, others are dedicated to capturing long-horizon utility. In this paper, we propose that optimal budget allocation should be governed by the marginal utility in preserving long-term semantic information. Building on this insight, we propose LU-KV, a novel framework that formulates head-level budget allocation as a global combinatorial optimization problem to maximize the long-horizon marginal contribution of reserved tokens. To solve this non-convex problem, we employ a convex-hull relaxation and a marginal-utility-based greedy solver, achieving near-optimal solutions. Furthermore, we implement a data-driven offline profiling protocol to facilitate the practical deployment of LU-KV. Evaluations on LongBench and RULER benchmarks demonstrate that LU-KV reduces KV cache size by 80% with minimal performance degradation, while also decreasing inference latency and GPU memory footprint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对KV缓存驱逐中忽略注意力头异质性的问题，提出LU-KV框架，将头部级预算分配建模为全局组合优化问题，通过最大化保留token的长期边际贡献来优化预算。采用凸包松弛和基于边际效用的贪心求解器获得近优解。在LongBench和RULER上，LU-KV可减少80%的KV缓存大小，性能下降极小，并降低推理延迟和GPU内存占用。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存驱逐方法依赖瞬时启发式指标，假设得分大小在所有头上是一致的重要性代理，但忽略了注意力头在预测保真度上的异质性：某些头关注瞬时贡献，另一些头捕捉长期效用。
Method: 将头部级预算分配形式化为全局组合优化问题，以最大化保留token的长期边际贡献；采用凸包松弛将非凸问题转化为可解形式，并设计基于边际效用的贪心求解器实现近优分配。
Result: 在LongBench和RULER基准上，LU-KV将KV缓存大小减少80%，性能下降极小，同时降低推理延迟和GPU内存占用。
Conclusion: 本文表明，考虑长期边际效用进行预算分配能更有效地保留语义信息，为KV缓存驱逐提供了新视角。

papers.title: retinalysis-vascx: An explainable software toolbox for the extraction of retinal vascular biomarkers
papers.abstract_en: Automatic extraction of retinal vascular biomarkers from color fundus images (CFI) is crucial for large-scale studies of the retinal vasculature. We present VascX, an open-source Python toolbox that extracts biomarkers from CFI artery-vein segmentations. VascX starts from vessel segmentation masks, extracts their skeletons, builds undirected and directed vessel graphs, and resolves vessel segments into longer vessels. A comprehensive set of biomarkers is derived, including vascular density, central retinal equivalents (CREs), and tortuosity. Spatially localized biomarkers may be calculated over grids placed relative to the fovea and optic disc. VascX is released via GitHub and PyPI with comprehensive documentation and examples. Our test-retest reproducibility analysis on repeat imaging of the same eye by different devices shows that most VascX biomarkers have moderate to excellent agreement (ICC > 0.5), with important differences in the level of robustness of different biomarkers. Our analyses of biomarker sensitivity to image perturbations and heuristic parameter values support these differences and further characterize VascX biomarkers. Ultimately, VascX provides an explainable and easily modifiable feature-extraction toolbox that complements segmentation to produce reliable retinal vascular biomarkers. Our graph-based biomarker computation stages support reproducible, region-aware measurements suited for large-scale clinical and epidemiological research. By enabling easy extraction of existing biomarkers and rapid experimentation with new ones, VascX supports oculomics research. Its robustness and computational efficiency facilitate scalable deployment in large databases, while open-source distribution lowers barriers to adoption for ophthalmic researchers and clinicians.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍VascX，一个开源Python工具箱，用于从彩色眼底图像（CFI）的动静脉分割中提取视网膜血管生物标志物。该工具箱从血管分割掩膜出发，提取骨架、构建血管图并分解血管段，计算血管密度、中央视网膜等值（CRE）和迂曲度等生物标志物，并支持相对于中央凹和视盘的空间局部计算。重现性分析表明大多数标志物具有中度到极好的一致性（ICC > 0.5），但不同标志物的稳健性存在差异。VascX提供可解释、易修改的特征提取，适用于大规模临床和流行病学研究。
Motivation: 自动提取视网膜血管生物标志物对大规模视网膜血管研究至关重要，但现有工具在可解释性、稳健性和易用性方面存在不足。
Method: VascX从血管分割掩膜开始，提取骨架、构建无向和有向血管图，并解析血管段。基于图计算多种生物标志物，包括血管密度、中央视网膜等值、迂曲度等，并支持在相对于中央凹和视盘的网格上计算空间局部标志物。工具箱通过GitHub和PyPI发布，附带文档和示例。
Result: 测试-重测重现性分析显示大多数VascX生物标志物具有中度到极好的一致性（ICC > 0.5），但对图像扰动和启发式参数值的敏感性分析揭示了不同标志物稳健性的重要差异。
Conclusion: VascX作为一个可解释且易修改的特征提取工具箱，补充分割方法以产生可靠的视网膜血管生物标志物，其基于图的计算支持可重复、区域感知的测量，适用于大规模临床和流行病学研究，并通过开源发布降低使用门槛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Picasso: Holistic Scene Reconstruction with Physics-Constrained Sampling
papers.abstract_en: In the presence of occlusions and measurement noise, geometrically accurate scene reconstructions -- which fit the sensor data -- can still be physically incorrect. For instance, when estimating the poses and shapes of objects in the scene and importing the resulting estimates into a simulator, small errors might translate to implausible configurations including object interpenetration or unstable equilibrium. This makes it difficult to predict the dynamic behavior of the scene using a digital twin, an important step in simulation-based planning and control of contact-rich behaviors. In this paper, we posit that object pose and shape estimation requires reasoning holistically over the scene (instead of reasoning about each object in isolation), accounting for object interactions and physical plausibility. Towards this goal, our first contribution is Picasso, a physics-constrained reconstruction pipeline that builds multi-object scene reconstructions by considering geometry, non-penetration, and physics. Picasso relies on a fast rejection sampling method that reasons over multi-object interactions, leveraging an inferred object contact graph to guide samples. Second, we propose the Picasso dataset, a collection of 10 contact-rich real-world scenes with ground truth annotations, as well as a metric to quantify physical plausibility, which we open-source as part of our benchmark. Finally, we provide an extensive evaluation of Picasso on our newly introduced dataset and on the YCB-V dataset, and show it largely outperforms the state of the art while providing reconstructions that are both physically plausible and more aligned with human intuition.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Picasso，一种物理约束的场景重建管线，通过快速拒绝采样方法结合物体接触图，在存在遮挡和噪声的情况下同时优化几何、非穿透性和物理合理性，输出多物体场景重建。在自建数据集和YCB-V数据集上，该方法在物理合理性和重建精度上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统几何重建即使准确拟合传感器数据，仍可能产生物体相互穿透或不稳定平衡等物理不合理配置，影响数字孪生对接触丰富场景的动态预测。
Method: 提出Picasso管线，利用推断的物体接触图指导快速拒绝采样，在多物体交互中联合考虑几何、非穿透约束和物理可行性。
Result: 在自建10个真实接触丰富场景数据集和YCB-V数据集上，Picasso在物理合理性指标和重建精度上大幅超越现有基线。
Conclusion: 整体性场景推理结合物理约束能有效提升重建的物理合理性，且基于接触图的采样方法在效率上具有优势。

papers.title: Controllable Value Alignment in Large Language Models through Neuron-Level Editing
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values has become increasingly important as their influence on human behavior and decision-making expands. However, existing steering-based alignment methods suffer from limited controllability: steering a target value often unintentionally activates other, non-target values. To characterize this limitation, we introduce value leakage, a diagnostic notion that captures the unintended activation of non-target values during value steering, along with a normalized leakage metric grounded in Schwartz's value theory. In light of this analysis, we propose NeVA, a neuron-level editing framework for controllable value alignment in LLMs. NeVA identifies sparse, value-relevant neurons and performs inference-time activation editing, enabling fine-grained control without parameter updates or retraining. Experiments show that NeVA achieves stronger target value alignment while incurring smaller performance degradation on general capability. Moreover, NeVA significantly reduces the average leakage, with residual effects largely confined to semantically related value classes. Overall, NeVA offers a more controllable and interpretable mechanism for value alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NeVA框架，通过神经元级编辑（neuron-level editing）在推理时对LLM进行可控的价值对齐，解决现有方法中目标价值调整导致非目标价值无意激活（价值泄漏）的问题。基于Schwartz价值理论定义归一化泄漏指标，实验表明NeVA在增强目标价值对齐的同时减少性能下降，且泄漏主要限于语义相关的价值类别。
Motivation: 现有基于引导（steering）的对齐方法可控性有限，调整目标价值时常意外激活非目标价值，即价值泄漏（value leakage），亟需更精细的控制手段。
Method: 提出NeVA框架，通过识别稀疏的价值相关神经元，在推理时进行激活编辑（activation editing），无需参数更新或重训练，实现细粒度的价值对齐控制。
Result: 实验表明NeVA在增强目标价值对齐的同时，通用能力下降更小；平均泄漏显著降低，残余效应主要限于语义相关的价值类别。
Conclusion: NeVA为价值对齐提供了更可控、更可解释的机制，但其泄漏分析依赖于Schwartz价值理论的分类框架，可能不完全适用于所有文化语境。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Principled Synthetic Data Enables the First Scaling Laws for LLMs in Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) represent a promising frontier for recommender systems, yet their development has been impeded by the absence of predictable scaling laws, which are crucial for guiding research and optimizing resource allocation. We hypothesize that this may be attributed to the inherent noise, bias, and incompleteness of raw user interaction data in prior continual pre-training (CPT) efforts. This paper introduces a novel, layered framework for generating high-quality synthetic data that circumvents such issues by creating a curated, pedagogical curriculum for the LLM. We provide powerful, direct evidence for the utility of our curriculum by showing that standard sequential models trained on our principled synthetic data significantly outperform ($+130\%$ on recall@100 for SasRec) models trained on real data in downstream ranking tasks, demonstrating its superiority for learning generalizable user preference patterns. Building on this, we empirically demonstrate, for the first time, robust power-law scaling for an LLM that is continually pre-trained on our high-quality, recommendation-specific data. Our experiments reveal consistent and predictable perplexity reduction across multiple synthetic data modalities. These findings establish a foundational methodology for reliable scaling LLM capabilities in the recommendation domain, thereby shifting the research focus from mitigating data deficiencies to leveraging high-quality, structured information.
