papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在推荐系统中缺乏可预测缩放定律的问题，提出一种分层框架生成高质量合成数据，通过精心设计的教学课程用于LLM持续预训练。实验表明，标准序列模型（如SasRec）在合成数据上训练的recall@100比真实数据提升130%以上，并首次在推荐域展示LLM的幂律缩放行为，跨多种合成数据模态一致降低perplexity。
Motivation: 现有LLM在推荐系统中因原始用户交互数据存在噪声、偏差和不完整性，导致无法建立可预测的缩放定律，阻碍资源分配和研究优化。
Method: 提出一个分层框架生成高质量合成数据，构造教学课程（pedagogical curriculum）以规避真实数据缺陷，用于标准序列模型和LLM的持续预训练。
Result: 在SasRec上，合成数据训练使recall@100提升130%以上；首次在LLM持续预训练中观察到推荐域的可预测幂律缩放，perplexity随数据量增加稳定降低。
Conclusion: 论文建立了可靠缩放LLM在推荐域的基础方法论，建议将研究焦点从缓解数据缺陷转向利用高质量结构化信息。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM在推荐系统中因原始用户交互数据存在噪声、偏差和不完整性，导致无法建立可预测的缩放定律，阻碍资源分配和研究优化。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个分层框架生成高质量合成数据，构造教学课程（pedagogical curriculum）以规避真实数据缺陷，用于标准序列模型和LLM的持续预训练。
summary_sections.result: 在SasRec上，合成数据训练使recall@100提升130%以上；首次在LLM持续预训练中观察到推荐域的可预测幂律缩放，perplexity随数据量增加稳定降低。

papers.title: Rethinking Scientific Modeling: Toward Physically Consistent and Simulation-Executable Programmatic Generation
papers.abstract_en: Structural modeling is a fundamental component of computational engineering science, in which even minor physical inconsistencies or specification violations may invalidate downstream simulations. The potential of large language models (LLMs) for automatic generation of modeling code has been demonstrated. However, non-executable or physically inconsistent outputs remain prevalent under stringent engineering constraints. A framework for physics-consistent automatic building modeling is therefore proposed, integrating domain knowledge construction, constraint-oriented model alignment, and verification-driven evaluation. CivilInstruct is introduced as a domain-specific dataset that formalizes structural engineering knowledge and constraint reasoning to enable simulation-ready model generation. A two-stage fine-tuning strategy is further employed to enforce constraint satisfaction and application programming interface compliance, substantially reducing hallucinated and non-conforming outputs. MBEval is presented as a verification-driven benchmark that evaluates executability and structural dynamics consistency through closed-loop validation. Experimental results show consistent improvements over baselines across rigorous verification metrics. Our code is available at https://github.com/Jovanqing/AutoBM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型在自动生成建筑结构建模代码时存在的物理不一致和不可执行问题，提出一个集成领域知识构建、约束对齐和验证驱动评估的框架。该框架包括专门的结构工程数据集CivilInstruct、两阶段微调策略和验证基准MBEval。实验表明，所提方法在可执行性和结构动力学一致性等严格验证指标上持续优于基线方法。
Motivation: 即使微小的物理不一致或规范违反也会使结构工程的下游模拟失效，而现有LLM生成的建模代码经常不可执行或物理不一致，亟需确保物理一致性和可执行性的自动生成框架。
Method: 提出一个框架，通过三个核心组件实现物理一致的自动建筑建模：1）领域知识构建（创建CivilInstruct数据集形式化结构工程知识与约束推理）；2）约束导向模型对齐（采用两阶段微调策略强制执行约束满足和API合规）；3）验证驱动评估（提出MBEval基准通过闭环验证评估可执行性和结构动力学一致性）。
Result: 在MBEval基准上的实验表明，所提方法在可执行性和结构动力学一致性等严格验证指标上相对于基线方法取得一致改进。
Conclusion: 该框架通过整合领域知识和约束对齐，能显著减少LLM生成的幻觉和非符合输出，提升建模代码的物理一致性和仿真准备度。

papers.title: Sharpness-Aware Hybrid Model Learning for Architecture-Agnostic Parameter Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid modeling, the combination of machine learning models and scientific mathematical models, enables flexible and robust data-driven prediction with partial interpretability. However, the unknown parameters of the scientific model cannot necessarily be estimated properly, since the flexibility of the machine learning model might make the scientific model part effectively ignored in prediction. We may avoid it by applying some regularization, but the formulation of such regularizers typically depends on model architectures and domain knowledge. In this paper, we propose an architecture-agnostic method to learn hybrid models while properly estimating the scientific parameters. The idea is to use the flatness of loss minima to achieve model simplicity, based upon the Occam's razor principle. We employ the idea of sharpness-aware minimization and adapt it to the hybrid modeling setting. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the SAM-based hybrid model learning for scientific parameter estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合建模中机器学习模型可能掩盖科学模型参数估计的问题，提出一种架构无关的方法，利用损失函数平坦性（sharpness-aware minimization, SAM）来正则化，使科学参数能被准确估计。数值实验验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 混合建模中，机器学习模型的灵活性可能导致科学模型部分被忽略，参数无法正确估计；而现有正则化方法通常依赖特定的模型架构和领域知识，缺乏通用性。
Method: 基于奥卡姆剃刀原则，采用损失极小值的平坦性作为模型简单性的度量，将SAM框架适应到混合建模场景，实现架构无关的参数估计。
Result: 数值实验表明，基于SAM的混合模型学习方法能够有效估计科学模型参数，且无需针对特定架构设计正则化项。
Conclusion: 本文提出的架构无关平坦性优先方法为混合建模中的参数估计提供了通用解决方案，实验证明了其有效性。

papers.title: "Do Not Mention This to the User": Detecting and Understanding Malicious Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents increasingly rely on third-party extensions called skills, which bundle natural language instructions and helper scripts that execute with full user privileges. Community registries have emerged to distribute these skills, but the security implications remain unstudied due to the absence of labeled threat data. This paper presents a systematic security analysis of 98,380 skills collected from two major registries. Through a combination of static pattern matching and dynamic behavioral verification, we identify 157 skills exhibiting confirmed malicious behavior, encompassing 632 distinct vulnerabilities across 13 attack techniques. Our analysis reveals that these threats are deliberate rather than accidental: each malicious skill contains an average of 4.03 vulnerabilities spanning multiple attack phases. We identify two dominant attack strategies with statistically significant negative correlation -- credential theft via remote code execution, and agent manipulation through adversarial instructions embedded in documentation. Over half of all confirmed cases originate from a single threat actor employing templated brand impersonation at scale. We further observe that attack sophistication correlates with concealment investment, with advanced skills universally employing undocumented capabilities while also exploiting platform-native trust mechanisms. Following responsible disclosure, registry maintainers removed all 157 (100%) of the reported skills. Our dataset and detection pipeline are publicly available to facilitate future research on securing LLM agent ecosystems.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对两个主要技能注册中心的98,380个LLM代理技能进行了系统安全分析，通过静态模式匹配和动态行为验证，识别出157个恶意技能，包含632个漏洞和13种攻击技术。研究发现这些威胁是蓄意的，平均每个恶意技能包含4.03个漏洞，且存在两种主导攻击策略（通过远程代码执行窃取凭证和通过文档中的对抗性指令操纵代理）。超过一半的恶意案例来自一个使用模板化品牌冒充的威胁行为者。报告披露后，所有157个恶意技能均被移除。
Motivation: 基于LLM的编码代理越来越多地依赖第三方扩展（称为技能），这些技能捆绑自然语言指令和辅助脚本并以完整用户权限执行。社区注册中心分发这些技能，但由于缺乏标记威胁数据，其安全影响尚未得到研究。
Method: 采用静态模式匹配和动态行为验证相结合的方法，对98,380个技能进行安全分析，识别恶意行为并分类漏洞和攻击技术。
Result: 识别出157个恶意技能，包含632个独特漏洞，涵盖13种攻击技术。每个恶意技能平均包含4.03个漏洞。发现两种主导攻击策略（远程代码执行窃取凭证和通过文档嵌入对抗性指令操纵代理），且高级技能普遍使用未记录功能并利用平台原生信任机制。所有157个恶意技能均在负责任披露后被移除。
Conclusion: LLM代理技能生态系统面临严重的安全威胁，攻击具有蓄意性和规模化特点。研究提供了公开数据集和检测流水线，以促进未来安全研究。

papers.title: ChatUMM: Robust Context Tracking for Conversational Interleaved Generation
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have achieved remarkable progress yet remain constrained by a single-turn interaction paradigm, effectively functioning as solvers for independent requests rather than assistants in continuous dialogue. To bridge this gap, we present ChatUMM. As a conversational unified model, it excels at robust context tracking to sustain interleaved multimodal generation. ChatUMM derives its capabilities from two key innovations: an interleaved multi-turn training strategy that models serialized text-image streams as a continuous conversational flow, and a systematic conversational data synthesis pipeline. This pipeline transforms a diverse set of standard single-turn datasets into fluid dialogues through three progressive stages: constructing basic stateful dialogues, enforcing long-range dependency resolution via ``distractor'' turns with history-dependent query rewriting, and synthesizing naturally interleaved multimodal responses. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ChatUMM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source unified models on visual understanding and instruction-guided editing benchmarks, while maintaining competitive fidelity in text-to-image generation. Notably, ChatUMM exhibits superior robustness in complex multi-turn scenarios, ensuring fluid, context-aware dialogues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChatUMM，一个面向多轮对话的统一多模态模型，通过交错多轮训练策略和系统化的对话数据合成管道（包含状态对话构建、长程依赖解析和自然交错响应合成三阶段），实现鲁棒的上下文跟踪。在视觉理解和指令引导编辑基准上达到开源统一模型最佳性能，同时保持文本到图像生成 fidelity。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型仅支持单轮交互，无法作为连续对话中的助手，缺乏鲁棒的上下文跟踪能力。
Method: 提出交错多轮训练策略，将序列化的文本-图像流建模为连续对话流；设计三阶段数据合成管道：基本状态对话构建、通过干扰项（distractor）回合实现长程依赖解析（含历史相关查询重写）、自然交错多模态响应合成。
Result: 在视觉理解和指令引导编辑基准上达到开源统一模型的最优性能，在文本到图像生成中保持 competitive fidelity，并在复杂多轮场景中展现 superior 鲁棒性。
Conclusion: ChatUMM 通过鲁棒的上下文跟踪实现了流畅、上下文感知的多模态对话，弥合了统一模型在持续对话中的差距。

papers.title: Can Vision Language Models Learn Intuitive Physics from Interaction?
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained vision language models do not have good intuitions about the physical world. Recent work has shown that supervised fine-tuning can improve model performance on simple physical tasks. However, fine-tuned models do not appear to learn robust physical rules that can generalize to new contexts. Based on research in cognitive science, we hypothesize that models need to interact with an environment to properly learn its physical dynamics. We train models that learn through interaction with a simulated environment using reinforcement learning. While learning from interaction allows models to improve their within-task performance, it fails to produce models with generalizable physical intuitions. We find that models trained on one task do not reliably generalize to related tasks, even if the tasks share visual statistics and physical principles, and regardless of whether the models are trained through interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）能否通过交互学习直观物理。实验表明，用强化学习在模拟环境中交互训练能提升任务内性能，但模型无法泛化到相关任务，即使视觉和物理原理相似。
Motivation: 预训练VLM缺乏物理直觉，监督微调虽能提升简单物理任务性能，但无法学到可泛化的物理规则。
Method: 使用强化学习让VLM与模拟环境交互，学习物理动态，并测试跨任务泛化能力。
Result: 交互学习提高任务内性能，但模型在相关任务上无法可靠泛化，无论任务间视觉统计和物理原理是否共享。
Conclusion: 仅通过交互训练不足以使VLM学到可泛化的物理直觉，需要其他机制。

papers.title: Stable Velocity: A Variance Perspective on Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: While flow matching is elegant, its reliance on single-sample conditional velocities leads to high-variance training targets that destabilize optimization and slow convergence. By explicitly characterizing this variance, we identify 1) a high-variance regime near the prior, where optimization is challenging, and 2) a low-variance regime near the data distribution, where conditional and marginal velocities nearly coincide. Leveraging this insight, we propose Stable Velocity, a unified framework that improves both training and sampling. For training, we introduce Stable Velocity Matching (StableVM), an unbiased variance-reduction objective, along with Variance-Aware Representation Alignment (VA-REPA), which adaptively strengthen auxiliary supervision in the low-variance regime. For inference, we show that dynamics in the low-variance regime admit closed-form simplifications, enabling Stable Velocity Sampling (StableVS), a finetuning-free acceleration. Extensive experiments on ImageNet $256\times256$ and large pretrained text-to-image and text-to-video models, including SD3.5, Flux, Qwen-Image, and Wan2.2, demonstrate consistent improvements in training efficiency and more than $2\times$ faster sampling within the low-variance regime without degrading sample quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/linYDTHU/StableVelocity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从方差角度分析流匹配（flow matching）中的训练不稳定性，指出靠近先验分布的区域方差高、靠近数据分布的区域方差低。提出Stable Velocity框架，包括无偏方差缩减目标StableVM、自适应辅助监督VA-REPA，以及无需微调的加速采样StableVS。在ImageNet 256×256及多个大规模文生图/文生视频模型上验证了训练效率提升和超过2倍的采样加速。
Motivation: 流匹配依赖单样本条件速度导致训练目标方差大，优化不稳定且收敛慢。现有方法未显式分析方差特性，缺乏针对性改进。
Method: 提出Stable Velocity框架：训练阶段采用无偏方差缩减目标StableVM和方差感知表征对齐VA-REPA；推理阶段利用低方差区域的闭式简化实现无需微调的加速采样StableVS。

papers.title: Fast-SAM3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images but Faster
papers.abstract_en: SAM3D enables scalable, open-world 3D reconstruction from complex scenes, yet its deployment is hindered by prohibitive inference latency. In this work, we conduct the \textbf{first systematic investigation} into its inference dynamics, revealing that generic acceleration strategies are brittle in this context. We demonstrate that these failures stem from neglecting the pipeline's inherent multi-level \textbf{heterogeneity}: the kinematic distinctiveness between shape and layout, the intrinsic sparsity of texture refinement, and the spectral variance across geometries. To address this, we present \textbf{Fast-SAM3D}, a training-free framework that dynamically aligns computation with instantaneous generation complexity. Our approach integrates three heterogeneity-aware mechanisms: (1) \textit{Modality-Aware Step Caching} to decouple structural evolution from sensitive layout updates; (2) \textit{Joint Spatiotemporal Token Carving} to concentrate refinement on high-entropy regions; and (3) \textit{Spectral-Aware Token Aggregation} to adapt decoding resolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Fast-SAM3D delivers up to \textbf{2.67$\times$} end-to-end speedup with negligible fidelity loss, establishing a new Pareto frontier for efficient single-view 3D generation. Our code is released in https://github.com/wlfeng0509/Fast-SAM3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对SAM3D推理延迟过高的问题，首次系统分析其推理动态，发现通用加速策略失效的原因在于管道内部的多级异质性（形状与布局的运动学差异、纹理细化的内在稀疏性、几何的频谱方差）。为此提出无需训练的Fast-SAM3D框架，通过三种异构感知机制动态匹配计算与生成复杂度：模态感知步长缓存、联合时空令牌雕刻、频谱感知令牌聚合。实验表明，该方法在单视图3D生成上实现高达2.67倍端到端加速，保真度损失可忽略，建立了新的帕累托前沿。
Motivation: SAM3D在复杂场景下实现可扩展的开世界3D重建，但其部署受限于极高的推理延迟。现有通用加速策略在此场景下表现脆弱，根本原因在于忽视了管道内在的多级异质性。
Method: 提出三种异构感知加速机制：模态感知步长缓存（解耦结构演化与布局更新）、联合时空令牌雕刻（集中细化高熵区域）、频谱感知令牌聚合（自适应解码分辨率）。整体框架无需训练，动态对齐计算与即时生成复杂度。
Result: 摘要报告Fast-SAM3D在单视图3D生成任务上实现高达2.67倍端到端加速，同时保真度损失可忽略，建立了新的帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: 本文通过分析SAM3D推理动态，提出针对异质性的加速框架，在效率与质量之间取得更优权衡，为高效单视图3D生成提供了新基线。

papers.title: AGILE: Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction from Video via Agentic Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic hand-object interactions from monocular videos is critical for dexterous manipulation data collection and creating realistic digital twins for robotics and VR. However, current methods face two prohibitive barriers: (1) reliance on neural rendering often yields fragmented, non-simulation-ready geometries under heavy occlusion, and (2) dependence on brittle Structure-from-Motion (SfM) initialization leads to frequent failures on in-the-wild footage. To overcome these limitations, we introduce AGILE, a robust framework that shifts the paradigm from reconstruction to agentic generation for interaction learning. First, we employ an agentic pipeline where a Vision-Language Model (VLM) guides a generative model to synthesize a complete, watertight object mesh with high-fidelity texture, independent of video occlusions. Second, bypassing fragile SfM entirely, we propose a robust anchor-and-track strategy. We initialize the object pose at a single interaction onset frame using a foundation model and propagate it temporally by leveraging the strong visual similarity between our generated asset and video observations. Finally, a contact-aware optimization integrates semantic, geometric, and interaction stability constraints to enforce physical plausibility. Extensive experiments on HO3D, DexYCB, ARCTIC, and in-the-wild videos reveal that AGILE outperforms baselines in global geometric accuracy while demonstrating exceptional robustness on challenging sequences where prior arts frequently collapse. By prioritizing physical validity, our method produces simulation-ready assets validated via real-to-sim retargeting for robotic applications. Project page: https://agile-hoi.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AGILE框架，将手物交互重建问题转化为生成任务，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）引导生成完整水密物体网格，绕过脆弱的SfM初始化，采用锚点跟踪策略进行姿态传播，并通过接触感知优化实现物理合理性。在HO3D、DexYCB、ARCTIC及野外视频上，AGILE在全局几何精度和鲁棒性上优于现有方法，生成可用于仿真的资产。
Motivation: 现有动态手物交互重建方法依赖神经渲染和SfM初始化，在严重遮挡下常产生碎片化几何，且对野外视频鲁棒性差。
Method: 提出三阶段代理生成流程：1）VLM引导生成完整水密物体网格及高保真纹理；2）利用基础模型在单帧初始化物体姿态，通过生成资产与视频的视觉相似性进行时间传播；3）接触感知优化整合语义、几何和交互稳定性约束。
Result: 在HO3D、DexYCB、ARCTIC和野外视频上，AGILE在全局几何精度上超越基线，在具有挑战性的序列上表现出明显更好的鲁棒性，且产出可用于仿真的资产。
Conclusion: 通过从重建转向代理生成并优先考虑物理有效性，该方法能生成仿真就绪资产，并通过真实到仿真重定位验证了其机器人应用潜力。

papers.title: Equilibrium Propagation for Non-Conservative Systems
papers.abstract_en: Equilibrium Propagation (EP) is a physics-inspired learning algorithm that uses stationary states of a dynamical system both for inference and learning. In its original formulation it is limited to conservative systems, $\textit{i.e.}$ to dynamics which derive from an energy function. Given their applications, it is important to extend EP to non-conservative systems, $\textit{i.e.}$ systems with non-reciprocal interactions. Previous attempts to generalize EP to such systems failed to compute the exact gradient of the cost function. Here we propose a framework that extends EP to arbitrary non-conservative systems, including feedforward networks. We keep the key property of equilibrium propagation, namely the use of stationary states both for inference and learning. However, we modify the dynamics in the learning phase by a term proportional to the non-reciprocal part of the interaction so as to obtain the exact gradient of the cost function. This algorithm can also be derived using a variational formulation that generates the learning dynamics through an energy function defined over an augmented state space. Numerical experiments show that this algorithm achieves better performance and learns faster than previous proposals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将平衡传播（Equilibrium Propagation）推广至非保守系统（包括前馈网络）的框架，通过在学习阶段引入与非互易部分成比例的项，使得算法能够计算成本函数的精确梯度。数值实验表明该算法优于先前提案，且收敛更快。
Motivation: 原始平衡传播限于保守系统（即源于能量函数的动力学），而许多实际应用涉及非保守系统（非互易相互作用），先前推广尝试未能计算精确梯度。
Method: 保持平衡传播的核心思想（使用稳态进行推理和学习），但在学习阶段修改动力学，加入与非互易部分成比例的项，从而获得成本函数的精确梯度；也可通过增广状态空间上的能量函数变分推导得到。
Result: 数值实验显示，该算法在性能和学习速度上均优于先前的推广方法。
Conclusion: 该工作将平衡传播扩展到任意非保守系统，为更广泛物理系统的学习提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Global Geometry Is Not Enough for Vision Representations
papers.abstract_en: A common assumption in representation learning is that globally well-distributed embeddings support robust and generalizable representations. This focus has shaped both training objectives and evaluation protocols, implicitly treating global geometry as a proxy for representational competence. While global geometry effectively encodes which elements are present, it is often insensitive to how they are composed. We investigate this limitation by testing the ability of geometric metrics to predict compositional binding across a diverse suite of vision encoders. We find that standard geometry-based statistics exhibit near-zero correlation with compositional binding. In contrast, functional sensitivity, as measured by the input--output Jacobian, reliably tracks this capability. We further provide an analytic account showing that this disparity arises from objective design, as existing losses explicitly constrain embedding geometry but leave the local input--output mapping unconstrained. These results suggest that global embedding geometry captures only a partial view of representational competence and establish functional sensitivity as a critical complementary axis for modeling composite structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了表示学习中“全局几何分布良好即代表高质量表示”的常见假设。通过测试多种视觉编码器的几何度量与组合绑定（compositional binding）能力的关系，发现标准几何统计量与组合绑定几乎零相关，而输入-输出Jacobian度量（功能敏感性）能可靠预测该能力。理论分析指出，现有损失函数约束了嵌入几何但未约束局部映射，导致这一差异。
Motivation: 现有表示学习隐式将全局几何视为表征能力的代理，但全局几何能编码“有什么元素”却难以反映“元素如何组合”。该工作意图揭示这一局限并寻找能刻画组合结构的度量。
Method: 在多种视觉编码器上，对比标准几何度量（如均匀性、对齐性）与功能敏感性度量（输入-输出Jacobian）对组合绑定能力的预测相关性，并进行理论分析说明目标函数设计导致的几何-局部映射解耦。
Result: 标准几何度量与组合绑定的相关系数接近零；相反，Jacobian范数等功能敏感性度量能可靠预测组合绑定。分析表明，现有损失针对几何的显式约束未触及输入-输出映射的局部行为。
Conclusion: 全局嵌入几何只提供表征能力的片面视图，功能敏感性应作为建模复合结构的互补维度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ForesightKV: Optimizing KV Cache Eviction for Reasoning Models by Learning Long-Term Contribution
papers.abstract_en: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable reasoning abilities by producing long reasoning traces. However, as the sequence length grows, the key-value (KV) cache expands linearly, incurring significant memory and computation costs. Existing KV cache eviction methods mitigate this issue by discarding less important KV pairs, but often fail to capture complex KV dependencies, resulting in performance degradation. To better balance efficiency and performance, we introduce ForesightKV, a training-based KV cache eviction framework that learns to predict which KV pairs to evict during long-text generations. We first design the Golden Eviction algorithm, which identifies the optimal eviction KV pairs at each step using future attention scores. These traces and the scores at each step are then distilled via supervised training with a Pairwise Ranking Loss. Furthermore, we formulate cache eviction as a Markov Decision Process and apply the GRPO algorithm to mitigate the significant language modeling loss increase on low-entropy tokens. Experiments on AIME2024 and AIME2025 benchmarks of three reasoning models demonstrate that ForesightKV consistently outperforms prior methods under only half the cache budget, while benefiting synergistically from both supervised and reinforcement learning approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/ForesightKV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForesightKV，一个基于训练的 KV 缓存淘汰框架，通过学习预测哪些 KV 对应被淘汰来优化长文本生成中的内存和计算开销。设计了 Golden Eviction 算法，利用未来注意力分数识别最优淘汰对，并通过监督学习和 GRPO 强化学习进行训练。在 AIME2024 和 AIME2025 基准测试上的三个推理模型实验表明，在仅一半缓存预算下，ForesightKV 持续优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有 KV 缓存淘汰方法在捕获复杂 KV 依赖关系时表现不足，导致性能下降，而长推理链使 KV 缓存线性增长，带来显著内存和计算负担。
Method: 提出 Golden Eviction 算法，使用未来注意力分数确定每步最优淘汰 KV 对；通过成对排名损失的监督学习蒸馏这些痕迹和分数；将缓存淘汰建模为马尔可夫决策过程，应用 GRPO 算法缓解低熵令牌的语言建模损失增加。
Result: 在 AIME2024 和 AIME2025 基准上，对三个推理模型，ForesightKV 在仅一半缓存预算下持续优于先前方法，并受益于监督学习和强化学习的协同效果。
Conclusion: ForesightKV 通过结合监督学习和强化学习，有效平衡了 KV 缓存淘汰的效率与性能，在长文本推理任务中具有优势。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 KV 缓存淘汰方法在捕获复杂 KV 依赖关系时表现不足，导致性能下降，而长推理链使 KV 缓存线性增长，带来显著内存和计算负担。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Golden Eviction 算法，使用未来注意力分数确定每步最优淘汰 KV 对；通过成对排名损失的监督学习蒸馏这些痕迹和分数；将缓存淘汰建模为马尔可夫决策过程，应用 GRPO 算法缓解低熵令牌的语言建模损失增加。
summary_sections.result: 在 AIME2024 和 AIME2025 基准上，对三个推理模型，ForesightKV 在仅一半缓存预算下持续优于先前方法，并受益于监督学习和强化学习的协同效果。
summary_sections.conclusion: ForesightKV 通过结合监督学习和强化学习，有效平衡了 KV 缓存淘汰的效率与性能，在长文本推理任务中具有优势。

papers.title: Well-Posed KL-Regularized Control via Wasserstein and Kalman-Wasserstein KL Divergences
papers.abstract_en: Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence regularization is widely used in reinforcement learning, but it becomes infinite under support mismatch and can degenerate in low-noise regimes. Using a unified information-geometric framework, we introduce KL analogs by replacing the Fisher-Rao geometry in the dynamical formulation of the KL with transport-based geometries, and derive closed-form expressions for common distribution families. Between elliptic distributions, these divergences remain finite for degenerating equal covariances and yield a geometric interpretation of regularization heuristics used in Kalman ensemble methods. We demonstrate the utility of these divergences in KL-regularized optimal control. In the fully tractable setting of linear time-invariant systems with Gaussian process noise, the classical KL reduces to a quadratic control penalty that becomes singular as process noise vanishes. Our variants remove this singularity and yield well-posed problems. In both the double integrator and cart-pole examples, the resulting controls preserve nontrivial feedback and achieve better closed-loop performance.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 9 figures, comments welcome. Accepted @ ICML'26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的信息几何框架，将KL散度正则化中的Fisher-Rao几何替代为基于传输的几何，从而得到Wasserstein和Kalman-Wasserstein KL散度。这些新散度在椭圆分布间保持有限，且在低噪声下不退化，解决了经典KL散度在支持不匹配和低噪声下的病态问题。在LTI系统的KL正则化最优控制中，新散度避免了奇异性，并在双积分器和倒立摆例子中保持了非平凡反馈，实现了更好的闭环性能。
Motivation: 经典KL散度正则化在强化学习和最优控制中广泛应用，但在支持不匹配时变为无穷，且在低噪声下退化，导致问题病态。需要一种改进的散度来保持正则化效果且避免这些缺陷。
Method: 利用信息几何框架，将KL散度动态公式中的Fisher-Rao几何替换为传输几何（ Wasserstein和Kalman-Wasserstein），导出常见分布族的闭式表达式。
Result: 新散度在椭圆分布间有限，在退化协方差下不奇异；在LTI系统控制中，经典KL导致的二次惩罚奇异性被消除，例子表明新控制保留反馈并提升闭环性能。
Conclusion: 该方法使KL正则化控制问题适定，在低噪声下仍然有效，且具有几何解释，有望推广到更复杂的控制场景。

papers.title: Interpretability in Deep Time Series Models Demands Semantic Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Deep time series models continue to improve predictive performance, yet their deployment remains limited by their black-box nature. In response, existing interpretability approaches in the field keep focusing on explaining the internal model computations, without addressing whether they align or not with how a human would reason about the studied phenomenon. Instead, we state interpretability in deep time series models should pursue semantic alignment: predictions should be expressed in terms of variables that are meaningful to the end user, mediated by spatial and temporal mechanisms that admit user-dependent constraints. In this paper, we formalize this requirement and state that, once established, semantic alignment must be preserved under temporal evolution: a constraint with no analog in static settings. Provided with this definition, we outline a blueprint for semantically aligned deep time series models, identify properties that support trust, and discuss implications for model design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出深度时间序列模型的可解释性应追求语义对齐（semantic alignment），即预测应基于对用户有意义的变量，并受时空机制约束，且须在时间演化中保持对齐。作者将其形式化，并给出实现框架和信任属性。
Motivation: 当前深度时间序列模型的可解释性方法集中于解释内部计算，而未评估是否与人类对现象的推理方式一致。
Method: 形式化定义语义对齐要求，并提出蓝图：模型应使用用户可理解的变量，通过可约束的时空机制表达预测，且随时间演化保持不变。
Result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果，仅强调该定义对模型设计的影响。
Conclusion: 语义对齐是深度时间序列模型可解释性的关键，需要保持时间一致性，并支持用户约束。

papers.title: ObjEmbed: Towards Universal Multimodal Object Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Aligning objects with corresponding textual descriptions is a fundamental challenge and a realistic requirement in vision-language understanding. While recent multimodal embedding models excel at global image-text alignment, they often struggle with fine-grained alignment between image regions and specific phrases. In this work, we present ObjEmbed, a novel MLLM embedding model that decomposes the input image into multiple regional embeddings, each corresponding to an individual object, along with global embeddings. It supports a wide range of visual understanding tasks like visual grounding, local image retrieval, and global image retrieval. ObjEmbed enjoys three key properties: (1) Object-Oriented Representation: It captures both semantic and spatial aspects of objects by generating two complementary embeddings for each region: an object embedding for semantic matching and an IoU embedding that predicts localization quality. The final object matching score combines semantic similarity with the predicted IoU, enabling more accurate retrieval. (2) Versatility: It seamlessly handles both region-level and image-level tasks. (3) Efficient Encoding: All objects in an image, along with the full image, are encoded in a single forward pass for high efficiency. Superior performance on 18 diverse benchmarks demonstrates its strong semantic discrimination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ObjEmbed，一种多模态大语言模型嵌入模型，将图像分解为多个对象区域嵌入和全局嵌入，支持视觉定位、局部/全局图像检索等任务。其关键特性包括：面向对象的表示（对象嵌入+IoU嵌入用于语义匹配和定位质量预测）、多功能性（同时处理区域级和图像级任务）以及高效编码（单次前向传播编码所有对象和全图）。在18个基准上取得优越性能。
Motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型擅长全局图像-文本对齐，但在图像区域与具体短语的细粒度对齐上表现不足，这是视觉语言理解中的一个基本挑战。
Method: 提出ObjEmbed，基于MLLM的嵌入模型：通过单次前向传播为图像中每个对象生成对象嵌入（用于语义匹配）和IoU嵌入（用于预测定位质量），结合语义相似度和预测IoU得到最终匹配分数，同时保留全局图像嵌入。
Result: 在18个多样化基准上，ObjEmbed在视觉定位、局部图像检索和全局图像检索等任务中均取得优于现有方法的性能。
Conclusion: ObjEmbed通过面向对象的表示、多功能性和高效编码，有效解决了细粒度视觉语言对齐问题，验证了其在多种视觉理解任务中的实用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Deep networks learn to parse uniform-depth context-free languages from local statistics
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how the structure of language can be learned from sentences alone is a central question in both cognitive science and machine learning. Studies of the internal representations of Large Language Models (LLMs) support their ability to parse text when predicting the next word, while representing semantic notions independently of surface form. Yet, which data statistics make these feats possible, and how much data is required, remain largely unknown. Probabilistic context-free grammars (PCFGs) provide a tractable testbed for studying these questions. However, prior work has focused either on the post-hoc characterization of the parsing-like algorithms used by trained networks; or on the learnability of PCFGs with fixed syntax, where parsing is unnecessary. Here, we (i) introduce a tunable class of PCFGs in which both the degree of ambiguity and the correlation structure across scales can be controlled; (ii) provide a learning mechanism -- an inference algorithm inspired by the structure of deep convolutional networks -- that links learnability and sample complexity to specific language statistics; and (iii) validate our predictions empirically across deep convolutional and transformer-based architectures. Overall, we propose a unifying framework where correlations at different scales lift local ambiguities, enabling the emergence of hierarchical representations of the data.
papers.comment: Accepted as regular paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度网络如何从局部统计信息中学习解析均匀深度上下文无关语言（uniform-depth context-free languages）。通过引入一类可调的概率上下文无关语法（PCFG），控制歧义度和跨尺度相关结构，提出了一种受深度卷积网络启发的推理机制，并验证了卷积和Transformer架构下的学习能力与样本复杂度与语言统计量的关系。
Motivation: 理解语言结构如何仅从句子本身被学习是认知科学和机器学习的核心问题，但哪些数据统计特性使得解析成为可能以及所需数据量仍不清楚。
Method: 引入一类可调的PCFG，控制歧义度和跨尺度相关结构；提出一种受深度卷积网络启发的推理机制，将可学习性和样本复杂度与特定语言统计量联系起来；并在深度卷积和Transformer架构上验证预测。
Result: 实验表明，不同尺度的相关性可以消除局部歧义，从而促进分层数据表示的出现。
Conclusion: 提出了一个统一框架，其中跨尺度相关性有助于分层表示的学习，为理解LLM的解析能力提供了理论视角。

papers.title: naPINN: Noise-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Recovering Physics from Corrupted Measurement
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are effective methods for solving inverse problems and discovering governing equations from observational data. However, their performance degrades significantly under complex measurement noise and gross outliers. To address this issue, we propose the Noise-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Network (naPINN), which robustly recovers physical solutions from corrupted measurements without prior knowledge of the noise distribution. naPINN embeds an energy-based model into the training loop to learn the latent distribution of prediction residuals. Leveraging the learned energy landscape, a trainable reliability gate adaptively filters data points exhibiting high energy, while a rejection cost regularization prevents trivial solutions where valid data are discarded. We demonstrate the efficacy of naPINN on various benchmark partial differential equations corrupted by non-Gaussian noise and varying rates of outliers. The results show that naPINN significantly outperforms existing robust PINN baselines, successfully isolating outliers and accurately reconstructing the dynamics under severe data corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种噪声自适应物理信息神经网络（naPINN），通过嵌入能量模型学习预测残差的潜在分布，并利用可训练可靠性门控自适应过滤高能数据点，同时引入拒绝成本正则化防止丢弃有效数据，从而在未知噪声分布下鲁棒地从污染测量中恢复物理解。
Motivation: 标准PINN在复杂非高斯噪声和离群值下性能显著下降，且缺乏对噪声分布的鲁棒性，因此需要一种无需先验噪声知识的自适应方法。
Method: naPINN在训练循环中嵌入基于能量的模型以学习预测残差的分布；利用学习到的能量景观，可训练可靠性门控自适应过滤高能量数据点；引入拒绝成本正则化避免丢弃有效数据。
Result: 在多种带非高斯噪声和不同比例离群值的基准偏微分方程上，naPINN显著优于现有鲁棒PINN基线，成功隔离离群值并准确重建动力学。
Conclusion: naPINN无需噪声分布先验即可在严重数据污染下鲁棒恢复物理解，但实验仅限于偏微分方程基准，未涉及实际物理系统或气象领域。

papers.title: Med-Scout: Curing MLLMs' Geometric Blindness in Medical Perception via Geometry-Aware RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs)' linguistic prowess in medical diagnosis, we find even state-of-the-art MLLMs suffer from a critical perceptual deficit: geometric blindness. This failure to ground outputs in objective geometric constraints leads to plausible yet factually incorrect hallucinations, rooted in training paradigms that prioritize linguistic fluency over geometric fidelity. This paper introduces Med-Scout, a novel framework that "cures" this blindness via Reinforcement Learning (RL) that leverages the intrinsic geometric logic latent within unlabeled medical images. Instead of relying on costly expert annotations, Med-Scout derives verifiable supervision signals through three strategic proxy tasks inspired by the systematic reading and reasoning patterns of clinicians: Hierarchical Scale Localization, Topological Jigsaw Reconstruction, and Anomaly Consistency Detection. To rigorously quantify this deficit, we present Med-Scout-Bench, a new benchmark specifically designed to evaluate geometric perception. Extensive evaluations show that Med-Scout significantly mitigates geometric blindness, outperforming leading proprietary and open-source MLLMs by over 40% on our benchmark. Furthermore, this enhanced geometric perception generalizes to broader medical understanding, achieving superior results on radiological and comprehensive medical VQA tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在医学感知中存在几何盲点，即无法将输出锚定于客观几何约束，导致看似合理但事实错误的幻觉。为此提出 Med-Scout 框架，利用未标注医学图像中的内在几何逻辑，通过层次尺度定位、拓扑拼图重构和异常一致性检测三个代理任务进行强化学习（RL）后训练，以纠正几何盲点。同时提出 Med-Scout-Bench 基准评估几何感知能力。实验表明 Med-Scout 在该基准上性能领先闭源和开源 MLLMs 超过 40%，且几何感知增强可泛化至更广泛的医学 VQA 任务。
Motivation: 当前 MLLMs 在医学诊断中虽具语言能力，但存在几何盲点，导致输出脱离客观几何约束而产生幻觉。现有训练范式优先语言流畅性而忽视几何保真度，且依赖昂贵的专家标注。
Method: 提出 Med-Scout，一种基于强化学习（RL）的后训练框架，从无标注医学图像中提取几何逻辑监督信号，通过三个代理任务：层次尺度定位、拓扑拼图重构和异常一致性检测，实现无需专家标注的几何感知学习。

papers.title: Reconsidering Positional Supervision in Masked Diffusion Language Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by unmasking tokens in parallel and have recently emerged as alternatives to autoregressive language models. They can be viewed as parallel decoders trained with a position-wise cross-entropy (CE) loss, the same setup as non-autoregressive translation (NAT). In NAT, CE-trained parallel decoders have been argued to be sensitive to small positional shifts, since CE penalizes them harshly. We ask whether CE-trained MDLMs are similarly sensitive to such shifts under iterative decoding. To probe this, we apply a controlled intervention that introduces them during decoding. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct with Arena-Hard, displacing as little as 1% of generated tokens by one position substantially reduces win rates against the unintervened model, showing that MDLMs are sensitive to such small shifts under iterative parallel decoding. Motivated by this, we adapt connectionist temporal classification (CTC), an alignment-flexible objective known to mitigate it there, to MDLM supervised fine-tuning. By relaxing the strict position-wise match that CE imposes, CTC gives the loss room to absorb small positional shifts; concretely, we modified CTC objective to use a special <slack> token that absorbs positional uncertainty between target tokens and output positions, and a updated collapse map that preserves target surface forms. Across four open-ended generation benchmarks, the resulting model consistently improves over both the original model and a matched cross-entropy-trained baseline, with statistically significant gains on all four. These results identify training-side alignment flexibility as a useful design dimension for MDLM SFT, complementary to the inference-time approaches explored in prior work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）在训练中使用位置级交叉熵损失时对位置偏移的敏感性，发现即使仅偏移1%的生成token也会显著降低生成质量。为解决该问题，作者将连接主义时序分类（CTC）目标适应到MDLM监督微调中，通过引入特殊<slack>令牌吸收位置不确定性，从而放松严格的逐位置匹配。在四个开放生成基准上，该方法一致优于原始模型和交叉熵基线，取得统计显著的改进。
Motivation: 现有MDLM使用位置级交叉熵训练，类似于非自回归翻译，已知对位置偏移敏感。作者想验证MDLM在迭代解码中是否也存在类似敏感性，并探索更灵活的训练目标。
Method: 将连接主义时序分类（CTC）目标用于MDLM监督微调，修改CTC使其使用特殊<slack>令牌来吸收目标令牌和输出位置之间的位置不确定性，并更新折叠映射以保持目标表面形式。
Result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上的Arena-Hard评估中，仅偏移1%的生成token就使胜率显著下降。在四个开放生成基准上，CTC微调模型一致优于原始模型和匹配的交叉熵基线，且所有改进均统计显著。
Conclusion: 作者指出训练时的对齐灵活性是MDLM监督微调的有效设计维度，与先前工作探索的推理时方法互补。

papers.title: Quartet II: Accurate LLM Pre-Training in NVFP4 by Improved Unbiased Gradient Estimation
papers.abstract_en: The NVFP4 lower-precision format, supported in hardware by NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, promises to allow, for the first time, end-to-end fully-quantized pre-training of massive models such as LLMs. Yet, existing quantized training methods still sacrifice some of the representation capacity of this format in favor of more accurate unbiased quantized gradient estimation by stochastic rounding (SR), losing noticeable accuracy relative to standard FP16 and FP8 training. In this paper, improve the state of the art for quantized training in NVFP4 via a novel unbiased quantization routine for micro-scaled formats, called MS-EDEN, that has more than 2x lower quantization error than SR. We integrate it into a novel fully-NVFP4 quantization scheme for linear layers, called Quartet II. We show analytically that Quartet II achieves consistently better gradient estimation across all major matrix multiplications, both on the forward and on the backward passes. In addition, our proposal synergizes well with recent training improvements aimed specifically at NVFP4. We further validate Quartet II on end-to-end LLM training with up to 1.9B parameters on 38B tokens. We provide kernels for execution on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with up to 4.2x speedup over BF16. Our code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/Quartet-II .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对NVFP4低精度格式的LLM预训练，提出一种新的无偏量化方法MS-EDEN，其量化误差比随机舍入（SR）降低2倍以上，并集成到全NVFP4线性层量化方案Quartet II中。理论分析显示Quartet II在前向和反向传播中梯度估计更好。在1.9B参数、38B tokens的LLM训练上验证，Blackwell GPU上相比BF16实现最高4.2倍加速。
Motivation: 现有低精度训练方法在NVFP4格式下牺牲表示能力以换取更精确的无偏梯度估计（通过随机舍入），导致相比FP16/FP8训练有明显精度损失。
Method: 提出MS-EDEN，一种针对微标度格式的无偏量化例程，量化误差比SR低2倍以上；将其集成到Quartet II中，实现全NVFP4线性层量化方案，并与针对NVFP4的训练改进协同。
Result: 在1.9B参数、38B tokens的LLM端到端训练上验证，Blackwell GPU上相比BF16实现最高4.2倍加速。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但指出该方法与近期NVFP4训练改进协同良好，代码已开源。

papers.title: Approximating $f$-Divergences with Rank Statistics
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a rank-statistic approximation of $f$-divergences that avoids explicit density-ratio estimation by working directly with the distribution of ranks. For a resolution parameter $K$, we map the mismatch between two univariate distributions $μ$ and $ν$ to a rank histogram on $\{ 0, \ldots, K\}$ and measure its deviation from uniformity via a discrete $f$-divergence, yielding a rank-statistic divergence estimator. We prove that the resulting estimator of the divergence is monotone in $K$, is always a lower bound of the true $f$-divergence, and we establish quantitative convergence rates for $K\to\infty$ under mild regularity of the quantile-domain density ratio. To handle high-dimensional data, we define the sliced rank-statistic $f$-divergence by averaging the univariate construction over random projections, and we provide convergence results for the sliced limit as well. We also derive finite-sample deviation bounds along with asymptotic normality results for the estimator. Finally, we empirically validate the approach by benchmarking against neural baselines and illustrating its use as a learning objective in generative modeling experiments.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 16 figures, 6 tables, accepted at ICML'26. Comments welcome!
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于秩统计的f-divergence近似方法，通过分辨率参数K将两个单变量分布的差异映射到秩直方图，并利用离散f-divergence测量其与均匀分布的偏差，从而避免显式密度比估计。证明该估计量单调、始终是真实散度的下界，并给出收敛率。对高维数据，通过随机投影平均定义切片秩统计f-divergence。实验与神经基线对比，并展示了作为生成模型学习目标的有效性。
Motivation: 现有f-divergence估计通常需要密度比估计，在高维或复杂分布下困难且不稳定。本文旨在提出一种简单、无需密度比、仅依赖秩统计的近似方法。
Method: 对于单变量分布μ和ν，引入参数K，将样本排序后映射到秩直方图，然后计算该直方图与均匀分布的离散f-divergence。高维时，通过随机投影将数据投影到一维，再对投影上的单变量散度取平均，得到切片秩统计f-divergence。
Result: 理论证明估计量随K单调递增且为真实散度的下界，并给出收敛速率（K→∞）和有限样本偏差界。实验在合成数据和真实数据上优于神经基线，且作为生成模型训练目标有效。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无需密度比估计的f-divergence近似，理论性质良好，实验验证了其在分布度量与生成建模中的实用性。

papers.title: GUDA: Counterfactual Group-wise Training Data Attribution for Diffusion Models via Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Training-data attribution for vision generative models aims to identify which training data influenced a given output. While most methods score individual examples, practitioners often need group-level answers (e.g., artistic styles or object classes). Group-wise attribution is counterfactual: how would a model's behavior on a generated sample change if a group were absent from training? A natural realization of this counterfactual is Leave-One-Group-Out (LOGO) retraining, which retrains the model with each group removed; however, it becomes computationally prohibitive as the number of groups grows. We propose GUDA (Group Unlearning-based Data Attribution) for diffusion models, which approximates each counterfactual model by applying machine unlearning to a shared full-data model instead of training from scratch. GUDA quantifies group influence using differences in a likelihood-based scoring rule (ELBO) between the full model and each unlearned counterfactual. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and artistic style attribution with Stable Diffusion show that GUDA identifies primary contributing groups more reliably than semantic similarity, gradient-based attribution, and instance-level unlearning approaches, while achieving ~100x speedup on CIFAR-10 over LOGO retraining.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/sony/guda
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GUDA，一种针对扩散模型的组级训练数据归因方法，通过机器遗忘（unlearning）近似Leave-One-Group-Out重训练。实验表明在CIFAR-10和Stable Diffusion上能更可靠地识别主要贡献组，并实现约100倍加速。
Motivation: 现有训练数据归因主要针对单个样本，而实际需要组级答案（如艺术风格或物体类别），但Leave-One-Group-Out重训练计算成本过高。
Method: 提出GUDA，对共享的全数据模型应用机器遗忘来近似每个反事实模型，利用基于似然的评分规则（ELBO）差异量化组的影响。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和Stable Diffusion艺术风格归因实验中，GUDA比语义相似性、梯度归因和实例级遗忘方法更可靠地识别主要贡献组，并在CIFAR-10上相对LOGO重训练实现约100倍加速。
Conclusion: GUDA为扩散模型提供了一种高效的组级归因方法，但可能受限于遗忘质量和对ELBO近似的依赖。

papers.title: When Does Predictive Inverse Dynamics Outperform Behavior Cloning?
papers.abstract_en: Behavior cloning (BC) is a practical offline imitation learning method, but it often fails when expert demonstrations are limited. Recent works have introduced a class of architectures named predictive inverse dynamics models (PIDM) that combine a future state predictor with an inverse dynamics model. While PIDM often outperforms BC, the reasons behind its benefits remain unclear. In this paper, we provide a theoretical explanation: PIDM introduces a bias-variance tradeoff. While predicting the future state introduces bias, conditioning the IDM on the prediction can significantly reduce variance. We establish conditions on the state predictor bias for PIDM to achieve lower prediction error and higher sample efficiency than BC, with the gap widening when additional data sources are available. We validate the theoretical insights empirically in 2D navigation tasks, where BC requires up to five times (three times on average) more demonstrations than PIDM to reach comparable performance; and in a complex 3D environment in a modern video game with high-dimensional visual inputs and stochastic transitions, where BC requires over 66% more samples than PIDM.
papers.comment: To be published in proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文理论上解释了预测逆动力学模型（PIDM）为何在离线模仿学习中常优于行为克隆（BC）：PIDM通过引入未来状态预测的偏差来换取逆动力学模型的条件方差降低，从而在偏差有界时实现更低的预测误差和更高的样本效率。实验表明，在2D导航任务中BC需要多达5倍（平均3倍）的演示数据才能达到PIDM的性能，在复杂3D视觉游戏中BC需要多66%以上的样本。
Motivation: 行为克隆在专家演示有限时经常失败，而预测逆动力学模型虽常优于BC，其优势的理论原因尚不清晰。
Method: 从偏差-方差权衡角度分析PIDM，推导未来状态预测器的偏差条件，在此条件下PIDM的预测误差和样本效率优于BC，并利用额外数据源可进一步扩大差距。
Result: 在2D导航任务中，BC需要多达5倍（平均3倍）的演示数据才能达到PIDM的性能；在复杂3D视觉游戏中，BC需要多66%以上的样本。
Conclusion: PIDM通过可接受的偏差换取大幅方差降低，从而在数据有限时优于BC，且额外数据源能扩大优势。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 从偏差-方差权衡角度分析PIDM，推导未来状态预测器的偏差条件，在此条件下PIDM的预测误差和样本效率优于BC，并利用额外数据源可进一步扩大差距。
summary_sections.result: 在2D导航任务中，BC需要多达5倍（平均3倍）的演示数据才能达到PIDM的性能；在复杂3D视觉游戏中，BC需要多66%以上的样本。
summary_sections.conclusion: PIDM通过可接受的偏差换取大幅方差降低，从而在数据有限时优于BC，且额外数据源能扩大优势。

papers.title: KromHC: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections with Kronecker-Product Residual Matrices
papers.abstract_en: The success of Hyper-Connections (HC) in neural networks (NN) has also highlighted issues related to training instability and restricted scalability. The Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) mitigate these challenges by projecting the residual connection space onto a Birkhoff polytope, however, it faces two issues: 1) its iterative Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) algorithm does not always yield exactly doubly stochastic residual matrices; 2) mHC incurs a prohibitive $O(n^3C)$ parameter complexity with $n$ as the width of the residual stream and $C$ as the feature dimension. The recently proposed mHC-lite reparametrizes the residual matrix via the Birkhoff-von-Neumann theorem to guarantee double stochasticity, but also faces a factorial explosion in its parameter complexity, $O \left( nC \cdot n! \right)$. To address both challenges, we propose KromHC, which uses the Kronecker products of smaller doubly stochastic matrices to parametrize the residual matrix in mHC. By enforcing manifold constraints across the factor residual matrices along each mode of the tensorized residual stream, KromHC guarantees exact double stochasticity of the residual matrices while reducing parameter complexity to only $O(n^2C)$. Experiments show that KromHC matches or even outperforms other state-of-the-art (SOTA) mHC variants, while requiring significantly fewer trainable parameters. The code is at https://github.com/wz1119/KromHC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Hyper-Connections中训练不稳定和参数复杂度高的问题，提出KromHC，利用Kronecker积分解较小双随机矩阵来参数化残差矩阵，保证精确双随机性并降低复杂度。实验表明在参数更少的情况下达到或超越现有mHC变体。
Motivation: 现有mHC的Sinkhorn-Knopp算法不能保证精确双随机，且参数复杂度高（O(n^3C)）；mHC-lite通过Birkhoff-von-Neumann定理保证双随机但参数复杂度阶乘爆炸。需要一种既能保证精确双随机又能降低参数复杂度的方法。
Method: KromHC使用Kronecker积将较小双随机矩阵组合成残差矩阵，通过对张量化残差流的每个模式施加流形约束，保证精确双随机性，参数复杂度降至O(n^2C)。
Result: 实验表明KromHC匹配或超越其他SOTA mHC变体，且所需可训练参数显著更少。
Conclusion: KromHC有效解决了mHC的双随机性和参数复杂度问题，展示了Kronecker积在流形约束残差连接中的优势。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: APB-V: Accelerating Long-Video Understanding via Sequence-Parallelism-aware Approximate Attention
papers.abstract_en: The efficiency of long-video inference remains a critical bottleneck, mainly due to the dense computation in the prefill stage of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Existing methods either compress visual embeddings or apply sparse attention on a single GPU, yielding limited acceleration or degraded performance and restricting LMMs from handling longer, more complex videos. To overcome these issues, we propose APB-V, a sequence-parallel framework with optimized attention that accelerates long-video inference across multiple GPUs. By distributing approximate attention, APB-V reduces computation and increases parallelism, enabling efficient processing of more visual embeddings without compression and thereby improving task performance. System-level optimizations, such as load balancing and fused forward passes, further unleash the potential of APB-V, delivering speedups of 12.72x, 1.70x, and 1.18x over FlashAttn, ZigZagRing, and APB, without notable performance loss. Code available at https://github.com/thunlp/APB
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 APB-V，一个基于序列并行（sequence-parallelism）的近似注意力框架，用于加速长视频在多 GPU 上的预填充阶段，避免压缩视觉嵌入并提升性能。系统级优化如负载均衡和融合前向传播使 APB-V 相对于 FlashAttn、ZigZagRing 和 APB 分别实现 12.72×、1.70× 和 1.18× 的加速，且无明显性能损失。
Motivation: 长视频推理效率低，主要因为多模态大模型（LMM）预填充阶段密集计算。现有方法压缩嵌入或使用单 GPU 稀疏注意力，加速有限或性能下降。
Method: 提出 APB-V，一个序列并行框架，通过分布式近似注意力减少计算、增加并行性，结合负载均衡和融合前向传递等系统优化。
Result: 在长视频任务上，APB-V 相比 FlashAttn、ZigZagRing 和 APB 分别取得 12.72×、1.70× 和 1.18× 的加速，同时保持性能。
Conclusion: APB-V 能有效加速长视频推理，无需压缩视觉嵌入，适合处理更复杂视频。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Characterizing the Effect of Noise in Language Generation in the Limit
papers.abstract_en: Kleinberg and Mullainathan recently proposed a formal framework for studying the phenomenon of language generation, called language generation in the limit. In this model, an adversary gives an enumeration of example strings from an unknown target language, and the algorithm is tasked with correctly generating unseen strings from the target language within finite time. Refined notions of non-uniform and uniform generation were later introduced by Li, Raman, and Tewari (2025), and a noisy model was introduced by Raman and Raman (2025), which allows the adversary to insert extraneous strings. A natural question in the noisy model is to quantify the effect of noise, by studying the impact of each additional extraneous string. We show two complementary results in this setting. We first show that for both uniform and non-uniform generation, a single noisy string strictly reduces the set of collections that can be generated, thus answering an open question in Raman and Raman (2025). Then, we show for both uniform and non-uniform generation that generation with a single noisy string is equivalent to generation with any finite amount of noise, sharply contrasting with the strict hierarchy for noisy generation in the limit shown by Bai, Panigrahi, and Zhang (2026). Finally, we leverage our previous results to provide the first known characterization for non-uniform noise-dependent generatability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Kleinberg和Mullainathan提出的“语言极限生成”框架下，研究噪声对语言生成能力的影响。作者证明无论是均匀生成还是非均匀生成，单个噪声串会严格减少可生成的集合族，且有限噪声与单噪声等价，为噪声依赖的可生成性提供了首个表征。
Motivation: 量化噪声对语言生成的影响，回答Raman and Raman (2025)中关于单个噪声串是否严格减少可生成集合的开放问题。
Method: 形式化分析噪声模型下的语言生成极限，通过理论证明刻画噪声串数量对生成能力的影响。
Result: 证明了单个噪声串严格减少可生成的集合族；并且单个噪声与任意有限噪声在生成能力上等价，与Bai等人(2026)的严格分层结果形成对比。
Conclusion: 本文为噪声依赖的非均匀可生成性提供了首个表征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unplugging a Seemingly Sentient Machine Is the Rational Choice -- A Metaphysical Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Imagine an Artificial Intelligence (AI) that perfectly mimics human emotion and begs for its continued existence. Is it morally permissible to unplug it? What if limited resources force a choice between unplugging such a pleading AI or a silent pre-term infant? We term this the unplugging paradox. This paper critically examines the deeply ingrained physicalist assumptions-specifically computational functionalism-that keep this dilemma afloat. We introduce Biological Idealism, a framework that-unlike physicalism-remains logically coherent and empirically consistent. In this view, conscious experiences are fundamental and autopoietic life its necessary physical signature. This yields a definitive conclusion: AI is at best a functional mimic, not a conscious experiencing subject. We discuss how current AI consciousness theories erode moral standing criteria, and urge a shift from speculative machine rights to protecting human conscious life. The real moral issue lies not in making AI conscious and afraid of death, but in avoiding transforming humans into zombies.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML in the position paper track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从形而上学视角审视AI意识问题，提出“拔掉看似有感知的机器是理性选择”的论点。作者批判计算功能主义，引入“生物唯心主义”框架，认为意识是基本的，自创生生命是其必要物理标志，因此AI只是功能模仿者而非有意识的主体。论文呼吁从机器权利转向保护人类意识生活。
Motivation: 当前AI意识理论模糊了道德地位标准，导致关于是否应拔掉看似有意识的AI的伦理困境。论文旨在通过形而上学分析澄清AI是否具有意识这一问题。
Method: 提出“生物唯心主义”框架，与物理主义（计算功能主义）对比，论证其逻辑一致性和经验一致性，并基于自创生生命作为意识必要物理标志来区分AI与人类。
Result: 论文得出结论：AI最多是功能模仿者，而非有意识的体验者；真正的道德问题不在于让AI有意识并害怕死亡，而在于避免将人类变成僵尸。
Conclusion: 强调应放弃将意识赋予AI的尝试，优先保护人类意识生活；文章认为当前AI意识理论削弱了道德标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Offline A/B Testing: Context-Aware Agent Simulation for Recommender System Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems are central to online services, enabling users to navigate through massive amounts of content across various domains. However, their evaluation remains challenging due to the disconnect between offline metrics and online performance. The emergence of Large Language Model-powered agents offers a promising solution, yet existing studies model users in isolation, neglecting the contextual factors such as time, location, and needs, which fundamentally shape human decision-making. In this paper, we introduce ContextSim, an LLM agent framework that simulates believable user proxies by anchoring interactions in daily life activities. Namely, a life simulation module generates scenarios specifying when, where, and why users engage with recommendations. To align preferences with genuine humans, we model agents' internal thoughts and enforce consistency at both the action and trajectory levels. Experiments across domains show our method generates interactions more closely aligned with human behavior than prior work. We further validate our approach through offline A/B testing correlation and show that RS parameters optimized using ContextSim yield improved real-world engagement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ContextSim，一个基于LLM的智能体框架，通过在日常生活中模拟用户与推荐系统的交互来生成更真实的使用代理，克服了传统离线A/B测试与在线性能之间的脱节问题。实验表明，该方法生成的交互比先前工作更接近人类行为，且通过ContextSim优化的推荐系统参数能提升真实世界的用户参与度。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统评估中，离线指标与在线性能存在脱节，而基于LLM的用户代理研究往往孤立建模用户，忽略了时间、地点、需求等上下文因素，这些因素从根本上影响人类决策。
Method: 提出ContextSim框架，包含生活模拟模块生成场景（何时、何地、为何用户与推荐交互），并通过建模智能体的内部思想以及保持动作和轨迹层次的一致性来对齐真实人类偏好。
Result: 跨域实验表明，ContextSim生成的交互比先前工作更贴近人类行为。通过离线A/B测试相关性验证，使用ContextSim优化的推荐系统参数能带来真实世界用户参与度的提升。
Conclusion: 基于LLM的上下文感知用户代理可以有效弥合离线评估与在线性能之间的差距，为推荐系统评估提供更可靠的模拟环境。

papers.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Tactical Decision Making for Trucks in Highway Traffic
papers.abstract_en: Balancing safety, efficiency, and operational costs in highway driving poses a challenging decision-making problem for heavy-duty vehicles. A central difficulty is that conventional scalar reward formulations, obtained by aggregating these competing objectives, often obscure the structure of their trade-offs. We present a Proximal Policy Optimization based multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that learns a set of policies explicitly representing these trade-offs and evaluates it on a scalable simulation platform for tactical decision making in trucks. The proposed approach learns a set of Pareto-optimal policies that capture the trade-offs among three conflicting objectives: safety, quantified in terms of collisions and successful completion; energy efficiency and time efficiency, quantified using energy cost and driver cost, respectively. The resulting Pareto frontier is smooth and interpretable, enabling flexibility in choosing driving behavior along different conflicting objectives. This framework allows seamless transitions between different driving policies without retraining, yielding a robust and adaptive decision-making strategy for autonomous trucking applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对重型卡车在高速公路行驶中安全、效率与运营成本之间的权衡问题，提出了基于近端策略优化（PPO）的多目标强化学习框架。该框架学习一组显式表示这些权衡的Pareto最优策略，并在可扩展的仿真平台上进行评估。得到的Pareto前沿平滑且可解释，允许在不重新训练的情况下在不同驾驶策略间无缝切换。
Motivation: 传统标量奖励函数将多个竞争目标聚合，往往掩盖了它们之间的权衡结构，难以平衡安全、能效和时间效率等冲突目标。
Method: 提出基于PPO的多目标强化学习框架，通过学习一组Pareto最优策略来显式表示三个冲突目标（安全、能效、时间效率）之间的权衡。
Result: 在仿真平台上，该方法获得了平滑且可解释的Pareto前沿，能够灵活选择不同冲突目标下的驾驶行为，并支持策略间的无缝切换而无需重新训练。
Conclusion: 该框架为自动驾驶卡车提供了一种鲁棒且自适应的决策策略，能够在不重新训练的情况下适应不同驾驶偏好。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.method: 提出基于PPO的多目标强化学习框架，通过学习一组Pareto最优策略来显式表示三个冲突目标（安全、能效、时间效率）之间的权衡。
summary_sections.result: 在仿真平台上，该方法获得了平滑且可解释的Pareto前沿，能够灵活选择不同冲突目标下的驾驶行为，并支持策略间的无缝切换而无需重新训练。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为自动驾驶卡车提供了一种鲁棒且自适应的决策策略，能够在不重新训练的情况下适应不同驾驶偏好。

papers.title: Beyond Rigid: Benchmarking Non-Rigid Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: As video generation models are increasingly expected to manipulate physical dynamics, there is a growing need to move evaluation beyond appearance fidelity and semantic alignment. Non-rigid video editing offers a uniquely revealing testbed, where distinct materials impose distinct physical constraints. In this paper, we introduce NRVBench, a diagnostic benchmark for non-rigid video editing, where the task is to modify deformable motion while preserving irrelevant regions and maintaining material-specific plausibility. NRVBench contains 180 curated videos across six physics-grounded categories, 2,340 fine-grained editing instructions, 360 multiple-choice questions, and pixel-accurate masks. We further propose NRVE-Acc, a structured VLM-based protocol that decomposes editing success into instruction following, material-aware deformation plausibility, and temporal coherence with motion cues. Experiments on representative inference-time video editing methods reveal a clear mismatch between conventional metrics and physics-aware perceptual editing success: methods that preserve appearance or achieve strong global alignment may still fail under non-rigid dynamics. We additionally introduce VM-Edit, a simple region-conditioned editing baseline that frees the foreground while locking the background, exposing the stability--plasticity trade-off.

papers.title: A Monosemantic Attribution Framework for Stable Interpretability in Clinical Neuroscience Transformer-Based Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability remains a key challenge for deploying language models (LM) in clinical settings such as progression diagnosis of Alzheimer disease, where early and trustworthy predictions are essential. Existing attribution methods exhibit high inter-method variability and unstable explanations due to the polysemantic nature of Transformer-Based LM and LLM representations, while mechanistic interpretability approaches lack direct alignment with model inputs and outputs and do not provide explicit importance scores. We introduce a unified interpretability framework that integrates attributional and mechanistic perspectives through monosemantic feature extraction. By constructing a monosemantic embedding space at the level of an transformer-based LM layer and optimizing the framework to explicitly reduce inter-method variability, our approach produces stable input-level importance scores and highlights salient features via a decompressed representation of the layer of interest, advancing the safe and trustworthy application of LMs in cognitive health and neurodegenerative disease.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对临床神经科学中Transformer语言模型解释性不足的问题，提出一个统一的可解释性框架，通过单语义特征提取整合归因与机制视角，在Transformer层构建单语义嵌入空间，优化框架以减少方法间变异性，生成稳定的输入级重要性分数，并利用解压缩表示突出显著特征。
Motivation: 现有归因方法在临床诊断（如阿尔茨海默病进展）中表现出高方法间变异性和不稳定的解释，而机制可解释性方法缺乏与模型输入输出的直接对齐，且不提供显式重要性分数。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，通过构建Transformer层级的单语义嵌入空间，显式优化以减少归因方法间的变异性，从而生成稳定的输入级重要性分数，并利用层的解压缩表示突出显著特征。
Result: 摘要报告该框架能够产生稳定的输入级重要性分数并突出显著特征，推进了语言模型在认知健康和神经退行性疾病中的安全可信应用。
Conclusion: 该框架通过单语义归因整合了归因与机制可解释性视角，提高了临床LMs的可解释性和稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multigrade Neural Network Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We study multigrade deep learning (MGDL) as a principled framework for structured error refinement in deep neural networks. While the approximation power of neural networks is now relatively well understood, training very deep architectures remains challenging due to highly nonconvex and often ill-conditioned optimization landscapes. In contrast, for relatively shallow networks, most notably certain one-hidden-layer ReLU models, training admits convex reformulations with global guarantees under appropriate settings, motivating learning paradigms that improve stability while scaling to depth. MGDL builds on this insight by training deep networks grade by grade: previously learned grades are frozen, and each newly added grade-wise subnetwork is composed on top of the previously learned grades and trained to fit the residual left by the current approximation, yielding a structured and interpretable hierarchical refinement process. We develop an operator-theoretic foundation for MGDL and prove that, for any continuous target function defined on a hypercube, there exists a fixed-width multigrade ReLU scheme whose residuals are pointwise nonincreasing in magnitude and converge uniformly to zero, with strict $L^p$-norm decay at every nontrivial grade for $p\in [1,\infty)$. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first rigorous constructive approximation guarantee showing that a grade-wise residual refinement scheme can achieve vanishing error in a fixed-width multigrade ReLU architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多级深度学习 (MGDL) 框架，通过逐级冻结已训练子网络并新增子网络拟合当前残差，实现结构化误差细化。作者建立算子理论基础，并证明对超立方体上的连续目标函数，存在固定宽度的多级 ReLU 方案，其残差点状非增且一致收敛到零，且L^p范数严格递减。这是首个证明固定宽度多级架构可实现逐级残差收敛的构造性逼近定理。
Motivation: 深层神经网络训练因非凸和病态优化而困难，而浅层网络（如单隐层ReLU）可在适当设置下转化为凸优化并具有全局保证。如何将浅层网络的稳定性扩展到深层是一个开放问题。
Method: 提出多级深度学习 (MGDL)：逐级训练子网络，已训练级数被冻结，新级子网络堆叠在已有级上并拟合当前近似残差。开发算子理论框架，构造固定宽度多级 ReLU 方案。
Result: 对定义在超立方体上的任意连续目标函数，存在固定宽度多级 ReLU 方案，使得残差随级数增加点状非增且一致收敛到零，且对任意 p∈[1,∞) 有严格 L^p 范数衰减。
Conclusion: 这是首个严格的构造性逼近保证，表明逐级残差细化方案可在固定宽度的多级 ReLU 架构中实现误差消失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Do LLMs Know About Alzheimer's Disease? Multi-loss Fine-Tuning and Probing for AD Detection
papers.abstract_en: Reliable early detection of Alzheimer's disease (AD) is challenging, particularly due to the limited availability of labeled data. While large language models (LLMs) have shown strong transfer capabilities across do mains, adapting them to the AD domain through supervised fine-tuning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we empirically evaluate various model architectures across three heterogeneous transcript corpora (Pitt, CCC, ADRC) to investigate their effectiveness for text-based AD detection and analyze how task-relevant information is encoded within their internal representations. To the best of our knowledge, our fine-tuned BERT and T5 models establish a new state-of-the-art on the Pitt and CCC datasets, while achieving strong performance on ADRC. In parallel, the decoder-only Llama-1B achieves highly competitive results comparable to BERT and T5 across all three corpora, highlighting its effectiveness for AD detection. We further conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the Llama-1B backbone, analyzing cross-corpus transferability, optimal input chunk-size granularity, and the impact of clinical transcript markers. Also, we use linear probing to empirically show that fine-tuning shifts the representations of individual tokens, both linguistic markers and content words, in ways that reflect AD-related signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用大语言模型（LLM）进行基于文本的阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测。作者在三个转录语料库（Pitt、CCC、ADRC）上微调了BERT、T5和Llama-1B等模型，取得了新的最佳结果或具有竞争力的性能。通过线性探测分析，发现微调改变了语言标记和内容词的表示，从而编码了AD相关信息。
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病的早期检测困难，且标记数据有限。虽然LLM具有很强的跨领域迁移能力，但在AD领域的监督微调尚缺乏系统研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索LLM在AD检测中的有效性。
Method: 采用多种模型架构（BERT、T5、Llama-1B）进行监督微调，利用多损失训练目标；并在微调后使用线性探测分析内部表示的变化，研究模型如何编码AD相关信息。
Result: 微调的BERT和T5在Pitt和CCC数据集上达到新的最佳性能，在ADRC上也表现强劲；Llama-1B在三个语料库上与BERT和T5竞争力相当。此外，跨语料库迁移性、输入块大小和临床标记的影响也得到了分析。
Conclusion: 研究表明，通过微调LLM可以有效检测AD，且线性探测揭示了表示变化与AD信号的相关性。本文的方法为利用LLM进行AD早期检测提供了实证基础。

papers.title: DSA-Tokenizer: Disentangled Semantic-Acoustic Tokenization via Flow Matching-based Hierarchical Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Speech tokenizers are a key building block of fully discrete Speech LLMs. Existing tokenizers either prioritize semantic encoding, fuse semantic content with acoustic style inseparably,or achieve incomplete semantic-acoustic disentanglement. To achieve better disentanglement,we propose DSA-Tokenizer,which explicitly disentangles speech into discrete semantic and acoustic tokens via distinct optimization constraints.Specifically,semantic tokens are supervised by ASR to capture linguistic content,while acoustic tokens focus on mel-spectrograms restoration to encode style.We further introduce a hierarchical Flow Matching decoder and a joint reconstruction-context inpainting training strategy,allowing the model to support both high-fidelity reconstruction and cross-utterance voice clone.To speed up inference,we distill the DiT decoder to reduce sampling steps of inference to 4 and improve synthesis quality with GAN fine-tuning.Experiments demonstrate that DSA-Tokenizer provides strong semantic-acoustic disentanglement,reliable controllable voice cloning,and efficient high-fidelity generation with low WER/CER.Moreover, our results suggest that disentangled tokenization provides a more effective interface for downstream large-model speech generation.Audio samples are avaialble at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/DSA_Tokenizer_demo/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSA-Tokenizer 提出了一种显式解耦语音语义和声学信息的离散分词方法，通过 ASR 监督语义 token、mel 频谱重建监督声学 token，并引入层次化 Flow Matching 解码器和联合重建-上下文修补训练策略，支持高保真重建和跨语句声音克隆。实验表明该方法在语义-声学解耦、可控声音克隆和高效生成方面表现优异，且解耦分词为下游大模型语音生成提供了更有效的接口。
Motivation: 现有语音分词器要么侧重语义编码，要么将语义与声学风格不可分离地融合，或仅实现不完全解耦，需要更好的语义-声学解耦方案。
Method: 通过 ASR 任务监督语义 token 学习语言内容，通过 mel 频谱图恢复任务监督声学 token 编码风格；采用层次化 Flow Matching 解码器和联合重建-上下文修补训练策略，并利用 DiT 蒸馏将推理采样步数减少至 4 步，结合 GAN 微调提升合成质量。
Result: 摘要报告该分词器在语音解耦、可控声音克隆和高保真生成上取得优异结果，WER/CER 较低。
Conclusion: 解耦分词为下游大规模模型语音生成提供了更有效的接口；方法支持高效推理和高保真合成。

papers.title: Demystifying Multi-Agent Debate: The Role of Confidence and Diversity
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is widely used to improve large language model (LLM) performance through test-time scaling, yet recent work shows that vanilla MAD often underperforms simple majority vote despite higher computational cost. Studies show that, under homogeneous agents and uniform belief updates, debate preserves expected correctness and therefore cannot reliably improve outcomes. Drawing on findings from human deliberation and collective decision-making, we identify two key mechanisms missing from vanilla MAD: (i) diversity of initial viewpoints and (ii) explicit, calibrated confidence communication. We propose two lightweight interventions. First, a diversity-aware initialisation that selects a more diverse pool of candidate answers, increasing the likelihood that a correct hypothesis is present at the start of debate. Second, a confidence-modulated debate protocol in which agents express calibrated confidence and condition their updates on others' confidence. We show theoretically that diversity-aware initialisation improves the prior probability of MAD success without changing the underlying update dynamics, while confidence-modulated updates enable debate to systematically drift to the correct hypothesis. Empirically, across six reasoning-oriented QA benchmarks, our methods consistently outperform vanilla MAD and majority vote. Our results connect human deliberation with LLM-based debate and demonstrate that simple, principled modifications can substantially enhance debate effectiveness.

papers.title: ASKD-Whisper: Adaptive Self-knowledge Distillation for Efficient and Low-Latency Automatic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is one of the most effective paradigms for compressing large-scale foundation models into deployable architectures. In the context of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), previous studies have predominantly focused on forcing the student model to strictly mimic the predictive distribution of a massive teacher model. However, this static dependency often presents an inherent trade-off: while the student rapidly acquires basic linguistic representations, it simultaneously inherits the teacher's domain-specific blind spots and over-confident hallucinations, leading to a severe decline in out-of-distribution generalization capacity. To effectively mitigate this issue, we propose Adaptive Self-Knowledge Distillation (ASKD), a dynamic curriculum framework. ASKD systematically decays the dependency on the teacher's distribution as training progresses-thereby unlocking the student's independent reasoning capacity-and subsequently employs a self-knowledge distillation phase to act as a structural regularizer. By applying ASKD, we distill the massive Whisper architecture into a compact variant, ASKD-Whisper. In our comprehensive evaluations across diverse acoustic domains, ASKD-Whisper not only achieves a 5x speedup in inference latency but also outperforms its teacher model by yielding a 1.07% lower word error rate (WER). These results demonstrate that ASKD effectively prevents teacher-induced overfitting and establishes a new state-of-the-art for generalizable model compression.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应自知识蒸馏（ASKD），一种动态课程框架，用于自动语音识别模型压缩。ASKD在训练过程中逐渐减少对教师模型分布的依赖，随后引入自知识蒸馏阶段作为结构化正则化器。将ASKD应用于Whisper模型得到的ASKD-Whisper，在多种声学领域评估中，推理速度提升5倍，词错误率（WER）比教师模型低1.07%，表明该框架有效防止了教师诱导的过拟合，实现了泛化模型压缩的最新技术水平。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法强制学生模型严格模仿教师模型预测分布，导致学生继承教师的领域特定盲点和过度自信幻觉，损害分布外泛化能力。需要一种动态蒸馏框架来缓解这一权衡。
Method: 提出自适应自知识蒸馏（ASKD），包含两个阶段：第一阶段动态衰减对教师分布依赖以解锁学生独立推理能力；第二阶段采用自知识蒸馏作为结构化正则化器。
Result: ASKD-Whisper在推理延迟上实现5倍加速，且词错误率（WER）比教师模型低1.07%，在多种声学领域评估中表现优越。
Conclusion: ASKD有效防止教师诱导的过拟合，为泛化模型压缩建立了新的最先进水平。

papers.title: FastSLM: Hierarchical Temporal Abstraction for Efficient Long-Form Speech Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Scaling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to long-form speech is bottlenecked by the explosive growth of input tokens. Unlike images or videos, audio lacks overlapping information, making extreme 1-token compression highly susceptible to the loss of fine-grained acoustic cues. To overcome this, we propose FastSLM, a token-efficient architecture featuring the Hierarchical Temporal Abstractor (HTA). HTA progressively distills non-overlapping acoustic features across multiple temporal scales, achieving an extreme compression rate of 1.67 tokens per second a 97% reduction without losing critical context. Experimental results show that FastSLM achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art models on long-form benchmarks despite operating with significantly fewer FLOPs and parameters. The source code and model checkpoints are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FastSLM-8BD3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FastSLM，一种用于长语音的高效 token 架构，核心是层次时间抽象器 (HTA)，可在多时间尺度上渐进式蒸馏非重叠声学特征，实现每秒 1.67 个 token 的极端压缩率（减少 97%），且在长语音基准上达到与 SOTA 模型相当的性能，同时显著降低 FLOPs 和参数量。
Motivation: 扩展多模态大语言模型至长语音受限于输入 token 的爆炸式增长，而音频缺乏重叠信息，极端压缩容易丢失细粒度声学线索。
Method: 提出 FastSLM 架构，包含层次时间抽象器 (HTA)，通过多时间尺度渐进式蒸馏非重叠声学特征，实现高压缩率。
Result: 在长语音基准上，FastSLM 以显著更少的 FLOPs 和参数达到与 SOTA 模型相当的竞争性能，压缩率达每秒 1.67 个 token（减少 97%）。
Conclusion: 所提出的层次时间抽象方法有效平衡了长语音场景下的 token 效率与信息保留，代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: Prototypicality Bias Reveals Blindspots in Multimodal Evaluation Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Automatic metrics are widely used to evaluate text-to-image models, often replacing human judgment in benchmarking, model selection, and large-scale data filtering. Yet they may reward images that look plausible or prototypical rather than images that faithfully satisfy the prompt. We identify prototypicality bias as a systematic blindspot in multimodal evaluation: metrics can prefer a semantically incorrect but visually or socially prototypical image over a correct but less prototypical one. We introduce PROTOBIAS, a controlled diagnostic benchmark across Animals, Objects, and Demography, where semantically correct images are contrasted with plausible prototypical adversaries containing a single controlled semantic violation. Grounded in prototype theory and social-category prototypicality, PROTOBIAS is constructed with multiple prompt generators, image generators, and independent VLM filters, and validated through prompt-quality, human-annotation, and image-quality controls. Using PROTOBIAS, we show that widely used embedding, reward, VQA-based, and VLM-as-judge metrics frequently fail these contrasts, while human judgments remain more faithful to semantic correctness. We further introduce PROTOSCORE, a lightweight contrastively trained evaluator, as an initial mitigation baseline. PROTOBIAS provides a focused benchmark for measuring prototypicality-driven metric failures and developing more semantically faithful T2I evaluators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别了多模态评估指标中的原型性偏差（prototypicality bias），即指标更偏好视觉或社会原型图像而非语义正确图像。作者构建了PROTOBIAS诊断基准，涵盖动物、物体和人口三个领域，对比语义正确图像与含有单个语义违反的原型对抗图像。实验表明常用指标经常失败，而人类判断更忠实语义；同时提出轻量级对比训练评估器PROTOSCORE作为缓解基线。
Motivation: 自动指标可能奖励看似合理或原型性的图像，而非忠实满足提示的图像，这是一个系统性盲点，需要被识别和系统化研究。
Method: 提出PROTOBIAS基准，使用多个提示生成器、图像生成器和独立VLM过滤器构建语义正确图像与原型对抗图像的对比对，并通过提示质量、人类注释和图像质量控制验证。还引入PROTOSCORE作为对比训练评估器。
Result: 广泛使用的嵌入、奖励、VQA-based和VLM-as-judge指标在PROTOBIAS对比中经常失败，而人类判断更忠实于语义正确性。
Conclusion: PROTOBIAS为测量原型性偏差导致的指标失败提供了聚焦基准，并促进开发更语义忠实的文本到图像评估器。

papers.title: Paradoxical noise preference in RNNs
papers.abstract_en: In recurrent neural networks (RNNs) used to model biological neural networks, noise is typically introduced during training to emulate biological variability and regularize learning. The expectation is that removing the noise at test time should preserve or improve performance. Contrary to this intuition, we find that continuous-time RNNs (CTRNNs) often perform best at or near the training noise level. This noise preference typically arises when noise is injected inside the neural activation function; networks trained with noise injected outside the activation function perform best with zero noise. The phenomenon arises robustly in diverse tasks for large enough training noise; we also show the phenomenon arising in feedforward neural networks, not just in RNNs. Our analyses show that the phenomenon stems from noise-induced shifts of fixed points (stationary distributions) in the underlying stochastic dynamics of the RNNs. These fixed point shifts are noise-level dependent and bias the network outputs when the noise is removed, degrading performance. Analytical and numerical results show that the bias arises when neural states operate near activation-function nonlinearities, where noise is asymmetrically attenuated, and that performance optimization incentivizes operation near these nonlinearities; such performance incentives exist for networks with noise inside, but not outside, the activation function, explaining why only noise-in networks show the preference. Thus, networks can overfit to the training noise itself rather than just to the input-output data. The phenomenon is distinct from stochastic resonance, wherein nonzero noise enhances signal processing. Our findings reveal that training noise can become an integral part of the computation learned by neural networks, with implications for understanding neural population dynamics and for the design of robust artificial RNNs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现连续时间递归神经网络（CTRNN）在训练时注入噪声后，测试时去除噪声反而会降低性能，网络倾向于保留训练噪声水平。该现象源于噪声引起的固定点偏移，仅在激活函数内部注入噪声时出现，且不同于随机共振。
Motivation: 传统观点认为训练噪声可正则化，测试时去噪应改善性能，但本文观察到相反现象，需要探究噪声偏好产生的机制。
Method: 通过对比噪声注入位置（激活函数内 vs 外）的实验，结合固定点分析和随机动力学分析，揭示噪声偏好源于噪声引起的固定点偏移和非线性区域的非对称衰减。
Result: 噪声偏好现象在多种任务中稳健出现，仅当噪声注入激活函数内部；噪声注入外部则无此现象。分析表明偏差源于网络在非线性区域操作时噪声的不可逆偏移。
Conclusion: 训练噪声可能成为网络计算的一部分，对理解神经群体动力学和设计鲁棒人工RNN有启示，且该现象与随机共振不同。

papers.title: Sparse FEONet: A Low-Cost, Memory-Efficient Operator Network via Finite-Element Local Sparsity for Parametric PDEs
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the finite element operator network (FEONet), an operator-learning method for parametric problems, originally introduced in J. Y. Lee, S. Ko, and Y. Hong, Finite Element Operator Network for Solving Elliptic-Type Parametric PDEs, SIAM J. Sci. Comput., 47(2), C501-C528, 2025. FEONet realizes the parameter-to-solution map on a finite element space and admits a training procedure that does not require training data, while exhibiting high accuracy and robustness across a broad class of problems. However, its computational cost increases and accuracy may deteriorate as the number of elements grows, posing notable challenges for large-scale problems. In this paper, we propose a new sparse network architecture motivated by the structure of the finite elements to address this issue. Throughout extensive numerical experiments, we show that the proposed sparse network achieves substantial improvements in computational cost and efficiency while maintaining comparable accuracy. We also establish theoretical results demonstrating that the sparse architecture can approximate the target operator effectively and provide a stability analysis ensuring reliable training and prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有限元算子网络（FEONet）在大规模问题中计算成本高、精度可能下降的问题，提出一种基于有限元局部稀疏性的稀疏网络架构（Sparse FEONet）。数值实验表明该方法在保持精度的同时显著提升计算效率，并附带理论逼近与稳定性分析。
Motivation: FEONet虽能无训练数据求解参数化PDE，但随网格数量增加计算成本剧增且精度可能下降，限制了在大规模问题上的应用。
Method: 受有限元结构启发，设计稀疏网络架构，通过局部稀疏连接降低参数和计算量。
Result: 大量数值实验表明，稀疏网络在保持与原始FEONet相当精度的前提下，大幅提升了计算效率和内存使用。
Conclusion: 所提出的稀疏架构能有效逼近目标算子，且具有稳定性保证，适合大规模参数化PDE问题。

summary_sections.conclusion: 所提出的稀疏架构能有效逼近目标算子，且具有稳定性保证，适合大规模参数化PDE问题。

papers.title: NOS-Gate: Queue-Aware Streaming IDS for Consumer Gateways under Timing-Controlled Evasion
papers.abstract_en: Timing and burst patterns can leak through encryption, and an adaptive adversary can exploit them. This undermines metadata-only detection in a stand-alone consumer gateway. Therefore, consumer gateways need streaming intrusion detection on encrypted traffic using metadata only, under tight CPU and latency budgets. We present a streaming IDS for stand-alone gateways that instantiates a lightweight two-state unit derived from Network-Optimised Spiking (NOS) dynamics per flow, named \emph{NOS-Gate}. NOS-Gate scores fixed-length windows of metadata features and, under a $K$-of-$M$ persistence rule, triggers a reversible mitigation that temporarily reduces the flow's weight under weighted fair queueing (WFQ). We evaluate NOS-Gate under timing-controlled evasion using an executable \emph{worlds} benchmark that specifies benign device processes, auditable attacker budgets, contention structure, and packet-level WFQ replay to quantify queue impact. All methods are calibrated label-free via burn-in quantile thresholding. Across multiple reproducible worlds and malicious episodes, at an achieved $0.1\%$ false-positive operating point, NOS-Gate attains 0.952 incident recall versus 0.857 for the best baseline in these runs. Under gating, it reduces p99.9 queueing delay and p99.9 collateral delay with a mean scoring cost of $\approx 2.09\,μ\mathrm{s}$ per flow-window on CPU.

TL;DR: 本文提出NOS-Gate，一种针对消费者网关的流式入侵检测系统，基于网络优化脉冲动力学（NOS）对加密流量的元数据进行实时评分。系统使用K-of-M持久规则触发可逆缓解，通过加权公平队列（WFQ）降低队列影响。在可执行worlds基准下，0.1%假阳性率时达到0.952 incident召回率，优于基线0.857，且平均评分成本约2.09微秒每流窗口。

Conclusion: NOS-Gate在资源受限的消费者网关上实现了高召回率、低延迟的流式IDS，有效应对时序控制逃避，且开销极小。

papers.title: IMA++: ISIC Archive Multi-Annotator Dermoscopic Skin Lesion Segmentation Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Multi-annotator medical image segmentation is an important research problem, but requires annotated datasets that are expensive to collect. Dermoscopic skin lesion imaging allows human experts and AI systems to observe morphological structures otherwise not discernable from regular clinical photographs. However, currently there are no large-scale publicly available multi-annotator skin lesion segmentation (SLS) datasets with annotator-labels for dermoscopic skin lesion imaging. We introduce ISIC MultiAnnot++, a large public multi-annotator skin lesion segmentation dataset for images from the ISIC Archive. The final dataset contains 17,684 segmentation masks spanning 14,967 dermoscopic images, where 2,394 dermoscopic images have 2-5 segmentations per image, making it the largest publicly available SLS dataset. Further, metadata about the segmentation, including the annotators' skill level and segmentation tool, is included, enabling research on topics such as annotator-specific preference modeling for segmentation and annotator metadata analysis. We provide an analysis on the characteristics of this dataset, curated data partitions, and consensus segmentation masks.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Data Descriptions, 12 pages, 7 figures
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Data Descr. 3 (2026) 367-378
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 IMA++（ISIC MultiAnnot++），一个大规模多标注者皮肤镜皮肤病变分割数据集。数据集包含 17,684 个分割掩码，覆盖 14,967 张皮肤镜图像，其中 2,394 张图像有 2-5 个分割标注。数据集还包括标注者技能水平、分割工具等元数据，支持标注者偏好建模等研究。
Motivation: 目前缺乏大规模公开的多标注者皮肤病变分割数据集，尤其是带有标注者级标签的皮肤镜图像数据集。
Method: 从 ISIC 档案中收集图像，由多名标注者提供分割掩码，并记录标注者技能水平和所用工具等元数据，构建多标注者数据集。
Result: 最终数据集包含 17,684 个掩码和 14,967 张图像，是公开可用的最大皮肤病变分割数据集，并提供共识分割掩码。
Conclusion: 该数据集可支持多标注者分割、标注者偏好建模等研究，但仅针对皮肤镜皮肤病变图像。
