papers.title: Degradation-Aware Metric Prompting for Hyperspectral Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Unified hyperspectral image (HSI) restoration aims to recover diverse degradations within a single model. However, current methods often rely on impractical explicit priors or opaque black-box representations that overfit to training distributions, hampering generalization to unseen scenarios. To bridge this gap, we propose Degradation-Aware Metric Prompting (DAMP), a novel framework that characterizes multi-dimensional degradations through interpretable spatial-spectral metrics. These metrics serve as Degradation Prompts (DP), enabling the model to capture shared characteristics across tasks and adapt to unknown corruptions. Central to our framework is the Degradation-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (DAMoE), where Spatial-Spectral Adaptive Modules (SSAMs) serve as experts that utilize learnable fusion coefficients to specialize in distinct degradation degrees. By using DP as a gating router, DAMoE dynamically activates specialized experts tailored to the specific degradation profile. Extensive experiments on natural and remote sensing HSI datasets demonstrate that DAMP achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibits exceptional zero-shot generalization on unseen restoration tasks. Code is publicly available at \href{DAMP}{https://github.com/MiliLab/DAMP}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出退化感知度量提示（DAMP）框架，用于统一高光谱图像恢复任务。该方法通过可解释的空间-光谱度量作为退化提示（DP），并利用退化自适应混合专家（DAMoE）动态激活专家模块，在自然和遥感数据集上达到最先进性能，并展示出对未见退化的零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有统一高光谱图像恢复方法依赖不切实际的显式先验或过拟合训练分布的黑盒表示，难以泛化到未知退化场景。
Method: 提出DAMP框架，包括基于空间-光谱度量的退化提示（DP）和退化自适应混合专家（DAMoE），其中空间-光谱自适应模块（SSAM）作为专家，DP作为门控路由器。
Result: 在自然和遥感高光谱数据集上，DAMP达到最先进性能，并展现出对未见退化任务的零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 可解释的退化度量提示和自适应专家路由能有效提升统一高光谱图像恢复的泛化性能。

papers.title: Dynamic Entropy Tuning in Reinforcement Learning Low-Level Quadcopter Control: Stochasticity vs Determinism
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the impact of dynamic entropy tuning in Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms that train a stochastic policy. Its performance is compared against algorithms that train a deterministic one. Stochastic policies optimize a probability distribution over actions to maximize rewards, while deterministic policies select a single deterministic action per state. The effect of training a stochastic policy with both static entropy and dynamic entropy and then executing deterministic actions to control the quadcopter is explored. It is then compared against training a deterministic policy and executing deterministic actions. For the purpose of this research, the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm was chosen for the stochastic algorithm while the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) was chosen for the deterministic algorithm. The training and simulation results show the positive effect the dynamic entropy tuning has on controlling the quadcopter by preventing catastrophic forgetting and improving exploration efficiency.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了强化学习（RL）中动态熵调整对随机策略训练的影响，并将其与确定性策略进行比较。使用SAC（随机策略，支持动态熵调整）和TD3（确定性策略）控制四旋翼飞行器。仿真结果表明，动态熵调整通过防止灾难性遗忘和提高探索效率，改善了四旋翼控制性能。
Motivation: 随机策略（如SAC）通常使用静态熵系数，可能导致探索不足或遗忘；动态熵调整能否进一步提升控制性能尚不清楚。
Method: 采用SAC算法训练随机策略，并结合动态熵调整；同时使用TD3训练确定性策略作为对比。在四旋翼低层控制任务中进行仿真实验，比较不同策略的执行效果。
Result: 动态熵调整的随机策略在四旋翼控制中优于静态熵的随机策略和确定性策略，具体表现为防止灾难性遗忘和提升探索效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态熵调整对强化学习控制四旋翼的正面作用，但未讨论实际部署或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Position Control of a Quadrotor Using Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new Reinforcement Learning (RL) based control architecture for quadrotors. With the literature focusing on controlling the four rotors' RPMs directly, this paper aims to control the quadrotor's thrust vector. The RL agent computes the percentage of overall thrust along the quadrotor's z-axis along with the desired Roll ($φ$) and Pitch ($θ$) angles. The agent then sends the calculated control signals along with the current quadrotor's Yaw angle ($ψ$) to an attitude PID controller. The PID controller then maps the control signals to motor RPMs. The Soft Actor-Critic algorithm, a model-free off-policy stochastic RL algorithm, was used to train the RL agents. Training results show the faster training time of the proposed thrust vector controller in comparison to the conventional RPM controllers. Simulation results show smoother and more accurate path-following for the proposed thrust vector controller.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习（Soft Actor-Critic）的四旋翼控制架构，通过控制推力矢量（thrust vector）而非直接控制四个旋翼的转速。智能体输出沿z轴的总推力百分比以及期望的滚转角和俯仰角，再由姿态PID控制器映射为电机转速。仿真结果表明，相较于传统RPM控制器，所提方法训练更快且路径跟踪更平滑、更精确。

Conclusion: 摘要表明所提推力矢量控制器在训练效率和跟踪性能上优于传统RPM控制器。

papers.title: Agent Tools Orchestration Leaks More: Dataset, Benchmark, and Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents increasingly use multiple external tools to complete complex tasks. We study Tools Orchestration Privacy Risk (TOP-R): an agent may combine individually non-sensitive tool returns and disclose an unintended sensitive conclusion. We formalize TOP-R with three conditions: conclusion sensitivity, single-source non-inferability, and compositional inferability. We introduce LRSE (Library-Grounded Reverse-Inference Seed Expansion), a four-library reverse-construction pipeline grounded in privacy norms, reasoning chains, tool schemas, and task scenarios, and use it to build TOP-Bench, a 1,000-instance benchmark. The benchmark evaluates final-response semantic disclosure under a controlled two-stage tool-use protocol. Across six LLM agents, task completion remains high, but the average leakage rate reaches 88.6 percent, yielding an H-score of only 20.4. Two prompt-only safeguards improve H-score by about 2.7 points on the main benchmark. We further propose TOP-Align, an SFT+DPO post-training method for safer task completion boundaries. On a separate post-training evaluation split, TOP-Align improves H-score by 16.2 points over the corresponding base model, compared with a 4.9-point average gain from prompt-only mitigation on the same split. These results show that TOP-R requires mitigation beyond prompting alone.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/1Ponder/TOP-R
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于LLM的智能体在编排外部工具时可能产生的隐私风险（TOP-R）：智能体组合多个单独非敏感的工具返回结果，可能推断出非预期的敏感结论。作者形式化定义了TOP-R的三个条件，构建了四个库的反向推断流水线LRSE，并基于此建立了包含1000个实例的基准TOP-Bench。实验表明，在六种LLM智能体上，平均泄露率达88.6%，H-score仅20.4。仅通过提示词缓解效果有限，作者提出的TOP-Align（SFT+DPO）后训练方法可将H-score提升16.2点。
Motivation: 现有研究未充分关注智能体工具编排中组合推论导致的隐私泄露风险，即单个非敏感输出组合后可能泄露敏感信息。
Method: 形式化定义TOP-R的三个条件；提出LRSE（Library-Grounded Reverse-Inference Seed Expansion）反向构建流水线，利用四个库（隐私规范、推理链、工具模式、任务场景）生成基准；提出TOP-Align，一种结合监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）的后训练方法。
Result: 在TOP-Bench上，六种LLM智能体平均任务完成率保持高位，但平均泄露率达88.6%，H-score仅20.4。提示词缓解平均提升H-score约2.7点；TOP-Align在单独评估集上提升16.2点，远优于提示词缓解。
Conclusion: TOP-R问题无法仅通过提示词缓解，需要模型层面的后训练方法（如TOP-Align）来定义更安全的任务完成边界。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究基于LLM的智能体在编排外部工具时可能产生的隐私风险（TOP-R）：智能体组合多个单独非敏感的工具返回结果，可能推断出非预期的敏感结论。作者形式化定义了TOP-R的三个条件，构建了四个库的反向推断流水线LRSE，并基于此建立了包含1000个实例的基准TOP-Bench。实验表明，在六种LLM智能体上，平均泄露率达88.6%，H-score仅20.4。仅通过提示词缓解效果有限，作者提出的TOP-Align（SFT+DPO）后训练方法可将H-score提升16.2点。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究未充分关注智能体工具编排中组合推论导致的隐私泄露风险，即单个非敏感输出组合后可能泄露敏感信息。
summary_sections.method: 形式化定义TOP-R的三个条件；提出LRSE（Library-Grounded Reverse-Inference Seed Expansion）反向构建流水线，利用四个库（隐私规范、推理链、工具模式、任务场景）生成基准；提出TOP-Align，一种结合监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）的后训练方法。
summary_sections.result: 在TOP-Bench上，六种LLM智能体平均任务完成率保持高位，但平均泄露率达88.6%，H-score仅20.4。提示词缓解平均提升H-score约2.7点；TOP-Align在单独评估集上提升16.2点，远优于提示词缓解。
summary_sections.conclusion: TOP-R问题无法仅通过提示词缓解，需要模型层面的后训练方法（如TOP-Align）来定义更安全的任务完成边界。

papers.title: Unified Semantic Transformer for 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Holistic 3D scene understanding involves capturing and parsing unstructured 3D environments. Due to the inherent complexity of the real world, existing models have predominantly been developed and limited to be task-specific. We introduce UNITE, a Unified Semantic Transformer for 3D scene understanding, a novel feed-forward neural network that unifies a diverse set of 3D dense semantic indoor tasks within a single model. Our model operates on unseen scenes trained in a fully end-to-end manner and only takes a couple seconds to infer the full 3D semantic geometry. Our approach is capable of directly predicting multiple dense semantic attributes, including 3D scene segmentation, instance embeddings, open-vocabulary features, and articulations, solely from RGB images. The method is trained using a combination of 2D distillation, heavily relying on self-supervision and leverages novel multi-view losses designed to ensure 3D view consistency. We demonstrate that UNITE achieves state-of-the-art performance on several different dense indoor semantic tasks and even outperforms task-specific models, in many cases, surpassing methods that operate on ground truth 3D geometry. See the project website at unite-page.github.io
papers.comment: Accepted at TMLR. Project page: https://unite-page.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UNITE，一个统一的语义 Transformer，用于从 RGB 图像直接预测 3D 室内场景的多种密集语义属性（如分割、实例嵌入、开放词汇特征和关节结构），无需依赖真实 3D 几何。模型通过端到端训练，结合 2D 蒸馏和自监督的多视图一致性损失，在多项任务上达到最新性能。
Motivation: 现有 3D 场景理解模型大多针对单一任务，缺乏能够统一处理多种密集语义预测的单一架构。
Method: 提出一个前馈神经网络 UNITE，使用 2D 蒸馏和自监督学习，设计新颖的多视图损失以确保 3D 视图一致性，直接从 RGB 图像端到端预测多种语义属性。
Result: 在多个室内密集语义任务上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，甚至超越基于真实 3D 几何的任务特定模型。
Conclusion: UNITE 展示了单个模型统一多种 3D 语义任务的可能性，并强调了自监督和多视图一致性训练的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Control of a Twin Rotor using Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3)
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for controlling and stabilizing the Twin Rotor Aerodynamic System (TRAS) at specific pitch and azimuth angles and tracking a given trajectory. The complex dynamics and non-linear characteristics of the TRAS make it challenging to control using traditional control algorithms. However, recent developments in RL have attracted interest due to their potential applications in the control of multirotors. The Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm was used in this paper to train the RL agent. This algorithm is used for environments with continuous state and action spaces, similar to the TRAS, as it does not require a model of the system. The simulation results illustrated the effectiveness of the RL control method. Next, external disturbances in the form of wind disturbances were used to test the controller's effectiveness compared to conventional PID controllers. Lastly, experiments on a laboratory setup were carried out to confirm the controller's effectiveness in real-world applications.
papers.comment: This is the Author Accepted Manuscript version of a paper accepted for publication. The final published version is available via IEEE Xplore
papers.journal_ref: 2024 28th IEEE International Conference on System Theory, Control and Computing (ICSTCC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于TD3强化学习算法的框架，用于控制双转子气动系统（TRAS）在俯仰和方位角上的稳定及轨迹跟踪。仿真和实验结果表明，该方法在抗风扰动方面优于传统PID控制器。
Motivation: TRAS的非线性动力学特性使传统控制算法难以有效控制，而强化学习在处理复杂连续控制问题上具有潜力。
Method: 采用Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3)算法训练强化学习智能体，无需系统模型，适用于连续状态和动作空间。
Result: 仿真结果验证了RL控制方法的有效性；引入风扰动后，TD3控制器表现优于传统PID控制器；实验室硬件实验进一步证实了实际应用中的控制效果。
Conclusion: TD3强化学习框架能有效控制TRAS，并具备抗干扰能力，为多旋翼控制提供了新思路。

papers.title: WorldLens: Full-Spectrum Evaluations of Driving World Models in Real World
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models are reshaping embodied AI, enabling agents to synthesize realistic 4D driving environments that look convincing but often fail physically or behaviorally. Despite rapid progress, the field still lacks a unified way to assess whether generated worlds preserve geometry, obey physics, or support reliable control. We introduce WorldLens, a full-spectrum benchmark evaluating how well a model builds, understands, and behaves within its generated world. It spans five aspects -- Generation, Reconstruction, Action-Following, Downstream Task, and Human Preference -- jointly covering visual realism, geometric consistency, physical plausibility, and functional reliability. Across these dimensions, no existing world model excels universally: those with strong textures often violate physics, while geometry-stable ones lack behavioral fidelity. To align objective metrics with human judgment, we further construct WorldLens-26K, a large-scale dataset of human-annotated videos with numerical scores and textual rationales, and develop WorldLens-Agent, an evaluation model distilled from these annotations to enable scalable, explainable scoring. Together, the benchmark, dataset, and agent form a unified ecosystem for measuring world fidelity -- standardizing how future models are judged not only by how real they look, but by how real they behave.
papers.comment: CVPR 2026 Oral Presentation; 80 pages, 37 figures, 29 tables; Project Page at https://worldbench.github.io/worldlens GitHub at https://github.com/worldbench/WorldLens
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WorldLens，一个全光谱基准，用于评估生成式驾驶世界模型在生成、重建、动作跟随、下游任务和人类偏好五个方面的表现。作者发现现有模型无一在所有维度上表现优秀：纹理逼真的模型常违反物理规律，几何稳定的模型则缺乏行为可信度。为统一评判标准，他们进一步构建了包含人工标注分数与文本理由的大型数据集WorldLens-26K，并蒸馏出可扩展的评估模型WorldLens-Agent。
Motivation: 现有的生成式驾驶世界模型虽然能合成逼真的4D驾驶环境，但往往在物理一致性或行为可靠性上存在缺陷，而领域内缺乏统一的评估框架来系统衡量生成世界的几何、物理与功能保真度。
Method: WorldLens覆盖五个评估维度：生成质量、重建精度、动作跟随能力、下游任务性能以及人类偏好。配套构建了WorldLens-26K人工标注数据集，并基于此蒸馏出可解释的自动评估模型WorldLens-Agent。
Result: 实验表明，没有任何现有世界模型在所有维度上表现突出：具有强纹理的模型常违反物理规律，而几何稳定的模型则在行为保真度上不足。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个统一基准、数据集和评估模型，推动未来世界模型不仅依据视觉真实性，更依据行为真实性来评判。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: On the Collapse of Generative Paths: A Criterion and Correction for Diffusion Steering
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time steering adapts pretrained diffusion and flow models to new tasks without retraining, often utilizing ratio-of-densities constructions that reweight time-indexed marginals with fixed exponents. We identify Marginal Path Collapse, a failure mode in which the intermediate density defined by such compositions becomes non-normalizable despite valid endpoints. This collapse can arise when composing heterogeneous experts trained with mismatched noise schedules (and/or negative exponents / partial supports). To address this, we provide (i) a sharp sufficient Path Existence Criterion that characterizes when the composed intermediate densities are mathematically well-defined, and (ii) Adaptive Path Correction with Exponents (ACE), which generalizes Feynman-Kac steering to support time-varying exponents. Our analysis reveals that ACE controls the quantile radius of the intermediate distributions, providing a theoretical mechanism for path stabilization observed in experiments. On flexible-pose scaffold decoration, a drug design task composed of de-novo, conformer, and protein-conditioned experts, ACE prevents collapse and significantly outperforms constant-exponent baselines. Furthermore, ACE improves attribute success rates in compositional image generation, establishing it as a general framework for compositional sampling. Project Page: https://ziseoklee.github.io/projects/ACE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文发现扩散/流模型在推理时引导中可能出现“边际路径坍缩”现象，即组合的中间密度不可归一化。作者提出路径存在性判据（sharp sufficient condition）和自适应路径校正（ACE），后者推广Feynman-Kac引导以支持时变指数。在药物设计和组合图像生成任务中，ACE防止坍缩并显著优于常数指数基线。
Motivation: 推理时引导常利用密度比构造重加权边际分布，但可能出现中间密度非归一化的失败模式，即边际路径坍缩，影响模型在组合任务中的稳定性。
Method: 提出路径存在性判据（sharp sufficient condition）来刻画中间密度数学定义的充分条件，以及自适应路径校正（ACE），该算法推广Feynman-Kac引导以支持时变指数，通过控制中间分布的量化半径实现路径稳定。
Result: 在灵活姿势骨架装饰（药物设计）任务中，ACE防止坍缩并显著优于常数指数基线；在组合图像生成中，ACE提高属性成功率。
Conclusion: ACE为组合采样提供通用框架，通过理论分析和实验验证了路径稳定机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpreto: An Explainability Library for Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Interpreto is an open-source Python library for interpreting HuggingFace language models, from early BERT variants to LLMs. It provides two complementary families of methods: attribution methods and concept-based explanations. The library bridges recent research and practical tooling by exposing explanation workflows through a unified API for both classification and text generation. A key differentiator is its end-to-end concept-based pipeline (from activation extraction to concept learning, interpretation, and scoring), which goes beyond feature-level attributions and is uncommon in existing libraries. See GitHub: https://github.com/FOR-sight-ai/interpreto and the demo website: https://for-sight-ai.github.io/interpreto-demo/.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 System Demonstration. Equal contribution: Poché and Jourdan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Interpreto 是一个开源 Python 库，用于解释 HuggingFace 语言模型（从早期 BERT 变体到 LLM）。它提供归因方法和基于概念的解释两类互补方法，通过统一 API 支持分类和文本生成。其关键差异化优势是端到端的基于概念的流水线（从激活提取到概念学习、解释和评分），超越了特征级归因，这在现有库中不常见。
Motivation: 现有可解释性库主要提供特征级归因，缺乏从激活到概念学习的端到端工具，难以满足用户对模型高层理解的需。
Method: Interpreto 提供两类方法：归因方法（如梯度、注意力）和基于概念的解释（包括激活提取、概念学习、解释和评分），通过统一 API 支持分类和文本生成任务。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但强调该库提供了现有库中罕见的端到端概念解释流水线。
Conclusion: Interpreto 桥接了近期研究与实用工具，为 Transformer 模型可解释性提供了一个全面的开源解决方案，特别适用于需要概念级解释的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpaceTools: Tool-Augmented Spatial Reasoning via Double Interactive RL
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong qualitative visual understanding, but struggle with metrically precise spatial reasoning required for embodied applications. The agentic paradigm promises that VLMs can use a wide variety of tools that could augment these capabilities, such as depth estimators, segmentation models, and pose estimators. Yet it remains an open challenge how to realize this vision without solely relying on handcrafted prompting strategies or enforcing fixed, predefined tool pipelines that limit VLMs' ability to discover optimal tool-use patterns. Reinforcement Learning could overcome this gap, but has so far been limited to reasoning with a single visual tool due to the large search space in multi-tool reasoning. We introduce Double Interactive Reinforcement Learning (DIRL), a two-phase training framework where VLMs learn to coordinate multiple tools through interactive exploration and feedback. In the teaching phase, we combine demonstrations from a single tool specialist trained via interactive RL with traces from a frontier model using all tools. In the exploration phase, the model further refines multi-tool coordination through continued RL. Our model, SpaceTools, with tool-augmented spatial reasoning ability, achieves state-of-the-art performance on spatial understanding benchmarks (RoboSpatial-Home, BLINK, BOP-ASK) and demonstrates reliable real-world manipulation using a 7-DOF robot as a tool. DIRL provides substantial improvements over the vanilla SFT (+12% on RoboSpatial) and RL (+16% on RoboSpatial) baselines. Project page: https://spacetools.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双交互强化学习（DIRL）框架，分两阶段训练视觉语言模型（VLM）协调多种空间工具（深度估计、分割、位姿估计等），解决多工具推理的搜索空间过大问题。SpaceTools模型在RoboSpatial-Home、BLINK、BOP-ASK等空间理解基准上取得最优，并在7-DOF机器人操控任务中验证了实用性。相比SFT和RL基线分别提升12%和16%。
Motivation: VLM在度量精确的空间推理任务中表现不足，现有方法依赖手工提示或固定工具流水线，限制了模型自主发现最优工具使用模式的能力。多工具推理的搜索空间大，RL此前仅用于单一视觉工具。
Method: DIRL包含教学和探索两阶段：教学阶段利用单工具专家（通过交互式RL训练）的演示与前沿模型（使用所有工具）的轨迹相结合；探索阶段通过持续RL进一步优化多工具协调。
Result: 在RoboSpatial-Home、BLINK、BOP-ASK上取得SOTA；在7-DOF机器人操控中展示真实世界操作能力；DIRL相比SFT提升12%，相比RL提升16%。

papers.title: Safeguarded Stochastic Polyak Step Sizes for Non-smooth Optimization: Robust Performance Without Small (Sub)Gradients
papers.abstract_en: The stochastic Polyak step size (SPS) has proven to be a promising choice for stochastic gradient descent (SGD), delivering competitive performance relative to state-of-the-art methods on smooth convex and non-convex optimization problems, including deep neural network training. However, extensions of this approach to non-smooth settings remain in their early stages, often relying on interpolation assumptions or requiring knowledge of the optimal solution. In this work, we propose a novel SPS variant, Safeguarded SPS (SPS$_{safe}$), for the stochastic subgradient method, and provide rigorous convergence guarantees for non-smooth convex optimization with no need for strong assumptions. We further incorporate momentum into the update rule, yielding equally tight theoretical results. Comprehensive experiments on convex benchmarks and deep neural networks corroborate our theory: the proposed step size achieves competitive performance to existing adaptive baselines and exhibits stable behavior across a wide range of problem settings. Finally, in the context of deep neural network training, the gradient norms under our step size do not collapse to (near) zero, indicating robustness to vanishing gradients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非光滑优化问题，提出一种新的随机Polyak步长变体SPS_safe，用于随机次梯度方法，无需强假设即可提供严格的收敛保证。在凸基准和深度神经网络上的实验表明，该方法与现有自适应基线性能相当，且梯度范数不会崩溃到零，表现出对消失梯度的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有的随机Polyak步长（SPS）在光滑优化中表现优异，但扩展到非光滑场景时往往依赖插值假设或需要最优解知识，缺乏实用性。
Method: 提出Safeguarded SPS (SPS_safe) 步长规则，并融入动量机制，提供非光滑凸优化的收敛性证明，无需强假设。
Result: 实验显示，在凸基准和深度神经网络训练中，所提步长取得与自适应基线相当的竞争性能，且梯度范数稳定不趋近于零。
Conclusion: SPS_safe步长在非光滑优化中有效且鲁棒，避免了小梯度问题，为实际训练提供可靠选择。

papers.title: Molecular Embedding-Based Algorithm Selection in Protein-Ligand Docking
papers.abstract_en: Selecting an effective docking algorithm is highly context-dependent, and no single method performs reliably across structural, chemical, and protocol regimes. MolAS is a lightweight algorithm-selection model that predicts per-algorithm performance from pretrained protein and ligand embeddings using attentional pooling and a shallow residual decoder. With hundreds to a few thousand labelled complexes, MolAS achieves up to a 15 percentage-point absolute improvement over the single-best solver (SBS) and closes 17--66\% of the Virtual Best Solver (VBS)--SBS gap across five docking benchmarks. Analyses of selection frequencies, margin-conditioned reliability, and benchmark-level oracle structure indicate that MolAS is most effective when the workflow-defined oracle landscape has low winner entropy and a reasonably separable top-solver region, but degrades under protocol mismatch that shifts solver rankings and changes the induced labels. These results suggest that, in the evaluated regime, robustness is limited less by representational capacity than by workflow- and protocol-induced instability in solver hierarchies, positioning MolAS as an in-domain selector for fixed pipelines and as a diagnostic tool for assessing when docking algorithm selection is well-posed.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MolAS是一种轻量级算法选择模型，利用预训练的蛋白质和配体嵌入，通过注意力池化和浅层残差解码器预测每个对接算法的性能。在五个对接基准测试中，与单一最佳求解器（SBS）相比，MolAS实现了高达15个百分点的绝对改进，并缩小了虚拟最佳求解器（VBS）与SBS之间17-66%的差距。分析表明，在低胜者熵和顶部求解器区域可分离的工作流中，MolAS效果最佳，但协议不匹配会导致性能下降。
Motivation: 对接算法的有效性高度依赖于上下文，没有单一方法能在所有结构、化学和协议条件下可靠工作，因此需要一种自动选择最佳算法的方法。
Method: MolAS使用预训练的蛋白质和配体嵌入，结合注意力池化和浅层残差解码器，从成百上千个标记复合物中学习预测每个对接算法的性能。
Result: 在五个对接基准上，MolAS相对于单一最佳求解器取得了高达15个百分点的绝对改进，并缩小了虚拟最佳求解器与单一最佳求解器之间17-66%的差距。
Conclusion: MolAS在固定管道中可作为领域内选择器，并作为评估对接算法选择是否适格的诊断工具；其鲁棒性主要受工作流和协议引起的求解器层次不稳定性限制，而非表示能力。

papers.title: Understanding the Effects of Distractors on Reasoning Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: How does irrelevant information (i.e., distractors) affect test-time scaling in vision-language models (VLMs)? Prior work on text-only language models has shown that textual distractors can intensify inverse scaling, causing models to reason longer but less effective reasoning traces. In this work, we investigate whether similar phenomena arise in multimodal settings. We introduce Idis (Images with distractors), a visual question-answering dataset that systematically varies distractors along semantic and numerical dimensions. Our analyses reveal that visual distractors affect reasoning VLMs in a fundamentally different way from textual distractors: although inverse scaling still emerges, visual distractors reduce accuracy without increasing reasoning length. We further show that attribute counts extracted from reasoning traces provide key insights into how distractors interact with reasoning length and accuracy. As a sanity check, we propose a simple prompting strategy that mitigates distractor-driven predictions in reasoning vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）中干扰物（distractors）对测试时推理的影响。作者引入Idis（Images with distractors）数据集，系统改变干扰物的语义和数量维度，发现视觉干扰物与文本干扰物作用方式根本不同：虽然逆缩放（inverse scaling）仍然出现，但视觉干扰物降低准确率而不增加推理长度。进一步从推理轨迹中提取属性计数来揭示干扰物与推理长度、准确率的相互作用，并提出了一个简单的提示策略来缓解干扰物驱动的预测。
Motivation: 文本语言模型中的文本干扰物会引发逆缩放，导致模型推理更长但效果更差。本文旨在探究多模态场景下是否也存在类似现象。
Method: 构建问答数据集Idis，系统变化干扰物的语义和数值维度；分析视觉干扰物对推理VLM的影响；从推理轨迹中提取属性计数进行解释；提出简单提示策略。
Result: 视觉干扰物降低准确率但不增加推理长度；逆缩放现象依然存在；属性计数揭示了干扰物与推理长度和准确率的相互作用。
Conclusion: 提出了简单提示策略可缓解干扰物驱动的预测，为理解视觉干扰物在VLM推理中的作用提供新视角。

papers.title: Latent Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) extend large language models (LLMs) from independent single-model reasoning to coordinative system-level intelligence. While existing LLM agents depend on text-based mediation for reasoning and communication, we take a step forward by enabling models to collaborate directly within the continuous latent space. We introduce LatentMAS, an end-to-end training-free framework that enables pure latent collaboration among LLM agents. In LatentMAS, each agent first performs auto-regressive latent thoughts generation through last-layer hidden embeddings instead of text. Then, a shared latent working memory preserves and transfers each agent's internal representations and latent thoughts, ensuring lossless information exchange without re-encoding. We provide detailed theoretical analyses showing that LatentMAS achieves higher expressiveness and lossless information preservation with lower overall complexity than standard text-based MAS. In addition, empirical evaluations across 9 comprehensive benchmarks spanning math and science reasoning, commonsense understanding, and code generation show that LatentMAS outperforms advanced single agents and text-based MAS baselines, achieving up to 14.6% higher accuracy, reducing output token usage by 70.8%-83.7%, and providing 4$\times$-4.3$\times$ faster end-to-end inference. Code and data are fully open-sourced at https://github.com/Gen-Verse/LatentMAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LatentMAS，一种无需训练的端到端框架，使LLM智能体在连续潜在空间中进行纯潜在协作。每个智能体通过最后一层隐藏嵌入进行自回归潜在思维生成，共享潜在工作记忆保留并传递内部表示，实现无损信息交换。理论分析表明LatentMAS比基于文本的MAS具有更高表达力和更低的复杂度。在9个基准上，LatentMAS优于单智能体和文本MAS，准确率最高提升14.6%，输出token减少70.8%-83.7%，推理速度提升4-4.3倍。
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统依赖文本中介进行推理和通信，存在信息丢失和效率低下问题。目标是在连续潜在空间中直接协作，避免重新编码和文本瓶颈。
Method: 提出LatentMAS框架，每个智能体通过自回归生成潜在思维（使用最后一层隐藏嵌入），并通过共享潜在工作记忆存储和传递内部表示，实现无损信息交换。无需额外训练。
Result: 在9个基准上（数学、科学、常识、代码生成），LatentMAS比先进单智能体和文本MAS基线准确率最高提升14.6%，输出token减少70.8%-83.7%，端到端推理速度提升4-4.3倍。
Conclusion: LatentMAS展示了纯潜在协作的有效性，实现了更高的表达力和无损信息保留，同时降低复杂度。代码和数据已开源。

papers.title: Evaluating the Performance of Deep Learning Models in Whole-body Dynamic 3D Posture Prediction During Load-reaching Activities
papers.abstract_en: This study aimed to explore the application of deep neural networks for whole-body human posture prediction during dynamic load-reaching activities. Two time-series models were trained using bidirectional long short-term memory (BLSTM) and transformer architectures. The dataset consisted of 3D full-body plug-in gait dynamic coordinates from 20 normal-weight healthy male individuals each performing 204 load-reaching tasks from different load positions while adapting various lifting and handling techniques. The model inputs consisted of the 3D position of the hand-load position, lifting (stoop, full-squat and semi-squat) and handling (one- and two-handed) techniques, body weight and height, and the 3D coordinate data of the body posture from the first 25% of the task duration. These inputs were used by the models to predict body coordinates during the remaining 75% of the task period. Moreover, a novel method was proposed to improve the accuracy of the previous and present posture prediction networks by enforcing constant body segment lengths through the optimization of a new cost function. The results indicated that the new cost function decreased the prediction error of the models by approximately 8% and 21% for the arm and leg models, respectively. We indicated that utilizing the transformer architecture, with a root-mean-square-error of 41.4 mm, exhibited approximately 58% more accurate long-term performance than the BLSTM-based model. This study merits the use of neural networks that capture time series dependencies in 3D motion frames, providing a unique approach for understanding and predict motion dynamics during manual material handling activities.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用深度神经网络预测动态负载伸手活动中的全身3D姿势。采用BLSTM和Transformer两种时间序列模型，以20名健康男性的204个任务数据为训练集，输入包括手-负载位置、举升/操作方式、体重身高及前25%任务时段的姿势坐标，预测剩余75%的姿势。提出通过优化成本函数强制身体段长度恒定来提升预测精度，结果显示新成本函数将手臂和腿部模型误差分别降低约8%和21%，Transformer模型的均方根误差为41.4毫米，长期性能比BLSTM模型准确约58%。
Motivation: 现有全身姿势预测方法在动态负载活动中的精度和长时依赖捕捉能力不足，需要更有效的模型和约束方法。
Method: 使用BLSTM和Transformer架构构建时间序列模型，输入包含初始姿势、负载位置、举升/操作方式等特征，并引入基于恒定身体段长度的新成本函数优化预测坐标。
Result: 新成本函数分别降低手臂和腿部模型预测误差约8%和21%；Transformer模型达到41.4毫米均方根误差，长期性能比BLSTM模型提升约58%。
Conclusion: 本研究表明利用捕捉时间序列依赖的神经网络可以有效预测动态负载活动中的3D姿势，为理解手动材料处理中的运动动力学提供了新途径。

summary_sections.result: 新成本函数分别降低手臂和腿部模型预测误差约8%和21%；Transformer模型达到41.4毫米均方根误差，长期性能比BLSTM模型提升约58%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本研究表明利用捕捉时间序列依赖的神经网络可以有效预测动态负载活动中的3D姿势，为理解手动材料处理中的运动动力学提供了新途径。

papers.title: A Unified Evaluation-Instructed Framework for Query-Dependent Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Most prompt-optimization methods refine a single static template, making them ineffective in complex and dynamic user scenarios. Existing query-dependent approaches rely on unstable textual feedback or black-box reward models, providing weak and uninterpretable optimization signals. More fundamentally, prompt quality itself lacks a unified, systematic definition, resulting in fragmented and unreliable evaluation signals. Our approach first establishes a performance-oriented, systematic, and comprehensive prompt evaluation framework. Furthermore, we develop and finetune an execution-free evaluator that predicts multi-dimensional quality scores directly from text. The evaluator then instructs a metric-aware optimizer that diagnoses failure modes and rewrites prompts in an interpretable, query-dependent manner. Our evaluator achieves the strongest accuracy in predicting prompt performance, and the evaluation-instructed optimization consistently surpass both static-template and query-dependent baselines across eight datasets and on three backbone models. Overall, we propose a unified, metric-grounded perspective on prompt quality, and demonstrated that our evaluation-instructed optimization pipeline delivers stable, interpretable, and model-agnostic improvements across diverse tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有提示优化方法依赖静态模板或不可解释的黑盒奖励模型的问题，提出一个统一评估指导框架。该框架首先建立性能导向的提示质量评估体系，然后训练一个无需执行的评估器，从文本直接预测多维度质量分数，最后评估器指导一个度量感知优化器，以可解释的查询依赖方式诊断失败模式并重写提示。实验表明评估器在预测提示性能上达到最强准确率，且评估指导的优化在八个数据集和三个骨干模型上一致超越静态模板和查询依赖基线。
Motivation: 现有提示优化方法多为单一静态模板，无法应对复杂动态用户场景；而查询依赖方法依赖不稳定的文本反馈或黑盒奖励模型，提供弱且不可解释的优化信号。根本问题是提示质量缺乏统一、系统的定义。
Method: 首先建立性能导向的、系统全面的提示评估框架；然后开发并微调一个免执行评估器，直接从文本预测多维度质量分数；该评估器指导一个度量感知优化器，以可解释的查询依赖方式诊断失败模式并重写提示。
Result: 评估器在预测提示性能上取得最强准确率；评估指导的优化在八个数据集和三个骨干模型上一致超越静态模板和查询依赖基线。
Conclusion: 提出了基于度量统一的提示质量视角，并证明了评估指导的优化管线能够在各种任务上提供稳定、可解释且模型无关的改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Relative Energy Learning for LiDAR Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is a critical requirement for reliable autonomous driving, where safety depends on recognizing road obstacles and unexpected objects beyond the training distribution. Despite extensive research on OOD detection in 2D images, direct transfer to 3D LiDAR point clouds has been proven ineffective. Current LiDAR OOD methods struggle to distinguish rare anomalies from common classes, leading to high false-positive rates and overconfident errors in safety-critical settings. We propose Relative Energy Learning (REL), a simple yet effective framework for OOD detection in LiDAR point clouds. REL leverages the energy gap between positive (in-distribution) and negative logits as a relative scoring function, mitigating calibration issues in raw energy values and improving robustness across various scenes. To address the absence of OOD samples during training, we propose a lightweight data synthesis strategy called Point Raise, which perturbs existing point clouds to generate auxiliary anomalies without altering the inlier semantics. Evaluated on SemanticKITTI and the Spotting the Unexpected (STU) benchmark, REL consistently outperforms existing methods by a large margin. Our results highlight that modeling relative energy, combined with simple synthetic outliers, provides a principled and scalable solution for reliable OOD detection in open-world autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Relative Energy Learning (REL) 框架，用于激光雷达点云中的分布外 (OOD) 检测。通过利用正（分布内）和负逻辑之间的能量差距作为相对评分函数，缓解了原始能量值的校准问题。同时提出轻量级数据合成策略Point Raise，通过扰动现有点云生成辅助异常而不改变内点语义。在SemanticKITTI和Spotting the Unexpected基准上，REL显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有LiDAR OOD方法难以区分罕见异常与常见类别，导致高误报率和过度自信错误。直接迁移2D图像OOD方法到3D点云效果不佳。
Method: 提出相对能量学习 (REL)，基于分布内与分布外逻辑值的能量差作为评分函数；以及Point Raise数据合成策略，通过扰动点云生成辅助异常样本。
Result: 在SemanticKITTI和STU基准上，REL方法大幅优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 建模相对能量并结合简单合成异常，为开放世界自动驾驶中的可靠OOD检测提供了可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Optimizing Diversity and Quality through Base-Aligned Model Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Alignment has greatly improved large language models (LLMs)' output quality at the cost of diversity, yielding highly similar outputs across generations, especially in open-ended generation tasks. We propose Base-Aligned Model Collaboration (BACo), an inference-time token-level model collaboration framework that dynamically combines a base LLM with its aligned counterpart to optimize diversity and quality. Using uncertainty and content-based signals, BACo employs routing strategies to determine, at each token, which model to decode from. Prior diversity-promoting methods often improve diversity at the expense of quality or require expensive decoding or post-training. In contrast, BACo achieves both high diversity and quality post hoc within a single pass, while offering strong controllability. We introduce a family of effective routing strategies and evaluate them across three open-ended generation tasks with 13 diversity and quality metrics. BACo consistently surpasses state-of-the-art inference-time baselines. With our best router, BACo achieves a 21.3% joint improvement in diversity and quality, which is further supported by human evaluations. Overall, our results demonstrate that collaboration between base and aligned models provides an effective and controllable mechanism for optimizing the diversity-quality trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Base-Aligned Model Collaboration (BACo)，一种推理时的token级模型协作框架，动态结合基础LLM与其对齐版本以优化生成多样性和质量。使用不确定性和基于内容的信号，通过路由策略决定每个token由哪个模型生成。在三个开放生成任务上，BACo在多样性和质量上联合提升21.3%，并得到人类评估支持。
Motivation: 对齐提高了LLM的输出质量但牺牲了多样性，导致开放生成任务中输出高度相似。现有多样性提升方法往往以质量为代价或需要昂贵解码/后训练。
Method: 提出BACo，推理时动态路由每个token到基础模型或对齐模型，使用不确定性和内容信号进行路由决策，无需额外训练或多次解码。
Result: 在三个开放生成任务上，最佳路由策略实现多样性和质量联合提升21.3%，并得到人类评估支持，一致优于SOTA推理时基线。
Conclusion: 基础模型与对齐模型之间的协作提供了一种有效且可控的机制来优化多样性-质量权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling depth capacity via zero/one-layer model expansion
papers.abstract_en: Model depth is a double-edged sword in deep learning: deeper models achieve higher accuracy but require higher computational cost. To efficiently train models at scale, progressive training (also known as model expansion) scales up model capacity during training and significantly reduces computation with little performance degradation. In this work, we study the depth expansion of large-scale models through the lens of optimization theory and feature learning, offering insights on the initialization of new layers, hyperparameter transfer, learning rate schedule, and timing of model expansion. Specifically, we propose zero/one-layer progressive training to achieve an optimal tradeoff between computation and loss, with a comprehensive ablations on our expansion strategy. For example, zero/one-layer progressive training on GPT2 can save $\approx 80\%$ compute, or equivalently achieve an $\approx 5\times$ acceleration, while attaining a loss comparable to that of a fully trained 60-layer model with 7B parameters, thus demonstrating a mixing behavior in terms of loss. Furthermore, scaling laws on LLAMA3 and DeepSeekV3 models show a $3\sim 5\times$ improvement in compute efficiency, with an increasing advantage at larger scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从优化理论和特征学习角度研究大规模模型的深度扩展，提出零/单层渐进训练方法，在GPT2上节省约80%计算量（约5倍加速）且损失与全训练的60层7B模型相当。在LLAMA3和DeepSeekV3上展示了3~5倍的计算效率提升，且随规模增大优势更明显。
Motivation: 模型深度是双刃剑：深层模型精度高但计算成本高。现有渐进训练方法可扩展模型容量并降低计算，但对深度扩展的初始化和超参数迁移缺乏理论指导。
Method: 提出零/单层渐进训练：在训练过程中每次扩展一层，并对新层初始化、学习率调度、扩展时机等进行理论分析和消融实验，以实现计算与损失的最优权衡。
Result: 在GPT2上节省约80%计算（约5倍加速），损失与全训练的60层7B模型相当；在LLAMA3和DeepSeekV3上计算效率提升3~5倍，且规模越大优势越明显。
Conclusion: 零/单层渐进训练能有效平衡深度扩展中的计算与损失，且遵循缩放定律，在更大模型上优势更突出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zero-Shot Multi-Animal Tracking in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Multi-animal tracking is crucial for understanding animal ecology and behavior, yet remains challenging due to variations in habitat, motion patterns, and species appearance. Traditional approaches typically require extensive fine-tuning and heuristic design for each new scenario. In this work, we explore vision foundation models for zero-shot multi-animal tracking. Building on SAM2MOT, we combine Grounding DINO with the Segment Anything Model2 (SAM 2) and introduce three targeted modifications to adapt the framework to animal appearance and behavior without any retraining or hyperparameter tuning between datasets. We also evaluate the recent SAM3 model, but identify practical limitations that restrict its applicability to multi-animal tracking in the wild. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results across Chimp-Act, Bird Flock Tracking, AnimalTrack, and a subset of GMOT-40, demonstrating robust generalization across diverse species and environments. The code is available at https://github.com/ecker-lab/SAM2-Animal-Tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉基础模型的零样本多动物跟踪方法，通过结合Grounding DINO与Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2)并引入三项针对性修改，无需重新训练即可适应不同物种和场景。方法在Chimp-Act、Bird Flock Tracking、AnimalTrack及GMOT-40子集上取得最先进结果，展现出跨物种与环境的鲁棒泛化能力。
Motivation: 多动物跟踪在野外场景中因栖息地、运动模式和物种外观的多样性而极具挑战性，传统方法需要对每个新场景进行大量微调和启发式设计。
Method: 基于SAM2MOT框架，融合Grounding DINO与SAM 2，并引入三项针对动物外观和行为的修改（无需重训练或超参数调整），同时评估了SAM 3但发现其存在实际局限性。
Result: 在Chimp-Act、Bird Flock Tracking、AnimalTrack及GMOT-40子集上达到最先进性能，验证了跨不同物种和环境的鲁棒泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了零样本多动物跟踪，避免了场景特定的微调，代码已开源。

papers.title: Two Datasets Are Better Than One: Method of Double Moments for 3-D Reconstruction in Cryo-EM
papers.abstract_en: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) is a powerful imaging technique for reconstructing three-dimensional molecular structures from noisy tomographic projection images of randomly oriented particles. We introduce a new data fusion framework, termed the method of double moments (MoDM), which reconstructs molecular structures from two instances of the second-order moment of projection images obtained under distinct orientation distributions: one uniform, the other non-uniform and unknown. We prove that these moments generically uniquely determine the underlying structure, up to a global rotation and reflection, and we develop a convex-relaxation-based algorithm that achieves accurate recovery using only second-order statistics. Our results demonstrate the advantage of collecting and modeling multiple datasets under different experimental conditions, illustrating that leveraging dataset diversity can substantially enhance reconstruction quality in computational imaging tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种称为双矩方法 (MoDM) 的数据融合框架，用于冷冻电镜 (cryo-EM) 三维结构重建。该方法利用同一分子在均匀和未知非均匀两种方向分布下采集的投影图像的二阶矩，理论上证明这些矩可以唯一确定结构（除全局旋转反射外），并开发基于凸松弛的算法仅用二阶统计量实现精确恢复。实验表明，利用多个不同实验条件的数据集能显著提升重建质量。
Motivation: 现有 cryo-EM 重建通常依赖单一数据集，而不同实验条件下的数据集可能包含互补信息。如何有效融合多个数据集以提升重建精确度是一个待解决的问题。
Method: 提出 MoDM 框架：从均匀方向分布和非均匀未知方向分布两个数据集计算投影图像的二阶矩，通过凸松弛算法仅利用二阶统计量恢复三维结构，并证明解的唯一性。
Result: 摘要证明二阶矩唯一确定结构（全局旋转反射模糊除外），并开发算法实现精确恢复；实验表明融合两个数据集优于单数据集。
Conclusion: 收集并建模多个不同实验条件下的数据集可以大幅提升计算成像任务的重建质量，MoDM 为 cryo-EM 提供了一种新的数据融合途径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 MoDM 框架：从均匀方向分布和非均匀未知方向分布两个数据集计算投影图像的二阶矩，通过凸松弛算法仅利用二阶统计量恢复三维结构，并证明解的唯一性。
summary_sections.result: 摘要证明二阶矩唯一确定结构（全局旋转反射模糊除外），并开发算法实现精确恢复；实验表明融合两个数据集优于单数据集。
summary_sections.conclusion: 收集并建模多个不同实验条件下的数据集可以大幅提升计算成像任务的重建质量，MoDM 为 cryo-EM 提供了一种新的数据融合途径。

papers.title: Seeing Through the MiRAGE: Evaluating Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MiRAGE, an evaluation framework for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from multimodal sources. As audiovisual media becomes a prevalent source of information online, it is essential for RAG systems to integrate information from these sources into generation. However, existing evaluations for RAG are text-centric, limiting their applicability to multimodal settings. MiRAGE is a claim-centric approach to multimodal RAG evaluation, consisting of InfoF1, which assesses factuality and information coverage, and CiteF1, which assesses citation support and completeness. We show that, when applied by humans, MiRAGE strongly aligns with extrinsic judgments of output quality. We additionally introduce an automatic implementation of MiRAGE as well as multimodal variants of three prominent text-based RAG metrics -- ALCE, ARGUE, and RAGAS -- demonstrating the limitations of text-centric work and laying the groundwork for automatic evaluation. We release open-source implementations and outline evaluation methods for multimodal RAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MiRAGE，一个面向多模态检索增强生成（RAG）的评估框架，包含 InfoF1（评估事实性与信息覆盖）和 CiteF1（评估引用支持与完整性）。人工评估显示 MiRAGE 与外部质量判断高度一致。文章还提供了自动化的 MiRAGE 实现以及三种文本 RAG 指标（ALCE、ARGUE、RAGAS）的多模态变体，揭示了文本中心方法的局限性。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 评估主要基于文本，难以适用于音频、视频等多模态信息源。
Method: 提出 claim-centric 的多模态 RAG 评估框架 MiRAGE，包含 InfoF1 和 CiteF1 两个指标；同时实现了自动化版本及多模态变体。
Result: 人工评估表明 MiRAGE 与输出质量的外在判断高度吻合。
Conclusion: MiRAGE 为多模态 RAG 评估提供了有效工具，并指出了现有文本指标在多模态场景下的不足。

papers.title: Symmetries in PAC-Bayesian Learning
papers.abstract_en: Symmetries are known to improve the empirical performance of machine learning models, yet theoretical guarantees explaining these gains remain limited. Prior work has focused mainly on compact group symmetries and often assumes that the data distribution itself is invariant, an assumption rarely satisfied in real-world applications. In this work, we extend generalization guarantees to the broader setting of non-compact symmetries, such as translations and to non-invariant data distributions. Building on the PAC-Bayes framework, we adapt and tighten existing bounds, demonstrating the approach on McAllester's PAC-Bayes bound while showing that it applies to a wide range of PAC-Bayes bounds. We validate our theory with experiments on several datasets with non-uniform and non-compact transformations, where the derived guarantees not only hold but also improve upon prior results. These findings provide theoretical evidence that, for symmetric data, symmetric models are preferable beyond the narrow setting of compact groups and invariant distributions, opening the way to a more general understanding of symmetries in machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了PAC-Bayesian学习框架中的对称性理论，从紧致群对称性和不变数据分布推广到非紧致对称性（如平移）和非不变数据分布，通过适配和收紧McAllester界等PAC-Bayes界，并在非均匀、非紧致变换的数据集上验证了理论，表明对称模型在更广的设定下仍具有优势。
Motivation: 现有理论仅对紧致群对称性和不变数据分布提供保证，但实际中数据分布往往非不变，且非紧致对称性（如平移）常见，缺乏理论解释。
Method: 基于PAC-Bayes框架，适配并收紧现有界，证明所提方法适用于多种PAC-Bayes界。
Result: 在非均匀、非紧致变换的数据集上，理论界不仅成立，且优于先前结果。
Conclusion: 对称性在机器学习中的优势可推广至非紧致群和非不变分布，为更一般的理解铺平道路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Video Reasoning without Training
papers.abstract_en: Video reasoning using Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) relies on costly reinforcement learning (RL) and verbose chain-of-thought, resulting in substantial computational overhead during both training and inference. Moreover, the mechanisms that control the thinking process in these reasoning models are very limited. In this paper, we use the entropy of the model's output distribution as a signal to study and guide reasoning behavior. We discover that high-quality models exhibit a characteristic pattern of micro-exploration and micro-exploitation cycles, followed by a later entropy peak (i.e., longer thinking) and a lower final entropy, indicating more deliberate exploration and confident convergence (i.e., avoid excessive randomness while the model is exploring or thinking through an answer). We then use these novel, theoretically-grounded insights to introduce V-Reason (Video-Reason), an inference-time optimization method that adapts the value cache of the LMM through a lightweight, trainable controller. Our proposed controller is guided by an entropy-based objective, to tune the model's behavior directly at inference, without using any RL or supervised fine-tuning. Our experiments show that V-Reason significantly outperforms the base instruction-tuned models on many video reasoning datasets, narrowing the gap with RL models to within 0.6% accuracy on average. We achieve this without any training, while offering efficiency benefits: V-Reason uses 58.6% fewer tokens than the RL model. Project Page https://deepaksridhar.github.io/vreason.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现高质量大多模态模型（LMM）在推理时表现出微探索-微利用循环、后期熵峰和较低最终熵的特征模式。基于此提出V-Reason，一种轻量级推理时优化方法，通过一个可训练的控制器调整模型的值缓存，由基于熵的目标引导，无需强化学习或监督微调。实验表明V-Reason在多个视频推理数据集上显著优于基础指令微调模型，平均准确率与强化学习模型差距在0.6%以内，同时推理时减省58.6%的令牌数。
Motivation: 现有视频推理LMM依赖昂贵的强化学习和冗长的思维链，计算开销大，且对思考过程的控制有限。需要一种无需训练、高效的推理时方法来提升推理能力。
Method: 利用模型输出分布的熵作为信号来研究推理行为，提出V-Reason，通过一个轻量级可训练控制器在推理时适配LMM的值缓存，控制器由基于熵的目标引导，直接调整模型行为，无需RL或监督微调。
Result: 在多个视频推理数据集上，V-Reason显著优于基础指令微调模型，与RL模型平均准确率差距在0.6%以内，且使用令牌数比RL模型减少58.6%。
Conclusion: V-Reason证明了利用熵信号在推理时优化LMM视频推理的有效性，无需额外训练即可接近RL模型的性能，同时具有效率优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are Large Reasoning Models Interruptible?
papers.abstract_en: Real-world applications of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often require reasoning about changing prompts or environments. In this work, we challenge the frozen world assumption and evaluate LRM robustness under two realistic dynamic scenarios: interruptions, which test the accuracy of model responses under budget-constrained outputs, and dynamic context, which tests model adaptation to in-flight changes. Across mathematics and programming benchmarks that require long-form reasoning, static evaluations consistently overestimate robustness: even state-of-the-art LRMs, which achieve high accuracy in static settings, can fail unpredictably when interrupted or exposed to changing context, with performance dropping by up to 60% when updates are introduced late in the reasoning process. Our analysis further reveals several novel failure modes, including reasoning leakage, where models fold the reasoning into their final answer when interrupted; panic, where under time pressure models abandon reasoning entirely and return incorrect answers; and self-doubt, where performance degrades when trying to incorporate updated information. Project Page: http://dynamic-lm.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了大型推理模型（LRM）固定世界的假设，评估其在中断和动态上下文两种现实动态场景下的鲁棒性。实验表明，在数学和编程基准上，静态评估高估了鲁棒性，顶级LRM在中断或上下文变化时性能最多下降60%，并发现了推理泄露、恐慌和自我怀疑等新型失效模式。
Motivation: 现有LRM评估大多假设推理过程中环境不变，但实际应用中需要处理变化的提示或环境，因此需要评估模型在动态场景下的鲁棒性。
Method: 设计了两种动态场景：中断（预算受限输出下测试准确性）和动态上下文（测试模型适应飞行中变化的能力），在需要长形式推理的数学和编程基准上进行评估。
Result: 静态评估高估了LRM的鲁棒性；状态最佳模型在中断或动态上下文下性能最多下降60%，且出现推理泄露、恐慌、自我怀疑等新型失效模式。
Conclusion: LRM在动态场景下鲁棒性不足，现有评估范式需要改进以反映实际部署需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A unifying Bayesian framework for adversarial robustness
papers.abstract_en: The vulnerability of machine learning models to adversarial attacks remains a critical societal security challenge. Traditional defenses, such as adversarial training, typically robustify models by minimizing a worst-case loss. These deterministic approaches do not account for uncertainty in the adversary's attack. While stochastic defenses placing a probability distribution on the adversary exist, they often lack statistical rigor and fail to make explicit their underlying assumptions. To resolve these issues, we introduce a formal Bayesian framework that models adversarial uncertainty through a stochastic channel, articulating all probabilistic assumptions. This yields two robustification strategies: a proactive defense enacted during training, aligned with adversarial training, and a reactive defense enacted during operations, aligned with adversarial purification. Several state-of-the-art defenses can be recovered as limiting cases of our model. We empirically validate our methodology, showcasing the benefits of explicitly modeling adversarial uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的贝叶斯框架来建模对抗攻击中的不确定性，通过随机信道（stochastic channel）显式表达所有概率假设，并衍生出两种鲁棒化策略：对抗训练（proactive defense）和对抗净化（reactive defense）。许多现有防御方法可视为该框架的极限情况，实验验证了显式建模对抗不确定性的优势。
Motivation: 传统对抗防御（如对抗训练）最小化最坏情况损失，未考虑攻击者的不确定性；而现有随机防御缺乏统计严谨性且假设不透明。需要一个形式化框架统一并改进这些方法。
Method: 建立贝叶斯框架，通过随机信道建模对抗不确定性，并基于此推导出训练阶段的主动防御（类似对抗训练）和推理阶段的被动防御（类似对抗净化）。
Result: 该框架能恢复多种现有防御方法作为极限情况，实验表明显式建模对抗不确定性带来性能提升。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯视角为对抗鲁棒性提供了统一理论，强调了概率建模在防御中的价值，但未讨论计算复杂度或大规模网络的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FM-IRL: Flow-Matching for Reward Modeling and Policy Regularization in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Flow Matching (FM) has shown remarkable ability in modeling complex distributions and achieves strong performance in offline imitation learning for cloning expert behaviors. However, despite its behavioral cloning expressiveness, FM-based policies are inherently limited by their lack of environmental interaction and exploration. This leads to poor generalization in unseen scenarios beyond the expert demonstrations, underscoring the necessity of online interaction with environment. Unfortunately, optimizing FM policies via online interaction is challenging and inefficient due to instability in gradient computation and high inference costs. To address these issues, we propose to let a student policy with simple MLP structure explore the environment and be online updated via RL algorithm with a reward model. This reward model is associated with a teacher FM model, containing rich information of expert data distribution. Furthermore, the same teacher FM model is utilized to regularize the student policy's behavior to stabilize policy learning. Due to the student's simple architecture, we avoid the gradient instability of FM policies and enable efficient online exploration, while still leveraging the expressiveness of the teacher FM model. Extensive experiments show that our approach significantly enhances learning efficiency, generalization, and robustness, especially when learning from suboptimal expert data.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对流匹配（Flow Matching）策略在强化学习中的在线交互困难，提出FM-IRL框架：用一个简单的MLP学生策略与环境交互并通过RL更新，同时使用教师FM模型作为奖励模型和行为正则化器。实验表明该方法在次优专家数据下提升学习效率、泛化性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 基于FM的策略缺乏环境交互和探索，在未见场景中泛化差；直接在线优化FM策略存在梯度不稳定和高推理成本的问题。
Method: 使用简单MLP结构的学生策略与环境交互，通过RL算法在线更新，其奖励模型由教师FM模型提供，同时教师FM对学生策略行为进行正则化。
Result: 大量实验表明方法显著提升了学习效率、泛化性和鲁棒性，尤其在次优专家数据下表现突出。
Conclusion: 通过解耦教师FM的表示能力和简单学生策略的在线探索优势，避免了FM策略的梯度不稳定性，实现了高效的在线学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SHERLOCK: Towards Dynamic Knowledge Adaptation in LLM-enhanced E-commerce Risk Management
papers.abstract_en: Effective e-commerce risk management requires in-depth case investigations to identify emerging fraud patterns in highly adversarial environments. However, manual investigation typically requires analyzing the associations and couplings among multi-source heterogeneous data, a labor-intensive process that limits efficiency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in automating these analyses, their deployment is hindered by the complexity of risk scenarios and the sparsity of long-tail domain knowledge. To address these challenges, we propose Sherlock, a framework that integrates structured domain knowledge with LLM-based reasoning through three core modules. First, we construct a domain Knowledge Base (KB) by distilling structured expertise from heterogeneous knowledge sources. Second, we design a two-stage retrieval-augmented generation strategy tailored for case investigation, which combines input contextual augmentation with a Reflect & Refine module to fully leverage the KB for improved analysis quality. Finally, we develop an integrated platform for operations and annotation to drive a self-evolving data flywheel. By combining real-time hotfixes through KB updates with periodic logic alignment via post-training, we facilitate continuous system evolution to counteract adversarial drifts. Online A/B tests at JD dot com demonstrate that Sherlock achieves an 82% Expert Acceptance Rate (EAR) and a 386.7% increase in daily investigation throughput. An additional 90-day evaluation shows that the flywheel successfully recovers from performance decay caused by changing tactics twice, raising the EAR ceiling by around 3.5% through autonomous model updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SHERLOCK框架，用于电商风险管理中的动态知识适应。该框架通过构建领域知识库、设计两阶段检索增强生成策略（包含输入上下文增强与反思细化模块）以及构建运营标注平台驱动自进化数据飞轮，将结构化知识与LLM推理相结合。在线A/B测试显示专家接受率达到82%，日调查吞吐量提升386.7%，90天评估表明数据飞轮能通过自主模型更新恢复因对抗性漂移导致的性能衰退，并将专家接受率上限提升约3.5%。
Motivation: 电商风险管理需要深入调查多源异构数据以发现新欺诈模式，但人工调查劳动密集且效率低。LLM虽能自动化分析，但受限于风险场景的复杂性和长尾领域知识的稀疏性。
Method: SHERLOCK包含三个核心模块：从异构知识源中蒸馏结构化知识构建领域知识库；设计两阶段检索增强生成策略（输入上下文增强+反思细化）以利用知识库提升分析质量；开发运营标注平台驱动自进化数据飞轮，通过实时知识库更新和周期性后训练逻辑对齐实现系统持续演化。
Result: 在线A/B测试达到82%专家接受率和386.7%日调查吞吐量提升；90天评估显示数据飞轮两次成功恢复由战术变化导致的性能衰退，并通过自主模型更新将专家接受率上限提升约3.5%。
Conclusion: SHERLOCK有效整合结构化领域知识与LLM推理，通过动态知识适应机制应对对抗性漂移，为LLM在电商风险管理中的部署提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Margin Adaptive DPO: Leveraging Reward Model for Granular Control in Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a simple and effective method for aligning large language models. However, its reliance on a fixed temperature parameter leads to suboptimal training on diverse preference data, causing overfitting on easy examples and under-learning from informative ones. Recent methods have emerged to counter this. While IPO addresses general overfitting, its uniform regularization can be overly conservative. The more targeted approach of $β$-DPO suffers from its own limitations: its batch-level adaptation applies a single, compromised temperature to mixed-margin pairs, its linear update rule can produce unstable negative $β$ values, and its filtering mechanism discards potentially useful training signals. In this work, we introduce Margin-Adaptive Direct Preference Optimization (MADPO), a method that provides a stable, data-preserving, and instance-level solution. MADPO employs a practical two-step approach: it first trains a reward model to estimate preference margins and then uses these margins to apply a continuous, adaptive weight to the DPO loss for each individual training sample. This re-weighting scheme creates an effective target margin that is amplified for hard pairs and dampened for easy pairs, allowing for granular control over the learning signal. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis, proving that MADPO has a well-behaved optimization landscape and is robust to reward model estimation errors. We validate our theory with experiments on a summarization task using human preference data. MADPO consistently outperforms strong baselines across a comprehensive sweep of decoding temperatures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Margin-Adaptive Direct Preference Optimization (MADPO)，一种稳定的、数据保留的、实例级的偏好优化方法。该方法先训练奖励模型估计偏好边界，再对每个样本自适应加权DPO损失，实现对学习信号的精细控制。实验在摘要任务上优于多个强基线。
Motivation: DPO依赖固定温度参数，在多样偏好数据上导致对简单样本过拟合、对信息样本文不足。现有改进方法如IPO正则化过于保守，β-DPO的批量级适应存在不稳定和丢弃有用信号的问题。
Method: MADPO采用两步法：先训练奖励模型估计偏好边界，然后利用这些边界对每个训练样本的DPO损失施加连续的自适应权重，放大困难样本的边界、削弱容易样本的边界。
Result: 在摘要任务的人类偏好数据上，MADPO在多种解码温度下一致优于强基线。理论分析证明其优化景观良好且对奖励模型估计误差鲁棒。
Conclusion: MADPO提供了一种稳定的、实例级的偏好优化解决方案，避免了现有方法的过度保守或不稳定问题，并保留了所有训练信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chaining 2-FWL GNNs for Combinatorial Graph Alignment
papers.abstract_en: For the combinatorial graph alignment problem (GAP) -- finding the node correspondence that maximizes the number of common edges (nce) between two unlabeled graphs -- properly initialized FAQ remains a strong classical baseline, while existing GNN approaches struggle in the purely structural setting. We introduce a chaining procedure: a sequence of Folklore-type (2-FWL) GNNs in which each network is trained with cross-entropy after decoding the previous network's similarity matrix and ranking nodes by their current alignment quality. This non-differentiable ranking step injects discrete combinatorial feedback at every link; at inference, we iterate the final network and keep the candidate with highest observed nce. On sparse Erdos-Renyi graphs at noise level 0.25, chained FGNNs with FAQ post-processing reach 85% accuracy versus 13% for FAQ initialized from the convex relaxation, and essentially 0% for prior GNN methods. On correlated regular graphs, where MPNNs with constant features produce identical node embeddings (1-WL fails to refine) and FAQ's convex initialization is degenerate, chaining is the only method we know that recovers a non-trivial alignment. On three real-world benchmarks (yeast PPI, coauthorship, and road networks), we show that recent comparisons underestimate FAQ by initializing it from a uniform doubly stochastic matrix; once FAQ is initialized from the convex relaxation it already surpasses prior reported numbers, and dataset-specific chained FGNNs further improve on this strengthened baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种链式2-FWL GNN方法解决组合图对齐问题（GAP），通过非可微排序步骤注入离散组合反馈，在稀疏Erdos-Renyi图、相关正则图和三个真实世界基准上显著优于FAQ和现有GNN方法。
Motivation: 现有GNN方法在纯结构图对齐任务中表现不佳，而经典FAQ基线在适当初始化下仍具竞争力，但缺乏有效的后处理方法。
Method: 提出链式过程：序列训练Folklore型(2-FWL) GNN，每个网络在解码前一网络相似矩阵并按对齐质量排序节点后，使用交叉熵训练；推理时迭代最终网络并保留最高nce候选。
Result: 在噪声0.25的稀疏Erdos-Renyi图上，链式FGNN结合FAQ后处理达到85%准确率，而FAQ凸松弛初始化仅13%，先前GNN方法接近0%；在相关正则图上，链式方法唯一能恢复非平凡对齐；在真实基准上，FAQ凸松弛初始化已超越先前报道，链式FGNN进一步改进。
Conclusion: 链式2-FWL GNN通过离散排序反馈有效提升图对齐性能，尤其适用于1-WL无法区分的图结构，但方法依赖于多次迭代和FAQ后处理。

papers.title: REBot: From RAG to CatRAG with Semantic Enrichment and Graph Routing
papers.abstract_en: Academic regulation advising is essential for helping students interpret and comply with institutional policies, yet building effective systems requires domain specific regulatory resources. To address this challenge, we propose REBot, an LLM enhanced advisory chatbot powered by CatRAG, a hybrid retrieval reasoning framework that integrates retrieval augmented generation with graph based reasoning. CatRAG unifies dense retrieval and graph reasoning, supported by a hierarchical, category labeled knowledge graph enriched with semantic features for domain alignment. A lightweight intent classifier routes queries to the appropriate retrieval modules, ensuring both factual accuracy and contextual depth. We construct a regulation specific dataset and evaluate REBot on classification and question answering tasks, achieving state of the art performance with an F1 score of 98.89%. Finally, we implement a web application that demonstrates the practical value of REBot in real world academic advising scenarios.

papers.journal_ref: Communications in Computer and Information Science (CCIS), Springer, 2025, pp. 435-447
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REBot，一种基于CatRAG（整合检索增强生成与图推理的混合检索-推理框架）的LLM增强学术咨询聊天机器人。CatRAG通过层次化、类别标注的知识图谱和轻量级意图分类器实现稠密检索与图推理的统一，在特定法规数据集上分类和问答任务达到98.89%的F1分数。
Motivation: 学术法规咨询需要领域特定的法规资源，现有系统缺乏有效的检索-推理整合方法来保证事实准确性和上下文深度。
Method: 提出CatRAG框架，融合稠密检索与图推理，构建层次化、类别标注且语义增强的知识图谱，并设计轻量级意图分类器路由查询至相应检索模块。
Result: 在自制法规数据集上分类和问答任务取得98.89%的F1分数，达到最优性能。
Conclusion: REBot展示了CatRAG在学术咨询实际场景中的实用价值，但方法限于法规领域知识图谱。

papers.title: ACON: Optimizing Context Compression for Long-horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents in dynamic real-world environments, where success depends on maintaining precise records of actions and observations. However, the resulting unbounded context growth in long-horizon agentic tasks makes two critical bottlenecks: prohibitive inference memory costs and reasoning degradation due to irrelevant information. Existing compression methods fail to fully address this, often relying on brittle heuristics or requiring parameter updates impractical for proprietary or large-scale LLMs. We introduce Agent Context Optimization (ACON), a unified framework that optimally compresses both observations and history into concise, informative representations. Distinct from prior works, ACON employs an optimization in natural language space: it iteratively refines compression guidelines based on failure analysis of the agent, ensuring critical state information is preserved without model fine-tuning. To further minimize computational overhead, we distill the optimized compressor into smaller models. Experiments on AppWorld, OfficeBench, and Multi-objective QA demonstrate that ACON reduces peak token usage by 26-54% while improving task success over existing compression baselines. Notably, it enables smaller LMs to function effectively as long-horizon agents, achieving up to 46% performance improvement by mitigating context distraction. Our code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/acon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACON（Agent Context Optimization）框架，通过自然语言空间中的优化方法压缩长视野LLM Agent的观察和历史信息，无需微调模型。实验表明，ACON在AppWorld、OfficeBench和Multi-objective QA上减少峰值token使用量26-54%并提升任务成功率，蒸馏至小模型后性能提升高达46%。
Motivation: LLM Agent在动态环境中需要维护精确的动作和观察记录，导致上下文无限增长，造成高推理内存成本和推理退化。现有压缩方法依赖脆弱启发式或需参数更新，不适用于专有或大规模LLM。
Method: ACON在自然语言空间中迭代优化压缩指导，基于Agent失败分析调整规则，保留关键状态信息。随后将优化后的压缩器蒸馏到更小的模型以降低计算开销。
Result: 在AppWorld、OfficeBench和Multi-objective QA上，ACON减少峰值token使用量26-54%，并提高任务成功率。将压缩器蒸馏后，小语言模型在长视野任务中性能提升达46%。
Conclusion: ACON提供了一种无需模型微调的上下文压缩统一框架，通过自然语言优化和蒸馏有效缓解了长视野Agent的上下文瓶颈。

papers.title: v-HUB: A Benchmark for Video Humor Understanding from Vision and Sound
papers.abstract_en: AI models capable of comprehending humor hold real-world promise -- for example, enhancing engagement in human-machine interactions. To gauge and diagnose the capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for humor understanding, we introduce v-HUB, a novel video humor understanding benchmark. v-HUB comprises a curated collection of non-verbal short videos, reflecting real-world scenarios where humor can be appreciated purely through visual cues. We pair each video clip with rich annotations to support a variety of evaluation tasks and analyses, including a novel study of environmental sound that can enhance humor. To broaden its applicability, we construct an open-ended QA task, making v-HUB readily integrable into existing video understanding task suites. We evaluate a diverse set of MLLMs, from specialized Video-LLMs to versatile OmniLLMs that can natively process audio, covering both open-source and proprietary domains. The experimental results expose the difficulties MLLMs face in comprehending humor from visual cues alone. Our findings also demonstrate that incorporating audio helps with video humor understanding, highlighting the promise of integrating richer modalities for complex video understanding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 v-HUB，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）视频幽默理解能力的基准。该基准包含非语言短视频，配有丰富注释，支持多种评估任务，包括环境声音对幽默的影响分析。实验表明，MLLMs 仅凭视觉线索理解幽默存在困难，而音频信息有助于提升幽默理解能力。
Motivation: 现有 MLLMs 对幽默的理解能力缺乏系统评估，尤其是非语言视频中的幽默。
Method: 构建 v-HUB 基准，包含非语言短视频和开放域问答任务，并引入环境声音注释以研究其作用。
Result: 多个 MLLMs（包括视频专用和通用多模态模型）在仅视觉条件下幽默理解表现不佳，加入音频后性能提升。
Conclusion: v-HUB 揭示了 MLLMs 在视频幽默理解上的短板，并表明多模态融合（尤其是音频）是改进方向。

papers.title: Query Circuits: Explaining How Language Models Answer User Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Explaining why a language model produces a particular output requires local, input-level explanations. Existing methods uncover global capability circuits (e.g., indirect object identification), but not why the model answers a specific input query in a particular way. We introduce query circuits, which directly trace the information flow inside a model that maps a specific input to the output. Unlike surrogate-based approaches (e.g., sparse autoencoders), query circuits are identified within the model itself, resulting in more faithful and computationally accessible explanations. To make query circuits practical, we address two challenges. First, we introduce Normalized Deviation Faithfulness (NDF), a robust metric to evaluate how well a discovered circuit recovers the model's decision for a specific input, and is broadly applicable to circuit discovery beyond our setting. Second, we develop sampling-based methods to efficiently identify circuits that are sparse yet faithfully describe the model's behavior. Across benchmarks (IOI, arithmetic, MMLU, and ARC), we find that there exist extremely sparse query circuits within the model that can recover much of its performance on single queries. For example, a circuit covering only 1.3% of model connections can recover about 60% of performance on an MMLU questions. Overall, query circuits provide a step towards faithful, scalable explanations of how language models process individual inputs. The project page is at https://tony10101105.github.io/query-circuit/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出查询电路（query circuits）概念，直接追踪语言模型中从特定输入到输出的信息流，以解释模型为何以特定方式回答用户查询。通过引入归一化偏差忠实性（NDF）度量电路恢复模型决策的程度，并开发基于采样的方法高效识别稀疏但忠实的电路。在IOI、算术、MMLU和ARC等基准上，仅覆盖1.3%模型连接的稀疏电路即可恢复约60%的MMLU单查询性能。
Motivation: 现有解释方法聚焦于全局能力电路（如间接宾语识别），无法解释模型对特定输入查询的具体回答机制，需要局部、输入级别的忠实解释。
Method: 提出查询电路，直接在模型内部追踪从输入到输出的信息流。引入NDF指标评估电路的忠实性，并采用采样方法识别稀疏且忠实的电路。
Result: 在多个基准上，极度稀疏的查询电路（如覆盖1.3%连接）能恢复单次查询约60%的性能，展示了稀疏电路的有效性。
Conclusion: 查询电路为解释语言模型如何处理单个输入提供了一种忠实且可扩展的方法，有助于推动可解释AI的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Hamiltonian Dynamics at Scale: A Differential-Geometric Approach
papers.abstract_en: Embedding physical intuition into network architectures allows the learning of dynamics that enforce fundamental properties, such as energy conservation laws, thereby leading to physically-plausible predictions. Yet, scaling these models to high-dimensional dynamical systems remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces Reduced-order Hamiltonian Neural Network (RO-HNN), a novel physics-inspired neural network that combines the conservation laws of Hamiltonian mechanics with the scalability of model order reduction. RO-HNN is built on two core components: a novel geometrically-constrained symplectic autoencoder that learns a low-dimensional, structure-preserving symplectic submanifold, and a geometric Hamiltonian neural network that models the dynamics on the submanifold. Our experiments demonstrate that RO-HNN provides physically-consistent, stable, and generalizable predictions of complex high-dimensional dynamics, thereby effectively extending the scope of Hamiltonian neural networks to high-dimensional physical systems.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 21 figures, Intl. Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reduced-order Hamiltonian Neural Network (RO-HNN)，一种将哈密顿力学的守恒定律与模型降阶（model order reduction）相结合的物理启发神经网络。该方法通过几何约束的辛自编码器（symplectic autoencoder）学习低维结构保持的辛子流形，并在此子流形上用几何哈密顿神经网络建模动力学。实验表明 RO-HNN 能对高维复杂动力学系统做出物理一致、稳定且可泛化的预测，从而将哈密顿神经网络的适用范围扩展到高维物理系统。
Motivation: 现有哈密顿神经网络难以扩展到高维动力学系统，而模型降阶方法虽能处理高维数据却常丢失物理结构。为同时满足可扩展性和物理一致性，本文结合两者优势。
Method: RO-HNN 包含两个核心组件：一个受几何约束的辛自编码器（学习低维结构保持的辛子流形），以及一个在该子流形上建模动力学的几何哈密顿神经网络。
Result: 摘要报告 RO-HNN 对复杂高维动力学提供物理一致、稳定且可泛化的预测，有效扩展了哈密顿神经网络在高维物理系统中的应用范围。
Conclusion: 本文通过将模型降阶与哈密顿力学结合，提升了哈密顿神经网络在高维系统上的可扩展性，同时保持了物理一致性。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Interpretable Self-Supervised Learning via Representer Landmarks and Nyström Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) learns representations from massive unlabeled data, yet the resulting models typically operate as black boxes, necessitating domain-specific explanations. We introduce KREPES, a unified framework to analytically interpret the learned representations of SSL objectives, including SimCLR, BYOL, and VICReg. By bridging empirical neural tangent kernel approximations of neural networks with the Representer Theorem for kernels, we express the learned latent space directly via "Representer Landmarks", which are the representations of influential unlabeled training examples. We introduce novel metrics, "Sample-Specific Influence Score", "Concept-Conditioned Influence Score" and "Feature Alignment Gap", to quantify the transparency of the learned representations. KREPES enables direct audit of the latent space without supervision, for example, revealing an algorithmic bias in the Adult-1M dataset where SSL uses demographic proxies for income. Finally, to ensure scalability to benchmarks with 1M+ samples (ImageNet-1K, Adult-1M), KREPES introduces a novel Nyström approximation-based analytical inference framework for SSL objectives.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures. Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KREPES 框架，通过将神经网络的神经切线核近似与核表示定理结合，将自监督学习（SimCLR、BYOL、VICReg）的表示空间解释为少数“表示地标”（Representer Landmarks）的线性组合。引入了样本特定影响分数、概念条件影响分数和特征对齐间隙等新指标，用于量化表示的透明度。该方法在 Adult-1M 数据集上揭示了 SSL 算法利用人口统计代理预测收入等偏见，并通过 Nyström 近似扩展到百万级样本（如 ImageNet-1K）。
Motivation: 自监督学习模型虽能从大量无标签数据中学习表示，但通常作为黑箱运作，缺乏领域特定的可解释性。
Method: 桥接神经切线核近似与表示定理，将潜在空间表达为训练集中有影响力样本（Representer Landmarks）表示的线性组合；提出 Nyström 近似实现分析推理的可扩展性。
Result: 在 Adult-1M 数据集上，KREPES 能够检测到 SSL 表示中的算法偏见，即使用性别、种族等人口统计代理变量来预测收入。
Conclusion: KREPES 提供了一种无需监督即可直接审计潜在空间的方法，有助于提升自监督学习的透明度和公平性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Learning as the Disciplined Construction of Tame Objects
papers.abstract_en: One can see deep-learning models as compositions of functions within the so-called tame geometry. In this expository note, we give an overview of some topics at the interface of tame geometry (also known as o-minimality), optimization theory, and deep learning theory and practice. To do so, we gradually introduce the concepts and tools used to build convergence guarantees for stochastic gradient descent in a general nonsmooth nonconvex, but tame, setting. This illustrates some ways in which tame geometry is a natural mathematical framework for the study of AI systems, especially within Deep Learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述性文章，概述了驯服几何（tame geometry，又称o-minimality）与优化理论及深度学习理论和实践之间的交叉领域。文章逐步介绍了在一般非光滑非凸但驯服的设定下，为随机梯度下降建立收敛保证所需的概念和工具，展示了驯服几何作为深度学习等AI系统自然数学框架的潜力。
Motivation: 深度学习模型通常涉及复合函数，而驯服几何为这些函数提供了结构化的数学框架；目前需要系统性地梳理该几何与深度学习优化理论之间的联系。
Method: 以综述形式，从基础概念开始，逐步引入驯服几何、优化理论和深度学习理论中的工具，重点阐述在驯服设定下随机梯度下降的收敛性证明。
Result: 文章本身没有报告新的实验结果，而是提供了概念框架和理论工具的综合总结。
Conclusion: 驯服几何为研究深度学习等AI系统提供了自然的数学基础，特别是在非光滑非凸优化场景下。

papers.title: VMDNet: Temporal Leakage-Free Variational Mode Decomposition for Electricity Demand Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate electricity demand forecasting is challenging due to the strong multi-periodicity of real-world demand series, which makes effective modeling of recurrent temporal patterns crucial. Decomposition techniques make such structure explicit and thereby improve predictive performance. Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) is a powerful signal-processing method for periodicity-aware decomposition and has seen growing adoption in recent years. However, existing studies often suffer from information leakage and rely on inappropriate hyperparameter tuning. To address these issues, we propose VMDNet, a causality-preserving framework that (i) applies sample-wise VMD to avoid temporal leakage; (ii) represents each decomposed mode with frequency-aware embeddings and decodes it using parallel temporal convolutional networks (TCNs), ensuring mode independence and efficient learning; and (iii) introduces a Stackelberg game inspired bilevel scheme to guide the selection of VMD's two key hyperparameters. Experiments on three widely used electricity demand datasets show that VMDNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Version 3: Accepted author manuscript for the 34th European Signal Processing Conference (EUSIPCO 2026), Bruges, Belgium. Improved figures, additional details on TCN-based parallel decoding, and extended literature review. Code and data available: https://github.com/weibin-feng/VMDNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VMDNet 提出一种因果保持的变分模态分解 (VMD) 框架用于电力需求预测，通过样本级 VMD 避免时间泄漏、频率感知嵌入与并行 TCN 解码，以及基于 Stackelberg 博弈的双层超参数选择方法。在三个电力需求数据集上超越现有基线。
Motivation: 现有 VMD 在电力需求预测中存在信息泄漏和不合适的超参数调优问题，需要一种保持因果性的分解预测方法。
Method: 提出 VMDNet：样本级 VMD 避免时间泄漏；频率感知嵌入表达每个模态，并用并行 TCN 解码保持模态独立；引入 Stackelberg 博弈启发的双层方案选择 VMD 的两个关键超参数。
Result: 在三个广泛使用的电力需求数据集上，VMDNet 持续优于最先进的基线模型。
Conclusion: VMDNet 通过因果保持的分解和系统性超参数选择有效提升了电力需求预测性能。

papers.title: Exploring the Capabilities of Large Language Model Encoders for Image-Text Retrieval in Chest X-rays
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning from paired medical images and clinical text is a central challenge in medical data-driven informatics, where effective cross-modal alignment is critical for scalable analysis and retrieval. In chest radiography, vision-language pretraining is constrained by heterogeneous radiology reports that contain abbreviations, impression-only notes, and institution-specific writing styles. Unlike general-domain settings, naively aggregating large collections of noisy reports can plateau or even degrade multimodal learning when reporting styles differ substantially. We propose a domain-adapted bidirectional large language model text encoder for chest radiograph reports, trained with masked token prediction and supervised contrastive learning on stylistically diverse but clinically equivalent report variants to produce robust, generalizable text embeddings. We then integrate this encoder into a dual-tower contrastive vision-language framework using parameter-efficient adaptation to improve image-text alignment. Across 1.6 million paired studies from public datasets and a de-identified hospital cohort, the proposed models improve bidirectional retrieval accuracy and external generalization, achieving GREEN scores of 0.308 on MIMIC-CXR and 0.618 on Open-I, while reducing the degradation observed when abbreviation-rich, impression-only hospital reports are added to training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对胸部X光报告的领域自适应双向大语言模型文本编码器，通过掩码标记预测和监督对比学习训练，处理风格多样但临床等价的报告变体，生成鲁棒的文本嵌入。将该编码器集成到双塔对比视觉语言框架中，使用参数高效适应改善图像-文本对齐。在160万对数据和外部数据集上，双向检索准确率和外推泛化能力得到提升，并减少了添加富含缩写和印象的医院报告时的性能退化。
Motivation: 胸部X光影像与临床文本之间的跨模态对齐对于可扩展分析和检索至关重要，但不同机构的放射学报告风格差异大（如缩写、印象式笔记等），直接聚合大量噪声报告会导致多模态学习效果停滞甚至退化。
Method: 提出一个领域自适应的双向LLM文本编码器，通过掩码标记预测和监督对比学习在风格多样但临床等价的报告变体上训练，获得鲁棒的文本嵌入；然后将该编码器集成到双塔对比视觉语言框架中，使用参数高效适配（parameter-efficient adaptation）来改进图像-文本对齐。
Result: 在MIMIC-CXR上GREEN得分0.308，在Open-I上GREEN得分0.618，双向检索准确率和外推泛化能力提升，且减少了添加富含缩写和印象的医院报告时的性能退化。
Conclusion: 本文的方法能够有效处理放射学报告风格多样性，提升图像-文本检索性能，并增强了在外部数据集上的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BERT4beam: Large AI Model Enabled Generalized Beamforming Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is anticipated to emerge as a pivotal enabler for the forthcoming sixth-generation (6G) wireless communication systems. However, current research efforts regarding large AI models for wireless communications primarily focus on fine-tuning pre-trained large language models (LLMs) for specific tasks. This paper investigates the large-scale AI model designed for beamforming optimization to adapt and generalize to diverse tasks defined by system utilities and scales. We propose a novel framework based on bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT), termed BERT4beam. We aim to formulate the beamforming optimization problem as a token-level sequence learning task, perform tokenization of the channel state information, construct the BERT model, and conduct task-specific pre-training and fine-tuning strategies. Based on the framework, we propose two BERT-based approaches for single-task and multi-task beamforming optimization, respectively. Both approaches are generalizable for varying user scales. Moreover, the former can adapt to varying system utilities and antenna configurations by re-configuring the input and output module of the BERT model, while the latter, termed UBERT, can directly generalize to diverse tasks, due to a finer-grained tokenization strategy. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the two proposed approaches can achieve near-optimal performance and outperform existing AI models across various beamforming optimization tasks, showcasing strong adaptability and generalizability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于BERT的大规模AI模型BERT4beam，用于波束赋形优化。将波束赋形问题转化为token级序列学习任务，对信道状态信息进行token化，并设计单任务和多任务两种方案。实验表明接近最优性能，优于现有AI模型。
Motivation: 现有AI模型多基于微调预训练LLM，缺乏专门针对波束赋形优化的通用大模型。需要能适应不同系统效用和规模的波束赋形优化框架。
Method: 提出BERT4beam框架，将波束赋形优化建模为token级序列学习，包括CSI token化、BERT模型构建、任务特定预训练和微调。单任务方案通过重配置输入输出模块适应不同配置；多任务方案UBERT通过更细粒度token化直接泛化到多样任务。
Result: 仿真结果表明，两种方法在多种波束赋形优化任务上达到接近最优性能，并优于现有AI模型，展现出强适应性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文展示了基于BERT的大规模AI模型在波束赋形优化中的潜力，为6G无线通信提供了新思路。

papers.title: Language-Native Materials Processing Design by Lightly Structured Text Database and Reasoning Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Materials synthesis procedures are predominantly documented as narrative text in papers, protocols, and laboratory records, placing them beyond the reach of conventional data-driven optimization frameworks. This language-native character poses a particular challenge for complex, multistage processes such as the preparation of boron nitride nanosheets (BNNS), where outcomes depend on path-dependent choices in exfoliation, functionalization, and functionalization. Here, we recast synthesis planning of the materials as a text reasoning problem enabled by a lightly structured knowledge substrate that preserves the procedural logic and causal contexts while exposing computable elements for retrieval. Built on this representation, our framework combines semantic matching, lexical search, and parameter-aware filtering to support retrieval-augmented generation with more accurate and better-grounded synthesis guidance. We further introduce experience-augmented reasoning, in which iteratively refined text guides distilled from multi-source narratives support hypothesis generation, failure diagnosis, and protocol revision. We validated the framework in the targeted exfoliation of BNNS, a synthesis problem governed by multivariate constraints and limited transferability of literature protocols across laboratory settings. By integrating dispersed literature evidence with experimentally observed failure modes, the system converged within only three iterative rounds on a high-performing protocol that yielded high-quality ultrathin nanosheets meeting the target specifications, substantially shortening what is often a prolonged cycle of expert-led trial-and-error. By enabling language-native reasoning over procedural knowledge, this framework moves AI beyond literature assistance toward active synthesis planning, adaptation and acceleration in complex materials workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将材料合成规划重构为文本推理问题，利用轻结构化文本数据库和大型语言模型的推理能力，在硼氮化物纳米片(BNNS)的定向剥离任务上，三个迭代周期内即获得满足目标规格的高质量超薄纳米片协议，显著缩短了传统专家试错周期。
Motivation: 材料合成流程通常以叙事文本形式记录，难以被传统数据驱动优化框架处理，尤其对于多阶段复杂过程如BNNS制备，其结果依赖于路径选择，现有方法难以应对。
Method: 构建轻结构化知识库保留过程逻辑和因果上下文，结合语义匹配、词汇搜索和参数感知过滤支持检索增强生成，并引入经验增强推理，通过多源文本的迭代细化指导假设生成、故障诊断和协议修正。
Result: 在BNNS定向剥离任务上，系统在三轮迭代内收敛到一个高性能协议，生成的高质量超薄纳米片满足目标规格，大幅缩短了专家驱动的试错周期。
Conclusion: 该框架使AI超越文献辅助，实现复杂材料工作流程中的主动合成规划、适应和加速。
Relevance: 0
