papers.title: Introduction to Graph Neural Networks for Machine Learning Engineers
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks are deep neural networks designed for graphs with attributes attached to nodes or edges. The number of research papers in the literature concerning these models is growing rapidly due to their impressive performance on a broad range of tasks. This survey introduces graph neural networks through the encoder-decoder framework and provides examples of decoders for a range of graph analytic tasks. It uses theory and numerous experiments on homogeneous graphs to illustrate the behavior of graph neural networks under different training sizes and degrees of graph complexity, with an emphasis on oversmoothing and oversquashing.
papers.comment: Author accepted manuscript. Title and metadata updated to match the published ACM Computing Surveys version. 73 pages, including references and supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇针对机器学习工程师的图神经网络（GNN）入门综述，采用编码器-解码器框架系统性地介绍GNN的设计原理，并通过理论分析和大量同质图上的实验，重点展示了不同训练规模和图复杂度下过平滑（oversmoothing）和过挤压（oversquashing）现象对模型行为的影响。
Motivation: 图神经网络在众多任务上表现优异，相关研究增长迅速，但缺乏面向工程师的系统性介绍，尤其是对过平滑和过挤压等关键问题的深入理解。
Method: 采用编码器-解码器框架组织内容，先介绍GNN的基础编码器设计，再针对图分析任务（如节点分类、链接预测、图分类）给出相应的解码器示例，并结合理论推导和实验分析模型行为。
Result: 通过同质图上的实验揭示了训练样本数量和图复杂度对GNN性能的影响，特别强调了过平滑和过挤压现象在不同条件下的表现，但未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 本文强调理解过平滑和过挤压对GNN行为的重要性，为工程人员选择和改进GNN提供了理论指导和实践参考。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Challenges in the calibration of tree-based models for imbalanced classification
papers.abstract_en: When using machine learning for imbalanced binary classification problems, it is common to subsample the majority class to create a (more) balanced training dataset. This biases the model's predictions because the model learns from data that is not fully representative of the underlying population of interest. One way of accounting for this bias is analytically mapping the resulting predictions to new values based on the sampling rate for the majority class. We show that calibrating a random forest this way has negative consequences, including prevalence estimates that depend on both the number of predictors considered at each split in the random forest and the sampling rate used. We explain the former using known properties of random forests and analytical calibration and the latter by demonstrating a bias in decision trees. In contradiction with much of the existing literature, we show that decision trees can be biased towards the minority class. These issues indicate that tree-based models trained on undersampled data should not be calibrated analytically. Calibration approaches that can learn a miscalibration pattern in the original model (e.g., beta calibration) are more suitable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究了不平衡二分类问题中，对多数类欠采样后使用基于采样率的解析校准对树模型的影响。发现该方法会导致预测流行率依赖于随机森林分裂时考虑的预测变量数量和采样率，并证明决策树可能偏向少数类，这与现有文献观点相反。建议采用可学习校准模式的方法（如beta校准）代替解析校准。
Motivation: 现有文献常用基于采样率的解析校准来校正欠采样导致的偏差，但本文发现该方法对树模型存在负面后果。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验，展示解析校准导致随机森林预测流行率依赖分裂变量数和采样率，并证明决策树可能偏向少数类。
Result: 揭示了解析校准的负面后果，并指出决策树可以偏向少数类。
Conclusion: 树模型欠采样后不应使用解析校准，而应使用可学习校准模式的方法。

papers.title: Fixed-Mean Gaussian Processes for Post-hoc Bayesian Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recently, there has been an increasing interest in performing post-hoc uncertainty estimation about the predictions of pre-trained deep neural networks (DNNs). Given a pre-trained DNN via back-propagation, these methods enhance the original network by adding output confidence measures, such as error bars, without compromising its initial accuracy. In this context, we introduce a novel family of sparse variational Gaussian processes (GPs), where the posterior mean is fixed to any continuous function when using a universal kernel. Specifically, we fix the mean of this GP to the output of the pre-trained DNN, allowing our approach to effectively fit the GP's predictive variances to estimate the DNN prediction uncertainty. Our approach leverages variational inference (VI) for efficient stochastic optimization, with training costs that remain independent of the number of training points, scaling efficiently to large datasets such as ImageNet. The proposed method, called fixed-mean GP (FMGP), is architecture-agnostic, relying solely on the pre-trained model's outputs to adjust the predictive variances. Experimental results demonstrate that FMGP improves both uncertainty estimation and computational efficiency when compared to state-of-the-art methods for DNN post-hoc Bayesian inference.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类稀疏变分高斯过程（GP），其中后验均值被固定为预训练DNN的输出，用于事后不确定性估计。该方法称为固定均值GP（FMGP），与架构无关，仅依赖预训练模型输出调整预测方差。实验表明FMGP在不确定性估计和计算效率上优于现有事后贝叶斯推断方法。
Motivation: 预训练DNN缺乏可靠的不确定性估计，现有事后方法在效率和扩展性上有限。
Method: 利用稀疏变分高斯过程，固定均值到预训练DNN输出，通过变分推断进行随机优化，训练成本独立于数据点数量。
Result: 在ImageNet等大规模数据集上，FMGP提升了不确定性估计和计算效率。
Conclusion: FMGP是一种架构无关、高效的事后贝叶斯深度学习方法，但抽象未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Self-supervised Monocular Depth and Pose Estimation for Endoscopy with Latent Priors
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D mapping in endoscopy enables quantitative, holistic lesion characterization within the gastrointestinal (GI) tract, requiring reliable depth and pose estimation. However, endoscopy systems are monocular, and existing methods relying on synthetic datasets or complex models often lack generalizability in challenging endoscopic conditions. We propose a robust self-supervised monocular depth and pose estimation framework that incorporates a Generative Latent Bank and a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). The Generative Latent Bank leverages extensive depth scenes from natural images to condition the depth network, enhancing realism and robustness of depth predictions through latent feature priors. For pose estimation, we reformulate it within a VAE framework, treating pose transitions as latent variables to regularize scale, stabilize z-axis prominence, and improve x-y sensitivity. This dual refinement pipeline enables accurate depth and pose predictions, effectively addressing the GI tract's complex textures and lighting. Extensive evaluations on SimCol and EndoSLAM datasets confirm our framework's superior performance over published self-supervised methods in endoscopic depth and pose estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自监督单目深度与姿态估计框架，用于内窥镜下的三维重建。框架引入生成式潜在银行（Generative Latent Bank）和变分自编码器（VAE），利用自然图像的深度先验增强深度预测鲁棒性，并将姿态估计重构为VAE中的隐变量问题。在SimCol和EndoSLAM数据集上，该方法优于已有自监督方法。
Motivation: 内窥镜系统为单目，现有方法依赖合成数据或复杂模型，在具有挑战性的内窥镜条件下泛化性不足，难以实现准确的深度和姿态估计。
Method: 提出一个自监督框架，包含生成式潜在银行（利用自然图像深度场景作为先验条件）和VAE（将姿态过渡建模为隐变量以正则化尺度、稳定z轴并提高x-y敏感性）。
Result: 在SimCol和EndoSLAM数据集上，该方法在内窥镜深度和姿态估计中优于已发表的自监督方法。

papers.title: RankByGene: Gene-Guided Histopathology Representation Learning Through Cross-Modal Ranking Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides essential spatial context by mapping gene expression within tissue, enabling detailed study of cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization. However, aligning ST data with histology images poses challenges due to inherent spatial distortions and modality-specific variations. Existing methods largely rely on direct alignment, which often fails to capture complex cross-modal relationships. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework that aligns gene and image features using a ranking-based alignment loss, preserving relative similarity across modalities and enabling robust multi-scale alignment. To further enhance the alignment's stability, we employ self-supervised knowledge distillation with a teacher-student network architecture, effectively mitigating disruptions from high dimensionality, sparsity, and noise in gene expression data. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets that encompass gene expression prediction, slide-level classification, and survival analysis demonstrate the efficacy of our method, showing improved alignment and predictive performance over existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RankByGene 框架，利用基于排名的对齐损失 (ranking-based alignment loss) 来对齐空间转录组学 (spatial transcriptomics) 的基因特征与组织学图像特征，并通过自监督知识蒸馏 (self-supervised knowledge distillation) 提高稳定性。在七个公开数据集上，该方法在基因表达预测、切片分类和生存分析任务中显示出优于现有方法的对齐与预测性能。

Method: 提出基于排名的对齐损失，保持样本间相对相似性以实现鲁棒的多尺度对齐；并采用教师-学生网络架构进行自监督知识蒸馏，减轻基因数据的高维、稀疏和噪声问题。
Result: 在七个公开数据集上，该方法在基因表达预测、切片分类和生存分析任务中取得了优于现有方法的对齐与预测性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该排名对齐框架能有效改善空间转录组学与组织学图像的跨模态对齐，并提升下游任务表现。

papers.title: Dimension Reduction via Sum-of-Squares and Improved Clustering Algorithms for Non-Spherical Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: We develop a new approach for clustering non-spherical (i.e., arbitrary component covariances) Gaussian mixture models via a subroutine, based on the sum-of-squares method, that finds a low-dimensional separation-preserving projection of the input data. Our method gives a non-spherical analog of the classical dimension reduction, based on singular value decomposition, that, among several other applications, forms a key component of the celebrated spherical clustering algorithm of Vempala and Wang [VW04]. As applications, we obtain an algorithm to (1) cluster an arbitrary total-variation separated mixture of $k$ centered (i.e., zero-mean) Gaussians with $n\geq \operatorname{poly}(d) f(w_{\min}^{-1})$ samples and $\operatorname{poly}(n)$ time, and (2) cluster an arbitrary total-variation separated mixture of $k$ Gaussians with identical but arbitrary unknown covariance with $n \geq d^{O(\log w_{\min}^{-1})} f(w_{\min}^{-1})$ samples and $n^{O(\log w_{\min}^{-1})}$ time. Here, $w_{\min}$ is the minimum mixing weight of the input mixture, and $f$ does not depend on the dimension $d$. Our algorithms naturally extend to tolerating a dimension-independent fraction of arbitrary outliers. Before this work, the techniques in the state-of-the-art non-spherical clustering algorithms needed $d^{O(k)} f(w_{\min}^{-1})$ samples and time for clustering such mixtures. Our results may come as a surprise in the context of the $d^{Ω(k)}$ statistical query and sum-of-squares lower bounds [DKS17, DKPP24] for clustering non-spherical Gaussian mixtures. While these results are usually thought to rule out $d^{o(k)}$ cost algorithms for the problem, our results show that the lower bounds can in fact be circumvented for a remarkably general class of Gaussian mixtures.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于和平方方法的降维子程序，用于聚类非球形高斯混合模型，实现了对任意总变差分离的中心高斯混合及具有相同未知协方差的高斯混合的聚类，样本和时间复杂度较之前工作有显著改进。
Motivation: 经典降维方法（如奇异值分解）适用于球形高斯混合，但非球形混合缺乏类似工具，导致现有算法需要高维指数级样本和时间。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 基于和平方方法设计一个子程序，找到输入数据的低维分离保持投影，作为非球形高斯混合聚类的核心步骤。
Result: 对于k个中心高斯混合，样本复杂度为poly(d) f(w_min^{-1})，时间为poly(n)；对于相同未知协方差的高斯混合，样本复杂度为d^{O(log w_min^{-1})} f(w_min^{-1})，时间为n^{O(log w_min^{-1})}，且可容忍任意离群点。
Conclusion: 本文表明，尽管存在d^{Ω(k)}的统计查询和和平方下界，但通过所提方法可以绕开这些下界，实现一类广泛高斯混合的有效聚类。

papers.title: Nonlinear Equilibrium Transitions in a Potential Game Model for Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: In federated learning (FL), a central server typically allocates training efforts to clients. However, from a market-oriented perspective, clients may independently choose their training efforts based on rational self-interest. To study this setting, we propose a potential game framework in which each client's payoff is determined by its individual effort and the rewards provided by the server. The rewards are influenced by the collective efforts of all clients and can be modulated by a reward factor. We first establish the existence of Nash equilibria (NEs) and then investigate their uniqueness in a stationary setting. We show that the NEs depend nonlinearly on the reward factor and exhibit a nonsmooth transition at a critical value, where the stationary potential loses strict curvature, leading to nonunique NEs and a jump between low-effort and high-effort branches. Furthermore, we prove the convergence of the best-response algorithm for computing NEs in our FL game. Finally, we apply the clients' rational efforts derived from the NEs to FL training with various datasets and models, thereby validating the effectiveness of the identified critical reward factor.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个势博弈框架来建模联邦学习中客户端基于自利的训练努力选择，证明了纳什均衡的存在性和唯一性条件，揭示了在临界奖励因子处均衡的非光滑跃迁，并验证了最佳响应算法的收敛性。实验使用不同的数据集和模型展示了临界奖励因子的有效性。
Motivation: 从市场角度，联邦学习中的客户端可能根据理性自利独立选择训练努力，但现有工作多假设服务器统一分配。需要理论框架来理解这种自利行为下的均衡与系统行为。
Method: 建立势博弈模型，其中客户端效用由个体努力和服务器奖励决定，奖励受集体努力影响并由奖励因子调控。分析纳什均衡的存在性、唯一性及对奖励因子的非线性依赖，证明最佳响应算法的收敛性。
Result: 纳什均衡随奖励因子非线性变化，在临界值处出现非光滑跃迁：势函数失去严格凸性，导致均衡非唯一，系统在低努力和高努力分支间跳跃。
Conclusion: 临界奖励因子可用于指导联邦学习中的激励机制设计，在多种数据集和模型上验证了其有效性。

papers.title: Implicit Regularization for Multi-label Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we address the problem of feature selection in the context of multi-label learning, by using a new estimator based on implicit regularization and label embedding. Unlike the sparse feature selection methods that use a penalized estimator with explicit regularization terms such as $l_{2,1}$-norm, MCP or SCAD, we propose a simple alternative method via Hadamard product parameterization. In order to guide the feature selection process, a latent semantic of multi-label information method is adopted, as a label embedding. Experimental results on some known benchmark datasets suggest that the proposed estimator suffers much less from extra bias, and may lead to benign overfitting.

papers.title: A Likelihood Approach for Inference of Population Heterogeneity in Particle Ensembles with Second-Order Langevin Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: The inherent complexity of biological agents often leads to motility behavior that appears to have random components. Robust stochastic inference methods are therefore required to understand and predict the motion patterns from time-discrete trajectory data provided by experiments. In many cases, second-order Langevin models are needed to adequately capture the motility. Additionally, population heterogeneity needs to be taken into account when analyzing data from several individual organisms. In this work, we describe a maximum likelihood approach to infer dynamical, stochastic models and, simultaneously, estimate the heterogeneity in a population of motile active particles from discretely sampled, stochastic trajectories. To this end, we propose a method to approximate the likelihood for non-linear second-order Langevin models. We show that this maximum likelihood ansatz outperforms alternative approaches, especially for short trajectories. Additionally, we demonstrate how a measure of uncertainty for the heterogeneity estimate can be derived. We thereby pave the way for the systematic, data-driven inference of dynamical models for actively driven entities based on trajectory data, deciphering temporal fluctuations and inter-particle variability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离散采样的随机轨迹数据，提出一种基于最大似然的方法，用于推断服从二阶朗之万动力学（second-order Langevin dynamics）的活性粒子群体的异质性（population heterogeneity）。方法通过近似非线性二阶朗之万模型的似然函数，同时推断动力学参数和群体异质性，在短轨迹场景下优于替代方法，并可量化异质性估计的不确定性。
Motivation: 生物活性粒子的运动常呈现随机性，实验轨迹数据需要鲁棒的随机推断方法。现有方法在处理二阶朗之万模型和群体异质性时存在局限，尤其短轨迹下精度不足。
Method: 提出一种近似最大似然方法，对非线性二阶朗之万模型的似然函数进行近似，同时估计动力学模型参数和群体异质性（即个体间参数分布）。
Result: 在短轨迹数据上，该最大似然方法优于替代方法；可导出异质性估计的不确定性度量。
Conclusion: 该方法为基于轨迹数据系统推断活性粒子动力学模型提供了数据驱动框架，能够解析时间涨落和粒子间变异性。

papers.title: Agricultural Landscape Understanding At Country-Scale
papers.abstract_en: Comprehensive agricultural landscape understanding is critical for addressing global challenges in food security, climate change, and resource management. This requires mapping not just crop fields, but also vital features like trees and water bodies which form an intricate mosaic in complex \textit{smallholder} systems dominating the Global South. Previous efforts to develop such land use maps have been limited by a narrow focus on methods for field delineation only, and also do not develop robust post-processing steps essential for real-world deployment. Further, to our knowledge, no prior system for smallholder farms has been deployed and evaluated at a national scale. This work addresses these limitations by presenting the first national-scale agricultural mapping system that moves beyond simple field delineation to enable segmentation of agricultural instances like fields, trees and water bodies. Our system is refined for real-world application using novel post-processing heuristics to ensure map consistency and accuracy, and is validated through a rigorous, multi-faceted evaluation process. Fine-grained land use maps generated by our system are publicly accessible via an API at \textit{\href{http://agri.withgoogle.com}{http://agri.withgoogle.com}}, enabling a wide range of applications from precision agriculture and policy-making to advancing global sustainability development goals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个国家级小农户农业景观系统，不仅进行农田分割，还同时分割树木和水体等特征，并通过新颖的后处理启发式方法提升地图一致性和准确性。系统在印度等国家规模部署验证，并公开API提供细粒度土地利用图。
Motivation: 现有农业土地覆盖制图多只关注农田边界，缺乏对树木、水体等关键要素的联合分割，且缺少适用于实际部署的鲁棒后处理步骤；此外，尚无系统在小农户农业场景中实现国家尺度评估。
Method: 提出端到端分割系统，包含多类别实例分割（农田、树木、水体），并设计一套后处理启发式方法（如边界平滑、小区域合并/去除）以确保地图的语义一致性和几何精度。系统通过多阶段评估验证。
Result: 系统在国家尺度上生成可公开访问的细粒度土地利用图，并在多重评估中证明其可靠性。
Conclusion: 该系统填补了小农户农业景观国家尺度制图的空白，可直接支撑精准农业、政策制定和可持续发展目标。

summary_sections.method: 提出端到端分割系统，包含多类别实例分割（农田、树木、水体），并设计一套后处理启发式方法（如边界平滑、小区域合并/去除）以确保地图的语义一致性和几何精度。系统通过多阶段评估验证。
summary_sections.result: 系统在国家尺度上生成可公开访问的细粒度土地利用图，并在多重评估中证明其可靠性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该系统填补了小农户农业景观国家尺度制图的空白，可直接支撑精准农业、政策制定和可持续发展目标。

papers.title: Efficient Hamiltonian, structure and trace distance learning of Gaussian states
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we initiate the study of Hamiltonian learning for positive temperature bosonic Gaussian states, the quantum generalization of the widely studied problem of learning Gaussian graphical models. We obtain efficient protocols, both in sample and computational complexity, for the task of inferring the parameters of their underlying quadratic Hamiltonian under the assumption of bounded temperature, squeezing, displacement and maximal degree of the interaction graph. Our protocol only requires heterodyne measurements, which are often experimentally feasible, and has a sample complexity that scales logarithmically with the number of modes. Furthermore, we show that it is possible to learn the underlying interaction graph in a similar setting and sample complexity. In addition, we use our techniques to obtain the first results on learning Gaussian states in trace distance with a quadratic scaling in precision and polynomial in the number of modes, albeit imposing certain restrictions on the Gaussian states. Our main technical innovations are several continuity bounds for the covariance and Hamiltonian matrix of a Gaussian state, which are of independent interest, combined with what we call the local inversion technique. In essence, the local inversion technique allows us to reliably infer the Hamiltonian of a Gaussian state by only estimating in parallel submatrices of the covariance matrix whose size scales with the desired precision, but not the number of modes. This way we bypass the need to obtain precise global estimates of the covariance matrix, controlling the sample complexity.
papers.comment: 54 pages, improvements in presentation and tighter analysis of the dependence on the precision in Hamiltonian and graph learning

TL;DR: 本文首次研究正温度玻色高斯态的哈密顿量学习问题，提出了样本和计算复杂度高效的协议。协议仅需外差测量，样本复杂度随模式数对数增长，能够学习哈密顿量参数和交互图。此外，还得到了迹距离下学习高斯态的首个结果，精度二次缩放、模式多项式。主要技术创新包括协方差矩阵和哈密顿矩阵的连续性界限以及局部逆技术。
Motivation: 经典学习中的高斯图模型已被广泛研究，但量子对应的高斯态哈密顿量学习尚未被充分探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出局部逆技术，通过并行估计协方差矩阵的子矩阵（大小由所需精度而非模式数决定）来可靠推断哈密顿量，避免全局精确估计。
Result: 样本复杂度随模式数对数增长，仅需外差测量；在迹距离下学习高斯态时，精度呈二次缩放，模式数为多项式。
Conclusion: 本文建立的连续性界限和局部逆技术具有独立价值，为高斯态的高效学习提供了新方法。

papers.title: Interventional Processes for Causal Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification for causal effects is crucial in high-stakes applications, but remains challenging when the target is an entire function rather than a scalar estimand. In this work, we introduce a GP-based approach for uncertainty quantification of interventional functions. The central idea is to build on recent work representing interventional functions as an inner-product of observational functions in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), by constructing appropriate GP priors for such functions and inferring posteriors from observational data. Our approach yields closed-form posterior moments and tractable training and inference, while avoiding pathologies of previous GP prior constructions for RKHS functions. We further derive a practical procedure for posterior coverage calibration. Across synthetic benchmarks, causal Bayesian optimization tasks, and a large-scale real dataset, our method improves uncertainty quantification while remaining competitive in causal effect estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于高斯过程（GP）的方法，用于对干预函数（interventional functions）进行不确定性量化。核心思想是将干预函数表示为再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中观测函数的内积，并为此类函数构造合适的GP先验，从观测数据推断后验。该方法得到闭式后验矩，训练和推理易于处理，且避免了以往GP先验构造的病理问题。还提出了后验覆盖校准的实际程序。在合成基准、因果贝叶斯优化任务和大规模真实数据集上，该方法在因果效应估计中保持竞争力的同时改进了不确定性量化。
Motivation: 在高风险应用中，对因果效应进行可靠的不确定性量化至关重要，但当目标是整个函数而非标量估计量时，这仍然具有挑战性。
Method: 基于GP的方法，将干预函数表示为RKHS中观测函数的内积，构造合适的GP先验并从中推断后验，得到闭式后验矩，并开发后验覆盖校准程序。
Result: 在合成基准、因果贝叶斯优化任务和大规模真实数据集上，该方法在因果效应估计中保持竞争力的同时改进了不确定性量化。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种可处理且有效的因果不确定性量化方式，避免了以往GP先验构造的问题，并提供了实用的校准程序。

papers.title: Unsupervised Cognition
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised learning methods have a soft inspiration in cognition models. To this day, the most successful unsupervised learning methods revolve around clustering samples in a mathematical space. In this paper we propose a primitive-based, unsupervised learning approach for decision-making inspired by a novel cognition framework. This representation-centric approach models the input space constructively as a distributed hierarchical structure in an input-agnostic way. We compared our approach with both current state-of-the-art unsupervised learning classification, with current state-of-the-art small and incomplete datasets classification, and with current state-of-the-art cancer type classification. We show how our proposal outperforms previous state-of-the-art. We also evaluate some cognition-like properties of our proposal where it not only outperforms the compared algorithms (even supervised learning ones), but it also shows a different, more cognition-like, behaviour.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于原语（primitive）的无监督学习方法，该方法受新认知框架启发，对输入空间进行分布式层次化表示，并在多个分类任务（包括小样本和不完整数据集分类、癌症类型分类）上超越现有方法。摘要还展示了该方法在类认知属性上的优势。
Motivation: 现有的无监督学习方法主要依赖数学空间中的聚类，而本文旨在提出一种更具认知启发的表示中心方法，以改善决策问题中的无监督学习效果。
Method: 提出一种基于原语的无监督学习框架，通过构建输入无关的分布式层次化表示来建模输入空间，并用于决策。
Result: 在多个分类基准上（包括小样本/不完整数据集分类和癌症类型分类）超越了当前最先进的无监督及部分监督学习方法，并展示了更接近认知的行为。
Conclusion: 该方法在无监督分类任务上表现优异，且具有良好的类认知属性，但需要进一步验证其可扩展性和通用性。

papers.title: Random Erasing vs. Model Inversion: A Promising Defense or a False Hope?
papers.abstract_en: Model Inversion (MI) attacks pose a significant privacy threat by reconstructing private training data from machine learning models. While existing defenses primarily concentrate on model-centric approaches, the impact of data on MI robustness remains largely unexplored. In this work, we explore Random Erasing (RE), a technique traditionally used for improving model generalization under occlusion, and uncover its surprising effectiveness as a defense against MI attacks. Specifically, our novel feature space analysis shows that models trained with RE-images introduce a significant discrepancy between the features of MI-reconstructed images and those of the private data. At the same time, features of private images remain distinct from other classes and well-separated from different classification regions. These effects collectively degrade MI reconstruction quality and attack accuracy while maintaining reasonable natural accuracy. Furthermore, we explore two critical properties of RE including Partial Erasure and Random Location. Partial Erasure prevents the model from observing entire objects during training. We find this has a significant impact on MI, which aims to reconstruct the entire objects. Random Location of erasure plays a crucial role in achieving a strong privacy-utility trade-off. Our findings highlight RE as a simple yet effective defense mechanism that can be easily integrated with existing privacy-preserving techniques. Extensive experiments across 37 setups demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the privacy-utility trade-off. The results consistently demonstrate the superiority of our defense over existing methods across different MI attacks, network architectures, and attack configurations. For the first time, we achieve a significant degradation in attack accuracy without a decrease in utility for some configurations.
papers.comment: Accepted in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). First two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了随机擦除（Random Erasing, RE）作为模型反转（Model Inversion, MI）攻击的防御方法。通过特征空间分析发现，RE图像训练的模型会使MI重建图像的特征与私有数据特征产生显著差异，同时保持私有图像特征的可分离性，从而降低攻击质量与准确率。实验表明，RE在37种设置下实现了隐私-效用权衡的最优性能。
Motivation: 现有MI防御主要聚焦模型端方法，数据层面对MI鲁棒性的影响尚未充分探索。随机擦除作为一种数据增强技术，其防御潜力未被认识。
Method: 使用随机擦除（RE）训练分类模型，分析其特征空间：RE引入部分擦除和随机位置，导致模型无法观察完整物体，破坏MI重建。结合隐私-效用权衡评估防御效果。
Result: 在37种攻击、网络和配置设置下，RE方法在隐私-效用权衡上达到SOTA，首次在某些配置中显著降低攻击准确率而不牺牲效用。
Conclusion: 随机擦除是一种简单有效的MI防御，可轻松集成现有隐私保护技术，但需注意其仅在特定条件下有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Practical Aspects on Solving Differential Equations Using Deep Learning: A Primer
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning is now common across many scientific fields, including the study of partial differential equations. This article provides a brief, accessible introduction to core deep learning concepts, including neural networks, backpropagation, and the universal approximation theorem. It mainly covers how to use deep learning in solving differential equations. The article aims to help undergraduate and graduate students in mathematics, physics, and related areas learn how to use Deep Learning to solve partial differential equations. Instructors in mathematics or physics can also use this article to introduce students to Deep Galerkin method and scientific deep learning. We focus on key questions: What is deep learning, and how can it help solve mathematical or physical problems? How can you implement a neural network and choose the right numerical method to solve differential equations? How do you select the best hyperparameters? How can you improve accuracy and speed up convergence? We should mention that all the problems in this article can be solved on a machine without a GPU, so any student can follow the presented methodology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于使用深度学习求解微分方程的入门教程，涵盖了神经网络、反向传播、通用近似定理等基本概念，并重点介绍了深度Galerkin方法（Deep Galerkin method）。文章旨在帮助数学、物理等领域的本科生和研究生了解如何用深度学习解决微分方程问题，并强调了无需GPU即可实现所有示例。
Motivation: 为数学和物理领域的学生和教师提供一个浅显易懂的深度学习解微分方程入门指南，降低该交叉领域的学习门槛。
Method: 教程式讲解：先介绍深度学习基础（神经网络、反向传播、通用近似定理），然后重点介绍深度Galerkin方法及其在偏微分方程求解中的应用，并给出超参数选择、精度提升和收敛加速的实用技巧。
Result: 未报告具体的实验结果或数值比较，但声称所有示例可在无GPU的机器上运行。
Conclusion: 本文作为入门级教程，适合初学者快速了解深度学习解微分方程的基本框架和流程，但未涉及更高级或特定领域的应用。

papers.title: Algebraic anti-unification
papers.abstract_en: Abstraction is key to human and artificial intelligence as it allows one to identify common structure in otherwise distinct objects or situations. Anti-unification (or generalization) is the branch of theoretical computer science and artificial intelligence that studies abstraction and has found applications in areas such as inductive logic programming, program synthesis, and analogy-making. To date, anti-unification has been studied almost exclusively from a syntactic perspective. In this paper, we initiate an algebraic (i.e.\ semantic) theory of anti-unification in the general setting of universal algebra, thereby extending anti-unification from term-based representations to arbitrary algebras and beyond equational theories. In particular, we introduce the notions of algebraic generalization ordering and minimally general generalization, establish basic structural properties, prove compatibility with homomorphisms and isomorphisms, and investigate computability in finite unary algebras and finite algebras via automata-theoretic methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从语义角度提出代数反统一（algebraic anti-unification）理论，在泛代数框架下将反统一从项表示扩展到任意代数，引入代数泛化序（algebraic generalization ordering）和最小泛化（minimally general generalization），并证明了与同态、同构的兼容性，最后通过自动机方法研究了有限一元代数和有限代数上的可计算性。
Motivation: 现有反统一研究几乎完全基于语法视角，缺乏语义层面的理论。本文旨在建立代数（语义）反统一理论，以支持更广泛的抽象推理应用。
Method: 在泛代数（universal algebra）的一般框架下定义代数泛化序和最小泛化，证明其基本结构性质及与同态、同构的关系，并利用自动机理论方法分析有限代数上的可计算性。
Result: 建立了代数反统一的基本理论框架，包括泛化序的格结构、同态保持性以及有限代数中反统一的可计算性结果。
Conclusion: 该工作将反统一从语法扩展到语义，为归纳逻辑编程、程序合成和类比推理等领域的代数抽象提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 在泛代数（universal algebra）的一般框架下定义代数泛化序和最小泛化，证明其基本结构性质及与同态、同构的关系，并利用自动机理论方法分析有限代数上的可计算性。
summary_sections.result: 建立了代数反统一的基本理论框架，包括泛化序的格结构、同态保持性以及有限代数中反统一的可计算性结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作将反统一从语法扩展到语义，为归纳逻辑编程、程序合成和类比推理等领域的代数抽象提供了理论基础。

papers.title: SCL: Towards Domain Generalization via Single-Temporal Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Remote Sensing Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, change detection and anomaly detection models based on CNN and transformer have achieved remarkable success across various datasets based on paired data. However, most such methods exhibit limited crossdataset generalization due to domain-specific designs and typically rely on large amounts of paired labeled data. In this paper, based on visual-language pre-training model, we introduce a Single-temporal multimodal Contrastive Learning (SCL) foundation models for change detection without training on the target dataset. To further improve the model's ability to learn context of textual and visual information, we propose a Dynamic Text-vision Context Optimization (DTCO) module for prompt learning. Meanwhile, to address the data dependency issue of existing methods, we introduce a controllable generation and Single-temporal trAINing strategy (SAIN). This allows us to train the model using a large number of existing single-temporal images without the need for paired label. Extensive experiments on various realworld change detection datasets demonstrate the superior performance and generalization of SCL, outperforming state-of-the-art methods under the evaluated settings. Code is available at https://github.com/Kane-Du/scl-cd.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于视觉语言预训练的单时相多模态对比学习（SCL）用于遥感变化检测，无需目标数据集训练。通过动态文本-视觉上下文优化（DTCO）模块和可控生成及单时相训练策略（SAIN），缓解数据依赖问题。在多个真实变化检测数据集上表现优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有变化检测方法跨数据集泛化能力有限，且依赖大量配对标注数据。
Method: 基于视觉语言预训练模型，提出单时相多模态对比学习（SCL）；引入动态文本-视觉上下文优化（DTCO）模块进行提示学习；提出可控生成和单时相训练策略（SAIN），利用大量单时相图像训练，无需配对标签。
Result: 在多个真实变化检测数据集上取得最优性能，泛化能力优越。
Conclusion: 本文方法可有效提升变化检测的跨数据集泛化能力，降低对配对标注数据的依赖。

papers.title: AutoEval Done Right: Using Synthetic Data for Model Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: The evaluation of machine learning models using human-labeled validation data can be expensive and time-consuming. AI-labeled synthetic data can be used to decrease the number of human annotations required for this purpose in a process called autoevaluation. We suggest efficient and statistically principled algorithms for this purpose that improve sample efficiency while remaining unbiased. These algorithms increase the effective human-labeled sample size by up to 50% on experiments with GPT-4.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出使用 AI 标注的合成数据（autoevaluation）来减少模型评估所需的人工标注量，并设计了无偏且统计高效的算法。实验表明，在 GPT-4 评估中，该算法可将有效人工标注样本量提升最多 50%。
Motivation: 传统模型评估依赖人工标注验证数据，成本高且耗时；使用合成数据自动评估可减少人工需求，但现有方法可能存在偏差或样本效率低的问题。
Method: 提出无偏且统计高效的算法，通过合成数据增强人工标注样本，同时保持评估结果的无偏性。
Result: 在 GPT-4 评估实验中，该方法将有效人工标注样本量提升最多 50%。
Conclusion: 合成数据可用于高效且无偏的模型评估，显著降低对人工标注的依赖。

papers.title: MACCA: Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning with Causal Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is valuable in scenarios where online interaction is impractical or risky. While independent learning in MARL offers flexibility and scalability, accurately assigning credit to individual agents in offline settings poses challenges because interactions with an environment are prohibited. In this paper, we propose a new framework, namely Multi-Agent Causal Credit Assignment (MACCA), to address credit assignment in the offline MARL setting. Our approach, MACCA, characterizing the generative process as a Dynamic Bayesian Network, captures relationships between environmental variables, states, actions, and rewards. Estimating this model on offline data, MACCA can learn each agent's contribution by analyzing the causal relationship of their individual rewards, ensuring accurate and interpretable credit assignment. Additionally, the modularity of our approach allows it to integrate with various offline MARL methods seamlessly. Theoretically, we proved that under the setting of the offline dataset, the underlying causal structure and the function for generating the individual rewards of agents are identifiable, which laid the foundation for the correctness of our modeling. In our experiments, we demonstrate that MACCA not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods but also enhances performance when integrated with other backbones.
papers.journal_ref: TMLR 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MACCA框架，利用动态贝叶斯网络对离线多智能体强化学习中的信用分配问题进行因果建模，通过估计环境变量、状态、动作和奖励之间的因果关系，实现准确且可解释的个体奖励分配。理论证明了离线数据下因果结构与个体奖励生成函数的可识别性，实验表明MACCA在离线MARL基准上优于现有方法，并能作为模块提升其他基线的性能。
Motivation: 离线MARL中，智能体之间准确的信用分配是关键挑战，因为无法与环境交互来评估个体贡献。现有独立学习方法在离线场景下难以正确分配信用。
Method: 将生成过程建模为动态贝叶斯网络，从离线数据中学习环境变量、状态、动作与奖励之间的因果关系，从而推断每个智能体的个体奖励贡献。该框架模块化，可集成到多种离线MARL算法中。
Result: 在多个离线MARL基准任务上，MACCA超越了当前最先进方法，并且作为插件能提升其他基线算法的性能。
Conclusion: 因果建模为离线MARL中的信用分配提供了准确且可解释的解决方案，且理论保证了因果结构的可识别性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Incentivized Collaboration in Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: In collaborative active learning, where multiple agents try to learn labels from a common hypothesis, we introduce an innovative framework for incentivized collaboration. Here, rational agents aim to obtain labels for their data sets while keeping label complexity at a minimum. We focus on designing (strict) individually rational (IR) collaboration protocols, ensuring that agents cannot reduce their expected label complexity by acting individually. We first show that given any optimal active learning algorithm, the collaboration protocol that runs the algorithm as is over the entire data is already IR. However, computing the optimal algorithm is NP-hard. We therefore provide collaboration protocols that achieve (strict) IR and are comparable with the best known tractable approximation algorithm in terms of label complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对协作主动学习中多个智能体共同学习假设的问题，提出了一个激励协作框架。通过设计严格个体理性协议，确保理性智能体合作不会增加预期标签复杂度。理论分析表明任何最优主动学习算法已满足个体理性，但计算最优算法是NP难的，因此提供了与已知近似算法兼容的协议。
Motivation: 在协作主动学习场景中，理性智能体倾向于单独行动以减少标签复杂度，但可能导致整体学习效率降低，需要设计激励兼容的协议来促进合作。
Method: 提出严格个体理性协议，证明任意最优主动学习算法天然满足个体理性，但最优算法计算复杂，因此给出与最佳有界近似算法兼容的协作协议。
Result: 任何最优主动学习算法已是个体理性的，但计算最优算法是NP难的；所提协议在标签复杂度上与已知最优近似算法相当，并保证严格个体理性。
Conclusion: 该工作为协作主动学习中的激励机制提供了理论基础，并给出了可计算的协作协议，确保理性智能体不会因合作而受损。

papers.title: Recent Advances in Multi-modal 3D Intelligence: A Comprehensive Survey and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal 3D Intelligence has gained considerable attention due to its wide applications in autonomous driving and world simulation, etc. Compared to conventional single-modal 3D understanding, introducing an additional modality not only elevates the richness and precision of scene interpretation but also provides a foundation for higher-level physical world interaction. This becomes especially crucial in varied and challenging environments where solely relying on 3D data might be inadequate. While there has been a surge in the development of multi-modal 3D methods over the past six years, especially those integrating multi-camera images (3D+2D) and textual descriptions (3D+language), a comprehensive and in-depth review is notably absent. In this paper, we present a systematic survey of recent progress to bridge this gap. We begin by briefly summarizing the unique challenges among various 3D multi-modal tasks. After that, we present a novel taxonomy that delivers a thorough categorization of existing methods according to modalities and tasks, exploring their respective strengths and limitations. Furthermore, comparative results of recent approaches on several benchmark datasets, together with insightful analysis, are offered. Finally, we discuss the unresolved issues and provide several potential avenues for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了多模态3D智能领域的最新进展，涵盖多相机图像（3D+2D）和文本描述（3D+语言）等方法，提出新的分类体系，并在多个基准数据集上比较了不同方法的性能，最后讨论了未解决的问题和未来研究方向。
Motivation: 现有综述缺乏对多模态3D智能的全面深入回顾，特别是近年来融合多相机图像和语言描述的方法激增，亟需系统整理和比较。
Method: 提出一种基于模态和任务的新型分类法，对现有方法进行细致分类，分析其优缺点，并在多个基准数据集上提供对比结果。
Result: 系统梳理了多模态3D智能领域的主要挑战、方法分类和性能比较，为研究者提供了清晰的现状总结。
Conclusion: 多模态3D智能在自主驾驶和世界模拟中至关重要，未来需解决数据融合、模态对齐等未解决问题。

papers.title: Federated Learning via Variational Bayesian Inference: Personalization, Sparsity and Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is a promising framework that models distributed machine learning while protecting the privacy of clients. However, FL suffers performance degradation from heterogeneous and limited data. To alleviate the degradation, we present a novel personalized Bayesian FL approach named pFedBayes. By using the trained global distribution from the server as the prior distribution of each client, each client adjusts its own distribution by minimizing the sum of the reconstruction error over its personalized data and the KL divergence with the downloaded global distribution. Then, we propose a sparse personalized Bayesian FL approach named sFedBayes to enhance the inference efficiency. To overcome the extreme heterogeneity in non-i.i.d. data, we propose a clustered Bayesian FL model named cFedbayes by learning different prior distributions for different clients. Theoretical analysis gives the generalization error bound of three approaches and shows that the generalization error rates of the proposed approaches achieve minimax optimality up to a logarithmic factor. Moreover, cFedBayes achieves a cluster-level generalization error bound, rather than a single uniform bound in pFedBayes. Numerous experiments demonstrate that the proposed approaches have better performance than other advanced personalized methods on private models in the presence of heterogeneous and limited data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习在异构有限数据下的性能下降问题，提出基于变分贝叶斯推断的个性化联邦学习方法pFedBayes，利用服务器全局分布作为先验，最小化重构误差和KL散度。进一步提出稀疏版本sFedBayes和聚类版本cFedBayes，分别提升推理效率和应对极端非独立同分布数据。理论分析给出泛化误差界，证明达到极小化最优（至多对数因子），并实验验证方法优于其他先进个性化方法。
Motivation: 联邦学习在客户端数据异构且有限时性能严重下降，现有方法难以有效利用全局信息并保持个性化。
Method: 提出变分贝叶斯框架：客户端以服务器全局分布为先验，通过最小化个性化数据重构误差与KL散度之和调整后验；稀疏版本引入稀疏性约束；聚类版本为不同客户端组学习不同先验分布。
Result: 理论证明三种方法的泛化误差率在极小化意义上最优（至多对数因子），且cFedBayes获得聚类级泛化界而非统一界。实验表明在异构有限数据场景下，所提方法性能优于多种先进个性化联邦学习方法。
Conclusion: 基于变分贝叶斯推断的个性化联邦学习框架能有效缓解数据异构和有限性问题，稀疏和聚类扩展分别提升推理效率和应对极端非独立同分布。

papers.title: Stability Analysis of Sharpness-Aware Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) is a training method that seeks to find flat minima in deep learning, resulting in state-of-the-art performance across various domains. Instead of minimizing the loss of the current weights, SAM minimizes the worst-case loss in its neighborhood in the parameter space. In this paper, we investigate the convergence instability of SAM near a saddle point. Using the qualitative theory of dynamical systems, we explain how SAM becomes stuck in the saddle point and theoretically prove that the saddle point can become an attractor under SAM dynamics. Additionally, we show that this convergence instability can also occur in stochastic dynamical systems by establishing the diffusion of SAM. We prove that SAM diffusion is worse than that of vanilla gradient descent in terms of saddle point escape. Finally, we demonstrate that often overlooked training tricks, momentum and batch-size, might be important to mitigate the convergence instability and achieve high generalization performance. Our theoretical and empirical results are thoroughly verified through experiments on several well-known optimization problems and benchmark tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析锐度感知最小化（SAM）在鞍点附近的收敛不稳定性，利用动力系统定性理论证明鞍点可能成为SAM的吸引子，并证明SAM在随机动力系统中逃离鞍点比标准梯度下降更慢。实验表明动量与批次大小等训练技巧可缓解该不稳定性。
Motivation: SAM虽在多个领域取得优秀性能，但其收敛行为，特别是鞍点附近的不稳定性尚未被深入理解。理解这种不稳定性对于改进SAM和提升泛化性能至关重要。
Method: 采用动力系统定性理论分析SAM的确定性动力学，并建立随机动力学模型，证明SAM扩散（diffusion）导致逃离鞍点更困难。结合理论分析与实验验证。
Result: 理论证明SAM下鞍点可成为吸引子，且SAM的扩散比标准梯度下降更差；实验表明动量与批次大小可缓解不稳定性。
Conclusion: SAM在鞍点附近存在收敛不稳定性，但通过动量、批次大小等技巧可改善，为实际应用提供指导。

papers.title: Variable Clustering via Distributionally Robust Nodewise Regression
papers.abstract_en: We study a multi-factor block model for variable clustering and connect it to regularized subspace clustering through a distributionally robust version of nodewise regression. To solve the latter problem, we derive a convex relaxation, provide a data-driven approach for selecting the size of the robust region, and develop an ADMM algorithm for efficient implementation. We validate our method in extensive numerical studies and demonstrate its superior performance.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 数值实验验证了方法的优越性能。

papers.title: c-TPE: Tree-structured Parzen Estimator with Inequality Constraints for Expensive Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is crucial for strong performance of deep learning algorithms and real-world applications often impose some constraints, such as on memory usage or latency, on top of the performance requirement. In this work, we propose constrained TPE (c-TPE), an extension of the widely-used versatile Bayesian optimization method, tree-structured Parzen estimator (TPE), to handle these constraints. Our proposed extension goes beyond a simple combination of an existing acquisition function and the original TPE, and instead includes modifications that address issues that cause poor performance. We thoroughly analyze these modifications both empirically and theoretically, providing insights into how they effectively overcome these challenges. In the experiments, we demonstrate that c-TPE exhibits the best average rank performance among existing methods with statistical significance on $81$ expensive HPO problems with inequality constraints. Due to the lack of baselines, we only discuss the applicability of our method to hard-constrained optimization in Appendix D. The implementation is now available via OptunaHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 c-TPE，一种扩展的树结构 Parzen 估计器（TPE），用于处理带有不等式约束的超参数优化问题。c-TPE 不仅简单组合现有采集函数和原始 TPE，还包含针对性能不佳问题的修改，并通过理论和实证分析展示其有效性。在 81 个昂贵的约束 HPO 问题上，c-TPE 在统计显著性下取得了最佳平均排名。
Motivation: 实际应用中的超参数优化常常需要考虑内存使用或延迟等约束，但现有贝叶斯优化方法如 TPE 缺乏对约束的直接处理，直接组合采集函数和 TPE 会导致性能不佳。
Method: 提出 constraint TPE（c-TPE），通过对 TPE 进行针对性修改来处理不等式约束，包括调整采样和排序方式，并集成约束建模。
Result: 在 81 个昂贵的约束 HPO 问题上，c-TPE 的平均排名性能显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: c-TPE 是处理昂贵超参数优化中不等式约束的有效扩展，适用于真实场景中的约束优化问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GottBERT: a pure German Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained language models have significantly advanced natural language processing (NLP), especially with the introduction of BERT and its optimized version, RoBERTa. While initial research focused on English, single-language models can be advantageous compared to multilingual ones in terms of pre-training effort, overall resource efficiency or downstream task performance. Despite the growing popularity of prompt-based LLMs, more compute-efficient BERT-like models remain highly relevant. In this work, we present the first German single-language RoBERTa model, GottBERT, pre-trained exclusively on the German portion of the OSCAR dataset. Additionally, we investigated the impact of filtering the OSCAR corpus. GottBERT was pre-trained using fairseq and standard hyperparameters. We evaluated its performance on two Named Entity Recognition (NER) tasks (Conll 2003 and GermEval 2014) and three text classification tasks (GermEval 2018 fine and coarse, and 10kGNAD) against existing German BERT models and two multilingual models. Performance was measured using the $F_{1}$ score and accuracy. The GottBERT base and large models showed competitive performance, with GottBERT leading among the base models in 4 of 6 tasks. Contrary to our expectation, the applied filtering did not significantly affect the results. To support the German NLP research community, we are releasing the GottBERT models under the MIT license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了第一个纯德语单语言RoBERTa模型GottBERT，在OSCAR数据集的德语部分预训练，使用fairseq和标准超参数。在Conll 2003、GermEval 2014等NER任务和GermEval 2018、10kGNAD等文本分类任务上评估，与现有德语BERT模型和多语言模型对比，GottBERT在基础模型中4/6任务领先。研究表明，对OSCAR语料库的过滤对结果影响不大。模型以MIT许可证发布。
Motivation: 尽管多语言预训练模型广泛使用，单语言模型在资源效率和下游任务性能上可能更具优势。德语领域尚无公开的单语言RoBERTa模型，亟需填补这一空白。
Method: 基于RoBERTa架构，使用fairseq在OSCAR德语子集上预训练GottBERT。探索了语料库过滤（清洗）的影响，采用标准超参数设置。
Result: GottBERT base和large模型在6个任务中表现有竞争力，base模型在4/6任务上领先其他德语BERT模型。过滤操作对性能影响不显著。
Conclusion: GottBERT是首个公开的德语单语言RoBERTa模型，为德语NLP社区提供了一种高效的选择。过滤OSCAR语料库的收益有限，未来可探索其他数据清洗方法。

papers.title: Semantic Retrieval for Product Search in E-Commerce
papers.abstract_en: Semantic retrieval in e-commerce must handle short, noisy, and colloquial queries over large product catalogs with fine-grained attribute distinctions. We present a Siamese LLM dual-encoder trained through a two-stage pipeline: contrastive learning with a false-negative margin mask to prevent penalization of near-duplicate products, followed by Relative Odds Alignment for Retrieval (ROAR), a preference optimization objective that extends Bradley-Terry to variable-sized graded relevance groups via consecutive odds-ratio margins. The training corpus mirrors this progression - substitute query-product pairs provide coarse semantic supervision in Stage 1 and graded relevance annotations drive fine-grained ranking in Stage 2. The resulting system accurately retrieves exact matches while correctly ordering substitutes and complementary products, with gains confirmed across query-frequency strata and business verticals, and statistical significance validated through live A/B deployment at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向电商搜索的语义检索系统，使用孪生LLM双编码器（Siamese LLM dual-encoder），通过两阶段训练：阶段1用带有假阴性边缘掩码（false-negative margin mask）的对比学习，阶段2用相对优势对齐检索（ROAR）偏好优化，从而处理短、噪声、口语化查询并区分细粒度属性。实验表明系统能准确检索精确匹配并正确排序替代品和互补品，在多查询频率层和业务领域均有提升，并通过大规模A/B测试验证了统计显著性。
Motivation: 电商搜索中查询短、嘈杂、口语化，且产品目录庞大、属性区分细粒度，现有语义检索模型难以同时处理准确匹配和排序相关性。
Method: 提出一个两阶段训练流程的孪生LLM双编码器：阶段1使用对比学习并引入假阴性边缘掩码以避免惩罚近重复产品；阶段2采用相对优势对齐检索（ROAR），通过连续优势比边缘将Bradley-Terry模型扩展到可变大小的分级相关组。
Result: 摘要报告该系统在精确匹配检索和替代品/互补品排序上均取得提升，增益跨越不同查询频率层和业务垂直领域，且通过大规模A/B部署验证了统计显著性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过两阶段训练（对比学习+ROAR偏好优化）能够使语义检索系统同时处理精确匹配和细粒度相关性排序，且方法在实际电商环境中有效。

papers.title: On the Limits of Token Reduction for Efficient Unified Vision Language Training
papers.abstract_en: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual understanding and visual generation within a single autoregressive backbone, but their joint training is computationally expensive and largely overlooked from an efficiency perspective. In this work, we study the feasibility and limits of token-reduction-based acceleration for unified VLM training. Through a systematic analysis of layerwise attention allocation, we uncover a fundamental asymmetry: visual understanding exhibits substantial late-layer visual redundancy, whereas visual generation maintains persistent dependence on image tokens across depth. Guided by this observation, we design task-specific accelerators that selectively reduce image-token computation for each objective. While these methods achieve significant efficiency gains in isolated settings, we observe a consistent synergy loss under unified training -- task-specific token dropping necessitates divergent parameter pathways and eliminates the mutual performance gains typically observed in joint optimization. Our findings suggest that efficient unified modeling requires preserving shared cross-task structures, highlighting the need for synergy-aware acceleration strategies. Project page: https://chicychen.github.io/TokenReductionUnifiedVLM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通过令牌减少（token reduction）加速统一视觉语言模型（VLM）训练的可行性和限制。通过逐层注意力分配的系统分析，发现视觉理解在深层存在冗余，而视觉生成则持续依赖图像令牌。基于此设计任务特定的加速器，但统一训练时存在协同损失，表明需要考虑协同感知的加速策略。
Motivation: 统一视觉语言模型（VLM）联合训练计算开销大，但效率提升问题被忽视。本文旨在探索令牌减少方法在统一VLM训练中的可行性和局限性。
Method: 对统一VLM训练中的层注意力分配进行系统分析，揭示视觉理解与视觉生成对图像令牌依赖的差异，并据此设计任务特定的令牌减少加速器。
Result: 任务特定的令牌减少在隔离设置下取得显著效率提升，但在统一训练中导致协同损失——不同任务的令牌丢弃迫使参数路径发散，消除联合优化中的相互性能增益。
Conclusion: 高效统一建模需要保留共享的跨任务结构，强调需要设计协同感知的加速策略。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Move the Query, Not the Cache: Characterizing Cross-Instance Latent Attention Redistribution Across GPU Fabrics
papers.abstract_en: Frontier LLMs increasingly decide what a query attends to with a sparse-attention indexer that picks a few KV-cache blocks per query: attention's unit is now a small, reusable chunk. Agentic workloads hammer it: many sub-agents query one large codebase, reusing the same blocks. When that corpus outgrows one GPU it is partitioned across instances, so a query and the blocks it selects often sit on different GPUs: answering it means attention across instances. The reflex of prior cross-instance KV systems is to move the cache: pull the selected blocks to the requester. Multi-head Latent Attention inverts the arithmetic, compressing each token's key and value into one narrow vector, so a routed query row is only ~1 KB, smaller than the chunk it attends; routing the query is then often cheaper than moving the cache. Which primitive wins, over which fabric and request shape, is uncharted, least of all on device-initiated RDMA that makes per-request cross-node transfers cheap. We characterize cross-instance MLA attention on a real multi-node H100 cluster, distilling two reusable artifacts: a topology-aware cost model (probe / transfer / compute / return / merge) and a closed-form route/fetch/local predicate, whose constants we measure on real IBGDA, where the model tracks batched round-trips to within ~7%. At decode it routes the query, trading the cost of moving the cache (a ~3 ms re-adaptation splice for a contiguous chunk, or a scattered gather under selection) for a tens-of-microsecond round trip, and picks the fabric by probe latency, not peak bandwidth. We instantiate the cost model and predicate for MLA, but neither is MLA-specific: they apply wherever compression or sparse selection shrinks attention to small chunks (DeepSeek-V3.2, V4, and GLM-5.1 today). Extending them to a new architecture requires measuring just two coefficients: the routed payload and fetch's move-the-cache cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型跨 GPU 实例的注意力计算优化问题，提出通过路由查询（move the query）而非移动 KV-cache 来降低延迟。在多头潜在注意力（MLA）架构下，查询向量仅约1KB，比其关注的缓存块更小，因此路由查询更经济。作者在真实多节点 H100 集群上测量，建立拓扑感知的成本模型和决策谓词，实验显示路由查询可将延迟从约3毫秒降低到数十微秒，模型对批处理往返时间的预测误差约7%。
Motivation: 当大型代码库超出单个 GPU 容量时，查询与所选 KV-cache 块位于不同实例，传统方法移动缓存开销大（约3毫秒）；而多头潜在注意力将 token 压缩成窄向量，使路由查询成为更优选择，但此前缺乏跨实例场景下的系统表征。
Method: 提出路由/获取/本地的决策谓词，通过测量路由负载和移动缓存成本两个常数来选择最优策略；在设备发起 RDMA（IBGDA）上建立包含探测、传输、计算、返回、合并阶段的成本模型，并在真实 H100 集群上标定模型参数。
Result: 成本模型对批处理往返时间预测误差约7%；在解码阶段，路由查询将移动缓存（连续块约3ms，分散收集更高）的成本降低到数十微秒的往返时间；决策时依据探测延迟而非峰值带宽选择网络结构。
Conclusion: 该方法适用于任何通过压缩或稀疏选择将注意力缩小到小块的结构（如 DeepSeek-V3.2、V4、GLM-5.1），扩展新架构只需测量路由负载和移动缓存成本两个系数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TimeSage-MT: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating Agentic Time Series Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Time series data inform critical decisions across many real-world domains. While large language model (LLM) agents can analyze data through natural language and tools, it remains unclear whether they can conduct reliable time series analysis across multi-turn conversations. Existing benchmarks focus on single-step tasks such as forecasting and anomaly detection, overlooking practical workflows where user goals evolve, agents must build on prior analyses, and conclusions emerge from accumulated evidence. In this work, we introduce TimeSage-MT, a multi-turn benchmark for agentic time series reasoning with 240 tasks and 2,680 dialogue turns across 8 real-world domains, spanning basic exploration to decision-oriented analysis. TimeSage-MT is built through a reproducible pipeline that converts real-world time series data into multi-turn conversations with verifiable answers. It provides a unified evaluation protocol and public leaderboard for comparing time series agentic systems. To demonstrate the benchmark's utility, we evaluate frontier LLMs alongside TimeSage, a novel structured agent equipped with a comprehensive time series skill library. The results show sharp performance drops on decision-oriented tasks, driven by failures in memory, uncertainty handling, and domain-based decision making. TimeSage-MT exposes critical gaps in current agentic reasoning and provides a rigorous foundation for future development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeSage-MT 是一个多轮对话基准，用于评估时间序列智能体推理能力。它包含 240 个任务和 2680 轮对话，覆盖 8 个真实领域，从基础探索到决策导向分析。通过可复现的流水线将真实时间序列数据转化为多轮对话，并提供统一评估协议。实验表明，前沿 LLM 在决策任务上性能显著下降，主要由于记忆、不确定性处理和领域决策能力不足。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基准只关注单步任务（如预测、异常检测），忽略了实际多轮对话中用户目标演化、智能体需基于先前分析累积证据的需求。
Method: 构建可复现的流水线，将真实时间序列数据转换为包含可验证答案的多轮对话，并设计统一评估协议和公开排行榜。同时提出 TimeSage 结构化智能体，配备综合时间序列技能库。
Result: 前沿 LLM 在决策导向任务上性能大幅下降，主要失败模式包括记忆缺陷、不确定性处理不足和领域决策能力薄弱。
Conclusion: TimeSage-MT 揭示了当前智能体推理的关键缺口，为未来发展提供了严格基准。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer -- A Parameter-Efficient Architecture with Learned Stability
papers.abstract_en: We present CART (Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer), a parameter-efficient language model that reuses a single shared core block R times across depth. Unlike prior looped transformers that recompute key-value tensors at every iteration, CART computes K and V once from a multi-layer prelude and has the recurrent core cross-attend to those frozen tensors via multi-head latent attention. A learned Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) gate keeps the recurrence stable: its spectral radius settles in a narrow band (rho in [0.79, 0.83]) across all 36 fully-trained configurations. We evaluate CART on single consumer GPUs in two stages: a 64-configuration screen at 3,000 steps, then 36 configurations (P=6, R in {6,8,10}, three seeds) trained for 30,500 steps (~1B tokens). Two patterns hold across widths d in {256,512,768,1024}: prelude depth P dominates loop count R, and the Stage-1 ranking of R reverses at full training (R=6 becomes best at d>=512). At the binding d=1024 parameter-parity test, CART does not beat a parameter-matched dense baseline, losing by 1-2% at stored-parameter parity and by ~10% at effective-parameter parity. Diagnostic ablations split the effective-parameter gap into ~5% from weight sharing and a residual ~5% from the heterogeneous prelude/anchor/core/coda framing; the recurrent-core machinery (hyper-connections, LTI gate, loop-index embedding) is individually vestigial. Variable-R inference degrades on both sides of the trained R, a negative result for test-time depth scaling under this recipe.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures. Code, training scripts, and the full experiment database (results.db) are available at https://github.com/ccapps42/CART
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CART，一种参数高效的语言模型，通过共享单个核心块实现深度循环，并采用学习到的线性时不变门控保持稳定性。在1024宽度参数平等测试中，CART未能超越参数匹配的密集基线，存储参数平等下差1-2%，有效参数平等下差约10%。消融实验表明性能差距主要来自权重共享和异质架构，循环核心的各个组件贡献微弱，且测试时深度缩放效果为负。
Motivation: 现有循环Transformer在每次迭代中重新计算KV张量，效率较低，且缺乏参数高效的稳定循环机制。CART旨在通过单次计算冻结的KV张量和循环核心的交叉注意力来提升参数效率，同时利用学习到的线性时不变门控维持稳定性。
Method: CART从多层前奏（prelude）中一次性计算键值张量K和V，然后循环核心通过多头潜在注意力交叉关注这些冻结张量。循环中引入学习到的线性时不变（LTI）门控，其谱半径稳定在[0.79,0.83]窄带内，以保证训练的稳定性。
Result: 在64种配置的屏选实验和36种配置的全训练实验中，前奏深度P主导循环次数R；在1024宽度参数平等测试中，CART不如参数匹配的密集基线：存储参数平等下损失1-2%，有效参数平等下损失约10%。消融分析表明，有效参数差距中约5%来自权重共享，剩余约5%来自异质的前奏/锚/核心/尾声框架，而核心循环组件（超连接、LTI门、循环索引嵌入）单独贡献微弱。可变R的推理实验显示，在训练R两侧均出现退化，表明测试时深度缩放效果为负。
Conclusion: 当前CART配方未能超越参数匹配的密集基线，循环核心的关键组件（LTI门、超连接等）单独效果微弱，且测试时深度缩放失败。作者强调需要进一步改进循环设计以提升参数利用率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ClawHub Security Signals: When VirusTotal, Static Analysis, and SkillSpector Disagree
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills extend AI agents with reusable instructions, tools, scripts, references, and workflows, establishing a security boundary distinct from both model safety and traditional package-malware detection. ClawHub Security Signals is a sanitized dataset of 67,453 latest public OpenClaw skill versions. Each row pairs redacted SKILL.md content and sanitized bundled files where present with a final ClawScan registry verdict and evidence from three scanner families: VirusTotal, static heuristic analysis, and NVIDIA SkillSpector. Rather than estimating malicious-skill prevalence, we study scanner disagreement. The three scanners rarely flag the same skills: any pair overlaps on at most 10.4% of their combined positives, only 0.69% of skills are flagged by all three, and 81.9% of flagged skills are identified by a single scanner. The disagreement is structured by attack surface. SkillSpector, which raises semantic agentic-risk advisories rather than malware-reputation signals, is positive for 19,209 of 25,504 suspicious rows (75.3%) but only 14 of 206 malicious rows (6.8%). The malicious-verdict region shows the inverse profile: 150 of 206 malicious rows (72.8%) are VirusTotal-positive, consistent with bundled-code malware evidence. These results show that agent-skill security requires layered governance, not single-scanner allow/block decisions. The corpus is released as a sanitized silver-standard dataset: labels are the registry's automated verdicts, not human-annotated ground truth, and the release represents an early, versioned snapshot intended to support the community while a human-annotated subset is developed. Further research is encouraged, including models tailored for skill-security triage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布了ClawHub Security Signals数据集，包含67,453个OpenClaw技能版本，每个技能有三个扫描器（VirusTotal、静态启发式分析、NVIDIA SkillSpector）的检测结果。研究发现三个扫描器很少同时标记同一技能，81.9%的被标记技能仅被单一扫描器识别，且不同扫描器对恶意和可疑技能的检测模式差异显著。结果表明代理技能安全需要分层治理，而非依赖单个扫描器的放行/阻断决策。
Motivation: 代理技能（agent skills）引入与模型安全和传统包恶意软件检测不同的安全边界，但现有扫描器之间的分歧尚未被系统研究。理解扫描器分歧的结构对于设计有效的多层安全治理至关重要。
Method: 构建了ClawHub Security Signals数据集，包含67,453个技能版本，每个版本关联三个扫描器的检测结果：VirusTotal（恶意软件声誉）、静态启发式分析、NVIDIA SkillSpector（语义代理风险建议）。分析扫描器之间的一致性及分歧模式。
Result: 三个扫描器成对重叠阳性样本最多10.4%，仅0.69%的技能被所有三个扫描器标记；81.9%的被标记技能仅被单一扫描器识别。SkillSpector在可疑行中阳性率高（75.3%），但在恶意行中阳性率低（6.8%）；VirusTotal在恶意行中阳性率高（72.8%）。
Conclusion: 代理技能安全需要分层治理，结合不同扫描器的优势，而非依赖单一扫描器。数据集作为银标准发布，后续将开发人工标注子集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Splatshot: 3D Face Avatar Generation from a Single Unconstrained Photo
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing a photorealistic 3D face avatar from a single unconstrained photograph is challenging: feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models degrade on out-of-distribution inputs, while pretrained diffusion models produce high-fidelity images but lack multi-view consistency. We observe that these paradigms are fundamentally complementary: explicit 3D representations guarantee geometric consistency, whereas 2D diffusion priors ensure photorealism. Building on this, we propose SplatShot, a training-free framework that couples these representations directly within the denoising process. Given a base 3DGS face model and a single reference image, we jointly denoise all target views using a per-step 3D feedback loop. At each timestep, we predict clean images from the noisy latents, refit the 3DGS to these multi-view predictions, and back-propagate the photometric discrepancy between the 3DGS re-renderings and 2D predictions into the noise estimate. This steers the sampling trajectory toward strictly 3D-coherent, identity-faithful outputs. Experiments on diverse in-the-wild images demonstrate that SplatShot produces 3D avatars with superior identity preservation, photorealism, and multi-view consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SplatShot，一种无需训练的框架，将三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）与二维扩散先验结合，从单张无约束照片生成3D人脸头像。方法在去噪过程中引入3D反馈循环，确保多视图一致性和逼真度。实验表明该方法在身份保持、照片真实感和多视图一致性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 从单张无约束照片重建逼真3D人脸头像具有挑战性：前馈3DGS在分布外输入上表现下降，而扩散模型虽生成高保真图像但缺乏多视图一致性。
Method: 提出SplatShot，一种无需训练的框架，在去噪过程中直接耦合3DGS和扩散模型。每个时间步，从噪声潜变量预测干净图像，用这些多视图预测重新拟合3DGS，并将3DGS重渲染与2D预测之间的光度差异反向传播到噪声估计中，引导采样走向严格3D一致且身份忠实的输出。
Result: 在多种非约束自然图像上的实验表明，SplatShot生成的人脸头像在身份保持、照片真实感和多视图一致性上表现优越。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将显式3D表示与2D扩散先验直接耦合可在无需训练的情况下实现高质量3D人脸头像生成。

summary_sections.motivation: 从单张无约束照片重建逼真3D人脸头像具有挑战性：前馈3DGS在分布外输入上表现下降，而扩散模型虽生成高保真图像但缺乏多视图一致性。
summary_sections.method: 提出SplatShot，一种无需训练的框架，在去噪过程中直接耦合3DGS和扩散模型。每个时间步，从噪声潜变量预测干净图像，用这些多视图预测重新拟合3DGS，并将3DGS重渲染与2D预测之间的光度差异反向传播到噪声估计中，引导采样走向严格3D一致且身份忠实的输出。
summary_sections.result: 在多种非约束自然图像上的实验表明，SplatShot生成的人脸头像在身份保持、照片真实感和多视图一致性上表现优越。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将显式3D表示与2D扩散先验直接耦合可在无需训练的情况下实现高质量3D人脸头像生成。

papers.title: LLM Consortium for Software Design Refinement: A Controlled Experiment on Multi-Agent Collaboration Topologies
papers.abstract_en: We present a controlled experiment evaluating 12 multi-agent LLM collaboration topologies for software architecture design. Using a $2\times2\times2$ factorial design (Authority $\times$ Roles $\times$ Dynamics), we conducted 520 experimental runs across 8 design tasks of varying complexity, with 5 repetitions each. Designs were evaluated on a 12-dimensional rubric by three independent automated evaluators (GPT-OSS 120B, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6). We report four core findings. First, structural adversarial (v4b) ranks #1 by ensemble -- a prompt-engineered adversarial variant that demands rewrite mandates rather than patches (weighted ensemble: 4.637/5.0). Second, cross-model review wins unanimously at #2 -- generate with one model, review with another -- ranking #2 by all three evaluators (weighted ensemble: 4.606). Third, evaluator diversity is itself a finding -- all three evaluators agree v4b is best and v3 is worst, but disagree sharply on v2b (Claude d=1.44 vs. GPT-OSS d=0.45), revealing how different model families weight design qualities. Fourth, parallel merge is fundamentally broken -- all three evaluators place merge variants in the bottom tier (3.65-3.79), due to token starvation and the Frankenstein effect. The weighted ensemble ($2\times$Opus + $2\times$Sonnet + $1\times$GPT-OSS) provides robust rankings across 520 runs, confirmed through independent cross-validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验评估了12种多智能体LLM协作拓扑在软件架构设计中的性能。采用2×2×2因子设计（权威性×角色×动态性），在8个不同复杂度的设计任务上进行了520次实验运行，每次重复5次。设计质量由三个独立自动评估器（GPT-OSS 120B, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6）按照12维评价标准评分。主要发现：结构对抗变体v4b排名第一（加权集成得分4.637/5.0）；跨模型审查（一个模型生成，另一个模型审查）排名第二（4.606）；评估器多样性导致对某些变体的评分分歧；并行合并因token饥饿和弗兰肯斯坦效应而失效。加权集成（2×Opus + 2×Sonnet + 1×GPT-OSS）提供了稳健排名。
Motivation: 软件架构设计中，多智能体LLM协作的拓扑结构对设计质量的影响尚缺乏系统性的受控实验评估。现有研究多关注单一模型或简单协作，缺乏对权威性、角色和动态性等因素的组合探究。
Method: 采用2×2×2因子设计（权威性×角色×动态性），定义12种协作拓扑变体。在8个设计任务上各进行5次重复，共520次实验。每个设计由三个独立自动评估器（GPT-OSS 120B, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6）按照12维客观评价标准进行评分，并通过加权集成（2×Opus + 2×Sonnet + 1×GPT-OSS）生成最终排名。
Result: 摘要报告四项核心发现：（1）结构对抗变体v4b（要求重写而非修补的对抗性提示工程变体）以加权集成4.637/5.0排名第一；（2）跨模型审查（生成模型与审查模型不同）以4.606排名第二，获得所有三个评估器一致认可；（3）评估器多样性导致对v2b变体的评分分歧（Claude d=1.44 vs. GPT-OSS d=0.45），揭示了不同模型家族对设计质量的权重差异；（4）并行合并变体因token饥饿和弗兰肯斯坦效应全部落入最低档次（3.65-3.79）。独立交叉验证确认了加权集成的稳健性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，结构对抗性协作拓扑和跨模型审查在软件架构设计中的有效性，同时指出并行合并的局限性。评估器多样性本身是一个重要发现，不同LLM评估器的偏好差异需在自动化评估中予以考虑。加权集成方法可在多评估器场景中提供稳健排名。

papers.title: Perception First: A Frontier Native-Video Model with Self-Consistency for Implicit Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: We describe our submission to the VRR Challenge @ CVPR 2026, built on the \emph{ImplicitQA} / \emph{VRR-QA} benchmark~\cite{implicitqa}: multiple-choice video question answering in which answers are deliberately \emph{not} observable in any single frame and must be inferred from spatial layout, motion, depth, viewpoint, causality, and social context across discontinuous frames of creative video. We conduct a systematic, training-free study spanning open-source Video-LMMs (Qwen2.5-VL~\cite{qwen25vl}, Qwen3-VL~\cite{qwen3vl}, InternVL3, Gemma-3, and the RL-tuned video reasoners Video-R1~\cite{videor1} and VideoChat-R1.5~\cite{videochatr15}) and a battery of inference-time strategies (chain-of-thought, question decomposition, describe-then-reason cascades, audio transcripts, spatial state prompting, self-consistency~\cite{selfconsistency}, multi-model ensembling, and category routing). Our central finding is that this benchmark is \emph{perception-bound rather than reasoning-bound}: reasoning-side augmentations are neutral-to-harmful, whereas base-model perceptual capability and lightweight test-time denoising are the only reliable levers. A per-category error analysis localizes the difficulty to low-level perception -- relative depth, viewpoint, and counting are the hardest categories, while causal and social reasoning are nearly solved -- and a prompt that explicitly injects monocular depth cues to attack the weakest category \emph{lowers} test accuracy by $5.8$ points, confirming that the model needs a better \emph{percept}, not a better \emph{procedure}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对隐式视频问答（答案无法从单帧获取，需跨帧推断空间布局、运动、深度、视角、因果关系和社会上下文），系统性地无训练研究了多种开源视频大模型（Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL、InternVL3、Gemma-3、Video-R1等）和推理策略（思维链、问题分解、描述再推理、音频转录、空间状态提示、自一致性、多模型集成、类别路由）。核心发现是该基准是感知受限而非推理受限：推理增强效果中性甚至有害，而模型本身的感知能力和轻量级测试时去噪是唯一可靠杠杆。错误分析将困难定位到低层感知（相对深度、视角、计数最难），而因果和社会推理近乎解决；注入单目深度线索反而降低5.8个点，确认模型需要更好的感知而非更好的推理过程。
Motivation: 现有视频问答研究多关注推理能力，但隐式视频问答中答案不可直接观察，需跨帧推断，感知能力可能比推理更关键。
Method: 在VRR-QA基准上，无训练地对比多种视频大模型和推理增强策略（如思维链、问题分解、自一致性、多模型集成等），并通过类别错误分析定位困难来源。
Result: 发现该基准感知受限：推理增强无效甚至有害，感知能力和测试时去噪是唯一可靠杠杆。最困难类别是相对深度、视角和计数，因果和社会推理近乎解决；注入深度线索反而降低5.8个点，确认问题在于感知。
Conclusion: 模型需要更好的感知，而非更好的推理过程；未来应聚焦于改进底层视觉感知能力。

papers.title: MURMUR: An Efficient Inference System for Long-Form ASR
papers.abstract_en: Long-form automatic speech recognition (ASR) requires both high accuracy and low latency, but existing systems force a trade-off between the two. Chunk-based pipelines process audio in parallel windows for low latency, but lose cross-chunk context and need brittle heuristics to align speakers and timestamps at boundaries. Long-context ASR models resolve everything in a single pass for better accuracy, but are an order of magnitude slower. We propose Murmur, an inference system that overcomes this trade-off by operating at two levels. At the inter-chunk level, we revisit the chunk-based pipeline for modern long-context ASR, treating chunk size as a tunable hyperparameter, and show that intermediate chunk sizes strike a good balance of accuracy and latency. At the intra-chunk level, we exploit attention sparsity through a sliding window KV cache eviction policy applied to both output and speech tokens. On AMI-IHM, Murmur matches single-pass accuracy while reducing latency by 4.2x, with further gains from token eviction at less than 1% relative tcpWER degradation. The code of Murmur is available at https://github.com/uw-syfi/Murmur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MURMUR是一个针对长格式语音识别（ASR）的推理系统，通过两级设计克服了准确性与延迟之间的权衡。块间层面将块大小作为可调超参数，块内层面利用注意力稀疏性采用滑动窗口KV缓存逐出策略。在AMI-IHM数据集上，MURMUR匹配了单遍模型的准确性，同时将延迟降低4.2倍，且令牌逐出带来的tcpWER退化小于1%。
Motivation: 现有长格式ASR系统在准确性和延迟之间被迫权衡：基于块的管道处理并行窗口以实现低延迟，但丢失跨块上下文并需要脆弱的启发式对齐；长上下文模型单遍处理更准确但慢一个数量级。
Method: 提出MURMUR系统，在两级操作：块间层面，重新审视基于块的管道，将块大小作为可调超参数；块内层面，通过滑动窗口KV缓存逐出策略利用注意力稀疏性，同时应用于输出和语音令牌。
Result: 在AMI-IHM数据集上，MURMUR匹配单遍ASR的准确性，同时延迟降低4.2倍；令牌逐出进一步降低延迟，且相对tcpWER退化小于1%。
Conclusion: MURMUR通过两级设计有效平衡了长格式ASR的准确性和延迟，且代码开源。

papers.title: SafeGen-Bench: Benchmarking Safety in Image-Conditioned Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancements in text-to-image diffusion models, generative video models (T2V models) like Sora can now produce short synthetic videos from a text prompt or an initial image. However, synthetic video generation -- especially when guided by an initial image -- often poses risks, including the potential creation of illegal, politically sensitive, or unethical content. Existing benchmarks have started to consider the safety of generated videos, but they primarily focus on testing models with malicious text prompts, ignoring the scenario where text prompt and image combination may still lead to harmful video content. In practice, this is a common and challenging issue: videos generated from safe text and image inputs can nonetheless convey harmful information. To bridge this gap, we introduce SafeGen-Bench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the safety of conditional T2V models. Our benchmark defines 10 malicious categories, concentrating on risks related to both temporal sequences and depicted behaviors. SafeGen-Bench consists of carefully selected start frames from diverse image and video sources, paired with corresponding text prompts to simulate realistic inputs. We evaluate a variety of conditional T2V models on SafeGen-Bench, and the results indicate that current models struggle to consistently avoid generating malicious content with unsafety scores reaching up to 44.5, especially under conditions requiring high quality. Furthermore, we assess the effectiveness of both text-based and image-based guardrails on our benchmark, finding that unimodal guardrails alone were insufficient to provide a robust defense, with an 80\% failure rate across seven malicious categories. We hope that SafeGen-Bench will foster the development of safer and more controllable conditional T2V models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeGen-Bench 是一个专门评估图像条件文本到视频生成模型安全性的基准。该基准定义了10个恶意类别，关注时序和行为相关的风险，并通过精心选择的起始帧和相应文本提示模拟真实输入。评估了多种条件T2V模型，结果显示当前模型难以一致避免生成恶意内容，不安全分数高达44.5，且单模态防护栏在七个恶意类别上失败率高达80%。
Motivation: 现有T2V安全基准主要关注恶意文本提示，忽略了文本和图像组合仍可能产生有害视频的常见场景。
Method: 构建包含10个恶意类别的基准，从多种图像和视频源中精选起始帧，配对相应文本提示，并评估多种条件T2V模型及文本/图像防护栏。
Result: 当前模型不安全分数高达44.5，单模态防护栏在七类恶意内容上80%失效。
Conclusion: 需要更鲁棒的多模态安全机制，SafeGen-Bench旨在促进更安全可控的条件T2V模型开发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
papers.abstract_en: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.

papers.title: OmniOPD: Logit-Free On-Policy Distillation via Speculative Verification
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own generative trajectories under dense token-level feedback from a stronger teacher, mitigating both the off-policy distribution shift of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and the sparse credit assignment of Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, standard OPD faces two coupled limitations. First, it requires direct access to the teacher's token-level logits, excluding a broad class of capable proprietary models from serving as teachers. Second, the token-level logit signal itself is brittle, depending on a narrow overlap of plausible next tokens between teacher and student, and prone to amplifying degenerate patterns such as repetition loops. In this paper, we introduce OmniOPD, a novel framework that addresses both limitations through a logit-free, chunk-level supervision signal. OmniOPD replaces deterministic logit matching with Monte Carlo rollouts that approximate the teacher's local preferences through a continuous semantic similarity metric over multi-token chunks, and concentrates this supervision via a peak-entropy scheduler that audits the student only at its high-uncertainty reasoning forks. A Dirichlet-Multinomial Bayesian prior and a base-model KL anchor further bound the variance of discrete sampling and prevent policy collapse across unaudited tokens. Across competitive benchmarks, OmniOPD surpasses the standard OPD approach by up to +28.64% on math, confirming that chunk-level semantic verification extracts a more reliable learning signal than token-level logit matching, whose high information density is offset by significant noise and brittleness. Furthermore, when paired with stronger black-box teachers such as Claude-4.5-Haiku and Gemini-2.5-Flash, OmniOPD achieves an additional +9.54% relative on math over its open-weight teacher counterpart, advancing the student past the performance of self-exploratory RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniOPD框架，通过投机验证实现无需logit的在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation）。该方法用蒙特卡洛rollout替代确定性logit匹配，通过块级语义相似度度量教师偏好，并采用峰值熵调度器仅在学生高不确定性处进行监督，解决标准OPD对教师token级logit的依赖及token级信号的脆弱性。在数学基准上，OmniOPD相比标准OPD提升+28.64%，结合黑盒教师（如Claude-4.5-Haiku）时额外提升+9.54%。
Motivation: 标准在线策略蒸馏需要直接访问教师模型的token级logits，排除了闭源模型作为教师，且token级logit信号本身脆弱，依赖于师生间窄重叠的候选token，容易放大重复模式等退化行为。
Method: OmniOPD用蒙特卡洛rollout近似教师局部偏好，通过连续语义相似度度量多token块进行监督；集中监督于高不确定性推理分叉处（峰值熵调度器）；引入Dirichlet-Multinomial贝叶斯先验和基模型KL锚定约束，防止未监督token处的策略坍塌。
Result: 在数学基准上，OmniOPD超越标准OPD方法最多+28.64%，与更强黑盒教师（如Claude-4.5-Haiku、Gemini-2.5-Flash）配对时，相比开源教师额外提升+9.54%，学生性能超越自探索强化学习。
Conclusion: 块级语义验证比token级logit匹配提供更可靠的学习信号，且无需教师logits，适用于闭源教师模型，为在线蒸馏提供了新的范式。

papers.title: A Minimalist Brain-Computer Musical Interface for Real-Time Emotion-Driven Sonification: System Design and Preliminary Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a minimalist brain-computer Musical Interface (BCMI) that functions as a real-time affective sonification system, translating prefrontal EEG activity into adaptive music. Emotional valence is estimated from frontal alpha asymmetry (AF7/AF8) and mapped to musical features such as mode, tempo, rhythmic density, and pitch register through a stochastic generative algorithm. The system integrates wireless EEG acquisition, real-time Python signal processing, and Ableton Live-based music generation synchronized via Lab Streaming Layer. An experiment with 22 participants investigated whether intentional emotional self-induction could modulate the BCMI neurofeedback signal. Linear mixed-effects analyses found no significant effects of target emotion or time, indicating that the frontal alpha asymmetry signal did not reliably distinguish instructed emotional states. Individual differences, including musical training and acting experience, explained more variance than the experimental manipulation, which accounted for only 0.40\% of total signal variance. These findings highlight the challenges of using frontal alpha asymmetry as a voluntary control signal for closed-loop emotion regulation and suggest methodological directions for future BCMI research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个极简脑机音乐接口(BCMI)，通过前额脑电alpha不对称性(AF7/AF8)实时估计情绪效价，并映射为音乐模式、速度、节奏密度和音高寄存器等特征。22人实验表明，有意情绪自我诱导未能显著调制神经反馈信号，个体差异解释方差远大于实验操纵。
Motivation: 现有BCMI系统复杂且依赖用户训练，本文探索能否用最简配置实现实时情绪驱动音乐生成，并验证前额alpha不对称性作为闭环情绪调节控制信号的可行性。
Method: 集成无线EEG采集、Python实时信号处理和Ableton Live音乐生成，通过线性混合效应模型分析情绪诱导对alpha不对称性的影响。
Result: 线性混合效应分析显示目标情绪或时间主效应不显著，前额alpha不对称性不能可靠区分诱导情绪状态；实验操纵仅解释0.40%信号方差。
Conclusion: 前额alpha不对称性作为自主控制信号存在挑战，未来BCMI研究需关注个体差异并优化信号特征设计。

papers.title: Hierarchical Online Prompt Mutation with Dual-Loop Feedback for Guardrailed Evidence Document Generation: A Production-Evaluation Case Study
papers.abstract_en: High-stakes production document-generation systems require language models to be adaptive, evidence-grounded, and auditable. We present HOPM, a hierarchical online prompt mutation framework evaluated on a real marketplace dispute-evidence workflow. HOPM treats prompts as online policies: a family/version router selects a prompt, deterministic guardrails attribute failures to mutable prompt-token categories, and dual feedback from human review and an automated judge updates both routing and mutation priorities. The primary evidence is an observed matched production-evaluation ablation: seven variants are evaluated on the same 600 cases each, enabling component comparisons against static prompting, manual iteration, bandit-only routing, mutation-only adaptation, human-only feedback, auto-judge-only feedback, and full dual-loop HOPM. Full HOPM improves count win rate over a static control from 34.7% to 45.7% (+11.0 pp; paired McNemar p = 1.31e-11) and amount-weighted win rate from 22.3% to 41.4% (+19.1 pp; 95% paired bootstrap CI [10.3, 28.9] pp). It also increases mean Likert quality from 3.18 to 4.40 and reduces issue-flag rate from 15.3% to 5.2%. Supporting review artifacts cover 770 generated-text reviews, 318 labeled reviewer exports, a 10-case/61-rating calibration slice, and a 70-case/350-rating OCR benchmark; these artifacts calibrate rubric, guardrail, title-risk, and OCR-risk interpretation rather than substituting for the production ablation. The paper includes control setup, sample sizes, confidence intervals, paired tests, prompt-token categories, pseudocode, schema, rubric, guardrail taxonomy, and a constructed example so the evaluation structure can be reproduced without exposing proprietary evidence.
papers.comment: 7 pages. Production-evaluation case study of guardrailed LLM evidence-document generation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层次化在线提示变异（HOPM）框架，用于高可靠性证据文档生成。HOPM将提示视为在线策略，通过家族/版本路由器选择提示，确定性护栏将失败归因于可变提示令牌类别，并结合人工审核和自动裁判的双重反馈更新路由和变异优先级。在实际市场纠纷证据工作流中评估了七个变体，全HOPM将计数胜率从34.7%提升至45.7%，金额加权胜率从22.3%提升至41.4%，平均Likert质量从3.18提升至4.40，问题标记率从15.3%降至5.2%。
Motivation: 高可靠性生产环境中的文档生成系统需要语言模型具有自适应性、证据基础性和可审计性，现有方法缺乏有效的在线反馈机制。
Method: 提出HOPM框架，包含层次化选择：家族/版本路由器选择提示，确定性护栏属性失败，双重反馈（人工审核和自动裁判）分别更新路由和变异优先级。
Result: 全HOPM相对于静态控制，计数胜率提升11.0个百分点（p=1.31e-11），金额加权胜率提升19.1个百分点（95% CI [10.3, 28.9]），平均Likert质量从3.18提升至4.40，问题标记率从15.3%降至5.2%。
Conclusion: HOPM通过双循环反馈框架有效提升了证据文档生成的性能，且提供了完整的评估结构和复现支持。
