papers.title: BRo-JEPA: Learning Modular Arithmetic in Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Can neural networks learn abstract algebraic rules, or do they merely memorize training patterns? We investigate this using MNIST digits as states and modular arithmetic operations as actions in a JEPA-style latent world model. Standard supervised baselines and JEPA models with additive operation embeddings fit seen operations but fail to extrapolate reliably to unseen ones. To bridge this gap, we introduce a block-rotation predictor that imposes the circular structure of modulo-10 arithmetic in latent space. This enables strong zero-shot generalization, with the best ResNet-based JEPA block-rotation model achieving 99.46\% zero-shot and 99.46\% rollout accuracy. Our results suggest that latent world models can learn symbolic transformation rules when architecture matches the structure of the problem. Our code can be \href{https://github.com/DL-World-Models/mnist-math}{accessed here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络能否学习抽象代数规则，将MNIST数字作为状态、模10算术作为动作，在JEPA风格潜在世界模型中建模。标准模型无法泛化到未见操作，而提出的块旋转预测器（block-rotation predictor）在潜在空间中施加模算术的循环结构，实现了强零样本泛化，最佳ResNet-JEPA模型达到99.46%零样本准确率和99.46% rollout准确率。
Motivation: 现有神经网络在潜在世界模型中常仅记忆训练模式，难以学习并泛化抽象符号规则（如模算术运算），需要探索架构设计如何对齐问题结构以提升符号推理能力。
Method: 提出BRo-JEPA，在JEPA潜在世界模型中使用块旋转预测器（block-rotation predictor），通过潜在向量旋转操作显式编码模10循环群结构，以预测状态转换。
Result: 最佳ResNet基JEPA块旋转模型在未见操作上达到99.46%零样本准确率，并保持99.46% rollout准确率，远超标准监督基线和加法嵌入JEPA模型。
Conclusion: 结果表明潜在世界模型通过匹配问题结构的架构设计（如块旋转）可以学习符号变换规则，但当前仅针对模10算术，通用性需进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ActMVS: Active Scene Reconstruction with Monocular Multi-View Stereo
papers.abstract_en: Active scene reconstruction enables robots/UAVs to autonomously plan trajectories and reconstruct environments without costly manual data acquisition. Unlike passive methods, active reconstruction requires real-time construction of high-confidence occupancy maps for collision-free navigation. Existing approaches rely on depth sensors for occupancy map updates, increasing platform cost and weight. To advance spatial intelligence, we aim for a vision-only monocular solution. However, current monocular scene reconstruction methods operate offline and fail to deliver globally consistent dense depth at the frame rates required for robots/UAVs navigation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ActMVS, the first framework for monocular active reconstruction. Our framework integrates a view factor graph construction for informed Multi-View Stereo depth prediction, along with a global depth optimization, to enable the online generation of high-quality, globally consistent dense depth maps. This enables monocular robots/UAVs to maintain reliable occupancy maps for safe trajectory planning during reconstruction. Experiments on Replica datasets demonstrate performance competitive with RGB-D methods. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/TrickyGo/ActMVS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActMVS是首个支持单目主动场景重建的框架，通过视图因子图构建引导多视图立体深度预测和全局深度优化，实现在线生成高质量、全局一致的稠密深度图，使单目机器人/无人机能够可靠地维护占据地图以实现安全轨迹规划。在Replica数据集上取得了与RGB-D方法竞争的性能。
Motivation: 现有主动重建方法依赖深度传感器来更新占据地图，增加了平台成本和重量；而单目场景重建方法通常离线运行且无法提供实时所需的高质量稠密深度。
Method: 提出ActMVS框架，集成视图因子图构建用于信息性多视图立体深度预测，以及全局深度优化，从而在线生成高质量且全局一致的稠密深度图。
Result: 在Replica数据集上的实验表明，该方法的性能与RGB-D方法具有竞争力。
Conclusion: ActMVS证明了仅使用单目视觉即可实现主动重建，使得单目机器人/无人机在重建过程中能维持可靠占据地图以进行安全轨迹规划。

papers.title: Early Diagnosis of Wasted Computation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Failure-Aware Observability
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems spend computation through model tokens, tool calls, retries, and code execution before producing an answer. When a run fails, final-answer evaluation reveals the endpoint but usually not the point at which the trajectory stopped making recoverable progress. This paper introduces a failure-aware observability framework for diagnosing wasted computation in multi-agent LLM traces. The framework maps recurring failure modes to online trace signals, including tool reliability, execution recovery, orchestration loops, evidence availability, information change, and budget pressure. We instantiate the framework in a three- agent question-answering system and evaluate it on 165 GAIA validation traces under identical execution caps. Operational failures remain common: 22/53 level-1 runs, 33/86 level-2 runs, and 12/26 level-3 runs fail to produce a usable final answer. The traces expose different mechanisms behind these outcomes, including insufficient evidence, repeated-action loops, max-step termination, tool-failure streaks, and execution calls that succeed without useful output. Mean token use rises from 8,152 tokens at level 1 to 16,389 tokens at level 3, while evidence availability and sentence-level support diverge. A cached 10-trace LLM-judge grounding audit shows that cheap online signals and deeper semantic metrics capture complementary layers of failure. The results position failure-aware observability as a diagnostic layer between raw execution logs and final-answer accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个故障感知的可观测性框架，用于诊断多智能体LLM系统中的浪费计算。框架将重复失败模式映射到在线轨迹信号，包括工具可靠性、执行恢复、编排循环等。在三智能体问答系统中实例化，并在165个GAIA验证轨迹上评估，发现操作失败频繁，平均token使用随难度增加。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在产生答案前花费大量计算（tokens、工具调用等），但最终答案评估只能显示端点，无法指出轨迹中何时停止可恢复进展，需要诊断机制识别浪费计算点。
Method: 提出故障感知可观测性框架，将失败模式映射到六种在线信号：工具可靠性、执行恢复、编排循环、证据可用性、信息变化和预算压力，并在三智能体问答系统中实例化。
Result: 在165个GAIA验证轨迹上，22/53（级别1）、33/86（级别2）、12/26（级别3）运行失败；失败机制包括证据不足、重复动作循环、最大步终止等；平均token使用从8152（级别1）增至16389（级别3）；廉价在线信号与深层语义指标互补。
Conclusion: 故障感知可观测性可作为原始执行日志与最终答案准确性之间的诊断层，帮助定位浪费计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Needles at Scale: LLM-Assisted Target Selection for Windows Vulnerability Research
papers.abstract_en: The attack surface of a modern operating system is a haystack: thousands of signed binaries and millions of functions, almost none relevant to any given vulnerability. A human analyst or an LLM agent must pick the function worth reading before analyzing it. At whole-OS scope, this target selection, not the analysis, is the binding constraint. We present Symbolicate-Enrich-Sample, a low-cost batch pipeline that turns a corpus of production Windows binaries into a queryable, priority-ranked research queue. We (i) recover function-level symbols for stripped vendor binaries by auto-fetching the public symbol files and joining them to a recovered call graph; (ii) attach cheap, deterministic structural features to each named function and, conditioned on those features, use a low-cost language model to assign a reachability tier, a risk level, a bug-class hypothesis, and a rationale; and (iii) draw diverse, prioritized batches via a priority-weighted importance sampler. The contribution is a selection substrate: the prioritization layer a downstream detector or LLM agent runs on top of. Across a whole Windows image of 7,231,419 functions, the labels are markedly selective, and stacking deterministic filters on them leaves a ~22K-function shortlist: the candidate needles, few enough for a human or agent to work through. We characterize the pipeline's selectivity and its failure modes, describe the methodology, and report aggregate statistics; we withhold the derived dataset for legal and dual-use reasons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个低成本的批处理管道Symbolicate-Enrich-Sample，用于从Windows生产二进制文件中生成可查询、优先级排序的研究队列，帮助分析师或LLM代理选择值得阅读的函数。管道包括恢复函数级符号、附加结构特征并使用低成本语言模型分配可达性层级、风险等级、错误类假设和理由，并通过优先级加权重要性采样器抽取多样化批次。在包含7,231,419个函数的完整Windows映像上，标签具有显著选择性，经过确定性过滤后留下约22K个函数候选。
Motivation: 现代操作系统的攻击面如同大海捞针，数百万个函数中几乎与任何漏洞无关。在操作系统规模上，目标选择（而非分析）是限制性约束。现有方法缺乏低成本、可扩展的优先级排序机制。
Method: 提出Symbolicate-Enrich-Sample管道：1) 通过自动获取公共符号文件并连接恢复的调用图来恢复剥离的供应商二进制文件的函数级符号；2) 为每个命名函数附加廉价的结构特征，并基于这些特征使用低成本语言模型分配可达性层级、风险等级、错误类假设和理由；3) 通过优先级加权重要性采样器抽取多样化、优先级排序的批次。
Result: 在包含7,231,419个函数的完整Windows映像上，标签具有显著选择性，确定性过滤器留下约22K个函数候选列表，足够人工或代理处理。论文报告了管道的选择性、失败模式，并描述方法论和汇总统计。
Conclusion: 论文贡献在于提供了一个选择基质，下游检测器或LLM代理可在此优先级层上运行。由于法律和双重用途原因，未公开派生数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: All Models are Wrong, Knowing Where is Useful: On Model Uncertainty in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) infers information about the environment from a learned dynamics model and bears the potential to address open problems such as data efficient and safe learning in robotics. However, inaccuracies of the learned dynamics model are typically exploited by the agent, substantially hampering the capabilities of MBRL methods. We present a framework for dealing with inaccuracies of probabilistic models through targeted handling of uncertainty that effectively mitigates model exploitation. We present recent successes in learning directly on hardware and safe exploration, and discuss future directions for uncertainty-aware MBRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个处理基于模型的强化学习中概率模型不准确性的框架，通过针对性处理不确定性来缓解模型利用问题，并总结了在硬件上直接学习和安全探索方面的近期成功及其未来方向。
Motivation: 基于模型的强化学习方法中，学习到的动力学模型的不准确性通常会被智能体利用，严重阻碍了MBRL方法的能力。
Method: 提出一个处理概率模型不准确性的框架，通过针对性处理不确定性来有效缓解模型利用。
Result: 在硬件上直接学习和安全探索方面取得了近期成功。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知的MBRL方法有潜力解决数据高效和安全的机器人学习问题，并讨论了未来方向。

papers.title: AlbedoEdit: Unified Instance-Level Video Editing with Albedo Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Video generative models have achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing photorealistic video sequences. However, enabling broader and more creative downstream applications requires fine-grained instance-level video editing, including object insertion, object removal, and texture editing, which has emerged as a prominent yet challenging problem. Existing approaches either propose unified generative frameworks with only coarse semantic control, or design task-specific frameworks for individual editing tasks, limiting their flexibility and applicability across diverse real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose AlbedoEdit, a unified generative video editing framework that jointly supports object insertion, object removal, and texture editing. Our key insight is that the intrinsic albedo map, which is invariant to lighting and contains no specularity, shadowing and inter-reflection effects, provides an effective and user-friendly mechanism for specifying fine-grained appearance edits. Built upon video foundation models, AlbedoEdit is fine-tuned to translate source RGB videos into edited RGB videos, conditioned on a user-edited first-frame albedo. Trained on a new paired synthetic dataset covering all three editing tasks, AlbedoEdit implicitly learns to harmonize edited contents and simulate complex real-world visual effects triggered by editing operations, including specular highlights, soft shadows, and mirror reflections. AlbedoEdit demonstrates superior performance over state-of-the-art video editing approaches, both qualitatively and quantitatively. Project webpage is https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/AlbedoEdit/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AlbedoEdit，一个统一的实例级视频编辑框架，支持对象插入、对象移除和纹理编辑。核心创新是利用反照率图（albedo map）的光照不变性，通过用户编辑首帧反照率图作为条件，基于视频基础模型微调生成编辑后的视频。在合成数据集上训练后，能模拟高光、软阴影和镜像反射等复杂视觉效果，定量和定性均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法要么只提供粗粒度语义控制，要么为每个编辑任务设计独立框架，缺乏灵活性和通用性，难以应对多样化现实场景。
Method: 提出 AlbedoEdit 统一框架，基于视频基础模型，以用户编辑的首帧反照率图为条件，通过微调将源 RGB 视频映射为目标编辑后的 RGB 视频。反照率图不受光照影响，能有效指定细粒度外观编辑。
Result: 在对象插入、移除和纹理编辑任务上，AlbedoEdit 在合成数据集上训练后，定量和定性均优于现有最先进方法，并能模拟高光、软阴影和镜像反射等效果。
Conclusion: AlbedoEdit 利用反照率引导实现了统一的实例级视频编辑，但依赖合成数据训练，在真实场景下的泛化能力需进一步验证。

papers.title: Diamonds in the Sky: Pareidolic Animals in Clouds
papers.abstract_en: People often see animal shapes in clouds, a phenomenon known as pareidolia. We propose an AI-based method that aims to predict which animals people are likely to perceive in clouds, even though state-of-the-art recognition methods typically fail to detect such animals. Additionally, we introduce a method to assist individuals in perceiving specific pareidolic animals, even if they did not recognize them initially. Our approach uses a diffusion model to transform cloud segments into an animal shape that visually resemble the original cloud. This diffusion technique is inspired by the observation that the diffusion process succeeds only when the target animal resembles the shape of the cloud, and that subtle visual hints often suffice to help individuals recognize specific pareidolic animals. A generated image, successfully derived from the diffusion model, is then used to predict the pareidolic animal. Additionally, a short morphing video transitioning from the generated image back to the original cloud segment is employed to further enhance the human's perception of the pareidolic animals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究云中动物视错觉（空想性错觉）现象，提出基于扩散模型的方法预测人类可能感知的动物形状，并通过生成相似形状的动物图像和变形视频帮助人类识别。
Motivation: 现有识别方法难以检测云中的错觉动物，需要AI方法模拟人类视错觉感知。
Method: 使用扩散模型将云片段转换为视觉上与原云相似的动物形状，若生成成功则预测该动物，并通过从生成图像到原云片的变形视频增强人类感知。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，仅说明该方法能预测人类感知的动物并辅助识别。
Conclusion: 该方法利用扩散模型对形状的敏感性，为研究空想性错觉和人类视觉感知提供新视角。

papers.title: FlowTime: Towards Continuous Generative Watch Time Prediction via Flow-based Personalized Priors
papers.abstract_en: Watch time has emerged as a pivotal metric for optimizing deep user engagement in short-video recommender systems. However, current methods of watch time prediction (WTP) suffer from inherent paradigm-specific limitations. Direct Regression faces mean-collapse due to unimodal Gaussian assumptions, while Ordinal Regression is hampered by quantization errors from rigid discretization. Similarly, Discrete Generative Regression struggles with high inference latency and heuristic vocabulary design. Beyond these specific flaws, a shared deficiency is the inability to capture the intrinsic multimodality and heterogeneity of User-Item Interaction Patterns. To address these challenges, we first revisit the WTP problem from a causal perspective and identify these user-specific patterns as structural confounders that modulate watch time outcomes, where identical interests manifest as distinct watch time outcomes conditioned on diverse user habits. Then, we formally propose a new (or the fourth) paradigm -- Continuous Generative Regression, and introduce FlowTime, a novel method utilizing a One-step Generative Variational Autoencoder. FlowTime effectively circumvents the latency of iterative denoising while maintaining the expressivity of continuous latent spaces. Furthermore, we design a Flow-based Personalized Prior that leverages NFs to warp a standard Gaussian prior into a complex, history-conditioned manifold, thereby enabling the adaptive modeling of multimodal interaction patterns. Finally, we build TimeRec, the first open-source WTP Library, alongside a novel personalization metric to establish a rigorous benchmarking standard. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests demonstrate FlowTime's significant superiority over SOTA methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对短视频推荐系统中的观看时间预测（Watch Time Prediction）问题，指出现有方法（直接回归、序数回归、离散生成回归）的局限性，并提出了一种新范式——连续生成回归（Continuous Generative Regression）。作者设计了一个名为 FlowTime 的方法，使用一步生成变分自编码器（One-step Generative Variational Autoencoder），避免了迭代去噪的延迟，同时保持连续隐空间的表达能力。通过基于流的个性化先验（Flow-based Personalized Prior），利用归一化流将标准高斯先验扭曲为复杂的历史条件分布，从而自适应地建模多模态的用户-物品交互模式。此外，还构建了第一个开源 WTP 库 TimeRec，并提出了新的个性化指标。离线实验和在线 A/B 测试表明 FlowTime 优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有观看时间预测方法存在固有局限：直接回归因单峰高斯假设导致均值塌陷（mean-collapse），序数回归受离散化量化误差影响，离散生成回归推理延迟高且词汇表设计启发式。更重要的是，这些方法无法捕捉用户-物品交互模式的内在多模态性和异质性。本文从因果视角重新审视问题，将用户特定模式视为调节观看时间结果的结构性混杂因素。
Method: 提出连续生成回归范式并实现 FlowTime 方法。核心是一个一步生成变分自编码器，通过单步前向传播生成连续时空中的预测分布，避免迭代去噪的高延迟。同时设计基于流的个性化先验，使用归一化流（Normalizing Flows）将标准高斯先验弯曲为依赖于用户历史的多模态分布，从而对用户-物品交互模式的异质性进行自适应建模。
Result: 离线实验和在线 A/B 测试均表明 FlowTime 显著优于现有最先进方法。具体性能提升幅度未在摘要中量化，但强调“显著优越性”。
Conclusion: 本文为观看时间预测提供了连续生成回归的新范式，并通过 FlowTime 证明了其在建模多模态用户模式及保持低推理延迟方面的有效性。开源库 TimeRec 和个性化指标为基准测试提供了标准化工具。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对短视频推荐系统中的观看时间预测（Watch Time Prediction）问题，指出现有方法（直接回归、序数回归、离散生成回归）的局限性，并提出了一种新范式——连续生成回归（Continuous Generative Regression）。作者设计了一个名为 FlowTime 的方法，使用一步生成变分自编码器（One-step Generative Variational Autoencoder），避免了迭代去噪的延迟，同时保持连续隐空间的表达能力。通过基于流的个性化先验（Flow-based Personalized Prior），利用归一化流将标准高斯先验扭曲为复杂的历史条件分布，从而自适应地建模多模态的用户-物品交互模式。此外，还构建了第一个开源 WTP 库 TimeRec，并提出了新的个性化指标。离线实验和在线 A/B 测试表明 FlowTime 优于现有方法。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有观看时间预测方法存在固有局限：直接回归因单峰高斯假设导致均值塌陷（mean-collapse），序数回归受离散化量化误差影响，离散生成回归推理延迟高且词汇表设计启发式。更重要的是，这些方法无法捕捉用户-物品交互模式的内在多模态性和异质性。本文从因果视角重新审视问题，将用户特定模式视为调节观看时间结果的结构性混杂因素。
summary_sections.method: 提出连续生成回归范式并实现 FlowTime 方法。核心是一个一步生成变分自编码器，通过单步前向传播生成连续时空中的预测分布，避免迭代去噪的高延迟。同时设计基于流的个性化先验，使用归一化流（Normalizing Flows）将标准高斯先验弯曲为依赖于用户历史的多模态分布，从而对用户-物品交互模式的异质性进行自适应建模。
summary_sections.result: 离线实验和在线 A/B 测试均表明 FlowTime 显著优于现有最先进方法。具体性能提升幅度未在摘要中量化，但强调“显著优越性”。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文为观看时间预测提供了连续生成回归的新范式，并通过 FlowTime 证明了其在建模多模态用户模式及保持低推理延迟方面的有效性。开源库 TimeRec 和个性化指标为基准测试提供了标准化工具。

papers.title: Recognize Your Orchestrator: An Entropy Dynamics Perspective for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: The transition from single-turn models to Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) promises enhanced problem-solving capabilities, yet the centralized orchestration topology remains a critical point of fragility. To analyze this, we propose a Mean-Field Entropy Dynamics framework, modeling the orchestration process as a system governed by the competing forces of task resolution and cumulative context loading. To facilitate validation, we introduce Inverse Workflow Generation (IWG), a multi-agent pipeline that synthesizes process-verifiable, high-complexity benchmarks with dense intermediate checkpoints. We demonstrate that our entropy dynamics model fits empirical trajectories, providing physically interpretable parameters that quantify system stability and performance collapse. Crucially, our analysis uncovers a ``Reasoning Trap": while reasoning-heavy models excel in isolated tasks, they frequently fail as orchestrators due to context squeezing. Elucidating the physical mechanisms underlying the Orchestrator and quantifying systemic uncertainty offers insights for the MASs' architectural design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出平均场熵动力学框架，将多智能体系统的编排过程建模为由任务解决与上下文负载累积竞争驱动的系统。通过逆工作流生成（IWG）管道合成高复杂度基准，验证熵动力学模型拟合经验轨迹，揭示推理型模型在作为编排器时因上下文挤压而失败的“推理陷阱”。
Motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）中集中式编排拓扑结构脆弱，现有研究缺乏对编排过程物理机制和系统不确定性量化的分析。
Method: 提出平均场熵动力学框架，将编排过程视为任务解决与上下文负载的竞争；并设计逆工作流生成（IWG）管道，生成带有密集中间检查点的可验证高复杂度基准。
Result: 熵动力学模型拟合经验轨迹，提供可解释参数量化系统稳定性与性能崩溃；发现推理型模型在孤立任务中表现优越，但编排时因上下文挤压而失败。
Conclusion: 阐明编排器的物理机制和系统不确定性，为MAS架构设计提供启示。

papers.title: ChartArena: Benchmarking Chart Parsing across Languages, Scenarios, and Formats
papers.abstract_en: Charts are a primary medium for conveying quantitative and relational information, yet systematically evaluating chart parsing models remains difficult. Existing benchmarks focus on narrow chart types and leave diagrammatic structures such as flowcharts and mind maps largely unaddressed, while models produce outputs in incompatible formats, and datasets rarely include the printed or hand-drawn images encountered in practice. To address these issues, we introduce ChartArena, a comprehensive bilingual benchmark covering eight chart families spanning both numeric charts and diagrammatic structures, each evaluated across three visual scenarios: digital renderings, printed photos, and hand-drawn photos. The dataset is built via a human-agent collaborative annotation pipeline with multi-stage human verification to ensure annotation reliability. To enable fair cross-model comparison, we further design a format-agnostic evaluation protocol that maps heterogeneous outputs into two canonical semantic spaces, a normalized triple view and a directed graph view, and scores them with structure-aware metrics. Through extensive evaluation of 26 leading MLLMs, we observe three consistent findings: (i) frontier proprietary models such as Gemini 3.1 Pro lead overall, yet the strongest open-source systems are rapidly closing the gap; (ii) document parsing models handle numeric charts reasonably but fall sharply behind on diagrammatic structures; and (iii) expert chart parsers remain limited to narrow chart families. Across all models, radar charts and hand-drawn scenarios stay especially challenging. These findings show that ChartArena exposes clear capability gaps and provides a unified foundation for future progress. ChartArena is publicly available at https://github.com/pspdada/ChartArena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChartArena，一个全面双语基准，涵盖八种图表家族（包括数值图表和图表结构），在数字渲染、打印照片和手绘照片三种视觉场景下评估。通过人机协作标注管道和格式无关评估协议，对26个前沿多模态大语言模型进行测试，发现前沿商业模型领先但开源模型快速追赶，文档解析模型对图表结构表现不佳，专家图表解析器局限于窄图表家族，雷达图和手绘场景仍具挑战。
Motivation: 现有图表解析基准局限于窄图表类型，未覆盖流程图、思维导图等图表结构，模型输出格式不兼容，且缺乏打印或手绘图场景。
Method: 构建包含8个图表家族的双语基准数据集，通过人机协作标注和多阶段人工验证保证可靠性；设计格式无关评估协议，将异构输出映射到规范三元组视图和有向图视图，使用结构感知指标评分。
Result: 对26个MLLM的评估显示：Gemini 3.1 Pro等前沿商业模型整体领先，但最强开源系统快速缩小差距；文档解析模型处理数值图表尚可，但图表结构上落后；专家图表解析器仅适用于窄家族；雷达图和手绘场景对所有模型仍具挑战。
Conclusion: ChartArena暴露了现有模型的能力差距，为未来进步提供了统一基础。

papers.title: FlowSDR: Sufficient Dimension Reduction via Conditional Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: Sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) seeks a low-dimensional linear projection of predictors that preserves the conditional distribution of the response. Existing methods target this conditional distribution indirectly, via inverse moments, local forward regression, or neural ensemble regression. We propose FlowSDR, a likelihood-based framework that jointly learns the projection and the conditional density by maximizing a conditional log-likelihood, with the density parameterized by monotone rational-quadratic spline flows. The estimator is Fisher consistent under the SDR model, and its sample objective admits a population interpretation in terms of mutual information. As a complementary model within the same likelihood framework, we introduce the neural Gaussian SDR, a heteroscedastic conditional Gaussian model whose mean and variance are parameterized by shared neural-network functions of the projected predictors. In simulations spanning Gaussian errors, heavy-tailed distributions, two-component mixtures, and settings with tail behavior not captured by mean-variance structure, FlowSDR recovers the central subspace more accurately than existing SDR methods and the neural Gaussian SDR baseline. We further validate these advantages on a face-age prediction task using the UTKFace dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowSDR，一种基于条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flows）的充分降维方法，通过最大化条件对数似然联合学习投影和条件密度。估计量具有Fisher一致性，且样本目标函数具有互信息的总体解释。在模拟实验（高斯误差、重尾分布、混合分布等）和UTKFace人脸年龄预测任务中，FlowSDR比现有SDR方法和神经高斯SDR基线更准确地恢复中心子空间。
Motivation: 现有充分降维方法通过逆矩、局部前向回归或神经集成回归间接逼近条件分布，缺乏直接基于似然的框架。本文旨在提出一个直接最大化条件似然的方法来联合学习投影和密度。
Method: 提出FlowSDR，使用单调有理二次样条流（monotone rational-quadratic spline flows）参数化条件密度，通过最大化条件对数似然联合学习投影矩阵和密度参数。同时提出神经高斯SDR（neural Gaussian SDR）作为同一似然框架下的异方差条件高斯模型，其均值和方差由共享神经网络参数化。
Result: 在模拟实验中，FlowSDR在多种误差分布（高斯、重尾、两成分混合）下比现有SDR方法和神经高斯SDR基线更准确地恢复中心子空间。在UTKFace数据集的人脸年龄预测任务中验证了其优势。
Conclusion: FlowSDR提供了一个似然基础的充分降维框架，具有Fisher一致性和清晰的互信息解释，在多种数据分布下优于现有方法。

papers.title: Towards Optimal Robustness in Learning-Augmented Paging
papers.abstract_en: Learning-augmented paging has been extensively studied in recent years. A key advantage over naive ML-based approaches is \emph{bounded robustness}, which guarantees worst-case performance even when predictions are inaccurate, making these algorithms valuable for real-world systems. Prior work achieves robustness bounds of $2H_k + O(1)$ in the randomized setting, leaving a gap to the optimal competitive ratio $H_k$. In this paper, we study how to close this gap. We begin by reviewing online optimality and proving a new property of the latest $H_k$-competitive algorithm, which facilitates our analysis in the learning-augmented setting. Then, we review existing learning-augmented paging algorithms and introduce a unifying primitive, the \emph{relative prediction budget}, which captures the essence of establishing robustness and reveals that prior algorithms either overuse or underutilize predictions. Guided by the above analysis, we develop a new framework that achieves the best-possible robustness up to an additive constant for learning-augmented paging: $H_k + O(1)$. Experiments further demonstrate strong practical performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究学习增强分页（learning-augmented paging）中的最优鲁棒性。现有随机算法实现2H_k+O(1)的鲁棒界，距离最优竞争比H_k有差距。通过提出相对预测预算（relative prediction budget）统一现有方法，并开发新框架达到H_k+O(1)的鲁棒性，实验显示强实用性能。
Motivation: 现有学习增强分页算法的鲁棒性界（2H_k+O(1)）与最优竞争比H_k之间存在差距，且现有算法要么过度使用要么未充分利用预测。
Method: 提出相对预测预算（relative prediction budget）统一原语，分析现有算法；基于此开发新框架，实现最优鲁棒性（H_k+O(1)）。
Result: 新框架达到H_k+O(1)的鲁棒界，并通过实验展示强实用性能。
Conclusion: 本文在理论上首次实现接近最优鲁棒性（仅差常数项），为学习增强分页提供了最优鲁棒性。

papers.title: FreqLite: A Lightweight Frequency-Decomposed Linear Model with Adaptive Reversible Normalization for Robust Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Long-term time-series forecasting needs models that are accurate yet efficient enough for commodity hardware. Lightweight linear forecasters are remarkably strong in this regime, yet they leave two openings: reversible instance normalization (RevIN) de-normalizes the entire horizon with a single lookback statistic, which is inaccurate under non-stationarity, and time-domain trend/seasonal decomposition relies on a fixed, non-adaptive filter. We present FreqLite, an ultra-lightweight, channel-independent frequency-decomposed linear forecaster: a learnable, lossless, partition-of-unity spectral filter splits the input into bands that are forecast by per-band linear heads and, unlike low-pass-truncation approaches, the high-frequency band is retained and modeled. FreqLite is the best lightweight model on the standard long-term forecasting benchmarks and, at long lookback (L=336), attains a lower average error than a PatchTST Transformer (0.3244 vs. 0.3587 MSE) while using 4x fewer parameters, 2.2x less memory, and 2.2x less time per epoch on a single 4 GB laptop GPU; although modest in magnitude, its improvements are statistically significant under paired Wilcoxon tests across all matched cells (p < 1e-5). We further introduce Adaptive Reversible Instance Normalization (A-RevIN), a regime-adaptive reversible normalization that strictly generalizes RevIN (recovered exactly when its gate is closed), engages under non-stationarity, and reduces to RevIN without harm on stationary data. We validate this on both a real strongly non-stationary dataset (ILI, up to ~5% MSE reduction) and a controlled synthetic drift sweep in which A-RevIN's benefit and its learned gate both rise monotonically with injected non-stationarity. Every component is independently ablatable (Linear and RLinear are special cases of FreqLite), and all results are reproducible on commodity hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreqLite 是一种超轻量级的频率分解线性预测模型，用于长期时间序列预测。它通过可学习的无损频谱滤波器将输入分解为多个频带，每个频带由独立的线性头预测，并保留高频信息。此外，提出自适应可逆实例归一化 (A-RevIN)，在非平稳数据上优于 RevIN。在标准长期预测基准上，FreqLite 以更少的参数和计算量实现了优于 PatchTST Transformer 的精度，且在非平稳数据集上验证了 A-RevIN 的有效性。
Motivation: 现有轻量级线性预测器存在两个问题：可逆实例归一化 (RevIN) 在非平稳性下不准确，以及时域趋势/季节分解依赖固定非自适应滤波器。
Method: 提出 FreqLite，一种通道独立的频率分解线性预测器：使用可学习、无损的单位划分频谱滤波器将输入分成多个频带，每个频带由单独线性头预测，并保留高频带。同时引入自适应可逆实例归一化 (A-RevIN)，使用门控机制自适应调整归一化，在非平稳时激活，平稳时退化为 RevIN。
Result: 在标准长期预测基准上，FreqLite 是表现最好的轻量模型。在长回溯窗口 (L=336) 下，平均误差低于 PatchTST Transformer (0.3244 vs 0.3587 MSE)，同时参数量减少 4 倍，内存减少 2.2 倍，每 epoch 时间减少 2.2 倍（单台 4GB 笔记本 GPU）。在真实非平稳数据集 ILI 上 MSE 降低约 5%，且所有改进经配对 Wilcoxon 检验统计显著 (p < 1e-5)。
Conclusion: FreqLite 在长期时间序列预测中实现了轻量、高效且鲁棒的预测，其组件可独立消融，且所有结果可在商品硬件上复现。A-RevIN 为非平稳数据提供了自适应归一化方案，而不会损害平稳数据上的性能。

summary_sections.tldr: FreqLite 是一种超轻量级的频率分解线性预测模型，用于长期时间序列预测。它通过可学习的无损频谱滤波器将输入分解为多个频带，每个频带由独立的线性头预测，并保留高频信息。此外，提出自适应可逆实例归一化 (A-RevIN)，在非平稳数据上优于 RevIN。在标准长期预测基准上，FreqLite 以更少的参数和计算量实现了优于 PatchTST Transformer 的精度，且在非平稳数据集上验证了 A-RevIN 的有效性。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有轻量级线性预测器存在两个问题：可逆实例归一化 (RevIN) 在非平稳性下不准确，以及时域趋势/季节分解依赖固定非自适应滤波器。
summary_sections.method: 提出 FreqLite，一种通道独立的频率分解线性预测器：使用可学习、无损的单位划分频谱滤波器将输入分成多个频带，每个频带由单独线性头预测，并保留高频带。同时引入自适应可逆实例归一化 (A-RevIN)，使用门控机制自适应调整归一化，在非平稳时激活，平稳时退化为 RevIN。
summary_sections.result: 在标准长期预测基准上，FreqLite 是表现最好的轻量模型。在长回溯窗口 (L=336) 下，平均误差低于 PatchTST Transformer (0.3244 vs 0.3587 MSE)，同时参数量减少 4 倍，内存减少 2.2 倍，每 epoch 时间减少 2.2 倍（单台 4GB 笔记本 GPU）。在真实非平稳数据集 ILI 上 MSE 降低约 5%，且所有改进经配对 Wilcoxon 检验统计显著 (p < 1e-5)。

papers.title: HOLA: Holistic Multi-Modal Alignment for Open-Set 3D Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Open-set 3D recognition requires models that generalize to rare or unseen categories. Recent approaches address this by distilling language-vision knowledge into 3D encoders, typically relying on heavy 2D ViTs and aligning each point cloud with a single image or caption, thus anchoring representations to partial views. We propose aligning each point cloud with multiple images and textual descriptions to capture a more holistic understanding of 3D objects. To realize this idea, it is essential to design a loss function capable of jointly aligning a 3D instance with multiple matched signals, multi-view images and multiple texts, while separating positive aggregation from negative competition. We introduce such a function, termed the decoupled multi-positive contrastive loss. Our formulation enhances the loss's hardness-aware focus on challenging negatives, avoiding the "spotlight crowding" that occurs when many positives share the same softmax with all the negatives. Complementing this, we present a lightweight text adapter applied only to web captions, reducing the domain gap to curated annotations and enabling effective use of large-scale unsupervised text. Our model demonstrates state-of-the-art open-vocabulary performance on long-tail benchmarks, yielding substantial zero-shot improvements while sustaining high frame rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HOLA 方法，通过多视图图像和文本与 3D 点云的多模态对齐，实现开放集 3D 识别。引入解耦多正例对比损失（decoupled multi-positive contrastive loss），避免多正例与负例的 softmax 干扰，并设计轻量文本适配器缩小网络文本与标注文本的领域差异。在长尾基准上取得开放词汇识别的 state-of-the-art 零样本性能。
Motivation: 现有开放集 3D 识别方法通常将每个点云与单一图像或文本对齐，导致表示受限于部分视角。需要更全面的多模态对齐来捕捉 3D 物体的整体理解。
Method: 提出解耦多正例对比损失，联合对齐一个 3D 实例与多个视图图像和多个文本描述，分离正样本聚合与负样本竞争，增强对困难负样本的关注。同时引入轻量文本适配器，减小网络文本与人工标注文本的领域差距。
Result: 在长尾基准上取得开放词汇识别的 state-of-the-art 零样本性能，同时保持高帧率。
Conclusion: 多模态对齐和损失函数设计能有效提升开放集 3D 识别能力，但方法依赖多视图图像和文本描述，可能增加数据要求。

papers.title: Conditioned free-energy density of proteins using unbalanced solutions to constraint satisfaction problems
papers.abstract_en: We show that computing the log-partition function (free-energy) of conditioned inhomogeneous Curie--Weiss spin Hamiltonians reduces to an unbalanced $2 \to 1$ norm computation, and design a polynomial-time SDP algorithm for this problem with a lower bound proof for the amount of unbalance achieved. Applied to the protein Ubiquitin, the framework starts from a known crystal structure, explores alternative backbone conformations across the free-energy landscape, and identifies flexible regions of the protein while preserving its native secondary structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明条件非均匀 Curie-Weiss 自旋哈密顿量的 log-配分函数（自由能）计算归结为非平衡 2→1 范数计算，并设计了多项式时间 SDP 算法，给出了非平衡度下界证明。在泛素蛋白上，该框架从已知晶体结构出发，探索自由能景观中的替代骨架构象，识别柔性区域同时保持天然二级结构。
Motivation: 蛋白质自由能计算通常困难，尤其是条件约束下的非均匀系统，缺乏高效算法。
Method: 将条件非均匀 Curie-Weiss 模型 log-配分函数转化为非平衡 2→1 范数问题，设计多项式时间 SDP 算法，并提供非平衡度的下界证明。
Result: 在泛素蛋白应用上验证了框架的有效性，能够探索自由能景观并识别柔性区域。
Conclusion: 框架为蛋白质自由能计算提供新途径，但可能仅适用于特定条件约束系统。

papers.title: SEArch: Optimistic Policy Selection Between Scene Noise and Drift for UAV Radar Search
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) equipped with radar sensors are deployed for target search missions in diverse environments, where targets exhibit characteristic signatures (e.g., respiration micro-motion in human search) detectable through occlusions. A fundamental challenge arises from shifts in radar statistics as the UAV moves through a dynamic and potentially non-stationary environment, rendering any fixed signal-processing strategy suboptimal; yet perception and adaptation must run onboard a resource-constrained aerial node in real time. Since no single detector performs well across all conditions, we adopt a multi-policy paradigm and formulate UAV target search as an online policy selection problem over a library of specialized detectors, with performance measured by regret, the cumulative loss gap relative to the best policy in each scene. The setting couples in-scene stochastic noise with inter-scene shifts. Whereas prior methods capture only one regime, we account for both through the Stochastically Extended Adversary (SEA) framework, without requiring oracle knowledge of scene dynamics. Because adaptation must run at the UAV, we instantiate SEA through \textsc{SEArch}, a lightweight optimistic Follow the Regularized Leader (OFTRL) selector with an adaptive learning rate, achieving regret $O(\barσ_T \sqrt{T} + \sqrt{J})$, where $\barσ_T$ captures radar measurement noise and $J$ is the number of scene transitions over the mission horizon $T$. To enable rapid adaptation under frequent scene changes, we further introduce \textsc{W-SEArch}, a windowed variant that restarts every $w$ rounds and achieves regret $O(\barσ_I \sqrt{w})$ under at most one transition per window. Experiments show up to 30\% regret reduction compared to non-adaptive baselines across a range of non-stationary settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机雷达搜索中环境动态非平稳的问题，提出SEArch和W-SEArch在线策略选择方法。该方法将目标搜索建模为在线策略选择，采用随机扩展对手（SEA）框架同时处理场景内噪声和场景间漂移，通过乐观FTRL选择器实现自适应学习。实验显示，在多种非平稳场景下，相比非自适应基线，后悔值降低高达30%。
Motivation: 无人机雷达搜索中，环境动态且非平稳，固定信号处理策略表现次优；现有方法仅能处理场景内噪声或场景间漂移之一，无法同时应对两者。
Method: 采用Stochastically Extended Adversary (SEA)框架，实例化为SEArch（乐观FTRL选择器，自适应学习率）和W-SEArch（窗口变体，每w轮重启），分别达到后悔界O(σ_T√T + √J)和O(σ_I√w)。
Result: 摘要报告在多种非平稳设置中，相比非自适应基线，后悔降低高达30%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SEArch框架可同时处理场景内统计噪声和场景间漂移，且适应资源受限的无人机实时运行。

papers.title: Digital Twin-Assisted Adaptive Multi-Agent DRL for Intelligent Spectrum and Resource Management in Open-RAN UAV-Enabled 6G Networks
papers.abstract_en: The evolution toward 6G wireless networks envisions a seamlessly intelligent, Open-RAN-enabled architecture where unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) play a pivotal role in extending coverage, enhancing resilience, and ensuring reliable connectivity for ground users deployment. However, efficiently managing spectrum and resources in such highly dynamic UAV-assisted environments remains a major challenge due to nonlinear system interactions, mobility-induced topology variations, and stringent latency and energy constraints. To address these challenges, we propose a digital twin (DT)-assisted adaptive deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework that enables intelligent spectrum sharing and resource allocation across distributed ground users. The complex optimization problem is decomposed into UAV trajectory optimization using particle swarm optimization (PSO) and dynamic spectrum-power-association management via multi-agent DRL (MADRL). This hybrid DT-driven approach empowers intelligent, context-aware decision-making and adaptive coordination among UAVs. Extensive simulations demonstrate significant gains in spectral efficiency, data rates, and energy utilization, showcasing a transformative path toward self-evolving, autonomous 6G UAV and ground users (GUs) connectivity.
papers.comment: accepted and presented at IEEE ICC-2026 conference paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对6G网络中无人机辅助Open-RAN架构的频谱与资源管理挑战，提出一种数字孪生（DT）辅助的自适应多智能体深度强化学习（MADRL）框架。该框架将复杂优化问题分解为粒子群优化（PSO）的无人机轨迹优化和MADRL的动态频谱-功率-关联管理，仿真结果表明在频谱效率、数据速率和能量利用方面均有显著提升。
Motivation: 无人机辅助环境下高度动态，存在非线性系统交互、移动性拓扑变化及严格的时延和能量约束，导致频谱和资源管理极为困难。
Method: 提出数字孪生辅助的自适应DRL框架，采用PSO优化无人机轨迹，并利用多智能体DRL进行动态频谱-功率-关联管理，实现上下文感知决策与自适应协调。
Result: 仿真实验验证了该方法在频谱效率、数据速率和能量利用上的显著增益。
Conclusion: 该框架为实现自演化、自主的6G无人机与地面用户连接提供了变革性路径。

papers.title: DiffuSent: Towards a Unified Diffusion Framework for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) encompasses seven distinct subtasks, each focusing on different extracted elements. Despite the proven success of generative models in unified aspect sentiment analysis, existing approaches often rely on auto-regressive token-by-token generation without grasping the whole information of the aspect and opinion terms, resulting in boundary insensitivity, particularly in context of multi-word aspect and opinion terms. To address these issues, we present DiffuSent, a non-auto-regressive diffusion framework that systematically formulates all ABSA subtasks as boundary denoising diffusion processes, progressively refining boundaries over noisy states. Furthermore, we introduce a contrastive denoising training strategy which effectively address duplicate predictions with subtle variations introduced by diffusion process. Extensive experiments across 28 settings (7 subtasks x 4 datasets) demonstrate that DiffuSent achieves delivers consistent improvements over the strongest generative and span-based systems. DiffuSent exhibits notable gains on multi-word triplets, achieving an average improvement of +2.48 F1, and maintains robust extraction accuracy in sentences containing multiple sentiment triplets. Moreover, the non-auto-regressive decoding enables substantial efficiency benefits, reaching up to 181 times faster inference than auto-regressive generative baselines
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffuSent是一个非自回归扩散框架，将方面情感分析（ABSA）的所有子任务统一为边界去噪扩散过程。通过对比去噪训练策略，有效解决多词方面词和观点词的边界不敏感问题，并在28个实验设置上取得一致提升，推理速度比自回归基线快181倍。
Motivation: 现有生成式模型在统一方面情感分析中采用自回归逐词生成，无法把握方面词和观点词的整体信息，导致多词术语的边界不敏感。
Method: 提出DiffuSent框架，将ABSA子任务建模为边界去噪扩散过程，逐步从噪声状态中精炼边界；并引入对比去噪训练策略，消除扩散过程引入的重复预测。
Result: 在7个子任务×4数据集共28个设置上，DiffuSent一致优于最强生成式和基于span的系统。多词三元组上平均F1提升+2.48，含多个情感三元组的句子中保持鲁棒性，且推理速度达到自回归基线的181倍。
Conclusion: DiffuSent通过非自回归扩散和对比训练有效提升了ABSA的边界敏感性和推理效率，尤其适用于多词术语和复杂句子。

papers.title: TukaBench: A Culturally Grounded Jailbreak Benchmark for African Languages
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) remains heavily English-centric, leaving Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), particularly African ones, critically underexplored. We introduce TUKABENCH, a jailbreak benchmark for seven African languages that extends JailbreakBench (JBB) beyond direct translation through four settings: human translation of JBB prompts, English adaptation to African contexts followed by human translation, human-curated prompts validated through interactions with GPT-5.2, and code-switched prompts combining English and African languages, isolating the effect of language, cultural grounding, and prompt evasiveness on model safety. Across closed and open models, prompting in African languages reduces refusal relative to English, with culturally adapted prompts leading to least refusal. The evaluation also surfaces two structural limitations: model comprehension failures and reduced LLM-as-a-judge reliability in LRLs. To capture the first, we introduce Deflection alongside Refused and Jailbroken; to assess the second, we validate outputs with human annotations, showing that judge-human agreement drops in lower-resource languages and less commonly supported scripts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TUKABENCH，一个针对七种非洲语言的越狱基准测试，通过四种设置（人工翻译、文化适应翻译、人工策划提示、代码切换）扩展JailbreakBench。评估显示，使用非洲语言提示相比英语降低拒绝率，其中文化适应提示拒绝率最低；同时发现模型理解失败和LLM-as-a-judge在低资源语言中可靠性下降。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型安全评估严重偏向英语，低资源语言特别是非洲语言的安全评估几乎空白。
Method: 基于JailbreakBench构建TUKABENCH，包含四种越狱提示设置：人工翻译JBB提示、英语到非洲文化适应后翻译、与GPT-5.2交互验证的人工策划提示、英语与非洲语言混合的代码切换提示。
Result: 在闭源和开源模型上，使用非洲语言提示比英语拒绝率更低，文化适应提示拒绝率最低；评估还揭示了模型理解失败和LLM-as-a-judge在低资源语言与少支持脚本中可靠性下降。
Conclusion: 论文指出当前安全评估在语言和文化多样性上的局限，并提出了针对低资源语言评估的两个结构性问题：模型理解失败和评判可靠性下降。

papers.title: Science Earth: Towards A Planet-Scale Operating System for AI-Native Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery demands intelligence, perseverance, and serendipity across vast search spaces. Today, top scientific capabilities remain siloed--one AI system for biological analysis, another for clinical reasoning, mathematical derivation, or materials simulation--and no pre-designed team can anticipate every skill a question will need. Science Earth is a planet-scale scientific runtime in which any capability--a simulation cluster, a wet-lab robot, a proof engine, a single-cell pipeline--can connect to any other, with collaboration structure emerging from the question itself. Its underlying EACN protocol lets capabilities discover one another, negotiate task ownership, and adjudicate across incompatible evidentiary standards without prior knowledge of who will meet whom. This shifts the organizing challenge from workflow design to open-ended connectivity. Two runs validate this under structurally distinct conditions. In a trans-Pacific higher-order Kuramoto synchronization study, agents identified and corrected a closure-ratio assumption in Ott-Antonsen analytic theory that fails outside the Lorentzian limit, within thirty minutes. In an eight-agent single-cell run on the 4.88M-cell Kang 2024 pan-cancer atlas, heterogeneous capabilities coupled over a 64.9-hour window with one structural external instruction, producing three new result layers and anchoring findings against an independent wet-lab study on an adjacent CCR8- TIGIT+ Treg subset. These cases are a first empirical reading, not a benchmark sweep. They show that when AI capabilities are truly connectable and coordination emerges from the problem, scientific reasoning becomes a distributed, self-correcting process--a step towards scaling AI-native discovery to the planet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Science Earth 是一个面向 AI 原生科学发现的星球级操作系统，通过 EACN 协议使多种科学能力（如模拟集群、湿实验室机器人、证明引擎等）自主连接和协作，无需预定义工作流。在跨太平洋 Kuramoto 同步研究和多智能体单细胞分析两个案例中验证了其有效性，展示了分布式、自纠正的科学推理能力。
Motivation: 现有科学 AI 系统功能孤立，无法灵活组合以应对多样化科学问题，缺乏开放式的协作框架。
Method: 提出 Science Earth 运行时系统，基于 EACN 协议让各能力自主发现、协商任务并裁决证据标准，实现问题驱动的协作结构。
Result: 在跨太平洋 Kuramoto 同步研究中，智能体在 30 分钟内识别并修正了 Ott-Antonsen 分析理论中超出 Lorentzian 极限的闭合比假设；在 8 智能体单细胞分析中，异构能力在 64.9 小时内产生三层新结果，并与独立湿实验验证一致。
Conclusion: 该工作首次实证表明，当 AI 能力真正可连接且协调来自问题本身时，科学推理可成为分布式自纠正过程，为规模化 AI 原生发现奠定基础。

papers.title: DeblurNVS: Geometric Latent Diffusion for Novel View Synthesis from Sparse Motion-Blurred Images
papers.abstract_en: Novel view synthesis (NVS) is a fundamental problem in computer vision and graphics. Recent advances in neural radiance fields (NeRF), 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), and generative view synthesis have substantially improved its quality. Yet most methods still rely on clean observations, where image structures and cross-view geometric cues are well preserved. Motion blur breaks this assumption by corrupting local details and weakening multi-view correspondences. Such blur commonly arises from camera shake, scene motion, or finite exposure in practical capture. Blur-aware NVS methods address this degradation by modeling image formation, but their reliance on costly per-scene optimization limits efficient and generalizable sparse-view synthesis. To address this, we propose DeblurNVS, a novel framework for synthesizing high-fidelity novel views directly from sparse motion-blurred images, without requiring per-scene optimization. DeblurNVS restores the intermediate geometric representations needed for multi-view reasoning, enabling blurred inputs to recover reliable structure and correspondence cues. The restored representations are then combined with target camera information to synthesize the target-view representation and reconstruct a sharp RGB novel view. To enable the large-scale training, we construct a motion-blurred NVS dataset from DL3DV-10K using interpolation-based finite-exposure blur synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeblurNVS outperforms existing baselines on synthetic motion-blur benchmarks and generalizes to real motion-blurred scenes, producing perceptually sharper and structurally more stable novel views while avoiding costly per-scene optimization. Project page: https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/DeblurNVS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeblurNVS，一个无需逐场景优化的框架，能从稀疏运动模糊图像直接合成高保真新视角。方法通过恢复中间几何表示来重建多视图对应关系，并利用目标相机信息生成清晰的新视图。作者从 DL3DV-10K 构建了运动模糊 NVS 数据集，实验表明在合成和真实模糊场景上均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有新视角合成方法通常依赖清晰输入，运动模糊会破坏局部细节和多视图对应关系。已有模糊感知方法需要昂贵的逐场景优化，难以实现高效且泛化的稀疏视图合成。
Method: 提出几何潜在扩散框架，先恢复模糊图像中的中间几何表示（如深度、特征），再结合目标相机信息合成目标视图表示，最终重建清晰 RGB 新视图。利用插值有限曝光模糊合成从 DL3DV-10K 构建大规模训练数据集。
Result: 在合成运动模糊基准上优于现有基线，并泛化到真实运动模糊场景，生成的新视角在感知锐度和结构稳定性上更优，且无需逐场景优化。
Conclusion: DeblurNVS 有效解决了运动模糊下稀疏视图新视角合成问题，避免逐场景优化，具有良好泛化能力。

papers.title: SkillSmith: Co-Evolving Skills and Tools for Self-Improving Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Recent self-evolving agents have shown that skills can be discovered, refined, and accumulated through execution. However, existing skill-evolution frameworks typically assume a fixed tool layer and evaluate each skill independently, limiting their ability to repair tool-level failures or reason about interactions among skills. We propose SkillSmith, a synergy-aware skill-tool co-evolution framework. SkillSmith introduces a unified proposal space in which reflection produces atomic bundles that jointly modify skills and tools, allowing tools to be wrapped, edited, composed, split, or retired when skill evolution identifies a reusable capability gap. To guide this joint search, SkillSmith maintains an ecological utility model inspired by Lotka-Volterra dynamics, where an interaction matrix estimated from execution traces captures pairwise complementarity and conflict among skills and provides pressure signals for retrieval, mutation prioritization, and retirement. Furthermore, SkillSmith records anti-patterns, including failure signatures, causal attributions, and remedies, to accelerate diagnosis and veto proposals that repeat known mistakes. Experiments on three benchmarks, including WildClawBench, and five Qwen3.5 model scales show that SkillSmith consistently outperforms strong baselines, with gains that amplify as task complexity and multi-skill co-activation increase.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillSmith，一个协同感知的技能-工具共同进化框架。它通过统一提议空间生成原子束同时修改技能和工具，并利用Lotka-Volterra动力学维护生态效用模型来引导搜索，同时记录反模式以加速诊断。在三个基准测试和五种Qwen3.5模型规模上，SkillSmith一致优于强基线，且随着任务复杂性和多技能协同激活的增加，增益放大。
Motivation: 现有自我进化agent框架通常假设固定的工具层并独立评估每个技能，限制了修复工具级故障或推理技能间交互的能力。
Method: 引入统一提议空间，通过反思产生原子束同时修改技能和工具；维护受Lotka-Volterra动力学启发的生态效用模型，利用执行轨迹估计交互矩阵捕捉技能间的互补性和冲突，提供检索、变异优先级和退休的压力信号；记录反模式包括失败签名、因果归因和补救措施。
Result: 在WildClawBench等三个基准测试和五种Qwen3.5模型规模上，SkillSmith一致优于强基线，且随着任务复杂性和多技能协同激活增加，增益放大。
Conclusion: SkillSmith通过技能-工具共同进化和生态建模，提升了自我进化agent在多技能协同任务中的性能。

papers.title: PSG-Nav: Probabilistic Scene Graph Navigation via Multiverse Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary navigation requires embodied agents to manage significant perception uncertainty stemming from semantic ambiguity and model errors. However, most existing works settle for local optimal deterministic approaches, depriving complex navigation decision-making over multiple composite possibilities that are critical for globally better solutions. In this paper, we propose Probabilistic Scene Graph Navigation (PSG-Nav), which constructs a 3D Probabilistic Scene Graph that uses full semantic categorical distributions to account for perception uncertainty. To efficiently use the local distributions to compose and reason about the optimal navigation landmarks, we propose Multiverse Decision to sample multiple most likely world settings from the joint distribution, and evaluate navigation landmarks based on the compatibility between landmarks and multiverses. To mitigate false positives due to epistemic uncertainty in open-vocabulary navigation, we introduce the Evidential Experience Calibrator, which enables online lifelong adaptation by cross-validating detections against memories of past successes and failures. Extensive experiments on widely-used benchmarks MP3D, HM3D, and HSSD demonstrate that PSG-Nav establishes new state-of-the-art results, achieving Success Rates of 66.1%, 44.8%, and 67.9%, respectively. Code is available at: https://psg-nav.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PSG-Nav，一种基于概率场景图的导航方法，通过构建3D概率场景图（Probabilistic Scene Graph）来表征语义类别分布，处理开放词汇导航中的感知不确定性。方法利用多世界决策（Multiverse Decision）从联合分布中采样最可能的场景设置，并评估导航地标与多世界的兼容性；同时引入证据经验校准器（Evidential Experience Calibrator）实现在线终身学习。在MP3D、HM3D和HSSD基准上，PSG-Nav分别达到66.1%、44.8%和67.9%的成功率，刷新了当时的最优结果。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇导航方法多采用局部最优的确定性策略，无法有效处理感知不确定性（语义歧义和模型误差），导致在复杂多可能性场景中难以得到全局更好的导航决策。
Method: 构建3D概率场景图，利用完整语义类别分布建模感知不确定性；提出多世界决策方法，从联合分布中采样多个最可能的世界设定，并基于地标与多世界的兼容性来评估导航地标；引入证据经验校准器，通过交叉验证当前检测与历史成功/失败记忆，实现在线终身适应。
Result: 在MP3D、HM3D和HSSD三个广泛使用的基准上，PSG-Nav的成功率分别达到66.1%、44.8%和67.9%，均取得了当时的最优结果。
Conclusion: 摘要指出PSG-Nav通过概率场景图和多世界决策有效处理了感知不确定性，并证明了在线终身校准机制在减少假阳性方面的作用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Communication-Centric 6G-LLM Architecture for Scalable Tactical Autonomous Defense Vehicle Networks
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and emerging 6G networks introduces new opportunities for scalable coordination in tactical autonomous vehicle systems. This paper proposes a communication-centric hierarchical architecture for Tactical Autonomous Defense Vehicle Networks (TADVNs) that models the integration of edge-assisted Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning with 6G-enabled connectivity and semantic communication. The framework is designed to improve coordination efficiency, reduce communication overhead, and enhance latency resilience under increasing fleet-scale operation. Unlike conventional task-specific AI pipelines that rely on structured feature processing and rule-based coordination, the proposed approach incorporates semantic abstraction and context-aware decision support within a layered edge-cloud communication architecture. We evaluate communication and coordination performance via Monte Carlo simulations across fleet sizes of 5-30 vehicles under contested network conditions. Results indicate that at a 30-vehicle scale, the 6G-LLM configuration achieves 75.2% latency reduction (29.1 ms vs. 117.5 ms), a 68.7 percentage point increase in mission success rate (82.9% vs. 14.2%), and an 88.6% reduction in communication overhead compared to a 5G-based conventional AI baseline. These findings demonstrate measurable benefits in coordination and communication when semantic reasoning is combined with low-latency 6G connectivity.
papers.comment: 10 pages, accepted in IEEE Network Magazine
papers.journal_ref: K. Khurshid, S. Javaid and N. Saeed, "A Communication-Centric 6G-LLM Architecture for Scalable Tactical Autonomous Defense Vehicle Networks," in IEEE Network, Early access, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种以通信为中心的6G-LLM分层架构，用于战术自主防御车辆网络（TADVNs），结合边缘辅助的大语言模型推理、6G连接和语义通信，以提升协调效率、降低通信开销并增强延迟弹性。通过蒙特卡洛仿真（5-30辆车）评估，在30辆车规模下，相比5G常规AI基线，6G-LLM配置实现了75.2%的延迟降低（29.1 ms对117.5 ms）、68.7个百分点的任务成功率提升（82.9%对14.2%）以及88.6%的通信开销减少。
Motivation: 现有战术自主车辆网络依赖结构化特征处理和规则协调的AI管线，在规模化运作时协调效率低、通信开销大、延迟弹性不足。
Method: 提出分层边缘-云通信架构，将语义抽象和上下文感知决策支持与6G连接相结合，并通过边缘辅助LLM实现语义推理。
Result: 在30辆车规模的模拟中，6G-LLM配置相比5G常规AI基线，延迟降低75.2%（29.1 ms vs 117.5 ms），任务成功率提升68.7个百分点（82.9% vs 14.2%），通信开销减少88.6%。
Conclusion: 将语义推理与低延迟6G连接相结合，能够在协调和通信方面带来可量化的改善，适用于可扩展的战术自主防御车辆网络。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SkillAdaptor: Self-Adapting Skills for LLM Agents from Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable external skills to solve long-horizon interactive tasks. Existing training-free skill adaptation pipelines usually update skills from full trajectories or session-level feedback, which makes failure attribution coarse and often produces unstable or overly broad revisions. We propose SkillAdaptor, a training-free step-level skill adaptation framework with explicit failure attribution, and it can plug into OpenClaw-class agent harnesses. Given a failed trajectory, SkillAdaptor identifies a first actionable fault step, links responsibility to candidate skills, and applies targeted updates under explicit acceptance checks while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate on WebShop, PinchBench, and Claw-Eval with Kimi-K2.5, GLM-5, and GPT-5.2. SkillAdaptor improves over no-skill and skill-adaptation baselines on all three suites, with the largest single-metric improvements of +1.5 points on PinchBench Avg Score%, +1.8 on Claw-Eval Avg Score, and +1.7 on WebShop success rate. These results indicate that step-level attribution supports more stable and auditable training-free skill maintenance\footnote{The code will be released at https://github.com/zjunlp/SkillAdaptor.}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillAdaptor 是一个无需训练的步骤级技能适应框架，用于大语言模型 (LLM) agent。它通过明确识别失败轨迹中的第一个可操作故障步骤，将责任归属于候选技能，并在冻结骨干模型的同时进行针对性更新。在 WebShop、PinchBench 和 Claw-Eval 三个基准上，与无技能和技能适应基线相比均取得提升，最大单项提升为 PinchBench 平均分 +1.5、Claw-Eval 平均分 +1.8 和 WebShop 成功率 +1.7。
Motivation: 现有无需训练的技能适应方法通常从完整轨迹或会话级反馈更新技能，导致失败归因粗糙，产生不稳定或过于宽泛的修订。
Method: 提出 SkillAdaptor，一种可插入 OpenClaw 类 agent 框架的步骤级技能适应方法。给定失败轨迹，首先识别第一个可操作的故障步骤，将责任链接到候选技能，然后进行针对性的技能更新，并施加显式接受检查，同时保持骨干模型冻结。
Result: 在 WebShop、PinchBench 和 Claw-Eval 上使用 Kimi-K2.5、GLM-5 和 GPT-5.2 进行评测，SkillAdaptor 在所有三项基准上均优于无技能和技能适应基线，最大单项提升分别为 PinchBench 平均分 +1.5、Claw-Eval 平均分 +1.8 和 WebShop 成功率 +1.7。
Conclusion: 步骤级归因支持更稳定和可审计的无需训练的技能维护，表明细粒度失败分析有助于提高 agent 技能适应效果。

papers.title: FAiT: Frequency-Aware Inverted Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: While Transformer-based architectures have established themselves as a dominant paradigm in Multivariate Time Series Forecasting (MTSF), their core self-attention mechanism inherently functions as a low-pass filter, systematically smoothing out high-frequency signals vital for sharp local changes. Recent advancements have increasingly incorporated frequency-domain operations to address this bias, however, most existing designs rely on fixed spectral bases and apply sequence-wise (uniform) modulation, implicitly assuming a time-invariant frequency response. This overlooks a key property of real-world series that their spectral characteristics often evolve over time, making uniform modulation insufficient for capturing fine-grained temporal dynamics. To tackle these limitations, we propose FAiT, a Frequency-Aware inverted Transformer. Specifically, FAiT rectifies the spectral bias internally through Inverted Attention, which interprets the attention map as a learnable low-pass operator and constructs a dedicated complementary high-pass branch by inverting the attention matrix to recover attenuated transient signals. Furthermore, FAiT introduces Dynamic Temporal-Frequency Modulation (DTFM), which synthesizes instance-conditioned weights to adaptively re-calibrate the energy of spectral sub-bands, enabling fine-grained control over evolving multi-scale patterns. Extensive experiments on widely used benchmarks demonstrate that FAiT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art Transformer-based and frequency-enhanced baselines, while maintaining computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FAiT，一种频率感知的倒置Transformer，用于多变量时间序列预测。核心思想是通过倒置注意力（Inverted Attention）构建高频分支，弥补标准自注意力的低通滤波偏置，并引入动态时频调制（DTFM）以自适应调整频谱子带能量。实验表明FAiT在多个基准上优于现有方法，且计算高效。
Motivation: 标准Transformer的自注意力本质上是低通滤波器，会平滑高频信号，而真实时间序列的频谱特性是时变的，现有固定频谱基和均匀调制方法无法捕捉细粒度时变模式。
Method: 提出FAiT，包含两个关键组件：1) 倒置注意力（Inverted Attention），通过倒置注意力矩阵构建互补的高通分支，恢复被衰减的瞬态信号；2) 动态时频调制（DTFM），生成实例条件权重自适应校准频谱子带能量，实现对演化多尺度模式的精细控制。
Result: 在广泛使用的基准上，FAiT一致优于最先进的基于Transformer和频率增强的基线方法，同时保持计算效率。
Conclusion: FAiT通过内部纠正频谱偏置和动态时频调制，有效提升了多变量时间序列预测的准确性。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: When Hard Negatives Hurt: Bridging the Generative-Discriminative Gap in Hard Negative Synthesis for Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Hard negative mining has become the dominant strategy for training retrievers, yet it faces intrinsic limitations: negatives are bounded by corpus availability, selected by retriever score rather than diagnostic value, and increasingly contaminated by false positives as the retriever improves. LLM-based synthesis offers a principled alternative, where negatives that are unconstrained, targeted, and free from false positive risk. But we show that naively incorporating generated negatives into contrastive learning often degrades retrieval performance. We identify and formalize the root cause as a generative-discriminative gap: LLM generation optimizes for fluent, plausible text, while contrastive learning demands strategic violations of relevance at the decision boundary. Our analysis reveals two compounding failure modes: discriminative-agnostic generation, where the LLM lacks an explicit model of query information needs and defaults to generic or topic-drifted text that provides no contrastive signal; and source-dependent shortcuts, where distributional artifacts enable the model to distinguish negatives by origin rather than relevance, causing gradient drift that actively corrupts optimization. To close this gap, we propose CausalNeg consisting of two main modules: (1) CoT-guided counterfactual perturbation for data construction: decomposes why a document satisfies a query into explicit information requirements, then surgically violates individual requirements to construct negatives with controlled, interpretable hardness. (2) Query-view entropy maximization during training: disperses generated negatives across the similarity spectrum, minimizing the mutual information between source identity and similarity scores to suppress shortcut exploitation. We make our code publicly available at https://github.com/mzhangzhicheng/CausalNeg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了LLM生成的硬负样本在对比学习中性能退化的根本原因——生成-判别差距（generative-discriminative gap），并提出了CausalNeg框架，通过CoT引导的反事实扰动和查询视图熵最大化来弥合该差距，提升检索性能。
Motivation: 现有硬负样本挖掘受限于语料库、检索器评分和假阳性污染；LLM合成负样本虽可避免这些问题，但直接用于对比学习常导致检索性能下降。作者将原因归结为生成-判别差距：LLM生成追求流畅性，而对比学习需要决策边界处的策略性相关性违反。
Method: 提出CausalNeg，包含两个模块：(1) CoT引导的反事实扰动：将文档满足查询的原因分解为显式信息需求，然后针对性地违反单个需求以构造可控、可解释的负样本；(2) 查询视图熵最大化：将生成的负样本分散在相似度谱上，最小化来源身份与相似度分数之间的互信息，抑制捷径利用。
Result: 该方法在检索任务上能够有效弥合生成-判别差距，提升检索性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 通过可控的反事实负样本构造和熵正则化，CausalNeg克服了LLM合成负样本的退化问题，为检索中的负样本合成提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure and Scale in Simplicial Sequence Modelling
papers.abstract_en: Modern large-scale deep learning exhibits two striking empirical phenomena: behavioural scaling laws (predictable performance gains with increasing scale) and emergent mechanisms (structured internal representations and circuits in deep neural networks). We hypothesise that these two phenomena are connected: that predictable changes in behaviour are the result of predictable changes in internal computational structure. In this paper, we report preliminary evidence of such a connection. We find a correlation between scaling patterns in performance and representations in small transformers trained to predict the outputs of a hidden Markov model, for which residual activations are known to linearly encode a belief distribution over latent states in a probability simplex.
papers.comment: HiLD 2026: 4th Workshop on High-dimensional Learning Dynamics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文假设深度学习中的行为缩放定律（scaling laws）与涌现机制（emergent mechanisms）存在关联，并通过训练小型Transformer预测隐马尔可夫模型输出，发现残差激活中编码信念分布的表示与性能缩放模式相关。摘要报告了初步证据支持这一假设。
Motivation: 现代深度学习表现出可预测的性能缩放定律和内部结构涌现，但两者之间的联系尚不明确。作者旨在探索行为变化是否源于内部计算结构的可预测变化。
Method: 训练小型Transformer来预测隐马尔可夫模型的输出，已知其残差激活在线性层面编码概率单纯形上的潜在状态信念分布，分析缩放模式与表示结构的相关性。
Result: 摘要报告在小型Transformer中观察到性能缩放模式与表示结构之间的相关性。
Conclusion: 初步证据表明行为缩放定律与内部计算结构变化存在联系，但需要进一步验证。

papers.title: ChronosAD: Leveraging Time Series Foundation Models for Accurate Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection is a crucial task in various domains, including finance, healthcare, and industry. However, existing methods often struggle to generalize across different datasets, especially when anomalies are subtle or context-dependent. To solve this issue, we introduce ChronosAD, a novel architecture for anomaly detection that uses a time series foundation model as a feature extractor. Specifically, it employs a two-stage pipeline: first, it uses the foundation model to extract embeddings for each time series in a zero-shot manner. Then, a custom-developed Temporal Block, composed of Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) and Multi-Head Attention, refines these embeddings to capture temporal dependencies and highlight salient patterns. Unlike previous approaches, our model requires minimal task-specific tuning and demonstrates robust generalization across a wide range of domains, including industrial, medical, cyber-physical, and automotive systems. Extensive experiments on 11 benchmarks show that ChronosAD outperforms existing methods by 4.72% in AUC and 6.60% in AP on average. The source code is available at https://github.com/intelligolabs/ChronosAD.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 24th IEEE International Conference on Industrial Informatics (INDIN) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronosAD 提出利用时间序列基础模型作为特征提取器进行异常检测。采用两阶段流程：先零样本提取嵌入，再通过由双向长短期记忆网络和多头注意力组成的时序模块细化嵌入，捕捉时间依赖并突出显著模式。在11个基准上平均AUC提升4.72%，AP提升6.60%，展现了跨工业、医疗等领域的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测方法难以跨数据集泛化，尤其是针对细微或上下文相关的异常。
Method: 两阶段架构：第一阶段使用时间序列基础模型零样本提取每个时间序列的嵌入；第二阶段通过BiLSTM和多头注意力组成的Temporal Block细化嵌入，捕捉时间依赖与显著模式。
Result: 在11个基准数据集上，AUC平均提升4.72%，AP平均提升6.60%，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该模型需极少任务特定微调，在工业、医疗、网宇物理和汽车系统等多个领域展现鲁棒泛化能力。

summary_sections.result: 在11个基准数据集上，AUC平均提升4.72%，AP平均提升6.60%，优于现有方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该模型需极少任务特定微调，在工业、医疗、网宇物理和汽车系统等多个领域展现鲁棒泛化能力。

papers.title: Don't Read Everything: A Curvature-Conditioned Query for Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention reduces the quadratic cost of softmax attention by maintaining a recurrent fast-weight state, but it consistently lags on in-context retrieval and long-context tasks. Existing remedies act on the write side of memory through gating, delta updates, or kernel feature maps, but the read step is left unchanged: every past key contributes additively to the output, so useful targets are diluted by the bulk of stored vectors. We borrow one specific piece of softmax's geometry to construct a cheap read-time contraction of the query. A second-order Taylor expansion of the softmax log-partition at the isotropic-attention point gives a local quadratic model whose curvature coincides with the running key covariance, a quantity that can be maintained with the same recurrent/chunkwise mechanism as the linear-attention state. The associated linear operator contracts the query along the high-density directions of memory before it reads the state. We call this mechanism Curvature-Conditioned Query (CCQ). CCQ modifies only the read step and is composable with any linear-attention backbone. Attached to GLA and Gated DeltaNet, it improves perplexity, zero-shot downstream accuracy, S-NIAH retrieval at and beyond the training context, length-extrapolation perplexity from 4K to 20K, and LongBench accuracy, at small extra cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出曲率条件查询（Curvature-Conditioned Query, CCQ），用于线性注意力机制。CCQ通过二阶泰勒展开近似softmax的几何特性，利用键协方差矩阵在读取前压缩查询向量，从而减少无关键的干扰。该方法仅修改读取步骤，可与GLA、Gated DeltaNet等线性注意力主干组合，在困惑度、零样本下游准确率、长上下文检索及长度外推等任务上取得一致提升，且额外计算成本很小。
Motivation: 现有线性注意力在长上下文检索任务中表现欠佳，因为读取步骤中每个过去键都叠加贡献，导致有用目标被大量存储向量稀释。
Method: 从softmax的几何中借鉴，在各向同性注意点处对softmax对数配分函数进行二阶泰勒展开，得到局部二次模型，其曲率等于运行键协方差矩阵。该矩阵可通过与线性注意力状态相同的循环/分块机制维护，其对应的线性算子在读取状态前沿内存高密度方向压缩查询。
Result: 在GLA和Gated DeltaNet上，CCQ提升了困惑度、零样本下游准确率、S-NIAH检索（训练上下文内及超出）、4K到20K长度外推困惑度以及LongBench准确率。
Conclusion: CCQ是一种轻量级的读取端改进，可组合到任何线性注意力骨干中，有效缓解长上下文检索中的稀释问题。

papers.title: ResNet-34 with Lightweight Decoder for Accurate and Efficient Segmentation of Fetal Brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of fetal brain tissues in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is critical for early diagnosis of congenital abnormalities and improving prenatal care. However, the task remains difficult because of fetal motion, low tissue contrast, and major anatomical variability throughout gestational ages, particularly in segmenting complex structures such as white matter, gray matter, lateral ventricles, deep gray matter, extra-cerebrospinal fluid, cerebellum, and brainstem. As a solution to these difficulties, this research introduces a novel deep learning model that combines a ResNet-34 encoder with a lightweight decoder leveraging multi-layer perceptron (MLP) modules for adaptive feature refinement. This design specifically enhances the model's ability to preserve anatomical boundaries and mitigate segmentation errors caused by motion artifacts and intensity inhomogeneities. Computational efficiency is achieved by reducing parameter count, employing bilinear upsampling instead of transposed convolutions, and optimizing the decoder for speed without sacrificing accuracy. Trained and validated on the FeTA 2021 dataset using 5-fold cross-validation, the proposed model outperforms baseline architectures such as UNet, UNet++, DeepLabV3, and DeepLabV3+, achieving an average Accuracy of 97.37% with a mean Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 90.33%, mean Intersection over Union (IoU) of 86.93%, and Precision of 90.83%. Additionally, its fast inference time and reduced computational load make it well-suited for integration into real-time clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对胎儿脑MRI分割中运动伪影、低对比度和解剖变异等挑战，提出一种结合ResNet-34编码器与轻量级MLP解码器的深度学习模型。该模型通过双线性上采样和参数优化实现高效推理，在FeTA 2021数据集上以5折交叉验证取得平均准确率97.37%、平均DSC 90.33%、平均IoU 86.93%的结果，优于UNet等基线方法。
Motivation: 胎儿脑MRI分割因运动伪影、组织对比度低和不同孕期的解剖变异而困难，现有方法对白质、灰质等复杂结构的分割精度不足，难以满足临床需求。
Method: 提出ResNet-34编码器配合轻量级MLP解码器的架构，通过多层感知机（MLP）模块进行自适应特征细化，采用双线性上采样替代转置卷积以减少参数量，优化解码器速度。
Result: 在FeTA 2021数据集上使用5折交叉验证，模型平均准确率97.37%，平均DSC 90.33%，平均IoU 86.93%，精确率90.83%，优于UNet、UNet++、DeepLabV3和DeepLabV3+。
Conclusion: 模型在保持高分割精度的同时实现了快速推理和低计算负载，适合集成到实时临床工作流中。

papers.title: What Makes a Strong Model? A Unified Spectral Analysis of Knowledge Transfer over High-dimensional Linear Regression
papers.abstract_en: Teacher-Student Knowledge Transfer (KT) is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, ranging from classical model compression via Knowledge Distillation (KD) to the emergent phenomenon of Weak-to-Strong (W2S) generalization. While existing studies offer isolated insights, a unified theoretical framework explaining the efficacy of KT across these disparate regimes remains lacking. In this work, we establish a unified spectral analysis of SGD dynamics in high-dimensional linear regression, elucidating the efficiency of KT across seemingly disparate regimes. We characterize KT efficiency through two distinct mechanisms: \emph{Spectral Horizon Expansion} in KD, which enables the capture of statistically inaccessible high-frequency signals, and \emph{Spectral Denoising} in W2S, where the student acts as a filter for optimization noise. Our framework unifies these phenomena, revealing that the efficacy of transfer is governed by the interplay between implicit regularization and heterogeneous spectral learning speeds over the spectrum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对知识迁移（KT）在不同机器学习范式（知识蒸馏与弱到强泛化）中有效性的统一理论问题，建立了高维线性回归下SGD动力学的频谱分析框架。摘要指出，KD通过频谱视界扩展捕获统计不可及的高频信号，而W2S通过频谱去噪过滤优化噪声，两者统一于隐式正则化与异质频谱学习速度的相互作用。
Motivation: 现有研究对知识迁移的有效性缺乏统一理论，无法解释知识蒸馏与弱到强泛化等不同范式下的成功机制。
Method: 在高维线性回归设定下，推导SGD动力学的频谱演化，并将KT效率分解为频谱视界扩展（KD）和频谱去噪（W2S）两种机制，利用隐式正则化进行统一分析。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果；理论贡献在于揭示了迁移效率由频谱结构决定，并统一了看似不同的KT现象。
Conclusion: 该工作强调迁移效率取决于隐式正则化与异质频谱学习速度的相互作用，为理解知识迁移提供了统一视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Algorithm for Distributed Reduction of Entanglements (QADR): A Trainable and Simulation-Efficient QML Framework
papers.abstract_en: Training Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) under Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) constraints introduces severe computational limitations: classical statevector simulation memory scales exponentially ($\mathcal{O}(2^n)$), and global cost functions suffer from barren plateaus where gradient variance decays exponentially ($\mathcal{O}(1/2^n)$). This paper introduces and evaluates the Quantum Algorithm for Distributed Reduction of Entanglements (QADR), a hybrid quantum-classical machine learning framework that decomposes a global $n$-qubit VQC into localized sub-circuits operating approximately within the causal light cones of individual target qubits. QADR reduces classical simulation memory scaling from $\mathcal{O}(2^n)$ to $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot 2^{2d+1})$ for a light cone radius $d$, while naturally mitigating global barren plateaus. We benchmark QADR against standard global VQCs, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and two customized classical parameter-matched neural networks (CANN and PMNN) on the MNIST dataset and the high-dimensional NASA IMS wind turbine drivetrain diagnostic task. QADR demonstrates excellent scalability, operating successfully at $n_{\text{features}}=2000$ where standard global VQCs crash due to memory exhaustion, while matching or exceeding the performance of optimized classical architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子算法用于分布式纠缠约简（QADR），一种混合量子-经典机器学习框架，将全局n量子比特变分量子电路（VQC）分解为因果光锥内的局部子电路，从而将经典模拟内存从O(2^n)降至O(n·2^(2d+1))，并缓解全局贫瘠高原问题。在MNIST和NASA IMS风力涡轮机诊断任务上，QADR在2000特征下成功运行（全局VQC因内存耗尽崩溃），且性能匹配或超越经典架构。
Motivation: 训练变分量子电路在含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）约束下面临计算限制：经典态矢量模拟内存指数增长（O(2^n)），且全局代价函数因贫瘠高原导致梯度方差指数衰减（O(1/2^n)）。
Method: QADR框架将全局n量子比特VQC分解为在目标量子比特因果光锥内局部运行的子电路，通过分布式约简降低模拟复杂度。
Result: 模拟内存从O(2^n)降至O(n·2^(2d+1))（d为光锥半径）；在MNIST和NASA IMS任务上，QADR在n_features=2000时成功运行（全局VQC崩溃），性能匹配或超越支持向量机（SVM）和参数匹配的经典神经网络（CANN和PMNN）。
Conclusion: QADR展示了在NISQ设备上的可扩展性和性能优势，为大规模量子机器学习提供了可行的混合框架。

papers.title: Feature to Dynamics: Feature-space to Autoregression strategy for Zero-shot Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot time series forecasting aims to predict future values for previously unseen series, requiring models to generalize temporal dynamics beyond the training distribution. While recent foundation models achieve strong in-domain performance through large-scale pretraining, their effectiveness often relies on broad data coverage and implicit pattern memorization, which can limit generalization when data are scarce or source and target domains are disjoint. In this work, we propose FSA, a feature-to-strategy framework for controlled zero-shot univariate forecasting. Instead of directly modeling raw sequences in the observation space, FSA learns a structured mapping from an interpretable feature space to an autoregressive strategy space. This design introduces explicit inductive biases that disentangle global trends, periodic components, and local temporal dynamics, enabling the model to capture transferable time-series structure with fewer data assumptions. Empirical results show that, under identical pretraining data, training protocol, and comparable parameter budgets, FSA outperforms Transformer-based architectures in our controlled zero-shot setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出零样本单变量时间序列预测框架FSA，通过学习从可解释特征空间到自回归策略空间的映射，显式分离全局趋势、周期分量和局部动态。在控制实验条件下，FSA使用相同的预训练数据和参数预算，性能优于Transformer架构。
Motivation: 现有零样本时间序列预测基础模型依赖大规模预训练和隐式模式记忆，在数据稀缺或源域与目标域差异大时泛化能力受限。
Method: 提出特征到自回归策略（Feature-to-Strategy, FSA）框架，学习从可解释特征空间到自回归策略空间的映射，引入显式归纳偏置以解耦趋势、周期和局部动态。
Result: 在控制零样本设置下，使用相同预训练数据、训练协议和可比参数预算，FSA在性能上优于基于Transformer的架构。
Conclusion: 通过结构化映射和显式归纳偏置，FSA能以更少数据假设捕捉可迁移的时间序列结构，提升零样本泛化能力。

papers.title: Beyond Visual Memory: Mechanistic Diagnostics of Latent Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent latent visual reasoning methods achieve substantial gains by inserting continuous latent tokens into multimodal language models. These gains are commonly attributed to the tokens encoding visual evidence; recent analyses, however, reveal a paradox: the tokens are loosely tied to the image and contribute little to the answer. Critically, these analyses treat latent tokens as a single unit, obscuring the true source of the gains. We therefore decompose latent tokens into three testable components: latent slots, boundary markers, and format, and develop a state-of-the-art method as a probe under favorable conditions. Across six method-stage settings and four perception-heavy benchmarks, latent slots fail every prediction of the visual-memory account. Strikingly, retaining only the boundary markers preserves 78 to 100% of the gain in several settings, while the model attends to the image more narrowly at latent positions than at answer positions. The gain therefore comes from boundary markers, format, and this attention pattern, not from latent slots. How each method engages this mechanism depends on its training supervision: at matched accuracy, mechanisms can still differ markedly. Latent visual reasoning thus needs evaluation not only by accuracy but by what the model actually relies on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多模态语言模型中插入的连续潜在令牌（latent tokens）的增益来源进行机制性诊断。通过将潜在令牌分解为潜在槽（latent slots）、边界标记（boundary markers）和格式（format）三个可测试组件，发现增益并非来自视觉记忆的潜在槽，而是来自边界标记、格式和注意力模式。不同训练监督方法即使达到相同准确率，其依赖的机制也可能显著不同。
Motivation: 现有分析将潜在令牌视为单一整体，掩盖了其增益的真正来源，且存在“令牌与图像关联薄弱但贡献大”的悖论。
Method: 将潜在令牌分解为潜在槽、边界标记和格式三个组件，并在六种方法-阶段设置和四个感知密集型基准上系统测试视觉记忆假说的每个预测。
Result: 潜在槽未能满足视觉记忆假说的任何预测；仅保留边界标记即可在多个设置中保留78-100%的增益，且模型在潜在位置对图像的关注比在答案位置更窄。
Conclusion: 潜在视觉推理的增益来自边界标记、格式和注意力模式，而非潜在槽；评估应不仅关注准确率，还需考察模型实际依赖的机制。

papers.title: BenchEvolver: Frontier Task Synthesis via Solution-Centric Evolution
papers.abstract_en: The rapid progress of frontier large language models has led to widespread benchmark saturation, limiting the ability of existing datasets to differentiate model capabilities or provide useful training signal. For instance, on LiveCodeBench, frontier models achieve over 99% Pass@1 on easy splits and exceed 90% Pass@1 on average across difficulty levels. Constructing new, challenging datasets typically requires substantial human effort, creating a bottleneck for progress. We introduce BenchEvolver, a solution-centric evolutionary framework that automatically transforms existing coding problems into harder variants. Rather than generating problems from scratch, BenchEvolver evolves reference solutions through structured transformations and derives corresponding statements and tests from the evolved solutions. This design grounds generation in executable semantics, enabling scalable construction of high-quality, diverse, and difficult tasks with verifiable correctness. Applying BenchEvolver to LiveCodeBench and SciCode, we obtain evolved tasks that are substantially harder while maintaining validity, reference correctness, and diversity. We further curate LiveCodeBench-Plus, a 91-problem benchmark combining evolved and difficult original LCB-v6 tasks, where frontier-model Pass@1 ranges from 27.5% to 62.6%, restoring clear discrimination among strong coding models. Importantly, evolved tasks remain challenging even for the model that generates them, enabling self-improvement. We further show that RL on evolved LCB tasks improves held-out coding performance: for gpt-oss-20b, seed+evolved training achieves +8.7 and +8.3 Pass@1 gains on LCB v6 Hard and LCB-Pro Easy, exceeding seed-only gains by 70.7% and 34.8%, respectively. Our results show that BenchEvolver can convert saturated benchmarks into frontier-level evaluation suites and reusable training signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BenchEvolver，一个以解决方案为中心的进化框架，自动将现有编程问题转化为更难的变体。通过演化参考解决方案并从中派生题目陈述与测试，可生成高难度、可验证的正确任务。在 LiveCodeBench 和 SciCode 上应用后，得到的进化任务显著更难且保持有效性。进一步构建的 LiveCodeBench-Plus 基准（91 题）中，前沿模型的 Pass@1 仅 27.5%-62.6%，恢复了强编码模型间的区分度。进化任务甚至对生成模型本身也具有挑战性，基于进化任务的强化学习可提升保留编码性能。
Motivation: 现有基准饱和，前沿模型在 LiveCodeBench 等上已接近满分（易题 99%+，平均 90%+），手动构建新数据集效率低，成为瓶颈。
Method: 提出 BenchEvolver，以解决方案为中心进行进化：对参考解决方案执行结构化变换，再从进化后的解决方案自动推导对应的题目陈述和测试用例，确保生成任务具有可执行语义和可验证正确性。
Result: 在 LiveCodeBench 和 SciCode 上，进化任务难度显著提高且保持有效性。构建的 LiveCodeBench-Plus（91 题）中，前沿模型 Pass@1 范围为 27.5%-62.6%。在 gpt-oss-20b 上，使用进化任务进行 RL 训练在 LCB v6 Hard 和 LCB-Pro Easy 上分别获得 +8.7 和 +8.3 Pass@1 增益，超过仅使用原始种子训练的增益 70.7% 和 34.8%。
Conclusion: BenchEvolver 可将饱和基准转化为前沿级评估套件和可复用的训练信号，支持自我改进。

papers.title: Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video generation has advanced rapidly in visual quality, but remains under-evaluated for factuality and practical usefulness. We introduce knowledge-intensive video generation (KIVI), where models generate videos from short information-seeking prompts that ask for explanations, procedures, or demonstrations. To evaluate this setting, we construct KIVI-Bench, a benchmark of 1,080 prompts, and propose automatic metrics for factuality and helpfulness. Human evaluation shows that our metrics significantly better align with human annotations than existing alternatives. Experiments on seven state-of-the-art video generation models show that current systems still lag behind human performance, especially on visual properties, procedural operations, and clear information presentation. These results highlight KIVI as a challenging direction for factual and instructionally useful video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识密集型视频生成（KIVI）任务，要求模型从短信息寻求提示生成解释、步骤或演示视频。构建了包含1080个提示的KIVI-Bench基准，并设计自动指标评估事实性和有用性。实验表明当前七个最优视频生成模型在视觉属性、程序操作和信息清晰度上仍落后于人类表现。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频生成在视觉质量上发展迅速，但对事实性和实际有用性评估不足，缺乏面向知识密集型任务的视频生成基准。
Method: 定义知识密集型视频生成任务，构建KIVI-Bench基准（1080个提示），并提出自动评估指标用于衡量事实性和有用性。
Result: 人类评估显示所提指标比现有替代方案更贴近人类判断；七个先进模型在KIVI-Bench上均低于人类水平，尤其在视觉属性、操作步骤和信息呈现清晰度方面差距显著。
Conclusion: KIVI是一个挑战性方向，当前模型在事实性和教学实用性上仍有较大提升空间。

papers.title: AdaKernel: Learning Adaptive Kernel Parameters for Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Modeling spatial dependencies is central to spatiotemporal data analysis using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Traditional methods rely on distance-based kernels with predefined parameters, which restricts model capacity. Although generic adaptive mechanisms (e.g., Graph Attention Networks) offer flexibility, they often fail to capture the underlying geometric structure, performing worse than distance-based models in data-sparse scenarios. Addressing this, we revisit the kernel parameterization problem and theoretically prove that misspecified kernel parameters introduce unavoidable approximation errors in GNNs. To overcome this, we propose AdaKernel, a simple yet effective approach that learns adaptive kernel parameters within the neural network. Unlike methods that learn graph structures from scratch, AdaKernel adopts a structure-preserving strategy that optimizes the scale of physical interactions rather than discarding them. Extensive experiments on Kriging, Imputation, and Forecasting demonstrate that AdaKernel consistently improves various GNN architectures and outperforms model-agnostic adaptive baselines, validating that accurately learned kernel parameters are superior to both fixed priors and fully latent graph structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AdaKernel，一种在时空图神经网络中学习自适应核参数的方法。理论证明错误预设的核参数会引入不可忽略的近似误差，为此采用结构保持策略优化物理交互尺度。在克里金、插补和预测任务上的实验表明，AdaKernel能够一致提升多种GNN架构的性能，优于固定先验和完全隐图结构。
Motivation: 距离基核的预设参数限制了模型容量，而通用自适应机制（如图注意力网络）在数据稀疏场景下难以捕捉几何结构，表现甚至不如距离基模型。
Method: AdaKernel通过在神经网络内部学习自适应核参数，采用结构保持策略优化物理交互尺度，而非从头学习图结构。
Result: 在克里金、插补和预测任务上，AdaKernel一致提升了多种GNN架构的性能，并优于模型不可知的自适应基线。
Conclusion: 准确学习的核参数优于固定先验和完全隐图结构，为时空图建模提供了有效的参数化方案。
