papers.title: PairedGTA: Generating Driving Datasets for Controlled Photometric Shift Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the performance of visual perception systems for autonomous driving is essential to ensure reliable operation across diverse environmental scenarios. Ideally, a balanced and fair analysis across different adverse conditions would require perfectly paired images of the same scene under different weather or illumination changes. This would allow evaluating the effect of photometric shifts independently of geometry and semantic changes. Unfortunately, real-world datasets rarely provide images of the same scene under different environmental conditions, because, normally, camera pose, traffic, and locations of dynamic objects (vehicles, pedestrians, etc.) vary over time, thus yielding only coarsely paired data. To address this challenge, this work introduces a data generation framework based on a high-fidelity game engine for extracting perfectly paired images. By leveraging software APIs that communicate with the GTA game engine, the framework modifies illumination and weather conditions while preserving scene geometry, camera pose, and the identity and placement of dynamic objects. For each sampled location, it procedurally instantiates dynamic entities and renders pixel-aligned images under diverse adverse conditions. The benefit of the proposed generation framework in driving scenarios is demonstrated through a systematic analysis of semantic segmentation models, whose output degradation can be attributed more directly to photometric shifts rather than to uncontrolled semantic or geometric factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PairedGTA框架，基于GTA游戏引擎生成完美配对的驾驶场景图像，在保持场景几何、相机姿态和动态物体不变的情况下，修改光照和天气条件。通过语义分割模型的系统分析，展示了该框架如何将输出退化更直接地归因于光度偏移而非语义或几何因素。
Motivation: 真实世界数据集难以提供同一场景在不同环境条件下的完美配对图像，因为相机姿态、交通和动态物体位置随时间变化，导致数据只能粗略配对，从而难以独立评估光度偏移的影响。
Method: 利用高保真游戏引擎（GTA）的软件API，修改光照和天气条件，同时保持场景几何、相机姿态和动态物体的身份与位置不变，程序化地生成像素对齐的图像。
Result: 通过语义分割模型的系统分析，展示了框架能够将输出退化更直接地归因于光度偏移，而不是不受控的语义或几何因素。
Conclusion: 该框架为自动驾驶视觉感知系统的公平评估提供了工具，尤其在不同环境条件下的性能分析中。

papers.title: The Case for Model Science: Verify, Explore, Steer, Refine
papers.abstract_en: We argue that the AI community is now ready to move beyond benchmarking and consolidate scattered efforts in model analysis into a systematic discipline, a direction we term Model Science. Complex AI models now serve billions of users, yet our understanding of how they work lags far behind our ability to deploy them. Decades of benchmark-driven research have delivered remarkable progress: extensive leaderboards, a wide range of performance metrics, tracking capability gains across diverse tasks; yet this success has also revealed the limits of benchmarks as they tell us whether models perform but not why they succeed or fail, they miss critical failure modes, such as hallucinations or shortcuts. Precedents from established sciences point the way forward: cognitive science shows that understanding complex systems requires complementary levels of analysis; neuroscience demonstrates that deep study of single cases reveals what population studies miss; medicine teaches that specialised training must develop alongside research practice; and agriculture models how shared infrastructure and principles enable cumulative progress. These lessons inform three foundations for Model Science. First, we propose to consolidate research around four functional perspectives: Verify, Explore, Steer, and Refine that address complementary questions about model behaviour. Second, we discuss the required infrastructure for cumulative knowledge: catalogues of datasets, models and findings. Third, we highlight the need for deep analysis of individual model instances, not just model families, because single cases can reveal what population studies miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张AI社区应超越基准测试，将模型分析整合为系统化学科——模型科学（Model Science）。通过借鉴认知科学、神经科学、医学和农业等领域的经验，提出围绕验证（Verify）、探索（Explore）、引导（Steer）和精炼（Refine）四个功能视角，以及必要的知识基础设施（数据集、模型、发现目录）和对单个模型实例的深入分析。
Motivation: 当前AI模型部署广泛，但对其工作机理的理解远落后于部署能力，基准测试只能反映性能却无法解释成功或失败的原因，且容易遗漏关键失效模式（如幻觉、捷径）。
Method: 提出Model Science框架，包括（1）四个互补的功能视角（Verify, Explore, Steer, Refine），（2）支持累积知识的基础设施（目录），（3）强调对单个模型实例的深度分析。
Result: 本文为观点性论文，未报告具体实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁社区从基准驱动转向模型科学，通过系统化的分析方法和共享基础设施，提升对复杂AI模型的理解。

papers.title: pcbGPT: Automatic PCB Schematic Synthesis from Natural Language Requirements
papers.abstract_en: Translating natural-language hardware requirements into correct printed circuit board (PCB) schematics remains difficult in embedded, IoT, and wearable development. Designers must choose compatible components, interpret datasheets, add support circuitry, and expose correct interfaces before layout and prototyping can begin, while many such circuits cannot be validated through straightforward simulation. We present pcbGPT, a grounded system for generating editable KiCad schematics from natural-language specifications. pcbGPT represents circuits in a Python DSL and combines tool-augmented synthesis with component-library search, datasheet-grounded design knowledge, execution-based checking, structural and semantic validation, and an interactive web workflow that supports iterative refinement and synchronization with KiCad projects. We evaluate the system on 20 embedded schematic-generation tasks with reference implementations, required components, and interface constraints that enable automatic comparison. The best model reaches overall pass@1 of 0.90 and pass@5 of 1.00; pass@1 is 1.00 on basic and easy tasks, 0.91 on medium tasks, and 0.72 on hard tasks. These results, together with failure analysis, show that pcbGPT can already generate useful, reviewable first-draft schematics for early prototyping, but is not yet reliable enough to replace expert review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: pcbGPT 是一个将自然语言硬件需求自动转换为可编辑 KiCad 原理图的系统。它使用 Python DSL 表示电路，结合工具增强合成、元件库搜索、数据手册知识、执行检查和验证，以及交互式 Web 工作流。在 20 个嵌入式原理图生成任务上，最佳模型达到了总体 pass@1 0.90 和 pass@5 1.00，但尚不能替代专家审查。
Motivation: 从自然语言硬件需求生成正确的 PCB 原理图在嵌入式、物联网和可穿戴设备开发中仍然困难，设计师需要手动选择兼容元件、解释数据手册、添加支持电路等，且许多电路无法通过简单仿真验证。
Method: 提出 pcbGPT，一个基于 Python DSL 的原理图生成系统，包含工具增强合成、元件库搜索、数据手册驱动的设计知识、基于执行的检查、结构和语义验证，以及交互式 Web 工作流（支持迭代精化和与 KiCad 项目同步）。
Result: 在 20 个嵌入式原理图生成任务上，最佳模型达到总体 pass@1 0.90、pass@5 1.00；基本和简单任务 pass@1 为 1.00，中等任务 0.91，困难任务 0.72。
Conclusion: pcbGPT 能够生成有用的初稿原理图以加速早期原型开发，但尚不足以替代专家审查，需要进一步改进。

papers.title: "Skill issues'': data-centric optimization of lakehouse agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are becoming users of data infrastructure, but their success depends not only on model quality: it also depends on the skills and environment files that teach agents how to use a system. We study how to optimize these artifacts for agents operating on a branching lakehouse, Bauplan. In our setting, headless APIs and Git-like data primitives expose data workflows through code, branches, commits, and merges. Our central observation is that a branching lakehouse turns data-agent evaluation from an output-matching problem into a state-verification problem: agent-generated pipeline code induces concrete, inspectable lakehouse changes. We present a data-centric optimization pipeline that generates task-verifier pairs, executes candidate skills in isolated sandboxes, and scores trajectories using both trace-level signals and programmatic checks over lakehouse state. In a preliminary evaluation on 25 tasks, optimized skills improve accuracy by 31.9%. These results suggest that write-path data workflows provide a useful substrate for optimizing agent skills beyond read-only tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何优化编码代理在分支数据湖（Bauplan）中的技能和环境文件。作者提出数据为中心的优化流程，将代理评估从输出匹配问题转化为状态验证问题，通过沙盒执行和轨迹评分（包括跟踪信号和编程检查）来生成任务-验证器对并优化技能。初步实验在25个任务上提升准确率31.9%，表明写路径数据工作流有助于优化代理技能。
Motivation: 编码代理的成功不仅依赖模型质量，还依赖教授代理如何使用系统的技能和环境文件，目前缺乏对这些工件的系统优化方法。
Method: 提出数据为中心的优化流程：利用Bauplan分支数据湖的Git-like原语，将代理生成的管道代码转化为可检查的湖仓状态变化；在隔离沙盒中执行候选技能，并使用跟踪信号和编程检查对轨迹进行评分，从而迭代优化技能。
Result: 在25个任务上的初步评估显示，优化后的技能准确率提升31.9%。
Conclusion: 作者认为写路径数据工作流为优化代理技能提供了有用基础，而不仅限于只读任务。

papers.title: CA-BED: Conversation-Aware Bayesian Experimental Design
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at static reasoning tasks, yet their performance often degrades in interactive scenarios where information must be actively acquired through questioning. A key challenge lies in selecting questions that reduce uncertainty while incorporating responses that may be ambiguous or only partially informative. To address this, we propose Conversation-Aware Bayesian Experimental Design (CA-BED), an inference-time probabilistic dialog planning framework that integrates Bayesian Experimental Design with LLM-based likelihood estimation to optimize question selection over multiple conversational turns. CA-BED maintains a belief distribution over hypotheses, anticipates possible answers, and propagates expected information gain through a simulated conversation tree. Across two structured entity-deduction benchmarks, CA-BED yields an average 21.8% improvement in success rates over direct prompting, with comparable gains relative to alternative information-seeking methods. It achieves these gains with an average increase of only 1.8 conversational turns compared to direct prompting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对话感知贝叶斯实验设计（CA-BED），一种推理时概率对话规划框架，将贝叶斯实验设计与基于LLM的似然估计相结合，以优化多轮对话中的问题选择。在两项结构化实体推理基准上，CA-BED相比直接提示平均提升21.8%的成功率，仅增加1.8轮对话。
Motivation: LLM在需要主动通过提问获取信息的交互场景中性能下降，现有方法难以选择能减少不确定性并处理模糊回答的问题。
Method: CA-BED维护关于假设的信念分布，预测可能答案，并通过模拟对话树传播期望信息增益，从而优化问题选择。
Result: 在两项结构化实体推理基准上，CA-BED平均成功率达到直接提示的121.8%，且对话轮次仅增加1.8轮。
Conclusion: CA-BED通过概率对话规划提升了交互式推理中LLM的信息获取效率，但实验限于结构化实体推理任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Entropy Prediction in Heterogeneous Systems: Thermodynamic and Information-Theoretic Case Studies
papers.abstract_en: Entropy production governs irreversibility and uncertainty in both physical and information-theoretic systems. While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) successfully solve differential equations, current architectures remain inherently domain-specific. The extraction of domain-invariant entropy representations across fundamentally different physical laws remains unexplored. This paper introduces a unified Physics-Informed Deep Learning (PIDL) framework that simultaneously enforces differential equation residuals and information-theoretic bounds within a single neural architecture. We demonstrate this framework via two canonical studies: (i) a thermodynamic continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) model solving governing ODEs, where a Softplus constraint strictly enforces the Second Law of Thermodynamics; and (ii) an information-theoretic financial market model solving the inverse Fokker-Planck PDE to infer latent drift and diffusion coefficients, guaranteeing diffusion positivity via a Softplus constraint while naturally inducing Shannon entropy. Three model variants are evaluated: two domain-specific baselines and one shared-encoder architecture. The PIDL framework guarantees absolute thermodynamic admissibility with zero Second-Law violations and exhibits exceptional data efficiency, retaining >90% predictive accuracy using merely 30% of available training data. Furthermore, a post-hoc Ruppeiner Riemannian geometric analysis of the learned entropy surface successfully identifies thermodynamic phase instabilities. This methodology provides a robust, domain-agnostic architecture for physics-constrained entropy modeling, advancing applications in sustainable process design and quantitative financial risk assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的物理信息深度学习（PIDL）框架，同时强制执行微分方程残差和信息论界限，用于异构系统中的熵预测。通过热力学CSTR模型（强制第二定律）和信息论金融市场模型（推断漂移和扩散系数）两个案例验证，该框架保证零违反热力学第二定律，且仅用30%训练数据即保持>90%预测精度。后验Ruppeiner几何分析能识别热力学相不稳定性。
Motivation: 现有物理信息神经网络（PINNs）具有领域特异性，缺乏跨不同物理定律的域不变熵表示提取方法，无法统一处理热力学和信息论系统的熵预测。
Method: 提出统一的PIDL框架，在单一神经网络架构中同时强制执行微分方程残差和信息论约束。采用Softplus约束严格保证热力学第二定律（CSTR案例）和扩散系数正定性（金融市场案例），并比较三种模型变体（两个领域特定基线和一个共享编码器架构）。
Result: PIDL框架在CSTR案例中实现零第二定律违反，在金融市场案例中通过Softplus约束自然诱导香农熵；仅用30%训练数据即可保留>90%预测精度。后验Ruppeiner几何分析成功识别热力学相不稳定性。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种领域无关的物理约束熵建模架构，可应用于可持续过程设计和量化金融风险评估，但需注意其熵预测能力仅在两个案例中验证。

papers.title: Temporal Motif Signatures for Temporal Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Real temporal interaction streams carry predictive structure in short-horizon motif patterns -- repetition, reciprocity, star diversity, triadic flow -- that vanilla temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) often fail to expose to their edge scorers. We show this concretely on MOOC interaction prediction, where a small four-feature family of past-window star counts already delivers most of the lift over a strong static GNN. Across a wide set of real and synthetic temporal datasets we find that motif activity organizes consistently along three scale-stable axes (dyadic recency/reciprocity, star diversity, triadic flow), and we use this empirical structure to design a compact 13-coordinate, leakage-safe, candidate-local motif feature map h(u, v, t) that linearly embeds into any static or temporal encoder without architectural changes. A temporal Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) analysis places the augmentation relative to the first level of an anchored temporal-WL hierarchy and exhibits a candidate-anchored pair on which motif features distinguish. We demonstrate empirically that the same augmentation consistently lifts performance across heterogeneous tasks: TGB link-property prediction across all five baselines, edge classification on Bitcoin Alpha/OTC and MOOC, and graph-level classification of synthetic temporal generators.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Reusing Fusion-Time Spectral Reliability for Adaptive Fusion and Expert Routing in RGB-Infrared Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: RGB-infrared detectors typically discard the statistics generated during cross-modal fusion, leaving downstream modules unaware of whether the current interaction is reliable. We propose to extract a parameter-free, 7-dimensional spectral reliability descriptor -- summarizing band energy, amplitude ratio, phase consistency, and cross-modal correlation -- and to reuse it beyond the fusion stage. The descriptor drives both Spectral Reliability Fusion (SRF), which gates a spectral residual against a conservative spatial base, and Reliability-Conditioned Expert Routing (RCER), which combines the descriptor with pooled content to steer sparse post-fusion experts. Under matched ablations, descriptor-aware gating improves mAP50 over content-only adaptive gating; a $2{\times}2$ factorial analysis further shows that descriptor-conditioned routing provides the larger marginal gain over expert architecture alone at near-equal parameter count. Under six synthetic degradations on DroneVehicle, average retention rises to 95.0%, versus 92.0% for content-only MoE and 87.9% for concatenation, with the largest gain under modality drop; the same model also improves mAP50 by +5.2/+5.3 on the natural day/night split. These results suggest that preserving fusion-time reliability as an explicit signal benefits both adaptive fusion and post-fusion conditional computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在RGB-红外目标检测中，提取融合阶段的光谱可靠性描述符（7维，包含频带能量、振幅比、相位一致性和跨模态相关性），并将其复用于自适应融合和专家路由。该方法通过频谱可靠性融合（SRF）和可靠性条件专家路由（RCER）改善了模型的鲁棒性，在DroneVehicle数据集上超过基于内容的门控方法和拼接基线。
Motivation: 现有RGB-红外检测器在融合后丢弃了融合阶段的统计信息，导致下游模块无法判断当前交互是否可靠。
Method: 提取一个无参数的7维光谱可靠性描述符，同时驱动SRF（频谱可靠性融合，用描述符门控频谱残差和空间基底的融合）和RCER（可靠性条件专家路由，将描述符与池化内容结合指导稀疏后融合专家）。
Result: 在DroneVehicle数据集上，描述符感知门控在mAP50上优于纯内容自适应门控；2×2因子分析表明描述符条件路由在参数相近时比专家架构本身提供更大的边际增益。在六种合成退化下，平均保留率（retention）达95.0%，优于纯内容MoE的92.0%和拼接的87.9%。在自然昼夜分割上mAP50提升+5.2/+5.3。
Conclusion: 保留融合时刻的可靠性作为显式信号有益于自适应融合和后融合条件计算。

papers.title: Revisiting Neural Processes via Fourier Transform and Volterra Series
papers.abstract_en: Modeling unknown latent functions from finite, irregularly sampled measurements is a recurring challenge across science and engineering. Neural processes (NPs), a family of probabilistic functional models, are promising solutions -- especially when endowed with domain-specific symmetries like translation equivariance, which improve sample efficiency and generalization. Yet existing translation-equivariant NPs face two limitations: (i) they stack generic components with non-linearities, obscuring the induced function class and limiting interpretability; and (ii) convolutional designs rely on kernels with local receptive fields and require dense uniform input grids, while attention-based methods avoid these issues but scale quadratically with the number of observations. We address both with two contributions. First, using the Volterra expansion, we characterize continuous translation-equivariant operators as sums of higher-order convolutions, yielding analytical transparency while admitting efficient approximation by first-order convolutions. Second, we introduce set Fourier convolutions (SFConvs), a frequency-domain parameterization that operates directly on irregularly sampled points, achieves approximately global receptive fields, and scales linearly in the number of observations. Building on these ideas, we propose two conditional NPs (CNPs): SFConvCNPs, which stack SFConv blocks with non-linearities, and SFVConvCNPs, which integrate the Volterra formulation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate our methods' efficacy against state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用Volterra级数将连续平移等变算子刻画为高阶卷积和，并提出set Fourier卷积（SFConvs）以在频域参数化，直接处理不规则采样点，实现近似全局感受野和线性复杂度。基于此构建了两种条件神经过程（SFConvCNP和SFVConvCNP），在合成和真实数据集上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有平移等变神经过程存在两个局限：堆叠非线性组件导致函数类不透明且可解释性差；卷积设计依赖局部感受野和均匀输入网格，而注意力方法在观测数上二次缩放。需要更透明且高效的平移等变神经过程。
Method: 利用Volterra级数将连续平移等变算子表示为高阶卷积和，并用一阶卷积高效近似；提出set Fourier卷积（SFConvs），在频域参数化，直接操作于不规则采样点，实现近似全局感受野和线性复杂度。基于此构建两种条件神经过程：SFConvCNP（堆叠SFConv块加非线性）和SFVConvCNP（整合Volterra公式）。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，所提方法优于现有最先进基线。
Conclusion: 通过结合平移等变性的Volterra和傅里叶方法，实现了可解释性与效率的平衡，并适用于不规则采样数据。

papers.title: AI From the Margins (AIM): Rethinking Participatory AI Design Through the Lived Experience of Minoritized Communities
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) can reproduce and amplify the structural inequities faced by minoritized communities. Participatory AI has been proposed as a response, but participation typically starts after problem definitions and success criteria have been set, leaving limited room for minoritized communities to reshape what an AI system is for. We propose AI From the Margins (AIM): a methodological stance that articulates the conditions under which lived experiences of minoritized communities can be elicited, centered, and carried forward to inform participatory AI design. AIM is not a fixed protocol; it articulates a set of preconditions that can be enacted through different techniques in different settings. We applied AIM in a Dutch healthcare context in eight sessions with 13 women and non-binary people of color and five municipal policy workers, namely through (1) narrative elicitation using the Biographic Narrative Interpretive Method (BNIM); (2) co-constructed rule-making; (3) participants' determination of whether, where, and how AI should be involved; and (4) translating lived experience into AI policy through dialogue with policymakers. In their reflections on the sessions, participants described the engagement as substantive and called for its continuation, demonstrating how preparatory orientation fundamentally grounded in lived experience shapes what participatory AI design is for.
papers.comment: Under review at the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AI From the Margins (AIM)方法论，旨在通过边缘化社区的生活经验来重新思考参与式AI设计。该方法不是固定协议，而是阐述了一系列前提条件，并通过在荷兰医疗保健背景下与13名有色人种女性和非二元性别者及5名市政政策工作者的八次会谈中实施，包括叙事启发、共同制定规则、参与者决定AI的参与方式以及将生活经验转化为AI政策。参与者的反馈表明这种参与是实质性的。
Motivation: 现有参与式AI设计通常从问题定义和成功标准设定后才开始参与，留给边缘化社区重塑AI系统目的的空间有限。
Method: 提出AIM方法论，阐述引发、集中和推进边缘化社区生活经验的前提条件，并通过具体技术（如BNIM、共同规则制定等）在不同场景中实施。
Result: 在荷兰医疗保健背景下，参与者在会谈中描述参与是实质性的，并呼吁继续。
Conclusion: 以生活经验为基础的预备性取向从根本上塑造了参与式AI设计的目的。

papers.title: Towards Interactive Video World Modeling: Frontiers, Challenges, Benchmarks, and Future Trends
papers.abstract_en: With rapid development of large language models and diffusion-based content generation, world modeling has attracted increasing research attention, benefiting various downstream domains such as game engines, embodied AI, autonomous driving, etc. Through explicitly incorporating user actions into world state transition, recent literature empowers world modeling with interactivity in an action-conditioned video or 3D generation paradigm, further enhancing controllability over world evolutions and facilitating users to freely traverse, manipulate, navigate, and personalize the state evolution. In this paper, we aim to systematically review recent research trends, technical developments, evaluation benchmarks, and also propose future potential directions in interactive world modeling. Specifically, we first summarize recent efforts and trends in terms of application scenarios, world state evolution, and scene modality. Afterwards, we delve into three crucial technical challenges, including action-conditioned controllability, long-horizon interactions and memory, and action-following responsiveness for real-time interactivity. Furthermore, we also thoroughly compare existing benchmarks and metrics in four specific application fields: open-world exploration, game engine, autonomous driving, and robotics. Finally, we discuss several promising future directions in achieving next-generation interactive world modeling. The corresponding repository is publicly available at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Awesome-Interactive-World-Model.

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了交互式世界建模的研究趋势、技术发展、评估基准和未来方向，强调将用户动作显式融入世界状态转移，以动作条件化的视频或3D生成范式实现交互性，从而增强对世界演化的可控性。摘要涵盖应用场景、技术挑战（包括动作条件可控性、长程交互与记忆、实时响应性）以及四个应用领域（开放世界探索、游戏引擎、自动驾驶、机器人）的基准比较。
Motivation: 随着大规模语言模型和扩散生成技术的发展，世界建模引起了广泛关注，但现有工作往往缺乏交互性。本文旨在系统回顾将用户动作融入世界状态转移的交互式世界建模研究，推动其在游戏、具身AI、自动驾驶等领域的应用。
Method: 本文是一篇综述论文，从应用场景、世界状态演化、场景模态三个角度总结近期工作，并深入分析三个关键技术挑战：动作条件可控性、长程交互与记忆、以及实时交互的动作跟随响应性。同时比较了四个应用领域的现有基准和评估指标。
Result: 摘要总结了过去的研究趋势、技术进展和评估基准，并提出了未来潜在方向。未提供具体的定量结果。
Conclusion: 本文指出了实现下一代交互式世界建模的几个有希望的未来方向，并提供了相关资源仓库。

papers.title: Expected Value Alignment for Generative Reward Modeling in Formal Mathematics Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used with formal interactive theorem provers such as Lean 4. Scaling these systems with reinforcement learning or search methods requires process reward models (PRMs) that can evaluate intermediate reasoning steps. Existing reward-model designs expose a practical trade-off. Value-head models provide continuous scores but modify the generative model interface, while generative reward models preserve textual rationales but are poorly matched to continuous floating-point regression because numeric values are split across tokens. We introduce Expected Value Alignment (EVA), a reward-modeling procedure that keeps the surface output discrete while extracting continuous scores from the model's token distribution. The model emits integer scores in a structured JSON format, and EVA computes a continuous score as the expectation over the logits of the corresponding anchor tokens. Training combines the causal language modeling objective with an auxiliary mean squared error loss on these expected values. We instantiate EVA in \textit{Leibniz}, a reward model for Lean 4 formal verification, and evaluate it against zero-shot and reward-modeling baselines. The evaluation demonstrates that continuous logit-based scoring significantly reduces discretization artifacts while retaining the interpretability of generative critiques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文提出期望值对齐（EVA）方法，用于形式数学验证中的生成式奖励建模，在保持离散输出可解释性的同时，从模型 token 分布中提取连续分数，并在 Lean 4 验证任务中减少离散化伪影。
Motivation: 现有奖励模型在连续分数与离散输出之间存在权衡：值头模型修改生成接口，而生成式奖励模型因数值被分割到多个 token 导致与连续回归不匹配。
Method: 提出 EVA 程序，模型以结构化 JSON 格式输出整数分数，并通过对应锚点 token 的 logits 期望计算连续分数；训练结合因果语言建模目标和辅助均方误差损失。
Result: 在 Lean 4 形式验证任务上，基于 logit 的连续评分显著减少离散化伪影，同时保持生成式批判的可解释性。
Conclusion: EVA 方法有效桥接了离散生成与连续评分之间的鸿沟，为形式数学验证中的过程奖励模型提供了新的设计方向。

summary_sections.conclusion: EVA 方法有效桥接了离散生成与连续评分之间的鸿沟，为形式数学验证中的过程奖励模型提供了新的设计方向。

papers.title: Fairness in two-player zero-sum games with bandit feedback
papers.abstract_en: We study two-player zero-sum games (TPZSGs) with bandit feedback under fairness constraints requiring every action to be played with probability at least $α/m$. Existing instance-dependent results target $\textit{pure}$ Nash equilibria, while fairness generically produces $\textit{mixed}$ equilibria, a harder learning target. Our key technical tool is a reparametrization: every fair strategy decomposes as $p = (α/m)\mathbf{1} + (1-α)\widetilde{p}$ with $\widetilde{p} \in Δ_m$, and substituting into the payoff form yields $p^{\top}Aq = \widetilde{p}^{\top}\widetilde{A} q$ for a fair payoff matrix $\widetilde{A} := (1-α)A + α\mathbf{1} c^{\top}$, where $c_j = \tfrac{1}{m}\sum_i A(i,j)$ is the column-mean vector. The fair game on $A$ is then equivalent to a standard zero-sum game on $\widetilde{A}$, so equilibrium existence, KKT structure, and LP basis stability reduce to classical results applied to $\widetilde{A}$. We derive the fair minimax value, fair Nash equilibrium, fair regret, and a clean dual representation showing the price of fairness is at most $α(1-1/m)$ and vanishes whenever the unconstrained equilibrium already has full support. Our main result is an $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret bound for an Explore-Then-Commit algorithm, $\texttt{Fair-ETC-TPZSG}$, applicable to general mixed fair equilibria, together with a discussion of why naive action elimination does not readily improve it. When the fair equilibrium has a single dominant action, equivalently when $\widetilde{p}^{\star}$ is a vertex of $Δ_m$, the bound sharpens to instance-dependent $\widetilde{O}(1/\widetildeΔ(α)^{2})$, where $\widetildeΔ(α)$ is the LP-margin gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带公平约束的两人零和博弈（TPZSG）中的bandit反馈问题，要求每个动作以至少α/m的概率被选择。通过重新参数化将公平博弈转化为标准零和博弈，推导出公平极小化值、公平纳什均衡、公平遗憾以及公平代价的上界，并给出Explore-Then-Commit算法的遗憾界。
Motivation: 现有实例相关的结果只针对纯纳什均衡，而公平约束通常产生混合均衡，学习目标更困难。需要为公平约束下的TPZSG设计算法并分析其遗憾。
Method: 提出重新参数化方法：公平策略分解为p = (α/m)1 + (1-α)̃p，代入支付函数得到公平支付矩阵̃A = (1-α)A + α1c^T，将公平博弈等价于̃A上的标准零和博弈。然后设计Explore-Then-Commit算法Fair-ETC-TPZSG。
Result: 公平代价最多为α(1-1/m)，当无约束均衡已有全支持时消失。主要结果为Fair-ETC-TPZSG算法的Õ(T^{2/3})遗憾界，当公平均衡只有一个主导动作时，遗憾界可改进为实例相关的Õ(1/̃Δ(α)^2)。
Conclusion: 通过重新参数化将公平博弈简化为标准博弈，为公平约束下的TPZSG提供了理论分析框架和遗憾界。

papers.title: HiTokSR: A Coarse-to-Fine Tokenizer with Hierarchical Codebooks for High-Fidelity Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Vector-quantized (VQ) generative models have shown promising results in real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR). However, existing methods typically rely on a monolithic latent space that entangles low-frequency structures with high-frequency textures. This entanglement forces a single codebook to capture a combinatorially complex set of structure-texture pairings, which constrains representational capacity and limits codebook utilization. To address this issue, we present HiTokSR, a hierarchical token prediction framework. Instead of using a single codebook, HiTokSR partitions the latent space along the channel dimension into frequency-aware groups, quantizing each with an independent sub-codebook. This coarse-to-fine design disentangles global structures from fine details, enhancing combinatorial expressiveness while circumventing the optimization instability of high-dimensional nearest-neighbor lookups. To further improve semantic consistency, our generator integrates priors from a vision foundation model via adaptive feature modulation, multi-scale class tokens, and a representation alignment loss. Additionally, we introduce an index-level perturbation strategy during decoder fine-tuning to bridge the train-test discrepancy in discrete token prediction. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that HiTokSR achieves state-of-the-art performance in both perceptual quality and reconstruction fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiTokSR，一种分层token预测框架，用于真实世界图像超分辨率。它将潜空间按通道维度划分为频率感知的组，每个组使用独立子码本量化，从而解耦全局结构与细粒度纹理。生成器集成了视觉基础模型先验（自适应特征调制、多尺度类token和表示对齐损失），并在解码器微调时引入索引级扰动策略以缓解训练-测试差异。在真实世界基准上，该方法在感知质量和重建保真度上均达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有VQ生成模型使用单一潜空间，导致低频结构与高频纹理纠缠，一个码本需捕获复杂的结构-纹理组合，限制了表示能力和码本利用率。
Method: 提出HiTokSR分层token预测框架，将潜空间沿通道维度划分为多个频率感知的组，每个组用独立子码本量化，实现粗到细的解耦。生成器利用视觉基础模型先验，通过自适应特征调制、多尺度类token和表示对齐损失增强语义一致性。解码器微调时采用索引级扰动策略来弥合离散token预测中的训练-测试差异。
Result: 在真实世界图像超分辨率基准上，HiTokSR在感知质量和重建保真度方面均取得了最先进的性能。
Conclusion: 通过层次化码本和频率解耦设计，HiTokSR提升了VQ生成模型在真实世界超分辨率中的表现，并有效缓解了训练与测试之间的不一致问题。

papers.title: When Data Is Scarce: Scaling Sparse Language Models with Repeated Training
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws for dense LLMs under infinite data are well explored, but how sparsity interacts with limited data is not. In this work, we study sparse training in data-constrained regimes where limited unique tokens require multi-epoch training. Our experiments span models up to 1.92B parameters in the fitting set, sparsity up to 93.75%, unique data budgets up to 2.6B tokens, and total training tokens up to 41.6B over 16 epochs; we further validate extrapolation on held-out dense-equivalent models up to 7.68B parameters. We find that: 1. Sparse scaling in data-limited settings: We introduce a scaling law that models loss as a function of active parameters, unique tokens, data repetition, and sparsity, accurately predicting performance across compute and data budgets. 2. Delayed data saturation: sparse training postpones diminishing returns from repeated data, making multi-epoch training more effective. 3. Resource trade-offs: With fixed data, loss-optimal sparsity is moderate ~ 50%, while compute-optimal sparsity is higher and grows with data scale. Overall, sparsity is not just a tool for efficiency, but a mechanism for improving scaling trade-offs under data scarcity. Our code is available at: https://github.com/boqian333/sparse-dc-scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据稀缺条件下稀疏语言模型的多轮训练行为，提出一个稀疏缩放定律，发现稀疏训练可延缓数据饱和效应，并揭示损失最优稀疏度与计算最优稀疏度的不同偏好。
Motivation: 现有密集大模型的缩放定律在无限数据下已充分探索，但稀疏训练与有限数据（需多轮训练）的交互机制尚不明确，论文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 通过系统实验（模型最高1.92B参数、稀疏度最高93.75%、唯一数据预算最高2.6B token、总训练token最高41.6B共16轮），提出一个以活跃参数、唯一token数、数据重复次数和稀疏度为变量的缩放定律，并外推至7.68B参数密集等效模型验证。
Result: 稀疏训练能延缓重复数据带来的收益递减，使多轮训练更有效；在固定数据下损失最优稀疏度约为50%，而计算最优稀疏度更高且随数据规模增长。
Conclusion: 稀疏性不仅是效率工具，更是数据稀缺下改善缩放权衡的机制，但实验限于特定模型规模和稀疏度范围，外推至更大规模尚需验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ASE-26: a curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline
papers.abstract_en: The work of a professional software engineer has begun to consist, increasingly, of directing agents rather than writing code, and the empirical evidence for the shift is now several years deep. Anthropic's Economic Index puts automation at 79 per cent of Claude Code interactions [2]; Handa and colleagues at Anthropic find AI exposure for Computer Programmer tasks at approximately 75 per cent of the role's distinct activities [3]; Brynjolfsson and colleagues at Stanford's Digital Economy Lab report a 13 per cent relative decline in employment for workers aged 22 to 25 in occupations most exposed to AI [4]. The shift is also unfinished, and the academic literature on agentic software engineering converges on the finding that the missing capability is not better models but structured practitioner discipline. This paper presents ASE-26, a comprehensive undergraduate curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline, deposited as a citable reference on Zenodo under CC BY-ND 4.0 [12]. The paper sets out the discipline framing the curriculum rests on, the conceptual contributions it makes (most importantly, the evolutionary spiral as the operational form of the co-evolution of intent and build), the twenty-one-module structure that organises the discipline for teaching, the pedagogical commitments that follow from grading work co-produced with an agent, what graduates leave with, and how the discipline as taught is designed to outlast the specific capabilities of today's models. The position the paper takes is that the practitioner skills the industry currently lacks are precisely the skills the discipline names, and that structured undergraduate curricula in agentic software engineering are the principal mechanism by which the gap closes.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 20 references. Companion paper to the ASE-26 curriculum deposited on Zenodo at doi:10.5281/zenodo.20468021. Part 1 of a planned series of two pre-prints on the curriculum and its conceptual core
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ASE-26，一个面向本科生的人工智能代理软件工程（agentic software engineering）课程体系，旨在培养行业当前缺乏的代理式软件工程实践技能。论文阐述了课程所基于的学科框架、核心概念贡献（如意图与构建协同进化的进化螺旋）、21个模块的结构、与代理合作产出评分所带来的教学承诺，以及该课程如何设计以超越当前模型的具体能力。
Motivation: 软件工程师的工作越来越多地转向指导代理而非编写代码，但学术文献表明缺失的能力并非更好的模型，而是结构化的从业者纪律。现有教育体系缺乏培养此类技能的本科课程。
Method: 提出了一个完整的本科课程体系ASE-26，包含21个模块，以进化螺旋为核心概念，并考虑了与AI代理合作产出时的教学承诺和评分方法。
Result: 课程已作为可引用的参考资料存放在Zenodo上（CC BY-ND 4.0）。论文描述了毕业生应具备的技能和课程如何超越当前模型能力。
Conclusion: 论文认为行业目前缺乏的从业者技能正是该课程所命名的技能，结构化的本科课程是缩小这一差距的主要机制。

papers.title: Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering: Latent Reinforcement Learning for Generative Policies
papers.abstract_en: Behavior cloning with high-capacity generative policies achieves strong imitation performance, but is often limited by demonstration coverage and distribution shift. Direct reinforcement learning fine-tuning can improve performance, but updating large action decoders is frequently unstable and sample inefficient. We propose Lagrangian Perturbation Diffusion Steering (LP-DS), a lightweight adaptation method that improves a frozen generative policy by learning a compact noise-space perturbation before decoding. LP-DS optimizes this perturbation with a Lagrangian trust-region objective, improving downstream value while constraining deviation from the latent prior. Across RoboMimic manipulation, OpenAI Gym locomotion, and Adroit dexterous manipulation benchmarks, LP-DS improves sample efficiency, success, and return while maintaining higher action-space entropy than unconstrained noise-space steering, with return improvements of up to 25% over prior baselines. Additional evaluations with flow-matching backbones, a large vision-language-action model, and physical Franka deployment show that LP-DS is not limited to compact diffusion policies or simulated benchmarks. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/lp-ds/home.
papers.comment: Accepted as a regular paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出拉格朗日扰动扩散引导（LP-DS），一种轻量级方法，通过在学习解码前的紧凑噪声空间扰动来改进冻结的生成策略。LP-DS使用拉格朗日信任区域目标优化该扰动，在约束潜在先验偏差的同时改善下游价值。在RoboMimic、OpenAI Gym和Adroit等多个基准上，LP-DS提高了样本效率、成功率和回报，回报改进高达25%，并保持比无约束噪声空间引导更高的动作空间熵。额外评估表明LP-DS不限于紧凑扩散策略或模拟基准。
Motivation: 行为克隆的高容量生成策略受限于演示覆盖和分布偏移，直接强化学习微调大动作解码器不稳定且样本效率低。
Method: 提出LP-DS，通过学习一个紧凑的噪声空间扰动来改进冻结的生成策略，使用拉格朗日信任区域目标优化扰动，同时改善下游价值和约束潜在先验偏差。
Result: 在RoboMimic、OpenAI Gym和Adroit基准上，LP-DS提高了样本效率、成功率和回报，回报改进高达25%，并保持更高动作空间熵。额外评估扩展到流匹配骨干、大视觉语言动作模型和物理Franka部署。
Conclusion: LP-DS是一种轻量级适应方法，能够改进冻结的生成策略，且不限于紧凑扩散策略或模拟基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoSTL: Comprehensive Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection
papers.abstract_en: Video Moment Retrieval (MR) and Highlight Detection (HD) are crucial tasks in video analysis that aim to localize specific moments and estimate clip-wise relevance based on a given text query. Recent approaches treat them as similar video grounding tasks and use the same architecture to solve them. These tasks require both fine-grained comprehension at the image level and high-level temporal understanding across the entire video. Existing approaches have primarily focused on temporal modeling using frame-level features, often neglecting the rich visual information related to the text query within individual frames. This oversight leads to inaccurate grounding results. To address this limitation, we propose a Comprehensive Spatial-Temporal Representation Learning Framework (CoSTL), which captures both fine-grained image-level information and temporal dynamics. Specifically, CoSTL incorporates a text-driven progressive fine-grained image encoder, performing a two-step text-driven knowledge extraction process to learn fine-grained spatial representations. Furthermore, a multi-scale temporal perception module captures comprehensive spatial-temporal representations, enhancing the model's ability to process temporal dynamics. We demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on four public benchmarks: QVHighlights, Charades-STA, TACoS, and TVSum.

papers.title: Reasoning4Sciences: Bridging Reasoning Language Models to All Scientific Branches
papers.abstract_en: While Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) are rapidly emerging as powerful tools for scientific research, their impact is primarily concentrated in "hard science" fields. The slow -- or lack of -- adoption of RLMs in other branches of science is causing a widening gap in research productivity. In this survey, we provide the first comprehensive analysis of RLM adoption across 28 scientific disciplines following the classification used by the European Research Council (ERC), spanning the Social Sciences and Humanities, Physical Sciences and Engineering, and Life Sciences. We examine how RLMs are developed, evaluated, and applied across disciplines. Furthermore, we introduce a maturity-oriented assessment framework based on available domain-specific development and evaluation resources, revealing substantial disparities in RLM maturity that become even more pronounced when only publicly available resources are considered. Finally, we highlight current implementation paradigms that are gaining popularity across disciplines, current challenges, and future directions in enabling RLM adoption across science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首篇全面调查推理语言模型（RLM）在28个科学学科（按欧洲研究委员会分类）中采用情况的综述。分析了RLM的开发、评估和应用方式，提出了一个基于领域特定开发和评估资源的成熟度评估框架，揭示了学科间的巨大差异，并讨论了当前挑战和未来方向。
Motivation: RLM在硬科学领域应用广泛，但在其他科学分支的采用缓慢，导致研究生产力差距扩大，因此需要系统了解RLM在不同学科中的现状。
Method: 基于ERC的28个学科分类，综述RLM的开发、评估和应用，并引入一个以领域特定资源为基础的成熟度评估框架。
Result: 发现各学科RLM成熟度存在显著差异，在仅考虑公开资源时差异更为突出。
Conclusion: 强调了跨学科采用RLM的挑战和未来方向，旨在推动RLM在全部科学领域的应用。

papers.title: AMP: A Vendor-Neutral Wire Format for Agent Memory Operations
papers.abstract_en: Agent-memory frameworks - mem0, Letta/MemGPT, Cognee, Zep/Graphiti, MemoryOS, MemTensor - each ship their own SDK, storage layout, and operational vocabulary. There is no shared wire format: every integration is bespoke, every migration rebuilds memory from scratch, and no framework ships a governance surface that lets a human review writes before they enter long-term storage. We present memorywire, a JSON-Schema 2020-12 wire format for five memory operations (remember, recall, forget, merge, expire) over four memory types (semantic, episodic, procedural, emotional), with a MemoryStore interface, a fan-out router, and an optional HITL governance channel. We describe an open-source reference implementation with five backend adapters (sqlite-vec, mem0, Letta, Cognee, pgvector); a microbenchmark on a 100-fact / 50-query labelled corpus achieving recall@5 = 1.000 on the 42 labelled queries with ingest p50 = 37.8 ms and recall p50 = 40.6 ms; an adversarial-fusion experiment showing Reciprocal Rank Fusion holds recall@5 = 1.000 across a 1-of-N rank-0 injection sweep (K in {0,5,...,50}) where max fusion collapses to 0.500 with 80% leak at K >= 5; and a 16-scenario cross-adapter conformance suite passing 68 of 80 cells with zero failures. The contribution is not a new algorithm; it is a packaging of established components (RRF, FSMs, STM/LTM consolidation, diff-and-approve workflows) into a venue-neutral protocol with an empirically validated reference, positioned to compose with the Model Context Protocol rather than compete with it.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Reference implementation with 5 backend adapters (sqlite-vec, mem0, Letta, Cognee, pgvector), governance UI, microbench, adversarial-fusion experiment, 16-scenario conformance suite, threat model, and preliminary LongMemEval + LoCoMo numbers. Code at https://github.com/mthamil107/memorywire. Companion to arXiv:2604.18248 (Prompt Injection Detection)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 memorywire，一种基于 JSON-Schema 2020-12 的供应商中立线格式，用于五种代理内存操作（记住、回忆、遗忘、合并、过期）和四种内存类型（语义、情景、程序、情感）。参考实现包含五个后端适配器（sqlite-vec、mem0、Letta、Cognee、pgvector），在 100 事实/50 查询的标注语料上 recall@5 = 1.000，ingest p50 = 37.8 ms，recall p50 = 40.6 ms。论文并非提出新算法，而是将现有组件（RRF、FSM、STM/LTM 整合、差异审批工作流）打包为可验证协议，旨在与模型上下文协议（MCP）共存。
Motivation: 当前代理内存框架（如 mem0、Letta、Cognee 等）各有独立 SDK、存储布局和操作词汇，缺乏共享的线格式，导致集成工作重复、迁移需重建内存，且缺乏允许人类审查写入的治理层。
Method: 定义 memorywire 格式，包含 JSON-Schema 2020-12 规范、MemoryStore 接口、扇出路由器、可选 HITL 治理通道，并用开源参考实现验证（5 后端适配器、16 场景一致性测试套件）。
Result: 在 100 事实/50 查询数据集上 recall@5 = 1.000，ingest p50 = 37.8 ms，recall p50 = 40.6 ms；对抗融合实验显示 Reciprocal Rank Fusion 在 1-of-N rank-0 注入扫描中保持 recall@5 = 1.000，而最大融合退化为 0.500 并泄漏 80%；80 个一致性测试用例通过 68 个，零失败。
Conclusion: memorywire 将现有成熟组件包装为供应商中立协议，并非竞争而是与模型上下文协议（MCP）互补，经实证验证的参考实现增强了可信度。

papers.title: Context-aware child-directed speech detection from long-form recordings
papers.abstract_en: Automatically distinguishing child-directed speech from adult-directed speech in long-form recordings is key to scalable analyses of children's language environments. Existing approaches process utterances in isolation and have been evaluated primarily on English. We address these gaps along three dimensions. First, we fine-tune and evaluate six-self supervised models on a multilingual dataset of 182 children, showing that in-domain pre-training on child-centered recordings substantially outperforms models trained on adult speech. Second, we demonstrate that incorporating surrounding context substantially improves classification, with an absolute gain of 13.8% in average F1-score. Third, we evaluate our model in a realistic end-to-end pipeline, from adult speech detection to addressee classification, showing that performance drops under automatic segmentation but still consistently outperforms a rule-based baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长时段录音中自动区分儿童导向语言（child-directed speech）与成人导向语言（adult-directed speech）的问题，提出了上下文感知的检测方法。在包含182名儿童的多语言数据集上微调了六个自监督模型，发现面向儿童录音的域内预训练显著优于成人语音训练的模型。加入上下文使平均F1分数绝对提升13.8%。在端到端管线中，尽管自动分割导致性能下降，但模型仍一致优于基于规则的基线。
Motivation: 现有方法孤立处理语音片段，且主要限于英语评估，无法有效应用于多语言长时段录音中儿童语言环境的规模化分析。
Method: 微调六个自监督模型，利用儿童录音进行域内预训练，并在分类时整合相邻语音片段的上下文信息。
Result: 域内预训练模型显著优于成人语音预训练模型；加入上下文带来13.8%的绝对平均F1提升；在自动分割的端到端管线中性能虽有下降，但仍优于规则基线。
Conclusion: 上下文感知和域内预训练对于多语言长时段录音中的儿童导向语音检测至关重要，但自动分割仍是实际部署中的挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HakushoBench: A Japanese Chart and Table VQA Benchmark from Governmental White Papers
papers.abstract_en: Understanding chart and table images is essential for applying vision-language models (VLMs) to real-world document understanding. While English benchmarks have advanced rapidly, non-English counterparts remain scarce, leaving it unclear whether this progress generalizes across languages. A key obstacle is the difficulty of collecting realistic and diverse non-English chart and table images at scale. To address this, we leverage governmental white papers as a scalable source for benchmark construction beyond English, as they contain naturally occurring charts and tables across diverse formats and domains and are freely accessible in many countries. As a first instantiation, we introduce HakushoBench, a challenging Japanese chart and table VQA benchmark built from 33 governmental white papers. HakushoBench contains 2,053 images spanning over 10 image types, with manually annotated QA pairs, designed to assess deep and holistic understanding of charts and tables, rather than local visual cues alone. Experiments across a broad range of VLMs demonstrate that HakushoBench remains challenging for open-weight models: the best open-weight model achieves only 58.6% accuracy, and a 34.9-point gap between open-weight and proprietary models highlights substantial room for improvement in complex chart and table understanding. We release our dataset and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HakushoBench是一个基于日本政府白皮书构建的日文图表VQA基准，包含2053张图片和手动标注的问答对，用于评估视觉语言模型对图表和表格的深度理解。实验显示，最佳开源模型准确率仅58.6%，与专有模型差距达34.9个百分点。
Motivation: 非英语图表VQA基准稀缺，难以评估视觉语言模型在多语言场景下的泛化能力。政府白皮书提供了可扩展的图表来源，但尚未被系统利用。
Method: 从33份日本政府白皮书中收集2053张图表图像，涵盖10余种类型，并手工标注问答对，构建难度高、需要整体理解的基准。
Result: 最佳开源模型（如LLaVA等）在HakushoBench上准确率仅58.6%，与专有模型（如GPT-4V）差距达34.9个百分点。
Conclusion: HakushoBench对当前开源VLM构成挑战，表明日文图表理解仍有显著改进空间。数据集和代码已公开。

papers.title: Local MixVR: Breaking the Communication-Sample Dependence in Distributed Learning
papers.abstract_en: Communication overhead is a crucial bottleneck in scalable distributed learning. While existing methods aim to efficiently utilize data points, such as Local SGD, Minibatch SGD, and their accelerated variants, they still exhibit communication-round complexity that scales with the total number of samples $N$. In this paper, we introduce Local MixVR, a distributed framework that integrates local updates with variance-reduction techniques to mitigate local noise. We show that Local MixVR is the first distributed method to eliminate the dependence of communication complexity on $N$, achieving a complexity that scales only with the number of workers $M$. In common regimes where $M<O\left(N^{1/4}\right)$, Local MixVR outperforms the state-of-the-art Minibatch Accelerated SGD baseline, bridging a long-standing gap in distributed optimization and establishing a new paradigm for communication-efficient training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Local MixVR，一种结合本地更新与方差缩减的分布式学习框架，首次消除了通信复杂度对总样本数 N 的依赖，使其仅与 worker 数 M 相关。在常见场景 M < O(N^{1/4}) 下，该方法优于现有最优的 Minibatch Accelerated SGD 基线。
Motivation: 分布式学习中通信开销是关键瓶颈，现有方法如 Local SGD 和 Minibatch SGD 的通信轮次复杂度仍随总样本数 N 增长，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 集成本地更新与方差缩减技术来抑制本地噪声，提出 Local MixVR 框架，通过设计新的通信协议实现复杂度与 N 解耦。
Result: 通信复杂度从 O(N) 降低到 O(M)，在 M < O(N^{1/4}) 时性能超越 Minibatch Accelerated SGD。
Conclusion: 该工作弥合了分布式优化中长期存在的差距，为通信高效训练建立了新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STARFISH: faST Accuracy Recovery in pruned networks From Internal State Healing
papers.abstract_en: Pruning is a process designed to reduce the number of weights in a large neural network. This can substantially speed up inference but might cause a considerable reduction in the model's accuracy, and thus it is usually followed by a healing process that regains some of the lost accuracy. In this paper, we propose a new healing method, STARFISH, that can recover (most of) the accuracy of any pruned network efficiently. The main idea of STARFISH is to optimize the pruned network to align with the original network's internal state representations using a tiny calibration set of unlabeled examples. For the common case of removing 50% of the weights, STARFISH healing improves the recovered accuracy by up to 22% over the state-of-the-art methods on ViT-based networks. Its advantage is even more pronounced under aggressive pruning. For example, after eliminating 75% of the weights in a DeiT-B network for ImageNet, STARFISH uses only 0.4% of the number of training images as a calibration set and recovers 82% of the original dense accuracy, whereas competing recovery techniques reach only 40% of the dense model accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STARFISH，一种针对剪枝后神经网络的高效精度恢复方法，通过使用少量无标签校准样本优化剪枝网络，使其内部状态表示与原始网络对齐。在ViT网络上，STARFISH在剪枝50%权重时相比现有方法恢复精度提升高达22%；在DeiT-B网络剪枝75%权重时，仅用0.4%的训练图像作为校准集，即可恢复原始稠密模型精度的82%，而其他方法仅恢复40%。

Method: STARFISH通过优化剪枝网络的内部状态表示（如中间层激活）以匹配原始网络，使用极少量无标签校准样本进行训练，无需标签或大量数据。
Result: 在ViT网络上剪枝50%权重时，STARFISH恢复精度比现有方法高22%；在DeiT-B上剪枝75%权重时，仅用0.4%训练图像即恢复82%的原始精度，而对比方法仅恢复40%。
Conclusion: STARFISH是一种高效的剪枝后精度恢复方法，尤其适用于大规模网络和强剪枝场景，仅需少量无标签数据即可显著恢复精度。

papers.title: From Reward-Free Representations to Preferences: Rethinking Offline Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) avoids explicit reward engineering by learning from pairwise human preference feedback. Existing offline PbRL methods typically follow a two-stage pipeline, first learning a reward or preference model from labeled preferences and then performing offline RL on unlabeled data. We revisit offline PbRL through the lens of reward-free representation learning (RFRL) from the zero-shot RL literature, and propose a new training framework that first learns latent successor-measure representations from reward-free offline data, followed by contrastive search and fine-tuning using preference data. Through extensive experiments and ablations, we show that our method achieves superior preference efficiency over offline PbRL baselines. This work is the first to connect RFRL with PbRL, highlighting its potential as a feedback-efficient solution. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/rl-bandits-lab/FB-PbRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种新的离线偏好强化学习框架，将奖励无关表示学习（RFRL）与偏好强化学习结合，通过学习潜在后继度量表示，再用偏好数据进行对比搜索与微调，实验显示在偏好效率上优于现有离线PbRL基线。
Motivation: 现有离线PbRL方法通常先学习奖励/偏好模型，然后进行离线RL，但可能存在效率问题。本文希望利用RFRL中奖励无关的表示学习来提高偏好数据的利用效率。
Method: 提出先使用奖励无关离线数据学习潜在后继度量表示，然后利用偏好数据进行对比搜索和微调的新训练框架。
Result: 实验表明该方法在偏好效率上优于离线PbRL基线。
Conclusion: 这是首次将RFRL与PbRL连接起来，展示了其作为反馈高效解决方案的潜力。

papers.title: A Per-Component Diagnostic Protocol for Neural HJB-PIDE Solvers under Control-Dependent Lévy Jumps
papers.abstract_en: We propose a five-step diagnostic protocol for residual-trained neural HJB-PIDE solvers with control-dependent Lévy jumps, targeting a general failure mode of neural PDE methods: a learned solution can match headline scalar diagnostics while miscomputing an operator inside its training loss. The protocol pairs each neural solve with at least one from-scratch independent reference, decomposes the Hamiltonian into drift, diffusion, compensator, and nonlocal-integral components across a u-grid, and compares the value function and its low-order derivatives over a (t,x) grid before any argmax comparison. Applied to a standard CRRA-Merton-Variance-Gamma benchmark, it isolates a missing 1/2-mixture factor in the neural method's importance-proposal density that scaled the nonlocal integral by exactly half - a textbook signature of a constant proposal scale error, invisible to longer training, grid refinement, and truncation sweeps. With the bug corrected, four references - two finite-difference solvers with disjoint discretizations, the neural solver, and a semi-analytic scalar baseline obtained from CRRA homogeneity - agree on the optimal control to within ~2%. The constant-coefficient CRRA benchmark collapses by homogeneity to a scalar maximization, so the scalar baseline is the efficient method here; the contribution is the protocol, applicable in principle to non-homogeneous and higher-dimensional settings where neural HJB-PIDE solvers are genuinely needed. The episode is a concrete instance of a broader neural-PDE verification failure: pointwise agreement of a learned value or control can coexist with a systematically wrong nonlocal operator, so per-component and surface-level checks are needed before trusting the argmax policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个五步诊断协议，用于检测残差训练的神经HJB-PIDE求解器在控制依赖Lévy跳跃下的故障模式。通过分解哈密顿量为漂移、扩散、补偿器和非局部积分分量，并在CRRA-Merton-Variance-Gamma基准上发现一个缺失的1/2混合因子误差，修正后四个参考解的控制误差在2%以内。
Motivation: 神经PDE方法可能存在学习解匹配标量诊断但内部算子计算错误的问题，需要系统性的诊断协议。
Method: 五步诊断协议：每次神经求解至少搭配一个独立参考，将哈密顿量按分量分解，在网格上比较值函数及其低阶导数。
Result: 在CRRA-Merton-Variance-Gamma基准上，诊断出神经方法中重要性提案密度缺少1/2混合因子，导致非局部积分缩放错误；修正后四个参考解（两个有限差分、神经求解器、半解析基线）的控制一致度达~2%。
Conclusion: 协议可推广至非齐次和高维神经HJB-PIDE求解器，强调逐分量和表面检查的必要性。

papers.title: Diagnosing LLM Arbitration Behavior over Pre-evidence Epistemic States in RAG-based Fact-Checking
papers.abstract_en: In RAG-based fact-checking, LLMs are increasingly used as verifiers to check given claims against retrieved evidence. Their parametric knowledge can induce pre-evidence tendencies that may conflict with the retrieved context, yet existing evaluation frameworks do not characterize such prior-context discrepancy or measure how verifiers arbitrate between parametric and contextual signals. We introduce \textsc{PAVE} (\emph{Prior-Aware Verifier Evaluation}), a diagnostic testbed that stratifies an LLM verifier into four epistemic states based on the correctness and confidence of its pre-evidence prior and evaluates its arbitration behavior on this new benchmark, i.e., whether it persists in correct prior under misleading evidence, and whether it corrects wrong prior when accurate evidence is provided. Experiments across seven LLMs reveal unreliable and highly model-dependent prior-context arbitration, highlighting the importance of verifier selection for real-world RAG-based fact-checking applications. Based on these findings, we propose a lightweight JSD-based test-time arbitration method that improves factual reliability without modifying the underlying model, achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PAVE诊断测试平台，用于评估基于RAG的事实核查中LLM在获取证据前的认知状态（正确性和置信度）对其仲裁行为的影响。实验表明不同LLM在正确先验与误导证据、错误先验与正确证据之间的仲裁行为不可靠且高度依赖模型，并据此提出一种轻量级基于JSD的测试时仲裁方法，在不修改模型的情况下提升事实可靠性。
Motivation: 现有RAG事实核查评估框架未考虑LLM参数知识导致的证据前倾向与检索证据之间的不一致，也无法度量验证器如何仲裁先验与上下文信号。
Method: 引入PAVE基准，将LLM验证器按证据前先验的正确性和置信度划分为四种认知状态，并测试其在误导证据下坚持正确先验、在正确证据下纠正错误先验的仲裁行为。提出基于JSD的测试时仲裁方法。
Result: 在七个LLM上的实验显示先验-上下文仲裁不可靠且高度依赖模型，但所提轻量方法能在不修改模型情况下提升事实可靠性，并在多种LLM家族中取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 该工作强调在真实RAG事实核查应用中验证器选择的重要性，并提出一种轻量仲裁方法作为补救。

papers.title: Rank-Aware Quantile Activation for Motion-Robust Crop Segmentation in UAV Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Motion blur from high-speed UAV acquisition de-grades semantic segmentation on rare texture-dependent classes with high agronomic value. Standard CNNs rely on high-frequency magnitude features that blur destroys, causing statistical erasure of minority signals. We propose Dual Quantile Activation (QAct), a rank-aware block replacing magnitude gating with instance-level rank normalization. Evaluated onAgriculture-Vision 2021 across zero-shot and blur-supervised regimes at multiple severities, QAct is the dominant architectural factor: it delivers consistent mIoU gains over ReLU across both regimes and all severities, with strongest gains on rare structural and texture-dependent classes. Some dominant classes (water,planter skip) show mixed per-class performance under distillation. At moderate blur, zero-shot QAct outperforms distillation-trained ReLU; across all severities, Distill-QAct achieves best performance, confirming rank aware activation and blur-domain training are complementary robustness sources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对无人机高速采集运动模糊导致的语义分割退化，特别是对稀有纹理依赖类别的统计擦除，提出秩感知的双分位激活（QAct）模块，替代传统ReLU的幅度门控。在Agriculture-Vision 2021数据集上，QAct在零样本和模糊监督两种设置下均持续提升mIoU，尤其在稀有结构类和纹理依赖类上效果显著，且与蒸馏训练互补。
Motivation: 运动模糊破坏高频幅度特征，导致标准CNN对稀有纹理依赖类别的语义分割性能严重下降，而传统ReLU激活无法缓解此问题。
Method: 提出Dual Quantile Activation (QAct)，一种秩感知模块，用实例级秩归一化替代传统的幅度门控激活机制。
Result: 在Agriculture-Vision 2021上，QAct在零样本和模糊监督两种设置下、所有模糊严重度上均持续优于ReLU，对稀有结构类和纹理依赖类提升最明显；中等模糊下零样本QAct超越蒸馏训练ReLU，而Distill-QAct在所有严重度上达到最佳性能。
Conclusion: 秩感知激活与模糊域训练是互补的鲁棒性来源，QAct可有效提升运动模糊下无人机影像作物分割的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HASTE: Hardware-Aware Dynamic Sparse Training for Large Output Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Extreme multi-label classification (XMC) involves learning models over large output spaces with millions of labels, making the output layer a memory-compute bottleneck. While sparsity-based methods reduce arithmetic complexity, they often fail to yield proportional speedups due to irregular memory access, poor hardware utilization, or reliance on auxiliary architectural components in long-tailed regimes. We introduce group-shared fixed fan-in sparsity, a semi-structured output-layer design in which semantically related labels share a sparse input pattern while retaining independent weights. This grouping introduces a task-aligned inductive bias -- encouraging related labels to share feature subsets -- while reducing index memory overhead, increasing feature reuse across labels, and enabling efficient GPU execution via custom CUDA kernels that leverage modern accelerator primitives. As an alternative to auxiliary objectives, we exploit the long-tailed structure of XMC by decomposing the output layer into a small dense head over frequent labels and a group-shared sparse tail over the remainder, providing an informative gradient pathway while preserving the memory benefits of sparsity. Through kernel-level microbenchmarking, we show that group-shared fixed fan-in translates arithmetic reductions into practical wall-clock gains, achieving up to $4.4\times$ speedup in the forward pass and up to $25\times$ speedup in backward passes over standard fixed fan-in sparsity, while operating within a few percent of a FLOPs-matched dense bottleneck. Across large-scale XMC benchmarks, our approach matches or improves precision@k over prior sparse baselines, while narrowing the performance gap to dense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对极端多标签分类（XMC）中输出层巨大导致的存储-计算瓶颈，提出了一种硬件感知的半结构化稀疏方法（HASTE）。首先设计组共享固定扇入稀疏性（group-shared fixed fan-in sparsity），使语义相关的标签共享稀疏输入模式，减少索引存储开销并提高特征复用。其次利用长尾结构，将输出层分解为密集头（频繁标签）和共享稀疏尾（剩余标签），提供有效梯度路径。通过自定义CUDA内核实现高效GPU执行，在前向和反向传播中分别获得高达4.4倍和25倍的加速，同时在大型XMC基准上匹配或优于先前稀疏基线，并缩小与密集模型的性能差距。
Motivation: 现有稀疏方法在XMC中因不规则内存访问、硬件利用率低或依赖辅助架构组件而未实现比例加速，亟需一种硬件感知且能利用长尾结构的稀疏输出层设计。
Method: 提出组共享固定扇入稀疏性：将语义相关标签分组，每组共享相同稀疏输入模式但权重独立；并采用密集头+共享稀疏尾的分解策略，结合定制CUDA内核和现代加速器原语实现高效执行。
Result: 在核级微基准测试中，前向传播加速达4.4倍，反向传播加速达25倍；在大型XMC基准上，prec@1等指标匹配或优于先前稀疏方法，且性能接近密集模型（FLOPs匹配时差距在几个百分点内）。
Conclusion: HASTE通过半结构化稀疏和长尾分解，在保持稀疏内存优势的同时实现实际墙钟加速，缩小了稀疏与密集模型在XMC中的性能差距。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出组共享固定扇入稀疏性：将语义相关标签分组，每组共享相同稀疏输入模式但权重独立；并采用密集头+共享稀疏尾的分解策略，结合定制CUDA内核和现代加速器原语实现高效执行。
summary_sections.result: 在核级微基准测试中，前向传播加速达4.4倍，反向传播加速达25倍；在大型XMC基准上，prec@1等指标匹配或优于先前稀疏方法，且性能接近密集模型（FLOPs匹配时差距在几个百分点内）。
summary_sections.conclusion: HASTE通过半结构化稀疏和长尾分解，在保持稀疏内存优势的同时实现实际墙钟加速，缩小了稀疏与密集模型在XMC中的性能差距。

papers.title: R^3: Composed Video Retrieval via Reasoning-Guided Recalling and Re-ranking
papers.abstract_en: The CoVR-R challenge evaluates composed video retrieval, where a system must retrieve a target video from a large gallery given a reference video and a textual edit instruction. This setting is not a standard video-text retrieval problem: the query is defined by both the visual evidence in the source video and the transformation implied by the edit. A strong embedding model can provide scalable candidate recall, but it may under-express target-side consequences such as state changes, action replacement, object preservation, or temporal consistency. A pairwise multimodal reranker can verify such details more directly, but exhaustive reranking over the full gallery is computationally infeasible. We present $\mathbb{R}^3$, a zero-shot composed video retrieval pipeline built around Reasoning-guided Recalling and Reranking. The core idea is to turn the source-edit query into a reasoning-grounded retrieval program rather than treating the edit text as a short caption. First, the model generates a reasoning trace that describes the expected target video after applying the edit. Then the trace is encoded together with the source video as a reasoning-augmented query, and its retrieval score is fused with the base composed query through an agreement-gated residual rule. At last, a re-ranker verifies the recalled candidates with direct source-candidate comparison. Experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of our method in addressing this challenge. Codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/R-3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对复合视频检索（CoVR）任务，提出零样本管道R^3，通过推理引导的召回和重排序（Reasoning-guided Recalling and Re-ranking）来改善检索效果。方法先生成编辑操作的推理轨迹，再与源视频编码为推理增强查询，通过一致性门控残差规则与基础复合查询融合，最后用重排序器验证候选视频。
Motivation: 复合视频检索中，查询由源视频和文本编辑指令共同定义，现有嵌入模型难以表达目标视频的状态变化、动作替换等细节，而全库重排序计算不可行。
Method: 提出R^3管道：1) 生成描述编辑后目标视频的推理轨迹；2) 将推理轨迹与源视频编码为推理增强查询，与基础复合查询通过一致性门控残差规则融合；3) 使用重排序器直接比较源视频与候选视频。
Result: 实验证明了该方法在复合视频检索任务上的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过生成推理轨迹并融合检索分数，再结合重排序，提升了零样本复合视频检索的性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: Accelerating physics-informed neural networks for full waveform inversion using a hybrid quantum-classical finite-basis architecture
papers.abstract_en: Full waveform inversion (FWI) reconstructs heterogeneous material properties from receiver data but remains computationally demanding. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and their domain-decomposed variants (FBPINNs) offer a mesh-free alternative but face convergence challenges when representing complex velocity fields. We present a hybrid quantum-classical FBPINN for acoustic FWI, bringing together quantum computing and classical machine learning, in which the decomposed wavefield network and the global velocity network are implemented as classical-to-quantum pipelines terminating in parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs). The PQCs are realized as differentiable JAX statevector simulators, enabling end-to-end automatic differentiation through the classical PINN, the quantum circuit, and the physics-informed loss. On a geophysical anomaly benchmark, the quantum hybrid reaches a lower L1 velocity error than the primary classical FBPINN baseline in approximately 8x fewer training iterations, despite using approximately 33% fewer trainable parameters, and it outperforms all 15 classical hyperparameter variants tested. A second benchmark (checkerboard) demonstrates the generality of the inversion pipeline, confirming that the quantum hybrid architecture can recover structured spatial variations beyond the localized anomaly benchmark. Our framework is broadly applicable to wave-based inverse problems beyond geophysics, including medical ultrasound tomography and non-destructive evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合量子-经典有限基物理信息神经网络（FBPINN）用于声波全波形反演（FWI），将分解波场网络和全局速度网络实现为经典到量子管道，末端使用可参数化量子电路（PQC）。在典型地球物理异常基准上，该混合方法在训练迭代次数减少约8倍、可训练参数减少约33%的情况下，L1速度误差低于经典FBPINN基线，并优于所有15种经典超参数变体；棋盘格基准验证了方法的泛化能力。
Motivation: 全波形反演计算成本高，物理信息神经网络（PINN）及其域分解变体（FBPINN）虽提供无网格替代方案，但在表示复杂速度场时面临收敛挑战。
Method: 提出混合量子-经典FBPINN架构，将波场网络和速度网络设计为经典到量子管道，末端采用可参数化量子电路（PQC），并通过可微分的JAX状态向量模拟器实现端到端自动微分。
Result: 在地球物理异常基准上，量子混合模型以约8倍少的训练迭代和约33%少的可训练参数，获得比经典FBPINN基线更低的L1速度误差，且优于所有15种经典超参数变体；棋盘格基准验证了其泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于基于波的反演问题，包括医学超声断层扫描和非破坏性评估，不限于地球物理学。

papers.title: How (and when) can you fit examples to logic-based hypothesis classes over infinite structures?
papers.abstract_en: We study fitting problems, sometimes called ``training problems'', where we have a finite sample consisting of inputs and outputs, and we want to know whether there is a function in a certain class that could produce these outputs, exactly or approximately, on the given inputs. We focus on the computational and descriptive complexity of fitting for logically-defined classes in common decidable structures, like the real ordered field and Presburger arithmetic, and also for broader classes defined via combinatorial or model-theoretic properties. We isolate the complexity of these fitting problems, with particular attention to cases where we can use queries in a natural query language over the sample to determine whether a sample is fittable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在无限结构（如实数有序域、Presburger算术）上，基于逻辑定义的假设类中，给定有限样本（输入输出对）是否能找到一个假设精确或近似拟合样本的计算复杂性与描述复杂性。作者分析了这些拟合问题的复杂度，特别关注是否能用自然查询语言中的查询来判断样本的可拟合性。
Motivation: 在经典机器学习中，拟合问题通常针对有限假设类或有限域，但在无限结构上的逻辑定义类中，拟合问题的复杂度尚未被系统刻画。本文填补了这一理论空白。
Method: 通过计算复杂度理论与描述复杂度理论，对基于逻辑（一阶逻辑、固定点逻辑等）定义的假设类在可判定的无限结构上的拟合问题进行复杂度分析，并与自然查询语言（如SQL）的表达力建立联系。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声明作者分离了这些拟合问题的复杂度，并指出了何时可以通过样本上的查询来决定可拟合性。
Conclusion: 本文为无限结构上逻辑假设类的拟合问题提供了复杂度刻画，并揭示了样本查询与可拟合性判定之间的联系。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Evidence Routing with Structured Visual Evidence for TimeLogicQA
papers.abstract_en: TimeLogicQA evaluates whether video question answering systems can reason over temporal relations such as event existence, ordering, persistence, boundary conditions, and overlap. We address this task with a visual evidence routing pipeline that separates perception from symbolic temporal reasoning. The system first parses each question into event targets, answer mode, candidate options, and temporal operators. It then routes videos according to duration and operator difficulty, using ordered full-frame evidence for short clips and event-focused candidate windows for long videos. A multimodal large language model produces structured visual evidence for the relevant events, while programmatic verifiers recover dense action intervals and a deterministic reducer applies operator-specific temporal rules to produce the final answer. Conservative fusion accepts an answer only when the visual evidence, temporal program, and confidence checks agree, reducing noisy answer flips. On the official test evaluation, our final system achieves an AvgAcc of 81.8.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频问答中的时间逻辑推理任务TimeLogicQA，提出一个视觉证据路由管道，将感知与符号时间推理分离。系统解析问题后根据视频时长和操作符难度路由视频，用多模态大模型生成结构化视觉证据，通过程序化验证器恢复动作区间，并用确定性还原器应用时间规则得出答案。在官方测试集上达到81.8的平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有视频问答系统在处理时间关系（事件存在、顺序、持久性、边界条件、重叠）时推理能力不足，需要一种结合感知和符号推理的混合方法。
Method: 提出视觉证据路由管道：先解析问题为事件目标、答案模式、候选选项和时间操作符；根据视频时长和操作符难度路由视频，短片段用全帧证据，长视频用事件聚焦候选窗口；多模态大模型生成结构化视觉证据，程序化验证器恢复动作区间，确定性还原器应用操作符特定时间规则输出答案；保守融合仅在视觉证据、时间程序和置信度一致时接受答案。
Result: 在TimeLogicQA官方测试集上，系统达到81.8的平均准确率（AvgAcc）。
Conclusion: 分离感知与符号推理、结合结构化视觉证据与确定性时间规则，可有效提高视频时间逻辑问答的准确性和可靠性。

papers.title: Adaptive Dense Evidence Refinement for Video Relational Reasoning for VRR-QA Challenge
papers.abstract_en: VRR-QA evaluates whether video-language systems can infer spatial, temporal, viewpoint, depth, and visibility relations that are not always resolved by a single frame. We present an inference-only system built around adaptive test-time computation. The system first answers each question with a direct video-language model pass, then uses multiple lightweight views to find unstable questions. Only these difficult questions are routed to a high-budget dense evidence module that constructs timestamped frame observations, relation-specific probes, candidate verification, and conservative temporal aggregation. This design separates two problems that are often confused in video question answering: finding plausible alternative answers and deciding when a current answer should actually be changed. On the test split, the final system obtains 90.07 average accuracy and 87.81 macro average accuracy. The report focuses on the final test system and the implementation settings required to reproduce the adaptive dense verifier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频关系推理问答（VRR-QA）任务，提出一种自适应测试时计算系统。系统先用直接视频-语言模型回答，再用多个轻量视图识别不稳定问题，仅将困难问题路由到高预算密集证据模块。该模块构建带时间戳的帧观察、关系特定探针、候选验证和保守时序聚合。在测试集上获得90.07平均准确率和87.81宏平均准确率。
Motivation: 视频问答中，单帧无法解决空间、时间、视角、深度和可见性关系推理。现有方法常混淆寻找合理备选答案和判断是否应改变当前答案这两个问题。
Method: 提出推理系统：先用直接视频-语言模型回答，再用多个轻量视图找出不稳定问题，仅对困难问题使用高预算密集证据模块（含时间戳帧观察、关系特定探针、候选验证和保守时序聚合）。
Result: 在测试集上获得90.07平均准确率和87.81宏平均准确率。
Conclusion: 系统设计将寻找备选答案与判断是否改变当前答案分离，通过自适应测试时计算提升推理效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Soft-NBCE: Entropy-Weighted Chunk Fusion for Long-Context
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic complexity of self-attention remains a bottleneck for Large Language Models (LLMs) processing ultra-long contexts. The Naive Bayes Cognitive Engine (NBCE) parallelizes long-context inference by chunking documents and routing to the lowest-entropy chunk at each decoding step. This hard-selection strategy causes semantic fragmentation during cross-chunk reasoning, as abrupt routing changes between adjacent tokens disrupt the model's contextual grounding. We present Soft-NBCE, a lightweight extension that replaces discrete chunk selection with soft entropy-weighted chunk fusion. A temperature-scaled Softmax over predictive entropies assigns continuous weights to all chunks, enabling log-space aggregation across chunk-conditioned distributions. To partially compensate for the conditional independence assumption introduced by chunking, we propose Consistency Distillation, a LoRA-based self-distillation that constrains the chunked logit distribution toward a full-context teacher via KL-divergence. On LongBench multi-hop benchmarks, Soft-NBCE with Consistency Distillation improves consistently over NBCE-style baselines (MuSiQue F1: 0.310 vs.\ 0.275 for Vanilla NBCE; HotpotQA F1: 0.479 vs.\ 0.427) while maintaining retrieval accuracy (NIAH-32K: 0.909) at O(L^2/n) peak memory.

papers.title: MiCU: End-to-End Smart Home Command Understanding with Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Command understanding systems in smart home ecosystems can automate device control and substantially improve user experience. However, while they perform well on precise utterances (e.g., "turn on the bedroom light"), they struggle with ambiguous or misaligned commands (e.g., "make the bedroom cozy"). Large language models (LLMs) generalize well across various domains and can outperform traditional rule-based systems on such tasks, but their effectiveness is often constrained by scarce domain-specific data, insufficient task-specific adaptation, and high computational costs. In this paper, we propose an automated training data synthesis workflow using user logs and LLMs; then we build MiCU, a domain-specific LLM that excels at command understanding. Specifically, we employ curriculum learning to inject domain knowledge into the base LLM, then we enhance its reasoning ability via cold-start training combined with reinforcement learning (RL) guided by domain-specific thinking rules. Additionally, we introduce a token compression technique that condenses device description into a single special token, substantially reducing inference overhead and enabling \model-fast, an efficient variant optimized for long inputs. Extensive experiments show that MiCU significantly outperforms baselines, with an average accuracy gain of 20.01% across all device categories. We have deployed MiCU in the Xiaomi Home app, receiving approximately 1.7 million page views per day. Production evaluations show that MiCU reduces user correction rate by 1.57% and increases human audited accuracy by 32.05%. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/xiaomi-research/iot_spec_llm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MiCU，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能家居命令理解系统，通过自动化数据合成、课程学习、强化学习和令牌压缩技术提升对模糊命令的理解能力。实验表明在小米智能家居场景中平均准确率提升20.01%，部署后日页面浏览量约170万，用户纠错率降低1.57%，人工审核准确率提升32.05%。
Motivation: 现有智能家居命令理解系统在精确指令上表现良好，但在模糊或错位命令上效果不佳；通用LLM受限于领域数据稀缺、任务适配不足和高计算成本。
Method: 提出自动化训练数据合成流程（基于用户日志和LLM），构建领域特定LLM MiCU；采用课程学习注入领域知识，通过冷启动训练结合基于领域思维规则的强化学习增强推理能力；引入令牌压缩技术将设备描述压缩为单个特殊令牌，降低推理开销并支持长输入的高效变体MiCU-fast。
Result: MiCU在所有设备类别上平均准确率提升20.01%；在小米Home APP部署后，日页面浏览量约170万，用户纠错率降低1.57%，人工审核准确率提升32.05%。
Conclusion: MiCU通过结合LLM和领域特定优化显著提升智能家居命令理解性能，并在实际部署中验证了有效性。摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Implicit Drifting Policy: One-Step Action Generation via Conditional Expert Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Generative action policies based on diffusion or flow matching excel in behavior cloning, yet their iterative sampling is prohibitive for high-frequency robot control. While recent one-step formulations alleviate this latency, they inevitably discard the intermediate trajectory evolution that provides crucial action correction. Directly recovering this mechanism by explicitly estimating a training-time drifting field is mathematically ill-posed due to extreme conditional demonstration sparsity. We introduce Implicit Drifting Policy (IDP), a one-step imitation learning framework that brings the training-time correction of Drifting into policy learning without explicit vector field estimation. IDP extracts a conditional expert geometry from the local variation of observation-similar expert actions, and compares it against a global reference geometry to isolate condition-specific constraints. This local geometric structure adaptively weights a scalar potential objective. Combined with an expert-proximal terminal evaluation, IDP directly enforces manifold constraints on the one-step generator during training. Extensive evaluations across 2D, 3D, and real-world manipulation tasks show IDP effectively maintains adherence to valid action manifolds, improving upon explicit drifting methods and achieving competitive performance with strong one-step baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出隐式漂移策略（IDP），一种单步模仿学习框架，旨在解决扩散或流匹配策略在高频机器人控制中迭代采样延迟的问题。IDP 无需显式估计向量场，通过提取条件专家几何并与全局参考几何比较，在训练中对单步生成器施加流形约束，从而保留动作修正机制。在 2D、3D 和真实世界操作任务中，IDP 有效维持有效动作流形，性能优于显式漂移方法，与强单步基线相当。
Motivation: 基于扩散或流匹配的生成式动作策略在行为克隆中表现出色，但迭代采样过程不适合高频机器人控制。现有的单步公式虽然减少了延迟，却丢弃了中间轨迹演化提供的动作修正。直接通过显式估计训练时的漂移场来恢复该机制因条件演示稀疏而病态。
Method: IDP 从观测相似专家动作的局部变化中提取条件专家几何，并与全局参考几何比较以隔离条件特定约束。该局部几何结构自适应地加权一个标量势目标，结合专家近端终端评估，在训练过程中直接对单步生成器施加流形约束。
Result: 在 2D、3D 和真实世界操作任务上，IDP 有效保持对有效动作流形的遵循，优于显式漂移方法，并与强单步基线取得竞争性能。
Conclusion: IDP 将训练时的漂移修正引入策略学习，无需显式向量场估计，是一种有效的单步模仿学习框架。

papers.title: Dual-Route Top-K Retrieval with 1v1 VLM Reranking for the CoVR-R
papers.abstract_en: We describe \emph{Dual-Route Top-K Retrieval with 1v1 VLM Reranking} for the CoVR-R challenge. The method treats composed video retrieval as two coupled problems: finding a sufficiently complete top-k candidate set, and then safely deciding whether any candidate should replace a strong current top-1. We first improve the reasoning/text seed with a VLM slot selector over existing candidates, without introducing DFN visual retrieval. We then add a visual route from contact-sheet embeddings using DFN-H/DFN-L. The routes are merged into a top-10 candidate set, after which a VLM final reranker performs conservative 1v1 comparisons between the current top-1 and each challenger. On the hidden test split, the final system reaches 95.28 R@1, 97.47 R@5, 98.48 R@10, and 99.66 R@50. The main lesson is that CoVR-R benefits more from recall-selection decoupling than from broad text reranking or direct multi-candidate VLM classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了双路由Top-K检索与1v1 VLM重排序方法，用于CoVR-R（复合视频检索）挑战。方法将复合视频检索分解为两个耦合问题：先构建足够完备的top-K候选集，再通过保守的1v1 VLM比较决定是否替换当前top-1。在隐藏测试集上达到了95.28 R@1，97.47 R@5，98.48 R@10，99.66 R@50。主要结论是CoVR-R更受益于召回-选择解耦，而非广泛的文本重排序或多候选VLM分类。
Motivation: 现有复合视频检索方法在候选集构建和最终排序上耦合过紧，导致检索性能受限。
Method: 首先通过VLM槽选择器改进推理/文本种子，不引入DFN视觉检索；然后添加基于联系图嵌入（DFN-H/DFN-L）的视觉路由。两条路由合并成top-10候选集后，VLM最终重排序器对当前top-1和每个挑战者进行保守的1v1比较。
Result: 在隐藏测试集上达到95.28 R@1，97.47 R@5，98.48 R@10，99.66 R@50。
Conclusion: 论文强调CoVR-R任务中，召回-选择解耦策略比广泛的文本重排序或多候选VLM分类更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies and World-Action Models (WAM) represent two increasingly important paradigms for robotic manipulation. However, it remains unclear whether future prediction in WAMs leads to behaviorally meaningful improvements beyond final task success. In this paper, we ask whether WAMs merely add future prediction, or whether they change robot behavior and internal representations in ways that are actionable for control. We introduce a model-agnostic diagnostic framework that compares WAMs and VLAs through two complementary lenses: behavioral rollout analysis and sparse-autoencoder-based feature analysis. The behavioral protocol measures action dynamics consistency, target-object progress, distractor disturbance, and runtime cost. The feature-space protocol characterizes internal representations as memorized, reactive, or predictive, revealing whether models encode future-oriented structure. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, we evaluate 7 policies spanning direct VLAs and joint, sequential, and auxiliary WAMs. Our results show that success alone hides key differences: WAMs often improve object-level behavior and target selectivity, but their gains depend on architecture and incur higher inference cost. Sequential WAMs show the clearest predictive structure, while auxiliary and joint WAMs respectively compress or entangle future information. These findings suggest future directions for WAMs design to preserve behaviorally actionable future representations for efficient manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模型无关的诊断框架，比较视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)和世界-动作模型(WAM)在机器人操作中的行为与表示差异。在LIBERO和RoboTwin2.0上评估7种策略，发现WAM在目标选择和行为动态上有改善，但高推理成本，不同架构对未来信息的编码方式不同。
Motivation: 不清楚WAM中的未来预测是否带来行为上有意义的改进，仅凭最终任务成功无法揭示模型间的关键差异。
Method: 引入两方面的诊断框架：行为rollout分析（测量动作动态一致性、目标进度、干扰物干扰和运行时成本）和基于稀疏自编码器的特征分析（表征内部表示是记忆型、反应型还是预测型）。
Result: 成功指标掩盖了关键差异：WAM改善对象级行为和目标选择性，但依赖于架构且推理成本更高；顺序WAM显示最清晰的预测结构，辅助和联合WAM分别压缩或纠缠未来信息。
Conclusion: 未来WAM设计需要保留行为可操作的未来表示以实现高效操作。

papers.title: CAREAgent: Clinical Agent with Structured Reasoning and Tool-Integrated for Order Generation
papers.abstract_en: Clinical order generation serves as a critical bridge between clinical decision-making and real-world practice, translating medical decisions into concrete and executable orders. Existing agents mainly focus on coarse-grained decisions and overlook the fine-grained, executable information required for clinical orders. To address this gap, we propose CAREAgent, an agent for clinical order generation. To support its training, we introduce a two-stage agentic reasoning data construction method. First, we design an agent framework that constructs verifiable reasoning trajectories aligned with realistic clinical tool usage. Second, we filter reasoning trajectories by format compliance, order validity, and clinical plausibility. Building on the constructed data, the model is first trained via supervised fine-tuning to acquire fundamental reasoning formats and medical knowledge, and is subsequently optimized through reinforcement learning with multi-dimensional reward functions to enhance complex clinical reasoning capabilities. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of CAREAgent. On ClinicalBench (unseen during training), CAREAgent improves the F1 score by 5.05%, 2.09%, and 0.86% over the single-agent, multi-agent, and agentic reasoning methods, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAREAgent，一个用于临床医嘱生成的智能体。通过两阶段推理数据构建方法（先构建可验证的推理轨迹，再筛选格式、有效性和临床合理性），使用监督微调结合强化学习训练模型。在ClinicalBench上，F1分数相比单智能体、多智能体和智能体推理方法分别提升5.05%、2.09%和0.86%。
Motivation: 现有临床决策智能体主要关注粗粒度决策，忽略了医嘱所需的细粒度可执行信息。
Method: 提出两阶段智能体推理数据构建方法：先设计框架构建与真实临床工具使用一致的可验证推理轨迹，再按格式合规性、医嘱有效性和临床合理性筛选轨迹。模型先通过监督微调学习推理格式和医学知识，再通过多维度奖励函数的强化学习增强复杂临床推理能力。
Result: 在ClinicalBench上，CAREAgent的F1分数比单智能体、多智能体和智能体推理方法分别提高5.05%、2.09%和0.86%。
Conclusion: CAREAgent在临床医嘱生成任务上表现有效，通过结构化推理与工具集成提升了细粒度医嘱生成能力。
