summary_sections.method: 提出两阶段智能体推理数据构建方法：先设计框架构建与真实临床工具使用一致的可验证推理轨迹，再按格式合规性、医嘱有效性和临床合理性筛选轨迹。模型先通过监督微调学习推理格式和医学知识，再通过多维度奖励函数的强化学习增强复杂临床推理能力。
summary_sections.result: 在ClinicalBench上，CAREAgent的F1分数比单智能体、多智能体和智能体推理方法分别提高5.05%、2.09%和0.86%。
summary_sections.conclusion: CAREAgent在临床医嘱生成任务上表现有效，通过结构化推理与工具集成提升了细粒度医嘱生成能力。

papers.title: A Fiber Criterion for Representation Identifiability in Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised learning evaluates predictors through their input-output behavior. When a predictor is implemented as a composition $f=c\circ h$, supervised evidence constrains the composite map $f$ but need not determine the representation-head factorization $(h,c)$. This paper formalizes the resulting representation-level identifiability problem: for a class of admissible representation-head pairs, a representation property is identifiable from the induced predictor exactly when it is constant on the fibers of the projection $(h,c)\mapsto c\circ h$, equivalently when it descends to a well-defined property of the predictor. Predictor-preserving augmentation gives a canonical obstruction: auxiliary information can be appended to a representation while the head ignores it, leaving the predictor unchanged but altering properties such as minimality, compression, invariance, equivariance, nuisance information, or semantic accessibility. This construction separates representation identifiability from optimization and finite-sample estimation. Finite-sample diagnostics illustrate, rather than prove, the criterion: exact algebraic witnesses hold the predictor fixed while changing representation diagnostics, and matched-performance Waterbirds models show that different constraints can select different representations at similar supervised performance. The results clarify that representation-level claims require assumptions, objectives, measurements, or inductive biases beyond supervised predictive behavior alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了监督学习中的表示可识别性问题：给定由表示-头部对(h,c)组成的预测器f=c∘h，从f能否唯一确定(h,c)的性质？作者提出了一个纤维判据：一种表示性质是可识别的当且仅当它在映射(h,c)→c∘h的纤维上为常数。通过预测器保持增广构造，展示了即使优化和有限样本估计不同，表示性质仍可随意改变，从而分离了表示可识别性与数据拟合问题。
Motivation: 监督学习通常只关注预测器的输入-输出行为，但实际应用中常需要理解或使用内部表示（如表示的最小性、不变性、语义可访问性等）。然而，表示-头部因子分解不唯一，导致表示层面的断言缺乏监督证据的支持。本文形式化了这一表示可识别性问题。
Method: 提出纤维判据：表示性质可识别当且仅当它在投影映射(h,c)↦c∘h的纤维上恒定。利用预测器保持增广构造（向表示中添加辅助信息，头部忽略该信息）作为规范障碍，证明许多常见表示性质（如最小性、压缩性、不变性、等变性、干扰信息、语义可访问性）在监督证据下不可识别。
Result: 通过精确代数证据（保持预测器不变的同时改变表示诊断）和匹配性能的Waterbirds模型（不同约束选择不同表示但监督性能相似）进行有限样本诊断，表明表示层面的声明需要超出监督预测行为的假设、目标、测量或归纳偏置。
Conclusion: 论文强调表示可识别性依赖于纤维判据，并指出单纯监督预测行为不足以唯一确定表示性质。这要求研究者在进行表示层面的解释时必须引入额外的结构或先验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring the Symmetry--Data Exchange Rate
papers.abstract_en: Equivariance theory predicts that an architectural symmetry prior reduces sample complexity by a factor of |G|; this is widely cited but rarely measured as a scaling law with controls that separate the prior from its confounds. On a controlled C_n-symmetric task, we report three findings. First, a wrong-group control with identical orbit size and matched compute is worse than no constraint (joint pairwise CI [+0.79, +3.26] excludes zero, robust across estimators); misaligned constraint is actively harmful, not merely unhelpful. Second, an augmentation baseline equipped with test-time orbit averaging matches the equivariant model exactly -- bit-identical per-epoch validation curves across matched cells -- so the architecture-vs-augmentation gap is conditional on asymmetric test-time computation, not unconditional. Third, the relative exchange rate beta_diff = 1.28 is consistent in sign and order of magnitude with the theoretical 1.0 (single-level CI [+0.92, +2.05]); the more conservative two-level bootstrap (seeds x group sizes) widens this to [-0.63, +1.72], including zero, and a finer-N replication on a sqrt(2)-spaced grid is inconclusive (point estimate -0.82). The methodological contributions -- the relative-rate estimator that cancels the shared-difficulty confound, the wrong-group control, and a pre-specified failure taxonomy -- transfer to any inductive bias whose strength can be parameterised. Honest scoping: the primary estimator beta_diff was adopted post-hoc after the initial analysis revealed a positive-slope identifiability problem; the design was never externally pre-registered; and the headline number rests on an OLS slope over seven group sizes on a coarse N grid. This is an exploratory study, not a confirmatory measurement; the wrong-group result is the cleanest finding and the one we report with the most confidence. A registered replication on fresh seeds is future work.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 9 figures. Exploratory study. Code and data at https://github.com/AhmedMostafa16/symmetry-exchange
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在受控的C_n对称任务上测量等变先验对样本复杂度的增益，发现：错误组约束（wrong-group control）反而有害；增强基线（test-time orbit averaging）可与等变模型完全匹配；相对交换率beta_diff的估计值1.28与理论值1.0一致但置信区间包含零。论文为探索性研究，最可靠的结果是错误组约束的负面效应。
Motivation: 等变理论预测对称先验可降低样本复杂度，但该增益从未作为标度律被严格测量，且常与数据增强等混淆因素混杂。
Method: 提出相对交换率（relative exchange rate）估计量beta_diff，通过OLS斜率从粗粒度网格上的七个群组大小中估计，并引入错误组控制（wrong-group control）和共享难度抵消（shared-difficulty confound cancelation）。
Result: 在C_n对称任务上，错误组控制比无约束更差（联合成对CI [+0.79, +3.26]排除零）；augmentation基线（test-time orbit averaging）与等变模型逐时期验证曲线完全一致；beta_diff点估计1.28（单级CI [+0.92, +2.05]），但更保守的两级bootstrap CI为[-0.63, +1.72]包含零，且细粒度复制结果不明确（点估计-0.82）。
Conclusion: 论文强调错误组结果是发现最清晰的结论，而beta_diff估计是探索性（非确认性）测量，需后续预注册复制。其方法学贡献（相对率估计、错误组控制、失败分类法）可推广至可参数化的其他归纳偏置。

papers.title: Strong Stochastic Flow Maps
papers.abstract_en: Flow and diffusion models generate high-quality samples in many modalities; however, many network evaluations are required during inference due to numerical integration of an underlying differential equation. Flow maps alleviate this problem by learning the solution map of the differential equation directly, enabling few-step sampling. Yet, current methods are restricted to approximating the solution map of ODEs. These methods can be used to learn the transition kernel of an SDE, thereby obtaining a solution map that recovers the marginal distributions of the process (weak convergence) rather than the solution path (strong convergence). We propose Strong Stochastic Flow Maps (SSFMs) as a novel framework for learning the strong solution map of additive-noise SDEs, directly generalizing deterministic flow maps to the stochastic setting. Further, a polynomial approximation to Brownian motion is introduced and shown to converge pathwise. These results enable a simulation-free training objective for the solution map of diffusion models. We demonstrate that SSFMs outperform previous stochastic flow map methods on image generation and enable few-step sampling of molecular systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出强随机流映射（Strong Stochastic Flow Maps, SSFMs），用于学习加性噪声随机微分方程（SDE）的强解映射，将确定性流映射推广到随机设置。通过引入布朗运动的多项式逼近并证明路径收敛，实现无模拟训练目标。实验表明，SSFMs在图像生成上优于先前随机流映射方法，并支持分子系统的少步采样。
Motivation: 现有流映射方法只能近似常微分方程（ODE）的解映射，无法直接处理SDE的强解，限制了扩散模型的采样效率。
Method: 提出SSFM框架直接学习加性噪声SDE的强解映射；引入布朗运动的多项式逼近并证明路径收敛，从而得到无模拟训练目标。
Result: 在图像生成任务上优于先前随机流映射方法，并实现了分子系统的少步采样。
Conclusion: SSFMs将确定性流映射推广到随机设置，为扩散模型提供了高效采样方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MViewRouter: Internalizing Geometric Equivariance via Multi-view Alternating Attention for Combinatorial Routing
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) are fundamental NP-hard problems with broad real-world applications. While recent deep reinforcement learning methods have shown promising performance, they typically handle geometric symmetries only through data augmentation, resulting in inconsistent decisions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose MViewRouter, a multi-view framework that internalizes geometric equivariance as a structural inductive bias to achieve invariant decision-making across routing problem variants. Our approach introduces a Multi-view Alternating Attention (MAA) mechanism that enables parallel processing over the $D_4$ symmetry group, alternating between intra-view relational modeling and inter-view feature alignment. Furthermore, we optimize the policy via Collective Policy Gradient Aggregation (CPGA), leveraging consensus gradients from multiple symmetric views to stabilize training and accelerate convergence. Experiments on TSP and CVRP benchmarks, as well as real-world TSPLIB instances, demonstrate that MViewRouter achieves competitive solution quality and strong zero-shot generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MViewRouter，一种通过多视图交替注意力（MAA）机制内化几何等变性的框架，用于解决旅行商问题（TSP）和带容量车辆路径问题（CVRP）等组合路由问题。该框架在D4对称群上并行处理，交替进行视图内关系建模和视图间特征对齐，并通过集体策略梯度聚合（CPGA）优化策略。实验表明，该方法在TSP和CVRP基准测试以及真实TSPLIB实例上取得了有竞争力的解质量和零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有深度强化学习方法通常仅通过数据增强处理几何对称性，导致决策不一致且泛化能力有限。
Method: 提出多视图交替注意力（MAA）机制，在D4对称群上并行处理，交替进行视图内关系建模和视图间特征对齐；并采用集体策略梯度聚合（CPGA）利用多个对称视图的共识梯度来稳定训练和加速收敛。
Result: 在TSP和CVRP基准测试以及TSPLIB真实实例上，MViewRouter实现了有竞争力的解质量和强零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: MViewRouter通过将几何等变性作为结构归纳偏置内化，实现了跨路由问题变体的不变决策，且无需数据增强。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Decision-Focused On-Policy Learning for Contextual Linear Optimization with Partial Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictive models by optimizing downstream decision quality rather than standalone prediction accuracy. For contextual linear optimization, most existing DFL methods assume offline data and full observations of the objective cost vector. We develop an on-policy learning method for sequential contextual linear optimization under partial feedback, generalizing the standard bandit feedback setting. Our method learns a stochastic predict-then-optimize policy that samples a cost-vector prediction from a conditional distribution and solves the resulting downstream linear optimization problem. To update this distributional model, we introduce a two-component hybrid gradient estimator. The first component is a score function estimator, which provides an unbiased but potentially high-variance policy gradient estimate. The second is a decision-focused plug-in component that uses an auxiliary nuisance estimate of the latent cost vector to exploit the downstream optimization structure, becoming more informative as the estimate improves. We prove an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ bound on the average squared policy-gradient norm, matching the standard non-convex SGD rate. Experiments on top-$k$ selection, shortest path, combinatorial pricing, and a real-data energy-scheduling benchmark show that the hybrid gradient approach achieves lower cumulative regret than contextual-bandit-style baselines across all benchmarks, using both Gaussian and richer conditional generative models. Code is available at https://github.com/Joeyetinghan/on-policy-bandit-dfl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对部分反馈下的序列化上下文线性优化问题，提出了一种决策聚焦在线学习方法。该方法学习一个随机预测-然后-优化的策略，通过混合梯度估计器（结合得分函数估计和决策聚焦插件估计）来更新条件分布模型，并证明平均策略梯度范数达到O(T^{-1/2})的界。实验在top-k选择、最短路径、组合定价和真实能源调度基准上显示，该方法相比上下文赌博基线降低了累积遗憾。
Motivation: 现有决策聚焦学习（DFL）方法大多假设离线数据和目标成本向量的完全观测，无法处理在线部分反馈（如赌博反馈）的序列决策问题。
Method: 提出一种在线学习方法，学习随机预测-然后-优化策略，使用混合梯度估计器：包括无偏但高方差的得分函数估计，以及利用辅助成本向量估计的决策聚焦插件估计，后者随着估计改进而提供更丰富信息。
Result: 实验在top-k选择、最短路径、组合定价和真实能源调度基准上显示，混合梯度方法在所有基准上均优于上下文赌博风格的基线，降低了累积遗憾。
Conclusion: 该方法为部分反馈下的上下文线性优化提供了一种有效的决策聚焦在线学习框架，理论保证与实验验证一致。

summary_sections.method: 提出一种在线学习方法，学习随机预测-然后-优化策略，使用混合梯度估计器：包括无偏但高方差的得分函数估计，以及利用辅助成本向量估计的决策聚焦插件估计，后者随着估计改进而提供更丰富信息。
summary_sections.result: 实验在top-k选择、最短路径、组合定价和真实能源调度基准上显示，混合梯度方法在所有基准上均优于上下文赌博风格的基线，降低了累积遗憾。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为部分反馈下的上下文线性优化提供了一种有效的决策聚焦在线学习框架，理论保证与实验验证一致。

papers.title: ThinkSwitch: Context Distillation with LoRA and Weight Interpolation for Specific-Purpose Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often improve on difficult tasks by spending inference-time compute on a reasoning trace before producing the final answer. That extra computation can be useful, but it also raises latency, token cost, and deployment complexity. We introduce \textbf{ThinkSwitch}, a low-compute procedure for co-training paired instruct and thinking checkpoints. Starting from compatible Qwen3-4B instruct and thinking models, each iteration asks the thinking checkpoint to generate answers, removes the reasoning trace, distills the answer-only pairs into the instruct checkpoint with QLoRA, and reconstructs a thinking checkpoint with spherical weight interpolation. The only human-supplied inputs are task prompts; the labels are generated by the model itself. On a 30-question AIME 2026 evaluation, ThinkSwitch improves the instruct checkpoint from 10/30 to 20/30 and the thinking checkpoint from 14/30 to 22/30. On a 30-question PubMedQA subset, it improves the instruct checkpoint from 13/30 to 18/30 and the thinking checkpoint from 18/30 to 25/30. The complete experiment uses 15 training prompts per domain and costs \$2.86 on a single cloud RTX 3070. The results are small-scale, but they indicate that targeted distillation loops can move part of the benefit of explicit reasoning into weights while preserving a separate thinking mode.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ThinkSwitch，一种低计算量的过程，用于协同训练配对的指令检查点和思考检查点。从 Qwen3-4B 的指令和思考模型开始，每次迭代让思考模型生成答案并移除推理轨迹，用 QLoRA 将仅答案对蒸馏进指令检查点，再通过球形权重插值重建思考检查点。在 AIME 2026 的 30 道题上，指令检查点从 10/30 提升到 20/30，思考检查点从 14/30 提升到 22/30；在 PubMedQA 子集上也有一致提升。仅需 15 个训练提示，成本 $2.86。
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理时花费额外计算生成推理轨迹能提升难度任务表现，但增加了延迟、token 成本和部署复杂度。需要低计算成本的方法将部分推理收益转移到模型权重中，同时保留独立的思考模式。
Method: 从兼容的 Qwen3-4B 指令和思考模型开始，每轮迭代让思考模型生成答案并移除推理轨迹，用 QLoRA 将仅答案对蒸馏进指令检查点，然后通过球形权重插值从蒸馏后的指令检查点和原始思考检查点重建新的思考检查点。仅需任务提示，标签由模型自身生成。
Result: 在小规模评估（30 题 AIME 2026 和 30 题 PubMedQA 子集）上，指令检查点分别从 10/30 提升到 20/30 和从 13/30 提升到 18/30；思考检查点分别从 14/30 提升到 22/30 和从 18/30 提升到 25/30。整个实验使用 15 个训练提示，花费 $2.86 在单块云 RTX 3070 上。
Conclusion: 结果表明目标蒸馏循环可以将显式推理的部分收益转移到权重中，同时保留独立的思考模式，但作者指出结果规模较小，需要进一步验证。

papers.title: Chameleon: Style-Content Disentangled Framework for Cross-Domain Object Compositing
papers.abstract_en: Image compositing aims to seamlessly insert a foreground object into a background image, and recent advances in diffusion models have significantly enhanced the quality, especially when the foreground and background images come from the same domain (e.g., natural images). However, cross-domain compositing, where the foreground and background come from different domains, is relatively underexplored and remains challenging because the model must preserve the foreground object's identity while stylizing it to match the background domain. Existing cross-domain compositing approaches largely rely on training-free blending and refinement strategies. This is partly due to the lack of large-scale paired datasets for cross-domain compositing, limiting the development of training-based solutions. As a result, they are limited to tone-level alignment and often produce style-inconsistent or overstylized results. To overcome such limitations, we construct ChameleonDataset, the first large-scale training dataset for cross-domain compositing, with a comprehensive evaluation benchmark, built through a scalable data construction pipeline. Building on this, we propose Chameleon, a novel two-stage training-based cross-domain compositing framework. In the first stage, we propose Joint Hard Contrastive Learning (JHCL) to train ChameleonEncoder, which effectively disentangles style and content representations. In the second stage, we introduce Spatio-Temporal Attention Gating (STAG) into a diffusion transformer for effective stylization, adaptively regulating how style tokens from the first-stage encoder are injected across spatial and temporal dimensions. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art in-domain and cross-domain compositing models, sequential pipelines and commercial models, achieving improvements in both compositional plausibility and stylistic fidelity.
papers.comment: The last two authors are co-corresponding authors. Please visit our project page at https://cmlab-korea.github.io/Chameleon/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨域图像合成问题，构建了首个大规模训练数据集 ChameleonDataset，并提出两阶段训练框架 Chameleon。第一阶段通过联合硬对比学习 (JHCL) 解耦风格与内容表示，第二阶段在扩散 transformer 中引入时空注意力门控 (STAG) 自适应控制风格注入。该方法在合成合理性和风格保真度上均优于现有域内、跨域模型及商业模型。
Motivation: 跨域图像合成（前景与背景来自不同域）因缺乏大规模配对数据而研究不足，现有无训练方法仅能进行色调级对齐，常导致风格不一致或过度风格化。
Method: 构建 ChameleonDataset 数据集及评估基准；提出两阶段框架：第一阶段 JHCL 训练 ChameleonEncoder 解耦风格和内容，第二阶段 STAG 在扩散 transformer 中按时空维度调节风格令牌注入。
Result: 该方法在合成合理性和风格保真度上超越 SOTA 域内和跨域合成模型、序列流程及商业模型。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确给出限制或未来方向，但表明所提数据集和框架有效解决了跨域合成中风格对齐与内容保持的平衡问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-Vacuous Certification of Transport MCMC via Oscillation-Controlled Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: Transport MCMC trains a normalizing flow to precondition Metropolis--Hastings proposals, achieving high empirical efficiency on challenging posteriors; yet no prior work produces a numerically non-vacuous, rigorous spectral-gap bound for such samplers. We establish the first such bounds. For independence MH on the banana family we certify (γ^\ast = 0.828) at (D = 2) (covering in the original space) and (γ^\ast \ge 7.6\times 10^{-4}) at (D = 5) (covering in an analytically unwarped Gaussian space with a grid-certified gradient bound under the stated numerical Lipschitz certification), both rigorous at 95% confidence. The framework rests on three pillars: (i) spectral normalization with reduced scale clips constrains the flow Lipschitz constant from (10^{47}) to (10^4); (ii) a coverage-based empirical oscillation bound replaces the vacuous analytical bound with a data-dependent certificate; and (iii) oscillation-regularised training cuts the empirical oscillation by 60--90% at no cost to density fit, extending practical certificates through (D = 20) ((γ^\ast \ge 1.7\times 10^{-4})). Tests on four further targets (Gaussian mixture, shear-building, Neal's funnel, Bayesian logistic regression) identify three precise barriers: boundary curvature, target stiffness, and tail-coverage mismatch. An affine-vs-spline comparison shows that simpler architectures yield tighter certificates at identical NLL, inverting the usual expressiveness hierarchy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出振荡控制归一化流（Oscillation-Controlled Normalizing Flows），首次为Transport MCMC采样器提供非空泛的、严格的谱间隙（spectral-gap）下界。在D=2的香蕉族上认证γ* = 0.828（原始空间覆盖），D=5时γ* ≥ 7.6×10⁻⁴（解析解卷高斯空间中的网格认证梯度界），均达到95%置信度。框架依赖三个支柱：缩减尺度的谱归一化将Lipschitz常数从10⁴⁷降至10⁴；基于覆盖的经验振荡界替代空泛解析界；振荡正则化训练在不损失密度拟合的前提下将经验振荡降低60–90%，将实用认证扩展到D=20（γ* ≥ 1.7×10⁻⁴）。在四个额外目标（高斯混合、剪切建筑、Neal漏斗、贝叶斯逻辑回归）上识别出三个精确障碍：边界曲率、目标刚度、尾部覆盖失配。仿射vs样条比较表明，相同NLL下简单架构产生更紧的认证，颠覆了通常的表达性层次。
Motivation: Transport MCMC通过训练归一化流预处理Metropolis-Hastings提议，在复杂后验上取得了高经验效率，但此前没有任何工作为此类采样器提供数值上非空泛、严格的谱间隙界。
Method: 提出振荡控制归一化流框架，包含三项关键技术：缩减尺度的谱归一化约束流Lipschitz常数；基于覆盖的经验振荡界替代空泛解析界；振荡正则化训练在不影响密度拟合的前提下大幅降低经验振荡。
Result: 在香蕉族上，D=2时认证γ* = 0.828，D=5时γ* ≥ 7.6×10⁻⁴（95%置信）；振荡正则化将经验振荡降低60–90%，并将实用认证扩展到D=20（γ* ≥ 1.7×10⁻⁴）。在四个额外目标上识别了三个障碍；仿射流比样条流在相同NLL下给出更紧的认证。
Conclusion: 本文建立了首个非空泛的Transport MCMC谱间隙认证，并表明通过振荡控制和架构选择可以显著改善认证紧度，但边界曲率、目标刚度和尾部覆盖失配仍是主要障碍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Expanding Spatial and Temporal Context for Robotic Imitation Learning With Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning enables robots to learn how to execute tasks via observation. However, real-world environments like homes and offices are often severely partially observed due to their large spatial scales. In addition, many tasks involve executing a series of subtasks requiring autonomous robots to reason over extended time horizons. To address these challenges, we propose using scene graphs as an explicit and structured memory mechanism in imitation learning. By maintaining a dynamic scene graph that captures object-centric relationships and their evolution over time, our method allows the agent to retain relevant historical context during task execution to efficiently reason over incrementally accrued scene information. Our experiments on simulated mobile manipulation and real-world tabletop manipulation demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy performance, particularly in settings that demand long-term reasoning and robust generalization under partial observability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将场景图作为机器人模仿学习中的显式结构化记忆机制，通过维护动态场景图来捕获对象关系随时间演化，从而在部分观测和长时域任务中提供历史上下文。实验在模拟移动操作和真实桌面操作上验证了该方法在长期推理和泛化方面的提升。
Motivation: 真实环境（如家庭、办公室）空间尺度大导致严重部分观测，且任务包含多个子任务需要长时间推理，现有模仿学习方法缺乏有效记忆机制。
Method: 提出使用动态场景图作为记忆，显式编码对象间关系及其随时间变化，使智能体在任务执行中保留相关历史上下文，逐步累积场景信息进行高效推理。
Result: 摘要报告在模拟移动操作和真实桌面操作任务上，该方法显著提升了策略性能，尤其是在需要长期推理和部分观测下鲁棒泛化的场景。
Conclusion: 场景图作为结构化记忆有效改善了模仿学习在部分观测和长时间跨度的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Training for Zero-Resource Dense Retrieval Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Dense retrievers excel at first-stage candidate generation but lack effective reranking in zero-resource settings. Existing approaches face a fundamental dilemma: cross-encoders deliver strong reranking quality but require costly supervised training and incur high latency, while unsupervised BM25 reranking consistently degrades dense retrieval performance on most of BEIR benchmarks. We propose DART (Dense Adaptive Reranking at Test-time), which resolves this dilemma by adapting the scoring function at inference time. For each query, the top-ranked documents serve as pseudo-positive examples and the bottom-ranked as pseudo-negative examples, providing noisy but readily available supervision to adapt a bilinear scoring matrix $W$ via a small number of gradient updates. We further introduce a confidence-weighted margin loss and a cross-query momentum buffer that warm-starts adaptation across queries. On six BEIR benchmarks, DART achieves a mean per-dataset relative NDCG@10 gain of +2.1% over the dense retrieval baseline with under 10ms additional latency per query, demonstrating a powerful capability for zero-shot performance enhancement and cross-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对密集检索在零资源场景下缺乏有效重排序的问题，提出DART方法，在测试时通过少量梯度更新调整双线性打分矩阵，利用顶部文档作为伪正例、底部文档作为伪负例。在六个BEIR基准上，DART在每条查询增加不到10ms延迟的情况下，相对于密集检索基线平均NDCG@10提升2.1%，展示了零样本性能增强和跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 密集检索在零资源场景下缺乏有效的重排序手段，交叉编码器虽好但需要监督训练且延迟高，无监督BM25重排序反而会降低性能。
Method: 提出DART，在测试时适应评分函数：对每个查询，将排名靠前的文档作为伪正例、靠后的作为伪负例，通过少量梯度更新调整双线性打分矩阵W；并引入置信加权边际损失和跨查询动量缓冲以稳定适应。
Result: 在六个BEIR基准上，DART相对于密集检索基线平均NDCG@10提升2.1%，每条查询额外延迟小于10ms。
Conclusion: DART有效解决了零资源重排序的困境，实现了零样本性能增强和跨域泛化，且延迟开销极低。

papers.title: A Multiscale Network with Supervised Contrastive Learning for Real-Time Facial Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Real-time emotion recognition from facial expressions is a challenging task, particularly in video-based scenarios where multiple emotional states may occur over time. The difficulty increases further due to the fact that each emotional state is associated with facial expressions that vary significantly across individuals. The change of facial expressions portraying emotional state is not discrete, but rather continuous, which is very challenging to represent through computational aids. A system with the ability to detect variations in facial expressions can have a significant impact on determining the emotional state of an individual. Such a system can be very beneficial for psychologists during counseling by providing additional insights into the emotional state of a subject. In this paper, a deep learning-based system is presented to detect emotional changes in real-time video of a person by modeling the change in facial expressions. The current study is conducted on a standard dataset for training of the deep learning system and the system has provided very satisfactory outcomes in this respect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的实时面部情绪识别系统，采用多尺度网络与监督对比学习，通过建模面部表情的连续变化来检测视频中的情绪状态。在标准数据集上训练后，系统取得了满意的识别效果。
Motivation: 实时面部情绪识别在视频场景中具有挑战性，因为情绪状态随时间连续变化且个体间表情差异大，现有计算方法难以有效表征这种连续变化。
Method: 构建一个多尺度深度学习网络，结合监督对比学习（supervised contrastive learning），对视频中面部表情的连续变化进行建模，实现实时情绪识别。
Result: 在标准数据集上训练后，系统提供了非常满意的识别效果。
Conclusion: 该系统有望为心理学家在咨询过程中提供额外的情绪状态洞察，但摘要未提及其局限性或泛化能力。

papers.title: Before the Model Learns the Bug:Fuzzing RLVR Verifiers
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) replaces human preference labels with executable reward functions such as math answer checkers, JSON tool-call validators, and code unit-test harnesses. That makes the reward partly a software artifact: if the verifier is wrong, optimization can learn the bug. We study this failure mode with a lightweight verifier-fuzzing framework that generates adversarial completions, compares buggy and stricter reference verifiers, logs paired decisions, and reports false-positive, false-negative, disagreement, exploit, and uncertainty metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）中验证器错误导致优化学习漏洞的问题，提出一个轻量级验证器模糊测试框架，生成对抗性补全，对比有bug和严格的参考验证器，记录假正、假负、不一致、利用和不确定性等指标。
Motivation: 在RLVR中，验证器是软件制品，一旦存在错误，强化学习优化会学会利用这些漏洞，导致模型行为出现意外缺陷。
Method: 提出一个轻量级模糊测试框架，通过生成对抗性补全，比较有bug的验证器和严格参考验证器的决策，并记录配对指标。
Result: 该框架能够系统性地发现验证器中的漏洞，并量化假正、假负、不一致等指标。
Conclusion: 验证器错误是RLVR中一个被忽视的风险，该模糊测试框架有助于在模型学习这些漏洞之前识别并修复它们。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leyline: KV Cache Directives for Agentic Inference
papers.abstract_en: Modern KV cache management assumes the chatbot workload: prompts arrive once and the cache grows append-only, so prefix caching and forward-only eviction are correct by construction. Agentic LLMs break this assumption. Their conversations evolve through policy-driven editing: failed tool calls are retried, stale outputs dropped, trajectories pivoted. Two distinct cache problems result. First, identical content moves to new positions between turns, invalidating exact-prefix caches even though the underlying KV would still be valid; recent work on position-independent caching for MLA addresses this reuse problem. Second, and this paper's focus, a policy may need to direct the serving system to actively remove or replace a span of cached content and continue without re-prefilling everything that came after. No existing primitive offers this. Production agentic harnesses fall back to re-prefill on every edit, paying full prefix-recomputation cost; kernel-level eviction methods make their own decisions and cannot accept policy directives from outside the kernel. We introduce Leyline, a serving-side primitive that closes this gap. A declarative directive 4-tuple separates what to edit from how to preserve position correctness. The policy declares the edit and its mode (in-place splice or prefix-trimmed re-prefill for semantic forgetting); an architecture-agnostic interface routes to a per-architecture kernel that restores attention math via a closed-form RoPE-rotation correction. The splice kernel lifts replay cache-hit by +11.2 pp and cuts latency by up to 241 ms. A ten-line truncation rule routed through the same interface lifts agentic solve rate by +14.3 pp on debug-gym. The mechanism is open; the policy space it enables is the agenda.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Leyline，一种面向代理推理（agentic inference）的KV缓存管理原语。针对代理LLM中策略驱动的编辑操作（如重试失败工具调用、丢弃过时输出）导致现有前缀缓存失效的问题，Leyline通过声明式指令四元组将编辑内容与位置校正分离，并通过架构无关接口调用特定内核（如splice核、前缀修剪核），支持原位拼接或前缀修剪后重预填充。实验表明，splice核提升回放缓存命中率11.2个百分点，降低延迟241毫秒；截断规则通过同一接口提升代理求解率14.3个百分点。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存管理假设聊天工作负载（前缀缓存、只追加增长），但代理LLM中策略驱动的内容编辑（如重试、输出丢弃）破坏此假设：已缓存的内容因位置变化而无效，且缺乏接受外部策略指令的原语。现有系统在每次编辑时需重预填充整个前缀，造成高计算成本。
Method: 提出Leyline服务端原语，通过声明式指令四元组（编辑内容、模式（原位拼接或前缀修剪重预填充）等）分离编辑语义与位置校正；设计架构无关接口，路由至特定内核（如splice核），利用闭式RoPE旋转校正恢复注意力计算。支持单次调用中完成缓存编辑和位置修正。
Result: 摘要报告：splice核使回放缓存命中率提升11.2个百分点，延迟降低241毫秒；一个十行的截断规则通过同一接口使代理求解率提升14.3个百分点（在debug-gym上）。
Conclusion: 该机制是开放的，为策略空间的设计提供了议程；但其有效性依赖于具体策略实现，且对非RoPE架构的适配性未讨论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MindClaw: Closed-Loop Embodied Mental-State Reasoning for Precision Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Theory of Mind (ToM) enables an agent to reason about another actor's beliefs, goals, and intentions, which is essential for human-centered embodied assistance. Existing ToM benchmarks have advanced text and multimodal mental-state recognition, but they mostly evaluate offline question answering or final action prediction. They do not fully test whether an embodied agent can stay connected to a changing environment, update actor-specific beliefs, decide when reasoning is needed, and intervene only when help is useful. Building on MindPower, we extend robot-centric ToM reasoning to a real-time closed-loop setting and introduce MindClaw, a framework for embodied mental-state reasoning with precision intervention. MindClaw connects multi-source inputs, belief memory, an embodied cognitive trigger skill, mental reasoning, and action generation, allowing the agent to output helpful actions at the right time while remaining silent when intervention is unnecessary. Experiments show that direct VLM baselines struggle with task awareness and intervention calibration, while MindClaw achieves the best overall performance, demonstrating the importance of trigger-skill optimization for closed-loop embodied ToM assistance.
papers.comment: Extended version of the CVPR 2026 paper *MindPower: Enabling Theory-of-Mind Reasoning in VLM-based Embodied Agents*
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文将心理理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）推理扩展到实时闭环具身场景，提出MindClaw框架，连接多源输入、信念记忆、具身认知触发技能、心智推理和动作生成，使智能体在需要时提供帮助，否则保持沉默。实验表明直接VLM基线在任务感知和干预校准上不足，MindClaw取得最佳整体性能。
Motivation: 现有ToM基准主要评估离线问答或最终动作预测，未测试具身智能体能否实时感知环境变化、更新信念、决定何时需要推理、并仅在有用时干预。
Method: 提出MindClaw闭环框架，包含多源输入、信念记忆、具身认知触发技能、心智推理和动作生成模块，实现精确干预。
Result: 直接VLM基线在任务感知和干预校准上表现不佳，MindClaw取得最佳整体性能，证明了触发技能优化对闭环具身ToM辅助的重要性。
Conclusion: 强调触发技能优化对于闭环具身ToM辅助的重要性，MindClaw展示了进行实时精确干预的能力。

papers.title: DAG-MoE: From Simple Mixture to Structural Aggregation in Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a leading approach for decoupling parameter count from computational cost in large language models, yet effectively scaling MoE performance remains a challenge. Prior work shows that fine-grained experts enlarge the space of expert combinations and improve flexibility, but they also impose substantial routing overhead, creating a new scalability bottleneck. In this paper, we explore a complementary axis for scaling -- how expert outputs are aggregated. We theoretically show that replacing the standard weighted-summation aggregation with structural aggregation expands the expert-combination space without altering the experts or router, and enables possible multi-step reasoning within a single MoE layer. To this end, we propose DAG-MoE, a sparse MoE framework that employs a lightweight module to automatically learn the optimal aggregation structure among the selected experts. Extensive experiments under standard language modeling settings show that DAG-MoE consistently improves performance in both pretraining and fine-tuning, surpassing traditional MoE baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAG-MoE，用轻量级模块自动学习所选专家之间的最优聚合结构（有向无环图），替代传统加权求和聚合，以扩展专家组合空间并实现单层MoE内的多步推理。在语言建模预训练和微调中持续提升性能。
Motivation: 传统MoE使用加权求和聚合，限制了专家组合的表达能力；细粒度专家虽增加组合但引入路由开销。本文探索聚合方式作为缩放维度。
Method: 提出DAG-MoE框架，包含一个轻量级模块自动学习所学专家输出的有向无环图聚合结构，代替简单加权求和。
Result: 在标准语言建模设置下的预训练和微调实验中，DAG-MoE持续优于传统MoE基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过结构聚合扩展专家组合空间，可实现单层内的多步推理，为MoE缩放提供新方向。

papers.title: MENTIS: What Belief Changes Under Alignment? Measuring Multi-Scale Latent Torsion in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Preference alignment has substantially improved the observable behavior of large language models, yet it remains unclear what alignment changes internally. Aligned systems still fail under jailbreaks, prompt injection, and retrieval-time corruption, suggesting behavior-level evaluation alone is incomplete. Post-training should leave measurable traces in internal computation. We ask: when an instruction-tuned (IT) model becomes a preference-aligned (PA) model, what geometric structure changes, where do those changes concentrate, and how selectively do they vary across concepts, prompts, and model families? We introduce MENTIS, a geometry-first framework for measuring alignment-induced internal reorganization in paired checkpoints. MENTIS compares IT and PA models using a primary layerwise covariance-based torsion norm (T1), a secondary spectral torsion diagnostic (T2), and an Energy-Radiance-Activation measure (ERA) for depth localization. Across four 7-8B model pairs on LITMUS, our study reveals that alignment-induced change is selective rather than uniform: normative concepts exhibit larger torsion shifts than factual concepts on average; torsion is negatively correlated with contextual entropy; and peak effects localize to architecture-specific mid-to-late layers. The same pattern appears across word-level, prompt-level, and model-level analyses. These results suggest preference alignment leaves structured, depth-localized geometric signatures in internal computation beyond what behavior-level evaluation alone can reveal.

papers.title: 3DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agentic Procedural 3D Modeling Via Code
papers.abstract_en: Procedural 3D modeling through code is emerging as a versatile paradigm, offering deterministic, engine-ready, and precisely editable assets that neural 3D generators inherently lack. Authoring such procedural content, however, demands deep expertise in 3D software APIs, parametric design, and code-level geometric reasoning. In this paper, we propose 3DCodeBench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents for procedural 3D generation in 3D modeling software. Specifically, 3DCodeBench evaluates how effectively 12 advanced VLMs can serve as procedural 3D modelers by translating text and image references into procedural code for 3D modeling software. Recognizing that automated metrics may not fully capture the perceptual quality of 3D shapes, we build 3DCodeArena, a ranking platform based on pairwise human preferences over generated 3D outputs. From extensive evaluations and results, we observe that: (1) Failures mostly arise from API mismatches, while successful renders still suffer from disconnected or floating 3D geometric components. (2) Test-time scaling, such as higher thinking budgets and multi-turn refinement, improves performance overall. Our findings highlight a critical need for high-quality procedural coding data to advance commercial VLMs. Furthermore, effective procedural 3D modeling requires a robust execution environment that provides high-fidelity feedback for iterative refinement. We release 3DCodeBench, including the curated large-scale dataset of multimodal (text/image) prompts, procedural code, 3D object triplets, evaluation protocol, and the public 3DCodeArena platform as a foundational toolkit for exploring VLM-based procedural 3D modelers.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 3DCodeBench，一个系统性的基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）代理通过代码进行程序化 3D 建模的能力。基准测试包含多模态提示、程序化代码和 3D 对象三元组，并引入基于成对人类偏好的排名平台 3DCodeArena。评估了 12 种先进 VLM，发现失败主要源于 API 不匹配，成功渲染仍存在几何组件断开或漂浮问题，测试时扩展（如更高思考预算和多轮精炼）能提升性能。
Motivation: 程序化 3D 建模通过代码生成确定性、可直接编辑的资产，但需要深厚的 3D 软件 API、参数设计和代码级几何推理专业知识。现有方法缺乏系统的基准来评估 VLM 代理在此任务上的效果。
Method: 构建包含多模态（文本/图像）提示、程序化代码和 3D 对象三元组的数据集，设计评估协议，并搭建基于成对人类偏好的排名平台 3DCodeArena，用于评估 VLM 代理生成程序化代码的质量。
Result: 评估 12 种先进 VLM 发现，失败主要由 API 不匹配导致，成功渲染仍存在几何组件断开或漂浮问题。测试时扩展（更高思考预算、多轮精炼）能整体提升性能。
Conclusion: 需要高质量的程序化编码数据来推进商业 VLM，有效的程序化 3D 建模需要提供高保真反馈的稳健执行环境以进行迭代精炼。

papers.title: AnyEdit++: Adaptive Long-Form Knowledge Editing via Bayesian Surprise
papers.abstract_en: Editing complex, long-form knowledge in Large Language Models remains a significant challenge due to the difficulty of maintaining generation coherence. Existing autoregressive methods like AnyEdit alleviate length constraints but rely on Fixed-window Chunking, which disregards logical structure and compromises consistency. To address this, we present AnyEdit++, a structure-aware framework incorporating Bayes-Chunk, an adaptive segmentation mechanism that dynamically identifies semantic boundaries based on Bayesian Surprise. We underpin this approach with a theoretical framework establishing two key principles: (1) Structural Independence: we prove that cross-segment interference is minimized when anchor keys are geometrically orthogonal (a condition naturally satisfied by our surprisal-based boundaries but violated by fixed windows), and (2) Causal Locality: we demonstrate that updates injected at these semantic peaks yield strictly superior control compared to arbitrary split points. Extensive experiments across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and narrative tasks demonstrate that AnyEdit++ achieves superior performance and robustness compared to state-of-the-art baselines, validating that structural awareness is critical for effective long-form knowledge editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AnyEdit++，一种结构感知的长形式知识编辑框架，通过基于贝叶斯惊奇的自适应分割机制（Bayes-Chunk）动态识别语义边界，解决了现有方法因固定窗口分块导致的逻辑结构破坏和生成不一致问题。理论证明结构独立性和因果局部性两个原则，实验在数学推理、代码生成和叙事任务上优于最新基线。
Motivation: 现有长形式知识编辑方法如AnyEdit依赖固定窗口分块，忽视逻辑结构，导致编辑后生成文本的一致性受损。需要一种能感知语义结构的自适应分割方法。
Method: 提出AnyEdit++框架，核心是Bayes-Chunk自适应分割机制，利用贝叶斯惊奇检测语义边界，实现结构感知的分块。理论层面建立两个原则：结构独立性（锚点键几何正交时跨段干扰最小）和因果局部性（在语义峰值处注入更新提供更优控制）。
Result: 在数学推理、代码生成和叙事任务上的实验表明，AnyEdit++相比现有基线取得更优的性能和鲁棒性，验证了结构感知对长形式知识编辑的关键作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构感知对长形式知识编辑的重要性，AnyEdit++通过自适应分割和理论原则有效提升了编辑的一致性和控制力。

papers.title: Interaction-Limited Safe Continuous-Time RL for Dynamical Medical Treatment
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic medical treatment requires deciding treatment intensity and intervention timing, while patient states evolve continuously and adverse events may occur between clinical interactions. Most existing treatment learning methods assume fixed schedules or enforce safety only at discrete decision points. We propose Interaction-Limited Safe Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning, a framework that jointly optimizes treatment administration and clinical interaction timing under trajectory-level safety constraints. Our key idea is to reformulate the continuous time treatment problem as an option-based semi-Markov decision process, where each option specifies a continuous-time treatment policy and its duration. We develop a safety-tightening mechanism showing that suitably constructed constraints at interaction times guarantee safety over the full continuous-time trajectory with high probability. We further establish finite-sample guarantees for policy learning from logged treatment trajectories and introduce a practical data-driven conservative surrogate. Experiments show that the proposed adaptive interaction-timing mechanism improves both safety and treatment effectiveness over equidistant interaction schemes across different safe policy optimization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Interaction-Limited Safe Continuous-Time RL框架，将动态医疗治疗建模为基于选项的半马尔可夫决策过程（option-based semi-Markov decision process），每个选项指定连续时间治疗策略和持续时间。通过安全收紧机制证明交互时刻的约束能以高概率保证全轨迹安全，并给出有限样本学习保证与数据驱动保守代理。实验表明自适应交互时机相比等距方案在安全性和治疗效果上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有动态治疗学习方法假设固定时间表或仅在离散决策点保证安全性，无法处理患者状态连续演化及交互间不良事件风险。
Method: 提出基于选项的半马尔可夫决策过程，每个选项包含连续时间治疗策略与持续时间；开发安全收紧机制，利用交互时刻的约束保证全连续轨迹安全；并引入有限样本学习保证与数据驱动保守代理。
Result: 实验表明，自适应交互时机机制在不同安全策略优化方法上均比等距交互方案改善了安全性和治疗效果。
Conclusion: 该框架通过联合优化治疗管理与临床交互时机，在轨迹级安全约束下提升安全性与有效性。

papers.title: TextFake: Benchmarking AI-Generated Image Detection on Text-Rich Images
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors perform well on natural-image benchmarks, but their behavior on text-rich forgeries, such as fabricated screenshots, documents, and news pages prevalent in misinformation, remains untested. We introduce TextFake, a 20,000-image benchmark for text-rich AIGI detection spanning 28 languages, 4 topic categories, and 2 scene modalities. Fake images are synthesized via a four-stage pipeline that annotates real images along three controlled dimensions and generates counterparts through distribution-aligned structured prompting, ruling out covariate shortcuts. Zero-shot evaluation of 14 specialized detectors and 3 frontier VLM APIs reveals a large systematic gap: no method exceeds 80% accuracy, with some dropping over 60% from natural-image benchmarks. Diagnostic evaluations identify three failure modes: the Text Density Curse, where dense glyphs overwhelm low-level detectors; Cloaking via Rendering Fidelity, where stronger text rendering suppresses enerative artifacts; and Threshold Collapse, where routine perturbations drive detectors toward chance-level performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TextFake基准，用于检测AI生成的文本丰富图像（如伪造截图、文档和新闻页面），包含20,000张图像、28种语言、4个主题类别和2种场景模态。零样本评估14个专用检测器和3个前沿VLM API，发现无方法准确率超过80%，部分方法相比自然图像基准下降超60%。诊断出三种失败模式：文本密度诅咒、渲染保真度伪装和阈值崩溃。
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器在自然图像上表现良好，但未测试其在文本丰富的伪造图像（如虚假截图、文档、新闻页面）上的性能，而这些图像在虚假信息中很常见。
Method: 构建TextFake基准：通过四阶段流水线合成伪造图像，包括标注真实图像、控制三维度、分布对齐的结构化提示生成，排除协变量捷径。
Result: 零样本评估显示，14个专用检测器和3个VLM API均未超过80%准确率，部分检测器性能下降超60%。诊断出文本密度诅咒、渲染保真度伪装和阈值崩溃三种失败模式。
Conclusion: 文本丰富图像的AI生成检测存在系统性差距，现有方法在密集文本、高渲染保真度和常规扰动下表现脆弱，需要专门设计。

papers.title: Decoupled Residual Denoising Diffusion Models for Unified and Data Efficient Image-to-Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: We propose Decoupled Residual Denoising Diffusion models (DRDD) for unified and data-efficient image-to-image (I2I) translation. While diffusion models have advanced I2I translation in terms of quality and diversity, we uncover a previously under-explored property in diffusion models. Crucially, beyond its conventional role of manifold lifting (i.e., moving data off low-dimensional manifolds), injecting Gaussian noise facilitates domain harmonization by implicitly aligning feature distributions across domains, a property particularly advantageous for unified I2I translation. However, existing diffusion models prematurely erode this harmonization effect, as noise and residuals are simultaneously removed in a single coupled diffusion process. To address this, DRDD decouples the diffusion process into two sequential and independent diffusion stages: (1) a stochastic noise diffusion for domain harmonization and manifold lifting, and (2) a deterministic residual diffusion that learns the core semantic mapping entirely within the fixed-noise domain. This decoupling preserves harmonization and manifold lifting effects throughout the transformation, substantially simplifying the learning of unified mappings across diverse tasks and domains. Notably, the noise diffusion stage is trained exclusively on abundant, unpaired target-domain images, greatly improving data efficiency. Comprehensive theoretical and empirical analysis demonstrates that DRDD is broadly compatible with mainstream diffusion models and consistently delivers robust, unified I2I translation, even under limited paired data. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DRDD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出去耦残差去噪扩散模型（DRDD），用于统一且数据高效的图像到图像翻译。关键发现是注入高斯噪声除了传统流形提升作用外，还能隐式对齐不同领域的特征分布，实现领域协调。DRDD将扩散过程解耦为两个独立阶段：随机噪声扩散（用于领域协调和流形提升）和确定性残差扩散（在固定噪声域中学习核心语义映射）。该方法在少量配对数据下也能实现鲁棒的统一I2I翻译。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在统一图像到图像翻译中，噪声和残差同时在单个耦合扩散过程中被去除，过早破坏了领域协调效应。需要一种解耦机制来保持领域协调和流形提升效果。
Method: DRDD将扩散过程解耦为两个独立阶段：第一阶段是随机噪声扩散，仅使用大量无配对目标域图像训练，实现领域协调和流形提升；第二阶段是确定性残差扩散，在固定噪声域中学习核心语义映射，简化跨任务和跨域的统一映射学习。
Result: 理论分析和实证表明DRDD与主流扩散模型广泛兼容，在有限配对数据下也能实现鲁棒、统一的图像到图像翻译。

papers.title: TravelEval: A Comprehensive Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating LLM-Powered Travel Planning Agents
papers.abstract_en: The development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly improved travel planning applications, yet evaluating such models is limited by existing benchmarks' limitations: 1) overemphasis on constraint compliance, neglecting multi-dimensional qualities like spatio-temporal cost; 2) datasets lacking real-world authenticity and coverage in key areas (e.g., lodging, transport); and 3) isolated daily plan assessments that miss critical details (e.g., the impact of daily accommodation and visit pacing) needed for entire plan's evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce TravelEval, a realistic and comprehensive benchmark. TravelEval features 1) a novel six-dimensional evaluation framework to holistically assess plans across accuracy, compliance, temporality, spatiality, economy, and utility dimensions; 2) a highly realistic data sandbox with precise accommodation pricing and authentic intercity transportation data; and 3) a simulation-based global evaluation method that emulates complete travel plans with API-integrated geographic information and fine-grained queuing time. Evaluating 12 mainstream approaches with TravelEval reveals several valuable insights, such that LLMs struggle with globally-optimized multi-dimensional planning (especially in spatio-temporal reasoning and budget compliance), and agentic reasoning strategies offer no consistent improvement. Concisely, TravelEval facilitates travel plan evaluation via grounded spatio-temporal emulation and comprehensive metrics, providing a robust foundation for advancing LLM-powered travel planning research and applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TravelEval 是一个面向 LLM 驱动的旅行规划代理的全面评测框架，包含六维评估体系（准确度、合规性、时间性、空间性、经济性、效用）、高真实感数据沙箱和基于仿真的全局评估方法。对 12 种主流方法的评测显示，LLM 在多维度全局优化规划（特别是时空推理和预算合规）方面存在困难，且代理推理策略未带来一致改进。
Motivation: 现有旅行规划评测基准存在三点不足：过度强调约束合规而忽略时空成本等多维质量；数据集缺乏真实性和关键区域覆盖（如住宿、交通）；孤立评估每日计划而忽略住宿安排、游览节奏等全局细节。
Method: 提出 TravelEval 基准，包括：1) 六维评估框架（准确度、合规性、时间性、空间性、经济性、效用）；2) 高真实感数据沙箱（精确住宿定价和真实城际交通数据）；3) 基于仿真的全局评估方法，集成 API 地理信息和细粒度排队时间模拟完整旅行计划。
Result: 对 12 种主流方法的评测揭示：LLM 在多维度全局优化规划（尤其是时空推理和预算合规）上表现不佳，且代理推理策略并未带来一致改进。
Conclusion: TravelEval 通过基于真实时空仿真和综合度量指标，为推进 LLM 驱动的旅行规划研究与应用提供了稳健基础。

papers.title: Ask4VG: Risk-Aware Question Selection for Reducing Prior-Driven Answers in Medical VQA
papers.abstract_en: Medical visual question answering requires models to ground their responses in image evidence, because visually unsupported answers can mislead downstream interpretation. However, many medical VQA questions are generic, template-like, or highly similar in form, which can encourage models to learn question-answer shortcuts instead of image-dependent reasoning and thereby increase the risk of hallucinated responses. We propose Ask4VG, a label-free pilot framework for risk-aware question selection. Ask4VG estimates question-induced hallucination risk through counterfactual visual probing: the same question is asked under the original image, a perturbed image, a blank image, and a mismatched image, and the resulting answer relations are converted into weak supervision for a counterfactual risk estimator. The learned estimator then reranks candidate question rewrites to favor intent-preserving questions that are less invariant to missing or mismatched visual evidence before final answer generation. On VQA-RAD with Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, prompt-only rewriting increases counterfactual risk, whereas predicted-risk reranking reduces held-out risk from 0.658 to 0.623 and improves exact accuracy from 0.337 to 0.356. A 300-sample PMC-VQA external check shows the same direction of risk reduction with a small accuracy gain. These results suggest that question selection is a promising complement to response-level hallucination mitigation for reliable medical VQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ask4VG，一个无标签的医学视觉问答（VQA）问题选择框架，通过反事实视觉探针估计问题引发的幻觉风险，并重排序候选问题改写以减少模型对视觉证据的忽视。在 VQA-RAD 上，该方法将反事实风险从 0.658 降至 0.623，精确准确率从 0.337 提升至 0.356。
Motivation: 医学 VQA 中，通用或模板化的问题容易导致模型学习问题-答案捷径而非图像依赖推理，增加幻觉风险。现有方法多聚焦于响应层面的幻觉缓解，而问题选择作为补充策略尚未被充分探索。
Method: Ask4VG 使用反事实视觉探针：对同一问题分别输入原图、扰动图、空白图和不匹配图，利用答案关系构建弱监督信号训练风险估计器，再对候选问题改写根据预测风险重新排序，选择对视觉证据缺失或错配更不鲁棒的问题（即更依赖图像的问题）。
Result: 在 Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct 模型上，基于 VQA-RAD 数据集，仅 prompt 改写会使反事实风险升高，而基于预测风险的重排序将留出反事实风险从 0.658 降至 0.623，精确准确率从 0.337 提升至 0.356。在 PMC-VQA 的 300 样本外部检验中观察到风险降低和小幅准确率提升。
Conclusion: 问题选择是响应级幻觉缓解的有效补充手段，可提升医学 VQA 的可靠性。

papers.title: Plausibility Is Not Prediction: Contrastive Evidence for LLM-Based Cellular Perturbation Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Perturbation experiments are central to understanding cellular mechanisms, but remain costly and sparse, motivating prediction of gene expression responses for unobserved conditions. A promising recent direction leverages large language models (LLMs) as "virtual cell" simulators-using stepwise, knowledge-grounded mechanistic reasoning to infer differential expression-pointing toward an interpretable, knowledge-driven paradigm that transcends purely data-driven approaches. However, we find that plausibility is not prediction: despite producing biologically plausible explanations, these methods fail to capture perturbation-specific effects: systematically overestimating differential expression, often underperforming a simple gene-frequency baseline in aggregate evaluations, and collapsing to chance-level performance at the per-gene level. This reveals a reliance on intrinsic gene response tendencies rather than true perturbation reasoning. We trace this failure to how evidence is presented: existing methods evaluate perturbation-gene pairs in isolation, without exposing how related perturbations differ in their effects on the same gene. To address this limitation, we introduce CORE (Contrastive Organization of Relational Evidence), which reframes prediction as a comparison task by organizing evidence into positive and negative outcomes from related perturbations. Using a biomedical knowledge graph for evidence retrieval, CORE improves calibration and substantially boosts perturbation-specific prediction in both LLM-based and non-LLM settings: for example, on drug-perturbation data, CORE-Reasoning improves Qwen3.5-9B aggregate metrics by up to 28.6%, while on generic perturbation data, CORE-Voting raises macro-per-gene AUROC from chance to 0.703 in average across four cell lines. This highlights contrastive evidence organization as essential to reliable LLM-based perturbation reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）用于细胞扰动推理的可靠性，发现尽管LLM能生成生物合理的解释，但其预测性能较差，往往不如简单基线，且无法捕捉扰动特异性效应。作者提出CORE（对比证据组织），通过将预测重构为比较任务，利用生物医学知识图检索相关扰动的正反证据，显著提升了LLM和非LLM方法的扰动特异性预测能力，例如在药物扰动数据上将Qwen3.5-9B的聚合指标提升28.6%，在通用扰动数据上使每基因AUROC从随机水平提升至平均0.703。
Motivation: 现有LLM方法在细胞扰动推理中只强调解释的合情理性，但忽视实际预测能力，导致在扰动特异性效应上表现差，甚至不如简单的基因频率基线。
Method: 提出CORE方法，将预测任务重新定义为对比任务：通过生物医学知识图检索相关扰动，组织正（相同效应）和负（不同效应）证据，使模型在比较中更准确判断扰动-基因关系。
Result: 在药物扰动数据上，CORE-Reasoning将Qwen3.5-9B的聚合指标提升28.6%；在通用扰动数据上，CORE-Voting将四个细胞系的每基因宏平均AUROC从随机水平提升至0.703。
Conclusion: 对比证据组织是可靠LLM扰动推理的关键，能有效解决“合理性不等于预测”的问题。

papers.title: OPD+: Rethinking the Advantage Design for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a widely used technique to transfer capabilities from capable teacher language models to the base student models, and can be formulated in a reinforcement learning style objective using student generated rollouts. Yet, despite the divergence reward being dependent on student model likelihood, existing works usually adopt a stop gradient design primarily for stability, which makes the resulting advantage estimation questionable. In this work, we provide a generic optimization framework based on f-divergence between the student and teacher, and mathematically revisit whether such design space is valid. We prove that general stop-gradient operation would lead to biased estimates of the reward objective and corresponding gradient for general divergence functions. We propose OPD+, the corrected version of OPD that demonstrates improved performance over the baseline KL approach and also supports the choice of various f-divergence. We validate our findings on mathematical reasoning and tool-use benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 on-policy distillation 中常用的 stop gradient 设计导致优势估计有偏的问题，提出基于 f-divergence 的通用优化框架。通过数学证明 stop gradient 会引入梯度偏差，并提出修正版本 OPD+，在数学推理和工具使用基准上优于基线 KL 方法。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation 方法为了稳定性普遍采用 stop gradient，但该设计使得优势估计存在偏差，影响学生模型的学习效果。
Method: 提出基于 f-divergence 的通用优化框架，理论分析 stop gradient 带来的梯度偏差，并设计无偏修正版本 OPD+，支持多种 f-divergence 的选择。
Result: 在数学推理和工具使用基准上，OPD+ 相比于基线 KL 方法取得更好的性能。
Conclusion: OPD+ 修正了 stop gradient 导致的优势估计偏差，为 on-policy distillation 提供了更通用的优化框架。

papers.title: TriLens: Per-Layer Logit-Lens Entropy for White-Box Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract_en: When a language model hallucinates, the final answer is wrong, but the mistake is not necessarily invisible inside the model. Different internal pathways may remain uncertain, disagree in how quickly they sharpen, or commit to competing continuations before the output is produced. We introduce TriLens, a white-box detector that turns this intuition into a compact representation: at every layer, it reads the multi-head self-attention output, the feed-forward output, and the residual stream through the model's own logit lens, then records only the entropy of each readout. The resulting 3L-dimensional trajectory describes how certainty forms across depth and across modules, without storing high-dimensional hidden states or sampling multiple generations. This simple signal yields a strong detector across instruction-tuned LLMs and QA benchmarks, and our analyses show that the three module-wise entropy trajectories provide complementary evidence. TriLens suggests that hallucination detection can benefit from tracking how internal computation settles, not only what the final layer predicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TriLens 是一种白盒幻觉检测方法，通过在每个 Transformer 层读取多头自注意力输出、前馈输出和残差流的熵（通过 logit lens 投影），形成 3L 维轨迹来表征模型内部的不确定性。实验表明，该信号在指令微调 LLM 和问答基准上能有效检测幻觉，且三个模块的熵轨迹提供互补信息。
Motivation: 语言模型产生幻觉时，最终答案错误，但内部计算过程可能已存在不确定或分歧，现有检测方法多依赖最终层输出或采样多个生成，未充分利用层间模块级的不确定性信号。
Method: 提出 TriLens，在每个 Transformer 层对多头自注意力输出、前馈输出和残差流使用 logit lens 投影到词汇空间，计算其熵，从而得到 3L 维轨迹（每层三个熵值），作为紧凑的幻觉检测特征。
Result: 在多个指令微调 LLM 和 QA 基准上，该基于熵轨迹的检测器取得强性能，且三个模块的熵轨迹提供互补证据。
Conclusion: 幻觉检测可受益于追踪内部计算如何稳定，而不仅依赖最终层预测，TriLens 提供了一种低存储开销的有效方案。

summary_sections.method: 提出 TriLens，在每个 Transformer 层对多头自注意力输出、前馈输出和残差流使用 logit lens 投影到词汇空间，计算其熵，从而得到 3L 维轨迹（每层三个熵值），作为紧凑的幻觉检测特征。
summary_sections.result: 在多个指令微调 LLM 和 QA 基准上，该基于熵轨迹的检测器取得强性能，且三个模块的熵轨迹提供互补证据。
summary_sections.conclusion: 幻觉检测可受益于追踪内部计算如何稳定，而不仅依赖最终层预测，TriLens 提供了一种低存储开销的有效方案。

papers.title: Temporally-Aligned Evaluation for Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven talking-head generation has advanced rapidly, yet existing evaluation protocols mainly rely on frame-wise metrics that assume strict temporal correspondence between generated and reference videos. This assumption does not match speech-driven facial motion, which naturally includes slight timing shifts, different speaking speeds, and stylistic variations. As a result, conventional metrics may treat harmless timing differences as quality errors, making it harder to fairly compare methods and understand their trade-offs. In this work, we argue that evaluation of dynamic generative models should be formulated as a sequence-alignment problem rather than independent frame comparison. We introduce a unified sequence-level reformulation that integrates Soft Dynamic Time Warping into established evaluation pipelines. By aligning feature trajectories while preserving temporal order, the proposed framework provides robustness to bounded temporal misalignments without altering the underlying perceptual, identity, or synchronization encoders. We show that frame-wise evaluation can be viewed as a special case under rigid alignment, while sequence-level alignment provides improved stability, lower sensitivity to timing differences, and clearer separation between modeling paradigms. Building on this principled formulation, we conduct a large-scale benchmark of 20 methods across seven datasets spanning canonical, in-the-wild, and style-diverse scenarios under standardized protocols. Extensive experiments show that temporally aligned metrics are more robust to timing differences, provide more consistent results across datasets, and better reveal systematic trade-offs between modeling paradigms, such as synchronization versus realism and expressiveness versus stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将音频驱动的说话头生成评价重新定义为序列对齐问题，引入软动态时间规整（Soft-DTW）到现有评价流程中，以容忍时间偏差、语速差异和风格变化。通过标准化协议对20种方法在7个数据集上进行大规模基准测试，表明时序对齐指标对时间差异更鲁棒，能更好地区分建模范式间的权衡（如同步性与真实感、表达性与稳定性）。
Motivation: 现有评价协议依赖帧级度量，假设生成视频与参考视频之间存在严格的时间对应，但这与语音驱动的面部运动（自然包含轻微时间偏移、不同语速和风格变化）不匹配，导致无害的时间差异被误判为质量错误，难以公平比较方法。
Method: 将评价重新表述为序列对齐问题，在保持时间顺序的同时，通过软动态时间规整（Soft Dynamic Time Warping）对齐特征轨迹，并将其集成到现有的感知、身份或同步编码器管线中。
Result: 在7个数据集上对20种方法的基准测试表明，时序对齐指标对时间差异更鲁棒，跨数据集结果更一致，并更清晰地揭示建模范式间的系统权衡（如同步性与真实感、表达性与稳定性）。
Conclusion: 帧级评价可视为刚性对齐的特例，而序列级对齐提供了改进的稳定性、更低的时序差异敏感性和更清晰的范式区分。

papers.title: MedGym:A Unified Continuous-Time Benchmark for Dynamic Medical Treatment Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Medical treatment recommendation poses several challenges to reinforcement learning (RL): patient physiology evolves in continuous time, measurements and interventions are performed at irregular intervals, and treatment effects vary substantially across individuals. Existing RL formulations and simulated environments, however, are based on discrete-time MDP or POMDP abstractions with fixed or pre-specified decision intervals. Thus, it remains difficult to evaluate whether RL methods can handle time-interval-dependent disease progression, personalized treatment response, and safety between consecutive measurement points. To address this gap, we introduce MedGym, a benchmark environment for dynamic treatment recommendation. MedGym models longitudinal patient evolution in a continuous-time framework and constructs a configurable medical RL benchmark from clinical data by using Physics-Informed Neural Networks. The resulting benchmark supports both offline and online RL, and enables direct comparison between discrete-time and continuous-time methods under irregular treatment timing and patient-specific dynamics. Besides, MedGym supports evaluation from clinically important perspectives, including personalization, trajectory-level safety, and the performance gap between model-based offline learning and online deployment. By providing a standardized and configurable benchmark for continuous-time dynamic treatment, MedGym aims to facilitate more realistic and informative evaluation of medical RL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedGym是一个用于动态医疗治疗强化学习的连续时间基准环境。它利用物理信息神经网络从临床数据构建可配置的医疗RL基准，支持离线和在线RL，并允许在非规则治疗时间和患者特定动态下比较离散时间和连续时间方法。该基准还支持个性化、轨迹级安全性以及基于模型的离线学习与在线部署之间的性能差距评估。
Motivation: 现有RL公式和模拟环境基于离散时间MDP/POMDP，难以评估RL方法处理时间间隔依赖的疾病进展、个性化治疗反应及测量点间安全性的能力。
Method: 提出MedGym，一个连续时间框架下的动态治疗推荐基准，使用物理信息神经网络从临床数据构建，支持离线和在线RL，并允许离散时间与连续时间方法的直接比较。
Result: MedGym提供了标准化、可配置的连续时间动态治疗基准，支持从个性化、轨迹级安全性及模型学习与在线部署差距等临床重要角度的评估。
Conclusion: MedGym旨在促进对医疗RL方法更现实和更有信息的评估。

papers.title: DSL-LLaDA: Scaling Continuous Denoising to 8B Masked Diffusion LMs
papers.abstract_en: Discrete Masked diffusion language models generate text by iterative parallel decoding, but few-step decoding suffers from a tradeoff between length and quality: with a fixed step budget, standard methods can generate a short, high-quality output, or they can produce long but repetitive text. Continuous denoising can sidestep this tradeoff by evolving all positions jointly in embedding space, but building such a model from scratch at scale remains an open problem. We show that a pretrained masked DLM can instead be lightly adapted to support continuous embedding-space denoising. Starting from LLaDA-8B-Instruct, we continue-pretrain for only 1,000 steps with Discrete Stochastic Localization (DSL), replacing binary masking with continuous per-token Gaussian noise as a soft mask. The adapted model supports continuous inference that evolves all positions jointly in embedding space and defers hard token commitment to the final step. On zero-shot summarization at low step budgets (<=16 forward passes), DSL-LLaDA-SDE achieves the best ROUGE-1 on all four benchmarks and largely avoids the premature-termination / repetition tradeoff of iterative unmasking. The same adaptation also yields selective noisy-state robustness: the model corrects corrupted tokens while preserving clean ones. Control experiments using standard masked diffusion training with the same compute demonstrate neither behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DSL-LLaDA，通过将预训练的掩码扩散语言模型（LLaDA-8B-Instruct）进行轻量连续预训练（仅1000步），使用离散随机定位（DSL）将二值掩码替换为连续逐token高斯噪声作为软掩码，从而支持连续的嵌入空间去噪推理。在低步数（≤16前向）的零样本摘要任务上，该方法在所有四个基准上取得最佳ROUGE-1，避免了迭代解掩码的过早终止/重复问题，并展现出选择性噪声鲁棒性。
Motivation: 离散掩码扩散语言模型在少步解码时面临长度与质量的权衡：固定步数下，标准方法只能生成短而高质量或长但重复的文本。连续去噪可以规避此权衡，但从头构建大规模连续去噪模型仍是难题。
Method: 从预训练掩码DLM（LLaDA-8B-Instruct）出发，仅继续训练1000步，使用离散随机定位（DSL），用连续逐token高斯噪声替代二值掩码作为软掩码，实现嵌入空间的连续推理，所有位置联合演化，仅在最后一步进行硬令牌承诺。
Result: 在低步数（≤16前向）的零样本摘要任务上，DSL-LLaDA-SDE在所有四个基准上取得最佳ROUGE-1，显著避免了迭代解掩码的过早终止/重复问题。控制实验显示标准掩码扩散训练不产生这些行为。
Conclusion: 摘要指出通过轻量适配预训练掩码DLM，可以实现连续嵌入空间去噪，从而改善低步数解码的质量与长度权衡。该方法还展现了选择性噪声鲁棒性。

papers.title: Data Collection for Training Quality-Control AI in Carpet Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Visual inspection remains the dominant quality-control practice in woven and tufted carpet production, yet it is slow, subjective, and inconsistent at the line speeds and widths of modern looms. We present a design proposal for an in-line machine-vision system whose primary purpose is twofold: to inspect the carpet web in real time and, equally importantly, to systematically collect and label images of defect patterns so that increasingly capable quality-control models can be trained over the life of the installation.The proposal is grounded in a concrete industrial setting: a Six Sigma (DMAIC) project at a woven-carpet production facility that anticipated a production bottleneck following the installation of additional weaving machines, with a substantial baseline defect rate and significant financial exposure associated with quality failures. We describe an imaging subsystem based on synchronized line-scan cameras with combined bright-field and grazing illumination, derive the resolution and throughput requirements needed to resolve fine structural defects across a multi-metre web, and define a carpet-specific defect taxonomy.We then lay out a staged modelling strategy that begins with unsupervised anomaly detection trained on defect-free material, following the paradigm exemplified by the carpet category of the MVTec Anomaly Detection benchmark, and matures through a human-in-the-loop annotation flywheel into supervised detection and segmentation models. Finally, we connect detection performance to the DMAIC objectives, showing how reductions in escaped defects translate into improved process quality and process sigma levels. The contribution is an end-to-end, deployable blueprint that treats data collection as a first-class engineering objective rather than an afterthought.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对地毯生产中视觉质检速度慢、主观性强的问题，提出了一套在线机器视觉系统设计蓝图，其核心目标是在实时检测缺陷的同时系统化收集并标注缺陷图像，以持续训练质检AI模型。方案基于六西格玛（DMAIC）项目背景，描述了线扫描相机成像子系统、分辨率要求及地毯缺陷分类体系，并规划了从无监督异常检测到有监督分割的分阶段建模策略，最终将检测性能与过程质量改进关联。
Motivation: 地毯生产中传统人工目检无法满足现代织机的高速宽幅需求，且缺乏系统化数据收集机制，导致质检模型难以持续改进，造成质量损失和财务风险。
Method: 设计同步线扫描相机配合明场和掠射照明的成像子系统，推导多幅宽下的分辨率与吞吐需求；定义地毯特定缺陷分类；提出从无监督异常检测（如MVTec地毯类）开始、经人工标注飞轮演进到有监督检测与分割的分阶段建模策略。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果，仅阐述预期通过减少逃逸缺陷来提升过程西格玛水平。
Conclusion: 本文贡献在于将数据收集作为一等工程目标，提供端到端可部署的蓝皮书，而非事后补充。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProductWebGen: Benchmarking Multimodal Product Webpage Generation
papers.abstract_en: Crafting a product display webpage from a source product image, along with layout and visual content instructions, holds significant practical value for domains such as marketing, advertising, and E-commerce. Intuitively, this task demands strict visual consistency across product displays and high-fidelity instruction following to jointly generate renderable HTML code. These requirements on controllability and instruction-following are closely aligned with the core features of advanced multimodal generative models, such as image editing models and unified models. To this end, this paper introduces ProductWebGen to systematically benchmark the product webpage generation capacities of these models. We organize ProductWebGen with 500 test samples covering 13 product categories; each sample consists of a source image, a visual content instruction, and a webpage instruction. The task is to generate a product showcase webpage including multiple consistent images in accordance with the source image and instructions. Given the mixed-modality input-output nature of the task, we design and systematically compare two workflows for evaluation -- one uses large language models and image editing models to separately generate HTML code and images (editing-based), while the other relies on a single UM to generate both, with image generation conditioned on the preceding multimodal context (UM-based). Empirical results show that editing-based approaches achieve leading results in webpage instruction following and content appeal, while UM-based ones may display more advantages in fulfilling visual content instructions. We also construct a supervised fine-tuning dataset, ProductWebGen-1k, with 1,000 groups of real product images and LLM-generated HTML code. We verify its effectiveness on the open-source UM BAGEL. The data and code are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DENG-Lab/ProductWebGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProductWebGen基准，用于评估多模态生成模型在从产品图片和指令生成可渲染HTML网页方面的能力。包含500个测试样本，覆盖13个产品类别，并比较了基于编辑和基于统一模型的两类工作流。实验表明编辑方法在指令遵循和内容吸引力上领先，而统一模型在视觉指令执行上更有优势。
Motivation: 产品展示网页生成需要严格的视觉一致性和高保真指令遵循，现有基准缺乏对此类多模态生成能力的系统评估。
Method: 构建ProductWebGen基准（500样本，13类别），设计两种工作流：基于LLM+图像编辑模型的分步生成（编辑方法）和基于统一模型（UM）的联合生成。并发布监督微调数据集ProductWebGen-1k。
Result: 编辑方法在网页指令遵循和内容吸引力上取得领先结果，统一模型在视觉内容指令执行上更具优势。微调数据集对开源UM BAGEL有效。
Conclusion: 该基准为多模态产品网页生成能力提供了系统评估框架，并验证了不同方法的性能差异。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建ProductWebGen基准（500样本，13类别），设计两种工作流：基于LLM+图像编辑模型的分步生成（编辑方法）和基于统一模型（UM）的联合生成。并发布监督微调数据集ProductWebGen-1k。
summary_sections.result: 编辑方法在网页指令遵循和内容吸引力上取得领先结果，统一模型在视觉内容指令执行上更具优势。微调数据集对开源UM BAGEL有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该基准为多模态产品网页生成能力提供了系统评估框架，并验证了不同方法的性能差异。

papers.title: Learning Neural Deformation Representation for 4D Dynamic Shape Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent developments in 3D shape representation opened new possibilities for generating detailed 3D shapes. Despite these advances, there are few studies dealing with the generation of 4D dynamic shapes that have the form of 3D objects deforming over time. To bridge this gap, we focus on generating 4D dynamic shapes with an emphasis on both generation quality and efficiency in this paper. HyperDiffusion, a previous work on 4D generation, proposed a method of directly generating the weight parameters of 4D occupancy fields but suffered from low temporal consistency and slow rendering speed due to motion representation that is not separated from the shape representation of 4D occupancy fields. Therefore, we propose a new neural deformation representation and combine it with conditional neural signed distance fields to design a 4D representation architecture in which the motion latent space is disentangled from the shape latent space. The proposed deformation representation, which works by predicting skinning weights and rigid transformations for multiple parts, also has advantages over the deformation modules of existing 4D representations in understanding the structure of shapes. In addition, we design a training process of a diffusion model that utilizes the shape and motion features that are extracted by our 4D representation as data points. The results of unconditional generation, conditional generation, and motion retargeting experiments demonstrate that our method not only shows better performance than previous works in 4D dynamic shape generation but also has various potential applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的神经变形表示，用于4D动态形状生成。该方法将运动潜空间与形状潜空间解耦，结合条件神经有符号距离场，设计了一个4D表示架构。通过预测多个部分的蒙皮权重和刚体变换，该变形表示在理解形状结构方面优于现有方法。训练了一个扩散模型来利用这些特征进行无条件生成、条件生成和运动重定向，实验表明在生成质量和效率上超过先前工作。
Motivation: 现有4D动态形状生成研究较少，且HyperDiffusion等先前工作存在时间一致性差和渲染速度慢的问题，原因是运动表示未与形状表示分离。
Method: 提出新的神经变形表示，通过预测多个部分的蒙皮权重和刚体变换来解耦运动与形状潜空间，并与条件神经有符号距离场结合，构建4D表示架构。在此基础上设计扩散模型训练过程，利用提取的形状和运动特征作为数据点。
Result: 在无条件生成、条件生成和运动重定向实验中，本文方法在4D动态形状生成方面优于先前工作，并展示了多种潜在应用。
Conclusion: 本文提出的4D生成方法在生成质量和效率上提升，且具有多种潜在应用，如运动重定向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tackling the Root of Misinformation by Teaching Laypeople about Logical Fallacies via Socratic Questioning and Critical Argumentation
papers.abstract_en: Identifying logical fallacies in everyday discourse is challenging for many people. This challenge is amplified in the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), where malicious agents can deploy fallacious arguments to disseminate misinformation at scale. In this work, we explore the potential of LLMs as part of the solution. We introduce LFTutor, an intelligent tutoring system which uses LLMs to tutor laypeople and help them learn about logical fallacies. LFTutor integrates intent-driven Socratic questioning and critical argumentation principles to actively engage learners to reflect on their reasoning. Through both automatic and human evaluations, we demonstrate that LFTutor significantly outperforms baseline LLMs lacking these pedagogical strategies. This work highlights the promise of combining LLMs with pedagogical scaffolding to foster critical thinking and argument literacy in the age of AI.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted to Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Long Paper), Main Conference
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向普通人识别逻辑谬误的难题，本文提出LFTutor——一种基于LLM的智能辅导系统，结合意图驱动的苏格拉底式提问与批判性论证原则，引导学习者反思推理过程。自动与人工评估显示，LFTutor在提升逻辑谬误识别能力上显著优于无教学策略的基线LLM。工作凸显了LLM与教学支架相结合在AI时代培养批判性思维与论证素养的潜力。
Motivation: 日常话语中的逻辑谬误对多数人而言难以识别，而LLM时代恶意行为者可大规模散布谬误信息，亟需帮助普通人掌握逻辑谬误辨别能力。
Method: 提出LFTutor系统，集成意图驱动的苏格拉底式提问（Socratic questioning）与批判性论证原则，利用LLM主动引导学习者反思自身推理过程。
Result: 自动与人工评估均表明LFTutor显著优于未采用上述教学策略的基线LLM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合LLM与教学支架（pedagogical scaffolding）可在AI时代有效促进批判性思维与论证素养。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hybrid Verified Decoding: Learning to Allocate Verification in Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) generation remains expensive because autoregressive decoding calls the model once for each new token. Speculative decoding reduces this cost by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them with the target model in one step, but its speedup depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. Parameter-free draft sources can propose long continuations at low cost in structured and agentic workloads, yet a cache match that looks promising at one generation step may have low payoff at the next. We propose Hybrid Verified Decoding, which predicts the accepted length of a cache draft before verification and uses this payoff estimate to choose between cache verification and a model-based drafter. Across three LLMs and sixteen datasets, Hybrid Verified Decoding is especially effective on agentic workflows, where it outperforms EAGLE3 in every setting with a 2.73x average speedup. Our analysis shows how prompt structure creates cache opportunities, how high-payoff cache drafts concentrate in a small part of the draft space, and how payoff-guided selection reduces sequential decoding work, pointing to runtime draft selection as a promising direction for speculative decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合验证解码 (Hybrid Verified Decoding)，通过预测缓存草稿的接受长度，在缓存验证和基于模型的草稿器之间动态选择，以加速大语言模型推理。在三个 LLM 和十六个数据集上，该方法在智能体工作流中平均加速 2.73 倍，优于 EAGLE3。
Motivation: 推测解码的加速依赖于草稿令牌的接受率，而参数无关的缓存草稿在不同生成步骤中收益不稳定，现有方法缺乏对草稿收益的预测和自适应选择。
Method: 在验证前预测缓存草稿的接受长度，基于此收益估计决定使用缓存验证还是模型驱动的草稿器，实现解码路径的动态分配。
Result: 在三个 LLM 和十六个数据集上，混合验证解码在智能体工作流中平均加速 2.73 倍，且在所有设置下优于 EAGLE3；分析显示高收益缓存草稿集中于草稿空间的一小部分。
Conclusion: 混合验证解码通过运行时草稿选择有效减少顺序解码工作，为推测解码提供了有前景的方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PolySpeech-100: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Speech Understanding Across 100+ Languages and Dialects
papers.abstract_en: While End-to-End (E2E) Speech-Large Language Models (Speech-LLMs) are rapidly evolving, their evaluation methodologies remain limited to the era of simple transcription. Existing benchmarks suffer from three critical limitations: a pronounced bias towards high-resource languages, a focus on low-level recognition (ASR) rather than semantic reasoning, and a neglect of regional dialects. To bridge this gap, we introduce PolySpeech-100, a massive-scale benchmark designed to assess `native-level' speech comprehension across 110 linguistic variants. We employ a novel hybrid construction pipeline that augments gold-standard human recordings with instruction-driven synthetic speech, allowing us to cover 19 distinct Chinese dialects and over 80 low-resource languages. Extensive evaluation of 22 state-of-the-art models (including Gemini-3, GPT-Audio, and Qwen2.5-Omni) yields pivotal insights. First, we demonstrate that open-source E2E models outperform Cascade (ASR+LLM) systems on heavy dialects, proving that direct audio processing preserves critical paralinguistic cues and prosodic features (e.g., intonation, stress) that are often lost in standard transcription. Second, we reveal a significant performance gap: while commercial models maintain robustness, open-source models suffer catastrophic degradation on low-resource languages. Finally, counter-intuitively, we observe that under standard zero-shot settings, Chain-of-Thought prompting frequently degrades speech understanding performance for most evaluated models, revealing a potential modality alignment gap in current architectures. PolySpeech-100 establishes a rigorous standard for the next generation of inclusive, omni-capable Speech-LLMs. The data, demo, and code are publicly available at https://github.com/YoungSeng/PolySpeech-100.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolySpeech-100 是一个覆盖 110 种语言/方言的大规模语音理解基准，通过混合构建管道（人工录音 + 指令驱动合成语音）来评估语音大模型。对 22 个 SOTA 模型（包括 Gemini-3、GPT-Audio、Qwen2.5-Omni）的评估发现：开源端到端模型在处理重方言时优于级联系统；开源模型在低资源语言上性能急剧下降；标准零样本设置下链式思维提示反而降低语音理解性能。
Motivation: 现有语音理解基准偏向高资源语言、聚焦低级 ASR 而非语义推理、忽视方言，作者旨在建立一个覆盖广泛语言变体的`母语级`语音理解评估基准。
Method: 提出混合构建管道，结合金标准人类录音和指令驱动合成语音，覆盖 19 种汉语方言和 80 多种低资源语言。评估了 22 个最新语音大模型，比较了端到端与级联架构以及不同提示策略。
Result: 摘要报告：开源端到端模型在重方言上优于级联系统，证明直接音频处理保留副语言线索和韵律特征；商业模型稳健但开源模型在低资源语言上显著退化；零样本设置下链式思维提示通常降低大多数模型的语音理解性能。
Conclusion: PolySpeech-100 为下一代包容性语音大模型建立严格标准，并公开数据、演示和代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-IoT-Robotics Integration: Survey of Frameworks, Emerging Trends, and the Path Toward Connected Robotics
papers.abstract_en: The convergence of Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, and Robotics is no longer a futuristic vision; it is rapidly becoming the foundation of real-time, intelligent, and context-aware systems. AI enables perception and reasoning, IoT provides scalable sensing and communication, and robotics delivers embodied actuation. Despite significant progress in pairwise combinations such as AIoT and the Internet of Robotic Things (IoRT), there remains a lack of unified design frameworks that fully integrate all three. This survey synthesizes the state-of-the-art across these domains, emphasizing the emerging role of Small Language Models (SLMs) at the edge and Large Language Models (LLMs) in the cloud for distributed cognition and autonomous decision-making. We propose a modular system architecture that aligns with these trends, analyze persistent gaps in interoperability and feedback control, and classify existing work by integration depth. Our review highlights how hybrid SLM-LLM systems, when coupled with IoT infrastructure and robotic agents, can address challenges in real-time adaptation, scalability, and reliability. This work offers a conceptual and technical roadmap for designing next-generation AI-IoT-Robotic ecosystems that are modular, interpretable, and capable of learning within dynamic environments, paving the way for the emerging paradigm of Connected Robotics and Physical AI.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Published in IEEE Internet of Things Journal
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Internet of Things Journal, vol. 13, no. 10, pp. 20398-20412, 15 May15, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理了人工智能 (AI)、物联网 (IoT) 与机器人 (Robotics) 三者融合的现状、框架与趋势，指出当前缺乏统一的设计框架。文章重点讨论了小型语言模型 (SLM) 在边缘端、大型语言模型 (LLM) 在云端的分工协作，提出模块化系统架构，并分析了互操作性、反馈控制等持续存在的差距。
Motivation: 尽管 AIoT 和 IoRT 等两两融合已有进展，但缺乏同时整合 AI、IoT 和 Robotics 三者的统一设计框架，限制了实时智能系统的构建。
Method: 通过文献综述，分类现有工作，并基于 SLM-LLM 混合系统与 IoT 基础设施和机器人代理的结合，提出模块化系统架构作为解决方案。
Result: 摘要指出，混合 SLM-LLM 系统结合 IoT 和机器人代理可以应对实时适应、可扩展性和可靠性等挑战，并为下一代 Connected Robotics 和 Physical AI 提供了路线图。
Conclusion: 本文为设计模块化、可解释、能在动态环境中学习的 AI-IoT-机器人生态系统提供了概念性和技术性路线图。

papers.title: Cross-Axis Feature Fusion with Joint-Wise Motion Difference Prediction for Text-Based 3D Human Motion Editing
papers.abstract_en: We address text-based 3D human motion editing, where the goal is to preserve the style and structure of a source motion while applying edits described in natural language. The release of the MotionFix dataset has spurred active research into training-based diffusion models that directly generate an edited motion from a source motion and a text instruction. While previous works have focused primarily on learning when an edit should occur temporally, our goal is to create a model that understands not only this temporal aspect but also which specific joints are responsible for the change. Targeting this, we propose a novel architecture and a complementary auxiliary task to aid its training. Our architecture consists of two axis-anchored transformers, which extract distinct features along the joint and time dimensions respectively, and a cross-axis fusion block that integrates these representations. We further introduce an auxiliary task that trains the joint-anchored transformer to regress the Soft-DTW distance between source and target joint rotations. This objective teaches the module to understand which joints to modify and which to preserve. Through comprehensive experiments on the MotionFix dataset, we demonstrate that our method significantly improves semantic alignment with both the text instruction and the source motion, as well as the overall fidelity of the generated motion, achieving state-of-the-art results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于文本的三维人体运动编辑方法，通过交叉轴特征融合（cross-axis fusion）和关节运动差异预测辅助任务来提升编辑质量。在MotionFix数据集上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法主要关注编辑的时间定位，忽略了哪些关节点需要被修改。本文旨在同时理解时间轴和关节轴上的变化。
Method: 提出两个轴锚定Transformer（joint-anchored和time-anchored），分别提取关节和时间维度的特征，并通过交叉轴融合块整合；另引入辅助任务：训练关节锚定Transformer回归源运动与目标运动关节旋转之间的Soft-DTW距离。
Result: 在MotionFix数据集上，该方法在语义对齐和生成运动保真度方面均取得最先进结果，显著优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 交叉轴特征融合与关节级运动差异预测能够有效提升文本驱动的三维人体运动编辑的准确性。
