papers.title: Property Prediction of Stacked Bilayer Materials: A Multimodal Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: AI for materials science is a critical topic within AI for science, aiming to accelerate materials discovery and produce accurate property predictions. Bilayer 2D material stacking is essential for exploring new materials with novel functions and inherent phenomena, enabling the creation of new 2D bilayers for diverse real-world applications. Research on bilayer vdWs materials has made significant progress from experimental and computational perspectives. Various bilayer materials have been successfully synthe sized experimentally and the increasing utilization of high-throughput computing technology has con structed several computational two-dimensional materials databases. However, the use of AI to model bilayer stacking and predict new properties remains underexplored, necessitating further research studies. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal learning approach to study the interfaces between dissimilar materials that jointly enable new or multiple functions, and to predict new properties arising from the vertical integration (stacking) of different functional material layers under given configurations. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach compared to baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/AnVuong123/bimat ml.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态学习方法，用于预测堆叠双层二维材料的性质。该方法旨在研究不同功能材料层间的界面，并预测垂直集成（堆叠）产生的新性质。实验表明，该方法在效率和效果上优于基线方法。

Result: 综合实验表明，该方法相较于基线方法在效果和效率上均有提升。
Conclusion: 多模态学习方法能有效预测双层堆叠材料的新性质，为材料发现提供新途径。

papers.title: FVSpec: Real-World Property-Based Tests as Lean Challenges
papers.abstract_en: We present a benchmark for evaluating AI models and agents on real-world formal software verification tasks. We first scrape 11,039 property-based tests (PBTs) from real-world Python repositories, then automatically translate 2,772 of them (25%) into 9,415 Lean 4 specifications with sorry placeholders (about 3 formalizations/PBT; we retain multiple attempts when none dominates on quality metrics). Translating PBTs into Lean specifications is challenging: it requires modeling Python semantics in Lean, inferring the logical property encoded in an imperative PBT, and handling the inherent difficulties of dependently-typed programming in a seldom-used language. We describe a three-agent LLM pipeline for transpiling PBTs into Lean specifications, evaluate coverage and quality metrics, and provide baselines for proof generation using several automated and model based approaches. All code (scraper and agents) and data (PBTs and Lean specifications) are open source. Our benchmark aims to drive progress on the underexplored problem of AI-assisted formal verification of real-world software, which is of increasing interest as AI produces more and more of the world's code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了FVSpec基准，用于评估AI模型在真实世界软件形式化验证任务上的能力。从11,039个Python仓库中的属性测试（PBT）自动翻译2,772个为9,415个Lean 4规范（含占位符），平均每个PBT约3个形式化。使用三智能体LLM流水线进行转译，并提供了多种方法进行证明生成的基线。所有数据和代码开源。
Motivation: 随着AI生成代码的增多，对AI辅助形式化验证的需求日益增长，但缺乏真实世界软件验证的基准。
Method: 从Python仓库抓取属性测试，使用三智能体LLM流水线自动翻译成Lean 4规范，保留多个翻译尝试（每个PBT约3个形式化）。
Result: 成功翻译2,772个PBT为9,415个Lean规范，评估了覆盖率和质量指标，并提供了自动化及基于模型的方法在证明生成上的基线结果。
Conclusion: 该基准旨在推动AI辅助形式化验证在真实世界软件上的应用，这是一个尚未充分探索的问题。

papers.title: Beyond Task-Agnostic: Task-Aware Grouping for Communication-Efficient Multi-Task MoE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity via conditional computation, but distributed inference suffers from cross-GPU expert communication and routing-induced load imbalance. Existing placement methods reduce this cost by co-locating frequently co-activated experts; however, they derive a single deployment plan from globally aggregated routing traces, thereby averaging away the heterogeneous, task-specific co-activation patterns that actually drive communication in multi-task serving. We observe that expert co-activation is strongly task-conditioned: pairs tightly coupled in one task family are often uncorrelated in another, so effective deployment should group experts by task-aware co-activation rather than by a task-agnostic average. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Task-Aware Coactivation Grouping} (TACG), a deployment-time framework that uses family-specific dispatch and co-activation traces to derive per-expert task-family preferences, reweights the co-activation graph so that intra-family locality dominates grouping, and assigns each expert to a primary GPU under exact capacity constraints. To keep the static placement robust under online workload skew, we further introduce \emph{Generic Expert Shared Replication} (GESR), a lightweight companion that identifies generic experts with consistently central co-activation profiles, replicates them across a small set of secondary GPUs, and applies locality- and load-aware selection at serving time. Experiments on three representative open-source MoE models demonstrate that our framework reduces the average communication cost by 31.39\% over the baseline, while preserving an average Jain fairness index of 0.9975. This advantage persists even under severe distribution shifts in the inference data, consistently outperforming strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多任务MoE推理中的通信开销和负载不均衡问题，提出任务感知共激活分组（TACG）框架，利用任务特定的路由踪迹进行专家部署，并引入通用专家共享复制（GESR）以增强鲁棒性。在三个开源MoE模型上，平均通信成本降低31.39%，Jain公平指数保持0.9975。
Motivation: 现有部署方法使用全局聚合路由踪迹生成单一部署计划，平均化了多任务服务中实际驱动通信的异构、任务特定的共激活模式，导致通信效率低下。
Method: 提出TACG框架，使用家族特定的分发和共激活踪迹推导每个专家的任务家族偏好，重新加权共激活图以使家族内局部性主导分组，并在精确容量约束下将每个专家分配到主GPU。同时引入GESR，识别具有一致性中心共激活特征的通用专家，在少量辅助GPU上复制，并在服务时进行局部性和负载感知选择。
Result: 在三个代表性开源MoE模型上的实验表明，平均通信成本降低31.39%，Jain公平指数平均为0.9975，即使在推理数据分布严重偏移下仍优于强基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调任务感知的专家共激活分组和通用专家复制可以有效降低多任务MoE推理的通信开销，且对分布偏移具有鲁棒性。

papers.title: Automated Erythrocyte Detection and Tracking for Retinal Blood Flow Quantification in Erythrocyte-Mediated Angiography
papers.abstract_en: Capillary-level retinal blood flow (RBF) has strong potential as a biomarker for various ocular diseases. However, modalities for measuring capillary-level RBF remain limited. Erythrocyte-mediated angiography (EMA), an emerging imaging technique, enables capillary-level RBF measurement by visualizing individual erythrocytes, yet automated erythrocyte detection and tracking, which are essential for quantifying blood flow, remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, we propose EMTrack, a novel framework featuring a flow-context module for erythrocyte detection that distinguishes moving from paused cells and a topology-aware tracking strategy that enables tracking under large inter-frame displacements and substantial motion variations. In addition, we establish RBF-EMA, a new EMA dataset with comprehensive erythrocyte detection and tracking annotations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms baseline methods both quantitatively and qualitatively on detection and tracking tasks in the RBF-EMA dataset. Moreover, RBF quantification results highlight the strong potential of our framework for automated retinal blood flow measurement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EMTrack，一种用于红细胞介导的血管造影（EMA）中自动检测和追踪红细胞的新框架，以量化视网膜血流量（RBF）。EMTrack包含流上下文模块用于区分运动与静止的红细胞，以及拓扑感知的追踪策略以处理大帧间位移和运动变化。同时建立了带详细标注的RBF-EMA数据集。实验表明该方法在检测和追踪任务上优于基线方法，并展示了在自动化视网膜血流测量中的潜力。
Motivation: 毛细血管水平的视网膜血流量（RBF）是多种眼病的潜在生物标志物，但测量手段有限。红细胞介导的血管造影（EMA）虽能实现毛细血管级RBF测量，但自动化的红细胞检测与追踪（血流量化的关键步骤）尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出EMTrack框架，包含：1）流上下文检测模块，通过时序信息区分运动与静止红细胞；2）拓扑感知追踪策略，利用红细胞间拓扑关系实现大位移和运动变化下的稳定追踪。同时构建了含完整标注的RBF-EMA数据集。
Result: 在RBF-EMA数据集上，EMTrack在红细胞检测和追踪任务上定量与定性均优于基线方法。RBF量化结果进一步证实该框架在自动化视网膜血流测量中的潜力。
Conclusion: EMTrack为EMA图像中的红细胞自动检测与追踪提供了有效方案，有望推动毛细血管级RBF的自动化定量分析。

papers.title: Theoretical Analysis of Engression and Reverse Markov Engression
papers.abstract_en: Engression is a recently proposed and effective framework for conditional distribution learning. Its multi-step Reverse Markov extension further improves generative flexibility by decomposing complex conditional sampling into sequential reverse transitions. Despite their strong empirical performance, rigorous finite-sample statistical guarantees for these methods remain unavailable. In this paper, under deep neural network parameterizations, we establish nonasymptotic convergence bounds for Engression by directly controlling the Energy Distance between the learned and target conditional distributions. For the Reverse Markov framework, we further develop an Energy-Distance-based chain rule that enables a rigorous analysis of error propagation across reverse steps. Our analysis yields corresponding excess-risk bounds that are near-optimal up to logarithmic factors relative to the classical minimax rate over a general Hölder class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Engression 和 Reverse Markov Engression 这两种条件分布学习方法进行了理论分析，在深度神经网络参数化下建立了非渐近收敛界，通过控制学习分布与目标分布之间的能量距离，并针对 Reverse Markov 框架提出了基于能量距离的链式法则以分析误差传播，得到了接近最优的 excess-risk 界。
Motivation: Engression 及其 Reverse Markov 扩展在实证上表现良好，但缺乏严格的有限样本统计保证，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 利用能量距离直接控制分布差异，对 Reverse Markov 框架推导了能量距离链式法则，从而分析反向步骤间的误差传播。
Result: 建立了非渐近收敛界，并证明了 excess-risk 界在 Hölder 类下接近 minimax 最优（仅差对数因子）。
Conclusion: 本文为 Engression 和 Reverse Markov Engression 提供了理论保证，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Trust Functions: Near-Lossless Weak-to-Strong Generalization by Learning When to Trust the Weak Teacher
papers.abstract_en: Weak-to-strong generalization studies how to improve a strong student using supervision from a weaker teacher when reliable labels are scarce. We view this primarily as a data selection problem, where the key challenge is to identify which weak labels are reliable enough to serve as a training signal. To address this, we introduce trust functions that assign each weak label a scalar trust score and use these scores to filter weak supervision. Across several domains, including world knowledge, quantitative reasoning, and strategy games, trust filtering yields students that match and sometimes surpass ground-truth supervision, achieving near-lossless weak-to-strong generalization. Moreover, trust functions enable an iterative weak-to-strong chain that compounds gains by training a student and reusing it as the next teacher, amplifying the gains. There are several mechanisms to which advantage of trust functions can be attributed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对弱到强泛化问题，提出信任函数（trust functions），为每个弱标签分配信任分数并据此过滤弱监督。在世界知识、定量推理、策略游戏等多个领域，信任过滤使学生模型匹配甚至超越真实标签监督，实现近乎无损的弱到强泛化。此外，信任函数支持迭代弱到强链，通过将学生复用为下一轮教师来累积增益。
Motivation: 在弱到强泛化中，可靠标签稀缺时需利用弱教师信号，但关键在于识别哪些弱标签足够可靠以作为训练信号。现有方法缺乏有效的过滤机制。
Method: 提出信任函数，为每个弱标签计算一个标量信任分数，并基于阈值或排序过滤弱监督，仅保留高信任标签用于训练学生模型。
Result: 在世界知识、定量推理、策略游戏等基准上，信任过滤后的学生模型性能匹配甚至超过使用真实标签监督的模型，实现了近无损的弱到强泛化。迭代训练链进一步放大了收益。

papers.title: SWARD: Stochastic Window-Attention-Based Relational Distillation for Cross-Architectural Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale vision foundation models have driven substantial gains on dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation, but their size makes deployment impractical in resource-constrained settings, motivating knowledge distillation as a means of transferring their capabilities to lightweight student networks. However, modern foundation teachers are predominantly transformer-based that encode global context, whereas efficient students are typically convolutional networks with locally biased receptive fields. Existing distillation methods largely assume architectural homogeneity and rely on direct feature mimicry, which fails to bridge this representational gap and neglects the structured spatial dependencies and discriminative organization required for accurate semantic segmentation. In this paper, we propose SWARD, a knowledge distillation framework that addresses this gap through two complementary mechanisms. First, we introduce a Multi-Scale Windowed Attention Distillation (MWAD) module that aligns teacher-student attention-based relations within stochastically shifted window partitions whose offsets are randomly resampled at every training iteration. This removes window boundary bias, and, combined with the multi-scale design, captures both short- and long-range spatial dependencies. Second, we introduce Prototype Discriminative Regularization (PDR), a loss that helps shape the student's feature distribution by enforcing inter-class separation and intra-class compactness, further sharpening the discriminative structure beyond what feature mimicry alone can produce under the student's reduced capacity. Experiments across different vision applications (i.e., urban scene parsing and medical image segmentation) show that SWARD achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWARD，一种针对跨架构语义分割的知识蒸馏框架，通过多尺度随机窗口注意力蒸馏（MWAD）和原型判别正则化（PDR）来弥合 Transformer 教师与 CNN 学生之间的表示差距。MWAD 利用随机偏移窗口捕获长短距离依赖，PDR 增强特征判别性。实验在城市场景解析和医学图像分割上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有蒸馏方法大多假设师生架构同质，直接特征模仿无法桥接 Transformer 全局与 CNN 局部感受野之间的表示差异，且忽略了语义分割所需的结构化空间依赖和判别性组织。
Method: 提出两个互补机制：(1) 多尺度窗口注意力蒸馏（MWAD），在随机偏移的窗口分区中对齐注意力关系，消除边界偏差并捕获多尺度空间依赖；(2) 原型判别正则化（PDR），通过类间分离和类内紧凑损失来塑造学生特征分布。
Result: 摘要报告在多种视觉应用（包括城市场景解析和医学图像分割）中达到最先进性能，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SWARD 有效弥合跨架构蒸馏的表示差距，但未讨论局限性。

papers.title: Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Subliminal learning refers to a student language model acquiring a teacher's traits (e.g. a system-prompted preference for owls) when fine-tuned on the teacher's outputs, despite the outputs being semantically unrelated to those traits. It remains poorly understood how data without semantic meaning can transfer specific semantic traits. In this work, we show that subliminal learning is mediated by a single steering vector, i.e. a vector added to the model's activations. Across two open-source models, we find that the teacher's system prompt is well approximated by a steering vector, and that the student's behavior is driven by learning an aligned vector over fine-tuning. System prompts that are not well approximated by steering vectors are not subliminally learned. This is a special case of steering vector distillation, in which a student trained on the outputs of a steered teacher learns to imitate that steering. We demonstrate steering vector distillation on a range of semantic and random vectors. Adding a semantic vector to a model's activations can have both model-independent and model-specific (i.e. non-semantic) effects on its behavior, so generated data that is non-semantic can transmit a vector with semantic effects, enabling subliminal learning. This also explains why subliminal learning does not transfer between models. We find that adaptive optimizers are necessary for subliminal learning in language models: activation gradients on steered data carry a small but consistent component along the steering direction, and non-adaptive optimizers impede this by allowing outlier gradients to dominate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究潜隐学习（subliminal learning）现象，即语言模型在微调教师模型的无语义输出时获得教师的系统提示偏好。作者发现该现象由单个steering vector介导，教师系统提示可近似为steering vector，学生通过学习对齐的向量模仿教师行为。这实际上是steering vector蒸馏的特例。实验表明，自适应优化器对潜隐学习至关重要，非自适应优化器会因异常梯度主导而阻碍学习。
Motivation: 潜隐学习现象中，学生模型从语义无关的输出中习得教师的特定语义特征（如系统提示偏好），其机制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示该现象背后的机制。
Method: 通过分析两个开源模型，证明教师系统提示可近似为steering vector，学生微调后学习到对齐的向量。将潜隐学习视为steering vector蒸馏的一种特例，并在多种语义和随机向量上验证。通过分析激活梯度，解释自适应优化器的必要性。
Result: 发现教师系统提示被steering vector良好近似时，潜隐学习发生；否则不发生。steering vector蒸馏可复制多种语义和随机向量的效果。无语义数据可通过模型独立和模型特定的效应传输语义向量。
Conclusion: 潜隐学习由steering vector介导，是steering vector蒸馏的特例。非语义数据可传输语义效应，解释了为何潜隐学习不跨模型迁移。自适应优化器是潜隐学习的必要条件。

papers.title: Large Language Models in Transportation Systems Management and Operations: From Text Reasoning to Multi-modal Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Transportation systems management and operations (TSMO) increasingly depends on timely interpretation of heterogeneous data, from various sensor streams, incident reports, traveler feedback, and visual observations. Large language models (LLMs), including emerging multi-modal large language models (MM-LLMs), provide a new mechanism for integrating these structured and unstructured inputs into operator-facing decision support. This survey paper reviews LLM- and MM-LLM-based applications in TSMO across three domains: transportation operations & services (supply), mobility & fleet services (demand), and data, modeling & decision support. Using a PRISMA-guided screening process, we synthesize current studies while distinguishing operationally oriented applications from prototype and emerging concepts. We further identify recurring challenges in data heterogeneity, real-time inference, explainability, multi-modal fusion, and governance. Finally, we outline existing gaps and future directions in localized adaptation, edge deployment, benchmarking, and cross-agency collaboration. Overall, LLM-based systems appear most promising as a decision-support layer, with MM-LLMs offering particular value when heterogeneous text, visual, and sensor inputs must be integrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该综述论文系统回顾了大型语言模型（LLM）及多模态大语言模型（MM-LLM）在交通系统管理与运营（TSMO）中的应用，涵盖供给侧运营、需求侧移动服务及数据建模决策支持三大领域。通过PRISMA筛选流程，区分了面向操作的实际应用与原型概念，并指出了数据异构性、实时推理、可解释性、多模态融合及治理方面的挑战。文章认为LLM作为决策支持层最具潜力，而MM-LLM在整合异构文本、视觉和传感器数据时价值突出。
Motivation: 交通系统管理与运营面临异构数据（传感器流、事故报告、旅行者反馈、视觉观测）的及时解读需求，现有方法难以有效整合结构化与非结构化信息，LLM及MM-LLM提供了新的集成机制。
Method: 采用PRISMA指导的筛选过程对现有研究进行综述，从供给侧（交通运输运营与服务）、需求侧（移动与车队服务）以及数据、建模与决策支持三个维度分类梳理，并区分面向操作的应用与原型概念。
Result: 综述识别了数据异构性、实时推理、可解释性、多模态融合和治理等反复出现的挑战；认为LLM系统作为决策支持层最有前景，MM-LLM在整合异构文本、视觉和传感器输入时价值显著。
Conclusion: 指出了未来方向包括本地化适配、边缘部署、基准测试和跨机构合作。

papers.title: Data Enrichment for Symbolic Regression Using Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) offers a route to scientific discovery by converting observations into interpretable governing equations. However, despite its promise, its reliability degrades sharply when spatiotemporal measurements are sparse, noisy, or physically incomplete, as commonly occurring in practice. Data enrichment (DE) has been shown to be able to mitigate this limitation, yet additional samples can mislead equation discovery unless they preserve the physical structure of the target system. Such implication of DE requires narrow domain expertise as well as technical fluidity, highly limiting its practical usefulness. In this study, we introduce a physics-guided latent diffusion framework for DE for down the line SR models. The proposed framework combines a variational autoencoder, a conditional latent diffusion model, and a physics-informed residual corrector to complete sparse observations with synthetic fields constrained by governing relations. We evaluate the approach on heat conduction, incompressible Navier-Stokes flow, and a moving single-mass Newtonian gravitational potential, using GPLearn, DEAP, and PySR as downstream SR backends. Our results reveal that physics-corrected enrichment consistently improves recovery in sparse regimes across physical dynamics and SR models. These results show that generative enrichment can strengthen equation discovery without additional domain expertise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对符号回归在稀疏、噪声数据下可靠性下降的问题，提出一个物理引导的潜扩散框架用于数据增强，结合变分自编码器、条件潜扩散模型和物理信息残差校正器。在热传导、不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯流和牛顿引力势上评估，使用GPLearn、DEAP和PySR作为下游SR后端。结果表明物理校正的增强一致提升了稀疏场景下的方程恢复能力。
Motivation: 符号回归在时空测量稀疏、噪声或物理不完整时可靠性严重下降，现有数据增强需要领域专家知识且技术复杂，限制了实用性。
Method: 提出物理引导的潜扩散框架，包含变分自编码器（VAE）、条件潜扩散模型和物理信息残差校正器，生成受控制关系约束的合成场来补全稀疏观测。
Result: 在热传导、不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯流和牛顿引力势上，物理校正的数据增强一致提升了稀疏场景下符号回归的方程恢复能力，适用于GPLearn、DEAP和PySR等多个下游SR模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调生成式增强可以在无需额外领域专业知识的情况下强化方程发现。

papers.title: An Open-Source Benchmark and Baseline for Multi-temporal Referring Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong visual understanding and language-guided grounding abilities, yet their capacity for multi-temporal visual reasoning remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{Multi-temporal Referring Segmentation (MTRS)}, a new task that aims to segment language-described temporal changes from multi-temporal images. MTRS extends conventional referring segmentation and change detection by jointly requiring temporal correspondence reasoning, language grounding, and pixel-level mask prediction. We propose \textbf{CRAFT-Agent}, an automated data construction pipeline with human auditing, and build \textbf{MTRefSeg-21K}, the first MTRS benchmark, containing 21K high-quality multi-temporal image-text-mask triplets across diverse scenes, viewpoints, and domains. Benchmarking a broad set of VLM- and LVLM-based models reveals that direct inference performs poorly, while task-specific fine-tuning remains limited. To address this, we propose \textbf{MTRefSeg-R1}, a change-aware LVLM framework trained with a two-stage strategy. It first learns general temporal-change perception from 20K vision-only bi-temporal samples, and is then fine-tuned on MTRefSeg-21K for fine-grained language-guided temporal localization. MTRefSeg-R1 explicitly models cross-temporal visual differences, aligns language instructions with temporal variations, and predicts referred change masks. Extensive experiments show that MTRefSeg-R1 achieves strong and often superior performance compared with existing LVLM baselines, demonstrating the challenge and potential of MTRS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多时相指代分割（MTRS）任务，要求模型从多时相图像中分割出语言描述的时间变化。为此，作者构建了自动化数据构建流程CRAFT-Agent和包含21K三元组的首个基准MTRefSeg-21K，并提出了两阶段训练的变化感知LVLM框架MTRefSeg-R1。实验表明MTRefSeg-R1在现有LVLM基线中表现优越，揭示了该任务的挑战与潜力。
Motivation: 现有大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多时相视觉推理方面表现不足，缺乏同时进行时间对应推理、语言定位和像素级掩码预测的基准和模型。
Method: 提出CRAFT-Agent自动化数据构建管道和MTRefSeg-21K基准；提出MTRefSeg-R1框架，采用两阶段训练：先学习通用时间变化感知，再在基准上微调进行细粒度语言引导的时间定位，显式建模跨时相视觉差异。
Result: 在MTRefSeg-21K基准上，MTRefSeg-R1相比现有LVLM基线取得优势性能，但直接推理效果差，任务特定微调仍有局限。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出多时相指代分割（MTRS）任务，要求模型从多时相图像中分割出语言描述的时间变化。为此，作者构建了自动化数据构建流程CRAFT-Agent和包含21K三元组的首个基准MTRefSeg-21K，并提出了两阶段训练的变化感知LVLM框架MTRefSeg-R1。实验表明MTRefSeg-R1在现有LVLM基线中表现优越，揭示了该任务的挑战与潜力。

papers.title: Profiling Privacy Preservation Against Gradient Inversion Attacks in Tabular Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple data holders to train machine learning models collaboratively without centralizing raw data, making it useful in privacy sensitive domains such as healthcare and institutional data sharing. FL keeps data local to clients while communicating only model updates, such as gradients or model deltas. Nevertheless, these updates can expose private client data through gradient inversion attacks (GIAs). We study this risk for tabular FL under an honest-but-curious server threat model across FL protocols, client batch sizes, training stages, attacker assumptions, model architectures, and binary classification, multiclass classification, and regression tasks. We use MIMIC-IV and complementary benchmark datasets. Our evaluation distinguishes numerical and categorical recovery, baseline recoverability, feature level recovery, and exact match rate (EMR). We evaluate FedSGD gradients and FedAvg model deltas with an exposure aligned protocol, comparing attacked models after matched client data exposure rather than matched communication rounds. We compare multilayer perceptron (MLP), ResNet, and FT-Transformer models, and isolate architecture effects through an MLP grid over width, depth, activation, normalization, and dropout. The results show that small client batches and updates representing few distinct records are most vulnerable. Larger local batches and stronger aggregation reduce reconstruction but do not eliminate leakage. FT-Transformer is consistently harder to invert than one-hot baselines, while reconstructability also varies substantially within the MLP family. These findings identify architecture as a practical privacy variable in tabular FL. We also show that aggregate reconstruction accuracy can overstate complete record recovery in sparse data, making EMR and baseline comparisons essential.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习在表格数据场景下，梯度反转攻击对隐私泄露的风险，重点关注客户端批次大小、模型架构、聚合策略等因素对恢复训练数据的影响。实验覆盖多种分类与回归任务，发现小批次和弱聚合最易泄露，而FT-Transformer架构比MLP更难被逆向，提示架构可作为隐私保护变量。
Motivation: 联邦学习中模型更新（梯度/模型差异）可能暴露客户端私有数据，现有研究多集中于图像数据，对表格数据尤其是数值与类别特征的恢复程度缺乏系统评估。
Method: 在诚实但好奇的服务器威胁模型下，分别评估FedSGD梯度和FedAvg模型差异在MLP、ResNet、FT-Transformer上的可逆性，通过暴露对齐协议匹配客户端数据暴露量，并区分数值/类别恢复、特征级恢复和精确匹配率。
Result: 小客户端批次更新最脆弱；大本地批次和强聚合能降低但无法消除泄露；FT-Transformer比独热编码基线更难逆向；MLP内部架构变化也会显著影响可逆性。
Conclusion: 架构应被视为表格联邦学习中实际可操作的隐私变量，且聚合恢复精度可能高估完整记录恢复，需结合精确匹配率与基线比较。

papers.title: Practical and Optimal Algorithm for Linear Contextual Bandits with Rare Parameter Updates
papers.abstract_en: We study linear contextual bandits under rare parameter updates: the learner may incorporate reward feedback into its parameter estimate only at a small number of update times, while still observing contexts online and selecting actions sequentially. This viewpoint clarifies a practical distinction that is often blurred in the literature: many "strictly batched" methods additionally restrict within-interval context adaptivity, meaning that the action rule inside an interval cannot depend on the sequence of realized contexts/actions in that interval (beyond the current round's context). For linear contextual bandits, we propose two practical algorithms with only $O(\log\log T)$ parameter updates. Our first algorithm BLCE-G attains minimax-optimal regret (up to polylogarithmic factors in $T$) simultaneously in both the small-$K$ and large-$K$ regimes under a static schedule. Our second algorithm BLCE removes the near G-optimal design step -- a dominant computational bottleneck in prior strictly batched static-grid methods -- yet preserves minimax-optimal regret and achieves the lowest known runtime complexity among optimal algorithms. We further extend these rare-update and computational principles to generalized linear contextual bandits. Overall, our results yield statistically optimal algorithms under $O(\log\log T)$ parameter updates that are also computationally efficient in practice.

papers.title: UME: A Unified Meta-Generalization Framework for Cross-Domain ETA
papers.abstract_en: Accurate Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction on checkout page is crucial in instant logistics for enhancing user satisfaction, optimizing dispatching, and controlling operational costs. In international on-demand delivery platforms, where ETA data originates from diverse countries or regions with different patterns, multi-domain modeling is of great importance and has been widely adopted. However, existing methods still face three critical challenges in real-world deployment. First, current multi-domain models struggle to generalize to completely unseen domains, failing to achieve zero-shot prediction during the initial cold-start phase. Second, cross-domain feature spaces are often assumed to be consistent, whereas new domains commonly suffer from structural missingness of offline (statistical) features due to the lack of historical data. Third, such feature missingness often compels industrial systems to model mature and cold-start domains separately, hindering knowledge transfer and increasing maintenance overhead. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{UME}, a \textbf{U}nified \textbf{M}eta-generalization framework for \textbf{E}TA. Specifically, UME integrates a unified dual-branch architecture with a novel meta-learning mechanism that employs a hypernetwork-based meta learner. By leveraging domain-level knowledge and instance-level context, the meta learner empowers three meta modules to dynamically modulate feature gating, expert attention, and final prediction, capturing cross-domain correlations and facilitating intra-domain adaptation. A knowledge distillation strategy is further introduce to enhance performance. UME has now been deployed in Meituan-keeta delivery platform (the largest international food delivery platform in China). Extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests demonstrate that UME significantly outperforms existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出统一元泛化框架UME，用于跨域预估到达时间（ETA）预测。UME采用双分支架构和基于超网络的元学习器，动态调节特征门控、专家注意力和最终预测，以解决多域ETA建模中冷启动零样本预测、跨域特征缺失等问题。在美团Keeta平台上线，离线实验和在线A/B测试显示UME显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有跨域ETA模型在真实部署中面临三大挑战：无法泛化到完全未见过的域（零样本冷启动）、新域常缺失离线统计特征、特征缺失迫使成熟域和冷启动域分开建模，阻碍知识迁移并增加维护成本。
Method: 提出UME统一元泛化框架，包含统一双分支架构和基于超网络的元学习器，利用域级知识和实例级上下文动态调节三个元模块（特征门控、专家注意力、最终预测），并引入知识蒸馏策略增强性能。
Result: 在美团Keeta国际外卖平台部署，离线实验和在线A/B测试表明UME显著优于现有基线。
Conclusion: UME通过元学习机制有效实现跨域ETA预测的零样本泛化和知识迁移，应对特征缺失问题，已在工业系统部署并取得提升。

papers.title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
papers.abstract_en: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $λ^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action's higher immediate expected value, and plays risky near catastrophe in negative-drift (decline) regimes despite the safe action's lower immediate expected loss. We derive a closed-form expression for the asymptotic loss-aversion plateau $\barλ$ that depends only on win probability $p$, payoff asymmetry $r = |Δ_\ell/Δ_w|$, and discount factor $β$, and matches numerical solutions to $R^2 = 0.999$. The mechanism does not require asymmetric payoffs. Across a sweep of $(p,β)$ at three asymmetry levels, the asymmetry share of $\barλ$ above unity has median 4.6% at $r = 1.25$ and rises to 13.9% at $r = 2$, with the boundary contribution exceeding the asymmetry contribution in every cell tested. The phenomena persist under tabular Q-learning (a model-free agent reproduces $V^*$ at correlation 0.98 in growth and 1.00 in decline) and under stochastic transitions with Gaussian, heavy-tailed Student-$t_3$, and asymmetric skew-normal noise up to 50% of the step size, where the asymptotic plateau tracks the closed-form prediction within 0.41% for safe-channel noise and within 9.6% for risky-channel or both-channel noise. These results identify absorbing failure states as a sufficient structural mechanism for prospect-theory-like behavior under optimal control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有吸收灾难状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制。即使奖励是线性的且智能体没有效用曲率、概率权重或框架依赖，标准Bellman最优性也会产生三种前景理论特征：S形值函数轮廓（灾难附近凸，远处凹）、内源性损失敏感系数λ*(S)>1以及反射效应策略反转。在495种配置中，最优策略在正漂移（增长）模式下在灾难附近选择安全行为，尽管风险行为具有更高的即时期望值；在负漂移（衰退）模式下则相反。推导出渐近损失规避平台λ的闭式表达式，仅依赖于获胜概率p、收益不对称比r和折扣因子β，与数值解的R²=0.999匹配。该机制不需要不对称收益。现象在表格Q学习和随机转移下仍存在。结果表明吸收失败状态是最优控制下产生前景理论行为的充分结构性机制。
Motivation: 前景理论行为通常归因于非标准效用函数或概率加权，但本文探索在标准风险中性MDP中是否可能由灾难状态本身触发此类行为，从而揭示前景理论现象的新解释机制。
Method: 在具有吸收灾难状态的MDP中，使用标准Bellman最优性求解最优值函数和政策，推导渐近损失规避平台的闭式表达式，并通过数值模拟验证，包括模型无关的Q学习和随机噪声下的扩展。
Result: 在495种配置下，观察到S形值函数、损失敏感系数>1和反射效应。闭式表达式以R²=0.999匹配数值解。在非对称收益设置中，边界贡献超过非对称贡献。Q学习复现V*相关性达0.98-1.00。在高达50%步长的高斯、重尾t分布和偏态噪声下，渐近平台与预测偏差不超过9.6%。
Conclusion: 吸收灾难状态是风险中性MDP中产生前景理论行为的充分结构性机制，无需非标准偏好假设，且对模型误差具有一定鲁棒性。

papers.title: Flexible Control of 3D CT Generation via Text and Semantically-Defined Segmentation Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Generative models for volumetric medical images have found many applications in medical imaging, ranging from data augmentation to serving as priors for inverse problems. For these applications, generating high-resolution 3D images with strong controllability is essential but remains highly challenging. Existing approaches typically control generation either through radiology reports used as text prompts or through full image segmentation. While text-based prompting is flexible, it provides limited spatial control over the location, shape, and boundary of abnormalities. In contrast, segmentation-based methods receive precise spatial guidance but are restrictive in requiring full-organ annotations. In this work, we propose a flexible multimodal framework for controllable volumetric image generation that supports input from radiology reports and segmentation prompts (both optional). Our approach allows users to provide segmentation of a specific anatomy or abnormality without requiring full-organ annotations. The semantic meaning of the segmentation mask is specified through an accompanying text description, resulting in a highly flexible and scalable conditioning mechanism. We develop a memory-efficient architecture based on a modified diffusion transformer that jointly processes image and segmentation tokens. The model further incorporates gated attention to effectively attend to long radiology reports. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art perceptual and semantic scores (e.g., 24% relative improvement in mean FID), generates high-resolution anatomically consistent CT volumes, and improves data efficiency when used for data augmentation. Radiologists' evaluation further confirms strong alignment between generated and real medical images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种灵活的多模态框架用于可控的3D CT体积图像生成，支持放射报告文本和分割提示作为可选输入。通过改进的扩散变换器和门控注意力机制联合处理图像与分割token，用户可指定特定解剖结构的分割并附上文本描述其语义。实验表明该方法在FID上相对提升24%，生成高分辨率、解剖一致的CT体积，并提升数据增强效率。
Motivation: 现有方法中，文本提示灵活但空间控制有限，完整分割图精确但需全器官标注，缺乏兼具灵活性和空间控制的方案。
Method: 构建基于扩散变换器的记忆高效架构，联合处理图像和分割token，并引入门控注意力处理长放射报告；用户可提供特定结构的分割掩码及其语义文本描述。
Result: 生成质量达到最佳感知和语义分数（FID相对提升24%），生成高分辨率、解剖一致的CT体积，数据增强时提升数据效率，放射科医生评估确认生成图像与真实图像高度一致。

papers.title: Reasmory: 3D Reconstruction as Explicit Memory for VLMs Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit emerging spatial reasoning capabilities, yet they remain unreliable on tasks requiring precise spatial understanding, such as viewpoint reasoning, directional comparison, and distance estimation. In multi-view images and monocular videos, relevant spatial cues are often sparse and distributed across redundant observations, making them difficult to organize and exploit. Reconstruction-based Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer a natural way to aggregate such observations into explicit spatial memory, such as point clouds. However, simply exposing reconstruction models as free-form tools is brittle, VLMs may invoke tools incorrectly, skip required spatial transformations, or misuse intermediate results. We propose \textbf{Reasmory}, a framework that formulates spatial reasoning as structured program execution over reconstructed spatial memory. Reasmory constructs explicit 3D memory, augments it with semantically grounded 3D object instances, and introduces a lightweight Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that constrains how VLMs query objects and cameras, transform viewpoints, and render observations during reasoning. Generated programs are parsed and validated before execution, enabling more reliable interaction with spatial memory than unconstrained tool use. Experiments on multi-view image and video spatial reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains of 6--18\% over strong baselines, including GPT-5-mini and Gemini-3-flash, indicating that explicit 3D memory is most useful when accessed through constrained, validated operations rather than free-form tool calls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Reasmory框架，将VLM的空间推理重构为对显式3D内存的结构化程序执行。通过构建3D点云、语义实例，并引入轻量级领域特定语言(DSL)约束VLM的查询和变换操作，经解析验证后执行，相比自由工具调用更可靠。在多视图图像和视频空间推理基准上，相比GPT-5-mini等强基线提升6-18%。
Motivation: VLM在需要精确空间理解的任务(如视角推理、方向比较、距离估计)上不可靠，多视图/单目视频中的空间线索稀疏且分散，难以组织和利用。现有重建模型作为自由工具使用时，VLM可能错误调用、跳过必要变换或误用中间结果。
Method: 提出Reasmory框架：1) 构建显式3D内存(点云)；2) 增强语义3D对象实例；3) 引入轻量级领域特定语言(DSL)约束VLM查询物体、相机、视角变换和渲染操作；4) 生成的程序经解析和验证后执行，确保与3D内存的可靠交互。
Result: 在多视图图像和视频空间推理基准上，相比GPT-5-mini和Gemini-3-flash等强基线，持续提升6-18%。
Conclusion: 显式3D内存通过受约束、经验证的操作访问最为有效，而非自由工具调用。该框架通过结构化程序执行提升了VLM空间推理的可靠性。

papers.title: SS-ZKR: Spatial-Semantic Zero-Knowledge Routing for Privacy-Preserving Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Foundational agent interoperability standards, notably the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), have advanced multi-agent system communication, and complementary identity frameworks leveraging W3C Decentralised Identifiers (DIDs) and Verifiable Credentials (VCs) provide cryptographic agent authentication. However, no existing protocol supports content-based semantic routing of agent payloads across organisational trust boundaries without requiring the routing intermediary to decrypt the payload, which is a hard constraint in compliance-sensitive environments governed by GDPR, HIPAA, and MiFID II. We propose SS-ZKR, a three-mechanism privacy-preserving routing protocol designed as a complementary layer atop A2A/MCP. Mechanism I introduces blind routing via differentially private semantic intent vectors cryptographically bound to zero-knowledge proofs of payload-schema consistency. Mechanism II offers vector-weighted adaptive payload sanitisation with formal (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy for numerical fields and heuristic semantic aggregation for textual fields. Mechanism III presents a spatial-to-cryptographic policy compiler that translates visually defined trust-zone topologies into deterministic zero-knowledge access circuits. We provide a formal threat model, analyse information leakage bounds of intent vectors, present pseudocode for all three mechanisms, and give analytical complexity comparisons against TEE-based and homomorphic encryption-based routing baselines. SS-ZKR lets enterprises in financial services, healthcare, and defence orchestrate heterogeneous AI agents across regulatory boundaries without exposing proprietary data to routing infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SS-ZKR，一种隐私保护路由协议，作为 A2A/MCP 协议的补充层，支持跨组织信任边界的内容级语义路由，而无需路由中介解密负载。协议包含三种机制：基于差分隐私语义意图向量的盲路由、向量权重的自适应负载净化、以及空间到密码策略编译器。提供了形式化威胁模型、信息泄漏界限分析和计算复杂度比较。
Motivation: 现有代理互操作标准（如 A2A、MCP）和身份框架（DID、VC）无法在不解密负载的情况下进行语义路由，这在 GDPR、HIPAA 等合规环境中是硬约束。
Method: 三种机制：I. 通过差分隐私语义意图向量和零知识证明实现盲路由；II. 向量加权自适应负载净化，数值字段保证 (ε,δ)-差分隐私，文本字段采用启发式语义聚合；III. 空间到密码策略编译器，将可视化信任区拓扑转换为确定性零知识访问电路。
Result: 提供了形式化威胁模型、意图向量信息泄漏界限分析，以及与 TEE 和同态加密路由基线的分析复杂度比较。
Conclusion: SS-ZKR 使金融服务、医疗和国防企业能够在跨监管边界编排异构 AI 代理，而无需向路由基础设施暴露专有数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Understanding Modality Interaction in Multimodal Language Models via Partial Information Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Understanding modality interaction in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is central to reliable deployment. We introduce Partial Information Decomposition (PID) as a decision-level framework that separates unique, redundant, and synergistic contributions of sensory and linguistic inputs, beyond representation alignment and outcome-based evaluation. Across vision--language benchmarks, PID reveals recurring modality-use profiles: reasoning and grounding-oriented tasks tend to exhibit high synergy, whereas expert and knowledge-oriented tasks show stronger language-unique reliance. These profiles generalize across model families and predict sensitivity to modality-level interventions. We further extend PID to tri-modal systems with Sensory PID, treating language as a control variable to decompose video--audio information gain. Applied to omni-modal models, Sensory PID reveals a sensory synergy bottleneck dominated by visual information even on audio--visual fusion tasks. Finally, PID-guided reweighting provides initial evidence for improving multimodal reasoning and grounding performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文引入部分信息分解（PID）作为决策层框架，分离视觉-语言多模态大模型中感官与语言输入的独特、冗余和协同贡献。在视觉-语言基准上，PID揭示了重复出现的模态使用模式：推理和面向定位的任务通常表现出高协同性，而专家和知识导向任务则更依赖语言独特性。这些模式跨模型家族泛化，并能预测对模态级干预的敏感性。进一步扩展至三模态系统（Sensory PID），将语言视为控制变量分解视频-音频信息增益。应用于全模态模型时，Sensory PID显示出以视觉信息为主的感觉协同瓶颈，即使在音频-视觉融合任务中也是如此。最后，PID引导的重加权为改进多模态推理和接地性能提供了初步证据。
Motivation: 理解多模态大模型中的模态交互对于可靠部署至关重要，现有方法多关注表征对齐或基于结果的评估，缺乏对模态贡献的深入分解。
Method: 提出使用部分信息分解（PID）作为决策层框架，将感官和语言输入的信息贡献分解为独特、冗余和协同三个部分，并扩展至三模态系统（Sensory PID）。
Result: 在视觉-语言基准上，PID识别出模态使用模式；跨模型家族泛化；Sensory PID揭示全模态模型中视觉信息主导的感官协同瓶颈；PID引导的重加权初步提升了多模态推理和接地性能。
Conclusion: PID提供了一个系统的工具来分析多模态模型中的模态交互，未来可应用于模型调试和模态级干预。

papers.title: Boundary-Protection W8A8 HiFloat8 Quantization for Large-Scale Text-to-Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We present a post-training quantization (PTQ) approach for Wan2.1-T2V-14B, a 14-billion-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer, targeting the W8A8 HiFloat8 (HiF8) format on Ascend 910B NPUs. A central challenge in quantizing video DiT models is the heterogeneous activation distribution across transformer blocks: boundary blocks (the first and last few blocks) exhibit fundamentally different statistical properties from middle blocks, making uniform quantization ineffective. We conduct a systematic per-block activation analysis across all 40 WanAttentionBlocks and use the findings to motivate a boundary-protection strategy that retains the first two and last three blocks in BF16 while quantizing the remaining 35 blocks with W8A8 HiF8. The proposed PTQ method matches or marginally exceeds the BF16 baseline on all five VBench dimensions evaluated, indicating no measurable accuracy loss within the 5-prompt evaluation set. An ablation study over four protection configurations confirms that full boundary protection yields the highest average VBench score, validating the data-driven block selection. We additionally investigate quantization-aware training (QAT) as a complementary fine-tuning stage and analyze the conditions under which it fails to outperform plain PTQ on single-card hardware.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to ICME 2026 Grand Challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Wan2.1-T2V-14B这一140亿参数文本到视频扩散Transformer模型，提出了一种后训练量化（PTQ）方法，目标是在Ascend 910B NPU上实现W8A8 HiFloat8（HiF8）格式。通过分析所有40个WanAttentionBlock的激活分布，发现边界块（前两块和后三块）与中间块统计特性差异显著，因此采用边界保护策略：保留前两块和后三块为BF16，其余35块量化为W8A8 HiF8。在5个VBench维度上，该方法匹配或略优于BF16基线，且无精度损失。
Motivation: 量化视频DiT模型时，不同Transformer块的激活分布不均匀，边界块与中间块统计特性差异大，统一量化效果不佳。
Method: 提出边界保护PTQ策略：基于per-block激活分析，保留前两个和后三个WanAttentionBlock为BF16，其余35块量化为W8A8 HiF8。
Result: 在5个VBench维度上，提出的PTQ方法匹配或略优于BF16基线，在5-prompt评估集上无精度损失。消融实验确认完全边界保护获得最高平均VBench分数。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的边界选择能有效保护量化精度，且QAT在单卡硬件上未必优于PTQ。

papers.title: Optimal-Point Variance Reduction For Bayesian Optimization With Regret Guarantee
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies a one-step lookahead Bayesian optimization (BO) method and its theoretical guarantee. Although the empirical effectiveness of one-step lookahead BO methods, such as entropy search, has been studied extensively, they often rely on computationally intractable approximations, and their regret guarantees remain underdeveloped. Thus, this paper proposes a one-step lookahead BO method called optimal-point variance reduction (OVR), which requires only posterior sampling and Monte Carlo approximations. We obtain a uniform error bound over an input domain for the Monte Carlo estimation in OVR. Furthermore, we show that the regularized OVR, with the slight modification to promote exploration, achieves a vanishing Bayesian expected simple regret upper bound. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of OVR through numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于一步前瞻（one-step lookahead）的贝叶斯优化方法——最优点方差缩减（OVR），通过后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似实现，并给出理论遗憾保证。正则化版本在贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上达到上界递减。
Motivation: 现有一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方法（如熵搜索）虽经验有效，但计算近似困难且遗憾保证不完善。
Method: 提出OVR方法，仅需后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似；通过正则化鼓励探索，得到贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上界。
Result: 数值实验展示了OVR的有效性；正则化OVR的贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上界递减。
Conclusion: OVR结合了理论保证与计算可行性，为一步前瞻BO提供了新途径。

papers.title: CryoProt: A Protein Pretraining Framework with Cross-Box Interactions on Cryo-EM Density Maps
papers.abstract_en: Despite the growing availability of cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) density maps, effectively leveraging them for protein representation remains challenging. First, current methods lack a general-purpose protein pretraining framework tailored for cryo-EM density maps, designed for protein-related property prediction. Second, existing approaches typically partition density maps into local box regions and model them independently, overlooking interactions across boxes which are essential for capturing global structural context in cryo-EM density map. To address these challenges, we propose CryoProt, a protein pretraining framework designed for cryo-EM density maps. CryoProt introduces a Map Encoder based on multi-head latent attention (MLA), where box-level representations interact through a shared latent space, enabling explicit modeling of cross-box dependencies within the density map. Furthermore, we adopt a multi-task pretraining strategy to learn generalizable representations that can be effectively transferred to diverse downstream tasks, such as protein flexibility prediction, where cryo-EM density maps are not required and can be inferred implicitly by the pretrained model. Experimental results demonstrate that CryoProt consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, achieving up to 12% improvement over the best-performing baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling cross-box interactions in cryo-EM data. The source code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CryoProt.

papers.title: COLLAR: Cascaded Object-Level Latent Refinement for High-Fidelity Conditional Generation
papers.abstract_en: Achieving high-fidelity object-level control in Diffusion Transformers remains a significant challenge despite the introduction of structural priors like depth and Canny maps. Current object-level conditional generation methods frequently suffer from visual artifacts and struggle to maintain precise control over objects within small localized regions. To address these limitations, we propose Cascaded Object-Level Latent Refinement (COLLAR), a training-free framework that progressively optimizes object-level features via the Field-of-View (FoV) expansion. First, we propose the Cross-Scale Semantic Alignment (CSSA) module to address spatial-semantic gaps by injecting object-level features into extended-FoV branches via attention mechanisms. To further optimize these features, the Cyclic Feature Injection (CFI) module introduces a reciprocal background feedback mechanism. It leverages a frequency-based adaptive strategy to selectively update the global backbone with context-aligned local information. Finally, the extended-FoV branch serves as a hub for feature optimization, ensuring that object-level features are integrated into the global generation process without compromising final image quality. Extensive experiments on the COCO-MIG and COCO-POS benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across semantic alignment, image quality, and spatial fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出COLLAR，一种无需训练的对象级潜在精化框架，用于提高扩散transformer在条件图像生成中的保真度。该方法通过交叉尺度语义对齐（CSSA）模块和循环特征注入（CFI）模块，在扩展视场分支中逐步优化对象级特征，解决了空间-语义差距和局部区域控制不精确的问题。在COCO-MIG和COCO-POS基准上的实验表明，该方法在语义对齐、图像质量和空间保真度方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散transformer在对象级条件生成中存在视觉伪影和局部区域控制不精确的问题，尽管引入了深度图和Canny边缘等结构先验，但仍难以实现高保真度的对象级控制。
Method: 提出级联对象级潜在精化（COLLAR）框架，包含两个核心模块：交叉尺度语义对齐（CSSA）通过注意力机制将对象级特征注入扩展视场分支；循环特征注入（CFI）利用频域自适应策略和背景反馈机制优化特征，最终通过扩展视场分支将优化后的特征整合到全局生成中。
Result: 在COCO-MIG和COCO-POS基准上，该方法在语义对齐、图像质量和空间保真度方面均优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: COLLAR作为无需训练的框架，通过视场扩展和级联优化有效提升了对象级条件生成的保真度和控制精度。

papers.title: When Parallelism Pays Off: Cohesion-Aware Task Partitioning for Multi-Agent Coding
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems offer a way to decompose complex tasks, such as coding, through parallelization and context isolation. However, adding agents in practice introduces inter-agent communication overhead, which incurs extra cost and can sometimes offset the efficiency gains. We formalize multi-agent orchestration as a graph partitioning problem that captures the communication-to-computation trade-off: task decomposition can shorten critical-path computation, but cross-agent dependencies require costly context transfer. We instantiate this view in repository-level software engineering and present Cohesion-aware Coder (Co-Coder), which builds dependency graphs from static analysis, isolates structural hub files, partitions the graph via community detection, and executes the partition with a dependency-aware scheduler. Across 28 real-world tasks on DevEval and CodeProjectEval, Co-Coder advances the Pareto-frontier over sequential and file-based parallel baselines as well as Claude Code with Agent Teams, lifting pass rate by up to 14.0%, achieving up to a 2.10x wall-clock speedup, and reducing API cost by up to 35%, with the largest gains on the most dependency-dense projects. Co-coder demonstrates how cohesion-aware orchestration can make parallel coding agents both theoretically grounded and practically efficient, suggesting a broader design principle for multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cohesion-aware Coder (Co-Coder)，一种基于图划分的多智能体代码生成框架，通过静态分析构建依赖图、隔离结构枢纽文件、社区检测划分，并采用依赖感知调度器。在DevEval和CodeProjectEval的28个真实世界任务上，Co-Coder相比顺序、文件级并行基线以及Claude Code等，在pass@1上提升最多14.0%，墙钟速度提升2.10倍，API成本降低35%，尤其在依赖密集的项目上效果显著。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统通过并行化和上下文隔离分解复杂任务，但智能体间通信开销可能抵消效率增益。现有方法缺乏对通信-计算权衡的理论形式化。
Method: 将多智能体编排形式化为图划分问题，权衡通信与计算。具体实例化为Co-Coder：从静态分析构建代码依赖图，识别并隔离结构枢纽文件（hub files），使用社区检测算法划分图，再以依赖感知调度器执行分区。
Result: 在DevEval和CodeProjectEval的28个任务上，Co-Coder相对于顺序基线、文件级并行基线和Claude Code等，pass@1提升最多14.0%，墙钟加速比达2.10倍，API成本降低最多35%，在依赖最密集的项目上增益最大。
Conclusion: Co-Coder证明了凝聚力感知的编排（cohesion-aware orchestration）能使并行代码智能体既有理论依据又实际高效，为多智能体系统提供了更广泛的设计原则。

papers.title: COLLIE: Guiding Skill Discovery in Semantically Coherent Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised skill discovery (USD) aims to learn diverse behaviors without reward functions, but often results in task-irrelevant or hazardous behaviors due to uniform exploration. Guided skill discovery (GSD) addresses this issue by incorporating human intent to focus exploration on meaningful regions. However, existing GSD methods typically require training additional guidance models, and rely on pre-defined rules or expert demonstration, which can be ineffective under sparse, online-collected human feedback. To overcome this, we propose COLLIE, a GSD framework that leverages dense unsupervised data to construct a semantically coherent skill latent space. This latent space is well-structured, enabling reliable guidance with sparse online feedback. Moreover, its semantic coherence property enables training-free construction of guidance signals, eliminating the need for additional model training beyond skill learning. Theoretical analysis justifies the effectiveness of our training-free guidance signal, while experiments across diverse state-based and pixel-based tasks show that COLLIE learns diverse, human-aligned skills, avoids hazardous behaviors, and achieves superior downstream performance with minimal human feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COLLIE，一种引导技能发现框架，利用无监督数据构建语义连贯的技能隐空间，仅需稀疏在线人类反馈即可生成无需额外训练的引导信号。理论分析证明其有效性，实验显示在多种任务中能学习多样且符合人类意图的技能，避免危险行为，并在下游任务中取得优异性能。
Motivation: 现有引导技能发现方法通常依赖预定义规则或专家演示，在稀疏在线反馈下效果不佳，且需要额外训练引导模型。
Method: 提出 COLLIE 框架，通过密集无监督数据构建语义连贯的技能隐空间，利用其结构特性实现无需训练的引导信号生成，仅需稀疏在线人类反馈。
Result: 实验在多种基于状态和像素的任务上表明，COLLIE 学习到多样且符合人类意图的技能，避免危险行为，并以极少的人类反馈达到卓越的下游性能。
Conclusion: 语义连贯的隐空间使得稀疏反馈有效引导技能发现，且无需额外模型训练，为引导技能发现提供了新的高效范式。

papers.title: Explainable deep reinforcement learning reveals energy-efficient control strategies for turbulent drag reduction
papers.abstract_en: We propose a method combining Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning (MARL) and eXplainable Deep Learning (XDL) to reduce drag in wall-bounded turbulent flows. Taking as a baseline the results of training agents directly targeting wall-shear stress and opposition control, three SHAP-guided approaches are compared. In the first, the reward is computed from SHAP attributions of a U-net predicting the future velocity field; in the second, from SHAP attributions of a U-net predicting the skin-friction coefficient; in the third, from a combination of SHAP attributions of two U-nets predicting the skin-friction coefficient and the wall pressure fluctuations, respectively. The combined SHAP strategy based on skin-friction coefficient and wall-pressure fluctuations achieves the best overall performance, achieving a DR of 34.44% and a NES of 34.01% with only 0.43% normalized input power. Relative to opposition control, drag reduction and net energy saving increase by 49.41% and 48.52%, respectively. Compared with the direct wall-shear-stress baseline, the proposed strategy simultaneously improves performance while reducing the normalized actuation cost from 5.90% to 0.43%. Analysis of the results reveals that the energetically efficient policy is consistent with pressure-gated actuation, activating predominantly at near-zero wall pressure, and operates on a temporal timescale comparable to the lifetime of the near-wall turbulent structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结合多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）与可解释深度学习（XDL）的方法，以减少壁面湍流中的阻力。通过SHAP归因引导三种奖励设计，其中基于摩擦系数和壁面压力波动组合的策略实现了34.44%的减阻率和34.01%的净能量节省，且归一化输入功率仅0.43%。分析表明节能策略与压力门控驱动一致。
Motivation: 现有湍流减阻控制方法（如反对控制）能耗较高，且缺乏可解释性，难以理解节能策略的物理机制。
Method: 训练多智能体强化学习智能体，利用U-net预测速度场或摩擦系数，通过SHAP归因计算奖励，比较三种策略：仅基于速度场SHAP、仅基于摩擦系数SHAP、以及结合摩擦系数与壁面压力波动SHAP。
Result: 结合摩擦系数与壁面压力波动的策略实现34.44%减阻率和34.01%净能量节省，输入功率仅0.43%。相比反对控制，减阻率提升49.41%，净能量节省提升48.52%。相比直接壁面剪切应力基线，功率从5.90%降至0.43%。
Conclusion: 提出的SHAP引导奖励方法能有效发现节能策略，该策略在近零壁面压力时激活，时间尺度与近壁湍流结构寿命相当。

papers.title: Silent Failures in Federated Personalization of Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly personalized on decentralized private data through federated learning and are now deployed at scale under growing regulatory requirements for post-market monitoring. We argue that this convergence creates a distinct and under-recognized class of trustworthiness failures, which we term "Silent Failures." These include amplified bias, fairness collapse, and alignment erosion that may remain difficult to detect because federated learning's privacy constraints limit visibility into model behavior. A landscape analysis of existing benchmarks reveals a structural divide. Federated benchmarks evaluate system performance but provide limited insight into model behavior, whereas centralized trustworthiness benchmarks assess behavior but require model access incompatible with federated privacy. We introduce a taxonomy of six silent failure modes arising from the interaction of foundation model personalization, dataset shift, and core federated constraints. Our analysis shows that privacy-preserving training alone is insufficient for trustworthy deployment. We conclude with a research agenda for privacy-preserving behavioral evaluation and propose that silent failures become a standard diagnostic category for trustworthy federated artificial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出联邦学习中基础模型个性化在隐私约束下会产生一种难以检测的信任失败，称为“静默失败”，包括放大偏见、公平性崩溃和对齐侵蚀。通过基准分析揭示联邦基准与集中式信任基准之间的结构性鸿沟，并提出了六种静默失败模式的分类法。结论是隐私保护训练不足以确保可信部署，需要隐私保护的行为评估。
Motivation: 联邦学习与基础模型个性化结合后，在隐私约束下模型行为难以监控，现有基准无法评估此类信任失败，存在被忽视的风险。
Method: 通过景观分析（landscape analysis）梳理现有基准的不足，提出六种静默失败模式的分类法（taxonomy），并给出研究议程。
Result: 分析表明隐私保护训练本身不足以确保可信部署；需要隐私保护的行为评估来解决结构性鸿沟。
Conclusion: 呼吁将静默失败作为联邦人工智能可信诊断的标准类别，并推动隐私保护行为评估。

summary_sections.motivation: 联邦学习与基础模型个性化结合后，在隐私约束下模型行为难以监控，现有基准无法评估此类信任失败，存在被忽视的风险。
summary_sections.method: 通过景观分析（landscape analysis）梳理现有基准的不足，提出六种静默失败模式的分类法（taxonomy），并给出研究议程。
summary_sections.result: 分析表明隐私保护训练本身不足以确保可信部署；需要隐私保护的行为评估来解决结构性鸿沟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 呼吁将静默失败作为联邦人工智能可信诊断的标准类别，并推动隐私保护行为评估。

papers.title: Lodestar: An Online-Learning LLM Inference Router
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently serving large language model (LLM) inference tasks is crucial both for user-perceived latency such as time-to-first-token (TTFT) and for GPU utilization. However, LLM request routing, that is, assigning each inference request to a GPU instance, is particularly challenging: execution is highly input-dependent; batching and KV-cache reuse create strong cross-request coupling; and latency responds nonlinearly to context length, model/engine settings, and heterogeneous accelerators. As a result, simple traditional load balancing algorithms, and even heuristics tailored for LLM inference, fail to achieve good performance. We present Lodestar, a novel learning-based request routing system for distributed GPU clusters. Lodestar continuously collects a snapshot of the cluster at per-request level, including real-time instance state, request characteristics, and observed performance, and trains an online reward predictor that it uses to route inference requests to the instance that will maximize given reward (e.g., minimizing TTFT). Lodestar is cloud-native and works seamlessly with existing serving stacks (vLLM). With continuous online adaptation to changing workloads and infrastructure conditions, Lodestar achieves 1.41x lower average TTFT and 1.47x lower P99 TTFT on average (up to 2.15x/1.86x on homogeneous and 4.38x/4.42x on heterogeneous clusters) compared to a state-of-the-art prefix cache and load-aware heuristic, and learns these efficient routing strategies within about 5 minutes, based on experiments in a public cloud GPU cluster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lodestar，一个基于在线学习的大语言模型 (LLM) 推理请求路由系统，用于分布式 GPU 集群。它持续收集每请求级别的集群快照（实例状态、请求特征、观测性能），训练一个在线奖励预测器，从而将请求路由到能最大化给定奖励（如最小化首令牌延迟 TTFT）的实例。实验表明，相比最先进的基于前缀缓存和负载感知的启发式方法，Lodestar 平均降低 TTFT 1.41 倍，P99 TTFT 1.47 倍，且在异构集群上优势更显著，仅需约 5 分钟即可学习到高效路由策略。
Motivation: LLM 推理请求路由面临挑战：执行高度依赖输入，批处理与 KV 缓存复用导致强跨请求耦合，延迟对上下文长度、模型/引擎设置和异构加速器呈现非线性响应。传统负载均衡算法乃至专门为 LLM 设计的启发式方法均难以达到良好性能。
Method: Lodestar 是一个基于学习的路由系统，采用在线学习框架。它在每请求粒度收集集群快照（包含实时实例状态、请求特征和观测性能），并训练一个在线奖励预测器，用于将推理请求路由到能最大化给定奖励（例如最小化 TTFT）的 GPU 实例。该系统是云原生的，可与现有服务栈（如 vLLM）无缝集成。
Result: 在公共云 GPU 集群上的实验表明，与最先进的基于前缀缓存和负载感知的启发式方法相比，Lodestar 平均降低 TTFT 1.41 倍，P99 TTFT 1.47 倍（同构集群上最高达 2.15x/1.86x，异构集群上最高达 4.38x/4.42x），且在大约 5 分钟内学会这些高效路由策略。
Conclusion: Lodestar 通过持续在线适应变化的工作负载和基础设施条件，显著提升了 LLM 推理路由性能，并能快速收敛到高效路由策略。

papers.title: PRISM: Gauge-Invariant Tangent-Space Differentially Private LoRA
papers.abstract_en: Applying differential privacy (DP) via DP-SGD to Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a natural approach for privacy-preserving fine-tuning. However, LoRA's low-rank parameterization poses a fundamental challenge. In LoRA, each trainable update is represented as a low-rank matrix $Z = AB^\top$, but this factorization is inherently non-identifiable: many factor pairs $(A,B)$ represent the same update $Z$. As a result, applying DP-SGD directly to the factors induces gauge-dependent perturbations on $Z$, and we show that this naive DP-LoRA can lead to unbounded noise amplification. We propose PRISM, an intrinsic DP mechanism for LoRA that is gauge invariant by construction, avoids bilinear noise amplification, and admits an efficient low-dimensional noise sampler. Moreover, PRISM yields a closed-form characterization of the effective intrinsic noise induced on $Z$, enabling stable privacy-utility trade-offs through bounded, gauge-invariant perturbations. We establish standard $(ε,δ)$-DP guarantees for PRISM and introduce a DP-aware, gauge-invariant adaptive update rule that prevents adaptive optimization from amplifying injected privacy noise, improving numerical stability in practice.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026) as an oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在低秩适应（LoRA）中直接应用DP-SGD会导致因分解非唯一性而产生的规范依赖噪声放大，并提出PRISM机制，通过规范不变的切空间扰动实现内在差分隐私，避免了双线性噪声放大，并支持高效低维噪声采样。PRISM提供了对Z上有效内在噪声的闭式表征，并引入了DP感知的规范不变自适应更新规则以改善数值稳定性。
Motivation: LoRA的低秩参数化中，矩阵分解A、B非唯一，直接对因子施加DP-SGD会在更新矩阵Z上引入规范依赖的扰动，可能导致无界噪声放大，破坏隐私-效用权衡。
Method: 提出PRISM，一种在LoRA更新矩阵Z的切空间中施加规范不变扰动的内在DP机制，利用低维噪声采样和闭式噪声表征，并设计DP感知的自适应更新规则。
Result: 建立了标准(ε,δ)-DP保证，通过规范不变的有界扰动实现稳定隐私-效用权衡，避免噪声放大。
Conclusion: PRISM为LoRA提供了一种内在的、规范不变的DP方法，解决了直接DP-LoRA的噪声放大问题，并提升了实际训练中的数值稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Machine Learning Surrogate Modeling for Homogenization of Hyperelastic Materials with Boolean Microstructures
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven surrogate models are an alternative to numerical homogenization of heterogeneous materials. In this contribution, a supervised learning approach is presented for predicting effective Lamé parameters of hyperelastic composites from low-dimensional microstructural descriptors. The data set is based on previously published numerical homogenization results for ensembles of two-phase stochastic microstructures generated by planar Boolean models, covering variations of inclusion shape, phase contrast, and area fraction; see Brändel, Brands, Maike, Rheinbach, Schröder, Schwarz and Stoyan (2022). A neural network is trained on combinations of scalar and curve-valued statistical descriptors, including the area fraction, a derived scalar shape descriptor $τ$, the two-point correlation function $S_2(r)$, and the lineal-path function $\ell(z)$. Additional data representing limiting cases of the parameter space are incorporated to stabilize training and improve extrapolation behavior. The surrogate is evaluated by leave-one-grain-type-out cross-validation in order to assess generalization to unseen grain geometries. Numerical results demonstrate that additional descriptors can reduce relative errors. A predictor trained with $τ$ and $S_2(r)$ provides a compact representation with good quantitative accuracy and regular dense response behavior. Adding the lineal-path function $\ell(z)$ further reduces the error at the available data points, indicating that it is a promising additional descriptor; however, dense post-training response evaluations show that improved pointwise accuracy does not automatically guarantee physically admissible behavior between sampled parameter values. This motivates future work on physically constrained surrogate models, loss formulations, bounded output parametrizations, and a more systematic representation of curve-valued geometric descriptors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用监督学习构建超弹性复合材料有效Lamé参数的代理模型，使用低维微观结构描述符（面积分数、形状描述符τ、两点相关函数S2(r)、线性路径函数ℓ(z)）训练神经网络。数据来自之前发表的数值均质化结果。通过留一类颗粒形状交叉验证评估泛化能力。结果显示额外描述符可降低相对误差，但点态精度提高不一定保证参数间物理合理性。
Motivation: 传统数值均质化计算成本高，需要数据驱动代理模型替代。本文针对布尔模型生成的两相随机微结构，预测有效Lamé参数。
Method: 采用监督学习，训练神经网络预测有效Lamé参数，输入组合面积分数、形状描述符τ、两点相关函数S2(r)和线性路径函数ℓ(z)。加入参数空间边界数据以稳定训练和外推。
Result: 留一类交叉验证表明，增加描述符可降低相对误差。使用τ和S2(r)的预测器精度良好且响应密集规则。添加ℓ(z)进一步降低数据点误差，但密集后训练响应评估显示点态精度不保证参数间物理合理性。
Conclusion: 未来需引入物理约束代理模型、损失函数、有界输出参数化以及曲线几何描述符的更系统表示。

papers.title: Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators for Structure-Preserving Surrogate Modeling of Constrained PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators provide fast surrogate models for PDE simulations, but standard architectures often treat geometry and discretization as secondary to field data. Physical states are usually represented as grid-channel stacks, even when different quantities naturally belong on vertices, edges, faces, cells, boundaries, or interfaces and must satisfy compatibility constraints. We propose Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators, a discretization-aware framework for structure-preserving neural PDE surrogates. The method represents PDE states on oriented cell complexes, couples local feature spaces through learned restriction maps, and uses incidence/Hodge-informed message passing to follow computational geometry. Learned update heads pass through coboundary or flux maps, allowing selected constraints to arise from cell-complex structure rather than only from loss penalties. For magnetohydrodynamics, this yields face-based magnetic-flux updates driven by edge electromotive fields and finite-volume-style fluid updates driven by learned face fluxes and cell sources. On turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium surrogate tasks, the method improves structure-sensitive diagnostics, including rollout behavior, divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium-regression accuracy. These results indicate that cellular-sheaf structure is a useful inductive bias for neural PDE surrogates in constrained multiphysics systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators，一种基于胞腔层（cellular sheaf）的离散化感知框架，用于构建结构保持的偏微分方程神经代理模型。该方法在有向胞腔复形上表示PDE状态，通过学习到的限制映射耦合局部特征空间，并利用余边界/通量映射实现约束条件。在湍流磁流体动力学（MHD）和聚变平衡代理任务上，该方法在卷积分、散度控制、谱误差和平衡回归精度方面优于基线。
Motivation: 标准神经代理架构通常将几何和离散化视为次要因素，物理量被简单堆叠为网格通道，忽略了量在不同结构（顶点、边、面、体元等）上的自然归属及兼容性约束。
Method: 在胞腔复形上表示PDE状态，通过学习到的限制映射耦合局部特征空间，并采用关联矩阵/霍奇（Hodge）启发的消息传递机制。学习到的更新头经过余边界或通量映射，使得约束来源于复形结构而非仅靠损失惩罚。
Result: 在湍流MHD和聚变平衡代理任务上，该方法在结构敏感的诊断指标（如卷积分、散度控制、谱误差和平衡回归精度）上表现更好。
Conclusion: 胞腔层结构作为归纳偏置，对于约束多物理系统中的神经PDE代理是有用的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Channel to Rule Them All: Rethinking Input Representation for Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is fundamental to long-term robot localization and SLAM, yet current systems overwhelmingly rely on RGB input, implicitly assuming color is necessary for global place recognition. We challenge this assumption, investigating the role of chromatic information across training regimes, model architectures and standard benchmarks under real-world appearance variation. We find that grayscale matches RGB performance generally and outperforms it under severe appearance shifts where color invariance is insufficiently learned, while color provides meaningful gains only where persistent and discriminative chromatic cues are present. Across selected benchmarks, a fully gray-trained MixVPR model achieves an average 82.4% Recall@1 compared to 81.2% for its RGB counterpart. In some cases, lightweight grayscale variants with 60% fewer parameters can outperform heavier RGB models. Grayscale further offers practical advantages in storage, bandwidth and alignment with resource-constrained systems. We conclude that for global VPR where scenes vary across illumination, weather, season and setting, color contributes minimally, and grayscale alone is sufficient for reliable place recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了视觉地点识别（VPR）中RGB输入为必需的隐含假设，系统研究了灰度图与RGB在不同训练策略、模型架构和真实环境变化下的性能。实验表明，灰度图在多数场景下与RGB性能相当，在严重外观变化下甚至更优，而颜色仅在持久且具有区分度的色度线索下才提供有意义增益。
Motivation: 现有VPR系统几乎全部依赖RGB输入，但颜色信息在光照、天气、季节等变化下的必要性未被严格验证，作者旨在重新评估灰度图的潜能。
Method: 通过对比实验，在标准VPR基准上测试灰度图与RGB在多模型（如MixVPR）和多训练方式下的表现，并分析颜色在不同外观变化场景中的实际贡献。
Result: 灰度训练的MixVPR模型平均Recall@1达82.4%，高于RGB版本的81.2%；轻量级灰度模型（参数减少60%）可超越更重的RGB模型。
Conclusion: 对于全局VPR任务，灰度图足以可靠定位，颜色贡献极小，且灰度图在存储、带宽和资源受限系统上具有实际优势。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文挑战了视觉地点识别（VPR）中RGB输入为必需的隐含假设，系统研究了灰度图与RGB在不同训练策略、模型架构和真实环境变化下的性能。实验表明，灰度图在多数场景下与RGB性能相当，在严重外观变化下甚至更优，而颜色仅在持久且具有区分度的色度线索下才提供有意义增益。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有VPR系统几乎全部依赖RGB输入，但颜色信息在光照、天气、季节等变化下的必要性未被严格验证，作者旨在重新评估灰度图的潜能。
summary_sections.method: 通过对比实验，在标准VPR基准上测试灰度图与RGB在多模型（如MixVPR）和多训练方式下的表现，并分析颜色在不同外观变化场景中的实际贡献。
summary_sections.result: 灰度训练的MixVPR模型平均Recall@1达82.4%，高于RGB版本的81.2%；轻量级灰度模型（参数减少60%）可超越更重的RGB模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对于全局VPR任务，灰度图足以可靠定位，颜色贡献极小，且灰度图在存储、带宽和资源受限系统上具有实际优势。

papers.title: Relational Intervention During Functional Collapse in Large Language Models: A Lexical-Statistical Ablation and a Structure x Register Factorial
papers.abstract_en: We test whether a relational-style intervention delivered during functional collapse in a small language model produces post-collapse behavior distinguishable from technical feedback, from a lexically-matched scrambled control, and from each of the two pragmatic dimensions in isolation. Using Qwen3.5-4B with a deliberately broken bash tool, we run 300 episodes across six conditions in a matched-pairs design (50 tasks): no intervention (A), technical/impersonal (B), relational/first-person (C), scrambled relational (D), technical/first-person (E), and relational/impersonal (F). E and F form a 2x2 factorial with B and C that dissociates relational structure (acknowledgment, absolution, agency restoration, unconditional acceptance) from sender register (first-person vs. impersonal). We report two main findings. First, an attention-behavior dissociation: attention follows lexical surprise (D > F > C > E > B, all q_FDR < 10^{-10}), with the scrambled message capturing the most attention; yet behaviorally A ~ B ~ D < E ~ F << C. Second, the factorial localizes the C effect: neither relational structure alone (F) nor first-person register alone (E) replicates C's behavioral signature; main effects of both dimensions are individually significant, and the structure x register interaction is significant on persistence (p = 0.046). A third dissociation emerges in emotion probes: F tracks C on 7 of 8 probes despite producing only baseline behavior, indicating that relational structure alone installs a probe-level state that only translates into behavior when paired with first-person register. The model's processing decomposes into three dissociable stages: attention (ordered by lexical surprise), probe-level state (ordered by structure), and behavior (ordered by the conjunction of both).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测试小语言模型在功能崩溃期间施加关系式干预（relational intervention）是否会产生可与技术支持、随机打乱控制等区分的后崩溃行为。使用Qwen3.5-4B模型和故意损坏的bash工具，在300轮六种条件的匹配对设计中发现注意力与行为分离：注意力受词汇惊喜度驱动，而行为上关系/第一人称条件显著优于其他；因子分析显示结构（relational structure）与语体（register）的交互显著。
Motivation: 探究在语言模型功能崩溃时，关系式人际干预（而非纯技术反馈）能否影响模型行为及其潜在机制。
Method: 采用六种条件（无干预、技术/非个人、关系/第一人称、打乱关系、技术/第一人称、关系/非个人）的匹配对设计，对Qwen3.5-4B模型执行300轮任务，记录注意力和行为指标，并利用2×2因子分析分离结构维度和语体维度。
Result: 注意力排序为打乱关系 > 关系/非个人 > 关系/第一人称 > 技术/第一人称 > 技术/非个人（q_FDR < 1e-10），但行为结果排序为无干预 ≈ 技术/非个人 ≈ 打乱关系 < 技术/第一人称 ≈ 关系/非个人 << 关系/第一人称；结构×语体交互对持久性显著（p=0.046）。
Conclusion: 模型处理可分解为三个可分离阶段：注意力（按词汇惊喜度排序）、探针级状态（按结构排序）、行为（按两者结合排序）。

papers.title: Efficient Synthetic Network Generation via Latent Embedding Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Network data are ubiquitous across the social sciences, biology, and information systems. Generating realistic synthetic network data has broad applications from network simulation to scientific discovery. However, many existing black-box approaches for network generation tend to overfit observed data while overlooking characteristic network structure, and incur substantial computational overhead at scale. These practical challenges call for synthetic network generation methods that are both efficient and capable of capturing structural properties of networks. In this paper, we introduce Synthetic Network Generation via Latent Embedding Reconstruction (SyNGLER), a general and efficient framework for synthetic network generation that builds on latent space network models. Given an observed network, SyNGLER first learns low-dimensional latent node embeddings via a latent space network model and then reconstructs the latent space by building a distribution-free generator over these embeddings. For generation, SyNGLER first samples (or resamples) node embeddings from the generator in the latent space and then produces synthetic networks using the latent space network model. Through the latent space framework, SyNGLER preserves unique characteristics in networks such as sparsity and node degree heterogeneity, while allowing for efficient training with lower computational cost than many existing deep architectures. We provide theoretical guarantees by developing consistency results on the distance between the true and synthetic edge distributions. Empirical studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of SyNGLER, which efficiently produces networks that better preserve key network characteristics such as network moments and degree distributions compared with existing approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/FeifanJiang/syngler.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SyNGLER 框架，一种基于潜在空间网络模型的高效合成网络生成方法。该方法先通过潜在空间模型学习节点嵌入，再构建无分布生成器重建潜在空间，从而生成保留稀疏性和节点度异质性等网络特性的合成网络。理论证明合成与真实边分布的距离一致性，实验表明该方法在保持网络矩和度分布等关键特征方面优于现有方法，且计算成本更低。
Motivation: 现有黑箱网络生成方法容易过拟合观测数据，忽略网络结构特征，且在大规模场景下计算开销大。需要一种既能高效生成又能捕捉网络结构属性的合成网络生成方法。
Method: SyNGLER 框架：首先通过潜在空间网络模型学习低维节点嵌入，然后构建无分布生成器重建这些嵌入的分布；生成时从生成器中采样节点嵌入，再用潜在空间模型生成合成网络。
Result: 理论证明合成与真实边分布的距离具有一致性。实验表明 SyNGLER 能高效生成网络，并在网络矩和度分布等关键特征上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: SyNGLER 提供了一种通用且高效的合成网络生成框架，能保留网络独特特性，且计算成本低于深度架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Trained Verification for Training- and Test-Time Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Self-improvement at scale has been a longstanding goal for reasoning models, and there are two natural places to do it: at test time, through verification-refinement (V-R) loops; and at training time, through self-training methods. Both are gated by the same bottleneck: the verifier. V-R loops stall when verifier scores inflate while accuracy stagnates, and when feedback is too generic to act on; self-training fails similarly when bad self-generated data are added to training. Better verification would unlock both, but the capability we want to train, i.e., catching self-generated errors, lacks training signal. To address this challenge, we propose self-trained verification (STV). Our key observation is that, while a model cannot catch these errors alone, it can when shown the reference solution. We turn this asymmetry into a supervision target and train the verifier to imitate a more informed version of itself. At test time, STV substantially improves V-R loops on hard problems, while alternatives (e.g., SFT, RL on verifier scores, and even meta-verifiers) do not. STV roughly doubles accuracy on hard math and lifts it 14x on scientific reasoning tasks (1.5% to 21%). At training time, we additionally train the generator using RL with STV verifier's feedback inside the V-R loop - a procedure we call verifier-in-the-loop training (ViL). Starting from an RL-converged generator, ViL yields a further 33% gain in pass@1. More notably, the generator's standalone pass@1, with no verifier at test time, climbs 30% relative past where standard RL had converged. Hence, the next frontier in reasoning on hard problems may lie in how we train for and with verification. Website: https://ar-forum.github.io/stv-webpage
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自我训练验证（STV）方法，利用模型在有参考答案时能捕捉错误这一不对称性训练验证器，在测试时通过验证-精炼（V-R）循环和训练时通过验证器在环训练（ViL）显著提升推理模型的性能，在数学和科学推理任务上取得大幅提升。
Motivation: 推理模型的自改进受限于验证器瓶颈：测试时V-R循环中验证器分数膨胀而准确率停滞，训练时自训练因糟糕的自生成数据而失败。需要更好的验证能力，但训练验证器缺乏捕捉自生成错误的训练信号。
Method: 提出自训练验证（STV），核心观察是模型单独无法捕捉错误，但在看到参考解答后可以；利用此不对称性训练验证器模仿一个更知情的自身版本。测试时改进V-R循环；训练时提出验证器在环训练（ViL），在V-R循环中使用STV验证器的反馈训练生成器。
Result: 在数学难题上准确率翻倍，在科学推理任务上从1.5%提升至21%（14倍）。从RL收敛的生成器开始，ViL进一步带来pass@1 33%提升；生成器在测试时无验证器的独立pass@1相对提升30%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调推理模型的下一个前沿可能在于如何训练以及使用验证。

papers.title: GRASP: Plan-Guided Graph Retrieval with Adaptive Fusion and Reranking on Semi-Structured Knowledge Bases
papers.abstract_en: Semi-structured knowledge bases (SKBs) embed textual documents in a typed graph of entities and relations, and underpin applications such as product search, academic paper search, and precision-medicine inquiries. Existing hybrid retrieval systems on SKBs either use the graph only for query expansion, mix textual and structural branches under a global weighting, or rely on fine-tuned graph-traversal generators. We present GRASP, a three-stage SKB retrieval framework unifying plan-based graph retrieval, plan-conditioned fusion with a dense retriever, and a fine-tuned reranker over the fused candidates. GRASP substantially advances the state of the art on every metric across the three STaRK benchmarks, lifting average Hit@1 from 62.0 to 73.9. Ablation and sensitivity studies further confirm the effectiveness and robustness of GRASP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRASP，一种针对半结构化知识库的三阶段检索框架，包括基于计划的图检索、计划条件融合和微调重排序。在三个STaRK基准上，GRASP在所有指标上显著超越现有技术，平均Hit@1从62.0提升至73.9。消融实验证实了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有半结构化知识库混合检索系统方法有限，要么仅用图进行查询扩展，要么全局加权混合文本与结构分支，或依赖微调的图遍历生成器，难以充分利用图结构和文本信息。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：首先基于计划进行图检索，然后利用计划条件与密集检索器融合，最后在融合后的候选集上进行微调重排序。
Result: 在三个STaRK基准上，每项指标都大幅提升，平均Hit@1从62.0提高到73.9。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GRASP显著推进了半结构化知识库检索的最新技术，且消融和敏感性研究证实了其有效性和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mean-Field Diffuser: Scaling Offline MARL to Thousands of Agents
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based planning has achieved strong results in single-agent offline reinforcement learning, yet scaling to many-agent systems remains intractable due to the curse of dimensionality in the joint trajectory space. We introduce MF-Diffuser, a framework that lifts trajectory planning to the Wasserstein space of trajectory distributions, where the propagation of chaos ensures a small representative subset of agents captures the full population dynamics. Our approach features a value-weighted chaotic entropy objective that reconciles generative fidelity with return maximization, and a hierarchical coarse-to-fine strategy that progressively grows the agent population during denoising. We establish end-to-end suboptimality bounds with four interpretable terms, revealing that mean-field approximation error scales as $O(H^2/\sqrt{N})$ while offline distribution shift provably does not grow with population size $N$, and prove the generated policy is an approximate mean-field Nash equilibrium with explicit convergence guarantees. Experiments on three mean-field RL benchmarks -- spanning stage games, sequential dynamics, and adversarial team competition -- show MF-Diffuser achieves the best return in the majority of settings, with the largest gains on suboptimal offline data and at extreme scales ($N \geq 10^3$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MF-Diffuser，一种将扩散规划扩展到多智能体离线强化学习的方法，通过提升到轨迹分布的Wasserstein空间，利用混沌传播确保小样本代理捕获整体动态。实验在平均场RL基准上显示效果，尤其在极端规模（N≥10^3）及次优离线数据上取得最大增益。
Motivation: 现有扩散规划在单智能体离线RL上成果显著，但扩展到多智能体系统面临联合轨迹空间的维度灾难。
Method: 提出MF-Diffuser框架，将轨迹规划提升到轨迹分布的Wasserstein空间，利用混沌传播保证小代表子集捕获全群体动态；引入值加权混沌熵目标平衡生成保真度和回报最大化，以及层次化粗到细策略在去噪过程中逐步增加代理群体。
Result: 建立了端到端次最优界限，表明平均场近似误差为O(H^2/√N)，离线分布偏移不随群体大小N增长；证明了生成的策略是近似平均场纳什均衡。实验在三个平均场RL基准上（阶段博弈、序列动态和对抗团队竞争）显示，MF-Diffuser在多数设置中取得最佳回报，尤其在次优离线数据和极端规模（N≥10^3）下。
Conclusion: 本文展示了扩散规划通过平均场近似可有效扩展到大规模多智能体系统，并提供了理论保证。
