summary_sections.result: 建立了端到端次最优界限，表明平均场近似误差为O(H^2/√N)，离线分布偏移不随群体大小N增长；证明了生成的策略是近似平均场纳什均衡。实验在三个平均场RL基准上（阶段博弈、序列动态和对抗团队竞争）显示，MF-Diffuser在多数设置中取得最佳回报，尤其在次优离线数据和极端规模（N≥10^3）下。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文展示了扩散规划通过平均场近似可有效扩展到大规模多智能体系统，并提供了理论保证。

papers.title: Beyond MSE: Improving Precipitation Nowcasting with Multi-Quantile Regression
papers.abstract_en: Deep-learning precipitation nowcasting models are often optimized using pointwise losses such as mean squared error or mean absolute error, which can lead to overly smooth forecasts and poor representation of heavy rainfall. This study investigates whether the predictive performance of an established deterministic nowcasting architecture can be improved by reformulating training as a multi-quantile regression problem. Using SmaAt-UNet as a core model, we compare MSE, MAE, and multi-quantile pinball-loss training on radar precipitation nowcasting over the Netherlands. The results show that multi-quantile training improves the central deterministic forecast, decreasing test-set MSE by 8.6\% compared to a model trained using MSE, while also producing upper-quantile outputs that are useful for risk-sensitive prediction of heavy precipitation. These findings suggest that quantile regression provides a simple alternative to standard pointwise losses without requiring a new architecture or generative sampling procedure. The implementation of our models and training setup is available on \href{https://github.com/gijsvn/Multi-Quantile-Precipitation-Nowcasting}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将确定性降水临近预报模型的训练目标从点式损失（MSE/MAE）改为多分位数回归（multi-quantile pinball loss）。基于SmaAt-UNet架构，在荷兰雷达降水数据上实验表明，多分位数训练不仅使中心预测的MSE降低8.6%，还输出上分位数预测，有助于高风险降水事件监测。该方法无需改变模型结构或引入生成采样，为提升预报质量提供了简单替代方案。
Motivation: 现有深度学习降水预报模型常用MSE/MAE等点式损失，导致预测过于平滑，难以捕捉强降水事件。需要一种不依赖新架构或生成模型的改进方法。
Method: 将SmaAt-UNet的训练目标替换为多分位数回归，使用pinball损失同时学习多个分位数（如0.1, 0.5, 0.9），从而同时获得中心预报和不确定性估计。
Result: 与MSE训练相比，多分位数训练使测试集上中心预报的MSE降低8.6%，同时提供上分位数（如0.9）输出，对强降水预测更有效。
Conclusion: 多分位数回归是点式损失的简单有效替代，无需新架构或生成过程，即可提升确定性预报质量并提供风险信息。作者开源了实现代码。
Relevance: 85

papers.title: Cookie-Bench: Continuous On-screen Key Interaction Evaluation for Web Generation
papers.abstract_en: Front-end web code has become a core product surface for every frontier LLM release, yet evaluating these interactive applications at development speed remains costly because human-judged leaderboards like Arena do not scale. Existing automated proxies typically lean on reference implementations, test suites, or rigid checklists, and tend to miss the reasoned synthesis a human reviewer performs over a live session. We articulate a new evaluation regime that is simultaneously reference-free, autonomously driven, and holistically reasoned, and instantiate it through two artifacts. \textbf{\dataname} is an 11-domain, 54-leaf, 1,000-query WebDev benchmark spanning both static-presentation and interactive-application tasks, balanced across three difficulty tiers and three target-language groups, with briefs rewritten to resist recall from circulated prompts. \textbf{\framename}, grounded in Flavell's metacognitive monitoring, separates evidence accumulation from judgment across three stages: Static Perception forms a first impression from passive observation; Agent-Driven Interaction explores the application autonomously while capturing continuous screen video, audio, and per-step screenshots; Dynamic Scoring issues holistic functionality and aesthetics verdicts with structured failure attribution only after the evidence chain is complete. On \dataname, \framename aligns closely with expert human ratings while surfacing substantial headroom across 13 frontier LLMs on interactive web generation. \noindenthttps://anonymous.4open.science/r/Cookie-3CE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cookie-Bench，一个面向Web前端代码生成的自动化评估框架，包含1,000个查询的基准数据集和基于元认知监控的三阶段评估方法，在13个前沿LLM上评估显示与人工评分高度一致但仍存在改进空间。
Motivation: 现有Web生成评估依赖人工或参考实现，成本高且难以规模化，缺乏参考无关、自主驱动、综合推理的评估方法。
Method: 提出Cookie-Bench，包含1,000个查询的WebDev基准（覆盖11个领域、54个叶子节点）和基于Flavell元认知监控的三阶段评估框架：静态感知、智能体驱动交互、动态评分。
Result: 该框架与专家人工评分高度一致，同时揭示了13个前沿LLM在交互式Web生成上的显著改进空间。
Conclusion: 参考无关、自主驱动、综合推理的评估方法可以替代人工评判，但当前LLM在交互式Web生成上仍有不足。

papers.title: MIC: Maximizing Informational Capacity in Adaptive Representations via Isotropic Subspace Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Although multi-scales representation learning enables elastic-dimension embeddings, nested subspaces often suffer from dimensional redundancy and spectral collapse. To address this, we introduce MIC, a framework that optimizes the geometric landscape of multi-granular embeddings through isotropic subspace alignment. MIC employs Soft Collapse Regularization (SCR) to mitigate redundancy between prefix and residual subspaces via cross-correlation penalties, alongside Spectral Isotropy Regularization (SIR) to ensure hyper-spherical uniformity in low-dimensional prefixes. By unifying these strategies through a self-distillation objective, MIC generates semantically dense representations that maintain high discriminative power. Our experiments demonstrate that MIC significantly outperforms standard baselines, particularly in high-compression scenarios where maintaining informational capacity is most critical.
papers.comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthML Workshop at ICML 2026. 8 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多尺度表示学习中嵌套子空间的维度冗余和谱坍缩问题，提出MIC框架，通过各向同性子空间对齐优化多粒度嵌入的几何结构。MIC包含软坍缩正则化（SCR）和谱各向同性正则化（SIR），并通过自蒸馏目标统一，生成语义密集且高判别力的表示。实验表明，MIC在高压缩场景下显著优于基线。
Motivation: 多尺度表示学习虽能产生弹性维度的嵌入，但嵌套子空间常面临维度冗余和谱坍缩，导致信息容量下降。
Method: 提出MIC框架，通过软坍缩正则化（SCR）利用互相关惩罚减少前缀与残差子空间之间的冗余，同时使用谱各向同性正则化（SIR）保证低维前缀的超球面均匀性，并通过自蒸馏目标联合优化。
Result: 实验表明MIC显著优于标准基线，尤其在高压缩场景下能更好地保持信息容量。
Conclusion: 该框架通过几何正则化有效缓解多尺度表示中的冗余与坍缩问题，提升了表示的信息密度和判别力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EVL-ECG: Efficient ECG Interpretation With Multi-Aspect Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity ECG interpretation is increasingly reliant on massive foundation models, yet their deployment in clinical edge-care remains hindered by extreme computational demands. While knowledge distillation (KD) is a promising solution, traditional methods fail to capture the complex spatio-temporal dependencies of ECG signals when transferring knowledge across heterogeneous architectures. In this paper, we propose EVL-ECG, a framework specifically designed for cross-architecture distillation of cardiac diagnostic logic. EVL-ECG introduces three ECG-aware innovations: (1) Multi-Head Cross-Attention Alignment, which harmonizes architectural discrepancies to preserve fine-grained morphological features; (2) Optimal Transport-based Visual Feature Matching, utilizing optimal transport to maintain global structural relationships across ECG leads despite mismatched token representations; and (3) Geometric Intra-Architecture Relation Matching, which distills the latent diagnostic reasoning of the teacher model. Evaluations across ECG benchmarks demonstrate that EVL-ECG yields improvements of up to 2.4% AUC and 1.1% clinical accuracy over existing baselines. Notably, EVL-ECG establishes an efficient 2B-parameter ECG foundation model, suitable for resource-constrained clinical environments.
papers.comment: 7Accepted at the SD4H Workshop at ICML 2026. 7 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EVL-ECG 框架，针对跨架构知识蒸馏中 ECG 信号时空依赖关系丢失的问题，引入多头交叉注意力对齐、最优传输视觉特征匹配和几何结构关系匹配三项创新，在压缩模型的同时保留诊断逻辑。
Motivation: 大规模 ECG 基础模型推理成本高，难以部署于临床边缘设备；传统知识蒸馏方法在跨架构迁移时无法保持 ECG 信号的复杂时空结构。
Method: EVL-ECG 包含三个组件：多头交叉注意力对齐以协调架构差异、基于最优传输的视觉特征匹配保持导联间全局结构、几何关系匹配蒸馏教师模型的潜在诊断推理。
Result: 在 ECG 基准上相比基线提升最多 2.4% AUC 和 1.1% 临床准确率，并得到一个高效的 2B 参数 ECG 基础模型。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了跨架构知识蒸馏对于资源受限临床环境中高效 ECG 解释的有效性。

papers.title: GiPL: Generative augmented iterative Pseudo-Labeling for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language foundation models have shown promising zero-shot generalization for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection (CD-FSOD). However, they face two critical challenges in fine-tuning: insufficient support set utilization due to sparse single-instance annotations, and severe overfitting under extremely limited target-domain samples. To address these issues, this paper proposes GiPL, an efficient two-branch training framework. In the first branch, we design an iterative pseudo-label self-training paradigm, which performs zero-shot inference on the support set to generate reliable pseudo-annotations, fuses them with ground-truth labels, and iteratively optimizes the model to fully exploit support set data. In the second branch, we introduce generative data augmentation pipeline using large vision-language models, which synthesizes domain-aligned, multi-object annotated images to enrich training samples and suppress overfitting. Extensive experiments on three challenging CD-FSOD datasets (RUOD, CARPK, CarDD) under 1/5/10-shot settings demonstrate that GiPL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods with significant performance gains. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/z-yaz/CDiscover}{CDiscover}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中微调时的两个关键挑战——支撑集单实例标注利用率不足和目标域样本极少导致的过拟合，提出GiPL双分支训练框架。第一分支设计迭代伪标签自训练范式，在对支撑集进行零样本推理后生成可靠伪标注，与真值融合并迭代优化模型；第二分支利用大视觉语言模型生成域对齐的多目标标注图像进行数据增强。在RUOD、CARPK、CarDD三个数据集上的1/5/10-shot实验表明，GiPL持续超越现有最优方法。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言基础模型在CD-FSOD微调时面临两大问题：支撑集仅含稀疏的单实例标注，利用率不足；目标域样本极其有限，导致严重过拟合。
Method: 提出双分支训练框架：分支一为迭代伪标签自训练，通过零样本推理生成伪标注并与真值融合，迭代优化以充分挖掘支撑集信息；分支二利用大视觉语言模型合成域对齐、多目标标注的图像，扩充训练样本并抑制过拟合。
Result: 在RUOD、CARPK、CarDD三个CD-FSOD数据集上的1/5/10-shot设置下，GiPL一致优于现有最优方法，并取得了显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过迭代伪标签与生成式数据增强有效解决了CD-FSOD中支撑集利用不足和过拟合问题。

papers.title: AnyMo: Scaling Any-Modality Conditional Motion Generation with Masked Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Conditional human motion generation remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics. Despite significant progress, current methods are often constrained by fixed modality configurations and task-specific architectures, leaving cross-modal interactions and the scaling laws of multimodal-conditioned synthesis largely underexplored. A key bottleneck is the scarcity of large-scale modality-aligned motion data, limiting generalization across diverse control signals. In this work, we introduce OmniHuMo, a large-scale, high-quality dataset comprising over 5,000 hours of motion and 3.2 million sequences with precisely aligned multimodal annotations (e.g., text, speech, music, and trajectory). Leveraging OmniHuMo, we propose AnyMo, a unified multimodal framework combining a Residual FSQ-based motion tokenizer with a scalable masked modeling transformer, enabling high-quality motion synthesis under arbitrary modality combinations. Extensive experiments show that AnyMo achieves high-fidelity synthesis while offering flexible control over both spatial and stylistic attributes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AnyMo，一个基于掩码建模的统一多模态条件人体运动生成框架，结合残差FSQ运动分词器和可扩展的掩码建模Transformer，并构建了包含5000小时运动数据的大型数据集OmniHuMo，支持任意模态组合的高质量运动合成。
Motivation: 现有条件运动生成方法受限于固定模态配置和任务特定架构，缺乏跨模态交互的探索，且大规模模态对齐运动数据稀缺，限制了泛化能力。
Method: 提出OmniHuMo大规模多模态对齐数据集和AnyMo统一框架，使用残差FSQ运动分词器将运动离散化，并采用可扩展的掩码建模Transformer进行条件生成。
Result: 实验表明AnyMo在多种模态组合下实现高保真运动合成，并支持空间和风格属性的灵活控制。
Conclusion: AnyMo证明了掩码建模在多模态运动生成中的有效性，但主要针对人体运动领域。

summary_sections.result: 实验表明AnyMo在多种模态组合下实现高保真运动合成，并支持空间和风格属性的灵活控制。
summary_sections.conclusion: AnyMo证明了掩码建模在多模态运动生成中的有效性，但主要针对人体运动领域。

papers.title: Honest Lying: Understanding Memory Confabulation in Reflexive Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reflexion-style agents rely on self-generated reflections as memory, implicitly assuming that agents can accurately diagnose their own failures. We show that this assumption can fail systematically: across ALFWorld and HumanEval, agents store confident but incorrect interpretations of the task and continue acting on them across trials, even though the environment resets to the correct task each time. We call this failure mode memory confabulation and introduce the Reflection Repetition Rate (RRR), a log-based metric that detects repeated reliance on incorrect reflective content. Using RRR, we identify 16 frozen environments in ALFWorld, where 0 of 121 reflections mention the correct target object, and 4 analogous cases in HumanEval. Our mitigation replaces open-ended self-diagnosis with programmatic extraction of trajectory-level failure signals, increasing correct object mention from 0% to 86%, reducing RRR from 0.64 to 0.10, and solving 3 of 16 frozen ALFWorld environments, suggesting that reflective memory can reinforce false beliefs rather than correct them.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop "Failure Modes in Agentic AI"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出Reflexion式智能体依赖自身生成的反思作为记忆，但这会导致系统性的记忆虚构：在ALFWorld和HumanEval环境中，智能体存储自信但错误的任务解释，并在多轮中持续依赖它们，尽管环境每次重置为正确任务。作者提出反思重复率（RRR）指标检测这种失败，并发现16个冻结的ALFWorld环境和4个HumanEval案例。通过用程序化提取轨迹级失败信号替代开放式自我诊断，正确目标提及率从0%升至86%，RRR从0.64降至0.10，解决了3/16的冻结环境。
Motivation: 现有Reflexion式智能体假设其能准确诊断自身失败，但这一假设可能系统性失效，导致记忆虚构并持续错误行动。
Method: 引入反思重复率（RRR）指标，基于日志检测重复依赖错误反思内容的模式；并设计缓解方案：用程序化提取轨迹级失败信号替代开放式自我诊断。
Result: 在ALFWorld中识别16个冻结环境（0/121反思提及正确目标），HumanEval中4个类似案例；缓解后正确目标提及率从0%升至86%，RRR从0.64降至0.10，解决3/16冻结环境。
Conclusion: 反思式记忆可能强化错误信念而非纠正它们，简单的程序化干预比开放式自我诊断更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TIMEGATE: Sustainable Time-Boxed Promotion Gates for Continual ML Adaptation Under Resource Constraints
papers.abstract_en: As machine learning(ML) systems evolve to continual adaptation, each re-training cycle uses compute, annotation, and energy. We introduce TIMEGATE, a policy layer managing adaptation by budgeting time, labeling, training, and evaluation. TIMEGATE emits a metric-availability signal M for partial vs. full-evaluation decisions. We validate: (i) labeling outperforms training by 2.3x on Adult tabular; (ii) it transfers to LLaMA-3.1-8B + QLoRA on SST-2 (accuracy 0.80 to 0.96; M =1 in 35/36 runs); (iii) M is informative, 28-cell sensitivity shows M drops to 0.81 at tight thresholds; (iv) 100-cycle simulation achieves 66% evaluation-compute savings with no silent mis-promotions; (v) 10%-slice evaluation on LLaMA uses 89% less wall-clock and energy on a single H200 (ratios agree to 0.2%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIMEGATE 是一个针对机器学习系统持续适应的策略层，通过预算时间、标注、训练和评估来管理适应过程。它发出度量可用性信号 M，用于部分评估与全评估决策。在多个任务上验证了其有效性，包括在 LLaMA-3.1-8B + QLoRA 上达到高准确率，并实现了评估计算节省。
Motivation: 机器学习系统需要持续适应，但每次重新训练周期消耗计算、标注和能源，需要有效的资源管理。
Method: 提出 TIMEGATE 策略层，通过预算时间、标注、训练和评估来管理适应过程，并发出度量可用性信号 M 来决定执行部分还是完全评估。
Result: 实验表明，标注比训练效果高 2.3 倍（Adult 表格数据）；在 LLaMA-3.1-8B + QLoRA 上 SST-2 准确率从 0.80 提升至 0.96，M 在 35/36 次运行中为 1；28 格灵敏度显示 M 在严格阈值下降至 0.81；100 周期仿真实现 66% 评估计算节省且无静默错误推广；在 LLaMA 上的 10% 切片评估减少 89% 墙钟时间和能量。
Conclusion: TIMEGATE 能够显著节省评估计算资源，同时保持模型性能，适用于资源受限下的持续机器学习适应。

papers.title: FundaPod: A Multi-Persona Agent Pod Platform with Knowledge Graph Memory for AI-Assisted Fundamental Investment Research
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in finance, yet most existing work emphasizes trading signals or financial NLP tasks centered on prediction. Institutional fundamental research, by contrast, requires human analysts or AI agents to gather evidence, identify business drivers, compare competing viewpoints, and generate investment memos. Its broader goal is not merely to predict outcomes, but to produce investment plans that are transparent, reusable, and verifiable, while contributing to the cumulative development of investment knowledge. We present FundaPod, a multi-persona agent platform for AI-assisted fundamental investment research. We argue that fundamental research is a human-centric decision-support task that is qualitatively distinct from trading-signal generation, and is therefore better served by an independence-preserving architecture. In FundaPod, AI agents with different personas, such as value investors or macro strategists, conduct research independently under a shared provenance contract. Their disagreements are then surfaced post hoc for adjudication by the human portfolio manager (PM) through a knowledge-graph memory system. This paper contributes five design principles for human-AI hybrid systems supporting fundamental research, grounded in design-science practice and theories of cognitive isolation and human-machine coordination. It also describes four architectural mechanisms: a persona distillation pipeline that turns public investor materials into deployable agents; a declarative skill registry that lets the planner derive typed task graphs; a grounded evidence model that links memo claims to verifiable sources; and a knowledge-graph "second brain" that connects tickers, memos, analysts, and themes. We demonstrate the architecture through a complete case study and a persona-based memo comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FundaPod，一个多角色智能体平台，用于辅助基本面投资研究。该平台通过知识图谱记忆系统，让不同投资风格的 AI 代理独立研究后由人类投资经理裁决。论文基于设计科学实践和认知隔离理论，提出了五项设计原则和四种架构机制，并通过案例研究和角色记忆比较展示了系统。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 在金融领域的应用多集中于交易信号或预测性 NLP 任务，而机构基本面研究需要人类分析师或 AI 代理收集证据、识别业务驱动因素、比较不同观点并生成投资备忘录，其目标不仅是预测，更是生成透明、可重复、可验证的投资计划。现有架构缺乏对这类人机协同决策的支持。
Method: 提出了多角色代理平台 FundaPod，包含角色提炼管线、声明式技能注册表、基于证据的模型和知识图谱“第二大脑”四种架构机制。AI 代理（如价值投资者、宏观策略师）在共享来源契约下独立研究，分歧通过知识图谱记忆系统呈现给人类投资经理裁决。
Result: 通过完整案例研究和基于角色的记忆比较展示了架构的可行性。
Conclusion: 论文强调基本面研究是独立于交易信号生成的人机协同决策任务，并提出了五项设计原则和四种架构机制，有助于支持可积累、可验证的投资知识发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agyn: An Open-Source Platform for AI Agents with Scalable On-Demand Execution, Agent Definition as a Code, and Zero-Trust Access
papers.abstract_en: As organizations move toward production deployments of AI agents, which execute non-deterministic workflows, maintain stateful sessions, and often operate with privileged access to internal services, the engineering challenge shifts from building individual agents to operating them at scale with proper isolation, governance, and security. In this paper we present Agyn, an open-source platform designed around three key principles tailored for agent workloads: a signal-driven, stateful serverless runtime on Kubernetes; a Terraform provider for agent and harness definition; and a security model grounded in zero-trust and least-privilege principles. Agyn is agent-agnostic, model-agnostic, and cloud-agnostic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agyn 是一个面向 AI 代理生产部署的开源平台，核心设计包括：基于 Kubernetes 的信号驱动有状态无服务器运行时（signal-driven stateful serverless runtime）、用于代理和 harness 定义的 Terraform 提供程序（Terraform provider），以及基于零信任和最小权限的安全模型。该平台是代理无关、模型无关和云无关的。
Motivation: 组织在将 AI 代理投入生产时，面临非确定性工作流执行、有状态会话维护以及特权访问内部服务等挑战，需要解决隔离、治理和安全问题。
Method: 提出 Agyn 平台，基于三个关键原则：在 Kubernetes 上实现信号驱动有状态无服务器运行时；提供 Terraform 提供程序用于定义代理和 harness；采用零信任和最小权限的安全模型。
Conclusion: Agyn 平台旨在为 AI 代理工作负载提供可扩展、隔离、治理和安全的运行环境，支持代理无关、模型无关和云无关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RULER: Representation-Level Verification of Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training records from a deployed model without retraining from scratch. Current protocols verify this at the output level through membership inference, retain accuracy, and forget-set accuracy, but a model can satisfy all three whilst still encoding forgotten records in its intermediate representations. We introduce RULER, a set of representation-level verification metrics. The oracle-comparative metric M2 measures whether forget-set records occupy the same representational position as in a model retrained without them. The oracle-free metric M4 detects residuals from the unlearned model's internal similarity structure alone, without retraining. Four approximate unlearning methods all pass output-level evaluation, yet under a linear mixed-effects model M2 detects significant residuals in 10 of 12 conditions (p<0.05), with effect sizes growing as the forget fraction increases. A fifth method, Bad Teacher, shows the same residuals despite a different forgetting mechanism. M4 acts as a pre-unlearning diagnostic across tabular, image, clinical text, and face-identity settings: it detects identity-level memorisation in face recognition models where no tested method fully erases the signal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RULER，一组表示级验证指标，用于检测机器遗忘方法是否在中间表示中残留遗忘记录的信息。实验表明，多种近似遗忘方法在输出级评估中均通过，但 RULER 的 M2 指标在多数条件下检测到显著残差，M4 指标可作为遗忘前诊断工具。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘验证仅在输出层面进行，通过成员推断、保留精度和遗忘集精度评估，但模型可能仍在中间表示中编码遗忘记录的信息。需要表示级验证方法。
Method: 提出 RULER，包含两个主要指标：M2（需重新训练模型的 oracle 对比指标）衡量遗忘集记录在表示空间中的位置是否与重新训练模型一致；M4（无需重新训练的 oracle-free 指标）仅从遗忘模型的内部相似性结构检测残差。
Result: 在四种近似遗忘方法中，所有方法均通过输出级评估，但线性混合效应模型显示 M2 在 12 种条件中的 10 种检测到显著残差（p<0.05），且效应量随遗忘比例增加而增大。第五种方法 Bad Teacher 也表现出相同的残差。M4 在表格、图像、临床文本和人脸识别数据中作为遗忘前诊断，能检测到人脸识别模型中的身份级记忆（无法被任何测试方法完全擦除）。
Conclusion: RULER 能够揭示输出级评估无法检测的表示残留，提供更严格的遗忘验证，并可作为遗忘前诊断工具。

papers.title: BatteryMFormer: Multi-level Learning for Battery Degradation Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Early battery degradation trajectory forecasting (BDTF), which predicts the full-life state-of-health trajectory from early operational data, is critical for battery optimization, manufacturing, and deployment. Battery degradation data exhibit two key characteristics. First, degradation data present a multi-level structure, including regularities shared within aging conditions and trajectory patterns shared across batteries. Second, degradation-related variations in voltage-current profiles are often localized to specific state of charge (SOC) intervals. Existing approaches often fail to explicitly model these characteristics. To bridge this gap, we propose BatteryMFormer, a multi-level Transformer for early BDTF. BatteryMFormer integrates (1) an aging-condition-aware decoder that injects aging-condition priors via aging-condition-informed queries and aging-condition-aware attention, (2) a meta degradation pattern memory that learns and retrieves trajectory prototypes to guide long-horizon forecasting, and (3) a dual-view encoder that jointly captures temporal dynamics and SOC-localized variations from voltage and current time series. Extensive experiments on four battery domains show that BatteryMFormer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, marking a significant step toward reliable BDTF. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ruifeng-Tan/BatteryMFormer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出BatteryMFormer，一种多级Transformer，用于早期电池退化轨迹预测，整合了老化条件感知解码器、元退化模式记忆和双视图编码器，在多个电池领域超越基线。
Motivation: 现有方法未能明确建模电池退化数据的多级结构（老化条件共享规律和电池间轨迹模式）以及局部化到特定SOC区间的退化相关变化。
Method: 提出BatteryMFormer，包含三个模块：老化条件感知解码器（通过老化条件查询和注意力注入先验）、元退化模式记忆（学习并检索轨迹原型）、双视图编码器（联合捕捉时间动态和SOC局部变化）。
Result: 在四个电池域的实验上，BatteryMFormer始终优于最先进的基线。
Conclusion: 该方法标志着向可靠BDTF迈出的重要一步，代码已开源。

papers.title: WINDQuant: Weight-Informed Neural Decision-Making for Global Mixed-Precision LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is an effective approach to reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet maintaining performance in the ultra-low-bit regime remains challenging. Existing post-training methods often suffer from severe accuracy degradation, while quantization-aware training requires costly retraining and additional resources. Moreover, most mixed-precision strategies rely on coarse-grained or heuristic sensitivity analysis that overlooks fine-grained variations within weight matrices. We propose WINDQuant, a reinforcement-learning-based allocation controller for ultra-low-bit LLM quantization. Rather than introducing another low-level quantization operator, WINDQuant learns how to assign bit-widths and quantization treatments to fine-grained column chunks under a global storage budget. By operating at the column-chunk level, WINDQuant enables flexible and fine-grained precision assignment within layers under a global target bit-width. The implementation combines PPO with activation-aware calibration, lightweight per-unit quantizer fitting, and explicit effective-bit accounting of the learned mixed-precision plan. Experiments on LLaMA models demonstrate that WINDQuant achieves competitive performance in ultra-low-bit settings while reducing optimization overhead relative to retraining-based approaches, highlighting reinforcement learning as a practical controller for adaptive mixed-precision quantization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WINDQuant，一种基于强化学习（PPO）的混合精度量化控制器，用于超低位宽 LLM 量化。该方法在列块（column-chunk）级别分配位宽和量化方式，结合激活感知校准和显式有效位计算，在 LLaMA 模型上取得有竞争力的性能，同时降低优化开销。
Motivation: 现有后训练量化在超低位宽下精度严重下降，而量化感知训练成本高昂；且大多数混合精度策略依赖粗粒度或启发式敏感性分析，忽略了权重矩阵内的细粒度变化。
Method: 采用强化学习（PPO）作为分配控制器，在全局存储预算下学习为每一列块分配位宽和量化处理；结合激活感知校准、轻量级每单元量化器拟合以及显式有效位会计。
Result: 在 LLaMA 模型上的实验表明，WINDQuant 在超低位宽设置下达到有竞争力的性能，并显著降低了相对于重训练方法的优化开销。
Conclusion: 摘要指出强化学习可以作为自适应混合精度量化的实用控制器，在保持模型性能的同时减少重新训练成本。

papers.title: Classification and detection of multiple UAVs using rational Gaussian wavelet neural networks
papers.abstract_en: The detection of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is important for the protection of civilian and military infrastructure. In this paper we propose a cost effective UAV detection system using sound signals obtained from microphones. The recorded signals are passed through a signal processing pipeline which employs interpretable adaptive feature extractors using so-called rational Gaussian wavelets. These adaptive wavelet transformations are embedded into and trained together with an underlying small neural network which detects and classifies UAVs based on the obtained features. This leads to a physically interpretable machine learning algorithm that in addition to classifying UAVs is also capable of detecting UAV swarms. We demonstrate our results using data collected in indoor studio and noisy outdoor environments. We conclude that the proposed method outperforms traditional machine learning approaches for detecting and classifying single UAVs as well as drone swarms, while retaining a high degree of interpretability. Our implementation of the proposed methods is made publicly available for reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于声音信号的多无人机检测与分类系统，使用有理高斯小波（rational Gaussian wavelets）作为可解释的自适应特征提取器，嵌入小型神经网络中联合训练。该方法能检测单架无人机和无人机群，在室内和室外噪声环境下优于传统机器学习方法，并保持高可解释性。代码已公开。
Motivation: 保护民用和军用基础设施免受无人机威胁，需要低成本、高可解释性的检测系统。
Method: 采用麦克风采集声音信号，通过信号处理流水线，利用有理高斯小波进行自适应特征提取，并与小型神经网络联合训练，实现无人机检测与分类。
Result: 在室内工作室和嘈杂室外环境的数据集上，该方法在检测和分类单架无人机及无人机群方面优于传统机器学习方法。
Conclusion: 该方法具有物理可解释性，能同时检测单机和群组，且提供了公开实现以促进可重复性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evi-Steer: Learning to Steer Biomedical Vision-Language Models through Efficient and Generalizable Evidential Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient adaptation of vision-language foundation models is crucial for precise multimodal understanding of biomedical images, yet existing methods remain deterministic and often struggle under domain shift or ambiguous image-text alignment. This limitation is particularly critical in the clinic, where models should remain robust in low-data regimes and domain shifts. We present Evi-Steer, an evidential cross-modal low-dimensional steering framework for BiomedCLIP that enables uncertainty-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning while updating only 0.11% of total model parameters. Our approach performs lightweight low-dimensional token updates in both vision and text encoders while simultaneously estimating epistemic uncertainty. These uncertainty estimates update gate residuals, allowing the model to adapt conservatively when evidence is weak. Furthermore, we introduce cross-modal confidence fusion based on Dempster-Shafer theory, enabling visual adaptation to be conditioned on textual confidence and suppressing conflicting or uncertain cross-modal updates. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation on 15 biomedical imaging datasets spanning 8 organs and 8 imaging modalities under few-shot learning and domain generalization settings. Evi-Steer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under few-shot learning and domain shift settings, demonstrating a practical and robust pathway for deploying vision-language models in real-world clinical settings. Code is available at https://github.com/HealthX-Lab/Evi-Steer.
papers.comment: MICCAI 2026 Early Accept; Project Page: https://tahakoleilat.github.io/Evi-Steer. This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this contribution will be published as part of the MICCAI 2026 proceedings in October
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evi-Steer，一种基于证据学习 (evidential learning) 的跨模态低维调控框架，用于 BiomedCLIP 的少样本和域泛化医学图像分析。仅更新 0.11% 的参数，通过轻量级 token 更新和不确定性引导的门控残差实现保守适应。在 15 个生物医学数据集（涵盖 8 个器官、8 种模态）上，该方法在少样本学习和域偏移设定下均持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法在领域偏移和模糊图像-文本对齐下表现脆弱，尤其在临床低数据场景中，模型需要保持鲁棒性。
Method: 对视觉和文本编码器进行轻量级低维 token 更新，同时估计认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty)；基于 Dempster-Shafer 理论进行跨模态置信度融合，使视觉适应受文本置信度调控，抑制冲突或不确定的跨模态更新。
Result: 在 15 个生物医学成像数据集（8 器官、8 模态）的少样本学习和域泛化设定下，Evi-Steer 一致超越当前最优方法。
Conclusion: 该工作为在真实临床环境中部署视觉-语言模型提供了一条实用且鲁棒的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InstructSAM: Segment Any Instance with Any Instructions
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce InstructSAM, a unified and streamlined framework designed for multi-instance segmentation under arbitrary instructions. We formulates instruction-driven instance segmentation as a set-structured query prediction problem and propose an explicit reasoning-to-instance query interface that elegantly bridges a vision-language model (VLM) and SAM3. Specifically, a bank of learnable instance queries is injected into the VLM and contextualized with instruction and visual information, enabling each query to serve as an instance-aware slot. A hybrid-attention mechanism further promotes interaction among these queries, visual tokens, and instruction tokens, improving instance enumeration and reducing duplicate predictions. The resulting LLM-conditioned queries are projected into SAM3's detector query space to drive accurate multi-instance segmentation in a single forward pass. This design equips SAM3 with high-level instruction understanding, compositional reasoning, and instance-level set prediction without modifying its core architecture. To support training and evaluation, we further construct Inst2Seg, a high-quality and large-scale instruction-based instance segmentation dataset and benchmark that couples free-form instructions with instance-level masks. Extensive experiments show that only 2B-scale InstructSAM achieves strong results across complex instruction-driven and phrase-level referring segmentation benchmarks, outperforming prior end-to-end methods and SAM3's agentic pipeline while enabling efficient single-pass multi-instance prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出InstructSAM，一个统一框架，用于在任意指令下进行多实例分割。该方法将指令驱动实例分割建模为集合结构查询预测问题，通过可学习实例查询与视觉语言模型交互，利用混合注意力机制促进交互，最终投影到SAM3检测器查询空间实现单次前向多实例分割。论文还构建了Inst2Seg数据集。实验表明2B参数模型在复杂指令驱动和短语级指代分割基准上取得强结果。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理任意指令的多实例分割时效率低或需要复杂流水线，缺乏统一高效框架。
Method: 提出显式的推理到实例查询接口，在VLM中注入可学习实例查询，通过混合注意力机制交互，然后将LLM条件查询投影到SAM3检测器查询空间，实现单次前向多实例分割。
Result: 2B规模的InstructSAM在复杂指令驱动和短语级指代分割基准上超越先前端到端方法和SAM3的智能体流水线，实现高效单次多实例预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为SAM3赋予高层指令理解和组合推理能力，无需修改核心架构，且数据集有助于未来研究。

papers.title: GoQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds. To address this geometric limitation, we propose Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, GoQuant adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, its analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately 15 minutes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate GoQuant's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, it achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that GoQuant effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees. By flattening the combinational logic depth, our parallel shift-and-add datapath reduces the critical path delay to 0.35 ns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GoQuant，一种算法-硬件协同设计的量化框架，针对 Power-of-Two (PoT) 量化在亚4比特下因低角度分辨率导致的高维特征退化问题。通过将量化建模为双基几何正交残差投影，利用 shift-and-add 运算合成高分辨率残差晶格，并设计解析求解器避免梯度计算。在 LLaMA-2-7B 上，3 比特权重 (W3A16) 下达到困惑度 6.10，28nm 工艺下关键路径延迟仅 0.35 ns。
Motivation: 低比特 PoT 量化的非均匀指数晶格存在低角度分辨率这一结构缺陷，在 sub-4-bit 阈值下尤为严重，导致高维特征流形退化。
Method: 提出 Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant)，将量化视为双基几何投影，自适应地通过 shift-and-add 操作合成更高分辨率的残差晶格；并采用解析求解器替代梯度优化，加速全模型校准。
Result: 在 LLaMA-2-7B 上，3 比特权重 (W3A16) 下困惑度达 6.10，优于依赖乘法的 AWQ 基线；28nm 标准单元 RTL 综合显示，并行 shift-and-add 数据路径将关键路径延迟降至 0.35 ns。
Conclusion: GoQuant 在不使用乘法器的情况下可达到有竞争力的量化精度，并通过减少组合逻辑深度缓解时序瓶颈，适用于边缘部署。

papers.title: Beyond the Frontier: Stochastic Backtracking for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute to explore multiple solution trajectories. The key challenge is to maximize accuracy while minimizing the total number of generated tokens during reasoning. Recent PRM-guided methods score intermediate prefixes to steer this search, but most are frontier-only: they keep only the current active prefixes and irreversibly prune or resample away the rest using noisy PRM scores. This can cause premature commitment, diversity collapse, and the loss of prefixes that still admit correct continuations. We introduce stochastic backtracking over a persistent pool of historical prefixes, allowing test-time compute to revisit previously generated states instead of only expanding the current frontier. To make this efficient, we propose two complementary mechanisms. Subpool Selection strengthens greedy PRM-guided search by applying Top-N selection within random subpools, giving historical prefixes a chance to bypass over-scored frontier candidates. Power Backtrack Sequential Monte Carlo extends SMC-style resampling to the persistent pool using powered PRM scores and mixture-corrected weights. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model scales, our methods consistently achieve higher accuracy per token count, and the same level of accuracy using only a fraction of the token count in comparison to strong PRM-guided baselines, demonstrating that persistent-pool stochastic backtracking provides a simple and effective way to improve the accuracy-token trade-off in test-time scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对测试时扩展（test-time scaling）中语言模型推理的精度-令牌权衡问题，提出基于持久历史前缀的随机回溯（stochastic backtracking）方法，包括子池选择（Subpool Selection）和功率回溯序列蒙特卡洛（Power Backtrack Sequential Monte Carlo）两种机制。在数学推理基准上，该方法相比强PRM引导基线，能以更少令牌达到相同精度，或在相同令牌数下获得更高精度。
Motivation: 现有PRM引导的搜索方法仅保留当前活动前缀（frontier-only），会因只使用当前前缀和不可逆地剪枝导致过早承诺、多样性崩溃以及丢失可能包含正确延续的前缀。
Method: 提出两种互补机制：子池选择通过在随机子池内进行Top-N选择，给历史前缀绕过高分前沿候选的机会；功率回溯序列蒙特卡洛将SMC式重采样扩展到持久池，使用功率化PRM分数和混合校正权重。
Result: 在多个数学推理基准和模型规模上，该方法每令牌数精度更高，且达到相同精度所需令牌数仅为强PRM引导基线的一小部分。
Conclusion: 持久池随机回溯提供了一种简单有效的改进测试时扩展中精度-令牌权衡的方法。

papers.title: Test-Time Deep Thinking to Explore Implicit Rules
papers.abstract_en: With the continuous advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), intelligent agents are becoming increasingly vital. However, these agents often fail in environments governed by implicit rules--hidden constraints that cannot be observed directly and must be inferred through interaction. This causes agents to fall into repetitive trial-and-error loops, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose Test-Time Exploration (TTExplore), a framework where a thinker component analyzes interaction history to infer these implicit rules and guide an actor. Effective exploration in this setting critically depends on the reasoning ability of the thinker. However, evaluating deep reasoning trajectories is inherently unstable and difficult, which poses a major obstacle to effective training. To overcome this issue, we introduce a novel and stable reinforcement learning pipeline. The core idea is to use accurate task-level scores as indirect rewards to bypass the difficulty of evaluating intermediate reasoning, and to retain only a single thinking node per trajectory to alleviate reward sparsity. Using this pipeline, we train a specialized 7B model, Exp-Thinker. Experiments on five text-based embodied tasks show that TTExplore equipped with Exp-Thinker improves baseline agent performance by an average of $14$-$19$ points, demonstrating the effectiveness of explicitly reasoning about implicit rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型智能体在隐含规则环境中失败的问题，提出Test-Time Exploration (TTExplore)框架。框架中包含一个thinker组件，通过分析交互历史推断隐含规则并指导actor。作者引入一种新颖稳定的强化学习流水线，利用准确的任务级分数作为间接奖励，避免评估中间推理的困难，并只保留每个轨迹单个思考节点以缓解奖励稀疏。训练得到7B模型Exp-Thinker，在五个基于文本的具体任务上平均提升基线agent性能14-19个点。
Motivation: 智能体在隐含规则环境中常失败，因为这些规则不能直接观察必须通过交互推断，导致重复试错循环和任务失败。
Method: 提出TTExplore框架，thinker分析交互历史推断隐含规则指导actor。强化学习流水线使用任务级分数作为间接奖励，且每个轨迹仅保留一个思考节点。
Result: 在五个基于文本的具体任务上，Exp-Thinker将基线agent性能平均提升14-19个点。
Conclusion: 明确推理隐含规则可提高智能体在文本基础任务中的表现，但方法依赖于任务级奖励且仅适用于文本环境。

papers.title: Fundamental Limitation in Explaining AI
papers.abstract_en: While large-scale models such as LLMs and diffusion models have achieved practical success, public institutions have emphasized the importance of explainability in AI. Existing methods for explaining AI, however, are not designed to provide completely faithful explanations of the behavior of large-scale AI systems. Although a completely faithful and interpretable explanation of the behavior of an AI system might be useful for AI governance, it has not been known whether providing such an explanation is theoretically possible. In this paper, we mathematically prove a fundamental quadrilemma in explaining AI, stating that AI and its explanation cannot satisfy the following four conditions simultaneously: 1) the complexity of the operation environment, 2) the goodness of the AI's performance, 3) the interpretability of the AI's explanation, and 4) the complete faithfulness of the AI's explanation. This quadrilemma suggests that, in most applications where we cannot change the environment or sacrifice good AI performance and an interpretable explanation, we should give up complete faithfulness of explanations and should instead aim to explain only the parts that are important for applications. As a consequence, the quadrilemma implies that AI governance should be designed on the premise that the faithfulness of AI explanations is always incomplete.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过数学证明提出了一个基本四难困境：AI及其解释无法同时满足环境复杂度、AI性能良好、解释可解释性和解释完全忠实性四个条件。该结果指出，在大多数应用中应放弃完全忠实的解释，AI治理应基于解释不完全忠实的前提。
Motivation: 大规模AI模型取得实际成功，但现有解释方法不能提供完全忠实的解释。完全忠实且可解释的解释对AI治理可能有用，但其理论可行性未知，因此需要研究其根本限制。
Method: 通过数学证明形式化地论证了AI及其解释存在一个四难困境（quadrilemma），证明四个条件不可能同时成立。
Result: 证明了四难困境的存在：环境复杂度、AI性能、解释可解释性和解释完全忠实性无法同时满足。
Conclusion: 在大多数实际应用中，应放弃完全忠实性，只解释重要部分；AI治理应基于解释不完全忠实的前提。

papers.title: Resolving Ambiguity in Composed Image Retrieval via Calibrated Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Composed image retrieval (CIR) searches a corpus with a reference image and a text describing how to modify it. Despite rapid progress from triplet-trained compositors to zero-shot and generative methods, essentially all systems share one assumption: that a query maps to a single target, scored by Recall@K against one annotation. We argue this is fundamentally at odds with the task. A query such as make it more formal does not name an image but a region of the corpus, and which member the user intends is genuinely underdetermined. This underspecification is the root of the well-known false-negative problem and leaves current models unable to tell a precise query from an ambiguous one. We reframe CIR as calibrated intent resolution under uncertainty: a retriever is wrapped in a conformal prediction layer that returns a candidate set with a coverage guarantee and whose size is a principled measure of ambiguity; when the set is large, an expected-information-gain policy asks the single most useful clarifying question, drawn from interpretable ambiguity axes, and the set contracts. We introduce AmbiCIR, a benchmark and human-validated user simulator that revive the dormant auxiliary and dialogue annotations of CIRR and extend the multiple-positive setting of CIRCO. Across open-domain and fashion benchmarks our method matches single-turn state of the art, confirming calibrated resolution is cost-free on precise queries, while reaching the intended target in a fraction of the interaction budget required by naive conversational baselines, and it is the first to report valid coverage and calibration for the task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出组合图像检索（CIR）中查询的歧义性（如“使其更正式”对应多个可能目标），认为现有假设单一目标与Recall@K评估不匹配。提出基于校准意图分辨的框架：在检索器后添加共形预测层，返回带覆盖率保证的候选集，集合大小作为歧义度量；当集合过大时，通过期望信息增益策略提问澄清问题。引入AmbiCIR基准和用户模拟器，在开放域和时尚基准上匹配单轮SOTA，并在少量交互内达到目标。
Motivation: 现有CIR系统假设查询映射到单一目标，但实际查询往往是指向一个区域而非具体图像，导致假阴性问题，且无法区分模糊与精确查询。
Method: 将CIR重构为校准意图分辨：使用共形预测层包裹检索器，输出有覆盖率保证的候选集；若集合较大，基于期望信息增益从可解释歧义轴中选择最有效的澄清问题。
Result: 在开放域和时尚基准上，该方法在单轮匹配SOTA，且以远少于朴素对话基线的交互预算达到目标，首次报告了该任务的有效覆盖率和校准度。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过共形预测和主动澄清，可在不牺牲精确查询性能的前提下解决歧义，实现校准的意图分辨。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring Alignment-Induced Activation Shifts Correctly: A Template-Controlled Difference-in-Differences Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Comparing a model's internal activations before and after alignment is a natural way to ask what safety training changes: one forms the matrix of paired aligned-minus-base activations on safety-relevant inputs and reads off its effective rank or top direction. We show the obvious way to form this matrix is confounded. The aligned model is evaluated under a chat template the base model never saw, so the naive difference conflates the alignment shift with chat formatting. We introduce a four-variant decomposition of the modification matrix (naive, template-controlled, within-aligned, and difference-in-differences, DiD) that separates the two effects. Template control alone removes a 2.0-3.9x inflation of the measured effective rank across Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, and Qwen-2.5-7B; the DiD contrast is what recovers the refusal direction of Arditi et al. (2024), lifting its cosine alignment from 0.18-0.39 to 0.50-0.86. Projection-ablation across the three families confirms the recovered subspace is behaviorally active and that singular-value order is not causal order. We validate the protocol on a controlled testbed and distill it into measurement recommendations for activation-difference studies of alignment.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. v3: substantially revised and reframed as a measurement-methodology paper. Code, data, and an immutable Zenodo archive are available at https://github.com/Nakammura/effective-rank-audit (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20341444)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出，在比较模型对齐前后的内部激活时，由于对齐模型使用了基础模型未见过的聊天模板，简单的对齐-基础差异会混淆对齐效应和模板效应。作者提出了一种四变体分解矩阵（naive, template-controlled, within-aligned, difference-in-differences）来分离这两种效应。在Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B和Qwen-2.5-7B上的实验表明，模板控制消除了有效秩的2.0-3.9倍膨胀，而双重差分对比恢复了Arditi等人(2024)的拒绝方向，将其余弦对齐从0.18-0.39提升到0.50-0.86。投影消融实验确认恢复的子空间行为上活跃，且奇异值顺序并非因果顺序。该协议在受控测试台上得到验证，并提炼为激活差异研究的测量建议。
Motivation: 现有方法通过配对对齐前后激活的差异矩阵来研究安全训练带来的变化，但简单差异混淆了聊天模板的效应，导致测量结果存在偏差。
Method: 引入四种变体分解：naive、template-controlled、within-aligned和difference-in-differences (DiD)，通过控制模板和设计对比来分离对齐效应与模板效应。
Result: 模板控制消除了Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B和Qwen-2.5-7B上有效秩的2.0-3.9倍膨胀；DiD对比将拒绝方向的余弦对齐从0.18-0.39提升至0.50-0.86；投影消融证实子空间行为活跃且奇异值顺序非因果顺序。
Conclusion: 该协议有效消除了模板混淆，为对齐诱导激活偏移的测量提供了更准确的方法，并给出了实用建议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Multi-Agent RL Improve LLM Workflows? Workflow, Scale, and Policy-Sharing Tradeoffs
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM workflows route inference through specialized roles to lift end-task accuracy, but jointly training those roles with reinforcement learning is unstable in ways that are poorly understood. We study when end-to-end RL training of multi-agent LLM workflows improves over their base models, comparing Shared-Policy training, where all roles update one policy, with Isolated-Policy training, where each role has its own parameters. Our experimental matrix spans Eval-Opt, Voting, and Orch-Workers workflows, math and code tasks, and three model scales (0.6B, 1.7B, 4B). We find that multi-agent RL usually improves over base models, but gains depend jointly on workflow, task, and scale, not on policy sharing alone. Isolated-Policy tends to reach higher peak accuracy yet more often falls off a terminal accuracy cliff, while Shared-Policy training does not eliminate failure; it redistributes failure into qualitatively different patterns. We then explain the strongest of these patterns through role-level gradient dynamics induced by workflow topology and policy routing: under Isolated-Policy, parallel same-role agents on shared prompts amplify per-role gradients and drive terminal degradation in Voting and Orch-Workers workflows; under Shared-Policy, asymmetric per-step gradient mass causes the shared policy to be captured by the dominant role, producing different failure signatures by task and workflow. Together, the empirical map and its underlying mechanisms show that policy sharing routes training pressure through different channels rather than offering uniform stability, making it a design choice with workflow- and task-conditional tradeoffs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体强化学习（Multi-Agent RL）在大型语言模型工作流中的应用，通过实验对比共享策略（Shared-Policy）与独立策略（Isolated-Policy）训练，发现多智能体RL通常能提升基模型性能，但增益依赖于工作流、任务和模型规模。独立策略倾向于达到更高峰值准确率但更易崩溃，共享策略则改变失效模式。论文通过角色级梯度动力学解释了最强失效模式。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM工作流通过角色分工提升准确率，但联合RL训练的稳定性尚不明确，现有研究缺乏对策略共享与独立训练的系统比较。
Method: 在Eval-Opt、Voting和Orch-Workers三种工作流、数学与代码任务、三种模型规模（0.6B、1.7B、4B）下，比较共享策略训练（所有角色更新同一策略）与独立策略训练（每个角色独立参数）。

papers.title: From Abstraction to Instantiation: Learning Behavioral Representation for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often suffer from performance degradation under distribution shifts, as they struggle to learn generalized behavior representations across varying environments. While existing approaches attempt to construct behavior representations through action-centric latent variables, they are often limited by short-horizon temporal fragmentation and static execution-alignment, leading to inconsistent behaviors in complex scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{BehaviorVLA}, a framework that facilitates robust manipulation through the learning of a temporally coherent behavioral representations. Our approach features two symmetric components: (1) the \textbf{Visuomotor Behavior Encoder (VBE)}, which utilizes a causal Mamba-based architecture to aggregate long-horizon trajectory information into a unified behavior representation; and (2) the \textbf{Phase-conditioned Behavior Decoder (PBD)}, which decodes this representation into precise actions by dynamically aligning task-level priors with real-time execution progress. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and CALVIN demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates of 58\%, 98\%, and 4.36 (Avg.Len), respectively. Notably, in real-world sim-to-real transfer, BehaviorVLA matches the performance of OpenVLA-OFT using only 50\% of the demonstration data, showcasing its superior data efficiency and generalization.

papers.title: Graph Navier Stokes Networks
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a cornerstone of deep learning, with most existing methods rooted in graph signal processing and diffusion equations to model message passing. However, these approaches inherently suffer from the oversmoothing problem, where node features become indistinguishable as the network depth increases. Inspired by the Navier Stokes equations, we introduce Graph Navier Stokes Networks (GNSN), a novel architecture that transcends conventional diffusion-based message passing by incorporating convection into graph structures. GNSN defines a dynamic velocity field on the graph to govern convection, enabling more efficient and direct message propagation. By adaptively balancing convection and diffusion, GNSN is able to efficiently handle datasets with varying levels of homophily. Extensive evaluations across twelve real-world datasets demonstrate that GNSN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in classification accuracy. Moreover, experimental results further emphasize its effectiveness in alleviating the oversmoothing problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图纳维-斯托克斯网络（GNSN），将纳维-斯托克斯方程中的对流机制引入图神经网络，以缓解过平滑问题。GNSN在图上定义动态速度场控制对流，并自适应平衡对流与扩散，在12个真实数据集上分类精度持续优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有GNN基于扩散方程的消息传递存在过平滑问题，节点特征随深度增加而不可区分。
Method: 受纳维-斯托克斯方程启发，GNSN在图上引入对流机制，通过动态速度场驱动消息传播，并自适应平衡对流与扩散。
Result: 在12个真实数据集上，GNSN的分类精度持续优于现有最先进基线，并能有效缓解过平滑问题。
Conclusion: GNSN通过融合对流机制改进了GNN的消息传递范式，为处理不同同质性水平的数据集提供了新思路。

papers.title: RelWitness: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation with Visual-Geometric Relation Witnesses
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation seeks to describe object instances and their relations with flexible natural-language predicates. The central difficulty is not only vocabulary expansion, but supervision reliability: relation annotations in 3D scene graph datasets are selective, and many valid object-pair relations are unannotated. We propose RelWitness, a framework for open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation from posed RGB-D sequences under incomplete relation supervision. The key concept is a relation witness: a concrete visual-geometric cue that makes a relation observable in the captured scene. Support relations require contact and vertical ordering; containment requires enclosure; proximity requires metric closeness; orientation requires facing direction; and stable relations should persist across views where both objects are visible. RelWitness constructs relation witness records from RGB views, depth maps, reconstructed 3D geometry, role-sensitive text, object-prior null views, and multi-view consistency. A visual-geometric witness verifier assigns unannotated relation candidates to verified missing positives, reliable negatives, or uncertain unlabeled cases. A witness-guided positive-unlabeled objective then learns from incomplete annotations without turning every missing label into a negative. We further introduce witness-consistent decoding and an RGB-D missing-relation audit protocol. Simulated manuscript-planning experiments on 3DSSG/3RScan and ScanNet-derived open-vocabulary splits show the intended behavior: improved unseen-relation recognition, higher witness precision, lower hallucination, and reduced redundant relation phrases. All numerical results are planning values and must be replaced by reproduced measurements before submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RelWitness，一种用于开放词汇 3D 场景图生成的框架，该框架从带姿态的 RGB-D 序列中生成场景图，并处理关系标注不完整的问题。核心是“关系见证者”概念：一种具体的视觉-几何线索，使关系在场景中可观测。RelWitness 从 RGB 视图、深度图、重建 3D 几何、角色敏感文本、对象先验空视图和多视图一致性构建关系见证记录，并通过见证者验证器将未标注关系候选分类为已确认的缺失正例、可靠负例或不确定未标注案例。见证者引导的正-无标签目标函数从不完整标注中学习，而不会将每个缺失标签视为负例。在 3DSSG/3RScan 和 ScanNet 衍生数据集上的模拟规划实验显示，该方法在未见关系识别、见证者精度、幻觉减少和冗余关系短语方面有所改进。
Motivation: 开放词汇 3D 场景图生成的核心困难不仅是词汇扩展，还有监督可靠性：3D 场景图数据集中的关系标注是选择性的，许多有效的对象-对关系未被标注。
Method: 提出 RelWitness 框架，关键概念是关系见证者：一种具体的视觉-几何线索，使关系可观测。从 RGB 视图、深度图、重建 3D 几何、角色敏感文本、对象先验空视图和多视图一致性构建见证记录。使用视觉-几何见证验证器将未标注候选分类为已确认的缺失正例、可靠负例或不确定未标注。采用见证者引导的正-无标签目标函数从不完整标注中学习。
Result: 在 3DSSG/3RScan 和 ScanNet 衍生数据集上的模拟规划实验显示，该方法在未见关系识别、见证者精度、幻觉减少和冗余关系短语方面有所改进。注意：所有数值结果均为规划值，需在正式提交前替换为复现测量值。
Conclusion: RelWitness 通过引入关系见证者来处理不完整关系监督，从而提升开放词汇 3D 场景图生成的泛化能力，并减少幻觉和冗余。

papers.title: Decision-Path Patterns as Tree Reliability Signals: Path-based Adaptive Weighting for Random Forest Classification
papers.abstract_en: Random forests construct each tree with a different, randomised representation of the feature space. Their uniform voting cannot correct errors in regions where trees with incorrect representations probabilistically outnumber correct ones, even when the ensemble collectively holds enough correct information - a reducible error that this paper addresses. We propose using the structural pattern of each tree's decision path as an instance-adaptive reliability signal to identify and differentially weight the more reliable trees. At inference, a random forest reaches its prediction through the root-to-leaf path the sample traverses in each tree, so path-level reliability offers a finer granularity than tree-level weighting can access. We show that this signal reflects the actual reliability of each tree's decision, and that using it yields a statistically significant accuracy improvement over RF on 36 binary classification benchmarks (Wilcoxon p < 0.0001). Class-recall regression - the typical failure mode of RF correction methods - is measured: zero minority-recall regressions and a single majority-recall regression at the 0.2 pp threshold, indicating bias reduction rather than a class trade-off. We further quantify the reducible error accessible to the method from the fitted RF alone; this estimate correlates strongly with per-dataset gain (Pearson r = +0.840, p < 0.0001). On the qualifying group it identifies, the method delivers a mean +0.99 pp accuracy improvement with strict wins on every dataset (7/0/0); an optional amplification mechanism further raises this to +1.48 pp.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机森林中均匀投票在局部区域可能被错误树主导的问题，提出基于决策路径结构模式作为实例自适应可靠性信号，对每棵树的投票进行差异化加权。在36个二分类基准上，该方法比原始随机森林有统计显著的精度提升，且未出现少数类召回率下降的现象。
Motivation: 随机森林的均匀投票无法纠正局部区域中错误树占多数的情况，即使集成整体拥有足够多正确信息，这种可减少的误差未被充分解决。
Method: 利用每棵树决策路径的结构模式作为实例级别的可靠性信号，在推理时根据样本经过的路径自适应地加权各棵树的投票，路径级可靠性比树级加权更细粒度。
Result: 在36个二分类基准上，方法相对于随机森林有统计显著的精度提升（Wilcoxon p < 0.0001），且没有出现少数类召回率下降（零次少数类召回率退化，仅一次多数类召回率退化在0.2 pp阈值下）。可减少误差估计与每数据集增益强相关（Pearson r = 0.840, p < 0.0001），在合格子集上平均提升+0.99 pp（严格胜出7/0/0），可选放大机制进一步达到+1.48 pp。
Conclusion: 该方法通过路径级可靠性加权有效减少了随机森林的冗余误差，且不会引入类别权衡，具有统计显著的精度提升和良好的可解释性。

papers.title: Auditing Privacy in Multi-Tenant RAG under Account Collusion
papers.abstract_en: Multi-tenant RAG services often treat the account as the privacy boundary: each account receives an $(\varepsilon_{\text{acc}},δ_{\text{acc}})$-DP retrieval guarantee against the tenant index. We show that this framing understates leakage under same-index account collusion. For Gaussian noise-then-select retrieval, $k$ coordinated same-tenant accounts compose to joint leakage $Θ(\sqrt{k}\,\varepsilon_{\text{acc}})$, not $\varepsilon_{\text{acc}}$; we give a matching membership-inference attack and validate the predicted $\sqrt{k}$ AUC trend in scalar, top-$K$, trained-embedder, and production-scale HNSW settings. We then give a verifier-runnable audit protocol that attests noise-then-select retrieval and reports $(\textsf{PASS},\varepsilon_{\text{audit}})$ for coalitions up to a declared cap $k_{\max}$, without disclosing the index or changing the retrieval decision rule. The claim is retrieval-channel only: generation-channel leakage and adversarially robust coalition-size estimation are complementary audit predicates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多租户RAG服务中账户共谋导致的隐私泄露问题。作者证明，在噪声选取检索机制下，同一租户内k个合谋账户会使得联合隐私泄露呈√k倍增长，并提出匹配的成员推理攻击验证该趋势。同时，给出了一个可验证的审计协议，在不暴露索引或改变检索规则的前提下，报告针对最多k_max个合谋账户的审计结果。
Motivation: 现有RAG服务将账户作为隐私边界，但未考虑同一租户内多个账户合谋可能显著放大泄露风险。
Method: 理论分析高斯噪声-选取检索机制下k个账户合谋的隐私损失；设计成员推理攻击；提出可运行审计协议。
Result: 证明联合泄露为Θ(√k·ε_acc)；在标量、top-K、训练嵌入器及生产规模HNSW设置中验证了√k的AUC趋势。
Conclusion: 该审计协议仅覆盖检索通道，生成通道泄露和对抗性鲁棒的合谋规模估计是互补审计谓词。

papers.title: Scale-Invariant Neural Network Optimization: Norm Geometry and Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: A growing lesson from neural network optimization is that optimizer design should respect how the model is parametrized. Scale-invariant methods become important because their normalized layerwise updates can not only support hyperparameter transfer across model sizes but exploit input-output matrix norm geometry. At the same time, stochastic gradient noises in deep learning are often far from sub-Gaussian and may exhibit heavy tails. These crucial observations have shaped recent algorithmic principles for training neural networks, yet their joint theoretical consequences remain underexplored. In particular, it is unclear what dimension dependence is unavoidable for scale-invariant methods with general input-output matrix norm, and whether higher-order smoothness can accelerate training under heavy-tailed noise. We study these questions through nonconvex smooth stochastic optimization over $\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ with general norms, where the goal is to achieve an $ε$-stationary point under $p^{\mathrm{th}}$-moment heavy-tailed noise. Our first contribution is a dimension-dependent lower bound: when $\frac{\max\{m,n\}}{(\min\{m,n\})^2}$ is large enough, any scale-invariant first-order method with spectral norm requires $Ω(\min\{m, n\}ε^{-\frac{3p-2}{p-1}})$ oracle calls. We prove that a batched Scion method with spectral norm achieves the matching upper bound of $O(\min\{m, n\}ε^{-\frac{3p-2}{p-1}})$. To exploit higher-order smoothness, we propose a transported Scion method and improve the bound to $O(\min\{m, n\}ε^{-\frac{5p-3}{2p-2}})$ when the norm is spectral and the Hessian is Lipschitz. Finally, we incorporate practical heuristics into our transported method and evaluate it across multiple architectures and model sizes, demonstrating its flexibility and compatibility in training neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了神经网络优化中尺度不变方法的理论基础，特别是范数几何和重尾噪声的影响。作者针对一般范数下的非凸光滑随机优化问题，推导了维度依赖的下界，并提出了匹配上界的批处理Scion方法。此外，利用高阶光滑性提出了传输Scion方法，进一步改善了复杂度。实验展示了方法在不同架构和规模上的灵活性。
Motivation: 现有尺度不变方法在神经网络优化中表现出超参数迁移等优势，但重尾噪声下的理论后果尚不明确，特别是维度依赖的下界和高阶光滑性能否加速训练。
Method: 通过非凸光滑随机优化框架，研究一般范数下的矩阵优化问题。首先证明维度依赖的下界，然后提出批处理Scion方法达到匹配上界，再基于高阶光滑性提出传输Scion方法。
Result: 在谱范数下，任意尺度不变一阶方法需要Ω(min{m,n}ε^{-(3p-2)/(p-1)})次查询，批处理Scion方法达到匹配的O(·)上界；传输Scion方法在Hessian Lipschitz条件下改进为O(min{m,n}ε^{-(5p-3)/(2p-2)})。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了尺度不变方法在重尾噪声下的维度依赖复杂度界限，并展示了高阶光滑性可以加速训练。实验验证了所提方法的实用性和兼容性。

papers.title: Ethical Hyper-Velocity (EHV): A Hardware-Rooted Zero-Trust Runtime Enforcement Architecture for Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous agentic systems scale across regulated critical infrastructures, the lack of mechanistic, hardware-rooted enforcement for high-frequency policy updates presents a fundamental safety gap. We present Ethical Hyper-Velocity (EHV), a governance-aware runtime enforcement architecture for agentic systems that combines Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD) for inline policy-constrained token generation, Causal Graph CRDT-based policy synchronization with vector-clock ordering, hardware-attested execution in Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), and OSCAL-formatted machine-readable audit logging. Unlike retrospective auditing frameworks (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF) that introduce 14-30 day policy latencies, EHV relocates the Policy Enforcement Point (PEP) into the inference pipeline via a Governance-Aware Just-In-Time (JIT) Compiler. Under explicitly stated assumptions, the architecture reduces enforcement latency, improves traceability, and supports formal verification of safety invariants in a bounded model. We demonstrate via TLA+ model checking that non-compliant agentic actions were unreachable in the verified bounded operating state space (1,738 states generated, 324 distinct, depth 8, zero violations). Under these conditions, O(1) runtime enforcement reduces the traditional trade-off between deployment velocity and governance integrity, targeting Governance Latency from O(days) toward O(1). EHV's differentiating contribution is the integration of GCD, Causal CRDT, TEE attestation caching, and bounded formal verification into a single, hardware-rooted enforcement architecture -- a combination not achieved by any contemporaneous system. The architecture is demonstrated through a pediatric oncology dosage use case, with applicability to regulated critical infrastructures including healthcare, financial compliance, and critical infrastructure control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ethical Hyper-Velocity (EHV)，一种面向自主智能体系统的硬件根信任零信任运行时执行架构。该架构结合语法约束解码 (GCD)、因果图 CRDT 策略同步、可信执行环境 (TEE) 硬件认证和 OSCAL 机器可读审计日志，将策略执行点嵌入推理流水线。通过 TLA+ 模型检查验证，在 1738 个状态、深度 8 的有界状态空间中，未发现违规行为，执行延迟从传统数天降至 O(1)，并在儿科肿瘤用药场景中演示。
Motivation: 当前自主智能体系统在受监管关键基础设施中缺乏机制性、硬件根信任的高频策略执行，现有审计框架（如 ISO/IEC 42001）存在 14-30 天的策略延迟，构成安全缺口。
Method: 提出 EHV 架构，核心组件包括：Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD) 实现内联策略约束的 token 生成；Causal Graph CRDT 结合向量时钟进行策略同步；TEE 认证缓存提供硬件根信任执行；OSCAL 格式审计日志；以及 Governance-Aware JIT 编译器将策略执行点移入推理流水线。
Result: TLA+ 模型检查表明，在 1738 个状态（324 个不同、深度 8）的有界状态空间中，违规行为不可达。架构实现 O(1) 运行时执行，将治理延迟从 O(天数) 降至 O(1)。
Conclusion: EHV 通过集成 GCD、Causal CRDT、TEE 认证缓存和有界形式化验证，在单一硬件根信任执行架构中实现低延迟策略执行，适用于医疗、金融和基础设施控制等受监管领域。

papers.title: Privacy Policy Enforcement Guardrails for Data-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Standard PII filters often miss contextual data leakage in RAG systems, such as non-regulated attribute clusters that collectively identify individuals. We introduce a Privacy Policy Enforcement (PPE) framework using dual one-class density estimators with fused text embeddings and a calibrated abstain region for out-of-distribution inputs. Using an axis-stratified, multi-LLM synthetic data pipeline across medicine, finance, and law, we found that traditional Gaussian Mixture baselines fail on borderline-safe stress tests by focusing on linguistic register rather than content. Our proposed T3+OCSVM detector, trained on safe and borderline-safe data, achieves a borderline AUROC of 0.93+ while reducing false positives by 44-55 percentage points and maintaining millisecond latency. Compared to supervised MLP classifiers or 14B-parameter LLM judges, our framework offers superior operational suitability, as the former suffers from high abstention rates and the latter from latency and calibration issues. This methodology provides a robust stress-testing standard for any synthetic-data-trained classifier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的上下文数据泄露问题，提出隐私策略执行（PPE）框架，使用双单类密度估计器融合文本嵌入，并引入校准的弃权区域处理分布外输入。通过医学、金融、法律领域的多LLM合成数据管道测试，传统高斯混合基线在边缘安全测试上失败，而提出的T3+OCSVM检测器在安全与边缘安全数据上训练，实现边界AUROC 0.93+，误报率降低44-55个百分点，并保持毫秒级延迟。相比监督MLP分类器或14B参数LLM法官，该框架在运营适用性上更优。
Motivation: 标准PII过滤器常遗漏RAG系统中的上下文数据泄露，例如非监管属性集群可共同识别个体，需要更鲁棒的隐私策略执行方法。
Method: 提出基于双单类密度估计器（T3+OCSVM）的隐私策略执行框架，结合融合文本嵌入和校准的弃权区域，并在多种领域使用多LLM合成数据管道进行训练和测试。
Result: 在边界安全测试上AUROC达0.93+，误报率降低44-55个百分点，维持毫秒级延迟，优于高斯混合基线、监督MLP和14B参数LLM法官。
Conclusion: 该框架为任何基于合成数据训练的分类器提供了鲁棒的压力测试标准，并证明了在隐私敏感RAG系统中的操作适用性。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Geometric Diffusion for Macro Placement Generation
papers.abstract_en: Macro placement is a pivotal stage in VLSI physical design, fundamentally determining the overall chip performance. Recent data-driven placement methods have demonstrated significant potential, yet they often struggle to handle sequential dependencies and to balance topological connectivity with physical constraints. To bridge this gap, we propose MacroDiff+, a physics-guided geometric diffusion framework. Specifically, we design a dual-domain denoising architecture that couples topological connectivity encoded by heterogeneous GNNs with global geometric context modeled by a Transformer. Furthermore, we introduce Physics-Guided Sampling, an inference strategy that actively steers the generation using explicit gradients to ensure both statistical plausibility and physical validity. On the ISPD2005 MMS benchmarks, MacroDiff+ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with a 6.1-6.2% reduction in wirelength. Notably, it exhibits superior stability and scalability on large-scale designs where prior methods fail to converge. The source code is available at https://github.com/jhy00n/MacroDiff-plus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MacroDiff+，一种物理引导的几何扩散框架用于宏布局生成。该方法设计了双域去噪架构，将异构GNN编码的拓扑连接性与Transformer建模的全局几何上下文结合，并引入物理引导采样作为推理策略。在ISPD2005 MMS基准上，线长减少6.1-6.2%，且在大规模设计中表现出优越的稳定性和可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动宏布局方法难以处理序列依赖，且难以平衡拓扑连接性与物理约束，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出双域去噪架构：异构GNN编码拓扑连接，Transformer建模全局几何上下文；并设计物理引导采样，利用显式梯度引导生成，确保统计合理性和物理有效性。
Result: 在ISPD2005 MMS基准上，与最先进方法相比，线长减少6.1-6.2%；在大规模设计中，相比先前方法展现出更优的稳定性和可扩展性。
Conclusion: 物理引导的扩散生成框架能有效提升宏布局的质量和稳定性，尤其适用于大规模设计。

papers.title: Many-Shot CoT-ICL: Making In-Context Learning Truly Learn
papers.abstract_en: While many-shot ICL achieves remarkable performance, prior studies of its scaling behavior have mainly focused on non-reasoning tasks. In this work, we study many-shot ICL on reasoning tasks, with a particular focus on many-shot chain-of-thought in-context learning (CoT-ICL). Analyzing across non-reasoning and reasoning tasks and across non-reasoning and reasoning-oriented LLMs, we identify several distinctive properties of many-shot CoT-ICL. We further interpret these findings by viewing many-shot CoT-ICL as in-context test-time learning rather than scaled pattern matching, and suggest two principles: (i) demonstrations should be easy for the target model to understand, and (ii) they should be ordered to support a smooth conceptual progression. Guided by the principle, we propose Curvilinear Demonstration Selection (CDS), a simple ordering method that yields up to a 5.42 percentage-point gain on a math task with 64 demonstrations. Overall, our results reframe the long context window from a retrieval buffer into a structured curriculum for in-context test-time learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多示例思维链上下文学习（many-shot CoT-ICL）在推理任务中的性质，发现其表现不同于非推理任务，并提出了将多示例CoT-ICL视为上下文测试时学习（in-context test-time learning）而非模式匹配的观点。据此提出曲线演示选择（CDS）方法，通过按难度排序演示，在数学任务上取得最高5.42个百分点的提升。
Motivation: 以往多示例ICL的扩展行为研究主要关注非推理任务，对推理任务中多示例CoT-ICL的特性缺乏理解。
Method: 提出Curvilinear Demonstration Selection (CDS)，一种简单排序方法，基于两条原则：演示应易于目标模型理解，且应有序排列以支持平滑的概念进展。
Result: CDS方法在数学任务上使用64个演示时，相比基线最高提升5.42个百分点。
Conclusion: 研究将长上下文窗口从检索缓存重新定义为上下文测试时学习的结构化课程。

papers.title: REALISTA: Realistic Latent Adversarial Attacks that Elicit LLM Hallucinations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to hallucinations, making it important to systematically evaluate their reliability under realistic adversarial inputs. We formulate hallucination elicitation as a constrained optimization problem, where the goal is to find semantically coherent adversarial prompts that are equivalent to benign user prompts. Existing attack methods remain limited: discrete prompt-based attacks preserve semantic equivalence and coherence but search only over a limited set of prompt variations, while continuous latent-space attacks explore a richer space but often decode into prompts that are no longer valid rephrasings. To address these limitations, we propose REALISTA, a realistic latent-space attack framework. REALISTA constructs an input-dependent dictionary of valid editing directions, each corresponding to a semantically equivalent and coherent rephrasing, and optimizes continuous combinations of these directions in latent space. This design combines the optimization flexibility of continuous attacks with the semantic realism of discrete rephrasing-based attacks. Experiments demonstrate that REALISTA achieves superior or comparable performance to state-of-the-art realistic attacks on open-source LLMs and, crucially, succeeds in attacking large reasoning models under free-form response settings, where prior realistic attacks fail. Code is available at https://github.com/Buyun-Liang/REALISTA.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/Buyun-Liang/REALISTA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REALISTA，一种针对大语言模型的潜在空间对抗攻击框架，通过构建输入相关的有效编辑方向字典，优化这些方向的连续组合，诱使模型产生幻觉。实验表明在开源LLM上达到或超过现有最真实攻击方法，并能攻击大型推理模型（先前方法失败）。
Motivation: 现有诱发LLM幻觉的对抗攻击方法有局限：离散提示攻击搜索空间有限；连续潜在空间攻击优化空间丰富但解码后的提示可能不再是有效复述。需要一种同时具备优化灵活性和语义真实性的攻击方法。
Method: 提出REALISTA框架，构造输入相关的有效编辑方向字典（每个方向对应语义等价且连贯的复述），在潜在空间中优化这些方向的连续组合。
Result: 在开源LLM上达到或超过最先进真实攻击性能；最关键的是，在自由形式响应设置中成功攻击大型推理模型，而先前真实攻击方法失败。
Conclusion: 通过结合连续攻击的优化灵活性和离散复述攻击的语义真实性，REALISTA能够更有效地诱发LLM幻觉，特别是针对大型推理模型。

papers.title: PermuQuant: Lowering Per-Group Quantization Error by Reordering Channels for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale visual generative models have achieved remarkable performance. However, their high computational and memory costs make deployment challenging in resource-constrained scenarios, such as interactive applications and personal single-GPU usage. Post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical solution by compressing pretrained models without expensive retraining. However, existing PTQ methods still suffer from severe quality degradation under extremely low-bit settings. In this paper, we identify channel ordering as an important but underexplored factor in per-group quantization. In this setting, each contiguous group shares one quantization scale. When channels with very different statistics are placed in the same group, the scale can be dominated by outliers and cause large quantization errors. Based on this observation, we propose PermuQuant, a simple and effective PTQ framework for low-bit diffusion models. PermuQuant sorts channels by a joint second-moment criterion before per-group quantization, placing channels with similar activation and weight statistics into the same group. It further uses a calibration-based acceptance rule to apply reordering only when the selected permutation reduces quantization error on calibration data. The selected permutations are absorbed into adjacent modules or applied to weights offline, avoiding explicit runtime permutation operations. Extensive experiments on multiple large diffusion models show that PermuQuant consistently reduces quantization error and outperforms existing PTQ baselines. On FLUX.1-dev with an RTX 5090, PermuQuant achieves up to a 1.7$\times$ single step speedup and reduces the DiT memory footprint by 3.5$\times$ under W4A4 NVFP4 quantization. Code will be available at https://github.com/yscheng04/PermuQuant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PermuQuant，一种针对扩散模型的低比特后训练量化（PTQ）方法，通过通道重排降低逐组量化误差。方法根据联合二阶矩准则对通道排序，并使用基于校验集的接受规则，仅在量化误差降低时应用重排，且重排可吸收到相邻模块中避免运行时开销。实验表明，在 FLUX.1-dev 模型上，W4A4 NVFP4 量化下实现 1.7 倍单步加速和 3.5 倍 DiT 内存缩减。
Motivation: 现有 PTQ 方法在极低位宽下质量严重下降，逐组量化中通道排序未被充分探索，导致统计差异大的通道共用一个量化尺度时产生较大误差。
Method: 提出 PermuQuant 框架：先通过联合二阶矩准则对激活和权重的通道排序，再基于校验数据应用接受规则，仅保留能降低量化误差的排列，并将排列吸收到相邻模块或离线应用于权重。
Result: 在多个大扩散模型上，PermuQuant 一致降低量化误差，优于现有 PTQ 基线。在 FLUX.1-dev 和 RTX 5090 上，W4A4 NVFP4 量化实现 1.7 倍单步加速和 3.5 倍内存缩减。
Conclusion: 通道重排是一种简单有效的低比特 PTQ 策略，无需运行时开销即可提升量化质量，适用于资源受限场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning-Augmented Scalable Linear Assignment Problem Optimization via Neural Dual Warm-Starts
papers.abstract_en: The Linear Assignment Problem is a fundamental combinatorial optimization task where classical exact solvers ensure optimality but suffer from an $\mathcal{O}(N^{3})$ bottleneck, while recent neural approximations struggle with scalability and exactness. We propose a learning-augmented framework that accelerates exact solvers by predicting dual variables to warm-start the search, backed by a fallback mechanism to preserve worst-case guarantees. Central to our approach is RowDualNet, a lightweight, row-independent architecture that avoids the $\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$ memory bottleneck of graph models, enabling scalable neural warm-starting up to $N=16{,}384$. Feasibility is guaranteed by construction via the Min-Trick mechanism, completely eliminating the need for costly iterative projections. Empirically, our method drastically reduces the search effort of the Jonker-Volgenant (LAPJV) algorithm, yielding robust zero-shot generalization with strict optimality and end-to-end speedups of over 2x on complex synthetic data, 1.25x on real-world tracking, and 1.5x on transportation networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习增强框架，通过神经网络预测对偶变量来热启动精确的线性分配问题求解器，从而加速Jonker-Volgenant算法。核心架构RowDualNet采用行独立设计，避免了图模型O(N^2)的内存瓶颈，可扩展至N=16,384。Min-Trick机制保证解的可行性，无需迭代投影。实验表明，在复杂合成数据上实现2倍以上端到端加速，真实跟踪任务1.25倍，交通网络1.5倍，且保持严格最优性和零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 经典精确求解器（如LAPJV）具有O(N^3)复杂度瓶颈，而近年神经近似方法在规模扩展和最优性保证上存在局限。
Method: 提出学习增强框架，利用RowDualNet（轻量级行独立网络）预测对偶变量，为Jonker-Volgenant算法提供热启动；通过Min-Trick机制确保对偶可行性，无需迭代投影；设有回退机制以维持最坏情况保证。
Result: 在合成数据上实现超过2倍加速，在真实跟踪任务上加速1.25倍，在交通网络上加速1.5倍；零样本泛化且保证结果严格最优。
Conclusion: 该方法以可扩展的方式加速线性分配问题的精确求解，同时保持最优性，适用于大规模实际场景。

papers.title: Expectation-Maximization as a Spectrally Governed Relaxation Flow
papers.abstract_en: The expectation--maximization (EM) algorithm combines global monotonicity, local linear convergence, and strong practical robustness, but these features are usually analyzed separately. Global descent is nonlinear, whereas local convergence is governed by the spectrum of the linearized EM map. How these two levels fit into a single dynamical picture has remained less transparent. We make explicit the latent-variable operator that connects them. Along the EM trajectory, the likelihood increment admits a global energy decomposition in terms of posterior-relative entropy. Linearization at a nondegenerate maximizer $θ^\ast$ reveals the local operator \[ \mathcal G_{θ^\ast}=I-DT(θ^\ast), \] which coincides with both the missing-information ratio and the information-geometric Hessian of the observed likelihood. From this operator we derive two acceleration strategies. The \textbf{G-Accelerator} uses the spectral gap to obtain an optimal Nesterov-type momentum $β^* = (1-\sqrt{λ_*})/(1+\sqrt{λ_*})$. The \textbf{Geo-Adaptive} accelerator extends the geometric EM framework of Zhou, Alexander \& Lange by replacing their fixed correction strength $γ=8$ with the adaptive rule $γ_k = 1/\hatλ_k$, where $\hatλ_k$ is estimated online from the parameter trajectory. Both methods are parameter-free; Geo-Adaptive achieves dramatic acceleration precisely when the spectral gap is smallest. Numerical experiments on Gaussian mixtures demonstrate that both accelerators consistently outperform standard EM and fixed-$γ$ DCC-EM, with Geo-Adaptive attaining speedups exceeding $8\times$ in the most challenging regimes.
papers.comment: This is an updated version in which the G-accelerator is enhanced by noval adaptive geometry method
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了期望最大化（EM）算法的全局单调性与局部线性收敛之间的动力学联系，通过定义潜变量算子将二者统一。基于该算子，作者提出了两种无参数加速策略：G-Accelerator（利用谱间隙优化Nesterov动量）和Geo-Adaptive加速器（自适应调整几何EM框架中的校正强度）。在混合高斯模型上的实验表明，两种加速器均显著优于标准EM和固定参数方法，其中Geo-Adaptive在最困难场景下实现超过8倍加速。
Motivation: EM算法的全局单调性与局部线性收敛性通常被分开分析，缺乏统一的动力学框架。理解二者之间的联系有助于设计更高效的加速策略。
Method: 从EM轨迹中提取潜变量算子，证明似然增量可分解为后验相对熵的全局能量。在非退化极大值点线性化得到局部算子，该算子同时等于缺失信息比和信息几何Hessian。基于该算子的谱信息，提出G-Accelerator（根据谱间隙计算最优Nesterov动量）和Geo-Adaptive加速器（在线估计特征值并自适应调整校正强度）。
Result: 在混合高斯模型实验中，两种加速器均持续优于标准EM和固定校正强度的DCC-EM，Geo-Adaptive加速器在最难收敛的情况下获得超过8倍的加速比。
Conclusion: 论文提出的统一动力学视角为EM加速提供了理论基础，所提无参数加速器在无需调参的情况下实现显著加速，特别在谱间隙小的困难问题上效果突出。

papers.title: ScriptHOI: Learning Scripted State Transitions for Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Detection
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection requires recognizing interaction phrases that may not appear as annotated categories during training. Recent vision-language HOI detectors improve semantic transfer by matching human-object features with text embeddings, but their predictions are often dominated by object affordance and phrase-level co-occurrence. As a result, a model may predict \textit{cut cake} from the presence of a knife and a cake without verifying whether the hand, tool, target, contact pattern, and object state jointly support the action. We propose \textbf{ScriptHOI}, a structured framework that represents each interaction phrase as a soft scripted state transition. Rather than treating a phrase as a single class token, ScriptHOI decomposes it into body-role, contact, geometry, affordance, motion, and object-state slots. A visual state tokenizer parses each detected human-object pair into corresponding state tokens, and a slot-wise matcher estimates both script coverage and script conflict. These two quantities calibrate HOI logits, expose missing visual evidence, and provide training constraints for incomplete annotations. To avoid suppressing valid but unannotated interactions, we further introduce interval partial-label learning, which constrains unannotated candidates with script-derived lower and upper probability bounds instead of assigning closed-world negatives. A counterfactual script contrast loss swaps individual script slots to discourage object-only shortcuts. Experiments on HICO-DET, V-COCO, and open-vocabulary HOI splits show that ScriptHOI improves rare and unseen interaction recognition while substantially reducing affordance-conflict false positives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScriptHOI，一种基于脚本化状态转移的结构化框架，用于开放词汇人体-物体交互（HOI）检测。该方法将交互短语分解为多个状态槽位（如身体角色、接触、几何等），通过视觉状态分词器提取状态令牌，并利用槽位匹配估计脚本覆盖和冲突来校准 HOI 逻辑值。引入区间部分标签学习和反事实脚本对比损失，以减少物体功能属性导致的假阳性。实验在 HICO-DET、V-COCO 和开放词汇 HOI 拆分上表明，该方法提升了稀有和未见交互的识别性能。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇 HOI 检测器依赖物体功能属性和短语共现，忽视动作的实际状态转移，导致预测不准确，例如仅凭刀和蛋糕就预测“切蛋糕”，而不验证手、工具、目标、接触模式和物体状态是否一致。
Method: 提出 ScriptHOI，将每个交互短语表示为软脚本状态转移，分解为身体角色、接触、几何、功能属性、运动和物体状态槽位。视觉状态分词器将人体-物体对解析为对应状态令牌，槽位匹配器计算脚本覆盖和冲突来校准 HOI 逻辑值。引入区间部分标签学习（interval partial-label learning），利用脚本推导的上下界约束未标注候选，避免封闭世界假设；并设计反事实脚本对比损失，交换单一脚本槽位以抑制仅依赖物体的捷径。
Result: 在 HICO-DET、V-COCO 和开放词汇 HOI 拆分上，ScriptHOI 提升了稀有和未见交互的识别性能，同时显著减少了基于物体功能属性冲突的假阳性。
Conclusion: 论文表明，结构化脚本状态表示和部分标签学习能有效改善开放词汇 HOI 检测的鲁棒性，减少对物体共现的过度依赖。
Relevance: 0
