summary_sections.method: 提出 ScriptHOI，将每个交互短语表示为软脚本状态转移，分解为身体角色、接触、几何、功能属性、运动和物体状态槽位。视觉状态分词器将人体-物体对解析为对应状态令牌，槽位匹配器计算脚本覆盖和冲突来校准 HOI 逻辑值。引入区间部分标签学习（interval partial-label learning），利用脚本推导的上下界约束未标注候选，避免封闭世界假设；并设计反事实脚本对比损失，交换单一脚本槽位以抑制仅依赖物体的捷径。
summary_sections.result: 在 HICO-DET、V-COCO 和开放词汇 HOI 拆分上，ScriptHOI 提升了稀有和未见交互的识别性能，同时显著减少了基于物体功能属性冲突的假阳性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文表明，结构化脚本状态表示和部分标签学习能有效改善开放词汇 HOI 检测的鲁棒性，减少对物体共现的过度依赖。

papers.title: Normalization Equivariance for Arbitrary Backbones, with Application to Image Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Normalization Equivariance (NE) is a structural prior that improves robustness to distribution shift in image-to-image tasks. A function $f$ is normalization equivariant iff $f(a y + b\mathbf{1}) = a f(y) + b\mathbf{1}$ for all $a>0$ and $b\in\mathbb{R}$. Existing NE methods constrain every internal layer to NE-compatible operations. These constraints add runtime cost and exclude standard transformer components such as softmax attention and LayerNorm. We introduce Wrapped Normalization Equivariance (WNE), a parameter-free wrapper that normalizes the input, applies any backbone, and denormalizes the output. We prove every NE function admits this factorization, so the wrapper exactly parameterizes the class of NE functions. On blind denoising, wrapping CNN and transformer architectures improves robustness under noise-level mismatch with no measurable GPU overhead, while architectural NE baselines are up to $1.6\times$ slower.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出包裹归一化等变性（Wrapped Normalization Equivariance, WNE），一种参数无关的包装器，通过对输入归一化、应用任意骨干网络、再反归一化输出，使整个函数满足归一化等变性。理论上证明每个归一化等变函数都可分解为此形式，从而精确参数化该类函数。在盲去噪任务中，对CNN和Transformer架构应用WNE能在噪声水平失配时提升鲁棒性，且无额外GPU开销，而架构级NE基线方法则慢至1.6倍。
Motivation: 现有归一化等变性（NE）方法要求每个内部层都与NE兼容，增加了运行时间成本，并排除了标准Transformer组件（如softmax注意力、LayerNorm）。作者希望提出一种更通用的方法，使得任意架构都能轻松获得NE性质，而不限制内部结构。
Method: 提出WNE包装器：对输入y进行归一化（减去均值除以标准差），通过任意骨干网络f处理，再反归一化（乘标准差加均值）。证明任何NE函数f均可写成此形式，因此WNE精确参数化所有NE函数。
Result: 在盲去噪任务上，对CNN和Transformer架构应用WNE，在噪声水平失配时提升鲁棒性，且不引入可测量的GPU开销；而直接约束架构的NE基线方法则慢至1.6倍。
Conclusion: WNE提供了一种简单、通用且零开销的方式使任意神经网络获得归一化等变性，尤其适用于图像到图像任务中的分布偏移鲁棒性。

papers.title: ANDRE: An Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor for Inductive Logic Programming
papers.abstract_en: Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) aims to learn interpretable first-order rules from data, but existing symbolic and neuro-symbolic approaches struggle to scale to noisy and probabilistic settings. Classical ILP relies on discrete combinatorial rule search and is brittle under uncertainty, while differentiable ILP methods typically depend on predefined rule templates or inaccurate fuzzy operators that suffer from vanishing gradients or poor approximation of logical structure when reasoning over probabilistic predicate valuations. This paper proposes an Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor (ANDRE), a novel ILP framework that learns first-order logic programs by optimizing over a continuous rule space with attention-based logical operators. ANDRE replaces both rule templates and logical operators with fully differentiable, attention-driven conjunction and disjunction operators that approximate logical min-max semantics, enabling accurate, stable, and interpretable reasoning over probabilistic data. By softly selecting, negating, or excluding predicates within each rule, ANDRE supports flexible rule induction while preserving symbolic structure. Extensive experiments on classical ILP benchmarks, large-scale knowledge bases, and synthetic datasets with probabilistic predicates and noisy supervision demonstrate that ANDRE achieves competitive or superior predictive performance while reliably recovering correct symbolic rules under uncertainty. In particular, ANDRE remains robust to moderate label noise, substantially outperforming existing differentiable ILP methods in both rule extraction quality and stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ANDRE，一种基于注意力的神经符号可微规则提取器，用于归纳逻辑编程（ILP）。它通过注意力驱动的连续逻辑运算符学习一阶逻辑程序，在概率和噪声设置下实现可解释推理。实验表明在经典ILP基准和大规模知识库上具有竞争性能，并能在中等标签噪声下可靠恢复正确符号规则。
Motivation: 现有符号和神经符号ILP方法难以扩展到噪声和概率环境，依赖于离散搜索或预定义模板，易受梯度消失或逻辑近似不准确的影响。
Method: ANDRE使用注意力机制近似逻辑min-max语义，替代传统的规则模板和逻辑运算符，实现全可微的合取和析取操作，并支持谓词的软选择、否定或排除。
Result: 在经典ILP基准、大规模知识库和含概率谓词与噪声标注的合成数据集上，ANDRE达到了有竞争性或更优的预测性能，并在中等标签噪声下可靠恢复正确符号规则，显著优于现有可微ILP方法。
Conclusion: ANDRE在不确定性下保持鲁棒性，在规则提取质量和稳定性方面优于现有可微ILP方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mesh Field Theory: Port-Hamiltonian Formulation of Mesh-Based Physics
papers.abstract_en: We present Mesh Field Theory (MeshFT) and its neural realization, MeshFT-Net: a structure-preserving framework for mesh-based continuum physics that cleanly separates the physics' topological structure from its metric structure. Imposing minimal physical principles (locality, permutation equivariance, orientation covariance, and energy balance/dissipation inequality), we prove a reduction theorem for mesh-based physics. Under these conditions, the physical dynamics admit a local factorization into a port-Hamiltonian form: the conservative interconnection is fixed uniquely by mesh topology, whereas metric effects enter only through constitutive relations and dissipation. This reduction clarifies what must be fixed and what should be learned, directly informing MeshFT-Net's design. Across evaluations on analytic and realistic datasets, physics-consistency tests, and out-of-distribution validation, MeshFT-Net achieves near-zero energy drift and strong physical fidelity (correct dispersion and momentum conservation) along with robust extrapolation and high data efficiency. By eliminating non-physical degrees of freedom and learning only metric-dependent structure, MeshFT provides a principled inductive bias for stable, faithful, and data-efficient learning-based physical simulation.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables. Accepted to ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出网格场理论 (Mesh Field Theory) 及其神经网络实现 MeshFT-Net，通过将物理的拓扑结构与度量结构解耦，在最小物理原理（局部性、置换等变性、定向协变性、能量平衡/耗散不等式）下，证明了网格物理的约化定理：动力学可分解为端口-哈密顿形式，其中保守互连由网格拓扑唯一确定，度量效应仅通过本构关系和耗散进入。在解析和真实数据集上，MeshFT-Net 实现了近乎零的能量漂移、强物理保真度（正确的色散和动量守恒）以及鲁棒的外推和高数据效率。
Motivation: 现有基于网格的物理模拟方法往往将拓扑与度量结构混杂，导致模型学习非物理的自由度，缺乏结构保持性，数据效率低且外推能力差。
Method: 基于端口-哈密顿形式 (port-Hamiltonian formulation) 分解物理动力学：保守部分由网格拓扑唯一固定，度量相关部分通过可学习的本构关系和耗散项处理；神经网络 MeshFT-Net 仅学习度量相关的结构，同时保证物理一致性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在解析和真实数据集上实现了近乎零的能量漂移、正确的色散关系和动量守恒，并在分布外验证中表现出鲁棒的外推和高数据效率。
Conclusion: Mesh Field Theory 为结构保持的网格物理模拟提供了系统的归纳偏置，通过消除非物理自由度并仅学习度量依赖结构，实现了稳定、保真且数据高效的基于学习的物理仿真。

papers.title: Necessary and sufficient conditions for universality of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
papers.abstract_en: We analyze the universal approximation property of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) in terms of their edge functions. If these functions are all affine, then universality clearly fails. How many non-affine functions are needed, in addition to affine ones, to ensure universality? We show that a single one suffices. More precisely, we prove that deep KANs in which all edge functions are either affine or equal to a fixed continuous function $σ$ are dense in $C(K)$ for every compact set $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ if and only if $σ$ is non-affine. In contrast, for KANs with exactly two hidden layers, universality holds if and only if $σ$ is nonpolynomial. We further show that the full class of affine functions is not required; it can be replaced by a finite set without affecting universality. In particular, in the nonpolynomial case, a fixed family of five affine functions suffices when the depth is arbitrary. More generally, for every continuous non-affine function $σ$, there exists a finite affine family $A_σ$ such that deep KANs with edge functions in $A_σ\cup\{σ\}$ remain universal. We also prove that KANs with the spline-based edge parameterization introduced by Liu et al.~\cite{Liu2024} are universal approximators in the classical sense, even when the spline degree and knot sequence are fixed in advance.
papers.comment: 19 pages; two corollaries from Section 6 removed and generalized in arXiv:2605.26550
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的通用逼近性质，证明当所有边函数为仿射时无法达到通用逼近，而仅需一个非仿射函数即可恢复通用逼近；深度KAN中边函数为仿射或固定连续函数σ时，充分必要条件为σ非仿射；两层KAN则要求σ非多项式。此外，仿射函数集可被有限集替代而不影响通用性，并证明了基于样条的KAN也是经典通用逼近器。
Motivation: KAN的通用逼近性质依赖于其边函数的非线性程度，明确需要多少非仿射函数才能保证通用性是理论基础的关键缺口。
Method: 通过构造和分析KAN的深度与宽度，给出边函数为仿射或固定函数σ时网络稠密性的充要条件，并研究有限仿射集替代完整仿射集的可行性。
Result: 深度KAN通用逼近当且仅当固定函数σ非仿射；两层KAN通用逼近当且仅当σ非多项式。仿射函数可简化为有限集，例如对非多项式σ，任意深度下5个仿射函数足够。
Conclusion: KAN的通用逼近能力对边函数的非线性要求非常弱，单非仿射函数即可；仿射集可被有限集替代，该结论也覆盖了基于样条的参数化方案。

papers.title: Sheaf Neural Networks on SPD Manifolds: Second-Order Geometric Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks face two fundamental challenges rooted in the linear structure of Euclidean vector spaces: (1) Current architectures represent geometry through vectors (directions, gradients), yet many tasks require matrix-valued representations that capture relationships between directions-such as how atomic orientations covary in a molecule. These second-order representations are naturally captured by points on the symmetric positive definite matrices (SPD) manifold; (2) Standard message passing applies shared transformations across edges. Sheaf neural networks address this via edge-specific transformations, but existing formulations remain confined to vector spaces and therefore cannot propagate matrix-valued features. We address both challenges by developing the first sheaf neural network operates natively on the SPD manifold. Our key insight is that the SPD manifold admits a Lie group structure, enabling well-posed analogs of sheaf operators without projecting to Euclidean space. Theoretically, we prove that SPD-valued sheaves are strictly more expressive than Euclidean sheaves: they admit consistent configurations (global sections) that vector-valued sheaves cannot represent, directly translating to richer learned representations. Empirically, our sheaf convolution transforms effectively rank-1 directional inputs into full-rank matrices encoding local geometric structure. Our dual-stream architecture achieves SOTA on 6/7 MoleculeNet benchmarks, with the sheaf framework providing consistent depth robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在SPD流形上定义了她束神经网络，利用SPD流形的李群结构，使得她束算子能够直接在流形上操作，无需投影到欧氏空间。理论上证明了SPD值她束比欧氏她束更具表达能力，能够表示向量她束无法捕捉的一致构型。实验上，双流架构在MoleculeNet基准上6/7任务达到SOTA，并展示了深度鲁棒性。
Motivation: 图神经网络受限于欧氏向量空间的线性结构：一是需要矩阵值表示（如分子中原子方向的协方差）而现有架构仅使用向量；二是标准消息传递使用共享变换，而她束网络虽引入边特定变换，但仅局限于向量空间，无法传播矩阵值特征。
Method: 利用SPD流形的李群结构，定义了她束算子的流形上类比，包括其上的连接、平行移动和聚合操作，无需投影到欧氏空间。设计了双流架构，结合秩1方向输入和全秩矩阵表示，并通过她束卷积进行信息传播。
Result: 在MoleculeNet基准上，所提方法在6/7个任务上达到当前最优（SOTA），并且她束框架提供了更深的深度鲁棒性。理论证明SPD值她束比欧氏她束严格更具表达能力。
Conclusion: SPD流形她束网络为图学习引入了二阶几何表示，在分子性质预测等任务上优于现有方法，并具有更好的深度扩展性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文首次在SPD流形上定义了她束神经网络，利用SPD流形的李群结构，使得她束算子能够直接在流形上操作，无需投影到欧氏空间。理论上证明了SPD值她束比欧氏她束更具表达能力，能够表示向量她束无法捕捉的一致构型。实验上，双流架构在MoleculeNet基准上6/7任务达到SOTA，并展示了深度鲁棒性。

papers.title: Efficient Diffusion Models under Nonconvex Equality and Inequality constraints via Landing
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling within constrained sets is essential for scientific and engineering applications involving physical, geometric, or safety requirements (e.g., molecular generation, robotics). We present a unified framework for constrained diffusion models on generic nonconvex feasible sets $Σ$ that simultaneously enforces equality and inequality constraints throughout the diffusion process. Our framework incorporates both overdamped and underdamped dynamics for forward and backward sampling. A key algorithmic innovation is a computationally efficient landing mechanism that replaces costly and often ill-defined projections onto $Σ$, ensuring feasibility without iterative Newton solves or projection failures. By leveraging underdamped dynamics, we accelerate mixing toward the prior distribution, effectively alleviating the high simulation costs typically associated with constrained diffusion. Empirically, this approach reduces function evaluations and memory usage during both training and inference while preserving sample quality. On benchmarks featuring equality and mixed constraints, our method achieves comparable sample quality to state-of-the-art baselines while significantly reducing computational cost, providing a practical and scalable solution for diffusion on nonconvex feasible sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，用于在非凸可行集上同时施加等式和不等式约束的扩散模型，并引入了一种计算高效的着陆机制（landing mechanism），避免了代价高昂的投影操作。通过利用欠阻尼动力学加速混合，减少了训练和推理中的函数评估次数和内存使用，同时保持了样本质量。
Motivation: 现有约束扩散模型在处理非凸可行集时，常需要昂贵的投影或迭代牛顿求解，且容易失败，限制了其在科学和工程中的应用。
Method: 提出一种着陆机制替代投影，结合过阻尼和欠阻尼动力学进行前向和反向采样，实现约束扩散。
Result: 在包含等式和混合约束的基准测试中，该方法在样本质量上与最先进的基线相当，但显著降低了计算成本。
Conclusion: 该框架为在非凸可行集上进行扩散提供了一个实用且可扩展的解决方案，尤其适用于需要物理、几何或安全约束的生成任务。

papers.title: Dual-Anchoring: Addressing State Drift in Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an agent to navigate through 3D environments by following natural language instructions. While recent Video Large Language Models(Video-LLMs) have largely advanced VLN, they remain highly susceptible to State Drift in long scenarios. In these cases, the agent's internal state drifts away from the true task execution state, leading to aimless wandering and failure to execute essential maneuvers in the instruction. We attribute this failure to two distinct cognitive deficits: Progress Drift, where the agent fails to distinguish completed sub-goals from remaining ones, and Memory Drift, where the agent's history representations degrade, making it lose track of visited landmarks. In this paper, we propose a Dual-Anchoring Framework that explicitly anchors the instruction progress and history representations. First, to address progress drift, we introduce Instruction Progress Anchoring, which supervises the agent to generate structured text tokens that delineate completed versus remaining sub-goals. Second, to mitigate memory drift, we propose Memory Landmark Anchoring, which utilizes a Landmark-Centric World Model to retrospectively predict object-centric embeddings extracted by the Segment Anything Model, compelling the agent to explicitly verify past observations and preserve distinct representations of visited landmarks. Facilitating this framework, we curate two extensive datasets: 3.6 million samples with explicit progress descriptions, and 937k grounded landmark data for retrospective verification. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate the superiority of our method, achieving a 15.2% improvement in Success Rate and a remarkable 24.7% gain on long-horizon trajectories. To facilitate further research, we will release our code, data generation pipelines, and the collected datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中的状态漂移问题，提出双锚定框架（Dual-Anchoring Framework），包括指令进度锚定（Instruction Progress Anchoring）和记忆地标锚定（Memory Landmark Anchoring）。前者通过生成结构化文本标记区分已完成和未完成的子目标，后者利用地标中心世界模型回顾预测由Segment Anything模型提取的物体中心嵌入，以保持对已访问地标的清晰表征。还构建了360万条进度描述样本和93.7万条地标数据的两个数据集。在仿真和真实环境中，该方法在成功率上提升15.2%，在长轨迹任务上提升24.7%。
Motivation: 现有的基于视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）的VLN方法在处理长场景时容易发生状态漂移，导致智能体内部状态偏离真实执行状态，表现为无目标漫游和无法执行指令中的关键操作。论文将这种失败归因于两种认知缺陷：进度漂移（无法区分已完成和剩余子目标）和记忆漂移（历史表征退化，丢失对已访问地标的跟踪）。
Method: 提出双锚定框架：1）指令进度锚定，监督智能体生成结构化文本标记，明确描述已完成与剩余的子目标；2）记忆地标锚定，利用地标中心世界模型回顾预测由Segment Anything模型提取的物体中心嵌入，迫使智能体显式验证过去观察并保持已访问地标的独特表征。同时，构建了包含360万条进度描述样本和93.7万条地标数据的两个数据集。
Result: 在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，该方法在成功率上提升15.2%，在长轨迹任务上提升24.7%。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过显式锚定指令进度和历史表征可以有效缓解VLN中的状态漂移，并计划开源代码、数据生成流程和收集的数据集以促进进一步研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Perspective on Bias in Biomedical AI: Preventing Downstream Healthcare Disparities
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare disparities persist across socioeconomic boundaries, often attributed to unequal access to screening, diagnostics, and therapeutics. However, this perspective highlights that critical biases can emerge much earlier, during data collection and research prioritization, long before clinical implementation, particularly in studies focused on molecular and omics data. A vast number of studies focus on collecting omics data, but the demographic information associated with these datasets is often not reported, and when it is reported, it reveals substantial biases. An automated analysis of 4514 PubMed-indexed omics publications from 2015 to 2024, examining reporting across multiple demographic dimensions, reveals limited reporting overall; for example, only 2.7% of studies report ancestry or ethnicity information and geographic origin reporting is limited to 2.5%. Analysis of large-scale datasets commonly used for model training, such as CellxGene and GEO, reveals substantial population bias where European-ancestry data dominates. As biomedical foundation models become central to biomedical discovery with a paradigm in which base models are pretrained on large datasets and reusing them repeatedly for many different downstream tasks, they risk perpetuating or amplifying these early-stage biases, leading to cascading inequities that regulatory interventions cannot fully reverse. We propose a community-wide focus on three foundational principles: Provenance, Openness, and Reliability through Evaluation Transparency. Together, these principles can help make biases and limitations more visible to model developers and users, supporting more informed model development, evaluation, and deployment decisions in biomedical AI.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Digital Health (ICDH). The final version will appear in IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇视角文章，指出生物医学AI中的偏见源于数据收集和研究优先级阶段，尤其在分子和组学数据中。通过对2015-2024年间4514篇PubMed索引组学出版物的自动分析，发现只有2.7%报告了祖先或种族信息，2.5%报告了地理来源。大规模数据集（如CellxGene、GEO）中欧洲血统数据占主导。作者认为，生物医学基础模型可能放大这些早期偏见，导致下游医疗不平等，并提出三项原则：来源(Provenance)、开放性(Openness)和通过评估透明度实现可靠性(Reliability through Evaluation Transparency)。
Motivation: 医疗不平等常归因于筛查、诊断和治疗的可及性不均，但本文强调偏见可能在数据收集和研究优先级阶段更早出现，尤其是在组学数据研究中，人口统计信息报告不足且存在显著偏见。
Method: 本文为视角文章，未提出具体技术方法，而是基于对4514篇PubMed索引组学出版物的自动分析以及大型数据集（CellxGene、GEO）的偏见评估，提出三项原则（来源、开放性和可重复性）以应对偏见。
Result: 自动分析显示，2015-2024年间组学出版物中仅2.7%报告祖先或种族信息，2.5%报告地理来源；大型数据集中欧洲血统数据占主导，存在显著人口偏见。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁社区关注来源、开放性和评估透明度三原则，以帮助模型开发者和用户识别偏见和局限性，促进更知情的模型开发、评估和部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vibe-driven model-based engineering
papers.abstract_en: There is a pressing need for better development methods and tools to keep up with the growing demand and increasing complexity of new software systems. New types of user interfaces, the need for intelligent components, sustainability concerns, etc. bring new challenges that we need to handle. In the last years, model-driven engineering (MDE), including its latest incarnation, i.e. low/no-code development, has been key to improving the quality and productivity of software development, but models themselves are becoming increasingly complex to specify and manage. At the same time, we are witnessing the growing popularity of vibe coding approaches that rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform natural language descriptions into running code at the expense of potential code vulnerabilities, scalability issues and maintainability concerns. While many may think vibe coding will replace model-based engineering, in this paper we argue that, in fact, the two approaches can complement each other and provide altogether different development paths for different types of software systems, development scenarios, and user profiles. In this sense, we introduce the concept of \textit{vibe-driven model-based engineering} as a novel approach to integrate the best of both worlds (AI and MDE) to accelerate the development of reliable complex systems. We outline the key concepts of this new approach and highlight the opportunities and open challenges it presents for the future of software development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“vibe驱动的模型驱动工程”概念，认为模型驱动工程（MDE）与大语言模型（LLM）驱动的vibe coding可以互补，而非替代。论文概述了该新方法的关键概念，并指出机遇与挑战。

Conclusion: 作者认为两种方法互补，可加速可靠复杂系统的开发，并指出未来研究方向。

papers.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer for Muscle-Actuated Robots via Generalized Actuator Networks
papers.abstract_en: Tendon drives paired with soft muscle actuation enable faster and safer robots while potentially accelerating skill acquisition. Still, these systems are rarely used in practice due to inherent nonlinearities, friction, and hysteresis, which complicate modeling and control. So far, these challenges have hindered policy transfer from simulation to real systems. To bridge this gap, we propose a sim-to-real pipeline that learns a neural network model of this complex actuation and leverages established rigid body simulation for the arm dynamics and interactions with the environment. Our method, called Generalized Actuator Network (GenAN), enables actuation model identification across a wide range of robots by learning directly from joint position trajectories rather than requiring torque sensors. Using GenAN on PAMY2, a tendon-driven robot powered by pneumatic artificial muscles, we successfully deploy dynamic but precise goal-reaching, ball-in-a-cup, and table tennis policies, trained entirely in simulation. To the best of our knowledge, this result constitutes the first successful sim-to-real transfer for a four-degrees-of-freedom muscle-actuated robot arm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对肌腱驱动软肌肉机器人从仿真到现实的策略迁移困难，提出了一种名为广义执行器网络（Generalized Actuator Network, GenAN）的方法。GenAN直接学习执行器模型，无需扭矩传感器，仅从关节位置轨迹即可识别执行器特性，并与刚体仿真结合实现策略迁移。在PAMY2机器人（气动人工肌肉驱动的四自由度肌腱驱动臂）上，成功在仿真中训练并部署了动态目标到达、接球和乒乓球策略，据作者称这是首次在四自由度肌肉驱动臂上实现sim-to-real迁移。
Motivation: 肌腱驱动与软肌肉执行器虽有安全、高速的优势，但因非线性、摩擦和迟滞导致建模困难，此前阻碍了仿真策略向真实系统的迁移。
Method: 提出广义执行器网络（GenAN），从关节位置轨迹直接学习执行器非线性模型，无需扭矩传感器；将学习到的执行器模型与标准刚体仿真结合，形成完整的sim-to-real流水线。
Result: 在PAMY2机器人上成功部署了完全在仿真中训练的动态且精准的目标到达、接球和乒乓球策略，实现了四自由度肌肉驱动臂的首次sim-to-real迁移。
Conclusion: GenAN为肌腱驱动软肌肉机器人的sim-to-real迁移提供了一种可行方案，可扩展到多种机器人平台，但摘要未提及在更复杂任务或高精度要求下的局限性。

summary_sections.method: 提出广义执行器网络（GenAN），从关节位置轨迹直接学习执行器非线性模型，无需扭矩传感器；将学习到的执行器模型与标准刚体仿真结合，形成完整的sim-to-real流水线。
summary_sections.result: 在PAMY2机器人上成功部署了完全在仿真中训练的动态且精准的目标到达、接球和乒乓球策略，实现了四自由度肌肉驱动臂的首次sim-to-real迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: GenAN为肌腱驱动软肌肉机器人的sim-to-real迁移提供了一种可行方案，可扩展到多种机器人平台，但摘要未提及在更复杂任务或高精度要求下的局限性。

papers.title: Frequency-Enhanced Diffusion Models: Curriculum-Guided Semantic Alignment for Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Human action recognition is pivotal in computer vision, with applications ranging from surveillance to human-robot interaction. Despite the effectiveness of supervised skeleton-based methods, their reliance on exhaustive annotation limits generalization to novel actions. Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition (ZSAR) emerges as a promising paradigm, yet it faces challenges due to the spectral bias of diffusion models, which oversmooth high-frequency dynamics. Here, we propose Frequency-Aware Diffusion for Skeleton-Text Matching (FDSM), integrating a Semantic-Guided Spectral Residual Module, a Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Loss, and Curriculum-based Semantic Abstraction to address these challenges. Our approach effectively recovers fine-grained motion details, achieving state-of-the-art performance on NTU RGB+D, PKU-MMD, and Kinetics-skeleton datasets. Code has been made available at https://github.com/yuzhi535/FDSM. Project homepage: https://yuzhi535.github.io/FDSM.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对零样本骨架动作识别中扩散模型的高频动态过平滑问题（谱偏置），提出频率感知扩散模型FDSM，集成语义引导谱残差模块、时间步自适应谱损失和基于课程学习的语义抽象。在NTU RGB+D、PKU-MMD和Kinetics-skeleton三个数据集上达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有零样本骨架动作识别依赖的扩散模型存在谱偏置，导致高频运动细节被过度平滑，限制了模型对未见动作的泛化能力。
Method: 提出FDSM框架，包括Semantic-Guided Spectral Residual Module（语义引导谱残差模块）增强高频信号，Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Loss（时间步自适应谱损失）平衡不同频率成分，以及Curriculum-based Semantic Abstraction（基于课程学习的语义抽象）逐步提升语义对齐。
Result: 在NTU RGB+D、PKU-MMD和Kinetics-skeleton数据集上达到SOTA性能，验证了方法在恢复细粒度运动动态方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 频率感知机制与课程学习语义抽象能有效缓解扩散模型谱偏置，提升零样本骨架动作识别精度；代码已开源。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Learning meets Genetic Programming: Analyzing Alignment in Latent Space Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover mathematical expressions from data, a task traditionally tackled using Genetic Programming (GP) through combinatorial search over symbolic structures. Latent Space Optimization (LSO) methods use neural encoders to map symbolic expressions into continuous spaces, transforming the combinatorial search into continuous optimization. SNIP (Meidani et al., 2024), a contrastive pre-training model inspired by CLIP, advances LSO by introducing a multi-modal approach: aligning symbolic and numeric encoders in a shared latent space to learn the phenotype-genotype mapping, enabling optimization in the numeric space to implicitly guide symbolic search. However, this relies on fine-grained cross-modal alignment, whereas literature on similar models like CLIP reveals that such an alignment is typically coarse-grained. In this paper, we investigate whether SNIP delivers on its promise of effective bi-modal optimization for SR. Our experiments show that: (1) cross-modal alignment does not improve during optimization, even as fitness increases, and (2) the alignment learned by SNIP is too coarse to efficiently conduct principled search in the symbolic space. These findings reveal that while multi-modal LSO holds significant potential for SR, effective alignment-guided optimization remains unrealized in practice, highlighting fine-grained alignment as a critical direction for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态潜在空间优化方法SNIP在符号回归中的跨模态对齐效果。实验发现，SNIP在优化过程中跨模态对齐并未提升，且对齐过于粗糙，无法有效引导符号空间搜索，表明多模态LSO虽然潜力巨大，但有效的对齐引导优化尚未实现。
Motivation: 符号回归的传统方法基于遗传编程的组合搜索，而潜在空间优化通过神经编码器将表达式映射到连续空间。SNIP引入多模态对齐，但类似CLIP的模型通常只能实现粗粒度对齐，因此需要验证SNIP是否真正实现了有效的双模态优化。
Method: 使用SNIP（基于对比学习的多模态预训练模型，受CLIP启发）进行符号回归实验，通过分析优化过程中的跨模态对齐程度和搜索效率来评估其性能。
Result: 实验表明：(1) 即使在适应度提升的情况下，跨模态对齐并未改善；(2) SNIP学习的对齐过于粗糙，无法有效指导符号空间中的原则性搜索。
Conclusion: 多模态潜在空间优化在符号回归中具有潜力，但目前有效对齐引导的优化尚未实现，细粒度对齐是未来关键研究方向。

papers.title: PECKER: A Precisely Efficient Critical Knowledge Erasure Recipe For Machine Unlearning in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning (MU) has become a critical technique for GenAI models' safe and compliant operation. While existing MU methods are effective, most impose prohibitive training time and computational overhead. Our analysis suggests the root cause lies in poorly directed gradient updates, which reduce training efficiency and destabilize convergence. To mitigate these issues, we propose PECKER, an efficient MU approach that matches or outperforms prevailing methods. Within a distillation framework, PECKER introduces a saliency mask to prioritize updates to parameters that contribute most to forgetting the targeted data, thereby reducing unnecessary gradient computation and shortening overall training time without sacrificing unlearning efficacy. Our method generates samples that unlearn related class or concept more quickly, while closely aligning with the true image distribution on CIFAR-10 and STL-10 datasets, achieving shorter training times for both class forgetting and concept forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PECKER，一种针对扩散模型机器遗忘的高效方法，利用显著性掩码（saliency mask）指引梯度更新，在蒸馏框架下减少不必要的计算，加速遗忘，同时保持生成分布质量。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法训练时间长、计算开销大，根源在于梯度更新方向不佳，导致训练效率低和收敛不稳定。
Method: 在知识蒸馏框架内引入显著性掩码，优先更新对遗忘目标数据贡献最大的参数，从而减少不必要的梯度计算，缩短训练时间，同时保持遗忘效果。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和STL-10数据集上，PECKER在类遗忘和概念遗忘任务中达到更短的训练时间，且生成样本更接近真实图像分布，遗忘性能匹配或超越现有方法。
Conclusion: 显著性掩码引导的梯度更新是一种高效且有效的机器遗忘策略，能够在不牺牲效果的前提下降低计算开销。

papers.title: Targeted Remasking: Replacing Token Editing with Token-to-Mask Refinement in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete masked diffusion language models such as LLaDA generate text through iterative denoising, where mask tokens are progressively replaced with predicted tokens. LLaDA2.1 introduced a Token-to-Token (T2T) editing mechanism that accelerates generation by directly replacing committed tokens suspected of being incorrect. However, we identify fundamental limitations of T2T editing: it couples error detection with replacement, pollutes the generation context with potentially incorrect tokens, and introduces a train-inference noise mismatch where systematic model-generated errors differ from the random perturbations seen during training. We propose Token-to-Mask (T2M) remasking, a training-free, drop-in replacement for T2T editing that resets suspected erroneous tokens back to the mask state, allowing the diffusion process to re-predict them under cleaner context. We design and empirically validate three complementary error detection strategies -- probability-based, trigger-mirrored, and temporal-difference-based -- and provide a unified theoretical analysis showing that T2M remasking purifies the generation context, converts systematic inference errors back to the model's native mask noise type, and enables delayed commitment for joint multi-position optimization. Comprehensive experiments across 12 benchmarks spanning knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, coding, and instruction following show that T2M generally improves performance on tasks requiring precise token-level output, with the largest gain on mathematics (+5.92% on CMATH). Error analysis on CMATH reveals that the dominant failure mode is last-mile token corruption -- where correct reasoning produces a corrupted final answer -- and that T2M repairs 59.4% of such cases.
papers.comment: This paper has been significantly revised, expanded, and superseded by a more comprehensive version available at arXiv:2604.18738. The authors have chosen to withdraw this version to avoid overlap and direct readers to the updated work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLaDA2.1中Token-to-Token (T2T)编辑机制的局限性，提出Token-to-Mask (T2M) remasking方法，训练无关且可直接替换T2T。T2M将疑似错误token重置为mask状态，让扩散过程在更干净的上下文中重新预测。实验在12个基准上显示改进，数学任务提升+5.92%，修复59.4%的last-mile token corruption。注意：本文已被作者撤回，更全面的版本见arXiv:2604.18738。
Motivation: T2T编辑耦合了错误检测与替换，将可能错误的token引入生成上下文，并导致训练-推理噪声不匹配，限制了离散扩散语言模型的生成质量。
Method: 提出T2M remasking，无需训练，直接替换T2T。设计了三种互补的错误检测策略：基于概率、触发镜像和时序差分，并进行统一理论分析，证明T2M能净化上下文、将推理错误转换为模型原生mask噪声，并实现延迟提交以联合优化多位置。
Result: 在12个基准（知识、推理、数学、编程、指令跟随）上，T2M在需要精确token输出的任务中普遍提升性能，数学基准CMATH上提升+5.92%，且59.4%的last-mile token corruption被修复。
Conclusion: T2M remasking作为T2T的无训练替代方案，能有效改善离散扩散模型的生成准确性，尤其适用于精确token级输出任务；但本文已被作者撤回，建议参考更新版本。

papers.title: MMTalker: Multiresolution 3D Talking Head Synthesis with Multimodal Feature Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Speech-driven three-dimensional (3D) facial animation synthesis aims to build a mapping from one-dimensional (1D) speech signals to time-varying 3D facial motion signals. Current methods still face challenges in maintaining lip-sync accuracy and producing realistic facial expressions, primarily due to the highly ill-posed nature of this cross-modal mapping. In this paper, we introduce a novel 3D audio-driven facial animation synthesis method through multi-resolution representation and multi-modal feature fusion, called MMTalker which can accurately reconstruct the rich details of 3D facial motion. We first achieve the continuous representation of 3D face with details by mesh parameterization and non-uniform differentiable sampling. The mesh parameterization technique establishes the correspondence between UV plane and 3D facial mesh and is used to offer ground truth for the continuous learning. Differentiable non-uniform sampling enables precise facial detail acquisition by setting learnable sampling probability in each triangular face. Next, we employ residual graph convolutional network and dual cross-attention mechanism to extract discriminative facial motion feature from multiple input modalities. This proposed multimodal fusion strategy takes full use of the hierarchical features of speech and the explicit spatiotemporal geometric features of facial mesh. Finally, a lightweight regression network predicts the vertex-wise geometric displacements of the synthesized talking face by jointly processing the sampled points in the canonical UV space and the encoded facial motion features. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that significant improvements are achieved over state-of-the-art methods, especially in the synchronization accuracy of lip and eye movements.
papers.comment: This article presents only the preliminary research results, which are not yet complete and lack necessary supplementary experiments. The author has decided to withdraw it to improve the research work, and will submit a more complete version in the future
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多分辨率表示和多模态特征融合的语音驱动3D人脸动画合成方法MMTalker。通过网格参数化和非均匀可微采样实现3D人脸连续细节表示，利用残差图卷积网络和双交叉注意力机制融合语音与面部几何特征，最终预测顶点位移。实验显示在唇部和眼部运动同步准确性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有语音驱动3D人脸动画方法在唇同步准确性和面部表情真实性上仍面临挑战，主要由于跨模态映射的病态性。
Method: 提出MMTalker，包含三部分：1) 通过网格参数化和非均匀可微采样建立3D人脸连续表示；2) 使用残差图卷积网络和双交叉注意力机制从多模态输入中提取面部运动特征；3) 轻量回归网络在规范UV空间联合处理采样点和编码特征，预测顶点位移。
Result: 综合实验表明，该方法在唇部和眼部运动同步准确性上显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 多分辨率表示和多模态特征融合可提升语音驱动3D人脸动画的细节重建和同步精度。

papers.title: Retrieval-aligned Tabular Foundation Models Enable Robust Clinical Risk Prediction in Electronic Health Records Under Real-world Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Clinical prediction from structured electronic health records (EHRs) is challenging due to high dimensionality, heterogeneity, class imbalance, and distribution shift. While tabular in-context learning (TICL) and retrieval-augmented methods perform well on generic benchmarks, their behavior in clinical settings remains unclear. We present a multi-cohort EHR benchmark comparing classical, deep tabular, and TICL models across varying data scale, feature dimensionality, outcome rarity, and cross-cohort generalization. PFN-based TICL models are sample-efficient in low-data regimes but degrade under naive distance-based retrieval as heterogeneity and imbalance increase. We propose AWARE, a task-aligned retrieval framework using supervised embedding learning and lightweight adapters. AWARE improves AUPRC by up to 12.2% under extreme imbalance, with gains increasing with data complexity. Our results identify retrieval quality and retrieval-inference alignment as key bottlenecks for deploying tabular in-context learning in clinical prediction.

papers.title: FlowIt: Global Matching via Hierarchical Transformers and Optimal Transport for Optical Flow
papers.abstract_en: We present FlowIt, a novel architecture for optical flow estimation that combines global matching with confidence and occlusion-guided refinement. At its core, FlowIt leverages a hierarchical transformer architecture that captures extensive global context, enabling the model to effectively model long-range correspondences. To overcome the limitations of localized matching, we formulate the flow initialization as an optimal transport problem. This formulation yields a highly robust initial flow field, alongside explicitly derived occlusion and confidence maps. These cues are then seamlessly integrated into a guided refinement stage, where the network actively propagates reliable motion estimates from high-confidence regions into ambiguous, low-confidence areas. Extensive experiments across the Sintel, KITTI, Spring, and LayeredFlow datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach. FlowIt achieves state-of-the-art results on the competitive Sintel benchmark and establishes new state-of-the-art cross-dataset zero-shot generalization performance on Sintel, Spring, and LayeredFlow, while also delivering competitive performance on both the KITTI benchmark and KITTI zero-shot generalization settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowIt，一种结合全局匹配与置信度/遮挡引导细化的光流估计架构。其核心是分层 transformer 捕获全局上下文，并通过最优传输计算初始流场，同时显式导出遮挡与置信度图，用于引导细化阶段从高置信度区域向低置信度区域传播运动。在 Sintel、KITTI、Spring 和 LayeredFlow 数据集上，FlowIt 在 Sintel 基准上达到最先进结果，并在跨数据集零样本泛化上创下新纪录。
Motivation: 现有光流方法受限于局部匹配，难以建模长距离对应并处理遮挡区域，导致对困难区域估计不准确。
Method: 构建分层 transformer 以获取全局上下文，将流初始化建模为最优传输问题，从而得到鲁棒的初始流场及显式的遮挡和置信度图；随后在引导细化阶段，网络依据置信度将可靠运动传播到模糊区域。
Result: 在 Sintel 基准上取得最先进结果；在 Sintel、Spring 和 LayeredFlow 上首次实现跨数据集零样本泛化最先进性能；在 KITTI 基准和零样本设置中也展现竞争力。
Conclusion: 实验表明，结合全局匹配与遮挡/置信度引导细化能有效提升光流估计的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

papers.title: Incentives, Equilibria, and the Limits of Healthcare AI: A Game-Theoretic Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Using a stylised coordination problem drawn from inpatient capacity management, three archetypal forms of AI deployment are described: effort-reducing technologies, observability-oriented systems, and interventions that alter underlying incentive structures. Effort reduction and observability may improve performance within existing patterns of behaviour but do not, in general, change which actions are individually rational. As a result, such interventions are typically absorbed into existing equilibria. By contrast, interventions that modify how local actions map to downstream consequences by redistributing or bounding local risk can change stable system behaviour. These mechanism-level interventions differ not in technical sophistication but in their interaction with institutional incentives. The analysis suggests that expectations of system-level gains from AI should be conditioned on whether a deployment changes incentives rather than optimising tasks or information flows alone. For healthcare organisations and policymakers, this has practical implications for procurement, governance, and evaluation of digital technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个住院容量管理的协调问题，从博弈论角度分析三种AI部署形式：减少努力、增强可观测性、改变激励机制。指出前两种通常被现有均衡吸收，唯有改变激励的机制干预能改变稳定系统行为。强调AI系统效益取决于是否改变激励，而非单纯优化任务或信息流。
Motivation: 现有医疗AI部署常忽略与制度激励的互动，导致预期系统效益未能实现。需要理解AI干预如何影响个体理性行为与系统均衡。
Method: 使用博弈论中的协调问题模型，对比三种理想类型的AI部署：减少努力、增强可观测性、修改激励结构。分析每种类型对个体理性行为和系统均衡的影响。
Result: 减少努力和增强可观测性的AI被现有均衡吸收，不改变行为；只有修改风险分配或边界的机制干预才能改变稳定系统行为。
Conclusion: 对AI系统效益的期望应基于其是否改变激励，而非单纯优化任务或信息。对医疗机构采购、治理和评估有实践启示。

papers.title: OpenDPR: Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Vision-Centric Diffusion-Guided Prototype Retrieval for Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) seeks to recognize arbitrary changes of interest by enabling generalization beyond a fixed set of predefined classes. We reformulate OVCD as a two-stage pipeline: first generate class-agnostic change proposals using visual foundation models (VFMs) such as SAM and DINOv2, and then perform category identification with vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP. We reveal that category identification errors are the primary bottleneck of OVCD, mainly due to the limited ability of VLMs based on image-text matching to represent fine-grained land-cover categories. To address this, we propose OpenDPR, a training-free vision-centric diffusion-guided prototype retrieval framework. OpenDPR leverages diffusion models to construct diverse prototypes for target categories offline, and to perform similarity retrieval with change proposals in the visual space during inference. The secondary bottleneck lies in change localization, due to the inherent lack of change priors in VFMs. To bridge this gap, we design a spatial-to-change weakly supervised change detection module named S2C to adapt their strong spatial modeling capabilities for change localization. Integrating the pretrained S2C into OpenDPR leads to an optional weakly supervised variant named OpenDPR-W, which further improves OVCD with minimal supervision. Experimental results on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve state-of-the-art performance under both supervision modes. Code is available at https://github.com/guoqi2002/OpenDPR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpenDPR，一种无需训练、以视觉为中心的扩散引导原型检索框架，用于遥感图像开放词汇变化检测。该方法利用SAM和DINOv2等视觉基础模型生成类不可知变化提议，再通过扩散模型构建目标类别原型进行视觉相似性检索，以解决视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在细粒度土地覆盖类别表征上的不足。此外，设计了S2C模块增强变化定位，并衍生出弱监督变体OpenDPR-W。在四个基准数据集上取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 当前开放词汇变化检测的瓶颈在于视觉-语言模型在细粒度土地覆盖类别上的识别能力不足，以及视觉基础模型缺乏变化先验导致变化定位不准。需要一种无需训练的方法来提升类别识别和变化定位性能。
Method: 提出两阶段流水线：先由视觉基础模型生成类不可知变化提议，再通过扩散模型离线构建目标类别原型库，并在推理时与变化提议进行视觉空间相似性检索。对于变化定位，设计空间到变化的弱监督变化检测模块S2C，整合后得到可选弱监督变体OpenDPR-W。
Result: 在四个基准数据集上，OpenDPR及OpenDPR-W在无监督和弱监督模式下均取得最先进性能。代码已开源。
Conclusion: 证明扩散模型可用于构建类别原型，结合视觉基础模型可在无需训练条件下有效提升开放词汇变化检测精度。弱监督变体进一步降低监督成本。

papers.title: Learning to Trim: End-to-End Causal Graph Pruning with Dynamic Anatomical Feature Banks for Medical VQA
papers.abstract_en: Medical Visual Question Answering (MedVQA) models often exhibit limited generalization due to reliance on dataset-specific correlations, such as recurring anatomical patterns or question-type regularities, rather than genuine diagnostic evidence. Existing causal approaches are typically implemented as static adjustments or post-hoc corrections. To address this issue, we propose a Learnable Causal Trimming (LCT) framework that integrates causal pruning into end-to-end optimization. We introduce a Dynamic Anatomical Feature Bank (DAFB), updated via a momentum mechanism, to capture global prototypes of frequent anatomical and linguistic patterns, serving as an approximation of dataset-level regularities. We further design a differentiable trimming module that estimates the dependency between instance-level representations and the global feature bank. Features highly correlated with global prototypes are softly suppressed, while instance-specific evidence is emphasized. This learnable mechanism encourages the model to prioritize causal signals over spurious correlations adaptively. Experiments on VQA-RAD, SLAKE, SLAKE-CP and PathVQA demonstrate that LCT consistently improves robustness and generalization over existing debiasing strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学视觉问答（MedVQA）模型过度依赖数据集特定相关性（如重复解剖模式）而非真实诊断证据的问题，提出可学习因果剪枝（LCT）框架。通过动态解剖特征库（DAFB）和可微分剪枝模块，在端到端优化中抑制与全局原型高度相关的特征，强调实例级证据。实验表明该方法在多个MedVQA基准上提升了鲁棒性和泛化性。
Motivation: 现有MedVQA模型常利用数据集中的虚假相关性（如频繁出现的解剖结构或问题类型规律）进行预测，而非真正的因果诊断证据，导致泛化能力差。现有的因果方法多为静态调整或事后修正，无法在训练中动态适应。
Method: 提出可学习因果剪枝（LCT）框架，包含动态解剖特征库（DAFB）和可微分剪枝模块。DAFB通过动量机制更新，捕捉数据集级别的全局原型；剪枝模块估计实例级表示与全局特征库的依赖关系，对高相关特征进行软抑制，突出实例级因果证据。
Result: 在VQA-RAD、SLAKE、SLAKE-CP和PathVQA数据集上，LCT在鲁棒性和泛化性上一致优于现有去偏策略。
Conclusion: LCT通过端到端可学习的因果剪枝机制，有效减轻了模型对虚假相关性的依赖，提升了MedVQA的因果推理能力。

papers.title: Limits of Spatial Imagery Reasoning in Frontier LLM Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, yet they struggle with spatial tasks that require mental simulation, such as mental rotation. This paper investigates whether equipping an LLM with an external ``Imagery Module'' -- a tool capable of rendering and rotating 3D models -- can bridge this gap, functioning as a ``cognitive prosthetic.'' We conducted experiments using a dual-module architecture in which a reasoning module (an MLLM) interacts with an imagery module on 3D model rotation tasks. Performance was lower than expected, with accuracy reaching at most 62.5%. Further investigation suggests that even when the burden of maintaining and manipulating a holistic 3D state is outsourced, the system still fails. This reveals that current frontier models lack the foundational visual-spatial primitives required to interface with imagery. Specifically, they lack: (1) the low-level sensitivity to extract spatial signals such as (a) depth, (b) motion, and (c) short-horizon dynamic prediction; and (2) the capacity to reason contemplatively over images, dynamically shifting visual focus and balancing imagery with symbolic and associative information.
papers.comment: 25 pages. v2: Title updated; added a section on object/spatial imagery and propositional reasoning; added new experimental results for the single-object rotation probe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了前沿大语言模型在空间想象推理上的局限性，特别是通过外部“想象模块”（Imagery Module）进行3D模型旋转任务。实验采用双模块架构，准确率最高仅62.5%，表明即使将空间状态维护外包，模型仍因缺乏视觉空间基元而失败。

Method: 采用双模块架构：推理模块（多模态大语言模型MLLM）与想象模块（能够渲染和旋转3D模型的工具）协作，在3D模型旋转任务上进行实验。
Result: 准确率最高仅达62.5%，表明系统即使在外部化空间状态维护后仍然失败。
Conclusion: 分析认为前沿模型缺乏与想象交互所需的视觉空间基元，包括低层空间信号提取能力和对图像进行沉思推理的能力。

summary_sections.motivation: 当前大语言模型在需要心理模拟的空间任务（如心理旋转）上表现欠佳，本文旨在探究通过外部工具（想象模块）是否能弥补这一差距。
summary_sections.method: 采用双模块架构：推理模块（多模态大语言模型MLLM）与想象模块（能够渲染和旋转3D模型的工具）协作，在3D模型旋转任务上进行实验。
summary_sections.result: 准确率最高仅达62.5%，表明系统即使在外部化空间状态维护后仍然失败。
summary_sections.conclusion: 分析认为前沿模型缺乏与想象交互所需的视觉空间基元，包括低层空间信号提取能力和对图像进行沉思推理的能力。

papers.title: Large Language Model Guided Incentive Aware Reward Design for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Designing effective auxiliary rewards for cooperative multi-agent systems remains challenging, as misaligned incentives can induce suboptimal coordination, particularly when sparse task rewards provide insufficient grounding for coordinated behavior. This study introduces an autonomous reward design framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to synthesize executable reward programs from environment instrumentation. The procedure constrains candidate programs within a formal validity envelope and trains policies from scratch using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) under a fixed computational budget. The candidates are then evaluated on the basis of their performance, and selection across generations solely based on the sparse task returns. The framework is evaluated in four Overcooked-AI layouts characterized by varying levels of corridor congestion, handoff dependencies, and structural asymmetries. The proposed reward design approach consistently yields higher task returns and delivery counts, with the most pronounced gains observed in environments dominated by interaction bottlenecks. Diagnostic analysis of the synthesized shaping components reveals stronger interdependence in action selection and improved signal alignment in coordination-intensive tasks. These results demonstrate that the proposed LLM-guided reward search framework mitigates the need for manual engineering while producing shaping signals compatible with cooperative learning under finite budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个利用大语言模型（LLM）自动为合作多智能体系统设计辅助奖励的框架。该框架从环境仪表中生成可执行的奖励程序，在形式有效性约束下使用MAPPO训练策略，并仅基于稀疏任务回报选择候选奖励。在Overcooked-AI的四种布局中，该方法提升了任务回报和交付数量，尤其在交互瓶颈紧密的环境中效果最显著。
Motivation: 合作多智能体系统中设计有效的辅助奖励极具挑战性，因为不对齐的激励会导致次优协调，而稀疏的任务奖励无法为协调行为提供足够的基础。
Method: 提出自主奖励设计框架，利用LLM从环境仪表合成为可执行的奖励程序；将候选程序限制在形式有效性包络内，在固定计算预算下使用MAPPO从头训练策略；根据稀疏任务回报跨代选择候选奖励。
Result: 在Overcooked-AI四个布局中，该方法始终获得更高的任务回报和交付数量，在交互瓶颈环境中增益最显著；诊断分析显示合成的奖励成分提高了动作选择的相互依赖性和信号对齐。
Conclusion: 所提出的LLM引导的奖励搜索框架减少了手动工程需求，同时产生与有限预算下的合作学习兼容的塑形信号。

papers.title: AgentDS Technical Report: Benchmarking the Future of Human-AI Collaboration in Domain-Specific Data Science
papers.abstract_en: Data science plays a critical role in transforming complex data into actionable insights across numerous domains. Recent developments in large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence (AI) agents have significantly automated data science workflow. However, it remains unclear to what extent AI agents can match the performance of human experts on domain-specific data science tasks, and in which aspects human expertise continues to provide advantages. We introduce AgentDS, a benchmark and competition designed to evaluate both AI agents and human-AI collaboration performance in domain-specific data science. AgentDS consists of 17 challenges across six industries: commerce, food production, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, and retail banking. We conducted an open competition involving 29 teams and 80 participants, enabling systematic comparison between human-AI collaborative approaches and AI-only baselines. Our results show that current AI agents struggle with domain-specific reasoning.AI-only baselines perform below the top quartile of competition participants, while the strongest solutions arise from human-AI collaboration. These findings challenge the narrative of complete automation by AI and underscore the enduring importance of human expertise in data science, while illuminating directions for the next generation of AI. Visit the AgentDS website here: https://agentds.org/ and open source datasets here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lainmn/AgentDS .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍AgentDS，一个用于评估AI代理和人类-AI协作在领域特定数据科学任务上表现的基准测试和竞赛。基准包含17个来自六个行业（商业、食品生产、医疗、保险、制造、零售银行）的挑战，并通过29支队伍和80名参与者的开放竞赛进行系统比较。结果显示当前AI代理在领域特定推理上表现不佳，纯AI基线低于参赛者的前25%，而最强解决方案来自人类-AI协作。
Motivation: 尽管AI代理在自动化数据科学工作流方面取得进展，但AI代理在领域特定数据科学任务上能否匹配人类专家表现，以及人类专业知识在哪些方面仍具优势，尚不明确。
Method: 构建AgentDS基准测试，包含17个跨六个行业的领域特定数据科学挑战；举办开放竞赛，比较人类-AI协作方法与纯AI基线。
Result: 纯AI基线表现低于参赛者中位数以上；最强解决方案来自人类-AI协作，挑战了AI完全自动化的叙事。
Conclusion: 人类专业知识在数据科学领域仍至关重要，研究为下一代AI发展指明了方向。

papers.title: OpenHospital: A Thing-in-itself Arena for Evolving and Benchmarking LLM-based Collective Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based Collective Intelligence (CI) presents a promising approach to overcoming the data wall and continuously boosting the capabilities of LLM agents. However, there is currently no dedicated arena for evolving and benchmarking LLM-based CI. To address this gap, we introduce OpenHospital, an interactive arena where physician agents can evolve CI through interactions with patient agents. This arena employs a data-in-agent-self paradigm that rapidly enhances agent capabilities and provides robust evaluation metrics for benchmarking both medical proficiency and system efficiency. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of OpenHospital in both fostering and quantifying CI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为解决基于大语言模型的集体智能（LLM-based CI）缺乏专用演化和基准测试平台的问题，提出了OpenHospital交互式竞技场。在该竞技场中，医生代理通过与患者代理互动来演化集体智能，采用数据-代理-内部（data-in-agent-self）范式快速提升代理能力，并提供稳健的评估指标用于医疗熟练度和系统效率的基准测试。实验表明OpenHospital在促进和量化集体智能方面有效。
Motivation: 目前缺乏专门的平台来演化和基准测试基于大语言模型的集体智能，限制了该领域的发展。
Method: 提出OpenHospital竞技场，其中医生代理与患者代理进行交互，采用data-in-agent-self范式，并设计评估指标以衡量医疗熟练度和系统效率。
Result: 实验验证了OpenHospital在促进和量化集体智能方面的有效性。
Conclusion: OpenHospital为LLM-based集体智能的演化和基准测试提供了一个有效的平台。

papers.title: ES-Merging: Biological MLLM Merging via Embedding Space Signals
papers.abstract_en: Biological multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as powerful foundation models for scientific discovery. However, existing models are specialized to a single modality, limiting their ability to solve inherently cross-modal scientific problems. While model merging is an efficient method to combine the different modalities into a unified MLLM, existing methods rely on input-agnostic parameter space heuristics that fail to faithfully capture modality specialization. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Embedding-Signal-based MLLM Merging (ES-Merging), a framework that estimates merging coefficients from embedding space signals, moving the merging paradigm from the parameter signals to the embedding signals. ES-Merging exploits coarse-grained and fine-grained signals from embedding space to estimate the layer-wise and element-wise merging coefficients, respectively, which are jointly combined for complementary coefficient estimation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that ES-Merging outperforms existing merging methods not only on the cross-modal reasoning but also on the single-modal knowledge preservation, establishing that embedding space signals provide a principled and effective foundation for MLLM merging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生物多模态大模型（MLLM）合并中现有参数空间启发式方法的局限，提出ES-Merging框架，利用嵌入空间信号（粗粒度和细粒度）估计逐层和逐元素的合并系数。实验表明，ES-Merging在跨模态推理和单模态知识保留上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有生物MLLM专精于单一模态，难以应对固有跨模态的科学问题；而现有模型合并方法依赖输入无关的参数空间启发式，无法准确捕捉模态专长。
Method: 提出ES-Merging，从嵌入空间信号中估计合并系数：利用粗粒度信号估计逐层系数，利用细粒度信号估计逐元素系数，并联合两者实现互补估计。
Result: 实验证明ES-Merging在跨模态推理和单模态知识保留上均优于现有合并方法。
Conclusion: 嵌入空间信号为MLLM合并提供了原则性强且有效的基础。

papers.title: On Information Self-Locking in Reinforcement Learning for Active Reasoning of LLM agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a de facto paradigm for building LLM-based agents that act, interact, and reason over extended task horizons. However, in active reasoning where agents must elicit new observations through interaction with the environment to solve the task, we find that outcome-based RL can induce a systematic failure mode which we call information self-locking (SeL): agents fail both to elicit informative feedback and to internalize obtained evidence. To understand the issue, we trace agentic behaviors into two coupled capabilities: Action Selection (AS), which determines observation streams, and Belief Tracking (BT), which updates the agent's internal task understanding. Theoretical and empirical analyses reveal a bidirectional bottleneck that leads to SeL: weak BT obscures the credit of informative actions, while weak AS deprives BT of useful evidence. This coupling weakens the learning signal for both capabilities and leads to SeL. To mitigate this issue, we propose AREW, a simple yet effective Advantage Reweighting method that uses easy-to-obtain directional critiques to reallocate credit within trajectories. Extensive experiments across 9 agentic tasks of varying complexity show that AREW significantly mitigates SeL, yielding up to 60-point gains in final performance. Code is available at https://github.com/unimpor/T3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现，在基于强化学习(RL)训练LLM代理进行主动推理时，存在一种称为信息自锁(SeL)的系统性失败模式：代理既无法引发信息性反馈，也无法内化已获得的证据。通过将代理行为分解为动作选择(AS)和信念追踪(BT)两个耦合能力，理论和实证分析揭示了双向瓶颈导致SeL。为解决该问题，提出AREW方法，利用易获取的方向性批评重新分配轨迹内的信用。在9个不同复杂度的代理任务上，AREW显著缓解SeL，最终性能提升高达60分。
Motivation: 现有基于结果的RL在训练LLM代理进行主动推理时，代理往往无法有效获取和利用新信息，导致任务失败。需要理解这一失败模式的根源并提出缓解方法。
Method: 提出AREW(Advantage Reweighting)方法，利用易获取的方向性批评(如正确/错误判断)来重新分配轨迹内不同步骤的信用，从而打破动作选择与信念追踪之间的双向瓶颈。
Result: 在9个不同复杂度的代理推理任务上，AREW显著缓解信息自锁，最终性能提升最高达60个百分点。
Conclusion: 信息自锁是RL训练LLM代理进行主动推理时的关键失败模式，AREW提供了一种简单有效的缓解方案。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的信用分配策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SmartThinker: Progressive Chain-of-Thought Length Calibration for Efficient Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) like OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1 achieve high accuracy on complex tasks by adopting long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning paths. However, the inherent verbosity of these processes frequently results in redundancy and overthinking. To address this issue, existing works leverage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to reduce LRM output length, but their static length reward design cannot dynamically adapt according to the relative problem difficulty and response length distribution, causing over-compression and compromised accuracy. Therefore, we propose SmartThinker, a novel GRPO-based efficient reasoning method with progressive CoT length calibration. SmartThinker makes a two-fold contribution: First, it dynamically estimates the optimal length with peak accuracy during training and guides overlong responses toward it to reduce response length while sustaining accuracy. Second, it dynamically modulates the length reward coefficient to avoid the unwarranted penalization of correct reasoning paths. Extensive experiment results show that SmartThinker achieves up to 52.5% average length compression with improved accuracy, and achieves up to 16.6% accuracy improvement on challenging benchmarks like AIME25. The source code can be found at https://github.com/SJTU-RTEAS/SmartThinker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SmartThinker，一种基于 GRPO 的渐进式思维链长度校准方法，旨在减少大推理模型（LRM）在复杂任务中的冗余推理长度，同时保持或提升准确率。SmartThinker 动态估计最优推理长度并调整长度奖励系数，避免对正确推理路径的不当惩罚。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上实现高达 52.5% 的长度压缩和 16.6% 的准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有 LRM 在复杂任务中采用长思维链导致冗余和过度思考，而基于 GRPO 的长度压缩方法因静态奖励设计无法适应问题难度和响应长度分布，造成过度压缩和准确率下降。
Method: 提出 SmartThinker，包含两个贡献：1）动态估计训练中达到峰值准确率的最优长度，引导过长响应向该长度靠拢；2）动态调整长度奖励系数，避免惩罚正确的推理路径。
Result: 在多个基准上实现平均 52.5% 的长度压缩且准确率提升，在 AIME25 等挑战性基准上准确率提升高达 16.6%。
Conclusion: SmartThinker 能有效减少 LRM 推理冗余，平衡长度与准确率，代码已开源。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SmartThinker，一种基于 GRPO 的渐进式思维链长度校准方法，旨在减少大推理模型（LRM）在复杂任务中的冗余推理长度，同时保持或提升准确率。SmartThinker 动态估计最优推理长度并调整长度奖励系数，避免对正确推理路径的不当惩罚。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上实现高达 52.5% 的长度压缩和 16.6% 的准确率提升。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LRM 在复杂任务中采用长思维链导致冗余和过度思考，而基于 GRPO 的长度压缩方法因静态奖励设计无法适应问题难度和响应长度分布，造成过度压缩和准确率下降。
summary_sections.method: 提出 SmartThinker，包含两个贡献：1）动态估计训练中达到峰值准确率的最优长度，引导过长响应向该长度靠拢；2）动态调整长度奖励系数，避免惩罚正确的推理路径。

summary_sections.conclusion: SmartThinker 能有效减少 LRM 推理冗余，平衡长度与准确率，代码已开源。

papers.title: MipSLAM: Alias-Free Gaussian Splatting SLAM
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces MipSLAM, a frequency-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM framework capable of high-fidelity anti-aliased novel view synthesis and robust pose estimation under varying camera configurations. Existing 3DGS-based SLAM systems often suffer from aliasing artifacts and trajectory drift due to inadequate filtering and purely spatial optimization. To overcome these limitations, we propose an Elliptical Adaptive Anti-aliasing (EAA) algorithm that approximates Gaussian contributions via geometry-aware numerical integration, avoiding costly analytic computation. Furthermore, we present a Spectral-Aware Pose Graph Optimization (SA-PGO) module that reformulates trajectory estimation in the frequency domain, effectively suppressing high-frequency noise and drift through graph Laplacian analysis. Extensive evaluations on Replica and TUM datasets demonstrate that MipSLAM achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality and localization accuracy across multiple resolutions. Code is available at https://github.com/yzli1998/MipSLAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MipSLAM 提出了一种频率感知的3D高斯溅射SLAM框架，通过椭圆自适应抗混叠算法和频谱感知位姿图优化，实现了在不同相机配置下的高保真抗混叠新视图合成和鲁棒位姿估计。在Replica和TUM数据集上的评估表明，该方法在渲染质量和定位精度上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有基于3DGS的SLAM系统因滤波不足和纯空间优化，常出现混叠伪影和轨迹漂移，限制了高保真渲染和鲁棒定位。
Method: 提出椭圆自适应抗混叠（EAA）算法，通过几何感知数值积分近似高斯贡献，避免昂贵解析计算；提出频谱感知位姿图优化（SA-PGO）模块，在频域重构轨迹估计，通过图拉普拉斯分析抑制高频噪声和漂移。
Result: 在Replica和TUM数据集上，MipSLAM在多分辨率下均实现了最先进的渲染质量和定位精度。
Conclusion: MipSLAM通过频率感知设计有效解决了混叠和漂移问题，适用于变相机配置的SLAM场景。

papers.title: HALO: Learning Human-Robot Collaboration via Heterogeneous-Agent Lyapunov Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: To improve generalization and resilience in human-robot collaboration (HRC), robots must contend with diverse combinations of human behaviors and contexts, motivating multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). However, inherent heterogeneity between robots and humans creates a rationality gap (RG), where decentralized policy updates deviate from cooperative joint optimization. The resulting learning problem is a general-sum differentiable game, so independent policy-gradient updates can oscillate or diverge without added structure. We propose heterogeneous-agent Lyapunov policy optimization (HALO), a framework that stabilizes decentralized MARL by enforcing Lyapunov-based contraction in policy-parameter space. Unlike Lyapunov-based safe RL, which targets state/trajectory constraints in constrained Markov decision processes, HALO uses Lyapunov certification to stabilize decentralized policy learning. HALO rectifies decentralized gradients via optimal quadratic projections, ensuring monotonic contraction of RG and enabling effective exploration of open-ended interaction spaces. Extensive simulations and real-world humanoid-robot experiments show that this certified stability improves generalization and robustness in collaborative corner cases. Our project website is available at https://HaoZhang-THU.github.io/HALO/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HALO 框架，通过 Lyapunov 认证的梯度投影来稳定异构人机协作中的多智能体强化学习，解决了理性差距导致的策略振荡问题。仿真和人形机器人实验表明该方法提升了泛化性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 人机协作中机器人与人类的异构性导致理性差距，使得独立策略梯度更新在一般的可微博弈中可能振荡或发散，缺乏稳定性。
Method: 提出异构智能体 Lyapunov 策略优化 (HALO)，在策略参数空间中通过最优二次投影修正分散式梯度，强制 Lyapunov 收缩，从而单调减小理性差距并实现有效探索。
Result: 在大量仿真和真实人形机器人协作实验中，HALO 在协作 corner cases 中表现出更好的泛化性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 通过 Lyapunov 认证的梯度稳定性可以使分散式多智能体强化学习在异构人机协作中更稳定、更泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Diffusion Planners by Self-Supervised Action Gating with Energies
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion planners are a strong approach for offline reinforcement learning, but they can fail when value-guided selection favours trajectories that score well yet are locally inconsistent with the environment dynamics, resulting in brittle execution. We propose Self-supervised Action Gating with Energies (SAGE), an inference-time re-ranking method that penalises dynamically inconsistent plans using a latent consistency signal. SAGE trains a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) encoder on offline state sequences and an action-conditioned latent predictor for short horizon transitions. At test time, SAGE assigns each sampled candidate an energy given by its latent prediction error and combines this feasibility score with value estimates to select actions. SAGE can integrate into existing diffusion planning pipelines that can sample trajectories and select actions via value scoring; it requires no environment rollouts and no policy re-training. Across locomotion, navigation, and manipulation benchmarks, SAGE improves the performance and robustness of diffusion planners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE（自监督动作门控与能量），一种针对扩散规划器的推理时重排序方法，通过训练联合嵌入预测架构和动作条件潜在预测器，利用潜在预测误差作为能量惩罚动态不一致的计划，从而在无需环境回滚或策略重训练的情况下提升离线强化学习中扩散规划器的性能和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 扩散规划器在离线强化学习中可能因值引导选择偏好与本地环境动态不一致的轨迹而导致执行脆弱。
Method: SAGE在离线状态序列上训练JEPA编码器和动作条件潜在预测器，测试时为每个采样候选分配基于潜在预测误差的能量，并与值估计结合进行动作选择。
Result: 在 locomotion、navigation 和 manipulation 基准上，SAGE 提升了扩散规划器的性能和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: SAGE 可集成到现有扩散规划管道中，无需环境回滚或策略重训练，有效改善动态一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable Multimodal Gesture Recognition for Drone and Mobile Robot Teleoperation via Log-Likelihood Ratio Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Human operators are still frequently exposed to hazardous environments such as disaster zones and industrial facilities, where intuitive and reliable teleoperation of mobile robots and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is essential. In this context, hands-free teleoperation enhances operator mobility and situational awareness, thereby improving safety in hazardous environments. While vision-based gesture recognition has been explored as one method for hands-free teleoperation, its performance often deteriorates under occlusions, lighting variations, and cluttered backgrounds, limiting its applicability in real-world operations. To overcome these limitations, we propose a multimodal gesture recognition framework that integrates inertial data (accelerometer, gyroscope, and orientation) from Apple Watches on both wrists with capacitive sensing signals from custom gloves. We design a late fusion strategy based on the log-likelihood ratio (LLR), which not only enhances recognition performance but also provides interpretability by quantifying modality-specific contributions. To support this research, we introduce a new dataset of 20 distinct gestures inspired by aircraft marshalling signals, comprising synchronized RGB video, IMU, and capacitive sensor data. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves performance comparable to a state-of-the-art vision-based baseline while significantly reducing computational cost, model size, and training time, making it well suited for real-time robot control. We therefore underscore the potential of sensor-based multimodal fusion as a robust and interpretable solution for gesture-driven mobile robot and drone teleoperation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于对数似然比（LLR）融合的多模态手势识别框架，集成Apple Watch的惯性数据和定制手套的电容传感信号，用于无人机和移动机器人的免手持远程操作。实验表明该方法在计算成本、模型大小和训练时间上显著优于基于视觉的基线方法，同时保持可比的识别性能，并提供模态贡献的可解释性。
Motivation: 基于视觉的手势识别在遮挡、光照变化和杂乱背景下性能下降，限制了其在真实远程操作中的应用。
Method: 设计了一种基于对数似然比（LLR）的后期融合策略，结合来自双腕Apple Watch的惯性数据（加速度计、陀螺仪、方向）和定制手套的电容传感信号，并引入包含20种手势的新数据集（同步RGB视频、IMU和电容传感器数据）。
Result: 该框架达到了与最先进的视觉基线方法相当的识别性能，同时显著降低了计算开销、模型大小和训练时间，适用于实时机器人控制。
Conclusion: 基于传感器的多模态融合为手势驱动的移动机器人和无人机远程操作提供了一种鲁棒且可解释的解决方案。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Without Forgetting In-Context Learning: A Theoretical Analysis of Linear Attention Models
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based large language models exhibit in-context learning, enabling adaptation to downstream tasks via few-shot prompting with demonstrations. In practice, such models are often fine-tuned to improve zero-shot performance on downstream tasks, allowing them to solve tasks without examples and thereby reducing inference costs. However, fine-tuning can degrade in-context learning, limiting the performance of fine-tuned models on tasks not seen during fine-tuning. Using linear attention models, we provide a theoretical analysis that characterizes how fine-tuning objectives modify attention parameters and identifies conditions under which this leads to degraded few-shot performance. We show that fine-tuning all attention parameters can harm in-context learning, whereas restricting updates to the value matrix improves zero-shot performance while preserving in-context learning. We further show that incorporating an auxiliary few-shot loss enhances in-context learning primarily on the target task, at the expense of degraded in-context learning ability on tasks not seen during fine-tuning. We provide empirical evidence from synthetic and real-world datasets consistent with the qualitative predictions of our theory.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用线性注意力模型理论上分析微调如何影响上下文学习能力。研究发现，微调所有注意力参数会损害上下文学习，而仅更新值矩阵可以提升零样本性能且不损失上下文学习能力。添加辅助的少样本损失能增强目标任务的上下文学习，但会降低未见过任务的上下文学习能力。理论预测在合成和真实数据上得到验证。
Motivation: 实际中微调可能退化上下文学习能力，限制模型在未见过任务上的表现。本文旨在从理论上分析微调目标如何修改注意力参数，并识别导致少样本性能下降的条件。
Method: 使用线性注意力模型进行理论分析，研究不同微调策略（全参数更新 vs. 仅值矩阵更新）以及附加辅助少样本损失的影响。
Result: 理论表明微调所有注意力参数会损害上下文学习；仅更新值矩阵能提升零样本性能并保持上下文学习能力；添加辅助少样本损失提升目标任务的上下文学习但损害未见任务的上下文学习能力。实证结果与理论定性预测一致。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了微调对上下文学习能力影响的机制，为保持上下文学习的同时提升零样本性能提供了指导。

papers.title: Induction Meets Biology: Mechanisms of Repeat Detection in Protein Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Protein sequences are abundant in repeating segments, both as exact copies and as approximate segments with mutations. These repeats are important for protein structure and function, motivating decades of algorithmic work on repeat identification. Recent work has shown that protein language models (PLMs) identify repeats, by examining their behavior in masked-token prediction. To elucidate their internal mechanisms, we investigate how PLMs detect both exact and approximate repeats. We find that the mechanism for approximate repeats functionally subsumes that of exact repeats. We then characterize this mechanism, revealing two main stages: PLMs first build feature representations using both general positional attention heads and biologically specialized components, such as neurons that encode amino-acid similarity. Then, induction heads attend to aligned tokens across repeated segments, promoting the correct answer. Our results reveal how PLMs solve this biological task by combining language-based pattern matching with specialized biological knowledge, thereby establishing a basis for studying more complex evolutionary processes in PLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究蛋白质语言模型（PLM）如何检测序列中的精确重复和近似重复。发现近似重复的检测机制在功能上包含了精确重复的机制，模型先通过位置注意力头和编码氨基酸相似性的生物专门神经元构建特征，然后通过归纳头（induction heads）对齐重复片段，促进正确预测。
Motivation: 蛋白质序列中重复片段对结构和功能至关重要，但PLM检测重复的内部机制尚不明确。
Method: 通过分析PLM在掩码预测任务中的行为，结合注意力头分析和神经元分析，揭示检测重复的两阶段机制。
Result: 近似重复检测机制功能上包含精确重复；模型先利用通用位置注意力头和编码氨基酸相似性的神经元构建特征，再通过归纳头对齐重复片段。
Conclusion: PLM通过结合基于语言的模式匹配和专门的生物知识解决重复检测任务，为研究更复杂的进化过程奠定基础。

summary_sections.result: 近似重复检测机制功能上包含精确重复；模型先利用通用位置注意力头和编码氨基酸相似性的神经元构建特征，再通过归纳头对齐重复片段。
summary_sections.conclusion: PLM通过结合基于语言的模式匹配和专门的生物知识解决重复检测任务，为研究更复杂的进化过程奠定基础。

papers.title: Position: Stop Preaching and Start Practising Data Frugality for Responsible Development of AI
papers.abstract_en: This position paper argues that the machine learning community must move from preaching to practising data frugality for responsible artificial intelligence (AI) development. For too long, progress has been equated with ever-larger datasets, driving remarkable advances but now yielding increasingly diminishing performance gains alongside rising energy use and carbon emissions. While awareness of data frugal approaches has grown, their adoption has remained rhetorical, and data scaling continues to dominate development practice. We argue that this gap between preach and practice must be closed, as continued data scaling entails substantial and under-accounted environmental impacts. To ground our position, we provide indicative estimates of the energy use and carbon emissions associated with the downstream use of ImageNet-1K. We then present empirical evidence that data frugality is both practical and beneficial, demonstrating that subset selection methods can substantially reduce training energy consumption with little loss in accuracy, while also mitigating dataset bias. Finally, we outline actionable recommendations for moving data frugality from rhetorical preaching to concrete practice for responsible development of AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张机器学习社区必须将数据节俭（data frugality）从口号转化为实践，以应对大规模数据集带来的能源消耗和碳排放问题。作者估算了ImageNet-1K下游使用的能耗和碳排放，并通过实验证明子集选择方法能在几乎不损失准确性的情况下显著降低训练能耗，同时减少数据集偏差。最后提出了将数据节俭付诸实践的具体建议。
Motivation: 尽管数据节俭的意识有所增长，但实际开发中仍以不断扩大的数据集为主导，这导致了递减的性能提升和日益严重的环境问题。论文呼吁弥合口号与实践之间的差距。
Method: 论文作为立场论文，主要论述而非提出新方法。它通过估算ImageNet-1K的能耗和碳排放，并引用子集选择的实验结果来支持其论点。
Result: 估算显示大规模数据集的下游使用具有显著的能源消耗和碳排放；子集选择方法可以大幅降低训练能耗，同时保持准确性并减轻数据集偏差。
Conclusion: 论文强调数据节俭不仅是理念，更应成为负责任AI开发的实践，并给出了具体行动建议。

papers.title: Are LLMs Ready for Neural-integrated Mechanistic Modeling? A Benchmark and Agentic Framework
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in constructing mechanistic models from data. However, existing evaluations largely focus on simplified settings and fail to capture the complexity of real-world scientific modeling. In practice, such modeling often involves neural-integrated formulations, where a mechanistic model component and a neural network component are jointly constructed, leading to a significantly more complex search space. Motivated by this gap, we introduce the Neural-Integrated Mechanistic Modeling (NIMM) benchmark, which evaluates LLM-generated neural-integrated mechanistic models across three scientific domains. Experiments on NIMM reveal that existing LLM-based approaches struggle to effectively explore this complex space, resulting in limited search stability and solution quality. To address this challenge, we propose NIMMGen, a tree-guided agentic framework that enables diversified exploration via branch-level search and improves solutions through atomic model refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NIMMGen achieves state-of-the-art performance on NIMM, significantly improving search stability and solution quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了神经集成机理建模（NIMM）基准，评估LLM在三个科学领域生成神经-机理混合模型的能力。实验发现现有LLM方法在复杂搜索空间中表现不佳，稳定性与解质量有限。为此，作者提出NIMMGen，一种树引导的智能体框架，通过分支级多样化探索和原子模型精炼提升性能，在NIMM上取得了state-of-the-art结果。
Motivation: 现有LLM评估多集中于简化设置，无法反映真实科学建模中神经集成配方的复杂性，导致搜索空间巨大且现有方法难以有效探索。
Method: 提出NIMMGen，一种树引导的智能体框架，包含分支级搜索（branch-level search）进行多样化探索，以及原子模型精炼（atomic model refinement）改进解质量。
Result: NIMMGen在NIMM基准上实现了state-of-the-art性能，显著提升了搜索稳定性和解质量。
Conclusion: LLM在神经集成机理建模中仍面临挑战，但通过树引导智能体框架可以有效提升搜索效率和模型质量。

papers.title: PETS: A Principled Framework Towards Optimal Trajectory Allocation for Efficient Test-Time Self-Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling can improve model performance by aggregating stochastic reasoning trajectories. However, achieving sample-efficient test-time self-consistency under a limited budget remains an open challenge. We introduce PETS (Principled and Efficient Test-TimeSelf-Consistency), which initiates a principled study of trajectory allocation through an optimization framework. Central to our approach is the self-consistency rate, a new measure defined as agreement with the infinite-budget majority vote. This formulation makes sample-efficient test-time allocation theoretically grounded and amenable to rigorous analysis. We study both offline and online settings. In the offline regime, where all questions are known in advance, we connect trajectory allocation to crowdsourcing, a classic and well-developed area, by modeling reasoning traces as workers. This perspective allows us to leverage rich existing theory, yielding theoretical guarantees and an efficient majority-voting-based allocation algorithm. In the online streaming regime, where questions arrive sequentially and allocations must be made on the fly, we propose a novel method inspired by the offline framework. Our approach adapts budgets to question difficulty while preserving strong theoretical guarantees and computational efficiency. Experiments show that PETS consistently outperforms uniform allocation. On GPQA, PETS achieves perfect self-consistency in both settings while reducing the sampling budget by up to 75% (offline) and 55% (online) relative to uniform allocation. Code is available at https://github.com/ZDCSlab/PETS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PETS框架，通过将轨迹分配建模为优化问题，在有限预算下实现样本高效的测试时自一致性。核心是自一致性率指标，定义为与无限预算多数投票的一致性。分别在离线（已知所有问题）和在线（流式问题）场景中，连接众包理论或提出自适应算法。实验表明，PETS在GPQA上达到完美自一致性，同时相比均匀分配节省高达75%（离线）和55%（在线）的采样预算。
Motivation: 测试时扩展可通过聚合随机推理轨迹提升模型性能，但在有限预算下实现样本高效的自一致性仍具挑战。
Method: 提出自一致性率作为新指标，将离线轨迹分配问题转化为众包任务，利用多数投票算法；在线场景基于离线框架提出自适应预算分配方法。
Result: 在GPQA基准上，PETS在离线和在线设置均达到完美自一致性，相比均匀分配节省75%（离线）和55%（在线）的采样预算。
Conclusion: PETS提供了一个理论上扎实的轨迹分配框架，在测试时自一致性中实现样本高效，但实验仅针对GPQA数据集，泛化性有待验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Amortized Predictability-aware Training Framework for Time Series Forecasting and Classification
papers.abstract_en: Time series data are prone to noise in various domains, and training samples may contain low-predictability patterns that deviate from the normal data distribution, leading to training instability or convergence to poor local minima. Therefore, mitigating the adverse effects of low-predictability samples is crucial for time series analysis tasks such as time series forecasting (TSF) and time series classification (TSC). While many deep learning models have achieved promising performance, few consider how to identify and penalize low-predictability samples to improve model performance from the training perspective. To fill this gap, we propose a general Amortized Predictability-aware Training Framework (APTF) for both TSF and TSC. APTF introduces two key designs that enable the model to focus on high-predictability samples while still learning appropriately from low-predictability ones: (i) a Hierarchical Predictability-aware Loss (HPL) that dynamically identifies low-predictability samples and progressively expands their loss penalty as training evolves, and (ii) an amortization model that mitigates predictability estimation errors caused by model bias, further enhancing HPL's effectiveness. The code is available at https://github.com/Meteor-Stars/APTF.
papers.comment: This work is accepted by the proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW 2026). The code is available at the link https://github.com/Meteor-Stars/APTF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用的摊销可预测性感知训练框架 (APTF)，用于时间序列预测 (TSF) 和时间序列分类 (TSC)。该框架通过层次化可预测性感知损失 (HPL) 动态识别低可预测性样本并逐步扩大其惩罚，同时引入摊销模型来减少模型偏差导致的可预测性估计误差。实验表明，APTF 在多个基准上提升了 TSF 和 TSC 的性能。
Motivation: 时间序列数据中常存在低可预测性样本，导致训练不稳定或收敛到次优解。现有深度学习方法很少从训练角度主动识别并惩罚这些样本，因此需要一种通用框架来提升模型对高可预测性样本的关注。
Method: 提出 APTF 框架，包含两个关键设计： (i) 层次化可预测性感知损失 (HPL)，在训练过程中动态识别低可预测性样本并逐步增大其损失权重； (ii) 摊销模型，用于校正模型偏差引起的可预测性估计误差，增强 HPL 的效果。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称 APTF 在多个时间序列预测和分类基准上提升了性能。
Conclusion: APTF 是一种通用训练框架，可有效缓解低可预测性样本的负面影响，适用于时间序列预测和分类任务。代码已开源。

papers.title: SEMixer: Semantics Enhanced MLP-Mixer for Multiscale Mixing and Long-term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Modeling multiscale patterns is crucial for long-term time series forecasting (TSF). However, redundancy and noise in time series, together with semantic gaps between non-adjacent scales, make the efficient alignment and integration of multi-scale temporal dependencies challenging. To address this, we propose SEMixer, a lightweight multiscale model designed for long-term TSF. SEMixer features two key components: a Random Attention Mechanism (RAM) and a Multiscale Progressive Mixing Chain (MPMC). RAM captures diverse time-patch interactions during training and aggregates them via dropout ensemble at inference, enhancing patch-level semantics and enabling MLP-Mixer to better model multi-scale dependencies. MPMC further stacks RAM and MLP-Mixer in a memory-efficient manner, achieving more effective temporal mixing. It addresses semantic gaps across scales and facilitates better multiscale modeling and forecasting performance. We not only validate the effectiveness of SEMixer on 10 public datasets, but also on the \textit{2025 CCF AlOps Challenge} based on 21GB real wireless network data, where SEMixer achieves third place. The code is available at the link https://github.com/Meteor-Stars/SEMixer.
papers.comment: This work is accepted by the proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW 2026). The code is available at the link https://github.com/Meteor-Stars/SEMixer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEMixer，一种轻量级多尺度 MLP-Mixer 模型，用于长时间序列预测（TSF）。通过随机注意力机制（RAM）和多尺度渐进混合链（MPMC），该模型增强了对多尺度时间依赖的建模能力，并在 10 个公共数据集和 21GB 真实无线网络数据上取得竞争力，在 2025 CCF AlOps Challenge 中获得第三名。
Motivation: 时间序列中的冗余噪声和非相邻尺度间的语义鸿沟使得高效对齐和集成多尺度时序依赖具有挑战性，现有方法难以兼顾多尺度模式建模。
Method: 提出 SEMixer，包含随机注意力机制（RAM）和多尺度渐进混合链（MPMC）。RAM 通过训练时多样化补丁交互和推理时丢弃集成增强语义；MPMC 以内存高效方式堆叠 RAM 和 MLP-Mixer，实现跨越尺度的有效混合。
Result: 在 10 个公共数据集上验证有效性，并在 21GB 真实无线网络数据的 2025 CCF AlOps Challenge 中获得第三名。
Conclusion: SEMixer 通过 RAM 和 MPMC 有效解决多尺度时间序列预测中的语义鸿沟问题，并保持轻量高效。

papers.title: Visual Persuasion: What Influences Decisions of Vision-Language Models?
papers.abstract_en: The web is littered with images, once created for human consumption and now increasingly interpreted by agents using vision-language models (VLMs). These agents make visual decisions at scale, deciding what to click, recommend, or buy. Yet, we know little about the structure of their visual preferences. We introduce a framework for studying this by placing VLMs in controlled image-based choice tasks and systematically perturbing their inputs. Our key idea is to treat the agent's decision function as a latent visual utility that can be inferred through revealed preference: choices between systematically edited images. Starting from common images, such as product photos, we propose methods for visual prompt optimization, adapting text optimization methods to iteratively propose and apply visually plausible modifications using an image generation model (such as in composition, lighting, or background). We then evaluate which edits increase selection probability. Through large-scale experiments on frontier VLMs, we demonstrate that optimized edits significantly shift choice probabilities in head-to-head comparisons. We develop an automatic interpretability pipeline to explain these preferences, identifying consistent visual themes that drive selection. We argue that this approach offers a practical and efficient way to surface visual vulnerabilities, safety concerns that might otherwise be discovered implicitly in the wild, supporting more proactive auditing and governance of image-based AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，通过受控图像选择任务和系统图像编辑来推断视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉偏好。作者将模型决策视为潜在视觉效用，利用图像生成模型迭代修改产品照片的构图、光照或背景等属性，并评估哪些编辑能提高选择概率。实验表明，优化后的编辑显著改变头部比较中的选择概率，并通过自动可解释性管道识别出一致的视觉主题。该方法可用于主动发现基于图像的AI代理的视觉漏洞和安全问题。
Motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在大规模图像决策（如点击、推荐、购买）中应用广泛，但其视觉偏好的结构尚不明确，缺乏系统研究其决策受图像因素影响的方法。
Method: 将VLM的选择行为视为潜在视觉效用的体现，通过系统编辑图像（如更改构图、光照、背景）并观察选择概率变化来推断偏好。采用视觉提示优化，将文本优化方法适配为迭代提出并施加视觉上合理的修改，使用图像生成模型实现。
Result: 在主流VLM上的大规模实验表明，优化后的编辑在头部比较中显著改变了选择概率，并开发了自动化可解释性管道以识别驱动选择的一致视觉主题。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种实用且高效的方法来暴露视觉漏洞和安全问题，支持对基于图像的AI代理进行主动审计和治理。
