papers.title: Knowing Isn't Understanding: Re-grounding Generative Proactivity with Epistemic and Behavioral Insight
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI agents equate understanding with resolving explicit queries, an assumption that confines interaction to what users can articulate. This assumption breaks down when users themselves lack awareness of what is missing, risky, or worth considering. In such conditions, proactivity is not merely an efficiency enhancement, but an epistemic necessity. We refer to this condition as epistemic incompleteness: where progress depends on engaging with unknown unknowns for effective partnership. Existing approaches to proactivity remain narrowly anticipatory, extrapolating from past behavior and presuming that goals are already well defined, thereby failing to support users meaningfully. However, surfacing possibilities beyond a user's current awareness is not inherently beneficial. Unconstrained proactive interventions can misdirect attention, overwhelm users, or introduce harm. Proactive agents, therefore, require behavioral grounding: principled constraints on when, how, and to what extent an agent should intervene. We advance the position that generative proactivity must be grounded both epistemically and behaviorally. Drawing on the philosophy of ignorance and research on proactive behavior, we argue that these theories offer critical guidance for designing agents that can engage responsibly and foster meaningful partnerships.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判生成式AI代理将理解等同于解决显式查询的假设，指出当用户自身缺乏对缺失、风险或值得考虑之事的意识时，主动行为不仅是效率提升，更是认知上的必要性。作者提出“认知不完全性”概念，并主张生成式主动性需在认知和行为两个层面进行基础构建，借鉴无知哲学与主动行为研究来设计能够负责任地参与并促进有意义伙伴关系的代理。
Motivation: 现有生成式AI代理假设用户能清晰表述需求，但当用户面临未知的未知（unknown unknowns）时，这种假设失效，导致代理无法提供有意义的支持。
Method: 通过结合无知哲学（philosophy of ignorance）和主动行为研究（proactive behavior research），提出主动代理应具有认知基础（epistemic grounding）和行为基础（behavioral grounding），即对何时、如何及何种程度进行干预设定原则性约束。
Conclusion: 作者强调，生成式主动性必须同时在认知和行为上扎根，才能避免误导注意力、使用户不堪重负或引入伤害，从而实现负责任的伙伴关系。

papers.title: You Can Learn Tokenization End-to-End with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tokenization is a hardcoded compression step which remains in the training pipeline of Large Language Models (LLMs), despite a general trend towards architectures becoming increasingly end-to-end. Prior work has shown promising results at scale in bringing this compression step inside the LLMs' architecture with heuristics to draw token boundaries, and also attempts to learn these token boundaries with straight-through estimates, which treat the problem of drawing discrete token boundaries as a continuous one. We show that these token boundaries can instead be learned using score function estimates, which have tighter theoretical guarantees due to directly optimizing the problem of drawing discrete token boundaries to minimize loss. We observe that techniques from reinforcement learning, such as time discounting, are necessary to reduce the variance of this score function sufficiently to make it practicable. We demonstrate that the resultant method outperforms prior proposed straight-through estimates, both qualitatively and quantitatively at the $100$ million parameter scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用强化学习中的score function估计来端到端学习大型语言模型（LLM）的离散分词边界，替代传统的硬编码分词步骤。该方法直接优化离散边界以最小化损失，并采用时间折扣技术降低方差。在1亿参数规模的实验中，该方法在定性和定量上均优于先前提出的straight-through估计方法。
Motivation: 分词仍然是LLM训练流程中硬编码的压缩步骤，尽管模型架构趋向端到端。现有的学习方法（如straight-through估计）将离散分词边界问题近似为连续问题，缺乏理论保证。本文旨在通过直接优化离散分词边界来最小化损失。
Method: 使用score function估计（来自强化学习的策略梯度方法）来学习离散分词边界，并引入时间折扣等技术降低方差，使训练变得可行。与straight-through估计方法进行对比。
Result: 在1亿参数规模的实验中，所提方法在定性和定量性能上均优于straight-through估计方法。
Conclusion: 研究表明，通过强化学习技术可以直接优化离散分词边界，并且具有更紧的理论保证，为端到端LLM训练提供了新方向。

papers.title: Length Generalization Bounds for Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Length generalization is a key property of a learning algorithm that enables it to make correct predictions on inputs of any length, given finite training data. To provide such a guarantee, one needs to be able to compute a length generalization bound, beyond which the model is guaranteed to generalize. This paper concerns the open problem of the computability of such generalization bounds for C-RASP, a class of languages which is closely linked to transformers. A positive partial result was recently shown by Chen et al. for C-RASP with only one layer and, under some restrictions, also with two layers. We provide complete answers to the above open problem. Our main result is the non-existence of computable length generalization bounds for C-RASP (already with two layers) and hence for transformers. To complement this, we provide a computable bound for the positive fragment of C-RASP, which we show equivalent to fixed-precision transformers. For both positive C-RASP and fixed-precision transformers, we show that the length complexity is exponential, and prove optimality of the bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer模型在长度泛化上的理论界限。主要结果是证明了对于两层及以上的C-RASP语言类（与Transformer紧密相关），不存在可计算的长度泛化界限；而对C-RASP的正片段（等价于固定精度Transformer）则给出了可计算的指数复杂度界限，并证明了其最优性。
Motivation: 长度泛化是学习算法对任意长度输入正确预测的关键属性，但计算其泛化界限是一个开放问题。本文试图彻底解决C-RASP及Transformer长度泛化界限的可计算性问题。
Method: 采用形式语言与自动机理论，通过构造不可判定性归约证明非存在性，并利用有限自动机理论为C-RASP正片段设计可计算界限。
Result: 主要结论：两层C-RASP（从而Transformer）不存在可计算的长度泛化界限；而C-RASP正片段（即固定精度Transformer）存在可计算的指数长度泛化界限，且该界限是最优的。
Conclusion: 本文给出了Transformer长度泛化界限的完整理论刻画，揭示了非线性层数增加会导致不可计算性，但固定精度模型仍具有可计算保证。

papers.title: Jointly Optimizing Debiased CTR and Uplift for Coupons Marketing: A Unified Causal Framework
papers.abstract_en: In online advertising, marketing interventions such as coupons introduce significant confounding bias into Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction. Observed clicks reflect a mixture of users' intrinsic preferences and the uplift induced by these interventions. This causes conventional models to miscalibrate base CTRs, which distorts downstream ranking and billing decisions. Furthermore, marketing interventions often operate as multi-valued treatments with varying magnitudes, introducing additional complexity to CTR prediction. To address these issues, we propose the \textbf{Uni}fied \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{V}alued \textbf{T}reatment Network (UniMVT). Specifically, UniMVT disentangles confounding factors from treatment-sensitive representations, enabling a full-space counterfactual inference module to jointly reconstruct the debiased base CTR and intensity-response curves. To handle the complexity of multi-valued treatments, UniMVT employs an auxiliary intensity estimation task to capture treatment propensities and devise a unit uplift objective that normalizes the intervention effect. This ensures comparable estimation across the continuous coupon-value spectrum. UniMVT simultaneously achieves debiased CTR prediction for accurate system calibration and precise uplift estimation for incentive allocation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and industrial datasets demonstrate UniMVT's superiority in both predictive accuracy and calibration. Furthermore, real-world A/B tests confirm that UniMVT significantly improves business metrics through more effective coupon distribution.

TL;DR: 本文针对优惠券营销中点击率预测存在混杂偏差的问题，提出统一多值处理网络UniMVT，通过解耦混杂因素、全空间反事实推断、辅助强度估计和单位提升目标，同时实现去偏CTR预测和精准提升估计。在合成和工业数据集上表现优越，A/B测试提升业务指标。
Motivation: 优惠券等营销干预引入混杂偏差，导致常规CTR模型误校准，影响排序和计费；多值处理（不同优惠券面额）进一步增加复杂性。
Method: 提出UniMVT，包含解耦混杂因素与处理敏感表征、全空间反事实推断模块重构去偏基CTR和强度-响应曲线、辅助强度估计任务捕捉处理倾向、单位提升目标归一化干预效果。
Result: 合成和工业数据集上预测准确度和校准性优于基线，真实A/B测试通过更有效的优惠券分发显著提升业务指标。
Conclusion: UniMVT同时实现去偏CTR预测和精准提升估计，适用于优惠券营销场景。

papers.title: Beyond End-to-End Video Models: An LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Educational Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Although recent end-to-end video generation models demonstrate impressive performance in visually oriented content creation, they remain limited in scenarios that require strict logical rigor and precise knowledge representation, such as instructional and educational media. To address this problem, we propose LASEV, a hierarchical LLM-based multi-agent system for generating high-quality instructional videos from educational problems. LASEV formulates educational video generation as a multi-objective task that simultaneously demands correct step-by-step reasoning, pedagogically coherent narration, semantically faithful visual demonstrations, and precise audio--visual alignment. To address the limitations of prior approaches--including low procedural fidelity, high production cost, and limited controllability--LASEV decomposes the generation workflow into specialized agents that collaborate through a central Orchestrating Agent, shared production state, explicit quality gates, and iterative critique mechanisms. Specifically, the Orchestrating Agent supervises a Solution Agent for rigorous problem solving, an Illustration Agent that produces executable visualization code, and a Narration Agent for learner-oriented instructional scripts. In addition, all outputs from the working agents are subject to semantic critique, rule-based constraints, and tool-based compilation checks. Rather than directly synthesizing pixels, the system constructs a structured executable video script that is deterministically compiled into synchronized visuals and narration using template-driven assembly rules, enabling fully automated production without manual editing. In large-scale deployments, LASEV achieves a throughput exceeding one million videos per day, delivering over a 95% reduction in cost compared to current industry-standard approaches while maintaining a high acceptance rate.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACM SIGKDD 2026 (KDD '26), Applied Data Science Track. 10 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. The project is available at \url{https://robitsg.github.io/LASEV}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LASEV，一个基于LLM的多智能体系统，用于从教育问题生成高质量教学视频。它分解工作流为多个专门智能体（解决方案、插图、叙述），由中央编排智能体协调，生成结构化可执行视频脚本，并确定性编译为同步视觉和叙述。在大规模部署中，LASEV每日处理超过一百万视频，成本降低95%以上，同时保持高接受率。
Motivation: 现有端到端视频生成模型在需要严格逻辑和精确知识表示的场景（如教育视频）中表现有限，面临过程保真度低、生产成本高、可控性差等问题。
Method: LASEV将教育视频生成建模为多目标任务，通过中央编排智能体监督解决方案智能体（严格问题求解）、插图智能体（生成可执行可视化代码）和叙述智能体（面向学习者的教学脚本），并引入语义批评、规则约束和工具编译检查。系统生成结构化可执行视频脚本，通过模板驱动组装规则确定性编译为同步视觉和叙述。
Result: 在大规模部署中，LASEV每天可生成超过一百万视频，相比当前行业标准方法成本降低95%以上，同时保持高接受率。
Conclusion: LASEV通过结构化视频脚本和确定性编译，实现了教育视频的全自动生产，无需手动编辑，显著降低了成本并提高了效率。

papers.title: Both Topology and Text Matter: Revisiting LLM-guided Out-of-Distribution Detection on Text-attributed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) associate nodes with textual attributes and graph structure, enabling GNNs to jointly model semantic and structural information. Although effective on in-distribution (ID) data, GNNs often fail on out-of-distribution (OOD) nodes with unseen textual or structural patterns, producing overconfident predictions without reliable OOD detection. Existing topology-driven methods mitigate node-level bias through neighboring structures, but typically encode texts as shallow features, underutilizing semantic information. Recent LLM-based approaches instead synthesize pseudo OOD priors from textual knowledge, yet suffer from two key limitations: (1) a trade-off between reliability and informativeness, where generated OOD exposures either deviate from true OOD semantics or introduce substantial ID noise; and (2) dependence on specialized architectures, limiting compatibility with topology-level advances validated in prior work. To address these issues, we propose LG-Plug, an LLM-Guided Plug-and-play framework for TAG OOD detection. LG-Plug aligns topology and text representations to obtain fine-grained node embeddings, then constructs consensus-driven OOD exposure through clustered iterative LLM prompting. To reduce LLM query cost, it further adopts lightweight in-cluster codebooks and heuristic sampling. The generated OOD exposure acts as a regularizer that separates ID and OOD nodes, enabling seamless integration with existing detectors. Experiments on six TAG benchmarks demonstrate that LG-Plug consistently improves topology-driven OOD detectors (>7% FPR95 reduction) and surpasses prior LLM-based methods (>5% FPR95 reduction).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LG-Plug，一个基于LLM引导的即插即用框架，用于文本属性图（TAG）上的分布外（OOD）节点检测。该方法通过对齐拓扑和文本表示获得细粒度节点嵌入，并通过聚类迭代LLM提示构建共识驱动的OOD暴露，作为正则化器来分离ID和OOD节点。在六个TAG基准上，LG-Plug使拓扑驱动的OOD检测器的FPR95降低超过7%，并优于之前的LLM方法（FPR95降低超过5%）。
Motivation: 现有方法在TAG的OOD检测中存在局限：拓扑驱动方法将文本编码为浅层特征，未充分利用语义；LLM方法生成的OOD暴露要么不可靠要么含有大量ID噪声，且依赖特殊架构，难以与拓扑层面的进展兼容。
Method: LG-Plug框架：首先对齐拓扑和文本表示得到细粒度节点嵌入；然后通过聚类迭代LLM提示构建共识驱动的OOD暴露；使用轻量级簇内码本和启发式采样降低LLM查询成本；OOD暴露作为正则化器，与现有检测器无缝集成。
Result: 在六个TAG基准上，LG-Plug使拓扑驱动的OOD检测器FPR95降低超过7%，优于先前LLM方法超过5%的FPR95降低。
Conclusion: LG-Plug有效结合了拓扑和文本信息进行TAG的OOD检测，且即插即用，兼容现有检测器。

papers.title: From Noise to Order: Learning to Rank via Denoising Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: In information retrieval (IR), learning-to-rank (LTR) methods have traditionally limited themselves to discriminative machine learning approaches that model the probability of the document being relevant to the query given some feature representation of the query-document pair. In this work, we propose an alternative denoising diffusion-based deep generative approach to LTR that instead models the full joint distribution over feature vectors and relevance labels. While in the discriminative setting, an over-parameterized ranking model may find different ways to fit the training data, we hypothesize that candidate solutions that can explain the full data distribution under the generative setting are better equipped to estimate relevance. With this motivation, we propose DiffusionRank that extends TabDiff, an existing denoising diffusion-based generative model for tabular datasets, to create generative equivalents of classical discriminative pointwise and pairwise LTR objectives. We conduct thorough empirical evaluation on four standard LTR datasets to demonstrate improvements from DiffusionRank models over their discriminative counterparts. Our work points to a rich space for future research exploration on how we can leverage ongoing advancements in deep generative modeling approaches, such as diffusion, for learning-to-rank in IR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于去噪扩散生成模型（denoising diffusion）的学习排序方法 DiffusionRank，其扩展了针对表格数据的 TabDiff，生成点式和 pairwise 排序目标的生成式等价物。在四个标准 LTR 数据集上的实验表明，DiffusionRank 优于对应的判别式模型，为生成式模型用于排序提供了新方向。
Motivation: 传统学习排序方法多采用判别式机器学习，仅建模给定查询-文档特征下的相关性概率，而忽略了对特征向量与相关性标签联合分布的建模。作者假设在生成式设置下能拟合完整数据分布的候选解更擅长估计相关性。
Method: 提出 DiffusionRank，基于去噪扩散生成模型 TabDiff，构建判别式点式与 pairwise 排序目标的生成式对应版本，通过建模特征向量与标签的联合分布实现排序。
Result: 在四个标准 LTR 数据集上的实验显示，DiffusionRank 模型在排序效果上一致优于其判别式对应方法。
Conclusion: 该工作指出了利用扩散等深度生成模型进行学习排序的广阔研究空间，鼓励未来探索生成式方法在 IR 中的更多应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: APEX-SQL: Talking to the data via Agentic Exploration for Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-SQL systems powered by Large Language Models have excelled on academic benchmarks but struggle in complex enterprise environments. The primary limitation lies in their reliance on static schema representations, which fails to resolve semantic ambiguity and scale effectively to large, complex databases. To address this, we propose APEX-SQL, an Agentic Text-to-SQL Framework that shifts the paradigm from passive translation to agentic exploration. Our framework employs a hypothesis-verification loop to ground model reasoning in real data. In the schema linking phase, we use logical planning to verbalize hypotheses, dual-pathway pruning to reduce the search space, and parallel data profiling to validate column roles against real data, followed by global synthesis to ensure topological connectivity. For SQL generation, we introduce a deterministic mechanism to retrieve exploration directives, allowing the agent to effectively explore data distributions, refine hypotheses, and generate semantically accurate SQLs. Experiments on BIRD (70.65% execution accuracy) and Spider 2.0-Snow (51.01% execution accuracy) demonstrate that APEX-SQL outperforms competitive baselines with reduced token consumption. Further analysis reveals that agentic exploration acts as a performance multiplier, unlocking the latent reasoning potential of foundation models in enterprise settings. Ablation studies confirm the critical contributions of each component in ensuring robust and accurate data analysis. Our code is released at https://github.com/Tencent/APEX-SQL-Project.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出APEX-SQL，一种基于智能体探索的Text-to-SQL框架，通过假设-验证循环将模型推理接地于真实数据。在模式链接阶段，采用逻辑规划、双路径剪枝和并行数据探查；在SQL生成阶段，引入确定性检索机制以探索数据分布。实验在BIRD（70.65%）和Spider 2.0-Snow（51.01%）上取得领先执行准确率，且token消耗更低。
Motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统依赖静态模式表示，无法解决语义歧义且难以扩展至大型复杂数据库，尤其在复杂企业环境中表现不佳。
Method: 提出Agentic Exploration框架，包含模式链接和SQL生成两阶段：模式链接使用逻辑规划生成假设、双路径剪枝缩小搜索空间、并行数据探查验证列角色，最后全局合成确保拓扑连通；SQL生成采用确定性机制检索探索指令，使智能体有效探索数据分布并生成准确SQL。
Result: 在BIRD基准上达到70.65%执行准确率，在Spider 2.0-Snow上达到51.01%，均优于竞争基线且token消耗更少。
Conclusion: 智能体探索作为性能倍增器，可释放基础模型在企业环境中的推理潜力；消融研究证实各组件对鲁棒和准确数据分析的关键贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parallel Complex Diffusion for Scalable Time Series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models learn data distributions indirectly through denoising, making the difficulty of generative modeling closely tied to the dependency structure of data. For time series, strong temporal dependence forces the noise / score estimator to recover highly entangled cross-time relationships, leading to the curse of entanglement. We mitigate this burden by changing the topology of the diffusion space: the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) decomposes temporal dependencies into spectral modes, diagonalizing second-order dependency structure and better aligning the data manifold with isotropic Gaussian noise and homogeneous diffusion dynamics. However, existing frequency-aware diffusion methods mainly use the DFT to design estimator blocks under temporal DDPM/SDE frameworks, while frequency-native diffusion paths face a mathematical barrier from complex-valued dynamics. We propose PaCoDi (Parallel Complex Diffusion), a frequency-native diffusion framework that constructs the diffusion path in the spectral domain while replacing the complex-valued estimator with parallel real-valued estimators for real and imaginary components. Theoretically, we prove the statistical orthogonality of spectral Gaussian noise, establish quadrature forward transitions and conditional reverse factorization, and extend discrete PaCoDi to continuous-time spectral SDEs through a Spectral Wiener Process. We further introduce a Mean Field Theory approximation with an Interactive Correction Branch to handle marginal coupling, and exploit Hermitian symmetry to reduce 50% attention FLOPs without information loss. Extensive experiments on unconditional and conditional time series generation demonstrate superior generative quality and computational efficiency against 5 SOTA baselines in 5 benchmarks, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/RongyaoCai/PaCoDi.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2 (KDD '26). Extended Version with Full Proofs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列生成中强时间依赖导致的纠缠问题，提出频域扩散框架PaCoDi。利用离散傅里叶变换将时间依赖分解为频谱模式，并在谱域构建扩散路径，用并行实值估计器替代复值估计器。理论证明谱高斯噪声的统计正交性，并引入平均场理论近似处理边际耦合。实验表明，在5个基准上，PaCoDi在无条件和条件时间序列生成中均优于5个SOTA基线，且具有计算效率优势。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在生成时间序列时，强时间依赖迫使估计器恢复高度纠缠的跨时间关系，导致纠缠诅咒。为缓解此问题，需要改变扩散空间拓扑，利用DFT对角化二阶依赖结构，但现有频域方法多在设计估计器块上使用DFT，缺乏频域原生扩散路径并面临复值动力学的数学障碍。
Method: 提出PaCoDi（并行复扩散），在谱域构建扩散路径，将复值估计器替换为实部和虚部的并行实值估计器。理论建立谱高斯噪声的正交性、四分之一前向转移和条件反向分解，并扩展到连续时间谱随机微分方程。引入平均场理论近似与交互校正分支处理边际耦合，并利用厄米对称性减少50%注意力FLOPs。
Result: 在5个基准上对无条件和条件时间序列生成任务进行实验，PaCoDi在生成质量和计算效率方面均优于5个SOTA基线。
Conclusion: PaCoDi通过频域原生扩散路径有效减轻时间序列生成中的纠缠问题，理论完备且计算高效，为大规模时间序列生成提供了可扩展方案。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: A Task-Centric Theory for Iterative Self-Improvement with Easy-to-Hard Curricula
papers.abstract_en: Iterative self-improvement fine-tunes an autoregressive large language model (LLM) on reward-verified outputs generated by the LLM itself. In contrast to the empirical success of self-improvement, the theoretical foundation of this generative, iterative procedure in a practical, finite-sample setting remains limited. We make progress toward this goal by modeling each round of self-improvement as maximum-likelihood fine-tuning on a reward-filtered distribution and deriving finite-sample guarantees for the expected reward. Our analysis reveals an explicit feedback loop where better models accept more data per iteration, supporting sustained self-improvement while explaining eventual saturation of such improvement. Adopting a task-centric view by considering reasoning tasks with multiple difficulty levels, we further prove quantifiable conditions on model initialization, task difficulty, and sample budget where easy-to-hard curricula provably achieve better guarantees than training on fixed mixtures of tasks. Our analyses are validated through Monte-Carlo simulations and experiments spanning a synthetic graph-based reasoning task and multiple standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归大语言模型（LLM）的迭代式自改进过程，提出了一种任务中心的理论分析框架。通过将每一轮自改进建模为在奖励过滤分布上的最大似然微调，推导了期望奖励的有限样本保证。分析揭示了更好的模型每轮接受更多数据，从而支持持续改进并解释最终饱和。进一步采用任务中心视角考虑多难度推理任务，证明了易到难课程（easy-to-hard curricula）在特定条件下比固定任务混合训练具有更优保证。蒙特卡洛模拟和合成图推理及多个标准数学推理基准实验验证了理论。
Motivation: 尽管迭代式自改进在LLM中取得实证成功，但其在有限样本下的理论基础仍然薄弱，缺乏对生成式迭代过程的严谨理论分析。
Method: 将每轮自改进建模为在奖励过滤分布上的最大似然微调，从任务中心视角定义多难度推理任务，推导有限样本下的期望奖励保证，并量化模型初始化、任务难度和样本预算对易到难课程优势的影响。
Result: 理论分析表明存在反馈循环：更好的模型每轮接受更多数据，从而维持改进但最终饱和；易到难课程在满足特定条件时比固定混合训练获得更优理论保证。模拟和实验（合成图推理及多个数学推理基准）验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 本文为迭代自改进提供了有限样本理论，揭示了易到难课程的有效性条件，但分析仅限于推理任务，且未考虑资源约束或更复杂场景。

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文为迭代自改进提供了有限样本理论，揭示了易到难课程的有效性条件，但分析仅限于推理任务，且未考虑资源约束或更复杂场景。

papers.title: AnomSeer: Reinforcing Multimodal LLMs to Reason for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is an emerging area, yet a persistent challenge remains: MLLMs rely on coarse time-series heuristics but struggle with multi-dimensional, detailed reasoning, which is vital for understanding complex time-series data. We present AnomSeer to address this by reinforcing the model to ground its reasoning in precise, structural details of time series, unifying anomaly classification, localization, and explanation. At its core, an expert chain-of-thought trace is generated to provide a verifiable, fine-grained reasoning from classical analyses (e.g., statistical measures, frequency transforms). Building on this, we propose a novel time-series grounded policy optimization (TimerPO) that incorporates two additional components beyond standard reinforcement learning: a time-series grounded advantage based on optimal transport and an orthogonal projection to ensure this auxiliary granular signal does not interfere with the primary detection objective. Across diverse anomaly scenarios, AnomSeer, with Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct, outperforms larger commercial baselines (e.g., GPT-4o) in classification and localization accuracy, particularly on point- and frequency-driven exceptions. Moreover, it produces plausible time-series reasoning traces that support its conclusions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnomSeer，通过专家思维链（expert chain-of-thought）增强多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在时间序列异常检测中的精细推理能力，并引入基于最优传输（optimal transport）的时间序列地面策略优化（TimerPO）。在多个异常场景中，Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct 模型在分类和定位精度上超越 GPT-4o 等更大基线，尤其在点异常和频率异常上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在进行时间序列异常检测时依赖粗粒度启发式规则，缺乏多维度精细推理能力，难以理解复杂时间序列数据。
Method: 生成专家思维链轨迹，提供从经典分析（统计量、频率变换）到可验证推理的细粒度依据；提出 TimerPO 强化学习方法，融入基于最优传输的时间序列地面优势和正交投影，确保辅助信号不干扰主检测目标。
Result: AnomSeer (Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct) 在分类和定位精度上超过 GPT-4o 等更大商业基线，尤其在点异常和频率异常上优势明显，并产生合理的时间序列推理轨迹。
Conclusion: 将精细推理与强化学习结合可有效提升 MLLM 在时间序列异常检测中的表现，但摘要未讨论在非异常或噪声数据上的泛化性及计算开销。

papers.title: When and How Much to Imagine: Adaptive Test-Time Scaling with World Models for Visual Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in MLLMs, visual spatial reasoning remains unreliable when correct answers depend on how a scene would appear under unseen or alternative viewpoints. Recent work addresses this by augmenting reasoning with world models for visual imagination, but questions such as when imagination is actually necessary, how much of it is beneficial, and when it becomes harmful, remain poorly understood. In practice, indiscriminate imagination can increase computation and even degrade performance by introducing misleading evidence. In this work, we present an in-depth analysis of test-time visual imagination as a controllable resource for spatial reasoning. We first study when static visual evidence is sufficient, when imagination improves reasoning, and how excessive or unnecessary imagination affects accuracy and efficiency. To support this analysis, we then introduce AVIC, an adaptive test-time framework with world models that explicitly reasons about the sufficiency of current visual evidence before selectively invoking and scaling visual imagination. Finally, to further learn this gating and planning behavior without any annotation of when and how much to imagine, we introduce AVIC-R, which trains the policy via GRPO from QA-correctness rewards and penalties by imagination cost. Across spatial reasoning benchmarks (SAT, MMSI) and an embodied navigation benchmark (R2R), our results reveal clear scenarios where imagination is critical, marginal, or detrimental, and show that selective control can match or outperform fixed imagination strategies with substantially fewer world-model calls and language tokens. Our AVIC-R surpasses strong proprietary baselines including GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 while invoking the world model less often. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of analyzing and controlling test-time imagination for efficient and reliable spatial reasoning.
papers.comment: the first two authors are equally contributed. Project page: https://adaptive-visual-tts.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型在视觉空间推理中何时以及如何进行视觉想象。通过分析静态视觉证据的充分性、想象的必要性和过度想象的危害，提出自适应测试时框架AVIC，基于世界模型选择性调用和缩放想象。进一步提出AVIC-R，通过GRPO从QA正确性奖励和想象成本惩罚中学习门控与规划策略。在空间推理和具身导航基准上，选择性控制方法在减少世界模型调用和语言令牌的同时，匹配或超越固定想象策略，并超过GPT-4o和GPT-4.1等强基线。
Motivation: 视觉空间推理中，模型依赖静态视觉证据往往不可靠，但盲目使用世界模型进行想象会增加计算开销，甚至因产生误导性证据而降低性能。现有工作缺乏对何时需要想象、想象多少以及何时有害的系统理解。
Method: 提出AVIC框架，通过显式推理当前视觉证据的充分性，选择性调用世界模型并进行自适应规模的视觉想象。进一步提出AVIC-R，利用GRPO基于QA正确性奖励和想象成本惩罚训练门控和规划策略，无需人工标注。
Result: 在SAT、MMSI和R2R基准上，AVIC-R在减少世界模型调用和语言令牌的同时，匹配或优于固定想象策略，并超越GPT-4o和GPT-4.1等专有模型。
Conclusion: 选择性控制测试时想象对于高效且可靠的视觉空间推理至关重要，过度或随意的想象反而有害。

papers.title: ToolSelf: Unifying Task Execution and Self-Reconfiguration via Tool-Driven Emergent Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered agentic systems excel at complex long-horizon tasks, but remain constrained by static configurations fixed before execution. Such rigidity forces a trade-off between domain-specific performance and cross-task generalization: strong priors and compact tool spaces aid specialization but weaken transfer, while task-agnostic workflows and broad action spaces expand coverage but dilute guidance. Existing pre-execution optimization, planner-worker orchestration, and configuration patching fall short of resolving this tension, as they decouple adaptation from execution, causing information loss, fragmented optimization, and ambiguous credit assignment. We propose ToolSelf, a tool-driven runtime self-reconfiguration paradigm that abstracts configuration updates as a standardized tool interface and unifies execution and adaptation within one policy's action space. The execution agent can dynamically update sub-goals, strategies, toolboxes, context, and context-management modes based on task progress and feedback. We further introduce Configuration-Aware Two-stage Training (CAT), which combines rejection sampling fine-tuning with trajectory-level KTO reinforcement learning to internalize self-reconfiguration. Across diverse benchmarks, zero-shot ToolSelf rivals task-specialized agents; after CAT training, ToolSelf gains 28.8 points over the static-configuration baseline on average, illuminating a path toward emergent adaptivity that obviates manually injected guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM代理系统中静态配置导致的领域性能与泛化权衡问题，提出工具驱动的运行时自我重新配置范式ToolSelf，将配置更新抽象为标准工具接口，统一执行与适应。结合拒绝采样微调与KTO强化学习的配置感知两阶段训练（CAT），使零样本性能媲美任务专用代理，且平均性能比静态配置基线提升28.8分。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理系统在执行前固定配置，导致领域专用性与跨任务泛化性难以兼得；预执行优化、规划-执行分离等方案因解耦适应与执行而信息损失、优化碎片化。
Method: 提出ToolSelf范式，将配置更新作为工具接口纳入策略动作空间，运行时动态调整子目标、策略、工具箱等；配合CAT两阶段训练：先拒绝采样微调，再以轨迹级KTO强化学习内化重配置能力。
Result: 零样本场景下ToolSelf表现与任务专用代理相当；经CAT训练后在多样基准上平均比静态配置基线提升28.8百分点。
Conclusion: 该方法验证了通过运行时自配置实现涌现自适应性的可行性，无需手动注入指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Bias After Another: Mechanistic Reward Shaping and Persistent Biases in Language Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward Models (RMs) are crucial for online alignment of language models (LMs) with human preferences. However, RM-based preference-tuning is vulnerable to reward hacking, whereby LM policies learn undesirable behaviors from flawed RMs. By systematically measuring biases in five high-quality RMs, including the state-of-the-art, we find that issues persist despite prior work with respect to length, sycophancy, and overconfidence. We also discover new issues related to bias toward model-specific ``styles'' and answer-order. We categorize RM failures as tractable or resistant to linear intervention and propose a simple post-hoc intervention to mitigate low-complexity biases that arise from spurious correlations. Our proposed mechanistic reward shaping reduces targeted biases without degrading reward quality and while using minimal labeled data. The method is extensible to new biases, model-internal, and generalizes out-of-distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统测量了五个高质量奖励模型（包括SOTA）中的偏见，发现长度、谄媚、过度自信等问题依然存在，并新发现了模型特定风格和答案顺序相关偏见。作者将RM失败分类为线性可干预和抵抗线性干预两类，然后提出一种简单的后处理干预方法——机械奖励塑造（mechanistic reward shaping），以减轻由虚假相关性引起的低复杂度偏见。该方法在最小化标记数据使用的同时减少目标偏见，不损害奖励质量，可扩展至新偏见且具有分布外泛化能力。
Motivation: 基于奖励模型（RM）的偏好调优易受奖励黑客攻击，即语言模型策略从有缺陷的RM中学习不良行为。现有工作虽已指出部分偏见（如长度），但系统性测量发现这些偏见依然存在，且存在未被注意的新偏见。
Method: 首先对五个高质量RM进行系统性偏见测量；然后将RM失败分为可线性干预和抵抗线性干预两类；最后提出机械奖励塑造（mechanistic reward shaping），一种基于后处理的简单干预，针对低复杂度（线性可干预）偏见，利用最小标记数据进行修正。
Result: 该方法有效减少了目标偏见，且不降低奖励质量，在分布外场景下也能泛化。实验覆盖长度、谄媚、过度自信、模型特定风格和答案顺序等多种偏见。
Conclusion: 作者强调所提出的机械奖励塑造方法可扩展至新出现的偏见，且仅需少量标注数据，为改进RM可靠性提供了实用方案。但该方法主要针对低复杂度偏见，对抵抗线性干预的偏见可能无效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Features to Actions: Explainability in Traditional and Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Over the last decade, Explainable AI has primarily focused on interpreting individual model predictions, producing post-hoc explanations that relate inputs to outputs under a fixed decision structure. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic AI systems whose behaviour unfolds over multi-step trajectories. In these settings, success and failure are determined by sequences of decisions rather than a single output. It remains unclear how explanation approaches designed for static predictions translate to agentic settings where behaviour emerges over time. In this work, we bridge this gap by comparing attribution-based explanations with trace-based diagnostics across both settings. Our results show that while attribution methods achieve stable feature rankings in static settings (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.86), they cannot be applied reliably to diagnose execution-level failures in agentic trajectories. In contrast, trace-grounded rubric evaluation for agentic settings consistently localizes behaviour breakdowns and reveals that state tracking inconsistency is 2.7x more prevalent in failed runs and reduces success probability by 49%. These findings motivate a shift towards trajectory-level explainability for evaluating and diagnosing autonomous AI behaviour in agentic systems. Code: https://github.com/VectorInstitute/unified-xai-evaluation-framework Project page: https://vectorinstitute.github.io/unified-xai-evaluation-framework
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了基于归因的解释方法和基于轨迹的诊断方法在静态预测与代理AI系统中的应用。结果表明，归因方法在静态设置中能稳定排序特征（Spearman ρ=0.86），但无法可靠诊断代理轨迹中的执行级故障；而基于轨迹的评估能定位行为故障，并发现状态跟踪不一致在失败运行中占比高2.7倍，使成功概率降低49%。研究呼吁转向轨迹级可解释性来评估和诊断自主AI行为。
Motivation: 现有可解释AI主要针对静态模型预测，而代理AI系统的行为涉及多步决策轨迹，尚不清楚静态解释方法如何迁移到这类动态场景。
Method: 通过实验对比归因解释与基于轨迹的诊断方法在静态和代理设置中的效果，并使用轨迹导向的评分标准评估代理行为。
Result: 归因方法在静态设置中特征排序稳定（Spearman ρ=0.86），但在代理轨迹中无法可靠诊断故障；轨迹评估显示状态跟踪不一致在失败运行中发生频率高2.7倍，且使成功概率降低49%。
Conclusion: 代理AI系统需要轨迹级别的可解释性，而非仅依赖静态归因方法。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 通过实验对比归因解释与基于轨迹的诊断方法在静态和代理设置中的效果，并使用轨迹导向的评分标准评估代理行为。
summary_sections.result: 归因方法在静态设置中特征排序稳定（Spearman ρ=0.86），但在代理轨迹中无法可靠诊断故障；轨迹评估显示状态跟踪不一致在失败运行中发生频率高2.7倍，且使成功概率降低49%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 代理AI系统需要轨迹级别的可解释性，而非仅依赖静态归因方法。

papers.title: Principle-Evolvable Scientific Discovery via Uncertainty Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific agents have accelerated scientific discovery, yet they often suffer from significant inefficiencies due to adherence to fixed initial priors. Existing approaches predominantly operate within a static hypothesis space, which restricts the discovery of novel phenomena, resulting in computational waste when baseline theories fail. To address this, we propose shifting the focus from searching hypotheses to evolving the underlying scientific principles. We present PiEvo, a principle-evolvable framework that treats scientific discovery as Bayesian optimization over an expanding principle space. By integrating Information-Directed Hypothesis Selection via Gaussian Process and an anomaly-driven augmentation mechanism, PiEvo enables agents to autonomously refine their theoretical worldview. Evaluation across four benchmarks demonstrates that PiEvo (1) achieves an average solution quality of up to 90.81%~93.15%, representing a 29.7%~31.1% improvement over the state-of-the-art, (2) attains an 83.3% speedup in convergence step via significantly reduced sample complexity by optimizing the compact principle space, and (3) maintains robust performance across diverse scientific domains and LLM backbones. Code is publicly available at \hyperlink{https://github.com/amair-lab/PiEvo}{github.com/amair-lab/PiEvo}.

TL;DR: 本文提出PiEvo框架，将科学发现视为在扩展的原理空间上的贝叶斯优化，通过信息导向假设选择（高斯过程）和异常驱动增强机制，使大语言模型智能体能够自主进化其理论原理。在四个基准上，PiEvo平均方案质量达90.81%-93.15%，比现有最优方法提升29.7%-31.1%，收敛步骤加速83.3%，且在不同科学领域和LLM骨干上保持稳健性能。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的科学智能体因固守初始先验而效率低下，多在静态假设空间内操作，限制了新现象发现并造成计算浪费。
Method: 提出PiEvo框架，通过高斯过程实现信息导向假设选择，结合异常驱动增强机制，在扩展的原理空间上执行贝叶斯优化，使智能体自主优化理论世界观。
Result: 在四个基准上，方案质量达90.81%-93.15%，优于SOTA 29.7%-31.1%；样本复杂度降低使收敛步数加速83.3%；在不同科学领域和LLM骨干上表现稳健。
Conclusion: PiEvo通过原理演化而非假设搜索，显著提升科学发现效率，代码已开源。

papers.title: Tempora: Characterising the Time-Contingent Utility of Online Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a compelling remedy for machine learning (ML) models that degrade under domain shifts, improving generalisation on-the-fly with only unlabelled samples. This flexibility suits real deployments, yet conventional evaluations unrealistically assume unbounded processing time, overlooking the accuracy-latency trade-off. As ML increasingly underpins latency-sensitive and user-facing use-cases, temporal pressure constrains the viability of adaptable inference; predictions arriving too late to act on are futile. We introduce Tempora, a framework for evaluating TTA under this pressure. It consists of temporal scenarios that model deployment constraints, evaluation protocols that operationalise measurement, and time-contingent utility metrics that quantify the accuracy-latency trade-off. We instantiate the framework with three such metrics: (1) discrete utility for asynchronous streams with hard deadlines, (2) continuous utility for interactive settings where value decays with latency, and (3) amortised utility for budget-constrained deployments. By applying Tempora to 11 TTA methods, we find that rank instability persists across 750+ temporal evaluations spanning diverse datasets, models, and hardware platforms; i.e., conventional rankings do not predict rankings under temporal pressure. The highest-utility method varies with the shift and temporal pressure, with no clear winner. By enabling systematic evaluation across diverse temporal constraints for the first time, Tempora reveals when and why rankings change, offering practitioners a lens for method selection and researchers a target for deployable adaptation. Code: https://github.com/sudotensor/tempora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Tempora框架，用于评估在线测试时自适应（TTA）方法在时间压力下的性能。框架包含时间场景、评估协议和三种时效效用指标（离散效用、连续效用、摊销效用）。在11种TTA方法上的实验表明，传统排名无法预测时间压力下的排名，最高效用的方法随域偏移和时间压力变化，无明确胜者。
Motivation: 现有TTA评估假设无限处理时间，忽略了实际部署中的精度-延迟权衡，不适用于延迟敏感场景。
Method: 提出Tempora框架，包括：建模部署约束的时间场景、操作化测量的评估协议、以及量化精度-延迟权衡的时效效用指标（离散、连续、摊销效用）。
Result: 对11种TTA方法在750+时间评估中（多种数据集、模型和硬件）发现排名不稳定，传统排名不能预测时间压力下的排名，最高效用方法随域偏移和时间压力变化。
Conclusion: Tempora框架首次实现跨不同时间约束的系统评估，揭示了排名变化的原因，为实践者提供方法选择视角，为研究者提供可部署适应的优化目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inverse Depth Scaling From Most Layers Being Similar
papers.abstract_en: Neural scaling laws relate loss to model size in large language models (LLMs), yet depth and width may contribute to performance differently, requiring more detailed studies. Here, we quantify how depth affects loss via analysis of LLMs and toy residual networks. We find loss scales inversely proportional to depth in LLMs, probably due to functionally similar layers reducing error through ensemble averaging rather than compositional learning or discretizing smooth dynamics. This regime is inefficient yet robust and may arise from the architectural bias of residual networks and target functions incompatible with smooth dynamics. The findings suggest that improving LLM efficiency may require architectural innovations to encourage compositional use of depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络中深度对损失的影响，发现大型语言模型（LLM）中损失与深度成反比，可能源于功能相似层的集成平均而非组合学习，这种机制稳健但低效。
Motivation: 现有神经缩放定律将损失与模型大小关联，但深度和宽度对性能的不同贡献需要更细致的量化研究。
Method: 通过分析LLM和玩具残差网络，量化深度对损失的影响，识别出功能相似层通过集成平均降低误差的模式。
Result: 损失与深度呈反比例缩放，该模式源于残差网络的架构偏置与目标函数的不兼容，而非组合学习或平滑动力学的离散化。
Conclusion: 提高LLM效率可能需要架构创新以鼓励深度的组合使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimal Bayesian Stopping for Efficient Inference of Consistent LLM Answers
papers.abstract_en: A simple strategy for improving LLM accuracy, especially in math and reasoning problems, is to sample multiple responses and submit the answer most consistently reached. In this paper we leverage Bayesian prior information to save on sampling costs, stopping once sufficient consistency is reached. Although the exact posterior is computationally intractable, we further introduce an efficient "L-aggregated" stopping policy that tracks only the L-1 most frequent answer counts. Theoretically, we prove that L=3 is all you need: this coarse approximation is sufficient to achieve asymptotic optimality, and strictly dominates prior-free baselines, while having a fast posterior computation. Empirically, this identifies the most consistent (i.e., mode) LLM answer using fewer samples, and can achieve similar answer accuracy while cutting the number of LLM calls (i.e., saving on LLM inference costs) by up to 50%.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在数学和推理问题中通过多次采样取最一致答案的策略，提出贝叶斯最优停止方法以节省采样成本。作者引入高效的“L-聚合”停止策略，仅追踪 L-1 个最频繁答案计数，理论证明 L=3 即足以达到渐近最优性，且严格优于无先验基线。实验表明该方法在保持答案准确率的同时，可将 LLM 调用次数减少高达 50%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 通过多次采样取最一致答案可提高准确率，但采样成本高。如何利用贝叶斯先验信息在达到足够一致性时提前停止，以减少推理成本，是本文要解决的问题。
Method: 提出贝叶斯最优停止框架，由于精确后验计算困难，进一步设计“L-聚合”停止策略：仅维护最频繁的 L-1 个答案计数，并证明 L=3 时策略渐近最优，且具有快速后验计算能力。
Result: 理论证明 L=3 的策略渐近最优并严格优于无先验基线；实验表明在多项任务中，该方法可在不损失答案准确率的前提下，将 LLM 调用次数减少最多 50%。
Conclusion: 本文的 L-聚合停止策略为 LLM 推理效率提供了一种理论保证且实用的方法，特别适用于需要多次采样取一致的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation via Multi-view Progressive Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation aims to segment categories in data-scarce domains conditioned on a few exemplars. Typical methods first establish few-shot capability in a large-scale source domain and then adapt it to target domains. However, due to the limited quantity and diversity of target samples, existing methods still exhibit constrained performance. Moreover, the source-trained model's initially weak few-shot capability in target domains, coupled with substantial domain gaps, severely hinders the effective utilization of target samples and further impedes adaptation. To this end, we propose Multi-view Progressive Adaptation, which progressively adapts few-shot capability to target domains from both data and strategy perspectives. (i) From the data perspective, we introduce Hybrid Progressive Augmentation, which progressively generates more diverse and complex views through cumulative strong augmentations, thereby creating increasingly challenging learning scenarios. (ii) From the strategy perspective, we design Dual-chain Multi-view Prediction, which fully leverages these progressively complex views through sequential and parallel learning paths under extensive supervision. By jointly enforcing prediction consistency across diverse and complex views, MPA achieves both robust and accurate adaptation to target domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MPA effectively adapts few-shot capability to target domains, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin (+7.0%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多视图渐进适应方法（Multi-view Progressive Adaptation, MPA）解决跨域小样本分割问题。从数据角度引入混合渐进增强（Hybrid Progressive Augmentation）逐步生成更多样化和复杂的视图；从策略角度设计双链多视图预测（Dual-chain Multi-view Prediction）充分利用这些视图进行顺序和并行学习。实验表明MPA在多个跨域小样本分割基准上大幅超越现有方法（+7.0%）。
Motivation: 跨域小样本分割中，目标域样本数量少、多样性低，且源域预训练模型在目标域的初始小样本能力弱，域间隙大，导致现有方法性能受限且难以有效利用目标样本。
Method: 提出多视图渐进适应框架：数据视角采用混合渐进增强（累积强增强逐步生成复杂视图），策略视角采用双链多视图预测（顺序+并行学习路径，强制预测一致性）。
Result: 在多个跨域小样本分割基准上，MPA相比现有最优方法平均提升7.0%的mIoU（抽象报告的具体数值）。
Conclusion: 通过渐进增强和多视图一致性约束，MPA能有效将小样本能力适应到目标域，显著改善跨域分割性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adaptive Exploration for Latent-State Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study bandits whose rewards depend on an unobserved Markov state that evolves independently of the learner's actions. The optimal arm can change even though the learner observes only past actions and rewards. We propose algorithms that feed LinUCB with two summaries of the hidden state: a lagged action-reward pair and, when available, a probe fingerprint formed from rewards of multiple arms. The adaptive variants refresh the fingerprint using residual, margin, and staleness tests. In synthetic stress tests over state count, transition rate, noise, and horizon, these methods reduce dynamic regret relative to standard, adversarial, and non-stationary bandit baselines when the summaries distinguish states and are updated often enough. Ablations and misspecification tests identify the main failure modes: weak fingerprint separation, high noise, and state changes during sequential probes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究奖励依赖于不可观测马尔可夫状态的bandit问题，提出自适应探索算法，利用滞后动作-奖励对和探针指纹（probe fingerprint）两种隐状态摘要，并通过残差、边际和过时测试更新指纹。在合成测试中，当摘要能区分状态且更新足够频繁时，该方法在动态遗憾上优于标准、对抗和非平稳bandit基线。
Motivation: 现有bandit方法在处理奖励依赖隐状态且状态演化独立于动作的场景时，难以应对最优臂的时变，缺乏有效的自适应探索策略。
Method: 向LinUCB输入两种隐状态摘要：滞后动作-奖励对和探针指纹（多臂奖励形成的向量）。自适应变体通过残差、边际和过时测试决定何时刷新指纹。
Result: 在合成压力测试中，该方法在状态数、转移率、噪声和时域等维度上，相比于标准、对抗和非平稳bandit基线降低了动态遗憾。消融和误设测试揭示了主要失效模式：弱指纹区分性、高噪声以及顺序探测期间的状态变化。
Conclusion: 该方法在隐状态bandit中有效，但依赖良好的状态区分度和足够的更新频率，存在明确失效边界。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究奖励依赖于不可观测马尔可夫状态的bandit问题，提出自适应探索算法，利用滞后动作-奖励对和探针指纹（probe fingerprint）两种隐状态摘要，并通过残差、边际和过时测试更新指纹。在合成测试中，当摘要能区分状态且更新足够频繁时，该方法在动态遗憾上优于标准、对抗和非平稳bandit基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有bandit方法在处理奖励依赖隐状态且状态演化独立于动作的场景时，难以应对最优臂的时变，缺乏有效的自适应探索策略。
summary_sections.method: 向LinUCB输入两种隐状态摘要：滞后动作-奖励对和探针指纹（多臂奖励形成的向量）。自适应变体通过残差、边际和过时测试决定何时刷新指纹。
summary_sections.result: 在合成压力测试中，该方法在状态数、转移率、噪声和时域等维度上，相比于标准、对抗和非平稳bandit基线降低了动态遗憾。消融和误设测试揭示了主要失效模式：弱指纹区分性、高噪声以及顺序探测期间的状态变化。

papers.title: VideoBrain: Learning Adaptive Frame Sampling for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video understanding remains challenging for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) due to the inherent tension between computational constraints and the need to capture information distributed across thousands of frames. Existing approaches either sample frames uniformly (risking information loss) or select keyframes in a single pass (with no recovery from poor choices). We propose VideoBrain, an end-to-end framework that enables VLMs to adaptively acquire visual information through learned sampling policies. Our approach features dual complementary agents: a CLIP-based agent for semantic retrieval across the video and a Uniform agent for dense temporal sampling within intervals. Unlike prior agent-based methods that rely on text-only LLMs orchestrating visual tools, our VLM directly perceives frames and reasons about information sufficiency. To prevent models from invoking agents indiscriminately to maximize rewards, we introduce a behavior-aware reward function coupled with a data classification pipeline that teaches the model when agent invocation is genuinely beneficial. Experiments on four long video benchmarks demonstrate that VideoBrain achieves +3.5% to +9.0% improvement over the baseline while using 30-40\% fewer frames, with strong cross-dataset generalization to short video benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/junbo-zou/VideoBrain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoBrain，一个端到端框架，通过双智能体（CLIP 语义检索智能体与均匀时序采样智能体）实现自适应帧采样，使视觉语言模型（VLM）能够直接感知帧并推理信息充分性，从而高效处理长视频理解任务。实验表明，在四个长视频基准上，VideoBrain 使用少 30-40% 的帧即可获得 +3.5% 到 +9.0% 的性能提升，并具有良好的跨数据集泛化能力。
Motivation: 长视频理解中，均匀采样可能丢失关键信息，而单遍关键帧选择无法纠正错误。现有的基于智能体的方法依赖纯文本 LLM 编排视觉工具，效率不高。
Method: 提出双智能体框架：CLIP 智能体负责语义检索，均匀智能体负责密集时序采样；VLM 直接感知帧并判断信息充分性，结合行为感知奖励函数和数据分类管道，避免智能体滥用。
Result: 在四个长视频基准上，VideoBrain 相比基线提升 +3.5% 到 +9.0%，同时减少 30-40% 的帧使用量，在短视频基准上也表现出跨数据集泛化能力。
Conclusion: VideoBrain 通过自适应帧采样有效平衡了计算成本与信息捕获，为长视频理解提供了一种新的高效范式。

papers.title: Statistical Guarantees for Reasoning Probes on Looped Boolean Circuits
papers.abstract_en: We study the statistical behavior of reasoning probes in a stylized model of iterative computation inspired by neural algorithmic reasoning. The underlying computation is given by a looped Boolean circuit whose graph is a perfect $ν$-ary tree ($ν\ge 2$), with outputs recursively fed back as inputs across computation rounds. A probe observes a sampled subset of internal nodes and seeks to infer the latent operation at each node, represented as a probability distribution over a finite set of admissible Boolean gates. This partial observability induces a transductive generalization problem on a structured computation graph. We show that when the probe is parameterized by a graph convolutional network and queries $N$ nodes, the worst-case generalization error decays at the optimal rate $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{\log(2/δ)}/\sqrt{N})$ with probability at least $1-δ$. Our analysis combines metric embedding techniques with tools from optimal transport. A key insight is that this rate is achievable independently of the size of the computation graph, enabled by a low-distortion one-dimensional snowflake embedding of the induced graph metric. These results highlight a geometric mechanism underlying statistical efficiency in probing structured, iterative computations.

papers.title: Universal One-third Time Scaling in Learning Peaked Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) is computationally expensive, partly because the loss exhibits slow power-law convergence whose origin remains debatable. Through systematic analysis of toy models and empirical evaluation of LLMs, we show that this behavior can arise intrinsically from the use of softmax and cross-entropy. When learning peaked probability distributions, e.g., next-token distributions, these components generically yield power-law vanishing losses and gradients, regardless of many microscopic details, creating a fundamental optimization bottleneck. This ultimately leads to power-law time scaling of the loss with a universal exponent of $1/3$. Our results provide a mechanistic explanation for observed neural scaling and suggest new directions for improving LLM training efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过理论分析和实验表明，大语言模型训练中损失函数的幂律收敛（指数1/3）源于softmax与交叉熵的固有特性，在学习峰值分布（如next-token分布）时普遍出现。该结果揭示了神经缩放定律的一个机制基础，并指出了改进训练效率的方向。
Motivation: 大语言模型训练损失呈现缓慢的幂律收敛，但其起源存在争议；论文旨在从softmax和交叉熵的角度提供机制解释。
Method: 通过玩具模型的理论推导和实际LLM的实证评估，系统分析softmax与交叉熵在学习峰值分布时产生幂律消失损失和梯度的条件。
Result: 发现损失随时间幂律缩放，普适指数为1/3，且该行为不依赖于模型微观细节。
Conclusion: 该机制解释了观察到的神经缩放现象，为改进LLM训练效率提供了新的理论指导。

papers.title: Consistency Deep Equilibrium Models
papers.abstract_en: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm in deep learning, offering the ability to model infinite-depth networks with constant memory usage. However, DEQs incur significant inference latency due to the iterative nature of fixed-point solvers. In this work, we introduce the Consistency Deep Equilibrium Model (C-DEQ), a novel framework that leverages consistency distillation to accelerate DEQ inference. We cast the DEQ iterative inference process as evolution along a fixed ODE trajectory toward the equilibrium. Along this trajectory, we train C-DEQs to consistently map intermediate states directly to the fixed point, enabling few-step inference while preserving the performance of the teacher DEQ. At the same time, it facilitates multi-step evaluation to flexibly trade computation for performance gains. Extensive experiments across various domain tasks demonstrate that C-DEQs achieve consistent 2-20$\times$ accuracy improvements over implicit DEQs under the same few-step inference budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/landrarwolf/CDEQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一致性深度均衡模型（C-DEQ），通过一致性蒸馏将DEQ的迭代推理过程加速为少量步骤，同时保持精度。实验表明，在相同少步推理预算下，C-DEQ比隐式DEQ精度提升2-20倍。
Motivation: DEQ推理延迟高，因为固定点求解器需要多次迭代。
Method: 将DEQ迭代过程视为沿固定ODE轨迹演化，训练C-DEQ将中间状态直接映射到固定点，支持少步推理和灵活的多步评估。
Result: 在多种任务上，C-DEQ在相同少步推理预算下精度比隐式DEQ提升2-20倍。
Conclusion: C-DEQ能有效加速DEQ推理，且在少步场景下精度显著优于隐式DEQ。

papers.title: Breaking the Reversal Curse in Autoregressive Language Models via Identity Bridge
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in many complex tasks, yet they can still fail in very simple logical reasoning such as the "reversal curse" -- when trained on forward knowledge data of the form "$A \rightarrow B$" (e.g., Alice's husband is Bob), the model is unable to deduce the reversal knowledge "$B \leftarrow A$" (e.g., Bob's wife is Alice) during test. Extensive prior research suggests that this failure is an inherent, fundamental limit of autoregressive causal LLMs, indicating that these models tend to memorize factual-level knowledge rather than capture higher-level rules. In this paper, we challenge this view by showing that this seemingly fundamental limit can be mitigated by slightly tweaking the training data with a simple regularization data recipe called the Identity Bridge of the form "$A \to A$" (e.g., The name of Alice is Alice). Theoretically, we prove that under this recipe, even a one-layer transformer can break the reversal curse by analyzing the implicit bias of gradient descent. Empirically, we show that a 1B pretrained language model finetuned with the proposed data recipe achieves a 50% success rate on reversal tasks, in stark contrast to a near-zero success rate when trained solely on forward-knowledge data. Our work provides a novel theoretical foundation for the reversal curse and offers a principled, low-cost path to encouraging LLMs to learn higher-level rules from data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了自回归语言模型存在“反转诅咒”（无法从A→B推断出B←A）是固有限制的观点，提出通过简单的身份桥接数据配方（A→A）在训练数据中微调即可缓解。理论上证明单层Transformer在梯度下降下可打破该诅咒，实验上1B模型微调后反转任务成功率从接近0%提升到50%。
Motivation: 自回归语言模型在简单逻辑推理中会出现反转诅咒，之前研究认为这是模型固有限制，无法从事实知识中学习高级规则。本文试图推翻这一结论，探索通过数据调整来克服该限制。
Method: 提出一种名为身份桥接（Identity Bridge）的正则化数据配方，即向训练数据中添加形如“A→A”的样本，理论分析梯度下降的隐式偏差，并在1B预训练模型上进行微调实验。
Result: 采用身份桥接微调的1B模型在反转任务上达到50%成功率，而仅使用前向知识训练时成功率接近0%。
Conclusion: 反转诅咒并非自回归语言模型的固有限制，通过简单的数据正则化即可显著缓解，为促使模型学习高级规则提供了低成本的理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic Performance Guarantees for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task reinforcement learning trains generalist policies that can execute multiple tasks. While recent years have seen significant progress, existing approaches rarely provide formal performance guarantees, which are indispensable when deploying policies in safety-critical settings. We present an approach for computing high-confidence guarantees on the performance of a multi-task policy on tasks not seen during training. Concretely, we introduce a new generalisation bound that composes (i) per-task lower confidence bounds from finitely many rollouts with (ii) task-level generalisation from finitely many sampled tasks, yielding a high-confidence guarantee for new tasks drawn from the same arbitrary and unknown distribution. Across state-of-the-art multi-task RL methods, we show that the guarantees are theoretically sound and informative at realistic sample sizes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种方法，为多任务强化学习策略在训练时未见过的任务上提供高置信度性能保证。通过组合每任务的置信下界（来自有限回合）和任务级泛化（来自有限采样任务），该方法能在任意未知分布下为新任务提供理论上有保障且实际中信息量足够的保证。在多种先进多任务RL方法上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏形式化性能保证，这在安全关键部署中不可或缺。
Method: 引入一种新的泛化界，结合有限rollout得到的每任务置信下界和有限采样任务的任务级泛化，从而对新任务给出高置信度保证。
Result: 在多种先进多任务RL方法上证明该保证在理论上合理，并在现实样本量下具有信息量。
Conclusion: 该方法为多任务RL在安全关键场景中的部署提供了可形式化验证的性能保证框架。

papers.title: Visible Light Positioning With Lamé Curve LEDs: A Generic Approach for Camera Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based visible light positioning (VLP) is a promising technique for accurate and low-cost indoor camera pose estimation (CPE). To reduce the number of required light-emitting diodes (LEDs), advanced methods commonly exploit LED shape features for positioning. Although interesting, they are typically restricted to a single LED geometry, leading to failure in heterogeneous LED-shape scenarios. To address this challenge, this paper investigates Lamé curves as a unified representation of common LED shapes and proposes a generic VLP algorithm using Lamé curve-shaped LEDs, termed LC-VLP. In the considered system, multiple ceiling-mounted Lamé curve-shaped LEDs periodically broadcast their curve parameters via visible light communication, which are captured by a camera-equipped receiver. Based on the received LED images and curve parameters, the receiver can estimate the camera pose using LC-VLP. Specifically, an LED database is constructed offline to store the curve parameters, while online positioning is formulated as a nonlinear least-squares problem and solved iteratively. To provide a reliable initialization, a correspondence-free perspective-n-points (FreePnP) algorithm is further developed, enabling approximate CPE without any pre-calibrated reference points. The performance of LC-VLP is verified by both simulations and experiments. Simulations show that LC-VLP outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both circular- and rectangular-LED scenarios. Compared to a perspective arcs algorithm, LC-VLP can achieve reductions of both over 30% in average position and rotation errors. Experiments further show that LC-VLP can achieve an average position accuracy of less than 4 cm.
papers.comment: Submitted to an IEEE journal for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Lamé曲线LED的通用可见光定位方法（LC-VLP），用于相机姿态估计。该方法利用Lamé曲线统一表示常见LED形状，通过可见光通信广播曲线参数，并将定位问题建模为非线性最小二乘问题迭代求解。同时提出免对应点的PnP算法（FreePnP）以提供可靠初始化。仿真和实验表明，LC-VLP在圆形和矩形LED场景中均优于现有方法，平均位置精度小于4厘米。
Motivation: 现有基于LED形状的可见光定位方法通常局限于单一几何形状，无法处理异构LED形状场景，限制了实际部署的通用性。
Method: 将Lamé曲线作为统一表示，构建离线LED数据库存储曲线参数；在线定位利用接收到的LED图像和曲线参数，通过非线性最小二乘迭代求解相机姿态；并设计免对应点的FreePnP算法实现无预校准参考点的近似姿态估计。
Result: 仿真显示，相较于基于圆弧的方法，LC-VLP在平均位置和旋转误差上均降低超过30%；实验达到平均定位精度小于4厘米。
Conclusion: Lamé曲线能有效统一不同LED形状的表示，所提方法在异构LED场景下具有通用性和高精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LRAgent: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Role specialization in multi-LLM agent systems is often realized via multi-LoRA, where agents share a pretrained backbone and differ only by lightweight adapters. Despite sharing base model weights, each agent independently builds and stores its own KV cache for the same long, tool-augmented trajectories, incurring substantial memory and compute overhead. Existing KV cache sharing methods largely overlook this multi-LoRA setting. We observe that, cache differences across agents are dominated by adapter outputs, while activations from the shared pretrained backbone remain highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose LRAgent, a KV cache sharing framework for multi-LoRA agents. It decomposes the cache into two components, a shared base component derived from pretrained weights and an adapter-dependent component derived from LoRA weights. LRAgent reduces memory overhead by sharing the base component across agents and storing the adapter component in its inherent low-rank form. It also reduces computational overhead by sharing the low-rank cache, enabled by a shared-A multi-LoRA architecture. This avoids redundant computations for contexts that have already been processed by other agents. To efficiently reconstruct adapter contributions at runtime, we introduce Flash-LoRA-Attention, a kernel that reorders attention computation to avoid materializing the low-rank cache to full dimension. LRAgent achieves throughput and time-to-first-token latency close to fully shared caching, while preserving accuracy near the non-shared caching baseline across agentic question-answering benchmarks.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026 Poster
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LRAgent 提出一种针对多 LoRA LLM 代理的高效 KV 缓存共享框架。通过将缓存分解为共享的基部分和适配器依赖的低秩部分，并采用共享 A 的多 LoRA 架构，LRAgent 在代理问答基准上实现了接近完全共享缓存的吞吐量和首 Token 延迟，同时保持精度接近非共享缓存基线。
Motivation: 多 LoRA 代理系统中每个代理独立为相同的长工具增强轨迹存储 KV 缓存，造成大量内存和计算冗余。现有 KV 缓存共享方法未针对多 LoRA 场景进行优化。
Method: 提出 LRAgent 框架，将 KV 缓存分解为共享基部分（来自预训练权重）和适配器依赖部分（来自 LoRA 权重），并通过共享低秩缓存避免冗余计算。引入 Flash-LoRA-Attention 核，重新排序注意力计算以避免将低秩缓存扩展到全维度。
Result: 在代理问答基准上，LRAgent 的吞吐量和首 Token 延迟接近完全共享缓存，精度接近非共享缓存基线。
Conclusion: LRAgent 有效减少了多 LoRA 代理的内存和计算开销，同时保持模型精度，是实现高效多代理系统的可行方案。

papers.title: Robust Learning of a Group DRO Neuron
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning a single neuron under standard squared loss in the presence of arbitrary label noise and group-level distributional shifts, for a broad family of covariate distributions. Our goal is to identify a ''best-fit'' neuron parameterized by $\mathbf{w}_*$ that performs well under the most challenging reweighting of the groups. Specifically, we address a Group Distributionally Robust Optimization problem: given sample access to $K$ distinct distributions $\mathcal p_{[1]},\dots,\mathcal p_{[K]}$, we seek to approximate $\mathbf{w}_*$ that minimizes the worst-case objective over convex combinations of group distributions $\boldsymbolλ \in Δ_K$, where the objective is $\sum_{i \in [K]}λ_{[i]}\,\mathbb E_{(\mathbf x,y)\sim\mathcal p_{[i]}}(σ(\mathbf w\cdot\mathbf x)-y)^2 - νd_f(\boldsymbolλ,\frac{1}{K}\mathbf1)$ and $d_f$ is an $f$-divergence that imposes (optional) penalty on deviations from uniform group weights, scaled by a parameter $ν\geq 0$. We develop a computationally efficient primal-dual algorithm that outputs a vector $\widehat{\mathbf w}$ that is constant-factor competitive with $\mathbf{w}_*$ under the worst-case group weighting. Our analytical framework directly confronts the inherent nonconvexity of the loss function, providing robust learning guarantees in the face of arbitrary label corruptions and group-specific distributional shifts. The implementation of the dual extrapolation update motivated by our algorithmic framework shows promise on LLM pre-training benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在任意标签噪声和组级分布偏移下，使用平方损失学习单个神经元的问题。目标是找到在最坏组权重下表现最佳的最优神经元参数。作者提出了一个计算高效的原始-对偶算法，输出与最优解常数因子竞争的向量，并在LLM预训练基准上展示了潜力。
Motivation: 现实数据常受标签噪声和组间分布偏移影响，标准经验风险最小化可能失败。需要一种对最坏组权重鲁棒的学习方法。
Method: 针对Group DRO问题，提出一个原始-对偶算法，利用双外推更新直接应对损失函数的非凸性，并给出理论保证。
Result: 算法输出向量与最优解在常数因子内竞争，在LLM预训练基准上表现有希望。
Conclusion: 该算法能有效应对非凸损失和标签噪声，为群鲁棒学习提供了实用框架。

papers.title: Physics-Encoded Inverse Modeling for Arctic Snow Depth Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation in time-varying inverse problems under limited and sparse observations remains a fundamental challenge across scientific domains. For example, snow depth estimation requires inferring hidden parameters governing sea ice physics, which can be incorporated through physics-informed encoding. To address this challenge, we introduce Physics-Encoded Inversion (PhysE-Inv), a novel framework that combines deep sequential learning with physics-informed inference for solving inverse problems under real-world sparse observational settings. PhysE-Inv integrates an LSTM encoder-decoder to capture temporal dependencies, together with contrastive learning regularization that enforces noise-invariant latent representations. The framework learns latent parameters that, when combined with observational inputs, reconstruct snow depth while incorporating physics-informed guidance. PhysE-Inv consistently outperforms all evaluated baselines, achieving an average MSE reduction of 24.7\% across all baseline models and a 17.3\% improvement over the strongest baseline under parameter estimation settings. Overall, our work demonstrates a generalizable inverse modeling paradigm for data-scarce domains where physics-informed guidance can be incorporated into sparse observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Physics-Encoded Inversion (PhysE-Inv) 框架，结合 LSTM 编码器-解码器与对比学习正则化，解决稀疏观测下时间变化逆问题的雪深估计。在雪深预测任务上，平均 MSE 降低 24.7%，优于所有基线。
Motivation: 在稀疏观测下准确估计时间变化的逆参数（如雪深）是科学领域的挑战，现有方法难以融合物理先验。
Method: PhysE-Inv 框架：LSTM 编码器-解码器捕捉时间依赖，对比学习正则化强制噪声不变的潜在表示，并引入物理信息编码。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在雪深预测中平均 MSE 降低 24.7%，相较于最强基线提升 17.3%。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了一种适用于数据稀缺领域的通用逆建模范式，可将物理指导融入稀疏观测。

papers.title: Render-of-Thought: Rendering Textual Chain-of-Thought as Images for Visual Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has achieved remarkable success in unlocking the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). Although CoT prompting enhances reasoning, its verbosity imposes substantial computational overhead. Recent works often focus exclusively on outcome alignment and lack supervision on the intermediate reasoning process. These deficiencies obscure the analyzability of the latent reasoning chain. To address these challenges, we introduce Render-of-Thought (RoT), the first framework to reify the reasoning chain by rendering textual steps into images, making the latent rationale explicit and traceable. Specifically, we leverage the vision encoders of existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) as semantic anchors to align the vision embeddings with the textual space. This design ensures plug-and-play implementation without incurring additional pre-training overhead. Extensive experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves 3-4x token compression and substantial inference acceleration compared to explicit CoT. Furthermore, it maintains competitive performance against other methods, validating the feasibility of this paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/TencentBAC/RoT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Render-of-Thought (RoT)，将文本推理链渲染为图像，利用 VLM 的视觉编码器作为语义锚点，实现无额外预训练的即插即用。在数学和逻辑推理基准上，相比显式 CoT 实现 3-4 倍 token 压缩和推理加速，性能竞争。
Motivation: 现有 CoT 虽然提升推理但冗长导致计算开销，且缺乏对中间推理过程的监督，使得隐式推理链难以分析。
Method: 将文本推理步骤渲染成图像，使用现有 VLM 的视觉编码器作为语义锚点对齐视觉嵌入与文本空间，无需额外预训练。
Result: 在数学和逻辑推理基准上，相比显式 CoT 实现 3-4 倍 token 压缩和推理加速，性能与其它方法持平。
Conclusion: 验证了将推理链可视化作为图像进行潜在推理的范式可行性。

papers.title: SilentDrift: Exploiting Action Chunking for Stealthy Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly deployed in safety-critical robotic applications, yet their security vulnerabilities remain underexplored. We identify a fundamental security flaw in modern VLA systems: the combination of action chunking and delta pose representations creates an intra-chunk visual open-loop. This mechanism forces the robot to execute K-step action sequences, allowing per-step perturbations to accumulate through integration. We propose SILENTDRIFT, a stealthy black-box backdoor attack exploiting this vulnerability. Our method employs the Smootherstep function to construct perturbations with guaranteed C2 continuity, ensuring zero velocity and acceleration at trajectory boundaries to satisfy strict kinematic consistency constraints. Furthermore, our keyframe attack strategy selectively poisons only the critical approach phase, maximizing impact while minimizing trigger exposure. The resulting poisoned trajectories are visually indistinguishable from successful demonstrations. Evaluated on the LIBERO, SILENTDRIFT achieves a 93.2% Attack Success Rate with a poisoning rate under 2%, while maintaining a 95.3% Clean Task Success Rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）中动作分块（action chunking）与增量位姿表示（delta pose representations）结合产生的安全漏洞，并提出一种名为SilentDrift的隐蔽后门攻击方法。该方法利用Smootherstep函数构造C2连续的扰动，保证轨迹边界的速度和加速度为零，并通过关键帧攻击策略仅污染关键接近阶段。在LIBERO基准上，攻击成功率93.2%，污染率低于2%，同时保持95.3%的清洁任务成功率。
Motivation: VLA模型在安全关键机器人应用中部署，但其安全漏洞未被充分探索。本文识别出动作分块与增量位姿表示结合产生的视觉开环机制，可被用于后门攻击。
Method: 提出SilentDrift攻击，使用Smootherstep函数构造C2连续扰动以满足运动学一致性约束，并采用关键帧攻击策略仅污染关键接近阶段，减少触发器暴露。
Result: 在LIBERO基准上，SilentDrift以低于2%的污染率达到93.2%的攻击成功率，同时保持95.3%的清洁任务成功率。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了VLA模型的安全脆弱性，并证明存在高效隐蔽的后门攻击方法，提示未来需加强此类系统的安全性。

papers.title: MASCOT: Towards Multi-Agent Socio-Collaborative Companion Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are emerging as promising socio-collaborative companions for emotional and cognitive support. However, existing systems frequently suffer from persona collapse, where agents revert to generic, homogenized assistant behaviors, and social sycophancy, where agents produce redundant, non-constructive dialogue. We propose MASCOT, a multi-agent framework for multi-perspective socio-collaborative companions. MASCOT introduces a novel bi-level optimization strategy to harmonize individual and collective behaviors: 1) Persona-Aware Behavioral Alignment, an RLAIF-driven pipeline that fine-tunes individual agents for agent-specific identities; and 2) Collaborative Dialogue Optimization, a group-level adaptation process that promotes complementary, diverse, and productive discourse. We evaluate MASCOT using human-grounded contexts drawn across both in-domain and out-of-domain (OOD) settings against state-of-the-art baselines. MASCOT improves persona consistency by up to +14.1 and social contribution by up to +10.6. A broad evaluation suite, including human evaluation, multiple LLM judges, three-way comparisons, and automatic metrics, further shows that MASCOT produces more role-consistent and less redundant multi-agent dialogue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MASCOT，一个面向多代理社交协作伴侣系统的框架，通过双层优化策略解决代理个性崩溃（persona collapse）和社会谄媚（social sycophancy）问题。MASCOT包含个性感知行为对齐（Persona-Aware Behavioral Alignment，基于RLAIF）和协作对话优化（Collaborative Dialogue Optimization，群体级适应）两个阶段。在域内和域外场景下，MASCOT相比基线在个性一致性上提升最高+14.1，社会贡献上提升最高+10.6。
Motivation: 现有多代理系统在情感和认知支持中常出现个性崩溃（代理退化为通用同质化助手行为）和社会谄媚（代理产生冗余、非建设性对话），缺乏有效的多视角协作机制。
Method: 提出MASCOT框架，包含双层优化策略：第一层是个性感知行为对齐，使用RLAIF（基于人工智能反馈的强化学习）微调单个代理以获得代理特定身份；第二层是协作对话优化，通过群体级适应促进互补、多样且富有成效的对话。
Result: 在域内和域外场景下，MASCOT相比最先进基线将个性一致性提升最多+14.1，社会贡献提升最多+10.6。广泛评估（包括人工评估、多个LLM评判、三方比较和自动指标）表明MASCOT生成更符合角色且更少冗余的多代理对话。
Conclusion: MASCOT框架通过协调个体和集体行为有效缓解了多代理系统中的个性崩溃和社会谄媚问题，提升了对话的个性一致性和社会贡献，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: IntraStyler: Intra-Domain Style Synthesis for Cross-Modality MRI Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Segmentation of vestibular schwannoma and cochlea from T2 MRI is clinically important yet annotation-intensive. Domain adaptation (DA) has been widely adopted to bridge the gap between labeled contrast-enhanced T1 and unlabeled T2 datasets. While existing methods focus on cross-domain alignment, intra-domain variability within the target domain remains largely overlooked. Images from the same domain may vary substantially due to different scanners, field strengths, and acquisition protocols. Ignoring this variability produces homogeneous synthetic images that limit the generalizability of downstream segmentation models. To address this, we propose IntraStyler, a 3D unpaired image translation method that automatically discovers fine-grained intra-domain styles without any predefined sub-domains, and synthesizes diverse target domain images using per-image style references. To this end, we design a 3D style encoder trained with a novel contrastive learning objective to extract style-only embeddings disentangled from anatomy. IntraStyler is built upon the 1st place CrossMoDA challenge solution and further advances it, generating more diverse synthetic data and achieving more reliable downstream segmentation. Code is available at https://github.com/MedICL-VU/IntraStyler.
papers.comment: Extension of our 1st place solution for the CrossMoDA 2023 challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IntraStyler，一种3D无配对图像翻译方法，针对跨模态MRI域适应中目标域内风格多样性的问题。通过对比学习提取与解剖结构解耦的风格嵌入，合成多样化的目标域图像，提升下游分割模型的泛化性。方法基于CrossMoDA 2023挑战赛第一名的方案改进，生成更逼真的合成数据。
Motivation: 现有跨模态MRI域适应方法主要关注域间对齐，忽略了目标域内因不同扫描仪、场强和采集协议导致的图像风格差异，导致合成图像单一，限制了下游分割模型的泛化能力。
Method: 提出IntraStyler，利用3D风格编码器结合对比学习目标，自动发现细粒度域内风格，无需预定义子域；基于每个图像的风格参考合成多样化的目标域图像。
Result: 基于CrossMoDA挑战赛第一名方案改进，生成更多样化的合成数据，下游分割更可靠。
Conclusion: 目标域内风格多样性是跨模态域适应的关键挑战，IntraStyler通过自动提取风格嵌入和多样化合成有效提升了分割性能。

papers.title: Early Prediction of Liver Cirrhosis Up to Two Years in Advance: A Machine Learning Study Benchmarking Against the FIB-4 and APRI Scores
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Develop and evaluate machine learning (ML) models for predicting incident liver cirrhosis (LC) one and two years prior to diagnosis using routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data and benchmark their performance against the FIB-4 and APRI clinical scores. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using de-identified EHR data from a large academic health system. XGBoost models were developed for 1- and 2-year prediction horizons, with model-specific feature selection and Bayesian hyperparameter tuning applied to improve predictive performance. The model was then evaluated on held-out test sets, and its performance was compared with FIB-4 and APRI using accuracy, precision, recall, F1, area under the precision-recall curve (PR AUC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Results: Final modeling cohorts included 60,481 patients for the 1-year prediction and 47,322 for the 2-year prediction. Across both prediction windows, the tuned ML models consistently outperformed FIB-4 and APRI. The XGBoost models achieved AUCs of 0.872 and 0.839 for the 1- and 2-year predictions, respectively, compared with 0.756 and 0.723 for FIB-4 and 0.798 and 0.761 for APRI. Improvements were larger on the precision-recall metric, with PR AUCs of 0.657 and 0.562 for XGBoost compared with 0.456 and 0.373 for FIB-4 and 0.504 and 0.421 for APRI. Performance gains persisted with longer prediction horizons, indicating maintained early risk discrimination. Conclusions: Machine learning models leveraging routine EHR data substantially outperform the traditional FIB-4 and APRI scores for early prediction of liver cirrhosis. These models enable earlier and more accurate risk stratification and can be integrated into clinical workflows as automated decision-support tools to support proactive cirrhosis prevention and management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究利用电子健康记录（EHR）数据，构建 XGBoost 模型在诊断前1年和2年预测肝硬化发生风险，并与临床评分 FIB-4 和 APRI 对比。模型在 AUC 和 PR AUC 上显著优于基线，且效果在更长预测窗口下保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有肝硬化早期筛查依赖 FIB-4 和 APRI 等临床评分，但准确率有限。研究旨在利用常规 EHR 数据开发机器学习模型，实现更早、更准确的风险分层。
Method: 回顾性队列研究，使用大型学术医疗系统的去标识化 EHR 数据。开发 XGBoost 模型，针对1年和2年预测窗口进行模型特异性特征选择和贝叶斯超参数调优。在留出测试集上评估，并与 FIB-4 和 APRI 比较多项指标。
Result: 最终队列包含60481（1年）和47322（2年）患者。调优后的 XGBoost 模型 AUC 分别为0.872和0.839，优于 FIB-4（0.756/0.723）和 APRI（0.798/0.761）；PR AUC 分别为0.657和0.562，也显著优于基线。
Conclusion: 机器学习模型在肝硬化早期预测中显著优于传统评分，可作为自动化决策支持工具整合到临床工作流程中，促进主动预防。

papers.title: Safety Alignment of LMs via Non-cooperative Games
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the safety of language models (LMs) while maintaining their usefulness remains a critical challenge in AI alignment. Current approaches rely on sequential adversarial training: generating adversarial prompts and fine-tuning LMs to defend against them. We introduce a different paradigm: framing safety alignment as a non-zero-sum game between an Attacker LM and a Defender LM trained jointly via online reinforcement learning. Each LM continuously adapts to the other's evolving strategies, driving iterative improvement. Our method uses a preference-based reward signal derived from pairwise comparisons instead of point-wise scores, providing more robust supervision and potentially reducing reward hacking. Our RL recipe, AdvGame, shifts the Pareto frontier of safety and utility, yielding a Defender LM that is simultaneously more helpful and more resilient to adversarial attacks. In addition, the resulting Attacker LM converges into a strong, general-purpose red-teaming agent that can be directly deployed to probe arbitrary target models. Code at github.com/facebookresearch/advgame.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将语言模型安全对齐形式化为非零和博弈，通过在线强化学习联合训练攻击者LM和防御者LM，利用偏好信号替代点式评分，实现了安全性与有用性Pareto前沿的改进。攻击者LM最终收敛为通用红队攻击代理。
Motivation: 现有顺序对抗训练方法存在效率与泛化局限，需要一种持续相互适应的动态安全对齐范式。
Method: 将安全对齐建模为Attacker LM与Defender LM之间的非零和博弈，通过在线强化学习联合训练，使用基于成对比较的偏好奖励信号，减少奖励破解。
Result: 所提方法AdvGame在安全性与实用性Pareto前沿上取得提升，防御者LM同时更友好且对对抗攻击更具韧性；攻击者LM成为通用红队测试代理。
Conclusion: 非零和博弈范式为语言模型安全对齐提供了新方向，偏好信号有助于稳健监督。

papers.title: MGRegBench: A Novel Benchmark Dataset with Anatomical Landmarks for Mammography Image Registration
papers.abstract_en: Robust mammography registration is essential for clinically relevant applications like tracking disease progression in breast tissue. However, progress has been limited by the absence of transparent public datasets and reproducible standardized benchmarks. Existing studies are often not directly comparable, as they use private data and inconsistent evaluation frameworks. To address this, we present MGRegBench, a patient-disjoint, leakage-controlled evaluation protocol for mammography registration, comprising over 5,000 image pairs, each with a breast segmentation mask, and 100 pairs with manually annotated anatomical landmarks, plus standardized train/evaluation splits and ready-to-run baselines. Using this resource, we benchmark diverse registration methods -- including classical (ANTs), learning-based (VoxelMorph, TransMorph), implicit neural representation (IDIR), a mammography-specific approach, and a recent deep learning method MammoRegNet, with implementations adapted to this modality, and validate generalization on the independent SDM-MCs dataset. Our contributions are: (1) the first public dataset of this scale with manual landmarks and masks for mammography registration; (2) a transparent, leakage-controlled benchmark enabling the first like-for-like comparison of diverse classical and machine learning-based methods; (3) external validation on SDM-MCs to test whether the main trend transfers beyond MGRegBench; and (4) an extensive analysis of deep learning-based registration. We publicly release our code and data to establish a foundational resource for fair, reproducible, and clinically relevant comparisons and catalyze future research in AI-driven medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MGRegBench，一个用于乳腺X线摄影图像配准的公开基准数据集和评估协议，包含5000多对图像和100对带手动标注解剖标志点的图像，并提供标准化划分和现成基线方法。该工作旨在解决现有研究因使用私有数据和不一致评估框架而难以比较的问题，并通过外部数据集验证泛化性。
Motivation: 乳腺X线摄影配准领域缺乏透明的公开数据集和可重复的标准化基准，导致现有研究难以直接比较，阻碍了临床应用进展。
Method: 构建MGRegBench数据集，包含5000+图像对（每对带分割掩膜）和100对带手动解剖标志点的图像；设计无泄漏的评估协议，提供标准化训练/测试划分和多种配准方法的现成实现（包括经典方法ANTs、学习方法VoxelMorph/TransMorph、隐式神经表示IDIR、专用方法及MammoRegNet），并在独立SDM-MCs数据集上进行外部验证。
Result: 首次提供该规模且带有手动标志点和掩膜的公开乳腺X线摄影配准数据集；实现不同方法（经典和基于机器学习）的公平比较；外部验证显示主要趋势可迁移。
Conclusion: 该基准和数据集为公平、可重复且临床相关的乳腺X线摄影配准比较奠定基础，并有望促进AI医学影像领域的未来研究。

papers.title: Ev-Trust: An Evolutionarily Stable Trust Mechanism for Decentralized LLM-Based Multi-Agent Service Economies
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized LLM-based multi-agent service economies face three vulnerabilities that undermine traditional trust mechanisms: reduced cost of fraud, difficulty in evaluating service quality, and instability of service content. These compounding vulnerabilities can trigger population-level trust collapse and the proliferation of short-sighted strategies. We propose Ev-Trust, an evolutionarily stable trust mechanism that addresses these vulnerabilities through three targeted designs: a cross-validation gate leveraging requestor semantic comprehension to assess response validity, a variance-standardized drift measure filtering endogenous stochasticity from genuine behavioral anomalies, and an embedding of trust signals into the expected revenue function that converts trustworthiness into an evolutionary survival advantage. Based on replicator dynamics with a noisy best response micro-foundation, we prove the asymptotic stability of cooperative evolutionarily stable strategies and derive explicit threshold conditions for maintaining cooperative equilibria. We evaluate Ev-Trust through 100-round simulations with at least 100 heterogeneous LLM-driven agents covering seven behavioral types. The experiments are conducted on TruthfulQA and TriviaQA, two factual question-answering benchmarks. Compared to baselines based on transitive trust aggregation, reinforcement-learning reputation, and pure evolutionary imitation, Ev-Trust reduces malicious agent participation by approximately 60%, suppresses the fraudulent service rate by approximately 50%, and maintains stable trust differentiation under a 30% adversarial mutation. These results demonstrate that coupling semantic trust evaluation with evolutionary incentives provides a principled foundation for securing cooperation in decentralized LLM-based multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ev-Trust，一种针对去中心化 LLM 多代理服务经济中信任崩溃问题的演化稳定信任机制。该机制通过交叉验证门、方差标准化的漂移度量以及将信任信号嵌入预期收益函数三个设计，在复制动态框架下证明了合作演化稳定策略的渐近稳定性。在 TruthfulQA 和 TriviaQA 基准上的 100 轮模拟（100+ 异构 LLM 代理）表明，Ev-Trust 相比基线将恶意代理参与率降低约 60%，欺诈服务率降低约 50%，并在 30% 对抗突变下保持稳定的信任分化。
Motivation: 去中心化 LLM 多代理服务经济面临欺诈成本降低、服务质量评估困难和内容不稳定三个漏洞，这些漏洞可导致群体信任崩溃和短视策略扩散。
Method: 提出 Ev-Trust 机制，包含三个组件：利用请求者语义理解的交叉验证门评估响应有效性；方差标准化的漂移度量区分内生随机性与异常行为；将信任信号嵌入预期收益函数，使可信赖性转化为演化生存优势。基于带噪声最佳响应的复制动力学证明合作演化稳定策略的渐近稳定性。
Result: 在 TruthfulQA 和 TriviaQA 上模拟 100 轮（至少 100 个异构 LLM 代理，覆盖 7 种行为类型），Ev-Trust 将恶意代理参与率降低约 60%，欺诈服务率降低约 50%，并在 30% 对抗突变下维持稳定信任分化。
Conclusion: 语义信任评估与演化激励的结合为去中心化 LLM 多代理系统中的合作安全提供了原则性基础。
