papers.title: MobiBench: Multi-Branch, Modular Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI Agents, AI agents capable of interacting with mobile applications on behalf of users, have the potential to transform human computer interaction. However, current evaluation practices for GUI agents face two fundamental limitations. First, they either rely on single path offline benchmarks or online live benchmarks. Offline benchmarks using static, single path annotated datasets unfairly penalize valid alternative actions, while online benchmarks suffer from poor scalability and reproducibility due to the dynamic and unpredictable nature of live evaluation. Second, existing benchmarks treat agents as monolithic black boxes, overlooking the contributions of individual components, which often leads to unfair comparisons or obscures key performance bottlenecks. To address these limitations, we present MobiBench, the first modular and multi path aware offline benchmarking framework for mobile GUI agents that enables high fidelity, scalable, and reproducible evaluation entirely in offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that MobiBench achieves 94.72 percent agreement with human evaluators, on par with carefully engineered online benchmarks, while preserving the scalability and reproducibility of static offline benchmarks. Furthermore, our comprehensive module level analysis uncovers several key insights, including a systematic evaluation of diverse techniques used in mobile GUI agents, optimal module configurations across model scales, the inherent limitations of current LFMs, and actionable guidelines for designing more capable and cost efficient mobile agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobiBench，一个模块化、多路径感知的离线基准测试框架，用于评估移动 GUI 代理。它解决了现有单路径离线基准测试不公平惩罚替代动作、在线基准测试可扩展性和可复现性差的问题，以及将代理视为黑箱导致组件贡献被忽视的局限。实验表明，MobiBench 与人工评估者的一致率达到 94.72%，与精心设计的在线基准测试相当，同时保持了离线评估的扩展性和可复现性。模块级分析揭示了移动 GUI 代理中不同技术的系统评估、不同模型规模下的最优模块配置、当前 LFM 的固有限制以及设计更高效代理的指导原则。
Motivation: 现有移动 GUI 代理评估存在两大限制：一是离线基准测试使用静态单路径标注数据集，不公平地惩罚有效的替代动作；而在线基准测试因动态和不可预测的实时环境导致可扩展性和可复现性差。二是现有基准测试将代理视为黑箱，忽略了各单独组件的贡献，导致不公平比较或掩盖关键性能瓶颈。
Method: 提出 MobiBench，首个模块化和多路径感知的离线基准测试框架，能够在完全离线环境下实现高保真、可扩展和可复现的评估。
Result: 实验表明，MobiBench 与人工评估者的一致率达到 94.72%，与精心设计的在线基准测试相当，同时保持了离线基准测试的可扩展性和可复现性。模块级分析提供了系统评估不同技术、最优模块配置、LFM 固有限制以及设计更高效移动代理的指导。
Conclusion: MobiBench 为移动 GUI 代理提供了高保真、可扩展且可复现的离线基准测试，并通过模块化分析揭示了关键见解和设计指南。

papers.title: VocSim: A Training-free Benchmark for Zero-shot Content Identity in Single-source Audio
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose audio representations aim to map acoustically variable instances of the same event to nearby points, resolving content identity in a zero-shot setting. Unlike supervised classification benchmarks that measure adaptability via parameter updates, we introduce VocSim, a training-free benchmark probing the intrinsic geometric alignment of frozen embeddings, with no parameters updated and no labels used (a label-free PCA whitening is fit per subset to correct anisotropy). VocSim aggregates 125k single-source clips from 19 corpora spanning human speech, animal vocalizations, and environmental sounds, isolating content representation from source separation (polyphonic mixtures are out of scope). We evaluate embeddings with Precision@k for local purity and the Global Separation Rate (GSR) for point-wise class separation, calibrated by lift over an empirical permutation baseline. A simple pipeline of frozen Whisper features, time-frequency pooling, and label-free PCA yields strong zero-shot performance with stable GSR rankings across domains (Kendall's tau = 0.60). However, on blind low-resource speech (Shipibo-Conibo, Chintang), local retrieval collapses while remaining above chance, exposing a cross-lingual speech generalization gap. As external validation, our top embeddings predict avian perceptual similarity, improve bioacoustic classification, and achieve state-of-the-art on the HEAR benchmark. We release data, code, and a public leaderboard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VocSim，一个无需训练的基准测试，用于评估零样本情况下单一来源音频的内容一致性。该基准包含 125k 个单源音频片段，覆盖人类语音、动物发声和环境声音。通过评估冻结嵌入的几何对齐，发现 Whisper 特征、时频池化和无标签 PCA 组成的简单流水线在零样本任务上表现强劲，但在跨语言低资源语音上存在泛化差距。
Motivation: 现有音频表示评估依赖有监督分类或参数微调，无法直接衡量冻结嵌入的零样本内容识别能力。需要一个无需训练、无需标签的基准来揭示嵌入本征的几何对齐特性。
Method: VocSim 基准采用无训练评估：使用冻结嵌入特征，通过无标签 PCA 白化矫正各向异性，采用 Precision@k 和全局分离率 (GSR) 评估局部纯度与点态类分离度，并基于经验排列基线计算提升量。
Result: 在 19 个语料库上，Whisper 特征+时频池化+无标签 PCA 流水线取得强零样本性能，GSR 排名跨领域稳定 (Kendall's tau=0.60)。但在盲测低资源语言（Shipibo-Conibo、Chintang）上，局部检索性能骤降，暴露跨语言泛化差距。外部验证显示，最佳嵌入可预测鸟类感知相似性、改进生物声学分类，并在 HEAR 基准上达到最优。
Conclusion: VocSim 提供了一种标准化的无训练评估方法，揭示了当前音频嵌入在跨语言泛化上的局限，并为音频内容识别研究提供了新的基准和排行榜。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-view Pyramid Transformer: Look Coarser to See Broader
papers.abstract_en: We propose Multi-view Pyramid Transformer (MVP), a scalable multi-view transformer architecture that directly reconstructs large 3D scenes from tens to hundreds of images in a single forward pass. Drawing on the idea of ``looking broader to see the whole, looking finer to see the details," MVP is built on two core design principles: 1) a local-to-global inter-view hierarchy that gradually broadens the model's perspective from local views to groups and ultimately the full scene, and 2) a fine-to-coarse intra-view hierarchy that starts from detailed spatial representations and progressively aggregates them into compact, information-dense tokens. This dual hierarchy achieves both computational efficiency and representational richness, enabling fast reconstruction of large and complex scenes. We validate MVP on diverse datasets and show that, when coupled with 3D Gaussian Splatting as the underlying 3D representation, it achieves state-of-the-art generalizable reconstruction quality while maintaining high efficiency and scalability across a wide range of view configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多视角金字塔变换器（MVP），一种可扩展的多视角Transformer架构，能够直接从数十到数百张图像单次前向传播重建大型3D场景。核心设计包括局部到全局的视角间层次和细到粗的视角内层次，实现计算效率与表示丰富性的平衡。结合3D高斯泼溅作为底层表示，在多种数据集上达到最新的可泛化重建质量，同时保持高效率和可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理大量图像的大规模3D场景重建时面临计算效率和表示能力的挑战，需要一种既能捕获全局结构又能保留细节的架构。
Method: 提出MVP架构，包含两个核心层次：1）局部到全局的视角间层次，逐步从局部视图扩展到组再扩展到全场景；2）细到粗的视角内层次，从详细的空间表示逐步聚合为紧凑的信息密集令牌。
Result: 结合3D高斯泼溅，MVP在多种数据集上实现了最先进的可泛化重建质量，并在各种视角配置下保持高效率和可扩展性。
Conclusion: MVP通过双层次金字塔设计实现了高效的大规模3D场景重建，为多视图重建提供了一种可扩展的通用框架。

papers.title: LocalSearchBench: Benchmarking Agentic Search in Real-World Local Life Services
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large reasoning models LRMs have enabled agentic search systems to perform complex multi-step reasoning across multiple sources. However, most studies focus on general information retrieval and rarely explores vertical domains with unique challenges. In this work, we focus on local life services and introduce LocalSearchBench, which encompass diverse and complex business scenarios. Real-world queries in this domain are often ambiguous and require multi-hop reasoning across merchants and products, remaining challenging and not fully addressed. As the first comprehensive benchmark for agentic search in local life services, LocalSearchBench comprises a database of over 1.3M merchant entries across 6 service categories and 9 major cities, and 900 multi-hop QA tasks from real user queries that require multi-step reasoning. We also developed LocalPlayground, a unified environment integrating multiple tools for LRMs interaction. Experiments show that even state-of-the-art LRMs struggle on LocalSearchBench: the best model (DeepSeek-V3.2) achieves only 35.60% correctness, and most models have issues with completeness (average 60.32%) and faithfulness (average 30.72%). This highlights the need for specialized benchmarks and domain-specific agent training in local life services. Code, Benchmark, and Leaderboard are available at https://localsearchbench.github.io/.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2 (KDD 2026), August 9--13, 2026, Jeju Island, Republic of Korea. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 12 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LocalSearchBench，首个面向本地生活服务领域的智能体搜索（agentic search）基准，包含130万商家条目、900个真实用户多跳问答任务。实验表明，最佳模型DeepSeek-V3.2仅达35.60%正确率，完整性和忠实度也较低，突显该领域智能体搜索的挑战。
Motivation: 现有智能体搜索研究集中于通用信息检索，缺乏对垂直领域（如本地生活服务）特殊挑战的探索，实际查询常含歧义且需跨商家/产品多跳推理。
Method: 构建包含130万商家条目（覆盖6个服务类别、9个城市）的数据库和900个多跳QA任务；开发LocalPlayground统一环境，集成多种工具供大推理模型（LRM）交互。
Result: 最佳模型DeepSeek-V3.2仅达35.60%正确率，多数模型完整性平均60.32%，忠实度平均30.72%。
Conclusion: 现有模型在本地生活服务智能体搜索中表现不足，需专门基准和领域特定智能体训练。

papers.title: HyperVQ: Enabling Hyperprior Entropy Modeling for VQ-Based Generative Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Vector Quantization (VQ) based generative image compression has achieved remarkable perceptual quality. However, existing VQ codecs suffer from two fundamental limitations. First, they lack efficient content-adaptive entropy modeling and rely on static frequencies, leading to low coding efficiency. Second, the inherent conflict between discrete indices and continuous priors prevents true end-to-end joint Rate-Distortion (RD) optimization. To resolve these issues, we propose HyperVQ, a principled framework that establishes a high-performance hyperprior entropy foundation for VQ-based codecs. The core insight of HyperVQ is to shift probability modeling entirely into the continuous embedding space. Instead of directly predicting probabilities for discrete symbols, HyperVQ predicts a high-dimensional continuous multivariate Gaussian distribution for the continuous latents. By treating the discrete codebook entries as fixed "anchors" in this space, we convert the continuous Gaussian density into categorical index probabilities based on relative distances. This elegant formulation provides a powerful, spatially-adaptive entropy engine and renders the cross-entropy rate objective fully differentiable, empowering the network to actively and dynamically optimize the RD trade-off during training. To ensure practicality, we design the lightweight H Block and the Probability Estimation Engine (PEE) to facilitate highly parallel, millisecond-level inference. Experiments demonstrate that HyperVQ acts as a universal module across diverse VQ architectures (single-scale, large-codebook, RVQ), achieving an average bitrate saving of 18.5%, which is 7.28x the saving achieved by conventional Huffman coding. This establishes a robust, RD-controllable foundation for next-generation generative image compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperVQ，一种为基于 VQ 的生成图像压缩建立超先验熵模型的新框架。通过将概率建模转移到连续嵌入空间，预测连续潜在变量的高斯分布，并利用码本条目作为锚点将连续密度转换为类别概率，从而实现空间自适应熵建模和完全可微的率失真优化。实验表明 HyperVQ 可作为通用模块应用于多种 VQ 架构，平均节省比特率 18.5%，是传统 Huffman 编码的 7.28 倍。
Motivation: 现有 VQ 压缩方法缺乏高效的内容自适应熵建模，依赖于静态频率导致编码效率低；同时，离散索引与连续先验之间的冲突阻碍了真正的端到端联合率失真优化。
Method: 提出将概率建模完全转移到连续嵌入空间，通过预测连续潜在变量的高维连续多元高斯分布，并基于离散码本条目与预测分布之间的相对距离将连续高斯密度转换为类别索引概率。设计了轻量级的 H Block 和概率估计引擎 (PEE) 以实现高度并行、毫秒级推理。
Result: 摘要报告在多种 VQ 架构（单尺度、大码本、RVQ）上平均比特率节省 18.5%，是传统 Huffman 编码节省量的 7.28 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HyperVQ 为下一代生成图像压缩建立了鲁棒、可率失真控制的基石。

papers.title: How to Correctly Report LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as scalable evaluators of model responses in lieu of human annotators. However, imperfect sensitivity and specificity of the LLM judges induce bias in naive evaluation scores. We propose a simple plug-in framework that corrects this bias and enables statistically principled uncertainty quantification. Our framework constructs confidence intervals that account for uncertainty from both the test dataset and a human-labeled calibration dataset. Additionally, it uses an adaptive strategy to allocate calibration samples for tighter intervals. Importantly, we characterize parameter regimes defined by the true evaluation score and the LLM judge's sensitivity and specificity in which our LLM-based evaluation yields more reliable estimates than human-only evaluation. Moreover, we show that our framework remains unbiased under distribution shift between the test and calibration datasets, in contrast to existing approaches.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于纠正大型语言模型（LLM）作为评估者时偏差的插件框架，该框架能够进行统计上有原则的不确定性量化，并构建考虑测试数据集和人工标注校准数据集不确定性的置信区间。该方法还采用自适应策略分配校准样本以获得更紧的区间，并在分布偏移下保持无偏。
Motivation: 现有LLM作为评估者时，由于不完美的敏感性和特异性，会导致评估分数产生偏差，需要一种校正偏差的方法。
Method: 提出一个简单的插件框架，通过结合测试数据集和人工标注的校准数据集，构建置信区间，并使用自适应策略分配校准样本。
Result: 框架在真实评估分数和LLM评估者的敏感性与特异性定义的参数范围内，比纯人工评估更可靠。且在校准集与测试集分布偏移下仍保持无偏，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该框架为LLM作为评估者提供了偏差校正和统计可靠的置信区间，适用于需要量化评估不确定性的场景。

papers.title: Back to the Feature: Explaining Video Classifiers with Video Counterfactual Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanations (CFEs) are minimal and semantically meaningful modifications of the input of a model that alter the model predictions. They highlight the decisive features the model relies on, providing contrastive interpretations for classifiers. State-of-the-art visual counterfactual explanation methods have primarily focused on interpreting image classifiers, leaving the domain of video models relatively underexplored. For the video CFEs to be useful, they have to be physically plausible, temporally coherent, and exhibit smooth motion trajectories. Existing CFE image-based methods, designed to explain image classifiers, lack the capacity to generate temporally coherent, smooth and physically plausible video CFEs. To address this, we propose Back To The Feature (BTTF), an optimization framework that generates video CFEs. Our method introduces two novel features, 1) an optimization scheme to retrieve the initial latent noise conditioned by the first frame of the input video, 2) a two-stage optimization strategy to enable the search for counterfactual videos in the vicinity of the input video. Both optimization processes are guided solely by the target classifier, ensuring the explanation is faithful. To accelerate convergence, we also introduce a progressive optimization strategy that incrementally increases the number of denoising steps. Extensive experiments on video datasets such as Shape-Moving (motion classification), MEAD (emotion classification), and NTU RGB+D (action classification) show that our BTTF effectively generates valid, visually similar and realistic counterfactual videos that provide concrete insights into the classifier's decision-making mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Back To The Feature (BTTF) 框架，用于生成视频分类器的反事实解释（CFEs）。该框架通过优化初始潜变量和两阶段优化策略，生成物理合理、时间一致且运动平滑的反事实视频。实验在 Shape-Moving、MEAD 和 NTU RGB+D 数据集上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有视觉反事实解释方法主要针对图像分类器，缺乏生成时间一致、平滑且物理合理的视频反事实解释的能力。
Method: 提出一个优化框架，包括：1) 基于输入视频第一帧的条件初始化潜噪声；2) 两阶段优化策略在输入视频附近搜索反事实视频；3) 渐进式优化策略逐步增加去噪步数以加速收敛。
Result: 在 Shape-Moving（运动分类）、MEAD（情感分类）和 NTU RGB+D（动作分类）数据集上，BTTF 生成了有效、视觉相似且真实的反事实视频，为分类器决策机制提供了具体洞察。
Conclusion: BTTF 通过优化框架生成了忠实于目标分类器的视频反事实解释，填补了视频模型可解释性领域的空白。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SpeedAug: Policy Acceleration via Tempo-Enriched Policy and RL Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Robotic policy learning for complex real-world manipulation tasks has seen rapid recent progress, enabled in large part by the ability to collect demonstrations through human operation. However, policies trained from such demonstrations often execute tasks far more slowly than the robot's physical capabilities, as demonstration data is collected under practical constraints that favor conservative, success-oriented trajectories over execution speed. Existing policy acceleration methods determine execution tempo through data preprocessing or heuristic rules, rather than learning execution speed optimized for the task. In this paper, we propose SpeedAug, a policy acceleration framework that enables policies to learn task-optimal execution tempo via reinforcement learning (RL). SpeedAug first learns a tempo-enriched prior policy from speed-augmented demonstrations that captures diverse execution tempos. Building on this tempo-enriched prior, RL fine-tuning guides exploration to refine action trajectories and optimize execution tempo efficiently. Experiments on robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that SpeedAug substantially improves the sample efficiency of policy acceleration while maintaining high success rates, achieving fast and stable task execution. Applied to a real-world manipulation task, SpeedAug improves task throughput by 1.8x using only 16 minutes of online interactions without compromising the success rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpeedAug，一种通过强化学习使机器人策略学习任务最优执行节奏加速的框架。首先从速度增强的演示中学习节奏增强的先前策略，再通过RL微调优化动作轨迹和执行节奏。在机器人操作基准上显著提高样本效率并保持高成功率，真实场景中仅用16分钟在线交互即提升吞吐量1.8倍。
Motivation: 从演示中学习的策略执行速度远低于机器人物理能力，现有方法通过预处理或启发式规则决定执行速度，而非学习优化速度。
Method: 提出SpeedAug框架：先利用速度增强的演示数据学习一个包含多种执行节奏的先前策略，再通过强化学习微调引导探索，高效优化动作轨迹和执行节奏。
Result: 在机器人操作基准上，SpeedAug大幅提升了策略加速的样本效率，同时保持高成功率；在真实操纵任务中，仅用16分钟在线交互便实现1.8倍的任务吞吐量提升，且未降低成功率。
Conclusion: SpeedAug能够学习任务最优的执行节奏，在保持高成功率的同时实现高效的政策加速。

papers.title: FDIO: Frequency Decomposed Inertial Odometry
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian inertial odometry (PIO) estimates autonomous pedestrian motion using only acceleration and angular velocity measurements collected by an inertial measurement unit (IMU), making it highly valuable for consumer level localization applications. However, under a dual device acquisition setting, IMU signals collected by a freely carried mobile device are inherently composite signals in which the global motion of the human torso is coupled with perturbations induced by local limb motion. This coupling makes accurate human motion modeling more challenging. To address this issue, this paper proposes frequency decomposed inertial odometry (FDIO). The proposed method first decomposes input IMU signals into low frequency and high frequency components using a Laplacian pyramid. It then adopts a Mamba module to model long range motion information from the low frequency component and uses a multi scale convolution module to extract fine grained local dynamic features from the high frequency component. Experiments on five public PIO datasets show that FDIO achieves an average absolute trajectory error of 3.221~m and an average relative trajectory error of 2.550~m, reducing the errors by 33.3\% and 16.7\% compared with the RoNIN ResNet baseline, respectively. These results validate the effectiveness of the proposed frequency decomposition strategy. To the best of our knowledge, this work is among the first efforts to introduce Mamba and a frequency decomposition architecture into inertial odometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出频率分解惯性里程计（FDIO），利用拉普拉斯金字塔将IMU信号分解为低频和高频分量，分别用Mamba模块建模远程运动信息和多尺度卷积提取局部动态特征。在五个公开数据集上平均绝对轨迹误差为3.221米，相对轨迹误差为2.550米，相比RoNIN ResNet基线分别降低33.3%和16.7%。
Motivation: 在双设备采集设置下，自由携带的移动设备收集的IMU信号是人体全身运动与局部肢体运动扰动的复合信号，导致准确的人体运动建模更具挑战性。
Method: 首先使用拉普拉斯金字塔将输入IMU信号分解为低频和高频分量；低频分量采用Mamba模块建模远程运动信息，高频分量使用多尺度卷积提取细粒度局部动态特征。
Result: 在五个公共PIO数据集上，平均绝对轨迹误差为3.221米，相对轨迹误差为2.550米，相比RoNIN ResNet基线分别降低33.3%和16.7%。
Conclusion: 频率分解策略有效提升了行人惯性里程计的精度，这是首次将Mamba和频率分解架构引入惯性里程计。

papers.title: From Scaling to Structured Expressivity: Rethinking Transformers for CTR Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Despite massive investments in scale, deep models for click-through rate (CTR) prediction often exhibit rapidly diminishing returns -- a stark contrast to the {predictable scaling laws} seen in large language models (LLMs). We identify the root cause as a {fundamental} \textit{structural misalignment}: {standard} Transformers assume sequential compositionality, whereas CTR data demand combinatorial reasoning over {heterogeneous} fields. To restore alignment, we introduce the \textbf{Field-Aware Transformer (FAT)}. {By reconstructing the standard Transformer block with field-centric parameters, FAT achieves \textit{structured expressivity}, {fundamentally shifting the model complexity dependence from the total vocabulary size $n$ with the number of fields $F$ ($n \gg F$).}} Crucially, to decouple model capacity from field cardinality, FAT employs a {Basis-Composed Hypernetwork} to synthesize field-specific parameters from shared bases, further reducing parameter complexity. {Theoretically, we ground this scaling behavior through a formal scaling law based on Rademacher complexity. Empirically, FAT outperforms exisiting state-of-the-art methods with up to \textbf{+4.38\%} AUC improvement, and delivers \textbf{+2.33\%} CTR and \textbf{+0.66\%} RPM in live production.} Our work establishes that scalable recommendation arises not from size alone, but from \textit{structured expressivity} -- architectural coherence with data semantics.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出CTR预测中的深度模型存在结构不匹配问题，并提出Field-Aware Transformer (FAT)，通过场感知参数和基础复合超网络实现结构化表达性，实验显示AUC提升达4.38%，并在线上部署中提升CTR和RPM。
Motivation: 标准Transformer假设序列组合性，而CTR数据需要异构字段上的组合推理，导致深度模型收益递减。
Method: 提出Field-Aware Transformer (FAT)，通过场中心参数重构标准Transformer块，并使用基础复合超网络从共享基础合成场特定参数，减少参数复杂度。
Result: 在AUC上提升最多4.38%，线上CTR提升2.33%，RPM提升0.66%。理论基于Rademacher复杂度建立了缩放定律。
Conclusion: 强调可扩展推荐来自结构化表达性，即与数据语义一致的架构，而非单纯扩大规模。

papers.title: Measurement-Driven Early Warning of Reliability Breakdown in 5G NSA Railway Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a measurement-driven study of early warning for reliability breakdown events in 5G non-standalone (NSA) railway networks. Using 10~Hz metro-train measurement traces with serving- and neighbor-cell indicators, we benchmark six representative learning models, including CNN, LSTM, XGBoost, Anomaly Transformer, PatchTST, and TimesNet, under multiple observation windows and prediction horizons. Rather than proposing a new prediction architecture, this study develops a measurement-driven benchmark to quantify the feasibility and operating trade-offs of seconds-ahead reliability prediction in 5G NSA railway environments. Experimental results show that learning models can anticipate radio link failure (RLF)-related reliability breakdown events seconds in advance using lightweight radio features available on commercial devices. The presented benchmark provides insights for sensing-assisted communication control and offers an empirical foundation for integrating sensing and analytics into future mobility control.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过10 Hz地铁列车测量数据，在5G NSA铁路网络中基准测试六种学习模型（CNN、LSTM、XGBoost、Anomaly Transformer、PatchTST、TimesNet），研究秒级提前预测无线链路故障（RLF）相关可靠性崩溃事件的可行性。结果显示，利用商用设备上的轻量级无线电特征，模型可提前数秒预测可靠性事件，为感知辅助通信控制和未来移动控制集成提供了实证基础。
Motivation: 5G NSA铁路网络中可靠性崩溃事件的提前预警对列车运行安全至关重要，但现有研究缺乏基于真实测量数据的系统基准，无法量化秒级预测的可行性和操作权衡。
Method: 基于10 Hz地铁列车测量轨迹（包含服务小区和邻小区指标），在多种观测窗口和预测时限下，对CNN、LSTM、XGBoost、Anomaly Transformer、PatchTST、TimesNet六种模型进行基准测试，未提出新架构，而是构建测量驱动的基准。
Result: 学习模型可利用商用设备上的轻量级无线电特征，在RLF事件发生前数秒实现预测；实验量化了不同观测窗口和预测时限下的预测性能与权衡。
Conclusion: 该基准为感知辅助通信控制提供了见解，并为将感知与分析集成到未来移动控制中奠定了实证基础。

papers.title: NILC: Discovering New Intents with LLM-assisted Clustering
papers.abstract_en: New intent discovery (NID) seeks to recognize both new and known intents from unlabeled user utterances, which finds prevalent use in practical dialogue systems. Existing works towards NID mainly adopt a cascaded architecture, wherein the first stage focuses on encoding the utterances into informative text embeddings beforehand, while the latter is to group similar embeddings into clusters (i.e., intents), typically by K-Means. However, such a cascaded pipeline fails to leverage the feedback from both steps for mutual refinement, and, meanwhile, the embedding-only clustering overlooks nuanced textual semantics, leading to suboptimal performance. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes NILC, a novel clustering framework specially catered for effective NID. Particularly, NILC follows an iterative workflow, in which clustering assignments are judiciously updated by carefully refining cluster centroids and text embeddings of uncertain utterances with the aid of large language models (LLMs). Specifically, NILC first taps into LLMs to create additional semantic centroids for clusters, thereby enriching the contextual semantics of the Euclidean centroids of embeddings. Moreover, LLMs are then harnessed to augment hard samples (ambiguous or terse utterances) identified from clusters via rewriting for subsequent cluster correction. Further, we inject supervision signals through non-trivial techniques seeding and soft must links for more accurate NID in the semi-supervised setting. Extensive experiments comparing NILC against multiple recent baselines under both unsupervised and semi-supervised settings showcase that NILC can achieve significant performance improvements over six benchmark datasets of diverse domains consistently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NILC，一种基于LLM辅助聚类的框架，用于新意图发现（NID）。NILC通过迭代优化聚类质心和文本嵌入，利用LLM创建语义质心并增强困难样本，从而改进聚类效果。实验表明NILC在多个基准数据集上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有NID方法采用级联架构，先编码再聚类，但无法实现步骤间互反馈，且仅基于嵌入聚类忽略文本语义，导致性能不佳。
Method: NILC采用迭代工作流，首先利用LLM为聚类创建额外的语义质心，然后使用LLM重写识别出的困难样本以修正聚类。在半监督设置下，还通过种子技术和软必须链接注入监督信号。
Result: 在六个不同领域的基准数据集上，NILC在无监督和半监督设置下均显著优于多个最新基线方法。
Conclusion: NILC通过LLM辅助的迭代聚类，有效提升了新意图发现的准确性，特别是在处理模糊或简洁话语时。

papers.title: Seq-DeepIPC: Sequential Sensing for End-to-End Control in Legged Robot Navigation
papers.abstract_en: We present Seq-DeepIPC, a sequential end-to-end perception-to-control model for legged robot navigation in real-world environments. Seq-DeepIPC advances intelligent sensing for autonomous legged navigation by tightly integrating multi-modal perception (RGB-D + GNSS) with temporal fusion and control. The model jointly predicts semantic segmentation and depth estimation, giving richer spatial features for planning and control. For efficient deployment on edge devices, we use a lightweight model as the encoder, reducing computation while maintaining accuracy. Heading estimation is simplified by removing the noisy IMU and instead deriving global heading via differential analysis of sequential GNSS coordinates. We collected a larger and more diverse dataset that includes both road and grass terrains, and validated Seq-DeepIPC on a robot dog. Comparative and ablation studies show that sequential inputs improve perception and control in our models, while other baselines do not benefit. Seq-DeepIPC achieves competitive or better results with reasonable model size; although GNSS-only heading is less reliable near tall buildings, it is robust in open areas. Overall, Seq-DeepIPC extends end-to-end navigation beyond wheeled robots to more versatile and temporally-aware systems. To support future research, we will release the codes to our GitHub repo at https://github.com/oskarnatan/Seq-DeepIPC.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the IEEE Sensors Journal. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11373257/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Seq-DeepIPC，一种用于四足机器人导航的顺序端到端感知-控制模型。该模型融合 RGB-D 和 GNSS 多模态感知，联合预测语义分割和深度估计，并通过顺序 GNSS 坐标差分推导全局航向以替代噪声较大的 IMU。在真实环境的机器人狗上验证，顺序输入提升了感知和控制性能，且模型尺寸合理，在开阔区域表现鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有端到端导航主要面向轮式机器人，缺乏对四足机器人时序感知和控制的适配，且传统 IMU 航向估计受噪声影响。
Method: 采用轻量编码器实现高效推理；联合预测语义分割和深度估计以增强空间特征；通过顺序 GNSS 坐标差分计算全局航向，避免使用 IMU；收集包含道路和草地的更大规模数据集进行训练和验证。
Result: 在机器人狗上的对比和消融实验表明，顺序输入显著提升了感知和控制性能，而其他基线未受益；基于 GNSS 的航向在高楼附近可靠性下降，但在开阔区域表现稳健。
Conclusion: Seq-DeepIPC 将端到端导航从轮式机器人扩展到四足机器人，展示了时序感知和轻量化设计的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WAON: A Large-Scale Japanese Image-Text Dataset for Cultural Adaptation in Contrastive Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive vision-language models have achieved remarkable progress through large-scale pretraining. Recent work has shown that removing English-only caption filters and pretraining on global data is effective for improving multicultural performance. We study whether such global pretraining is sufficient for culture-specific understanding, or whether further adaptation with natively sourced data can boost performance beyond what global pretraining alone achieves. To enable this investigation, we present WAON, the largest publicly available native Japanese image-text dataset constructed from native Japanese web content in Common Crawl, containing approximately 155 million examples. We also introduce WAON-Bench, a manually curated Japanese cultural benchmark spanning 374 classes. Through comparative fine-tuning experiments on multiple Japanese image-text datasets, we observe that models fine-tuned on WAON consistently achieve stronger performance on Japanese cultural benchmarks than those fine-tuned on English-to-Japanese translated data. We release our dataset and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了WAON，目前最大的公开原生日语图像-文本数据集，包含约1.55亿个样本，来自Common Crawl中的日语网页。同时提出WAON-Bench，一个涵盖374类的手工标注日语文化基准。通过对比微调实验，发现使用WAON微调的模型在日语文化基准上的表现持续优于使用英文-日文翻译数据微调的模型。
Motivation: 现有对比视觉语言模型通过大规模预训练取得了显著进展，但全球预训练是否足以实现特定文化理解仍存疑问。需要研究是否可以通过原生源数据的进一步适应来提升模型在特定文化上的表现。
Method: 从Common Crawl中的日语网络内容构建大规模原生日语图像-文本数据集WAON（约1.55亿样本），并创建手工标注的日语文化基准WAON-Bench（374类）。通过对比微调实验，比较在WAON和英文-日文翻译数据上微调的效果。
Result: 使用WAON微调的模型在日语文化基准上的表现持续优于使用翻译数据微调的模型。
Conclusion: 原生源数据的适应可以进一步提升模型在特定文化上的表现，释放了数据集和代码供进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tractable Shapley Values and Interactions via Tensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: We show how to replace the O(2^n) coalition enumeration over n features behind Shapley values and Shapley-style interaction indices with a few-evaluation scheme on a tensor-network (TN) surrogate: TN-SHAP. The key idea is to represent a predictor's local behavior as a factorized multilinear map, so that coalitional quantities become linear probes of a coefficient tensor. TN-SHAP replaces exhaustive coalition sweeps with just a small number of targeted evaluations to extract order-k Shapley interactions. In particular, both order-1 (single-feature) and order-2 (pairwise) computations have cost O(n*poly(chi) + n^2), where chi is the TN's maximal cut rank. We provide theoretical guarantees on the approximation error and tractability of TN-SHAP. On UCI datasets, our method matches enumeration on the fitted surrogate while reducing evaluation by orders of magnitude and achieves 25-1000x wall-clock speedups over KernelSHAP-IQ at comparable accuracy, while amortizing training across local cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TN-SHAP，通过张量网络（tensor network）代理模型将Shapley值和Shapley交互指数的计算复杂度从O(2^n)降至近似线性，仅需少量评估即可提取高阶交互。在UCI数据集上，TN-SHAP匹配枚举精度，实现数量级的评估次数减少和25-1000倍加速。
Motivation: 传统Shapley值计算需要枚举所有特征子集（O(2^n)），在高维特征空间中不可行，且现有近似方法在大规模交互分析中效率低。
Method: 将预测器的局部行为表示为因子化多线性映射（factorized multilinear map），使联盟量成为系数张量的线性探针。通过张量网络表示，用少量定向评估提取k阶Shapley交互，一阶和二阶成本为O(n·poly(χ) + n²)。
Result: 在UCI数据集上，TN-SHAP在拟合代理模型上匹配枚举精度，评估次数减少数个数量级，相比KernelSHAP-IQ实现25-1000倍实际加速，同时可跨局部批次平摊训练成本。
Conclusion: 张量网络为可解释AI提供了一种可计算且理论上可保证的Shapley值及交互指数估计方法，在特征维度较大时具有实用优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CARES: Context-Aware Resolution Selector for VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (VLMs) commonly process images at native or high resolution to remain effective across tasks. This inflates visual tokens ofter to 97-99% of total tokens, resulting in high compute and latency, even when low-resolution images would suffice. We introduce \emph{CARES}-a \textbf{C}ontext-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}esolution \textbf{S}elector, a lightweight preprocessing module that, given an image-query pair, predicts the \emph{minimal} sufficient input resolution. CARES uses a compact VLM (350M) to extract features and predict when a target pretrained VLM's response converges to its peak ability to answer correctly. Though trained as a discrete classifier over a set of optional resolutions, CARES interpolates continuous resolutions at inference for fine-grained control. Across five multimodal benchmarks spanning documents and natural images, as well as diverse target VLMs, CARES preserves task performance while reducing compute by up to 80%.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers) Accepted to ACL 2026 (Oral presentation). Code available at https://github.com/mkimhi/CARES
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARES 是一个轻量级预处理模块，针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中图像-查询对预测最小足够输入分辨率，以减少计算开销。它使用紧凑 VLM（350M）提取特征并预测目标 VLM 的响应在何时达到峰值准确率，训练为离散分辨率分类器，推理时插值连续分辨率。在五个多模态基准上，CARES 保持任务性能的同时将计算量降低最多 80%。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 通常以原生或高分辨率处理图像，导致视觉 token 占比高达 97-99%，产生大量计算和延迟，即使低分辨率足以完成任务。
Method: 提出 CARES，一个上下文感知分辨率选择器，使用紧凑 VLM（350M）提取图像-查询对特征，训练为离散分辨率分类器，预测目标 VLM 的响应何时收敛到峰值准确率，推理时插值实现连续分辨率控制。
Result: 在涵盖文档和自然图像的五个多模态基准上，针对多种目标 VLM，CARES 保持任务性能的同时将计算量减少最多 80%。
Conclusion: CARES 表明通过上下文感知的分辨率选择可以大幅降低 VLM 的计算成本而不牺牲性能，为实际部署提供高效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NAPPure: Adversarial Purification for Robust Image Classification under Non-Additive Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial purification has achieved great success in combating adversarial image perturbations, which are usually assumed to be additive. However, non-additive adversarial perturbations such as blur, occlusion, and distortion are also common in the real world. Under such perturbations, existing adversarial purification methods are much less effective since they are designed to fit the additive nature. In this paper, we propose an extended adversarial purification framework named NAPPure, which can further handle non-additive perturbations. Specifically, we first establish the generation process of an adversarial image, and then disentangle the underlying clean image and perturbation parameters through likelihood maximization. Experiments on GTSRB and CIFAR-10 datasets show that NAPPure significantly boosts the robustness of image classification models against non-additive perturbations.

Result: 在GTSRB和CIFAR-10数据集上，NAPPure显著提升了分类模型对非加性扰动的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: NAPPure将对抗净化扩展到非加性扰动领域，为实际场景下的鲁棒分类提供了新思路。

papers.title: Learning-To-Measure: In-Context Active Feature Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Active feature acquisition (AFA) is a sequential decision-making problem where the goal is to improve model performance for test instances by adaptively selecting which features to acquire. In practice, AFA methods often learn from retrospective data with systematic missingness in the features and limited task-specific labels. Most prior work addresses acquisition for a single predetermined task, limiting scalability. To address this limitation, we formalize the meta-AFA problem, where the goal is to learn acquisition policies across various tasks. We introduce Learning-to-Measure (L2M), which consists of i) reliable uncertainty quantification over unseen tasks, and ii) an uncertainty-guided greedy feature acquisition agent that maximizes conditional mutual information. We demonstrate a sequence-modeling or autoregressive pre-training approach that underpins reliable uncertainty quantification for tasks with arbitrary missingness. L2M operates directly on datasets with retrospective missingness and performs the meta-AFA task in-context, eliminating per-task retraining. Across synthetic and real-world tabular benchmarks, L2M matches or surpasses task-specific baselines, particularly under scarce labels and high missingness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出元主动特征获取（meta-AFA）问题，目标是在多个任务间学习特征获取策略。方法L2M通过序列建模/自回归预训练实现可靠的不确定性量化，并采用不确定性引导的贪婪特征获取（最大化条件互信息）。在合成和真实表格基准上，L2M匹配或超越任务特定基线，尤其在标签稀缺和高缺失率下表现优异。
Motivation: 现有主动特征获取方法通常针对单一任务设计，限制了可扩展性；回顾性数据中特征缺失和标签稀缺进一步增加了跨任务学习的难度。
Method: 提出L2M框架：先通过序列建模/自回归预训练对任意缺失模式的任务进行不确定性量化，再使用不确定性引导的贪婪特征获取策略（最大化条件互信息）。该方法直接在回顾性缺失数据上操作，以上下文方式完成元主动特征获取，无需每任务重新训练。
Result: 在合成和真实表格基准上，L2M匹配或超越任务特定基线，尤其在标签稀缺和高缺失率条件下性能突出。
Conclusion: L2M通过上下文学习消除了每任务重新训练的需求，展现了跨任务可扩展性，并在数据稀缺场景下保持鲁棒性。

papers.title: Characterizing Web Search in The Age of Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: The advent of LLMs has given rise to generative search, a new search paradigm in which LLMs retrieve information from the web related to a query and synthesize it into a single, coherent response. This paradigm differs fundamentally from traditional web search, where results are returned as a ranked list of independent web pages. In this paper, we ask: Along what dimensions does generative search differ from traditional search? We conduct a systematic comparison between Google organic search and five generative search systems from three providers: Google, OpenAI, and Perplexity. Our analysis reveals substantial variation among engines in their reliance on internal v.s. external knowledge, source diversity, and stability. While generative systems often achieve topical coverage comparable to traditional search, they do so using markedly different retrieval footprints and synthesis strategies. We further show that the outputs of generative search can vary across time and executions, raising new challenges for robustness. Our findings demonstrate that generative search introduces new dimensions that are not captured by existing evaluation paradigms, motivating the development of evaluations that explicitly account for retrieval behavior, synthesis, and stability in generative search systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了传统Google搜索与五种生成式搜索系统（来自Google、OpenAI和Perplexity）的差异。分析发现生成式搜索在内部与外部知识依赖、来源多样性和稳定性方面存在显著差异。尽管在主题覆盖上与传统搜索相当，但生成式搜索使用不同的检索足迹和合成策略，且输出随时间与执行而变化，带来鲁棒性挑战。研究指出现有评估范式未涵盖生成式搜索的新维度。
Motivation: 生成式搜索作为新范式与传统网页搜索有根本区别，但缺乏对其差异的定量刻画和系统性比较。
Method: 对Google有机搜索及五个生成式搜索系统进行多维度对比，包括知识源（内部vs外部）、来源多样性、稳定性、主题覆盖等。
Result: 生成式搜索在主题覆盖上与传统搜索相当，但检索足迹和合成策略差异巨大；不同引擎间输出稳定性差，随时间与执行波动。
Conclusion: 生成式搜索引入了检索行为、合成策略和稳定性等新维度，现有评估范式不足以捕捉，需开发针对性评估方法。

papers.title: Catch-Only-One: Non-Transferable Examples for Model-Specific Authorization
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI regulations increasingly emphasize the need for mechanisms that preserve the utility of data for AI innovation while preventing misuse, particularly by enforcing purpose limitation in downstream AI applications. In practice, enforcing this principle remains challenging, as released data can be trivially fed into arbitrary models beyond its declared intent. Existing approaches attempt to mitigate this risk by either perturbing data or retraining models to limit unintended use. These strategies, however, offer no protection against inference by unknown or externally trained models, or fundamentally rely on control over the training or deployment. In this work, we introduce non-transferable examples (NTEs), recoded data that act as a task-level "ciphertext" decodable only by a designated model. Whereas adversarial examples exploit directions of high model sensitivity, NTEs leverage the complementary insensitive subspace. We propose a training-free, data-agnostic method that recodes data within a model-specific low-sensitivity subspace, preserving outputs for the authorized model while degrading unauthorized ones through subspace misalignment. We establish formal bounds certifying authorized-model fidelity and showing that unauthorized degradation scales with measurable spectral misalignment between models. Empirically, NTEs preserve performance across diverse vision backbones and state-of-the-art vision-language models under common preprocessing, while unauthorized models collapse even under adaptive reconstruction attacks. These results establish NTEs as a practical means to preserve intended data utility while preventing unauthorized exploitation. Our project is available at https://trusted-system-lab.github.io/model-specificity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出非迁移性示例（NTEs），通过对数据在模型特定的低敏感子空间内重新编码，使得只有授权模型能正确解码，而未经授权的模型输出严重退化。该方法无需训练、与数据无关，并在多种视觉骨干和视觉-语言模型上验证了效果。
Motivation: 现有AI法规强调数据用途限制，但实践中数据可被任意模型使用；已有方法无法防止未知模型或外部训练模型的滥用。
Method: 利用模型特定的低敏感子空间对数据进行重新编码，相当于将数据转换为任务级“密文”，只有授权模型能在此子空间内正确解码，未经授权模型因子空间错位而失效。
Result: 在多种视觉骨干和视觉-语言模型上，NTEs保持授权模型性能，同时未经授权模型在常见预处理甚至自适应重建攻击下性能崩溃。
Conclusion: NTEs提供了一种实用的数据授权机制，能在保留数据目的效用同时防止未经授权的利用。

papers.title: StreamingVLM: Real-Time Understanding for Infinite Video Streams
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) could power real-time assistants and autonomous agents, but they face a critical challenge: understanding near-infinite video streams without escalating latency and memory usage. Processing entire videos with full attention leads to quadratic computational costs and poor performance on long videos. Meanwhile, simple sliding window methods are also flawed, as they either break coherence or suffer from high latency due to redundant recomputation. In this paper, we introduce StreamingVLM, a model designed for real-time, stable understanding of infinite visual input. Our approach is a unified framework that aligns training with streaming inference. During inference, we maintain a compact KV cache by reusing states of attention sinks, a short window of recent vision tokens, and a long window of recent text tokens. This streaming ability is instilled via a simple supervised fine-tuning (SFT) strategy that applies full attention on short, overlapped video chunks, which effectively mimics the inference-time attention pattern without training on prohibitively long contexts. For evaluation, we build Inf-Streams-Eval, a new benchmark with videos averaging over two hours that requires dense, per-second alignment between frames and text. On Inf-Streams-Eval, StreamingVLM achieves a 66.18% win rate against GPT-4O mini and maintains stable, real-time performance at up to 8 FPS on a single NVIDIA H100. Notably, our SFT strategy also enhances general VQA abilities without any VQA-specific fine-tuning, improving performance on LongVideoBench by +4.30 and OVOBench Realtime by +5.96. Code is available at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/streaming-vlm.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026. The first two authors contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StreamingVLM，一种用于实时理解无限视频流的视觉语言模型。通过训练与流式推理对齐，维护紧凑的KV缓存（注意力汇、近窗口视觉token、远窗口文本token），实现低延迟高帧率处理。在自制Inf-Streams-Eval基准（平均2小时视频）上，StreamingVLM以66.18%胜率击败GPT-4O mini，单H100上达8 FPS，且微调策略提升通用VQA能力。
Motivation: 现有VLM在无限视频流上存在延迟和内存爆炸问题：全注意力计算成本高，滑动窗口会破坏连贯性或导致冗余重计算。
Method: 提出统一框架对齐训练与流式推理。推理时维护紧凑KV缓存：复用注意力汇、最近视觉token窗口、最近文本token窗口。训练采用简单SFT，在短重叠视频块上应用全注意力，模拟推理模式而无需超长上下文训练。
Result: 在Inf-Streams-Eval上，StreamingVLM胜率66.18% vs GPT-4O mini；单H100上实时8 FPS；无需VQA微调，LongVideoBench提升+4.30，OVOBench Realtime提升+5.96。
Conclusion: StreamingVLM通过训练-推理对齐和紧凑KV缓存实现无限视频流的实时稳定理解，同时增强通用VQA能力。

papers.title: Safety Game: Inference-Time Alignment of Black-Box LLMs via Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring that large language models (LLMs) comply with safety requirements is a central challenge in AI deployment. Existing alignment approaches primarily operate during training, such as through fine-tuning or reinforcement learning from human feedback, but these methods are costly and inflexible, requiring retraining whenever new requirements arise. Recent efforts toward inference-time alignment mitigate some of these limitations but still assume access to model internals, which is impractical, and not suitable for third party stakeholders who do not have access to the models. In this work, we propose a model-independent, black-box framework for safety alignment that does not require retraining or access to the underlying LLM architecture. As a proof of concept, we address the problem of trading off between generating safe but uninformative answers versus helpful yet potentially risky ones. We formulate this dilemma as a two-player zero-sum game whose minimax equilibrium captures the optimal balance between safety and helpfulness. LLM agents operationalize this framework by leveraging a linear programming solver at inference time to compute equilibrium strategies. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of black-box safety alignment, offering a scalable and accessible pathway for stakeholders, including smaller organizations and entities in resource-constrained settings, to enforce safety across rapidly evolving LLM ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种与模型无关、仅需黑盒访问的推理时安全对齐框架，将安全与有用性的权衡建模为两人零和博弈，通过线性规划求解纳什均衡策略，避免重新训练或访问模型内部结构。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐方法多依赖训练阶段（微调、RLHF），成本高且灵活性差；推理时对齐方法仍需要模型内部信息，不适用于第三方利益相关者或无法访问模型内部的情况。
Method: 提出黑盒安全对齐框架，将安全-有用性权衡建模为两人零和博弈，在推理时利用线性规划求解器计算均衡策略，无需重训练或模型内部访问。
Result: 实验证明了黑盒安全对齐的可行性，为资源受限的第三方提供了可扩展且可访问的安全保障途径。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为黑盒LLM安全对齐提供了可行路径，适用于快速演化的LLM生态系统中的各方利益相关者。

papers.title: BLISS: A Lightweight Bilevel Influence Scoring Method for Data Selection in Language Model Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Effective data selection is essential for pretraining large language models (LLMs), enhancing efficiency and improving generalization to downstream tasks. However, existing approaches often require leveraging external pretrained models, making it difficult to disentangle the effects of data selection from those of the external pretrained models. In addition, they often overlook the long-term impact of selected data if the model is trained to convergence, primarily due to the prohibitive cost of full-scale LLM pretraining. In this paper, we introduce BLISS (\textbf{B}ileve\textbf{L} \textbf{I}nfluence \textbf{S}coring method for data \textbf{S}election): a lightweight data selection method that operates entirely \emph{from scratch}, without relying on any external pretrained oracle models, while explicitly accounting for the long-term impact of selected data. BLISS leverages a small proxy model as a surrogate for the LLM and employs a score model to estimate the long-term influence of training samples if the proxy model is trained to convergence. We formulate data selection as a bilevel optimization problem, where the upper-level objective optimizes the score model to assign importance weights to training samples, ensuring that minimizing the lower-level objective (i.e., training the proxy model over the weighted training loss until convergence) leads to best validation performance. Once optimized, the trained score model predicts influence scores for the dataset, enabling efficient selection of high-quality samples for LLM pretraining. We validate BLISS by pretraining 410M/1B/2.8B Pythia and LLaMA-0.5B models on selected subsets of the C4 dataset. Notably, under the 1B model setting, BLISS achieves $1.7\times$ speedup in reaching the same performance as the state-of-the-art method, demonstrating superior performance across multiple downstream tasks.

Method: BLISS使用小代理模型作为LLM的替代，并采用评分模型估计训练样本在代理模型训练至收敛时的长期影响。将数据选择建模为双层优化问题：上层优化评分模型以分配重要性权重，下层最小化加权训练损失至收敛，使验证性能最优。
Result: 在C4数据集上预训练多个LLM，1B模型设置下BLISS达到与最先进方法相同性能时加速1.7倍，且在多个下游任务上表现优越。
Conclusion: BLISS是一种轻量级、从零开始的数据选择方法，通过显式考虑长期影响和双层优化，有效提升LLM预训练效率。

papers.title: Domain-Shift-Aware Conformal Prediction for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have achieved impressive performance across diverse tasks. However, their tendency to produce overconfident and factually incorrect outputs, known as hallucinations, poses risks in real-world applications. Conformal prediction provides finite-sample, distribution-free coverage guarantees, but standard conformal prediction breaks down under domain shift, often leading to under-coverage and unreliable prediction sets. We propose a new framework called Domain-Shift-Aware Conformal Prediction (DS-CP). Our framework adapts conformal prediction to large language models under domain shift, by systematically reweighting calibration samples based on their proximity to the test prompt, thereby preserving validity while enhancing adaptivity. Our theoretical analysis and experiments on the MMLU benchmark demonstrate that the proposed method delivers more reliable coverage than standard conformal prediction, especially under substantial distribution shifts, while maintaining efficiency. This provides a practical step toward trustworthy uncertainty quantification for large language models in real-world deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出域偏移感知共形预测（DS-CP）框架，通过系统重新加权校准样本适应域偏移，为大语言模型提供更可靠的覆盖保证，实验在MMLU基准上验证。
Motivation: 标准共形预测在域偏移下失效，导致覆盖不足和不可靠的预测集，大语言模型容易产生过度自信和错误输出。
Method: 提出DS-CP框架，根据校准样本与测试提示的接近度重新加权，保留有效性的同时增强自适应性。
Result: 理论分析和在MMLU基准上的实验表明，DS-CP在分布偏移下提供更可靠的覆盖，同时保持效率。
Conclusion: DS-CP为大语言模型在真实部署中提供了可信的不确定性量化。

papers.title: Neural Low-Discrepancy Sequences
papers.abstract_en: Low-discrepancy points are designed to efficiently fill the space in a uniform manner. This uniformity is highly advantageous in many problems in science and engineering, including in numerical integration, computer vision, machine perception, computer graphics, machine learning, and simulation. Whereas most previous low-discrepancy constructions rely on abstract algebra and number theory, Message-Passing Monte Carlo (MPMC) was recently introduced to exploit machine learning methods for generating point sets with lower discrepancy than previously possible. However, MPMC is limited to generating point sets and cannot be extended to low-discrepancy sequences (LDS), i.e., sequences of points in which every prefix has low discrepancy, a property essential for many applications. To address this limitation, we introduce Neural Low-Discrepancy Sequences (NeuroLDS), the first machine learning-based framework for generating finite LDS. Drawing inspiration from classical LDS, we train a neural network to map indices to points such that the resulting sequences exhibit minimal discrepancy across all prefixes. To this end, we deploy a two-stage learning process: supervised approximation of classical constructions followed by unsupervised fine-tuning to minimize prefix discrepancies. We demonstrate that NeuroLDS outperforms all previous LDS constructions by a significant margin with respect to discrepancy measures. Moreover, we demonstrate the effectiveness of NeuroLDS across diverse applications, including numerical integration, robot motion planning, and scientific machine learning. These results highlight the promise and broad significance of Neural Low-Discrepancy Sequences. Our code can be found at https://github.com/camail-official/neuro-lds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroLDS，首个基于机器学习生成有限低差异序列（LDS）的框架。通过两阶段学习（先监督近似经典构造，再无监督微调最小化前缀差异），NeuroLDS 在差异度量上显著优于所有现有 LDS 构造，并在数值积分、机器人运动规划和科学机器学习等应用中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有低差异序列构造多依赖抽象代数和数论，而基于机器学习的 MPMC 方法只能生成点集，无法生成序列（即每个前缀都具有低差异的序列），限制了其在许多应用中的使用。
Method: 提出两阶段学习过程：第一阶段用监督学习逼近经典 LDS 构造，第二阶段用无监督微调优化前缀差异，训练神经网络将索引映射到点。
Result: NeuroLDS 在差异度量上显著超越所有先前 LDS 构造，并在数值积分、机器人运动规划和科学机器学习中展现有效性。
Conclusion: NeuroLDS 证明机器学习可以生成优于传统方法的低差异序列，具有广泛的应用前景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Trajectory Data Suffices for Statistically Efficient Policy Evaluation in Fixed-Horizon Offline RL with Linear $q^π$-Realizability and Concentrability
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-horizon offline reinforcement learning (RL) with function approximation for both policy evaluation and policy optimization. Prior work established that statistically efficient learning is impossible for either of these problems when the only assumptions are that the data has good coverage (concentrability) and the state-action value function of every policy is linearly realizable ($q^π$-realizability) (Foster et al., 2021). Recently, Tkachuk et al. (2024) gave a statistically efficient learner for policy optimization, if in addition the data is assumed to be given as trajectories. In this work we present a statistically efficient learner for policy evaluation under the same assumptions. Further, we show that the sample complexity of the learner used by Tkachuk et al. (2024) for policy optimization can be improved by a tighter analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限时域离线强化学习中的策略评估问题，在线性q^π可实现性和集中性假设下，当数据以轨迹形式提供时，给出了统计高效的学习器，并通过更紧的分析改进了先前策略优化算法的样本复杂度。
Motivation: 针对离线RL中仅凭线性可实现性和数据覆盖无法实现统计高效学习的理论障碍，探索在轨迹数据假设下能否实现高效策略评估。
Method: 基于轨迹数据假设，提出统计高效的政策评估学习器，并对现有政策优化算法的样本复杂度进行更紧的分析。
Result: 理论结果：在轨迹数据假设下，策略评估可实现统计高效；同时改进了策略优化的样本复杂度。
Conclusion: 证明了轨迹数据足以在有限时域线性函数近似下实现统计高效的策略评估，并提供更优的样本复杂度界限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HRTFformer: A Spatially-Aware Transformer for Individual HRTF Upsampling in Immersive Audio Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Individual Head-Related Transfer Functions (HRTFs) are starting to be introduced in many commercial immersive audio applications and are crucial for realistic spatial audio rendering. However, one of the main hesitations regarding their introduction is that creating individual HRTFs is impractical at scale due to the complexities of the HRTF measurement process. To mitigate this drawback, HRTF spatial upsampling has been proposed with the aim of reducing the measurements required. While prior work has seen success with different machine learning (ML) approaches, these models often struggle with long-range preservation of local spatial variation patterns across neighbouring source directions and generalization at high upsampling factors. In this paper, we propose a novel transformer-based architecture for HRTF upsampling, leveraging the attention mechanism to better capture spatial correlations across the HRTF sphere. Working in the spherical harmonic (SH) domain, our model learns to reconstruct high-resolution HRTFs from sparse input measurements with significantly improved accuracy. To enhance spatial coherence, we introduce a neighbour dissimilarity loss that promotes magnitude smoothness, yielding more realistic upsampling. We evaluate our method using both perceptual localization models and objective spectral distortion metrics. Experiments show that our model outperforms existing methods across several evaluation metrics in generating realistic, high-fidelity HRTFs.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的空间感知HRTF上采样模型HRTFformer，在球谐域中利用注意力机制从稀疏测量重建高分辨率HRTF，并引入邻域差异损失增强空间平滑性。实验表明该方法在感知定位模型和客观谱失真指标上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 个体HRTF对于沉浸式音频渲染至关重要，但测量过程复杂导致难以大规模应用。现有机器学习方法在保留相邻方向局部空间变化模式和高上采样因子下的泛化能力不足。
Method: 在球谐域中采用Transformer架构，利用注意力机制捕获HRTF球面上的空间相关性，并设计邻域差异损失（neighbour dissimilarity loss）促进幅度平滑性。
Result: 在多个评估指标上，包括感知定位模型和客观谱失真度量，所提模型在生成真实、高保真HRTF方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: HRTFformer通过空间感知的Transformer和自定义损失函数有效提升了HRTF上采样的准确性和真实性，为个体HRTF的实际应用提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Contrastive Representation Regularization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robot manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, their representations arguably remain suboptimal, lacking sensitivity to robotic signals such as control actions and proprioceptive information. To address the issue, we introduce Robot State-aware Contrastive Loss (RS-CL), a simple and effective representation regularization for VLA models, designed to bridge the gap between VLM representations and robotic signals. In particular, RS-CL aligns the representations more closely with the robot's proprioceptive states by using relative distances between the states as soft supervision. Complementing the original action prediction objective, RS-CL enhances control-relevant representation learning, while being lightweight and fully compatible with standard VLA training pipelines. Our empirical results demonstrate that RS-CL substantially improves the performance of state-of-the-art VLA models; it pushes the prior art to 69.7% achieving the state-of-the-art performance on the RoboCasa-Kitchen benchmark, and boosts success rates from 45.0% to 58.3% on challenging real-robot manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出机器人状态感知对比损失(RS-CL)，一种用于视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)的表示正则化方法，通过将表征与机器人本体感知状态对齐来提升机器人操作性能。摘要显示该方法在RoboCasa-Kitchen基准上达到了69.7%的最优性能，并在真实机器人任务上将成功率从45.0%提升到58.3%。
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型表征对机器人信号（如控制动作和本体感知信息）不够敏感，导致性能次优。
Method: 提出RS-CL，利用机器人本体感知状态之间的相对距离作为软监督，将表征与状态对齐，作为原始动作预测目标的补充。
Result: 在RoboCasa-Kitchen基准上达到69.7%的最优性能；在真实机器人操作任务上将成功率从45.0%提升到58.3%。
Conclusion: RS-CL是一种轻量且与标准VLA训练流程兼容的正则化方法，能有效增强控制相关表征学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Verifying Meta-Awareness via Predictive Rewards in Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent research on reasoning models explores the meta-awareness of language models, including their ability to determine optimal thinking duration, recognize knowledge boundaries, and structure concept-level thinking. While current large reasoning models depend solely on answer-based verification, we show that adding meta-awareness objectives leads to significant performance gains over models without such meta-knowledge. MAPR (Meta-Awareness via Predictive Reward) utilizes a self-generated task of predicting rollout statistics - specifically length, pass-rate, and concepts used - allowing for verification against the actual statistics. Furthermore, by leveraging this self-predictive capability, the model can regulate its reasoning behavior by i) filtering out trivial or unsolvable prompts, ii) reducing lengthy generations that tend to be incorrect, and iii) generating hints relevant to the problem. The results are inspiring: MAPR yields significant improvements in both accuracy and training efficiency on various reasoning benchmarks. More specifically, our method can speed up GRPO training by over 1.28x to reach the same performance, and achieve 83.18% gain in accuracy on AIME25, and a 13.04% average gain over six mathematics benchmarks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/akatigre/MAPR-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAPR（Meta-Awareness via Predictive Reward）方法，通过让推理模型自生成并预测 rollout 统计量（长度、通过率、所用概念），并与实际统计量进行验证，来增强模型的元认知能力。实验表明，MAPR 在多个数学推理基准上显著提升准确率和训练效率，例如在 AIME25 上准确率提升 83.18%，在六个数学基准上平均提升 13.04%，并能以 1.28 倍以上速度达到相同的 GRPO 训练性能。
Motivation: 现有大语言推理模型仅依赖基于答案的验证，缺乏对思考时长、知识边界等元认知的感知，限制了推理性能。
Method: 通过自生成任务预测 rollout 统计量（长度、通过率、所用概念），并基于实际统计量进行验证，利用该自预测能力过滤无关或不可解提示、减少错误的长生成、生成相关问题提示。

papers.title: Towards a Physics Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have revolutionized natural language processing through a ``train once, deploy anywhere'' paradigm, where a single pre-trained model adapts to countless downstream tasks without retraining. Access to a Physics Foundation Model (PFM) would be transformative - democratizing access to high-fidelity simulations, accelerating scientific discovery, and eliminating the need for specialized solver development. Yet current physics-aware machine learning approaches remain fundamentally limited to single, narrow domains and require retraining for each new system. We present the General Physics Transformer (GPhyT), trained on 1.8 TB of diverse simulation data, that demonstrates foundation model capabilities are achievable for physics. Our key insight is that transformers can learn to infer governing dynamics from context, enabling a single model to simulate fluid-solid interactions, shock waves, thermal convection, and multi-phase dynamics without being told the underlying equations. GPhyT achieves three critical breakthroughs: (1) superior performance across multiple physics domains, outperforming specialized architectures by more than 7x, (2) plausible zero-shot generalization to entirely unseen physical systems through in-context learning, and (3) more stable long-term predictions through long-horizon rollouts. By establishing that a single model can learn generalizable physical principles from data alone, this work opens the path toward a universal PFM that could transform computational science and engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通用物理变换器 (GPhyT)，在1.8TB多样化模拟数据上训练，首次展示基础模型能力可用于物理模拟。GPhyT 通过上下文学习推断控制动力学，无需知道底层方程，在多个物理领域（流固耦合、激波、热对流、多相流）上超越专业架构7倍以上，并实现零样本泛化到未见物理系统。
Motivation: 现有物理感知机器学习方法局限于单一窄领域，每个新系统都需要重新训练，缺乏像自然语言处理中“一次训练，处处部署”的基础模型能力。构建物理基础模型 (PFM) 可民主化高保真模拟访问并加速科学发现。
Method: 提出 General Physics Transformer (GPhyT)，在1.8 TB 的多样化模拟数据上预训练。核心思想是利用 Transformer 从上下文序列中学习推断潜在的控制动力学方程，从而无需显式指定方程即可模拟不同物理系统。
Result: GPhyT 在多个物理领域上性能优于专业架构超过7倍；通过上下文学习实现零样本泛化到完全未见过的物理系统；长程 rollout 预测更稳定。
Conclusion: 单一模型可以从数据中学习可泛化的物理原理，这为构建通用物理基础模型开辟了道路，有望变革计算科学与工程。

papers.title: InPhyRe Discovers: Large Multimodal Models Struggle in Inductive Physical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal models (LMMs) encode physical laws observed during training, such as momentum conservation, as parametric knowledge. It allows LMMs to answer physical reasoning queries, such as the outcome of a potential collision event from visual input. However, since parametric knowledge includes only the physical laws seen during training, it is insufficient for reasoning in inference scenarios that follow physical laws unseen during training. In such novel physical environments, humans could adapt their physical reasoning based on provided demonstrations. This inductive physical reasoning ability is indispensable for LMMs if they are to replace human agents in safety-critical applications. Despite its importance, existing visual benchmarks do not evaluate inductive physical reasoning and only consider the parametric knowledge in LMMs. To this end, we propose InPhyRe, the first visual question answering benchmark to measure inductive physical reasoning in LMMs. InPhyRe evaluates LMMs' ability to predict the outcome of collision events in algorithmically generated synthetic videos. By inspecting over 13 open-source and proprietary LMMs, InPhyRe informs us that (1) LMMs struggle to apply their limited parametric knowledge about universal physical laws to reasoning, (2) inductive physical reasoning in LMMs is weak when the physical laws underlying inference scenarios were unseen during training, and (3) inductive physical reasoning in LMMs suffers from language bias and may ignore the visual inputs, questioning the trustworthiness of LMMs regarding visual inputs.
papers.comment: Accepted to TMLR. 53 pages including appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InPhyRe，首个用于评估大型多模态模型（LMMs）归纳物理推理能力的视觉问答基准。通过在算法生成的合成视频中测试碰撞事件预测，发现 LMMs 难以应用训练中见过的通用物理定律进行推理，在未见过的物理规律场景下归纳推理能力弱，且存在语言偏差，可能忽略视觉输入。
Motivation: 现有视觉基准只评估 LMMs 对训练中见过的物理规律的参数化知识，无法衡量其在全新物理环境下的归纳物理推理能力，而这一能力对安全关键应用至关重要。
Method: 提出 InPhyRe 基准，使用算法生成的合成视频构建碰撞事件预测任务，通过改变物理规律（如动量守恒）来测试 LMMs 的归纳推理。
Result: 评估13个开源和专有 LMMs 发现：(1) LMMs 难以将其有限的通用物理定律知识用于推理；(2) 当推理场景的物理规律在训练中未见时，归纳推理能力弱；(3) 归纳推理受语言偏差影响，可能忽视视觉输入，质疑其视觉可信度。
Conclusion: 归纳物理推理是 LMMs 在安全关键应用中替代人类的关键能力，但当前 LMMs 在此方面表现不足，需改进。

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion VLA: Bringing Discrete Diffusion to Action Decoding in Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models adapt large vision-language backbones to map images and instructions into robot actions. However, prevailing VLAs either generate actions autoregressively in a fixed left-to-right order with poor performance or attach separate diffusion heads outside the backbone that fragments information pathways and hinders unified, scalable architectures. Instead, we present Discrete Diffusion VLA that discretizes action chunks and models them with discrete diffusion pattern retaining progressive refinement inside the unified transformer backbone. Our method achieves an adaptive decoding order that resolves high-confidence action elements before harder ones and employs secondary re-masking to revisit uncertain predictions, enabling robust error correction. This design preserves pretrained vision-language priors, supports parallel decoding, and improves the efficiency. Discrete Diffusion VLA achieves 96.4% avg. success on LIBERO, 71.2% visual matching on SimplerEnv-Fractal, and 54.2% overall on SimplerEnv-Bridge. On out-of-distribution tests of LIBERO-Goal, our method exhibits only 0.8% language degradation versus 8.0% of parallel decoding, and 20.4% vision degradation versus 29.0% for continuous diffusion, demonstrating well retention of pretrained vision-language capabilities. We also conduct two real-robot evaluations on AgileX Cobot Magic platform to show the method's effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Discrete Diffusion VLA，将离散扩散模型引入视觉-语言-动作策略的动作解码。通过将动作块离散化并采用离散扩散模式在统一Transformer骨干内逐步精化，实现自适应解码顺序和二次重掩码以纠正不确定预测。在LIBERO、SimplerEnv等基准上取得高成功率，并展现出对预训练视觉-语言能力的良好保持。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型要么固定自回归顺序生成动作，性能差；要么将扩散头附加在骨干外部，导致信息碎片化，阻碍统一可扩展架构。
Method: 提出将动作块离散化，用离散扩散模式在统一的Transformer骨干内进行逐步精化，采用自适应解码顺序（先高置信度动作元素，后难元素）和二次重掩码（re-masking）以纠正错误预测。
Result: 在LIBERO上平均成功率为96.4%，SimplerEnv-Fractal视觉匹配71.2%，SimplerEnv-Bridge总体54.2%。在LIBERO-Goal分布外测试中，语言退化仅0.8%（对比并行解码8.0%），视觉退化20.4%（对比连续扩散29.0%），表明对预训练视觉-语言能力的良好保持。
Conclusion: 论文强调该方法通过将离散扩散嵌入统一Transformer骨干，保留了预训练的视觉-语言先验，支持并行解码，提高了效率，并在多个基准上优于现有方法。

papers.title: TuneAgent: Agentic Operating System Kernel Tuning with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Linux kernel tuning is essential for optimizing operating system (OS) performance, yet remains challenging due to the complex kernel space, sparse performance feedback, and strong workload sensitivity. We present TuneAgent, an agentic Linux kernel tuning framework powered by rule-based reinforcement learning (RL). TuneAgent formulates the kernel space as a constrained RL environment, enabling large language models (LLMs) to autonomously explore the kernel while enforcing valid and precise configuration modifications. To address sparse performance feedback, we design structured reward functions that jointly promote reasoning standardization, configuration correctness, and performance awareness. Furthermore, we propose a two-phase training strategy that first ensures format and semantic correctness and then transitions to performance-driven exploration, accelerating convergence and reducing overhead. Experimental results show that TuneAgent consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving up to 5.6% relative overall performance improvement while maintaining high configuration validity. We further demonstrate its robustness across multiple real-world applications, highlighting its practicality and adaptability in diverse deployment environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TuneAgent，一种基于规则强化学习 (RL) 的智能体框架，用于 Linux 内核参数自动调优。它将内核空间建模为带约束的 RL 环境，让大语言模型 (LLM) 自主探索并修改配置；通过结构化的奖励函数解决性能反馈稀疏问题，并采用两阶段训练策略（先确保格式和语义正确性，再转向性能驱动探索）。实验表明，TuneAgent 在多个实际应用中实现高达 5.6% 的相对整体性能提升，并保持高配置有效性。
Motivation: Linux 内核调优对系统性能至关重要，但由于内核空间复杂、性能反馈稀疏、工作负载敏感性强，手动调优困难。现有方法缺乏自动化和智能性。
Method: 将内核空间建模为约束强化学习环境；设计结构化奖励函数（促进推理标准化、配置正确性和性能感知）；采用两阶段训练（先保证格式与语义正确，再启动性能驱动探索）。
Result: 相对整体性能提升最高达 5.6%，配置有效性高；在多种真实应用场景中验证了鲁棒性和适应性。
Conclusion: 规则强化学习可以有效驱动 LLM 自主进行内核调优，平衡探索与约束，框架具有良好的实用性和泛化能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: iLRM: An Iterative Large 3D Reconstruction Model
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D modeling has emerged as a promising approach for rapid and high-quality 3D reconstruction. In particular, directly generating explicit 3D representations, such as 3D Gaussian splatting, has attracted significant attention due to its fast and high-quality rendering. However, many state-of-the-art methods, primarily based on transformer architectures, suffer from severe scalability issues because they rely on full attention across image tokens from multiple input views, resulting in prohibitive computational costs as the number of views or image resolution increases. Toward a scalable and efficient feed-forward 3D reconstruction, we introduce an iterative Large 3D Reconstruction Model (iLRM) that generates 3D Gaussian representations through an iterative refinement mechanism, guided by three core principles: (1) decoupling the scene representation from input images to enable compact 3D representations; (2) decomposing global multi-view interactions into a two-stage attention scheme to reduce computational costs; and (3) injecting high-resolution information at every layer to achieve high-fidelity reconstruction. Experimental results on widely used datasets, such as RE10K and DL3DV, demonstrate that iLRM outperforms existing methods in both reconstruction quality and speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种迭代式大规模3D重建模型（iLRM），通过迭代细化机制生成3D高斯表示。三个核心原则：解耦场景表示与输入图像以实现紧凑表示；将全局多视图交互分解为两阶段注意力机制以降低计算成本；每层注入高分辨率信息以实现高保真重建。在RE10K和DL3DV数据集上，iLRM在重建质量和速度上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的前馈3D重建方法因对多视图图像token进行全注意力计算，随着视图数量或图像分辨率增加导致计算成本过高，存在严重的可扩展性问题。
Method: 提出iLRM，基于迭代细化机制，包含三个设计原则：解耦场景表示与输入图像；两阶段注意力分解全局多视图交互；每层注入高分辨率信息。
Result: 在RE10K和DL3DV数据集上，iLRM在重建质量和速度上均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限性，但表明所提方法在可扩展性和效率上取得了进步。

papers.title: Beyond Model Base Retrieval: Weaving Knowledge to Master Fine-grained Neural Network Design
papers.abstract_en: Designing high-performance neural networks for new tasks requires balancing optimization quality with search efficiency. Current methods fail to achieve this balance: neural architectural search is computationally expensive, while model retrieval often yields suboptimal static checkpoints. To resolve this dilemma, we model the performance gains induced by fine-grained architectural modifications as edit-effect evidence and build evidence graphs from prior tasks. By constructing a retrieval-augmented model refinement framework, our proposed M-DESIGN dynamically weaves historical evidence to discover near-optimal modification paths. M-DESIGN features an adaptive retrieval mechanism that quickly calibrates the evolving transferability of edit-effect evidence from different sources. To handle out-of-distribution shifts, we introduce predictive task planners that extrapolate gains from multi-hop evidence, thereby reducing reliance on an exhaustive repository. Based on our model knowledge base of 67,760 graph neural networks across 22 datasets, extensive experiments demonstrate that M-DESIGN consistently outperforms baselines, achieving the search-space best performance in 26 out of 33 cases under a strict budget.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Title changed from "Beyond Model Base Selection: Weaving Knowledge to Master Fine-grained Neural Network Design" to "Beyond Model Base Retrieval: Weaving Knowledge to Master Fine-grained Neural Network Design"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出M-DESIGN，一种检索增强的神经网络细粒度修改框架，通过将架构修改的性能增益建模为编辑效应证据并构建证据图，动态编织历史证据以发现近优修改路径。在包含67,760个图神经网络和22个数据集的知识库上，M-DESIGN在预算约束下的33个案例中26个达到搜索空间最优性能，优于基线方法。
Motivation: 现有神经架构搜索计算昂贵，而模型检索只能得到次优静态检查点，无法在优化质量与搜索效率之间取得平衡。
Method: 将细粒度架构修改的收益建模为编辑效应证据并构建证据图；提出自适应检索机制校准不同来源证据的可迁移性；引入预测任务规划器通过多跳证据外推增益以减少对完备库的依赖。
Result: 在67,760个图神经网络的知识库和22个数据集上，M-DESIGN在预算约束下的33个案例中26个达到搜索空间最优性能，持续超越基线。
Conclusion: M-DESIGN通过编织历史证据实现了高效的神经网络设计，其自适应检索和预测规划器有助于处理分布外偏移，降低对穷尽库的依赖。

papers.title: Model Parallelism With Subnetwork Data Parallelism
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training large neural networks at scale imposes heavy memory demands on accelerators and often requires costly communication. We introduce Subnetwork Data Parallelism (SDP), a distributed training framework that partitions a model into structured subnetworks trained across workers without exchanging activations. We study two complementary masking regimes: backward masking, which applies sparsity only in the backward step to retain unbiased gradients, and forward masking, which also removes parameters in the forward pass to deliver stronger efficiency gains while providing additional regularization. We further explore two subnetwork construction strategies: neuron level and block level, applied across both transformers and CNNs. In experiments spanning 1B LLaMA pre-training on FineWeb to ResNet-18 on CIFAR, SDP reduces per device memory usage by 28%-60% while maintaining or improving performance under FLOP-matched settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出子网络数据并行（SDP）框架，通过将模型划分为结构化子网络并在不同工作节点上独立训练，无需交换激活值，从而降低分布式训练的内存和通信开销。研究了后向掩码和前向掩码两种稀疏化策略，以及神经元级和块级两种子网构建方法。在1B参数的LLaMA预训练和ResNet-18等实验中，SDP在FLOP匹配条件下减少每设备内存28%-60%，并保持或提升性能。
Motivation: 大规模神经网络预训练对加速器内存需求高，且分布式训练中激活值交换导致通信成本昂贵。现有模型并行方法往往需要复杂的激活同步或流水线调度。
Method: 提出SDP框架，将模型参数分为多个不重叠的子网络，每个子网络在一组工作节点上独立训练，前向和反向传播均不交换激活。采用两种掩码策略：后向掩码（仅反向传播施加稀疏，保持无偏梯度）和前向掩码（前向也移除参数，提高效率并提供正则化）。子网构建支持神经元级和块级两种粒度。
Result: 在1B LLaMA预训练（FineWeb）和ResNet-18（CIFAR）等实验中，SDP将每设备内存占用降低28%-60%，并在FLOP匹配条件下保持或超过基线模型的性能。
Conclusion: SDP通过避免激活交换和灵活的子网稀疏掩码，有效缓解了模型并行中的内存和通信瓶颈，可适用Transformer和CNN架构。

papers.title: Truth, Trust, and Trouble: Medical AI on the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) hold significant promise for transforming digital health by enabling automated medical question answering. However, ensuring these models meet critical industry standards for factual accuracy, usefulness, and safety remains a challenge, especially for open-source solutions. We present a rigorous benchmarking framework using a dataset of over 1,000 health questions. We assess model performance across honesty, helpfulness, and harmlessness. Our results highlight trade-offs between factual reliability and safety among evaluated models -- Mistral-7B, BioMistral-7B-DARE, and AlpaCare-13B. AlpaCare-13B achieves the highest accuracy (91.7%) and harmlessness (0.92), while domain-specific tuning in BioMistral-7B-DARE boosts safety (0.90) despite its smaller scale. Few-shot prompting improves accuracy from 78% to 85%, and all models show reduced helpfulness on complex queries, highlighting ongoing challenges in clinical QA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对医疗问答的LLM基准测试框架，使用1000多个健康问题评估模型的诚实性、有用性和无害性。实验比较了Mistral-7B、BioMistral-7B-DARE和AlpaCare-13B，发现AlpaCare-13B在准确率(91.7%)和无害性(0.92)上表现最佳，领域微调提升了安全性，但所有模型在复杂查询上表现下降。
Motivation: 确保LLM在数字健康中满足事实准确性、有用性和安全性的行业标准仍具挑战，尤其对于开源模型。
Method: 提出了一个严格的基准测试框架，使用超过1000个健康问题，评估模型在诚实性、有用性和无害性三个维度上的表现。
Result: AlpaCare-13B准确率最高(91.7%)和无害性(0.92)；BioMistral-7B-DARE通过领域微调在较小规模下实现0.90的安全性；少样本提示将准确率从78%提升到85%；所有模型在复杂查询上有用性降低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调事实可靠性与安全性之间的权衡，并指出临床QA仍面临挑战。

papers.title: CLIP-like Model as a Foundational Density Ratio Estimator
papers.abstract_en: Density ratio estimation is a core concept in statistical machine learning because it provides a unified mechanism for tasks such as importance weighting, divergence estimation, and likelihood-free inference, but its potential in vision and language models has not been fully explored. Modern vision-language encoders such as CLIP and SigLIP are trained with contrastive objectives that implicitly optimize log density ratios between joint and marginal image-text distributions, which implicitly learn similarity scores proportional to log density ratios. However, prior work has largely focused on their embedding utility, and the density-ratio structure induced by contrastive learning has not been systematically examined or exploited in multimodal applications. To address this gap, we reinterpret CLIP-style models as pretrained and general-purpose density ratio estimators and show that this perspective enables new algorithmic capabilities. We present a unified explanation of how contrastive objectives estimate density ratios and propose two practical applications: Importance Weight Learning and KL divergence estimation. Our Importance Weight Learning method requires only a single additional prompt and improves F1 scores by up to 7 points. We further show that CLIP-based density ratios support estimation of KL divergences that quantify how conditioning on an image or text alters the distribution of the other modality. Through qualitative examples and an N-gram analysis of captions, we find that these divergences capture semantic diversity and mode structure in multimodal data. Leveraging this property, we introduce a simple KL-guided data curation method that achieves performance competitive with LAION2B filtering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新解释CLIP-style模型作为预训练的通用密度比估计器，并展示了这一视角的新算法能力。提出了重要性权重学习（仅需额外一个提示，F1提升最多7点）和KL散度估计。通过KL引导的数据筛选方法，性能与LAION2B过滤竞争。
Motivation: 密度比估计在统计机器学习中核心但未在视觉语言模型中充分探索。对比学习隐式优化了联合与边际分布的log密度比，但未被系统利用。
Method: 统一解释对比目标如何估计密度比，提出重要性权重学习和KL散度估计两个应用。重要性权重学习仅需额外一个提示；KL散度估计用于量化模态间条件分布变化，并用于数据筛选。
Result: 重要性权重学习在F1上提升最多7点。CLIP-based密度比支持KL散度估计，通过定性示例和N-gram分析发现其捕捉语义多样性和模式结构。KL引导数据筛选方法性能与LAION2B过滤竞争。
Conclusion: 通过重新解释CLIP作为密度比估计器，实现了重要性学习与KL估计的有效应用，为多模态密度比估计提供了新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: Stop Chasing the C-index when Evaluating Survival Analysis Models
papers.abstract_en: The current state of evaluation in survival analysis is plagued by the persistent use of evaluation metrics in ways that are misaligned with the stated modeling objective. In addition, many such evaluations are based on censoring assumptions that are left implicit or unjustified. This means that the reported performance can be misleading and may fail to answer the scientific or modeling question the evaluation was intended to address. In this position paper, we critically examine evaluation practices in survival analysis and highlight how censoring makes evaluation fundamentally different from standard regression or classification. We place particular focus on concordance-based measures, such as the C-index, which we show are heavily overused in the literature. To help identify appropriate metrics, we propose a set of key desiderata and introduce a double-helix ladder, in which valid evaluation requires alignment between metric and modeling assumptions. Through controlled experiments, we show that violations of this alignment can lead to misleading model comparisons. We conclude by providing practical guidance on how to evaluate a survival model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判了生存分析领域当前评估指标使用不当的问题，特别是C-index的过度使用，指出其与建模目标不匹配且依赖未经证实的删失假设。作者提出关键期望属性双螺旋阶梯（double-helix ladder）来指导指标选择，并通过实验证明违反指标对齐会导致误导性模型比较，最后给出实践建议。
Motivation: 生存分析的评估指标常与建模目标不一致，且基于隐含或未被验证的删失假设，导致报告性能具有误导性，无法正确回答科学问题。
Method: 作者以立场论文形式批判评估实践，重点关注C-index等一致性指标。提出关键期望属性（key desiderata）和双螺旋阶梯框架，要求评估指标与模型假设对齐。通过控制实验展示指标错配的危害。
Result: 通过控制实验表明，违反指标-假设对齐会导致误导性的模型比较。
Conclusion: 论文强调评估生存模型时需要谨慎选择与建模假设一致的指标，并提供实用指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ToMAP: Training Opponent-Aware LLM Persuaders with Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promising potential in persuasion, but existing works on training LLM persuaders are still preliminary. Notably, while humans are skilled in modeling their opponent's thoughts and opinions proactively and dynamically, current LLMs struggle with such Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning, resulting in limited diversity and opponent awareness. To address this limitation, we introduce Theory of Mind Augmented Persuader (ToMAP), a novel approach for building more flexible persuader agents by incorporating two theory of mind modules that enhance the persuader's awareness and analysis of the opponent's mental state. Specifically, we begin by prompting the persuader to consider possible objections to the target central claim, and then use a text encoder paired with a trained MLP classifier to predict the opponent's current stance on these counterclaims. Our carefully designed reinforcement learning schema enables the persuader learns how to analyze opponent-related information and utilize it to generate more effective arguments. Experiments show that the ToMAP persuader, while containing only 3B parameters, outperforms much larger baselines, like GPT-4o, with a relative gain of 39.4% across multiple persuadee models and diverse corpora. Notably, ToMAP exhibits complex reasoning chains and reduced repetition during training, which leads to more diverse and effective arguments. The opponent-aware feature of ToMAP also makes it suitable for long conversations and enables it to employ more logical and opponent-aware strategies. These results underscore our method's effectiveness and highlight its potential for developing more persuasive language agents. Code is available at: https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/ToMAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ToMAP方法，通过集成两个心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）模块增强LLM说服者的对手意识。方法包括让说服者考虑对目标主张的可能反对，并用文本编码器和MLP分类器预测对手对这些反主张的立场。强化学习模式让说服者学会分析对手信息并生成更有效论点。实验表明3B参数的ToMAP在多个说服对象模型和语料上相对GPT-4o提升39.4%，且展现出复杂推理链和减少重复。
Motivation: 现有LLM说服者缺乏对人类对手的动态建模能力，无法像人类一样主动和动态地建模对手想法和意见，导致多样性不足和对手意识欠缺。
Method: 引入两个心智理论模块：首先提示说服者考虑对目标主张的可能反对意见，然后使用文本编码器和训练的MLP分类器预测对手当前对这些反主张的立场。采用精心设计的强化学习模式，让说服者学会分析对手相关信息并利用其生成更有效论点。
Result: 3B参数的ToMAP在多个说服对象模型和不同语料上优于GPT-4o等更大基线模型，相对提升39.4%。ToMAP展现出复杂推理链和更低的重复率，产生更多样有效的论点，且对手感知特性使其适用于长对话。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ToMAP方法的有效性，并指出其在开发更 persuasive 的语言代理方面的潜力。
Relevance: 0
