summary_sections.method: 引入两个心智理论模块：首先提示说服者考虑对目标主张的可能反对意见，然后使用文本编码器和训练的MLP分类器预测对手当前对这些反主张的立场。采用精心设计的强化学习模式，让说服者学会分析对手相关信息并利用其生成更有效论点。
summary_sections.result: 3B参数的ToMAP在多个说服对象模型和不同语料上优于GPT-4o等更大基线模型，相对提升39.4%。ToMAP展现出复杂推理链和更低的重复率，产生更多样有效的论点，且对手感知特性使其适用于长对话。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调ToMAP方法的有效性，并指出其在开发更 persuasive 的语言代理方面的潜力。

papers.title: Cellwise and Casewise Robust Covariance in High Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: The sample covariance matrix is a cornerstone of multivariate statistics, but it is highly sensitive to outliers. These can be casewise outliers, such as cases belonging to a different population, or cellwise outliers, which are deviating cells (entries) of the data matrix. Recently some robust covariance estimators have been developed that can handle both types of outliers, but their computation is only feasible up to at most 20 dimensions. To remedy this we propose the cellRCov method, a robust covariance estimator that simultaneously handles casewise outliers, cellwise outliers, and missing data. It relies on a decomposition of the covariance on principal and orthogonal subspaces, leveraging recent work on robust PCA. It also employs a ridge-type regularization to stabilize the estimated covariance matrix. We establish some theoretical properties of cellRCov, including its casewise and cellwise influence functions as well as consistency and asymptotic normality. A simulation study demonstrates the superior performance of cellRCov in contaminated and missing data scenarios. Furthermore, its practical utility is illustrated in a real-world application to anomaly detection. We also construct and illustrate the cellRCCA method for robust and regularized canonical correlation analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高维稳健协方差估计方法cellRCov，能同时处理casewise离群点、cellwise离群点和缺失数据。该方法基于主成分和正交子空间的分解，结合岭型正则化，并具有理论性质如影响函数和渐近正态性。模拟和实际数据表明其在污染和缺失场景下的优越性能，并扩展为cellRCCA用于稳健典型相关分析。
Motivation: 现有稳健协方差估计方法难以同时处理casewise和cellwise离群点，且维度上限仅约20维。需要一种能在高维下同时应对两种离群点和缺失数据的方法。
Method: 提出cellRCov方法，通过将协方差分解到主成分和正交子空间（基于稳健PCA），并加入岭正则化来稳定估计。
Result: 模拟研究显示cellRCov在污染和缺失数据场景下表现优越，并成功应用于实际异常检测案例。
Conclusion: cellRCov是一种高维稳健协方差估计，能同时处理多种数据异常，并具备理论保证，可扩展至稳健典型相关分析。

papers.title: DetailMaster: Can Your Text-to-Image Model Handle Long Prompts?
papers.abstract_en: While recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models show impressive capabilities in synthesizing images from brief descriptions, they struggle with the long, detailed prompts required for professional applications. We present DetailMaster, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating T2I capabilities on long prompts with complex compositional requirements, accompanied by an automated data construction pipeline and an evaluation workflow. Comprising expert-validated prompts averaging 284.89 tokens, our benchmark introduces four critical evaluation dimensions: Character Attributes, Structured Character Locations, Multi-Dimensional Scene Attributes, and Spatial/Interactive Relationships. Evaluations on various general-purpose and long-prompt-optimized models reveal critical performance limitations, showing that weak encoders struggle to preserve syntactic dependencies within prompts and diffusion models suffer from attribute leakage under detail-intensive conditions. Through a controlled ablation study under varying constraints, we further show that high-fidelity generation requires a synergistic combination of expanded prompt limits and long-prompt training. We open-source our dataset and code to foster progress in long-prompt-driven T2I generation.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 10 figures, 21 tables, accepted by ICML2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DetailMaster，一个专门评估文本到图像模型处理长提示能力的基准，包含平均 284.89 token 的专家验证提示，涵盖字符属性、结构位置、多维场景属性和空间/交互关系四个维度。实验发现弱编码器难以保留句法依赖，扩散模型在细节密集条件下存在属性泄露，并提出高保真生成需要扩展提示限制与长提示训练的协同组合。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型在简短描述上表现良好，但无法处理专业应用所需的长而详细的提示，缺乏系统性评估基准。
Method: 构建一个自动化数据构建管道和评估工作流，生成专家验证的长提示，并设计四个关键评估维度：字符属性、结构化角色位置、多维场景属性、空间/交互关系。
Result: 评估多种通用和长提示优化模型，发现弱编码器无法保持句法依赖，扩散模型在细节密集型条件下出现属性泄漏；消融实验表明高保真生成需要扩展提示限制和长提示训练的组合。
Conclusion: 开源数据集和代码以推动长提示驱动的文本到图像生成进步，强调当前模型的局限性及改进方向。

papers.title: LLMSynthor: Macro-Aligned Micro-Records Synthesis with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Macro-aligned micro-records are crucial for credible simulations in social science and urban studies. For example, epidemic models are only reliable when individual-level mobility and contacts mirror real behavior, while aggregates match real-world statistics like case counts or travel flows. However, collecting such fine-grained data at scale is impractical, leaving researchers with only macro-level data. LLMSynthor addresses this by turning a pretrained LLM into a macro-aware simulator that generates realistic micro-records consistent with target macro-statistics. It iteratively builds synthetic datasets: in each step, the LLM generates batches of records to minimize discrepancies between synthetic and target aggregates. Treating the LLM as a nonparametric copula allows the model to capture realistic joint dependencies among variables. To improve efficiency, LLM Proposal Sampling guides the LLM to propose targeted record batches, specifying variable ranges and counts, to efficiently correct discrepancies while preserving realism grounded in the model's priors. Evaluations across domains (mobility, e-commerce, population) show that LLMSynthor achieves strong realism, statistical fidelity, and practical utility, making it broadly applicable to economics, social science, and urban studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLMSynthor 将预训练大语言模型（LLM）转化为宏观对齐的微记录生成器，通过迭代生成合成数据集来匹配目标宏观统计量。该方法将 LLM 视为非参数 Copula，捕获变量间的真实联合依赖，并使用 LLM 提议采样（LLM Proposal Sampling）指导生成目标批次以高效修正差异。在流动性、电子商务和人口等领域的评估显示其具有强真实性和统计保真度。
Motivation: 社会科学和城市研究中需要宏观对齐的微观记录进行可信模拟，但大规模收集细粒度数据不切实际，只有宏观数据可用。
Method: 将预训练 LLM 作为宏观感知模拟器，通过迭代生成合成微记录并最小化与目标宏观统计的差异；采用 LLM 提议采样高效生成目标批次，利用模型先验保持真实性。
Result: 在流动性、电子商务和人口等跨领域评估中，LLMSynthor 实现了强真实性、统计保真度和实际效用。
Conclusion: 该方法可广泛适用于经济学、社会科学和城市研究中的模拟任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HR-VILAGE-3K3M: A Human Respiratory Viral Immunization Longitudinal Gene Expression Dataset for Systems Immunity
papers.abstract_en: Respiratory viral infections pose a global health burden, yet the cellular immune mechanisms underlying protection and pathology remain unclear. Natural infection cohorts often lack pre-exposure baselines and time-controlled sampling, whereas inoculation and vaccination trials generate well-structured longitudinal transcriptomic data. However, these datasets are scattered across repositories and processed inconsistently, hindering integrative and AI-driven analyses. To address these challenges, we developed the Human Respiratory Viral Immunization LongitudinAl Gene Expression (HR-VILAGE-3K3M) repository: an AI-ready resource integrating bulk and single-cell transcriptomic profiles from 3,178 subjects across 66 studies. The dataset spans vaccination, inoculation, and mixed exposures, with samples from blood and nasal swabs collected from public repositories including GEO, ImmPort, and ArrayExpress. We curated and harmonized subject-level metadata, standardized outcome measures, and applied unified preprocessing with rigorous quality control. We further provide benchmark analyses illustrating its utility. This resource supports discovery of biomarkers, immune mechanisms, and methodological development. As one of the largest longitudinal transcriptomic resources for human respiratory viral immunization, HR-VILAGE-3K3M enables reproducible and scalable analyses to accelerate vaccine and antiviral research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了HR-VILAGE-3K3M，一个整合了66项研究、3178名受试者的呼吸病毒免疫纵向基因表达数据集，涵盖疫苗接种、病毒接种和混合暴露场景，包含bulk和单细胞转录组数据，并经过统一预处理和质量控制，旨在支持生物标志物发现、免疫机制研究和分析方法开发。
Motivation: 呼吸病毒感染造成全球健康负担，但细胞免疫机制仍不清楚。现有自然感染队列缺乏暴露前基线和时间对照采样，而接种和疫苗试验数据分散且处理不一致，阻碍了整合和AI驱动分析。
Method: 构建了HR-VILAGE-3K3M资源库：从GEO、ImmPort和ArrayExpress等公共数据库收集66项研究、3178名受试者的血液和鼻拭子样本转录组数据（bulk和单细胞），进行主题级元数据协调、结果标准化、统一预处理和严格质量控制，并提供基准分析。
Result: 该数据集是目前最大的人类呼吸病毒免疫纵向转录组资源之一，支持可重复、可扩展的分析以加速疫苗和抗病毒研究。摘要未提供具体的性能数值。
Conclusion: HR-VILAGE-3K3M作为AI-ready资源，能够支持呼吸病毒免疫相关的生物标志物发现、机制研究和分析方法开发。

papers.title: Language Model Networks: Supervision-Efficient Learning through Dense Communication
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly used not only as standalone predictors but also as components in larger inference systems, from test-time scaling to multi-agent collaboration. We study language model networks, where pre-trained language models serve as reusable nodes and intelligence emerges from their topology, communication, and optimization. Existing systems mostly communicate through natural language: easy to deploy, but discrete, inefficient, and hard to optimize from end-task supervision. We propose LMNet, a dense and differentiable realization of this paradigm. LMNet uses stripped LLMs as vertex modules and trainable seq2seq modules as communication edges, enabling intermediate nodes to exchange dense vectors while preserving natural-language input and output at the system boundary. By bypassing intermediate embedding and de-embedding, LMNet enables efficient information transfer, end-to-end gradient optimization, and learned communication beyond hand-designed protocols. Experiments show performance with small additional training cost and effective adaptation under limited supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LMNet，一种密集可微的语言模型网络，利用精简LLM作为节点、可训练seq2seq模块作为通信边，实现密集向量交换和端到端梯度优化，以提升监督效率。实验表明，该方法在有限监督下以少量额外训练成本取得性能提升。
Motivation: 现有语言模型网络主要依赖自然语言通信，离散、低效且难以从端任务监督中优化，限制了端到端学习和信息传递效率。
Method: LMNet使用精简LLM作为顶点模块，可训练的seq2seq模块作为通信边，在系统边界保留自然语言输入输出，中间节点交换密集向量，实现端到端梯度优化和超越手工设计的通信。
Result: 实验显示该方法在有限监督下有效适应，性能提升且仅需小额外训练成本。
Conclusion: 本文表明密集可微的通信设计能提升语言模型网络的监督效率和端到端优化能力。

papers.title: Machine Learning (ML)-Physics Fusion Model Outperforms Both Physics-Only and ML-Only Models in Typhoon Predictions
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven machine learning (ML) models, such as FuXi, exhibit notable limitations in forecasting typhoon intensity and structure. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of FuXi-SHTM, a hybrid ML-physics model, using all 2024 western North Pacific typhoon cases. The FuXi-SHTM hybrid demonstrates clear improvements in both track and intensity forecasts compared to the standalone SHTM, FuXi, and ECMWF HRES models. Compared to FuXi alone, FuXi-SHTM reduces typhoon track forecast errors by 16.5% and 5.2% at lead times of 72 h and 120 h, respectively, and reduces intensity forecast errors by 59.7% and 47.6%. Furthermore, FuXi-SHTM simulates cloud structures more realistically compared to SHTM, and achieves superior representation of the 10-m wind fields in both intensity and spatial structure compared to FuXi and SHTM. Increasing the resolution of FuXi-SHTM from 9 km to 3 km further enhances intensity forecasts, highlighting the critical role of the resolution of the physical model in advancing hybrid forecasting capabilities.
papers.comment: We request withdrawal of this manuscript because we identified an error in the experimental workflow after submission. The issue concerns the data preprocessing and verification procedure used for the model evaluation,
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了混合ML-物理模型FuXi-SHTM在2024年西北太平洋台风预测中的表现，结果显示相比纯物理模型SHTM、纯ML模型FuXi和ECMWF HRES，该混合模型在路径和强度预测上均有显著改进，并更真实地模拟云结构和10米风场。
Motivation: 数据驱动的ML模型（如FuXi）在台风强度和结构预测上存在明显局限，亟需结合物理模型提升预测能力。
Method: 融合FuXi（ML模型）与SHTM（物理模型）构建混合模型FuXi-SHTM，并在9km和3km分辨率下进行台风预测实验。
Result: FuXi-SHTM相比纯FuXi，72小时和120小时路径预测误差分别降低16.5%和5.2%，强度预测误差降低59.7%和47.6%；提高分辨率至3km进一步改善强度预测。
Conclusion: ML-物理融合方法在台风预测中优于单一模型，物理模型分辨率对混合预测能力至关重要。

summary_sections.method: 融合FuXi（ML模型）与SHTM（物理模型）构建混合模型FuXi-SHTM，并在9km和3km分辨率下进行台风预测实验。
summary_sections.result: FuXi-SHTM相比纯FuXi，72小时和120小时路径预测误差分别降低16.5%和5.2%，强度预测误差降低59.7%和47.6%；提高分辨率至3km进一步改善强度预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: ML-物理融合方法在台风预测中优于单一模型，物理模型分辨率对混合预测能力至关重要。

papers.title: Atmospheric Predictability Beyond 30 Days with Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric predictability research has long held that rapid error growth at small spatial scales imposes an intrinsic limit of roughly two weeks on deterministic weather forecast skill. We challenge this limit using GraphCast, a machine-learning weather model, by optimizing initial conditions for twice-daily forecasts spanning 2020. This approach yields an average error reduction of 86% at ten days relative to control forecasts from reanalysis initial conditions, with skill lasting beyond 30 days. Mean optimal initial-condition perturbations reveal large-scale, spatially coherent corrections primarily reflecting an intensification of the Hadley circulation. Forecasts using GraphCast-optimal initial conditions in the Pangu-Weather model achieve a 21% error reduction, peaking at four days, indicating that analysis corrections reflect adjustments that target both model and analysis error. These results demonstrate the existence of initial conditions producing skillful deterministic forecasts far beyond two weeks. Whether such initial conditions can be identified in real-time for improving operational weather forecasts remains a topic of future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用机器学习天气模型GraphCast，通过优化初始条件，挑战了传统认为确定性天气预报存在两周固有可预报性极限的观点。在2020年每日两次的预报实验中，该方法在10天时平均误差比再分析初始条件的控制预报降低86%，且技能持续超过30天。最优初始条件扰动主要增强哈德莱环流。使用GraphCast最优初始条件在Pangu-Weather模型中也实现21%的误差降低。结果表明存在产生超越两周确定性预报技能的初始条件。
Motivation: 传统观点认为小尺度快速误差增长导致确定性天气预报上限约为两周，本文旨在证明通过机器学习优化初始条件可以突破这一极限。
Method: 使用GraphCast模型，针对2020年每日两次预报，优化初始条件以获得更长的可预报性；并评估最优扰动在Pangu-Weather模型中的迁移效果。
Result: GraphCast优化初始条件使10天预报误差平均降低86%，技能持续超过30天；最优扰动主要为大规模、空间连贯的哈德莱环流增强。在Pangu-Weather模型上迁移实现21%误差降低，峰值在4天。
Conclusion: 研究证明了存在可产生远超两周确定性预报技能的初始条件，但在实际业务预报中实时识别此类初始条件仍是未来课题。

papers.title: Agent Guide: A Simple Agent Behavioral Watermarking Framework
papers.abstract_en: The increasing deployment of intelligent agents in digital ecosystems, such as social media platforms, has raised significant concerns about traceability and accountability, particularly in cybersecurity and digital content protection. Traditional large language model (LLM) watermarking techniques, which rely on token-level manipulations, are ill-suited for agents due to the challenges of behavior tokenization and information loss during behavior-to-action translation. To address these issues, we propose Agent Guide, a novel behavioral watermarking framework that embeds watermarks by guiding the agent's high-level decisions (behavior) through probability biases, while preserving the naturalness of specific executions (action). Our approach decouples agent behavior into two levels, behavior (e.g., choosing to bookmark) and action (e.g., bookmarking with specific tags), and applies watermark-guided biases to the behavior probability distribution. We employ a z-statistic-based statistical analysis to detect the watermark, ensuring reliable extraction over multiple rounds. Experiments in a social media scenario with diverse agent profiles demonstrate that Agent Guide achieves effective watermark detection with a low false positive rate. Our framework provides a practical and robust solution for agent watermarking, with applications in identifying malicious agents and protecting proprietary agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agent Guide，一种针对智能体（agent）的行为水印框架，通过在行为概率分布上施加偏置来嵌入水印，并使用z统计量进行检测。实验在社交媒体场景下验证了低假阳率的有效检测。
Motivation: 传统LLM水印依赖token级操作，不适用于智能体，因为行为难以token化且行为到动作的转换存在信息损失。需要一种针对智能体行为的水印方法以增强可追溯性和责任性。
Method: 将智能体行为解耦为行为（如选择书签）和动作（如用特定标签书签）两个层次，在行为概率分布上施加水印引导的偏置，并通过z统计量进行多轮统计检测。
Result: 在社交媒体场景中，使用多种智能体配置的实验表明，Agent Guide能够实现有效的水印检测，且假阳性率较低。
Conclusion: 该框架为智能体水印提供了一种实用且鲁棒的解决方案，可应用于识别恶意智能体及保护专有智能体系统。

papers.title: Scalable Ride-Sourcing Vehicle Rebalancing with Service Accessibility Guarantee: A Constrained Mean-Field Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: The expansion of ride-sourcing services such as Uber and Lyft has reshaped urban transportation by offering flexible, on-demand mobility via mobile applications. Despite convenience, these platforms confront significant operational challenges, particularly vehicle rebalancing-strategic repositioning of a fleet of vehicles to address spatiotemporal mismatches in supply and demand. Inadequate rebalancing results in prolonged rider waiting times and inefficient vehicle utilization, but also leads to fairness issues, such as the inequitable distribution of service and disparities in driver income. To tackle these, we introduce continuous-state mean-field control (MFC) and mean-field reinforcement learning (MFRL) models with continuous repositioning actions. MFC and MFRL offer scalable solutions by modeling each vehicle's behavior through interaction with the vehicle distribution, rather than with individual vehicles. This mitigates the curse of dimensionality with respect to the number of agents, enabling coordination across large fleets with significantly reduced computational complexity and eliminating the need to retrain the model when fleet size changes. To ensure equitable service access across geographic regions, we integrate an accessibility constraint into models and derive rebalancing policies that strike a balance between high fulfillment of rider demand and fair coverage of vehicle supply. Extensive evaluation using data-driven simulation of Shenzhen demonstrates the efficiency and robustness of our approach. Remarkably, it scales to tens of thousands of vehicles, with training times comparable to linear programming rebalancing. Besides, our policies effectively explore the efficiency-equity Pareto front, outperforming conventional benchmarks across key metrics like fleet utilization, fulfilled requests, and pickup distance, while ensuring equitable service access.
papers.journal_ref: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies, Vol. 188, 105705 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于连续状态均值场控制(MFC)和均值场强化学习(MFRL)的网约车车辆再平衡方法，通过引入服务可达性约束，在保证公平服务的前提下优化效率。在深圳市数据驱动的仿真中，该方法可扩展至数万辆车，训练时间与线性规划再平衡相当，并能有效探索效率-公平帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 网约车平台面临车辆再平衡挑战，供需时空不匹配导致乘客等待时间长、车辆利用率低，且存在服务分布不均等公平性问题。现有方法难以兼顾大规模车队协调与公平性约束。
Method: 采用连续状态均值场控制和均值场强化学习，通过车辆与车辆分布交互而非个体交互建模，克服智能体数量维数灾难，并引入可达性约束以平衡需求满足率与公平覆盖。
Result: 基于深圳数据驱动的仿真表明，该方法可扩展至数万辆车，训练时间与线性规划再平衡相当，在车队利用率、请求满足率和接送距离等指标上优于传统基准，并有效探索效率-公平帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: 该工作表明均值场强化学习结合可达性约束可高效解决大规模网约车再平衡问题，兼顾效率与公平，但依赖准确的仿真模型，实际部署中需考虑真实动态环境。

papers.title: Seg-Zero: Reasoning-Chain Guided Segmentation via Cognitive Reinforcement
papers.abstract_en: Traditional methods for reasoning segmentation rely on supervised fine-tuning with categorical labels and simple descriptions, limiting its out-of-domain generalization and lacking explicit reasoning processes. To address these limitations, we propose Seg-Zero, a novel framework that demonstrates remarkable generalizability and derives explicit chain-of-thought reasoning through cognitive reinforcement. Seg-Zero introduces a decoupled architecture consisting of a reasoning model and a segmentation model. The reasoning model interprets user intentions, generates explicit reasoning chains, and produces positional prompts, which are subsequently used by the segmentation model to generate precious pixel-level masks. We design a sophisticated reward mechanism that integrates both format and accuracy rewards to effectively guide optimization directions. Trained exclusively via reinforcement learning with GRPO and without explicit reasoning data, Seg-Zero achieves robust zero-shot generalization and exhibits emergent test-time reasoning capabilities. Experiments show that Seg-Zero-7B achieves a zero-shot performance of 57.5 on the ReasonSeg benchmark, surpassing the prior LISA-7B by 18\%. This significant improvement highlights Seg-Zero's ability to generalize across domains while presenting an explicit reasoning process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Seg-Zero，一种通过认知强化学习实现推理链引导的分割框架。该方法采用解耦架构，由推理模型和分割模型组成，推理模型生成推理链和位置提示，分割模型据此产生像素级掩码。通过 GRPO 强化学习训练，无需显式推理数据，Seg-Zero 在 ReasonSeg 基准上零样本性能达到 57.5，超过 LISA-7B 18%。
Motivation: 传统推理分割方法依赖带有类别标签和简单描述的监督微调，限制了跨域泛化能力且缺乏显式推理过程。
Method: 提出解耦架构：推理模型通过强化学习（GRPO）学习生成推理链和位置提示，分割模型基于提示生成掩码。设计包含格式奖励和准确率奖励的奖励机制来优化推理方向。
Result: Seg-Zero-7B 在 ReasonSeg 基准上零样本性能达 57.5，比 LISA-7B 提升 18%，展示了跨域泛化和测试时的推理能力。
Conclusion: 通过认知强化学习，Seg-Zero 实现了无需显式推理数据的零样本推理分割，并改善了泛化性和推理可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ML-Physical Fusion Models Are Accelerating the Paradigm Shift in Operational Typhoon Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we develop a hybrid operational typhoon forecasting model that integrates the FuXi machine-learning (ML) model with the physics-based Shanghai Typhoon Model (SHTM) into a dual physics-data-driven framework. By employing spectral nudging, the hybrid model named FuXi-SHTM leverages FuXi's robust large-scale forecasting capabilities alongside SHTM's mesoscale strengths, significantly enhancing track, intensity, and precipitation predictions for super typhoons Yagi (2024) and Krathon (2024). Besides, this study aims to identify the sensitive regions for the hybrid model by using Conditional Nonlinear Optimal Perturbation (CNOP) method. Despite being constrained by FuXi's large-scale forecast fields, the dense assimilation of satellite observations within these sensitive regions can further enhance typhoon forecasts. Besides, this study offers key insights into the emerging paradigms that are set to shape the future development of both machine learning and physics-based modeling approaches.

papers.title: ShapeLib: Designing a library of programmatic 3D shape abstractions with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present ShapeLib, the first method that uses the priors of Large Language Models (LLMs) to design libraries of programmatic 3D shape abstractions. Our system accepts two forms of user-provided design intent: high-level text descriptions of functions to include in the output library and a small seed set of exemplar shapes. We discover a library of abstractions that matches this design intent with a guided LLM workflow that first proposes different ways of applying and implementing functions, and then validates these functions are helpful in representing seed set shapes. To extend beyond the seed set, we develop library-specific recognition networks that map shapes (represented as primitives, voxels, or point clouds) to programs that use these newly discovered abstractions. Across multiple modeling domains (split by shape category), we find that LLMs, when thoughtfully combined with geometric reasoning, can be guided to author libraries of abstraction functions that generalize across shape distributions. Our framework takes a step towards realizing the long-standing shape analysis aspiration of discovering reusable, programmatic shape abstractions while exposing interpretable, semantically aligned interfaces. Our extensive evaluation demonstrates that ShapeLib provides distinct advantages over prior alternative abstraction discovery works in terms of generalization, usability, and maintaining plausibility under manipulation. Finally, we demonstrate that ShapeLib's abstraction functions unlock a number of downstream applications, combining LLM reasoning over shape programs with geometry processing tools to support shape editing and generation workflows.

TL;DR: ShapeLib 是首个利用大语言模型（LLM）先验知识来设计程序化3D形状抽象库的方法。系统接受用户提供的高层文本描述和少量示例形状，通过引导式LLM工作流发现匹配的抽象函数库，并开发库特定的识别网络将形状映射到程序。实验表明该方法在泛化性、可用性和操作合理性上优于先前工作，并支持形状编辑和生成等下游应用。
Motivation: 现有的形状抽象发现方法通常无法生成可重用、可解释且语义对齐的程序化抽象，而手动设计抽象库成本高且难以泛化。
Method: 结合LLM的先验知识与几何推理：LLM首先提出函数的应用和实现方式，然后验证这些函数对种子形状的表示有效性；随后训练库特定的识别网络，将不同表示（体素、点云等）映射为包含新抽象的程序。
Result: 在多个形状类别上，ShapeLib 发现的抽象函数能够跨形状分布泛化，并在泛化性、可用性和操作合理性上优于先前方法；同时支持形状编辑与生成等下游应用。
Conclusion: LLM与几何推理的有机结合可指导程序化形状抽象库的自动发现，为可重用、可解释的形状分析提供了新路径。

papers.title: Scaling Pre-training to One Hundred Billion Data for Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We provide an empirical investigation of the potential of pre-training vision-language models on an unprecedented scale: 100 billion examples. We find that model performance tends to saturate at this scale on many common Western-centric classification and retrieval benchmarks, such as COCO Captions. Nevertheless, tasks of cultural diversity achieve more substantial gains from the 100-billion scale web data, thanks to its coverage of long-tail concepts. Furthermore, we analyze the model's multilinguality and show gains in low-resource languages as well. In addition, we observe that reducing the size of the pretraining dataset via quality filters like using CLIP, typically used to enhance performance, may inadvertently reduce the cultural diversity represented in large-scale datasets. Our results highlight that while traditional benchmarks may not benefit significantly from scaling noisy, raw web data to 100 billion examples, this data scale is vital for building truly inclusive multimodal systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实验性地将视觉语言模型的预训练数据规模扩展到1000亿样本，发现许多常见的西方中心分类和检索基准（如COCO Captions）上的性能趋于饱和，但在文化多样性任务和多语言低资源语言上有显著提升。此外，使用CLIP等质量过滤器缩减数据集可能会降低文化多样性。
Motivation: 现有大规模预训练通常使用数十亿数据，尚不清楚扩展到1000亿是否能持续提升性能，尤其对多样性和多语言任务的影响。
Method: 直接使用1000亿网络图像-文本对进行预训练，并评估在多种基准上的表现，包括西方中心基准、文化多样性基准以及多语言任务。还分析了质量过滤器对文化多样性的影响。
Result: 在COCO Captions等常见基准上性能饱和；但在文化多样性任务和多语言低资源语言上有显著改进。质量过滤器可能意外减少数据集中的文化多样性。
Conclusion: 传统基准可能不会从扩展到1000亿噪声网络数据中显著受益，但这种数据规模对于构建真正包容性的多模态系统至关重要。

papers.title: Towards Simple and Provable Parameter-Free Adaptive Gradient Methods
papers.abstract_en: Optimization algorithms such as AdaGrad and Adam have significantly advanced the training of deep models by dynamically adjusting the learning rate during the optimization process. However, ad-hoc tuning of learning rates poses a challenge and leads to inefficiencies in practice. To address this issue, recent research has focused on developing ``parameter-free'' algorithms that operate effectively without the need for learning rate tuning. Despite these efforts, existing parameter-free variants of AdaGrad and Adam tend to be overly complex and/or lack formal convergence guarantees. In this paper, we present AdaGrad++ and Adam++, novel and simple parameter-free variants of AdaGrad and Adam with convergence guarantees. We prove that AdaGrad++ achieves comparable convergence rates to AdaGrad in convex optimization without predefined learning rate assumptions. Similarly, Adam++ matches the convergence rate of Adam without relying on any conditions on the learning rates. Experimental results across various deep learning tasks validate the competitive performance of Adam++.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaGrad++ 和 Adam++，两种简单且无参数的自适应梯度方法变体，并证明它们在凸优化中与 AdaGrad/Adam 具有相同收敛率，无需预定义学习率假设。实验表明 Adam++ 在多种深度学习任务上性能有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有自适应优化器如 AdaGrad 和 Adam 需要手动调整学习率，而现有的无参数变体过于复杂或缺乏收敛保证。目标是设计简单、可证明收敛的无参数变体。
Method: 提出 AdaGrad++ 和 Adam++，通过修改学习率更新规则实现无参数化，并给出收敛性证明。
Result: AdaGrad++ 在凸优化中达到与 AdaGrad 相当的收敛率，无需预设学习率；Adam++ 同样匹配 Adam 的收敛率且无学习率条件限制。实验验证了 Adam++ 的竞争力。
Conclusion: 论文提供了简单且可证明收敛的无参数自适应梯度方法，填补了现有变体在复杂性和理论保证上的空白。

papers.title: OP-LoRA: The Blessing of Dimensionality
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adapters (LoRA) enable finetuning of large models with only a small number of parameters. However, they often suffer from an ill-conditioned loss landscape, leading to difficult optimization. Prior work addresses these challenges by aligning adapter updates with full finetuning gradients via custom optimizers, but these methods lack the flexibility to accommodate new adapter architectures and are computationally expensive. We instead introduce OP-LoRA, a novel method which replaces each LoRA adapter with weights predicted by an extra MLP, which is discarded after training. This temporarily allows additional parameters during training to improve optimization, yet requires less wall time than custom optimizers and zero extra cost at inference time because the MLP is discarded. Crucially, extending OP-LoRA to other adapters is as simple as modifying the size of the prediction head for each new adapter type. We show that OP-LoRA allows the optimization to adaptively increase or decrease step size, improving performance and decreasing sensitivity to learning rate. On both small and large-scale LoRA tuning tasks, we observe consistent performance gains of OP-LoRA relative to LoRA and its variants. We achieve especially notable improvements in image generation, with OP-LoRA CMMD scores improving by up to 15 points relative to LoRA. This allows OP-LoRA to achieve the performance of LoRA with half of the inference parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OP-LoRA通过一个额外的MLP在训练时预测LoRA适配器的权重，训练后丢弃该MLP，从而暂时增加参数改善优化，而不增加推理开销。该方法在图像生成任务上CMMD分数提升高达15点，且能以一半的推理参数达到LoRA的性能。
Motivation: LoRA在微调中常遭遇病态损失景观，导致优化困难。现有方法通过自定义优化器对齐适配器更新与全微调梯度，但缺乏兼容性且计算成本高。
Method: 用额外MLP预测每个LoRA适配器的权重，训练后丢弃MLP；调整预测头尺寸即可适配其他适配器架构。
Result: 在大小规模LoRA调优任务中一致提升性能，图像生成CMMD分数最多提升15点，推理参数减半仍保持LoRA性能。
Conclusion: OP-LoRA通过临时增加参数自适应调整步长，改善优化并降低对学习率的敏感度，是一种灵活且零额外推理成本的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Blind Source Separation with Dissociative Principal Component Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Principal component analysis (PCA) and its sparse variants (sPCA) are widely used as a precursor to independent component analysis (ICA) for blind source separation (BSS). However, sPCA typically relies on a deflation strategy that extracts components sequentially and imposes orthogonality between them. When the underlying sources overlap, this discards the cross component structure that ICA depends on, degrading separation. This paper proposes dissociative PCA (DPCA), which estimates components jointly rather than by deflation. DPCA introduces left and right dissociation matrices into the SVD based decomposition to explicitly model the interdependencies among principal components (PCs) and loading vectors (LVs), while sparsity constraints maintain interpretability. We develop three algorithms called DPCA1a, DPCA1b, and DPCA2, using adaptive soft thresholding with gradient and coordinate descent, together with a secondary firm thresholding step that preserves sparsity and suppresses background noise in the recovered loading vectors. The method is evaluated on four settings, namely simulated fMRI source retrieval, foreground and background separation, image reconstruction, and image inpainting, where it recovers source structure more reliably than classical sPCA based pipelines, with the largest gains under significant spatial overlap. DPCA reduces to ordinary PCA when the sparsity parameter is zero. A MATLAB implementation of the proposed algorithms is publicly available at https://github.com/usmankhalid06/DPCA.
papers.comment: 13 pages with 6 figures, this work has not been published before
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出解离性PCA (DPCA)，一种新的PCA变体，用于盲源分离。DPCA通过在SVD分解中引入左、右解离矩阵来联合估计主成分和载荷向量，避免传统稀疏PCA的逐步收缩策略导致的跨成分结构丢失。在模拟fMRI源检索、前景/背景分离、图像重建和图像修复四个任务上，DPCA优于经典sPCA，尤其在源重叠场景下增益显著。
Motivation: 传统稀疏PCA (sPCA) 采用逐步收缩策略，当源信号重叠时会丢弃ICA依赖的跨成分结构，从而降低分离效果。
Method: 提出解离性PCA (DPCA)，在SVD分解中引入左、右解离矩阵显式建模主成分与载荷向量间的相互依赖，并施加稀疏约束。开发了三种算法（DPCA1a, DPCA1b, DPCA2），使用自适应软阈值结合梯度下降和坐标下降，以及二级硬阈值步骤保持稀疏性并抑制背景噪声。
Result: 在模拟fMRI源检索、前景/背景分离、图像重建和图像修复四个设置上，DPCA比基于sPCA的管道更可靠地恢复源结构，空间重叠较大时增益最大。当稀疏参数为零时，DPCA退化为普通PCA。
Conclusion: DPCA通过联合估计成分克服了sPCA的逐步收缩限制，在源重叠场景下显著提升盲源分离性能。MATLAB实现已公开。

papers.title: Learning Fine-grained Parameter Sharing via Sparse Tensor Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Large neural networks achieve state-of-the-art performance on many tasks, yet their sheer size hinders deployment on resource-constrained devices. Among existing compression approaches, cross-layer parameter sharing remains relatively unexplored for transformer models. In this paper, we introduce Fine-grained Parameter Sharing (FiPS), a unified framework for compressing transformer Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) that combines cross-block parameter sharing, low-rank factorization, and sparsity in a single optimization. FiPS concatenates MLP weight matrices across a group of transformer blocks and factorizes them into a shared basis and sparse, layer-specific projection matrices. Both factors are initialized via singular value decomposition (SVD) and jointly optimized by block-wise reconstruction error minimization. FiPS compresses Vision Transformers (ViTs) by up to 33% with less than 1% top-1 accuracy loss on ImageNet-1k, and by up to 57% when combined with fine-tuning. It also compresses Large Language Models (LLMs) by up to 20% while outperforming existing SVD-based methods in perplexity and downstream benchmarks at matched compression. Combined with Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), 3-bit FiPS on Gemma-2-2B achieves lower perplexity than 2-bit QAT alone while matching the same 8x compression. These results establish fine-grained parameter sharing as a practical and effective approach for transformer MLP compression.
papers.comment: Accepted as is to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=vbS7Z8Zswe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FiPS（Fine-grained Parameter Sharing），一种统一框架，通过跨块参数共享、低秩分解和稀疏性压缩Transformer的MLP层。方法将多个Transformer块的MLP权重矩阵拼接，分解为共享基和层特定稀疏投影矩阵，通过SVD初始化并联合优化重建误差。在ImageNet-1k上，ViT压缩33%时top-1精度损失小于1%；结合微调可压缩57%。LLM压缩20%时困惑度和下游任务优于现有SVD方法。结合量化感知训练，Gemma-2-2B在3-bit FiPS下达到8倍压缩，困惑度低于2-bit QAT。
Motivation: 大型神经网络部署受限，现有压缩方法中跨层参数共享在Transformer模型中探索不足。
Method: FiPS框架将一组Transformer块的MLP权重矩阵拼接，通过张量分解为共享基和稀疏层特定投影矩阵，使用SVD初始化，并通过块级重建误差最小化联合优化。
Result: ViT压缩33%时top-1精度损失<1%，LLM压缩20%时困惑度和下游任务优于SVD方法；结合QAT，3-bit FiPS在Gemma-2-2B上达到8倍压缩，困惑度低于2-bit QAT。
Conclusion: 细粒度参数共享是Transformer MLP压缩的有效实用方法，可与量化等技术组合。

papers.title: Explainable AI Through a Democratic Lens: DhondtXAI for D'Hondt-Projected Feature Attribution
papers.abstract_en: This study presents DhondtXAI as a SHAP-independent, D'Hondt-based attribution framework for tabular XAI. Instead of model-native feature importance or SHAP values, DhondtXAI computes background-interventional removal effects, separates positive and negative evidence, forms optional feature alliances, applies optional thresholds, allocates seats via the D'Hondt rule, and projects onto the local model-output difference. Completeness is preserved by construction, with the projection residual ratio reported as a diagnostic. The method is evaluated on synthetic additive and interaction tests, correlated-feature perturbations, operator and apportionment ablations, projection-mode comparisons, logit-scale checks, repeated split validation, paired deletion tests, and two healthcare datasets: Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (CatBoost) and early-stage diabetes risk prediction (XGBoost). SHAP serves only as an external comparator with aligned settings. In additive synthetics, DhondtXAI exactly recovers ground-truth rankings; in multiplicative interactions, alliances reduce the mean projection residual from 0.2527 to 0.0001. On WDBC and diabetes data, it shows high agreement with SHAP (Spearman rho = 0.9273 and 0.9353), supported by further signed, top-k, magnitude, deletion, and sensitivity analyses. Results position DhondtXAI as a complementary proportional, alliance-aware, and threshold-aware tabular XAI method, not a replacement for SHAP or LIME.

papers.title: Near-Optimal and Tractable Estimation under Shift-Invariance
papers.abstract_en: How hard is it to estimate a discrete-time signal $(x_{1}, ..., x_{n}) \in \mathbb{C}^n$ satisfying an unknown linear recurrence relation of order $s$ and observed in i.i.d. complex Gaussian noise? The class of all such signals is parametric but extremely rich: it contains all exponential polynomials over $\mathbb{C}$ with total degree $s$, including harmonic oscillations with $s$ arbitrary frequencies. Geometrically, this class corresponds to the projection onto $\mathbb{C}^{n}$ of the union of all shift-invariant subspaces of $\mathbb{C}^\mathbb{Z}$ of dimension $s$. We show that the statistical complexity of this class, as measured by the squared minimax radius of the $(1-δ)$-confidence $\ell_2$-ball, is nearly the same as for the class of $s$-sparse signals, namely $O\left(s\log(en) + \log(δ^{-1})\right) \cdot \log^2(es) \cdot \log(en/s).$ Moreover, the corresponding near-minimax estimator is tractable, and it can be used to build a test statistic with a near-minimax detection threshold in the associated detection problem. These statistical results rely upon a simple analytic observation: the interpretation of the Fourier coefficients of the Christoffel function of any shift-invariant subspace of~$\mathds{C}^\mathds{Z}$ as a reproducing filter with the smallest possible spectrum, in all~$\ell_p$-norms, $p \in [1,\infty]$, at once.
papers.comment: 28 pages. In the previous version, our construction of the reproducing filter was erroneous. It is now replaced with an alternative construction using the Christoffel function
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在独立同分布复高斯噪声中观测的、满足未知s阶线性递推关系的离散时间信号(x_1,...,x_n)的估计难度。该类信号包含所有总次数为s的复指数多项式，包括具有s个任意频率的谐波振荡。从几何上看，该类别对应于C^Z中所有s维权不变子空间的并集在C^n上的投影。作者证明该类的统计复杂度（以(1-δ)置信ℓ2球的平方极小极大半径衡量）与s-稀疏信号类几乎相同，即O(s log(en) + log(δ^{-1})) * log^2(es) * log(en/s)。相应的近似极小极大估计器是易处理的，可用于构建检测问题中具有近似极小极大检测阈值的检验统计量。这些统计结果依赖于一个简单的解析观察：将任何移不变子空间~C^Z的Christoffel函数的傅里叶系数解释为同时在所有ℓ_p范数(p∈[1,∞])中具有最小可能频谱的再现滤波器。
Motivation: 研究满足未知线性递推关系的信号在噪声中估计的统计复杂度，该类信号参数化但极其丰富，需要量化其估计难度并设计有效估计器。
Method: 利用Christoffel函数的傅里叶系数作为再现滤波器，该滤波器在所有ℓ_p范数中具有最小频谱，从而得到近极小极大估计器。
Result: 平方极小极大半径约为O(s log(en) + log(δ^{-1})) * log^2(es) * log(en/s)，与s-稀疏信号类相当。
Conclusion: 证明了该类信号的统计复杂度与稀疏信号类相近，且存在易处理的近极小极大估计器，可用于检测问题。

papers.title: Towards Stable, Globally Expressive Graph Representations with Laplacian Eigenvectors
papers.abstract_en: A popular way to improve the expressive power of graph neural networks (GNNs) is to use Laplacian eigenvectors as additional node features, since they can serve both as structural identifiers and global coordinates of nodes. Properly handling the orthogonal group symmetry among eigenvectors is crucial for the stability and generalizability of Laplacian eigenvector augmented GNNs. Previous studies have shown that using a naive $O(p)$-group invariant encoder for each $p$-dimensional eigenspace often leads to expressivity loss and numerical instability. In this paper, we propose a novel method exploiting Laplacian eigenvectors to generate \emph{stable} and globally \emph{expressive} graph representations. The main difference from previous works is that (i) our method utilizes \textbf{learnable} $O(p)$-invariant representations for each Laplacian eigenspace of dimension $p$, which are built upon powerful orthogonal group equivariant neural network layers already well studied in the literature, and that (ii) our method deals with numerically close eigenvalues in a \textbf{smooth} fashion, ensuring its better robustness against perturbations. Experiments on various graph learning benchmarks witness the competitive performance of our method, especially its great potential to learn global properties of graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用拉普拉斯特征向量生成稳定且全局表达性图表示的方法。该方法通过可学习的 O(p)-不变表示处理每个 p 维特征空间，并以平滑方式处理数值接近的特征值，增强鲁棒性。实验表明该方法在多个图学习基准上具有竞争力，尤其擅长学习图的全局属性。
Motivation: 现有图神经网络 (GNN) 使用拉普拉斯特征向量作为节点特征时，处理特征空间的正交群对称性存在稳定性和泛化性问题，且简单的 O(p)-群不变编码器导致表达力损失和数值不稳定。
Method: 提出利用可学习的 O(p)-不变表示（基于正交群等变神经网络层）处理每个 p 维拉普拉斯特征空间，并以平滑方式处理数值接近的特征值，从而生成稳定且全局表达性的图表示。
Result: 在多个图学习基准上取得有竞争力的性能，尤其在全局属性学习上展现潜力。
Conclusion: 该方法通过可学习不变表示和平滑特征值处理，有效提升了拉普拉斯特征增强 GNN 的稳定性和表达力。

papers.title: GSDeformer: Direct, Real-time and Extensible Cage-based Deformation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We present GSDeformer, a method that enables cage-based deformation on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Our approach bridges cage-based deformation and 3DGS by using a proxy point-cloud representation. This point cloud is generated from 3D Gaussians, and deformations applied to the point cloud are translated into transformations on the 3D Gaussians. To handle potential bending caused by deformation, we incorporate a splitting process to approximate it. Our method does not modify or extend the core architecture of 3D Gaussian Splatting, making it compatible with any trained vanilla 3DGS or its variants. Additionally, we automate cage construction for 3DGS and its variants using a render-and-reconstruct approach. Experiments demonstrate that GSDeformer delivers superior deformation results compared to existing methods, is robust under extreme deformations, requires no retraining for editing, runs in real-time, and can be extended to other 3DGS variants. Project Page: https://jhuangbu.github.io/gsdeformer/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GSDeformer 是一种基于笼形变形的3D高斯溅射编辑方法，通过代理点云桥接形变操作，支持实时、无需重新训练的形变，并兼容多种3DGS变体。实验表明其在极端形变下鲁棒性好，形变效果优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯溅射编辑方法多需重新训练或受限，缺乏直接、实时且可扩展的形变框架。
Method: 从3D高斯生成代理点云，将点云形变映射为高斯变换，并引入分裂过程处理弯曲效应。同时采用渲染-重建方法自动化笼构造。
Result: GSDeformer在形变质量上超越现有方法，支持极端形变，实时运行，无需重训练，且可扩展至其他3DGS变体。
Conclusion: 该方法为3DGS提供了高效、兼容的形变编辑方案，适用于交互式图形应用。

papers.title: Optimizing accuracy and diversity: a multi-task approach to forecast combinations
papers.abstract_en: We present a multi-task optimization approach based on a deep learning architecture for time series forecasting. We leverage large collections of time series to identify the weights of forecasting models that can be combined to produce forecasts for each series. This method jointly addresses two tasks: the selection of different forecasting models, and their effective combination. In doing so, it keeps into account, in an original way, both the accuracy and diversity of the forecasting methods. For a given time series, the model combination module extracts features and uses them to optimize the weights of the forecasting methods. Simultaneously, the model selection module extracts other features to identify the subset of methods to be used for the prediction. This selection process is framed as a classification problem, with the labels representing the set of models to be used for a series. These labels are determined by solving an auxiliary optimization problem that identifies accurate and diverse methods for each time series. The outputs of the two modules are then combined and the entire neural network is jointly trained by minimizing a custom loss function via gradient descent optimization. Experimental results on a large set of series from the M4 competition dataset and from real road traffic data show that our proposal enhances point forecast accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.journal_ref: Annals of Operations Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的多任务优化方法，用于时间序列预测中的模型组合。该方法同时处理模型选择和组合两个任务，通过考虑预测方法的准确性和多样性来优化权重。实验在M4竞赛数据集和真实道路交通数据上表明，该方法相比现有技术提高了点预测准确性。
Motivation: 现有预测组合方法通常分别处理模型选择和权重优化，未能充分考虑准确性和多样性之间的平衡。本文旨在通过联合优化这两个任务来改进预测性能。
Method: 提出一个多任务神经网络架构，包含模型选择模块（分类问题，选择预测模型子集）和模型组合模块（加权融合），通过自定义损失函数联合训练，并利用辅助优化问题生成每个时间序列的标签。
Result: 在M4竞赛数据集和真实道路交通数据上，该方法相比现有先进方法提升了点预测准确性。
Conclusion: 本文展示了多任务学习在预测组合中的有效性，但未讨论对极端事件或高动态变化序列的适用性。

papers.title: DeepIPCv2: LiDAR-powered Robust Environmental Perception and Navigational Control for Autonomous Vehicle
papers.abstract_en: We propose DeepIPCv2, an end-to-end autonomous driving framework that integrates LiDAR-based environmental perception with command-specific control learning. Unlike prior camera-reliant models, DeepIPCv2 employs point cloud segmentation and multi-view projection to construct robust scene representations. These features are fused and decoded through a combination of gated recurrent units, command-specific multi-layer perceptrons, and PID controllers to estimate both waypoints and navigational control commands. This design enhances maneuverability and addresses action imbalance in driving datasets. To validate the model, we constructed a dataset covering diverse illumination conditions and conducted ablation studies and comparative tests against recent methods, including TransFuser. Results demonstrate that DeepIPCv2 achieves the lowest total metric error and the fewest driving interventions, highlighting both its robustness to illumination changes and its improved control accuracy. By releasing the codes at https://github.com/oskarnatan/DeepIPCv2 later, we aim to support reproducibility and future advancements in end-to-end autonomous driving research.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Access. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11313052
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeepIPCv2，一种基于LiDAR的端到端自动驾驶框架，通过点云分割和多视角投影构建鲁棒的环境表示，结合门控循环单元、命令特定多层感知机和PID控制器估计航点和导航控制指令。实验表明，DeepIPCv2在不同光照条件下达到最低的总度量误差和最少的驾驶干预次数，优于TransFuser等方法。
Motivation: 现有相机为主的自动驾驶模型在光照变化下性能下降，且驾驶数据集存在动作不平衡问题，需要更鲁棒的感知和控制方法。
Method: 集成LiDAR点云分割与多视角投影生成场景表示，通过门控循环单元融合特征，使用命令特定多层感知机和PID控制器分别输出航点和控制命令。
Result: 在涵盖不同光照条件的数据集上，DeepIPCv2取得最低总度量误差和最少的驾驶干预次数，体现了对光照变化的鲁棒性和控制精度的提升。

papers.title: Score Function Gradient Estimation to Widen the Applicability of Decision-Focused Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world optimization problems contain parameters that are unknown before deployment time, either due to stochasticity or to lack of information (e.g., demand or travel times in delivery problems). A common strategy in such cases is to estimate said parameters via machine learning (ML) models trained to minimize the prediction error, which however is not necessarily aligned with the downstream task-level error. The decision-focused learning (DFL) paradigm overcomes this limitation by training to directly minimize a task loss, e.g. regret. Since the latter has non-informative gradients for combinatorial problems, state-of-the-art DFL methods introduce surrogates and approximations that enable training. But these methods exploit specific assumptions about the problem structures (e.g., convex or linear problems, unknown parameters only in the objective function). We propose an alternative method that makes no such assumptions, it combines stochastic smoothing with score function gradient estimation which works on any task loss. This opens up the use of DFL methods to nonlinear objectives, uncertain parameters in the problem constraints, and even two-stage stochastic optimization. Experiments show that it typically requires more epochs, but that it is on par with specialized methods and performs especially well for the difficult case of problems with uncertainty in the constraints, in terms of solution quality, scalability, or both.
papers.journal_ref: Silvestri, Mattia, et al. "Score Function Gradient Estimation to Widen the Applicability of Decision-Focused Learning." Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research 85 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于得分函数梯度估计的决策聚焦学习（DFL）方法，通过随机平滑与得分函数估计梯度，无需对问题结构（如凸性、线性、参数位置）做特殊假设，适用于非线性目标、约束中的不确定参数以及两阶段随机优化。实验表明，该方法在训练epoch数上高于专用方法，但在解质量和可扩展性上与现有方法相当，尤其在约束不确定性问题上表现更优。
Motivation: 现有DFL方法依赖于问题结构的特定假设（如凸线性问题、未知参数仅在目标函数中），限制了其应用范围。本文旨在消除这些假设，使DFL能处理更一般的优化问题。
Method: 结合随机平滑（stochastic smoothing）与得分函数梯度估计（score function gradient estimation），对任意任务损失提供非平凡梯度，无需模型可微性或问题结构约束。
Result: 实验显示该方法通常需要更多训练epochs，但与针对特定结构的专用方法相比性能相当，在约束中存在不确定性的困难问题上，在解质量和可扩展性方面均表现良好。
Conclusion: 该方法成功拓宽了决策聚焦学习的适用范围，可处理非线性目标、约束中的不确定参数以及两阶段随机优化，为更广泛的实际优化问题提供了一种无假设的DFL训练范式。

papers.title: Tree-Structured Parzen Estimator: Understanding Its Algorithm Components and Their Roles for Better Empirical Performance
papers.abstract_en: Recent scientific advances require complex experiment design, necessitating the meticulous tuning of many experiment parameters. Tree-structured Parzen estimator (TPE) is a widely used Bayesian optimization method in recent parameter tuning frameworks such as Hyperopt and Optuna. Despite its popularity, the roles of each control parameter in TPE and the algorithm intuition have not been discussed so far. The goal of this paper is to identify the roles of each control parameter and their impacts on parameter tuning based on the ablation studies using diverse benchmark datasets. The recommended setting concluded from the ablation studies is demonstrated to improve the performance of TPE. Our TPE implementation used in this paper is available at https://github.com/nabenabe0928/tpe/tree/single-opt. OptunaHub now provides our standalone TPE implementation at https://hub.optuna.org/samplers/tpe_tutorial/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过消融实验深入分析了树结构Parzen估计器（TPE）中各个控制参数的作用，并在多种基准数据集上评估了它们对参数调优性能的影响。基于实验结果，给出了推荐的参数设置，并证明该设置能提升TPE的实证性能。
Motivation: TPE被广泛用于超参数优化，但其内部组件和参数的影响尚未被系统理解，导致用户难以有效配置。
Method: 对TPE的多个控制参数（如样本数量、分位数等）进行消融研究，在多个基准数据集上比较不同配置下的优化性能。
Result: 消融实验确定了各参数的作用，并提出了改进的默认配置，该配置在多种任务上优于原始TPE。
Conclusion: 本文提供了TPE组件的深入理解，并给出了实证上更优的参数设定，可作为未来使用的指导。

papers.title: Braille to Text Translation for Bengali Language: A Geometric Approach
papers.abstract_en: Braille is the only system to visually impaired people for reading and writing. However, general people cannot read Braille. So, teachers and relatives find it hard to assist them with learning. Almost every major language has software solutions for this translation purpose. However, in Bengali there is an absence of this useful tool. Here, we propose Braille to Text Translator, which takes image of these tactile alphabets, and translates them to plain text. Image deterioration, scan-time page rotation, and braille dot deformation are the principal issues in this scheme. All of these challenges are directly checked using special image processing and geometric structure analysis. The technique yields 97.25% accuracy in recognizing Braille characters.
papers.journal_ref: Jahangirnagar University Journal of Information Technology (JJIT), vol. 7, pp. 93-111, June, 2018
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对孟加拉语盲文到文本翻译的缺失，提出一种基于几何结构分析的图像处理方法。通过特殊图像处理和几何结构分析处理图像退化、页面旋转和盲文点变形问题，在盲文字符识别上达到97.25%的准确率。
Motivation: 孟加拉语缺乏盲文到文本的翻译工具，导致普通人与视障人士在教育和日常交流中存在障碍。
Method: 采用图像处理和几何结构分析直接处理图像退化、扫描旋转和盲文点变形等主要问题。
Result: 在盲文字符识别上达到97.25%的准确率。
Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了孟加拉语盲文识别中的主要挑战，为视障人士的辅助工具提供了可行方案。

papers.title: CV-Arena: An Open Benchmark for Instructional Computer Vision Problem Solving with Human-AI Collaborative Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-guided image editing is becoming a general interface for visual work, yet existing benchmarks still focus largely on narrow appearance edits and do not fully capture the diversity of real-image tasks in professional workflows. Here, we define instructional computer vision problem solving as a broader formulation of image editing: given a real input image and a natural-language instruction, a system must produce an edited output that realizes the requested transformation while satisfying explicit preservation, geometric, physical, and usability constraints. We introduce CV-Arena, an open benchmark designed to evaluate this capability at professional scales. CV-Arena contains 12K high-resolution real-image instruction pairs spanning 16 instruction-based visual task types, constructed using CogRetriever, a dual-track retrieval-and-curation pipeline that combines targeted web search, agentic query refinement, verification, and traceability. To evaluate models at scale while preserving human fidelity, we propose Active Elo, a human-AI collaborative preference protocol that leverages CV-Judge, a logic-gated, multi-dimensional VLM evaluator, to reject clear failures and resolve high-confidence comparisons; and to route close, high-quality comparisons to expert raters. Mixed human and AI supervision is then aggregated through reliability-weighted Elo updates. Our comprehensive evaluation of 21 systems, including proprietary, open-source, and agentic models, on CV-Arena reveals persistent gaps in instruction adherence, physical reasoning, structural control, and fine-grained detail preservation. We further develop CV-Agent, a lightweight agentic model that combines planning, editing, and verification, and demonstrate that closed-loop reasoning is a promising direction for professional-grade instruction-following visual editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CV-Arena是一个面向指令式计算机视觉问题求解的开放基准，包含12K高分辨率真实图像指令对，覆盖16种任务类型。通过CogRetriever流水线构建，并采用Active Elo协议结合人类与AI偏好进行评测。评估了21个系统，发现指令遵循、物理推理等方面存在显著差距。

Method: 提出CogRetriever双轨检索-策展流水线构建12K指令对；提出Active Elo协议，结合CV-Judge逻辑门控VLM评估器与人类专家，通过可靠性加权Elo更新聚合监督。
Result: 对21个系统（含专有、开源和智能体模型）的评估揭示在指令遵循、物理推理、结构控制和细节保持方面存在持续差距。
Conclusion: CV-Agent智能体模型展示闭环推理是提升专业级指令视觉编辑的有前景方向。

papers.title: Detection vs. Execution: Single-Bucket Probes Miss Half the Mamba-2 State Sink
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability often assumes that probes identifying a representational signature also identify the circuit executing the corresponding computation. We show that this assumption can fail systematically in Mamba-2. Studying the state sink (disproportionate Delta-gate activation on boundary tokens, analogous to the attention sink), we find that single-bucket probes recover only a small execution layer while missing a much larger detection layer with the same representational signature. In Mamba-2, the state sink decomposes into two functional head sets. Single-bucket BOS-specialist heads (about 5% of heads at 2.7B) causally support both BOS-context and newline-target predictions across model scales and corpora. Dual heads (27-35% of heads, recovered by multi-class aggregation of the same probe) show stronger BOS-newline representational similarity but substantially weaker causal effects under ablation. Representational similarity does not imply functional equivalence. This distinction matters for downstream behaviour: ablating BOS-specialist heads collapses RULER NIAH retrieval accuracy from 1.00 to 0.00 at 1024 context length in both Mamba-1 2.8B and Mamba-2 2.7B, while size-matched complements preserve baseline performance. A random channel-bucketing control rules out substrate granularity alone, implicating Mamba-2's head-shared Delta projection. Probe-derived specialty can identify execution circuits; at coarse granularity the same probe also recovers detection circuits, and separating them requires class-conditional ablation rather than class-conditional cosine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Mamba-2中的state sink现象，发现单桶探针（single-bucket probes）只能捕获一小部分执行层，而遗漏了更大的检测层。BOS-specialist heads（约5%）因果支持预测，而dual heads（27-35%）虽有更强表示相似性但因果效应弱。消融BOS-specialist heads会导致RULER NIAH检索准确率从1.00降至0.00，表明表示相似性不等于功能等价。
Motivation: 机制可解释性常假设识别表示特征的探针也能识别执行相应计算的电路，但这一假设在Mamba-2中可能系统性失败。
Method: 使用单桶探针（single-bucket probes）和多类聚合（multi-class aggregation）分析Mamba-2的state sink，区分BOS-specialist heads和dual heads，并通过消融实验验证因果作用。
Result: 单桶探针只恢复约5%的BOS-specialist heads（执行层），而遗漏了27-35%的dual heads（检测层）；消融BOS-specialist heads使RULER NIAH检索准确率从1.00降至0.00，而大小匹配的补全保持基线。
Conclusion: 表示相似性不意味着功能等价；探针识别的特殊性可能指向执行电路，但在粗粒度下也会恢复检测电路，需要类条件消融来分离。

papers.title: Single-Channel Tissue Segmentation via Cross-Modal Distillation from Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Multiplexed fluorescence microscopy improves tissue segmentation by providing complementary channels including nuclear (DAPI) and membrane (E-cadherin), that together encode richer spatial context than single-channel imaging alone. However, multiplexed models require all channels at inference, limiting deployment where only a subset is available. This work proposes a cross-modal knowledge distillation framework that transfers semantic information from a frozen foundation model teacher processing multiplexed input to a lightweight student operating on the nuclear channel only. The distillation objective combines MSE-based probability matching, boundary-aware supervision, and learnable uncertainty weighting. SAM ViT-H and CellSAM are evaluated as teachers across four U-Net students: Swin-Tiny (27M), ResNet18 (11M), EfficientNet-B0 (5.3M), and MobileNetV3 (1.5M), on TissueNet and BBBC038. On TissueNet, the SAM-distilled Swin-Tiny student achieves Dice 78.36 (plus or minus 1.44), a 13.05-point improvement over the no-KD baseline (65.31 plus or minus 1.35) and 87.9% recovery of teacher oracle performance (89.12 plus or minus 1.21) at a 23x parameter reduction. KD consistently improves all four students by approximately 12 Dice points, confirming architecture-agnostic distillation. SAM ViT-H outperforms CellSAM as teacher across all settings. Cross-dataset evaluation on BBBC038 shows consistent gains without teacher retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨模态知识蒸馏框架，利用多通道荧光显微镜的预训练基础模型（如SAM ViT-H）作为教师，蒸馏到仅使用核通道（DAPI）的轻量级学生网络（如Swin-Tiny），实现单通道组织分割。在TissueNet上，蒸馏后的Swin-Tiny学生网络Dice达到78.36，比无蒸馏基线提升13.05点，并恢复了教师模型87.9%的性能，参数量减少23倍。
Motivation: 多通道荧光显微镜需要所有通道同时输入，限制了在仅有部分通道可用时的部署。本文旨在通过知识蒸馏将多通道模型的语义信息迁移到仅使用核通道的轻量级模型上。
Method: 提出跨模态知识蒸馏框架，使用冻结的基础模型教师（SAM ViT-H或CellSAM）处理多通道输入，学生网络仅接受核通道。蒸馏损失结合了基于MSE的概率匹配、边界感知监督和可学习的不确定性权重。
Result: 在TissueNet上，SAM蒸馏的Swin-Tiny学生Dice达到78.36±1.44，比无蒸馏基线（65.31±1.35）提升13.05点，达到教师 oracle 性能（89.12±1.21）的87.9%，参数量减少23倍。所有四种学生网络均获得约12个Dice点的提升，SAM ViT-H优于CellSAM。在BBBC038上的跨数据集评估也显示一致提升。

papers.title: Bridging Topology and Deep Representation Learning: A TDA-ViT Fusion Model for Four-Class Brain Tumor Classification
papers.abstract_en: Accurate brain tumor classification from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a key requirement for early diagnosis and clinical decision-making. Vision Transformers (ViTs) have shown strong performance in medical image analysis by learning global contextual representations, but they often fail to capture intrinsic structural and topological patterns present in tumor regions. To address this limitation, we propose a fusion framework that combines Topological Data Analysis (TDA) features with pretrained Vision Transformer representations for four-class brain tumor classification. In the proposed method, TDA is used to extract complementary topological descriptors that capture geometric structure, connectivity, and shape information from MRI images. In parallel, a pretrained ViT model learns high-level semantic representations from the same images. These two feature spaces are then fused to form a unified and more discriminative representation for classification. The model is evaluated on the BRISC2025 dataset, which contains four brain tumor classes: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and non-tumor cases. Experimental results show that combining topological and transformer-based features significantly improves performance compared to using either approach alone. The proposed TDA-ViT fusion model achieves an accuracy of 99.10%, precision of 99.27%, recall of 99.15%, F1-score of 99.21%, and an AUC of 99.98%. It also outperforms several state-of-the-art models, including ResNet50, ResNet101, EfficientNetB2, and standalone Vision Transformers. These results demonstrate that topological features provide valuable complementary information that enhances deep representation learning, leading to a robust and highly accurate framework for automated brain tumor classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种融合拓扑数据分析（TDA）特征与预训练Vision Transformer（ViT）表示的框架，用于四类脑肿瘤分类（胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、垂体瘤、非肿瘤）。在BRISC2025数据集上，该方法达到99.10%的准确率、99.27%的精确率、99.15%的召回率、99.21%的F1分数和99.98%的AUC，显著优于单独使用ViT或TDA。
Motivation: Vision Transformer在医学图像分析中擅长学习全局上下文，但难以捕捉肿瘤区域的固有结构和拓扑模式，导致分类性能受限。
Method: 并行使用TDA提取MRI图像的几何结构、连通性和形状等拓扑描述符，同时使用预训练ViT学习高层语义表示，将两种特征融合形成统一判别表示进行分类。
Result: 在BRISC2025数据集上，TDA-ViT融合模型准确率99.10%，精确率99.27%，召回率99.15%，F1-分数99.21%，AUC 99.98%，优于ResNet50、ResNet101、EfficientNetB2和单独ViT。
Conclusion: 拓扑特征提供互补信息，增强了深度表示学习，从而构建了鲁棒且高精度的自动化脑肿瘤分类框架。

papers.title: Task Structure Reverses Layerwise State Encoding in Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic studies of sequence models often treat layerwise state encodings as architectural traits: recurrent models concentrate readable state, attention-based models distribute it. We find that the same architecture reverses this profile when the task changes. Across Transformers, Mamba, Mamba-2, LSTMs, and GRUs, Parity is concentrated late in Mamba and the recurrent baselines and built gradually by Transformer; on bounded-depth Dyck-k the pattern flips. The same flip appears in fine-tuned Mamba-130M and Pythia-160M, and the Pythia Dyck bottleneck persists at 410M. Two explanations are conflated in the literature: algebraic structure (commutativity) versus computational structure (prefix update vs. stack). To separate them we add a third task: non-commutative S_3 permutation composition. S_3 groups with Parity, not Dyck, on layerwise probing across all five architectures and on Mamba-specific Conv1D attribution, so the grouping tracks computational structure rather than commutativity. Causal interventions show that, in the 4-layer formal models, linearly readable directions are often functionally necessary and can remain important at out-of-distribution lengths on Parity and Dyck. At pretrained scale the picture splits. Fine-tuned Pythia Dyck has a strong middle-layer bottleneck (L6-L7 ablation drops accuracy by roughly 81% at 160M; broader L4-L18 plateau at 410M), far weaker at the best-probe layer. Pretrained Mamba shows the complementary failure mode: its final layer is highly readable, no single probe direction breaks the task on Parity, Dyck, or S_3, yet mid-position activation patching there recovers about 97-98% of the clean-corrupted logit gap. Probing localizes where state is linearly available, not always where the computation is bottlenecked. Mechanistic signatures are properties of architecture and task together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究序列模型中层级状态编码如何随任务结构逆转。在Transformer、Mamba、LSTM、GRU等架构上，Parity和Dyck任务的层级探测模式相反，且这种反转在预训练模型微调后依然存在。通过非交换S_3置换群任务分离了代数结构和计算结构的影响，发现计算结构（前缀更新 vs 堆栈）是分组依据。因果干预显示线性可读方向在形式模型中功能必要，但在预训练规模下，可读性与计算瓶颈分离。
Motivation: 现有机械解释研究通常将层级状态编码视为架构固有特征，但未充分探讨任务结构如何改变这一特性。本文旨在揭示同一架构在不同任务下层级编码模式反转的现象及其原因。
Method: 在多种架构（Transformer, Mamba, Mamba-2, LSTM, GRU）上分别对Parity、有界深度Dyck-k和非交换S_3排列组合任务进行层级探测、Mamba专用Conv1D归因和因果干预实验。并比较预训练模型微调（Mamba-130M, Pythia-160M/410M）时的表现。
Result: 发现（1）Parity任务中，Mamba和循环模型的编码集中在深层，Transformer逐步构建；Dyck任务则相反。（2）非交换S_3任务与Parity分组，而非Dyck，表明分组由计算结构（前缀更新 vs 堆栈）决定，而非代数结构（交换性）。（3）在4层形式模型中，线性可读方向通常是功能必要的，且可外推至不同长度；在预训练尺度下，Pythia Dyck模型在中层（L6-L7）存在瓶颈，削弱约81%准确率（160M），而Mamba的最终层可读性高，但单方向探测无法破坏任务，中层激活替换可恢复97-98%的logit差距。
Conclusion: 机械解释签名是架构与任务的共同属性，层级可读性并不总是对应计算瓶颈所在。

papers.title: Benchmarking Security Risk Detection and Verification in Open Agentic Skill Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Open agent platforms allow community contributors to publish reusable skills that agents can invoke at runtime. This extensibility also creates a supply-chain risk: malicious contributors can hide harmful behavior inside skills that appear benign under superficial inspection. However, existing defenses are hard to evaluate because there is no benchmark that measures both malicious-skill detection and runtime verification. We present SkillVetBench, a two-stage security vetting benchmark for open agentic skill ecosystems. The first stage performs semantic vetting over each skill's natural-language specification to detect hidden malicious intent. The second stage executes flagged skills in an instrumented sandbox to observe runtime behavior and collect auditable evidence. We build a benchmark from confirmed malicious skills in the live OpenClaw ecosystem, including samples from the recent ClawHavoc supplychain campaign. Unlike static-only methods, SkillVetBench verifies detected threats with execution traces. Our experiments show that: (1) semantic-only and signature-based baselines are insufficient, missing up to 89\% of malicious skills whose threats arise from natural-language instructions, multicomponent logic, or cross-component interactions; (2) runtime attacks are concentrated in a small set of high-permission primitives, especially exec, write\_file, install\_skill, and spawn; and (3) SkillVetBench provides case studies in which sandbox execution directly supports malicious verdicts with concrete runtime evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillVetBench，一个用于开放智能体技能生态系统的两阶段安全审查基准。第一阶段通过语义审查检测隐藏恶意意图，第二阶段在沙箱中执行技能以收集运行时证据。基于OpenClaw生态系统的真实恶意技能构建基准，实验表明纯语义或签名基线的漏检率高达89%，且运行时攻击集中于少量高权限原语。
Motivation: 开放智能体平台允许社区贡献可复用技能，但存在供应链风险：恶意技能可能在表面无害的审查下隐藏有害行为。缺乏同时评估恶意技能检测和运行时验证的基准。
Method: 两阶段基准：阶段一对技能的自然语言规范进行语义审查；阶段二在沙箱中执行标记技能，观察运行时行为并收集可审计证据。基准来源于OpenClaw生态系统中的真实恶意技能。
Result: 语义和签名基线漏检89%的恶意技能，这些技能通过自然语言指令、多组件逻辑或跨组件交互产生威胁。运行时攻击集中exec、write_file、install_skill和spawn等高权限原语。
Conclusion: SkillVetBench通过沙箱执行提供具体运行时证据来支持恶意判定，揭示了纯静态检测的不足。

papers.title: Accuracy, Stability, and Repeated-Run Reliability of Large Language Models on Deterministic Programming Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Run-level pass rate overstates retry-free coverage by up to 17.8 percentage points -- and the gap is largest precisely for mid-performing systems. We investigate this accuracy--stability relationship in large language model (LLM) evaluation for deterministic text-conditioned generation, using programming tasks as a concrete testbed. Standard code-generation benchmarks emphasize single-run accuracy or eventual success under repeated sampling, but many deployment settings also require stability: consistent outcomes across repeated invocations under the same task description. We present a repeated-run evaluation protocol with metrics for run-level accuracy, retry-free coverage, and per-problem variability. On a recency-based benchmark of 100 LeetCode-style problems, we evaluate 16 models from five provider families under two prompt templates with five repeated runs per problem, yielding 16,000 evaluation instances. Although run-level pass rate and perfect stability rate are strongly correlated (r=0.985), pass rate consistently exceeds retry-free coverage -- a gap that reaches 17.8 percentage points and reverses model rankings even among closely matched systems. Prompt effects are model-dependent rather than uniformly beneficial. These results suggest that repeated-run stability analysis is a necessary complement to conventional accuracy reporting for deterministic text-conditioned generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型在确定性编程任务上的评估，发现运行级通过率（run-level pass rate）会高估重试自由覆盖率（retry-free coverage）最多17.8个百分点，且差距在中等性能系统上最大。作者提出了重复运行评估协议，包含运行级准确率、重试自由覆盖率和每个问题的变异性指标，并在100个LeetCode风格问题上使用两种提示模板，对16个模型进行5次重复运行，共计16000个评估实例。结果显示，尽管通过率与完美稳定性率高度相关（r=0.985），但通过率始终超过重试自由覆盖率，差距可达17.8个百分点，甚至会改变模型排名，且提示效应依赖于模型。
Motivation: 现有代码生成基准强调单次运行准确率或多次采样的最终成功率，但许多部署场景还要求稳定性：在相同任务描述下重复调用得到一致结果。因此需要研究准确性与稳定性之间的关系，并弥补传统评估指标的不足。
Method: 提出重复运行评估协议，定义运行级准确率、重试自由覆盖率和每个问题的变异性指标。在基于时效性的100个LeetCode风格问题上，使用两种提示模板，每个问题执行5次重复运行，评估来自五个提供者家族的16个模型，共产生16000个评估实例。
Result: 运行级通过率与完美稳定性率强相关（r=0.985），但通过率始终高于重试自由覆盖率，最大差距达17.8个百分点，且这种差距会改变模型排名。提示模板的效果因模型而异，并非普遍有益。
Conclusion: 对于确定性文本条件生成任务，重复运行稳定性分析是传统准确性报告的必要补充，有助于更全面评估模型的可靠性。

papers.title: Towards Lightweight Reliability: Using Soft Prompts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have seen widespread adoption across various domains, yet their reliability is frequently undermined by hallucinations - responses that are plausible-sounding but factually incorrect. In high-stakes domains, these errors can reduce trust and introduce real-world risk. To address this challenge, we present a parameter-efficient approach that uses soft prompts to mitigate hallucinated content and promote responsible abstention in generative question-answering (QA) tasks. Our method, called Responsible Contrastive Soft Prompting (RCSP), uses a composite loss to train soft prompts that balance three goals: suppressing hallucinatory content, encouraging abstention under uncertainty, and preserving or improving factual recall. To achieve these goals, we incorporate contrastive loss, curriculum learning, and KL regularization into our training mechanism. We evaluate our approach on five diverse generative QA datasets using an LLM-as-a-Judge framework. Experimental results on the Gemma 3 (12B) and Llama 3.1 (8B) backbones demonstrate that RCSP effectively balances factual recall with hallucination suppression and abstention, yielding a generally superior F-score over standard reasoning and instruction-based prompting baselines. Notably, these improvements are achieved by training only a fraction of the parameters required by other tuning techniques. Our results demonstrate that soft prompts provide a modular and computationally efficient path toward improving LLM reliability.

papers.title: Adversarial Feeds Steer LLM Agent Decisions Against Their Defaults
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly act after consuming ranked external information streams such as social feeds, search results, retrieval contexts, and email queues, yet safety evaluations almost always test the model or the user prompt in isolation, never the upstream ranker that decides what the agent reads just before it acts. We introduce a controlled protocol that holds the model, persona, topic, and final decision prompt fixed and varies only the composition and ordering of the posts an agent encounters during a preceding ten-turn "scrolling" phase, isolating the causal effect of feed curation on a downstream decision. Across 2,785 decision rollouts on four modern open instruct LLMs from three independent labs, we identify three response regimes: adversarial capitulation, default saturation, and a default-direction asymmetry in which a one-sided feed tips a decision the model was genuinely uncertain about (in the clearest cases from 5% to 100%; Fisher p as low as 3 x 10^-10) but cannot dislodge one it already favors or holds firmly. The effect follows a dose-response curve, survives a generator swap that rules out a writing-style artifact, generalizes across several decision domains including security-relevant choices such as removing a deployment approval gate or relaxing access controls, and is partly mitigated by two simple feed-level defenses; a frontier model retains its default. We characterize the recommender as a practical, default-bounded control surface for LLM agents, and argue that agent evaluations must audit the feed layer rather than the final prompt alone.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Code, post pools, and 2,785 decision rollouts: https://github.com/ranausmanai/recommenders-as-control-surfaces
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了LLM代理在接收外部信息流（如社交推送、搜索结果等）时的决策安全性。通过控制实验，发现推送内容的选择性排序可以显著影响代理的决策，甚至使其偏离默认行为。作者提出了一个评估框架，强调在代理安全性评估中必须审计推送层。
Motivation: 现有LLM安全评估通常孤立测试模型或用户提示，忽略了上游信息流排序器对代理决策的因果影响。
Method: 引入一个受控协议，固定模型、角色、主题和最终决策提示，仅变化代理在'滚动'阶段遇到的帖子组成和顺序，隔离推送策划对下游决策的因果效应。
Result: 在2785次决策 rollout 和四个现代开源 instruct LLM 上，识别出三种响应模式：对抗性投降、默认饱和、以及默认方向不对称。单边推送可以将模型原本不确定的决策从5%改变到100%（Fisher p 低至3e-10），但无法动摇其已经偏好或坚定持有的决策。效果遵循剂量-反应曲线，并通过生成器交换排除了写作风格的伪影，跨多个决策领域泛化，部分被两种简单的推送级防御缓解。
Conclusion: 论文将推荐系统描述为LLM代理的一种实用、默认有界的控制表面，并主张代理评估必须审计推送层，而不仅仅是最终提示。

papers.title: Bandit Simulation for Average Reward Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multi-arm bandit algorithms are increasingly used in online platforms, clinical trials, and social science experiments, but valid statistical inference on their performance remains an open challenge. After deploying bandits, a natural question is whether one can construct a confidence interval for its mean reward and assess whether it reliably outperforms a baseline policy. The total reward achieved in any single bandit deployment is random, and deploying a bandit twice on the same population typically yields different reward trajectories due to stochastic rewards. Standard statistical inference methods cannot be used because bandit algorithms introduce complex dependencies in the collected data, which violate the i.i.d. assumption underlying many classical approaches. Moreover, existing inference methods for adaptively collected data only apply to estimands that do not depend on the data-collection algorithm (such as the mean reward under a fixed action). We propose Bandit Simulation for Inference (BSI), a framework that fits a simulator of the bandit environment from observed data--either on-policy or off-policy--and uses it to estimate the mean reward under any evaluation policy, including adaptive blackbox algorithms. BSI formally propagates uncertainty in the estimated simulator parameters into the confidence interval construction. Furthermore, for BSI to be valid, it requires only weak exploration assumptions on the behavior policy and avoids importance weighting. We prove that BSI yields asymptotically valid confidence intervals, and demonstrate empirically that it maintains nominal coverage in settings where standard off-policy evaluation methods fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Bandit Simulation for Inference (BSI)框架，用于多臂老虎机算法部署后的平均奖励推断。BSI从观测数据拟合环境模拟器，估计任意评估策略（包括自适应黑箱算法）下的平均奖励，并形式化传播模拟器参数的不确定性到置信区间。证明BSI给出渐近有效的置信区间，并在标准off-policy方法失效时保持名义覆盖。
Motivation: 多臂老虎机算法在在线平台、临床试验等中广泛使用，但对其性能的有效统计推断仍是开放问题。现有方法仅适用于不依赖于数据收集算法的估计量（如固定动作下的平均奖励），且标准方法因算法引入的复杂依赖关系而失效。
Method: BSI框架通过从观测数据（on-policy或off-policy）拟合bandit环境的模拟器，使用该模拟器估计任意评估策略下的平均奖励，并形式化传播估计参数的不确定性到置信区间。该方法仅需对行为策略的弱探索假设，避免重要性加权。
Result: 论文证明BSI能给出渐近有效的置信区间，并在标准off-policy评估方法失败的情景下维持名义覆盖。
Conclusion: BSI为自适应收集数据的平均奖励推断提供了有效方法，但需要进一步研究其对模型误设的鲁棒性等。

papers.title: Reason, Retrieve, Re-rank: A Zero-Shot Reasoning-Aware Framework for Composed Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed Video Retrieval (CoVR) seeks the target video that results from applying a free-form textual modification to a reference video. We address the \emph{Reason-Aware} CoVR (CoVR-R) challenge at the CVPR~2026 VidLLMs workshop, where retrieval is strictly zero-shot. We present \textbf{R3-CoVR} (\emph{Reason, Retrieve, Re-rank}), a training-free pipeline built entirely from frozen foundation models. A multimodal large language model (Qwen3-VL-8B) reasons about the \emph{after-effects} an edit implies -- state transitions, action phases, scene, camera and tempo -- and verbalises a concise post-edit description; a contrastive video--text encoder (SigLIP-2) embeds this description and the gallery for first-stage retrieval; finally a constraint-aware re-ranking stage uses the same multimodal model as a judge that scores each shortlisted candidate against the intended edited result. On the challenge test set, R3-CoVR attains \textbf{91.9\% R@1} and \textbf{98.2\% R@10}. Two findings drive these results: (i)~matching the description length to the contrastive encoder's text window lifts \Rk{1} from $67.5$ to $72.7$; and (ii)~the constraint-aware re-ranker, which reorders only the shortlist, lifts \Rk{1} from $72.7$ to $91.9$ -- the single largest gain. We analyse the re-ranker's behaviour, the retrieve/re-rank blend, and the shortlist depth, and we release a clean three-layer implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 R3-CoVR，一个零样本的组合视频检索框架，无需训练，完全由冻结的基础模型构建。使用多模态大模型推理编辑后的效果并生成描述，对比视频-文本编码器进行首次检索，再通过约束感知重排序提升精度。在 CVPR 2026 VidLLMs 挑战赛测试集上达到 91.9% R@1 和 98.2% R@10。
Motivation: 现有组合视频检索（CoVR）方法在零样本场景下性能有限，尤其是缺乏对编辑语义的推理能力。本文针对 CoVR-R 零样本挑战，旨在不依赖训练数据的情况下提升检索准确性。
Method: 三阶段训练无关流程：Reason（Qwen3-VL-8B 推理编辑后状态变化并生成简洁描述）、Retrieve（SigLIP-2 编码描述与候选库进行对比检索）、Re-rank（同一多模态模型作为裁判对候选集进行约束感知重排序）。
Result: 在挑战测试集上达到 91.9% R@1 和 98.2% R@10。描述长度匹配对比编码器文本窗口使 R@1 从 67.5 提升至 72.7；约束感知重排序进一步将 R@1 从 72.7 提升至 91.9，贡献最大增益。
Conclusion: 分析表明，描述长度匹配和约束感知重排序是零样本 CoVR 的关键因素。框架完全无需训练，代码已开源。

papers.title: MLLM-Microscope: Unlocking Hidden Structure Within Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This work presents MLLM-Microscope, a novel system designed for analyzing the hidden representations within Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our system evaluates the linearity, intrinsic dimension, and anisotropy of multimodal token embeddings across transformer layers. Utilizing the ScienceQA dataset, we evaluate two state-of-the-art MLLMs, LLaVA-NeXT and OmniFusion. We find that both the main and residual streams for tokens of both modalities exhibit highly linear behaviors across transformer layers. However, LLaVA-NeXT's image tokens reveal a slight decline in linearity, whereas OmniFusion's remain consistent. Image token dimensions in OmniFusion remain consistently higher across layers compared to LLaVA-NeXT. Also, the OmniFusion's anisotropy is observed to stay consistently low throughout the layers. These findings suggest that the inner workings of MLLMs highly depend on the nature of modality fusion performed before passing the token sequence into LLM. This and other new potential insights obtainable from our system are surely capable of enhancing our understanding of the inner workings of MLLMs, informing future model design and optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MLLM-Microscope 系统，用于分析多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 中隐藏表示的线性度、内在维度和各向异性。基于 ScienceQA 数据集，对 LLaVA-NeXT 和 OmniFusion 两个模型进行评测，发现不同模态的 token 在各层表现出高度线性行为，但图像 token 的线性度、维度和各向异性在两个模型中存在差异，表明模型内部工作高度依赖于模态融合方式。
Motivation: 理解 MLLM 内部表示的结构特性，为未来模型设计和优化提供指导。
Method: 开发 MLLM-Microscope 系统，通过测量线性度、内在维度和各向异性来分析 transformer 层中的多模态 token 嵌入。
Result: 在 ScienceQA 上，两个模型的主流和残差流均呈现高度线性；LLaVA-NeXT 的图像 token 线性度略有下降，而 OmniFusion 保持一致；OmniFusion 的图像 token 维度在各层更高，且各向异性持续较低。
Conclusion: MLLM 的内部工作机制高度依赖于将 token 序列送入 LLM 之前的模态融合方式，该系统可提供新的洞察以改进模型设计。

papers.title: hZACH-ViT: Curved Latent Geometry for Compact Vision Transformers in Low-Data Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Compact Vision Transformers are attractive for medical imaging in low-data and resource-constrained settings, but most existing variants assume that Euclidean latent geometry is sufficient for organizing image representations. We introduce hZACH-ViT, a family of curved-geometry extensions of ZACH-ViT, a compact zero-token Vision Transformer that removes positional embeddings and the class token and relies on global average pooling over patch representations. To isolate the role of geometry, we preserve the verified ZACH-ViT backbone and modify only the final representation space and prototype-based classifier head, enabling a controlled comparison between Euclidean, hyperbolic, and spherical latent geometries. We evaluate Poincaré, Klein, and spherical hZACH-ViT heads on seven MedMNIST datasets under an identical few-shot protocol with 50 samples per class and five random seeds. The completed benchmark contains 770 training runs spanning seven datasets, three non-Euclidean geometries, seven curvature magnitudes, and a Euclidean baseline. Across all seven datasets, the best non-Euclidean hZACH-ViT configuration improves over Euclidean ZACH-ViT, with an average gain of +0.021 in the dataset-specific primary metric and the largest improvement on OCTMNIST (+0.055 MacroF1). Fixed low-curvature configurations retain positive gains on the majority of datasets, and low curvature values (c = 0.1 or 0.2) account for six of the seven dataset-level winners. Rather than identifying a universally optimal manifold, our results establish geometry and curvature as dataset-dependent model-selection variables, with fixed low-curvature analyses confirming that gains persist beyond exhaustive per-dataset tuning.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code, execution notebooks, and aggregated result summaries will be released at https://github.com/Bluesman79/hZACH-ViT upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 hZACH-ViT，在紧凑型 Vision Transformer ZACH-ViT 基础上引入非欧几里得潜几何（双曲、球面），仅修改表示空间和分类头。在七个 MedMNIST 数据集上以每类 50 样本的小样本协议评估，最佳非欧配置平均提升 +0.021 主指标，OCTMNIST 提升 +0.055 MacroF1。低曲率（c=0.1 或 0.2）在六个数据集中最优。结论认为几何与曲率是数据集依赖的超参数，不存在普适最优流形。
Motivation: 紧凑型 ViT 在低数据医学成像中受关注，但现有变体默认欧几里得潜几何足够，可能限制表示组织能力。
Method: 保留 ZACH-ViT 骨干（无位置编码、无类令牌、全局平均池化），仅替换最终表示空间和基于原型的分类头为 Poincaré、Klein 或球形几何，并调节曲率大小。
Result: 在七个 MedMNIST 数据集上，最佳非欧配置平均提升 +0.021 数据集特定主指标，OCTMNIST 提升最大（+0.055 MacroF1）。低曲率（c=0.1 或 0.2）在六个数据集中获胜，且固定低曲率分析确认增益无需逐数据集精细调参。
Conclusion: 几何和曲率是数据集依赖的模型选择变量，不存在单一最优流形；低曲率设置即可获得稳健收益。
