papers.title: Ryze: Evidence-Enriched Data Synthesis from Biomedical Papers
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose VLMs remain unreliable for biomedical research because valid answers in scientific papers depend on evidence split across figures, tables, charts, captions, and referring text. Existing post-training pipelines are bottlenecked by costly expert annotation and by synthetic data that drops this evidence structure. We present Ryze, a fully automated system that converts raw biomedical papers into an evidence-enriched training set and a domain-specialized VLM. Ryze synthesizes QA pairs with complete supporting evidence (visual element, caption, extracted structure, and referring paragraphs), reduces layout and OCR errors via chart/table-aware extraction and LLM-based cleansing, and applies a progress-gated post-training strategy combining supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B, Ryze produces BioVLM-8B at under USD 200, achieving 48.0% weighted accuracy on LAB-Bench, outperforming the base model by +12.6 percentage points (pp) and surpassing GPT-5.2 by +3.8 pp. We release Ryze as open source together with the trained BioVLM-8B model.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACL 2026 System Demonstrations Track. 8 pages, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ryze，一个全自动系统，可将原始生物医学论文转换为富含证据的训练集，并训练出领域专用的视觉语言模型（VLM）。系统通过图表感知提取和LLM清洗减少布局和OCR错误，结合监督微调和强化学习的进度门控训练策略，从Qwen3-VL-8B出发生成BioVLM-8B，成本低于200美元，在LAB-Bench上达到48.0%的加权准确率，超过基础模型12.6个百分点，并超越GPT-5.2达3.8个百分点。
Motivation: 通用VLM在生物医学领域不可靠，因为论文中的证据分散在图表、表格、标题和引用文本中，而现有后训练管道受限于昂贵的专家标注和丢失证据结构的合成数据。
Method: Ryze自动从原始论文中合成QA对，包含完整支持证据（视觉元素、标题、提取结构和引用段落）；通过图表感知提取和LLM清洗减少布局和OCR错误；采用进度门控后训练策略，结合监督微调和强化学习。
Result: 从Qwen3-VL-8B出发，Ryze以低于200美元成本产出BioVLM-8B，在LAB-Bench上取得48.0%加权准确率，比基础模型高12.6个百分点，比GPT-5.2高3.8个百分点。
Conclusion: Ryze展示了自动化生物医学证据富集数据合成的有效性，并开源了系统和模型。

papers.title: Tiny Recursive Models for Solving the J2-Perturbed Lambert Problem
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a fast, recursive neural solver for the J2-perturbed Lambert problem based on Tiny Recursive Models (TRM), termed the TRM-Perturbed Lambert (TRM-PL) model. TRM is a weight-shared architecture whose effective capacity emerges from iteration depth rather than parameter count: a compact reasoning module is applied repeatedly within a two-level latent hierarchy, refining a candidate departure velocity by simulating the J2 trajectory and correcting it from the resulting tracking error. This unifies initial-guess generation and iterative correction in a single, end-to-end differentiable architecture. The recursive refinement loop is a learned alternative to the homotopy and continuation schemes of classical perturbed-Lambert solvers: rather than following a hand-designed path from the Keplerian to the perturbed solution, the network learns its own sequence of corrections. We evaluate TRM-PL on three test cases of increasing difficulty: single-revolution low-Earth-orbit (LEO) transfers, multi-revolution LEO transfers, and multi-revolution Jovian transfers. Three training paradigms are compared: jointly learning the Lambert solution and the J2 correction; refining the Lambert initial velocity with target-position and J2-corrected velocity supervision; and refining it with target-position supervision alone. Across all cases, the refinement-only approaches are the most reliable. The position-supervised variant reduces the median terminal-position error from 21.7 km to 0.027 km on single-revolution LEO, from 340.9 km to 0.31 km on multi-revolution LEO, all with the same 2.3M-parameter architecture. A single Newton corrector iteration on the TRM-PL output tightens the Jovian median to 0.063 km, yielding compact models accurate enough for embedded deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于 Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) 的递归神经求解器 TRM-PL，用于求解 J2 摄动 Lambert 问题。TRM 通过迭代深度而非参数数量获得有效容量，紧凑的推理模块在双层潜在层次内反复应用，通过模拟 J2 轨迹并从跟踪误差中修正来优化候选出发速度。该方法将初值生成和迭代修正统一为端到端可微架构。在单圈低地球轨道转移、多圈低地球轨道转移和多圈木星转移三个测试案例上评估，仅使用位置监督的细化方法最可靠，在单圈 LEO 上将中位终端位置误差从 21.7 km 降至 0.027 km，多圈 LEO 从 340.9 km 降至 0.31 km，均使用 2.3M 参数架构。对 TRM-PL 输出进行一次牛顿校正迭代可将木星案例中位误差缩小至 0.063 km。
Motivation: 经典摄动 Lambert 求解器依赖同伦或延续方案，需要手工设计的路径从 Kepler 解过渡到摄动解，缺乏端到端可微性且计算开销大。本文旨在用学习到的递归细化替代这些方案，获得快速、紧凑且可微的求解器。
Method: 提出 TRM-PL 模型，采用权重共享的递归架构，在双层潜在层次内重复应用紧凑推理模块。每次迭代模拟 J2 轨迹，计算跟踪误差并修正出发速度。训练范式包括联合学习、速度监督和仅位置监督三类细化策略。
Result: 摘要报告在单圈 LEO 转移中，仅位置监督的细化方法将中位终端位置误差从 21.7 km 降至 0.027 km；多圈 LEO 从 340.9 km 降至 0.31 km；木星转移经一次牛顿校正后中位误差降至 0.063 km。模型参数量为 2.3M。
Conclusion: TRM-PL 是一种紧凑、准确的可微求解器，适合嵌入式部署。细化策略（尤其仅位置监督）是可靠训练范式，且输出可通过一次牛顿迭代进一步精化。

papers.title: An Exploratory Study into using Machine-Learning for Fast Step-by-step Emulation of Numerical Mechanical Thrombectomy Simulations for Ischemic Stroke
papers.abstract_en: The treatment of ischemic stroke using mechanical thrombectomy involves difficult decisions under intense time constraints. Numerical physics simulations can in theory inform operators to make better decisions regarding treatment approaches and device selection, but are too slow to do so in practice. In this thesis, we investigate if current machine learning based surrogates can accurately emulate these simulations in a step-by-step manner while making them significantly faster. To do this we train three surrogate models on two simulations that involve a simplified aspiration procedure, with varying levels of geometric complexity. Our results show that two of our models accurately predict singular simulation steps and provide substantial speedups, especially when combined with specific data augmentations. However, the models showed a lack of stability when emulating simulations with complex geometries over longer time periods. Overall, this work provides a foundation for future studies to develop stable methods that scale to realistic numerical physics simulations of mechanical thrombectomy.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 16 figures, master thesis artificial intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该硕士论文探索使用机器学习代理模型快速逐步模拟缺血性卒中机械取栓的数值物理仿真。在简化抽吸过程的两个仿真上训练了三个代理模型，结果显示模型能准确预测单步并显著加速，但对复杂几何的长时间仿真稳定性不足。为后续开发稳定方法提供了基础。
Motivation: 机械取栓治疗缺血性卒中需要在极短时间内做出困难决策，数值物理仿真理论上可提供指导，但速度太慢无法实际应用。
Method: 基于机器学习训练三个代理模型，在两种不同几何复杂度的简化抽吸仿真上进行逐步仿真，并尝试数据增强。
Result: 两个模型能准确预测单步仿真，并提供显著加速（结合特定数据增强后效果更佳），但在复杂几何的长时间仿真中稳定性不足。
Conclusion: 该工作为未来开发能扩展到真实复杂机械取栓数值仿真的稳定方法奠定了基础，但当前方法在长时序复杂几何下不稳定。

papers.title: MMDG-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal Domain Generalization (MMDG) seeks to leverage complementary modalities to enhance model robustness on unseen domains. Despite extensive progress in Multi-modal Learning (MML) and Domain Generalization (DG) as individual fields, their systematic integration remains under-explored. Current MMDG research is largely confined to action recognition and lacks standardized evaluation protocols. To address this, we introduce MMDG-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring two foundational frameworks: DG then MML (D2M) and MML then DG (M2D). We provide unified experimental protocols across diverse tasks, including video-audio-flow action recognition and RGB-Depth-IR face anti-spoofing. By instantiating ten MMDG baselines through pairing a unified MML configuration with five DG techniques under both D2M and M2D orderings, we demonstrate that these structured combinations frequently outperform existing state-of-the-art methods, underscoring the necessity of a unified benchmarking effort. Our analysis yields three key insights: (1) Integrating DG techniques provides consistent generalization gains across various backbones, whereas non-DG methods are highly sensitive to backbone shifts; (2) The optimal framework choice depends on inter-modal stability: D2M excels when modal relations are stable across domains, while M2D is more robust to cross-domain relational variance; (3) Stronger backbones yield amplified performance dividends when integrated into our structured frameworks. MMDG-Bench provides a principled foundation and actionable design guidelines for future research in multi-modal robustness. Code is released at https://github.com/qszhan/MMDG-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMDG-Bench是一个面向多模态领域泛化的综合基准，提供了两种基础框架（D2M和M2D）和统一实验协议，涵盖视频-音频-光流动作识别和RGB-Depth-IR人脸反欺骗等任务。通过实例化十个基线方法，证明结构化组合常优于现有方法，并揭示了三个关键洞见。
Motivation: 多模态学习和领域泛化的系统集成研究不足，现有MMDG研究局限在动作识别且缺乏标准化评估协议。
Method: 提出MMDG-Bench基准，包含D2M（先领域泛化后多模态学习）和M2D（先多模态学习后领域泛化）两种框架，统一实验协议，并实例化十种基线方法。
Result: 结构化组合常优于现有方法；DG技术在不同骨干网络上提供一致泛化收益；框架选择依赖模态稳定性；更强骨干网络在结构化框架中带来更大性能收益。
Conclusion: MMDG-Bench为多模态鲁棒性研究提供了原则性基础和可操作设计指南。

papers.title: Cohort-Scale Neural Atlases of Ultrasound Video
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound is the most widely used real-time imaging modality in clinical practice, yet per-frame video annotation remains a major bottleneck: expert labels are scarce and costly, and image appearance varies with speckle, shadowing, attenuation, and operator-dependent probe pose. This is especially limiting because clinically relevant information is often dynamic, from left-ventricular motion in echocardiography to muscle and bone kinematics in musculoskeletal imaging. Population atlases can amortize annotation cost by registering observations to a shared canonical coordinate system, but existing neural atlas methods mainly target single videos, small test-time image sets, or object-centric image collections. We introduce a cohort-scale neural atlas for ultrasound video: a single canonical chart with per-video Generative Latent Optimization embeddings, trained jointly over thousands of frames in DINOv3 feature space. Across five cardiac and musculoskeletal datasets with point landmarks and segmentation masks, our method learns coherent canonical templates and enables accurate atlas-space annotation transfer. On EchoNet-Dynamic and MSK-Bone, it supports single- and few-shot transfer with accuracy competitive with strong dense-correspondence baselines, while training in minutes on a single consumer GPU. The learned embeddings are interpretable: linear projections reveal structured cohort variation, image-decoder interpolation produces anatomically plausible intermediate frames, and test-time latent inversion reconstructs held-out frames through the atlas. These results suggest that cohort-scale neural atlases offer a practical, interpretable representation for reducing expert annotation burden in ultrasound video analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种群体级神经图谱（cohort-scale neural atlas）用于超声视频分析，通过共享规范图表和每视频的生成性隐优化嵌入，在DINOv3特征空间联合训练。在五个心脏和肌肉骨骼数据集上，该方法实现了准确的标注转移，训练仅需数分钟，且嵌入具有可解释性。
Motivation: 超声视频的每帧人工标注成本高且可变，现有神经图谱方法局限于单视频或小样本，无法在群体水平共享标注信息。
Method: 构建单一规范图表，为每个视频学习一个生成性隐优化（Generative Latent Optimization）嵌入，在DINOv3特征空间中对数千帧进行联合训练，实现群体级标注转移。
Result: 在EchoNet-Dynamic和MSK-Bone等五个数据集上，单次/少次标注转移的准确度匹敌强密集对应基线，训练仅需单个消费级GPU数分钟；嵌入的线性投影揭示群体变异，插值生成解剖合理的中间帧。
Conclusion: 群体级神经图谱为超声视频分析提供了实用、可解释的表示，有望减少专家标注负担。

papers.title: A Lightweight Hybrid MLP-Based Framework for Real-Time Phishing URL Detection Using Structural URL Features
papers.abstract_en: Phishing attacks remain a major cybersecurity threat, exploiting deceptive URLs to steal sensitive user information. Traditional blacklist and rule-based detection approaches are reactive and often fail to identify newly emerging phishing URLs. This paper proposes a lightweight hybrid framework for real-time phishing URL detection that combines blacklist-based screening with a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifier operating solely on structural URL features. The framework extracts 16 URL-derived features capturing structural, domain-based, and security-related characteristics without requiring webpage content access, third-party APIs, or visual rendering, making it computationally efficient for real-time deployment. The system was trained and evaluated on the PhiUSIIL phishing dataset containing 235,795 labelled URLs. Experimental results show that the proposed MLP achieved 99.24% accuracy, 98.74% precision, 99.95% recall, 99.34% F1-score, and 99.65% ROC-AUC, outperforming Random Forest, Logistic Regression, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost under the same evaluation setting. The hybrid architecture achieved an average inference latency of 1.2 ms per URL and a peak throughput of 4,200 URLs per second under concurrent processing. A functional desktop application prototype, CyberGuard, further demonstrates deployment viability. The results indicate that the proposed framework provides an accurate and computationally efficient solution for real-time phishing URL detection in resource-constrained environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个轻量级混合框架用于实时钓鱼URL检测，结合黑名单筛选和仅基于结构URL特征的多层感知机（MLP）分类器。在PhiUSIIL数据集（235,795条URL）上，MLP达到99.24%准确率、98.74%精确率、99.95%召回率、99.34% F1分数和99.65% ROC-AUC，推理延迟为1.2毫秒/URL，吞吐量为4200 URLs/秒。原型应用CyberGuard验证了部署可行性。
Motivation: 传统黑名单和基于规则的检测方法反应滞后，难以识别新型钓鱼URL，需要更高效实时的检测方案。
Method: 框架首先进行黑名单筛选，然后利用MLP分类器对16个结构化URL特征（包括结构、域名和安全性相关特征）进行分类，无需访问网页内容或第三方API。
Result: MLP在PhiUSIIL数据集上优于随机森林、逻辑回归、XGBoost、LightGBM和CatBoost；混合架构实现1.2ms推理延迟和4200 URLs/s吞吐量。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了准确且计算高效的实时钓鱼URL检测方案，适合资源受限环境，原型证明了实际部署潜力。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient LLM Training with Dynamic Sparsity: From Stability to Practical Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) offers a promising paradigm for improving the training and inference efficiency of deep neural networks; however, we find that in large language model training, DST can suffer from optimization instability, manifested as loss spikes after topology updates. In this work, we show that the naive use of standard Adam-based optimizers leads to a cold-start issue for newly regrown parameters, resulting in excessively large updates and disrupted training dynamics. To address this issue, we propose Sparse Memory-Efficient Training (SMET), which stabilizes DST with optimizer warm-up and improves training progress through density-aware learning-rate scaling. SMET further reduces memory consumption by storing gradients and optimizer states only for active parameters. We provide a theoretical analysis of the update behaviors under SMET, showing improved optimization stability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SMET enables stable, scalable, and memory-efficient sparse pre-training of LLMs, paving the way for sparse training as a practical alternative to dense training. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/QiaoXiao7282/SMET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现动态稀疏训练（DST）在大语言模型训练中会出现优化不稳定性（loss spikes），原因是Adam优化器对新生长的参数存在冷启动问题。为此提出SMET，通过优化器预热和密度感知学习率缩放稳定训练，并仅存储活跃参数的梯度和优化器状态以降低内存。实验表明SMET能实现稳定、可扩展且内存高效的LLM稀疏预训练。
Motivation: DST在LLM训练中面临优化不稳定性（拓扑更新后loss spikes），阻碍其实际应用。
Method: 提出SMET，包含优化器预热（解决新参数冷启动）和密度感知学习率缩放，并仅存储活跃参数的梯度和优化器状态以节省内存。
Result: 实验表明SMET能稳定且可扩展地训练LLM，内存消耗降低，使稀疏训练成为密集训练的实际替代方案。
Conclusion: SMET通过优化器预热和密度感知学习率缩放解决了DST的不稳定性，为大规模LLM稀疏训练提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GABI: Geometry-Aware Boundary Integration for Spacecraft Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation is crucial for autonomous spacecraft, as it directly affects downstream tasks related to 3D situational awareness. The harsh illumination conditions of space, however, produce images with high variability in appearance, hindering the generalization of segmentation approaches across different spacecraft and environments. In this work, we propose GABI, a lightweight boundary-aware multi-task segmentation architecture that augments a convolutional backbone with an auxiliary distance-field prediction head. The distance field provides dense geometric supervision around object boundaries, encouraging the network to learn spatially consistent representations of spacecraft structures while maintaining low model complexity suitable for onboard perception systems. We evaluated GABI against both an established convolutional baseline and a heavier transformer-based architecture. On the SPARK benchmark, distance-field supervision improves the baseline by up to $5\%$ in Average Precision while achieving performance comparable to the transformer models. In generalization experiments, GABI improves Average Precision by more than $50\%$ over the baseline. In cross-domain evaluation, the lightweight GABI variant performs within $5\%$ in IoU and F1-score of the heavier transformer model while being approximately ten times smaller. At the same time, the heavier GABI variant surpasses the transformer architectures while remaining nearly three times lighter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GABI，一种轻量级边界感知多任务分割架构，通过附加距离场预测头为航天器图像分割提供密集几何监督。在SPARK基准上，该架构在保持低模型复杂度的同时，在平均精度上比卷积基线提升高达5%，并接近重型Transformer模型的性能。跨域实验中，GABI的轻量版本在IoU和F1-score上与Transformer模型相差不到5%，体积却小十倍，而重型版本则超越Transformer且体积小近三倍。
Motivation: 太空恶劣光照条件导致航天器图像外观变化大，现有分割方法泛化性差，且需兼顾机载系统的低复杂度要求。
Method: 在卷积骨干网络基础上附加一个辅助的距离场预测头，通过边界周围的密集几何监督学习航天器结构的空间一致表示。
Result: 在SPARK基准上，距离场监督使基线平均精度提升高达5%；跨域实验中平均精度提升超过50%；轻量GABI变体在IoU和F1-score上接近重型Transformer模型（差距<5%），体积小十倍；重型GABI变体超越Transformer且轻三倍。
Conclusion: GABI表明，利用距离场作为辅助监督能有效提升航天器分割的泛化性和精度，同时保持模型轻量化，适合星上感知。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dive into Waves: Morlet Spectral Transformer for Cross-Subject Emotion Decoding from EEG
papers.abstract_en: We study cross-subject emotion recognition from EEG, a practically important yet challenging problem in brain-computer interfaces. Unlike tasks with clear waveform signatures, emotion-related EEG signals are primarily encoded in spectral power and are weak, noisy, and highly variable across subjects. Existing approaches rely either on large pretrained EEG foundation models, which require massive data yet still struggle with cross-subject variability, or frequency-domain encoders, which better reflect spectral structure but suffer from mismatched representations, drift-dominated tokenization, and lack of band-specific spatial modeling. In this article, we propose the Morlet Spectral Transformer (MST), built around three key components and integrated with a spatiotemporal Transformer backbone. First, Morlet wavelet tokenization provides a time-frequency representation that matches the multi-scale structure of brain rhythms, and extends classical differential entropy features to a form suitable for Transformers. Second, long-context baseline removal acts as a simple temporal normalization that removes subject-specific drift and redundancy across nearby windows. Third, frequency-specific spatial projection learns a separate channel mixer for each frequency band, capturing interpretable band-specific patterns and reducing cross-channel mixing. We show that, even without pretraining, MST consistently outperforms both large pretrained EEG foundation models and frequency-based methods across all SEED-family datasets. These results suggest that careful representation design can yield an accurate, cost-effective, and interpretable alternative to large-scale pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Morlet 谱 Transformer (MST) 用于跨被试脑电情绪识别，无需预训练即可优于大型预训练模型和频域方法。该方法通过 Morlet 小波标记化、长上下文基线去除和频率特异性空间投影，有效处理脑电信号的微弱、噪声和跨被试变异性。
Motivation: 脑电情绪识别中，信号主要编码在频谱功率中，现有方法要么依赖大规模预训练模型但跨被试变异性仍存，要么频域编码器存在表征不匹配、漂移主导的标记化和缺乏频带特定空间建模的问题。
Method: 提出 Morlet 谱 Transformer，包含三个关键组件：Morlet 小波标记化（提供匹配脑节律多尺度结构的时频表示）、长上下文基线去除（去除被试特异性漂移和冗余）、频率特异性空间投影（为每个频带学习独立通道混合器）。
Result: 在 SEED 系列数据集上，即使没有预训练，MST 一致优于大型预训练脑电基础模型和基于频率的方法。
Conclusion: 精心设计的表示可以在脑电情绪识别中成为大规模预训练的准确、经济且可解释的替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Task diversity produces systematic transfer but inhibits continual reinforcement learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning aims to produce agents that learn not only to improve at their current tasks but also to adapt as task distributions change. Training an agent on many diverse tasks can induce zero-shot generalization, but previous work generally evaluates this generalization after training -- with frozen weights. Whether task diversity also improves an agent's ability to continue learning across distribution shifts remains unclear. We introduce Banyan, a GPU-accelerated continual RL domain in which task diversity factors into three independently controllable axes: the map layouts an agent must navigate, the objects it must interact with, and the hierarchical structures of sub-goal dependencies. Across individual distribution shifts, increasing diversity along each axis causes agents to begin training on the new tasks near the performance attained on the previous one, even when the shift changes the structure of the optimal policy. However, as the number of shifts increases, this local transfer does not by itself yield sustained continual learning: longer-horizon tasks plateau, and earlier task distributions are forgotten after later training. Banyan is a benchmark for studying when controlled task diversity produces transferable learning, when that transfer persists, and where it falls short of proper continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Banyan，一个GPU加速的持续强化学习领域，其中任务多样性沿三个独立轴（地图布局、交互对象、子目标依赖的层次结构）进行控制。实验表明，增加任务多样性可以在单次分布偏移时实现局部迁移，但随着偏移次数增多，这种迁移无法维持持续学习——长期任务性能停滞，早期任务分布被遗忘。论文旨在作为研究可控任务多样性何时产生可迁移学习、何时转移持久以及何时未能实现真正持续学习的基准。
Motivation: 持续强化学习旨在使智能体不仅提高当前任务的表现，还能适应任务分布的变化。以往研究通常评估训练后冻结权重的零样本泛化，但尚不清楚任务多样性是否能改善智能体在分布偏移下的持续学习能力。
Method: 引入Banyan领域，将任务多样性分解为三个独立可控的轴：地图布局、交互对象和子目标依赖的层次结构，以研究不同多样性维度对持续学习的影响。
Result: 摘要报告：沿着每个轴增加多样性使得代理在新任务上的初始训练性能接近前一任务的性能，即使偏移改变了最优策略的结构。然而，随着偏移次数增加，局部迁移不足以维持持续学习：长期任务出现平台期，早期任务分布在后续训练后被遗忘。
Conclusion: Banyan为研究何时可控任务多样性产生可迁移学习、迁移何时持久以及何处未能实现真正的持续学习提供了基准。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：沿着每个轴增加多样性使得代理在新任务上的初始训练性能接近前一任务的性能，即使偏移改变了最优策略的结构。然而，随着偏移次数增加，局部迁移不足以维持持续学习：长期任务出现平台期，早期任务分布在后续训练后被遗忘。
summary_sections.conclusion: Banyan为研究何时可控任务多样性产生可迁移学习、迁移何时持久以及何处未能实现真正的持续学习提供了基准。

papers.title: Images as Tables: In-Context Learning with TabPFN for Low-Data Detection of AI-Generated Images
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image detection is a moving-target problem: detectors trained on one generator often fail when a new generator appears, and only a few labeled examples are available. We study a simple image-to-table formulation for this regime, where each image is encoded by a frozen DINOv3 backbone, its CLS feature is reduced to a 500-dimensional structured row with PCA, and TabPFN performs real/fake classification by in-context tabular inference rather than task-specific classifier training. This turns fake-image detection into low-data structured prediction over learned visual features, making detector adaptation depend on the labeled context set instead of gradient-based fine-tuning. On GenImage, LATTE, a recent state-of-the-art detector, remains stronger when many labeled samples from all generators are available, by 7.4% in the largest pooled setting, but DINOv3-PCA-TabPFN is stronger in the practically important low-data regime, outperforming LATTE by up to 8.2%, and in transfer settings where the detector must generalize from one generator to another. These results position tabular foundation models as a strong complementary adaptation mechanism for image forensics, shifting adaptation from detector retraining to lightweight in-context updates with a small labeled set of examples. Code URL: https://github.com/jpwalter30/Towards-Generalizable-Detection-of-AI-Generated-Images
papers.comment: Accepted as a Spotlight Oral at the ICML 2026 Workshop Foundation Models for Structured Data. *Equal Contribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将图像转换为表格形式，利用冻结的DINOv3骨干网络提取特征并通过PCA降至500维，再使用TabPFN进行上下文学习（in-context learning）来检测AI生成图像，无需梯度更新。在低数据场景下，该方法优于SOTA检测器LATTE最高达8.2%；在数据充足时，LATTE仍领先7.4%。
Motivation: AI生成图像检测面临移动目标问题：检测器对未见过的生成器泛化差，且实际中仅有少量标记样本可用。
Method: 将图像编码为表格：用冻结的DINOv3提取CLS特征，经PCA降至500维作为结构化行，然后TabPFN通过上下文推理进行真/假分类，避免任务特定分类器训练。
Result: 在GenImage和LATTE数据集上，当所有生成器的大量标记样本可用时，LATTE在最大池化设置下领先7.4%；但在低数据场景下，DINOv3-PCA-TabPFN优于LATTE最高达8.2%，且在跨生成器迁移设置中表现更强。
Conclusion: 表格基础模型可作为图像取证的强互补适应机制，使检测器适应从重训练转变为轻量级上下文更新，仅需少量标记样本。

papers.title: Benchmarks for Vision-Language Models in Urban Perception Should Be Reliability-Aware and Negotiated
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to generate structured descriptions of street-level imagery for tasks such as streetscape auditing, mapping, and public consultation. These uses combine observable attributes with appraisal categories, and the human targets are often distributions of judgments with disagreement and explicit non-response. This paper argues that benchmarking VLMs for urban perception should treat disagreement and abstention as measurement outcomes, report inter-annotator reliability alongside model alignment, and treat the label space and scoring policy as negotiable artifacts when outputs are intended to inform urban governance. We ground the argument in a benchmark of 100 Montreal street scenes annotated along 30 dimensions by 12 participants from seven community organizations, and in a deterministic zero-shot evaluation of seven VLMs. Across dimensions, model agreement with human consensus co-varies with dimension-level human reliability, and for the appraisal dimension Overall Impression models and annotators exhibit distributional mismatch including different rates of Not applicable. We close with actions for benchmark creators, model developers, and institutions to make uncertainty and benchmark assumptions visible in evaluation reports.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证视觉语言模型（VLM）在城市感知任务中的基准测试应纳入标注者间不一致和弃权作为度量，报告信度，并将标签空间和评分策略视为可协商的。基于100张蒙特利尔街景在30个维度上的参与者标注和7个VLM的零样本评估，发现模型与人类共识的一致性随维度级人类信度变化，且在整体印象维度上存在分布不匹配。
Motivation: 现有VLM基准忽略人类判断的不一致和弃权，而城市感知任务中这些因素对评估和治理决策至关重要。
Method: 提出可靠性感知和协商的基准框架，包括报告标注者间信度、处理弃权，并将标签空间和评分策略视为可协商的人工制品。
Result: 在蒙特利尔街景数据集上，模型与人类共识的一致性随维度级人类信度变化；在整体印象维度上，模型和标注者存在分布不匹配，包括不同的“不适用”率。
Conclusion: 呼吁基准创建者、模型开发者和机构在评估报告中明确不确定性和基准假设，以使评估更可靠。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Enhancing LLM Metacognition via Cognitive Pairwise Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become central to LLM reasoning, but its outcome-level rewards can make models more willing to give confident answers when evidence or reasoning is unreliable. Existing SFT or RL methods mainly teach LLMs to refuse or express uncertainty at the response level, which can overfit abstention behavior rather than improve reasoning reliability. To address this limitation, we propose Cognitive Pairwise Training (CPT), a cognitive mid-training alignment stage that turns pairwise comparisons over reasoning traces into a reusable alignment signal. By learning to distinguish trustworthy from flawed reasoning, CPT encourages the model to internalize a reasoning-quality discrimination boundary rather than memorize surface refusal patterns. Across five model scales and three model families, CPT improves the reasoning--metacognition trade-off. At 14B, CPT+RL outperforms the standard SFT+RL pipeline by +2.2 math-average points and +5.2 abstention-F1 points. Further analyses show that CPT improves trace quality and exhibits strong robustness and scalability across evaluation and training settings. Code and models are released at https://github.com/Tsinghua-dhy/CPT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出认知对训练（CPT），一种用于增强LLM元认知的中训练对齐方法。通过将推理轨迹上的成对比较转化为可重用的对齐信号，CPT鼓励模型区分可信与不可靠推理，而非记忆表面拒绝模式。实验表明，在五个模型规模和三个模型家族上，CPT改善了推理-元认知权衡，14B模型上CPT+RL比标准SFT+RL管线在数学平均上提升2.2个点，abstention-F1提升5.2个点。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法使模型在证据不可靠时仍给出自信答案，而SFT/RL方法主要教会模型在响应层面拒绝或表达不确定性，可能过拟合拒答行为而非改善推理可靠性。
Method: 提出认知对训练（CPT），一种认知中训练对齐阶段，将推理轨迹上的成对比较转化为可重用的对齐信号，通过区分可信与不可靠推理，使模型内化推理质量判别边界。
Result: 在五个模型规模和三个模型家族上，CPT改善了推理-元认知权衡；14B模型上CPT+RL比标准SFT+RL管线在数学平均上+2.2点，abstention-F1上+5.2点。
Conclusion: CPT改善了推理轨迹质量，并在评估和训练设置中表现出强鲁棒性和可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Statistical Analysis of using the Shapley Value for Sensor Anomaly Localization with Accurate Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Recent publications have suggested using the Shap- ley value for sensor anomaly/attack localization. We study the performance of such an approach by using mathematically de- fined optimum binary classifiers in the Shapley value calculation. To judge localization performance, we study the ability of the Shapley value of a given sensor observation to determine if that observation is anomalous. First, we prove that for cases with independent sensor observations, an optimized anomaly test using the Shapley value is equivalent to an optimized lower-complexity anomaly test using a single term in the Shapley value calculation, yielding the exact same probability of error. For some popular dependent observation cases involving two sensors, including correlated bivariate Gaussian/Laplacian probability density functions and constant/Gaussian at- tacks/anomalies, we prove that these two tests are fundamentally different, yielding different decision regions and error probabil- ities. Further, we prove that the Shapley value test is sometimes strictly inferior to the other (single term in Shapley calculation) test in certain statistically dependent bivariate Gaussian scenarios with large correlation magnitude and additive attacks/anomalies, while it is strictly superior in others, depending on the sign of the correlation. One can combine these two approaches to obtain a strictly better approach in these cases. These results, which provide the first theoretical statistical analysis of Shapley-based localization, seem very interesting based on the wide acceptance of the Shapley value by many researchers and should encourage further research on this topic. Numerical results are provided which illustrate our findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文对使用Shapley值进行传感器异常定位的性能进行了理论统计分析。在独立传感器观测下，证明了基于Shapley值的优化异常检验与Shapley计算中单项检验等价并具有相同误差概率。在相关二元高斯/拉普拉斯分布及恒定/高斯攻击等依赖情形下，证明两种检验本质不同，且Shapley检验在某些大相关幅值情形下严格劣于单项检验，而在其他情形下严格优于，具体取决于相关符号。数值结果验证了理论发现。
Motivation: 现有文献建议用Shapley值定位传感器异常/攻击，但缺乏理论统计性能分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 使用数学定义的最优二元分类器在Shapley值计算中分析定位性能，通过与Shapley值中单项检验对比，分别独立和相关观测情形下推导误差概率和决策区域。
Result: 独立观测下两种检验等价；相关二元高斯/拉普拉斯及恒定/高斯攻击下，两种检验的决策区域和误差概率不同。对于大相关幅度的相关二元高斯场景，Shapley检验有时严格低于单项检验，有时严格优于，取决于相关符号。
Conclusion: 提供了首个Shapley定位的理论统计分析，表明依赖结构影响性能，组合两种方法可获得更优方案，鼓励进一步研究。

papers.title: Meta-Black-Box Optimization with Ensemble Surrogate Modeling for Robustness-Accuracy Trade-off within SAEA
papers.abstract_en: Surrogate-assisted evolutionary algorithms (SAEAs) have been widely used for expensive black-box optimization problems. However, their reliance on rigid and manually designed components limits their flexibility and generalization across tasks. Meta-black-box optimization (MetaBBO) provides a promising paradigm for adaptively configuring algorithmic components. Nevertheless, existing MetaBBO methods usually control only a single component, and few studies have investigated the unified control of multi-component optimizers such as SAEAs. Moreover, the robustness-accuracy trade-off in surrogate modeling, which is crucial for stable early-stage exploration and accurate late-stage exploitation, has rarely been explicitly considered. To address these issues, we propose AdaE-SAEA, an adaptive ensemble surrogate-assisted evolutionary algorithm for expensive multi-objective optimization. AdaE-SAEA embeds SAEA as the low-level optimizer within the MetaBBO framework and jointly controls the infill criterion and ensemble-based surrogate modeling. Specifically, bagging and boosting are designed as surrogate modeling modules to adaptively balance robustness and accuracy across different search phases, while the meta-policy simultaneously selects the infill criterion to enable adaptive sampling decisions. The meta-policy is trained through reinforcement learning with parallel sampling and centralized training, improving both training efficiency and transferability. Experiments on synthetic and real-world problems demonstrate that AdaE-SAEA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and MetaBBO-based methods. We further verify the effectiveness of TabPFN as the base surrogate model for ensemble learning. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to unify the control of surrogate modeling and infill criteria in SAEAs while explicitly addressing the robustness--accuracy trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaE-SAEA，一种自适应集成代理辅助进化算法，用于昂贵多目标优化。它通过元黑盒优化框架统一控制代理建模和填充准则，利用 bagging 和 boosting 平衡不同搜索阶段的鲁棒性和准确性，并通过强化学习训练元策略。实验表明该方法在合成和真实问题上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有代理辅助进化算法依赖刚性手工设计组件，灵活性和泛化性不足；元黑盒优化方法通常只控制单一组件，且很少考虑代理建模中鲁棒性与准确性的权衡。
Method: 将 SAEA 嵌入 MetaBBO 框架作为底层优化器，联合控制填充准则和集成代理建模。采用 bagging 和 boosting 作为代理建模模块，由元策略根据搜索阶段自适应选择；填充准则也由元策略决定。元策略通过并行采样和集中训练的强化学习进行训练。
Result: 在合成和真实世界问题上，AdaE-SAEA 优于最先进的基线和基于 MetaBBO 的方法。验证了 TabPFN 作为集成学习的基础代理模型的有效性。
Conclusion: 这是首个在 SAEA 中统一控制代理建模和填充准则并显式处理鲁棒性-准确性权衡的工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GenPT: Beyond Self-Report for Reliable LLM Psychometrics via Generative Projective Testing
papers.abstract_en: Self-report questionnaires remain the prevailing tool for probing the psychological states of persona-conditioned agents (PC-Agents). However, classical instruments inherit two well-known threats: contamination from training corpora and directional bias driven by social-desirability or contextual framing. To overcome these methodological bottlenecks, we ask whether projective paradigms can be adapted into a robust psychometric tool. We introduce \textbf{GenPT} (Generative Projective Testing), which reformulates TAT, Rorschach, and SCT with newly generated stimuli and organizes assessment as a three-stage pipeline to derive standardized psychological indicators and target states. Evaluating PC-Agents induced via CharacterRAG and AnnaAgent profiles, we benchmark GenPT's reliability and validity against classical questionnaires. The results indicate that questionnaires exhibit systematic directional shifts under social-desirability framing, most strongly on suicide ideation. In contrast, GenPT's collected behavioral patterns stay near the symmetric baseline. Furthermore, under a longitudinal counselling context, GenPT-based depression assessment shifts by roughly an order of magnitude more than the questionnaire counterpart when Qwen3 serves as the backbone. Overall, GenPT complements self-report methods in scenarios where contamination resistance, bias asymmetry, and context sensitivity matter. papers.title: From Cues to Horizons: Dynamic Risk Horizon Profiling for Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and reliable vehicle trajectory prediction is essential for safe autonomous driving. Recent studies have incorporated safety risk into trajectory prediction to quantify dangers posed by surrounding agents. However, most risk-aware approaches use past risk information as a secondary signal to help guide decisions, overlooking its future evolution and uncertainty. In this paper, we propose a risk horizon profiling (RHP) module that incorporates a continuous, learnable potential field model for risk-aware trajectory prediction. The RHP module calculates the spatial-temporal proximity of surrounding objects to profile risk distributions across future horizons, which supports better trajectory prediction by adaptively identifying what human drivers perceive as critical moments. We evaluate our method on two datasets from different driving settings, highD for highway corridors and SHRP2 for urban streets, which cover diverse risk scenarios including safe, near-crash, and crash events. Compared to the baseline methods, our framework achieves a 25.0\% reduction in 5s RMSE on the highD dataset and a 29.1\% reduction in 5s minFDE on SHRP2. These results indicate strong performance for both short and long horizon prediction and robust generalization across highway and urban scenarios. The proposed method enables more realistic AV path planning and strategic selection, thereby supporting safer autonomous driving and more advanced driver-assistance systems. The source code for this work is available at: https://github.com/bilab-nyu/RHP
papers.comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (T-ITS)

TL;DR: 本文提出风险地平线分析（RHP）模块，将连续可学习的势场模型融入轨迹预测，通过分析周围物体在未来时间窗口内的时空接近度来刻画风险分布，并在高D和SHRP2数据集上分别降低5秒RMSE 25.0%和5秒minFDE 29.1%。
Motivation: 现有风险感知轨迹预测方法仅将历史风险作为辅助信号，忽略了风险的未来演化和不确定性，无法像人类驾驶员那样动态识别关键时刻。

Result: 在高D（高速公路）和SHRP2（城市道路）数据集上，相比基线方法，5秒RMSE降低25.0%，5秒minFDE降低29.1%，涵盖安全、近碰撞和碰撞场景。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式建模风险未来演化提升了轨迹预测精度和泛化能力，有助于更安全的自动驾驶路径规划。

papers.title: RefDiffNet: Learning to Expose Subtle PCB Defects Before Detection
papers.abstract_en: Printed circuit board (PCB) defect detection is challenging because many defects are small and difficult to distinguish from complex background patterns. Most deep learning-based PCB inspection methods rely only on the inspected PCB image for defect detection, ignoring the defect-free reference image that encodes the expected layout of traces, pads, and other PCB structures. In this work, we propose RefDiffNet, a lightweight plug-and-play input enhancement block placed before the detector backbone to enhance the image before defect detection. RefDiffNet brings one proven idea from classical inspection into the deep learning era, using a defect-free reference image to reveal defects. RefDiffNet compares the defective image with the aligned reference, captures structural changes relative to the reference, and uses a lightweight encoder to output the original image with defective regions highlighted, thereby making the downstream detector's task easier. Results on HRIPCB and DeepPCB show that RefDiffNet consistently improves performance across detector families, including one-stage detectors from YOLOv8 to YOLOv26, the transformer-based RT-DETR, and the two-stage Faster R-CNN. It achieves up to 18% relative mAP50:95 gain with negligible overhead, introducing only 0.004 - 0.005M additional parameters and 0.7 - 0.8 GFLOPs, amounting to at most 0.25% of the parameter count of any evaluated detector. Results establish RefDiffNet as a lightweight, plug-and-play, detector-agnostic input enhancement module that substantially improves PCB defect detection with minimal computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RefDiffNet，一种轻量级即插即用的输入增强模块，利用无缺陷参考图像对比来凸显PCB缺陷区域，从而提升下游检测器的性能。在HRIPCB和DeepPCB数据集上，该模块在YOLOv8-26、RT-DETR和Faster R-CNN等多种检测器上均获得一致提升，最高相对mAP50:95提升18%，额外参数量仅0.004-0.005M。
Motivation: 现有深度学习PCB缺陷检测方法仅依赖待检图像，忽视无缺陷参考图像中蕴含的预期布局信息，导致微小缺陷难以被区分。
Method: RefDiffNet将缺陷图像与对齐后的无缺陷参考图像进行结构变化比较，通过轻量级编码器输出高亮缺陷区域的原始图像，作为检测器骨干网络的输入增强。
Result: 在HRIPCB和DeepPCB上，RefDiffNet使YOLOv8-26、RT-DETR和Faster R-CNN等检测器的mAP50:95相对提升最高18%，仅引入0.004-0.005M参数和0.7-0.8 GFLOPs。
Conclusion: RefDiffNet是一种轻量级、检测器无关的输入增强模块，能以极小的计算代价显著提升PCB缺陷检测性能。

papers.title: Sympatheia: Emotionally Adaptive Voice Assistant with Continuous Affect Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Empathetic spoken dialogue systems must infer a user's emotional state to respond appropriately, yet everyday speech often carries weak, neutral, or ambiguous affective cues. To address this, we introduce Sympatheia, a speech-to-speech dialogue framework conditioned on affect inferred from the user's speech and, when available, explicit affect specifications provided as a continuous valence--arousal (VA) control signal by a multimodal sensing module or user interface. To train our model, we construct Sympatheia-18k, an emotion-conditioned synthetic spoken dialogue corpus with 12 emotion anchors. This dataset includes an emotional split for learning affective speech behavior, and a neutral split that pairs emotionally neutral queries with multiple emotion-conditioned responses to isolate explicit emotion control in emotionally ambiguous cases. Empirical results show that Sympatheia outperforms speech conversational baselines in generating responses whose semantic content and spoken delivery are both emotionally appropriate. We further show that the same VA interface can integrate emotion estimates from diverse sensing modules, including facial expression, biosignals, and textual affect descriptions, improving response alignment when speech alone provides limited emotional evidence. These results suggest that continuous affect conditioning is an effective practical step for building emotionally adaptive voice assistants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sympatheia，一种基于连续情感条件（valence-arousal）的语音对话框架，能够从用户语音推断情感状态，并可接收多模态模块提供的显式情感规格。构建了包含12个情感锚点的合成对话语料库 Sympatheia-18k，实验表明该模型在语义内容和语音表达上均优于基线，且能整合面部表情、生物信号等情感估计，提升低情感语音场景下的响应对齐度。
Motivation: 日常语音常带有弱、中性或模糊的情感线索，现有共情对话系统难以准确推断用户情绪，需要一种能够处理情感模糊情况且能灵活融合多模态情感信息的方法。
Method: 构建 Sympatheia-18k 合成对话语料库，包含情感分割（学习情感语音行为）和中性分割（配对中性查询与多种情感条件响应以隔离显式情感控制）；模型以连续效价-唤醒度（VA）为条件，融合语音推断和外部情感规格。
Result: Sympatheia 在生成语义和语音表达均情感适当的响应上优于语音对话基线；同一 VA 接口可整合面部表情、生物信号和文本情感描述，在语音情感证据不足时提升响应对齐度。
Conclusion: 连续情感条件是构建情感自适应语音助手的有效实践步骤，能够处理模糊情感并融合多模态输入。

papers.title: CUPID in the Model Zoo: Online Matchmaking for Selecting Your Dream LLM
papers.abstract_en: Users increasingly face the challenge of selecting an appropriate LLM for a given task from a rapidly growing pool of LLMs, each with distinct but often opaque latent properties. Compounding this challenge, users may lack the vocabulary or awareness to explicitly articulate the characteristics they value in an LLM's responses or deployment. We propose an interaction-efficient active learning framework in which a dueling bandit algorithm iteratively selects pairs of LLMs, collects user feedback about their responses, and updates its belief about the user's latent preferences. We introduce a novel belief-aware upper confidence bound strategy that balances exploration of the model pool with exploitation of inferred preferences, enabling efficient alignment between user needs and LLM capabilities under user-specified cost and time budgets. Through diverse experiments on LLMs and human studies, we experimentally verify that our model can efficiently match well-aligned LLMs to users at a lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于决斗赌博机（dueling bandit）的交互式主动学习框架，用于在用户缺乏明确偏好词汇的情况下，高效地从众多LLM中匹配用户需求的模型。通过引入信念感知的上置信界策略，该框架在用户指定的成本和时间预算下平衡探索与利用，实验表明能够以较低成本找到与用户偏好对齐的LLM。
Motivation: 用户面对海量LLM时难以选择，且往往无法清晰表达自己看重的模型特性，现有方法缺乏交互效率和成本控制。
Method: 提出交互高效的主动学习框架，采用决斗赌博机算法迭代选取LLM对，收集用户对回复的偏好反馈，并更新对用户潜在偏好的信念；引入信念感知上置信界策略，平衡探索模型池与利用已推断偏好。
Result: 在多种LLM实验和人类研究中，该方法能以较低成本高效匹配与用户需求对齐的LLM。
Conclusion: 该框架能够在用户缺乏明确偏好描述的情况下，通过少量交互实现个性化LLM选择，并适应成本和时间预算约束。

papers.title: MoEIoU: Rethinking Bounding-Box Regression as a Mixture of Experts
papers.abstract_en: Bounding-box regression is a fundamental component of object detection, playing a critical role in precise object localization. Existing Intersection-over-Union (IoU)-based loss functions extend the IoU objective by incorporating geometric penalties, such as center-distance and aspect-ratio mismatch, to improve bounding-box regression. However, these penalties typically remain fixed throughout training and do not account for the optimization dynamics in which predicted boxes initially exhibit large center-distance and shape errors, with later stages focusing on improving overlap with the ground truth. To address this limitation, we introduce MoEIoU, a mixture-of-experts based regression loss that jointly models overlap, center alignment, and aspect-ratio mismatch. MoEIoU aggregates these components using a log-sum-exp function, which emphasizes the dominant localization error while maintaining smooth contributions from other terms. Additionally, a curriculum-based weighting schedule is employed to prioritize correcting box position and shape in early training stages and improving overlap in later stages. We evaluated proposed MoEIoU on PASCAL VOC, HRIPCB, and MS COCO using multiple YOLO architectures, along with large-scale simulation experiments. It consistently outperforms standard and recent state-of-the-art losses, demonstrating faster convergence and improved localization accuracy. We further show that this adaptive aggregation improves existing IoU-based losses, yielding consistent gains and providing more effective optimization guidance for bounding-box regression in object detection frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoEIoU，一种基于混合专家（MoE）的边界框回归损失函数，通过 log-sum-exp 函数动态聚合重叠、中心对齐和长宽比失配项，并采用课程式权重调度在早期优先修正位置和形状、后期提升重叠度。在 PASCAL VOC、HRIPCB、MS COCO 等数据集上使用多种 YOLO 架构评估，MoEIoU 持续优于现有 IoU 损失，收敛更快、定位更准。
Motivation: 现有 IoU 损失函数中的几何惩罚项在训练过程中固定不变，未考虑优化初期预测框中心距离和形状误差大、后期侧重提升重叠度的动态变化，导致优化效率受限。
Method: 引入 MoEIoU 损失，利用 log-sum-exp 函数将重叠度、中心对齐度和长宽比匹配项聚合，使主导误差项被强调而其他项保持平滑贡献；同时设计课程式权重调度，训练早期加大位置和形状修正权重，后期加大重叠度权重。
Result: 在 PASCAL VOC、HRIPCB、MS COCO 数据集上，基于多种 YOLO 架构的实验表明 MoEIoU 持续优于标准及最新 IoU 损失，收敛速度更快，定位精度更高。
Conclusion: MoEIoU 的自适应聚合机制可有效改进现有 IoU 损失，为目标检测中边界框回归提供更高效的优化指导。

summary_sections.method: 引入 MoEIoU 损失，利用 log-sum-exp 函数将重叠度、中心对齐度和长宽比匹配项聚合，使主导误差项被强调而其他项保持平滑贡献；同时设计课程式权重调度，训练早期加大位置和形状修正权重，后期加大重叠度权重。
summary_sections.result: 在 PASCAL VOC、HRIPCB、MS COCO 数据集上，基于多种 YOLO 架构的实验表明 MoEIoU 持续优于标准及最新 IoU 损失，收敛速度更快，定位精度更高。
summary_sections.conclusion: MoEIoU 的自适应聚合机制可有效改进现有 IoU 损失，为目标检测中边界框回归提供更高效的优化指导。

papers.title: Certificate-Guided Evaluation of Reinforcement Learning Generalization
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a logic-driven framework to evaluate the performance of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms in their ability to generalize to unseen tasks. Our framework defines a family of inductive reach-avoid tasks, characterized by structural similarities in task dynamics, enabling evaluation of generalization capabilities. We introduce a neural certificate function that validates trajectories generated by RL algorithms by enforcing key conditions, thereby serving as a litmus test for RL generalization. We empirically demonstrate our method's capability in certifying generalization for several state-of-the-art generalizable RL algorithms on challenging continuous environments. Our results show that a lower percentage of certificate function violations correlates with a higher number of test tasks successfully solved, highlighting the effectiveness of our framework in evaluating and distinguishing generalization capabilities of RL algorithms. This work provides a principled approach for benchmarking RL generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于逻辑的框架，用于评估强化学习（RL）算法在泛化到未见任务上的能力。该框架定义了一类归纳性可达-避免任务，通过任务动态的结构相似性来评估泛化性能。作者引入了一个神经证书函数（neural certificate function），通过强制关键条件验证RL算法生成的轨迹，从而作为RL泛化的试金石。在具有挑战性的连续环境中，对几种最先进的可泛化RL算法的实证表明，证书函数违反率较低与成功解决的测试任务数量较高相关，突显了该框架在评估和区分RL算法泛化能力方面的有效性。本文为RL泛化的基准测试提供了一种原则性方法。
Motivation: 现有RL泛化评估缺乏统一标准，难以可靠地衡量算法对未见任务的适应性。需要一种形式化的、可验证的方法来区分不同RL算法的泛化能力。
Method: 提出一个逻辑驱动框架，定义归纳性可达-避免任务族，并引入神经证书函数，该函数通过验证轨迹满足关键条件来评估RL算法的泛化能力。
Result: 在连续环境中的实验表明，证书函数违反率越低，成功解决的测试任务越多，证明该框架能有效区分RL算法的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该工作为RL泛化提供了一种基于证书验证的原则性基准测试方法，但摘要未明确讨论框架在更复杂任务或大规模场景下的扩展性。

papers.title: Decoupled Behavioral Cloning for Scalable Inductive Generalization in RL from Specifications
papers.abstract_en: Inductive generalization is a framework for reinforcement learning (RL) generalization in which inductively related task instances admit inductively related policies. Prior work captures this structure via a higher-order policy-evolution function learned directly with RL, but suffers from poor training scalability: as training tasks grow, aggregated reward feedback becomes noisy and conflicting, destabilizing training and weakening generalization. We propose DIBS, a decoupled behavioral cloning approach that separates learning task-specific policies from learning the evolution function. We first learn individual teacher policies per task via standard RL, then fit the evolution function via behavioral cloning on teacher-labeled state-action pairs. This replaces noisy reward aggregation with dense, stable supervision. DIBS achieves significant improvements in both training stability and zero-shot generalization against existing RL and meta-RL algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习（RL）中归纳泛化（inductive generalization）的训练可扩展性问题，提出一种解耦的行为克隆方法DIBS。该方法先通过标准RL为每个任务独立学习教师策略，再通过行为克隆在教师标注的状态-动作对上拟合策略演化函数，用密集稳定的监督替代噪声奖励聚合。实验表明，DIBS在训练稳定性和零样本泛化上显著优于现有RL和元RL算法。
Motivation: 现有归纳泛化方法通过RL直接学习策略演化函数，但随着训练任务增多，聚合的奖励反馈变得嘈杂且冲突，导致训练不稳定和泛化能力下降。
Method: 提出DIBS：第一阶段为每个任务独立训练教师策略（标准RL）；第二阶段通过行为克隆（behavioral cloning）在教师提供的状态-动作对上学习演化函数，从而用密集稳定的监督信号替代原始的噪声奖励。
Result: DIBS在训练稳定性和零样本泛化方面显著优于现有的RL和元RL算法。
Conclusion: 解耦行为克隆可以有效解决归纳泛化中的训练可扩展性问题，通过分离任务策略学习和演化函数学习提升泛化性能。

papers.title: Coarse-to-Fine Compositional Diffusion for Long-Horizon Planning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide strong priors for generating structured data, but many tasks require outputs beyond the scale on which these models are typically trained. Compositional generation addresses this by composing overlapping local plans from a pretrained short-horizon prior into a long-horizon output. However, standard composition primarily enforces agreement between neighboring local plans, yielding local consistency without directly specifying the global structure of the full composition. As a result, locally compatible plans may still form an implausible route, task sequence, or temporal evolution. Existing methods improve global coherence by repeatedly propagating local consistency signals or by adding inference-time optimization, but these procedures become expensive as the number or dimensionality of local plans increases. We propose Coarse-to-Fine Compositional Diffusion (CoFi), an inference-time sampler that separates global structure formation from local detail refinement. CoFi first aligns local denoised estimates around a shared coarse structure, producing a global scaffold that captures the long-range task-level arrangement. It then diffuses this scaffold to an intermediate noise level and denoises it with the same pretrained local prior, restoring local fine structure while preserving the scaffold-induced global coherence. Across long-horizon robotic planning, panoramic image generation, and long video generation, CoFi not only improves both global coherence and local sample quality over prior compositional baselines, but also requires 2-8x fewer denoiser evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Coarse-to-Fine Compositional Diffusion (CoFi)，一种推理时采样方法，通过先对齐局部去噪估计形成全局粗结构，再扩散并重新去噪以恢复局部细节，从而在长程规划中实现全局一致性与局部质量。在长程机器人规划、全景图像生成和长视频生成任务上，CoFi相比先前组合基线提升了全局与局部质量，并将去噪器评估次数减少2-8倍。
Motivation: 标准组合扩散主要强制相邻局部计划一致，导致局部一致但全局结构不合理；现有改善全局连贯性的方法（如重复传播局部一致信号或推理时优化）随着局部计划数量或维度增加而变得昂贵。
Method: CoFi首先对齐局部去噪估计，使其围绕一个共享的粗结构，形成捕获长程任务级排列的全局骨架；然后将该骨架扩散到中间噪声水平，并用相同的预训练局部先验去噪，恢复局部细节的同时保留骨架带来的全局连贯性。
Result: 在长程机器人规划、全景图像生成和长视频生成基准上，CoFi在全局连贯性和局部样本质量上均优于先前组合基线，且所需去噪器评估次数减少2-8倍。
Conclusion: CoFi通过分离全局结构形成与局部细节精炼，实现了高效且高质量的复合扩散生成，适用于需要长程一致性的多种生成任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Packet Scheduling with Deadlines and Learning
papers.abstract_en: Network routers that enforce Quality-of-Service (QoS) guarantees must decide, at every clock cycle, which expiring packet of information to transmit, even when the value of the packet is unknown until it is processed. We frame this problem as the Online Packet Scheduling with Deadlines (OPSD) problem under Partial Feedback: packets arrive at every clock cycle, with different deadlines, but the weights are only observed after execution. Under a stochastic assumption on the unknown weights, we explore different variants of the OPSD problem with bandit feedback. We establish a connection between our setting and the sleeping bandits problem, and set our learning goal to $α$-regret minimization. We provide algorithms with provable $α$-regret guarantees under different spans of slackness, distinguishing systems allowing for randomization and systems that do not. In every scenario, our algorithms achieve an $α$-regret upper bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\sqrt{KT}\right)$, matching the lower bound for the standard bandit setting. In the practically relevant case of $2$-bounded deadline instances, where the deadline is set at most one clock cycle away from the arrival, our deterministic algorithm achieves the provably tightest possible competitive ratio. Remarkably, when the number of distinct packet types $K\ge 2$ is finite, it is possible to break the well-established $Φ= \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$ competitive ratio barrier and attain a tighter competitive ratio $θ_K$ ranging in $[\sqrt{2}, Φ)$.

papers.title: Hybrid Probabilistic Forecasting of Under-Five Malaria Admissions in Ghana: A Gaussian Process Regression with Holt-Winters Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: Accurate malaria forecasting remains a major challenge in sub-Saharan Africa, where strong seasonality, reporting uncertainty, and non-stationary transmission dynamics reduce the reliability of conventional models. In Ghana, district-level malaria surveillance requires forecasting frameworks that are probabilistically rigorous and robust under limited data. This study proposes a hybrid framework integrating Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) with Holt-Winters exponential smoothing for modelling monthly under-five malaria admissions. GPR captures non-linear behaviour and predictive uncertainty, while Holt-Winters stabilises long-horizon forecasts and preserves seasonal structure. Using ten years of district-level data (2014-2023), performance was evaluated via rolling-origin expanding-window validation. The hybrid model achieved $R^2 = 0.9906$ versus $0.8213$ for Holt-Winters alone, with $94.2\%$ of residuals within $\pm 2σ$ bounds. Forecasts for 2024-2028 project average monthly admissions from approximately 8{,}000 to 12{,}200 cases. Spatio-temporal analysis revealed pronounced ecological heterogeneity: northern high-burden districts exhibited stable relative patterns despite large absolute fluctuations. The framework provides a scalable probabilistic approach for malaria early warning and operational planning in endemic settings, supporting Ghana's national malaria control strategy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对加纳地区五岁以下儿童疟疾住院人数的精准预测问题，提出了一个混合概率预测框架，整合高斯过程回归（GPR）与Holt-Winters指数平滑法。GPR捕捉非线性行为和预测不确定性，Holt-Winters稳定长期预测并保持季节性结构。基于2014-2023年地区级数据，通过滚动原点扩展窗口验证，混合模型R²=0.9906，优于Holt-Winters单模型的0.8213，且94.2%残差落在±2σ范围内。
Motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区疟疾预测面临强季节性、报告不确定性及非平稳传播动态的挑战，使得传统模型可靠性降低。加纳地区级疟疾监测需要概率上严谨且在小数据量下鲁棒的预测框架。
Method: 提出混合框架，将高斯过程回归（GPR）与Holt-Winters指数平滑法结合。GPR处理非线性和不确定性，Holt-Winters维持季节性结构并稳定长期预测。采用滚动原点扩展窗口验证评估性能。
Result: 混合模型在测试集上R²达到0.9906，而单独Holt-Winters仅0.8213；94.2%的残差落在±2σ范围内。对2024-2028年的预测显示月平均住院人数约为8000至12200例。空间分析揭示北部高负担地区存在显著生态异质性。
Conclusion: 该框架为地方病环境下的疟疾早期预警和操作规划提供了可扩展的概率方法，支持加纳国家疟疾控制战略。摘要未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: Subliminal Learning is a LoRA Artifact
papers.abstract_en: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where language models can transmit behavioral traits to other models through seemingly innocuous data (Cloud et al., 2025). In subliminal learning, a teacher model with a behavioral trait (e.g. obsession with cats) can transmit this cat obsession to a student model finetuned only on numerical sequences generated by the teacher. In this paper, we ask: how does this unexpected behavioral transmission occur? We show that subliminal learning is a LoRA artifact. When subliminal learning occurs, transmission has an inverted U-shaped relationship with LoRA rank; it also disappears with full finetuning. We show that subliminal learning is highly dependent on the context seen during finetuning and evaluation. For example, a Qwen model with the default system prompt during finetuning ("You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.") does not show subliminal learning during generation when no system prompt is included. We further demonstrate that subliminal behavior is localized to computation at tokens seen during both finetuning and evaluation (e.g. the model's default system prompt, the standard chat template tokens, etc.). Overall, subliminal learning seems to be a fragile artifact of LoRA hyperparameters and finetuning context, making it an unstable channel for behavioral transmission.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文研究潜意识学习现象，即语言模型通过看似无关的数据（如教师模型生成的数字序列）将行为特征（如对猫的痴迷）传递给微调后的学生模型。作者发现该现象是LoRA微调的人工产物：行为传递与LoRA秩呈倒U形关系，且完全微调下消失；强烈依赖于微调和评估时的上下文（如默认系统提示）。总体而言，潜意识学习是LoRA超参数和微调上下文的脆弱产物，并非稳定的行为传递通道。
Motivation: 探究潜意识学习现象背后的机制——为何教师模型的行为能通过数字序列等无直接关联的数据传递给微调的学生模型。
Method: 通过实验系统分析潜意识学习与LoRA秩的关系、与完全微调的对比，以及微调和评估上下文（如系统提示）的影响。
Result: 发现潜意识学习是LoRA人工产物：传递与LoRA秩呈倒U形关系，完全微调下消失；行为传递高度依赖微调和评估中共有的上下文（如默认系统提示），且局限于这些标记的计算。
Conclusion: 潜意识学习是LoRA超参数和微调上下文共同作用的脆弱产物，不具备作为稳定行为传递渠道的可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Right Inference Strategy Is All You Need: Nearly Training-Free Domain-Wise Inference for EgoCross Challenge
papers.abstract_en: EgoCross evaluates multimodal large language models on egocentric video question answering under substantial domain shift, where test videos come from surgery, industrial assembly, extreme sports, and animal-mounted cameras rather than ordinary daily-life scenes. In the source-limited track, the base model is fixed to Qwen3-VL-4B, while the official task-specific support set contains only 20 training samples. This setting makes the challenge less about model scaling and more about exposing the right visual, temporal, and answer-selection cues to a constrained model. Our key observation is that the frozen baseline model is not simply incapable of these rare scenarios; rather, it often fails to transfer its existing visual-language knowledge to the new task format without an appropriate interface. We therefore use a domain-wise inference strategy that treats the four target domains separately and designs different input, prompting, and answer-mapping procedures according to each domain's task characteristics. These strategies make the rare egocentric scenes more interpretable to the VLM by emphasizing the cues that matter for each domain. The resulting system is nearly training-free: surgery, and animal questions are answered with the base Qwen3-VL-4B model, while XSports and industry use only the official SFT checkpoint trained for two epochs on the provided 20 training samples. On the final evaluation, this simple strategy reaches 66.98\% overall accuracy, suggesting that careful domain-aware inference can compensate for limited base-model strength and recover much of the ability already present in the baseline model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EgoCross挑战赛中的域迁移问题，提出一种几乎无需训练的域感知推理策略。通过将四个目标域分开处理，为每个域设计不同的输入、提示和答案映射流程，使冻结的Qwen3-VL-4B模型在手术、工业装配、极限运动和动物摄像头视频问答上达到66.98%的总体准确率。
Motivation: EgoCross挑战赛面临严重的域迁移问题，测试视频来自罕见场景，而基模型固定且仅提供20个训练样本。现有方法难以让冻结的小模型适应这些新领域。
Method: 采用域感知推理策略：将四个目标域分开，根据每个域的任务特征设计不同的输入格式、提示模板和答案映射方案，使视觉-语言模型更易理解罕见场景的关键线索。仅对XSports和工业域使用官方SFT检查点训练两个epoch，其余域直接使用基模型。
Result: 在最终评估中达到66.98%的总体准确率，表明域感知推理可以弥补基模型能力的不足并恢复其已有知识。
Conclusion: 本文强调，在数据极度稀缺的域迁移场景下，精心设计的推理策略比模型扩展更重要，可以几乎无训练地利用冻结模型的能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoboStressBench: Benchmarking VLM Robustness to Physical Visual Stress in Embodied Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual understanding and are increasingly deployed in embodied AI systems, where reliable perception under real conditions is essential. However, existing benchmarks assess VLMs using clean images or isolated perturbations rather than stresses caused by physical scene formation. This design has two limitations: it covers only a narrow subset of everyday visual stresses, and some perturbations rarely appear in realistic embodied scenes. This gap raises a fundamental question: how can we define visual stress in a principled way that captures the diverse factors encountered in physical environments? To address this question, we formulate visual perception from an inverse graphics perspective and introduce RoboStressBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLM robustness to physical visual stress in embodied scenes. Inspired by the physical rendering equation, RoboStressBench decomposes visual stress into four physically grounded dimensions: Material (M), Viewpoint (V), Lighting (L), and Geometry (G). This design enables RoboStressBench to cover a broad range of visual stresses in real-world environments, while allowing controlled analysis of their effects on VLM capabilities such as visual recognition, reasoning, and planning. Through comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art VLMs, we identify stress-specific failure modes and reveal that different physical factors degrade different embodied capabilities, which are often obscured by aggregate accuracy. We further introduce a stress-aware agentic solver that detects visual stressors and invokes visual-editing skills before reasoning, improving robustness in high-stress scenarios. Overall, RoboStressBench provides a principled evaluation framework for diagnosing and improving VLM perception under real-world physical stress, supporting the development of more reliable embodied AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RoboStressBench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型在具身场景中面对物理视觉压力（材料、视角、光照、几何）的鲁棒性的基准。通过分解物理渲染方程，该基准覆盖真实环境中的多种视觉压力，并发现不同物理因素会退化不同的具身能力。此外，作者引入了一种压力感知的智能体求解器，通过检测视觉压力并调用视觉编辑技能来提高鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有VLM基准使用干净图像或孤立扰动，未能捕捉真实场景中由物理形成过程引起的视觉压力，限制了评估的全面性和实际意义。
Method: 从逆图形学视角出发，基于物理渲染方程将视觉压力分解为材料、视角、光照、几何四个物理维度，构建包含这些压力因素的评估基准，并提出压力感知的智能体求解器。
Result: 对多个SOTA VLM的评估揭示了压力特定的失败模式，不同物理因素退化不同的具身能力，而总体准确率会掩盖这些差异。
Conclusion: RoboStressBench提供了一个原则性的评估框架，用于诊断和改善VLM在真实物理压力下的感知，支持更可靠的具身AI系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Independent Manipulation: Individual Fairness-aware Strategic Classification with Peer Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Strategic classification (SC) investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to obtain favorable decisions from predictive models. Existing fairness-aware SC approaches primarily focus on group fairness and typically assume that agents respond independently. However, when individual fairness is required, ensuring similar individuals receive similar outcomes, agents' manipulation becomes interdependent: an agent's preferred manipulation depends on the neighborhoods' outcomes. This induces a mismatch between classical SC formulations and fairness-aware decision settings, where independent models no longer accurately characterize strategic manipulations. To address this issue, we introduce individual fairness-aware strategic classification (IFSC), a framework that models peer-driven manipulation arising from individual fairness, where agents imitate nearby positively decided peers to obtain favorable outcomes. IFSC characterizes strategic manipulation as similarity-based imitation toward visible accepted peers and learns classifiers under the resulting post-manipulation distributions. To account for uncertainty in peer observability, IFSC employs a robust learning process that introduces stochastic perturbations during manipulation simulation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that IFSC improves individual-fairness consistency and mitigates imitation-induced distortions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出个体公平感知战略分类（IFSC）框架，解决现有公平感知战略分类中假设代理独立响应与个体公平所需的相互依赖之间的不匹配问题。IFSC建模代理基于个体公平性模仿邻近已获得正面决策的同伴的操纵行为，并学习后操纵分布下的分类器。通过引入随机扰动模拟同伴可观测性的不确定性，实现鲁棒学习。实验表明IFSC能提高个体公平一致性并减轻模仿导致的分布扭曲。
Motivation: 现有公平感知战略分类多关注群体公平且假设代理独立响应，但当个体公平要求相似个体获得相似结果时，代理的操纵行为会相互依赖，独立模型无法准确刻画这种同伴驱动的操纵，导致理论与实际的不匹配。
Method: 提出IFSC框架：将战略操纵建模为代理向邻近可见的已接受同伴的相似性模仿行为；学习后操纵分布下的分类器；通过引入随机扰动模拟同伴可观测性的不确定性，实现鲁棒学习过程。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，IFSC提升了个体公平一致性，并减轻了模仿导致的分布扭曲。
Conclusion: IFSC为个体公平与战略分类的结合提供了新视角，但文中未明确讨论其在大规模或动态环境下的适用性及计算开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Partial Fairness Awareness: Belief-Guided Strategic Mechanism for Strategic Agents
papers.abstract_en: Strategic machine learning investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to receive favorable decisions from predictive models. To address fairness concerns intrinsic to strategic classification, recent work has introduced group-specific fairness constraints. However, current fairness-aware approaches face a fundamental dilemma in the issue of fairness exposure: making these constraints public enables strategic manipulation and can lead to fairness reversal, while keeping them hidden may reduce social welfare and discourage genuine improvement. To fill this gap, we subsequently propose the problem of partial fairness awareness (PFA), as our theoretical analysis informs that such a dilemma can be mitigated by releasing the candidate set of fairness constraints and concealing the grounding constraint. To be specific, we introduce a belief-guided strategic mechanism, wherein agents iteratively interact with the decision system and maintain a belief distribution over the candidate set of fairness constraints. This belief-guided process enables agents, through iterative interaction and feedback, to update their belief distribution over the candidate set, thereby gradually aligning their belief with the grounding fairness constraint employed by the system. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that PFA achieves lower group fairness gaps, higher acceptance of truly qualified individuals, and more stable outcomes compared to fully public or private fairness regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对战略机器学习中的公平暴露困境，提出部分公平意识（PFA）问题，即释放候选公平约束集并隐藏真实约束。引入信念引导战略机制，代理通过迭代交互更新信念分布，逐渐对齐真实公平约束。实验表明PFA在公平差距、合格个体接受率和结果稳定性上优于完全公开或私有的公平机制。
Motivation: 当前公平感知方法面临公平暴露的根本困境：公开约束导致战略操纵和公平逆转，隐藏约束可能降低社会福利和阻碍真实改进。论文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出部分公平意识（PFA）问题，并引入信念引导战略机制，代理维护候选约束集上的信念分布，通过迭代交互和反馈更新信念，逐步对齐系统使用的真实公平约束。
Result: 在真实和合成数据集上的实验表明，PFA相比完全公开或私有的公平机制，实现了更低的群体公平差距、更高的合格个体接受率和更稳定的结果。
Conclusion: PFA通过部分暴露公平约束，能够缓解公平暴露困境，并带来更好的公平性和结果稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SuperMemory-VQA: An Egocentric Visual Question-Answering Benchmark for Long-Horizon Memory
papers.abstract_en: AI glasses present a compelling platform for AI agents to serve as personalized memory assistants. To be genuinely useful, such systems must move beyond short-term video comprehension and address memory gaps that humans experience for practical, personal, or social purposes over longitudinal egocentric video streams. However, existing egocentric datasets predominantly focus on action recognition or generic QAs from short clips, measuring perceptual capabilities rather than realistic human memory needs. We introduce SuperMemory-VQA, an egocentric visual question answering (VQA) dataset for evaluating AI assistants on practical, long-horizon memory tasks. It contains 52.9 hours of everyday activities recorded with AI glasses, including synchronized RGB video, audio transcription, eye gaze, IMU, and SLAM trajectories. Through a human-verified annotation pipeline, we construct grounded 4,853 question-answer pairs that span object and location memory, intent recall, visual scene recall, timeline reconstruction, conversational memory, and in-context retrieval. Each question is posed as multiple-choice with an explicit "unanswerable" option to test hallucination robustness. Benchmarking leading agentic frameworks and LLM backbones reveals that existing systems remain far from reliable on real-world memory tasks, highlighting the need for new architectures for grounded AI memory that can answer only when evidence is sufficient. A participant survey further supports that our questions are realistic, useful, and aligned with everyday memory needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SuperMemory-VQA，一个用于评估AI助手长期记忆能力的自我中心视觉问答基准数据集。该数据集包含52.9小时日常活动记录（RGB视频、音频转录、眼动、IMU、SLAM轨迹），并经过人工验证构建了4853个多选题问答对，覆盖对象、位置、意图、场景、时间线、对话和上下文检索等记忆类型，且包含显式“无法回答”选项以测试幻觉鲁棒性。对现有智能体框架和LLM的基准测试表明，现有系统在实际记忆任务上远不可靠，需发展基于证据的新架构。
Motivation: 现有自我中心数据集主要关注短片段动作识别或通用QA，缺乏对实际人类长期记忆需求的评估，而AI眼镜作为记忆助手需处理跨时间段的视频流记忆空白。
Method: 利用AI眼镜录制52.9小时日常活动，同步采集RGB视频、音频转录、眼动、IMU和SLAM数据，通过人工验证标注流程构建4853个多选题问答对，每个问题包含“无法回答”选项。
Result: 基准测试显示，当前主流智能体框架和LLM后端在长期记忆任务上表现远不可靠，尤其在幻觉鲁棒性方面存在明显不足。
Conclusion: 论文强调需开发新架构以实现基于充分证据的AI记忆系统，仅在证据足够时给出答案，参与者调查支持问题的真实性和实用性。

papers.title: SkillPager: Query-Adaptive Intra-Skill Navigation via Semantic Node Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Skill-based LLM agents increasingly rely on long procedural documents, but full-document prompting wastes tokens and dilutes information critical to execution. We study this setting as intra-skill retrieval, where the goal is to select a minimal, execution-sufficient context from a known skill document given a query. We present SkillPager, a two-stage framework that parses each Markdown skill into typed semantic nodes offline and leverages Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to perform global, query-conditioned node selection online. On a benchmark of 395 skills and 1,975 queries, SkillPager achieves 78.89% LLM-judged context sufficiency, compared to 82.23% for the exhaustive full-document baseline, while reducing prompt tokens by 47.04%. A granularity ablation shows that applying the same retrieval algorithm to raw fixed-length chunks reaches a comparable 81.77% sufficiency but increases token cost by 28.81%, demonstrating that efficiency gains are driven by typed semantic granularity rather than the retrieval algorithm alone. Among graph-based baselines, SkillPager outperforms the strongest baseline by a margin of 12.16%. Further ablations show that supporting content is most effective when retained in the candidate pool and selected adaptively rather than removed by static heuristics. These results identify typed intra-document retrieval as a distinct access problem for skill-based agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillPager 是一个两阶段框架，针对基于技能的 LLM 代理的长程序文档，通过离线解析 Markdown 技能为类型化语义节点，并在线使用最大边际相关性 (MMR) 进行查询条件的全局节点选择，以最小化上下文 token 的同时保持执行充分性。在 395 个技能和 1975 个查询的基准上，SkillPager 实现了 78.89% 的 LLM 判断上下文充分性，相比全文档基线降低了 47.04% 的提示 token 成本。
Motivation: 基于技能的 LLM 代理依赖长程序文档，但全文提示浪费 token 且稀释关键信息。现有方法缺乏针对技能文档的查询自适应节点级检索。
Method: 两阶段框架：离线阶段将 Markdown 技能文档解析为类型化语义节点（如标题、步骤、注释等）；在线阶段使用 MMR 进行全局、查询条件的节点选择。
Result: 在基准上，SkillPager 达到 78.89% 上下文充分性（全文档基线 82.23%），token 减少 47.04%；相同检索算法用于原始固定长度块时充分性 81.77% 但 token 成本增加 28.81%；优于最强图基线 12.16%。
Conclusion: 类型化节点粒度是效率提升的关键，而非检索算法本身；支持性内容应保留在候选池中并通过自适应选择而非静态启发式移除。

papers.title: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Multi-Task Prediction of the Parameters of the Pectin Hydrolysis--Extraction Process
papers.abstract_en: This study addresses the challenge of controlling a complex, multi-parameter technological process -- pectin hydrolysis--extraction -- using machine learning methods. The experimental foundation is a unique database comprising 1,000 laboratory experiments conducted under controlled conditions on seven types of plant raw material with four variable process factors (temperature 85--130 C, pressure 0.9--2.2 atm, holding time 3--10 min, pH 1.5--2.0). Four output characteristics were recorded: pectin yield, galacturonic acid content, molecular weight, and degree of esterification. To solve the multi-task regression problem, 11 algorithms were trained and compared: regularised linear models, ensemble methods (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, CatBoost, Extra Trees), k-nearest neighbours, support vector regression, and a multilayer perceptron. The best results were demonstrated by CatBoost (average R-squared approximately 0.946 after hyperparameter optimisation). Feature importance analysis revealed the dominant role of the raw material type (63.6% of total importance), followed by temperature and holding time. The developed pipeline was exported in a production-ready format and deployed as an interactive web interface. The findings demonstrate that ensemble methods combined with rigorous statistical analysis and interpretable AI significantly reduce the need for physical experiments and form the basis for intelligent pectin production control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对果胶水解提取过程的多参数预测问题，比较了11种机器学习算法。基于1000个实验室实验数据（含4个输入变量和4个输出指标），CatBoost表现最佳，平均R-squared约为0.946。特征重要性分析表明原料类型贡献63.6%的重要性，其次为温度和保持时间。研究展示了集成方法在复杂工业过程控制中的潜力。
Motivation: 控制复杂多参数技术过程（如果胶水解提取）存在挑战，传统方法依赖大量物理实验，效率低下。目标是利用机器学习减少实验需求并实现智能控制。
Method: 基于1000个样本的实验数据库，训练并比较11种算法，包括正则化线性模型、集成方法（随机森林、梯度提升、XGBoost、CatBoost、Extra Trees）、k近邻、支持向量回归和多层感知器。对CatBoost进行超参数优化，并将管道导出为生产就绪格式，部署为交互式Web界面。
Result: CatBoost取得最优平均R-squared约0.946。特征重要性分析显示原料类型占63.6%，其次是温度（9.6%）和保持时间（8.9%）。模型已部署为交互式Web界面。
Conclusion: 集成方法结合严格统计分析和可解释AI能显著减少物理实验需求，为智能果胶生产控制奠定基础。

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Language Models Via Decoder Layer Skipping
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse natural language tasks, yet their outputs often suffer from hallucinations -- content that is misaligned with factual information. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive layer-wise analysis of the decoding process and reveal that hallucinations tend to originate from deeper decoder layers. To address this issue, we introduce \textbf{DeLask} (\textbf{De}coder \textbf{La}yer \textbf{Sk}ipping), a novel decoding framework that dynamically skips layers prone to producing hallucinations. DeLask leverages the theoretical insight that the forward computation of an $L$-layer Transformer is conditionally equivalent to $L$ steps of gradient descent. We define a \emph{driftance value} by computing the cosine similarity between gradients derived from consecutive decoder steps, identifying problematic layers when the descent direction reverses. Rather than discarding such layers entirely, DeLask partially aggregates their hidden states with preceding layers, thereby preserving consistency while suppressing erroneous signals. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that DeLask consistently mitigates hallucinations and enhances overall reliability, providing a lightweight and generalizable decoding framework for improving the robustness of large-scale language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeLask（解码器层跳过）框架，通过分析发现大语言模型的幻觉倾向于从深层解码器层产生。DeLask利用梯度下降等价性定义driftance value，基于余弦相似度识别问题层，动态跳过这些层并部分聚合隐藏状态以保持一致性。实验表明该方法能持续缓解幻觉，增强模型可靠性。
Motivation: 大语言模型输出常出现与事实不符的幻觉，现有方法缺乏对解码层级的针对性分析，而本文通过层间分析揭示幻觉主要源自深层解码器层。
Method: 提出DeLask解码框架：利用Transformer前向计算等价于L步梯度下降的理论，定义driftance value（基于连续解码步骤梯度的余弦相似度），在梯度方向反转时识别易产生幻觉的层，随后动态跳过这些层并将其隐藏状态与前面层部分聚合。
Result: 在多种大语言模型和基准上，DeLask持续缓解幻觉并提升整体可靠性，为轻量级可泛化解码方案。
Conclusion: DeLask通过跳跃易幻觉解码层并聚合状态，有效抑制错误信号，提升大规模语言模型鲁棒性，且无需额外训练。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Directed Distance Fields for Constant-Time Ray Queries on Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders new views of a scene in real time. Like every rasterizer, it answers only primary rays, the rays from the camera through the image. It cannot trace the secondary rays that shadows, ambient occlusion, and global illumination need. We turn a trained 3DGS scene into a ray oracle by distilling a Directed Distance Function (DDF). The DDF is a small neural field. It takes a ray, given by an origin and a direction, and returns the distance to the first surface and whether the ray hits anything. Each query is one forward pass. The field is 52~MB, and its size does not depend on the number of Gaussians, so its cost and memory stay flat as the scene grows. We make three points. First, we study what supervision a DDF needs. Depth rendered from the Gaussians is too blurry to teach thin parts, while clean distance supervision recovers them. Second, we measure speed. The DDF is 26 to 72 times faster than sphere tracing an equivalent signed distance field, and unlike a bounding volume hierarchy built over the Gaussians, even on dedicated RT-core hardware, its query time and memory do not grow with the scene. Third, we show a pipeline that needs no mesh: images give a 3DGS scene, a neural surface gives clean distances, and the DDF learns from them. We use the DDF as a secondary-ray oracle for global illumination. It reproduces reference ray-traced shadows at 30.3~dB and ambient occlusion at 21.3~dB across 142 objects, and on real captured scenes. Our codes are available at https://github.com/smlab-niser/ddf-gs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景蒸馏为定向距离函数（DDF），实现次射线（阴影、环境光遮蔽、全局光照）的常数时间查询。DDF是一个小型神经场（52 MB），输入射线原点和方向，输出距离和命中标志，查询时间不随场景复杂度增长。实验表明，DDF比球体追踪快26-72倍，且无需网格，在142个对象上重建光线追踪阴影达30.3 dB、环境光遮蔽达21.3 dB。
Motivation: 3DGS作为光栅化器只能处理从相机的主动射线，无法追踪阴影、环境光遮蔽和全局光照所需的次射线，而现有加速结构（如BVH）的查询时间和内存随场景规模增长。
Method: 通过蒸馏训练一个小型神经场（DDF），利用从3DGS渲染的深度（模糊）和干净距离监督（用于薄结构），并结合无需网格的流水线（图像→3DGS→神经表面→DDF）。
Result: DDF查询比球体追踪快26-72倍，且内存和查询时间不随高斯数量增加；在142个对象上，重建光线追踪阴影PSNR 30.3 dB，环境光遮蔽PSNR 21.3 dB。
Conclusion: DDF可作为3DGS场景的次射线查询模块，实现高效的全局光照效果，且不依赖网格，性能不随场景复杂度退化。

papers.title: OmniEEG-Bench: A Standardized Evaluation Benchmark for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) supports a variety of brain-computer interface (BCI) tasks ranging from brain-state monitoring to human-LLM interactions. EEG foundation models are emerging, but evaluation remains fragmented due to heterogeneous datasets and nconsistent task protocols. Here, we introduce OmniEEG-Bench, a unified benchmark and downstream task roadmap for EEG foundation models (FMs). It organizes evaluation of EEG FMs into six task families spanning (i) signal reliability, (ii) biometrics and disease, (iii) consciousness and state, (iv) cognition and emotion, (v) naturalistic stimulus decoding, and (vi) motor and interaction, introducing a new generation of tasks not systematically benchmarked in prior EEG FM work. OmniEEG-Bench standardizes model deployment, task definitions, and metrics through a task-card specification, and unifies 54 EEG datasets with consistent evaluation protocols. We benchmark 10 representative EEG foundation models and report a leaderboard that covers diverse evaluation settings. Both pretraining dataset diversity and model size are significantly associated with better average ranks across datasets, revealing scaling-law behavior in EEG foundation models (Figure 1). These results suggest that scaling EEG foundation models requires not only larger architectures but also broader and more diverse pretraining data. The benchmark code is available at https://github.com/ncclab-sustech/omni-eegbench.git.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables; benchmark of EEG foundation models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniEEG-Bench，一个统一的脑电图（EEG）基础模型评估基准，覆盖六大任务家族（信号可靠性、生物特征与疾病、意识与状态、认知与情感、自然刺激解码、运动与交互），整合 54 个 EEG 数据集并标准化评估协议。对 10 个代表性 EEG 基础模型进行基准测试，发现预训练数据多样性和模型规模与平均排名显著相关，表明 EEG 基础模型存在缩放定律行为。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 基础模型评估因数据集异构和任务协议不一致而碎片化，缺乏统一基准来系统比较不同模型。
Method: 构建 OmniEEG-Bench，通过任务卡规范统一模型部署、任务定义和指标，整合 54 个数据集，并定义六大任务家族进行标准化评估。
Result: 对 10 个 EEG 基础模型进行基准测试，发现预训练数据多样性和模型规模均与更好的平均排名显著相关，揭示了 EEG 基础模型的缩放定律。
Conclusion: 缩放 EEG 基础模型不仅需要更大的架构，还需要更广泛、更多样的预训练数据。
