papers.title: An Attribute-Based Measure of Video Complexity
papers.abstract_en: A new framework for the estimation of the complexity posed by video-question pairs to video-LLMs, Video Attribute-Based Complexity (VideoABC), is proposed. Video complexity is defined as the probability of failure of a video-LLM for a given video-question pair. VideoABC is a non-parametric complexity measure, using a reference video dataset and a pre-defined vocabulary of video attributes informative of complexity, \eg the scene complexity or the speed of the video event informative of the question. In a training phase, reference videos are projected into the space of these attributes, which is then quantized. The expected ABC of each quantization cell is then computed. Given a new video and its projection into the attribute space, complexity is estimated by the expected ABC of the associated quantization cell. To enable the use of VideoABC with small reference video datasets, two quantizers are combined: a k-means quantizer that enables accurate complexity estimates for samples in the distribution of the reference dataset and a universal lattice quantizer that guarantees generalization to out-of-distribution samples. A synthetic video generation procedure, inspired by target-distractor manipulations of psychophysics studies, is proposed to populate the cells of the lattice quantizer during training, enabling the computation of their expected ABCs. Experimental results show that VideoABCis effective even with very low-dimensional attribute representations, substantially outperforming approaches like `video-LLM as judge' with much less complexity. Finally, the explainable nature of the VideoABC score, in terms of well-defined attributes, is shown to provide insights on how the attribute composition of benchmarks affects their complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoABC，一种基于属性的视频复杂度度量方法，用于估计视频-问题对给视频-LLM 带来的复杂度。该方法利用参考视频集和预定义的视频属性词汇，通过 k-means 和通用格点量化器进行量化，并合成视频数据以填充格点单元。实验表明，即使在低维属性表示下，VideoABC 也优于“视频-LLM 作为评判者”等方法，且具有可解释性。
Motivation: 现有视频复杂度度量方法缺乏对视频-LLM 失败的预测能力，且难以解释。需要一种非参数化的、基于属性的复杂度度量来评估视频-问题对的难度。
Method: 定义视频复杂度为视频-LLM 失败的概率。训练阶段将参考视频投影到属性空间并量化，计算每个量化单元的期望 ABC。对于新视频，根据其属性投影到对应单元得到复杂度估计。结合 k-means 和通用格点量化器以处理分布内和分布外样本，并利用合成视频生成过程填充格点单元。
Result: 实验表明 VideoABC 在低维属性表示下仍有效，显著优于“视频-LLM 作为评判者”等方法，且复杂度更低。属性可解释性可揭示基准测试的属性组成如何影响复杂度。
Conclusion: VideoABC 是一种有效的、可解释的视频复杂度度量，可用于视频-LLM 评估和基准设计。

papers.title: LP5X-PIM Sim: A High-Fidelity HW/SW Integrated Simulator for LPDDR5X-PIM
papers.abstract_en: This tech note describes the architecture and execution results of the LPDDR5X-PIM simulator, developed by Samsung Electronics. Based on the latest research and internal specifications, the simulator provides a high-fidelity model of both the hardware data paths and the software control layers of the LPDDR5X-PIM block. This integrated hardware-software simulation approach enables precise evaluation of system performance and energy efficiency while maximizing PIM resource utilization. We have refined existing simulation frameworks to align with actual hardware implementation, ensuring consistent behavioral accuracy. Further technical details regarding the specific architecture and circuit design of the LPDDR5X-PIM will be disclosed in future publications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了三星电子开发的LPDDR5X-PIM模拟器，该模拟器对LPDDR5X-PIM模块的硬件数据路径和软件控制层进行高保真建模，支持硬件-软件集成仿真以评估系统性能和能效，并最大化PIM资源利用率。
Motivation: 缺乏高保真的LPDDR5X-PIM模拟器来准确评估系统性能和能效，现有模拟框架与真实硬件实现存在偏差。
Method: 基于最新研究和内部规范，构建了集成硬件数据路径和软件控制层的LPDDR5X-PIM模拟器，并对现有仿真框架进行优化以对齐实际硬件实现。
Result: 模拟器能够精确评估系统性能和能效，最大化PIM资源利用率，且行为准确性得到验证。
Conclusion: 该模拟器为LPDDR5X-PIM架构的后续研究和设计提供了可靠评估工具，具体架构和电路设计细节将在未来工作中公开。

papers.title: How Neural Losses Shape VAE Latents
papers.abstract_en: Modern VAEs are rarely trained with the pointwise likelihood implied by the standard $β$-VAE objective. In practice, pointwise reconstruction is often combined with perceptual and adversarial losses, despite a lack of understanding of how this changes the latent dynamics of the model. We show that the choice of reconstruction loss reshapes the rate-distortion problem itself, altering both the information content and the geometry of the learned latent space in ways that may be invisible from reconstructions alone. First, we prove and verify empirically that augmenting pointwise reconstruction with neural terms, such as perceptual and adversarial objectives, reduces the amount of information stored in the latent representations. Second, we show that neural reconstruction losses systematically change the geometry of the latent space: they make representations more isotropic and distribute uncertainty more evenly across latent dimensions, producing different posterior variance profiles. These findings highlight how the rate-distortion tradeoff is not a comprehensive lens to understand the behavior of VAEs, and we propose a more mechanistic approach to investigate how the choice of a distortion metric reshapes the optimization problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经损失函数（如感知损失和对抗损失）如何改变VAE的潜在表示特性。证明并实验验证了添加神经损失会减少潜在表示中的信息量，并使得潜在空间更各向同性、不确定性分布更均匀。作者提出需要更机械的方法来理解失真度量对优化问题的影响。
Motivation: 现代VAE常使用感知损失和对抗损失，但缺乏这些损失对潜在动力学影响的系统理解。
Method: 通过理论证明和实验验证，分析不同重建损失（点对点、感知、对抗）下VAE潜在空间的信息内容和几何特性。
Result: 神经损失减少潜在表示的信息量，并使潜在空间更各向同性、后验方差更均匀。
Conclusion: 仅用率失真权衡不足以理解VAE行为，需要更机械的方法研究失真度量对优化问题的影响。

papers.title: French parsing enhanced with a word clustering method based on a syntactic lexicon
papers.abstract_en: This article evaluates the integration of data extracted from a French syntactic lexicon, the Lexicon-Grammar (Gross, 1994), into a probabilistic parser. We show that by applying clustering methods on verbs of the French Treebank (Abeillé et al., 2003), we obtain accurate performances on French with a parser based on a Probabilistic Context-Free Grammar (Petrov et al., 2006).
papers.journal_ref: Second Workshop on Statistical Parsing of Morphologically Rich Languages (SPMRL), 2011, Dublin, Ireland, pp.22-27
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了将法语语法词典（Lexicon-Grammar）数据集成到概率解析器中的效果。通过对法语树库中的动词应用聚类方法，基于概率上下文无关文法（PCFG）的解析器在法语上取得了准确的解析性能。
Motivation: 提升法语概率解析的准确性，利用句法词典中的丰富信息来改进基于PCFG解析器的性能。
Method: 采用聚类方法对法语树库中的动词进行处理，从法语语法词典中提取数据并集成到概率解析器中。
Result: 实验表明，所提出的词聚类方法结合PCFG解析器在法语解析任务上取得了准确的性能。
Conclusion: 句法词典的数据集成与词聚类方法能有效提升法语概率解析的效果。

papers.title: A Systematic Benchmark of Intraoperative Ultrasound-to-MR Synthesis for Brain Tumour Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Intraoperative ultrasound (ioUS) is a versatile, cost-effective modality in brain tumour surgery, but its interpretation is difficult: acquisition planes are non-standard, artefacts are modality-specific, and its appearance differs markedly from the preoperative MRI on which surgical-planning tools, segmentation models and the surgeon's experience rely. Synthesising MRI-like images from ioUS could let this MRI-based infrastructure be reused intraoperatively without an extra scan. Most prior work evaluates a single architecture in isolation; to our knowledge, no benchmark has spanned architectural paradigms, inference regimes and downstream-task endpoints under a common protocol. We address this gap on the public ReMIND data set (76 patients; 153 paired ioUS/T2w and 104 paired ioUS/FLAIR studies; 60/16 patient-level train/held-out split). Six generators (four GAN baselines: Pix2Pix, SwinPix2Pix, CycleGAN, CUT; the transformer-augmented ResViT; and the few-step diffusion model SynDiff) were each trained under four inference regimes (2D, 2.5D, 2D + 3D-refinement, full-3D) and two targets (T2w only; T2w + FLAIR multi-task), yielding 48 experiments. Image-fidelity metrics (SSIM, PSNR, MAE, LPIPS) were complemented by an nnU-Net v2 downstream segmentation evaluation (tumour and resection cavity) and by subgroup analyses by histological grade and reoperation. No architecture dominated every axis, and, critically, perceptual quality tracked downstream utility most closely (LPIPS, r=-0.66, p<0.001), whereas higher SSIM was associated with worse utility (r=-0.64, p<0.001); SynDiff-2.5D best preserved downstream segmentation (U_Dice=0.55). Perceptual and downstream-task metrics should therefore be reported alongside or in preference to global SSIM, and architecture choice conditioned on surgical phase, patient history and clinical objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脑肿瘤手术中术中超声（ioUS）难以解读的问题，系统比较了六种图像生成架构（GAN、扩散模型等）在不同推理设置和目标下的ioUS到MR合成效果，并在ReMIND数据集上进行评估。结果表明没有单一架构全面占优，感知质量（LPIPS）与下游分割性能高度相关，而SSIM反而与分割效果负相关。
Motivation: 术中超声虽经济实用，但图像解读困难，与术前MRI差异大，现有MRI基础设施无法复用。本文填补了缺乏统一协议下跨架构、推理方式和下游任务基准的空白。
Method: 在ReMIND数据集上，对六种生成器（Pix2Pix, SwinPix2Pix, CycleGAN, CUT, ResViT, SynDiff）在四种推理设置（2D, 2.5D, 2D+3D细化, 全3D）和两种目标（仅T2w, T2w+FLAIR多任务）下进行训练，共48个实验，用图像保真度指标和nnU-Net分割评估。
Result: 感知质量（LPIPS）与下游分割效用高度相关（r=-0.66, p<0.001），而SSIM与效用负相关（r=-0.64, p<0.001）。SynDiff-2.5D在下游分割上表现最佳（U_Dice=0.55）。
Conclusion: 报告感知和下游任务指标应与或优先于全局SSIM一起报告，架构选择应基于手术阶段、患者病史和临床目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quality Audio Prototyping: a prototype system for unified sound retrieval and procedural generation
papers.abstract_en: Sound design workflows frequently oscillate between time-consuming library searches and the complexity of procedural synthesis, with practitioners typically relying on disconnected tools to address each challenge separately. This paper introduces Quality Audio Prototyping (QuAP), a working prototype that unifies content-based audio retrieval and procedural sound generation within a single interface, reducing the procedural distance between a narrative concept and its sonic realisation. QuAP integrates a similarity-based retrieval engine with real-time procedural audio models, complemented by a rule-based assistant that provides perceptually informed parameter guidance, offering definitions and recommendations derived from empirical optimisation rather than requiring prior synthesis knowledge. Preliminary evaluation confirms the viability of this approach: subjective assessment demonstrated statistically significant quality improvements in five of six embedded synthesis models, and an encoder ablation study established the preferred retrieval architecture on a sound effect dataset. A user evaluation with 16 practitioners confirmed the tool's workflow utility, with all participants agreeing that the parameter assistant preserved creative agency while lowering the barrier to procedural interaction.

papers.title: MM-Snowball: Evaluating and Mitigating Hallucination Snowballing in Multimodal Multi-Turn Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) demonstrate remarkable visual understanding, yet their reliability in interactive settings is severely undermined by hallucination snowballing: a phenomenon where initial errors amplify across conversational turns, leading to a collapse in coherence. This failure reveals a fundamental vulnerability where models progressively neglect visual grounding in favor of over-relying on polluted textual history. Existing benchmarks are predominantly confined to single-turn VQA, which fail to capture the complex dynamics of error propagation in long-horizon interactions. To address this, we introduce MM-Snowball, the first benchmark for fine-grained diagnosis of hallucination snowballing within dialogues. Extensive evaluation shows that our benchmark poses a significant challenge even to advanced MLLMs and reveals the inefficacy of existing mitigation methods designed for single-turn VQA. To counteract this degradation, we propose Conflict-Aware Visual Rectification (CAVR). This training-free method mitigates snowballing through a synergistic dual-mechanism that refreshes visual grounding at the representation level and rectifies output distributions at the logit level, effectively re-anchoring the model to visual facts. Experiments demonstrate that CAVR achieves state-of-the-art performance, offering a promising path toward more reliable interactive AI. Data and code are available at: https://frenkie-chiang.github.io/MM-Snowball
papers.comment: Accepted by The International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MM-Snowball，首个针对多模态多轮对话中幻觉雪球现象的细粒度诊断基准。实验表明现有方法在该基准上效果不佳，为此提出了无需训练的冲突感知视觉修正（CAVR）方法，通过表示级刷新视觉锚定和logit级修正输出分布来缓解幻觉雪球，取得当前最佳性能。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在交互场景中因初始错误在多轮对话中累积放大，导致视觉锚定失效，而现有基准仅关注单轮VQA，无法捕捉长期交互中的错误传播动态。
Method: 提出Conflict-Aware Visual Rectification (CAVR)，一种无需训练的双机制方法：在表示层刷新视觉锚定，在logit层矫正输出分布，使模型重新聚焦于视觉事实。
Result: 在MM-Snowball基准上，CAVR显著优于现有单轮VQA缓解方法，达到当前最佳性能。
Conclusion: CAVR通过无需训练的双机制有效缓解多模态多轮对话中的幻觉雪球，为构建更可靠的交互式AI提供了可行路线。

papers.title: Authenticity Debt and the Synthetic Content Threat Landscape: A Layered Framework for Trust, Provenance, and IP Governance in the Generative AI Era
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence has fundamentally changed how content is now produced. It has enabled how high-fidelity text, images, audio, and videos are created, modified, and redistributed at near-zero marginal cost. This shift exposes enterprises and ecosystems to a number of risks across four reinforcing authenticity layers -- authenticity, provenance, integrity, and accountability -- that traditional controls are inadequate to address in isolation. We introduce the concept of authenticity debt: the cumulative institutional liability that accumulates when organizations deploy AI-generated content without preserving verifiable origin, integrity, and accountability, deferring exposure that surfaces under regulatory, legal, or market scrutiny. This paper presents a comprehensive, multi-dimensional taxonomy of generative AI harms and attack vectors, surveys the capabilities and failure modes of technical controls including digital watermarking, provenance frameworks (C2PA, Adobe CAI), and detection technologies, and argues that no single mechanism is sufficient in open, adversarial, and evolving environments. Drawing on Zero Trust Architecture principles and enterprise governance frameworks, we propose a layered reference architecture that integrates cryptographic provenance, human-in-the-loop verification, and continuous governance to sustain defensible authenticity at scale. We further examine the regulatory landscape (EU AI Act, U.S.\ FTC, NIST AI RMF) and identify practical guiding principles for organizations seeking to build authenticity as institutional infrastructure rather than an afterthought.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“真实性债务”（authenticity debt）概念，系统梳理生成式AI内容在真实性、溯源、完整性、问责四个层面的风险，指出现有控制手段无法单独应对。作者基于零信任架构（Zero Trust Architecture）原则，提出一个分层参考架构，整合加密溯源、人机协同验证和持续治理，并讨论了EU AI Act等监管框架对组织构建真实性基础设施的指导意义。
Motivation: 生成式AI使得高保真内容以近零边际成本生成和传播，传统控制手段难以覆盖真实性、溯源、完整性和问责四个层面的叠加风险。
Method: 提出分层参考架构，融合加密溯源框架（C2PA、Adobe CAI）、数字水印、检测技术、人类在环验证和持续治理，并借鉴零信任架构原则；同时梳理了技术控制的失败模式。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验数值，但通过多维分类体系论证了单一机制在开放对抗环境中的不足，并给出了“真实性债务”这一概念性框架。
Conclusion: 组织应将真实性作为制度基础设施而非事后补救，遵循EU AI Act、FTC、NIST AI RMF等监管框架的指导原则。

papers.title: FlowNar: Scalable Streaming Narration for Long-Form Videos
papers.abstract_en: Recent Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), primarily designed for offline settings, are ill-suited for the dynamic requirements of streaming video. While recent online adaptations improve real-time processing, they still face critical scalability challenges, with resource demands typically growing at least linearly with video duration. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose FlowNar, a novel framework for scalable streaming video narration. The core of FlowNar is a dynamic context management strategy for historical visual context removal, combined with our CLAM (Cross Linear Attentive Memory) module for streaming visual history retention, ensuring bounded visual memory usage and computational complexity, crucial for efficient streaming. We also introduce a realistic self-conditioned evaluation protocol and complementary evaluation metrics to assess streaming narration models under deployment-like conditions. Experiments on the Ego4D, EgoExo4D, and EpicKitchens100 datasets demonstrate that FlowNar substantially improves narration quality over strong baselines while being highly efficient, supporting processing of 10$\times$ longer videos and achieving 3$\times$ higher throughput (FPS). The code is available at https://github.com/zeyun-zhong/FlowNar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowNar，一种用于长视频流式叙述的可扩展框架。核心是动态上下文管理策略与 CLAM（Cross Linear Attentive Memory）模块，在保持有界视觉内存和计算复杂度的同时高效处理视频流。实验在 Ego4D、EgoExo4D 和 EpicKitchens100 数据集上显示，FlowNar 在叙述质量上优于强基线，支持处理 10 倍更长视频，吞吐量提升 3 倍。
Motivation: 现有大型多模态模型（LMM）主要为离线场景设计，不适用于流式视频，而在线适应方法在长视频中资源需求随时长线性增长，缺乏可扩展性。
Method: 提出 FlowNar 框架，包括动态上下文管理策略（选择性移除历史视觉上下文）和 CLAM 模块（线性注意记忆），以维持有界视觉内存和恒定计算复杂度，实现高效流式叙述。
Result: 在 Ego4D、EgoExo4D 和 EpicKitchens100 数据集上，FlowNar 显著提升叙述质量，支持处理 10 倍更长视频，吞吐量（FPS）提升 3 倍。
Conclusion: FlowNar 通过动态上下文管理和记忆模块实现了可扩展的流式视频叙述，在效率和质量上均优于现有方法，适用于部署场景。

papers.title: MemPro: Agentic Memory Systems as Evolvable Programs
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon autonomous agents require memory systems to retain historical information, track evolving states, and reuse relevant knowledge beyond finite context windows. Existing agentic memory systems typically follow a memory construction-retrieval (MCR) pipeline, but often adapt mainly the memory bank while keeping the surrounding pipeline fixed after deployment. This fixed-pipeline design struggles to handle heterogeneous task-specific failure modes and can become misaligned with memory banks that evolve in scale and structure over time. To address these limitations, we propose MemPro, a system-level evolution framework that treats the entire MCR pipeline as an evolvable program rather than adapting only the memory bank or prompt text. MemPro maintains a version tree of runnable memory-system implementations, where an Evolving Agent iteratively selects promising versions, diagnoses recurring failures, and creates improved child versions through failure-mode-guided edit-debug refinement. Experiments on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, HotpotQA, and NarrativeQA show that MemPro consistently outperforms strong static and prompt-level evolving baselines within a few iterations, continues to improve with evolution, and achieves a favorable performance-cost trade-off. Code is available at https://github.com/wanghai673/MemPro.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemPro，一个将整个记忆构建-检索（MCR）流水线视为可进化程序的系统级进化框架。通过版本树管理，进化智能体迭代选择版本、诊断故障并生成改进的子版本。实验表明该方法在多个基准上优于静态和提示级进化基线，性能成本权衡良好。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统通常采用固定流水线设计，仅适应记忆库而忽略其他组件，难以处理异构任务失败模式，且与不断演化的记忆库不匹配。
Method: MemPro将MCR流水线作为可进化程序，维护可运行记忆系统实现的版本树，进化智能体通过故障模式引导的编辑调试反复创建改进子版本。
Result: 在LongMemEval、LoCoMo、HotpotQA、NarrativeQA等基准上，MemPro在几次迭代内持续优于强基线，性能随进化提升，实现良好的性能-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为将记忆系统视为可进化程序可以有效解决固定流水线设计的局限性。

papers.title: Efficient Test-time Inference for Generative Planning Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for AI planning, yet their performance remains constrained by the training data distribution. One approach is to improve generated solutions during inference by scaling test-time compute. A more efficient alternative is to optimize the inference process itself. In this paper, we show that a modified version of a classical Open-Closed List (OCL) search provides just such an efficient inference procedure. Our algorithm synergizes two learned components: a generative model that performs fast rollouts from intermediate states and a heuristic model that prioritizes among candidate reasoning paths. Key contributions include novel exploration control mechanisms and integration of learned models within the OCL framework. Across multiple combinatorial planning domains, our approach outperforms both neurosymbolic search baselines and classical solvers in computational efficiency and solution quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的 Open-Closed List (OCL) 搜索算法，用于生成式规划模型的高效测试时推理。该方法结合生成模型和启发式模型，通过探索控制机制和模型集成，在多个组合规划域上优于神经符号搜索基线和经典求解器。
Motivation: 生成式规划模型受训练数据分布限制，现有方法通过扩展测试时计算来改进解，但效率较低。本文旨在优化推理过程本身，提高计算效率和解决方案质量。
Method: 提出改进的 Open-Closed List (OCL) 搜索算法，集成两个学习组件：一个用于从中间状态快速展开的生成模型，以及一个用于优先排序候选推理路径的启发式模型，并引入新颖的探索控制机制。
Result: 在多个组合规划域上，该方法在计算效率和解决方案质量上均优于神经符号搜索基线和经典求解器。
Conclusion: 改进的 OCL 搜索结合生成模型和启发式模型，可高效提升生成式规划模型的测试时推理性能。

papers.title: Pause and Think: A Dataset and Benchmark for Video-Grounded Assistive Action Suggestion
papers.abstract_en: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with grounded reasoning, temporal consistency, and context aware planning in videos. We introduce pause-and-think-T, a reasoning-centric training dataset that encourages models to pause, reason over visual evidence, and produce concise, actionable responses. The dataset promotes structured reasoning prior to answer generation, guiding models toward human-like, scene-grounded assistance. We fine-tune a compact 4B-parameter model and evaluate it on our pause-and-think-B benchmark targeting contextual understanding and goal planning tasks. The model achieves 58.0% accuracy at 59x fewer parameters than Qwen3-VL-235B (58.9%), matching GPT-5.2 on scene understanding and surpassing GPT-4o. Beyond our benchmark, it also shows strong out-of-distribution performance on EgoThink and TempCompass, with substantial gains in affordance, assistance, attribution recognition, situated reasoning, and temporal order, without benchmark-specific training. Our results indicate that targeted reasoning supervision enables compact models to deliver actionable, visually grounded guidance while generalizing beyond training data, without requiring large-scale model expansion.

papers.title: Linguistics-Aware Non-Distortionary LLM Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking should identify language-model output without degrading quality or limiting verification to the model provider. Multilingual deployment makes this harder because morphology, segmentation, and script change where watermark evidence can enter naturally. We introduce LUNA, a linguistically adaptive watermark that combines model-free detection with single-token non-distortion under the standard random-key model. LUNA estimates normalized next-tag entropy from part-of-speech contexts in an external corpus and uses it to set the depth of a non-distortionary binary tournament sampler; the detector reconstructs the same schedule from text, a tokenizer, a tagger, and a secret key. We evaluate six typologically diverse languages and two domains against eight primary baselines. LUNA attains an AUROC of 0.9959 and the lowest mean absolute median perplexity shift of 0.045 across the twelve settings; its 95% bootstrap interval [0.022, 0.073] lies below all baseline intervals. LUNA also records the lowest mean Self-BLEU, Distinct-1, surprisal, and entropy shifts. It is the only method that simultaneously achieves AUROC > 0.99 and an absolute median perplexity shift below 0.1 in a majority of settings, reaching this regime in 9 of the 12 settings while no baseline reaches it in more than 2. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Shinwoo-Park/luna_watermark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LUNA是一种语言学自适应水印方法，结合无模型检测与单令牌非失真特性，通过外部语料库估计词性上下文的归一化熵，设置非失真二元锦标赛采样器的深度。在六种类型多样的语言和两个领域的实验中，LUNA在12个设置中达到平均AUROC 0.9959和最低的平均绝对中位数困惑度偏移0.045，是唯一在多数设置中同时实现AUROC>0.99和困惑度偏移<0.1的方法。
Motivation: 多语言部署中，水印容易因形态、分词和文字差异而降低输出质量或限制检测范围，现有方法难以兼顾语言适应性和非失真性。
Method: 提出LUNA，通过外部语料库计算词性上下文的归一化熵，动态调整非失真二元锦标赛采样器的深度；检测器利用文本、分词器、词性标注器和密钥重建相同调度，支持模型无关检测。
Result: 在12个设置中，LUNA平均AUROC为0.9959，平均绝对中位数困惑度偏移为0.045，95%自助法区间[0.022,0.073]低于所有基线；在9个设置中达到AUROC>0.99且困惑度偏移<0.1，而基线最多仅2个设置达到该标准。
Conclusion: LUNA是唯一在多数语言和领域设置中同时实现高检测精度和低生成质量影响的水印方法，代码已开源。

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents produce safety evidence across long trajectories, where sparse, delayed, and compositional risk signals often escape local moderation. Existing turn-level or short-context detectors struggle to reliably retain and aggregate such evidence over extended horizons. We reframe long-horizon agent safety detection as trajectory-level evidence compression and propose Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety (TRACE). TRACE uses a Compressor-Reader design: the Compressor encodes the full trajectory into a compact latent evidence state under trajectory-level supervision, and the Reader judges the raw trajectory with this latent evidence state as a safety reference. This design helps aggregate dispersed risk cues and reduce premature evidence loss. Across ASSEBench, Pre-Ex-Bench, and R-Judge, TRACE achieves the best accuracy on all evaluated backbones, improving over strong baselines by up to 12.6 percentage points. On LongSafety, TRACE shows smaller performance degradation as context length grows. Attention visualizations and case studies suggest that the compressed reference helps the Reader focus on risk-critical segments and recover cross-step evidence. Code is available at https://github.com/Peregrine123/TRACE_official.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长程LLM智能体安全检测中稀疏、延迟和组合风险信号难以被局部调节捕获的问题，提出TRACE方法，将安全检测重构为轨迹级证据压缩。TRACE采用Compressor-Reader结构：Compressor将完整轨迹压缩为紧凑的潜在证据状态，Reader以此状态作为安全参考对原始轨迹进行判断。在ASSEBench、Pre-Ex-Bench和R-Judge基准上，TRACE在所有评估骨干网络上达到最佳准确率，较强基线提升最多12.6个百分点；在LongSafety上，随上下文长度增长性能退化更小。注意可视化与案例研究表明，压缩参考有助于Reader关注风险关键片段并恢复跨步证据。
Motivation: 现有基于逐轮或短上下文的检测器难以可靠地保留和聚合长程轨迹中的安全证据，导致稀疏、延迟和组合风险信号易被遗漏。
Method: 提出轨迹风险感知压缩（TRACE），采用Compressor-Reader设计：Compressor在轨迹级监督下将完整轨迹编码为紧凑的潜在证据状态，Reader基于该状态作为安全参考判断原始轨迹。
Result: 在ASSEBench、Pre-Ex-Bench和R-Judge基准上，TRACE在所有评估骨干网络上取得最佳准确率，较强基线提升最多12.6个百分点；在LongSafety上随上下文长度增长性能退化更小。
Conclusion: 压缩参考有助于读者聚焦风险关键片段并恢复跨步证据，表明轨迹级证据压缩可有效提升长程智能体安全检测性能。

papers.title: MemGraphRAG: Memory-based Multi-Agent System for Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become an essential method for mitigating hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) by leveraging external knowledge. Although effective for simple queries, traditional RAG struggles with large-scale, unstructured corpora where information is highly fragmented. Graph-based RAG (GraphRAG) incorporates knowledge graphs to capture structural relationships, enabling more comprehensive retrieval for complex reasoning. However, existing GraphRAG methods rely on isolated, fragment-level extraction for graph construction, lacking a global perspective on the whole corpus. As a result, these methods frequently lead to thematically inconsistent, logically conflicting, and structurally fragmented graphs that degrade retrieval performance. In this paper, we propose MemGraphRAG, a novel framework that introduces a memory-based multi-agent system to ensure high-quality graph construction. Specifically, MemGraphRAG employs a collaborative society of agents supported by shared memory, which provides a unified global context throughout the extraction process. This mechanism allows agents to dynamically resolve logical conflicts and maintain structural connectivity throughout the corpus. Furthermore, we propose a memory-aware hierarchical retrieval algorithm tailored for the constructed graph. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that MemGraphRAG outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline models with comparable efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/MemGraphRAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 MemGraphRAG，一种基于记忆的多智能体系统用于图检索增强生成，解决现有 GraphRAG 方法全局视角缺失导致图结构碎片化的问题。通过共享记忆的多智能体协作构建高质量知识图谱，并设计记忆感知的分层检索算法。实验表明优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有 GraphRAG 方法依赖孤立片段提取构建图，缺乏全局视角，导致图主题不一致、逻辑冲突、结构碎片，影响检索性能。
Method: 提出 MemGraphRAG 框架，核心是记忆型多智能体系统，通过共享记忆提供统一全局上下文，让智能体在提取过程中动态解决逻辑冲突并保持结构连通性；还提出记忆感知的分层检索算法。
Result: 在多个基准上超越最先进基线，且效率相当。
Conclusion: 论文强调记忆机制能提升图构建质量，从而改善复杂推理检索性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CARE-RL: Capability-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Mitigating Cross-Domain Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has achieved strong progress in reasoning-oriented LLMs, but extending it to multi-domain RL remains challenging due to reward unreliability in non-verifiable tasks and capability interference across domains. We propose CARE-RL to combine protocol-aware reward generation with capability-aware optimization for mitigating cross-domain conflicts. For non-verifiable tasks, the Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model (PA-GRM) constructs prompt-level evaluation protocols and schemas before producing trace-conditioned rewards, enabling task-adaptive yet comparable evaluation of open-ended responses. For multi-domain optimization, Direction-Aware Capability Subspace Projection (DACSP) extracts historical capability directions from previous RL stages and modulates later updates by amplifying aligned components, suppressing conflicting components, and preserving orthogonal updates. Experiments across math, chat, and instruction-following benchmarks show that CARE-RL consistently outperforms standard multi-domain RL baselines, achieving Total Avg scores of 47.9 and 50.7 on Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-4B, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CARE-RL框架，结合协议感知奖励生成和能力感知优化，用于缓解多领域强化学习中跨领域冲突。对于不可验证任务，协议感知生成奖励模型(PA-GRM)在生成奖励前构建提示级评估协议，实现自适应且可比的评估。方向感知能力子空间投影(DACSP)从历史RL阶段提取能力方向，通过放大一致成分、抑制冲突成分并保留正交更新来调制后续更新。在数学、聊天和指令遵循基准上，CARE-RL在Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen3-4B上分别取得47.9和50.7的总平均分。
Motivation: 多领域RL中可验证奖励的不可靠性以及不同领域能力之间的相互干扰导致优化困难，现有方法缺乏对跨领域冲突的系统性处理。
Method: 提出CARE-RL框架，包含两个核心组件：PA-GRM（协议感知生成奖励模型）和DACSP（方向感知能力子空间投影），分别用于不可验证任务的奖励生成和多阶段更新的方向调制。
Result: 在数学、聊天和指令遵循基准上，CARE-RL一致优于标准多领域RL基线，Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen3-4B的总平均分分别达到47.9和50.7。
Conclusion: 协议感知奖励与能力方向投影的结合能有效缓解多领域RL中的跨领域冲突，为训练通用推理模型提供了可行思路。

papers.title: FiSeR: Fine-Grained Source Representations for Cross-Domain AI Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Real-world synthetic image detectors often generalize poorly under domain shift despite strong in-domain performance. Using unsupervised UMAP projections, we find that natural and synthetic features remain partially separable on unseen datasets, yet performance still drops, suggesting that the classification head overfits to training-domain artifacts. Therefore, the key is to learn more transferable representations so that the decision criterion is more stable and robust to domain shifts. Based on the structural fact that synthetic images are produced by diverse generators, we propose a hierarchical contrastive learning framework that improves the separability between natural and synthetic images while preserving generator identity information. It jointly optimizes (i) a coarse contrastive objective between natural and synthetic images and (ii) a fine contrastive objective among synthetic images using generator identities. Trained on WildFake, our method achieves an average AUROC gain of +10.22 on cross-domain evaluation over Chameleon, AIGIBench, Community Forensics, and GenImage under the same settings as the strong baseline DIRE. For few-shot adaptation, we freeze the backbone and fit an SVM head on 10 labeled samples per class, improving AUROC by +10.64 on AIGIBench and +17.41 on Chameleon, averaged over 12 widely used detectors. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/heyongxin233/FiSeR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FiSeR，一种层次化对比学习框架，用于跨域AI图像检测，通过在粗细粒度上区分自然和合成图像，提高分类头的域泛化能力。在WildFake上训练，在多个跨域基准上平均AUROC提升+10.22，在少样本自适应上也取得显著提升。
Motivation: 真实场景的合成图像检测器在域迁移下泛化差，因为分类头过度拟合训练域伪影。需要学习更可迁移的特征表示。
Method: 基于合成图像由不同生成器生成的结构事实，提出层次化对比学习框架：同时优化自然与合成图像的粗粒度对比目标和利用生成器标识的合成图像间细粒度对比目标。
Result: 在WildFake上训练，在Chameleon、AIGIBench、Community Forensics、GenImage等跨域评估上平均AUROC较DIRE基线提升+10.22；少样本自适应中，冻结骨干，用每类10个标注样本拟合SVM头，在AIGIBench和Chameleon上分别提升+10.64和+17.41 AUROC（平均12个常用检测器）。
Conclusion: 学习可迁移的表示能稳定决策准则，对域迁移更鲁棒；层次对比学习有效保留生成器身份信息并提高自然/合成图像的可分离性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出FiSeR，一种层次化对比学习框架，用于跨域AI图像检测，通过在粗细粒度上区分自然和合成图像，提高分类头的域泛化能力。在WildFake上训练，在多个跨域基准上平均AUROC提升+10.22，在少样本自适应上也取得显著提升。

papers.title: Looped Transformers with Layer Normalization Provably Learn the Power Method
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of applications, and a growing body of work suggests that part of their strength comes from their ability to learn and execute algorithmic procedures. However, our understanding of how transformers learn such algorithms remains limited, especially in the presence of layer normalization (LN). In this work, we study principal component prediction as a concrete testbed for understanding the training dynamics of transformers with LN. We prove that a looped linear transformer with LN, trained by gradient descent, converges to a solution that implements the power method, with each self-attention layer performing one power iteration. Notably, the model is trained only for principal component prediction, rather than being explicitly supervised to implement the power method. Our finding thus reveals an "algorithmic implicit bias" of looped transformers with LN: principal-component prediction can in principle be achieved by many mechanisms, yet gradient descent selects one that realizes the power method. We further provide a concrete comparison between transformers with and without LN: even with layerwise guidance from power iterations, a transformer without LN cannot exactly learn the power method, whereas the corresponding transformer with LN can, leading to a provable performance gap in principal component prediction. Our results provide, to our knowledge, the first theoretical analysis of the training dynamics of looped and single-layer transformers with LN, and shed light on the role of LN in transformer models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明，带有层归一化（LN）的循环线性Transformer在通过梯度下降训练主成分预测任务时，会收敛到实现幂方法的解，即每层自注意力执行一次幂迭代。该发现揭示了循环Transformer的“算法隐式偏差”：尽管主成分预测可以通过多种机制实现，但梯度下降选择了幂方法。进一步，与无LN的Transformer对比表明，即使有逐层引导，无LN的Transformer也无法精确学习幂方法，而带LN的可以，这导致了主成分预测上的可证明性能差距。
Motivation: 尽管Transformer在许多任务中表现出色，但其学习算法过程的能力，特别是在层归一化（LN）存在下的训练动力学，尚未被充分理解。本文旨在通过主成分预测这一具体测试平台，分析带LN的Transformer的训练动力学。
Method: 研究带LN的循环线性Transformer，通过梯度下降训练主成分预测任务，从理论上分析其收敛行为，证明其学习到实现幂方法的解，并通过与无LN的Transformer对比，揭示LN的作用。
Result: 证明了带LN的循环Transformer在训练主成分预测时，梯度下降会使其收敛到实现幂方法的解，即每层自注意力执行一次幂迭代。同时，即使有逐层幂迭代引导，无LN的Transformer也无法精确学习幂方法，导致性能差距。
Conclusion: 本文提供了首个关于循环和单层Transformer带LN的训练动力学的理论分析，揭示了LN在促使模型学习算法（幂方法）中的关键作用，并展示了LN带来的可证明性能优势。

papers.title: ASAP: Advancing Medical Volumetric Representation Learning with Anatomy-aware Semantically-adaptive Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: Learning transferable and interpretable representations from medical volumetric scans remains challenging due to complex anatomical structures and weak, heterogeneous supervision provided by radiology reports. In this paper, we propose Anatomy-aware Semantically-Adaptive Pre-training (ASAP), a principled vision-language pre-training framework for fine-grained medical volumetric representation learning from large-scale chest CT scans and their corresponding radiology reports. ASAP integrates three key components: (1) an anatomy-aware knowledge injection module that incorporates organ-level structural priors via off-the-shelf segmentation tool to encourage anatomically coherent representations; (2) a semantically-adaptive selective alignment mechanism that dynamically associates sentence-level findings with localized volumetric regions; and (3) a semantically-adaptive fusion module for effective interaction between anatomically informed visual features and grounded textual cues under dual-modal masked modeling paradigm. Beyond methodological contributions, we establish a comprehensive benchmark for medical volumetric vision-language pre-training on chest CT, covering 15 datasets and 22 downstream tasks spanning abnormality classification, segmentation, disease prognosis prediction, report generation, vocabulary classification, cross-modal retrieval and visual question answering. This benchmark provides standardized evaluation protocols to systematically assess representation quality under diverse clinical settings and data regimes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ASAP consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across tasks and datasets, with particularly pronounced gains under limited supervision and distribution shift, validating its effectiveness in learning transferable and clinically meaningful volumetric representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASAP，一种面向医学体积扫描的解剖感知语义自适应预训练框架，利用大规模胸部 CT 和放射学报告进行细粒度表示学习。框架包含解剖知识注入、语义自适应选择性对齐和语义自适应融合三个模块，并在 15 个数据集和 22 个下游任务上建立基准，展示出对有限监督和分布偏移的鲁棒性，取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 医学体积扫描的表示学习因复杂解剖结构和放射学报告的弱监督而具有挑战性，现有方法难以学习可迁移且可解释的表示。
Method: 提出 ASAP 框架，包含三个组件：(1) 解剖感知知识注入模块，利用现成分割工具注入器官级结构先验；(2) 语义自适应选择性对齐机制，动态关联句子级发现与局部体积区域；(3) 语义自适应融合模块，在双模态掩码建模范式下交互解剖视觉特征和文本线索。
Result: 在 15 个数据集、22 个下游任务上全面超越基线，尤其在有限监督和分布偏移场景下提升显著，验证了学习可迁移且临床有用的体积表示的有效性。
Conclusion: ASAP 作为医学体积视觉-语言预训练的通用框架，通过整合解剖先验和语义自适应对齐，有效提升了表示质量，适用于多种临床任务。

papers.title: SPADER: Step-wise Peer Advantage with Diversity-Aware Exploration Rewards for Multi-Answer Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents to acquire information beyond parametric knowledge. While recent work has improved long-horizon tool-use reasoning, most approaches focus on tasks with a single correct answer. In contrast, many real-world queries require discovering a comprehensive set of valid answers, a setting known as Multi-Answer QA. This setting raises two challenges: fine-grained credit assignment over long search trajectories and reward alignment for sustained exploration beyond easy high-frequency entities. We propose SPADER, a reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon tool use in Multi-Answer QA. SPADER includes Step-wise Peer Advantage (SPA), a critic-free step-level credit assignment mechanism that aligns parallel trajectories by decision step and estimates advantages from peer returns. It also includes a diversity-aware exploration reward that promotes long-tail entity discovery by upweighting rare findings and downweighting redundant ones. Experiments on QAMPARI, Mintaka, WebQSP, and QUEST show that SPADER generally improves recall and overall F1 over prompting-based agents, outcome-supervised RL methods, and recent step-level supervision approaches. Our code and model weights are available at https://github.com/KhanCold/spader.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPADER 是一个针对多答案问答（Multi-Answer QA）的强化学习框架，旨在解决长程工具使用任务中的细粒度信用分配和奖励对齐问题。它包含步骤级同行优势（SPA）机制和多样性感知探索奖励，在 QAMPARI、Mintaka 等基准上提升了召回率和 F1 分数。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在工具增强的长期推理中多关注单答案任务，而多答案 QA 需要全面发现有效答案，面临信用分配稀疏和探索偏向高频实体的问题。
Method: 提出 SPADER 框架，包含步骤级同行优势（SPA）：一种无需评论家的步骤级信用分配方法，通过对齐并行轨迹的决策步骤来估计优势；以及多样性感知探索奖励，通过上采样罕见发现、下采样冗余发现来促进长尾实体发现。
Result: 在 QAMPARI、Mintaka、WebQSP 和 QUEST 数据集上，SPADER 相较于基于提示的智能体、结果监督强化学习方法和最近的步骤级监督方法，普遍提升了召回率和整体 F1 分数。
Conclusion: SPADER 证明了步骤级信用分配和多样性奖励在多答案长程工具使用任务中的有效性。

papers.title: Through the PRISM: Principle-Aware, Interpretable, and Multi-Scale Evaluation of Visual Designs
papers.abstract_en: Effective visual communication stems from the harmony of multiple design principles, such as readability, contrast, alignment, overlap, and coherence, which collectively govern clarity and intent of the communicator. While human designers reason holistically over these principles, machine agents typically condense them into a single heuristic score, offering limited interpretability and diagnostic precision. To address this gap, we introduce PRISM (PRinciple-aware, Interpretable, and Structure-guided Design Modifications), a benchmark that systematically perturbs professional layouts from the Crello dataset along measurable design principles. The benchmark comprises 100K perturbed training samples and 10K perturbed validation designs, each isolating a specific principle violation for controlled analysis of multimodal reasoning about design quality. We show that models like Qwen-2.5-VL and GPT-4o-mini are largely insensitive to targeted principle degradations, whereas GPT-4o exhibits global awareness without fine-grained disentanglement. Building on these insights, we propose a multi-scale evaluation framework that integrates lightweight scorers for quantitative assessment, instruction-tuned vision-language models for localised feedback, and prompt-based methods for global reasoning. Our framework provides interpretable explanations of design failures. Using these localised insights, we show targeted refinements that improve layout quality. Together, PRISM and our framework lay the foundation for interpretable design-literate multimodal reasoning systems.
papers.journal_ref: CVPR 2026 Findings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM基准，通过系统扰动Crello数据集中的专业布局，沿可测量的设计原则（如可读性、对比度、对齐、重叠、连贯性）生成10万训练样本和1万验证样本，用于评估多模态模型对设计质量的推理能力。实验发现Qwen-2.5-VL和GPT-4o-mini对特定原则退化不敏感，而GPT-4o有全局意识但缺乏细粒度解耦。基于此，提出多尺度评估框架，结合轻量评分器、指令微调视觉语言模型和提示方法，提供可解释的设计失败诊断和改进建议。
Motivation: 现有机器评估视觉设计通常依赖单一启发式分数，缺乏可解释性和诊断精度，无法像人类设计师一样整体考虑多个设计原则的和谐性。
Method: 构建PRISM基准，包含系统扰动设计原则的100K训练和10K验证样本；提出多尺度评估框架，整合轻量定量评分器、指令微调VLM局部反馈和提示全局推理。
Result: 摘要显示Qwen-2.5-VL和GPT-4o-mini对原则退化不敏感，GPT-4o有全局意识但无细粒度解耦；框架通过局部化见解实现有针对性的布局改进。
Conclusion: PRISM和提出的框架为构建可解释的、具备设计素养的多模态推理系统奠定了基础，但当前模型在细粒度设计原则解耦上仍有不足。

papers.title: Critic-R: Improving Agentic Search using Instruction-tuned Retrievers with Natural Language Introspective Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Agentic search systems iteratively interact with retrieval models to answer complex queries. Despite substantial progress, optimizing retrievers for agentic search remains challenging, often requiring heavy co-training or gold-standard annotations that limit real-world applicability. We propose Critic-R, a framework that explicitly closes the feedback loop between the reasoning agent and the retrieval model during both inference and training. Critic-R introduces a critic model that evaluates the agent's introspective reasoning trace after consuming retrieved evidence to determine whether the retrieved context sufficiently supports the next reasoning step. Critic-R has two complementary mechanisms: Critic-R-Zero, an inference-time query refinement loop that iteratively rewrites queries and retrieval instructions, and Critic-Embed, an optimization approach for retrieval models that leverages successful and failed refinement trajectories as automatic supervision without requiring manual relevance annotation. We evaluate Critic-R on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle. Results show that Critic-R significantly improves both retrieval quality and downstream answer accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Critic-R框架，通过引入批评模型（critic model）评估智能体的内省推理轨迹，从而在推理和训练阶段明确闭合智能体与检索模型之间的反馈循环。Critic-R包含两种互补机制：Critic-R-Zero（推理时查询细化循环）和Critic-Embed（利用成功/失败细化轨迹作为自动监督优化检索模型）。在HotpotQA等数据集上，该方法显著提升了检索质量和答案准确率。
Motivation: 现有agentic search中检索模型优化困难，通常需要大量协同训练或人工标注，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出Critic-R框架，包括Critic-R-Zero推理时迭代重写查询和检索指令，以及Critic-Embed利用自动监督（无需人工标注）优化检索模型。
Result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue和Bamboogle上，Critic-R显著提升检索质量和下游答案准确率。
Conclusion: 通过批评模型连接智能体推理与检索模型，实现了无需人工标注的自动优化，提升了agentic search性能。

summary_sections.method: 提出Critic-R框架，包括Critic-R-Zero推理时迭代重写查询和检索指令，以及Critic-Embed利用自动监督（无需人工标注）优化检索模型。
summary_sections.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue和Bamboogle上，Critic-R显著提升检索质量和下游答案准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过批评模型连接智能体推理与检索模型，实现了无需人工标注的自动优化，提升了agentic search性能。

papers.title: Response-Aware Multimodal Learning for Post-Treatment Visual Acuity Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Long-term visual acuity (VA) outcomes after anti-VEGF therapy are central to patient counseling, expectation setting, and follow-up planning in diabetic macular edema (DME). However, in clinical practice, physicians must often estimate long-term visual trajectories based only on early post-treatment findings, making reliable prognostication difficult. Although prior OCT-based learning approaches have largely focused on short-term response or single-endpoint prediction, modeling VA trajectories across multiple future time points from early longitudinal observations remains insufficiently explored. In this study, we assembled a real-world cohort of 188 anti-VEGF-treated DME patients with paired baseline and month-1 OCT scans, along with tabular OCT-derived biomarkers and non-imaging clinical variables. Using only these early data, we formulate a multi-horizon VA forecasting problem aimed at predicting visual outcomes at 3, 6, 12, 18, and 24 months, reflecting clinically meaningful follow-up intervals. We propose ReVA, a response-aware multimodal framework that integrates structural features from baseline and month-1 OCT with the tabular variables to capture baseline disease status and early treatment response. ReVA uses spatial attention to preserve localized prognostic imaging features and a dependency-aware tabular encoder to model interactions among clinical variables. These multimodal representations are fused to predict patient-specific long-term visual acuity trajectories. The proposed framework achieves MAE=0.1246, RMSE=0.1621, and R^2=0.6064 for 24-month VA prediction, with consistent performance across all forecast horizons. Our findings show that incorporating early treatment-response signals enables clinically meaningful long-term visual acuity forecasting, supporting data-driven decision support for routine anti-VEGF management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReVA框架，利用基线及治疗后1个月的OCT影像和临床表型数据，预测糖尿病黄斑水肿患者抗VEGF治疗后的长期视力轨迹（3、6、12、18、24个月）。该多模态模型通过空间注意力保留局部影像特征，并依赖感知表格编码器建模临床变量交互，在24个月预测中达到MAE=0.1246、RMSE=0.1621、R²=0.6064。结果表明早期治疗反应信号能支持临床决策。
Motivation: 临床中医生仅凭早期治疗后发现象难以可靠预测长期视力结局，而现有基于OCT的方法多聚焦短期或单点预测，缺乏多时间点轨迹建模研究。
Method: 构建真实世界188例患者数据集，整合基线及第1个月OCT扫描、OCT衍生生物标志物及非影像临床变量；提出ReVA框架，采用空间注意力保留影像预后特征，并设计依赖感知表格编码器建模变量交互，融合多模态表征实现多时间点视力预测。
Result: 24个月视力预测MAE=0.1246，RMSE=0.1621，R²=0.6064，且在所有五个预测时间点表现一致。
Conclusion: 早期治疗反应信号的融入使得临床可行的长期视力预测成为可能，为抗VEGF治疗的常规管理提供数据驱动的决策支持。

papers.title: Spectra-Guided Neural Tucker Factorization
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes Spectra-Guided Neural Tucker Factorization (SG-NTF) for High-Dimensional and Incomplete (HDI) tensor completion. Circumventing discrete representational limits, SG-NTF maps scalar timestamps into a continuous spectral space to abstract temporal periodicities. Concurrently, a Spatio-Temporal Co-Gating (STCG) mechanism explicitly filters latent interactions via multiplicative modulation on spatiotemporal contexts. Evaluations on real-world HDI tensors verify that SG-NTF maintains competitive completion accuracy with parameter efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spectra-Guided Neural Tucker Factorization (SG-NTF)，用于高维不完全张量补全。通过将时间戳映射到连续频谱空间来捕捉时间周期性，并设计时空共门控机制显式筛选潜在交互。在真实数据集上，SG-NTF 以参数高效的方式保持了有竞争力的补全精度。
Motivation: 现有张量分解方法受限于离散表示，难以有效建模时间周期性；同时缺乏对时空上下文的显式过滤机制。
Method: 在神经 Tucker 分解框架中引入频谱编码（将标量时间戳映射到连续谱空间）和时空共门控（Spatio-Temporal Co-Gating）模块，对潜在交互进行乘法调制。
Result: 在真实高维不完全张量上的评估表明，SG-NTF 能在保持参数效率的同时达到有竞争力的补全精度。
Conclusion: SG-NTF 是一种有效的张量补全方法，尤其适用于具有时间周期性和时空结构的高维不完全数据。

papers.title: Improving Visual Representation Alignment Generation with GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion transformers have demonstrated strong image synthesis capabilities but remain inefficient to train due to weak alignment between generative and discriminative representations. While representation alignment frameworks such as REPA improve convergence by aligning noisy denoising features with pretrained visual encoders, their externally supervised alignment loss is static and lacks adaptivity during training and inference. Existing methods rely on fixed cosine alignment or contrastive objectives, which cannot dynamically balance representation consistency and generation quality, resulting in limited discriminative benefit and failing to optimize alignment in a task-adaptive manner. To address this, we propose VRPO, a reinforcement-based optimization strategy that replaces REPA's static alignment loss with a generative representation policy optimization objective. Instead of enforcing a fixed similarity constraint, VRPO treats representation alignment as a reward-guided process: the model receives adaptive rewards based on generation fidelity, perceptual quality, and semantic coherence between the diffusion features and pretrained visual embeddings. This formulation enables the generator to continuously refine its internal representations toward semantically meaningful directions while improving image quality. Our VRPO-driven training seamlessly integrates into diffusion transformers, introducing negligible computation cost and preserving full compatibility with SiT and DiT architectures. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-256x256 demonstrate that our VRPO-Alignment substantially enhances both convergence and fidelity, achieving up to +1.8 FID improvement and 2.3x faster training compared to REPA under identical compute budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VRPO，一种基于强化学习的优化策略，用生成表示策略优化目标替代REPA的静态对齐损失。该方法将表示对齐视为奖励引导过程，根据生成保真度、感知质量和语义一致性提供自适应奖励，从而在扩散变压器中同时提升收敛速度和图像质量。在ImageNet-256x256上，VRPO-Alignment相比REPA在相同计算预算下实现最多+1.8 FID改进和2.3倍训练加速。
Motivation: 现有扩散变压器训练效率低，因为生成与判别表示之间对齐弱；REPA等方法的静态对齐损失缺乏自适应性，无法动态平衡表示一致性和生成质量，导致判别收益有限且无法任务自适应优化对齐。
Method: 提出VRPO（生成表示策略优化），将表示对齐形式化为奖励引导过程，模型根据生成保真度、感知质量和扩散特征与预训练视觉嵌入之间的语义一致性获得自适应奖励，从而不断优化内部表示。
Result: 在ImageNet-256x256上，VRPO-Alignment相比REPA实现最多+1.8 FID改进和2.3倍训练加速，且计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: VRPO能够无缝集成到SiT和DiT等扩散变压器架构中，在几乎不增加计算成本的情况下显著提升收敛速度和生成保真度。

papers.title: PropLLM: Propagation-Aware Scene Reconstruction for Network Fault Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Network faults propagate layer by layer along topology and protocol dependencies, yet operations systems typically observe only symptomatic alerts at the tail end of propagation chains, where distinct root-cause faults may produce highly similar end-point symptoms. Existing approaches, whether rule-based, machine learning (ML)-based, or large language model (LLM)-based, fundamentally map the alert set to a diagnosis in a single pass and are structurally incapable of resolving this end-point ambiguity. This paper proposes PropLLM, which is the first to integrate the hop-by-hop scene reconstruction paradigm with the generative reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Starting from end-point alerts, PropLLM traces back hop-by-hop along the propagation path, retrieving verifiable factual evidence from a dual-layer knowledge graph (KG) at each hop, while the proposed Temporal Causal Propagation Attention (TCPA) mechanism encodes known topological causal priors directly into the attention computation to guide the model along the correct causal direction, ultimately localizing the root cause and determining the fault type through a fully evidenced causal chain. On a real-world Wi-Fi multimodal fault dataset, PropLLM improves fault type diagnosis accuracy by 3.9\% and root cause localization accuracy by 4.7\% over the strongest baseline, while reducing the hallucination rate by 50.8\%. Supplementary experiments on the TeleLogs 5G dataset further demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method across different network scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PropLLM首次将逐跳场景重建范式与LLM的生成推理能力结合，用于网络故障诊断。该方法从终端告警出发，沿传播路径逐跳回溯，在每个跳点从双层知识图谱中检索可验证事实，并利用时域因果传播注意力机制将拓扑因果先验编码到注意力计算中，最终通过证据链定位根因和故障类型。在真实Wi-Fi多模态故障数据集上，故障类型诊断准确率提升3.9%，根因定位准确率提升4.7%，幻觉率降低50.8%。
Motivation: 现有网络故障诊断方法（规则、ML、LLM）均将告警集一次性映射到诊断结果，无法从根本上解决因传播路径终端症状相似而导致的端点歧义问题。
Method: 提出PropLLM，集成逐跳场景重建与LLM生成推理：从终端告警开始，沿传播路径反向逐跳回溯，每跳利用双层知识图谱获取事实证据，并通过时域因果传播注意力（TCPA）机制将拓扑因果先验直接融入注意力计算，引导模型沿正确因果方向推理。
Result: 在真实Wi-Fi多模态故障数据集上，PropLLM的故障类型诊断准确率比最强基线提升3.9%，根因定位准确率提升4.7%，幻觉率降低50.8%。在TeleLogs 5G数据集上的补充实验进一步验证了方法在不同网络场景下的有效性。
Conclusion: PropLLM通过逐跳场景重建与LLM结合，有效解决了网络故障诊断中端点症状歧义问题，并显著降低了幻觉率。

papers.title: Sandboxed Coding Agents are Competitive Omni-modal Task Solvers
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal LLMs increasingly target video and audio, it is often assumed that such tasks require native omnimodal models. We show that this is not always the case: coding agents with only text+image access and a sandboxed tool-use interface can match, and in several settings outperform, SOTA native omnimodal models and predefined multimodal agent scaffolds across multiple audio-video benchmarks. Our trajectory analysis suggests that their strength comes from writing code and orchestrating tools to extract relevant evidence from transcripts, frames, and other modality signals, thereby converting omnimodal tasks into retrieval and information-processing problems rather than ingesting entire media streams. We further characterize their limitations through a failure taxonomy and process-level trace analysis, and show that simple skill injection, including human-written and self-distilled skills, substantially improves performance. To explore open-source elicitation, we introduce Code-X, a training recipe with the OmniCoding trajectory dataset and verifiable reward, and provide baselines on Qwen-3.5-9B and Qwen-3.6-27B. Finally, we argue that the next frontier is many-modality processing, and introduce TerminalBench-O, a process-level benchmark for real-world omnimodal processing tasks. Code will be available at https://github.com/Dongping-Chen/OmniCoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现仅具备文本+图像访问能力的编码代理（coding agents）通过沙盒工具接口，可以在多个音频-视频基准上匹配甚至超越SOTA原生多模态模型。轨迹分析表明其优势来源于编写代码和编排工具，将多模态任务转化为检索和信息处理问题。作者提出Code-X训练配方（OmniCoding轨迹数据集和可验证奖励），并在Qwen-3.5-9B和Qwen-3.6-27B上提供基线，同时引入过程级基准TerminalBench-O。
Motivation: 通常假设视频和音频等任务需要原生多模态模型，但作者质疑这一点，并展示编码代理的竞争力。
Method: 使用仅文本+图像访问的编码代理，配合沙盒工具接口；提出Code-X训练配方，包含OmniCoding轨迹数据集和可验证奖励，并在Qwen-3.5-9B和Qwen-3.6-27B上给出基线。
Result: 在多个音频-视频基准上匹配或超越SOTA原生多模态模型和预定义多模态代理框架，技能注入（人工编写和自我蒸馏）显著提升性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为下一前沿是许多模态处理，并引入过程级基准TerminalBench-O；编码代理可将多模态任务转化为检索和信息处理问题，而非直接处理整个媒体流。

papers.title: LASER: Loss-Aware Singular-value Decomposition and Rank Allocation for Efficient Low-Precision Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) deliver strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but their large computational cost and high parameter counts make deployment challenging on resource-constrained devices. Low-rank decomposition has emerged as a promising compression technique, yet existing methods often optimize local matrix reconstruction error, rely on uniform or heuristic rank allocation, and focus mainly on attention projections while leaving feed-forward networks underexplored. In this paper, we propose~\textit{LASER} (\textbf{L}oss-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{S}ingular-value d\textbf{E}composition and \textbf{R}ank allocation), a low-rank compression framework for efficient low-precision VLM inference. LASER derives a curvature-weighted SVD objective from a second-order approximation of the model loss and uses Kronecker-factored Fisher information to guide decomposition toward downstream performance rather than reconstruction alone. We further introduce a loss-aware cross-layer rank allocation strategy based on calibration gradients, enabling more effective parameter budgeting across layers. Finally, we extend low-rank compression to FFN layers through a hybrid scheme that combines SVD with quantization. The evaluation results show that LASER achieves more than $2.3\times$ decoding speedup over previous work while preserving strong accuracy under low-precision inference.

TL;DR: 本文提出 LASER 框架，通过损失感知奇异值分解和秩分配来压缩视觉语言模型（VLM），实现低精度推理加速。该方法利用曲率加权的 SVD 目标和克罗内克分解的 Fisher 信息指导分解，并提出跨层秩分配策略，同时将低秩压缩扩展到前馈网络层。实验表明，在低精度推理下，解码速度相比之前工作提升 2.3 倍以上，且保持较强精度。

Method: 基于模型损失的二阶近似推导曲率加权 SVD 目标，使用克罗内克分解的 Fisher 信息引导分解；提出基于校准梯度的损失感知跨层秩分配策略；对 FFN 层采用 SVD 结合量化的混合方案。
Result: 在低精度推理下，LASER 实现超过 2.3 倍解码加速，同时保持强精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 损失感知的 SVD 和秩分配能有效压缩 VLM，并扩展至 FFN 层，在低精度下实现显著加速。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Multi-Task Graph Transformer for Trip-Level Transit Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Passenger count data from public transit systems reveals urban mobility patterns and is essential for planning, operation, and optimisation. However, non-linear spatiotemporal interdependencies across stops and lines make modelling and prediction challenging. Existing approaches often rely on fixed temporal, spatial, or stop-level formulations, limiting their ability to capture within-trip evolution and network context. This study proposes SMT-GraphFormer, a spatiotemporal multi-task graph transformer that frames trip-level transit prediction as sequence-to-sequence modelling. Given a line's stop sequence and trip-level context, the model predicts successive boarding and alighting counts, with delay and dwell time treated as encoder-side surrogate tasks. Key components include graph embeddings for multi-relational stop similarity, a context encoder for weather and temporal information, and a multi-gate mixture-of-experts module that produces task-specific decoder representations for boarding and alighting predictions. Evaluation on public bus transit data from Trondheim, Norway, shows that SMT-GraphFormer outperforms stop-level tabular benchmarks, with ablation studies examining each component's contribution. The sequential formulation yields substantial gains on alighting prediction ($+$0.24 in $R^2$) and consistent improvements on boarding, delay, and dwell, confirming the value of explicit trip-level sequential bias and inter-target dependencies. These findings demonstrate the potential of transformer-based sequence modelling for capturing complex spatiotemporal dynamics in public transit and underscore the value of architectures tailored to transit data rather than off-the-shelf tabular models. The proposed framework provides a horizon-agnostic basis for scenario analysis in digital twin environments, supporting informed decision-making by planners and transit operators.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables, including appendix. Code available at https://github.com/Outsiders17711/SMTGraphFormer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SMT-GraphFormer，一种时空多任务图变换器，将行程级公交乘客预测建模为序列到序列问题。模型利用图嵌入编码站点相似性、上下文编码器融合天气与时间信息，并通过多门控混合专家模块生成上下车人数、延误和停留时间的预测。在挪威特隆赫姆公交数据上，下车预测R²提升0.24，其他指标也有改进。
Motivation: 现有方法多基于固定时间、空间或站点级公式，难以捕捉行程内演变和网络上下文的复杂时空依赖，导致预测精度受限。
Method: 提出SMT-GraphFormer，包含多关系图嵌入、天气/时间上下文编码器，以及多门控混合专家模块，将延误和停留时间作为编码器侧代理任务，以序列到序列方式预测上下车人数。
Result: 在真实公交数据上，下车预测R²提高0.24，上车、延误和停留时间预测均获得一致提升，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
Conclusion: Transformer序列建模和任务特定架构能有效捕获公交系统中的复杂时空动态，为数字孪生场景分析提供了与预测时域无关的基础框架。

papers.title: On the Difficulty of Learning a Meta-network for Training Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data are increasingly used to train neural networks, yet distributional mismatch with real data limits their effectiveness when used indiscriminately. A common strategy is to learn data weights via bi-level optimization, which we refer to as Meta-learning for Training-data Selection (MTS). Interestingly, in practice, MTS often performs below expectation. We identify two obstacles in properly training MTS: a poor gradient signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR), which causes optimization difficulties, and lack of informative features that correlates with data quality. We present a mathematical analysis of MTS, which reveals the dynamics of normalized data weights and the relation between disparate data quality and poor GSNR. The analysis suggests a a simple yet effective solution: increasing the batch size. Further, we propose a set of informative features that capture the positions of training data in their distributions and training dynamics. Experiments across four benchmarks show consistent improvements, achieving average gains of 5.49% over training without selection and 2.89% over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了元网络训练数据选择（MTS）在实践中表现不佳的两个障碍：梯度信噪比（GSNR）低导致优化困难，以及缺乏与数据质量相关的信息特征。通过数学分析揭示了归一化数据权重的动态，并提出增大批大小和一组捕捉数据分布位置与训练动态的信息特征作为解决方案。在四个基准上平均提升5.49%（相对于无选择）和2.89%（相对于最强基线）。
Motivation: 合成数据与真实数据的分布不匹配限制了其效果，现有MTS方法在实践中常低于预期，主要原因是梯度信噪比差和缺乏信息特征。
Method: 数学分析MTS中数据权重的动态，指出劣质数据导致GSNR差，并提出增大批大小以及一组描述数据在分布中位置和训练动态的信息特征。
Result: 在四个基准上，本文方法平均提升5.49%相对于无选择训练，2.89%相对于最强基线。
Conclusion: 本文识别并解决了MTS中的关键障碍，为训练数据选择提供了有效且简单的改进方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting Parameter-Based Knowledge Editing in Large Language Models: Theoretical Limits and Empirical Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-based knowledge editing updates the internal knowledge of large language models (LLMs) via localized weight modifications and has attracted significant attention. However, most existing methods overlook fundamental theoretical limitations and are rarely evaluated under realistic, practice-oriented settings. In this paper, we first present a theoretical analysis based on the dimensional Collapse Hypothesis, explaining how localized parameter edits can propagate along fragile directions in the representation space, inducing global interference and ultimately causing reasoning collapse. Building on this insight, we conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation by systematically varying knowledge complexity, number of edits, evaluation dimensions, and baseline methods. Our results show that parameter-based editing methods consistently damage core LLM capabilities. In contrast, a simple retrieval-based baseline achieves consistently stronger performance than all parameter-editing methods across all evaluated conditions. These findings highlight that preserving the fundamental capabilities of LLMs after knowledge editing should be a central concern for future research.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Equal contribution by the first two authors. 9 pages main paper, 10 figures, with appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于参数的大语言模型知识编辑方法，从理论上分析了其局限性，并进行了全面的实证评估。作者基于维度坍塌假说（dimensional Collapse Hypothesis）解释了局部参数编辑如何沿脆弱方向传播并导致全局干扰和推理崩溃。实验表明，所有参数编辑方法都会持续损害LLM的核心能力，而简单的检索基线在所有条件下均表现更优。
Motivation: 现有基于参数的知识编辑方法忽略了根本性的理论限制，且缺乏面向实际应用的评估。
Method: 提出维度坍塌假说进行理论分析，并通过系统改变知识复杂度、编辑数量、评估维度和基线方法进行实证评估。
Result: 参数编辑方法持续损害LLM核心能力，而检索基线在所有条件下均稳定优于所有参数编辑方法。
Conclusion: 未来研究应将保护LLM在知识编辑后的基本能力作为核心关注点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Recoverability of Causal Relations from Bulk Gene Expression Data
papers.abstract_en: Bulk gene expression profiling, which aggregates pooled RNA across cells within a biological sample, remains important in the single-cell era because it is typically less noisy, more sensitive, and more cost-effective than single-cell assays. Accordingly, a growing body of computational methods seeks to recover causal relations among genes from bulk expression data. However, aggregation is a lossy, non-invertible coarsening of the underlying cellular system, and it remains unclear whether and under what conditions causal relations are recoverable from aggregated bulk gene expression data. To answer this, we formalize recoverability under aggregation through two notions of consistency: functional-form consistency and conditional-independence consistency. We then derive necessary and sufficient conditions for recoverability, showing that these properties are preserved only under linear aggregations (e.g., sum/mean) coupled with affine structural equations. To assess the practical plausibility of these conditions, analyses of four bulk and four single-cell gene expression datasets further reveal that the estimated pairwise regulatory functions among genes deviate from linearity in both data types, providing limited empirical support for the linearity assumptions required for recoverability. Together, these results caution against recovering causal relations from aggregated bulk expression data without strong additional assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从批量（bulk）基因表达数据中恢复因果关系的可恢复性条件。通过定义两种一致性（函数形式一致性和条件独立性一致性），推导出可恢复的充要条件：仅当采用线性聚合（如求和/平均）且结构方程为仿射时，因果关系才能保持。进一步分析多个真实数据集发现，基因间调控函数在批量与单细胞数据中均偏离线性，因此线性假设缺乏实证支持。结论提示，在没有强附加假设的情况下，从批量表达数据恢复因果关系需谨慎。
Motivation: 批量基因表达数据因成本低、噪声小仍被广泛使用，但其本质是对细胞系统的不可逆聚合，因果关系的可恢复性缺乏理论保证。
Method: 从理论上定义两种一致性（函数形式一致性和条件独立性一致性），推导出可恢复性的充要条件；并通过四个批量与四个单细胞数据集分析成对调控函数的线性程度。
Result: 可恢复性仅在线性聚合（如和/均值）与仿射结构方程同时满足时才成立；实际数据中基因间调控函数普遍偏离线性。
Conclusion: 恢复批量表达数据中的因果关系需要强附加假设，否则结果不可靠。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Same Payload, Different Channel: Measuring Trust Asymmetry in Tool-Using Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As language models take on agentic roles that span calling external APIs, reading tool outputs, and acting on instructions embedded in third-party content, their attack surface expands well beyond what users type. Whether a model treats a malicious instruction the same way regardless of where it arrives has not been systematically studied. We introduce the Safety Asymmetry Score (SAS), which measures how much a model's susceptibility to adversarial content shifts depending on whether that content arrives in the user message, tool metadata, or tool output, using matched payload pairs that keep the malicious text identical and vary only the context of delivery. Evaluated across 6 production LLMs and three attack families, we find a consistent and informative asymmetry: agent-native models are substantially more vulnerable when adversarial content arrives via tool descriptions than via user messages, while general-purpose models show the reverse. This asymmetry further inverts when the same content is delivered through tool outputs rather than descriptions, suggesting models implicitly treat tool metadata as trusted instructions and tool results as ordinary data. A mechanistic study on Llama 3.3 70B reveals that the safety-relevant representation is causally present at mid-to-late network depths but non-linearly encoded, explaining why linear probes fail to detect it. These findings expose a systematic, channel-dependent blind spot in how current tool-using models handle adversarial content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Safety Asymmetry Score (SAS)来测量语言模型在处理恶意指令时是否因指令来源（用户消息、工具元数据、工具输出）不同而表现不同。在6个生产级LLM和三个攻击家族上发现一致的不对称性：agent-native模型在工具描述中更脆弱，通用模型相反；当内容通过工具输出传递时不对称性反转。机制研究表明Llama 3.3 70B的安全相关表示在中间到深层网络存在但非线性编码。
Motivation: 语言模型在调用API、读取工具输出等agent角色中攻击面扩大，但恶意指令是否因到达渠道不同而受到不同对待尚未系统研究。
Method: 引入Safety Asymmetry Score (SAS)，使用匹配的payload对（恶意文本相同，仅传递上下文不同）来量化模型在不同渠道（用户消息、工具元数据、工具输出）中的脆弱性。
Result: 在6个生产LLM和三个攻击家族中发现：agent-native模型在工具描述中更脆弱，通用模型相反；传递渠道从描述变为输出时不对称性反转。机制研究显示Llama 3.3 70B的安全相关表示在中间层到深层存在但非线性编码。
Conclusion: 发现了一种系统性的、渠道依赖的盲点，现有的工具使用模型在处理对抗内容时存在不对称性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decomposed On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Reasoning: Steering Gradients for Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: While on-policy distillation offers dense supervision for training small reasoning models, its optimization dynamics in the multimodal domain remain under-explored. In this work, we challenge the standard monolithic view of Vision-Language Model (VLM) distillation by mathematically decomposing the loss into two distinct components: the language prior and visual grounding. Our analysis uncovers that gradient vectors for these components are nearly orthogonal, indicating that the objective of aligning with the teacher's language distribution is geometrically independent from the objective of matching its visual perception. Consequently, standard optimization passively follows a suboptimal compromise trajectory that implicitly balances the two objectives. Hypothesizing that visual grounding constitutes the primary bottleneck for vision-language reasoning, we introduce Visual Gradient Steering (VGS), a method that dynamically reorients the update vector to prioritize the visual subspace. Experimental results on multiple distillation settings and complex multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that VGS significantly outperforms the standard monolithic formulation of on-policy distillation, achieving superior grounding with minimal training overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）蒸馏中的优化动态，将蒸馏损失分解为语言先验和视觉接地两个独立分量，发现其梯度近乎正交。提出视觉梯度引导（VGS）方法，动态重定向更新向量以优先学习视觉子空间，在多个蒸馏设置和多模态基准上显著优于标准在线蒸馏。
Motivation: 标准在线蒸馏在视觉-语言模型中的优化动态尚未被充分探索，其损失函数中的语言先验和视觉接地分量可能相互独立，导致优化轨迹次优。
Method: 数学上将蒸馏损失分解为语言先验和视觉接地两个正交分量，提出Visual Gradient Steering (VGS)，动态调整梯度方向以增强视觉接地学习。
Result: 在多个视觉-语言蒸馏实验和复杂多模态基准上，VGS显著优于标准在线蒸馏，以最小训练开销实现更好的视觉接地性能。
Conclusion: 视觉接地是视觉-语言推理的主要瓶颈，VGS通过梯度重定向有效提升多模态蒸馏效果。

papers.title: A Practical Upper Bound on Selection Bias Effects in Medical Prediction Models
papers.abstract_en: Selection bias is a common and often unavoidable aspect of real-world data that challenges the generalizability of machine learning models. When models trained on biased data are deployed in the broader target population, poor model generalization may lead to real harm, particularly in high-risk settings such as healthcare. This risk highlights the need for practitioners to reliably assess model generalizability prior to deployment. However, existing methods for predicting model performance rely on unrealistic access to the target distribution or knowledge of the selection mechanism causing bias. To address these limitations, we propose a novel upper bound on the worst-case model performance on the target population under the realistic setting where the selection mechanism and the target population data are only partially observed. We demonstrate the validity and practical utility of our method through experiments on fully synthetic data, semi-synthetic data derived from the All of Us Research Program, and real-world selection bias in MIMIC-IV. Our work offers a principled and practical tool to estimate the impact of selection bias in an otherwise intractable setting, thereby enabling practitioners to build safer and more generalizable models in healthcare and beyond.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 27 figures, will be published at ACM SIGKDD '26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医疗预测模型中的选择偏差问题，提出了一种在目标分布和选择机制仅部分可观测时，对目标群体模型最差性能的可计算上界。通过全合成数据、All of Us研究计划半合成数据以及MIMIC-IV真实选择偏差实验，验证了该上界的有效性和实用性。
Motivation: 现有方法评估模型泛化能力需要不可实际获取的目标分布或选择机制知识，导致医疗等高危场景下模型部署风险难以预估。
Method: 提出一个理论上界，在仅部分观测到选择机制和目标群体数据时，量化模型在目标群体上的最差性能。
Result: 在全合成数据、All of Us半合成数据以及MIMIC-IV真实选择偏差实验中，该上界被证明有效且实用。
Conclusion: 该工作为原本不可解的场景提供了量化选择偏差影响的原则性实用工具，有助于构建更安全、更泛化的医疗模型。

papers.title: DeepLatent: Think with Images via Parallel Latent Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The emerging paradigm of "thinking with images" embeds visual states into intermediate reasoning steps, defining a new frontier for Vision-Language Models. Existing approaches diverge along two lines. Tool-assisted methods apply explicit visual operations but suffer from high latency and restricted manipulation types. Latent reasoning methods autoregressively produce implicit visual states, but underperform tool-assisted methods, and their latent tokens fail to capture effective visual information. In this work, we propose DeepLatent, a parallel framework for latent visual reasoning. First, we introduce LatentFormer. It uses learnable 2D tokens to generate context-conditioned latent states in parallel, anchoring every visual update directly in the original image features. Second, we design a continuous-space reinforcement learning algorithm. It optimizes latent modulation parameters directly in the embedding space, significantly improving latent representation quality. The framework is trained via knowledge distillation followed by this continuous-space RL algorithm. Furthermore, we contribute DeepLatent-180K, a large-scale dataset tailored for latent visual reasoning. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DeepLatent achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepLatent，一种并行潜伏视觉推理框架，通过 LatentFormer 和连续空间强化学习，在多个视觉语言基准上取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有潜伏视觉推理方法性能不如工具辅助方法，且潜伏token难以捕获有效视觉信息，同时工具辅助方法延迟高。
Method: 引入 LatentFormer，使用可学习2D token并行生成上下文条件的潜伏状态；设计连续空间强化学习算法优化潜伏调制参数，结合知识蒸馏训练。
Result: 在多个基准测试上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: DeepLatent 通过并行潜伏推理和连续空间优化，显著提升潜伏视觉推理质量。

papers.title: Interpretable Policy Distillation for Power Grid Topology Control
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising route to real-time power grid operation, yet large neural policies are costly to evaluate, hard to deploy on constrained hardware, and opaque to operators. We ask whether a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent for grid topology control can be compressed into compact tree-based surrogates without losing operational performance. A PPO teacher is trained on Grid2Op's standard 14-bus environment with a stability-oriented reward, using stress-focused data collection on critical, high-loading states. The policy is then distilled into a decision tree and a random forest. Across held-out validation episodes, both surrogates exceed the teacher in mean reward and survival length at a fraction of the inference cost. The decision tree shows high exact-action agreement with the PPO argmax and near-complete agreement within its top-ranked actions, while remaining small enough to be inspected directly. Feature-importance analysis reveals a representational shift: the PPO policy relies mainly on line-loading signals, while the distilled tree is driven primarily by bus-topology variables. These results suggest that stress-focused distillation can convert a black-box neural controller into a lightweight, auditable rule-like surrogate suited for real-time deployment, while also surfacing risks tied to deterministic actions and topology-specific generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将深度强化学习（PPO）策略蒸馏为紧凑的决策树和随机森林，用于电网拓扑控制。在Grid2Op的14节点环境中，蒸馏后的树模型在平均回报和生存时长上超越原PPO教师，推理成本大幅降低。决策树与PPO argmax动作高度一致，且特征重要性分析显示蒸馏模型从依赖线路负载转向依赖母线拓扑变量。
Motivation: 深度强化学习策略在电网实时控制中计算成本高、部署困难且缺乏可解释性，需要将其压缩为轻量、可审计的替代模型。
Method: 训练一个PPO教师模型，在Grid2Op的14节点环境中使用稳定性导向奖励和压力聚焦数据收集（关注关键高负载状态），然后将其策略蒸馏为决策树和随机森林。
Result: 在保留验证集上，两种蒸馏模型在平均奖励和生存时长上均超过教师模型，决策树与PPO argmax动作高度一致（且与排名前几的动作近乎完全一致），推理成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: 压力聚焦蒸馏可将黑箱神经控制器转化为适用于实时部署的轻量、可审计规则型替代模型，同时揭示了确定性动作和拓扑特定泛化的风险。

papers.title: Richer Representations for Neural Algorithmic Reasoning via Auxiliary Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Neural algorithmic reasoning has emerged as a popular research direction. It aims to train neural networks to mimic the step-by-step behavior of classical rule-based algorithms. More specifically, the execution of such algorithms can be abstracted as a sequence of states, where each state represents the intermediate outcome after an execution step. The training objective is to generate state sequences that replicate the underlying algorithmic process. A common framework for this task adopts an encoder-processor-decoder architecture, where the encoder learns representations of states, the processor simulates algorithmic steps, and the decoder reconstructs output states. While prior work has focused on improving the processor, the role of the encoder in representation learning has received little attention. Most methods rely on simple MLP encoders, raising the question of whether such representations are sufficiently informative for supporting algorithmic reasoning. This paper investigates how to improve encoder representations for neural algorithmic reasoning. We propose a reconstruction module that aims to recover the input state from its encoded representation. This auxiliary reconstruction task encourages the encoder to retain critical information about the input. We demonstrate that incorporating this task during training improves the performance of existing neural architectures on standard benchmarks. Furthermore, we observe that current encoders often underutilize the correlations among features within a state. To address this, we draw inspiration from self-supervised learning and design an enhanced variant of the auxiliary task that encourages the encoder to capture intra-state feature dependencies. Experimental results show that our method enables the encoder to learn richer representations, thereby enhancing the performance of existing processors on algorithmic reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络算法推理中编码器表示的学习问题。现有方法多使用简单的MLP编码器，可能信息不足。作者提出辅助重建任务，通过从编码表示中重建输入状态来迫使编码器保留关键信息，并受自监督学习启发，设计增强变体以捕捉状态内部特征依赖。实验表明该方法能学习更丰富的表示，提升现有处理器在标准基准上的表现。
Motivation: 现有神经网络算法推理工作主要改进处理器，而编码器（常为简单MLP）的表示学习被忽视，可能不足以支持算法推理。
Method: 提出辅助重建任务：从编码表示中重建输入状态，并设计增强变体利用自监督学习思想鼓励编码器捕捉状态内部特征依赖。
Result: 摘要报告该方法提升了现有神经架构在标准算法推理基准上的性能，并学到了更丰富的表示。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过辅助重建改进编码器表示可以有效增强处理器在算法推理任务上的表现。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Noise Adaptation: Transferring Knowledge from Noise Domain
papers.abstract_en: Transfer learning aims to facilitate the learning of a target domain by transferring knowledge from a source domain. The source domain typically contains semantically meaningful samples (*e.g.*, images) to facilitate effective knowledge transfer. However, a recent study observes that the noise domain constructed from simple distributions (*e.g.*, Gaussian distributions) can serve as a surrogate source domain in the semi-supervised setting, where only a small proportion of target samples are labeled while most remain unlabeled. Based on this surprising observation, we formulate a novel problem termed *Semi-Supervised Noise Adaptation* (SSNA), which aims to leverage a synthetic noise domain to improve the generalization of the target domain. To address this problem, we first establish a generalization bound characterizing the effect of the noise domain on generalization, based on which we propose a Noise Adaptation Framework (NAF). Extensive experiments demonstrate that NAF effectively leverages the noise domain to tighten the generalization bound of the target domain, leading to improved performance. The codes are available at https://github.com/AIResearch-Group/SSNA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出半监督噪声适应（SSNA）问题，利用合成噪声域作为源域，通过噪声适应框架（NAF）提升目标域泛化性能。理论分析给出泛化界，实验表明NAF能有效收紧泛化界并改善性能。
Motivation: 传统迁移学习依赖语义有意义的源域，但近期发现噪声域在半监督设置中可作为替代源域。本文旨在形式化并解决如何利用合成噪声域提升半监督目标域泛化的问题。
Method: 首先建立噪声域影响目标域泛化的理论泛化界，基于此提出噪声适应框架（NAF），通过设计特定机制利用噪声域来收紧泛化界。
Result: 大量实验表明NAF有效利用噪声域收紧目标域泛化界，并提升性能。
Conclusion: 噪声域可作为半监督学习中的有效源域，NAF为利用噪声域提供了理论和实践方案。

papers.title: Normalized Relevance Measure as a Unifying Framework to Explain Neural Network Latent Structures
papers.abstract_en: To understand how a neural network (NN) functions and makes predictions, it has become increasingly clear that analyzing only the input domain is insufficient -- one must also examine its internal inference mechanisms to capture the complete picture. To explain the internal inference mechanisms of such models, it is essential to analyze the importance of latent representations for a given task. In this paper, we propose the \emph{normalized relevance measure} (NRM) framework -- a novel general explanation procedure that attributes relevance to \emph{arbitrary sets of neurons across layers of arbitrary architectures}. In the NRM framework, relevance of selected neurons is explicitly defined as a normalized signed measure, constructed using simple operations -- marginalization and conditioning based on additive and multiplicative laws -- in analogy to the probability measures. The normalization property further guarantees comparability across layers. The NRM framework subsumes existing propagation-based explanation algorithms by explicitly identifying the underlying quantity being computed. We demonstrate the utility of the framework in computer vision applications, where joint relevance analysis across multiple layers reveals key information flows in VGG16 networks. Overall, the NRM framework provides a general, mathematically grounded approach to understanding how modern NNs propagate information, offering a versatile and broadly applicable foundation for explainable artificial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出归一化相关度量（NRM）框架，用于解释神经网络中任意层任意神经元集合的重要性。NRM通过类似概率测度的边缘化和条件化操作定义归一化符号度量，确保跨层可比性，并统一了现有传播解释算法。在VGG16上的计算机视觉应用展示了跨层联合分析揭示关键信息流。
Motivation: 仅分析输入域不足以理解神经网络内部推理机制，需要解释潜在表示的重要性。
