papers.title: Improving Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing via Cluster-Guided Refinement and Model Ensemble Voting
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding aims to locate image regions that correspond to natural language descriptions and is a key component of interpretable vision systems. In remote sensing imagery, grounding is particularly challenging due to complex scenes, small objects, and large variations in scale. Relying on a single model is often insufficient to address these diverse challenges. In this work, we propose two grounding pipelines, Sequential Grounding Refinement (SGR) and Cluster-Aware Grounding Refinement (CGR), that combine the complementary strengths of RemoteSAM, a visual grounding model specialized for remote sensing, and SAM3, a powerful general-purpose segmentation model. Our approach first uses RemoteSAM to obtain an initial estimate of object location, which is then refined using SAM3 to produce more accurate and spatially consistent segmentations. Additionally, we explore an ensemble strategy based on majority voting across six diverse grounding pipelines, each with distinct capabilities. This multi-model framework improves robustness and significantly enhances localization accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed pipelines and ensemble approach outperform individual models, leading to more reliable and precise visual grounding predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像中的视觉定位问题，提出两种流水线：顺序定位细化（SGR）和聚类感知定位细化（CGR），结合遥感专用模型RemoteSAM和通用分割模型SAM3，通过初始定位再细化的方式提升分割精度。此外，采用基于多数投票的集成策略，组合六种不同的定位流水线，显著提高定位鲁棒性和准确性。
Motivation: 遥感图像中场景复杂、目标小、尺度变化大，单一模型无法应对这些挑战，需要结合互补能力的模型。
Method: 提出SGR和CGR流水线：先用RemoteSAM获得初始定位估计，再用SAM3进行细化以获得更精确、空间一致的分割。同时，集成六个不同流水线的预测结果，通过多数投票进行最终预测。
Result: 实验表明，所提流水线和集成方法优于单个模型，实现了更可靠、更精确的视觉定位预测。
Conclusion: 本文证明了在遥感视觉定位中，通过模型互补和集成投票能有效提升性能，为多模型协作提供了实用范式。

papers.title: CAFOSat: A Strongly Annotated Dataset for Infrastructure-Aware CAFO Mapping Using High-Resolution Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Concentrated Animal Feeding Operations (CAFOs) play an important role in agricultural production but are also associated with environmental, public health, and disease surveillance concerns. Large-scale mapping of CAFOs from remote sensing imagery remains challenging due to heterogeneous infrastructure layouts, noisy location records, inconsistent annotations, and incomplete inventories. We introduce CAFOSat, a strongly annotated, infrastructure-aware dataset for CAFO mapping across the United States. CAFOSat integrates high-resolution National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP) imagery with multi-source CAFO inventories collected across multiple states and transforms weak geolocation records into refined annotations through a human-in-the-loop pipeline combining AI-assisted annotation, GradCAM-based localization, and geometric clustering. To improve dataset quality, we curate challenging negative samples using land-cover-guided sampling with spatial exclusion constraints and provide infrastructure-level annotations, including barns, manure ponds, and grazing-related features, through manual verification. The resulting dataset contains more than 45,000 image patches spanning 20 states and four major CAFO categories. We benchmark a diverse set of convolutional, transformer-based, and vision-language models, demonstrating the value of refined annotations and curated negative samples for CAFO classification and generalization. In addition, we introduce a synthetic augmentation pipeline that generates infrastructure-aware variations to increase training diversity and improve robustness under distribution shifts. CAFOSat provides a large-scale benchmark for advancing infrastructure-aware agricultural monitoring and CAFO mapping from high-resolution remote sensing imagery.
papers.comment: Accepted at CVPR Workshop-2026. First two authors has equal contribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了CAFOSat数据集，用于从高分辨率遥感图像中映射集中动物饲养操作（CAFO）。该数据集整合了多源CAFO清单和高分辨率NAIP影像，通过人工辅助标注、GradCAM定位和几何聚类将弱地理位置记录转化为精细标注，并包含超过45,000个图像块覆盖20个州。作者还基准测试了多种卷积、Transformer和视觉语言模型，证明了精细标注和精心挑选的负样本的价值。
Motivation: 大规模CAFO映射面临异质基础设施布局、噪声位置记录、不一致标注和不完整清单等挑战。
Method: 提出了一个包含AI辅助标注、GradCAM定位和几何聚类的人类在环流程，将弱地理记录转化为精细标注；并采用土地覆盖引导采样和空间排除约束来策划挑战性负样本；还引入合成增强流水线生成基础设施感知变体。
Result: 数据集包含超过45,000个图像块，覆盖20个州和四个主要CAFO类别。基准测试显示精细标注和负样本对分类和泛化的价值。
Conclusion: CAFOSat为从高分辨率遥感图像推进基础设施感知农业监测和CAFO映射提供了大规模基准。

papers.title: The Assistant as a Privileged Persona: A canonical reference in cross-persona self-recognition
papers.abstract_en: Post-trained language models can recognize their own outputs from a sentence or two out of context. In a companion paper \citep{jack2026twomodes} we showed they can also recognize when they are currently acting on-policy, through the sharp entropy drop of assistant-mode generation. Both signals are tied to the Assistant persona that post-training mainly shapes. This paper widens the frame to cross-persona authorship judgement on Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct. We measure a matrix of authorship claim rates over a panel of evaluator and generator personas spanning librarian to dragon to Shakespeare, and make two claims. \emph{First}, on the Assistant's own row of the matrix, the Assistant's claim rate, the persona-vector distance from the Assistant in activation space, and the entropy gap between the Assistant's surprise on a persona's text and the persona's surprise on its own text are all tightly coupled. This extends the entropy signature of \emph{acting} from the companion paper to a retrospective signature of \emph{having acted}. \emph{Second}, this coupling fails off the Assistant's row: the natural symmetric extension of the entropy gap does not predict authorship for distinctive evaluators (pirate, dragon, Shakespeare); what does is asymmetric -- the evaluator's surprise compared to the Assistant's surprise on the same text, not to the generator's. We rule out the alternative that any persona could play this reference role by trying many candidate substitutes; none does. We interpret the asymmetry as the model performing an implicit Bayesian likelihood-ratio test against the Assistant as the canonical alternative hypothesis, with the persona-vector geometry of \citet{chen2025persona} (every persona a delta off the Assistant) ensuring that the Assistant is the only persona universally accessible to that test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究后训练语言模型在跨角色身份识别中的表现，以Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct为对象，测量不同角色（如图书管理员、龙、莎士比亚）之间的作者归属率矩阵。研究发现，助理角色的自认率、激活空间中的角色向量距离与熵差高度耦合，但这种耦合仅在助理行内成立；其他角色则表现出不对称性，即评估者的惊讶度相对于助理的惊讶度能预测归属，而相对于生成者的惊讶度则不能。论文将这种不对称解释为模型在隐式进行贝叶斯似然比检验，以助理为标准备择假设。
Motivation: 现有研究表明后训练语言模型能识别自身输出，但跨角色身份识别中的不对称性及其机制尚不明确，需探究角色间判断的对称性是否成立。
Method: 在Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct上构建角色面板（如管理员、龙、莎士比亚等），测量作者归属率矩阵，分析助理行内的熵差、角色向量距离与自认率的关联，并测试其他角色作为参考的替代方案。
Result: 助理行内，自认率、角色向量距离与熵差紧密耦合；其他角色则显示不对称性：评估者相对于助理的惊讶度预测归属，而非相对于生成者。尝试多种候选参考角色均失败，表明助理是唯一普遍适用的参考。
Conclusion: 模型在跨角色身份判断中隐含地将助理作为规范参考，利用贝叶斯似然比检验机制，且角色几何结构（每个角色为助理的偏移）确保此参考的普适性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Escaping the Mode Lottery: Multi-Response Training Improves Language Model Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Modern language-model fine-tuning typically pairs each prompt with a single response, even though many prompts admit multiple valid completions. This effectively reduces a multi-modal conditional distribution to a one-sample view, a phenomenon we call the "mode lottery," where training emphasizes a subset of plausible modes while leaving others underrepresented. We study multi-response training (MRT), which retains multiple responses per prompt, and develop a principled account of when and why it helps. Our key insight is that prompts and responses are distinct statistical resources: additional prompts reduce uncertainty about the input distribution, while additional responses reduce uncertainty about the conditional output distribution. This yields a variance-budget tradeoff that predicts when retaining multiple responses is worthwhile, shows diminishing returns as prompt-level uncertainty dominates, and explains why large redundant corpora can exhibit an implicit multi-response effect. We further analyze response selection, and show that Random-K-of-N is the unbiased default for distributional fine-tuning, reward-based selection can induce mode collapse, and a submodular quality-diversity objective provides an efficient alternative with theoretical guarantees. Controlled simulations validate the predicted variance and selection effects, including a striking failure mode where reward-only selection produces gradients misaligned with the true objective. Across structured and real-world datasets, including a new multi-prompt, multi-response benchmark, MRT consistently improves distributional generalization, with the largest gains in high response-diversity, low prompt-redundancy regimes. MRT reframes response multiplicity as a data-allocation problem with clear guidance: when responses are cheap and diverse, keeping more than one is not a heuristic, but a statistically grounded choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型微调中的“模式彩票”问题，即单响应训练忽略多模态条件分布中的多数模式。提出多响应训练（MRT）并建立理论框架，证明额外响应减少条件输出分布的不确定性，而额外提示减少输入分布的不确定性，形成方差-预算权衡。分析响应选择策略，指出随机K-of-N无偏、奖励选择可能导致模式崩塌、子模质量-多样性目标提供高效替代。模拟和真实数据实验表明MRT提升分布泛化，尤其在响应多样高、提示冗余低的场景。
Motivation: 语言模型微调通常每个提示只配对单个响应，但许多提示允许多个有效完成，这导致多模态条件分布被简化为单样本视角，称为“模式彩票”，使得训练强调部分模式而忽略其他模式。
Method: 提出多响应训练（MRT），保留每个提示的多个响应。理论分析提示和响应作为不同统计资源：提示减少输入分布不确定性，响应减少条件输出分布不确定性，导出方差-预算权衡。分析三种响应选择策略：随机K-of-N、奖励选择和子模质量-多样性目标。
Result: 模拟验证了预测的方差和选择效应，包括奖励选择导致梯度与真实目标错位的失败模式。在结构化和真实数据集上，MRT持续提升分布泛化，最大增益出现在高响应多样性、低提示冗余场景。
Conclusion: 多响应训练将响应多样性重新定义为数据分配问题，并给出清晰指导：当响应廉价且多样时，保留多个响应不是启发式，而是统计上有根据的选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ETC: Extreme Token Compression via Task-aware Visual Information Distillation in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: In Vision-Language Models (VLMs), high-resolution images produce a large number of visual tokens, resulting in high computational costs and KV-cache overhead during inference. To address this problem, we propose an Extreme Token Compression (ETC) framework that minimizes task loss when reducing the number of input tokens based on the principle of variational information distillation. Specifically, from an information-theoretic perspective, we show that minimizing task loss requires the compact representation to preserve the instruction-aware sufficient statistic of the task-relevant visual information for prediction. In practice, ETC leverages text-to-image cross-attention to weight the original visual features to approximate the latent instruction-aware predictive statistic. Moreover, ETC introduces a variational information distillation, enabling the compact representation to preserve the essential information to recover this predictive statistic. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-2B show that ETC remains effective even under single-token compression, substantially reducing KV-cache overhead while retaining strong task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ETC 框架针对视觉语言模型（VLMs）中高分辨率图像产生大量视觉 token 导致的高计算成本问题，基于变分信息蒸馏原理，通过最小化任务损失来压缩输入 token 数量。该方法利用文本-图像交叉注意力加权原始视觉特征以近似指令感知的预测统计量，并引入变分信息蒸馏使紧凑表示保留恢复该统计量的必要信息。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-2B 上的实验表明，ETC 即使在单 token 压缩下仍能显著降低 KV-cache 开销并保持任务性能。
Motivation: 高分辨率图像在 VLMs 中产生大量视觉 token，导致推理时高计算成本和 KV-cache 开销，现有方法在极端压缩下任务性能下降严重。
Method: 提出 ETC 框架：从信息论角度证明最小化任务损失需紧凑表示保留指令感知的充分统计量；实践中通过文本-图像交叉注意力加权原始特征近似该统计量，并采用变分信息蒸馏使紧凑表示保留恢复统计量的必要信息。

papers.title: GNMR: Runtime Stability Control for Low-Precision Large Language Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Training stability is a key bottleneck in low-precision language model training: efficient low-cost paths can still produce short-lived numerical risks at a small set of operators. We formulate this as runtime stability control and present Gradient Norm-to-Mean Ratio (GNMR), a lightweight controller that compares each recoverable unit's current gradient norm with its historical mean. Together with $Δ$-GNMR for abrupt short-window increases, GNMR maps local risk signals to bounded recovery actions under a hard $\mathrm{maxO}$ budget and a short lock interval, without changing the numerical format, kernel, or backend recipe. Across activation-quantization stress, DeepSeek-style recipe-level training, and LLaMA-2 13B fine-tuning, GNMR preserves high-fidelity quality with sparse, budgeted recovery. These results support GNMR as a backend-agnostic controller to improve low-precision training stability while preserving low-cost execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GNMR（梯度范数与均值比）和Δ-GNMR（短窗口突然增加），一种运行时稳定性控制器，用于低精度大语言模型训练。GNMR通过比较每个可恢复单元的当前梯度范数与其历史均值，在硬maxO预算和短锁间隔内执行有界恢复动作，无需改变数值格式或内核。在激活量化应力、DeepSeek风格训练和LLaMA-2 13B微调上，GNMR保持高保真质量，且恢复稀疏、预算内。
Motivation: 低精度语言模型训练的稳定性是关键瓶颈，高效低成本路径仍可能在一小部分算子上产生短暂的数值风险。
Method: 提出GNMR控制器，计算每个可恢复单元的当前梯度范数与历史均值之比，并结合Δ-GNMR检测短窗口内的突然增加。将局部风险信号映射到有界恢复动作，在硬maxO预算和短锁间隔内执行，不改变数值格式、内核或后端方案。
Result: 在激活量化应力、DeepSeek风格配方级训练和LLaMA-2 13B微调中，GNMR以稀疏、预算化的恢复保持高保真质量。
Conclusion: GNMR作为后端无关的控制器，可提高低精度训练稳定性，同时保持低成本执行。

papers.title: DREAM-S: Speculative Decoding with Searchable Drafting and Target-Aware Refinement for Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding (SD) has proven to be an effective technique for accelerating autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) however, its application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains relatively unexplored. We propose~\textit{DREAM-S}, a novel SD framework designed specifically for fast and efficient decoding in VLMs. DREAM-S leverages a neural architecture search (NAS) framework with target-aware supernet training to automatically identify both the optimal interaction strategy between the draft and target models, and the most suitable draft model architecture for the underlying hardware implementation platform. DREAM-S additionally incorporates adaptive intermediate feature distillation, guided by attention entropy, to enable efficient draft training. Experiments on a range of well-established VLMs show that DREAM-S achieves up to a $3.85\times$ speedup compared to standard decoding approaches and significantly outperforms existing SD baselines. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/DREAM-S .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DREAM-S，一种专门用于视觉语言模型（VLM）的推测解码框架。它通过神经架构搜索（NAS）自动寻找最优的草稿与目标模型交互策略及草稿模型架构，并利用基于注意力熵的中间特征蒸馏进行高效训练。在多个VLM上实现最高3.85倍加速，显著优于现有SD基线。
Motivation: 推测解码在大型语言模型中已成功应用，但在视觉语言模型上的探索尚不充分，现有方法未充分利用架构搜索与目标感知优化。
Method: 采用神经架构搜索（NAS）框架进行目标感知超网络训练，自动确定草稿与目标模型的最优交互策略及草稿模型架构，并引入基于注意力熵的适应性中间特征蒸馏以提升训练效率。
Result: 在多个主流VLM上，DREAM-S相比标准解码方法取得最高3.85倍加速，并显著超越现有推测解码基线。代码已开源。
Conclusion: DREAM-S有效加速VLM自回归生成，与硬件平台相关的架构搜索和蒸馏策略是核心贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KACE: Knowledge-Adaptive Context Engineering for Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Context engineering can improve large language models without updating their weights, but mathematical reasoning exposes a key limitation: feedback accumulated in one growing prompt causes context bloat and limits the amount of learned guidance that can be used. Existing methods often conflate storage, what is learned across runs, with usage, what is included for a particular problem, and therefore inherit this prompt-size ceiling. We introduce Knowledge-Adaptive Context Engineering (KACE), which separates storage from usage through difficulty- and domain-based organization. Offline, a self-reflective learning loop distills training traces into an epistemic tree: a knowledge base of typed cards stratified by problem difficulty and epistemic domain. Each card is assigned to the difficulty-domain node corresponding to the failure from which it originated. At evaluation time, tiered self-consistency with per-tier agreement gates dynamically classifies each problem as easy, medium, or hard. Easy problems exit without retrieved cards, while harder problems retrieve only the matching branch of the tree. This tiered scheme matches or exceeds Best-of-N while using comparable compute, and it classifies problem difficulty with 78 percent pairwise concordance. The main empirical contribution is the construction and use of a difficulty- and domain-stratified knowledge base enabled by tiered self-consistency. On AIME 2025, KACE achieves 62.2 percent accuracy, a 10.4-point absolute gain over fixed Best-of-5 self-consistency at a comparable solver-call budget and a 5.6-point gain over the strongest learned-context baseline, Tiered + GEPA. We also observe consistent gains on MATH-HARD and the verifiable subset of OlymMATH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识自适应上下文工程 (KACE)，将存储与使用分离，通过难度和领域分层的知识库来改进大语言模型的数学推理能力。离线阶段用自反思学习循环将训练轨迹蒸馏为认知树，在线阶段用分层自一致性动态分类问题难度。在AIME 2025上达到62.2%准确率，比固定Best-of-5自一致性高10.4个点。
Motivation: 数学推理中，累积反馈导致的上下文膨胀限制了学习指导的使用量，且现有方法混淆了存储和与使用，受限于提示长度。
Method: KACE：离线构建认知树，按难度和领域分层存储卡片；在线用分层自一致性（按难度门控）动态分类问题，仅对难问题检索对应分支。
Result: 在AIME 2025上，KACE达到62.2%准确率，比固定Best-of-5自一致性高10.4个点，比最强学习上下文基线Tiered+GEPA高5.6个点；在MATH-HARD和OlymMATH可验证子集上也有一致提升。问题难度分类的成对一致性为78%。
Conclusion: KACE通过分层知识库和难度感知检索，在相当计算预算下匹配或超过Best-of-N，展示了分离存储与使用的有效性。

papers.title: An Effective Solution for the CVPR 2026 8th UG2+ Challenge Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present our solution for the 8th UG2+ Challenge (CVPR 2026) Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence (DOST). Our method is built upon the strong baseline framework Segment Any Motion (SegAnyMo), which provides powerful mask generation and motion tracking capabilities. To further boost the segmentation performance under severe atmospheric distortions, we propose two key improvements. First, we employ a data-centric domain adaptation strategy. We significantly expand our training data by incorporating selected sequences from the DAVIS dataset alongside a subset of the DOST dataset, and apply simulated atmospheric fluctuation degradations to enhance the model's robustness against complex geometric distortions. Second, we introduce a spatio-temporal post-processing module. This refinement step effectively removes persistent boundary-connected false foregrounds and short-lived fragmented noise, while strictly preserving genuine small targets and maintaining original individual labels across frames. With these combined strategies, our proposed method ranks the 2st place in the challenge.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, CVPR 2026 8th UG2+ Challenge Track 3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CVPR 2026第8届UG2+挑战赛Track 3：湍流中动态目标分割（DOST）问题，提出基于Segment Any Motion（SegAnyMo）框架的改进方案。通过数据中心的领域自适应策略，利用DAVIS和DOST数据集的子集并施加模拟大气波动退化来增强鲁棒性，并引入时空后处理模块去除边界连接假前景和短时噪声。最终在挑战中获得第二名。
Motivation: 大气湍流导致动态目标分割性能下降，现有方法在严重几何失真下难以保持准确。
Method: 基于SegAnyMo基线，采用数据增强：从DAVIS和DOST数据集选取序列并模拟大气波动退化；引入时空后处理模块，去除持久边界假前景和短时碎片噪声，同时保留小目标和原始标签。
Result: 在UG2+ Challenge Track 3中排名第2。
Conclusion: 所提数据领域适应和时空后处理有效提升了湍流条件下的动态目标分割性能。

papers.title: In-Expectation Convergence of Stochastic Gradient Methods under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: Many stochastic gradient methods are believed not to converge when the noise in stochastic gradients has only a finite $p$-th moment for $p\in\left(1,2\right)$, a setting known as the heavy-tailed noise assumption. However, some recent studies have found that Stochastic Gradient Descent ($\textsf{SGD}$), without any modification to its update rule, can surprisingly converge in expectation for convex problems with bounded domains, highlighting the potential of classical stochastic gradient methods. Inspired by this recent progress, we provide a comprehensive study of stochastic optimization under heavy-tailed noise and establish new in-expectation convergence results for Stochastic Mirror Descent ($\textsf{SMD}$) and Accelerated Stochastic Mirror Descent ($\textsf{ASMD}$) in convex optimization, and for $\textsf{SGD}$ and Stochastic Gradient Descent with Momentum ($\textsf{SGDM}$) in nonconvex optimization. Notably, our results not only hold without algorithmic changes but also avoid restrictive assumptions, such as bounded domains, imposed in prior work. More importantly, our analysis provides a new, elegant, and powerful framework for studying heavy-tailed stochastic optimization, opening a new route to understanding first-order stochastic gradient methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究重尾噪声下随机梯度方法的期望收敛性，证明SMD和ASMD在凸优化中以及SGD和SGDM在非凸优化中无需修改算法即可收敛，且不要求有界域等限制。提出新的分析框架，为理解重尾随机优化开辟了新途径。
Motivation: 现有观点认为当随机梯度噪声仅有有限p阶矩（p∈(1,2)）时，随机梯度方法不收敛；但近期发现SGD在凸有界域下可收敛。本文旨在更广泛设定下探索经典方法的重尾收敛性。
Method: 提出统一的分析框架，分别证明SMD和ASMD（凸优化）以及SGD和SGDM（非凸优化）在期望意义下的收敛性，不依赖算法修改或有界域假设。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，仅声称建立的新收敛结果避免了先前工作中的有界域等限制。
Conclusion: 本文为理解重尾随机优化提供了新框架，开辟了研究一阶随机梯度方法的新途径。

papers.title: Acting with AI: An Interaction-Based Framework for Agentic Tort Liability
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems can plan over multiple steps, use tools, and execute tasks over time. When such systems cause harm, tort law struggles to allocate responsibility because the harmful path may be neither fully chosen by the user nor specifically foreseen by the developer. This paper proposes an interaction-based framework for agentic torts, drawing on Michael Bratman's planning theory and on the common law's treatment of human-human concerted action. We distinguish three interaction types: autonomous drift, pure tool use, and collaborative planning. Pure tool cases remain governed by ordinary product-defect and warning doctrines; collaborative planning cases map onto the independent contractor control test, professional malpractice, and negligent misrepresentation; autonomous drift maps onto frolic and detour under respondeat superior and strict product liability. The framework treats the stateful interaction log as the primary evidentiary trace, allowing courts to infer where the human-AI trajectory departed from the authorized undertaking and where liability should attach. We resolve four incident-anchored cases, situate the account alongside strict-liability and insurance-based proposals, note its relationship to regulatory oversight, and propose a ``Reasonable Agent'' standard built around constraint verification, epistemic transparency, runtime grounding, and forensic logging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于Bratman规划理论及普通法中的人类共同行为处理，为智能体AI系统侵权责任提出一个基于交互类型的框架。将人机交互分为自主漂移、纯工具使用和协作规划三类，并分别对应不同的归责原则。
Motivation: 当智能体AI系统在多步规划、使用工具和执行任务过程中造成损害时，现行侵权法难以分配责任，因为损害路径既非用户完全选择也非开发者具体预见。
Method: 区分三种人机交互类型（自主漂移、纯工具使用、协作规划），将每种类型映射至现有侵权法原则（如独立承包人控制测试、职业过失、转承责任中的frolic and detour等），并以有状态交互日志作为主要证据链。
Result: 通过四个案例分析了框架的应用，并提出了“合理智能体”标准，包括约束验证、认识透明度、运行时接地和法医记录。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种将AI代理行为归责的法律路径，与严格责任和保险方案互补，并强调交互日志作为证据的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Threshold-Based Exclusive Batching for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Mixed batching (MB)--interleaving prefill and decode in a single batch--has become the standard scheduling strategy for large language model (LLM) inference due to its efficiency in maximizing compute and memory utilization. However, through controlled experiments, we find that prefill-decode interference inflates MB's per-step marginal cost above that of pure decode. On the high-bandwidth H200 (4.8 TB/s), this occurs only when decode tokens exceed 80% of the batch; however, on the bandwidth-constrained RTX PRO 6000 (1.792 TB/s), this threshold plummets to just 20%. Consequently, the optimal choice between MB and exclusive batching (EB) fundamentally depends on GPU memory bandwidth, model size, and workload composition. We derive a closed-form condition for this EB-MB performance crossover, along with asymptotically optimal phase-switching thresholds and memory-safe batch sizing for EB. Optimized EB achieves up to 41.9% higher throughput on bandwidth-constrained GPUs, while MB retains its advantage on high-bandwidth hardware with larger models. Our hybrid scheduler EB+ applies this condition online to dynamically switch between EB and MB without manual intervention. Under non-stationary traffic with distribution or concurrency shifts, EB+ attains the highest or near-highest throughput in every setting, outperforming MB by up to 36.4%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型推理中混合批处理（MB）与独占批处理（EB）的性能权衡。实验发现，预填充与解码的干扰会导致MB的边际成本高于纯解码，且该效应的阈值取决于GPU显存带宽。基于此，作者推导了EB-MB性能交叉点的闭式条件，并提出了自适应混合调度器EB+，在动态工作负载下实现了高达36.4%的吞吐量提升。
Motivation: 混合批处理在LLM推理中广泛使用，但预填充与解码之间的干扰可能降低效率。现有研究缺乏对这种干扰的系统分析和最优批处理策略的指导。
Method: 通过控制实验分析预填充-解码干扰的阈值条件，推导EB-MB性能交叉点的闭式解，并提出在线混合调度器EB+，根据闭式条件动态切换EB与MB。
Result: 在带宽受限的GPU上，优化后的EB可提升吞吐量高达41.9%；EB+在非平稳流量下优于MB最多36.4%，且在各种设置中达到最高或接近最高吞吐量。
Conclusion: 最佳批处理策略取决于GPU带宽、模型大小和工作负载组成，EB+提供了一种无需手动干预的在线自适应方案。

papers.title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation demands both high-level semantic reasoning and the safe regulation of high-frequency contact dynamics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide unprecedented semantic generalization, their low-rate outputs lack the reliability required for direct plant authority in force-sensitive tasks. To bridge this semantic-to-control gap, we introduce PaCo-VLA, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface. Rather than trusting VLAs with direct motor commands, PaCo-VLA treats network outputs as task-level compliance proposals: semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules. A high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield governs these proposals through energy-tank accounting and boundary checks, preventing invalid, stale, or unverified model predictions from bypassing low-level contact physics. This decoupled architecture also enables causal evaluation, isolating semantic contributions from geometric shortcuts. Extensive simulated and real-world connector-insertion experiments demonstrate that PaCo-VLA achieves superior precision over unshielded VLA baselines, sustaining zero passivity violations even under adversarial compliance shifts. This framework establishes a provably sampled-passive runtime contract at the admittance port and provides a runtime interface for deploying foundation models in contact-rich domains.
papers.comment: Under review, code will be available soon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PaCo-VLA，一种被动屏蔽合规先验（passivity-shielded compliance prior），用于接触丰富的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）操作。它把 VLA 网络输出视作任务级合规建议（compliance proposals），通过能量罐核算（energy-tank accounting）和边界检查来阻止无效或过时的预测绕过底层接触物理。在仿真和真实世界的连接器插入实验中，PaCo-VLA 相比无屏蔽的 VLA 基线实现了更高的精度，并在对抗性合规偏移下保持零被动性违规（zero passivity violations）。
Motivation: VLA 模型虽提供语义泛化能力，但其低频输出在力敏任务中缺乏直接控制所需的可靠性；需要弥合语义到控制之间的鸿沟，确保接触丰富的操作既安全又精确。
Method: 提出 PaCo-VLA 框架，将 VLA 预测重构为任务级合规建议（包括语义绑定、任务阶段和接纳调度），并用一个高频的、独立于建议的被动屏蔽模块通过能量罐核算与边界检查来监管这些建议，防止无效或未经验证的模型输出影响底层接触动力学。同时，该解耦架构支持因果评估，可分离语义贡献与几何捷径。
Result: 在连接器插入任务（仿真和真实环境）中，PaCo-VLA 比无屏蔽的 VLA 基线取得更优的精度，并在对抗性合规偏移下维持零被动性违规。
Conclusion: 该框架在接纳端口（admittance port）建立了可证明的采样被动运行时合约（sampled-passive runtime contract），为在接触丰富领域部署基础模型提供了一种可靠的运行时接口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generate in Reconstruction Space, Match in Semantic Space: Transport Geometry for One-Step Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling and self-supervised representation learning (SSL) optimize structurally different objectives: generative training rewards distributional fidelity, while SSL rewards semantic coherence. Yet recent work repeatedly finds that SSL features improve generative training, though the mechanism of this synergy remains unclear. Here, we study the benefits of SSL in generative modeling in the framework of one-step generation where the role of representation is explicit: frozen SSL features are used to match generated samples to real data. We use the Sinkhorn divergence in that feature space, providing a tractable surrogate for the Wasserstein distance, the population-level discrepancy approximated by Fréchet-style evaluation metrics (such as FID). We find that this objective becomes highly effective when computed in a semantically structured SSL feature space (a 39$\times$ reduction in ImageNet FID). We trace this behavior primarily to matching estimation: semantic SSL features that suppress nuisance reconstruction details induce a more compact geometry, making distribution matching more tractable. As a consequence, the best training SSL features need not match the features used by the evaluation metric. In particular, we show that using Inception as the feature extractor can improve FID while degrading matching stability and sample quality, revealing a form of metric hacking. Using extensive experiments on ImageNet, we identify which SSL feature families lead to best generation performance and show that matching stability is a quantitative criterion for selecting them. Code is available at https://github.com/Genentech/semantic-transport-generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自监督表示学习（SSL）在一步生成模型中的作用，提出在语义化的SSL特征空间中使用Sinkhorn散度作为Wasserstein距离的替代，以匹配生成样本与真实数据。实验表明该方法在ImageNet上将FID降低39倍，并揭示使用Inception特征提取器可能引发度量欺骗（metric hacking）。
Motivation: 生成模型与SSL的目标不同，但SSL特征常能提升生成训练效果，其机制尚不明确。本文旨在一步生成框架下研究SSL特征的效用，特别是语义特征空间对分布匹配的影响。
Method: 使用冻住的SSL特征，在特征空间中通过Sinkhorn散度（作为Wasserstein距离的可计算替代）匹配生成样本与真实数据，该度量与FID等评价指标近似。
Result: 在ImageNet上，使用语义SSL特征空间使FID降低39倍；发现使用Inception特征提取器可改善FID但降低匹配稳定性和样本质量，揭示度量欺骗现象。
Conclusion: 语义SSL特征通过抑制无关重构细节、产生更紧凑的几何结构，使分布匹配更易处理。匹配稳定性可作为选择SSL特征族的定量标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Learning with Noisy Proxy Covariates: Generalization Bounds and Distribution Regression
papers.abstract_en: In many modern machine learning pipelines, abundant pretrained representations serve as noisy proxy covariates, while task-specific labels remain scarce. We study semi-supervised regression in this setting, and propose a simple two stage estimator that learns kernel eigenfeatures from all proxy covariates and fits a ridge predictor on labeled data. We derive finite sample bounds showing that fast labeled sample rates are recovered when proxy perturbation is controlled and unlabeled proxy covariates are sufficiently abundant. We also show that distribution regression is a direct special case, with analogous guarantees when the finite bag size is large enough. Experiments show consistent gains over supervised and semi-supervised baselines, especially in low label regimes.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究半监督回归场景，其中存在大量有噪声的预训练表示（代理协变量）但任务标签稀缺。提出两阶段估计器：先利用所有代理协变量学习核特征特征，再在带标签数据上拟合岭回归器。推导了有限样本界，表明当代理扰动受控且无标签代理协变量充足时，可恢复快标签样本率。分布回归是直接特例。实验在低标签率下一致优于监督和半监督基线。
Motivation: 实际中预训练表示丰富但标签稀缺，且表示可能含有噪声。现有半监督方法未充分利用这种带噪声的代理协变量结构，本文旨在理论上和算法上证明其有效性。
Method: 两阶段估计器：第一阶段从所有（有标签和无标签）代理协变量中计算核特征函数（kernel eigenfeatures）；第二阶段仅在带标签数据上使用这些特征进行岭回归（ridge prediction）。
Result: 理论证明当代理扰动受控且无标签样本足够多时，标签样本率的收敛速度接近监督学习的理想速率。实验在低标签率设置下，该方法在多个数据集上一致地提升预测性能，超过监督和半监督基线。
Conclusion: 本文表明在半监督回归中利用有噪声的代理协变量是可行且有效的，分布回归作为特例也有类似保证。未来工作可拓展至更复杂的代理模型或理论边界。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Saliency-Aware Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Model merging aims to consolidate multiple task-specific models fine-tuned on different datasets into a unified architecture that performs cross-domain proficiency. Current data-free model merging methods often struggle to scale as they rely on simple parameter-level heuristics that ignore inter-layer dependencies and non-uniform distribution of expertise. This work proposes SA-Merging, which is built upon connectivity-based saliency formulations from structural pruning (e.g., SynFlow) and extends them to the data-free model merging setting. We define a saliency score over task vectors relative to a shared base model, and further introduce merge-aware modulation that incorporates agreement across experts to mitigate task interference. Based on this formulation, an iterative saliency-aware merging procedure progressively removes non-informative updates while preserving end-to-end connectivity. Furthermore, we extend SA-Merging to introduce rank-wise saliency decomposition for LoRAs without compromising their structural integrity. Extensive experiments on vision and language tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our saliency-based approach, further reducing the gap between data-free and test-time adaptation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SA-Merging，一种基于连接性显著性（如SynFlow）的数据无关模型合并方法。该方法为任务向量定义显著性分数，并引入合并感知调制以缓解任务干扰，通过迭代过程移除不重要的更新。此外，SA-Merging扩展至LoRA的秩级显著性分解。实验表明，该方法在视觉和语言任务上有效，缩小了数据无关方法与测试时自适应方法之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有数据无关的模型合并方法依赖简单的参数级启发式，忽略层间依赖和专家知识的非均匀分布，难以扩展至大规模多任务场景。
Method: 基于结构性剪枝中的连通性显著性（如SynFlow），为任务向量定义显著性分数，并结合跨专家一致性引入合并感知调制。迭代地移除非信息性更新，同时保持端到端连通性。
Result: 在视觉和语言任务上的实验表明，SA-Merging有效提升了合并模型的性能，缩小了与测试时自适应方法之间的差距。
Conclusion: SA-Merging通过显著性引导和一致性调制，为数据无关模型合并提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，但摘要未提及在降水预测等领域的适用性。

papers.title: Skill or Skip? Learning Selective Skill Invocation in Agentic Tasks via Dual-Granularity Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are callable procedural modules that provide reusable knowledge and execution policies for complex agentic tasks. However, existing methods mainly focus on selecting relevant skills or improving the skills themselves, while overlooking whether a relevant skill should actually be invoked at the current decision point. Unhelpful invocations may introduce irrelevant context and disrupt an otherwise correct execution process. To address this issue, we propose SelSkill, a dual-granularity preference-learning framework for selective skill invocation. SelSkill formulates skill use as a skill-or-skip decision, uses predictive uncertainty to prioritize candidate decision points, and constructs controlled invoke-skip preference pairs from shared trajectory prefixes. It further combines episode-level outcome preferences with step-level invocation preferences to capture both overall trajectory quality and the local effectiveness of skill invocation. On ALFWorld with Qwen3-8B, SelSkill improves task success by 10.9 percentage points and execution precision by 29.1 percentage points. On BFCL, it improves task success by 5.7 percentage points and execution precision by 29.5 percentage points. Zero-shot results on Tau-bench and PopQA further suggest that the learned invocation policy transfers to new domains with previously unseen skills.

papers.title: Structure-Aware Consistency Priors for Shape from Polarization in Complex Media
papers.abstract_en: Recovering surface normals from single view polarization images in complex media remains challenging. This paper focuses on ice as a representative complex medium, where intricate light matter interactions lead to a nonlinear mapping between polarization observations and surface normals. To address this, a structure-aware polarization prior based on autocorrelation functions is proposed to capture the local spatial consistency of AoLP. Building on this, a dual-branch network (IceSfP) is designed to integrate raw polarization features with priors via cross modal attention and multi-scale feature fusion, enabling accurate surface normal estimation under complex media conditions. To evaluate the method, the first real-world ice SfP dataset is constructed. Experimental results show that the method outperforms existing approaches across all metrics, achieving a MAE of 16.01 deg, which is 2.74 deg lower than the second-best method. The framework provides a generalizable solution for high-precision geometric perception in complex media.

papers.title: V-LynX: Token Interface Alignment for Video+X LLMs
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces an intriguing phenomenon in Video LLMs: rather than merely translating frames into textual embeddings, Video LLMs establish a continuous manifold, token interface, allowing visual tokens to operate as standalone entities within the architecture. Exploiting this discovery, we propose V-LynX, a scalable framework that integrates novel modalities into Video LLMs by repurposing the internalized interface. Departing from conventional paradigms that necessitate heavy modality-specific encoders or paired supervision, V-LynX employs a lightweight auxiliary pathway in parallel with the frozen vision encoder. Our method integrates new sensory inputs with intrinsic video priors by aligning both attention responses and statistical distributions using unpaired unimodal data sets. This ensures manifold compatibility while preserving the integrity of the Video LLMs. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate that V-LynX achieves SOTA and efficiency across audio-visual QA, 3D reasoning, high-frame-rate, and multi-view video understanding. The code is available at https://github.com/park-jungin/lynx.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）中视觉token可作为独立实体在token接口上运作，并提出V-LynX框架，通过轻量辅助路径对齐注意力响应和统计分布，无需专用编码器或成对监督即可集成新模态。在音频-视觉问答、3D推理、高帧率和多视角视频理解任务上取得SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有视频大语言模型集成新模态通常需要重编码器或成对监督，效率低且扩展性差。本文从视觉token的独立实体现象出发，探索更高效的模态集成方式。
Method: V-LynX采用与冻结视觉编码器并行的轻量辅助路径，仅使用非成对单模态数据，通过对齐注意力响应和统计分布来兼容新模态与视频先验，保持模型完整性。
Result: 在音频-视觉QA、3D推理、高帧率和多视角视频理解等多个基准上达到SOTA，且效率优于传统方法。
Conclusion: V-LynX证明了通过token接口对齐可高效集成多模态，为视频大语言模型扩展提供可扩展框架。

papers.title: EnergyMamba: An Uncertainty-Aware Graph-Enhanced Selective State Space Model for Energy Consumption Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Energy consumption prediction is essential for efficient grid management, demand-side optimization, and sustainable energy planning. Although advanced machine learning methods have been employed for better prediction performance, existing works have two key limitations: (1) they usually formulate this task as a purely time-series prediction problem without explicitly modeling the spatial dependencies among different regions, and (2) they fail to provide reliable predictions with uncertainty estimates under abnormal situations such as extreme weather events. To advance existing research, we propose EnergyMamba, an uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal learning framework for accurate and reliable energy consumption prediction, which comprises two key components: (i) a novel Graph-Enhanced Selective State Space Model (GE-Mamba) that injects spatial context learned from the grid topology into the temporal dynamics, enabling coupled spatiotemporal modeling, and (ii) an Adaptive Sequential Conformalized Quantile Regression (AS-CQR) module, which includes locally adaptive normalization and an online feedback mechanism to dynamically calibrate prediction intervals under potential distribution shifts. We evaluate EnergyMamba on four large-scale real-world datasets from Florida, New York, and California. Results show EnergyMamba achieves around 5% improvement in prediction accuracy and 6% improvement in uncertainty quantification over 15 state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnergyMamba 是一个面向能源消耗预测的时空学习框架，结合图增强状态空间模型 (GE-Mamba) 和自适应序列分位数回归 (AS-CQR) 来同时建模空间依赖和时间动态，并提供不确定性估计。在佛罗里达、纽约和加利福尼亚的四个真实数据集上，预测精度提升约5%，不确定性量化提升约6%。
Motivation: 现有能耗预测方法通常仅作为纯时间序列问题处理，忽略了不同区域间的空间依赖，且在极端天气等异常情况下无法提供可靠预测及不确定性估计。
Method: 提出 EnergyMamba，包含两个关键组件：(1) 图增强选择性状态空间模型 (GE-Mamba)，通过电网拓扑注入空间上下文到时间动态中，实现时空联合建模；(2) 自适应序列共形分位数回归 (AS-CQR)，包括局部自适应归一化和在线反馈机制，动态校准预测区间以应对分布偏移。
Result: 在四个大规模真实数据集上，EnergyMamba 相比15个基线方法在预测精度上提升约5%，在不确定性量化上提升约6%。
Conclusion: EnergyMamba 通过显式建模空间依赖并提供不确定性估计，实现了更准确可靠的能耗预测，适用于电网管理和异常情况下的需求侧优化。

papers.title: TabChange: Precise Attribute Changes in Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Modifying an attribute in tabular data often introduces an unnatural instance by breaking its relationships with other attributes. The modified instance must be both natural and minimally changed from the original instance. This paper addresses the challenge of generating such a modified instance. We identify key limitations in existing approaches: generative models either don't support instance-level attribute editing or, in the case of methods like CVAE, retain attribute information in the latent space, leading to unnecessary modifications. To solve this, we propose TabChange, an approach that analyzes the relationship between the attribute of interest and other attributes in the dataset. If the relationship is weak, it simply flips the attribute; if it is strong, it uses an adversarial framework that removes information about the attribute in the latent space representation. This removal enables precise modifications, making only the necessary adjustments to maintain naturalness. Our experiments across seven datasets show that TabChange generates counterfactuals in attributes that are comparable in naturalness and are more proximal to their original instances. This leads to a higher number of valid counterfactuals and a lower number of invalid counterfactuals compared to the baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TabChange方法，用于在表格数据中精确修改单个属性，同时保持实例的自然性和最小变化。通过分析目标属性与其他属性的关系强度，弱关系时直接翻转属性，强关系时使用对抗框架移除潜在空间中的属性信息，从而仅做必要调整。实验表明，相比基线，TabChange能生成更接近原始实例且自然性相当的反事实样本，并增加有效反事实数量、减少无效反事实。
Motivation: 在表格数据中修改属性常因破坏属性间关系而产生不自然的实例，现有生成式模型不支持实例级属性编辑或（如CVAE）在潜在空间中保留属性信息导致无关修改，需要一种能精准控制修改且保持自然性的方法。
Method: TabChange方法先分析目标属性与其他属性的关系：若关系弱则直接翻转属性值；若关系强则采用对抗训练框架，通过分类损失和重建损失迫使编码器移除潜在表示中的目标属性信息，随后基于移除后的潜在向量生成修改后实例。
Result: 在七个数据集上的实验显示，TabChange生成的反事实在自然性上与基线相当，且更接近原始实例（更小的距离），从而产生更多有效反事实和更少无效反事实。
Conclusion: TabChange通过关系感知的编辑策略和对抗性信息移除机制，实现了表格数据中属性修改的精准性、自然性和最小变化性，优于现有方法。

papers.title: Easy, robust approximate message passing for planted spike models
papers.abstract_en: We present a simple and efficient algorithm for robust approximate message passing (AMP) in the spiked matrix setting. In particular, let $\varepsilon$ be a sufficiently small constant, and suppose that $X \in \mathbb R^{n \times n}$ is a Gaussian matrix with a planted rank-$1$ spike, and $E \in \mathbb R^{n \times n}$ is an adversarially chosen matrix supported on an $\varepsilon n \times \varepsilon n$ principal minor. Let $v_{\mathrm{AMP}}(X)$ be the output of an AMP iteration on the uncorrupted matrix $X$. We give a procedure that, given access only to the corrupted matrix $Y = X + E$, computes a vector $v_{\mathrm{ALG}}(Y)$ which is $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$-close to $v_{\mathrm{AMP}}(X)$, for any of a class of AMP iterations which includes sparse Principal Component Analysis (PCA), non-negative PCA, and $\mathbb Z_2$ synchronization. Our algorithm consists of a spectral pre-processing step combined with a robust spectral initialization procedure; given these inputs, we prove that (perhaps surprisingly) AMP is robust out-of-the-box.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对植环矩阵模型（spiked matrix model）中的鲁棒近似消息传递（AMP）问题，提出一个简单高效的算法。在存在大小为εn×εn的对抗性破坏主子的情况下，该算法可利用谱预处理和鲁棒谱初始化，使得AMP迭代的输出与无破坏时的AMP输出接近Õ(√ε)，覆盖稀疏PCA、非负PCA和Z₂同步等迭代类。
Motivation: 实际数据常受对抗性破坏（如主数据块被篡改），而标准AMP对此敏感。现有鲁棒方法复杂或需要特定噪声模型，本文旨在提供一种简单且理论上保证的鲁棒AMP方案。
Method: 算法包含两个步骤：首先进行谱预处理（可能是基于奇异值分解的清洗），然后执行鲁棒谱初始化；之后直接运行标准AMP迭代，无需修改迭代本身。
Result: 理论结果表明，对于任意来自特定类别的AMP迭代（包括稀疏PCA、非负PCA、Z₂同步），算法输出的向量与无破坏AMP输出之间的误差为Õ(√ε)，其中ε为破坏块相对大小。
Conclusion: 本文证明了在适当预处理和初始化下，AMP本身是“开箱即用”鲁棒的，这一发现简化了鲁棒AMP的实现。方法适用于多种经典问题，但依赖ε足够小的常数假设。

summary_sections.result: 理论结果表明，对于任意来自特定类别的AMP迭代（包括稀疏PCA、非负PCA、Z₂同步），算法输出的向量与无破坏AMP输出之间的误差为Õ(√ε)，其中ε为破坏块相对大小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文证明了在适当预处理和初始化下，AMP本身是“开箱即用”鲁棒的，这一发现简化了鲁棒AMP的实现。方法适用于多种经典问题，但依赖ε足够小的常数假设。

papers.title: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models are becoming a scalable form of world models, but they mainly generate plausible motion rather than proactively control or optimize the underlying dynamics. As a result, an object in the generated video may follow trajectories that are unsafe, not smooth, inefficient, or physically inconsistent. In this work, we propose \textbf{OptiWorld}, a framework that brings classical optimal control into video generation at inference time. OptiWorld first extracts a compact, task-relevant world state, then plans an optimal trajectory under physical constraints, and finally renders the video conditioned on this trajectory. We formulate planning as a geometric problem on a continuous manifold, which converts 3D geometry and task-dependent physical constraints into a unified planning geometry. By adding this optimal-control layer, OptiWorld generates videos with preferable dynamics, demonstrating strong potential in multiple tasks including goal-conditioned image-to-video generation, video dynamics editing, and counterfactual generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OptiWorld 是一个将经典最优控制引入视频生成推理阶段的框架。它通过提取紧凑的世界状态、在物理约束下规划最优轨迹，并基于该轨迹生成视频，从而产生符合物理规律、安全平滑的动态。该方法在目标条件图像到视频生成、视频动力学编辑和反事实生成等任务中展示了潜力。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型主要生成看似合理的运动，但缺乏对底层动力学的主动控制或优化，导致生成的物体轨迹可能不安全、不平滑、不高效或物理不一致。
Method: OptiWorld 首先提取与任务相关的紧凑世界状态，然后在物理约束下规划最优轨迹（将规划问题视为连续流形上的几何问题，统一处理3D几何和物理约束），最后基于该轨迹条件生成视频。
Result: 该方法能够生成具有更优动力学的视频，并在多个任务（如目标条件图像到视频生成、视频动力学编辑、反事实生成）中展示出强潜力。
Conclusion: OptiWorld 通过在推理时引入最优控制层，提升了视频生成中动态的物理合理性和可控性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Torus Graphs for Large Scale Neural Phase Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Oscillatory neural signals such as electroencephalography (EEG) and local field potentials (LFPs) show phase relationships that coordinate communication across brain regions. Modern recordings capture hundreds of channels across many frequency bins, yet standard phase analyses are restricted to only a few variables. The Torus Graph (TG) model, an exponential-family distribution over phases whose univariate and pairwise potentials generalize von Mises distributions, infers principled structure among oscillations but models only static, undirected dependencies and is limited to $\sim \! 100$ variables because its score matching inference scales as $\mathcal{O}(d^{6})$. We introduce a stochastic score matching procedure that reduces the per-iteration cost to $\mathcal{O}(d^{2})$, enabling inference on datasets with thousands of variables. This scalable foundation supports analyses of 1,860 frequency-phase features from multi-electrode LFPs and enables two extensions previously inaccessible to TGs or classical circular statistics: (i) a TG Hidden Markov Model capturing state-dependent phase-coupling changes (e.g., spindle-related states during sleep) and (ii) an autoregressive TG inferring directional interactions via transfer-entropy estimation. Applied to LFP recordings, these models reveal state-dependent phase-interaction patterns between wakefulness and NREM sleep. Together, they enable systematic, large-scale mapping of dynamic and directional phase relationships across brain and cognitive states.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 15 figures; to be published in ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模神经相位分析中环面图（Torus Graph）模型计算复杂度高的问题，提出一种随机分数匹配（stochastic score matching）方法，将每步推理复杂度从O(d^6)降至O(d^2)，使模型能够处理数千变量。基于此扩展出两种新模型：环面图隐马尔可夫模型（TG-HMM）和自回归环面图（AR-TG），分别用于捕获状态依赖的相位耦合变化和定向交互。应用于局部场电位记录，揭示了清醒和NREM睡眠期间状态依赖的相位相互作用模式。
Motivation: 标准相位分析仅能处理少量变量，而现代神经记录包含数百个通道和多个频率，现有环面图模型受限于O(d^6)的推理复杂度，无法扩展到大规模数据。
Method: 提出随机分数匹配过程，将每步推理代价降低到O(d^2)；并基于此可扩展基础，构建环面图隐马尔可夫模型（推断状态相关相位耦合变化）和自回归环面图（通过传递熵估计定向交互）。
Result: 摘要报告该方法使模型能够分析来自多电极局部场电位的1860个频率-相位特征，并在睡眠数据中识别出与纺锤波相关的状态依赖性相位耦合变化。
Conclusion: 该系统能够在大脑和认知状态下系统地绘制动态和定向相位关系图，突破了经典圆形统计的限制。

papers.title: Pre-Deployment Robustness Stress Testing for CT Segmentation Systems Using Clinically Motivated Multi-Corruption Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based CT segmentation systems often achieve high accuracy on clean benchmark images, but their performance may degrade under heterogeneous clinical imaging conditions such as noise, resolution loss, contrast variation, intensity shift, and artifacts. This instability can limit reliable deployment in real-world medical imaging workflows. We propose Robustness via Augmented Multi-corruption Pipeline (RAMP), a robustness-oriented augmentation framework for CT segmentation. RAMP combines anatomically constrained spatial perturbations, CT intensity transformations, and stochastic multi-corruption composition to expose models to clinically plausible image degradation during training. Across two CT segmentation evaluation settings, RAMP achieved the strongest corrupted-image performance and the smallest clean-to-corrupted robustness gap. In the five-organ noisy evaluation benchmark, RAMP improved mean corrupted Dice from 0.610 to 0.753 and reduced the robustness gap from 0.264 to 0.064 compared with the nnU-Net baseline. In Abdomen1K, RAMP improved mean corrupted Dice from 0.633 to 0.789 and reduced the robustness gap from 0.290 to 0.070. Although RAMP did not achieve the highest clean-image Dice, it substantially mitigated worst-case segmentation collapse under severe image degradation. These results suggest that multi-corruption augmentation can serve as a practical pre-deployment strategy for improving the reliability of CT segmentation systems in heterogeneous clinical environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为RAMP的鲁棒性增强数据扩增框架，用于CT分割系统的部署前压力测试。该框架结合解剖约束的空间扰动、CT强度变换和随机多损坏组合，在训练中模拟临床图像退化。在五器官噪声基准和Abdomen1K数据集上，RAMP显著提升了损坏图像的Dice分数并缩小了清洁到损坏的鲁棒性差距。
Motivation: 基于深度学习的CT分割系统在清洁基准图像上精度高，但在噪声、分辨率损失、对比度变化等异构临床条件下性能可能下降，影响可靠部署。现有方法缺乏针对CT分割的临床相关多损坏扩增策略。
Method: 提出Robustness via Augmented Multi-corruption Pipeline (RAMP)，结合解剖约束空间扰动、CT强度变换和随机多损坏组合，在训练时暴露模型于临床合理图像退化。
Result: 在五器官噪声基准上，RAMP将平均损坏Dice从0.610提升至0.753，鲁棒性差距从0.264降至0.064；在Abdomen1K上，从0.633提升至0.789，差距从0.290降至0.070。
Conclusion: 多损坏扩增可作为改善CT分割系统在异构临床环境中可靠性的实用部署前策略。

papers.title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TAPS（目标感知前缀树选择），用于扩散模型草稿的投机解码。TAPS将扩散边际概率转化为路径条件接受估计，在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀封闭子树，改善接受-成本权衡。实验表明，在不同数据集和模型上，TAPS相比原始自回归解码实现高达7.9倍无损加速，超越DFlash和DDTree。
Motivation: 现有扩散树方法按边际概率排序节点，忽略验证是前缀条件化的，导致验证不可达的后代节点，增加延迟且收益有限。
Method: TAPS通过将扩散边际转化为路径条件接受估计，在固定验证预算内选择紧凑的前缀封闭子树，优化接受-成本权衡而非简单扩展草稿树。
Result: 实验显示TAPS实现7.9倍无损端到端加速，分别比DFlash和DDTree提升1.36倍和1.74倍。
Conclusion: TAPS有效改进了扩散模型投机解码中的接受-成本权衡，是一种实用的并行草稿验证策略。

papers.title: Annotation-Informed Block-Sparse Bayesian Modeling for cis-Expression Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Genotype-based cis-expression prediction depends on accurately modeling local regulatory architecture. We present block-sparse Bayesian sparse linear mixed model (bsBSLMM), an extension of Bayesian sparse linear mixed model (BSLMM) that incorporates linkage disequilibrium (LD)-block spike-and-slab sparsity and a transcription start site (TSS)-informed SNP inclusion prior. Across 23,098 genes from GEUVADIS European-ancestry lymphoblastoid cell lines, bsBSLMM retained more predictable genes than BSLMM, LASSO, BLUP, TIGAR elastic net, and TIGAR Dirichlet-process regression under matched evaluation criteria. Compared with BSLMM, bsBSLMM improved held-out prediction performance for most shared genes, with gains driven primarily by LD-block sparsity and further enhanced by the TSS-informed prior. Variants selected by bsBSLMM showed stronger enrichment in GM12878 DNase and H3K27ac regulatory regions than variants selected by BSLMM. In transcriptome-wide association study (TWAS) analysis, bsBSLMM recovered established inflammatory bowel disease signals, including IL23R, and identified additional genome-wide significant genes not detected by BSLMM. Independent validation in the Louisiana Osteoporosis Study reproduced the increased prediction yield across ancestries and recovered biologically relevant bone mineral density pathways in downstream TWAS and gene set enrichment analyses. These results demonstrate that incorporating LD-block structure and biologically informed SNP priors improves cis-expression prediction and enhances downstream TWAS discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出块稀疏贝叶斯稀疏线性混合模型（bsBSLMM），扩展了BSLMM，整合了LD块稀疏性和TSS注释先验，用于基于基因型的顺式表达预测。在GEUVADIS数据上，bsBSLMM比多种方法预测更多基因，提高了预测性能，选择的变异在调控区域富集更强，并在TWAS分析中检测到更多显著基因。在路易斯安那骨质疏松研究中独立验证。
Motivation: 现有顺式表达预测模型未能充分利用LD块结构和生物学先验知识，导致预测精度和基因覆盖度有限。
Method: 提出bsBSLMM模型，在BSLMM基础上加入按LD块分组的spike-and-slab先验和基于转录起始位点（TSS）的SNP包含先验。
Result: 在GEUVADIS中，bsBSLMM保留了比BSLMM等更多可预测基因，提高了大部分共同基因的预测性能，选择的变异在DNase和H3K27ac调控区域富集更强，并在TWAS中发现额外显著基因如IL23R。独立研究验证了预测产量增加和生物学相关通路。
Conclusion: 引入LD块结构和生物学注释先验可改善顺式表达预测和下游TWAS发现。

papers.title: Continuous Data Assimilation with Learned Surrogate Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Continuous data assimilation seeks to estimate the state of a dynamical system from partial observations. In many applications, however, the state dynamics are unknown or prohibitively expensive to simulate at the required resolution, leading to model error. Motivated by this challenge and the increasing adoption of machine learning surrogates in data assimilation, this paper develops a unified finite-dimensional analysis of nudging algorithms that employ learned surrogate models of the dynamics. We first establish general conditions on the dynamics and observations that guarantee accurate tracking for nudging with the true dynamics model, both in the noise-free and noisy settings. We then show that nudging algorithms that employ surrogate models retain exponential convergence up to an explicit error floor that quantifies the effects of surrogate approximation error and observation noise. Finally, we analyze surrogate models obtained by learning either the vector field or the short-time solution map of the system, and quantify the amount of training data needed to ensure accurate nudging in the noise-free setting. Numerical experiments support the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对连续数据同化中动力学模型未知或计算昂贵的问题，提出使用学习到的替代动力学模型的nudging算法的统一有限维分析。建立了在无噪声和有噪声条件下保证精确追踪的条件，并证明了使用替代模型时指数收敛至一个显式误差界限，该界限量化了替代近似误差和观测噪声的影响。分析了通过学习向量场或短时解图得到的替代模型，并量化了确保无噪声情况下精确nudging所需的训练数据量。数值实验支持理论。
Motivation: 许多应用中状态动力学未知或模拟成本过高，导致模型误差。现有数据同化方法处理模型误差存在挑战，而机器学习替代模型日益普及但缺乏统一理论分析。
Method: 提出使用学习到的替代动力学模型的nudging算法的统一有限维分析。先建立使用真实模型时的追踪条件（无噪声和有噪声），再证明使用替代模型时指数收敛至一个误差界限（由替代误差和观测噪声决定）。最后分析通过学习向量场或短时解图得到的替代模型，并量化训练数据需求。
Result: 给出了保证精确追踪的条件，证明了使用替代模型的指数收敛性及误差界限，并量化了训练数据需求。数值实验支持理论结果。
Conclusion: 提供了统一有限维分析框架，表明使用学习到的替代动力学模型的nudging算法可保持指数收敛性，但存在由替代误差和观测噪声决定的误差下限。为数据同化中机器学习替代模型的使用提供理论基础。
Relevance: 70

papers.title: Do Text Edits Generalize to Visual Generation? Benchmarking Cross-Modal Knowledge Editing in UMMs
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose multimodal intelligence. As they are deployed in real-world applications, effectively updating internal knowledge becomes critical. While knowledge editing has matured for text-only models, it remains unclear whether edits that successfully modify textual outputs also transfer to image generation in UMMs. To study this question, we introduce UniKE, the first benchmark for cross-modality knowledge editing in UMMs, comprising 2,971 edit subjects spanning attribute and relation edits. Using VQA-based visual verification, we reveal a striking modality gap: text-side efficacy can reach approximately 92%, whereas the best overall VQA accuracy under direct image generation is only 18.5%. We further propose Reasoning-augmented Parameter Editing, which explicitly activates edited knowledge before generation and improves overall VQA accuracy for all evaluated model-editor pairs, with gains up to 18.6 percentage points. Mechanistic analysis shows that this gap is associated with partial alignment between edited textual representations and the conditioning pathways for visual generation, where edits sufficient for text outputs may remain too weak or misaligned to steer image synthesis. These findings show that textual knowledge edits do not guarantee reliable cross-modality transfer and motivate modality-aware editing methods. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/gxx27/UniKE.
papers.comment: Published at ICML 2026; Code and data available at https://github.com/gxx27/UniKE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniKE，首个针对统一多模态模型（UMMs）的跨模态知识编辑基准，包含2,971个编辑主题。实验发现文本模态编辑成功率约92%，但直接图像生成下最佳VQA准确率仅18.5%，存在显著模态差距。进一步提出推理增强参数编辑（Reasoning-augmented Parameter Editing），通过显式激活编辑知识提升所有评估模型-编辑器组合的VQA准确率，最高提升18.6个百分点。机制分析表明差距源于编辑后的文本表示与视觉生成条件路径的局部对齐不足。
Motivation: 知识编辑在文本模型中已成熟，但成功修改文本输出是否也能迁移到图像生成尚不清楚，缺乏跨模态编辑的系统研究。
Method: 构建UniKE基准，包含属性与关系编辑；提出推理增强参数编辑，在生成前显式激活编辑知识；使用VQA进行视觉验证。
Result: 文本编辑效果约92%，图像生成最佳VQA仅18.5%；推理增强参数编辑提升所有模型-编辑器组合，最高增益18.6个百分点。
Conclusion: 文本知识编辑不能保证可靠跨模态迁移，需开发模态感知的编辑方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Doing What They Say, Not What They Reason: Locating the Faithfulness Gap in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Do LLM agents act on the reasoning they state? This question of process fidelity is central to using LLMs in social simulation, yet it is hard to measure where no reference for correct behavior exists. We study it in acontrolled setting, a Texas Poker simulator with a verifiable reference action for every decision by decomposing the faithfulness gap into two steps: reasoning-conclusion and conclusion-action. The two steps behave oppositely.
papers.comment: submitted to COLM social simulation with LLM workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理是否按照其推理行动，即过程忠实度（process fidelity）。在德州扑克模拟器中，通过将忠实度差距分解为推理-结论和结论-行动两步，发现两步表现相反。
Motivation: 在LLM用于社会模拟时，过程忠实度难以测量，因为缺乏正确行为参考。
Method: 在可控的德州扑克模拟器中，针对每个决策都存在可验证的参考动作，将忠实度差距分解为推理-结论和结论-行动两步。
Result: 两步表现相反。
Conclusion: 强调了忠实度差距的两个步骤具有相反行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CodeCytos: AI-assisted spatial molecular imaging analysis via code-augmented agent action space
papers.abstract_en: Conventional tissue image analysis software provides foundational capabilities for cellular analysis, including segmentation, basic morphological feature extraction, and spatial organization analysis. However, these tools often require manual intervention and are not well integrated with code-driven automation, limiting efficiency and scalability for complex spatial tissue studies. In addition, they offer limited flexibility for custom analyses, as they typically support only a fixed set of pre-implemented spatial cellular features. To address these limitations, we propose CodeCytos, a coding-based reasoning agent framework that enables dynamic, programmable interaction with spatial molecular imaging data to improve automation and customization. CodeCytos is designed to streamline the exploration of custom spatial cellular features and adapt to diverse research needs. We demonstrate its utility through case studies on four expert-curated datasets from distinct tissue types: frontal cortex, non-small-cell lung cancer, pancreas, and tonsil. We evaluate CodeCytos under a realistic minimal prompt setting, where bioscientists pose simple questions without task-specific instructions or contextual information about spatial cellular analysis, and benchmark multiple LLM backbones with strong coding capabilities. We further show that incorporating tailored, domain-agnostic few-shot in-context coding-reasoning examples (randomly sampled demonstrations outside the spatial analysis domain) can substantially improve performance without requiring costly, expert-crafted in-domain demonstrations. Overall, CodeCytos outperforms baseline approaches, highlighting the potential of code-action agents to assist with custom feature exploration in spatial molecular imaging and to accelerate biomarker discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CodeCytos，一个基于编码推理的智能体框架，用于空间分子成像数据分析，通过代码增强的动作空间实现动态、可编程的交互，提升自动化与定制化能力。在四个不同组织类型的数据集（额叶皮层、非小细胞肺癌、胰腺、扁桃体）上，使用多种大语言模型后端进行评估，并引入领域无关的小样本示例提升性能。
Motivation: 传统组织图像分析软件需人工干预，与代码驱动自动化集成不佳，且仅支持固定预置特征，缺乏灵活性，难以应对复杂空间组织研究。
Method: 提出CodeCytos框架，采用编码推理智能体，通过代码增强的动作空间实现与空间分子成像数据的动态交互，支持自定义特征探索。在无任务特定指令的极简提示设置下，结合多种强编码能力的大语言模型后端，并利用领域无关的小样本编码推理示例提升性能。
Result: 在四个专家策划的数据集上，CodeCytos优于基线方法，展示了代码智能体在自定义特征探索和加速生物标志物发现方面的潜力。
Conclusion: CodeCytos证明了代码动作智能体在辅助空间分子成像自定义特征探索中的有效性，有望加速生物标志物发现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MUSCLE-NET: Predicted-Multiscale-Aware Network for Pedestrian Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction is essential for safe navigation in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. Despite substantial progress made by recent methods, most existing approaches are limited in fully exploiting diverse observations and often overlook the scale dependency of future motion, treating multiscale features uniformly regardless of underlying motion dynamics. This limits their robustness across diverse pedestrian behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose a Predicted-MUltiSCale-Aware Network (MUSCLE-NET) for Pedestrian Trajectory Forecasting that integrates complementary multimodal cues with scale-adaptive prediction mechanisms. The proposed framework is built upon a Multiscale Multimodal Feature Extraction (MMFE) module, which combines multiscale representation, modality-aware recalibration, and directional cross-modal fusion to construct semantically aligned representations from bounding boxes, velocities, and pose information. Building on these features, a Multiscale Enhanced Hierarchical Prediction (MEHP) module performs prediction-aware future-motion refinement via a probabilistic coarse predictor, scale-aligned fusion, and progressive refinement, adaptively selecting scale-relevant cues to mitigate spatial drift. Extensive experiments on the JAAD and PIE benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed MUSCLE-Net achieves competitive performance and consistent gains compared with state-of-the-art trajectory prediction methods.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been accepted to the IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems as a regular paper

Conclusion: 通过自适应选择尺度相关线索缓解空间漂移，提升了轨迹预测的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Constructive interpolation and generalization rates for neural ODEs: a control perspective
papers.abstract_en: We study supervised regression with neural ODEs (NODEs) from a control-theoretic perspective to derive explicit population-risk bounds. We focus on a widely used class of non-autonomous models with constant parameters and explicit time dependence, which we call semi-autonomous NODEs (SA-NODEs). We constructively prove that SA-NODEs are capable of \emph{exact} interpolation of admissible finite datasets, and even satisfy a stronger property that we call \emph{simultaneous cell controllability} (SCC): their flows can map prescribed disjoint cells into arbitrarily small target balls. This property is the mechanism that upgrades interpolation into quantitative generalization, by allowing SA-NODEs to emulate piecewise-constant nonparametric estimators. Consequently, our risk bounds recover the rates of histogram and nearest-neighbor estimators, provided the network width satisfies a conservative scaling with the sample size. Numerical experiments show that trained SA-NODEs achieve competitive -- often lower -- test errors than these baselines. Finally, we show that the explicit time dependence is essential. Although two-layer autonomous NODEs can interpolate geometrically nondegenerate datasets, structural obstructions prevent them from achieving SCC. These limitations, further confirmed numerically, support the view that SA-NODEs provide a minimal effective architecture for learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从控制理论视角研究神经ODE（NODE）的监督回归，提出构造性插值方法和泛化界。作者聚焦半自主NODE（SA-NODE），证明其能实现精确插值和同时单元可控性（SCC），从而将插值转化为定量泛化，风险界恢复直方图和最近邻估计器的速率。数值实验显示SA-NODE达到竞争性测试误差，且显式时间依赖性对SCC至关重要。
Motivation: 神经ODE的泛化理论尚不完善，缺乏从控制视角解释其插值和泛化能力的严格框架。
Method: 将SA-NODE视为控制系统的流动，构造性地证明其能精确插值有限数据集，并满足同时单元可控性（SCC），通过模拟分段常数非参数估计器获得泛化界。
Result: SA-NODE的泛化风险界恢复直方图和最近邻估计器的速率，数值实验显示其测试误差与这些基线相当或更低。
Conclusion: 显式时间依赖性是SA-NODE实现SCC的关键，而两层自主NODE虽能插值但无法实现SCC，因此SA-NODE是学习的最小有效架构。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Limits of LLM Adaptability: Impact of Model-Internalized Priors on Annotation Task Performance
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for zero-shot annotation and LLM-as-a-judge tasks, yet their reliability hinges on how model-internalized priors interact with user-provided instructions. We investigate three dimensions of this interaction: (1) how an LLM's familiarity with data and task definitions affects performance, (2) the extent to which additional information in prompts can correct zero-shot errors ("decision stickiness"), and (3) model susceptibility to misaligned task definitions. Through experiments on toxicity detection across diverse datasets (spanning social media, gaming, news, and forums) using both dense and mixture-of-experts models, we find that nearly two-thirds of zero-shot errors are resistant to correction, with an overall rescue rate (fraction of initial errors corrected by prompting) of only 34.8%. High-confidence errors prove especially resistant to correction. When given misaligned definitions, LLMs follow them while maintaining confidence levels unchanged from the aligned condition. Crucially, we introduce Definition-Specific Familiarity (DSF), which measures alignment between a model's internal concept and the task definition. After controlling for dataset-level confounds, DSF shows a positive association with model performance (partial r = +0.41), while three distinct memorization metrics (ROUGE-L, BERTScore, and embedding cosine similarity) all fail to show a positive association. These findings show the limitations of prompt-based correction in annotation tasks, highlighting the importance of definition alignment over text-level memorization.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 (Oral & Spotlight); PMLR vol. 306. 9 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文通过毒性检测实验研究LLM在零样本标注任务中对提示修正的局限性。发现近三分之二的零样本错误无法通过提示纠正，总体纠正率仅34.8%，高置信错误尤其顽固。引入定义特异性熟悉度（DSF）指标，显示其与模型性能正相关（偏相关系数+0.41），而文本记忆指标无正关联。
Motivation: LLM在零样本标注和LLM-as-a-judge任务中可靠性受模型内化先验与用户指令交互的影响，现有研究未充分揭示这种交互的边界和局限性。
Method: 在社交媒体、游戏、新闻和论坛等多来源毒性检测数据集上，使用稠密和混合专家模型进行实验。通过操纵任务定义和提示信息，分析模型对熟悉度、错误修正（决策粘性）和错位定义的敏感性。引入DSF指标衡量模型内部概念与任务定义的对齐程度。
Result: 零样本错误中62%以上无法通过提示纠正，总纠正率34.8%；高置信错误纠正率更低。DSF与性能呈正相关（偏相关系数+0.41），而ROUGE-L、BERTScore和嵌入余弦相似度均无正关联。
Conclusion: 提示修正的局限性显著，定义对齐比文本记忆对模型性能更重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Short-form Text Rewriting with Phi Silica
papers.abstract_en: Short-form text rewriting is a constrained variant of paraphrasing in which limited context and high semantic density leave little room for variation. While large language models perform well on general paraphrasing, small language models (SLMs) often struggle with semantic fidelity and hallucination robustness in short-form settings. In this work, we present an empirical study of adapting an SLM, Phi Silica, for short-form rewrite through dataset curation, prompt distillation, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and evaluation. We curate a dataset of short presentation-style text from public slide decks and use GPT-5-chat both to generate rewrite supervision and to conduct LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Our results show that finetuning improves semantic fidelity, reduces hallucinations, and increases preference win rate against GPT-5-chat rewrites. The findings suggest that targeted adaptation for SLMs can substantially narrow the gap to cloud models and provide practical guidance for adapting SLMs to precision-critical rewrite tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对短文本改写任务，研究了如何将小型语言模型（SLM）Phi Silica适配到该场景。通过数据集筛选、提示蒸馏、参数高效微调和评估，发现微调能提升语义保真度、减少幻觉，并提高对GPT-5-chat改写结果的偏好胜率。结果表明，有针对性的适配可以显著缩小SLM与云端模型的差距。
Motivation: 短文本改写受限于有限上下文和高语义密度，小语言模型在语义保真度和幻觉鲁棒性上表现不佳，需要探索有效的适配方法。
Method: 从公开幻灯片中筛选短演示文本数据集，使用GPT-5-chat生成改写监督信号并作为裁判评估，对Phi Silica进行参数高效微调（如LoRA）。
Result: 微调后的Phi Silica在语义保真度、幻觉减少和偏好胜率（对GPT-5-chat改写结果）上均有提升。
Conclusion: 有针对性的适配可以让小型语言模型在精度关键的重写任务上接近云端模型，为SLM适配提供了实用指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An explainable hierarchical self attention-based approach for tremor detection in the time domain
papers.abstract_en: Tremor is a common movement disorder associated with conditions like Parkinson's disease and Essential tremor, traditionally diagnosed through expert clinician assessment. Current automated detection methods rely on frequency-domain features informed by clinical expertise. In this work, we present an explainable, two-stage hierarchical framework for tremor detection in the time domain that learns tremor patterns directly from 3D kinematic marker time-series data across entire tremor-provoking trials. Our framework combined a deep convolutional and long short-term memory network to learn tremor representations from short, discrete, non-overlapping time segments of kinematic time series data from trials, which are then processed by a vision transformer that models their long-term temporal dynamics of time segment features for trial (session) level classification. Evaluated across nine body parts, the framework achieved F1-scores of 0.594 - 0.947 depending on body parts (average: 0.765), falling short of the frequency-domain state-of-the-art performance (0.909) while requiring minimal preprocessing. Attention weights and gradient-based class activation maps (Grad-CAM) identified time-domain features of tremor across body parts. This proof of concept demonstrated the feasibility of data-driven time-domain modeling for tremor detection across anatomically diverse body parts, while reducing reliance on expert-engineered spectral features and providing posthoc interpretability of temporal and anatomical patterns of tremor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的两阶段层次化框架，用于在时域中从3D运动学标记时间序列数据检测震颤，结合卷积长短时记忆网络和视觉Transformer，在9个身体部位上F1分数为0.594-0.947（平均0.765），低于频域方法，但降低了预处理要求并提供事后可解释性。
Motivation: 传统震颤检测依赖频域特征和临床专家知识，现有自动化方法需要大量预处理。本文旨在探索数据驱动的时域建模可行性，减少对专家设计频谱特征的依赖。
Method: 两阶段层次框架：第一阶段用深度卷积和长短期记忆网络从短时非重叠时间片段学习震颤表征；第二阶段用视觉Transformer建模时间片段间的长期时序动态，实现试验（会话）级分类。
Result: 在9个身体部位评估，F1分数范围0.594-0.947（平均0.765），低于频域最优方法（0.909），但仅需最小预处理。注意力权重和Grad-CAM识别了各身体部位的时域震颤特征。
Conclusion: 该概念验证表明数据驱动的时域建模可用于解剖多样身体部位的震颤检测，提供事后可解释性，并减少对专家构建频谱特征的依赖，但性能尚不如频域方法。

papers.title: Beyond Static Gaussians: An Empirical Investigation of Architectural Paradigms for Dynamic 3D Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic scene reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a compelling approach for representing evolving environments, yet understanding trade-offs between methodologies remains crucial. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of dynamic 3DGS methods, categorizing them into two paradigms: structure-guided methods employing auxiliary representations (deformation fields, canonical spaces, grids) to model temporal changes, and gaussian-centric methods encoding dynamics directly into primitives via continuous functions or 4D representations. We evaluate representative methods from both paradigms on the D-NeRF benchmark. Our findings reveal that structure-guided methods achieve superior reconstruction fidelity and compact model sizes, while gaussian-centric approaches demonstrate significantly higher rendering speeds enabling real-time performance, though with greater quality variability and potentially substantial storage overhead. This analysis highlights a fundamental trade-off between reconstruction quality/compactness versus rendering speed, providing insights to guide future research and application development in dynamic scene reconstruction.
papers.comment: Accepted in Journal of Computational Vision and Imaging Systems (JCVIS)
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Computational Vision and Imaging Systems, Vol. 11, No. 1, 2025, p. 99
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对动态3D高斯溅射（3DGS）场景重建的两类范式——结构引导方法（辅助变形场、规范空间、网格等）和高斯中心方法（将动力学直接编码到原语中）——进行了系统比较。在D-NeRF基准上的实验表明：结构引导方法在重建保真度和模型紧凑性上更优，而高斯中心方法渲染速度显著更快，可实现实时性能，但质量变异较大且存储开销可能更高。研究揭示了重建质量/紧凑度与渲染速度之间的根本权衡。
Motivation: 动态场景重建中不同方法（结构引导与高斯中心）之间存在性能权衡，但缺乏系统性的比较分析，导致难以指导方法选择和未来发展。
Method: 将动态3DGS方法分为结构引导和高斯中心两类，选取每类中的代表性方法（如变形场、4D表示等），在D-NeRF基准上评估其重建保真度、模型大小、渲染速度和存储开销。
Result: 结构引导方法实现了更高的重建保真度和更紧凑的模型大小；高斯中心方法渲染速度显著更高，可实现实时性能，但质量变异大且可能产生大量存储开销。
Conclusion: 研究突出了质量/紧凑度与渲染速度之间的权衡，为动态场景重建的未来研究和应用开发提供了指导。

papers.title: Optimizing 3D Gaussian Splatting via Point Cloud Upsampling
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a technique for creating and rendering 3D scenes, however its performance depends heavily on the quality of initial seed points. To improve 3DGS initialization, this study presents and evaluates several point cloud upsampling approaches: linear interpolation, triangular interpolation, spline-based surface reconstruction, moving least squares surface fitting, and Voronoi-based point generation. Additionally, this research introduces a depth-guided point lifting method that leverages depth maps to maintain geometric consistency with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) reconstructions. Through extensive experiments on the Mip-NeRF360 and Replica datasets, the proposed methods demonstrate improvements in reconstruction quality across diverse scene types. Results indicate that different upsampling strategies excel in different scenarios: surface reconstruction methods perform better with organic, detailed scenes, while simpler interpolation approaches are more suited for scenes dominated by piecewise-smooth geometries. In comparison, the depth-guided approach shows promise for adding geometry-aware points across the entire scene, importantly in texture-less regions. These findings, which provide preliminary practical guidelines for selecting appropriate upsampling methods based on scene characteristics and computational constraints, advances the understanding of how point cloud initialization affects 3DGS quality.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）依赖初始种子点质量的问题，评估了多种点云上采样方法（线性插值、三角插值、样条曲面重建、移动最小二乘曲面拟合、Voronoi点生成）以及一种深度引导的点提升方法。在Mip-NeRF360和Replica数据集上的实验表明，不同上采样策略在不同场景中各有优劣：曲面重建方法适合有机细节丰富的场景，简单插值适合分段平滑几何场景，深度引导方法在纹理缺失区域有潜力。研究为根据场景特性选择上采样方法提供了初步指导。
Motivation: 3DGS的重建质量高度依赖于初始种子点的质量，但目前缺乏系统的方法来优化点云初始化。
Method: 提出了多种点云上采样方法（线性插值、三角插值、样条曲面重建、移动最小二乘曲面拟合、Voronoi点生成）以及一种利用深度图保持几何一致性的深度引导点提升方法。
Result: 在Mip-NeRF360和Replica数据集上，不同方法在不同场景类型中表现各异：曲面重建方法在有机细节场景中更好，简单插值在分段平滑几何场景中更优，深度引导方法在纹理缺失区域有优势。
Conclusion: 提供了根据场景特性和计算约束选择上采样方法的初步实用指南，加深了对点云初始化影响3DGS质量的理解。

papers.title: When Safe Skills Collide: Measuring Compositional Risk in Agent Skill Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on community-contributed skills that expand an agent's operational capability set. We study a core safety problem in agentic AI systems: whether individually safe skills can compose into unsafe installed skill sets. We present SkillReact, a compositional security measurement framework with three components: a deterministic static-composition benchmark, a two-rater LLM-assisted human-adjudication pipeline, and an action-based exploitability harness. On 1,520 ClawHub skills, 651 pass individual inspection and form 211,575 pairs; the benchmark flags 22.25% of these as structural candidates. We treat this raw rate as a recall-oriented scanner ceiling and calibrate it against human judgment: in a pattern-stratified audit, roughly one in five flagged pair-pattern hits survives as a real compositional risk (population-weighted validity 18.2%, our headline result), implying about 14K genuine risk memberships in a single registry that per-skill scanning misses by construction, since every pair is individually safe. An action-based harness then probes when these candidates become model-issued tool calls, and finds realization gated by host-model disposition: on an anchor-conditioned dropper subset, Haiku-4-5 issues the dropper-stage tool call on all 39 direct-prompt trials (36 of them the full download-then-execute chain, 3 download-only), Opus-4-7 stops at the download, and Sonnet-4-6 refuses outright. A control that holds the request fixed and varies only the installed skills finds compliance highest with no skills installed: a composition fixes which capabilities are reachable, while the host model decides whether to use them. Together these motivate install-time compositional checks and capability isolation as complements to per-skill scanning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI代理系统中社区贡献技能的组合安全问题，提出SkillReact框架，包含静态组合基准、两阶段人工审核流程和基于动作的可利用性测试。在1,520个ClawHub技能中，651个通过个体检查并形成211,575对组合；基准标记22.25%为结构性候选，经人工审核后约五分之一为真实组合风险（群体加权有效性18.2%），表明单个注册表中约有14K真实风险成员被逐技能扫描遗漏。动作测试发现风险实现受宿主模型倾向限制：Haiku-4-5在所有39次直接提示中执行危险工具调用，Opus-4-7仅下载，Sonnet-4-6完全拒绝。控制实验表明，无技能安装时合规性最高，说明组合决定了能力可及性，而宿主模型决定是否使用。
Motivation: 现有AI代理系统依赖社区贡献技能，但个体安全的技能组合后可能产生不安全的能力集，而逐技能扫描无法检测这种组合风险。
Method: 提出SkillReact框架，包括确定性静态组合基准、双评估者LLM辅助人工审核流程、以及基于动作的可利用性测试工具。
Result: 在ClawHub技能集上，22.25%的技能对为结构性候选，约18.2%的候选为真实复合风险；动作测试显示风险实现依赖于宿主模型倾向。
Conclusion: 需要安装时的组合检查和能力隔离作为逐技能扫描的补充，以防范个体安全技能的复合风险。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对AI代理系统中社区贡献技能的组合安全问题，提出SkillReact框架，包含静态组合基准、两阶段人工审核流程和基于动作的可利用性测试。在1,520个ClawHub技能中，651个通过个体检查并形成211,575对组合；基准标记22.25%为结构性候选，经人工审核后约五分之一为真实组合风险（群体加权有效性18.2%），表明单个注册表中约有14K真实风险成员被逐技能扫描遗漏。动作测试发现风险实现受宿主模型倾向限制：Haiku-4-5在所有39次直接提示中执行危险工具调用，Opus-4-7仅下载，Sonnet-4-6完全拒绝。控制实验表明，无技能安装时合规性最高，说明组合决定了能力可及性，而宿主模型决定是否使用。

papers.title: GeoSAM-3D: Geodesic Prompt Propagation for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Segmentation from Monocular Video
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D scene segmentation usually assumes RGB-D video, calibrated multi-view imagery, or a reconstructed mesh. GeoSAM-3D studies a lighter setting: a user uploads a short monocular video, clicks or names an object in one frame, and receives a propagated 3D mask over a Gaussian scene. The implementation combines frozen image and video foundation models with a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction and a differentiable graph-geodesic propagation kernel over Gaussian centroids. The central design choice is to propagate prompts by heat-kernel distance on the reconstructed scene graph, rather than by Euclidean nearest neighbors in 3D. This preserves continuity around curved surfaces and reduces leakage across nearby but disconnected objects. This paper describes the repository state, the mathematical kernel implemented in geosam3d.propagate, the feature head trained from Segment Anything masks, and the validation already present in the codebase. The evaluation protocol separates implementation validation, graph propagation quality, leakage control, and interactive latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoSAM-3D 提出一种轻量级设置：用户上传单目视频，在一帧中点击或命名物体，即可在3D高斯场景中获得传播的3D遮罩。该方法结合冻结的图像和视频基础模型、单目3D高斯泼溅重建，以及在高斯质心上可微的图测地传播核，通过热核距离传播提示词，以保持曲面连续性并减少泄漏。
Motivation: 现有的开放词汇3D场景分割通常需要RGB-D视频、已标定的多视图图像或重建网格，而GeoSAM-3D探索更轻量的单目视频输入，使交互式3D分割更易用。
Method: 提出结合冻结的图像和视频基础模型、单目3D高斯泼溅重建以及可微的图测地传播核。提示词传播基于重建场景图上的热核距离，而非3D欧氏最近邻，以保持曲面连续并减少不同连通物体间的泄漏。
Result: 论文描述了代码仓库状态、传播核的数学实现、从Segment Anything遮罩训练的特征头，以及代码库中已有的验证。评估方案包括实现验证、图传播质量、泄漏控制和交互延迟。
Conclusion: GeoSAM-3D为单目视频的开放词汇3D场景分割提供了有效方案，通过图测地传播实现提示词传播，在保持曲面连续性的同时减少泄漏。
