papers.title: The Refusal--Compliance Tradeoff: A Large-Scale Safety Behavior Audit of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Refusal rates are a poor proxy for LLM safety, i.e., a model may over-refuse benign prompts while still complying with harmful ones. We audit both failure modes across 21 open-weight LLMs on four safety benchmarks (OR-Bench, XSTest, ToxiGen, BOLD), using a composition adjustment to isolate model sensitivity from dataset toxicity confounds. We report three findings. First, models adopt fundamentally different calibration strategies: conservative ecosystems such as Llama suppress unsafe outputs at the cost of elevated over-refusals, while permissive ecosystems such as DeepSeek and Qwen preserve helpfulness but tolerate higher harmful compliance. Second, demographic protection is unequal: models over-protect prominent racial and religious groups, frequently refusing even benign prompts about them, while providing substantially weaker protection against disability-targeted attacks. Third, refusal and compliance tendencies are stable within model families across generations and scales, suggesting that post-training objectives shape safety behavior more than architecture. Our results call for joint, demographically-aware, and multi-judge safety evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了21个开源LLM的安全行为，发现拒绝率并不能代表模型安全性，模型存在过度拒绝良性提示和服从有害提示的双重失败模式。通过组成调整隔离模型敏感性，报告了三个发现：不同模型生态采用不同的校准策略；人口统计保护不平等；拒绝和服从倾向在模型家族内稳定。
Motivation: 现有研究用拒绝率作为安全代理指标存在缺陷，需要同时审计过度拒绝和有害服从两种失败模式。
Method: 在四个安全基准（OR-Bench, XSTest, ToxiGen, BOLD）上对21个开源LLM进行审计，使用组成调整来隔离模型敏感性与数据集毒性混杂。
Result: 发现Llama等保守模型过度拒绝但抑制有害输出，DeepSeek和Qwen等开放模型容忍更高有害服从；模型过度保护显著种族和宗教群体但弱化残疾攻击；拒绝和服从倾向在模型家族内跨代际和规模稳定。
Conclusion: 呼吁联合、人口统计感知、多评判者的安全评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Decision-Propagation for Answer Set Programming
papers.abstract_en: Integration of Answer Set Programming (ASP) with neural networks has emerged as a promising tool in Neuro-symbolic AI. While existing approaches extend the capabilities of ASP to real world domains, their reasoning pipelines depend on classical solvers, which is a bottleneck for scalability. To tackle this problem, we propose a new method to compute stable models, called decision-propagation (DProp), which alternates falsity decisions and truth propagations. Successful DProp computations are shown to capture the stable model semantics. We then develop Neural DProp (NDProp), a differentiable extension of DProp with neural computation for decisions and fuzzy evaluation for propagations. We evaluate the capabilities of NDProp for learning decision heuristics as well as neuro-symbolic integration, and compare it with existing neuro-symbolic approaches. The results show that NDProp can learn to efficiently compute stable models, and it improves accuracy and scalability on neuro-symbolic benchmarks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的回答集编程（ASP）计算方法决策传播（DProp），它交替执行假值决策和真值传播，并证明其能捕获稳定模型语义。随后开发神经决策传播（NDProp），即DProp的可微扩展，用神经网络进行决策、模糊逻辑进行传播。实验表明NDProp能学习高效计算稳定模型，并在神经符号基准上提升准确率和可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有ASP与神经网络的结合依赖经典求解器，成为可扩展性的瓶颈。
Method: 提出决策传播（DProp）方法，交替假值决策与真值传播；进一步开发可微扩展NDProp，用神经网络进行决策、模糊评估进行传播。
Result: 实验表明NDProp能学习高效计算稳定模型，并在神经符号基准上提升准确率和可扩展性。
Conclusion: NDProp作为一种新的神经符号方法，在可扩展性和准确性上优于现有方法。

papers.title: Robust Linear Dueling Bandits with Post-serving Context under Unknown Delays and Adversarial Corruptions
papers.abstract_en: We study linear dueling bandits in volatile environments characterized by the simultaneous presence of post-serving contexts, delayed feedback, and adversarial corruption. Feedback is subject to unknown stochastic or adversarial delays and a cumulative corruption budget $\mathcal{C}$. To address these challenges, we propose e RCDP-UCB, which integrates a learned approximator that predicts post-serving contexts from pre-serving information. It further employs an adaptive weighting strategy that clips feature vectors to mitigate the impact of corrupted and delayed observations simultaneously. Under standard regularity conditions and a parametric post-serving mapping, we rigorously establish that our algorithm is delay-regime-agnostic, achieving a regret upper bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d(\sqrt{T} + \mathcal{C} + \mathcal{D}))$, where $d$ is the total feature dimension and $\mathcal{D}$ encapsulates the delay complexity. Crucially, our analysis reveals an additive cost structure between corruption and delay, avoiding the multiplicative degradation typical of prior works. We further establish lower bounds that nearly match our upper bounds up to a $\sqrt{d}$ factor for adversarial delays in the absence of post-serving contexts. Code is available at https://github.com/youngmin0oh/rcdp-public.

papers.title: Divergence is Uncertainty: A Closed-Form Posterior Covariance for Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has become a leading framework for generative modeling, but quantifying the uncertainty of its samples remains an open problem. Existing approaches retrain the model with auxiliary variance heads, maintain costly ensembles, or propagate approximate covariance through many integration steps, trading off training cost, inference cost, or accuracy. We show that none of these trade-offs is necessary. By extending Tweedie's formula from the denoising setting to the flow matching interpolant, we derive an exact, closed-form expression for the posterior covariance at every point along the generative trajectory. The result depends on a single quantity, namely the divergence of the learned velocity field, which can be computed post-hoc on any pre-trained flow matching model, requiring no retraining and no architectural modification. For one-step generators such as MeanFlow, the same formula yields the end-to-end generation uncertainty in a single forward pass, eliminating the multi-step variance propagation required by all prior methods. Experiments on MNIST confirm that the resulting per-pixel uncertainty maps are semantically meaningful, concentrating on digit boundaries where inter-sample variation is highest, and that the scalar uncertainty score tracks actual prediction error, all at roughly $10^4 \times$ less total compute than ensembling or Monte Carlo dropout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明流匹配（flow matching）生成模型的后验协方差可以解析计算，无需重新训练或修改架构。通过将Tweedie公式从去噪扩展至流匹配插值，得到封闭形式的后验协方差表达式，仅依赖于学习速度场的散度（divergence）。在MNIST上验证，得到的逐像素不确定性图集中在数字边界，标量不确定性分数与实际预测误差相关，且计算量比集成或MC Dropout低约10^4倍。
Motivation: 现有量化流匹配采样不确定性的方法需要重训练、维护集成或近似协方差传播，在训练成本、推理成本或精度之间存在权衡。本文试图消除这些权衡。
Method: 将Tweedie公式从去噪设置扩展到流匹配插值，推导出生成轨迹每一点上精确的封闭形式后验协方差表达式。该表达式仅依赖于学习速度场的散度，可在任何预训练流匹配模型上事后计算，无需重训练或架构修改。
Result: 在MNIST上，逐像素不确定性图语义上有意义（集中在数字边界），标量不确定性分数跟踪实际预测误差，且总计算量比集成或MC Dropout低约10^4倍。
Conclusion: 本文表明流匹配生成模型的不确定性量化可以精确且高效地通过散度计算实现，消除了现有方法的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Querying with AI Persona Priors
papers.abstract_en: We study adaptive querying for learning user-dependent quantities of interest, such as responses to held-out items and psychometric indicators, within tight query budgets. Classical Bayesian design and computerized adaptive testing typically rely on restrictive parametric assumptions or expensive posterior approximations, limiting their use in heterogeneous, high-dimensional, and cold-start settings. We introduce a persona-induced latent variable model that represents a user's state through membership in a finite dictionary of AI personas, each offering response distributions produced by a large language model. This yields expressive priors with closed-form posterior updates and efficient finite-mixture predictions, enabling scalable Bayesian design for sequential item selection. Experiments on synthetic data and WorldValuesBench demonstrate that persona-based posteriors deliver accurate probabilistic predictions and an interpretable adaptive elicitation pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于AI人格先验的自适应查询方法，通过将用户状态表示为有限人格字典中的成员身份，利用大语言模型生成响应分布，实现可扩展的贝叶斯设计。该方法在合成数据和WorldValuesBench上展示了准确的概率预测和可解释的自适应查询流程。
Motivation: 经典贝叶斯设计和自适应测试依赖严格的参数假设或昂贵的后验近似，难以处理异质性、高维和冷启动场景。
Method: 引入人格诱导的潜变量模型，将用户状态表示为有限AI人格字典中的成员，每个字典元素由大语言模型提供响应分布，实现闭式后验更新和高效有限混合预测。
Result: 在合成数据和WorldValuesBench上的实验表明，基于人格的后验能提供准确的概率预测和可解释的自适应查询流程。
Conclusion: 该方法为有限查询预算下学习用户相关量提供了一种可扩展且可解释的贝叶斯设计框架。

papers.title: Consistent Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are an attractive alternative to autoregressive models because they promise sublinear-time, parallel generation, yet practical gains remain elusive as high-quality samples still demand hundreds of refinement steps. In continuous domains, consistency training along the probability-flow ODE is a popular recipe to accelerate diffusion. For discrete diffusion, no analogous sample-space ODE exists, making direct adaptation ill-defined. We argue that the right discrete substitute is the exact posterior bridge, the closed-form conditional law linking any two noise levels, which is available for broad corruptions including masked and uniform diffusion. Building on this observation, we introduce Multi-Path Discrete Consistency (MPDC), a new principle that trains a denoiser to be path-invariant in expectation across these stochastic bridges, and instantiate it as the Consistent Diffusion Language Model (CDLM), a single-stage training framework that does not require an already trained teacher model. Our CDLM objective recovers masked diffusion, continuous consistency models, and progressive or discrete distillation as analytic limits or empirical approximations of one common view. Empirically, CDLM establishes a new state of the art on both conditional and unconditional text-generation, consistently outperforming strong base discrete diffusion models and often even multi-stage distilled baselines across sampling budgets, with the largest gains in the few-step regime. Together, these results position CDLM as a principled and scalable foundation for the next generation of fast, high-fidelity discrete generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离散扩散语言模型生成效率低的问题，提出多路径离散一致性（MPDC）原则，并实例化为一致扩散语言模型（CDLM）。CDLM利用精确后验桥（exact posterior bridge）训练去噪器在随机桥上保持路径不变，实现单阶段训练，无需教师模型。实验表明，CDLM在条件与非条件文本生成任务上均达到新SOTA，尤其在少步数生成场景中显著优于强基线离散扩散模型和多阶段蒸馏模型。
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型为生成高质量样本仍需大量细化步骤，而连续域加速方法（一致性训练）无法直接应用于离散扩散。需要一种原则性的离散加速方案。
Method: 提出多路径离散一致性（MPDC）原则，利用离散扩散中精确后验桥的闭式条件律，训练去噪器在多个随机桥上实现期望路径不变性；并实例化为CDLM框架，统一了掩码扩散、连续一致性模型等先验方法。
Result: 在条件与非条件文本生成任务上，CDLM均取得新SOTA，在少步数生成中提升最大，一致优于强基线离散扩散模型和多阶段蒸馏基线。
Conclusion: CDLM为快速、高保真的离散生成建模提供了有原则且可扩展的基础，有望作为下一代加速离散扩散模型的通用框架。

papers.title: Hierarchical Long-Term Semantic Memory for LinkedIn's Hiring Agent
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly used in real-world products, where personalized and context-aware user interactions are essential. A central enabler of such capabilities is the agent's long-term semantic memory system, which extracts implicit and explicit signals from noisy longitudinal behavioral data, stores them in a structured form, and supports low-latency retrieval. Building industrial-grade long-term memory for LLM agents raises five challenges: scalability, low-latency retrieval, privacy constraints, adaptability, and observability. We introduce the Hierarchical Long-Term Semantic Memory (HLTM) framework, which organizes textual data into a schema-aligned memory tree that captures semantic knowledge at multiple levels of granularity, enabling scalable ingestion, privacy-aware storage, low-latency retrieval, and transparent provenance; HLTM further incorporates an adaptation mechanism to generalize across diverse use cases. Extensive evaluations on LinkedIn's Hiring Assistant show that HLTM improves answer correctness by more than 5% and retrieval F1 by more than 10%, while significantly advancing the Pareto frontier between query and indexing latency. HLTM has been fully deployed in LinkedIn's Hiring Assistant to power core personalization features in production hiring workflows.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Applied Data Science (ADS) track at the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型代理在工业产品中的长期语义记忆需求，提出了层级长期语义记忆（HLTM）框架。HLTM将文本数据组织成符合模式的记忆树，捕获多粒度语义知识，支持可扩展的摄入、隐私感知存储、低延迟检索和透明溯源。在LinkedIn招聘助手上的评估表明，HLTM将答案正确性提升超过5%，召回F1提升超过10%，并显著推进了查询与索引延迟之间的帕累托前沿。该框架已在LinkedIn招聘助手中全面部署。
Motivation: 构建工业级LLM代理长期记忆面临五大挑战：可扩展性、低延迟检索、隐私约束、适应性和可观测性。现有方法无法同时满足这些要求。
Method: 提出HLTM框架，核心是一个模式对齐的记忆树，从嘈杂的纵向行为数据中提取显式和隐式信号，以结构化形式存储，并支持低延迟检索。还包括适应机制以泛化到不同用例。
Result: 在LinkedIn招聘助手上的实验显示：答案正确性提升超过5%，检索F1提升超过10%，并显著推进了帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: HLTM已全面部署在LinkedIn招聘助手的生产环境中，支持核心个性化功能。摘要强调其解决了工业级长期记忆的挑战，并在实际产品中验证有效性。

papers.title: OmniHuman: A Large-scale Dataset and Benchmark for Human-Centric Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in audio-video joint generation models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in content creation. However, generating high-fidelity human-centric videos in complex, real-world physical scenes remains a significant challenge. We identify that the root cause lies in the structural deficiencies of existing datasets across three dimensions: limited global scene and camera diversity, sparse interaction modeling (both person-person and person-object), and insufficient individual attribute alignment. To bridge these gaps, we present OmniHuman, a large-scale, multi-scene dataset designed for fine-grained human modeling. OmniHuman provides a hierarchical annotation covering video-level scenes, frame-level interactions, and individual-level attributes. To facilitate this, we develop a fully automated pipeline for high-quality data collection and multi-modal annotation. Complementary to the dataset, we establish the OmniHuman Benchmark (OHBench), a three-level evaluation system that provides a scientific diagnosis for human-centric audio-video synthesis. Crucially, OHBench introduces metrics that are highly consistent with human perception, filling the gaps in existing benchmarks by providing a comprehensive diagnosis across global scenes, relational interactions, and individual attributes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniHuman，一个大规模、多场景的人类中心视频生成数据集，提供分层标注（视频级场景、帧级交互、个体级属性），并配套建立了 OmniHuman Benchmark (OHBench)，一个三级评估系统，用于科学诊断人类中心音视频合成，其指标与人类感知高度一致。
Motivation: 现有数据集在全局场景和相机多样性、稀疏交互建模（人与人、人与物体）以及个体属性对齐方面存在结构性缺陷，限制了复杂真实物理场景下高保真人类中心视频的生成。
Method: 开发全自动流水线进行高质量数据收集和多模态标注，构建 OmniHuman 数据集；并建立 OHBench 评估系统，包含视频级场景、帧级交互和个体级属性三个层次的诊断指标。
Result: OmniHuman 数据集和 OHBench 基准填补了现有数据及评估的空白，提供了与人类感知高度一致的指标，可在全局场景、关系交互和个体属性上全面诊断生成质量。
Conclusion: OmniHuman 数据集和基准为人类中心音视频合成研究提供了更全面的数据支持和科学评估工具。

papers.title: FlowC2S: Flowing from Current to Succeeding Frames for Fast and Memory-Efficient Video Continuation
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel methodology for generating fast and memory-efficient video continuations. Our method, dubbed FlowC2S, fine-tunes a pre-trained text-to-video flow model to learn a vector field between the current and succeeding video chunks. Two design choices are key. First, we introduce inherent optimal couplings, utilizing temporally adjacent video chunks during training as a practical proxy for true optimal couplings, resulting in straighter flows. Second, we incorporate target inversion, injecting the inverted latent of the target chunk into the input representation to strengthen correspondences and improve visual fidelity. By flowing directly from current to succeeding frames, instead of the common combination of current frames with noise to generate a video continuation, we reduce the dimensionality of the model input by a factor of two. The proposed method, fine-tuned from LTXV and Wan, surpasses the state-of-the-art scores across quantitative evaluations with FID and FVD, with as few as five neural function evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowC2S方法，通过微调预训练文本到视频流模型，学习当前帧与后续帧之间的向量场，实现快速且内存高效的视频延续。关键设计包括利用时序相邻视频块作为最优耦合代理，以及目标反转注入以增强视觉保真度。在LTXV和Wan模型上微调后，在FID和FVD指标上超越现有方法，仅需5次神经函数评估。
Motivation: 现有视频延续方法通常将当前帧与噪声结合生成后续帧，导致输入维度过高且计算开销大。
Method: 提出FlowC2S，微调预训练文本到视频流模型，引入内在最优耦合（使用时序相邻视频块作为代理）和目标反转（将目标块的反转潜变量注入输入表示），直接从当前帧流向后续帧，将输入维度减半。
Result: 在定量评估中，FlowC2S在FID和FVD指标上超越当前最优方法，仅需5次神经函数评估。
Conclusion: FlowC2S通过更直的流和更强的帧间对应，实现了快速且内存高效的视频延续，适用于长序列生成。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Reward Score Matching: Unifying Reward-based Fine-tuning for Flow and Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward-based fine-tuning steers a pretrained diffusion or flow-based generative model toward higher-reward samples while remaining close to the pretrained model. Although existing methods are derived from different perspectives, we show that many can be written under a common framework, which we call reward score matching (RSM). Under this view, alignment becomes score matching against a value-guided target, and the main differences across methods reduce to the construction of the value-guidance estimator and the effective optimization strength across timesteps. This unification clarifies the bias-variance-compute tradeoffs of existing designs, and distinguishes core optimization components from auxiliary mechanisms that add complexity without clear benefit. Guided by this perspective, we develop simpler, more efficient redesigns across representative differentiable and black-box reward alignment tasks. Overall, RSM turns a seemingly fragmented collection of reward-based fine-tuning methods into a smaller, more interpretable, and more actionable design space. Code is available at https://github.com/jaylee2000/rsm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出奖励分数匹配（RSM）统一框架，将基于奖励的微调方法（针对扩散模型和流模型）归结为对值引导得分匹配的变体。该框架揭示了现有方法在偏差-方差-计算权衡上的差异，并指导设计更简单高效的微调方法。
Motivation: 现有基于奖励的微调方法来源不同，缺乏统一理解，导致设计碎片化，难以比较和优化。
Method: 提出奖励分数匹配框架，将微调视为对值引导目标的得分匹配，不同方法的差异仅在于值引导估计器的构造和优化强度的时序调度。
Result: 在可微和黑盒奖励对齐任务上，基于该框架设计的简化方法更高效。
Conclusion: RSM将看似多样的奖励微调方法转化为更小、更可解释和更可行的设计空间。

papers.title: Mean Flow Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have recently emerged as expressive policy representations for online reinforcement learning (RL). However, their iterative generative processes introduce substantial training and inference overhead. To overcome this limitation, we propose to represent policies using MeanFlow models, a class of few-step flow-based generative models, to improve training and inference efficiency over diffusion-based RL approaches. To promote exploration, we optimize MeanFlow policies under the maximum entropy RL framework via soft policy iteration, and address two key challenges specific to MeanFlow policies: action likelihood evaluation and soft policy improvement. Experiments on MuJoCo, DeepMind Control Suite and HumanoidBench benchmarks demonstrate that our method, Mean Flow Policy Optimization (MFPO), achieves performance comparable to or exceeding current diffusion-based baselines while considerably reducing training and inference time. Our code is available at https://github.com/dongxiaoyi-xyz/MFPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Mean Flow Policy Optimization (MFPO)，使用MeanFlow模型（一种少步流生成模型）作为策略表示，替代扩散模型在在线强化学习中的迭代生成，以降低训练和推理开销。在最大熵强化学习框架下，通过软策略迭代优化MeanFlow策略，解决了动作似然评估和软策略改进两个关键问题。在MuJoCo、DeepMind Control Suite和HumanoidBench上的实验表明，MFPO性能可与基于扩散的基线相当或更好，同时大幅减少训练和推理时间。
Motivation: 扩散模型作为策略表示在在线RL中有效，但其迭代生成过程带来了较大的训练和推理开销，限制了实际应用效率。
Method: 提出使用MeanFlow模型（少步流生成模型）表示策略，并在最大熵RL框架下通过软策略迭代进行优化；专门处理MeanFlow策略的动作似然评估和软策略改进挑战。
Result: 在MuJoCo、DeepMind Control Suite和HumanoidBench上，MFPO达到或超越了当前基于扩散的基线方法的性能，同时显著降低了训练和推理时间。
Conclusion: MFPO提供了一种更高效的基于生成模型策略的RL方法，减少了计算开销，性能不逊于扩散方法。

papers.title: Representation over Routing: Diagnosing Temporal Routing Pathologies in Multi-Timescale PPO
papers.abstract_en: Temporal credit assignment in reinforcement learning is often approached by introducing value estimates at multiple discount factors. A natural next step is to let the actor dynamically route among these temporal heads, using either differentiable attention or heuristic uncertainty weights. This paper argues that such routing can create a numerical shortcut rather than a reliable temporal abstraction. We study this issue in a controlled PPO setting on LunarLander-v2, using the environment as a visual sandbox for diagnosing failure modes. First, we formalize Surrogate Objective Hacking: a differentiable softmax router exposed to the PPO surrogate receives a direct gradient toward advantage heads that are numerically favorable for the current update, even when this routing change does not correspond to improved physical control. Because unnormalized advantages at different discount factors have different effective scales, this creates a scale-discrepancy vulnerability. Second, we identify the Paradox of Temporal Uncertainty in gradient-free error-based routing: short-horizon heads can receive the largest routing share because their prediction targets are easier, even when they are less aligned with delayed task success. As a structural response, we study Target Decoupling: the critic may retain multi-timescale auxiliary heads, but the actor is updated only with the long-horizon advantage. Target Decoupling is not presented as a broad performance booster; in this run set it removes the exploitable actor-side routing pathway and improves the observed worst-seed return. Code is available at https://github.com/ben-dlwlrma/Representation-Over-Routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多时间尺度PPO中时间信度分配的问题，指出动态路由机制可能导致数值捷径而非可靠的时间抽象。在LunarLander-v2上诊断了两种失败模式：可微路由的“代理目标劫持”和梯度无关路由的“时间不确定性悖论”。作为解决方案，提出“目标解耦”：只让演员使用长时域优势更新，从而移除可被利用的路由路径，在实验中改善了最差种子的回报。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法通过多个折扣因子估计价值，并让演员动态路由到不同时间尺度的头部，但这种路由可能产生数值捷径，导致路由变化不反映物理控制的改进。
Method: 形式化分析了两种路由失败模式（代理目标劫持和时间不确定性悖论），并提出目标解耦：评论家保留多时间尺度辅助头，但演员只使用长时域优势进行更新。
Result: 在LunarLander-v2上的实验表明，目标解耦移除了可被利用的演员侧路由路径，并改善了最差种子的回报。
Conclusion: 多时间尺度路由可能不可靠，目标解耦是一种简单的结构性回应，但并非通用的性能提升方法。

papers.title: TInR: Exploring Tool-Internalized Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) has emerged as a promising direction by extending Large Language Models' (LLMs) capabilities with external tools during reasoning. Existing TIR methods typically rely on external tool documentation during reasoning. However, this leads to tool mastery difficulty, tool size constraints, and inference inefficiency. To mitigate these issues, we explore Tool-Internalized Reasoning (TInR), aiming at facilitating reasoning with tool knowledge internalized into LLMs. Achieving this goal presents notable requirements, including tool internalization and tool-reasoning coordination. To address them, we propose TInR-U, a tool-internalized reasoning framework for unified reasoning and tool usage. TInR-U is trained through a three-phase pipeline: 1) tool internalization with a bidirectional knowledge alignment strategy; 2) supervised fine-tuning warm-up using high-quality reasoning annotations, and 3) reinforcement learning with TInR-specific rewards. We comprehensively evaluate our method across in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Experiment results show that TInR-U achieves superior performance in both settings, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索工具内化推理 (Tool-Internalized Reasoning, TInR)，旨在将工具知识内化到大语言模型中，避免推理时依赖外部工具文档。提出 TInR-U 框架，通过三阶段训练：双向知识对齐的工具内化、监督微调预热、强化学习。实验表明在域内和域外设置下均取得优越性能。
Motivation: 现有工具集成推理 (TIR) 方法依赖外部工具文档，导致工具掌握困难、工具规模受限和推理效率低下。
Method: 提出 TInR-U 框架，包含三阶段流水线：1) 双向知识对齐策略进行工具内化；2) 使用高质量推理标注进行监督微调预热；3) 基于 TInR 特定奖励的强化学习。
Result: 在域内和域外设置下，TInR-U 均取得优越性能，证明其有效性和效率。
Conclusion: 工具内化推理可避免外部依赖，提升推理效率，框架在多种设置下表现出色。

papers.title: SCOPE: Signal-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation Enhancement with Dual-Path Adaptive Weighting
papers.abstract_en: On-policy reinforcement learning has become the dominant paradigm for reasoning alignment in large language models, yet its sparse, outcome-level rewards make token-level credit assignment notoriously difficult. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) alleviates this by introducing dense, token-level KL supervision from a teacher model, but typically applies this supervision uniformly across all rollouts, ignoring fundamental differences in signal quality. We propose Signal-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation Enhancement (SCOPE), a dual-path adaptive training framework that routes on-policy rollouts by correctness into two complementary supervision paths. For incorrect trajectories, SCOPE performs teacher-perplexity-weighted KL distillation to prioritize instances where the teacher demonstrates genuine corrective capability, while down-weighting unreliable guidance. For correct trajectories, it applies student-perplexity-weighted MLE to concentrate reinforcement on low-confidence samples at the capability boundary rather than over-reinforcing already mastered ones. Both paths employ a group-level normalization to adaptively calibrate weight distributions, accounting for the intrinsic difficulty variance across prompts. Extensive experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that SCOPE achieves an average relative improvement of 11.42% in Avg@32 and 7.30% in Pass@32 over competitive baselines, demonstrating its consistent effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE框架，针对在线策略强化学习中的稀疏奖励问题，通过双路径自适应加权进行在线策略蒸馏增强。对于错误轨迹使用教师困惑度加权的KL散度，对于正确轨迹使用学生困惑度加权的MLE，并引入组级归一化。在六个推理基准上取得平均相对提升11.42% (Avg@32)和7.30% (Pass@32)。
Motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏对所有轨迹均匀应用监督，忽略了信号质量差异，导致信用分配困难。
Method: 双路径自适应训练框架，根据正确性拆分轨迹：错误路径使用教师困惑度加权的KL蒸馏，正确路径使用学生困惑度加权的MLE，并采用组级归一化校准权重分布。
Result: 在六个推理基准上，SCOPE在Avg@32和Pass@32上分别比强基线平均相对提升11.42%和7.30%。
Conclusion: SCOPE通过自适应加权和双路径蒸馏一致有效。

papers.title: AffordGen: Generating Diverse Demonstrations for Generalizable Object Manipulation with Afford Correspondence
papers.abstract_en: Despite the recent success of modern imitation learning methods in robot manipulation, their performance is often constrained by geometric variations due to limited data diversity. Leveraging powerful 3D generative models and vision foundation models (VFMs), the proposed AffordGen framework overcomes this limitation by utilizing the semantic correspondence of meaningful keypoints across large-scale 3D meshes to generate new robot manipulation trajectories. This large-scale, affordance-aware dataset is then used to train a robust, closed-loop visuomotor policy, combining the semantic generalizability of affordances with the reactive robustness of end-to-end learning. Experiments in simulation and the real world show that policies trained with AffordGen achieve high success rates and enable zero-shot generalization to truly unseen objects, significantly improving data efficiency in robot learning. Project Page: https://jiaweiz9.github.io/AffordGen-release/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出AffordGen框架，利用3D生成模型和视觉基础模型的语义对应，从大规模3D网格生成多样化机器人操作轨迹，训练闭环视觉运动策略，实现零样本泛化到未见物体。
Motivation: 现有模仿学习方法因数据多样性不足而受限于几何变化，需要更高效的数据生成方法。
Method: 通过大规模3D网格上关键点的语义对应，使用3D生成模型和视觉基础模型生成新轨迹，训练结合语义泛化性和端到端鲁棒性的闭环视觉运动策略。
Result: 仿真和真实实验表明，策略成功率高，能零样本泛化到未见物体，显著提升数据效率。
Conclusion: 框架结合可泛化性与鲁棒性，大幅提升机器人学习的数据效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BareBones: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Geometric Comprehension in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable zero-shot recognition capabilities across a diverse spectrum of multimodal tasks, it yet remains an open question whether these architectures genuinely comprehend geometric structure or merely exploit RGB textures and contextual priors as statistical shortcuts. Existing evaluations fail to isolate this mechanism, conflating semantic reasoning with texture mapping and relying on imprecise annotations that inadvertently leak environmental cues. To address this gap, we introduce $\textbf{BareBones}$, a zero-shot benchmark designed to stress-test pure geometric shape comprehension. We curate pixel-level silhouettes of geometrically distinct classes across six datasets: five established segmentation sources (ImageNet-S, DIS5K, ThinObject5K, PASCAL VOC, CUB-200) and our novel flagship collection, WTP-Bench, establishing a noise-free geometric taxonomy. WTP-Bench is an extreme, fine-grained visual puzzle that forces models to identify inter-class geometric concepts from boundary contours alone. Our evaluation of 26 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight VLMs (eg. GPT-4.1, Gemini, Claude Sonnet 4.5, LLaVA) reveals a consistent, severe performance collapse under RGB deprivation, a phenomenon we term the $\textit{Texture Bias Cliff}$. By documenting universal structural blindspots, BareBones establishes a rigorous yardstick for genuine geometric grounding. Project Page: https://eternal-f1ame.github.io/WTP-Bench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BareBones 基准，通过像素级轮廓图像剥离 RGB 纹理和上下文先验，专门测试视觉语言模型（VLM）的纯几何形状零样本理解能力。评估了 26 个 SOTA 模型（如 GPT-4.1、Gemini、Claude Sonnet 4.5、LLaVA），发现在无 RGB 信息时所有模型性能严重下降，称为“纹理偏置悬崖”（Texture Bias Cliff）。关键数据集 WTP-Bench 提供细粒度几何分类任务。
Motivation: 现有评估无法区分 VLM 是真正理解几何结构还是利用 RGB 纹理和上下文统计捷径，缺乏隔离几何推理的严格基准。
Method: 构建 BareBones 基准，使用像素级轮廓图像（来自 ImageNet-S、DIS5K、ThinObject5K、PASCAL VOC、CUB-200 和自建 WTP-Bench），去除颜色和纹理，仅保留几何边界，对 26 个 VLM 进行零样本分类测试。
Result: 所有 VLM 在无 RGB 条件下性能剧烈下降，揭示对纹理的普遍依赖，即“纹理偏置悬崖”。
Conclusion: 现有 VLM 缺乏真正的几何理解，依赖纹理统计捷径；BareBones 可作为评估几何基础能力的严苛标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Genie 4D: Semantic-Prior-Guided 4D Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: At the intersection of computer vision and robotic perception, 4D reconstruction of dynamic scenes connects low-level geometric sensing with high-level semantic understanding. We present Genie 4D, a framework that turns hand-held phone capture into a semantically grounded, action-controllable 4D world model. Genie 4D couples a real-time visual-inertial Gaussian splatting front-end for metric geometry with a feed-forward 4D backbone regularized by frozen DINOv3 features acting as structural priors. The semantic priors suppress identity drift during dynamic tracking, while a short conditional diffusion refiner recovers high-frequency surface detail that regression backbones smooth away. Finally, a lightweight latent-action head exposes the reconstructed 4D state to a Genie-style world model trained with a JEPA-style next-embedding objective, so that the scene can be rolled forward under user actions. On the Point Odyssey and TUM-Dynamics benchmarks, Genie 4D retains the linear time complexity O(T) of feed-forward baselines while improving 3D tracking accuracy (APD) and reconstruction completeness, and it runs interactively on a single consumer GPU (RTX 5090) from iPhone, Mac, Windows, and Linux capture clients. Genie 4D offers a practical, semantic-prior-guided path toward physically grounded world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Genie 4D是一个从手持手机拍摄构建语义化、动作可控的4D动态场景重建框架。它结合实时视觉-惯性高斯泼溅前端和前馈4D骨干网络，利用冻结的DINOv3特征作为结构先验抑制动态跟踪中的身份漂移，并通过短条件扩散精化器恢复高频表面细节。最后，轻量级潜在动作头将重建的4D状态暴露给以JEPA风格下一嵌入目标训练的Genie式世界模型，支持用户动作下的场景前向推演。在Point Odyssey和TUM-Dynamics基准上，该方法保持前馈基线O(T)的时间复杂度，同时提升了3D跟踪精度和重建完整性，可在消费级GPU上交互运行。
Motivation: 现有4D动态场景重建方法在长时间动态跟踪中易出现身份漂移，且难以同时保证几何精度、语义一致性和动作可控性。
Method: 提出Genie 4D框架：使用实时视觉-惯性高斯泼溅前端恢复度量几何；以冻结的DINOv3特征作为语义先验正则化前馈4D骨干，抑制动态跟踪中的身份漂移；引入短条件扩散精化器恢复被回归骨干平滑掉的高频细节；最后通过轻量级潜在动作头连接JEPA式世界模型实现用户动作下的场景推演。
Result: 在Point Odyssey和TUM-Dynamics基准上，Genie 4D保持O(T)线性时间复杂度，提升了3D跟踪准确度（APD）和重建完整性，可在单个RTX 5090 GPU上交互运行，支持iPhone、Mac、Windows和Linux客户端。
Conclusion: Genie 4D提供了一条利用语义先验引导的实用路径，将手机拍摄转化为物理上有根基的、动作可控的4D世界模型。

summary_sections.conclusion: Genie 4D提供了一条利用语义先验引导的实用路径，将手机拍摄转化为物理上有根基的、动作可控的4D世界模型。

papers.title: AtomEval: Validity-Aware Atomic Evaluation of Adversarial Claim Rewriting in Fact Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can rewrite refuted claims to evade evidence-based fact verifiers, but conventional attack success rate (ASR) can be inflated when rewrites change, weaken, or correct the false proposition they are supposed to preserve. We introduce AtomEval, a validity-aware evaluation protocol for fixed-evidence adversarial claim rewriting. AtomEval represents claims as subject--relation--object--modifier (SROM) atoms, applies a one-way preservation gate to separate valid verifier evasion from proposition-changing rewrites, and reports validity-aware attack success rate (VASR), which counts only verifier-evasive rewrites that preserve the original false proposition. AtomEval further provides fine-grained diagnostics that explain both proposition-level failures and non-minimal valid rewrites. On FEVER refuted-claim rewriting, AtomEval exposes and explains ASR inflation: many apparent attacks fool the verifier by altering, weakening, or correcting the proposition they should preserve. By making attacked-proposition preservation explicit and measurable, AtomEval provides a stable evaluation target for evaluating adversarial rewriters that must balance verifier evasion with proposition preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AtomEval，一种用于事实核查中对抗性声明重写评估的有效性感知协议。通过将声明表示为SROM原子，并应用单向保留门，AtomEval能够区分真实绕过验证器与改变命题的重写，并报告有效性感知攻击成功率（VASR）。在FEVER数据集上，AtomEval揭示了传统ASR指标的膨胀现象。
Motivation: 现有攻击成功率（ASR）指标可能因重写改变、削弱或修正原始虚假命题而膨胀，导致对对抗性声明重写效果的误判。需要一种能够评估重写是否真正保留原始命题的评估方法。
Method: AtomEval将声明分解为主体-关系-客体-修饰语（SROM）原子，引入单向保留门区分有效绕过与命题改变的重写，并计算VASR。同时提供细粒度诊断，解释命题级别失败和非最小有效重写。
Result: 在FEVER数据集上，AtomEval暴露并解释了ASR膨胀现象：许多看似成功的攻击实际上通过改变、削弱或修正命题来欺骗验证器。
Conclusion: AtomEval通过显式且可量化的命题保留评估，为需要平衡验证器绕过与命题保留的对抗性重写器提供了一个稳定的评估目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What's Missing in Screen-to-Action? Towards a UI-in-the-Loop Paradigm for Multimodal GUI Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) reasoning tasks remain challenging, particularly in UI understanding. Current methods typically rely on direct screen-based decision-making, which lacks interpretability and overlooks a comprehensive understanding of UI elements, ultimately leading to task failure. To enhance the understanding and interaction with UIs, we propose an innovative GUI reasoning paradigm called UI-in-the-Loop (UILoop). Our approach treats the GUI reasoning task as a cyclic Screen-UI elements-Action process. By enabling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to explicitly learn the localization, semantic functions, and practical usage of key UI elements, UILoop achieves precise element discovery and performs interpretable reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a more challenging UI Comprehension task centered on UI elements with three evaluation metrics. Correspondingly, we contribute a benchmark of 26K samples (UI Comprehension-Bench) to comprehensively evaluate existing methods' mastery of UI elements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UILoop achieves state-of-the-art UI understanding performance while yielding superior results in GUI reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的GUI推理范式UI-in-the-Loop (UILoop)，将屏幕截图、UI元素和操作步骤循环结合，让多模态大模型明确学习UI元素的定位、语义功能和实际用法，从而提升可解释性和任务成功率。同时，构建了包含26K样本的UI Comprehension-Bench基准，定义三种评估指标来衡量UI理解能力。实验表明UILoop在UI理解和GUI推理任务上达到最优。
Motivation: 现有GUI推理方法直接基于屏幕截图决策，缺乏对UI元素的全面理解和可解释性，导致任务易失败。
Method: 提出UILoop范式，将GUI推理建模为循环过程：屏幕→UI元素→动作。通过让MLLMs显式学习关键UI元素的定位、语义功能和实际用法，实现精确的元素发现和可解释推理。
Result: 在UI Comprehension-Bench基准上，UILoop在UI理解任务上取得最优性能，并在GUI推理任务上表现优越。
Conclusion: UILoop通过将UI元素信息显式引入循环，有效提升了GUI推理的可解释性和准确性。

papers.title: Automated Conjecture Resolution with Formal Verification
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have significantly improved their ability to perform mathematical reasoning, extending from elementary problem solving to increasingly capable performance on research-level problems. However, reliably solving and verifying such problems remains challenging due to the inherent ambiguity of natural language reasoning. In this paper, we propose an automated framework that integrates natural language reasoning with formal verification to tackle research-level mathematical problems. Our framework consists of two components: an informal reasoning agent, Rethlas, and a formal verification agent, Archon. Rethlas combines reasoning primitives with our theorem search engine, Matlas, to explore solution strategies and construct candidate proofs. Archon, equipped with LeanSearch, translates informal arguments into formalized Lean 4 projects through task decomposition, iterative refinement, and automated proof synthesis, ensuring machine-checkable correctness. Using this framework, we resolve an open problem in commutative algebra and formally verify the resulting proof in Lean 4 with essentially no human involvement. Additional case studies illustrate the capabilities of Rethlas in informal mathematical reasoning and discovery, as well as the ability of Archon to formalize research-level proofs in Lean 4. Our experiments demonstrate that strong theorem retrieval tools enable the discovery and application of cross-domain mathematical techniques, while the formal agent can autonomously fill nontrivial gaps in informal arguments. More broadly, our work illustrates a promising paradigm for mathematical research in which informal and formal reasoning systems, equipped with theorem retrieval tools, operate in tandem to produce verifiable results, reduce human effort, and support human-AI collaborative mathematical research.
papers.comment: Code and resources are available at: Rethlas (https://github.com/frenzymath/Rethlas), Rethlas Results (https://github.com/frenzymath/Rethlas_results), Archon (https://github.com/frenzymath/Archon), and the formalization results (https://github.com/frenzymath/Anderson-Conjecture)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合自然语言推理与形式验证的自动化框架，用于解决研究级数学问题。框架包含非正式推理智能体Rethlas和形式验证智能体Archon，通过定理检索和自动证明合成解决了一个交换代数开放问题并在Lean 4中形式验证。实验表明定理检索工具能发现跨领域数学技术，形式智能体能自主填补非正式论证中的非平凡空白。
Motivation: 数学推理中自然语言的固有模糊性使得可靠地求解和验证研究级问题仍然困难。
Method: 提出由非正式推理智能体Rethlas（结合推理基元和定理搜索引擎Matlas）和形式验证智能体Archon（配备LeanSearch，通过任务分解、迭代细化和自动证明合成将非正式论证翻译为形式化Lean 4项目）组成的框架。
Result: 利用该框架解决了一个交换代数开放问题，并在无需人类介入的情况下在Lean 4中形式验证了证明。其他案例展示了Rethlas在非正式数学推理和发现中的能力以及Archon形式化研究级证明的能力。
Conclusion: 展示了非正式与形式推理系统配备定理检索工具协同工作以产生可验证结果的数学研究范式，减少了人类努力并支持人机协作数学研究。

papers.title: Rashomon Memory: Towards Argumentation-Driven Retrieval for Multi-Perspective Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: AI agents operating over extended time horizons accumulate experiences that serve multiple concurrent goals, and must often maintain conflicting interpretations of the same events. A concession during a client negotiation encodes as a ``trust-building investment'' for one strategic goal and a ``contractual liability'' for another. Current memory architectures assume a single correct encoding, or at best support multiple views over unified storage. We propose Rashomon Memory: an architecture where parallel goal-conditioned agents encode experiences according to their priorities and negotiate at query time through argumentation. Each perspective maintains its own ontology and knowledge graph. At retrieval, perspectives propose interpretations, critique each other's proposals using asymmetric domain knowledge, and Dung's argumentation semantics determines which proposals survive. The resulting attack graph is itself an explanation: it records which interpretation was selected, which alternatives were considered, and on what grounds they were rejected. We present a proof-of-concept showing that retrieval modes (selection, composition, conflict surfacing) emerge from attack graph topology, and that the conflict surfacing mode, where the system reports genuine disagreement rather than forcing resolution, lets decision-makers see the underlying interpretive conflict directly.
papers.comment: Presented at EXTRAAMAS workshop at AAMAS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rashomon Memory 架构，允许并行目标条件代理根据各自优先级编码经验，并在查询时通过论证进行协商。每个视角维护自己的本体和知识图谱。检索时，视角提出解释，使用非对称领域知识相互批评，Dung 的论证语义决定哪些提议存活。攻击图本身作为解释。概念验证显示检索模式（选择、组合、冲突揭示）从攻击图拓扑中涌现，冲突揭示模式让决策者看到潜在的诠释冲突。
Motivation: 现有记忆架构假设单一正确编码或最多在统一存储上支持多视图，无法处理同一事件的矛盾诠释。
Method: 提出 Rashomon Memory 架构，使用并行目标条件代理、各自的知识图谱，在查询时通过 argumentation 协商，使用 Dung 的论证语义。
Result: 概念验证表明检索模式（选择、组合、冲突揭示）从攻击图拓扑中涌现，冲突揭示模式可展示根本性诠释冲突。
Conclusion: 论文强调攻击图作为解释，让决策者看到诠释冲突。

papers.title: Real-Time Sensing of Inaccessible Physical Fields via an Edge-Deployable Hardware-Portable Graph Neural Operator
papers.abstract_en: Real-time inference of inaccessible interior physical fields from sparse boundary observations is a fundamental but unresolved problem in scientific machine learning, with direct relevance to safety-critical monitoring across many engineering applications. Existing neural operators achieve high accuracy but leave deployment to embedded edge platforms unaddressed. Here we introduce VIRSO (Virtual Irregular Real-Time Sparse Operator), the first neural operator with a unique spatial-spectral architecture that explicitly addresses edge-deployment hardware. VIRSO learns a nonlinear mapping from sparse, geometrically disjoint boundary inputs to spatially continuous interior multiphysics fields on irregular unstructured meshes through a spectral-spatial decomposition explicitly aligned with hardware execution: a compute-bound graph spectral pathway and a memory-bandwidth-bound spatial-aggregation pathway, each independently characterized on datacenter and embedded accelerators. The design reduces the inference energy-delay product by 29$\times$ relative to the vanilla graph-operator baseline (206 J$\cdot$ms $\to$ 7.0 J$\cdot$ms on an NVIDIA H200) and enables 17.0 samples/s embedded inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano within 7.06 W board-level power, without modification. A mesh-density-adaptive graph construction strategy (V-KNN) simultaneously improves accuracy and reduces graph edge count by 34%. Across three benchmarks with reconstruction ratios from 47:1 to 156:1, VIRSO achieves mean relative $L_2$ errors below 1% with fewer parameters than operator baselines and delivers an inference speedup of $\approx 10^4$ times over the high-fidelity reference solver. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of a single-digit-watt neural operator, establishing hardware co-design as a missing ingredient in operator-based inference and a tractable path to real-time deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIRSO，首个面向边缘部署的硬件协同设计神经算子，用于从稀疏边界观测实时推断不可达内部物理场。VIRSO 通过光谱-空间分解架构，在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 上实现 17.0 samples/s 的推理，能耗延迟积降低 29 倍，并在三个基准上达到平均相对 L2 误差低于 1%。
Motivation: 现有神经算子虽精度高，但未考虑边缘嵌入式平台部署，难以用于安全关键监控场景。
Method: 设计 VIRSO，包含计算密集型图光谱路径和内存带宽密集型空间聚合路径，并引入网格密度自适应图构建策略 V-KNN。
Result: 在 H200 上能耗延迟积降低 29 倍，Jetson Orin Nano 上 7.06W 功耗下 17.0 samples/s，重建比 47:1 至 156:1 时平均相对 L2 误差<1%，推理速度比高保真解算器快约 10^4 倍。
Conclusion: 该工作首次实现单瓦级神经算子，证明硬件协同设计是算子推理实时部署的关键，但未涉及天气或降水应用。

papers.title: Understand and Accelerate Memory Processing Pipeline for Large Language Model Inference
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly depends on efficient long-context processing and generation mechanisms, including sparse attention, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and compressed contextual memory, to support complex reasoning. We show that these optimizations can be unified into a four-step memory processing pipeline: Prepare Memory, Compute Relevancy, Retrieval, and Apply to Inference. Through systematic profiling, we identify a 22%-97% memory processing overhead in LLM inference and strong heterogeneity in its computational characteristics. Motivated by this insight, we argue that \textbf{heterogeneous systems} are well-suited to accelerate memory processing and thus end-to-end inference. We demonstrate this approach on a GPU-FPGA system by offloading sparse, irregular, and memory-bounded operations to FPGAs while retaining compute-intensive operations on GPUs. Evaluated on an AMD MI210 GPU and an Alveo U55C FPGA, our system is up to $2.2\times$ faster and achieves up to $4.7\times$ less energy across multiple LLM inference optimizations than the GPU baseline (similar results hold on NVIDIA A100). These results establish heterogeneous systems as a practical direction for efficient LLM memory processing and inform future heterogeneous hardware design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型推理中的内存处理开销，通过系统分析识别出内存处理占推理时间的22%-97%，并提出使用GPU-FPGA异构系统加速。在AMD MI210 GPU和Alveo U55C FPGA上评估，相比仅GPU基线，端到端推理速度提升最高2.2倍，能耗降低最高4.7倍。
Motivation: 现代LLM依赖长上下文处理和生成机制（如稀疏注意力、RAG、压缩上下文记忆），但这些优化引入了显著的内存处理开销（22%-97%），且计算特征高度异构。
Method: 提出将多种优化统一为四步内存处理流水线（Prepare Memory, Compute Relevancy, Retrieval, Apply to Inference），并采用GPU-FPGA异构系统，将稀疏、不规则、内存受限的运算卸载到FPGA，密集计算保留在GPU。
Result: 在AMD MI210 GPU和Alveo U55C FPGA上，系统实现最高2.2倍加速和最高4.7倍能耗降低；类似结果在NVIDIA A100上也成立。

papers.title: Preconditioned One-Step Generative Modeling for Bayesian Inverse Problems in Function Spaces
papers.abstract_en: We propose a machine-learning algorithm for Bayesian inverse problems in the function-space regime. Based on one-step generative transport, the method learns an amortized neural operator whose pushforward of a Gaussian source approximates the posterior distribution conditioned on each new observation. We show that white-noise sources are incompatible with the function-space limit, and therefore adopt a prior-aligned GRF as the source. We justify this choice through the Lipschitz regularity of the resulting one-step conditional posterior transport and numerical experiments on linear inverse and PDE-based inverse problems. The method is not distilled from MCMC: it is trained only with prior samples and simulated partial noisy observations. Once trained, it generates a $64\times64$ posterior sample in $\sim 10^{-3}$s, avoiding repeated forward-model evaluations in MCMC and repeated network evaluations in multistep generative samplers while matching key posterior summaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对函数空间中的贝叶斯逆问题，提出一种基于一步生成传输（one-step generative transport）的机器学习算法。该方法学习一个摊销的神经算子，将高斯源的推前分布近似为以观测为条件的后验分布。理论分析表明白噪声源不适用于函数空间极限，因此采用先验对齐的GRF作为源，并通过Lipschitz正则性证明其合理性。数值实验在线性和PDE逆问题上验证了方法，训练后生成64×64后验样本仅需约10⁻³秒，避免了MCMC的重复正向模型评估和多步生成采样器的重复网络评估，同时匹配关键后验摘要。
Motivation: 传统MCMC方法在函数空间贝叶斯逆问题上计算成本高，且多步生成模型需要重复评估网络。现有一步生成方法使用白噪声源时在函数空间极限下不兼容，导致后验近似失效。
Method: 提出先验对齐的高斯随机场（GRF）作为源分布，训练神经算子实现从源到后验的一步推前传输（pushforward），避免多步采样或MCMC的迭代。训练仅需先验样本和模拟的部分噪声观测。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在线性和PDE逆问题上匹配关键后验摘要，且生成64×64后验样本仅需约10⁻³秒，显著快于MCMC和多步生成方法。
Conclusion: 论文强调该方法在函数空间贝叶斯逆问题上的高效性和理论合理性，但实验仅限于线性逆问题和PDE逆问题，未涉及更大规模或更复杂的逆问题。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Probabilistic Circuits via Voronoi Tessellations
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) enable exact and tractable inference but employ data independent mixture weights that limit their ability to capture local geometry of the data manifold. We propose Voronoi tessellations (VT) as a natural way to incorporate geometric structure directly into the sum nodes of a PC. However, naïvely introducing such structure breaks tractability. We formalize this incompatibility and develop two complementary solutions: (1) an approximate inference framework that provides guaranteed lower and upper bounds for inference, and (2) a structural condition for VT under which exact tractable inference is recovered. Finally, we introduce a differentiable relaxation for VT that enables gradient-based learning and empirically validate the resulting approach on standard density estimation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过Voronoi图将几何结构引入概率电路（PC）的求和节点，以更好地捕捉数据流形的局部几何特性。然而，直接引入会破坏可处理推理（tractable inference），作者形式化了这一不兼容性并提出了两种互补解决方案：近似推理框架（提供保证的上下界）和一种结构条件（恢复精确可处理推理）。此外，引入了VT的可微松弛以实现梯度下降学习，并在标准密度估计任务上进行了实证验证。
Motivation: 现有概率电路使用与数据无关的混合权重，限制了其捕捉数据流形局部几何结构的能力。
Method: 利用Voronoi图将几何结构直接整合到PC的求和节点中，针对由此导致的不可处理性，提出近似推理框架（保证上下界）和一种结构条件（恢复精确推理），并开发了可微松弛以支持梯度优化。
Result: 在标准密度估计任务上，所提方法展现了有效性能，但摘要未提供具体的定量结果（如数据集上的数值改进）。
Conclusion: 本文证明了将Voronoi图融入概率电路的可行性与局限性，为在可处理概率模型中融合几何先验提供了理论与算法框架。

papers.title: RESBev: Making BEV Perception More Robust
papers.abstract_en: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception has emerged as a cornerstone of autonomous driving systems, providing a structured, ego-centric representation critical for downstream planning and control. However, real-world deployment faces challenges from sensor degradation and adversarial attacks, which can cause severe perceptual anomalies and ultimately compromise the safety of autonomous driving systems. To address this, we propose a resilient and plug-and-play BEV perception method, RESBev, which can be easily applied to existing BEV perception methods to enhance their robustness to diverse disturbances. Specifically, we reframe perception robustness as a latent semantic prediction problem. A latent world model is constructed to extract spatiotemporal correlations across sequential BEV observations, thereby learning the underlying BEV state transitions to predict clean BEV features for reconstructing corrupted observations. The proposed framework operates at the semantic feature level of the Lift-Splat-Shoot pipeline, enabling recovery that generalizes across both natural disturbances and adversarial attacks without modifying the underlying backbone. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that, with few-shot fine-tuning, RESBev significantly improves the robustness of existing BEV perception models against various external disturbances and adversarial attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RESBev 是一种即插即用的鲁棒 BEV 感知方法，通过构建潜世界模型提取时空相关性，预测清洁 BEV 特征以恢复受扰观测，提升对传感器退化、对抗攻击等干扰的鲁棒性。在 nuScenes 数据集上，少量微调即可显著提高现有 BEV 模型的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 BEV 感知方法在真实部署中易受传感器退化和对抗攻击影响，导致感知异常并危及自动驾驶安全。
Method: 将感知鲁棒性问题重构为潜在语义预测问题，构建潜世界模型从连续 BEV 观测中学习状态转移，预测清洁 BEV 特征以重建受损观测；在 LSS 流水线的语义特征层面操作，无需修改主干模型。
Result: 在 nuScenes 数据集上，通过少量微调，RESBev 显著提升了多种现有 BEV 感知模型对抗自然扰动和对抗攻击的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: RESBev 提供了一种通用、无需修改主干模型的鲁棒增强方法，适用于多种 BEV 感知系统。

papers.title: See, Plan, Rewind: Progress-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robust Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Measurement of task progress through explicit, actionable milestones is critical for robust robotic manipulation. This progress awareness enables a model to ground its current task status, anticipate verifiable intermediate states, and detect and recover from failures when progress stalls. To embody this capability, we introduce \textbf{S}ee, \textbf{P}lan, \textbf{R}ewind (SPR), a progress-aware vision-language-action framework that dynamically grounds language instructions into a sequence of spatial subgoals. SPR operates through a continuous core cycle, Seeing the current state and upcoming milestone, Planning a trajectory towards the next 2D waypoint, and Rewinding to a recoverable state upon failure by monitoring progress against the expected sequence. This closed-loop approach enables robust error correction without requiring additional training data or auxiliary models. Extensive experiments demonstrate the framework's effectiveness, generalization and robustness: SPR outperforms the MolmoAct baseline by 5\% on the LIBERO benchmark. On the challenging LIBERO-Plus benchmark with unseen instructions and initial states, SPR achieves state-of-the-art robustness with the smallest performance drop, surpassing OpenVLA-OFT and UniVLA, demonstrating superior out-of-distribution robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种进度感知的视觉-语言-动作框架 SPR，通过将语言指令动态接地为空间子目标序列，实现机器人操作中的错误检测与恢复。该方法在 LIBERO 基准上比 MolmoAct 基线提升 5%，在更具挑战性的 LIBERO-Plus 上表现出最佳鲁棒性。
Motivation: 机器人操作需要感知任务进度以检测和恢复失败，现有方法缺乏对中间里程碑的显式建模，导致对分布外状态鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出 See-Plan-Rewind 闭环框架：See 模块观测当前状态和即将到来的里程碑，Plan 模块规划朝向下一二维路点的轨迹，Rewind 模块在进度停滞时回退到可恢复状态，无需额外训练数据或辅助模型。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，SPR 优于 MolmoAct 基线 5%；在 LIBERO-Plus 上，SPR 性能下降最小，超过 OpenVLA-OFT 和 UniVLA，展现强分布外鲁棒性。
Conclusion: SPR 框架通过进度感知和显式错误恢复机制提升了机器人操作的鲁棒性和泛化能力，且无需额外训练数据。

papers.title: Reading, Not Thinking: Understanding and Bridging the Modality Gap When Text Becomes Pixels in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process text presented as images, yet they often perform worse than when the same content is provided as textual tokens. We systematically diagnose this "modality gap" by evaluating seven MLLMs across seven benchmarks in five input modes, spanning both synthetically rendered text and realistic document images from arXiv PDFs to Wikipedia pages. We find that the gap is highly sensitive to rendering choices such as font and resolution, and that natural document images often exhibit much smaller gaps, suggesting the performance difference partly reflects evaluation artifacts rather than fundamental limitations. Through a grounded-theory error analysis of over 4,000 examples, we identify the primary cause: image input alone suppresses reasoning effort, with models producing 5--19x shorter outputs that skip step-by-step computation or reasoning. The reluctance to reason, not a failure of perception or knowledge retrieval, drives the performance gap, particularly on tasks requiring multi-step reasoning. We show that a simple, lightweight on-policy self-distillation method by fine-tuning models on their own text-mode reasoning traces paired with image inputs closes this gap, raising image-mode accuracy to match or exceed text-mode performance with over 50\% improvement, and the gains transfer to unseen benchmarks without catastrophic forgetting. Overall, our results and analyses provide a systematic understanding of the modality gap and suggest a practical path toward improving visual text understanding in multimodal language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在处理文本作为图像时性能下降的“模态差距”问题。通过评估七个模型在七个基准上的五种输入模式，发现渲染选择（如字体、分辨率）敏感，但自然文档图像差距较小。错误分析表明，主要原因在于图像输入抑制了推理努力，模型输出变短且跳过逐步推理。提出一种轻量级on-policy自蒸馏方法，通过微调模型使用其文本模式推理痕迹和图像输入，消除了差距，图像模式精度提升超过50%。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型处理图像中的文本时性能不如直接文本输入，这种“模态差距”的原因和机制尚不明确，需要系统诊断和解决。
Method: 系统评估七个MLLMs在七个基准上的五种输入模式；进行超过4000个示例的扎根理论错误分析；提出一种轻量级on-policy自蒸馏方法，通过微调模型使其图像输入下模仿自身文本模式的推理痕迹。
Result: 图像输入导致模型输出缩短5-19倍，跳过逐步推理；自蒸馏方法将图像模式精度提升超过50%，达到或超过文本模式性能，且泛化到未见基准。
Conclusion: 模态差距主要源于图像输入抑制推理努力，而非感知或知识检索失败。自蒸馏方法提供了一种实用路径来改善多模态语言模型的视觉文本理解。

papers.title: DyLLM: Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference via Saliency-based Token Selection and Partial Attention
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models enable parallel token decoding, providing a promising alternative to the sequential nature of autoregressive generation. However, their iterative denoising process remains computationally expensive because it repeatedly processes the entire sequence at every step. We observe that across these diffusion steps, most token representations remain stable; only a small subset, which we term salient tokens, contributes meaningfully to the next update. Leveraging this temporal sparsity, we present DyLLM, a training-free inference framework that accelerates decoding by selectively computing only these salient tokens. DyLLM identifies saliency by measuring the cosine similarity of attention contexts between adjacent denoising steps. It recomputes feed-forward and attention operations only for salient tokens while reusing cached activations for the remainder. Across diverse reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, DyLLM achieves up to 9.6x higher throughput while largely preserving the baseline accuracy of representative open-source diffusion LLMs, LLaDA, and Dream.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyLLM是一种无需训练的推理框架，利用扩散步骤中token表示的时间稀疏性，仅对显著token（salient tokens）计算前馈和注意力操作，其余token重用缓存激活，从而加速掩码扩散语言模型的解码过程。在推理和代码生成基准上，DyLLM在LLaDA和Dream模型上实现了最高9.6倍的吞吐量提升，同时基本保持基线精度。
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型在每一步都需要处理整个序列，计算成本高，而观察到大多数token在扩散步骤中保持稳定，只有少数显著token对后续更新有贡献。
Method: 通过计算相邻去噪步骤间注意力上下文的余弦相似度来识别显著token，仅对这些token重新计算前馈和注意力操作，其余token重用缓存激活。
Result: 在多种推理和代码生成基准上，DyLLM实现高达9.6倍的吞吐量提升，同时基本保持代表性开源扩散LLM（LLaDA和Dream）的基线精度。
Conclusion: DyLLM是一种训练免费的推理加速方法，利用时间稀疏性高效解码，显著提升吞吐量而不牺牲太多精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vision Language Models Cannot Reason About Physical Transformation
papers.abstract_en: Understanding physical transformations is fundamental for reasoning in dynamic environments. While Vision Language Models (VLMs) show promise in embodied applications, whether they genuinely understand physical transformations remains unclear. We introduce ConservationBench evaluating conservation -- whether physical quantities remain invariant under transformations. Spanning four properties with paired conserving/non-conserving scenarios, we generate and evaluate 23,040 questions across 112 VLMs. Results reveal systematic failure: performance remains near chance with improvements on conservation tasks accompanied by drops on controls. Control experiments show strong textual priors favoring invariance, yet models perform worse with actual visual content when performance is balanced across conserving and non-conserving scenarios. Neither temporal resolution, prompting, nor curated sampling helps. These findings show that current VLMs fail to maintain transformation-invariant representations of physical properties across dynamic scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过ConservationBench评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）对物理变换中守恒属性的理解能力，发现当前VLMs在动态场景中无法保持物理属性的变换不变表示，性能接近随机，且模型更依赖文本先验而非视觉内容。
Motivation: 现有工作对VLMs是否真正理解物理变换尚不清楚，缺乏系统评估其守恒推理能力的基准。
Method: 构建ConservationBench，涵盖四个物理属性的守恒与非守恒配对场景，生成23,040个问题，测试112个VLMs。
Result: 所有VLMs性能接近随机；守恒任务有微弱提升但对照任务下降；模型在有平衡场景时对实际视觉内容表现更差；时间分辨率、提示或精心采样均无效。
Conclusion: 当前VLMs未能掌握物理变换中的守恒不变性，该能力缺陷是系统性的。

papers.title: Design-MLLM: A Reinforcement Alignment Framework for Verifiable and Aesthetic Interior Design
papers.abstract_en: Interior design is a requirements-to-visual-plan generation process that must simultaneously satisfy verifiable spatial feasibility and comparative aesthetic preferences. While recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a unified foundation for interpreting user intent and producing design rationales, our empirical analysis reveals a persistent contradiction in real-world deployment: MLLMs often produce layouts that are unbuildable and aesthetically inconsistent. These findings indicate that simply adding in-domain text is insufficient; effective interior design requires an alignment mechanism that separates hard constraints from soft preferences and coordinates them during optimization. To address this, we propose Design-MLLM, a reinforcement alignment framework that optimizes a feasibility-first preference objective via a dual-branch, aesthetic-oriented reward. Specifically, Design-MLLM (i) explicitly evaluates spatial feasibility using programmatic constraint checks, (ii) assesses aesthetic preference only among feasible candidates to avoid visually appealing but unexecutable shortcuts, and (iii) performs group-relative optimization to obtain stable preference signals. Through this process, Design-MLLM learns a controllable policy that consistently selects and generates solutions that are both executable and aesthetically coherent, rather than occasionally producing visually appealing but infeasible designs. Extensive experiments on various benchmark datasets demonstrate the advantages of Design-MLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Design-MLLM，一种基于强化对齐的框架，用于生成既满足空间可行性又符合美学偏好的室内设计布局。该方法通过程序化约束检查评估可行性，仅在可行候选中评估美学偏好，并采用组相对优化获得稳定偏好信号。实验表明该方法优于基线。
Motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型在室内设计任务中常生成不可建造或美学不一致的布局，仅增加领域文本数据不足以解决，需要一种能够分离硬约束和软偏好并协调优化的对齐机制。
Method: Design-MLLM框架包含双分支美学导向奖励，通过强化学习优化可行性优先的偏好目标：显式检查空间可行性，仅对可行候选进行美学评估，并通过组相对优化获取稳定偏好信号。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，Design-MLLM在生成可执行且美学一致的布局方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了MLLM在室内设计中的可行性-美学矛盾，通过约束与偏好的协调优化实现了可控的布局生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Constitutional Black-Box Monitoring for Scheming in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Safe deployment of Large Language Model (LLM) agents in autonomous settings requires reliable oversight mechanisms. A central challenge is detecting scheming, where agents covertly pursue misaligned goals. One approach to mitigating such risks is LLM-based monitoring: using language models to examine agent behaviors for suspicious actions. We study constitutional black-box monitors: prompted classifiers that detect scheming using only externally observable inputs and outputs, optimized on synthetic data generated from natural-language behavior specifications. We introduce two pipelines for generating synthetic agent trajectories, STRIDE (iterative refinement) and Gloom (agent-environment simulation), from which we generate 1,000 samples each. We optimize frontier LLM monitors on these datasets via prompt sweeps, human refinement, and automated prompt optimization, and evaluate performance on 7,500 held-out trajectories from ControlArena, a suite of grounded environments where agents operate in more realistic contexts. Our results demonstrate that monitors selected purely on synthetic data can generalize to more realistic environments, capturing a meaningful scheming signal. However, we find that performance saturates quickly in our setting, with simple prompt sweeps matching the results of more extensive optimization. Pushing beyond this limit yields no further improvements and instead leads to overfitting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用大语言模型（LLM）作为黑箱监控器，仅通过外部可观察的输入输出检测LLM代理（agent）的欺骗行为（scheming）。作者提出了两种生成合成代理轨迹的流程STRIDE和Gloom，各生成1000个样本，通过提示搜索、人工优化和自动提示优化来优化前沿LLM监控器，并在ControlArena的7500个保留轨迹上评估性能。结果发现，基于合成数据选择的监控器能泛化到更真实的环境，捕捉到有意义的欺骗信号，但性能很快饱和，进一步优化只会导致过拟合。
Motivation: 在自主环境中安全部署LLM代理需要可靠的监督机制，核心挑战是检测代理秘密追求错误目标的欺骗行为。现有方法不足，本文探索基于LLM的监控方法。
Method: 提出宪法黑箱监控器（constitutional black-box monitors），即使用提示分类器仅基于外部输入输出检测欺骗。通过STRIDE（迭代细化）和Gloom（代理-环境模拟）两个流程生成合成代理轨迹，各1000条，然后对前沿LLM监控器进行提示搜索、人工精炼和自动提示优化。
Result: 在ControlArena的7500个保留轨迹上，基于合成数据优化的监控器能泛化到更真实环境，捕捉到有意义的欺骗信号。但性能很快饱和，简单提示搜索与更广泛优化结果相当，进一步优化无改进且导致过拟合。
Conclusion: 结果表明，基于合成数据的宪法黑箱监控器在检测欺骗方面有一定泛化能力，但性能上限有限，需要更谨慎地处理优化以避免过拟合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow-Based Density Ratio Estimation for Intractable Distributions with Applications in Genomics
papers.abstract_en: Estimating density ratios between pairs of intractable data distributions is a core problem in probabilistic modeling, enabling principled comparisons of sample likelihoods under different data-generating processes across conditions. While exact-likelihood models such as normalizing flows offer a promising approach to density ratio estimation, naive evaluations are computationally expensive and prone to discretization errors because they require simulating each distribution's likelihood independently. In this work, we leverage condition-aware flow matching to derive a single dynamical formulation for tracking density ratios along generative trajectories. We demonstrate competitive performance on simulated benchmarks for closed-form ratio estimation, and show that our method supports versatile tasks in single-cell genomics data analysis, where likelihood-based comparisons of cellular states across experimental conditions enable treatment effect estimation and batch correction evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于条件感知流匹配（condition-aware flow matching）的密度比估计方法，用于处理难以计算的数据分布对之间的密度比。该方法通过单一动力学公式追踪生成轨迹上的密度比，避免了独立模拟每个分布似然的高计算成本和离散化误差。在模拟基准测试中表现出竞争力，并在单细胞基因组学数据分析中展示了治疗效应估计和批次校正评估等应用。
Motivation: 密度比估计是概率建模中的核心问题，但基于精确似然模型（如归一化流）的朴素方法计算成本高且易产生离散化误差。
Method: 利用条件感知流匹配推导出一个单一的动力学公式，沿着生成轨迹追踪密度比。
Result: 在封闭形式密度比估计的模拟基准测试中取得竞争性能，并在单细胞基因组学数据中支持治疗效应估计和批次校正评估。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种高效且准确的密度比估计途径，适用于基因组学等领域的多种任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LookWise: Knowing When and Where to Look for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are shifting towards "Thinking with Images" by actively exploring image details. While effective, large-scale training is computationally expensive, which has spurred growing interest in lightweight, training-free solutions. However, existing training-free methods suffer from two flaws: perceptual redundancy from indiscriminate cropping, which increases computational cost and introduces noise; and a drift between semantic intent and spatial attention, which prevents accurate localization of user-focused regions. To address these challenges, we propose LookWise, a framework for adaptive visual reasoning. LookWise follows a two-stage pipeline: a confidence-based module decides when to look more carefully, and a semantic-guided localization module determines where to look. This design enables MLLMs to adaptively acquire fine-grained visual evidence without additional training. Experiments on fine-grained and high-resolution visual reasoning benchmarks show that LookWise consistently improves accuracy over strong baselines while achieving an approximately $4.0\times$ inference speedup over the search-based method ZoomEye, demonstrating robust cross-model generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LookWise框架，用于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的细粒度视觉推理。该框架采用两阶段流水线：基于置信度的模块决定何时更仔细地查看，语义引导的定位模块决定查看哪里。无需额外训练即可自适应获取细粒度视觉证据，在细粒度和高分辨率视觉推理基准上显著提升准确率，并实现约4倍的推理加速。
Motivation: 现有训练无关的视觉推理方法存在两个缺陷：无差别裁剪导致感知冗余和噪声，以及语义意图与空间注意力之间的漂移，无法准确定位用户关注区域。
Method: 提出LookWise框架，包含两个模块：置信度模块动态判断是否需要更精细的观察，语义引导定位模块确定关注区域，实现自适应视觉推理，无需额外训练。
Result: 在细粒度和高分辨率视觉推理基准上，LookWise一致地提高了强基线的准确率，并相比搜索方法ZoomEye实现了约4倍推理加速，展现出跨模型泛化能力。
Conclusion: LookWise通过轻量级、训练无关的框架有效解决了现有方法的冗余和注意力漂移问题，为MLLM的细粒度视觉推理提供了高效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IDLM: Inverse-distilled Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently achieved strong results in text generation. However, their multi-step sampling leads to slow inference, limiting practical use. To address this, we extend Inverse Distillation, a technique originally developed to accelerate continuous diffusion models, to the discrete setting. Nonetheless, this extension introduces both theoretical and practical challenges. From a theoretical perspective, the inverse distillation objective lacks uniqueness guarantees, which may lead to suboptimal solutions. From a practical standpoint, backpropagation in the discrete space is non-trivial and often unstable. To overcome these challenges, we first provide a theoretical result demonstrating that our inverse formulation admits a unique solution, thereby ensuring valid optimization. We then introduce gradient-stable relaxations to support effective training. As a result, experiments on multiple DLMs show that our method, Inverse-distilled Diffusion Language Models (IDLM), reduces the number of inference steps by 4x-64x, while preserving the teacher model's generation quality. We provide the code, model checkpoints, and video tutorials on the project page: https://david-cripto.github.io/idlm-project-page

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散语言模型（DLM）推理速度慢的问题，将逆蒸馏（Inverse Distillation）技术扩展至离散文本生成场景。通过理论证明逆蒸馏目标存在唯一解，并引入梯度稳定松弛（gradient-stable relaxations）解决离散空间反向传播的不稳定性。实验表明，该方法（IDLM）在多个DLM上减少4x-64x推理步数，同时保持教师模型的质量。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型多步采样导致推理缓慢，限制了实际应用；现有逆蒸馏方法适用于连续扩散，但在离散域存在目标非唯一解和反向传播不稳定的挑战。
Method: 理论证明离散逆蒸馏目标具有唯一解，从而确保优化有效性；设计梯度稳定松弛方法以支持稳定训练。
Result: 在多个扩散语言模型上，IDLM将推理步数减少4x-64x，同时生成质量与教师模型相当。
Conclusion: 逆蒸馏可有效加速离散扩散语言模型，且所提理论保证和稳定训练技术是关键贡献。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Adaptive Time Series Reasoning via Segment Selection
papers.abstract_en: Time series reasoning tasks often start with a natural language question and require targeted analysis of a time series. Evidence may span the full series or appear in a few short intervals, so the model must decide what to inspect. Most existing approaches encode the entire time series into a fixed representation before inference, regardless of whether or not the entire sequence is relevant. We introduce ARTIST, which formulates time-series reasoning as a sequential decision problem. ARTIST interleaves reasoning with adaptive temporal segment selection. It adopts a controller-reasoner architecture and uses reinforcement learning to train the controller role to select informative segments and the reasoner role to generate segment-conditioned reasoning traces and final answers. During inference, the model actively acquires task-relevant information instead of relying on a static summary of the full sequence. We use a novel hierarchical policy optimization approach for post-training that allows the model to excel in both segment selection and question-answering behavior. We evaluate ARTIST on six time-series reasoning benchmarks and compare it with large language models, vision-language models, and prior time-series reasoning systems. ARTIST improves average accuracy by 6.46 absolute percentage points over the strongest baseline. The largest gains appear on rare event localization and multi-segment reasoning tasks. Supervised fine-tuning improves performance, and reinforcement learning provides additional gains by optimizing question-adaptive segment selection. These results show that selective data use drives effective time-series reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARTIST，将时间序列推理建模为顺序决策问题，通过控制器-推理器架构和强化学习自适应选择相关时间段，避免对整个序列进行固定编码。在六个基准测试上平均准确率提升6.46个百分点，尤其在罕见事件定位和多段推理任务上增益最大。
Motivation: 现有方法将整个时间序列编码为固定表示，忽略了任务相关性可能仅存在于少数短区间，导致效率低下。
Method: 采用控制器-推理器架构，控制器通过强化学习选择信息段，推理器生成基于选定段的推理轨迹和答案；提出分层策略优化进行后训练。
Result: 在六个时间序列推理基准上，ARTIST平均准确率比最强基线提高6.46个绝对百分点，罕见事件定位和多段推理任务提升最大。
Conclusion: 选择性数据使用驱动有效的时间序列推理，监督微调提升性能，强化学习通过自适应段选择带来额外增益。

papers.title: LERD: Latent Event-Relational Dynamics for Neurodegenerative Classification
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) alters brain electrophysiology and disrupts multichannel EEG dynamics, making accurate and clinically useful EEG-based diagnosis increasingly important for screening and disease monitoring. However, many existing approaches rely on black-box classifiers and do not explicitly model the latent event timing and cross-channel coordination behind their decisions. To address these limitations, we propose LERD, an end-to-end Bayesian latent event--relational dynamical system that infers latent neural events and their relational structure directly from multichannel EEG without event or interaction annotations. LERD combines a continuous-time event inference module with a stochastic event-generation process to capture flexible temporal patterns, while incorporating an electrophysiology-inspired dynamical prior to guide learning in a principled way. We further provide theoretical analysis that yields a tractable IVP-based KL regularizer and stability guarantees for the inferred relational dynamics. Extensive experiments on synthetic benchmarks and two real-world AD EEG cohorts demonstrate that LERD consistently outperforms strong baselines and yields physiology-aligned rate, timing, and graph summaries that help characterize group-level dynamical differences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LERD，一个端到端贝叶斯潜在事件-关系动力学系统，用于从多通道脑电图 (EEG) 推断潜在神经事件及其关系结构，以改进阿尔茨海默病的分类。该方法结合连续时间事件推断与随机事件生成过程，并融入电生理学启发的动力学先验。在合成数据和两个真实 AD 脑电图数据集上，LERD 优于强基线，并产生与生理学一致的动力学表征。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 诊断方法多依赖黑箱分类器，未显式建模潜在事件时序和跨通道协调，限制了临床可解释性和准确性。
Method: 提出 LERD，一种端到端贝叶斯潜在事件-关系动力学系统，包含连续时间事件推断模块和随机事件生成过程，并引入电生理学启发的动力学先验，通过理论分析得到基于初值问题的 KL 正则化子和稳定性保证。
Result: 在合成基准和两个真实 AD EEG 队列上，LERD 持续优于强基线，并产生具有生理意义的速率、时序和图摘要，可表征群体水平动力学差异。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LERD 通过显式建模潜在事件和关系结构，提升了分类性能并提供了可解释的动力学表征，适用于神经退行性疾病分类。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-WikiRace Benchmark: How Far Can LLMs Plan over Real-World Knowledge Graphs?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LLM-Wikirace, a benchmark for evaluating planning, reasoning, and world knowledge in large language models (LLMs). In LLM-Wikirace, models must efficiently navigate Wikipedia hyperlinks step by step to reach a target page from a given source, requiring look-ahead planning and the ability to reason about how concepts are connected in the real world. We evaluate a broad set of open- and closed-source models, including Gemini-3, GPT-5, and Claude Opus 4.5, which achieve the strongest results on the easy level of the task and demonstrate superhuman performance. Despite this, performance drops sharply on hard difficulty: the best-performing model, Gemini-3, succeeds in only 23\% of hard games, highlighting substantial remaining challenges for frontier models. Our analysis shows that world knowledge is a necessary ingredient for success, but only up to a point, beyond this threshold, planning and long-horizon reasoning capabilities become the dominant factors. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that even the strongest models struggle to replan after failure, frequently entering loops rather than recovering. LLM-Wikirace is a simple benchmark that reveals clear limitations in current reasoning systems, offering an open arena where planning-capable LLMs still have much to prove. Our code and leaderboard available at https:/llmwikirace.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了 LLM-Wikirace 基准，任务是从维基百科源页面通过超链接逐步导航到目标页面，以评估大语言模型的规划、推理和世界知识能力。评估了 Gemini-3、GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.5 等模型，在简单级别上达到超人类性能，但在困难级别上最佳模型（Gemini-3）仅成功 23%。分析表明世界知识是必要的但存在阈值，超过后规划能力成为主导因素；轨迹分析显示模型在失败后难以重新规划，常陷入循环。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 在需要长期规划和世界知识导航的任务上缺乏系统评估，本文旨在通过一个简单但困难的基准揭示当前推理系统的局限。
Method: 构建基于维基百科超链接图的导航任务，模型需从给定源页面逐步选择超链接到达目标页面；评估包括开源和闭源模型（Gemini-3、GPT-5、Claude Opus 4.5 等）。
Result: 在简单级别上，前沿模型超越人类表现；在困难级别上，最佳模型 Gemini-3 仅 23% 成功率；轨迹分析表明模型在失败后难以重新规划，常进入循环。
Conclusion: LLM-Wikirace 基准揭示了当前 LLM 在规划、推理和世界知识方面的显著局限，特别是长期推理和重规划能力不足，表明规划能力仍需提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When AI Benchmarks Plateau: A Systematic Study of Benchmark Saturation
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence benchmarks are an important mechanism for measuring model progress and guiding deployment decisions. However, benchmarks quickly "saturate", making it difficult to differentiate models and diminishing their long-term value. In this study, we define benchmark saturation and analyze it across 60 language model benchmarks using 14 properties that relate to saturation. We find that nearly half of the our benchmarks exhibit saturation, with rates increasing with age. Further, we find that resilience to saturation is impacted by expert-curation, not by public test data. Our results suggest that design choices can extend benchmark longevity and inform more durable evaluation approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了AI基准测试的饱和现象，分析了60个语言模型基准的14个属性，发现近半数基准已饱和，且随年龄增长饱和率增加。专家策划的基准对饱和更有弹性，而公开测试数据则无此效果。
Motivation: 基准测试饱和使得模型难以区分，降低了其长期价值，但缺乏对饱和的系统性定义和实证分析。
Method: 定义基准饱和，并基于14个属性对60个语言模型基准进行大规模分析。
Result: 近半数基准已饱和，饱和率随基准年龄增加；专家策划的基准更能抵抗饱和，而公开测试数据则无显著影响。
Conclusion: 设计选择（如专家策划）可以延长基准寿命，并为更持久的评估方法提供指导。

papers.title: REAL: Resolving Knowledge Conflicts in Knowledge-Intensive Visual Question Answering via Reasoning-Pivot Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-intensive Visual Question Answering (KI-VQA) frequently suffers from severe knowledge conflicts caused by the inherent limitations of open-domain retrieval. However, existing paradigms face critical limitations due to the lack of generalizable conflict detection and intra-model constraint mechanisms to handle conflicting evidence. To address these challenges, we propose the REAL (Reasoning-Pivot Alignment) framework centered on the novel concept of the Reasoning-Pivot. Distinct from reasoning steps that prioritize internal self-derivation, a reasoning-pivot serves as an atomic unit (node or edge) in the reasoning chain that emphasizes knowledge linkage, and it typically relies on external evidence to complete the reasoning. Supported by our constructed REAL-VQA dataset, our approach integrates Reasoning-Pivot Aware SFT (RPA-SFT) to train a generalizable discriminator by aligning conflicts with pivot extraction, and employs Reasoning-Pivot Guided Decoding (RPGD), an intra-model decoding strategy that leverages these pivots for targeted conflict mitigation. Extensive experiments on diverse datasets demonstrate that REAL significantly enhances discrimination accuracy and achieves superior performance, validating our pivot-driven resolution paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REAL 框架，通过引入“推理枢轴”(reasoning-pivot)概念解决知识密集型视觉问答中的知识冲突问题。推理枢轴是推理链中依赖外部证据的原子单元，旨在增强知识链接。该框架包括基于枢轴感知的监督微调（RPA-SFT）训练通用判别器，以及推理枢轴引导解码（RPGD）进行冲突缓解。在多个数据集上的实验表明，REAL 显著提升了判别准确率和整体性能。
Motivation: 知识密集型视觉问答（KI-VQA）因开放域检索的固有限制而频繁遭受严重知识冲突，现有范式缺乏可泛化的冲突检测和模型内约束机制来处理冲突证据。
Method: 提出推理枢轴对齐（REAL）框架，包括：1) 构建 REAL-VQA 数据集；2) 推理枢轴感知监督微调（RPA-SFT），通过将冲突与枢轴提取对齐来训练可泛化判别器；3) 推理枢轴引导解码（RPGD），一种利用枢轴进行针对性冲突缓解的模型内解码策略。
Result: 在多个异构数据集上的广泛实验表明，REAL 显著提升了判别准确率并取得了优越性能，验证了枢轴驱动的冲突解决范式的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文证明通过引入推理枢轴概念和相应的对齐训练与解码策略，可以有效处理 KI-VQA 中的知识冲突，且该方法具有通用性和有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: iML: Executable, Problem-Grounded, and Broadly Exploratory Code-Driven AutoML
papers.abstract_en: Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) has improved access to machine learning, yet existing techniques often remain limited in flexibility, transparency, and execution reliability. Code-driven AutoML offers a promising direction by synthesizing executable code for preprocessing, model training, and evaluation. However, current LLM-based approaches frequently generate code that is plausible in text yet brittle in execution, insufficiently grounded in the actual dataset, or restricted to narrow solution paths. In this paper, we introduce iML, a multi-agent code-driven AutoML framework designed around three requirements: executability, problem grounding, and broad exploration of valid solutions. iML first analyzes the task and profiles the data, then synthesizes a structured blueprint that guides modular code generation across multiple implementation tracks, including traditional ML,pretrained adaptation, and custom neural architectures. To improve reliability, iML enforces interface checking, dynamic execution, and iterative debugging during integration. We evaluate iML on MLE-BENCH and the newly introduced iML-BENCH, covering diverse Kaggle-style tasks. On MLE-BENCH, iML attains a 90% valid submission rate and a 45% medal rate, and an APS of 0.82, improving the average standardized performance score (APS) over the LLM-based baselines by 52%-273%. On iML-BENCH, it achieves the highest APS and demonstrates robust performance even when task descriptions are substantially stripped. These results establish iML as a reliable and competitive framework for code-driven AutoML.

papers.title: How Accurately Can a Gaussian Approximate Stochastic Approximation Iterates?
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic approximation (SA) is a method for finding the root of an operator perturbed by noise. The focus of this paper is studying the distribution of SA iterates in finite time. In general, it is not possible to characterize the exact distribution, and therefore our goal is to find an approximation which can yield useful tail bounds. Inspired by the rich literature on the asymptotic normality of rescaled SA iterates, we approximate the pre-limit distributions by a sequence of Gaussians whose covariance is recursively defined. In particular, we establish explicit bounds on the Wasserstein-1 distance between the rescaled iterate at time $k$ and the aforementioned Gaussian for various choices of step-sizes. Since these covariances converge to the classical asymptotic limit, our analysis also provides a convergence rate for asymptotic normality as a by-product. As an immediate consequence of our bounds, we obtain tail bounds on the error of SA iterates at any time. Finally, we establish the sharpness of our rates by providing matching lower bounds and validate our findings through simulations. We obtain the sharp rates by first studying the convergence rate of the discrete Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (O-U) process driven by general noise, whose stationary distribution is identical to the limiting Gaussian distribution of the rescaled SA iterates. We believe that this is of independent interest, given its connection to sampling literature. The analysis involves adapting Stein's method for Gaussian approximation to handle the matrix weighted sum of i.i.d. random variables. The desired finite-time bounds for SA are obtained by characterizing the error dynamics between the rescaled SA iterate and the discrete time O-U process and combining it with the convergence rate of the latter process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机逼近（SA）迭代的有限时间分布，提出用协方差递归定义的高斯序列近似，并给出Wasserstein-1距离的显式界，同时推导出渐近正态性的收敛速率和尾概率界。通过匹配下界和仿真验证了结果的尖锐性，其中涉及离散Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的收敛分析以及Stein方法的推广。
Motivation: 随机逼近迭代的精确分布通常无法解析刻画，但有限时间分布的理解对统计推断和算法设计至关重要。现有工作多聚焦渐近正态性，对有限时间行为的精确近似及其误差量化缺乏系统研究。
Method: 利用离散Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程作为桥梁，通过Stein方法分析矩阵加权i.i.d.随机变量和，建立重缩放SA迭代与递归定义的高斯序列之间的Wasserstein-1距离界，并进一步获得渐近正态性的收敛速率。
Result: 对多种步长选择给出了重缩放SA迭代与高斯近似之间Wasserstein-1距离的显式上界和下界，证明了所得收敛速率的尖锐性，并通过仿真验证。推导出任意时刻SA迭代误差的尾概率界。
Conclusion: 理论上证明了用Gaussian近似SA迭代有限时间分布的可行性及其最优收敛速率，为SA迭代的有限样本推断提供了理论工具。所发展的离散O-U过程分析对该领域本身亦有独立价值。
