papers.title: Towards Sparse Video Understanding and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We present \revise (\underline{Re}asoning with \underline{Vi}deo \underline{S}parsity), a multi-round agent for video question answering (VQA). Instead of uniformly sampling frames, \revise selects a small set of informative frames, maintains a summary-as-state across rounds, and stops early when confident. It supports proprietary vision-language models (VLMs) in a ``plug-and-play'' setting and enables reinforcement fine-tuning for open-source models. For fine-tuning, we introduce EAGER (Evidence-Adjusted Gain for Efficient Reasoning), an annotation-free reward with three terms: (1) Confidence gain: after new frames are added, we reward the increase in the log-odds gap between the correct option and the strongest alternative; (2) Summary sufficiency: at answer time we re-ask using only the last committed summary and reward success; (3) Correct-and-early stop: answering correctly within a small turn budget is rewarded. Across multiple VQA benchmarks, \revise improves accuracy while reducing frames, rounds, and prompt tokens, demonstrating practical sparse video reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REVISE，一个多轮智能体用于视频问答 (VQA)，通过稀疏选择信息帧、维护摘要状态并在置信时提前停止，减少帧数、轮数和提示词数量，同时提升准确率。支持闭源视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的即插即用和开源模型的强化微调，其中微调引入无标注奖励 EAGER。
Motivation: 现有视频问答方法通常均匀采样帧，导致大量冗余计算，且无法自适应地聚焦关键信息。
Method: REVISE 是一个多轮智能体，每轮选择少量信息帧，维护跨轮的摘要状态，并在置信时提前停止。对于开源模型，使用 EAGER 奖励进行强化微调，包含三项：置信增益、摘要充分性、正确且早停。
Result: 在多个 VQA 基准上，REVISE 在减少帧数、轮数和提示词的同时提高了准确率。
Conclusion: 展示了实用的稀疏视频推理，通过选择关键帧和多轮摘要实现高效视频理解。

papers.title: Concept Heterogeneity-aware Representation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Representation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by intervening on internal activations at inference time. Most existing methods rely on a single global steering direction, typically obtained via difference-in-means over contrastive datasets. This approach implicitly assumes that the target concept is homogeneously represented across the embedding space. In practice, however, LLM representations can be highly non-homogeneous, exhibiting clustered, context-dependent structure, which renders global steering directions brittle. In this work, we view representation steering through the lens of optimal transport (OT), noting that standard difference-in-means steering implicitly corresponds to the OT map between two identical distributions with differing first moments, yielding a global translation. To relax this restrictive assumption, we theoretically model source and target representations as Gaussian mixture models and formulate steering as a discrete OT problem between semantic latent clusters. From the resulting transport plan, we derive an explicit, input-dependent steering map via barycentric projection, producing a smooth, kernel-weighted combination of cluster-level shifts. We term this method Concept Heterogeneity-aware Representation Steering (CHaRS). Through numerous experimental settings, we show that CHaRS yields more effective behavioral control than global steering.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）表示的非均匀性问题，提出一种基于最优传输（optimal transport）的表示操控方法 CHaRS。该方法将源和目标表示建模为高斯混合模型，通过离散最优传输和重心投影得到输入依赖的操控方向，从而替代传统的全局均值差操控。实验表明，CHaRS在行为控制上优于全局操控方法。
Motivation: 现有表示操控方法大多假设目标概念在嵌入空间中均匀表示，但实际LLM表示具有聚类、上下文依赖的非均匀结构，导致全局操控方向脆弱、效果不稳定。
Method: 将表示操控形式化为最优传输问题：将源和目标表示建模为高斯混合模型，通过离散最优传输得到语义潜在聚类间的传输计划，再通过重心投影推导出平滑的、核加权组合的输入依赖操控映射（CHaRS）。
Result: 在多个实验设置中，CHaRS比全局均值差操控方法实现了更有效的行为控制。
Conclusion: 所提输入依赖的、考虑概念非均匀性的操控方法优于全局平移方法，为LLM行为控制提供了更鲁棒的轻量级方案。

papers.title: SWE-MiniSandbox: Container-Free Reinforcement Learning for Building Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for training software engineering (SWE) agents, but existing pipelines typically rely on per-task containers for isolation. At scale, pre-built container images incur substantial storage overhead, slow environment setup, and require container-management privileges. We propose SWE-MiniSandbox, a lightweight, container-free method that enables scalable RL training of SWE agents without sacrificing isolation. Instead of relying on per-instance containers, SWE-MiniSandbox executes each task in an isolated workspace backed by kernel-level mechanisms, substantially reducing system overhead. It leverages lightweight environment pre-caching techniques to eliminate the need for bulky container images. As a result, our approach lowers disk usage to approximately 5\% of that required by container-based pipelines and reduces environment preparation time to about 25\% of the container baseline. Empirical results demonstrate that SWE-MiniSandbox achieves evaluation performance comparable to standard container-based pipelines. By removing the dependency on heavy container infrastructure, SWE-MiniSandbox offers a practical and accessible foundation for scaling RL-based SWE agents, particularly in resource-constrained research environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE-MiniSandbox，一种无需容器（container-free）的轻量级方法，用于软件工程（SWE）智能体的强化学习训练。该方法通过内核级隔离和轻量级环境预缓存，大幅降低存储和准备时间，同时保持与基于容器的 pipeline 相当的评估性能。
Motivation: 现有基于容器的 SWE 智能体强化学习 pipeline 在大规模训练时面临存储开销大、环境设置慢和需要容器管理权限等问题，阻碍了在资源受限环境中的应用。
Method: SWE-MiniSandbox 使用内核级机制实现每个任务的隔离工作区，替代每任务容器的隔离方式，并采用轻量级环境预缓存技术消除对臃肿容器镜像的依赖。
Result: 该方法将磁盘使用量降低至基于容器 pipeline 的约 5%，环境准备时间缩短至约 25%，且评估性能与标准容器 pipeline 相当。
Conclusion: SWE-MiniSandbox 提供了一种实用的、可访问的基础设施，用于扩展基于强化学习的 SWE 智能体训练，尤其适用于资源受限的研究环境。

papers.title: SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Simulation has become a key tool for training and evaluating home robots at scale, yet existing environments fail to capture the diversity and physical complexity of real indoor spaces. Current scene synthesis methods produce sparsely furnished rooms that lack the dense clutter, articulated furniture, and physical properties essential for robotic manipulation. We introduce SceneSmith, a hierarchical agentic framework that generates simulation-ready indoor environments from natural language prompts. SceneSmith constructs scenes through successive stages$\unicode{x2013}$from architectural layout to furniture placement to small object population$\unicode{x2013}$each implemented as an interaction among VLM agents: designer, critic, and orchestrator. The framework tightly integrates asset generation through text-to-3D synthesis for static objects, dataset retrieval for articulated objects, and physical property estimation. SceneSmith generates 3-6x more objects than prior methods, with <2% inter-object collisions and 96% of objects remaining stable under physics simulation. In a user study with 205 participants, it achieves 92% average realism and 91% average prompt faithfulness win rates against baselines. We further demonstrate that these environments can be used in an end-to-end pipeline for automatic robot policy evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SceneSmith，一个层级式智能体框架，从自然语言提示生成适用于仿真的室内场景。通过依次进行建筑布局、家具布置和小物体填充，每个阶段由VLM智能体（设计师、评论家、协调者）交互完成。框架集成了文本到3D生成、数据集检索和物理属性估计。生成的对象数量比先前方法多3-6倍，碰撞率低于2%，96%的对象在物理仿真中保持稳定。在205名参与者的人机评估中，真实感和提示忠实度胜率分别达到92%和91%。进一步展示了在自动机器人策略评估中的端到端应用。
Motivation: 现有仿真环境缺乏真实室内空间的多样性和物理复杂性，场景合成方法生成稀疏的房间，缺少密集杂乱、铰接式家具和机器人操作所需的物理属性。
Method: 提出层级式智能体框架，包含设计师、评论家和协调者VLM智能体，分阶段构建场景：建筑布局、家具放置、小物体填充。集成文本到3D合成、铰接物体数据集检索和物理属性估计。
Result: 生成对象数量比先前方法多3-6倍，物体间碰撞率低于2%，96%的对象在物理仿真中保持稳定。用户研究中真实感胜率92%，提示忠实度胜率91%。

papers.title: Learning to Remember, Learn, and Forget in Attention-Based Models
papers.abstract_en: In-Context Learning (ICL) in transformers acts as an online associative memory and is believed to underpin their high performance on complex sequence processing tasks. However, in gated linear attention models, this memory has a fixed capacity and is prone to interference, especially for long sequences. We propose Palimpsa, a self-attention model that views ICL as a continual learning problem that must address a stability-plasticity dilemma. Palimpsa uses Bayesian metaplasticity, where the plasticity of each attention state is tied to an importance state grounded by a prior distribution that captures accumulated knowledge. We demonstrate that various gated linear attention models emerge as specific architecture choices and posterior approximations, and that Mamba2 is a special case of Palimpsa where forgetting dominates. This theoretical link enables the transformation of any non-metaplastic model into a metaplastic one, significantly expanding its memory capacity. Our experiments show that Palimpsa consistently outperforms baselines on the Multi-Query Associative Recall (MQAR) benchmark and on Commonsense Reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Palimpsa自注意力模型，将上下文学习视为持续学习问题，通过贝叶斯元可塑性（Bayesian metaplasticity）解决稳定性-可塑性困境。该模型将注意力状态的塑性绑定到由先验分布定义的重要性状态上，从而扩展记忆容量。实验表明Palimpsa在Multi-Query Associative Recall基准和常识推理任务上优于现有基线。
Motivation: Transformer中的上下文学习（ICL）作为在线关联记忆，在门控线性注意力模型中存在固定容量和长序列干扰问题，需解决稳定性-可塑性困境。
Method: Palimpsa模型利用贝叶斯元可塑性，通过先验分布捕捉累积知识，将每个注意力状态的塑性与其重要性状态关联。该框架将多种门控线性注意力模型统一为特定的架构选择和后验近似，Mamba2是其遗忘主导的特例。
Result: 在Multi-Query Associative Recall（MQAR）基准和常识推理任务上，Palimpsa一致优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 论文从理论上将非元塑性模型转化为元塑性模型，显著扩展了记忆容量，并在关联记忆和推理任务上验证了有效性。

papers.title: Gradient Preconditioning for Efficient and Reliable Reward-Guided Generation
papers.abstract_en: We propose a gradient preconditioning method that makes reward-guided generation with one-step generative models both efficient and reliable. Test-time noise optimization can unlock substantially better reward-guided generations from pretrained generative models, but it is prone to reward hacking that degrades quality and is often too slow for practical use. We precondition reward gradients by projecting them onto a carefully designed white Gaussian noise feasible set, a compact spectral set with blockwise norm constraints that tightly captures the statistics and spatial uncorrelatedness of white Gaussian noise. This preconditioning reshapes each gradient update into a noise-aligned direction, driving faster and more effective reward ascent while preventing reward hacking. The projection is closed-form and matches the $O(N \log N)$ complexity of FFT, adding negligible overhead in practice. In experiments on FLUX with four reward models, our approach reaches a comparable Aesthetic Score using only 30% of the wall-clock time required by the state-of-the-art regularization-based method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种梯度预条件方法，用于一步生成模型的奖励引导生成，通过将奖励梯度投影到白高斯噪声可行集（具有块状范数约束的紧致谱集）上，使梯度更新方向与噪声对齐，从而加速奖励提升并防止奖励破解。该方法投影是闭式的，复杂度为O(N log N)。在FLUX模型上使用四个奖励模型的实验中，该方法仅用30%的壁钟时间就达到了与最新正则化方法相当的美学评分。
Motivation: 测试时噪声优化可以解锁更好的奖励引导生成，但容易导致奖励破解（质量下降）且速度慢，不实用。
Method: 提出梯度预条件方法，通过将奖励梯度投影到精心设计的白高斯噪声可行集（具有块状范数约束的紧致谱集）上，使每个梯度更新变为噪声对齐方向，从而加速奖励上升并防止奖励破解。投影是闭式且计算高效。
Result: 在FLUX模型上使用四个奖励模型的实验中，该方法仅用30%的壁钟时间就达到了与最新正则化方法相当的美学评分。
Conclusion: 该方法使得一步生成模型的奖励引导生成既高效又可靠，通过梯度预条件避免了奖励破解。

papers.title: One-Shot Crowd Counting With Density Guidance For Scene Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Crowd scenes captured by cameras at different locations vary greatly, and existing crowd models have limited generalization for unseen surveillance scenes. To improve the generalization of the model, we regard different surveillance scenes as different category scenes, and introduce few-shot learning to make the model adapt to the unseen surveillance scene that belongs to the given exemplar category scene. To this end, we propose to leverage local and global density characteristics to guide the model of crowd counting for unseen surveillance scenes. Specifically, to enable the model to adapt to the varying density variations in the target scene, we propose the multiple local density learner to learn multi prototypes which represent different density distributions in the support scene. Subsequently, these multiple local density similarity matrixes are encoded. And they are utilized to guide the model in a local way. To further adapt to the global density in the target scene, the global density features are extracted from the support image, then it is used to guide the model in a global way. Experiments on three surveillance datasets shows that proposed method can adapt to the unseen surveillance scene and outperform recent state-of-the-art methods in the few-shot crowd counting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不同监控场景下人群计数模型泛化能力不足的问题，将场景视为不同类别，引入少样本学习（few-shot learning），提出利用局部和全局密度特征引导模型适应未见过的目标场景。方法包括多局部密度学习器提取多个原型并计算相似度矩阵进行局部引导，以及提取全局密度特征进行全局引导。在三个监控数据集上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有群体计数模型对不同监控场景的泛化能力有限，难以适应未见过的场景。
Method: 提出基于密度引导的少样本人群计数方法：通过多局部密度学习器学习多个原型表征不同密度分布，编码局部密度相似度矩阵进行局部引导；同时提取全局密度特征进行全局引导。
Result: 在三个监控数据集上，该方法能有效适应未见过的监控场景，并优于最新少样本人群计数方法。
Conclusion: 局部和全局密度特征联合引导可提升模型对目标场景的适应能力。

papers.title: RAIGen: Rare Attribute Identification in Text-to-Image Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models achieve impressive generation quality but inherit and amplify training-data biases, skewing coverage of semantic attributes. Prior work addresses this in two ways. Closed-set approaches mitigate biases in predefined fairness categories (e.g., gender, race), assuming socially salient minority attributes are known a priori. Open-set approaches frame the task as bias identification, highlighting majority attributes that dominate outputs. Both overlook a complementary task: uncovering rare or minority features underrepresented in the data distribution (social, cultural, or stylistic) yet still encoded in model representations. We introduce RAIGen, the first framework, to our knowledge, for label-free rare-attribute discovery in diffusion models, requiring no predefined minority categories. RAIGen leverages Matryoshka Sparse Autoencoders and a novel minority metric combining neuron activation frequency with semantic distinctiveness to identify interpretable neurons whose top-activating images reveal underrepresented attributes. Experiments show RAIGen discovers attributes beyond fixed fairness categories in Stable Diffusion, scales to larger models such as SDXL, supports systematic auditing across architectures, and enables targeted amplification of rare attributes during generation. The project page is available at https://vssilpa.github.io/RAIGen_webpage/ .
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Webpage and code available at https://github.com/VSSILPA/RAIGen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAIGen，第一个用于扩散模型无标签罕见属性发现的框架，利用 Matryoshka 稀疏自编码器和结合神经元激活频率与语义独特性的新颖少数指标，识别出揭示未充分表示属性的可解释神经元。实验在 Stable Diffusion 和 SDXL 上发现超越固定公平类别的属性，支持系统审计，并能定向增强生成中的罕见属性。
Motivation: 现有方法要么聚焦预定义公平类别（封闭集），要么识别主导输出的多数属性（开放集），但忽略了数据分布中罕见或少数特征（社会、文化或风格）的发现，这些特征仍编码在模型表示中。
Method: 结合 Matryoshka 稀疏自编码器（Matryoshka Sparse Autoencoders）和一种新颖的少数指标，该指标融合神经元激活频率与语义独特性，筛选出激活图像揭示未充分表示属性的可解释神经元。
Result: 在 Stable Diffusion 和 SDXL 上发现传统公平类别之外的属性，支持跨架构系统审计，并能定向增强生成中的罕见属性。
Conclusion: RAIGen 首次实现了扩散模型中无需预定义标签的罕见属性自动发现，为模型偏见审计和属性平衡生成提供了新工具。

papers.title: Better Source, Better Flow: Learning Condition-Dependent Source Distribution for Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has recently emerged as a promising alternative to diffusion-based generative models, particularly for text-to-image generation. Despite its flexibility in allowing arbitrary source distributions, most existing approaches rely on a standard Gaussian distribution, a choice inherited from diffusion models, and rarely consider the source distribution itself as an optimization target in such settings. In this work, we show that principled design of the source distribution is not only feasible but also beneficial at the scale of modern text-to-image systems. Specifically, we propose learning a condition-dependent source distribution under flow matching objective that better exploit rich conditioning signals. We identify key failure modes that arise when directly incorporating conditioning into the source, including distributional collapse and instability, and show that appropriate variance regularization and directional alignment between source and target are critical for stable and effective learning. We further analyze how the choice of target representation space impacts flow matching with structured sources, revealing regimes in which such designs are most effective. Extensive experiments across multiple text-to-image benchmarks demonstrate consistent and robust improvements, including up to a 3x faster convergence in FID, highlighting the practical benefits of a principled source distribution design for conditional flow matching.

TL;DR: 本文提出条件依赖的源分布学习方法用于流匹配生成模型，在文本到图像任务上通过方差正则化和方向对齐解决分布坍塌和不稳定问题，实现更快的收敛和更优的生成质量。

papers.title: Echo State Networks for Time Series Forecasting: Hyperparameter Sweep and Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the performance of Echo State Networks (ESNs) for univariate forecasting of monthly and quarterly time series from the M4 Forecasting Competition dataset. We evaluate whether a simple first-order autoregressive ESN can serve as a competitive alternative to widely used forecasting methods. The study uses a two-stage design: a Parameter dataset is used to analyze ESN model configurations over leakage rate, spectral radius, reservoir size, and regularization selection, while a disjoint Forecast dataset is reserved for out-of-sample benchmarking. Forecast accuracy is measured using mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE) and compared with simple benchmarks and statistical models including autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), exponential smoothing state space (ETS), the Theta method, and TBATS. The model-configuration analysis reveals frequency-specific patterns: monthly series tend to favor moderately persistent reservoirs, whereas quarterly series favor more contractive dynamics; across both frequencies, high leakage rates are generally preferred. In the final benchmark, the ESN performs on par with ARIMA and TBATS for monthly data and achieves the lowest mean MASE for quarterly data, although it is not uniformly best across all metrics. Overall, the results indicate that a simple autoregressive ESN can provide competitive forecast accuracy on the considered filtered M4 subsets, particularly under MASE, while requiring low training and forecasting time once the ESN configuration has been fixed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究回声状态网络（ESN）在M4竞赛数据集上的单变量时间序列预测性能，通过两阶段设计（参数分析+独立测试）评估其与ARIMA、ETS等统计模型的竞争力。结果表明，简单的自回归ESN在月度数据上表现与ARIMA和TBATS相当，在季度数据上平均MASE最低，且训练速度快。
Motivation: 探索简单的ESN是否能在传统统计方法主导的预测任务中提供有竞争力的替代方案，填补ESN在标准基准测试中系统评估的空白。
Method: 两阶段设计：先在参数数据集上分析泄露率、谱半径、储层规模和正则化对ESN的影响，再在独立测试集上使用MASE和sMAPE进行外样本基准测试。
Result: 月度系列偏好中等持久性储层，季度系列偏好收缩性动力学，且高泄露率普遍有利。在基准测试中，ESN在月度数据上表现与ARIMA和TBATS相当，在季度数据上取得最低平均MASE。

papers.title: Lookahead Sample Reward Guidance for Test-Time Scaling of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have demonstrated strong generative performance; however, generated samples often fail to fully align with human intent. This paper studies an efficient test-time scaling method for sampling from regions with higher human-aligned reward values. Existing methods for computing the expected future reward (EFR) face important limitations: backward rollout incurs prohibitively high sampling costs, while Tweedie-based approaches, including Sequential Monte Carlo and gradient guidance, suffer from bias and inherent sampling issues. We show that the EFR at any $\mathbf{x}_t$ can be computed using only marginal samples from a pre-trained diffusion model, enabling closed-form reward guidance without neural backpropagation. To further improve efficiency, we introduce a few-step lookahead sampling and an accurate solver that guides particles toward high-reward lookahead samples. We refer to this sampling scheme as LiDAR sampling. LiDAR achieves the same GenEval performance as the latest gradient guidance method for SDXL with a 9.5x speedup. We release the code at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/Diffusion-LiDAR-Sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LiDAR采样方法，用于扩散模型的测试时扩展。通过利用预训练扩散模型的边际样本直接计算期望未来奖励（EFR），实现无需反向传播的闭式奖励引导。引入几步前瞻采样和精确求解器，引导粒子向高奖励区域移动。在SDXL上，LiDAR在GenEval上达到与最新梯度引导方法相同的性能，且速度提升9.5倍。
Motivation: 扩散模型生成的样本常与人类意图不完全对齐，现有计算期望未来奖励（EFR）的方法存在高采样成本（反向展开）或偏差（Tweedie类方法）的问题。
Method: 提出LiDAR采样，利用预训练扩散模型的边际样本直接计算任意x_t处的EFR，实现闭式奖励引导；引入几步前瞻采样和精确求解器，引导粒子向高奖励前瞻样本移动。
Result: 在SDXL上，LiDAR在GenEval上达到与最新梯度引导方法相同的性能，并实现9.5倍加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LiDAR是一种高效的测试时扩展方法，避免了反向传播，显著提升采样速度，且不牺牲生成质量。

papers.title: Exposing Vulnerabilities in Explanation for Time Series Classifiers via Dual-Target Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Interpretable time series deep learning systems are often assessed by checking temporal consistency on explanations, implicitly treating this as evidence of robustness. We show that this assumption can fail: Predictions and explanations can be adversarially decoupled, enabling targeted misclassification while the explanation remains plausible and consistent with a chosen reference rationale. We propose TSEF (Time Series Explanation Fooler), a dual-target attack that jointly manipulates the classifier and explainer outputs. In contrast to single-objective misclassification attacks that disrupt explanation and spread attribution mass broadly, TSEF achieves targeted prediction changes while keeping explanations consistent with the reference. Across multiple datasets and explainer backbones, our results consistently reveal that explanation stability is a misleading proxy for decision robustness and motivate coupling-aware robustness evaluations for trustworthy time series tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026; Code is available at https://github.com/Bohan7/TSEF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双目标攻击方法TSEF，同时操控时间序列分类器的预测和解释输出，证明解释稳定性无法作为决策鲁棒性的可靠代理。实验表明TSEF在保持解释与参考一致的前提下实现特定误分类，暴露了现有鲁棒性评估的漏洞。
Motivation: 现有评估常将时间序列深度学习的解释时间一致性视为鲁棒性证据，但这一假设尚未被充分检验。
Method: 提出TSEF（Time Series Explanation Fooler），一种双目标攻击方法，联合优化分类器和解释器输出，使预测错误而解释仍与预设参考一致。
Result: 在多个数据集和解释器骨干上，TSEF成功实现定向预测变化，同时保持解释的合理性和一致性，表明解释稳定性不能代替决策鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 解释稳定性是误导性的鲁棒性代理，需要引入耦合感知的鲁棒性评估来确保时间序列任务的可信度。

papers.title: Structure Enables Effective Self-Localization of Errors in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Self-correction in language models remains elusive. In this work, we explore whether language models can explicitly localize errors in incorrect reasoning, as a path toward building AI systems that can effectively correct themselves. We introduce a prompting method that structures reasoning as discrete, semantically coherent thought steps, and show that models can localize errors more reliably within this structure than in conventional, unstructured chain-of-thought reasoning. Motivated by how the human brain monitors errors at discrete decision points and resamples alternatives, we introduce Iterative Correction Sampling of Thoughts (Thought-ICS), a self-correction framework. Thought-ICS iteratively prompts the model to generate reasoning one discrete and complete thought at a time--where each thought represents a deliberate decision by the model--creating natural boundaries for precise error localization. Upon verification, the model localizes the first erroneous step, and the system backtracks to generate alternative reasoning from the last correct point. When asked to correct reasoning verified as incorrect by an oracle, Thought-ICS achieves 20-40% self-correction lift. In a completely autonomous setting without external verification, it outperforms contemporary self-correction baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索语言模型能否在推理过程中显式定位错误，并提出一种将推理结构化为离散语义步骤的提示方法，使得错误定位更可靠。基于此，作者设计了迭代修正采样框架（Thought-ICS），通过逐句生成推理并回溯首个错误步骤来修正推理，在或acles验证下实现20-40%的自修正提升，在完全自主设定下也优于现有基线。
Motivation: 语言模型的自修正能力仍不理想，现有无结构链式推理难以精确定位错误，人类大脑则能在离散决策点监测错误并重新采样替代方案。
Method: 提出Thought-ICS框架：将推理分解为离散且完整的步骤（每个步骤代表模型的显式决策），生成后通过验证步骤定位首个错误，并从最后正确点回溯生成替代推理。
Result: 通过oracle验证错误并修正后，自修正提升20-40%；在无外部验证的全自主设定下，性能优于当代自修正基线。
Conclusion: 结构化推理为错误定位提供自然边界，提升了语言模型自修正的效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zero-Shot Off-Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy learning methods seek to derive an optimal policy directly from a fixed dataset of prior interactions. This objective presents significant challenges, primarily due to the inherent distributional shift and value function overestimation bias. These issues become even more noticeable in zero-shot reinforcement learning, where an agent trained on reward-free data must adapt to new tasks at test time without additional training. In this work, we address the off-policy problem in a zero-shot setting by discovering a theoretical connection of successor measures to stationary density ratios. Using this insight, our algorithm can infer optimal importance sampling ratios, effectively performing a stationary distribution correction with an optimal policy for any task on the fly. We benchmark our method in motion tracking tasks on SMPL Humanoid, continuous control on ExoRL, and for the long-horizon OGBench tasks. Our technique seamlessly integrates into forward-backward representation frameworks and enables fast-adaptation to new tasks in a training-free regime. More broadly, this work bridges off-policy learning and zero-shot adaptation, offering benefits to both research areas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本离线策略学习方法，通过发现后继度量与稳态密度比的理论联系，推导最优重要性采样比率，实现在测试时无需额外训练即可为新任务在线调整策略。方法在SMPL人体运动跟踪、ExoRL连续控制和OGBench长时域任务上进行了基准测试，并可与前向-后向表示框架无缝集成。
Motivation: 离线策略学习面临分布偏移和价值函数过估计偏差，在零样本强化学习中这些问题更为突出，而现有方法难以在无额外训练情况下适应新任务。
Method: 发现后继度量与稳态密度比之间的理论联系，利用此联系推断最优重要性采样比率，实现稳态分布校正，从而在测试时在线获得任意任务的最优策略。
Result: 在SMPL Humanoid运动跟踪、ExoRL连续控制和OGBench长时域任务上的实验表明，该方法能够实现无需训练的快速任务适应。
Conclusion: 本文桥接了离线策略学习与零样本适应，为两个领域带来益处，并可与前向-后向表示框架结合。

papers.title: PolarMem: A Training-Free Polarized Latent Graph Memory for Verifiable Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Memory is not merely a storage mechanism for intelligent systems, but a structure for organizing evidence and constraining belief. This is especially important for multimodal reasoning, where retrieved evidence must be both query-relevant and visually consistent. However, current memory systems for vision-language models (VLMs) remain largely positive-associative: they retrieve what is similar or previously observed, but lack an explicit way to remember what has been verified as absent or logically excluded. To this end, we propose \textbf{PolarMem}, a training-free polarized latent graph memory framework for verifiable vision-language reasoning. PolarMem transforms frozen VLM perceptual signals into \textit{HAS}, \textit{NOT\_HAS}, and \textit{Uncertain} memory states through semantic consistency verification and adaptive distributional partitioning, and stores them in a polarized graph with distinct positive and negative memory relations. During inference, a lexicographical logic-aware retrieval protocol enforces logical consistency before semantic similarity, suppressing conflicting memories before they enter the model context. Across eight frozen VLM backbones and six multimodal benchmarks, PolarMem consistently improves retrieval-intensive tasks and reduces retrieval-level contradictions. These results highlight negative memory as a key mechanism for building more reliable multimodal memory systems. Our code is available at https://github.com/czs-ict/PolarMem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolarMem，一种无需训练的极化潜在图记忆框架，用于可验证的视觉-语言推理。PolarMem 将冻结的视觉语言模型感知信号通过语义一致性验证和自适应分布划分转换为 HAS、NOT_HAS 和 Uncertain 三种记忆状态，并存储在具有正负记忆关系的极化图中。推理时，词典逻辑感知的检索协议先强制逻辑一致性再考虑语义相似性，抑制冲突记忆进入模型上下文。在 8 个冻结 VLM 主干和 6 个多模态基准上，PolarMem 持续提升检索密集型任务并减少检索层面的矛盾。
Motivation: 当前视觉语言模型的记忆系统主要是正联想式的，缺乏显式记录已验证为不存在或逻辑排除的信息的能力，导致多模态推理中检索的证据可能不一致。
Method: PolarMem 将 VLM 感知信号通过语义一致性验证和自适应分布划分转换为三种记忆状态（HAS、NOT_HAS、Uncertain），存储在极化图中；推理时采用逻辑感知检索协议，先强制逻辑一致性再考虑语义相似性。
Result: 在 8 个冻结 VLM 主干和 6 个多模态基准上，PolarMem 提升了检索密集型任务的性能，并减少了检索层面的矛盾。
Conclusion: 负记忆（negative memory）是构建更可靠多模态记忆系统的关键机制，PolarMem 提供了一种无需训练即可整合逻辑约束的记忆框架。

papers.title: MulFeRL: Enhancing Reinforcement Learning with Verbal Feedback in a Multi-turn Loop
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve reasoning across domains, but outcome-only scalar rewards are often sparse and uninformative. This limitation is especially severe for failed samples, where scalar rewards indicate only that a solution is incorrect without explaining why the reasoning breaks down. In this paper, we leverage richer verbal feedback to guide RLVR on failed samples and convert feedback-induced progress into trainable learning signals. We propose MulFeRL (Multi-turn Feedback-guided Reinforcement Learning), a multi-turn, event-triggered RLVR framework that combines progress induction for feedback-guided regeneration of failed samples, progress credit assignment for learning from verifier-confirmed progress, and structured feedback injection for integrating feedback into the model's reasoning process. Trained on sampled OpenR1-Math, MulFeRL outperforms supervised, self-distillation-based, and RLVR baselines in-domain, while also showing strong out-of-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）中标量奖励稀疏且对失败样本缺乏解释的问题，提出MulFeRL框架。该框架利用更丰富的口头反馈，通过进度诱导、进度信用分配和结构化反馈注入三个组件，在多个回合中引导失败样本的重新生成并从中学习。在OpenR1-Math数据集上训练的模型，在域内任务上优于监督学习、自蒸馏和RLVR基线，并展现出较强的域外泛化能力。
Motivation: RLVR使用的标量奖励稀疏且信息不足，尤其对于失败样本，仅指示答案错误而不提供推理中断的原因，限制了学习效率。
Method: 提出MulFeRL，一个多轮、事件触发的RLVR框架，包含三个关键组件：进度诱导（通过反馈引导失败样本的重新生成）、进度信用分配（从验证器确认的进度中学习）、结构化反馈注入（将反馈整合到模型的推理过程中）。
Result: 在采样得到的OpenR1-Math数据集上，MulFeRL在域内任务上超越了监督学习、自蒸馏和RLVR基线，并在域外任务上展现出良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，利用口头反馈指导失败样本的RLVR可以显著提升学习效果，并支持跨域泛化。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）中标量奖励稀疏且对失败样本缺乏解释的问题，提出MulFeRL框架。该框架利用更丰富的口头反馈，通过进度诱导、进度信用分配和结构化反馈注入三个组件，在多个回合中引导失败样本的重新生成并从中学习。在OpenR1-Math数据集上训练的模型，在域内任务上优于监督学习、自蒸馏和RLVR基线，并展现出较强的域外泛化能力。
summary_sections.motivation: RLVR使用的标量奖励稀疏且信息不足，尤其对于失败样本，仅指示答案错误而不提供推理中断的原因，限制了学习效率。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，利用口头反馈指导失败样本的RLVR可以显著提升学习效果，并支持跨域泛化。

papers.title: Knowledge-Informed Kernel State Reconstruction from Heterogeneous Partial Observations
papers.abstract_en: Real-world scientific systems are rarely observed through complete, regularly sampled state trajectories. Instead, measurements are often partial, noisy, and heterogeneous, providing fragmented views of latent dynamical states. We introduce MAAT (Model Aware Approximation of Trajectories), a framework for knowledge-informed Kernel State Reconstruction in partially observed dynamical systems. MAAT formulates reconstruction in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space and incorporates heterogeneous observation operators together with semantic and structural priors, including non-negativity, conservation constraints, and domain-specific measurement models. This yields smooth, physically consistent state estimates with analytic time derivatives, providing a principled interface between fragmented measurements and downstream mechanistic discovery methods such as symbolic regression. Across nine scientific benchmarks, multiple noise regimes, and a real-world COVID-19 dataset, MAAT substantially reduces trajectory and derivative reconstruction error relative to strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAAT 框架，用于从异构部分观测中重构动态系统的核状态。该框架在再生核希尔伯特空间中建模，整合异质观测算子及语义和结构先验（如非负性、守恒约束），生成平滑且物理一致的状态估计，并提供解析时间导数。在九个科学基准和真实 COVID-19 数据集上，MAAT 在轨迹和导数重构误差上显著优于强基线。
Motivation: 真实科学系统的观测通常是部分、有噪声且异质的，导致潜动态状态的分析碎片化，缺乏统一的重构方法。
Method: 提出 MAAT，在再生核希尔伯特空间中利用核方法重构状态，并融入异质观测算子以及非负性、守恒约束等先验知识，得到平滑且物理一致的状态轨迹及其解析时间导数。
Result: 在九个科学基准和真实 COVID-19 数据集上，MAAT 在不同噪声水平下均大幅降低了轨迹和导数重构误差，优于强基线方法。
Conclusion: MAAT 提供了一种将碎片化测量与下游机制发现（如符号回归）有效连接的原则性框架，但摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Private Tests for Simple and MLR Hypotheses
papers.abstract_en: We develop a near-optimal testing procedure under the framework of Gaussian differential privacy for simple as well as one- and two-sided tests under monotone likelihood ratio conditions. Our mechanism is based on a private mean estimator with data-driven clamping bounds, whose population risk matches the private minimax rate up to logarithmic factors. Using this estimator, we construct private test statistics that achieve the same asymptotic relative efficiency as the non-private, most powerful tests while maintaining conservative type I error control. In addition to our theoretical results, our numerical experiments show that our private tests outperform competing DP methods and offer comparable power to the non-private most powerful tests, even at moderately small sample sizes and privacy loss budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在高斯差分隐私框架下，针对单调似然比条件下的简单假设、单侧和双侧检验，提出了一种近乎最优的检验程序。该方法基于具有数据驱动截断边界的私有均值估计器，其总体风险达到私有极小极大速率（对数因子除外）。使用该估计器构造的私有检验统计量在保守控制第一类错误的同时，实现了与非私有最有效检验相同的渐近相对效率。数值实验表明，即使样本量和隐私损失预算适中，该私有检验方法也优于其他差分隐私方法，且功效与非私有最有效检验相当。
Motivation: 差分隐私下的假设检验通常面临功效损失或保守性问题，现有方法在简单和复合假设下难以同时达到渐近最优性和精确的第一类错误控制。
Method: 提出基于数据驱动截断边界的私有均值估计器，利用其构造检验统计量；该估计器的总体风险匹配私有极小极大速率（忽略对数因子），使得检验统计量在差分隐私下保持渐近相对效率。
Result: 理论证明所提检验统计量在保证保守第一类错误控制的同时，达到与非私有最有效检验相同的渐近相对效率；数值实验显示在适度样本量和隐私预算下，该方法优于已有的差分隐私检验方法，功效接近非私有最有效检验。
Conclusion: 所提出的私有检验程序在简单和单调似然比复合假设下实现近乎最优的效用，为差分隐私下的假设检验提供了实用且理论保证的方法。

papers.title: Semantic-Geometric Task Representations for Bimanual Manipulation from Human Demonstrations to Robot Action Planning
papers.abstract_en: Learning structured task representations from human demonstrations is essential for bimanual manipulation, where action ordering, object involvement, and interaction geometry vary significantly across executions. A key challenge lies in jointly capturing the discrete semantic task structure and the temporal evolution of object-centric geometric relations in a form that supports reasoning over task progression. We introduce a semantic--geometric graph-based task representation that jointly encodes object identities, inter-object semantic relations, and per-object motion histories, via a Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) encoder and a Transformer-based decoder. The encoder operates solely on the temporal scene graph, producing structured representations decoupled from action labels. The decoder then conditions on action-context to forecast future actions, associated objects, and object motions. This decoupling learns task-agnostic representations, enabling encoder reuse across embodiments through decoder-only finetuning on a small robot dataset. Across eleven bimanual tasks from two datasets, we find that the benefit of structured semantic--geometric representations over simpler sequence-based models grows with task variability in action ordering and object involvement. At deployment, a planner couples the action and motion predictions with learned Probabilistic Movement Primitives, achieving full task success on two real-robot bimanual tasks and outperforming graph ablations, Transformer, decoder-only, and finetuned vision-language model baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对双臂操作中任务表示学习的问题，提出一种语义-几何图任务表示方法，通过消息传递神经网络编码器和Transformer解码器联合编码物体身份、语义关系和运动历史。该表示与动作标签解耦，支持任务无关的表示迁移，通过仅解码器微调可适应不同机器人平台。在11个双臂任务上，该方法优于序列模型和多种基线，并在真实机器人上实现了完整任务成功率。
Motivation: 人类演示中双臂操作的执行方式多样，动作顺序、物体参与和交互几何存在变化，现有方法难以同时捕获离散语义结构和物体几何关系的时间演化，且缺乏支持任务推理的表示。
Method: 提出语义-几何图任务表示：MPNN编码器从时序场景图生成结构化表示（解耦动作标签），Transformer解码器基于动作上下文预测未来动作、相关物体和物体运动。通过解耦实现编码器跨实体复用，仅需少量机器人数据微调解码器。
Result: 在11个双臂任务数据集上，语义-几何表示相比序列模型的优势随任务变量增加而增大。真实机器人部署中，结合学习到的概率运动基元，实现两个双臂任务的完整成功，优于图消融、Transformer、仅解码器和微调视觉语言模型基线。
Conclusion: 论文强调解耦语义-几何表示能有效编码双臂任务的可变结构，并支持跨实体迁移，但实验仅限于受控环境，未探讨复杂动态场景或大规模泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hot-Start Chinese Language Modeling:Visual Glyphs Accelerate Sample-Efficient Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study whether rendering Chinese characters as visual glyph images, rather than discrete token IDs as mainstream LLMs do, providing an inductive bias for character-level language modeling. Our central finding gives a double-edged insight: visual inputs produce a pronounced hot-start effect, more than doubling early-stage accuracy within the first epoch (at 0.4% of total training steps) (12.3% visual inputs vs. 5.8% index-based baseline), yet both approaches converge to essentially identical final accuracy (39%). This pattern holds across resolutions as low as 8x8 pixels, partial cropping up to 50%, and model scales from 110M to 1.78B parameters. The mechanism we identify is that glyph rendering pre-encodes radical-based structure into embedding space before any training (cosine similarity 0.27 vs. 0.002 for random embeddings), enabling faster alignment but not higher final capacity. Our results clarify both the promise and fundamental limitation of visual representations as inductive biases for Chinese language modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将汉字渲染为视觉图像（visual glyphs）而非离散token ID是否能为字符级语言建模提供归纳偏置。主要发现是视觉输入产生显著的热启动效果：在0.4%训练步数内早期准确率翻倍（12.3% vs 5.8%），但最终两者收敛到相同准确率（39%）。该模式在8x8像素分辨率、50%裁剪、110M到1.78B参数规模下均成立。机制是字形渲染在训练前将部首结构预编码到嵌入空间（余弦相似度0.27 vs 0.002），从而加速对齐但不提升最终容量。
Motivation: 现有主流LLM将汉字处理为离散token ID，可能丢失字形中的结构信息；本文探索视觉输入是否提供更好的归纳偏置以提升数据效率。
Method: 将汉字渲染为低分辨率（如8x8）灰度图像作为模型输入，而非token ID；在标准语言建模任务上比较视觉输入与索引基线的学习曲线。
Result: 视觉输入在第一个epoch内使准确率翻倍（12.3% vs 5.8%），但最终准确率与基线相同（约39%）；该模式在不同分辨率、裁剪比例和模型规模下均一致。
Conclusion: 视觉字形提供了热启动优势，但最终表达能力受限于相同的模型容量；视觉归纳偏置加速早期学习但无法突破容量上限。

papers.title: PFT: Phonon Fine-tuning for Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: Many materials properties depend on higher-order derivatives of the potential energy surface, yet machine learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) trained with a standard loss on energy, force, and stress errors can exhibit error in curvature, degrading the prediction of vibrational properties. We introduce phonon fine-tuning (PFT), which directly supervises second-order force constants of materials by matching MLIP energy Hessians to DFT-computed force constants from finite displacement phonon calculations. To scale to large supercells, PFT stochastically samples Hessian columns and computes the loss with a single Hessian-vector product. We also use a simple co-training scheme to incorporate upstream data to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. On the MDR Phonon benchmark, PFT improves Nequix MP by 55% on average across phonon thermodynamic properties and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among models trained on Materials Project trajectories. PFT also generalizes to improve properties beyond second-derivatives, improving thermal conductivity predictions that rely on third-order derivatives of the potential energy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出声子微调（Phonon Fine-tuning, PFT）方法，通过直接监督二阶力常数来改进机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的曲率预测。方法随机采样Hessian列并利用Hessian-vector product计算损失，结合协同训练防止灾难性遗忘。在MDR Phonon基准上，PFT将Nequix MP的声子热力学性质平均提升55%，并改善了热导率等依赖于三阶导数的性质预测。
Motivation: 标准MLIP训练仅优化能量、力和应力的误差，导致势能面曲率误差，影响振动性质预测。需要直接监督二阶力常数以改善曲率。
Method: 通过匹配MLIP能量Hessian与DFT有限位移声子计算的力常数，随机采样Hessian列并计算Hessian-vector product损失，结合协同训练整合上游数据防止灾难性遗忘。
Result: 在MDR Phonon基准上，Nequix MP的声子热力学性质平均提升55%，达到基于Materials Project轨迹训练模型的最先进水平。PFT还改善了依赖于三阶导数的热导率预测。
Conclusion: PFT有效改进了MLIP的曲率预测，提升振动性质和热导率等下游性质，且具有良好的泛化能力。

summary_sections.conclusion: PFT有效改进了MLIP的曲率预测，提升振动性质和热导率等下游性质，且具有良好的泛化能力。

papers.title: Safe-FedLLM: Delving into the Safety of Federated Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) addresses privacy and data-silo issues in the training of large language models (LLMs). Most prior work focuses on improving the efficiency of federated learning for LLMs (FedLLM). However, security in open federated environments, particularly defenses against malicious clients, remains underexplored. To investigate the security of FedLLM, we conduct a preliminary study to analyze potential attack surfaces and defensive characteristics from the perspective of LoRA updates. We find two key properties of FedLLM: 1) LLMs are vulnerable to attacks from malicious clients in FL, and 2) LoRA updates exhibit distinct behavioral patterns that can be effectively distinguished by lightweight classifiers. Based on these properties, we propose Safe-FedLLM, a probe-based defense framework for FedLLM, which constructs defenses across three levels: Step-Level, Client-Level, and Shadow-Level. The core concept of Safe-FedLLM is to perform probe-based discrimination on each client's local LoRA updates, treating them as high-dimensional behavioral features and using a lightweight classifier to determine whether they are malicious. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Safe-FedLLM effectively improves FedLLM's robustness against malicious clients while maintaining competitive performance on benign data. Notably, our method effectively suppresses the impact of malicious data without significantly affecting training speed, and remains effective even under high malicious client ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦大语言模型（FedLLM）的安全性，发现LLM易受恶意客户端攻击，且LoRA更新具有可区分的模式。基于此，提出Safe-FedLLM，一种基于探针的防御框架，在步骤级、客户端级和影子级三个层面构建防御，使用轻量级分类器判别恶意LoRA更新。实验表明该方法能有效提升FedLLM对恶意客户端的鲁棒性，抑制恶意数据影响而不显著降低训练速度，即使在高恶意客户端比例下也保持有效。
Motivation: 联邦学习在LLM训练中解决了隐私和数据孤岛问题，但先前工作主要关注效率，安全性（尤其是防御恶意客户端）研究不足。
Method: 提出Safe-FedLLM，基于探针的防御框架，对每个客户端的LoRA更新进行探针判别，将其视为高维行为特征，使用轻量级分类器判断是否为恶意更新。防御分为三层：Step-Level、Client-Level和Shadow-Level。
Result: 实验表明Safe-FedLLM有效提升了FedLLM对恶意客户端的鲁棒性，同时保持良性数据上的性能；抑制恶意数据影响而不显著影响训练速度，在高恶意客户端比例下仍有效。
Conclusion: 本文强调了FedLLM的安全问题，并提出了有效的探针式防御框架，但未讨论对攻击类型泛化性或通信开销等潜在局限性。

papers.title: VLM4VLA: Revisiting Vision-Language-Models in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which integrate pretrained large Vision-Language Models (VLM) into their policy backbone, are gaining significant attention for their promising generalization capabilities. This paper revisits a fundamental yet seldom systematically studied question: how VLM choice and competence translate to downstream VLA policies performance? We introduce VLM4VLA, a minimal adaptation pipeline that converts general-purpose VLMs into VLA policies using only a small set of new learnable parameters for fair and efficient comparison. Despite its simplicity, VLM4VLA proves surprisingly competitive with more sophisticated network designs. Through extensive empirical studies on various downstream tasks across three benchmarks, we find that while VLM initialization offers a consistent benefit over training from scratch, a VLM's general capabilities are poor predictors of its downstream task performance. This challenges common assumptions, indicating that standard VLM competence is necessary but insufficient for effective embodied control. We further investigate the impact of specific embodied capabilities by fine-tuning VLMs on seven auxiliary embodied tasks (e.g., embodied QA, visual pointing, depth estimation). Contrary to intuition, improving a VLM's performance on specific embodied skills does not guarantee better downstream control performance. Finally, modality-level ablations identify the visual module in VLM, rather than the language component, as the primary performance bottleneck. We demonstrate that injecting control-relevant supervision into the vision encoder of the VLM yields consistent gains, even when the encoder remains frozen during downstream fine-tuning. This isolates a persistent domain gap between current VLM pretraining objectives and the requirements of embodied action-planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VLM4VLA，一个最小适配流水线，仅用少量可学习参数将通用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 转化为视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略。在三个基准的多项任务上，实验表明 VLM 初始化相比随机初始化有持续优势，但 VLM 的通用能力无法预测下游任务性能；微调特定具身能力（如具身 QA、视觉指向、深度估计）不能保证更好的控制性能；视觉模块是性能瓶颈，注入控制相关监督到 VLM 的视觉编码器能带来一致提升。
Motivation: VLA 模型正受到广泛关注，但 VLM 的选择和能力如何影响下游 VLA 策略性能这一基本问题尚未被系统研究。
Method: 提出 VLM4VLA，一个仅需少量可学习参数的适配流水线，将通用 VLM 转换为 VLA 策略，以实现公平且高效的比较。进一步通过七种辅助具身任务微调 VLM，并进行了模态级消融。
Result: VLM 初始化带来持续优势，但通用能力与下游任务性能无强相关性；微调特定具身技能不保证控制性能提升；视觉模块是主要瓶颈，对视觉编码器注入控制相关监督即使冻结也能带来一致改善。
Conclusion: 标准 VLM 能力是下游控制的必要条件而非充分条件；视觉编码器与具身动作规划之间存在持续的领域差距，需要控制相关的预训练目标。

papers.title: ELF: A Family of Encoder-Free ECG-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: ECG-Language Models (ELMs) extend recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to automated ECG interpretation. However, most existing ELMs inherit Vision-Language Model (VLM) design choices and rely on pretrained ECG encoders, introducing substantial architectural and training complexity. Inspired by encoder-free VLMs, we introduce ELF, a family of three encoder-free ELM architectures that remain competitive with, and often outperform, prior state-of-the-art ELMs across two datasets despite substantially simpler architectures and training pipelines. All code and data is available at github.com/ELM-Research/ECG-Language-Models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ELF，一个无编码器的 ECG-语言模型 (ECG-Language Model) 系列，包含三种架构，在无需预训练心电图编码器的情况下，与之前最先进的 ECG-语言模型相比保持竞争力甚至更优。
Motivation: 现有 ECG-语言模型大多沿用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 设计，依赖预训练心电图编码器，引入大量架构和训练复杂性。
Method: 受无编码器 VLM 启发，提出 ELF 系列三种无编码器架构，简化训练流程。
Result: 在两个数据集上，ELF 与之前最先进模型相比保持竞争力甚至更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调简单架构仍能取得优异性能。

papers.title: Avatar Forcing: Real-Time Interactive Head Avatar Generation for Natural Conversation
papers.abstract_en: Talking head generation creates lifelike avatars from static portraits for virtual communication and content creation. However, current models do not yet convey the feeling of truly interactive communication, often generating one-way responses that lack emotional engagement. We identify two key challenges toward truly interactive avatars: generating motion in real-time under causal constraints and learning expressive, vibrant reactions without additional labeled data. To address these challenges, we propose Avatar Forcing, a new framework for interactive head avatar generation that models real-time user-avatar interactions through diffusion forcing. This design allows the avatar to process real-time multimodal inputs, including the user's audio and motion, with low latency for instant reactions to both verbal and non-verbal cues such as speech, nods, and laughter. Furthermore, we introduce a direct preference optimization method that leverages synthetic losing samples constructed by dropping user conditions, enabling label-free learning of expressive interaction. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework enables real-time interaction with low latency (approximately 500ms), achieving 6.8X speedup compared to the baseline, and produces reactive and expressive avatar motion, which is preferred over 80% against the baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Avatar Forcing 框架，用于实时交互式头部头像生成，利用扩散强迫（diffusion forcing）模型处理用户实时多模态输入，实现低延迟响应（约500ms），并通过直接偏好优化（DPO）无标签学习表达性交互。实验表明速度比基线快6.8倍，且用户偏好超过80%。
Motivation: 现有对话头生成模型缺乏真正的交互感，通常产生单向响应，无法实时处理用户的言语和非言语线索（如点头、笑声），且需要额外标注数据学习富有表现力的反应。
Method: 提出 Avatar Forcing 框架，基于扩散强迫模型，以低延迟处理实时多模态输入（音频和动作）；引入直接偏好优化（DPO）方法，通过丢弃用户条件构建合成负样本，实现无标签学习表达性交互。
Result: 实现实时交互，延迟约500ms，速度比基线快6.8倍；生成的反应性、表达性头部动画在用户偏好中超过基线80%以上。
Conclusion: 框架验证了扩散强迫在实时交互头像生成中的有效性，使得能够生成对语音和非言语线索有自然反应的虚拟形象，但可能在更复杂交互场景下存在局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CountGD++: Generalized Prompting for Open-World Counting
papers.abstract_en: The flexibility and accuracy of methods for automatically counting objects in images and videos are limited by the way the object can be specified. While existing methods allow users to describe the target object with text and visual examples, the visual examples must be manually annotated inside the image, and there is no way to specify what not to count. To address these gaps, we introduce novel capabilities that expand how the target object can be specified. Specifically, we extend the prompt to enable what not to count to be described with text and/or visual examples, introduce the concept of `pseudo-exemplars' that automate the annotation of visual examples at inference, and extend counting models to accept visual examples from both natural and synthetic external images. We also use our new counting model, CountGD++, as a vision expert agent for an LLM. Together, these contributions expand the prompt flexibility of multi-modal open-world counting and lead to significant improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and generalization across multiple datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/niki-amini-naieni/CountGDPlusPlus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CountGD++，一种泛化性更强的开放世界目标计数方法，通过扩展提示方式实现了对计数对象和排除对象的灵活指定，并引入伪样本自动标注和外部图像示例支持，显著提升了多模态开放世界计数的准确性、效率和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有开放世界计数方法在对象指定方式上存在局限：视觉示例必须手动标注在图像内，且无法指定不计数对象，限制了方法的灵活性和自动化程度。
Method: CountGD++扩展了提示功能，支持用文本和/或视觉示例描述不计数对象；引入“伪示例”概念，在推理时自动生成视觉示例注释；并支持从自然或合成外部图像中接受视觉示例，同时将计数模型作为LLM的视觉专家代理。
Result: 该方法在多个数据集上显著提升了准确率、效率和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 通过更灵活的提示方式，开放世界多模态计数的实用性得到增强，且伪示例和外部图像支持减少了人工标注需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: Current Benchmarking Hinders Real Progress in Deep Learning for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models have grown popular in time series applications. However, the large quantity of newly proposed architectures and the often contradictory empirical results make it difficult to assess which design choice and model component drives performance. In this position paper, we argue that current benchmarking practices fail to identify the factors responsible for performance differences, thus slowing down progress in the field. In particular, differences in crucial design dimensions are overlooked when comparing architectures, ultimately leading to inconsistent outcomes. To support our position, we show that such differences-often treated as mere implementation details-can have a greater impact than adopting specific sequence modeling layers. We discuss how overlooked aspects (such as globality and locality) can (1) fundamentally change the class of the forecasting method and (2) drastically affect empirical results. Our findings suggest rethinking our benchmarking practices and focusing on the foundational aspects of the forecasting problem when designing and comparing architectures. As a concrete step, we propose an auxiliary forecasting model card, i.e., a template with a set of fields to characterize existing and new forecasting architectures based on key design choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，批评当前时间序列预测的深度学习基准测试实践未能识别性能差异的真正来源，导致进展缓慢。作者指出，架构设计中常被视为实现细节的方面（如全局性与局部性）对结果的影响可能超过序列建模层本身，并提议使用辅助预测模型卡来标准化设计维度描述。
Motivation: 时间序列预测中大量新架构和矛盾实验结果使得评估设计选择变得困难，现有基准测试忽视了关键设计维度，阻碍了领域进步。
Method: 通过实验展示设计细节（如全局性与局部性）对性能的重大影响，并提议建立一个辅助预测模型卡（template）来标准化架构描述，聚焦基础设计选择。
Result: 作者表明被忽略的设计维度（如全局性与局部性）可以根本改变预测方法类别并显著影响实证结果，其影响甚至超过特定序列建模层。
Conclusion: 应重新思考基准测试实践，在设计和比较架构时关注预测问题的基本面，模型卡是迈向更清晰报告的一步。
Relevance: 55

summary_sections.conclusion: 应重新思考基准测试实践，在设计和比较架构时关注预测问题的基本面，模型卡是迈向更清晰报告的一步。

papers.title: Hard Labels In! Rethinking the Role of Hard Labels in Mitigating Local Semantic Drift
papers.abstract_en: Soft labels from teacher models are a de facto practice for knowledge transfer and large-scale dataset distillation (e.g., SRe2L, LPLD). However, when we limit the number of crops per image to reduce the substantial cost of storing precomputed soft labels, these methods suffer severely from local semantic drift: visually ambiguous crops can cause soft supervision to deviate from the image-level ground-truth semantics, leading to persistent errors and a train-test distribution mismatch. We revisit the overlooked role of hard labels and show that, when properly integrated, they can act as a content-invariant semantic anchor that calibrates such drift. We theoretically analyze the emergence of drift under sparse soft-label supervision and demonstrate that hybridizing hard and soft labels restores alignment between visual content and semantic supervision. Building on this insight, we propose a new training paradigm, Hard Label for Alleviating Local Semantic Drift (HALD), which uses hard labels as intermediate corrective signals while preserving the fine-grained benefits of soft labels. Extensive experiments on dataset distillation and large-scale classification benchmarks show consistent generalization improvements. On ImageNet-1K, our method achieves 42.7% accuracy with only 285M soft-label storage (reduces by 100X), outperforming prior state-of-the-art LPLD 9.0%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了软标签（soft labels）在知识迁移和大规模数据集蒸馏中的主导地位，指出当每张图像的裁剪数受限时，软标签易引发局部语义漂移（local semantic drift），导致训练-测试分布不匹配。作者从理论和实验上证明，合理整合硬标签（hard labels）可以作为内容不变的语义锚点来校准这种漂移，并据此提出HALD训练范式。在ImageNet-1K上，该方法仅用285M软标签存储（减少100倍）就达到42.7%准确率，比先前最先进的LPLD高出9.0%。
Motivation: 现有依赖软标签的蒸馏方法在减少每张图像裁剪数以降低存储成本时，会遭受严重的局部语义漂移：模糊的裁剪块使软监督偏离图像级真实语义，导致持续错误和训练-测试分布不匹配。
Method: 提出HALD（Hard Label for Alleviating Local Semantic Drift）训练范式，在保持软标签细粒度优势的同时，使用硬标签作为中间校正信号，混合两种标签来恢复视觉内容与语义监督的对齐。
Result: 在ImageNet-1K上，HALD仅需285M软标签存储（相比之前方法减少100倍），即可达到42.7%准确率，比先前最先进的LPLD高9.0%。
Conclusion: 硬标签在适当整合下可以作为内容不变的语义锚点，有效缓解稀疏软标签监督下的局部语义漂移，为大规模数据集蒸馏提供更高效的标签存储方案。

papers.title: Calibrating Uncertainty for Zero-Shot Adversarial CLIP
papers.abstract_en: CLIP delivers strong zero-shot classification but remains highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Prior adversarial fine-tuning work primarily matches predicted logits between clean and adversarial examples, which overlooks uncertainty calibration and may degrade the zero-shot generalization. A common expectation in reliable uncertainty estimation is that predictive uncertainty should increase as inputs become more difficult or shift away from the training distribution. However, we frequently observe the opposite in the adversarial setting: perturbations not only degrade accuracy but also suppress uncertainty, leading to severe miscalibration and over-confidence. This reveals a critical reliability gap beyond robustness. To bridge this gap, we propose an adversarial fine-tuning objective for CLIP considering both accuracy and uncertainty. By reparameterizing CLIP outputs as the concentration parameters of a Dirichlet distribution, we propose a unified representation that captures relative semantic structure and confidence magnitude. This enables holistic distribution alignment under perturbations, moving beyond single-logit anchoring and restoring calibrated uncertainty. Experiments across multiple zero-shot benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves uncertainty calibration and achieves competitive adversarial robustness while preserving clean accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出CLIP在零样本分类中对抗攻击后不仅准确率下降，还会出现不确定性被抑制、过度自信的严重校准问题。作者提出一种对抗微调目标，将CLIP输出重参数化为Dirichlet分布的浓度参数，从而在扰动下实现整体分布对齐，同时恢复校准的不确定性。实验在多个零样本基准上表明该方法显著改进不确定性校准，并在保持干净准确率的同时取得有竞争力的对抗鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有CLIP对抗微调主要匹配logits，忽略不确定性校准，且对抗扰动常导致不确定性降低和过度自信，暴露了超越鲁棒性的可靠性质疑。
Method: 将CLIP输出重参数化为Dirichlet分布的浓度参数，统一表示相对语义结构和置信度大小，并在对抗微调时对干净和对抗样本进行整体分布对齐。
Result: 在多个零样本基准上，该方法显著改进不确定性校准，并取得有竞争力的对抗鲁棒性，同时保持干净准确率。
Conclusion: 作者强调所提出的分布对齐方法能同时提升对抗鲁棒性和不确定性校准，弥补了先前工作的可靠性gap。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Boosting RL-Based Visual Reasoning with Selective Adversarial Entropy Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Recently, reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common choice in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs). Considering existing RL-based finetuning methods, entropy intervention turns out to be an effective way to benefit exploratory ability, thereby improving policy performance. Notably, most existing studies intervene in entropy by simply controlling the update of specific tokens during policy optimization of RL. They ignore the entropy intervention during the RL sampling that can boost the performance of GRPO by improving the diversity of responses. In this paper, we propose Selective-adversarial Entropy Intervention, namely SaEI, which enhances policy entropy by distorting the visual input with the token-selective adversarial objective coming from the entropy of sampled responses. Specifically, we first propose entropy-guided adversarial sampling (EgAS) that formulates the entropy of sampled responses as an adversarial objective. Then, the corresponding adversarial gradient can be used to attack the visual input for producing adversarial samples, allowing the policy model to explore a larger answer space during RL sampling. Then, we propose token-selective entropy computation (TsEC) to maximize the effectiveness of adversarial attack in EgAS without distorting factual knowledge within VLMs. Extensive experiments on both in-domain and out-of-domain datasets show that our proposed method can greatly improve policy exploration via entropy intervention, to boost reasoning capabilities. Code will be released once the paper is accepted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出选择性对抗熵干预（SaEI），通过对抗性攻击视觉输入以增加采样多样性，从而提升基于强化学习的视觉语言模型推理能力。在域内和域外数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有强化学习微调方法在策略优化时简单控制特定token熵，忽略了采样阶段的熵干预，限制了探索能力和性能提升。
Method: 提出SaEI，包含熵引导对抗采样（EgAS）和Token选择性熵计算（TsEC）。EgAS将采样响应的熵作为对抗目标攻击视觉输入生成对抗样本；TsEC选择性计算熵以避免扭曲事实知识。
Result: 在域内和域外数据集上，该方法通过采样阶段的熵干预显著提升了策略探索和推理能力。
Conclusion: 选择性对抗熵干预能有效利用采样阶段熵信息增强探索，且不破坏VLM的事实知识。

papers.title: Design Space Exploration of DMA based Finer-Grain Compute Communication Overlap
papers.abstract_en: Modern ML workloads demand distributing training and inference across multiple GPUs. However, these parallelization techniques often suffer from exposed critical-path communication, leaving a potential 1.7x speedup on the table through compute-communication overlap. Prior overlapping methods harness the fact that ML model state and inputs are already sharded into the number of GPUs, and overlap the compute and communication at shard granularity. However, such coarse-grained overlap suffers from limited network topology support, and suboptimal dataflows. In this work, we instead make a case for finer-grain compute-communication overlap which we term FiCCO. FiCCO operates one level deeper than traditional sharding, and unlocks overlap for a wider set of network topologies and enables finer-grain dataflow. We show that FiCCO opens up a wider design space of execution schedules than possible at shard-level alone. To walk the design space of schedules, we study and characterize the performance inefficiencies on doing overlap and overlay the schedules with the associated inefficiency signatures. Our characterization reveals decomposition and contention based slowdowns to be the major performance limiters, and we correlate the slowdown factors with the static compute/communication operator sizes. This helps us design heuristics (that frameworks and runtimes can harness) to select bespoke FiCCO schedules based on the nature of underlying ML operations. Finally, to further minimize contention inefficiencies inherent with operation overlap, we offload communication to GPU DMA engines. We evaluate several scenarios from realistic ML deployments and demonstrate that our proposed heuristics driven bespoke schedules deliver up to 1.6x speedup. Further, our heuristics provide accurate guidance to pick the optimal schedule in 81% of unseen scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出细粒度计算通信重叠（FiCCO）方法，在ML分布式训练中实现比传统分片更细粒度的重叠，支持更广泛的网络拓扑和更精细的数据流。通过表征分解和竞争导致的性能限制，设计基于静态算子大小的启发式方法选择定制调度，并利用GPU DMA引擎卸载通信以减少竞争。实验表明，启发式定制调度在真实ML部署场景中实现最高1.6倍加速，在81%未见场景中准确选出最优调度。
Motivation: 现有粗粒度重叠方法支持网络拓扑有限、数据流次优，导致暴露的通信成为关键路径瓶颈，可能浪费1.7倍加速潜力。
Method: 提出FiCCO，在比传统分片更细的粒度上（操作于分片内部更深层次）重叠计算和通信；通过表征分解和竞争导致的性能限制，建立与静态计算/通信算子大小的关联，设计启发式方法选择定制调度；使用GPU DMA引擎卸载通信以减少竞争。
Result: 在真实ML部署场景中，启发式定制调度实现最高1.6倍加速；启发式在81%未见场景中准确选择最优调度。
Conclusion: FiCCO通过更细粒度重叠和DMA卸载有效缓解通信瓶颈，启发式方法可被框架和运行时利用，为分布式ML训练提供高效调度。

papers.title: InFerActive: Interactive Tree-Based Exploration of LLM Sampling for Safety Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Even LLMs that appear safe during evaluation can still produce harmful responses in deployment. Because stochastic sampling yields different responses to the same prompt, low-probability harmful outputs can still reach users at scale. Common human evaluation workflows generate many random samples per prompt and review them in static spreadsheets. The practice scales poorly, forcing evaluators to repeatedly reread near-duplicate prefixes. To address this, we present InFerActive, an interactive system that visualizes sampling results as a navigable tree of readable phrases, allowing evaluators to filter, explore, and extend the generation space on demand. InFerActive utilizes breadth-first sampling, a novel tree construction procedure that matches the harmful-response coverage of random sampling while requiring up to 5.0x fewer samples. Two controlled user studies (N = 12 each) demonstrate that InFerActive significantly improves evaluation efficiency and coverage over both spreadsheet and basic tree baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InFerActive 交互式系统，将 LLM 安全评估中的随机采样结果可视化为可导航短语树，支持评估者过滤、探索和扩展生成空间。该系统采用广度优先采样，在保持有害响应覆盖的同时，所需样本数最多减少 5.0 倍。两项用户研究（N=12）表明，与电子表格和基本树基线相比，InFerActive 显著提高了评估效率和覆盖率。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全评估中，人类评估者需在静态电子表格中审查大量随机采样结果，重复阅读近似冗余前缀，导致评估效率低、扩展性差，且难以覆盖低概率有害输出。
Method: 提出 InFerActive 交互式系统，通过广度优先采样（广度优先采样）构建可导航短语树，评估者可交互式过滤、探索和扩展生成空间。
Result: 广度优先采样在匹配随机采样的有害响应覆盖的前提下，所需样本数减少至多 5.0 倍；用户研究中，InFerActive 的评估效率和覆盖率均显著优于电子表格和基本树基线。
Conclusion: InFerActive 通过交互式树形探索提升了 LLM 安全评估的效率和覆盖，但系统可能因具体任务和 LLM 类型而异。

papers.title: ShelfAware: Real-Time Semantic Localization in Quasi-Static Environments with Low-Cost Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Many indoor workspaces are quasi-static: their global geometric layout is stable, but local semantics change continually, producing repetitive geometry, dynamic clutter, and perceptual noise that defeat standard vision-based localization. We present ShelfAware, a semantic particle filter for robust global localization that treats scene semantics as statistical evidence over object categories rather than fixed quantity landmarks. ShelfAware fuses a depth likelihood with a category-centric semantic similarity and uses a precomputed bank of semantic viewpoints to perform inverse semantic proposals inside Monte Carlo Localization (MCL), yielding fast, targeted hypothesis generation on low-cost, vision-only hardware. To demonstrate perception-agnostic scalability, we evaluate ShelfAware across two domains. In a rigorously controlled mock retail environment, ShelfAware achieves a 97% global localization success rate, maintaining the highest tracking success (66%) across cart, wearable, and dynamic occlusion conditions. Furthermore, in a 3,500 sq. ft. operational grocery store leveraging an open-vocabulary vision pipeline, ShelfAware significantly outperforms both geometric and fixed-quantity semantic baselines. By modeling semantics distributionally and leveraging inverse proposals, ShelfAware resolves geometric aliasing, providing an infrastructure-free building block for mobile and assistive robots in dynamic real-world environments.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShelfAware提出了一种语义粒子滤波器，利用物体类别的语义相似度作为统计证据，结合预计算的语义视点库实现快速全局定位。在模拟零售环境和实际杂货店中，该方法在低成本视觉硬件上达到了97%的全局定位成功率，优于几何和固定数量语义基线。
Motivation: 许多室内工作空间是准静态的：全局几何布局稳定，但局部语义不断变化，产生重复几何、动态杂波和感知噪声，使得标准视觉定位方法失效。
Method: 提出语义粒子滤波器，融合深度似然和类别中心语义相似度，利用预计算语义视点库在蒙特卡洛定位（MCL）内进行逆语义提议，实现快速假设生成。
Result: 在严格控制的模拟零售环境中达到97%全局定位成功率，在推车、可穿戴和动态遮挡条件下保持最高跟踪成功率（66%）；在3500平方英尺的实际杂货店中显著优于几何和固定数量语义基线。
Conclusion: 通过分布化建模语义并利用逆提议，ShelfAware解决了几何混叠问题，为动态真实环境中移动和辅助机器人提供了无需基础设施的构建模块。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Family Matters: A Systematic Study of Spatial vs. Frequency Masking for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Recent continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) methods adopt masked image modeling to stabilize learning under distribution shift, yet each treats its masking family F as a fixed design choice and innovates exclusively along the selection strategy S, leaving the family axis underexplored. We present a systematic empirical study that isolates this axis. Using a controlled CTTA instantiation -- Mask to Adapt (M2A) -- that fixes S = random and standard losses, we vary only F across spatial (patch, pixel) and frequency (all-band, low-band, high-band) families while keeping every other component identical. The study's contributions are the design guidance it extracts for the CTTA settings we evaluated: (1) the masking family determines whether adaptation compounds useful structure or compounds errors -- on patch-tokenized architectures, spatial masking accumulates stable representations over long streams while frequency masking collapses catastrophically. We characterize this instability through a structural-preservation account, where spatial coherence maintains the broad-spectrum redundancy needed to avoid terminally overlapping with a corruption's spectral signature; (2) the optimal family depends on architecture-task alignment -- on CNNs, whose overlapping receptive fields dilute patch occlusion, the family gap vanishes, whereas on fine-grained tasks with global cues and large-capacity ViTs, frequency masking becomes competitive. In confounded system-level comparisons -- where baselines also differ in losses and auxiliary components -- M2A's random selection performs comparably to heuristic strategies, though we treat this observation as suggestive context rather than a controlled quantification of S's relative importance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了持续测试时间适应中空间掩码和频率掩码的影响，通过控制实验设计（M2A框架）发现掩码家族的选择决定了适应是否会积累有用结构或放大错误，并且最优掩码家族依赖于架构-任务对齐。
Motivation: 现有CTTA方法将掩码家族视为固定设计选择，仅沿选择策略创新，忽略了掩码家族维度的影响。
Method: 采用受控的CTTA实例化——Mask to Adapt (M2A)——固定选择策略为随机并使用标准损失，仅变化掩码家族（空间：patch, pixel；频率：全频、低频、高频），保持其他组件相同。
Result: 在patch-tokenized架构上，空间掩码积累稳定表示，频率掩码导致灾难性崩溃；在CNN上家族差距消失；在细粒度任务和大容量ViT上频率掩码具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 掩码家族对CTTA性能有决定性影响，设计指导依赖于架构和任务对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReasonBENCH: Benchmarking the (In)Stability of LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark scores for LLM reasoning systems are reported as single numbers, yet the same model, strategy, and task can produce meaningfully different answers and costs across repeated executions, even under greedy decoding (T = 0). This variance is not a statistical nuisance: the highest-performing strategy wins only 77% of head-to-head runs against its nearest competitor, meaning a single observed score can silently misrank systems. We introduce ReasonBench, a benchmark suite recording 30 independent trials across 10 reasoning strategies, 12 models, and 6 tasks, treating quality and cost as distributions rather than point estimates. We find that this variance is structured rather than random: a two-component taxonomy -- Global Noise, capturing cross-benchmark unevenness, and Run Noise, capturing within-benchmark stochasticity -- reveals that strategy architecture predicts stability profiles, while models and strategies shift orthogonal aspects of the distribution. A hierarchical decomposition attributes three-quarters of score variance to benchmark, system, and item structure, with a persistent residual that single-run evaluation silently absorbs. Finally, cost and quality decouple asymmetrically: cheap methods are structurally immune to joint cost-quality failure, while expensive methods remain exposed regardless of their accuracy. These findings establish instability as an inherent property of reasoning systems and motivate distribution-aware evaluation as standard practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出LLM推理系统的基准得分存在显著的不稳定性，即使使用贪心解码（T=0），相同模型、策略和任务在多次运行中也会产生不同的答案和成本。这种方差并非统计噪音：最优策略在头对头运行中仅以77%的胜率击败次优策略。作者提出ReasonBench基准套件，记录30次独立试验，覆盖10种推理策略、12个模型和6个任务，将质量和成本视为分布而非点估计。方差是结构化的，可分为全局噪声和运行噪声，策略架构可预测稳定性特征。层次分解将四分之三的得分方差归因于基准、系统和项目结构，而剩余部分被单次运行评估隐性吸收。此外，成本与质量非对称解耦：廉价方法在结构上对联合成本-质量故障免疫，而昂贵方法无论准确性如何仍暴露于风险。这些发现确立了不稳定性作为推理系统的固有属性，并推动分布感知评估成为标准实践。
Motivation: 现有LLM推理基准报告单次得分，但相同配置下多次运行结果存在非平凡方差，导致系统排名可能被无声误判。
Method: 提出ReasonBench基准套件，对10种推理策略、12个模型和6个任务各执行30次独立试验，将质量和成本建模为分布，并引入两层噪声分类（全局噪声和运行噪声）。
Result: 最优策略在头对头运行中仅以77%胜率胜出；层次分解显示四分之三方差由基准、系统和项目结构解释，剩余残差被单次评估吸收；成本与质量非对称解耦。
Conclusion: 不稳定性是推理系统的固有属性，应使用分布感知评估取代单次点估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MINES: Explainable Anomaly Detection through Web API Invariant Inference
papers.abstract_en: Detecting the anomalies of web applications, important infrastructures for running modern companies and governments, is crucial for providing reliable web services. Many modern web applications operate on web APIs (e.g., RESTful, SOAP, and WebSockets), their exposure invites intended attacks or unintended illegal visits, causing abnormal system behaviors. However, such anomalies can share very similar logs with normal logs, missing crucial information (which could be in database) for log discrimination. Further, log instances can be also noisy, which can further mislead the state-of-the-art log learning solutions to learn spurious correlation, resulting superficial models and rules for anomaly detection. In this work, we propose MINES which infers explainable API invariants for anomaly detection from the schema level instead of detailed raw log instances, which can (1) significantly discriminate noise in logs to identify precise normalities and (2) detect abnormal behaviors beyond the instrumented logs. Technically, MINES (1) converts API signatures into table schema to enhance the original database shema; and (2) infers the potential database constraints on the enhanced database schema to capture the potential relationships between APIs and database tables. MINES uses LLM for extracting potential relationship based on two given table structures; and use normal log instances to reject and accept LLM-generated invariants. Finally, MINES translates the inferred constraints into invariants to generate Python code for verifying the runtime logs. We extensively evaluate MINES on web-tamper attacks on the benchmarks of TrainTicket, NiceFish, Gitea, Mastodon, and NextCloud against baselines such as LogRobust, LogFormer, and WebNorm. The results show that MINES achieves high recall for the anomalies while introducing almost zero false positives, indicating a new state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MINES，一种从 Web API 模式（schema）级别推断可解释不变量的异常检测方法。MINES 利用 LLM 推断 API 与数据库表之间的潜在关系，并通过正常日志验证不变量，将其转换为 Python 代码用于运行时日志验证。在多个 Web 应用基准上，MINES 对异常检测实现了高召回率且几乎零误报。
Motivation: 现有方法基于日志实例学习，难以区分相似日志中的异常，且易受噪声误导。
Method: 将 API 签名转换为表模式并增强数据库模式，利用 LLM 基于两表结构提取潜在关系，再用正常日志实例筛选 LLM 生成的不变量，最终将推断的约束转换为不变量并生成 Python 代码。
Result: 在 TrainTicket、NiceFish、Gitea、Mastodon、NextCloud 等基准上，针对 Web 篡改攻击，MINES 实现了高召回率且几乎零误报，超越了 LogRobust、LogFormer、WebNorm 等基线。
Conclusion: 从模式级别推断不变量可以有效进行可解释的异常检测，对日志噪声具有鲁棒性，并能检测超出日志范围的异常行为。

papers.title: From Segments to Scenes: Temporal Understanding in Autonomous Driving via Vision-Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as the perception and reasoning backbone of autonomous agents acting in the wild, with autonomous driving (AD) being one of the most safety-critical instances. Reliable temporal understanding is essential for such agents to anticipate events, attribute causes, and act safely in dynamic environments, yet this remains a significant challenge even for state-of-the-art (SoTA) VLMs. Prior video benchmarks have emphasized other content (sports, cooking, etc.), yet no existing benchmark focuses exclusively on temporal understanding for both short- and long-form AD footage. To fill this gap, we present the Temporal Understanding in Autonomous Driving (TAD) benchmark, comprising nearly 6000 question-answer (QA) pairs across 7 tasks, and evaluate 9 closed- and open-source generalist as well as AD-specialist models. Current SoTA models perform substantially below human accuracy on TAD. To improve the temporal reasoning of VLM-based driving agents, we propose two novel training-free solutions: Scene-CoT, which uses Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, and TCogMap, which incorporates an ego-centric temporal cognitive map produced by a trajectory-analysis module that operates as an agentic tool around the VLM. Integrated with existing VLMs, our methods improve average accuracy on TAD by up to $17.72\%$ and by up to $10.35\%$ on STSBench. By introducing TAD, benchmarking SoTA models, and proposing effective enhancements, this work aims to catalyze further progress on temporal understanding for agentic AD systems operating in the wild. The benchmark and evaluation code are available at ${\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/vbdai/TAD}{\text{Hugging Face}}}$ and ${\href{https://github.com/vbdi/tad_bench}{\text{GitHub}}}$, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向自动驾驶场景的时序理解基准TAD，包含近6000个问答对和7项任务，评估了9个通用及AD专用视觉语言模型。作者提出两种无需训练的改进方法（Scene-CoT和TCogMap），在TAD上平均提升17.72%准确率，但所有模型仍远低于人类水平。
Motivation: 现有视频基准聚焦于体育、烹饪等内容，缺乏专门针对自动驾驶短时和长时视频的时序理解基准，而时序理解对安全关键系统至关重要。
Method: 构建TAD基准，包含7类时序任务；提出Scene-CoT（链式思考推理）和TCogMap（基于轨迹分析的自我中心时序认知图）两种无需训练的增强方法，集成到现有VLM中。
Result: 当前最优模型在TAD上准确率远低于人类；所提方法在TAD上最高提升17.72%，在STSBench上提升10.35%。
Conclusion: 该工作通过新基准、评估和有效增强，旨在推动自动驾驶系统中视觉语言模型的时序理解研究。基准和代码已开源。

papers.title: WUSH: Near-Optimal Adaptive Transforms for LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Quantizing LLM weights and activations is a standard approach for efficient deployment, but a few extreme outliers can stretch the dynamic range and amplify low-bit quantization errors. Prior transform-based mitigations (e.g., Hadamard rotations) are fixed and data-agnostic, and their optimality for quantization has remained unclear. We derive closed-form optimal linear blockwise transforms for joint weight-activation quantization under standard RTN AbsMax-scaled block quantizers, covering both integer and floating-point formats. The resulting construction, WUSH, combines a Hadamard backbone with a data-dependent second-moment component to form a non-orthogonal transform that is provably near-optimal for FP and INT quantizers under mild assumptions while admitting an efficient fused GPU implementation. Empirically, WUSH improves W4A4 accuracy over the strongest Hadamard-based baselines (e.g., on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in MXFP4, it gains +2.8 average points with RTN and +0.7 with GPTQ) while delivering up to 5.8$\times$ per-layer throughput over BF16 via FP4 MatMul. Source code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/WUSH.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026): https://openreview.net/forum?id=ZsECxUkbKB
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推导了用于联合权重量化和激活量化的闭式最优线性块变换，提出了WUSH方法，它结合哈达玛主干与数据依赖的二阶矩分量，形成非正交变换，在标准RTN AbsMax缩放块量化器下对FP和INT量化器具有近最优性。实验表明，WUSH在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上相比于最强的基于哈达玛的基线，在W4A4精度上提升了+2.8平均点（RTN）和+0.7（GPTQ），并通过FP4矩阵乘法实现了高达5.8倍的单层吞吐量提升。
Motivation: 现有基于变换的量化缓解方法（如哈达玛旋转）是固定的且数据无关，其最优性尚不明确，需要一种数据自适应的近最优变换来进一步减少低比特量化误差。
Method: 推导了联合权重量化和激活量化下闭式最优线性块变换，提出WUSH结构，融合哈达玛主干与数据依赖的二阶矩分量，形成非正交变换，并给出了高效的融合GPU实现。
Result: 在W4A4量化下，WUSH在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上相比于最强哈达玛基线，RTN提升+2.8平均点，GPTQ提升+0.7，且通过FP4矩阵乘法实现了高达5.8倍的单层吞吐量提升。

papers.title: Semimage: HSV-Based Semantic Image Encoding for Disentangled Text Representation
papers.abstract_en: We propose SemImage, a novel method for representing a text document as a two-dimensional semantic image to be processed by convolutional neural networks (CNNs). In a SemImage, each word is represented as a pixel in a 2D image: rows correspond to sentences and an additional boundary row is inserted between sentences to mark semantic transitions. Each pixel is not a typical RGB value but a vector in a disentangled HSV color space, encoding different linguistic features: the Hue with two components H_cos and H_sin to account for circularity encodes the topic, Saturation encodes the sentiment, and Value encodes intensity or certainty. We enforce this disentanglement via a multi-task learning framework: a ColorMapper network maps each word embedding to the HSV space, and auxiliary supervision is applied to the Hue and Saturation channels to predict topic and sentiment labels, alongside the main task objective. The insertion of dynamically computed boundary rows between sentences yields sharp visual boundaries in the image when consecutive sentences are semantically dissimilar, effectively making paragraph breaks salient. We integrate SemImage with standard 2D CNNs (e.g., ResNet) for document classification. Experiments on multi-label datasets (with both topic and sentiment annotations) and single-label benchmarks demonstrate that SemImage can achieve competitive or better accuracy than strong text classification baselines (including BERT and hierarchical attention networks) while offering enhanced interpretability. An ablation study confirms the importance of the multi-channel HSV representation and the dynamic boundary rows. Finally, we present visualizations of SemImage that qualitatively reveal clear patterns corresponding to topic shifts and sentiment changes in the generated image, suggesting that our representation makes these linguistic features visible to both humans and machines.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 12th International Conference on Web Research (ICWR), 253-259
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SemImage，一种将文本文档编码为二维语义图像的方法，每个单词用 HSV 颜色空间中的像素表示，分别编码主题（Hue）、情感（Saturation）和强度（Value），并通过多任务学习强制解耦。边界行用于标记句子间的语义转换。使用标准 2D CNN（如 ResNet）进行文档分类，在多标签和单标签基准上取得与 BERT 等基线相当或更好的准确率，并增强可解释性。
Motivation: 现有文本表示方法（如词嵌入）难以直接可视化语义特征，且缺乏对主题、情感等低维因素的明确解耦。
Method: 设计 ColorMapper 网络将词嵌入映射到 HSV 色空间，Hue 用 H_cos 和 H_sin 双分量表示主题，Saturation 表示情感，Value 表示强度；通过多任务学习（辅助预测主题和情感标签）强制解耦；在句子间插入动态计算的边界行以突出语义变化。
Result: 在多标签数据集和单标签基准上，SemImage 与 BERT、层次注意力网络等强基线相比取得竞争性甚至更好的准确率；消融实验验证了多通道 HSV 表示和动态边界行的重要性。
Conclusion: SemImage 通过视觉可解释的图像表示实现文本分类，使得主题转移和情感变化在生成的图像中清晰可见，对人和机器均有帮助。

papers.title: FIRM: Federated In-client Regularized Multi-objective Alignment for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values often involves balancing multiple, conflicting objectives such as helpfulness and harmlessness. Training these models is computationally intensive, and centralizing the process raises significant data privacy concerns. Federated Learning (FL) offers a compelling alternative, but existing Federated Multi-Objective Optimization (FMOO) methods face severe communication bottlenecks as their reliance on transmitting multiple gradients to a server is unscalable for large models. We introduce FIRM (Federated In-client Regularized Multi-objective alignment), a novel algorithm that achieves both client disagreement drift mitigation and communication efficiency. In FIRM, each client locally solves a regularized multi-objective optimization problem. By directly mitigating client disagreement drift through in-client regularization, our method eliminates the need for the multi-gradient transmissions common in prior works. Consequently, clients need only to transmit a single set of adapted parameters, maintaining high communication efficiency. We prove that our algorithm converges to Pareto-stationary points and, to our knowledge, provide the first finite-time convergence guarantees for this federated multi-objective alignment setting. Empirically, we show that FIRM leads to smoother training dynamics, reduced client disagreement drift, and improved reward trade-offs compared to baselines. We further propose a method to incorporate a preference over the objectives and report empirical Pareto plots, demonstrating that FIRM can smoothly adapt trade-offs between objectives in response to specified preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FIRM算法，用于联邦学习环境下的大型语言模型多目标对齐（如帮助性和无害性）。通过客户端内正则化消除多梯度传输需求，只需传输单组参数，显著提升通信效率。理论证明收敛到Pareto平稳点并提供有限时间收敛保证。实验表明训练更平滑、客户端分歧漂移减少、奖励权衡改善。
Motivation: 现有联邦多目标优化方法因传输多个梯度而面临严重通信瓶颈，无法规模化适用于大模型，且客户端分歧漂移问题未解决。
Method: 每个客户端本地求解正则化多目标优化问题，通过客户端内正则化直接缓解分歧漂移，无需多梯度传输，仅需传输单组适应参数。
Result: 理论证明算法收敛到Pareto平稳点，并提供首个有限时间收敛保证；实验显示训练动态更平滑、客户端分歧漂移降低、奖励权衡优于基线。
Conclusion: FIRM在保持高通信效率的同时有效处理多目标对齐，并能通过偏好输入平滑调整目标间的权衡。
