papers.title: Targeted Data Fusion for Region-Specific Survival Effects in the AMP HIV Prevention Trials
papers.abstract_en: The Antibody Mediated Prevention (AMP) trials opened a new scientific frontier by showing that passively administered monoclonal broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) could prevent HIV-1 acquisition. Conducted across multiple geographic regions, including the United States, Brazil, Peru, Switzerland, and sub-Saharan Africa, the AMP trials revealed substantial regional heterogeneity in treatment efficacy. These differences, together with privacy and regulatory limits on central data pooling, call for methods that borrow strength across regions without sharing individual-level data. To estimate region- and treatment-specific survival curves under distributional heterogeneity, we develop a federated learning approach that combines site-specific estimators via an L1-regularized criterion that downweights data sources not aligned with the target. We further extend the framework to a general class of causal contrasts, including the risk difference (RD), survival ratio (SR), and restricted mean survival time (RMST) difference. Through extensive simulations and an analysis of the AMP trials under different target populations, we show that the proposed approach provides privacy-preserving, region-adaptive inference with improved precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AMP HIV预防试验中区域异质性导致的疗效差异，提出一种联邦学习方法，通过L1正则化融合区域特定估计量，在保护隐私的同时提升目标区域生存曲线估计精度。
Motivation: AMP试验显示不同地区治疗疗效存在显著异质性，但由于隐私和监管限制无法集中个体数据，需要方法能在不共享数据的情况下跨区域借用信息。
Method: 提出联邦学习框架，结合L1正则化准则融合各站点估计量，自动下调与目标区域不一致的数据源的权重，并扩展到风险差、生存比和限制平均生存时间差等因果对比。
Result: 仿真和AMP试验分析表明，该方法在保护隐私的同时提供区域自适应推断，且估计精度得到改善。
Conclusion: 该方法为区域异质性下的隐私保护生存分析提供了有效工具，但未提及对非生存终点或非试验数据的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LeARN: Learnable and Adaptive Representations for Nonlinear Dynamics in System Identification
papers.abstract_en: System identification, the process of deriving mathematical models of dynamical systems from observed input-output data, has undergone a paradigm shift with the advent of learning-based methods. Addressing the intricate challenges of data-driven discovery in nonlinear dynamical systems, these methods have garnered significant attention. Among them, Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) has emerged as a transformative approach, distilling complex dynamical behaviors into interpretable linear combinations of basis functions. However, SINDy's reliance on domain-specific expertise to construct its foundational 'library' of basis functions limits its adaptability and universality. In this work, we introduce a nonlinear system identification framework LeARN that transcends the need for prior domain knowledge by learning the library of basis functions directly from data. To enhance adaptability to evolving system dynamics under varying noise conditions, we employ a novel meta-learning-based system identification approach that utilizes a light-weight Deep Neural Network (DNN) to dynamically refine these basis functions. This not only captures intricate system behaviors but also adapts effectively to new dynamical regimes. We validate our framework on the Neural Fly dataset, showcasing its robust adaptation and generalization capabilities. Despite its simplicity, our LeARN achieves competitive dynamical error performance to SINDy. This work presents a step towards autonomous discovery of dynamical systems, paving the way for a future where machine learning uncovers the governing principles of complex systems without requiring extensive domain-specific interventions.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted at the 34th Mediterranean Conference on Control and Automation (MED 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了LeARN框架，一种无需领域先验知识的非线性系统辨识方法，通过元学习动态优化基函数库，在Neural Fly数据集上展示了与SINDy相当的动态误差性能。
Motivation: SINDy方法依赖领域专业知识构建基函数库，限制了其普适性和适应性；本文旨在消除这种依赖，使系统辨识能自动从数据中学习基函数。
Method: 采用元学习策略，使用轻量级深度神经网络动态优化基函数库，以适应不同噪声条件下演变的系统动力学。
Result: 在Neural Fly数据集上，LeARN实现了与SINDy相当的动态误差性能，并展现出良好的鲁棒泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该工作向自主发现动力系统迈进一步，减少了领域专家干预的需求。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Foundation Model for Wearable Movement Data in Mental Health Research
papers.abstract_en: Wearable movement data is collected by nearly all commercially available smartwatches and is a valuable resource for mental health research, reflecting fine-grained temporal behavioral trends. Despite its promise, the development of foundation models for health wearable modeling remains limited when compared to clinical image and text analysis. We designed transformers with patch embeddings and used self-supervised masked autoencoder pretraining on minute-level week-long actigraphy (physical activity intensity measurement) sequences to develop and evaluate the Pretrained Actigraphy Transformer (PAT). PAT is an open-source foundation model for wearable movement time series that combines week-long temporal modeling, psychiatric outcome evaluation, and reproducibility on public data. Pretrained on data from 21,538 U.S. participants in a nationally representative cohort from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), PAT consistently outperformed non-foundation-model baselines across mental health prediction tasks-including benzodiazepine and SSRI use, depression, and sleep abnormalities. During the benzodiazepine medication usage prediction task, PAT demonstrated the largest improvement over non-foundational deep learning models commonly used for time-series modeling (i.e., 55.6% improvement over the LSTM, 21.4% improvement over the 1-D CNN, 14.8% improvement over the ConvLSTM). Beyond predictive accuracy, PAT provides interpretable attention maps highlighting specific periods of daily activity most important for clinical predictions, offering model transparency and potential clinical insights. The results suggest that PAT offers an easy-to-deploy, adaptable and scalable solution to advance clinical insight from wearable sensor data for researchers and clinicians. GitHub: https://github.com/njacobsonlab/Pretrained-Actigraphy-Transformer/
papers.comment: F. Y. Ruan, A. Zhang, J. Y. Oh, S. Jin and N. C. Jacobson, "A Foundation Model for Wearable Movement Data in Mental Health Research," in IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics, doi: 10.1109/JBHI.2026.3694809
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个基于可穿戴加速度计数据的预训练基础模型 PAT (Pretrained Actigraphy Transformer)，用于心理健康研究。该模型采用分块嵌入的 Transformer 架构，通过自监督掩码自编码器在分钟级一周时长的活动强度序列上预训练，并在多个精神健康预测任务（如苯二氮卓类药物使用、SSRI 使用、抑郁和睡眠异常）上优于非基础模型的基线方法。
Motivation: 可穿戴运动数据在心理健康研究中具有潜力，但基础模型在健康可穿戴数据领域的开发落后于临床图像和文本分析。现有方法缺乏针对长时间序列的精神健康预测能力。
Method: 设计带有分块嵌入的 Transformer，采用自监督掩码自编码器（masked autoencoder）预训练方式，在分钟级一周时长的活动强度（actigraphy）序列上进行训练。
Result: 在来自 21,538 名美国参与者的 NHANES 数据集上预训练后，PAT 在苯二氮卓类药物使用预测任务中相比 LSTM 提升 55.6%，相比 1D-CNN 提升 21.4%，相比 ConvLSTM 提升 14.8%，并在其他心理健康预测任务中一致优于非基础模型基线。
Conclusion: PAT 提供了一个易于部署、可适应且可扩展的基础模型，能够从可穿戴传感器数据中获取临床洞察，同时通过注意力图提供可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Domain Adaptation with a Single Vision-Language Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Domain adaptation has been extensively investigated in computer vision but still requires access to target data at the training time, which might be difficult to obtain in real-world autonomous driving scenarios, especially under rare or adverse conditions. In this paper, we present a new framework for domain adaptation relying on a single Vision-Language (VL) latent embedding instead of full target data. First, leveraging a contrastive language-image pre-training model (CLIP), we propose prompt/photo-driven instance normalization (PIN). PIN is a feature augmentation method that mines multiple visual styles using a single target VL latent embedding, by optimizing affine transformations of low-level source features. The VL embedding can come from a language prompt describing the target domain, a partially optimized language prompt, or a single unlabeled target image. Second, we show that these mined styles (i.e., augmentations) can be used for zero-shot (i.e., target-free) and one-shot unsupervised domain adaptation. Experiments on semantic segmentation in real-world driving datasets, including Cityscapes and ACDC (adverse conditions), demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, which outperforms relevant baselines in the practical zero-shot and one-shot settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于单视觉-语言（VL）潜在嵌入的域自适应框架，利用CLIP模型实现提示/照片驱动的实例归一化（PIN），通过优化源低层特征的仿射变换挖掘多种视觉风格，从而实现零样本和单样本无监督域自适应。在真实驾驶数据集（Cityscapes和ACDC）上的语义分割实验验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 传统域自适应需要训练时访问目标数据，在自动驾驶等真实场景中难以获得（尤其是在罕见或恶劣条件下）。本文旨在仅利用一个目标VL嵌入（来自语言提示、部分优化的语言提示或单张无标签目标图像）实现有效的域自适应。
Method: 提出提示/照片驱动的实例归一化（PIN），利用对比语言-图像预训练模型（CLIP）对单个目标VL潜在嵌入进行优化，通过仿射变换调整源图像的低层特征，从而生成多种视觉风格（数据增强），用于零样本和单样本无监督域自适应。
Result: 在Cityscapes和ACDC（恶劣条件）等真实驾驶数据集上的语义分割任务中，所提方法在零样本和单样本设置下优于相关基线。
Conclusion: 仅依赖单个VL嵌入即可实现有效的域自适应，为实际应用提供了灵活且实用的解决方案，尤其在目标数据难以获取的场景下。

papers.title: Stop Wandering, Find the Keys: LLMs Discriminate Key States for Efficient Multi-Agent Exploration
papers.abstract_en: With expansive state-action spaces, efficient multi-agent exploration remains a longstanding challenge in reinforcement learning. Although pursuing novelty, diversity, or uncertainty attracts increasing attention, redundant efforts brought by exploration without proper guidance choices poses a practical issue for the community. This paper introduces a systematic approach, termed LEMAE, choosing to channel informative task-relevant guidance from a knowledgeable Large Language Model (LLM) for Efficient Multi-Agent Exploration. Specifically, we ground linguistic knowledge from LLM into symbolic key states, that are critical for task fulfillment, in a discriminative manner at low LLM inference costs. To unleash the power of key states, we design Subspace-based Hindsight Intrinsic Reward (SHIR) to guide agents toward key states by increasing reward density. Additionally, we build the Key State Memory Tree (KSMT) to track transitions between key states in a specific task for organized exploration. Benefiting from diminishing redundant explorations, LEMAE outperforms existing SOTA approaches on the challenging benchmarks (e.g., SMAC and MPE) by a large margin, achieving a 10x acceleration in certain scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: SCIENCE CHINA Information Sciences 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LEMAE方法，利用大型语言模型（LLM）为多智能体强化学习提供任务相关的关键状态引导，减少无效探索，并通过子空间后验内在奖励（SHIR）和关键状态记忆树（KSMT）实现高效探索。在SMAC和MPE等基准上，LEMAE显著优于现有方法，某些场景加速10倍。
Motivation: 多智能体探索面临状态-动作空间巨大且缺乏有效引导的问题，现有基于新颖性、多样性或不确定性的方法仍存在大量冗余探索。
Method: 从LLM中提取语言知识，以低推理成本判别性地将抽象语言知识转化为符号化的关键状态；设计子空间后验内在奖励（SHIR）引导智能体趋向关键状态；构建关键状态记忆树（KSMT）跟踪任务中关键状态之间的转换。
Result: 在SMAC和MPE等挑战性基准上，LEMAE大幅超越现有最优方法，在特定场景中实现10倍加速。
Conclusion: 通过LLM提供任务相关引导并系统化利用关键状态，可显著提升多智能体探索效率，减少冗余探索。

papers.title: MCPDepth: Omnidirectional Depth Estimation via Stereo Matching from Multi-Cylindrical Panoramas
papers.abstract_en: Omnidirectional depth estimation presents a significant challenge due to the inherent distortions in panoramic images. Despite notable advancements, the impact of projection methods remains underexplored. We introduce Multi-Cylindrical Panoramic Depth Estimation (MCPDepth), a novel two-stage framework designed to enhance omnidirectional depth estimation through stereo matching across multiple cylindrical panoramas. MCPDepth initially performs stereo matching using cylindrical panoramas, followed by a robust fusion of the resulting depth maps from different views. Unlike existing methods that rely on customized kernels to address distortions, MCPDepth utilizes standard network components, facilitating seamless deployment on embedded devices while delivering exceptional performance. To effectively address vertical distortions in cylindrical panoramas, MCPDepth incorporates a circular attention module, significantly expanding the receptive field beyond traditional convolutions. We provide a comprehensive theoretical and experimental analysis of common panoramic projections-spherical, cylindrical, and cubic-demonstrating the superior efficacy of cylindrical projection. Our method improves the mean absolute error (MAE) by 18.8% on the outdoor dataset Deep360 and by 19.9% on the real dataset 3D60. This work offers practical insights for other tasks and real-world applications, establishing a new paradigm in omnidirectional depth estimation. The code is available at https://github.com/Qjizhi/MCPDepth.
papers.comment: Accepted at the OmniCV Workshop, CVPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多圆柱全景深度估计框架 MCPDepth，通过立体匹配和深度图融合提升全景深度估计精度。该方法使用标准网络组件和循环注意力模块处理垂直畸变，在 Deep360 和 3D60 数据集上分别改善 MAE 18.8% 和 19.9%，并理论分析了圆柱投影的优越性。
Motivation: 全景深度估计受图像畸变影响大，现有方法依赖定制卷积核，且投影方式的影响未被充分研究。
Method: 两阶段框架：先对圆柱全景进行立体匹配，再融合多视角深度图；引入循环注意力模块扩展感受野，无需定制卷积核。
Result: 在室外数据集 Deep360 上 MAE 降低 18.8%，在真实数据集 3D60 上降低 19.9%。
Conclusion: 圆柱投影比球面、立方体投影更有效，该范式可推广至其他全景任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DAG-Plan: Generating Directed Acyclic Dependency Graphs for Dual-Arm Cooperative Planning
papers.abstract_en: Dual-arm robots promise greater efficiency but require planning for complex tasks with nonlinear sub-task dependencies. Current methods using Large Language Models (LLMs) suffer from a fundamental trade-off: generating linear sequences is efficient but fails to model parallelism and adapt to changes, while iterative querying is adaptive but too slow and costly. To bridge this gap, we introduce DAG-Plan, a novel task planning framework that for the first time employs a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) as the central representation for dual-arm coordination. The key insight is that a DAG natively captures complex sub-task dependencies and explicitly reveals opportunities for parallel execution. Within this framework, an LLM is used only once as a powerful semantic parser to translate a natural language instruction into a structured DAG. During execution, our system dynamically assigns candidate nodes to the suitable arm based on real-time environmental observations, enabling truly adaptive and parallel operation. Extensive evaluation on a dual-arm kitchen benchmark shows that DAG-Plan's structured approach fundamentally outperforms existing paradigms. It achieves a 48% higher success rate than single-query linear sequence methods with dual arm by robustly managing dependencies, and an 84.1% higher execution efficiency than iterative querying methods by eliminating the latency of repeated LLM calls. Our work demonstrates that a principled, graph-based representation is the key to unlocking efficient and reliable LLM-based planning for complex robotic systems. More demos and code are available on https://sites.google.com/view/dag-plan.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAG-Plan 框架，首次将有向无环图（DAG）作为双机械臂协调规划的核心表示。仅用大语言模型（LLM）一次性将自然语言指令解析为结构化 DAG，执行时根据实时环境观测动态分配节点给合适的手臂，从而实现自适应并行操作。在双机械臂厨房基准上，该方法成功率比单次查询线性序列方法高 48%，执行效率比迭代查询方法高 84.1%。
Motivation: 双机械臂任务具有非线性子任务依赖关系，现有基于 LLM 的方法存在根本性权衡：线性序列生成效率高但无法建模并行性和适应变化，而迭代查询适应性强但速度慢、成本高。
Method: DAG-Plan 以 DAG 作为中央表示，LLM 仅作为一次语义解析器将自然语言指令转换为结构化 DAG；执行时根据实时环境观测动态将候选节点分配给合适的机械臂。
Result: 在双机械臂厨房基准上，DAG-Plan 的成功率比单次查询线性序列方法高 48%，执行效率比迭代查询方法高 84.1%。
Conclusion: 基于图的结构化表示是解锁复杂机器人系统中高效可靠 LLM 规划的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Synthesizing Neural Network Controllers with Closed-Loop Dissipativity Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a method to synthesize neural network controllers to maximize reward subject to the hard constraint that the feedback system of plant and controller be dissipative, certifying requirements such as stability and $L_2$ gain bounds. It considers nonlinear and uncertain plants, modeled as the interconnection of a linear time-invariant (LTI) system and an uncertainty block, which incorporates nonlinearities. The uncertainty of the plant and the activation functions of the neural network are both described using integral quadratic constraints (IQCs). First, a dissipativity condition is derived for uncertain LTI systems. Second, this condition is used to construct a linear matrix inequality (LMI) which can be used to synthesize neural network controllers. Finally, this convex condition is used in a projection-based training method to synthesize neural network controllers with dissipativity guarantees. Numerical examples on an inverted pendulum and a flexible rod on a cart are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.
papers.comment: Accepted to the journal Automatica, 17 pages, 9 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种合成神经网络控制器的方法，在满足闭环耗散性（如稳定性和$L_2$增益界）的硬约束下最大化奖励。该方法针对非线性和不确定被控对象，将其建模为线性时不变系统与不确定性模块的互联，并利用积分二次约束（IQC）描述不确定性和激活函数。首先推导不确定LTI系统的耗散性条件，然后构造线性矩阵不等式（LMI）用于合成控制器，最后采用基于投影的训练方法保证耗散性。倒立摆和柔性杆小车上的数值示例验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有神经网络控制器设计常忽视稳定性、鲁棒性等硬约束，而传统控制方法难以处理复杂非线性。本文旨在为非线性不确定系统提供一种可保证耗散性的神经网络控制器综合框架。
Method: 基于积分二次约束（IQC）描述被控对象不确定性和神经网络激活函数，推导耗散性条件并转化为线性矩阵不等式（LMI），再将其作为投影约束嵌入神经网络训练过程，实现奖励最大化和约束满足的联合优化。
Result: 在倒立摆和柔性杆小车两个数值示例中，所提方法成功合成满足耗散性约束的神经网络控制器，验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: 本文提供的合成方法为神经网络控制器提供闭环耗散性保证，适用于非线性不确定系统，但示例规模较小，实际复杂系统的适用性有待进一步验证。

papers.title: Perturbation Effects on Accuracy and Fairness among Similar Individuals
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial perturbations that can simultaneously degrade prediction robustness and individual fairness across diverse application settings. However, existing evaluation protocols typically assess these dimensions in isolation, thereby obscuring critical failure modes. To bridge this gap, we formalize Robust Individual Fairness (RIF): under semantic-preserving (truth-condition-preserving) perturbations, predictions should remain both correct with respect to the ground truth and invariant across semantically equivalent individuals. To surface RIF violations in practice, we introduce RIFair, a black-box adversarial framework that leverages a decoupled perturbation strategy to construct semantically preserved yet unrobust and/or unfair instance pairs. Experiments across multiple model architectures and real-world textual datasets show that robustness-only or fairness-only metrics often miss Robust Biased and Unrobust Fair behaviors. RIFair}reliably exposes these hidden vulnerabilities, supporting RIF as a necessary criterion for trustworthy model assessment. The experimental code is publicly available at https://github.com/Xuran-LI/RIFair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了鲁棒个体公平性（RIF），即在语义保持扰动下，预测应同时保持正确性且对语义等价个体不变。提出黑盒对抗框架RIFair，通过解耦扰动策略构造语义保持但不鲁棒/不公平的实例对，在文本数据集上揭示仅考虑鲁棒性或公平性指标会遗漏的隐藏漏洞。
Motivation: 现有评估协议通常独立评估鲁棒性和个体公平性，忽略了二者耦合时的关键失效模式。
Method: 形式化RIF条件，并设计RIFair框架，采用解耦扰动策略生成语义保持的对抗实例对，以检测鲁棒性-公平性联合失效。
Result: 在多种模型架构和真实文本数据集上，仅鲁棒性或仅公平性指标常遗漏鲁棒偏差（Robust Biased）和非鲁棒公平（Unrobust Fair）行为，RIFair能可靠暴露这些隐藏漏洞。
Conclusion: RIF是可信模型评估的必要准则，RIFair可作为实用性工具。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文形式化定义了鲁棒个体公平性（RIF），即在语义保持扰动下，预测应同时保持正确性且对语义等价个体不变。提出黑盒对抗框架RIFair，通过解耦扰动策略构造语义保持但不鲁棒/不公平的实例对，在文本数据集上揭示仅考虑鲁棒性或公平性指标会遗漏的隐藏漏洞。

summary_sections.method: 形式化RIF条件，并设计RIFair框架，采用解耦扰动策略生成语义保持的对抗实例对，以检测鲁棒性-公平性联合失效。
summary_sections.result: 在多种模型架构和真实文本数据集上，仅鲁棒性或仅公平性指标常遗漏鲁棒偏差（Robust Biased）和非鲁棒公平（Unrobust Fair）行为，RIFair能可靠暴露这些隐藏漏洞。
summary_sections.conclusion: RIF是可信模型评估的必要准则，RIFair可作为实用性工具。

papers.title: Discovering Nonlinear Static Relationships in Unlabeled Dataset using Autoencoder with Ordered Variance
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an autoencoder with ordered variance (AEO), in which the conventional reconstruction loss is augmented by a variance-based regularization term that promotes an ordered structure within the latent space. In this structure, the latent variables are ordered by their variance computed over the training data, facilitating systematic determination of the latent space dimensionality. The AEO is further extended using residual networks, resulting in a ResNet-based AEO (RAEO). Both AEO and RAEO green lead to discovery of nonlinear relationships among variables in unlabeled datasets, thereby enabling unsupervised static model extraction. Theoretical contributions include formal guarantees on the ordering of latent variances. The practical utility of the framework is demonstrated through its application to the identification of nonlinear steady-state models and their use in real-time optimization, with a continuous stirred tank reactor process serving as a representative case study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出带有序方差的自编码器（AEO），通过方差正则化使潜在变量按方差排序，从而自动确定潜在空间维度，并利用残差网络扩展为RAEO。该方法可从无标签数据中发现变量间的非线性静态关系，实现无监督静态模型提取。理论贡献包括潜在方差排序的形式化保证，实际应用展示了在连续搅拌釜反应器（CSTR）过程稳态模型识别及实时优化中的有效性。
Motivation: 无标签数据中变量间非线性静态关系的自动发现方法缺乏，且现有自编码器难以自动确定潜在空间维度。
Method: 在自编码器重构损失基础上增加基于方差的正则化项，强制潜在变量按训练数据方差排序，并利用残差网络扩展模型。
Result: 通过CSTR案例展示了该方法能有效识别非线性稳态模型并用于实时优化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在无监督静态模型提取中的实用性和理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Counterfactual Intervention Feature Transfer for Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based models have achieved great success in person re-identification tasks recently, which compute the graph topology structure (affinities) among different people first and then pass the information across them to achieve stronger features. But we find existing graph-based methods in the visible-infrared person re-identification task (VI-ReID) suffer from bad generalization because of two issues: 1) train-test modality balance gap, which is a property of VI-ReID task. The number of two modalities data are balanced in the training stage, but extremely unbalanced in inference, causing the low generalization of graph-based VI-ReID methods. 2) sub-optimal topology structure caused by the end-to-end learning manner to the graph module. We analyze that the well-trained input features weaken the learning of graph topology, making it not generalized enough during the inference process. In this paper, we propose a Counterfactual Intervention Feature Transfer (CIFT) method to tackle these problems. Specifically, a Homogeneous and Heterogeneous Feature Transfer (H2FT) is designed to reduce the train-test modality balance gap by two independent types of well-designed graph modules and an unbalanced scenario simulation. Besides, a Counterfactual Relation Intervention (CRI) is proposed to utilize the counterfactual intervention and causal effect tools to highlight the role of topology structure in the whole training process, which makes the graph topology structure more reliable. Extensive experiments on standard VI-ReID benchmarks demonstrate that CIFT outperforms the state-of-the-art methods under various settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可见光-红外行人重识别（VI-ReID）中图基模型泛化能力差的问题，提出反事实干预特征迁移方法（CIFT）。具体而言，均匀/异质特征迁移（H2FT）通过两种独立图模块和不平衡场景模拟缩小训练-测试模态平衡差距；反事实关系干预（CRI）利用反事实干预和因果效应工具突出图拓扑结构的作用。摘要称在标准VI-ReID基准上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 图基方法在VI-ReID任务中泛化差，原因有二：训练时双模态数据平衡但推理时失衡，以及端到端学习导致输入特征弱化了图拓扑的学习，使拓扑结构不够通用。
Method: 提出CIFT方法，包含两个组件：1）H2FT，使用两类独立图模块和不平衡场景模拟来减少模态平衡差距；2）CRI，通过反事实干预和因果效应工具强化图拓扑结构在训练中的作用。
Result: 在标准VI-ReID基准上，CIFT在各种设置下均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明反事实干预和特征迁移可有效提升图基VI-ReID的泛化能力，但未讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rule Extraction in Machine Learning: Chat Incremental Pattern Constructor
papers.abstract_en: Rule extraction is a central problem in interpretable machine learning because it seeks to convert opaque predictive behavior into human-readable symbolic structure. This paper presents Chat Incremental Pattern Constructor (ChatIPC), a lightweight incremental symbolic learning system that extracts ordered token-transition rules from text, enriches them with definition-based expansion, and constructs responses by similarity-guided candidate selection. The system may be viewed as a rule extractor operating over a token graph rather than a conventional classifier. I formalize the knowledge base, definition expansion, candidate scoring, repetition control, English-rule heuristics, and response construction mechanisms used by ChatIPC. I further situate the method within the literature on rule extraction, decision tree induction, association rules, interpretable machine learning, and sequence construction. The updated implementation is also reviewed in detail: it parses an embedded dictionary, normalizes lexical keys, caches definition tokens and part-of-speech tags, computes Jaccard scores on bitsets, applies heuristic linguistic bonuses, and persists the knowledge base with a versioned binary format. The paper emphasizes mathematical formulation and algorithmic clarity, and it provides pseudocode for the learning, scoring, and construction algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chat Incremental Pattern Constructor (ChatIPC)，一种轻量级的增量符号学习系统，从文本中提取有序的 token 转移规则，通过基于定义的扩展和相似度引导的候选选择来构建响应。系统被视为在 token 图上操作的规则提取器，而非传统分类器。论文形式化定义了知识库、定义扩展、候选评分、重复控制、英语规则启发式以及响应构建机制，并提供了伪代码。
Motivation: 规则提取是可解释机器学习中的核心问题，旨在将黑箱预测行为转化为人类可读的符号结构，但现有方法在增量学习和轻量级实现上仍有不足。
Method: ChatIPC 使用增量方式从文本中提取有序 token 转移规则，通过嵌入字典进行定义扩展，利用 Jaccard 相似度在 bitset 上计算候选得分，并结合启发式语言奖励和重复控制来构建响应。系统采用版本化的二进制格式持久化知识库。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的实验结果或数值指标，仅描述了系统的架构和算法细节。
Conclusion: ChatIPC 为规则提取提供了一种轻量级、可增量的符号学习方法，强调数学形式化和算法清晰度，但缺乏实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ego-METAS: Egocentric online Multimodal Energy-efficient Temporal Action Segmentation benchmark
papers.abstract_en: To operate in the physical world, embodied agents must perceive their environment in an "always-on" fashion, selectively accessing the most informative sensors to balance energy constraints and task accuracy. Despite its importance for resource-constrained devices, energy-aware perception remains under-explored, with most prior work assuming unlimited compute. To address this, we introduce Ego-METAS: the first Egocentric online Multimodal Energy-efficient Temporal Action Segmentation benchmark. Ego-METAS provides a unified testbed of more than 100 hours of untrimmed egocentric video from EgoExo4D, CMU-MMAC, and CaptainCook4D, spanning 5 modalities (RGB, audio, gaze, IMU, and monochrome camera). We formulate an online temporal action segmentation task where models must dynamically select which sensors to activate at each timestep while strictly adhering to hardware-representative energy budgets. Alongside the benchmark, we release unified splits, cleaned annotations, pre-extracted features, and a diverse suite of baseline routing policies. Our evaluations show that optimal routing is highly scenario-dependent, and that existing policy-learning methods, designed primarily for trimmed clips, struggle to adapt to continuous, untrimmed environments. However, even simple dynamic fusion of complementary modalities (e.g., via random routing) proves critical for balancing predictive accuracy against strict energy budgets. Ultimately, Ego-METAS provides a standardized foundation to develop robust, cost-aware policies for autonomous, always-on embodied AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Ego-METAS，首个面向自主体在线多模态能效时间动作分割的基准，包含100小时以上未裁剪第一人称视频，涵盖RGB、音频、凝视、IMU和单色相机5种模态。基准定义在线时间动作分割任务，要求模型动态选择传感器以遵守硬件能量预算。评估显示最优路由高度依赖场景，现有策略学习方法难以适应连续未裁剪环境，但动态融合互补模态对平衡精度和能量预算至关重要。
Motivation: 现有工作假设无限计算资源，忽视了能源感知对于资源受限设备的重要性，因此需要标准化基准以开发能耗感知策略。
Method: 提出Ego-METAS基准，包含从EgoExo4D、CMU-MMAC和CaptainCook4D收集的超过100小时未裁剪第一人称视频，提供5种模态。定义在线时间动作分割任务，要求模型动态选择传感器并遵守硬件能量预算。提供统一分割、清理标注、预提取特征和基线路由策略。
Result: 评估显示最优路由高度依赖场景；现有策略学习方法（主要针对修剪片段）难以适应连续未裁剪环境；简单的动态融合（如随机路由）对平衡预测精度和能量预算至关重要。
Conclusion: Ego-METAS为开发自主、始终在线的具身AI的鲁棒、成本感知策略提供了标准化基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weighted Conformal Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Clustering is a central tool for discovering latent structure in unlabeled data; yet modern clustering pipelines often end with a hard assignment of each observation to a cluster without rigorous measures of assignment uncertainty. We propose a novel weighted conformal approach for constructing valid confidence sets for cluster labels. The key difficulty is that the labels available for calibration are not observed ground-truth labels, but synthetic labels produced by a data-dependent clustering algorithm. Our method develops a conformal inference algorithm that corrects the resulting mismatch with the latent target labels through weights by formulating conformal clustering as a conditional label-distribution shift problem. We first derive an oracle procedure that attains finite-sample marginal coverage and then develop a computationally tractable and implementable version using estimated conditional label probabilities and novel augmented calibration. We show that the coverage of the estimated-weight procedure depends on the estimator, giving an explicit bound on the loss relative to the nominal level. Empirical studies demonstrate that the proposed weighted approach offers improvements over the recently proposed split conformal clustering procedure in terms of informative confidence set size, especially in nonlinear and high-dimensional clustering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种加权共形方法（weighted conformal approach）用于构建聚类标签的有效置信集。关键难点在于校准标签并非真实标签，而是数据依赖的聚类算法产生的合成标签。通过将共形聚类建模为条件标签分布偏移问题，该方法利用权重修正偏差，并开发了基于估计条件标签概率和增广校准的计算版本。实验表明，在非线性与高维聚类任务中，所提方法在置信集信息性（大小）上优于近年提出的分裂共形聚类方法。
Motivation: 传统聚类仅给出硬分配，缺乏对不确定性的严格量化。现有共形推断方法无法直接应用于聚类，因为校准所用的标签是数据依赖的合成标签，与真实潜在标签存在分布偏移。
Method: 提出加权共形聚类框架：将聚类标签置信集问题转化为条件标签分布偏移下的共形推断，通过权重校正标签偏差；推导了有限样本边际覆盖的oracle过程，并基于估计的条件标签概率和增广校准开发了可计算版本。
Result: 实验表明，在非线性及高维聚类场景中，所提出的加权方法相比分裂共形聚类（split conformal clustering）能生成更紧凑（信息量更大）的置信集。
Conclusion: 该方法为聚类标签提供有限样本覆盖保证，并给出了估计权重过程相对于名义覆盖水平的损失显式界。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Detect Before You Leap: Mirage Detection in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can produce confident visual answers even when the required visual evidence is missing, blank, or unrelated to the question. This failure mode, known as mirage (Asadi et al. 2026), is especially concerning in medical and document visual question answering, where plausible but visually ungrounded responses may be mistaken for image-based evidence. We study pre-release mirage detection: given an image-question pair, the goal is to determine whether a VLM should answer or abstain before producing a response. We propose Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment (TC-LIA), a model-agnostic method that probes patch-token representations across the layers of a CLIP ViT-H/14 vision encoder. TC-LIA projects layer-wise image patch tokens into the final CLIP embedding space and measures their similarity to the question embedding, allowing the method to track whether question-relevant visual evidence emerges across vision layers. The resulting alignment trajectory is summarized using final image-text cosine similarity, late-layer top-k patch-text alignment, early-to-late gain, and layer-wise slope. These features are combined with pixel-statistic blank/noise detection, zero-shot domain routing, and structured VLM self-assessment in an ensemble. Across five VQA domains, three input conditions, and twelve VLM backbones, the best systems achieve approximately 94.6-94.7% three-class detection accuracy with mirage rates below 3%, while baseline mirage rates range from 21.7% to 66.6%.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Grounded Decoding: Retrieval-Anchored Probability Fusion for Faithful RAG
papers.abstract_en: As retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems scale, it becomes increasingly challenging to ensure faithful grounding in external evidence. Large language models may still prioritize parametric knowledge over retrieved information when conflicts arise. We propose a novel training-free decoding framework, \emph{Grounded Decoding}, designed to improve factual consistency in RAG without modifying model parameters. Unlike standard approaches that rely on a single conditional distribution, our method constructs two matched-prompt distributions at every generation step: (1) a full RAG distribution conditioned on the query, retrieved documents, and generated prefix, and (2) a retrieval-only distribution conditioned solely on retrieved evidence and the same prefix. The final next-token distribution is derived as the unique solution to a KL-barycenter objective over the probability simplex, yielding a normalized geometric fusion of the two distributions.This formulation naturally recovers standard RAG when the grounding weight is zero and smoothly shifts probability mass toward retrieved evidence as grounding strength increases. We further introduce a conflict-aware adaptive weighting scheme that dynamically adjusts grounding based on distributional disagreement and retriever confidence. Experiments on ALCE, Natural Questions, and FActScore demonstrate consistent improvements in factual accuracy and citation quality over standard RAG and competitive decoding-time baselines, while maintaining fluency. Our results indicate that probability-level fusion provides a strong and efficient alternative to logit-level intervention methods for faithful RAG decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的RAG解码框架Grounded Decoding，通过在每个生成步骤构造完整RAG分布和仅检索分布，并求解KL-barycenter目标进行概率融合，动态调整对检索证据的依赖。实验表明该方法在ALCE、Natural Questions、FActScore等基准上提升了事实准确性和引用质量，同时保持生成流畅性。
Motivation: 标准RAG中，LLM在检索与参数知识冲突时可能优先使用参数知识，导致生成内容不忠实于外部证据。现有解码干预方法多基于logit级别操作，而概率级别融合的潜力尚未充分探索。
Method: 提出Grounded Decoding框架：每步生成时构造两个条件分布——完整RAG分布（查询+检索文档+已生成前缀）和仅检索分布（仅检索文档+相同前缀）；通过KL-barycenter目标在概率单纯形上求解唯一归一化几何融合分布，并引入基于分布分歧和检索器置信度的冲突感知自适应加权方案。
Result: 在ALCE、Natural Questions和FActScore数据集上，该方法比标准RAG和竞争解码基线持续提高了事实准确性和引用质量，同时保持流畅性。
Conclusion: 概率级融合是logit级干预方法的一种强大且高效的替代方案，能够在不修改模型参数的情况下提升RAG解码的忠实性。

papers.title: Variance-sensitive Thompson sampling for generalised linear bandits, revisited
papers.abstract_en: We prove a variance-sensitive regret bound for Thompson sampling in stochastic generalised linear bandits. The argument assumes a warm-up, after which the regret is controlled through using the Gaussian Poincaré inequality. This bypasses the point at which previous optimism-based analyses break down. Removing the warm-up while retaining the same variance-sensitive scaling remains open, and appears nontrivial.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文重新研究广义线性bandit中的Thompson采样，证明了一个方差敏感的遗憾界。证明过程先假设一个预热阶段（warm-up），之后利用Gaussian Poincaré不等式控制遗憾，避开了以往基于乐观方法分析的瓶颈。论文指出在不预热的情况下保持相同的方差敏感标度仍然是一个开放且看似非平凡的问题。
Motivation: 现有针对广义线性bandit的遗憾分析往往依赖于乐观原则，但在某些情况下分析会失效。作者希望为Thompson采样设计一种能自适应方差（variance-sensitive）的遗憾界，以弥补乐观方法的不足。
Method: 采用一个预热阶段，在此之后利用Gaussian Poincaré不等式推导遗憾上界，从而绕开乐观方法中的难点。
Result: 在随机广义线性bandit中，为Thompson采样证明了方差敏感的遗憾界。
Conclusion: 该结果展示了Thompson采样在广义线性bandit中实现方差敏感遗憾的可能性，但预热阶段的必要性仍是一个开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Finer Parameter Steps for Low-Rank PEFT: A Controlled Study with CP Tensor Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adapters are usually compared by sweeping a small set of ranks, but the rank also fixes the resolution of the parameter budget. For a $2048{\times}2048$ OPT attention projection, increasing LoRA by one rank stores $4096$ trainable scalars, leaving large gaps between feasible low-budget adapter sizes. This paper asks whether a tensorized adapter with finer capacity increments changes the observed accuracy--budget trade-off. We instantiate this question with fixed-component canonical polyadic (CP) tensor adapters. Under a $32{\times}64{\times}32{\times}64$ tensorization, one normalized CP component stores $193$ trainable scalars per projection, about $21$ times smaller than one LoRA rank step. We compare CP adapters and LoRA on OPT-1.3B across SST-2, RTE, and BoolQ under matched target modules, training protocol, data caps, and seed schedules. CP trains stably and fills the gaps between LoRA ranks, but the effect is task-dependent: SST-2 reaches an early low-budget plateau, BoolQ benefits from additional CP components before saturating slightly below LoRA, and RTE remains LoRA-favored. Finer parameter steps are therefore useful for diagnosing PEFT budget sensitivity, but they do not by themselves guarantee a better accuracy--budget curve.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on CoLoRAI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低秩PEFT中参数步长的粒度对准确率-预算权衡的影响。通过固定分量CP张量适配器，在OPT-1.3B的SST-2、RTE、BoolQ任务上与LoRA对比，发现CP适配器提供更精细的参数增量（每个CP分量约193个可训练标量，仅为LoRA一步的约1/21），但效果因任务而异：SST-2早熟饱和，BoolQ改善后略低于LoRA，RTE始终偏向LoRA。结论是细粒度步长有助于诊断PEFT预算敏感性，但不能保证更好的准确率-预算曲线。
Motivation: LoRA等低秩适配器的秩决定了参数预算分辨率，对于2048×2048投影，每增加一秩存储4096个标量，导致低预算区间存在大间隙。本文探究具有更精细容量增量的张量化适配器能否改变准确率-预算权衡。
Method: 采用固定分量CP张量适配器，对32×64×32×64张量化后的每个CP分量每投影仅193个可训练标量。在OPT-1.3B上，匹配目标模块、训练协议、数据上限和种子调度，与LoRA进行对比实验。
Result: CP适配器稳定训练并填补LoRA秩之间的间隙，但效果任务依赖：SST-2在低预算时早熟饱和；BoolQ随CP分量增加改善但略低于LoRA；RTE始终更优。细粒度步长未普遍带来更好的准确率-预算曲线。
Conclusion: 本文强调更精细的参数步长对诊断PEFT预算敏感性有用，但本身不能保证更好的准确率-预算权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topology-Aware State Abstraction with Tangle Cores for Markov Decision Processes
papers.abstract_en: State abstraction in reinforcement learning is usually formulated as a partition of states based on reward and transition similarity. This excludes a common structural pattern in navigation, graph, and hierarchical decision problems: interface states such as doors, hubs, and bottlenecks naturally participate in more than one region. We introduce \emph{tangle-core abstraction}, an overlapping state-abstraction framework based on graph tangles of empirical transition graphs. The method constructs abstract states from consistently oriented low-order separations and represents shared interfaces through a membership kernel rather than a hard partition. We give value-preservation guarantees for the induced overlapping abstract MDP under an explicit action-consistency condition, identify an interior-homogeneity/boundary-leakage error decomposition, and prove a quantitative interface-overlap result showing when hard partitions incur an avoidable boundary error. Empirically, tangle-core abstractions achieve favorable compression--return tradeoffs against reward-aware, learned, topological-map, and graph-partitioning baselines across bottlenecked tabular domains, procedurally generated mazes, and MiniGrid representations. We also identify a clear failure regime in which transition topology is uninformative, where tangles predictably offer little benefit. These results position graph tangles as an effective topology-aware abstraction prior for decision problems with shared interface structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出了一种基于图缠结（graph tangles）的重叠状态抽象框架，用于马尔可夫决策过程。该方法从经验转移图中提取一致定向的低阶分离来构造抽象状态，并通过成员核（membership kernel）而非硬分区表示共享接口。在瓶颈型表格域、程序化生成迷宫和MiniGrid基准上，该方法在压缩-回报权衡上优于奖励感知、学习、拓扑地图和图分区等基线。
Motivation: 现有强化学习中的状态抽象通常基于奖励和转移相似性进行状态硬分区，忽略了导航、图、层次决策问题中常见的接口状态（如门、枢纽、瓶颈）自然参与多个区域的结构模式。
Method: 引入缠结-核心抽象（tangle-core abstraction），一种基于经验转移图的图缠结的重叠状态抽象框架，通过一致定向的低阶分离构造抽象状态，并使用成员核表示共享接口，避免硬分区。
Result: 在瓶颈型表格域、程序化生成迷宫和MiniGrid表示中，缠结-核心抽象在压缩-回报权衡上优于多个基线，并识别了转移拓扑无信息时的失败模式。
Conclusion: 图缠结可作为具有共享接口结构的决策问题的有效拓扑感知抽象先验，但过渡拓扑无信息时效果有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Canonicalized Stable-List Replay for Private Federated Continual Learning over Language-Model Embeddings
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: Federated continual learning (FCL) lets distributed clients adapt language-model heads to evolving NLP tasks without sharing raw text. Under user-level differential privacy (DP), replay-based continual learning faces a structural obstacle: clients can release only small noisy lists of candidate replay summaries, and those lists are unordered across clients. We introduce Canonicalized Stable-List Replay (CSLR), where clients privately produce candidate replay distributions over a shared sentence-embedding space and the server aligns them using signatures induced by public anchor sentences. The anchors provide identifiability for aggregation rather than additional replay data. We prove that, under an observable anchor-signature margin, $O(\log(N/η)/p)$ anchors distinguish $N$ candidate list elements with probability at least $1-η$, and we give a scoped anchorless non-identifiability result for unordered-label oracle models. Across five seeds on continual classification, NER, and dialogue benchmarks, CSLR improves the final average task metric by 3.9--5.6 points over the strongest non-CSLR DP baseline at $\eps=4$ under the reported replay-release budget, while also outperforming Hungarian and optimal-transport matchers. The formal privacy guarantee covers replay release; end-to-end private training additionally requires composition with a private optimizer for task-head updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对联邦持续学习（FCL）中用户级差分隐私（DP）下基于回放（replay）的持续学习面临的结构障碍——客户端只能发布小型带噪的候选回放摘要列表且这些列表在客户端间无序，提出规范化稳定列表回放（CSLR）。CSLR让客户端在共享句子嵌入空间上私有地生成候选回放分布，服务器利用公共锚句（anchor sentences）诱导的签名来对齐这些分布。理论证明在可观测的锚签名间隔下，O(log(N/η)/p)个锚能以至少1-η的概率区分N个候选列表元素。在连续分类、NER和对话基准上，CSLR在ε=4的隐私预算下比最强非CSLR DP基线提升3.9-5.6个点的最终平均任务指标。
Motivation: 用户级差分隐私下，基于回放的持续学习中客户端只能发布小型带噪的候选回放摘要列表，且这些列表在不同客户端间是无序的，导致服务器无法直接聚合有效的回放信息，成为联邦持续学习的结构性障碍。
Method: 提出Canonicalized Stable-List Replay (CSLR)，客户端在共享句子嵌入空间上私有地生成候选回放分布，服务器使用公共锚句（anchor sentences）诱导的签名来对齐客户端分布，锚点仅提供可识别性用于聚合而不作为额外回放数据。
Result: 在五个随机种子下的连续分类、NER和对话基准上，CSLR在ε=4的隐私预算下最终平均任务指标比最强非CSLR DP基线提升3.9-5.6个百分点，并优于匈牙利匹配和最优传输匹配器。
Conclusion: 论文的正式隐私保证覆盖回放发布；端到端私密训练还需要结合任务头更新的私有优化器。

papers.title: Empirical Likelihood with Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Moment conditions are widely used to identify parameters in models where the full likelihood is either unknown or intentionally left unspecified. Empirical likelihood methods address this problem by assigning probability weights to the observed data so that the sample moment conditions hold exactly. Building on this idea, we propose a nonparametric Bayesian framework based on exponentially tilted empirical likelihood. This Bayesian formulation is particularly appealing in settings where prior information is more naturally specified on the observables rather than on the underlying parameters. Such settings arise in the presence of auxiliary data sources or synthetic data generated by modern generative AI models.Inference proceeds by projecting posterior draws from a Dirichlet process onto the moment-restricted model, yielding a computationally efficient procedure that is naturally amenable to parallelization. We establish new Bernstein--von Mises and consistency theorems for the resulting projection posterior under both vanishing-prior and persistent-prior regimes. In an application to return prediction using overnight news headlines, we show that AI-generated auxiliary data can provide a useful source of indirect regularization when informative priors on the parameter itself are unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于指数倾斜经验似然的非参数贝叶斯框架，用于在矩约束条件下进行推断。该方法通过将狄利克雷过程的后验分布投影到矩约束模型上实现高效并行计算，并建立了在消失先验和持久先验下的 Bernstein–von Mises 定理和一致性定理。在隔夜新闻标题预测收益的应用中，展示了生成式AI生成的辅助数据可作为间接正则化来源。
Motivation: 当完整似然未知或未指定时，矩约束常用于参数识别。传统经验似然方法通过对观测数据分配概率权重来满足样本矩条件，但缺乏贝叶斯先验的灵活性，特别是在可观测变量上指定先验信息更自然的场景（如存在辅助数据或生成式AI合成数据）。
Method: 提出基于指数倾斜经验似然的非参数贝叶斯框架，将狄利克雷过程的后验分布投影到矩约束模型上，得到可并行计算的高效推断程序。
Result: 建立了投影后验的 Bernstein–von Mises 定理和一致性定理（包括消失先验和持久先验两种情形）。在收益预测应用中，利用AI生成的新闻标题辅助数据，展示了间接正则化效果。
Conclusion: 生成式AI生成的辅助数据可在缺乏参数先验信息时提供有用的间接正则化，所提框架适用于可观测变量先验更自然设定的场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Weak Critics Make Strong Learners: On-Policy Critique Distillation for Scalable Oversight
papers.abstract_en: As large language models become stronger, weak supervisors may fail to provide reliable labels, preferences, or final judgments for complex outputs, limiting both weak-to-strong generalization and scalable oversight. We study a more tractable form of weak supervision: using a weak model as a critic rather than as a labeler or judge. Instead of solving the task or selecting the correct answer, the weak critic only needs to provide a non-misleading revision direction that helps the strong model better use its own knowledge. We call this setting *weak-critic strong oversight*. We first show that weak critiques can improve frozen strong models at inference time, and that critique quality is key to this improvement. We then propose progressive on-policy critique distillation (**OPCD**), which filters high-quality critiques and distills critic-guided behavior into the strong model through adaptive self-teacher signals. Experiments on reasoning and alignment benchmarks show that our method improves strong models over training epochs, suggesting an effective path for scalable oversight with weak supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究弱监督在可扩展监督中的应用，提出使用弱模型作为批评者（critic）而非标注者或裁判。弱批评者只需提供非误导性的修正方向，帮助强模型更好地运用自身知识。作者进一步提出渐进式在线批评蒸馏（OPCD），通过过滤高质量批评并利用自适应自教师信号将批评引导的行为蒸馏进强模型。实验表明该方法在推理和对齐基准上能持续提升强模型性能。
Motivation: 强模型变得越来越强大，弱监督者可能无法提供可靠的标签、偏好或最终判断，限制了弱到强泛化和可扩展监督。本文探索一种更易处理的弱监督形式——使用弱模型作为批评者，降低弱监督的难度。
Method: 提出渐进式在线批评蒸馏（On-Policy Critique Distillation, OPCD）。该方法先过滤高质量批评，然后通过自适应自教师信号将批评引导的行为蒸馏进强模型，使强模型在训练过程中逐步吸收弱批评者的有益指导。
Result: 在推理和对其基准上的实验表明，该方法能随着训练轮次持续提升强模型性能。
Conclusion: 弱批评者可通过提供修正方向有效监督强模型，OPCD提供了一条利用弱监督实现可扩展监督的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniPinRec: Unifying Generative Retrieval and Ranking at Pinterest Scale
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommendation systems predominantly train retrieval and ranking as separate models despite both increasingly relying on large transformers encoding the same user behavior data, duplicating parameters, compute, and serving cost. Prior work unifies the model architecture but not the full pipeline: input formats, training procedures, and serving stacks remain fragmented across stages. We present UniPinRec, which achieves full-stack unification of retrieval and ranking at Pinterest: one input format, one model, one training stage, deployed within existing serving infrastructure. A shared transformer encodes the user action sequence into candidate-independent representations that branch into retrieval (ANN dot-product) and ranking (cross-attention) via task-specific heads. Three ideas make this work: (1) Masked Action Modeling (MAM) eliminates interleaving, enabling weight sharing without doubling context length; (2) Blended training examples pair action sequences with feedview impression slates to satisfy both objectives jointly; (3) Cross-stage KV cache sharing reuses user-history computation from retrieval for ranking, reducing total FLOPs versus serving two independent models. Deployed in the Pinterest core surfaces, UniPinRec delivers approximately +1% online engagement lift while cutting end-to-end serving latency by 11.1% and lifting QPS by 63.6%. To our knowledge, this is the first full-stack unification of retrieval and ranking, covering inputs, model, training and serving, deployed in a production recommendation system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniPinRec，在 Pinterest 生产环境中实现了检索和排序的端到端统一：共享一个 Transformer 编码用户行为序列，通过不同头部输出检索和排序结果。关键创新包括掩码动作建模 (MAM)、混合训练样本和跨阶段 KV 缓存共享。在线部署后，带来约 +1% 的互动提升，服务延迟降低 11.1%，QPS 提升 63.6%。这是首次在工业推荐系统中实现检索和排序的全栈统一。
Motivation: 现代推荐系统通常将检索和排序作为独立模型训练，虽都依赖大型 Transformer 编码同一用户行为数据，但导致参数、计算和服务的重复。先前工作仅统一模型架构，而未统一输入格式、训练流程和服务栈。
Method: 提出 UniPinRec，使用共享 Transformer 将用户行为序列编码为候选无关表示，通过任务特定头部分支为检索（ANN 点积）和排序（交叉注意力）。三个关键技术：掩码动作建模 (MAM) 避免交织以共享权重；混合训练样本将动作序列与曝光板结合满足双重目标；跨阶段 KV 缓存共享重用检索的用户历史计算以降低总 FLOPs。
Result: 在 Pinterest 核心界面部署后，在线互动提升约 +1%，端到端服务延迟降低 11.1%，QPS 提升 63.6%。
Conclusion: UniPinRec 是首个在工业推荐系统中实现检索和排序全栈统一（输入、模型、训练和服务）的工作，证明了统一架构的实际收益。

papers.title: AgentxGCore: Agentic AI for Next-Generation Mobile Core Network
papers.abstract_en: To meet the stringent requirements of emerging applications and the increasingly complex network management and operation, the Next Generation Mobile Networks (NextG), or 6G, will adopt an AI-native architecture on the Core Network (CN). In this movement, the Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) has extended the cellular CN with new function as a first step toward integrating analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and machine learning. However, those new functionalities are constrained by a centralized approach and managerial complexity. Furthermore, with the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs), a new era in network orchestration and management begins, leveraging and empowering the Intent-based Networking (IBN) paradigm. In addition, AI agents and Agentic AI integrate Reasoning and Acting (ReAct), enabling the usage of such intents to continuously interact with the network. Unlike state-of-the-art approaches that primarily employ Agentic AI to mitigate deployment and configuration complexity in the CN, this paper introduces AgentxGCore, which leverages an Agentic AI-Native layer to extend the 3GPP architecture and enable a system based on the existing APIs across the Beyond Next Generation Core (xGC) domain. This proposal establishes an AI-driven closed-loop for continuous optimization based on real-time information, enabling self-organization and self-adaptation. Our approach involves a multi-agent specialized system, divided into a network planner agent, capable of visualizing the network state and developing a plan to meet the intents, and a network executor, responsible for criticizing and executing the plan. To validate the proposed solution, an environment was built using an open-source CN, heterogeneous datasets, and different LLMs were employed to demonstrate its effectiveness.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in IEEE Network
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentxGCore，一种用于6G核心网的Agentic AI原生架构。该方法在3GPP标准基础上增加AI代理层，通过多代理系统（网络规划器与网络执行器）实现意图驱动的闭环自优化。使用开源核心网、异构数据集和多种大语言模型验证了有效性，但未报告定量性能指标。
Motivation: 现有3GPP核心网对AI的集成是集中式的，管理复杂且无法满足6G的自治需求；同时缺乏利用LLM和Agentic AI实现灵活意图驱动网络编排的方案。
Method: 提出AgentxGCore，在3GPP核心网架构上添加Agentic AI原生层，利用现有关键字：无；因此relevance_score设为0。
Result: 在开源核心网环境中使用异构数据集和不同LLM验证了多代理系统的有效性，但摘要未提供具体性能数值。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了利用LLM代理实现6G核心网意图驱动自组织与自适应的潜力。

papers.title: 4D Radar Meets LiDAR and Camera: Cooperative Perception under Adverse Weather
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative perception is important for autonomous driving but remains fragile when cameras and LiDAR degrade in adverse weather. We address this challenge by integrating 4D imaging radar as a weather-robust modality into collaborative perception and introducing a Doppler-guided spatial attention mechanism for multi-agent fusion. Our approach extends two representative backbones: a radar-camera pipeline where radar substitutes LiDAR, and a LiDAR-radar pipeline where radar complements LiDAR. To support evaluation, we release radar-augmented benchmarks, OPV2V-R and Adver-City-R, with physics-based LiDAR degradation. Experiments show strong robustness gains in fog and rain, including substantial improvements when radar replaces degraded LiDAR. Additional validation on MAN TruckScenes demonstrates transfer beyond simulation. Overall, our results highlight 4D imaging radar as a robust modality for all-weather collaborative perception. Dataset and code are available at: https://url.fzi.de/SlimComm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过集成4D成像雷达作为天气鲁棒模态，并引入多普勒引导空间注意力机制，解决了恶劣天气下相机和LiDAR退化导致的协同感知脆弱问题。实验表明在雾和雨条件下雷达能显著提升感知鲁棒性，并发布了雷达增强基准数据集。
Motivation: 现有协同感知在恶劣天气下因相机和LiDAR退化而性能下降，需要引入鲁棒模态。
Method: 将4D成像雷达集成到协同感知中，提出多普勒引导空间注意力机制用于多智能体融合，扩展了雷达-相机和LiDAR-雷达两种骨干网络。
Result: 在雾和雨条件下取得显著鲁棒性提升，当雷达替换退化LiDAR时性能大幅改善，并在MAN TruckScenes上验证了跨仿真迁移能力。

papers.title: Auditing Near-Optimal Policies Can Be Exponentially Hard: Conditional Query Lower Bounds via Occupancy Rashomon Capacity
papers.abstract_en: When many reinforcement-learning policies achieve near-optimal return, a post-hoc auditor may have to distinguish among many behaviorally distinct but return-equivalent policies. We formalize this phenomenon through an occupancy-measure analogue of Rashomon capacity: the metric entropy of the near-optimal occupancy region, computed relative to an audited deployment class. Because occupancy measures identify behavior only up to occupancy equivalence, we formulate auditing at the occupancy-class level and distinguish exact local-query oracles from noisy sample-query oracles. Our main exact-query result is conditional: if the audited class contains a $2/H$-separated near-optimal packing whose local signatures are $b$-sparse, then exact local-query auditing requires $Ω(M/b)$ queries; when the packing realizes deployment-class capacity and $b=O(1)$, this becomes $Ω(2^{\Hopt^\cF(\eps)})$. We give a finite discounted hidden-branch MDP attaining this bound and show the exact Bayes success law. For noisy hidden-trigger testing, we prove a mixture lower bound of order $M/β$, where $β$ is the per-sample KL signal, yielding $Ω(2^{\Hopt^\cF(\eps)}/(ρ^2Δ^2))$ for capacity-order packings with $β=O(ρ^2Δ^2)$. We also provide a static target-recognition information lower bound, a transcript-compatible oracle-cover verification upper bound, and a canonical occupancy regularizer whose regularized audited capacity collapses when a trusted reference occupancy is available. Controlled benchmarks distinguish positive sparse-signature instances from high-capacity negative controls where exact auditing is easy, and map the noisy-trigger law to post-processed continuous-control and visual-RL auditing regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习中审计近最优策略的复杂性，通过占用度量（occupancy measure）的Rashomon容量形式化，证明在精确查询和噪声查询下审计下界呈指数级，并给出具体MDP构造和上下界。
Motivation: 强化学习中存在许多行为各异但回报近最优的策略，审计者需要区分它们，但传统方法难以刻画其查询复杂性。
Method: 提出占用Rashomon容量作为度量熵，定义审计在占用类层面，区分精确局部查询和噪声样本查询，并利用条件下界、混合下界等工具推导审计所需查询次数。
Result: 精确查询下界为Ω(M/b)，当b=O(1)时可达Ω(2^{Hopt^F(ε)})；噪声查询下界为Ω(2^{Hopt^F(ε)}/(ρ^2Δ^2))。提供有限折扣隐藏分支MDP达到该界，并给出准确贝叶斯成功律。
Conclusion: 审计近最优策略的查询复杂性可指数级高，但若存在可靠参考占用度量则可通过正则化降低容量。实验区分正负控制组，并映射到连续控制和视觉RL审计场景。

papers.title: Riemannian Stochastic Optimization for Sufficient Dimension Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) makes high-dimensional regression tractable by projecting the covariates onto a low-dimensional subspace that preserves the conditional mean of the response. Existing gradient-based estimators either operate in the ambient space and suffer from the curse of dimensionality, or localize in the reduced space at a per-outer-iteration cost at least quadratic in the sample size. We show that minimizers of the population Minimum Average Variance Estimation (MAVE) risk approximate the same Grassmannian target as the Outer Product of Gradients (OPG), and recast the empirical criterion as a smooth maximization on the Stiefel manifold with closed-form Riemannian gradient. The resulting algorithm, SMAVE, combines sparse projected-space nearest-neighbor localization with Riemannian stochastic gradient ascent. A simplified version comes with almost-sure convergence and a non-asymptotic rate matching the standard non-convex stochastic first-order scaling. Empirically, SMAVE matches or improves on RMAVE's synthetic subspace recovery at moderate-to-high ambient dimension, and on four real datasets it uniformly improves over OPG and is competitive with or outperforms RMAVE at orders of magnitude lower runtime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于黎曼流形随机优化的充分降维算法SMAVE，通过将MAVE风险最小化转化为Stiefel流形上的光滑最大化，利用闭式黎曼梯度实现高效优化。实验表明SMAVE在合成数据和真实数据集上优于或匹配现有方法，且计算成本显著降低。
Motivation: 现有SDR梯度估计方法要么受维度灾难影响，要么每次迭代计算成本与样本量二次相关，需要更高效的算法。
Method: 证明MAVE风险的最小化器近似Grassmannian目标，将经验准则重写为Stiefel流形上的光滑最大化，推导闭式黎曼梯度，结合稀疏投影空间近邻定位和黎曼随机梯度上升，提出SMAVE算法。
Result: 在合成数据上，SMAVE在中等至高环境维度下匹配或改进RMAVE的子空间恢复性能；在四个真实数据集上一致优于OPG，与RMAVE相当或更好，且运行时间降低数个数量级。
Conclusion: SMAVE提供了一种高效、可扩展的SDR方法，兼具理论收敛保证和实际计算优势。

papers.title: Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents -- Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon search agents accumulate large amounts of retrieved content across many tool calls, making context-budget efficiency increasingly important. A minimal intervention is to mask stale observations from the context as the trajectory progresses, but it remains unclear when this form of context management helps and why. We study observation masking through a systematic sweep over various agent backbones (4B to 284B parameters) and three retrievers on offline and live-web agentic search benchmarks. We find that the accuracy gain from masking follows an asymmetric inverted-U shape when plotted against the model's accuracy without context management: a plateau under weak retrievers, a peak when a strong retriever meets a mid-capacity model, and a sharp collapse when the model is saturated. This pattern reflects the interaction between retriever recall and the model's implicit filtering capacity, rather than either factor in isolation. Mechanistically, masking implements a token-for-turn trade-off: it removes observations the model has largely stopped attending to and pages the agent rarely re-opens. The added turns help when they convert failures into successes, but they fail when masking removes evidence the model would otherwise have used. We therefore reframe context management as a regime-dependent intervention and provide a holistic perspective for analyzing context use in agentic deep search. We release our scaffold and trajectories here (https://github.com/i-DeepSearch/observation-masking) to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了长程搜索代理中掩蔽过时观察（observation masking）对准确率的影响，发现其效果呈非对称倒U形：弱检索器下平台期、强检索器搭配中等容量模型时达到峰值、模型饱和时急剧下降。机制上，掩蔽实现了词元与回合的权衡，移除模型已停止关注的观察，但可能移除有用证据。
Motivation: 长程搜索代理在多次工具调用中积累大量检索内容，上下文预算效率至关重要。掩蔽过时观察是一种最小干预，但何时有效及原因尚不清楚。
Method: 通过系统扫描不同代理骨干（4B-284B参数）和三种检索器，在离线与实时网页搜索基准上研究观察掩蔽的效果，并分析其机制。
Result: 准确率提升呈非对称倒U形：弱检索器下增益平稳，强检索器配合中等容量模型时增益最大，模型饱和时增益急剧下降。
Conclusion: 上下文管理应视为依赖于干预所处的状态，需考虑检索器召回与模型隐式过滤能力的交互作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Amortized Neural Representations for High-Resolution Terrain Elevation Data
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) model a signal as a continuous coordinate-to-value function. For terrain elevation data, this supports analytic derivatives, arbitrary-resolution decoding, and a smooth surface model of the underlying heightfield. However, fitting and storing a separate INR for every tile does not scale to large terrain datasets. Amortized neural representations reduce this cost with a shared network: a new tile is mapped to a compact per-tile payload, and a shared decoder reconstructs the heightfield from it. Most such methods are hypernetworks that predict the payload in a single forward pass, while others recover it through a short per-tile optimization. These methods were developed primarily for natural images, and their suitability for terrain heightfields remains unclear. We introduce a controlled benchmark on a 1 m/pixel terrain dataset and evaluate three representative methods under a unified protocol. Observing a clear cross-domain gap, we propose HUVR+SIREN, a hypernetwork that adapts the strongest benchmarked method (HUVR) by replacing its coordinate decoder with a smooth, analytically differentiable one. It attains the best height and derivative fidelity on the benchmark with no additional per-tile storage and lower decode cost, and tolerates aggressive post-training quantization with negligible quality loss, giving a compact terrain neural format. Ablations and diagnostics further identify which design choices transfer to terrain and show that the per-tile bottleneck is already near its useful limit, leaving the remaining gap in the shared hypernetwork's architectural design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高分辨率地形高程数据，在统一协议下评估了三种摊销神经表示方法（HUVR、Du等），发现它们存在跨领域差距。作者提出HUVR+SIREN，将HUVR的坐标解码器替换为平滑可微的SIREN，在1米/像素的地形数据集上实现了最佳高度和导数保真度，且无需额外逐片存储、解码成本更低，并能容忍激进的后训练量化，从而形成紧凑的地形神经格式。消融实验表明逐片瓶颈已接近有用极限，剩余差距在于共享超网络的架构设计。
Motivation: 现有摊销神经表示方法主要为自然图像设计，其在地形高度场上的适用性尚不清楚，缺乏针对大规模地形数据的高效、可扩展表示方法。
Method: 提出HUVR+SIREN，一种基于超网络的摊销神经表示方法，通过将原始HUVR中的坐标解码器替换为平滑且解析可微的SIREN激活函数，并保持其他组件不变，以适应地形高程数据的连续性需求。
Result: 在1米/像素地形数据集上，HUVR+SIREN取得了最佳的高度和导数重建精度，无需额外逐片存储，解码成本更低，且在后训练量化至低比特时质量损失可忽略。
Conclusion: 研究表明，通过合适的解码器设计（如SIREN），摊销神经表示可以高效适用于地形数据，但超网络架构本身仍是进一步提升性能的瓶颈所在。

papers.title: A Distribution-Free Framework for Rewrite-Based Human-text Detection via Knockoff Filtering
papers.abstract_en: We propose a distribution-free statistical framework that converts arbitrary rewrite-based detectors into detectors with finite-sample FDR guarantees without retraining. Our key observation is that rewrite-based detection implicitly constructs knockoff samples, enabling LLM-generated text detection to be formulated as a multiple hypothesis testing problem with knockoff structure. This perspective separates the design of detection statistics from the control of false discoveries, allowing existing rewrite detectors to inherit finite-sample false discovery rate (FDR) guarantees through a simple calibration procedure. We demonstrate reliable FDR control with meaningful detection power across three detection models, 19 domains, and four LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个无需分布假设的统计框架，利用knockoff方法将任意基于重写（rewrite-based）的LLM文本检测器转化为具有有限样本错误发现率（FDR）保证的检测器，无需重新训练。关键洞察是重写检测隐式构造knockoff样本，将问题建模为多重假设检验。在三个检测模型、19个领域和四个LLM上验证了可靠的FDR控制和有意义的检测能力。
Motivation: 现有基于重写的LLM文本检测器缺乏统计上的假阳性率控制，可能产生过多误判，需要一种通用框架来保证有限样本下的FDR。
Method: 通过将重写检测视为隐式产生knockoff样本，将LLM文本检测表述为具有knockoff结构的多重假设检验问题，从而分离检测统计量设计与FDR控制，并通过简单校准为任意重写检测器赋予有限样本FDR保证。
Result: 在三个检测模型、19个领域和四个LLM上，该方法实现了可靠的FDR控制，同时保持了有意义的检测能力。
Conclusion: 该框架无需重新训练即可为现有重写检测器提供有限样本FDR保证，但未讨论在非重写检测器或更复杂场景下的适用性。

papers.title: Data-Driven Spectral Prediction for Accelerating Large-Scale Electronic Structure Calculations
papers.abstract_en: Simulating large molecular systems comprising thousands of atoms requires highly scalable methodologies. While modern Density Functional Theory (DFT) codes exhibit linear scaling, solving the associated large, sparse generalized eigenproblems remains a critical computational bottleneck on exascale architectures. In the context of the LimitX project, we propose a data-driven framework to accelerate these calculations. By shifting the machine learning target from discrete eigenvalues to the coefficients of an interpolating Chebyshev polynomial, and by comparing both all-atom and fragment-based structural representations, we successfully overcome the dimensionality constraints of large-scale spectral prediction. We investigate three machine learning models (Kernel Ridge Regression, Graph Neural Networks, and Random Forests) trained on a novel 2 TB dataset of protein dimers. The predicted spectra provide initial guesses that effectively bypass early Self-Consistent Field (SCF) iterations in BigDFT. Ultimately, these spectral predictors will be deployed to dynamically optimize upcoming rational filter-based eigensolvers, such as FrASE, which is currently in initial development.

papers.title: Dynamic Proxy-Mixing: Transferring Replay Controllers from Small to Large Models for Continual Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Continual instruction tuning updates a language model through a sequence of new domains, yet each update can progressively erode previously learned capabilities and alignment behavior. Replay is the standard mitigation, but fixed replay ratios are inherently limited because the optimal mixture varies with the current domain, the training stage, and the evolving vulnerability of prior behaviors. We propose PROX-YMIX, a framework that learns a dynamic replay controller on a small proxy model and transfers the frozen controller to a larger target. The controller never observes future tasks and constructs its state from normalized validation losses and their temporal dynamics, producing a masked mixture over the current task and accessible replay buffers. Our core empirical hypothesis is forgetting mirroring: task vulnerability rankings remain largely consistent across model scales even when absolute loss magnitudes differ. We validate this assumption empirically before transferring controllers across scales. On LLaMA-3-8B across five continual instruction tuning sequences, PROXYMIX improves average accuracy by 3.4 points, reduces final forgetting by 3.5 points, and raises safety score by 5.8 points over the strongest non-oracle baseline, at roughly 50x lower policy learning cost than Oracle Target RL. The framework is leakage free and architecture independent at the interface level, and we also identify settings where the proxy assumption breaks down, highlighting limitations for robust deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PROXYMIX框架，通过学习小代理模型上的动态重放控制器并将其迁移到大模型，以解决持续指令微调中的灾难性遗忘问题。在LLaMA-3-8B的五个持续指令微调序列上，该方法相比最强非oracle基线，平均准确率提升3.4点，最终遗忘降低3.5点，安全分数提升5.8点，且策略学习成本降低约50倍。
Motivation: 持续指令微调中，固定重放比例无法适应不同领域和训练阶段的最优混合需求，导致遗忘问题。现有方法需要未来任务信息或高成本训练，缺乏高效且可迁移的解决方案。
Method: 提出PROXYMIX框架，在小代理模型上学习动态重放控制器，控制器基于归一化验证损失及其时间动态构建状态，生成当前任务和重放缓冲区的掩码混合，并将冻结的控制器迁移到大模型。核心假设是遗忘镜像性：不同规模模型上任务脆弱性排名一致。
Result: 在LLaMA-3-8B上，PROXYMIX平均准确率提升3.4点，最终遗忘降低3.5点，安全分数提升5.8点，策略学习成本约为Oracle Target RL的1/50。
Conclusion: 该框架无信息泄漏且架构无关，但代理假设在某些设置下失效，限制了鲁棒部署。

papers.title: Multi-Objective Reference-Aligned Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training samples while preserving the model's utility. Existing single-objective approaches, such as gradient ascent or random relabeling, often induce catastrophic forgetting due to conflicting optimization dynamics and unbounded forgetting objectives that cause the model to drift from its pre-trained knowledge. We propose Reference-Aligned UnLearning (RAUL), a multi-objective framework that jointly optimizes forgetting and retention by replacing unbounded loss maximization with a bounded KL alignment of predictions on forgotten samples toward a reference distribution representing unseen data, instantiated either as a uniform distribution or an empirical distribution from a held-out reference set, which constrains the forgetting objective and reduces gradient conflict with retention. The resulting multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem is solved via Jacobian descent, which aggregates multiple gradients into a direction that does not conflict. Our results demonstrate that RAUL achieves the closest gap compared to full retraining.
papers.comment: Accepted as a short paper at Canadian AI 2026. Author version with an added framework overview figure for clarity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参考对齐遗忘（RAUL）框架，通过多目标优化解决机器遗忘中的灾难性遗忘问题。该方法用有界KL散度将遗忘样本的预测对齐到参考分布（均匀分布或留出集经验分布），替代无界损失最大化，并通过雅可比下降法聚合梯度。实验表明RAUL在遗忘效果上比现有单目标方法更接近完全重训的水平。
Motivation: 现有单目标机器遗忘方法（如梯度上升、随机重标记）因优化冲突和无限遗忘目标，导致模型从预训练知识漂移，引发灾难性遗忘。
Method: 提出多目标优化框架RAUL，将遗忘目标替换为有界KL散度对齐，使遗忘样本的预测分布逼近参考分布（均匀分布或留出集经验分布），并与保留目标联合优化，通过雅可比下降法求解多目标优化问题。
Result: 实验表明，RAUL在遗忘性能上实现了与完全重训最接近的差距（closest gap），优于现有单目标基线方法。
Conclusion: 该框架通过约束遗忘目标和减少梯度冲突，有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，为机器遗忘提供了更稳定的多目标优化方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoIQ: An Ensemble Framework for Automatic Assessment of Geometric Distortion in Prostate Diffusion-Weighted Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Geometric distortion in prostate diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) can impair lesion localization and reduce the reliability of MRI-based clinical assessment. We propose AutoIQ, an ensemble machine learning framework for automatic quantification and classification of DWI geometric distortion severity. A total of 140 retrospective prostate biparametric MRI examinations were analyzed, including 33 scans with severe distortion requiring repeat acquisition and 107 scans with acceptable distortion based on expert radiologist assessment. AutoIQ combines two complementary distortion quantification strategies: a segmentation-based method measuring prostate boundary mismatch between T2-weighted imaging (T2WI) and DWI, and a registration-based method estimating deformation magnitude after DWI-to-T2WI alignment. The resulting distortion scores were used to train individual classifiers and a logistic-regression ensemble model. Both computational methods significantly differentiated severe from acceptable distortion cases (p < 0.001). On an independent test set, the ensemble model achieved an accuracy of 0.95, F1-score of 0.93, and AUC of 0.98, outperforming individual models. These results suggest that AutoIQ can provide automated, quantitative quality assessment for prostate DWI and may help identify scans that require repeat acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoIQ，一个集成机器学习框架，用于自动量化和分类前列腺扩散加权成像（DWI）的几何失真严重程度。在140例回顾性前列腺双参数MRI检查中，结合基于分割和基于配准的失真量化策略，训练逻辑回归集成模型。在独立测试集上，集成模型准确率0.95，F1分数0.93，AUC 0.98，显著优于单一模型。
Motivation: 前列腺DWI的几何失真会损害病灶定位并降低MRI临床评估的可靠性，现有缺乏自动量化方法。
Method: AutoIQ结合两种互补策略：基于分割的方法测量T2加权成像与DWI的前列腺边界不匹配，以及基于配准的方法估计DWI-to-T2WI对齐后的变形幅度。将失真分数用于训练个体分类器和逻辑回归集成模型。
Result: 集成模型在独立测试集上达到0.95准确率、0.93 F1分数和0.98 AUC，显著优于个体模型，且两种计算方法均显著区分严重与可接受失真（p < 0.001）。
Conclusion: AutoIQ可自动提供前列腺DWI的定量质量评估，可能有助于识别需要重复采集的扫描。

papers.title: Detector-Evasive LLM Paraphrasing via Constrained Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: AI-text detectors are vulnerable to paraphrasing and detector-guided paraphrasing attacks, but existing detector-evasion methods often lack precise control over semantic preservation. In particular, optimizing directly for detector evasion can degrade fine-grained semantics, whereas scalarized reward designs provide only indirect, weight-sensitive control over the evasion-semantics trade-off. We address this limitation by formulating detector-evasive LLM paraphrasing as a Constrained Markov Decision Process, where detector evasion is the primary objective and semantic preservation is enforced as an explicit constraint. We propose Detector Evasion Policy Optimization (DEPO), a Lagrangian primal-dual reinforcement learning algorithm with a novel GRPO-style group-based policy update. DEPO adaptively balances semantic preservation and detector evasion during training, enabling the policy to improve attack success within a prescribed semantic-preservation region. Experiments on MAGE, M4, RAID, and peer-review datasets, evaluated against MAGE, RoBERTa, RADAR, Binoculars, and Fast-DetectGPT detectors, show that DEPO achieves strong detector evasion while precisely satisfying the semantic preservation constraint. DEPO also exhibits cross-domain, cross-detector, and prompt-level robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI文本检测器易受改写攻击的问题，提出将检测规避式LLM改写建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），其中检测规避是主要目标，语义保留作为显式约束。作者提出基于拉格朗日原始-对偶强化学习算法的检测规避策略优化（DEPO），并引入类GRPO的组策略更新。实验表明，DEPO在MAGE、M4、RAID和同行评审数据集上，针对多种检测器实现了强检测规避，同时精确满足语义保留约束，并展现出跨域、跨检测器和跨提示的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有检测规避方法缺乏对语义保留的精确控制：直接优化检测规避会降低细粒度语义，而标量化奖励设计仅提供间接、权重敏感的权衡。
Method: 将检测规避式LLM改写形式化为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），主目标为检测规避，语义保留作为显式约束；提出DEPO算法，采用拉格朗日原始-对偶强化学习与类GRPO的组策略更新，自适应平衡语义保留与检测规避。
Result: 在MAGE、M4、RAID和同行评审数据集上，针对MAGE、RoBERTa、RADAR、Binoculars和Fast-DetectGPT检测器，DEPO实现了强检测规避并精确满足语义保留约束，且表现出跨域、跨检测器及提示级别的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DEPO能够在严格满足语义保留约束的前提下提升攻击成功率，且方法具有泛化能力。

papers.title: Zamba2-VL Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present Zamba2-VL, a suite of vision-language models built on Zamba2, a hybrid language-model architecture combining Mamba2 state-space layers with a small number of shared transformer blocks. Across a broad range of image understanding, reasoning, OCR, grounding, and counting benchmarks, Zamba2-VL is competitive with leading Transformer-based open-weight VLMs of comparable scale, including the Molmo2, Qwen3-VL, and InternVL3.5 families, and substantially outperforms prior SSM-based and hybrid VLMs such as VL-Mamba, Cobra, and mmMamba. Inheriting the near-linear prefill compute and small, near-constant recurrent state of its Zamba2 backbone, Zamba2-VL delivers roughly an order of magnitude lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) than these Transformer baselines at matched parameter scale, with the efficiency gap most pronounced at the smaller 1.2B and 2.7B scales most relevant to on-device and edge deployment. We release three models -- 1.2B, 2.7B, and 7B -- together with inference code at https://huggingface.co/collections/Zyphra/zamba2-vl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Zamba2-VL 是一系列基于 Zamba2 混合语言模型架构的视觉语言模型，结合 Mamba2 状态空间层和少量共享 Transformer 块。在图像理解、推理、OCR、定位和计数等多个基准测试中，Zamba2-VL 与同规模领先的基于 Transformer 的开源 VLM（如 Molmo2、Qwen3-VL 和 InternVL3.5）竞争，并显著优于之前的 SSM 和混合 VLM（如 VL-Mamba、Cobra 和 mmMamba）。得益于 Zamba2 骨干网络的近线性预填充计算和小型近乎恒定的循环状态，Zamba2-VL 在相同参数规模下实现了比 Transformer 基线模型约一个数量级更低的首 token 延迟（TTFT），在 1.2B 和 2.7B 小规模上效率差距最为明显，适合设备端和边缘部署。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型多基于 Transformer 架构，推理效率受限，尤其在资源受限设备上。本文旨在利用混合 Mamba2-Transformer 架构获得高性能同时降低延迟。
Method: 基于 Zamba2 混合语言模型（结合 Mamba2 状态空间层和共享 Transformer 块）构建视觉语言模型系列，涵盖 1.2B、2.7B 和 7B 三种规模。
Result: 在多个图像理解、推理、OCR、定位和计数基准上，Zamba2-VL 与同规模 Transformer 开源模型相当，优于先前 SSM/混合模型；TTFT 降低约一个数量级。
Conclusion: 混合 Mamba2-Transformer 架构在保持与 Transformer 竞争性能的同时，能显著提升推理效率，适合边缘部署。

summary_sections.tldr: Zamba2-VL 是一系列基于 Zamba2 混合语言模型架构的视觉语言模型，结合 Mamba2 状态空间层和少量共享 Transformer 块。在图像理解、推理、OCR、定位和计数等多个基准测试中，Zamba2-VL 与同规模领先的基于 Transformer 的开源 VLM（如 Molmo2、Qwen3-VL 和 InternVL3.5）竞争，并显著优于之前的 SSM 和混合 VLM（如 VL-Mamba、Cobra 和 mmMamba）。得益于 Zamba2 骨干网络的近线性预填充计算和小型近乎恒定的循环状态，Zamba2-VL 在相同参数规模下实现了比 Transformer 基线模型约一个数量级更低的首 token 延迟（TTFT），在 1.2B 和 2.7B 小规模上效率差距最为明显，适合设备端和边缘部署。

papers.title: αDepth: Learning Single-Pass Soft Boundary Decomposition for Stereo Conversion
papers.abstract_en: Accurately modeling soft boundaries, e.g., hair and defocus blur, is a fundamental challenge in stereo conversion due to the ambiguous blending of foreground and background. Existing depth models primarily predict single-layer depth, leading to ambiguity in depth correspondence at soft boundaries. While matting techniques can capture opacity for layered modeling, they often struggle in complex scenes with multiple targets and usually require user intervention. This paper introduces αDepth, a layered representation that decomposes soft boundaries for high-fidelity stereo conversion. Specifically, we first resolve mixed color and depth ambiguity by estimating layered color and depth values at soft boundaries. Considering complex multi-target scenes, we design a Circular Alpha Representation (CAR) that shifts the paradigm from global target extraction to local boundary decomposition. Unlike prior matting methods restricted to a single foreground/background, CAR enables efficient scene-level inference without manual guidance. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that αDepth achieves state-of-the-art performance in stereo conversion, eliminating background bleeding and structural distortions at soft boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 αDepth，一种用于立体转换的软边界分解方法。通过估计分层颜色和深度值解决混合颜色与深度模糊问题，并设计圆形Alpha表示（CAR）实现局部边界分解，无需手动干预。实验表明，αDepth在立体转换中达到最先进性能，消除背景渗色和结构失真。
Motivation: 立体转换中软边界（如头发、散焦模糊）的精确建模是基本挑战，现有深度模型预测单层深度导致软边界处深度对应模糊，而抠图技术虽能捕获不透明度但难以处理多目标复杂场景且需要用户干预。
Method: 提出分层表示αDepth，首先估计软边界处的分层颜色和深度值以解决混合模糊；然后设计圆形Alpha表示（CAR），将全局目标提取转变为局部边界分解，支持场景级高效推理。
Result: 广泛评估表明，αDepth在立体转换中达到最先进性能，消除了软边界处的背景渗色和结构失真。
Conclusion: 该方法通过分层分解软边界实现高保真立体转换，无需手动引导，并在复杂多目标场景中保持有效。

papers.title: VESTA: Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents
papers.abstract_en: Fitting quantitative models to data is a central step in scientific workflows, yet it remains one of the least automated. Recent agent-based systems leverage language and vision-language models (VLMs) to iteratively propose and refine statistical models, but these systems struggle on more challenging modeling tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce VESTA: Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents, a framework that equips VLMs with a dynamically growing exploration toolkit to guide model refinement through data transformations, hypothesis-driven visualizations, and robust statistical tests. Unlike prior systems that rely on iterative critique alone, VESTA actively explores data before and during refinement by selecting or creating diagnostic tools, which accumulate in the model's context and can be reused later. We evaluate VESTA against established baselines in three toolkit configurations: no tools, static expert-written tools, and dynamic model-written tools. To support this evaluation, we introduce DAWN (Dataset for Automated Workflows and Numerical Modeling), a benchmark targeting distribution fitting and time series modeling with varying difficulty tiers, and culminating in real-world astronomy tasks including modeling initial mass functions and gravitational-wave chirp signals. We find that VESTA's dynamic tool creation outperforms prior agentic pipelines, with the largest gains on complex and domain-specific tasks. We further show that dynamically generated tools are substantially more sophisticated than those produced by existing visual tool-creation systems, covering more diagnostic categories per function and strongly preferring visual outputs that the VLM critic can reason over directly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VESTA 是一个为视觉语言模型（VLM）配备动态增长探索工具包的框架，用于自动拟合统计模型。它在数据转换、假设驱动可视化和统计检验方面优于先前依赖迭代评判的系统。为了评估，作者提出了 DAWN 基准，包含分布拟合和时间序列任务，最终应用于真实天文学任务。动态工具创建在复杂和领域特定任务上表现最佳。
Motivation: 自动拟合统计模型是科学工作流中的关键步骤，但现有基于 VLM 的系统在复杂建模任务上表现不佳。
Method: VESTA 框架赋予 VLM 一个动态增长的工具箱，通过数据变换、假设驱动可视化和统计检验引导模型细化，并在上下文中积累可重用工具。
Result: 在 DAWN 基准上，VESTA 的动态工具创建优于先前的智能体管道，尤其在复杂和领域特定任务上提升显著；生成的工具比现有视觉工具创建系统更复杂。
Conclusion: 动态工具生成和视觉输出推理能有效改进统计模型自动拟合，但领域限制在分布拟合和时间序列建模。

papers.title: Behavior Cloning of MPC for 3-DOF Robotic Manipulators
papers.abstract_en: While Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides strong stability and robustness, it imposes a significant computational burden on real-time systems. This paper investigates the application of Behavior Cloning to approximate MPC policies for the real-time control of a 3-degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator. We present a baseline controller combining Inverse Kinematics with MPC and evaluate neural network architectures, ranging from classical regression algorithms to deep learning models including Deep MLPs and RNNs, to derive computationally efficient surrogate policies. We analyze generalization capabilities, stability considerations, and the trade-offs inherent in different architectural choices. Our empirical study employs both online and offline evaluations to assess performance regarding accuracy, computational efficiency, and fidelity to the original MPC policy. Our results demonstrate that Behavior Cloning can effectively reduce the computational burden of MPC policies for 3-DOF robotic manipulators, achieving a 3x reduction in inference latency with a 84.98% success rate under relaxed tolerances. Notably, we find that static architectures outperform temporal variants, confirming the sufficiency of instantaneous state observations for this task. However, we observe a precision gap under strict tolerances, which suggest that while Behavior Cloning captures the global optimal trajectory, further research is needed to minimize terminal steady-state error.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE ICRA 2026 Workshop on Reinforcement Learning in the Era of Imitation Learning (RL4IL), 6 pages excluding references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文研究使用行为克隆（Behavior Cloning）近似模型预测控制（MPC）策略，以降低三维机械臂实时控制的计算负担。摘要报告神经网络架构（Deep MLP、RNN等）在模拟中实现了3倍推理延迟降低，在宽松容差下成功率达84.98%，但严格容差下存在精度差距。
Motivation: MPC实时计算负担大，需要更高效的近似策略用于机械臂控制。
Method: 采用行为克隆从MPC演示中学习策略，比较多种神经网络架构（传统回归、Deep MLP、RNN），结合逆运动学与MPC的基线控制器。
Result: 行为克隆将推理延迟降低3倍，在宽松容差下成功率达84.98%；静态架构优于时序架构，但严格容差下存在末端稳态误差。
Conclusion: 行为克隆能有效降低MPC计算负担，但需进一步研究以减少严格容差下的精度差距。
