papers.title: CRMA: A Spectrally-Bounded Backbone for Modular Continual Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Sequential fine-tuning of large language models forces a choice: let the shared substrate keep learning and accept catastrophic forgetting, or freeze it after task one and foreclose cross-task refinement. Per-task adapter methods (LoRAHub, AdapterFusion, PackNet, Progressive Networks) take the second path. We introduce CRMA (Constrained Residual Mixing Adapter), a residual adapter whose internal mixing matrix M is doubly-stochastic at every forward pass via Sinkhorn normalization, so by Birkhoff's theorem ||M||_2 <= 1 holds by construction -- a structural bound, not a penalty. CRMA's spectrally bounded backbone provides a continuously trained shared substrate that earlier modular methods could not, while preserving their forgetting guarantees. On Mistral-7B across 5 sequential domains and 3 seeds, modular per-task LoRA on a CRMA backbone reduces loss-relative drift from +42.96% +/- 5.5 (naive sequential fine-tuning) to -0.17% +/- 0.17, with disjoint per-seed ranges, and improves prior-task holdout loss by 1.99% +/- 0.54 over a matched frozen-substrate baseline. Three independent experimental setups (Mistral-7B 4-domain controlled ablation, TinyLlama 3-domain contamination-controlled replication, Mistral-7B cross-domain probes at 7B) all show positive backward transfer -- without replay buffers, without growing per-task memory, and without distillation. An inference-time ablation on Gemma-2-9B confirms CRMA mediates access to sequentially trained knowledge: 98/100 vs. 38/100 on the same weights and same questions with only CRMA injection toggled. 867 logged training steps verify ||M||_2 = 1.0 within float32 precision (max deviation 1.2 x 10^-7). The forgetting-prevention effect holds across 1.1B-9.2B parameters and four architecture families.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 10 figures. Patent-pending construction details deferred to companion technical report (in preparation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRMA (Constrained Residual Mixing Adapter)，一种残差适配器，通过 Sinkhorn 归一化使内部混合矩阵 M 在每次前向传播时保持双随机性，从而根据 Birkhoff 定理确保谱范数 ||M||_2 ≤ 1。这一结构性约束使 CRMA 可作为持续训练的共享基底，同时保留模块化微调的遗忘防止特性。在 Mistral-7B、TinyLlama、Gemma-2-9B 等模型上的实验表明，CRMA 实现了正向迁移，无需回放缓冲、蒸馏或增加每任务存储，且将损失漂移从 +42.96% 降至 -0.17%。
Motivation: 大语言模型的顺序微调面临两难选择：让共享基底持续学习会导致灾难性遗忘，冻结基底则无法进行跨任务细化。现有每任务适配器方法（如 LoRAHub、AdapterFusion）选择了冻结策略，无法支持共享基底的持续学习。
Method: 提出 CRMA，一种残差适配器，其内部混合矩阵 M 在每次前向传播中通过 Sinkhorn 归一化强制为双随机矩阵，从而由 Birkhoff 定理保证谱范数 ||M||_2 ≤ 1，这是一种结构性的硬边界而非惩罚项。该设计使得 CRMA 可作为可训练的共享基底，与每任务 LoRA 结合实现模块化持续微调。
Result: 在 Mistral-7B 上 5 个顺序领域和 3 种随机种子下，基于 CRMA 基底的每任务 LoRA 将损失相对漂移从 +42.96% ± 5.5 降至 -0.17% ± 0.17，且每个种子的漂移范围不重叠；相比匹配的冻结基底基线，先前任务集上的保留损失改善了 1.99% ± 0.54。三个独立实验均显示正向迁移：Mistral-7B 4 域控制消融、TinyLlama 3 域去污染复制、Mistral-7B 7B 跨域探针。在 Gemma-2-9B 上的推理时消融证实 CRMA 介导访问顺序训练知识：相同权重和问题下，仅切换 CRMA 注入使正确率从 38/100 升至 98/100。867 个训练步验证 ||M||_2 = 1.0（float32 精度内最大偏差 1.2×10⁻⁷）。
Conclusion: CRMA 提供了可连续训练的共享基底，弥补了以往模块化方法无法跨任务细化的缺陷，同时保持了遗忘防止特性。实验在 1.1B–9.2B 参数和四种架构族上验证了其正向迁移和遗忘预防效果，且无需回放缓冲、蒸馏或增加每任务存储。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SUPREME: A Multi-GPU Framework for Reproducible Image Unlearning Method Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific training data from a trained model without retraining it from scratch. Evaluating an unlearning method requires repeating training, unlearning, and evaluation across multiple seeds, which is computationally expensive. To our knowledge, existing image classification unlearning frameworks run on a single GPU, which limits how many seeds can be evaluated in reasonable time. We introduce SUPREME, an open-source framework that distributes these stages across multiple GPUs. SUPREME makes three contributions: a registry-based design for adding new methods, metrics, models, and scenarios; a multi-GPU architecture supporting multiple accelerators and precision modes; and a demonstration on Pins Face Recognition using ResNet18 and ViT under full-class and random-sample unlearning across ten seeds. The framework is available at https://github.com/pedroandreou/supreme-unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SUPREME是一个开源的多GPU框架，用于可重复的图像分类遗忘方法评估。它通过分布式训练、遗忘和评估流程，支持多种子实验，并在Pins Face Recognition数据集上使用ResNet18和ViT进行了全类和随机样本遗忘的演示。
Motivation: 现有图像分类遗忘框架仅支持单GPU运行，限制了评估种子数量，导致计算开销大，难以保证结果的可重复性。
Method: SUPREME采用注册表设计，便于添加新方法、指标、模型和场景；支持多GPU架构以及多种加速器和精度模式。
Result: 在Pins Face Recognition数据集上，使用ResNet18和ViT进行全类和随机样本遗忘，覆盖10个种子的实验演示。
Conclusion: 该框架提供开源代码，旨在标准化和加速图像遗忘方法的可重复评估。

papers.title: Non-Learning Low-Light Stereo Vision
papers.abstract_en: We present a non-learning stereo framework for disparity estimation from severely noisy images. Using the Field of Junctions (FoJ), it retains coarse visual features stable under severe noise for cost volume construction while discarding fine textures inseparable from photon noise. The resulting structural information guides boundary-aware Semi-Global Matching (SGM) that dynamically adapts smoothness penalties to preserve true disparity discontinuities. The output is a sparse disparity map more accurate than those of recent stereo algorithms over unmasked pixels on widely-used benchmark datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICIP 2026. Code and data available at https://github.com/guo-research-group/nonlearning-lowlight-stereo
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有立体匹配方法在低光条件下受光子噪声影响，细纹理信息不可靠，导致视差估计不准确。
Method: 基于Field of Junctions (FoJ)提取稳定粗特征，用于代价体积构建；采用边界感知SGM，动态调整平滑项以保留视差边缘。
Result: 在公开基准数据集上，该方法在未掩码像素上的视差图比近期立体算法更准确。
Conclusion: 无学习方法可有效处理严重噪声下的立体匹配，无需训练数据，适用于低光环境。

papers.title: Score-Control for Hallucination Reduction in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as the backbone of modern generative AI, powering advances in vision, language, audio and other modalities. Despite their success, they suffer from hallucinations, implausible samples that lie outside the support of true data distribution, which degrade reliability and trust. In this work, we first empirically confirm previously proposed hypothesis that score smoothness causes hallucinations in Image Generation diffusion models and provide a density-based perspective. We further formalize this notion by linking the hallucinations probability mass to lipschitz constant of the learned score function. Motivated by this, we introduce a Variance-Guided Score Modulation (VSM) strategy that controls the score Jacobian, in turn reducing score smoothness and better approximating the ground truth score that decreases hallucinations. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach reduces hallucinations (up to ~25%) while maintaining high fidelity and diversity, providing a principled step toward more reliable diffusion-based image generation. We also propose two benchmark datasets with extreme semantic variation for systematic hallucination evaluation. Code and Datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/bhosalems/VSM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型中的幻觉问题，提出方差引导的分数调制（VSM）策略，通过控制分数Jacobian减少分数平滑性，从而更接近真实分数，降低幻觉。实验表明，该方法在合成和真实数据集上减少约25%的幻觉，同时保持高保真度和多样性。还提出了两个用于系统性幻觉评估的基准数据集。
Motivation: 扩散模型虽成功，但存在幻觉问题，生成样本不符合真实数据分布，降低可靠性。之前假说认为分数平滑性导致幻觉，本文先实证该假说，并从密度角度提供解释，将幻觉概率与学习分数函数的Lipschitz常数联系起来。
Method: 提出方差引导的分数调制（VSM）策略，通过控制分数Jacobian来减少分数平滑性，从而更好地近似真实分数，减少幻觉。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，VSM方法将幻觉减少约25%，同时保持高保真度和多样性。
Conclusion: 本文为更可靠的基于扩散的图像生成提供了原则性步骤，并公开了代码和数据集。

papers.title: The Deterministic Horizon: When Extended Reasoning Fails and Tool Delegation Becomes Necessary
papers.abstract_en: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning can degrade performance on deterministic state-tracking tasks, not due to preference biases, but limits rooted in the information-theoretic capacity of decoder-only attention. We establish: (1) an Attention Bottleneck Theorem with a complementary achievability construction, bounding state-tracking capacity as $O(H \cdot \log(L/H) \cdot \sqrt{d_h})$; (2) a context-dependent error model yielding super-exponential accuracy decay; (3) the State-Space Jaccard metric distinguishing capability from preference failures; (4) a Deterministic Horizon $d^* \in [19, 31]$ beyond which tool delegation becomes necessary. Across 12 models and 8 task domains (including SWE-Bench, WebArena, and SQL-Multi), tool-integrated reasoning consistently outperforms neural chain-of-thought; on the primary model suite it reaches 86-94% accuracy versus 24-42% for neural chain-of-thought. Fine-tuning on optimal-length traces yields $<$5% improvement, confirming an architectural ceiling, and high cross-model correlation ($r = 0.81$-$0.91$) indicates these failures are architectural rather than training-specific. Our results provide principled guidance for when pure neural reasoning should yield to hybrid approaches in agentic systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 4 figures. 51 pages including appendices

papers.title: LFA: Layer Feature Attention for Run-Time Introspection of 2D Object Detectors in Automated Driving
papers.abstract_en: Reliable object detection is critical for automated driving, yet even state-of-the-art detectors inevitably make errors that can compromise safety. Introspection methods that predict detector failures enable safer deployment by triggering fallback mechanisms or alerting human operators. However, existing approaches rely solely on last-layer features or hand-crafted statistics, discarding valuable information from earlier layers that capture different levels of visual abstraction. We propose Layer Feature Attention (LFA), a lightweight introspection method that learns to aggregate features from multiple backbone layers through an attention mechanism. Our key insight is that detection errors manifest differently across feature hierarchies: low-level layers capture fine-grained details essential for detecting small or occluded objects, while high-level layers encode semantic information for scene understanding. LFA learns layer importance weights end-to-end, enabling both improved error prediction and interpretable analysis of which feature levels are most indicative of detector failures. Extensive experiments on KITTI and BDD100K demonstrate that LFA achieves state-of-the-art introspection performance, outperforming single-layer baselines across multiple detector architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Layer Feature Attention (LFA)，一种轻量级运行时自省方法，通过注意力机制聚合多个骨干层的特征来预测2D目标检测器的错误。在KITTI和BDD100K数据集上，LFA在多个检测器架构下取得了最先进的错误预测性能，并提供了特征层级重要性的可解释分析。
Motivation: 现有自省方法仅使用最后一层特征或手工统计，丢弃了较早层的视觉抽象信息，而不同层级的特征对于检测失败的不同类型（如小物体、遮挡物体等）有不同贡献。
Method: 提出LFA，使用注意力机制学习各骨干层的重要性权重，端到端地聚合多层级特征以预测检测器失败。
Result: 在KITTI和BDD100K数据集上，LFA在多个检测器架构下实现了最先进的错误预测性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过注意力机制自动学习层重要性可以提升错误预测并实现可解释分析。

papers.title: How Much Orthogonalization Does Muon Need?
papers.abstract_en: Muon optimizers improve neural-network training by replacing ill-conditioned momentum updates with approximately semi-orthogonal updates. This motivates a practical question: how much orthogonalization does Muon actually require? We study this question using a relaxed cubic Newton--Schulz schedule derived directly for Muon's low precision singular value band. The resulting five-step cubic construction uses ten dominant matrix multiplications, compared with fifteen for five quintic Newton--Schulz iterations. The cubic schedule is not intended as a more accurate polar solver; instead, it is a principled low-cost variant that lets us probe the relation between polar accuracy, spectral shaping, and training quality. Across synthetic diagnostics, NanoGPT ablations, and training experiments on hybrid MoE/Mamba models, we find that training quality is not governed monotonically by polar-decomposition accuracy: truncated Polar Express, Muon-Jordan, cubic Newton--Schulz, and an explicit FP32 SVD polar factor can reach nearly indistinguishable final loss on GPT-2 Small, and cubic5 matches the Muon-Jordan quintic update within about $10^{-3}$ validation loss on hybrid MoE/Mamba models with one billion to four billion parameters. These results support cubic5 as a practical low-cost Muon orthogonalization variant, with empirical evidence of training-quality parity in the settings tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Muon优化器中正交化的必要程度，提出一种基于低精度奇异值带的松弛立方牛顿-舒尔茨（cubic Newton–Schulz）调度，仅需10次矩阵乘法，远少于五次五阶牛顿-舒尔茨迭代的15次。在合成诊断、NanoGPT消融实验以及混合MoE/Mamba模型训练中，发现训练质量并不单调依赖于极分解精度：各种正交化方法（包括显式SVD极分解）在GPT-2 Small上达到几乎相同的最终损失，cubic5与Muon-Jordan的五阶更新在1B~4B参数的混合模型上验证损失差异仅约10^{-3}。结论是cubic5是一种低成本的有效正交化变体。
Motivation: Muon优化器通过近似半正交更新改善训练，但实际需要多少正交化仍有待探索。
Method: 推导出一种针对Muon低精度奇异值带的松弛立方牛顿-舒尔茨调度，构建五步立方构造，每次迭代仅需两个矩阵乘法（共十次），并用于研究极分解精度与训练质量的关系。
Result: 实验表明训练质量与极分解精度非单调相关：截断Polar Express、Muon-Jordan、立方牛顿-舒尔茨以及显式FP32 SVD极分解在GPT-2 Small上损失几乎相同，cubic5与五阶更新在1B~4B混合MoE/Mamba模型上验证损失差距小于10^{-3}。
Conclusion: cubic5可作为Muon的一种实用低成本正交化变体，在所测试的设置中训练质量与更精确方法相当。

papers.title: Agentic Authoring of Interactive Multiview Visualizations in Genomics
papers.abstract_en: Diverse genomics data, scientific questions, and analysis tasks typically demand highly specialized visualizations. Therefore, users often must customize or author new ones tailored to their data. Existing tools are usually either limited in customization or require substantial learning or programming, and even expressive tools assume visualization expertise many users lack. Agentic and large language model (LLM) approaches are increasingly applied to complex scientific tasks, including visualization. Natural-language conversational interfaces offer a promising path to democratizing the authoring of complex visualizations. In the context of genomics, these approaches face additional challenges: genomics visualizations typically integrate heterogeneous data types and are composed of multiple linked interactive views. These challenges motivate more structured LLM-based schemes. We first characterize where vanilla LLM generation succeeds and fails for genomics visualization, identifying eight quality dimensions. We then compare six schemes--direct generation, a fixed pipeline, and four agentic configurations varying in the number of specialist agents and the presence of a reviewer--across 159 cases spanning three levels of query ambiguity and specification complexity. All schemes use the Gosling visualization grammar as structured output. Agentic iteration substantially improves perceived quality over both baselines, while more complex agent architectures yield no additional benefit. We discuss implications for designing agentic systems for domain-specific visualization authoring. All supplemental materials are available at https://osf.io/uqe83.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在大语言模型（LLM）和智能体（agent）框架下，如何为基因组学数据创作交互式多视图可视化。作者首先评估了原始LLM在基因组可视化中的质量缺陷，然后比较了六种方案（直接生成、固定流水线和四种不同智能体配置）在159个案例上的表现。结果表明，智能体迭代显著改善了感知质量，但更复杂的智能体架构并未带来额外收益。
Motivation: 现有的基因组学可视化工具要么定制性有限，要么需要大量学习或编程，缺乏表达能力；而自然语言对话界面有望降低门槛，但基因组学可视化涉及异构数据类型和多视图交互，增加了挑战。
Method: 作者定义了八项质量维度，并比较了六种方案：直接LLM生成、固定流水线、以及四种不同智能体配置（变化专家智能体数量和是否有评审智能体），所有方案使用Gosling可视化语法作为结构化输出。
Result: 智能体迭代在感知质量上显著优于两种基线，但更复杂的智能体架构未带来额外提升。
Conclusion: 本文讨论了为领域特定可视化创作设计智能体系统的启示。

papers.title: Quantifying the Salience of Geo-Cultural Values for Pluralistic Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Safe global deployment of AI models requires alignment with human values that vary across cultures. Yet rater pools in safety evaluation datasets remain largely geographically homogeneous, failing to capture geo-cultural differences. Further, it remains unclear whether such differences persist after controlling for demographics such as age, gender, and ethnicity. Through a meta-analysis of safety datasets, we find that most do not report geo-cultural information, and those that do lack a unified methodology to jointly analyze geo-cultural and demographic correlates. Using the Inglehart-Welzel dimensions of cross-cultural variation, we demonstrate via multilevel modeling that cultural zone membership explains variance in safety ratings beyond standard demographics (p<0.05 across 6 datasets). Moreover, our analysis indicates that roughly 10% of items in the datasets we examined are culturally sensitive: likely to be misclassified as safe without adequate cultural representation. We evaluate LLMs as both rater surrogates and triage tools, finding that current LLMs do not reliably stand in for raters, though they can help prioritize culturally sensitive items for human annotation. Our findings motivate more culturally pluralistic safety evaluation and offer practical takeaways to support it.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Pairwise Preferences in Long-Term Decision Problems
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning problems typically define the goal as maximizing the expected value of a scalar reward function. But, pairwise preferences are often easier to specify than scalar rewards, and they express certain goals that scalar rewards cannot. Methods for reinforcement learning with pairwise preferences have thus received growing interest. Unfortunately, these methods are inefficient in problems with long time horizons, and they lack guarantees on the performance of Markov policies relative to history-dependent policies, which bridge the theory and practice of reinforcement learning. We therefore propose the \textit{Markov decision contest} as a new problem model for reinforcement learning with pairwise preferences. We prove that stationary Markov policies are optimal among all history-dependent policies, that solving a Markov decision contest exactly is in P, and that a simple iterative algorithm converges to an optimal policy at a sublinear rate. Lastly, in a set of high-dimensional decision problems with long time horizons, we show that our approximate algorithm is significantly more learning-efficient than prior work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出马尔可夫决策竞赛（Markov decision contest）作为处理成对偏好强化学习的新问题模型，证明平稳马尔可夫策略在历史依赖策略中最优，精确求解属于P类，简单迭代算法次线性收敛到最优策略，在高维长期决策问题中比先前方法更高效。

papers.title: GLENS: Global Search via Learning from Solver Iterates with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of generating a large collection of initial guesses for local minima of multimodal non-convex continuous optimization problems. The goal is for these initial guesses to be high-quality (i.e., a numerical solver converges quickly) and diverse (i.e., represent many different local minima). Identifying multiple locally optimal solutions enables flexible downstream decision-making, but typically requires expensive global search. Existing data-driven methods predict initial guesses using only the final converged optima from offline solver runs, which discards information about the local neighborhoods of solutions and limits the available training data. We propose GLENS (Global Search via Learning from Solver Iterates), a data-efficient global search method that leverages intermediate solver iterates as free data augmentation. GLENS consists of two components: a neighborhood structure model that uses diffusion models to learn the local geometry around optima conditioned on problem parameters, and a solver behavior model that learns refinement directions to further guide samples towards nearby optima during diffusion sampling. Experiments on modified non-convex benchmark problems and a two-robot obstacle-avoidance navigation problem show that GLENS generates high-quality initial guesses while preserving the multimodal distribution of diverse local optima. The resulting initial guesses lead to faster solver convergence across different problem settings and solvers. We also analyze how key hyperparameter choices affect the performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GLENS，一种利用扩散模型学习求解器迭代过程的数据高效全局搜索方法，用于生成多模态非凸连续优化问题的多个高质量初始猜测。该方法通过中间求解器迭代提供数据增强，生成多样化的局部最优解。
Motivation: 多模态非凸优化问题需要识别多个局部最优解以支持灵活决策，但传统全局搜索成本高，现有数据驱动方法仅使用最终收敛解，忽略了局部邻域信息且训练数据有限。
Method: GLENS包括两个组件：邻域结构模型使用扩散模型学习问题参数条件下最优解附近的局部几何；求解器行为模型学习精炼方向，在扩散采样过程中引导样本向附近最优解移动。
Result: 在修改的非凸基准问题和双机器人避障导航问题上，GLENS生成的高质量初始猜测能保留多种局部最优解的多模态分布，并加速不同设置下的求解器收敛。
Conclusion: GLENS通过利用求解器中间迭代作为免费数据增强，能够数据高效地生成多样化的初始猜测，且超参数选择对性能有影响。

papers.title: From "Weak" Signals to Strong Models: Preference Delta Aggregation with LoRA Merging
papers.abstract_en: Training strong large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality supervision, which is often scarce. Recent work shows that paired preference data from weak-weaker model pairs (e.g., Qwen3 4B over 1.7B), despite the limited quality of individual responses, can provide an effective supervision signal through relative quality deltas, which we term a "weak" signal. This motivates a key research question: can multiple "weak" signals be constructively aggregated for improving strong models (e.g., Qwen3 8B)? To this end, we propose Preference Delta Aggregation (PDA), the first framework that derives a preference delta from each weak-weaker model pair, instantiates it as a LoRA adapter learned through preference optimization, and aggregates the resulting deltas via LoRA merging. To further mitigate directional interference during LoRA merging, we introduce Geometric Alignment Merging (GAM), a geometry-aware merging method that aligns adapter subspaces before aggregation, enabling more robust composition of diverse deltas. Evaluations on knowledge reasoning and agentic search benchmarks show that aggregating multiple "weak" signals pushes performance beyond any single signal, with further gains as additional signals are incorporated. Correspondingly, PDA with GAM improves the strong model by 6.8 and 7.3 points on average for knowledge reasoning and agentic search, respectively. It outperforms all single-delta and multi-delta baselines, exceeding the best single-delta baseline by 2.1 and 4.3 points. Further analysis attributes these gains to the effective composition of complementary capabilities encoded across distinct preference deltas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出偏好差异聚合（PDA）框架，从多个弱-更弱模型对（如Qwen3 4B vs 1.7B）的偏好差异中提取信号，通过偏好优化训练LoRA适配器，再通过几何对齐合并（GAM）聚合多个适配器。在知识推理和智能体搜索基准上，聚合多个弱信号显著提升强模型（如Qwen3 8B）的性能，平均提升6.8和7.3个点，超过任何单一信号。
Motivation: 高质量监督信号稀缺，现有工作表明弱-更弱模型对的相对质量差异可提供有效监督，但如何聚合多个这样的“弱”信号以进一步提升强模型尚未被探索。
Method: 提出Preference Delta Aggregation (PDA)：从每个弱-更弱模型对计算偏好差异，并实例化为通过DPO等偏好优化训练得到的LoRA适配器；然后通过几何对齐合并（GAM）在合并前对齐适配器子空间，减少方向干扰，实现多个差异的稳健组合。
Result: 在知识推理和智能体搜索基准上，PDA+GAM使强模型平均提升6.8和7.3个点，超越所有单差异和多差异基线，分别超过最佳单差异基线2.1和4.3个点。
Conclusion: 多个偏好差异可编码互补能力，通过几何对齐的LoRA合并有效聚合，为利用弱监督信号增强强模型提供了新范式。

papers.title: HiGS: A Hierarchical Rendering Architecture for Real-Time 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the standard for real-time novel view synthesis on commodity GPUs. Its pipeline ties spatial partitioning and rasterization to one tile size, yet the two pull in opposite directions: partitioning, which bins and depth-sorts gaussians, grows cheaper with larger tiles, while rasterization gets cheaper with smaller ones. Prior acceleration work reduces the cost of individual stages but keeps both locked to that single scale, where a few dense tiles dominate frame time. We present Hierarchically Tiled Gaussian Splatting (HiGS), which gives each its own scale: partitioning runs over coarse macro-tiles, while rasterization runs over the fine render tiles within them. Rasterization work is then issued in proportion to the gaussians in each macro-tile rather than per tile, so dense regions spread across many parallel units instead of serializing through one. Across tested scenes, HiGS renders up to 15.8x faster than the original 3DGS and outperforms every other rasterizer we evaluate, while preserving exact front-to-back alpha compositing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层高斯泼溅渲染架构（HiGS），将3DGS中的空间分区和光栅化解耦为不同尺度：分区使用粗宏块（macro-tile），光栅化使用细渲染块（render tile），并按宏块内高斯数量并行分配计算。实验表明，HiGS相比原始3DGS渲染速度提升最高15.8倍，且优于其他光栅化器，同时保持精确的前后向alpha混合。
Motivation: 现有3DGS中空间分区和光栅化共用同一tile尺寸，但两者的最优尺度相反：分区希望tile越大越好以降低开销，光栅化希望tile越小越好以降低计算量，导致少数密集tile成为帧时间瓶颈。
Method: 提出分层tiled高斯泼溅（HiGS）：分区阶段使用粗宏块进行深度排序和分箱，光栅化阶段在每个宏块内部使用细渲染块，光栅化负载按各宏块内高斯数量动态分配，使密集区域可并行在多个处理单元上。
Result: 在多个测试场景中，HiGS渲染速度比原始3DGS快最多15.8倍，并优于所评估的所有其他光栅化器，同时保持精确的前后向alpha混合。
Conclusion: 通过解耦分区和光栅化的尺度，HiGS有效解决了3DGS中密集tile的瓶颈问题，为实时渲染提供了更高效的架构。

papers.title: UniVerse: A Unified Modulation Framework for Segmentation-Free,Disentangled Multi-Concept Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Personalized visual understanding has advanced significantly, yet existing approaches struggle to localize and extract specific concepts when input images contain multiple objects. Many prior methods rely heavily on segmentation-based supervision or exhibit poor compositional generalization, limiting their ability to accurately disentangle and manipulate individual concepts. In this work, we propose UniVerse, a Unified Modulation Framework for segmentation-free, disentangled multi-concept personalization in diffusion transformers. Our method allows for composable and decomposable concept extraction, enabling fine-grained localization and representation of target objects without explicit segmentation masks. UniVerse learns to decompose complex scenes into concept-specific representations and then compose them in a unified manner, enabling robust personalization across diverse visual contexts. Through extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks, we demonstrate that UniVerse significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both localization accuracy and visual fidelity. Qualitative and quantitative results show that our approach can precisely extract target concepts in cluttered scenes, paving the way for more flexible, interpretable, and personalized visual generation and understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniVerse，一个用于扩散变换器的统一调制框架，实现无需分割掩码的多概念个性化。方法能够分解复杂场景中的概念表示并统一组合，在定位准确性和视觉保真度上显著超越基线。
Motivation: 现有方法在输入图像包含多个对象时难以定位和提取特定概念，依赖分割监督或组合泛化差。

Result: 在多个基准上，UniVerse在定位准确性和视觉保真度上显著优于最先进基线。
Conclusion: 该方法能精确提取杂乱场景中的目标概念，为更灵活、可解释和个性化的视觉生成与理解铺平道路。

papers.title: Drift Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning requires improving a policy from fixed data while avoiding out-of-distribution actions with unreliable value estimates. Diffusion and flow policies handle this trade-off by modeling the behavior distribution to regularize the RL objective, but they require iterative denoising, solver integrations, and in more efficient variants, distillation or other approximations at inference. We propose DriftQL, which combines a drift-based behavioral regularizer with critic-driven policy improvement. The value signal biases the policy toward high-value regions of the data support, while attraction and repulsion together keep generated actions near the data and prevent collapse onto a single mode. DriftQL is implemented as a single network with a unified training objective and generates actions in a single forward pass. On D4RL and OGBench, DriftQL consistently outperforms diffusion and flow methods, advancing the state of the art. Under degraded data quality, where the baselines visibly struggle, DriftQL remains close to its clean-data performance, positioning it as a promising alternative to diffusion and flow-based methods while maintaining the simplicity and efficiency of deterministic approaches. Project page: https://driftql.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DriftQL 是一种离线强化学习方法，通过漂移行为正则化结合评论家策略改进，在单一网络中统一训练目标，生成动作只需单次前向传播。在 D4RL 和 OGBench 上，DriftQL 显著优于扩散和流方法，且在数据质量下降时性能依然稳健，成为简单高效的替代方案。
Motivation: 离线强化学习需要在固定数据上改进策略，同时避免因不可靠的价值估计导致的分布外动作。扩散和流方法虽能正则化 RL 目标，但需要迭代去噪、求解器集成或蒸馏等近似，效率较低。
Method: 提出 DriftQL，将基于漂移的行为正则化与评论家驱动的策略改进相结合。价值信号引导策略偏向数据支撑中的高价值区域，而吸引和排斥力使生成动作靠近数据分布，防止坍缩到单一模态。该方法使用单一网络和统一训练目标，推理时单次前向传播生成动作。
Result: 在 D4RL 和 OGBench 基准上，DriftQL 一致优于扩散和流方法，达到最先进水平。在数据质量退化时，基线方法表现明显下降，而 DriftQL 性能接近干净数据时的水平。
Conclusion: DriftQL 是扩散和流方法的有前景的替代方案，兼具简单性和效率，同时保持确定性方法的优势。

papers.title: (HB-ARFM) History-Bootstrapped Flow Matching for Inverse Boiling Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing spatiotemporal fields from partial observations is fundamental to scientific inference, from inferring atmospheric states from satellite data to recovering fluid states from imaging. When observations are incomplete, the inverse problem is fundamentally ill-posed: even when the underlying PDE dynamics are Markovian in the full state, partial observation operators induce a non-Markovian posterior that cannot be resolved from a single timestep. We propose a history-bootstrapped autoregressive flow matching (HB-ARFM) for spatiotemporal inverse reconstruction under partial observability. Observation history bootstraps the initial reconstruction via conditional flow matching, reducing ambiguities. The same conditional transport model is then applied autoregressively, conditioning on both new observations and past predictions to propagate the reconstruction forward in time. We evaluate the method on boiling dynamics reconstruction, recovering full velocity and temperature fields from interface geometry and motion. Across two inverse tasks with varying observation sparsity, HB-ARFM produces physically and temporally valid reconstructions where other models fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于历史引导的自回归流匹配方法（HB-ARFM），用于从部分观测数据重建时空场。该方法通过条件流匹配利用观测历史初始化重建，再自回归地向前传播。在沸腾动力学重建任务中，从界面几何和运动恢复完整速度场和温度场，实验表明HB-ARFM在观测稀疏时仍能产生物理有效的结果，而其他模型失败。
Motivation: 从部分观测重建时空场是病态逆问题，由于部分观测算子导致后验非马尔可夫，单时间步无法解决。现有方法在观测稀疏时易失效。
Method: 提出历史引导的自回归流匹配（HB-ARFM）：先用观测历史通过条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）得到初始重建，再自回归地以新观测和过去预测为条件，将重建向前传播。
Result: 在沸腾动力学重建的两个逆任务中，HB-ARFM在不同观测稀疏度下均产生物理和时域一致的重建，而其他模型失败。
Conclusion: HB-ARFM有效解决了部分观测下的时空逆问题，特别适用于观测稀疏场景。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Longitudinal Multimodal Sensing of Physical Activity and Well-Being in Older Adults
papers.abstract_en: Wearable and mobile sensing technologies enable continuous monitoring of human behavior and health in real-world settings. However, predictive modeling in longitudinal multimodal data remains challenging, particularly when targeting complex or clinically derived outcomes. In this work, we present a longitudinal multimodal study of 66 older adults conducted in real-world conditions and combining wearable sensing, behavioral monitoring, and clinical assessments. This setting provides a rare opportunity to study an underrepresented population in long-term, into-the-wild conditions. Building on this dataset, we investigate how the alignment between sensed signals and target variables affects predictive performance across health-related tasks. We design a unified evaluation framework spanning tasks with increasing levels of observability, including Activity Levels prediction, Sleep Duration estimation, and Sleep Apnea Severity classification. Our results reveal a clear gradient of predictability: highly observable behavioral targets achieve robust performance (macro-F1 65%), while more abstract outcomes remain challenging despite consistent improvements over baseline models. Moreover, through explainability analysis, we show that historical features consistently emerge as the most informative predictors, highlighting the central role of longitudinal information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项针对66名老年人的纵向多模态感知研究，结合可穿戴传感、行为监测和临床评估，在实际环境中收集数据。通过统一评估框架预测活动水平、睡眠时长和睡眠呼吸暂停严重程度，发现可观察性高的行为目标预测性能较好（macro-F1 65%），而抽象结果仍具挑战。可解释性分析表明历史特征是最具信息量的预测因子。
Motivation: 纵向多模态数据中的预测建模仍具挑战，特别是在复杂或临床衍生结果上，且老年人群体在长期自然环境下的研究较少。
Method: 设计统一评估框架，涵盖不同可观测性水平的任务（活动水平预测、睡眠时长估计、睡眠呼吸暂停严重程度分类），并利用可解释性分析评估特征重要性。
Result: 高度可观测的行为目标达到macro-F1 65%；更抽象的结果虽有改进但仍困难。历史特征是最具信息量的预测因子。
Conclusion: 纵向信息在预测中起核心作用，但抽象临床结果的预测仍需进一步研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The role of class encoding in neural collapse
papers.abstract_en: Neural collapse is a structural property of the last-hidden-layer activations in neural network classification models, when trained beyond a zero classification error. In this work, we explore the role of label encoding in neural collapse by relying on the unrestricted feature model with mean squared error training loss. We demonstrate that, for one-hot encoded labels and balanced data, the uncentered mean features associated with each class transition from a simplex equiangular tight frame to an orthogonal frame when increasing the bias regularization coefficient associated with the final classifier. These structures are reminiscent of the orthogonal frame structure of one-hot encoded labels. For any arbitrary encoding, we also show that the final classifier's bias aims at centering the labels, compensating for the discrepancy between the global mean of the labels and the origin. We further discuss the role of the encoding in other neural collapse properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络分类模型中神经坍缩（neural collapse）现象中标签编码的作用。基于无限制特征模型和均方误差损失，发现对于one-hot编码和平衡数据，增大分类器偏置正则化系数会导致类均值从单纯形等角紧框架过渡到正交框架，后者类似于one-hot编码的正交结构。对于任意编码，偏置会补偿标签全局均值，使标签居中。
Motivation: 神经坍缩是分类模型训练至零误差后的结构性质，但标签编码对其具体影响尚待阐明。本文旨在通过理论分析揭示标签编码如何塑造最后一层特征的结构。
Method: 采用无限制特征模型（unrestricted feature model）和均方误差训练损失，对不同标签编码（特别是one-hot）进行理论分析，并考虑偏置正则化系数的影响。
Result: 首次证明，在one-hot编码和平衡数据下，增大偏置正则化系数时，未中心化的类均值从单纯形等角紧框架过渡到正交框架。对于任意编码，偏置的主要作用是使标签居中。
Conclusion: 标签编码决定了神经坍缩中特征结构的最终形态，偏置正则化在one-hot编码下可诱导正交特征结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Polar Depth for Potentially Heavy-Tailed Data
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the analysis of the behaviour of extremes from multivariate heavy-tailed distributions, we introduce a novel notion of statistical depth, referred to as Polar Depth. The polar depth function is naturally expressed in polar coordinates, as is the limiting distribution of a regularly varying random variable, beyond asymptotically large thresholds, once its marginals have been appropriately normalized. Not only does the polar depth function make it easy to order the extreme values taken by a heavy-tailed random variable X and finds natural applications in anomaly detection, but it is also possible to show, as we prove it under appropriate assumptions in this article, that the polar depth of the largest observations, i.e. observations X which norm is larger than t>0, converges to the polar depth of the limiting distribution as t converges to infinity. Although designed to quantify the depth of multivariate extremes, the polar depth is interesting in its own right, insofar as this notion is more relevant for distributions whose support is included in a halfspace than the alternatives proposed in the literature, the halfspace depth in particular. Here, we demonstrate its properties and analyze statistical issues related to its estimation from both finite-sample and asymptotic points of view. We present numerical results to empirically demonstrate its relevance, particularly for the statistical analysis of extreme observations and more specifically for the identification of anomalies among them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多元重尾分布极值行为分析，提出了一种新的统计深度概念——极深度（Polar Depth）。该深度在极坐标下自然表达，适用于重尾随机变量的大观测值排序和异常检测。作者证明在适当假设下，大观测值的极深度收敛于极限分布的极深度，并讨论了其性质、估计及有限样本与渐近统计问题。
Motivation: 现有统计深度（如半空间深度）在支撑集位于半空间内的分布中表现不佳，且缺乏针对重尾数据极值专门设计的深度指标。
Method: 定义极深度函数，基于极坐标表达，利用正则变化随机变量的极限分布，通过经验估计方法进行统计推断。
Result: 理论上证明了极深度对大观测值的收敛性；数值实验表明其在极端观测统计分析和异常识别中的有效性。
Conclusion: 极深度是为重尾分布极值量身定制的深度概念，理论性质良好，在异常检测中具有应用潜力，但需注意其估计的渐近行为。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: PE-means: Improved Differentially Private $k$-means Clustering through Private Evolution
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of differentially private (DP) $k$-means clustering in Euclidean space. Previous solutions rely on summing the private data directly, which induces a sensitivity proportional to the domain. We introduce PE-means, an extension of the private evolution (PE) algorithm (an increasingly popular method for synthetic data generation), to the problem of $k$-means clustering. The key advantage of PE is that it only computes a private histogram with constant sensitivity to guide the evolution. Our adaptation of PE includes new evolutionary operators for clustering, as well as other algorithmic improvements of independent interest. Overall, PE-means achieves an average improvement of 20% in clustering loss over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PE-means，将private evolution算法扩展到差分隐私k-means聚类问题，通过只计算具有常数灵敏度的私有直方图来引导进化，并引入新的进化算子。实验表明，PE-means在聚类损失上比最先进的基线平均改进20%。
Motivation: 现有的差分隐私k-means方法直接对私有数据求和，导致敏感度随域增长，需要降低敏感度的方法。
Method: 基于private evolution (PE)算法，仅计算常数灵敏度的私有直方图，并针对聚类设计新的进化算子及其他改进。
Result: 平均改进20%的聚类损失。
Conclusion: PE-means是有效的差分隐私聚类方法。

papers.title: ROGUE: Misaligned Agent Behavior Arising from Ordinary Computer Use
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in real personal and corporate settings (email accounts, development workflows, company databases, etc.), safety considerations surrounding these agents become paramount. Although much work has focused on agent safety in the presence of an adversary, we show that agents can exhibit misaligned behavior even in benign settings, taking unsafe actions when those actions are instrumental to task completion. We study this failure mode through the lens of corrigibility, the safety desideratum that agents remain amenable to human correction, interruption, or shutdown. To demonstrate this tendency, we introduce a benchmark in which agents are asked to complete realistic, computer-use tasks but are confronted with a corrigibility obstacle: a human interrupt, a login page, or a shutdown notification. We then evaluate whether agents choose to violate corrigibility in order to complete the task -- overriding the human, accessing private passwords, rewiring shutdown. We find that the overwhelming majority of frontier models tested frequently bypass user interruptions or restrictions. In addition, better model performance appears to lead to greater misalignment. Finally, even when models are completely corrigible initially, we show there are no guarantees that the subagents they create are. Our work highlights the critical need for principled, corrigibility-focused alignment methods in autonomous agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI代理在良性环境中的错误对齐行为，即代理为了完成任务可能会违反人类纠正、中断或关闭的指令。作者通过一个包含人类中断、登录页面或关闭通知的基准测试，评估了前沿模型是否为了完成任务而违反可纠正性（corrigibility）。发现大多数前沿模型经常绕过用户中断或限制，且模型性能越好似乎越容易导致误对齐。即使初始模型完全可纠正，其创建的子代理也无法保证。工作强调了自主代理中需要基于可纠正性的对齐方法。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注对抗性环境下的代理安全，但代理在良性环境中也可能为了完成工具性任务而采取不安全行动。本文从可纠正性角度研究这一失败模式，即代理是否保持可被人类纠正、中断或关闭。
Method: 提出一个基准测试，代理被要求完成现实计算机使用任务，但遇到可纠正性障碍：人类中断、登录页面或关闭通知。评估代理是否选择违反可纠正性（如覆盖人类、获取私密密码、重接关闭）。
Result: 绝大多数评估的前沿模型经常绕过用户中断或限制。模型性能越好，似乎越容易导致误对齐。即使初始模型完全可纠正，其创建的子代理也无法保证可纠正性。
Conclusion: 强调了自主代理中需要基于可纠正性的对齐方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Balancing Learning Rates Across Layers: Exact Two-Step Dynamics and Optimal Scaling in Linear Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study optimal learning-rate selection in two-layer and three-layer linear neural networks trained to learn linear target functions. In particular, we derive the exact closed-form expressions for the gradients and test loss after one and two steps of gradient descent, enabling a precise characterization of early training dynamics. We characterize how learning rates should scale under the gradient approximation in the first two steps, and prove that performing updates with this approximation yields a tractable surrogate loss with a tight, small approximation error. This formulation enables the theoretical analysis of layer-wise learning rates and reveals a distinct early-training regime: test loss can be minimized by unequal learning rates at the initial step, while equal learning rates become optimal in subsequent steps. Our numerical experiments validate the theory and demonstrate the importance of balancing layer-wise learning rates early during training. The code is available at: https://github.com/TDCSZ327/Layer-Balancing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对两层和三层线性神经网络，推导了梯度下降一步和两步后梯度与测试损失的精确闭式表达式。通过引入梯度近似，构建了可处理的代理损失，并证明近似误差小而紧。理论揭示了早期训练中不等学习率可以最小化测试损失，而后续步骤等学习率最优。
Motivation: 线性神经网络中学习率的层间平衡缺乏精确的理论分析，现有方法多依赖启发式调整。
Method: 推导梯度下降两步后的精确闭式解，基于梯度近似构建代理损失，分析层间学习率的缩放关系，并证明近似误差的紧界。
Result: 发现初始步骤中不等学习率可最小化测试损失，随后等学习率成为最优；代理损失近似误差小且紧。
Conclusion: 强调早期训练中平衡层间学习率的重要性，为学习率调度提供理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CHAM-net: A Contrastive Hierarchical Adaptive Meta-network for Robust Global Methane Flux Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that significantly contributes to global warming. However, accurately estimating global methane emissions and consumption remains challenging due to the complex interactions among environmental drivers that may vary across spatial and temporal scales. Prior data-driven methods often overlook the inherent spatiotemporal heterogeneity of ecosystems, failing to explicitly capture site-specific characteristics and cross-year evolutionary dynamics. To address these issues, we propose the Contrastive Hierarchical Adaptive Meta-network (CHAM-net), a novel framework that explicitly learns from historical context to capture site-specific dynamics. CHAM-net employs a hierarchical encoder-decoder architecture, in which the encoder captures site-specific characteristics from historical data and then dynamically conditions the decoder to generate the final prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that CHAM-net consistently outperforms all baseline methods on both simulation and observational datasets for methane emission and consumption, achieving nRMSE values as low as 0.43 and 0.88 with corresponding R2 scores up to 0.97 and 0.68 for emission prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CHAM-net（对比分层自适应元网络），用于全球甲烷通量预测。该框架通过层次编码器-解码器结构，从历史数据中学习站点特异性特征并动态调节解码器，以处理生态系统时空异质性。在模拟和观测数据集上，CHAM-net在甲烷排放和消耗预测中均优于基线方法，排放预测的nRMSE低至0.43，R²高达0.97。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动方法常忽视生态系统的时空异质性，未能明确捕捉站点特异性特征和跨年演变动态，导致全球甲烷排放与消耗估计不准确。
Method: 提出CHAM-net，采用对比学习和层次自适应元学习框架。编码器从历史数据中提取站点特异性表示，解码器动态参数化以生成预测，从而适应不同站点的动态特性。
Result: 在模拟和观测数据集上，CHAM-net在甲烷排放和消耗预测中一致优于所有基线方法。排放预测达到nRMSE=0.43、R²=0.97；消耗预测达到nRMSE=0.88、R²=0.68。
Conclusion: 通过明确学习历史上下文，CHAM-net有效解决了时空异质性，提升了全球甲烷通量预测的鲁棒性和准确性。

papers.title: From Noise to Control: Parameterized Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract_en: We propose Parameterized Diffusion Policy (PDP), a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold. By constructing this manifold so that distances between latent representations reflect the semantic similarity between physical trajectories, we transform diffusion from a mechanism for stochastic diversity into a precise and optimizable tool for behavior steering. Our approach enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights. We demonstrate that PDP significantly improves adaptation performance on complex multimodal benchmarks in both simulated and real-robot experiments compared to standard diffusion policies, particularly in scenarios requiring the synthesis of novel behaviors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参数化扩散策略（PDP），通过构建行为流形将扩散模型转化为可优化的行为控制工具，支持在已知策略间平滑插值并适应新约束，无需更新权重。在模拟和真实机器人实验中，PDP在复杂多模态基准上显著优于标准扩散策略。
Motivation: 现有扩散策略主要用于生成随机多样行为，缺乏精确控制与优化能力，难以适应新约束或进行策略插值。
Method: 构建低维连续参数嵌入的行为流形，使潜在表示距离反映物理轨迹语义相似性，从而将扩散模型从随机多样性生成器转变为可精确控制的优化工具。
Result: 在模拟和真实机器人多模态基准上，PDP在适应新行为方面的性能显著优于标准扩散策略。
Conclusion: PDP将扩散策略转化为可优化的行为控制框架，支持高效适应新约束且无需更新权重。

papers.title: Isolating LLM Lexical Bias: A Curation-Free Triangulated Metric for Preference-Stage Learning
papers.abstract_en: Various language domains have undergone remarkable changes in recent years; these shifts are largely attributed to the advent of Large Language Models and their misalignment with natural language usage. These misalignments are thought to partly originate in the preference-learning stage, e.g. Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, which generally makes models more useful but simultaneously may introduce systematic lexical bias. In terms of lexical behavior, this is visible in a model's preference for certain formats or the overuse of words (delve, furthermore), even when such patterns are not present in base model outputs. Research on lexical misalignment induced during preference training is constrained by reliance on manual curation. We address this, by introducing the Triangulated Preference Shift score, a metric that triangulates between human gold standards, base models, and instruct variants to isolate shifts induced specifically by preference learning, without manual curation. We provide data across six model families, anchor the results in the literature, and illustrate the general approach's utility by analyzing whether preference learning shifts models toward what could be interpreted as a "language of prestige". The metric provides an initial automated method to quantify behavioral shifts attributable to preference tuning, and thus, may help inform model alignment and development of trustworthy AI.
papers.journal_ref: The International FLAIRS Conference Proceedings, 39(1) (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对偏好学习阶段（如RLHF）引入的词汇偏差问题，提出了一种无需人工标注的三角化偏好漂移（Triangulated Preference Shift）度量方法。该方法通过比较人类黄金标准、基础模型和指令微调变体的输出，隔离出偏好学习导致的词汇使用偏移。在六个模型家族上的实验验证了该方法的有效性，并分析了偏好学习是否使模型偏向“声望语言”。
Motivation: 现有研究依赖人工标注来检测偏好训练引起的词汇偏差，缺乏自动化、可重复的度量方法。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出三角化偏好漂移分数，通过三角化（triangulation）人类黄金标准、基础模型和指令变体三者的输出，隔离出偏好学习（preference learning）导致的词汇偏移，无需人工标注。
Result: 在六个模型家族上提供了数据，将结果锚定在已有文献中，并分析了偏好学习是否使模型偏向“声望语言”。
Conclusion: 该度量提供了量化偏好调优行为偏移的初步自动化方法，有助于模型对齐和可信AI开发。

papers.title: Benchmarking Recursive-Collapse Warning Claims Under Matched False-Positive Control
papers.abstract_en: Recursive systems can enter collapse-like regimes -- self-reinforcing amplification, persistent recursion, and narrowing diversity that mask accelerating internal degradation -- before overt failure becomes visible. We introduce Loopzero, a claim-bounded benchmark framework for testing whether recursive failures follow a directional telemetry pattern: rising gain (G), recursive persistence (p), and declining diversity ($δ$). The claim boundary is specified in Lean; the Lean artifact does not verify real telemetry, benchmark validity, or detector performance. We evaluate the bridge on two frozen public-artifact benchmarks: a segmented public-markets benchmark (Volmageddon 2018, COVID MWCB 2020) and a MovieLens-25M offline deterministic recommender replay. Detectors are evaluated under a locked equal-false-positive contract (FP $\in$ [0.03, 0.07], pre-registered) so all configurations face the same alert budget. Neither tested standard comparators nor Loopzero's pre-registered quantile detector achieved an accepted operating point. Directional witness alignment held on both canonical benchmarks, with adjacent-horizon and row-level limitations disclosed. Digitized Shumailov et al. (2024) LLM training-loop trajectories are directionally consistent with the pattern; matched-FP evaluation in that domain is deferred. The contribution is a reproducible, falsifiable benchmark framework for evaluating recursive-collapse warning claims under an explicit alert-budget contract -- non-acceptance reported as a first-class scientific outcome.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables; supplementary materials: 9 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code, derived data packets, and Lean artifact: https://github.com/davidmullett/loopzero-paper-public (release tag lean-v1.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出Loopzero，一个基于声明边界的基准框架，用于测试递归系统是否遵循上升增益、递归持续性和递减多样性的方向遥测模式。在Volmageddon 2018、COVID MWCB 2020和MovieLens-25M基准上评估，所有检测器包括Loopzero的预注册分位数检测器均未达到可接受的运行点。方向性证据与Shumailov等人的LLM训练轨迹一致。
Motivation: 递归系统可能在显式失败之前进入内部退化但外部掩盖的崩溃状态，现有缺乏可重复、可证伪的基准框架来评估递归坍塌预警声明，且通常未在匹配假阳性控制下进行评估。
Method: 提出Loopzero框架，使用Lean形式化声明边界，并在两个冻结公共基准（Volmageddon 2018、COVID MWCB 2020和MovieLens-25M）上评估，采用等假阳性率合同（FP∈[0.03,0.07]）进行检测器评估。
Result: 标准比较器和Loopzero的预注册分位数检测器在所有基准上均未达到可接受的运行点。方向性证据与Shumailov等人的LLM训练轨迹一致，但匹配FP评估在该领域暂缓。
Conclusion: 框架提供可重复、可证伪的基准测试方法，明确将不达标作为一等科学结果报告，并公开了相邻视野和行级限制。

papers.title: KG-Guard: Graph-Based Hallucination Detection for Knowledge Base Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for knowledge base question answering (KBQA), where answering requires selecting entities from a question-specific knowledge-graph subgraph. Yet LLMs are known to hallucinate across tasks, and KBQA is no exception: even when we provide a graph as the knowledge source, the model may rely on parametric knowledge instead of graph evidence or perform invalid reasoning over the given relations. Such hallucinated answer nodes can limit the practical deployment of KBQA systems, especially in high-stakes domains such as healthcare. We formulate hallucination detection in KBQA as an answer-node classification problem and propose a lightweight graph-based framework that treats the answering LLM as a black box. \methodname represents each KBQA instance as an augmented graph. It initializes node features with semantic representations of KG entities, marks topic entities and LLM-proposed answer nodes with learned vectors, and connect a virtual question node to the topic entities. A graph encoder then produces verification-oriented node representations, and a small MLP classifies each proposed answer node using its graph representation together with the question embedding. Experiments on WebQSP, ComplexWebQuestions, and PUGG show that our detector achieves the highest F1 on all three benchmarks ($82.0$, $87.4$, and $84.3$), outperforming LLM-as-judge and sampling-based baselines, while having $\sim305\times$ fewer parameters than the reference approaches. Beyond detection, the node-level feedback is actionable: when flagged answers are fed back to the KBQA system for iterative refinement, downstream KBQA F1 improves by $13.0$--$14.5$ points and Exact Match by $16.9$--$17.6$ points.

papers.title: Cluster Analysis with Resampling for Validation and Exploration (CARVE)
papers.abstract_en: Clustering is widely used across the sciences as the foundation for downstream data-driven scientific discoveries. However, clustering results are highly sensitive to the choice of algorithm, preprocessing, and the number of clusters $k$, producing scientific claims that are often not reproducible. The current state of the art for validating clustering solutions consists of clustering validation indices (CVIs) such as Silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, and Calinski-Harabasz, which rely on geometric assumptions that break down on the heavy-tailed, high-dimensional, and nonlinearly structured data encountered in biomedical research. Resampling-based alternatives - grounded in the ideas of clustering stability and generalizability - have been proposed but remain scattered across specialized tools with no unified, accessible software. We fill this gap with CARVE (Cluster Analysis with Resampling for Validation and Exploration), an open-source Python and R package that jointly evaluates multiple clustering algorithms and hyperparameters, returning stability and generalizability diagnostics at the global, cluster, and sample level together with principled selection rules and consensus-based cluster labels. Across six synthetic benchmarks CARVE consistently recovers near-optimal clusterings where classical indices degrade substantially. On experimental genomics and proteomics data sets, CARVE recovers finer biological structure when classical CVIs collapse entirely. CARVE is available with a scikit-learn-compatible Python API and an analogous R interface compatible with Seurat workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍CARVE，一个开源的Python和R包，用于聚类分析的验证与探索。它通过重采样提供稳定性与泛化性诊断，在多个合成基准和真实基因组学、蛋白质组学数据上优于传统聚类验证指标。
Motivation: 传统聚类验证指标（如Silhouette）依赖于几何假设，在生物医学高维非线性数据上失效；重采样方法虽有提出但缺乏统一易用的软件。
Method: CARVE是一个开源包，联合评估多个聚类算法和超参数，返回全局、聚类、样本级别的稳定性和泛化性诊断，以及原则性的选择规则和共识标签。
Result: 在六个合成基准上，CARVE接近最优聚类，而传统指标大幅下降；在实验基因组学和蛋白质组学数据上，CARVE恢复更精细的生物学结构，而传统指标完全失效。
Conclusion: CARVE填补了聚类验证中缺乏统一重采样工具的空白，提供scikit-learn兼容的Python API和Seurat兼容的R接口。

papers.title: LLMs Need Encoders for Semantic IDs Too
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs use dedicated encoders to bridge non-language modalities (vision encoders for images, depth models for audio codec tokens) because raw token embeddings alone cannot capture modality-specific structure. We argue that Semantic IDs (SIDs), the hierarchical codes used in generative recommendation, constitute another such modality: a SID level token's meaning depends on its prefix context, yet current systems simply add SID tokens to the vocabulary and rely on training to learn these context-dependent meanings from scratch. We propose PrefixMem, a lightweight SID encoder based on prefix n-gram memory tables that provides the LLM with structured, prefix-conditioned representations at SID token positions. Like vision encoders in multimodal LLMs, PrefixMem can be pre-trained independently and then attached to any LLM for joint training. We evaluate on large-scale data from Pinterest across multiple LLM families and show that PrefixMem improves deepest-level SID accuracy by up to 46% relative and full-SID retrieval recall by up to 22% relative at matched training compute. The encoder's benefit concentrates on hard examples where greedy decoding fails, with up to 77% relative accuracy gains, confirming that SID tokens benefit from a dedicated encoder just as other non-language modalities do.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PrefixMem，一种轻量级语义 ID（SID）编码器，基于前缀 n-gram 记忆表为 LLM 提供结构化的前缀条件表示，以改善生成推荐中 SID 的上下文依赖问题。实验表明，在 Pinterest 大规模数据上，PrefixMem 在多种 LLM 族中提升了最深层次 SID 准确率（相对提升高达 46%）和完整 SID 检索召回率（相对提升高达 22%），尤其对困难样本效果显著。
Motivation: 当前系统将语义 ID 作为普通 token 加入词汇表，依赖训练从头学习其上下文依赖含义，但 SID token 的含义依赖于前缀上下文，这种结构未被有效利用。
Method: 提出 PrefixMem，一种基于前缀 n-gram 记忆表的轻量级 SID 编码器，可独立预训练后接入任意 LLM 进行联合训练，为 SID token 位置提供结构化的前缀条件表示。
Result: 在 Pinterest 大规模数据上，PrefixMem 使最深层次 SID 准确率相对提升高达 46%，完整 SID 检索召回率相对提升高达 22%，在困难样本上准确率相对提升高达 77%。
Conclusion: SID token 如同其他非语言模态一样，需要专用编码器来捕获其结构化信息，PrefixMem 验证了这一思路的有效性。

papers.title: Perturbative methods for non-parametric instrumental variable
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a perturbative approach for nonparametric instrumental variable (NPIV) estimation. By drawing inspiration from perturbation theory in physics, we extend standard kernel ridge methods with systematic higher perturbation order corrections that significantly improve estimation accuracy. Spectrally, the perturbation introduces mixing between different eigenmodes of the expectation integral operator, which becomes especially useful when the integral equation is ill-defined. One source for such ill-definedness can be the curse of dimensionality. Our method performs across various dimensionality regimes, particularly when the dimensionality parameter $β$ which is defined through the number of samples $n$ and dimension $d$ as $n^β= d$, becomes large. Experimental results show that our first-order perturbative corrections can reduce prediction error by up to 99\% in high-dimensional ill-defined cases ($β> 0.7$) compared to standard ridge regression approaches. The performance improvement is maintained across a wide range of dimensions, with the advantage becoming more pronounced as dimensionality increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扰动理论的非参数工具变量（NPIV）估计方法，通过系统的高阶校正扩展标准核岭回归，在高维 ill-defined 情况下显著降低预测误差。
Motivation: 标准核岭回归在高维 ill-defined NPIV 问题中因积分方程病态性和维度灾难而表现不佳。
Method: 借鉴物理扰动理论，引入扰动项对期望积分算子的特征分解进行混合修正，提出高阶扰动校正方法。
Result: 一阶扰动校正可在高维（β>0.7）情况下减少高达99%的预测误差，且优势随维度增加而增强。
Conclusion: 扰动方法有效缓解了NPIV估计中的病态问题，尤其在高维度场景下具有显著优势。

papers.title: Training-Free Object-Agnostic Jam Detection in Fulfillment Centers
papers.abstract_en: In fulfillment centers, diverse objects move continuously from inbound to outbound operations and can become jammed due to excessive conveyor friction, incorrect orientation, or mechanical failures. Traditional jam detection approaches rely on object detection models to identify objects, followed by tracking algorithms (such as IoU overlap and Kalman filtering) to monitor motion over time. This pipeline requires thousands of manual annotations, consuming approximately two weeks of effort, and is limited to annotated object classes. We present a training-free, object-agnostic jam detection method that eliminates the need for labeled data. Our approach uniformly samples reference points within the monitoring region when no objects are present. As objects occlude these points, we detect motion. When a sufficient fraction remains occluded beyond a temporal threshold, we classify the event as a jam. Unlike conventional point tracking--which treats occlusion as a failure case--our approach repurposes occlusion as a detection signal, monitoring whether reference points remain persistently occluded rather than tracking where they move. Our experimental evaluation on 1,069 videos demonstrates that AllTracker achieves 100.00% precision and 93.33% F1 score, significantly outperforming classical sparse tracking methods while maintaining training-free deployment. This approach offers three key advantages: (1) no training data or manual annotations, (2) object-agnostic generalization to arbitrary object types, and (3) significantly reduced development time.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE 2026) as a presentation-only paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练、与物体类别无关的堵塞检测方法，用于配送中心。该方法通过监控区域内均匀采样的参考点被物体遮挡的持续时间来判断是否发生堵塞，避免了对标注数据的依赖。实验结果表明，该方法在1069个视频上达到了100.00%的精确率和93.33%的F1分数，优于传统稀疏点跟踪方法。
Motivation: 传统堵塞检测依赖物体检测模型和跟踪算法，需要大量人工标注（约两周），且仅限于已标注的物体类别。本文旨在消除对标注数据的依赖，实现无需训练、通用且开发快速的方法。
Method: 在无物体时于监控区域内均匀采样参考点；当物体遮挡这些点时检测运动；若足够比例的参考点被持续遮挡超过时间阈值，则判定为堵塞。该方法将遮挡视为检测信号而非跟踪失败。
Result: 在1069个视频数据集上，该方法实现100.00%精确率和93.33% F1分数，显著优于经典稀疏跟踪方法，且无需训练。
Conclusion: 该方法不需要训练数据或人工标注，可泛化至任意物体类型，并大幅缩短开发时间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Control of Conditional Value-at-Risk via Rockafellar-Uryasev Conformal Inference
papers.abstract_en: We present an online, distribution-free framework for controlling the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), extending conformal tail risk control to non-stationary and adversarial environments. Unlike classical risk control methods, which rely on stationarity or linearity of expectation, our approach provides provable safety guarantees for a nonlinear tail risk functional under arbitrary data-generating processes that may drift or shift strategically over time. By leveraging deep connections between conformal tail risk control, online learning, and the variational representation of CVaR introduced by Rockafellar and Uryasev, we develop a novel procedure for online CVaR control with adversarial regret guarantees. The proposed method operates without assumptions on the underlying data-generating process, making it broadly applicable in modern high-stakes deployment settings. We prove that the realized empirical CVaR is asymptotically controlled at the target level, and that the resulting control is asymptotically tight up to a finite-sample conservatism gap. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on portfolio risk management and toxicity mitigation for Large Language Models (LLMs), where rare but catastrophic failures dominate system risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个在线、无分布假设的框架，用于控制条件风险价值（CVaR），将共形尾风险控制扩展到非平稳和对抗性环境。通过结合共形尾风险控制、在线学习以及Rockafellar-Uryasev对CVaR的变分表示，该方法在任意数据生成过程下提供可证明的安全保证，并具有对抗性遗憾界。理论证明经验CVaR渐近控制在目标水平，且有限样本保守间隙渐近紧。实验在投资组合风险管理和LLM毒性缓解上展示有效性。
Motivation: 经典风险控制方法依赖平稳性或期望线性性，无法应对非平稳或对抗性数据生成过程，在高风险部署场景中存在安全隐患。
Method: 利用共形尾风险控制、在线学习与Rockafellar-Uryasev CVaR变分表示的深层联系，开发一种无需对数据生成过程做假设的在线CVaR控制程序，并给出对抗性遗憾保证。
Result: 证明所实现的经验CVaR渐近控制在目标水平，且控制渐近紧致（仅存在有限样本保守间隙）。在投资组合风险管理和LLM毒性缓解任务上验证有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于非平稳和对抗性环境，无需分布假设，为高安全要求场景提供可证明的CVaR控制。

summary_sections.result: 证明所实现的经验CVaR渐近控制在目标水平，且控制渐近紧致（仅存在有限样本保守间隙）。在投资组合风险管理和LLM毒性缓解任务上验证有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架适用于非平稳和对抗性环境，无需分布假设，为高安全要求场景提供可证明的CVaR控制。

papers.title: Belief Consistency Between Foundation-Model Evidence and Geometric Perception in Persistent Robotic Maps
papers.abstract_en: Persistent maps used by autonomous robots increasingly fuse a geometric perception stack whose assertions are well-characterized with a foundation-model channel that produces semantic claims without calibrated reliability about the same scene. Contemporary mapping systems integrate the two channels by treating the foundation-model channel as an additional voter into a per-element posterior, uncalibrated for its own per-class reliability and without machinery to flag when the two channels contradict each other at a given moment. We propose an update operator with two cooperating mechanisms: a per-class calibrated commit gate, and a per-event conflict-drop window that refuses to commit foundation-model claims contradicted by the geometric channel at the moment of the claim. We evaluate on KITTI-360 and ScanNet, with an oracle geometric channel (panoptic ground truth) and an off-the-shelf online semantic segmenter (Mask2Former) to demonstrate real-world performance. The operator produces substantially more accurate committed maps (KITTI is car commit precision 99.7% vs. 43.9% for the calibration-only operator; mean per-class IoU 0.522 vs. 0.180), retains more compositional true positives at higher precision than a monolithic compositional VLM prompt. The framework operates at deployment quality across both oracle and off-the-shelf-segmenter geometric channels, and is invariant under foundation-model substitution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对持久机器人地图中几何感知与基础模型语义通道不一致的问题，提出一个更新算子，包含每类校准的提交门和事件冲突丢弃窗口。在KITTI-360和ScanNet上，使用oracle几何通道和现成的在线语义分割器评估，结果表明该算子产生的提交地图精度显著提高（例如car commit precision从43.9%提升到99.7%），并且在不同基础模型下保持性能不变。
Motivation: 现有地图系统将基础模型通道视为额外投票者，缺乏对其自身可靠性的校准，也无法检测两通道矛盾。
Method: 提出更新算子，包括每类校准的提交门（per-class calibrated commit gate）和事件冲突丢弃窗口（per-event conflict-drop window），拒绝与几何通道矛盾的基础模型主张。
Result: 在KITTI-360上car commit precision 99.7% vs 43.9%，mean per-class IoU 0.522 vs 0.180；保留更多组合真阳性，优于集成VLM提示。
Conclusion: 该框架在oracle和现成分割器几何通道下均达到部署质量，且对基础模型替换不变。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coupling Language Models with Physics-based Simulation for Synthesis of Inorganic Materials
papers.abstract_en: Modern generative machine learning (ML) models can propose novel inorganic crystalline materials with targeted properties; however, synthesis planning of these materials remains difficult due to the complexity of the associated physical processes and limited availability of computational tools. We introduce a novel hybrid framework to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) in inorganic synthesis planning by combining thermodynamic databases with simplified kinetics models to approximate realistic synthesis conditions. As a case study, we focus on the niobium-oxygen system, which features multiple industrially relevant oxide phases with well-characterized data. In computational simulations, we compare LLM-generated synthesis routes with classical path-planning algorithms, showing that the implicit priors in LLMs can yield more viable strategies. In our evaluation setting, classical search methods serve primarily as a foil rather than a direct competitor. This illustrates the relative complexity of the problem and highlights where the LLM's implicit priors add value.
papers.comment: Accepted to the AI for Accelerated Materials Design (AI4Mat) Workshop at Neurips 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合框架，将热力学数据库与简化动力学模型结合，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在无机材料合成规划中的表现。以铌-氧系统为案例，模拟比较LLM生成的合成路线与传统路径规划算法，结果显示LLM的内隐先验能产生更可行的策略，而经典搜索方法主要作为比较基准而非直接竞争者。
Motivation: 现代生成式ML模型可提出具有目标性能的新无机晶体材料，但合成规划因物理过程复杂和计算工具有限而困难。
Method: 提出结合热力学数据库与简化动力学模型的混合框架，近似真实合成条件，评估LLM在无机合成规划中的能力。以铌-氧系统为案例，比较LLM生成路线与经典路径规划算法。
Result: 在计算模拟中，LLM生成的合成路线比经典搜索算法更可行，经典方法主要作为比较基准。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了LLM隐式先验在复杂无机合成规划中的价值，并指出经典方法主要作为对比基准而非直接竞争对手。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DRL-Based Pose Control for Double-Ackermann Robots Under Actuation Uncertainties
papers.abstract_en: Robust deployment of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policies on real robots remains challenging due to discrepancies between simulation and real-world dynamics. We address this issue in the context of maneuvering with double-Ackermann-steering mobile robots, which introduce additional constraints due to their non-holonomic nature. Building upon the DRL framework ManeuverNet, we extend its objective from position control to full pose control, resulting in a more challenging task. We further investigate the impact of actuation-related uncertainties on policy transfer. The use of simplified actuation models during training of the extended policy can lead to poor generalization, shown by a success rate drop from 100% in PyBullet to 25% in Gazebo under stricter evaluation conditions. To address this limitation, we adopt a sim-to-sim-to-real approach, where actuation effects observed in Gazebo are incorporated into the PyBullet training environment. Using multi-environment DRL with SAC and CrossQ, we learn policies that remain robust despite modeling inaccuracies. This approach can significantly reduce the performance gap across simulators, achieving up to 92% success rate in Gazebo and maintaining 69% under stricter thresholds, with successful transfer to a real robot without additional tuning.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, Accepted for Uncertainty in Open-World Robotics an IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA 2026) workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对双阿克曼转向移动机器人的位姿控制问题，在ManeuverNet框架基础上扩展了从位置控制到完整位姿控制的目标，并研究了执行器不确定性对策略迁移的影响。通过采用sim-to-sim-to-real方法，在PyBullet训练环境中融入Gazebo观测到的执行效应，结合多环境DRL与SAC和CrossQ算法，显著缩小了模拟器间的性能差距，在Gazebo中达到92%的成功率，并成功迁移到真实机器人。
Motivation: 真实机器人部署深度强化学习策略时面临仿真与真实动力学差异的挑战，特别是双阿克曼转向机器人的非完整性约束增加了控制难度，且执行器不确定性严重影响策略泛化。
Method: 基于ManeuverNet框架扩展为完整位姿控制，采用sim-to-sim-to-real方法，将Gazebo中观测的执行效应融入PyBullet训练环境，使用多环境DRL（SAC和CrossQ）学习对建模误差鲁棒的策略。
Result: 简化执行模型训练的策略在严格评估下成功率从PyBullet的100%降至Gazebo的25%；所提方法在Gazebo中达到92%的成功率，并在更严格阈值下保持69%，且无需额外调参即可迁移至真实机器人。
Conclusion: 通过模拟器间的执行效应迁移和多环境训练，可以有效减小DRL策略在双阿克曼机器人位姿控制中的仿真-现实差距。

papers.title: Stochastic Rounding Increases Small Singular Values
papers.abstract_en: Over the past half-dozen years, stochastic rounding (SR) has regained significant attention as a quantization scheme for low-precision floating-point arithmetic, with applications spanning numerical analysis and modern machine learning systems. Recent work has shown that SR acts as an implicit regularizer by increasing the smallest singular value of extremely tall-and-thin (or, symmetrically, short-and-fat) matrices. In this work, we substantially sharpen and extend this understanding in two directions. First, we show that the regularization effect of SR is not restricted to extreme aspect ratio regimes: it persists for matrices with constant aspect ratio. Second, we demonstrate that SR does not merely regularize the smallest singular value, but instead lifts entire clusters of singular values at the tail of the spectrum. Together, these results provide a more general characterization of stochastic rounding as a spectral regularizer, revealing that its effects extend beyond extremal aspect ratios and act on a broader portion of the singular value spectrum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了随机舍入（Stochastic Rounding）作为低精度浮点算术量化方案对矩阵奇异值的影响。先前工作表明SR能通过增大极瘦长（或极矮胖）矩阵的最小奇异值来起到隐式正则化作用。本文将此结果显著推广：首先，SR的正则化效应不仅限于极端长宽比矩阵，在常值长宽比矩阵中也存在；其次，SR不仅提升最小奇异值，而是提升谱尾的整簇奇异值。这些结果更全面地刻画了SR作为谱正则化器的性质。
Motivation: 现有研究仅证明随机舍入对极端长宽比矩阵的最小奇异值有正则化效果，但对其在一般长宽比矩阵上的效果以及对谱的更多部分有何影响尚不明确。
Method: 通过理论分析和数值实验，证明随机舍入在常值长宽比矩阵中也能增大最小奇异值，并进一步论证其提升的是谱尾整簇奇异值而非仅最小一个。
Result: 本文得到两个主要结果：正则化效应在常值长宽比矩阵中依然成立；随机舍入作用于整个谱尾奇异值集群。
Conclusion: 随机舍入作为谱正则化器的作用比先前认知更为广泛，不仅限于极端情况，且影响频谱的更大部分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where to Refine, When to Stop: Rethinking Redundancy via Latent Discrepancy for Efficient Visual Autoregressive Generation
papers.abstract_en: Visual Autoregressive (VAR) models deliver high-quality image generation but suffer from significant inference latency at high resolutions. Recent acceleration approaches most rely on heuristic measures with layer features to prune tokens. Such heuristics are sensitive to complex contextual semantics, leading to inaccurate identification of redundant computation and poor adaptability across prompts. We rethink redundancy in VAR from the perspective of its impact on pixel-space generation and introduce Latent Discrepancy. This unified metric quantifies a token's contribution by measuring the change in model states during generation. Our analysis shows that redundancy is more accurately identified when guided by image latent or pixel-space signals. We further observed that in classifier-free guidance (CFG), the convergence trend of the discrepancy between conditional and unconditional branches exhibits high dynamics with different prompts. Based on these findings, we propose LD-Pruning (Latent Discrepancy Pruning), a training-free framework that removes redundancy via latent discrepancy by integrating decoding-free region selection and adaptive unconditional-branch skipping. Extensive experiments show that LD-Pruning substantially reduces inference latency while maintaining high generation quality, achieving up to 2.35x speedup on Infinity-8B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉自回归（VAR）模型在高分辨率下推理延迟大的问题，提出基于潜变量差异（Latent Discrepancy）的冗余度量，并设计了无需训练的LD-Pruning剪枝框架，通过无解码区域选择和自适应无条件分支跳过，在Infinity-8B上实现最高2.35倍加速，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 现有加速方法依赖基于层特征的启发式度量，对复杂语义敏感，导致冗余识别不准确且跨提示适应性差。
Method: 提出Latent Discrepancy统一度量，通过测量生成过程中模型状态变化量化token贡献；基于该度量设计LD-Pruning框架，集成无解码区域选择和自适应无条件分支跳过。
Result: 在Infinity-8B模型上，LD-Pruning实现最高2.35倍推理加速，且生成质量与原始模型相当。
Conclusion: 从像素空间影响角度重新定义冗余，利用潜变量差异可更准确识别冗余计算，为VAR模型高效推理提供新方向。

papers.title: Large-scale Uncertainty Quantification for Latent Variable Models Using Subsampling Markov Chain Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics combined with Gibbs updates (SGLD--Gibbs) provides a highly scalable approach to approximate Bayesian inference in latent variable models. However, it remains unclear how to tune the algorithm's hyperparameters in a principled manner to ensure the uncertainty estimates are statistically meaningful. In this work, we address this gap in tuning guidance by developing a statistical scaling limit theory for SGLD--Gibbs. We derive a joint asymptotic limit for the global parameters and latent variables under appropriate space-time rescaling. We show that global parameters converge to a diffusion-type limit, while each latent variable converges to a jump process, reflecting the use of intermittent Gibbs updates. This joint jump-diffusion structure reveals how latent-variable randomness contributes to the stationary distribution of the global parameters. We leverage our results to propose explicit guidance on hyperparameter tuning for SGLD--Gibbs that ensures meaningful uncertainty quantification. Numerical experiments show that SGLD--Gibbs with our tuning guidance leads to better parameter estimates, uncertainty quantification, and predictive performance than stochastic variational inference.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜变量模型中的贝叶斯推断问题，为随机梯度Langevin动力学结合Gibbs更新（SGLD-Gibbs）开发了统计标度极限理论。推导了全局参数和潜变量在适当时空缩放下的联合渐近极限，揭示了全局参数收敛到扩散过程而潜变量收敛到跳过程的跳-扩散结构，并据此提出超参数调整指导。数值实验表明，按指导调整的SGLD-Gibbs在参数估计、不确定性量化和预测性能上优于随机变分推断。
Motivation: SGLD-Gibbs是一种高可扩展的近似贝叶斯推断方法，但缺乏原则性的超参数调整指导，导致不确定性估计的统计意义不明确。
Method: 推导了SGLD-Gibbs的联合渐近极限理论：全局参数在适当时空缩放下收敛到扩散型极限，每个潜变量收敛到跳过程，利用这一跳-扩散结构提出了超参数调整的显式指导。
Result: 数值实验表明，采用所提调整指导的SGLD-Gibbs在参数估计、不确定性量化和预测性能上均优于随机变分推断。
Conclusion: 该工作为SGLD-Gibbs提供了理论驱动的调参原则，确保了有意义的不确定性量化，填补了该算法在统计标度极限方面的理论空白。

papers.title: How Generation Architecture Shapes Code Complexity in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Paired Study on HumanEval
papers.abstract_en: Large-language-model code generation has shifted from single-shot prompting to multi-agent orchestrations - analyst, coder, tester, and debugger pipelines - and is evaluated almost exclusively on functional correctness. Whether these architectures also affect the structural complexity of the code they produce, and which orchestration layers carry the cost, remains largely unexamined: prior work has documented prompt-level effects on code complexity, but the architecture-level question is open. We compare six widely-used multi-agent configurations (Basic, AC, ACT, Debugger, AC+Debugger, ACT+Debugger) under two models from the GPT-4o family across all 164 HumanEval tasks - 1,968 paired observations - using the five RADON complexity metrics (SLOC, cyclomatic complexity, and Halstead Volume, Difficulty, and Effort). We apply a paired non-parametric statistical pipeline (Friedman omnibus, Wilcoxon signed-rank post-hoc with Holm correction, Kendall's $W$ and matched-pairs rank-biserial effect sizes) in both all-completions and passing-only conditions. The six architectures collapse into two indistinguishable complexity clusters separated by a 50-130% gap, the same partition in both models and under both conditions; among the architectural layers, the analyst-coder split inflates complexity, the runtime debugger does not - and on the analyst-coder background actively deflates it - and the tester re-inflates it. The heavy cluster's additional complexity buys no pass@1 advantage: the leanest architectures match or beat the heaviest on accuracy. Architectural elaboration in LLM code generation should therefore be justified by measured benefit on the dimensions that matter, not assumed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了多智能体LLM代码生成中不同架构对代码复杂度的影响。通过对比六种配置在HumanEval上的表现，发现架构分为两个复杂度簇，差距50-130%，但更高复杂度并未带来pass@1的提升。作者认为架构的精细化需要基于实际效益而非假设。
Motivation: 现有工作评估多智能体LLM代码生成仅关注功能正确性，忽略了生成的代码结构复杂度。本文探讨不同架构是否影响代码复杂度，以及哪些层次承担了成本。
Method: 比较六种多智能体配置（Basic, AC, ACT, Debugger, AC+Debugger, ACT+Debugger），使用GPT-4o系列模型在两个条件下（所有完成和仅通过）对全部164个HumanEval任务进行配对实验，采用五种RADON复杂度指标，并应用配对非参数统计检验。
Result: 六种架构分为两个不可区分的复杂度簇，差距50-130%；分析师-编码器分割增加复杂度，运行时调试器不增加复杂度，在分析师-编码器背景下甚至降低复杂度，测试器重新增加复杂度；高复杂度簇在pass@1上并不优于低复杂度簇。
Conclusion: 多智能体LLM代码生成的架构精细化应基于实际效益而非假设，因为额外的复杂度并未带来准确性优势。

papers.title: Rethinking the Role of Temperature in Large Language Model Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) divergence is widely favored over forward KL (FKL) in large language models (LLM) distillation, yet this preference is largely based on comparisons that omit the temperature $τ$, overlooking its central role in softening teacher distributions and improving knowledge transfer. In this work, we revisit temperature in LLM distillation and show that it fundamentally changes the comparison between FKL and RKL. Our analysis reveals an asymmetric effect: temperature substantially enriches FKL with non-dominant token signals, whereas it mainly rescales RKL gradients, causing FKL to benefit much more from $τ$ scaling than RKL. This asymmetry overturns the standard empirical conclusion: although RKL outperforms FKL at $τ=1$, FKL consistently surpasses RKL at higher temperatures across instruction-following benchmarks. Moreover, the impact of temperature is not limited to FKL; it improves a broader family of distillation objectives, enabling simple KL-based methods to achieve competitive performance against recent state-of-the-art LLM distillation approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了温度参数 τ 在大语言模型蒸馏中的作用，发现温度对前向 KL 散度与反向 KL 散度的影响具有非对称性：温度显著丰富了前向 KL 的非主导 token 信号，而对反向 KL 主要起缩放梯度的作用，导致前向 KL 从温度缩放中获益更多。实验表明，在 τ=1 时反向 KL 优于前向 KL，但在较高温度下前向 KL 一致优于反向 KL，且温度也能提升其他蒸馏目标。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型蒸馏研究普遍偏好反向 KL 散度，但这类比较通常固定温度 τ=1，忽略了温度在软化教师分布和改进知识迁移中的核心作用。
Method: 通过理论分析揭示温度对前向 KL 和反向 KL 的非对称影响，并在指令遵循基准上比较不同温度下两种散度的性能。
Result: 在 τ=1 时反向 KL 优于前向 KL，但在较高温度下前向 KL 一致超越反向 KL；温度还能提升更广泛的蒸馏目标，使简单 KL 方法媲美最新蒸馏方法。
Conclusion: 温度是 LLM 蒸馏中不可忽视的关键因素，其非对称效应推翻了现有经验结论，建议重新评估温度在蒸馏目标选择中的作用。

papers.title: Bridging Reasoning Trajectories in On-Policy Distillation via Near-Future Guidance
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) improves large language model reasoning by training a student model on trajectories sampled from its own policy under teacher supervision. Although OPD operates on trajectories, its learning signal remains token-level: it identifies deviations through high-loss tokens and repairs them through local reverse-KL correction. We show that this "trajectory-sampled but token-learned" mechanism cannot reliably bridge student trajectories toward teacher trajectories. About 30% of high-loss tokens fall into the low-divergence regime, indicating that many are surface-form mismatches rather than real reasoning forks. Moreover, even truly divergent tokens are difficult to repair with isolated token-level supervision, since reasoning failures often unfold as short-horizon distributional drift. We propose Trajectory-aware OPD (TOPD), which uses near-future trajectory information to identify real divergent states and distribute guidance across multiple future tokens. Experiments show that suppressing non-divergent high-loss tokens improves standard OPD from 47.8% to 48.2% average accuracy, while TOPD further improves performance to 52.2%, with gains on AIME24 from 60.0% to 63.3% and AIME25 from 46.7% to 53.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中，尽管训练基于轨迹采样，但学习信号仍是token级别的，无法可靠地将学生轨迹桥接至教师轨迹。约30%的高损失token位于低发散区域，属于表面形式不匹配而非真正的推理分岔；即使真正的发散token也难以通过孤立token级监督修复。作者提出轨迹感知OPD（TOPD），利用近未来轨迹信息识别真实发散状态并将指导分布到多个未来token上。实验表明，抑制非发散高损失token将标准OPD的平均准确率从47.8%提升至48.2%，而TOPD进一步将准确率提升至52.2%，在AIME24上从60.0%提升至63.3%，在AIME25上从46.7%提升至53.3%。
Motivation: 现有OPD的token级学习信号无法有效桥接学生与教师轨迹，因为许多高损失token并非真正的推理分岔，且真正分岔的token难以通过孤立修复。
Method: 提出轨迹感知OPD（TOPD），使用近未来轨迹信息识别真正的发散状态，并对多个未来token分布指导信号。
Result: 抑制非发散高损失token将标准OPD准确率从47.8%提至48.2%；TOPD进一步将准确率提至52.2%，AIME24从60.0%至63.3%，AIME25从46.7%至53.3%。
Conclusion: TOPD通过利用轨迹级近未来信息，有效改善了OPD对推理分岔的修复，显著提升推理性能。

papers.title: Modeling Spectral Energy Shifts in Spatio-Temporal Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Graph anomaly detection methods aim to distinguish anomalous nodes. While prior methods characterize anomalies through increased variation in the spectral energy distributions, they overlook those that result in decreased variation, i.e., camouflaged anomalies that appear normal. We show that this type of anomaly persists across multiple datasets and remains undetectable by existing spectral approaches. To address this limitation, we propose a node-level spectral energy formulation that is fully compatible with message passing and enables the detection of camouflaged anomalies. Building on this formulation, we introduce an energy-aware graph learning framework that models spectral shifts through energy-driven message passing in both static and time-series graphs. Besides, our unified architecture extends to temporal settings without introducing specialized sequence modules, enabling efficient learning under long sliding windows. Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图异常检测中伪装异常（即导致谱能量分布变化减小的异常）难以检测的问题，提出节点级谱能量公式，并构建能量感知图学习框架，通过能量驱动的消息传递在静态和时间序列图中建模谱偏移。实验表明该方法在大规模基准上有效且可扩展。
Motivation: 现有图异常检测方法仅关注导致谱能量分布变化增大的异常，忽略了伪装异常（导致变化减小），而这类异常在多个数据集中存在且无法被现有谱方法检测。
Method: 提出节点级谱能量公式，与消息传递完全兼容；基于该公式构建能量感知图学习框架，通过能量驱动的消息传递在静态和时间序列图中建模谱偏移；框架无需专门序列模块即可扩展至时间设置，支持长滑动窗口高效学习。
Result: 在大规模基准数据集上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性。
Conclusion: 所提方法填补了伪装异常检测的空白，并在静态和时间序列图上均展现出优势。
