papers.title: ERICA: Quantifying Replicability of Cluster Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Despite being ubiquitous in science, clustering remains a technique whose results are not quantitatively scrutinized via a framework. We present an analysis called evaluating replicability via iterative clustering assignments (ERICA) that is applied to a dataset to determine whether clusters are identified in a replicable manner. The pipeline computes a statistic that describes whether structure is found in a dataset. Quantitative visualization methods are presented to answer important questions such as the similarity between clusters, and the identity of points that may be outliers. When tested on synthetic data, the findings show clusters being discovered in a replicable manner. However, we note a possibility for non-replicable results when the pipeline is applied to three gene expression datasets for breast cancer subtype validation. The study underscores the need for rigorous inspection and offers a practical tool for doing so.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出ERICA方法，用于量化聚类分析的可重复性，通过迭代聚类分配计算统计量，并给出可视化工具。在合成数据上验证了可重复性，但在三个乳腺癌基因表达数据集中发现可能不可重复的结果。
Motivation: 聚类分析在科学中广泛应用，但缺乏定量评估其可重复性的框架。
Method: 提出ERICA（evaluating replicability via iterative clustering assignments）流程，计算描述数据集结构是否被可重复发现的统计量，并开发定量可视化方法。
Result: 合成数据上显示聚类可重复，但在三个乳腺癌基因表达数据中观察到可能不可重复的结果。
Conclusion: 强调需要严格审查聚类结果，并提供了实用工具。

papers.title: FLaG: Fine-Grained Latent Grouping for Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hallucinations in large language models (LLMs) arise from heterogeneous failure mechanisms, making reliable detection difficult for any single global uncertainty score. In this work, we formulate hallucination detection as a mechanism-aware evidence aggregation problem, where diverse representation- and token-level signals must be interpreted under multiple latent explanations. We propose FLaG, a lightweight hallucination detection framework that models correctness through a set of latent evidence groups. Each instance is softly associated with multiple groups via an energy-based routing mechanism, and group-conditional reliability signals are combined through a principled log-marginal aggregation. This design enables FLaG to capture heterogeneous hallucination patterns while remaining invariant to decision thresholds and evaluation metrics. The framework operates as a frozen-model head, requires no modification to the underlying language model, and incurs minimal computational overhead. We further provide a theoretical perspective that connects FLaG to optimal evidence aggregation under heterogeneous error mechanisms, showing that the Bayes-optimal test statistic necessarily admits a log-marginal form and that FLaG constitutes a tractable approximation with a controllable error bound. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones demonstrate that FLaG consistently achieves SOTA performance, while exhibiting robust transfer across datasets and models, and remaining effective under limited supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FLaG，一种轻量级的幻觉检测框架，通过构建潜在证据组来建模异构故障机制，并采用基于能量的路由机制和 log-marginal 聚合实现机制感知的检测。在多个基准和LLM骨干上取得SOTA性能，且对决策阈值和评估指标不变。
Motivation: LLM幻觉来源于异构的失败机制，单一全局不确定性分数难以可靠检测，需要机制感知的证据聚合。
Method: FLaG通过一组潜在证据组建模正确性，每个实例通过基于能量的路由机制软关联到多个组，再通过log-marginal聚合组合组条件可靠性信号，作为冻结模型头部运行，不修改底层语言模型。
Result: 在多个基准和LLM骨干上持续达到SOTA性能，跨数据集和模型表现出鲁棒迁移性，且在有限监督下仍有效。

papers.title: Real2SAM2Real: Generative 3D Caches as Complementary Context for Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: While Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) excel at synthesizing high-fidelity videos, enabling precise camera and scene control remains challenging. Existing methods predominantly rely on implicit diffusion priors to generate unobserved regions, inevitably leading to structural collapse during high-dynamic movements or complex occlusions. To address this challenge, we propose Real2SAM2Real, a framework that leverages 3D lifting models (e.g., SAM3D) to extract an explicitly editable 3D cache, serving as a robust geometric scaffold for the VDM. By capturing the entire 3D volume of foreground entities rather than just their visible shells, this cache injects holistic spatial priors into the VDM, providing dependable 3D-aware guidance for complex scene dynamics. To effectively leverage this 3D guidance while preserving pre-trained priors, we design a Soft Spatial-Aligned Injection mechanism alongside a minimally invasive fine-tuning strategy tailored for VDMs. Furthermore, we employ masked normal maps as a cross-modal bridge to construct a 3D-free data curation and perturbation pipeline. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Real2SAM2Real enables precise, decoupled control over both camera trajectories and multi-entity motions. By utilizing the complementary context from generative 3D caches, our framework overcomes typical breakdowns caused by over-reliance on diffusion priors, maintaining exceptional spatiotemporal consistency under large camera shifts and severe occlusions. Crucially, by decoupling geometry from appearance, our VDM-tailored 3D cache eradicates perspective ambiguities caused by structural holes and erroneous facades, as well as misleading cues from reflections and refractions. Project website is available at https://jiayi-wu-leo.github.io/real2sam2real
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Real2SAM2Real 框架，利用 SAM3D 等 3D 提升模型提取显式可编辑的 3D 缓存，作为视频扩散模型 (VDM) 的几何骨架，以实现精确的相机轨迹和多实体运动解耦控制。通过软空间对齐注入机制和最小侵入微调策略，该框架在复杂遮挡和大相机位移下保持时空一致性，并消除由结构孔洞、错误立面及反射折射导致的视角模糊。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型主要依赖隐式扩散先验生成未观测区域，在高动态运动或复杂遮挡时易出现结构坍塌。
Method: 使用 3D 提升模型 (如 SAM3D) 提取前景实体的完整 3D 体积作为显式缓存，设计软空间对齐注入机制和最小侵入微调策略，并利用掩膜法向图作为跨模态桥梁构建无 3D 的数据增强管道。
Result: 实验表明该方法能够精确解耦控制相机轨迹与多实体运动，在大相机位移和严重遮挡下保持优异的时空一致性，消除了结构孔洞和反射折射等误导性线索。
Conclusion: 通过将几何与外观解耦，VDM 专用的 3D 缓存克服了过度依赖扩散先验导致的典型故障，为视频生成提供了可靠的 3D 感知指导。

papers.title: Symmetric Hermite quadrature-based balanced truncation for learning linear dynamical systems from derivative data
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven reduced-order modeling is an essential component in the computer-aided design of control systems. In this work, we present a novel symmetric Hermite formulation of the quadrature-based balanced truncation algorithm that constructs linear reduced-order models from evaluations of the full-order system's transfer function and its derivative. Significantly, the Hermite formulation preserves desirable qualitative properties of the system used to generate the data, such as state-space Hermiticity and, consequently, asymptotic stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于对称Hermite正交的平衡截断算法，从全阶系统传递函数及其导数的数据构建线性降阶模型。该方法保留了状态空间的Hermite性质，从而保证渐近稳定性。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动降阶建模方法在处理导数数据时可能破坏系统固有性质（如Hermite对称性和稳定性），本文旨在设计一种保留这些性质的算法。
Method: 采用对称Hermite形式的正交基平衡截断算法，利用系统传递函数及其导数的评估数据构建线性降阶模型。
Result: 摘要中未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法能够保持状态空间的Hermite性及渐近稳定性。
Conclusion: 本文的方法在理论上保证了从导数数据学习的降阶模型能保留关键系统性质，适用于控制设计等应用。

papers.title: Is Zero-Shot Super-Resolution Possible in Operator Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators are often reported to exhibit zero-shot super-resolution, a phenomenon in which a model trained on coarse grids produces accurate predictions on finer testing grids without additional retraining. Despite strong empirical evidence, the theoretical foundations of this phenomenon remain unclear. In this work, we provide a systematic theoretical study of zero-shot super-resolution in operator learning. We first show that zero-shot super-resolution can be information-theoretically impossible even in benign settings such as when the input functions are available over the entire continuum and the ground truth is a simple rank-one linear operator. We then identify H{\" o}lder smoothness of the output functions as a sufficient condition for zero-shot super-resolution and derive corresponding generalization bounds. Finally, we also validate the identified failure modes through experimental results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对算子学习中的零样本超分辨率（zero-shot super-resolution）现象进行了系统的理论研究。结果表明即使在理想条件下（如输入函数在整个连续域上可用且真值为简单的秩一线性算子），零样本超分辨率在信息论意义下也可能不可实现。进一步指出输出函数的Hölder光滑性是零样本超分辨率的充分条件，并推导了相应的泛化界。实验验证了理论识别的失败模式。
Motivation: 虽然算子学习在粗网格上训练后能在细网格上准确预测（零样本超分辨率）有实证支持，但其理论基础尚不清晰。作者旨在填补这一理论空白，解释何时零样本超分辨率可能或不可能。
Method: 采用信息论和泛化界分析的方法，通过构造反例证明零样本超分辨率的信息论不可能性，然后给出Hölder光滑性作为充分条件的理论证明，并推导泛化界。
Result: 证明零样本超分辨率即使在简单设置（如秩一线性算子、连续输入）下也可能信息论不可实现；同时识别出输出函数的Hölder光滑性可作为实现零样本超分辨率的充分条件。
Conclusion: 本文为算子学习中的零样本超分辨率提供了理论边界，揭示了其不可能性的条件和充分条件，并实验验证了理论失败模式。

papers.title: Adaptive Order Policies for Masked Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models have seen great success in capturing data distributions over discrete sequences in domains such as text and proteins. These models generate data by iteratively unmasking tokens starting from a fully masked sequence, with the unmasking order typically chosen at random or using a heuristic based on denoiser probabilities. In this work, we propose a scheme for learning the unmasking order using an additional lightweight policy network on top of a diffusion model. Our proposed loss reweights terms in the masked diffusion loss according to policy probabilities, and results in a policy that prefers positions where the denoiser is more likely to be correct. We study this loss in two settings: (i) training solely the policy while using a frozen pre-trained denoiser, and (ii) training the policy and denoiser jointly with the weighted loss to allow for mutual adaptation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms common heuristics on problems that are sensitive to token ordering, such as combinatorial tasks and proteins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对离散序列的掩码扩散模型，提出通过轻量级策略网络学习解掩码顺序，使用概率加权的损失项训练，使策略偏好去噪器更可能正确的位置。在组合任务和蛋白质上优于启发式方法。
Motivation: 现有掩码扩散模型的解掩码顺序多采用随机或启发式策略，缺乏对任务敏感顺序的优化能力，尤其在顺序依赖的任务中表现有限。
Method: 在扩散模型上附加策略网络以学习解掩码顺序；损失函数根据策略概率对掩码扩散损失项重新加权。实验包括冻结去噪器训练策略和联合训练两种设置。
Result: 在组合任务和蛋白质等顺序敏感问题上，该方法优于常用的启发式顺序策略。
Conclusion: 学习解掩码顺序可显著提升掩码扩散模型在顺序敏感任务上的性能，且策略网络与去噪器的联合训练能带来相互适应收益。

papers.title: Accurate Large-sample Uncertainty Quantification using Stochastic Gradient Markov Chain Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Tuning algorithms such as stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD) for approximate sampling and uncertainty quantification remains challenging, particularly in the practically relevant settings when the batch size is large or the model is misspecified. Existing theory that provides tuning guidance relies on continuous-time limits or strong statistical assumptions, which can become quantitatively inaccurate in these regimes. We address these shortcomings by proposing new discrete-time approximations to SG(L)D with and without momentum, which enables accurate predictions of the stationary covariance, iterate average covariance, and integrated autocorrelation time. Moreover, we prove quantitative, non-asymptotic error bounds showing that these estimates are sufficiently accurate for practical tuning and uncertainty quantification. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our theory yields improved tuning guidance across a range of models and data-generating distributions where existing approaches fail, including when using the $β$-divergence rather than log-loss to obtain statistically robust inferences.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机梯度下降（SGD）和随机梯度Langevin动力学（SGLD）在大批量或模型设定错误时的不确定量化难题，提出新的离散时间近似方法，能够准确预测平稳协方差、迭代平均协方差和积分自相关时间，并给出定量非渐近误差界。实验表明，该方法在现有理论失效的多种模型和数据分布下提供了更好的调优指导，包括使用β-散度代替对数损失以获得统计鲁棒推断。
Motivation: 现有SG(L)D的调优理论依赖于连续时间极限或强统计假设，在大批量或模型误设定时量化不准确，导致实际中不确定量化困难。
Method: 提出带或不带动量的SG(L)D的离散时间近似，通过新推导的协方差和自相关时间表达式实现精确预测，并给出非渐近误差界。
Result: 理论预测的平稳协方差、迭代平均协方差和积分自相关时间在数值实验中准确，且在多种模型和数据分布（包括使用β-散度时）下优于现有方法的调优指导。
Conclusion: 所提离散时间近似为SG(L)D的调优和不确定量化提供了实用的理论工具，尤其在现有方法失效的大批量或模型误设定场景中有效。

papers.title: The Representation-Rationalizability Tradeoff in Reward Learning
papers.abstract_en: In RLHF, each training example contains a prompt $x$ and two candidate responses $y,y'$, and annotators provide pairwise preferences between these responses. The learning problem is to convert these heterogeneous pairwise judgments into a single scalar reward $r(x,y)$ that measures response quality for each prompt. Classical social choice implies an impossibility because heterogeneous annotator samples can induce pooled preferences with Condorcet cycles, so no scalar reward can evaluate all compared response pairs consistently. A growing literature analyzes RLHF as a social-choice problem, but usually assumes a fixed finite set of alternatives, i.e., a pre-enumerated finite set of candidate responses for each prompt. Modern pipelines instead score responses through a learned representation $φ(x,y)$ before a scalar head, so $φ$ determines which responses are treated as distinguishable alternatives and which comparisons are visible to the reward model. Once this embedding is part of the problem, the impossibility results from social choice theory become a tradeoff. We show that the excess cross-entropy loss of any reward built on $φ$ decomposes exactly into a representational term, which a richer $φ$ shrinks, and an aggregation term, which a richer $φ$ enlarges by exposing more comparisons that no scalar can rank consistently. The same results extend to direct preference optimization (DPO), and jointly training the embedding and the reward cannot guarantee to recover the sweet spot of this tradeoff. Experiments on synthetic data and real preference datasets corroborate our results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究RLHF中奖励学习的一个基本权衡：表示能力与理性可聚合性之间的冲突。当使用更丰富的表示时，可以区分更多响应，但也会暴露更多无法被单一标量奖励一致排序的比较对，导致聚合损失增加。
Motivation: 现有RLHF方法通常忽略标注者偏好的异质性和潜在的Condorcet循环问题，而经典社会选择理论表明不可能将任意偏好聚合为单一标量。本文旨在揭示表示学习如何引入这种权衡。
Method: 形式化奖励学习问题，将偏好数据分解为表示项和聚合项，证明基于φ的奖励的交叉熵损失可精确分解为两项：表示损失随φ丰富度减小，聚合损失随φ丰富度增大。该结果也扩展到直接偏好优化（DPO）。
Result: 在合成数据和真实偏好数据集上实验，验证了表示-理性权衡的存在：更丰富的表示确实降低表示损失但增加聚合损失，且联合训练嵌入和奖励不能保证自动找到最优平衡点。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了奖励学习中表示能力与理性可聚合性之间的根本权衡，表明单纯增加表示维度可能适得其反，需要谨慎设计表示空间。

papers.title: Inner Product Aware Quantization: Provably Fast, Accurate, and Adaptive Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is a fundamental tool used to compress datasets, neural network weights, and memory usage in a range of computational tasks. Many downstream applications of vector quantization perform inner products with arbitrary inputs. This motivates the study of inner product aware quantization schemes that approximately preserve inner products with unseen vectors -- in contrast to simply minimizing the mean-squared error. In this work, we formulate objectives that capture natural desiderata and develop adaptive and unbiased quantization methods that approximately preserve inner products with worst-case and average-case inputs. An analysis of these objectives shows a tight connection with the well-studied notion of Adaptive Stochastic Quantization (ASQ). We develop provably fast exact and approximate algorithms for our objectives. Our theoretical results inspire efficient practical algorithms that perform well across a variety of workload distributions. They also lead to practical algorithms for standard ASQ which are 2-10$\times$ faster than prior state-of-the-art methods while maintaining quality. These theoretical and empirical results contribute towards making adaptive quantization techniques more efficient and tractable in practical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究内积感知量化 (inner product aware quantization) 方法，旨在压缩向量数据的同时近似保持与任意未见向量的内积。作者提出自适应、无偏的量化目标，分析表明其与自适应随机量化 (ASQ) 紧密相关，并设计了快速精确与近似算法。实验表明，所提算法在多种工作负载分布上表现良好，并将标准 ASQ 的速度提升 2-10 倍。
Motivation: 现有量化方法多关注均方误差，但在下游任务（如内积计算）中未必最优。本文致力于设计能近似保持内积的量化方案，以提升压缩数据在后续运算中的实用性。
Method: 形式化内积感知量化的期望目标，建立与 ASQ 的联系；提出基于局部敏感性哈希和重要性采样的快速精确与近似算法。
Result: 理论分析表明所提目标与 ASQ 等价；实际算法在保持量化质量的前提下，使 ASQ 运行速度提升 2-10 倍。
Conclusion: 本文的理论与实证结果使自适应量化技术在实际应用中更高效、更易处理。

papers.title: Model-Native Computing Architecture: Envisioning Future System Architecture Through the Lens of Computer Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are undergoing a transition from model technology to system technology. As developers use Codex, Claude Code, AutoGPT, and related agents to write code, manage projects, and execute multi-step tasks, recurring engineering problems such as cache reuse, context management, agent scheduling, and permission control increasingly resemble classical computer systems problems. This paper develops that analogy as a visionary survey. We map concepts from computer architecture to the emerging model-native stack and review work on LLM-as-OS, memory management, agent frameworks, tool protocols, multi-agent coordination, cognitive architectures, and safety governance. We argue that these strands address different layers of the same system but lack a unified model. To fill this gap, we propose the Intelligent Computing Architecture Model (ICAM), a six-layer framework for model-native computing with explicit interface contracts and design axioms. ICAM resolves the apparent tension over whether an LLM is more like a CPU or an operating system through a dual-plane view: a probabilistic execution plane concerned with what can be computed, and a deterministic control plane concerned with what should be computed. We further introduce three design laws: the Semantic Locality Law for KV-cache reuse and inference speedup, the Context Budget Law for effective working sets under finite windows and attention decay, and the Agent Speedup Law for diminishing returns in multi-agent collaboration. We validate these laws against published system-level data and relate them to recent evidence on agentic software practices. We conclude by identifying where the analogy breaks down and outlining a research roadmap for model-native computing. This is a conceptual and survey contribution; it does not report new experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以计算机架构视角系统性地类比大语言模型（LLM）与经典计算机系统，提出模型原生计算架构（ICAM）六层框架，包含概率执行平面和确定性控制平面的双平面视图，并给出三条设计定律。
Motivation: LLM 正从模型技术转向系统技术，但分散的工程问题（如缓存复用、上下文管理、智能体调度）缺乏统一模型。
Method: 通过综述现有 LLM-as-OS、内存管理、智能体框架等工作，提出 ICAM 六层架构和三条设计定律（语义局部性定律、上下文预算定律、智能体加速定律）。
Result: 三条定律通过已发表的系统级数据得到初步验证，并关联了近期智能体软件实践证据。
Conclusion: 论文为概念性和综述性贡献，未报告新实验，指出类比局限并给出研究路线图。

papers.title: Synthetic Data from Cross-Domain Events for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale recommendation systems operate across diverse domains, yet they face the challenges of data sparsity and noisy implicit feedback. Traditional approaches mitigate this via model-specific knowledge distillation from source domains to a target domain. Inspired by the transformative success of synthetic data generation in large language models (LLMs), we introduce Synthetic Cross-domain Augmentation and Learning for Recommendation (SCALR), a framework that generates synthetic user-item interaction events for a target recommendation domain by leveraging observed events from a source domain. SCALR decomposes cross-domain learning into two modular stages. First, it translates observed user events in source domains by framing event generation as estimating the likelihood that a user would interact with a target-domain item, conditioned on their observed interactions in a source domain. Second, downstream models train on these synthetic events as cross-domain learning objectives, where the synthetic events augment the target domain's training data in a model-agnostic manner. Our approach yields statistically significant improvements in online A/B tests on an industrial recommendation platform. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first works to explicitly frame cross-domain event transfer as synthetic data generation for recommendation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCALR 框架，通过源域事件生成目标域的合成用户-物品交互事件，用于大规模推荐系统的跨域数据增强。该方法在工业推荐平台的在线 A/B 测试中取得统计显著的提升，是首批将跨域事件迁移明确视为合成数据生成的工作之一。
Motivation: 大规模推荐系统面临数据稀疏和隐式反馈噪声的问题，现有跨域方法依赖模型特定的知识蒸馏，缺乏通用性。
Method: SCALR 将跨域学习分解为两个模块：首先基于源域观察事件估计用户与目标域物品交互的概率以生成合成事件，然后下游模型以模型无关的方式在合成事件上训练。
Result: 在线 A/B 测试显示该方法在工业推荐平台上取得统计显著的提升。
Conclusion: 该工作首次将跨域事件迁移形式化为合成数据生成，为推荐系统提供了一种模块化、模型无关的增强方案。

papers.title: Flow Matching for Convective-Scale Precipitation Downscaling
papers.abstract_en: Generative machine learning is an increasingly important complement to dynamical downscaling for producing high-resolution precipitation projections, with diffusion models currently the leading approach. Flow matching is a related generative framework that has recently achieved strong results across image, video and other domains, and shown early promise for downscaling. We train a flow matching model to map daily precipitation from 8 km to 2 km over a convective-scale domain centred on Singapore, and benchmark it against CPMGEM, a score-based diffusion model. Flow matching achieves consistently better spatial skill: higher fractions skill score at every precipitation threshold and neighbourhood scale tested, and tighter structure and amplitude components of the SAL score with comparable location skill. However, flow matching underestimates the upper tail of the precipitation distribution, resulting in a dry bias in the climatological mean. These results suggest that flow matching is a competitive generative framework for convective-scale precipitation downscaling, particularly well suited to capturing spatial structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对流匹配（flow matching）在对流尺度降水降尺度任务上的应用进行了基准测试，以新加坡区域为中心，将每日降水从8 km分辨率映射到2 km。与主流的基于分数的扩散模型CPMGEM相比，流匹配在所有测试的降水阈值和邻域尺度上均取得了更高的分数技巧分数（fractions skill score），并在SAL评分中展现出更紧凑的结构和幅度分量，但位置技巧相当。然而，流匹配低估了降水分布的上尾，导致气候平均场出现干偏差。研究结果表明，流匹配是对流尺度降水降尺度的一种有竞争力的生成框架，尤其擅长捕捉空间结构。
Motivation: 生成式机器学习已成为动力降尺度生成高分辨率降水预测的重要补充，但当前扩散模型是主流方法，而流匹配作为相关生成框架在图像、视频等领域表现优异，但在降水降尺度领域的潜力尚未充分探索。
Method: 作者训练了一个流匹配模型，将每日降水从8 km降尺度到2 km，并基于新加坡的对流尺度区域进行验证，同时以基于分数的扩散模型CPMGEM作为对比基准。
Result: 流匹配在空间技巧上持续优于CPMGEM：所有降水阈值和邻域尺度下的分数技巧分数更高，SAL评分中的结构和幅度分量更紧凑，位置技巧相当；但流匹配显著低估了降水分布的上尾，导致平均气候场出现干偏差。
Conclusion: 流匹配是对流尺度降水降尺度的有效生成框架，特别适合捕捉空间结构，但其对上尾的偏差需要进一步改进。

papers.title: Bit-Exact AI Inference Verification Without Performance Tradeoffs
papers.abstract_en: Verifying claims about AI workloads is a pre- requisite for credible AI governance of covert adversaries (who comply with monitoring only when detection likelihood is high), yet the ap- parent non-determinism of GPU floating-point arithmetic forces auditors to accept approximate output matches. Covert adversaries can exploit un- verifiable degrees of freedom in monitored compu- tation. Attack vectors include steganography, un- reported modification of inference software, and covert computation via unreported batch elements. Empirically, we analyze how modern inference engines (vLLM, HF transformers) produce deter- ministic but non-invariant outputs, without need- ing to set performance-compromising determin- ism flags, if the right information is available for re-computation and no atomic functions are called in the backend. We demonstrate that such bitwise- precise re-computation does not require access to identical hardware, via a software-only emula- tion of LLM inference across multiple NVIDIA GPU variants. Thus, accumulated rounding errors can be an auditable signature of the software and hardware setup used for inference, instead of a constraint on verifiability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对GPU浮点运算非确定性导致AI推理验证困难的问题，分析了vLLM、Hugging Face Transformers等推理引擎。结果显示，在不调用原子函数且具备重计算所需信息时，这些引擎能产生确定性输出。通过跨不同NVIDIA GPU的软件仿真，实现了无需相同硬件的比特精确重计算，将累积舍入误差用作软硬件设置的审计签名。
Motivation: GPU浮点运算的非确定性迫使审计者接受近似输出，留下被隐蔽攻击者利用的漏洞（如隐写术、未报告的软件修改等）。需要一种不牺牲性能的比特精确验证方法。
Method: 分析现代推理引擎在未设置性能妥协的确定性标志时产生确定性输出的条件；提出通过软件模拟跨不同NVIDIA GPU的LLM推理，实现比特精确重计算。
Result: 摘要表明，若重计算信息可用且后端无原子函数，推理引擎输出为确定性。跨GPU变体的软件仿真验证了比特精确重计算可行性，证明累积舍入误差可作为软硬件设置的审计签名。
Conclusion: 累积舍入误差应被视为可审计的签名而非可验证性的约束，从而在不牺牲性能的前提下实现AI推理的比特精确验证。

papers.title: Evaluating Bivariate Causal Statements Based on Mutual Compatibility
papers.abstract_en: For many real-world systems, causal ground truth is difficult to obtain, making claims about causal effects hard to assess. We develop methods for evaluating collections of $\binom{n}{2}$ bivariate causal statements over a set of $n$ variables. In the setting of acyclic linear statements, any such collection can be extended to a unique multivariate causal model, but we argue that this induced model is implausible if it imposes substantial additional confounding to explain observed correlations. We introduce a compatibility score that quantifies this notion of plausibility, notably without relying on the faithfulness assumption. Additionally, we define an incompatibility score for purely graphical bivariate causal statements, based on global consistency constraints that are derived from acyclicity and faithfulness assumptions. We give theoretical and empirical evidence that both scores can successfully distinguish correct from incorrect causal statements in generic settings. Moreover, we demonstrate the practical applicability of our methods by analyzing causal claims made by large language models. Our work aims to provide a foundation for assessing the reliability of causal information derived from human experts or artificial intelligence in settings where alternative forms of validation are unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现实系统中难以获得因果真相的问题，提出评估一组n个变量上的二元因果陈述集的方法。对于无环线性因果陈述，每个集合可唯一扩展为多元因果模型，但作者指出若该模型需引入大量额外混杂才能解释观测相关性，则不可信。他们引入无需信仰假设的兼容性分数，以及基于无环性和信仰假设的纯图形不兼容性分数。理论和实验表明两者在一般设定下能有效区分正确与错误因果陈述，并通过分析大语言模型产生的因果声明确认了实用性。该方法为在缺乏验证手段时评估因果信息的可靠性提供了基础。
Motivation: 现实系统中因果真相难以获取，现有方法难以评估一组因果陈述的集体合理性。
Method: 针对无环线性因果陈述，将任意集合唯一扩展为多元因果模型，并通过评估该模型所需的额外混杂程度定义兼容性分数；同时基于全局一致性约束定义纯图形不兼容性分数。
Result: 理论和经验证据表明，两种分数在一般设定下能成功区分正确与错误的二元因果陈述；分析大语言模型产生的因果声明确认了实际可用性。
Conclusion: 该方法为在缺乏替代验证方式时评估来自人类专家或AI的因果信息可靠性提供了基础。

papers.title: Hyperbolic and Evidence-Prioritized Experts for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance on multimodal tasks through scaled architectures and extensive training. Recent studies introduce Mixture of Experts (MoE) into LVLMs for improved computational efficiency. However, existing MoE approaches treat visual and linguistic modalities with symmetric architectures, overlooking the inherent asymmetry in how these two modalities are processed. This asymmetry causes two critical issues. First, text and vision form hierarchical rather than parallel relationships, as text queries typically describe partial aspects of complete visual scenes. Euclidean expert space struggles to encode such containment structures. Second, language experts in deeper layers progressively shift from evidence-based processing to parametric memory dependence, losing grounding in the provided visual and linguistic information. To address these issues, we propose AsyMoE, a novel architecture that explicitly models this asymmetry through three specialized expert groups. Intra-modality experts handle modality-specific processing. Hyperbolic inter-modality experts capture hierarchical cross-modal relationships through negative curvature geometry. Evidence-priority language experts suppress parametric memory activation and maintain contextual grounding throughout network depth. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AsyMoE achieves consistent improvements over baseline methods, with average gains of 1.5\% over MoE variants and up to 3.8\% on hallucination-sensitive tasks. AsyMoE activates 25.45\% fewer parameters compared to dense models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AsyMoE架构，针对大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中视觉和语言模态的不对称性，通过三类专家组（模态内专家、双曲跨模态专家和证据优先语言专家）进行建模。双曲空间利用负曲率几何捕捉层次化的跨模态关系，证据优先语言专家抑制参数记忆依赖以保持上下文锚定。实验显示AsyMoE在多任务上平均提升1.5%，在幻觉敏感任务上提升3.8%，同时比密集模型减少25.45%的参数。
Motivation: 现有MoE方法对视觉和语言模态采用对称架构，忽略了两种模态处理的内在不对称性，导致欧几里得空间难以编码文本与视觉的层次关系，且深层语言专家逐渐依赖参数记忆而丢失证据基础。
Method: 提出AsyMoE，包含三类专家组：模态内专家处理模态特定特征；双曲跨模态专家通过负曲率几何捕获层次化跨模态关系；证据优先语言专家抑制参数记忆激活，保持深层网络的上下文锚定。
Result: 实验在多个LVLM基准上一致优于基线，平均比MoE变体提升1.5%，在幻觉敏感任务上提升高达3.8%，且激活参数比密集模型少25.45%。
Conclusion: AsyMoE通过明确建模模态不对称性，提升了LVLM的计算效率和幻觉鲁棒性，但论文未讨论在非层次化任务或大规模多模态预训练中的泛化能力。

papers.title: On Wednesdays, We Ask Questions: Optimizing "Active Listening" in Automated Legal Triage and Referral
papers.abstract_en: The FETCH classifier generates follow-up questions to help refine the best match for the applicant's legal problem, using a low-cost ensemble of LLMs. In this paper, we describe an expert attorney and LLM-assisted evaluation of the follow-up question approach in FETCH and show that while low-cost LLMs perform well at classification tasks, generating high-quality plain-language questions in this setting appears to require a more sophisticated and higher-cost model. Through discussion with legal intake workers, we propose a rubric for the evaluation of legal intake classification questions, and we find that prompt engineering alone is not enough to improve question quality for intake purposes. We also find that LLM-as-judge and human ratings diverge. We demonstrate that with the addition of a single high-cost model, GPT-5, the classifier can elicit relevant information from applicants for legal help, and that the questions lead to more accurate performance at classification tasks. We also find uneven fact elicitation across different categories, including domestic violence, at odds with family law screening protocols, suggesting the value of including dedicated screening panels for certain areas of law.
papers.comment: Working paper submitted as accepted to AIDA2J workshop at International Conference for AI and Law in Singapore, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍FETCH分类器，通过低成本LLM集成为法律求助者生成后续问题以优化案件分类。评估发现低成本LLM分类准确但问题质量差，而高成本模型GPT-5能提升问题质量并提高分类准确率；不同法律类别（如家庭暴力）的事实引导不均匀，提示需专用筛查面板。
Motivation: 现有法律分类系统缺乏交互式问题引导，难以准确分类复杂法律问题，需优化问题生成以提升分类效果。
Method: 使用低成本LLM集成构建FETCH分类器，生成后续问题；通过法律专家和LLM辅助评估问题质量；引入GPT-5提升问题生成能力。
Result: 低成本LLM分类任务表现好，但生成高质量问题需要高成本模型；GPT-5能引导相关信息，提升分类准确率；不同类别的事实引导不均匀，与法律筛查协议不一致。
Conclusion: 提示工程不足以提升问题质量，LLM-as-judge与人类评分不一致；建议在特定法律领域加入专用筛查面板。

papers.title: Robust Shielding for Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Shielding is an effective approach to formally guarantee the safety of reinforcement learning agents in Markov decision processes (MDPs). However, existing shielding techniques typically assume knowledge of the safety-relevant transition dynamics - a requirement that is seldom met in practice. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel shielding framework for robust MDPs (RMDPs), i.e., MDPs with sets of transition probabilities. We define safety as the satisfaction of a linear temporal logic (LTL) formula with a certain threshold probability under the worst-case transition probabilities of the RMDP. We prove that our shielding framework is both sound and optimal for the RMDP: every policy admissible by the shield is safe, and conversely, every safe RMDP policy is admissible by the shield. We combine our approach with existing sampling methods for learning transition probabilities of MDPs with probably approximately correct (PAC) guarantees. This combination enables the construction of shields for MDPs that, with high confidence, guarantee safety while remaining minimally restrictive. Our experiments show that our shields for learned RMDPs guarantee safety in unknown MDPs while recovering strong expected return as the number of samples increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有屏蔽技术需要已知安全相关转移动力学的局限，提出了一种基于鲁棒MDP（RMDP）的屏蔽框架，在不确定转移概率下保证线性时序逻辑（LTL）安全，并证明其既完备又最优。结合PAC采样方法，可在未知MDP中以高置信度构造安全且最小限制的屏蔽。实验表明，随着样本增多，该方法在未知MDP中保证安全并恢复高期望回报。
Motivation: 现有屏蔽技术通常假设已知安全相关的转移动力学，这在实践中难以满足。本文旨在解决这一局限，在模型不确定的情况下提供正式的安全保证。
Method: 提出一种针对RMDP的屏蔽框架，其中安全定义为在RMDP最坏转移概率下以一定阈值概率满足LTL公式。证明该屏蔽既可靠（任何被采纳的策略都是安全的）又最优（任何安全策略都可被采纳）。结合PAC样本方法学习MDP转移概率，构建高置信度安全且最小限制的屏蔽。
Result: 在未知MDP上，屏蔽保证了安全，且随样本数增加恢复强期望回报。
Conclusion: 该屏蔽框架能够处理模型不确定性，为强化学习提供正式安全保证，且在实践中有效。

papers.title: Closed-Loop Neural Activation Control in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can be steered at test time by intervening on semantically meaningful internal directions, but existing methods use a fixed steering coefficient, effectively operating in open loop. This is poorly suited to embodied control, where task state and concept error evolve over time, often causing overcorrection, oscillation, and reduced task success, especially for temporal behaviors such as speed and smoothness. We propose CTRL-STEER, a closed-loop framework that replaces static intervention strength with adaptive, time-varying control signals. The key idea is to decouple representation from regulation: rather than assuming temporal concepts are directly controlled by individual neurons, we steer along motion-aligned residual directions while a feedback controller adjusts intervention magnitude online. We instantiate this framework with both PID and reinforcement learning based controllers. Experiments with a fine-tuned OpenVLA policy on four LIBERO task suites show that CTRL-STEER achieves more stable concept regulation and a better steering-task success trade-off than fixed-coefficient baselines, without modifying or retraining the base model.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF CVPR 2026 Workshop on Visual Concepts (VisCon). 25 pages, 8 figures, including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CTRL-STEER，一种闭环控制框架，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的固定干预强度替换为自适应时变控制信号，通过解耦表示与调节，沿运动对齐的残差方向进行干预，并使用PID或强化学习控制器在线调整干预幅度。在微调的OpenVLA策略上，LIBERO任务套件的实验表明，CTRL-STEER在保持基础模型不变的情况下，实现了更稳定的概念调节和更好的操控-任务成功权衡。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在测试时通过干预语义方向进行控制，但使用固定干预系数（开环）不适合具身控制，因为任务状态和概念误差随时间变化，导致过度校正、振荡和任务成功率降低，尤其是在速度和平滑度等时间行为上。
Method: 提出CTRL-STEER闭环框架，核心是解耦表示与调节：不假设时间概念直接由单个神经元控制，而是沿运动对齐的残差方向进行干预，同时反馈控制器（PID或强化学习）在线调整干预幅度。
Result: 在LIBERO任务套件上的实验表明，相比固定系数基线，CTRL-STEER实现了更稳定的概念调节和更好的操控-任务成功权衡，且无需修改或重训基础模型。
Conclusion: CTRL-STEER展示了闭环控制在VLA模型测试时干预中的有效性，为具身控制中的自适应调节提供了新思路。

papers.title: StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Video world models (WMs) have shown promise for policy evaluation and improvement by imagining realistic future observations conditioned on ego-robot actions. While WMs can model distributions over futures, policy evaluation and improvement typically rely on nominal imaginations, which can miss high-impact outcomes of robot actions unless prohibitively many samples are drawn. To enable robust policy evaluation and improvement over WM imaginations, we propose StressDream, which steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified at inference time by optimizing the initial noise of diffusion-based WMs. However, optimizing high-dimensional noise is challenging: the optimization must reason about nuanced, scene-dependent target events in generated videos while avoiding out-of-distribution (OOD) noise that yields implausible imaginations. We address this with two complementary objectives: a semantic objective with a Vision-Language Model that provides informative gradients by reasoning about the generated video, and a plausibility objective that prevents the optimized noise from drifting OOD. With state-of-the-art video world models for autonomous driving and robotic manipulation, we show that StressDream effectively steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified by text at inference time, such as task failures, enabling robust policy evaluation and improvement by identifying actions whose plausible futures include undesirable outcomes. Video results are available at https://junwon.me/StressDream/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StressDream，一种通过优化扩散模型初始噪声来引导视频世界模型想象的方法，使其在策略评估和改善中聚焦于高影响且合理的未来场景（如任务失败）。在自动驾驶和机器人操作任务中，该方法能有效基于文本指定目标生成相关想象，从而支持鲁棒的策略评估与改进。
Motivation: 视频世界模型可以模拟未来分布，但策略评估与改善通常依赖名义想象，忽略高影响结果，除非大量采样。需要一种方法在推理时引导想象至关键且合理的场景。
Method: StressDream通过优化扩散模型的初始噪声，结合两个互补目标：语义目标利用视觉语言模型（VLM）提供可微梯度，合理性目标防止噪声偏离分布产生不合理想象。
Result: 在自动驾驶和机器人操作的最先进视频世界模型上，StressDream能有效根据文本指定（如任务失败）引导想象产生高影响且合理的未来，从而识别导致不利后果的动作。

papers.title: KISS: Keeping it Simple and Slotted when Learning to Communicate over Wireless
papers.abstract_en: A long-standing challenge in distributed wireless systems is ensuring efficient and fair random channel access. Existing solutions often address specific constraints related to timing, periodicity, or centralization, but they typically rely on fixed heuristics. Motivated by recent advances in machine learning (ML), we investigate whether ML agents can autonomously learn efficient and fair access strategies, and whether such learning can offer new insights into medium access control (MAC) design. Rather than proposing a deployable protocol, our aim is to examine whether decentralized learning can rediscover or approximate theoretically efficient random-access mechanisms under minimal assumptions. To this end, we deploy an off-policy Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) with Bayesian inference to train agents operating over a slotted channel. The resulting method is fully online (no pre-training), fully distributed (independent multi-agent learners), stochastic (non-periodic), and requires no coordination or explicit communication. Extensive simulations show that the learned strategy adapts to varying network conditions and achieves near-theoretical efficiency while maintaining fairness. Ablation studies further reveal that the learned behavior resembles slotted ALOHA with a dynamically adjusted transmission probability, leading us to refer to the method as KISS: Keeping It Simple and Slotted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式无线系统中，使用离策略双深度Q网络（DDQN）结合贝叶斯推断，让智能体在时隙信道上自主学习高效公平的随机信道接入策略。该方法完全在线、分布式、随机且无需协调，仿真表明其适应网络变化并接近理论效率，同时保持公平性。消融实验发现学习行为类似动态调整传输概率的时隙ALOHA，因此命名为KISS。
Motivation: 现有分布式无线信道接入方案通常依赖固定启发式或强加特定约束（如时序、周期性或中心化），缺乏通用性和适应性。本文探索机器学习能否在没有先验知识的情况下，自动发现高效公平的随机接入策略，并为MAC设计提供新见解。
Method: 采用离策略双深度Q网络（DDQN）结合贝叶斯推断训练多智能体，每个智能体独立决策，在时隙信道上在线学习发送概率。无需预训练、无中心协调、无显式通信，完全分布式且随机非周期。
Result: 仿真结果显示，学习策略在不同网络条件下自适应，达到接近理论极限的效率，同时维持公平性。消融实验表明行为等效于动态调整发送概率的时隙ALOHA协议。
Conclusion: 本文证明纯分布式强化学习可无需协调地重新发现接近最优的随机接入策略，为MAC设计提供了简单高效的基线思路。方法限于时隙信道，未在非时隙或更复杂场景验证。

papers.title: Out-of-Distribution generalization of quantile regression with heavy tailed inputs: an SVM approach
papers.abstract_en: We study quantile regression in an extrapolation regime where the covariate takes unusually large values. Under regular variation assumptions, extreme observations can be effectively characterized through their angular components, enabling learning strategies that focus on the angle of the most extreme observations. This approach is formalized through the minimization of an asymptotic conditional risk that localizes learning in the tail of the covariate distribution. We propose a novel Support Vector Machine (SVM) framework for extreme quantile regression, leveraging reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces to handle high-dimensional and nonlinear settings. Our method also accommodates unbounded response variables and avoids restrictive transformations. We establish finite-sample learning guarantees under mild regularity assumptions. The proposed framework unifies ideas from statistical learning and multivariate extremes, providing a tractable and theoretically grounded approach to extrapolation. We complement our theoretical findings with an empirical study on river flow data from the Danube, demonstrating the practical relevance of our methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究协变量取极值时的分位数回归外推问题，基于正则变化假设，利用极值观测的角度信息进行尾部学习。提出一种新的支持向量机（SVM）框架用于极值分位数回归，通过再生核希尔伯特空间处理高维和非线性场景，允许响应变量无界并避免严格变换。建立了有限样本学习保证，并在多瑙河径流数据上进行了实证验证。
Motivation: 现有分位数回归方法在协变量极端值区域通常失效，缺乏针对重尾输入的理论保证和实用方法。极值理论虽能刻画尾部行为，但如何将其与统计学习框架结合仍是一个开放问题。
Method: 提出基于SVM的极值分位数回归方法：通过最小化渐近条件风险将学习集中在协变量分布尾部，利用角度分量表征极端观测；在RKHS中实现非线性决策边界，并建立有限样本泛化界。
Result: 在理论层面，给出了温和正则性条件下的有限样本学习保证；实证中，多瑙河径流数据上的实验表明该方法能有效预测极端分位数。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了统计学习与多元极值理论，为协变量极端值下的分位数外推提供了可计算且理论严谨的方案。局限性包括对正则变化假设的依赖以及高维场景下的计算扩展性未充分讨论。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: ReFLEX: Length-Generalizable CSI Denoising for MIMO-OFDM via Relative-Frequency Bias
papers.abstract_en: This letter studies CSI denoising for MIMO--OFDM with variable NR resource block (RB) allocations. ReFLEX is a length-generalizable Transformer whose frequency attention uses a relative-frequency position bias (RFPB) generated from subcarrier offsets. A single checkpoint handles unseen RB lengths and can be applied to sparse DM-RS observations in the tested RB5/RB10 PUSCH setup without retraining. In a 3GPP~TR~38.901 UMa NLOS channel, ReFLEX achieves about $-9.6$~dB NMSE on unseen RB lengths. In NR PUSCH/UL-SCH simulations, ReFLEX denoising followed by time-frequency interpolation reduces the 10\% BLER threshold by about 2--3~dB.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, submitted to IEEE journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReFLEX，一种长度可泛化的Transformer，用于MIMO-OFDM系统中变长资源块（RB）分配的CSI去噪。其频率注意力采用相对频率位置偏置（RFPB），使得单个检查点可在未见RB长度上直接应用，无需重新训练。在3GPP TR 38.901 UMa NLOS信道中，ReFLEX对未见RB长度达到约-9.6 dB的NMSE；在NR PUSCH/UL-SCH仿真中，结合时频插值将10% BLER阈值降低约2-3 dB。
Motivation: 现有CSI去噪方法难以泛化到不同的NR资源块（RB）长度分配，需要针对每种配置重新训练，缺乏灵活性。
Method: 设计ReFLEX，一种基于Transformer的架构，其核心是相对频率位置偏置（RFPB），该偏置根据子载波偏移生成，使模型能够处理任意长度的RB分配。
Result: 在3GPP TR 38.901 UMa NLOS信道中，对未见RB长度实现约-9.6 dB NMSE；在NR PUSCH/UL-SCH仿真中，去噪后时频插值使10% BLER阈值降低约2-3 dB。
Conclusion: ReFLEX通过相对频率位置偏置实现了对可变RB长度的泛化，一个模型即可处理多种配置，且无需针对稀疏DM-RS观测重新训练。

papers.title: When Softmax Fails at the Top: Extreme Value Corrections for InfoNCE
papers.abstract_en: InfoNCE is the standard contrastive learning objective, but its softmax form is not only a computational convenience: it also encodes a statistical assumption about how the top-scoring example is selected. Using extreme value theory, we show that this assumption is often misaligned with the normalized embedding setting used in modern contrastive learning. Motivated by this mismatch, we propose \textsc{WEINCE}, a simple modification of InfoNCE that uses anchor-wise online batch statistics to blend the usual softmax logits with an endpoint shortfall correction, adding no trainable parameters. Across five vision benchmarks, \textsc{WEINCE} yields consistent improvements in frozen-feature evaluation. These results show that a more faithful statistical treatment of hard negatives can improve contrastive objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出InfoNCE对比学习目标中的softmax形式在选择最高分样本时隐含了与归一化嵌入设置不匹配的统计假设。基于极值理论，作者提出WEINCE，通过锚点在线批次统计混合softmax logits与端点短尾修正，无需额外参数。在五个视觉基准上，WEINCE在冻结特征评估中取得一致改进。
Motivation: InfoNCE的softmax形式在归一化嵌入的对比学习场景中，其统计假设与数据分布不匹配，导致对困难负样本的处理不够准确。
Method: 提出WEINCE，利用锚点在线批次统计，将标准softmax logits与端点短尾修正（endpoint shortfall correction）混合，不增加可训练参数。
Result: 在五个视觉基准（如ImageNet等）的冻结特征评估中，WEINCE一致优于InfoNCE。
Conclusion: 对困难负样本进行更准确的统计处理可以改进对比学习目标，WEINCE是简单有效的修正方案。

papers.title: The Harsh Truth: Segment-Level Analysis of Harsh Driving Events in Milan Using Large-Scale Telematics, Street Networks, and Google Street View
papers.abstract_en: Police-reported crash statistics remain the standard input for urban road-safety assessment, but their incompleteness and reporting lag limit their usefulness for timely, fine-grained intervention design. Harsh acceleration and braking events are widely used as surrogate safety indicators, but have so far been studied only in comparatively small urban samples. This study analyses harsh events across the urban road network of Milan, combining high-resolution telematics from more than 4.2 million vehicles equipped with On-Board Units, segment-level traffic metrics from TomTom, street-network and infrastructure attributes from OpenStreetMap, and visual streetscape features extracted from Google Street View via semantic segmentation using a OneFormer model. We employ an analytical framework combining non-parametric Mann--Whitney U tests of segment-feature distributions between high- and low-harshness groups with supervised machine-learning regressors. We find that, once exposure is controlled for, wider carriageways, crossings and transit stops, and more open visual fields (higher sky- and road-pixel proportions) are associated with higher harsh-event intensity, while denser built frontage is associated with lower intensity. Finally, the cycling-infrastructure case study identifies a gradient in harsh-event intensity across facility types: markings-only cycle lanes are associated with a 19.5% higher harshness score, and mixed-traffic configurations with an 11.5% higher score, relative to physically separated cycle paths, conditional on the included controls. These results support context-specific rather than uniform urban-safety interventions and illustrate how large-scale telematics combined with open geospatial and visual data can inform Vision Zero decision-making at the metropolitan scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用大规模车辆遥测数据、TomTom交通指标、OpenStreetMap道路网络和Google街景语义分割特征，分析米兰城市道路网络中激进驾驶事件的空间分布。研究发现，在控制暴露量后，更宽的车道、人行横道、公交停靠站以及更开阔的视野与更高的激进事件强度相关，而更密集的建筑临街面与较低强度相关。自行车基础设施案例研究表明，物理隔离自行车道相比仅有标线的自行车道和混合交通配置具有更低的激进事件分数。
Motivation: 警方报告的事故统计数据存在不完整和报告延迟的问题，限制了及时、细粒度的干预设计。因此需要利用替代安全指标（如激进加速和制动事件）进行更大规模的分析。
Method: 结合来自超过420万辆配备车载单元的车辆的遥测数据、TomTom路段级交通指标、OpenStreetMap的道路网络和基础设施属性，以及通过OneFormer模型对Google街景进行语义分割提取的视觉特征。采用非参数Mann-Whitney U检验和机器学习回归器分析高、低激进组之间的特征分布。
Result: 控制暴露量后，更宽的车道、交叉口和公交站、更开阔的视觉场（更高的天空和道路像素比例）与更高的激进事件强度相关，而更密集的建筑临街面与较低强度相关。物理隔离的自行车道相比标线车道和混合交通配置，激进分数分别低19.5%和11.5%。
Conclusion: 这些结果支持针对具体情境而非统一的城市安全干预措施，并展示了大规模遥测数据与开放地理空间和视觉数据如何为Vision Zero决策提供信息。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 控制暴露量后，更宽的车道、交叉口和公交站、更开阔的视觉场（更高的天空和道路像素比例）与更高的激进事件强度相关，而更密集的建筑临街面与较低强度相关。物理隔离的自行车道相比标线车道和混合交通配置，激进分数分别低19.5%和11.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些结果支持针对具体情境而非统一的城市安全干预措施，并展示了大规模遥测数据与开放地理空间和视觉数据如何为Vision Zero决策提供信息。

papers.title: LastAct: Trajectory-Guided Latest-Activity Localization for Real-Time Smart-Home Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from ambient sensors enables smart-home applications such as health monitoring and assisted living. In realistic deployments, however, sensor events arrive as a continuous stream and activity boundaries are unknown. Sliding-window inference therefore produces many windows that straddle transitions and contain mixed activities, creating boundary contamination that violates the pre-segmented instance assumption used by most benchmarks and models. Moreover, many pipelines under-use spatial context by treating sensor IDs as independent tokens. We present LastAct, a trajectory-centric framework for streaming smart-home HAR that targets the most recent activity under mixed windows while explicitly modeling spatial structure. LastAct projects sensor events onto the home floorplan to form a layout-aligned trajectory image sequence that preserves spatial continuity. A lightweight gate identifies contaminated windows, and a boundary localizer estimates the last transition to enable boundary-guided masking that emphasizes post-boundary evidence and suppresses stale context. For efficiency, we reuse a precomputed layout-aligned template cache to avoid repeated rendering. Empirically, across four public smart-home datasets under near-realistic mixed-activity protocols, LastAct achieves competitive or superior performance on pure windows and yields substantial Macro-F1 gains on cross/mixed windows, demonstrating improved robustness under near-realistic sliding-window regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LastAct，一种面向流式智能家居活动识别的轨迹中心框架，针对混合窗口中的最新活动进行定位。通过将传感器事件投影到家庭平面图形成布局对齐的轨迹图像序列，利用轻量级门控识别污染窗口，边界定位器估计最后活动边界以进行边界引导掩码。在四个公开数据集上的近真实混合活动协议下，LastAct在纯窗口上表现竞争性，在交叉/混合窗口上取得显著的Macro-F1提升。
Motivation: 现有滑动窗口方法在处理连续传感器流时，窗口常跨越活动边界导致边界污染，且多数管道未充分利用空间上下文。
Method: 将传感器事件投影到家庭平面图形成布局对齐的轨迹图像序列；轻量级门控识别污染窗口；边界定位器估计最后活动边界进行边界引导掩码；预计算布局对齐模板缓存避免重复渲染。
Result: 在四个公开智能家居数据集上，近真实混合活动协议下，LastAct在纯窗口上性能竞争，在交叉/混合窗口上获得显著的Macro-F1增益。
Conclusion: LastAct在近真实滑动窗口设定下展现出更强的鲁棒性，有效处理了边界污染问题。

papers.title: ARCA: Adapter-Residual Credit Assignment When Token Signals Degenerate
papers.abstract_en: Token-level credit assignment for language-model reinforcement learning is usually formulated as if the policy were fully trainable, while practical LLM-RL pipelines often rely on parameter-efficient fine-tuning, especially LoRA. We argue that this separation hides a structural failure mode. Under LoRA, the policy is restricted to a low-rank neighborhood of the reference model, so the per-token output-distribution differences used by common intrinsic credit signals, surprisal, entropy reduction, and policy divergence, can become degenerate after within-trajectory normalization, either approaching uniform weights or concentrating on a small set of task-agnostic positions. We formalize this behavior and propose measuring it directly with concentration diagnostics such as weight Gini and effective-token ratio. We then introduce \emph{Adapter-Residual Credit Assignment} (ARCA), a lightweight alternative that derives token salience from the adapter's own hidden-state residual, $\|h^{\text{adapted}}_t - h^{\text{base}}_t\|_2$. ARCA asks where the adapter actually changes the model, rather than where the output distribution appears uncertain or shifted, and requires no learned reward model, value head, or tree construction. In a compact MATH/Qwen3-1.7B GRPO sweep, ARCA exhibits the predicted non-degenerate middle-regime credit distribution under matched rollout budgets and remains competitive with rank-matched baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted to DEMO 2026: ICML Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation. Non-archival report
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对参数高效微调（特别是LoRA）下语言模型强化学习中的token级信用分配问题，指出常见内在信用信号在LoRA受限策略下会退化，并提出Adapter-Residual Credit Assignment (ARCA)方法，通过对比适配器隐藏状态残差来分配信用，实验显示在MATH/Qwen3-1.7B GRPO扫查中保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有token级信用分配方法假设策略完全可训练，但在LoRA等参数高效微调下，策略受限导致内在信用信号退化（趋近均匀权重或聚焦于任务无关位置）。
Method: 提出ARCA方法，计算每个token的适配器隐藏状态残差范数 ||h_adapted - h_base||_2，指示适配器实际改变模型的位置，无需学习奖励模型、价值头或树结构。
Result: 在MATH/Qwen3-1.7B GRPO扫查中，ARCA展现出预期的非退化中间区域信用分布，并在匹配的rollout预算下与排名匹配的基线保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ARCA通过直接测量适配器变更来避免信号退化，为参数高效微调下的RL信用分配提供轻量级替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Per-Group Error, Not Total MSE: Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models for 11-DoF Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for mobile manipulators with heterogeneous joint spaces can produce a counterintuitive result: the checkpoint with the lowest aggregate MSE is not the one that performs best on the real robot. We argue this is a predictable consequence of collapsing heterogeneous joint groups (arm, gripper, head, wheeled base) into a single metric, where easy-to-predict joints can mask joints that still fail. We fine-tune SmolVLA (450M, action-expert only) on the 11-DoF Toyota HSR and compare it against $π_{0.5}$ (3.3B), a stronger pretrained baseline. Per-group analysis exposes two patterns: in SmolVLA, the mobile base converges slowest and limits overall performance. In expert-only fine-tuning of $π_{0.5}$ (training only the action head, backbone frozen), total MSE drops below the baseline but arm accuracy degrades. On 60 real-robot trials (20 per model), $π_{0.5}$ 80k (4.0/4) significantly outperforms both fine-tuned variants (expert-only 3k: 3.75/4; HSR-SmolVLA: 3.5/4; Mann-Whitney $p \leq 0.010$), despite expert-only 3k having the lowest total MSE. This separation is most consistent with the offline arm-group error, not total MSE or base-group error. We conclude that per-group error is a more reliable signal than total MSE for checkpoint selection on robots with heterogeneous action spaces. Code: https://github.com/paumontagut/per-group-mse-vla
papers.comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted as poster at ICRA 2026 Workshop "From Data to Decisions: VLA Pipelines for Real Robots". Code: [https://github.com/paumontagut/per-group-mse-vla](https://github.com/paumontagut/per-group-mse-vla)

TL;DR: 本文针对11自由度移动机械手微调视觉-语言-动作模型时，发现总MSE最低的检查点并非实际机器人表现最好。通过比较SmolVLA和π0.5在丰田HSR上的微调，在60次真实试验中，π0.5 80k表现最佳，而最低MSE的微调变体表现反而差。结论是对于异构动作空间，每分组误差比总MSE更适合检查点选择。
Motivation: 异构关节空间（臂、夹爪、头、轮式基座）的移动机械手在微调VLA模型时，总MSE不能反映真实性能，因为易预测的关节会掩盖失败关节。
Method: 微调SmolVLA（仅动作专家）和π0.5（仅微调动作头，冻结骨干）在11-DoF丰田HSR上，并分析分组误差与总MSE，进行60次真实机器人试验。
Result: π0.5 80k在成功率上显著优于微调变体（4.0/4 vs 3.75/4和3.5/4，p≤0.010），尽管expert-only 3k有最低总MSE，离线臂组误差与结果最一致。
Conclusion: 对于异构动作空间的机器人，分组误差是比总MSE更可靠的检查点选择信号。

papers.title: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads
papers.abstract_en: Manipulating suspended payloads with humanoid robots is challenging because the robot can only influence an underactuated, oscillatory load through whole-body motion and intermittent contact. Imitation learning provides safe initial behavior but does not directly optimize final placement, while reinforcement learning from scratch is unsafe and sample-inefficient on real humanoids. We present HOIST-Humanoid Optimized with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for manipulating suspended loads. HOIST first finetunes a high-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy from virtual-reality (VR) teleoperation demonstrations and executes its commands through a whole-body controller. It then uses VLA rollouts and iterative batched RL to improve placement accuracy and stopping behavior. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid show that HOIST improves over imitation-only and additional-demonstration baselines; compared with pure VLA rollouts, HOIST reduces translational placement error by 19.9 cm and raw angular error by 3.56 degrees, demonstrating the potential of humanoids for underactuated material-handling tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HOIST框架，用于人形机器人操作悬挂负载。首先从VR遥操作演示微调高级视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，然后通过VLA rollout和迭代批量RL优化放置精度和停止行为。在仿真和真实人形机器人上，HOIST相比纯模仿学习和额外演示基线，平移放置误差降低19.9 cm，角度误差降低3.56度。
Motivation: 人形机器人操作悬挂负载具有挑战性，因为只能通过全身运动和间歇接触影响欠驱动振荡负载；模仿学习提供安全初始行为但不能直接优化最终放置，强化学习从零开始不安全且样本效率低。
Method: 两阶段方法：首先从VR遥操作演示微调VLA策略，并通过全身控制器执行命令；然后使用VLA rollout和迭代批量RL提高放置精度和停止行为。

Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法展示了人形机器人在欠驱动物料搬运任务中的潜力。

papers.title: Capability Self-Assessment: Teaching LLMs to Know Their Limits
papers.abstract_en: The ability to recognize one's own limitations and decide whether to solve a problem or delegate is fundamental for reliable intelligent systems. Yet we show that modern large language models systematically lack this ability: across diverse model families and scales, they overestimate their competence and attempt queries they cannot solve. We refer to this ability as Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) and formulate it as a policy-learning problem, aiming to improve self-assessment while preserving the model's original capabilities. Our results show that reinforcement learning teaches CSA effectively, significantly outperforming supervised fine-tuning while preserving original capabilities. In contrast, supervised fine-tuning severely degrades the capabilities the model is meant to assess. Moreover, learned self-assessment behavior generalizes well out of distribution, suggesting that CSA is a transferable model trait. Finally, CSA is practically useful: it improves local-cloud decision making at inference time and provides a signal for targeted data selection during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）的自我评估能力（Capability Self-Assessment, CSA），发现现有模型系统性高估自身能力。将CSA形式化为策略学习问题，结果表明强化学习比监督微调更有效地提升自我评估能力且不损害原始能力，而监督微调会严重退化被评估的能力。学习到的自我评估行为具有良好的分布外泛化性，并在推理时优化本地-云决策、训练时辅助数据选择。
Motivation: 现代LLM缺乏识别自身局限性的能力，倾向于高估自身能力并尝试无法解决的问题，这限制了智能系统的可靠性。现有方法未能有效赋予模型自我评估能力。
Method: 将能力自我评估（CSA）建模为策略学习问题，比较强化学习与监督微调两种训练范式，旨在提升自我评估同时保持模型原始能力。
Result: 强化学习显著优于监督微调，在保持原始能力的同时有效提升自我评估；监督微调则严重退化被评估的能力。学习到的自我评估行为能泛化到分布外场景，并提升推理时的本地-云决策效率及训练数据选择。
Conclusion: CSA是可迁移的模型特质，强化学习是赋予LLM自我评估能力的有效途径，具有实际应用价值。

papers.title: Effects of Varying LLM Access on Essay Writing Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Investigating the degree to which large language models (LLMs) affect teaching and learning in universities can help identify strategies for integrating LLMs in a way that supports, rather than undermines, student learning outcomes. This study examined how varying levels of LLM assistance affect writing performance, engagement, and perceived authorship. We report a pilot study in which 24 college students were randomly assigned to write a short essay with no LLM access, limited access (<=3 prompts, responses capped at 100 words), or unlimited access. Overall essay quality was statistically indistinguishable across groups. Yet writing behavior and perceived authorship diverged sharply: students with limited access reported higher ownership (62.5% would submit the essay as independent work, vs. 25% in the unlimited group), stronger organizational gains, and more strategic, revision-focused prompting. The unlimited group spent more time writing, produced essays more similar to LLM output, and reported reduced creative expression. Our findings suggest that constraining, rather than banning, LLM access may preserve authorship confidence while retaining the scaffolding benefits of AI assistance.

papers.title: Geodesic Flow Matching for Denoising High-Dimensional Structured Representations
papers.abstract_en: Vector Symbolic Algebras (VSAs) enable robust neurosymbolic reasoning by encoding symbolic information into high-dimensional distributed representations. For continuous domains, Spatial Semantic Pointers (SSPs) extend this framework by mapping variables onto continuous toroidal manifolds. However, standard approaches like Flow Matching assume a flat Euclidean geometry, which fails to account for the geometric constraints imposed on valid SSP states. We demonstrate that this assumption fails for SSPs: Euclidean linear interpolants ``cut through" the manifold's interior, destroying the phase and magnitude structure required for accurate decoding. To resolve this, we employ Geodesic Flow Matching, adapting Riemannian transport dynamics to strictly restrict the denoising flow to the SSP toroidal manifold. We validate this approach in a Spiking Neural SLAM system, showing that manifold-aware cleanup stabilizes path integration against drift. The method achieves a 72\% reduction in tracking error and enables a 40\% increase in neural efficiency compared to competitive baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/kremHabashy/CleanupSSP .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对向量符号代数中的空间语义指针（SSP）去噪问题，指出标准流匹配（Flow Matching）假设平坦欧几里得几何，导致线性插值破坏SSP的相位和幅度结构。作者采用测地线流匹配（Geodesic Flow Matching），将去噪流限制在SSP的环面流形上，并在脉冲神经网络SLAM系统中验证，实现了跟踪误差降低72%和神经效率提升40%。
Motivation: 标准流匹配假设平坦欧几里得几何，不适用于受几何约束的SSP表示，导致解码不准确。
Method: 使用测地线流匹配（Geodesic Flow Matching），采用黎曼传输动力学严格限制去噪流在SSP环面流形上。
Result: 在脉冲神经网络SLAM系统中跟踪误差降低72%，神经效率提升40%。
Conclusion: 流形感知的去噪能稳定路径积分对抗漂移。

papers.title: Dynamics and Representation Structure of Local Approximations to Gradient-Based Learning in Linear Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Biological and neuromorphic recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are subject to spatial and temporal locality constraints on the information that can plausibly be used during learning. A common strategy to satisfy these constraints is to modify gradient descent by neglecting non-local terms to varying degrees, as in random feedback local online (RFLO) learning and truncated backpropagation through time (tBPTT). However, the learning dynamics of these algorithms, and how they compare with BPTT, remain poorly understood. We apply dynamical systems theory to data-aligned linear RNNs -- whose dynamics can be separated into orthogonal modes -- to compare stationary solutions, stability properties, and convergence rates, finding qualitatively distinct behaviour for RFLO versus BPTT and one-step tBPTT. We further observe that the solutions learned by RFLO are restricted to low-rank perturbations of initial parameters, a result which holds beyond the data-aligned setting. Our work provides analytical insight into how locality constraints shape learning dynamics, with implications for neuroscientific models of learning and alternative optimization approaches for RNNs.
papers.comment: accepted to ICML 2026 as poster. Current version is camera-ready submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生物和神经形态递归神经网络中梯度下降学习的局部近似动力学，使用数据对齐的线性RNN分析RFLO、tBPTT与BPTT的差异。发现RFLO的解局限于初始参数的低秩扰动，且定性行为与BPTT和一步tBPTT不同。
Motivation: 生物和神经形态RNN的学习受空间和时间局部性约束，但局部近似算法的学习动力学及其与BPTT的对比尚不清楚。
Method: 应用动力系统理论到数据对齐的线性RNN（动力学可分解为正交模式），比较不同算法的平衡点、稳定性和收敛率。
Result: RFLO与BPTT及一步tBPTT表现出定性不同的行为；RFLO学习的解局限于初始参数的低秩扰动，且该结论在非数据对齐设置下仍成立。
Conclusion: 提供了局部性约束如何塑造学习动力学的分析性见解，对神经科学学习模型和RNN的替代优化方法有启示。

papers.title: InfoAtlas: A Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Statistical Dependence Estimate
papers.abstract_en: Measuring statistical dependency between high-dimensional random variables is a fundamental task in data science and machine learning. Neural mutual information (MI) estimators offer a promising avenue, but they typically require costly iterative optimization for each new dataset, making them impractical for real-time applications. We present InfoAtlas, a foundation model-like architecture that eliminates this bottleneck by directly inferring MI in a single forward pass. Pretrained on large-scale synthetic data with rich dependence patterns, InfoAtlas learns to identify diverse dependence structures and predict MI directly from the dataset. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that InfoAtlas matches state-of-the-art neural estimators in accuracy while achieving $100\times$ speedup, can flexibly handle varying dimensions and sample sizes through a single unified model, and generalizes effectively to complex, real-world scenarios. By reformulating MI estimation as an inference task, InfoAtlas establishes a foundation for real-time dependency analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InfoAtlas 是一个用于零样本统计依赖性估计的基础模型，通过单次前向传播直接推断互信息，无需针对每个新数据集进行迭代优化。在大规模合成数据上预训练后，它能识别多种依赖结构并准确预测互信息，在精度媲美现有最优方法的同时实现 100 倍加速，且能灵活处理不同维度和样本量，有效泛化到真实场景。
Motivation: 现有神经互信息估计器需要针对每个新数据集进行昂贵的迭代优化，难以满足实时应用需求。
Method: 采用基础模型架构，在大规模合成数据上预训练，学习从数据集直接预测互信息，实现零样本推断。
Result: 实验表明 InfoAtlas 在精度上匹配当前最优神经估计器，同时取得 100 倍速度提升，且单一模型可处理不同维度和样本量，泛化到复杂真实数据。
Conclusion: InfoAtlas 将互信息估计重构为推理任务，为实时依赖性分析奠定基础。

papers.title: MindZero: Learning Online Mental Reasoning With Zero Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Effective real-world assistance requires AI agents with robust Theory of Mind (ToM): inferring human mental states from their behavior. Despite recent advances, several key challenges remain, including (1) online inference with robust uncertainty updates over multiple hypotheses; (2) efficient reasoning suitable for real-time assistance; and (3) the lack of ground-truth mental state annotations in real-world domains. We address these challenges by introducing MindZero, a self-supervised reinforcement learning framework that trains multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for efficient and robust online mental reasoning. During training, the model is rewarded for generating mental state hypotheses that maximize the likelihood of observed actions estimated by a planner, similar to model-based ToM reasoning. This method thus eliminates the need for explicit mental state annotations. After training, MindZero internalizes model-based reasoning into fast single-pass inference. We evaluate MindZero against baselines across challenging mental reasoning and AI assistance tasks in gridworld and household domains. We found that LLMs alone are insufficient; model-based methods improve accuracy but are slow, costly, and limited by backbone MLLM capacity. In contrast, MindZero enhances MLLMs' intrinsic ToM ability and significantly outperforms model-based methods in both accuracy and efficiency, showing that mental reasoning can be effectively learned as a self-supervised skill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MindZero，一个自监督强化学习框架，训练多模态大语言模型进行在线心理推理（Theory of Mind），无需心理状态标注。方法通过奖励生成最大化观察行为似然的心理状态假设，将基于模型的推理内化为单次前向推理。在网格世界和家庭域任务中，MindZero 在准确率和效率上优于基于模型的方法。
Motivation: 现有 AI 辅助需要强大的心理理论能力，但面临在线推理不确定性、实时效率、缺乏真值标注等挑战。
Method: 使用自监督强化学习，奖励基于规划器估计的似然，消除标注需求；训练后将模型内化为快速单次推理。
Result: 在心理推理和 AI 辅助任务中，MindZero 比 LLM 单独使用和基于模型的方法在准确率和效率上更优。
Conclusion: 心理推理可以作为自监督技能有效学习，无需显式标注。

papers.title: Civilizational Metamaterials: Engineering Coordination Under Capability Gradients and Structural Turbulence
papers.abstract_en: We argue that governance must transition from a normative discipline to an engineering discipline, and we develop a formal framework, inspired by the physics of metamaterials, to make this transition quantitative and testable. Artificial General Intelligence affects civilization primarily by increasing decision velocity while human verification capacity remains bounded. When the cost of validating AI-generated outputs exceeds the expected utility of acting on them, rational agents default to inaction: a stable but catastrophic Nash equilibrium we term the Freezing Equilibrium. Drawing on metamaterials, where emergent macro-properties arise from designed microstructure, we develop a phenomenological constitutive law for institutional coordination: $R_{\mathrm{eff}} = β\cdot (1-ρ) \cdot (1-τ) \cdot (1-γρτ)$, where $β$ is the decision branching factor, $ρ$ is provenance fidelity, $τ$ is the verification rate, and $γ\in [0,1]$ captures correlated-detection synergy between provenance and verification failures. The model predicts a sharp phase transition between self-healing ($R_{\mathrm{eff}} < 1$) and self-destabilizing ($R_{\mathrm{eff}} > 1$) regimes. We introduce a three-class provenance taxonomy: cryptographic, institutional, and context binding, and derive four falsifiable hypotheses with a proposed 12-week stepped-wedge cluster-randomized trial in government grant review panels. The framework bridges AI alignment theory and institutional design.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for presentation at AGI-26 (Springer LNAI, forthcoming). v2 corrects the sign of the synergy term in the constitutive law (Eq. 2) and reformulates H3 as a threshold-crossing claim, per peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将治理从规范性学科转变为工程学科，并借鉴超材料物理学建立形式化框架。核心是一个机构协调的本构定律 $R_{\mathrm{eff}} = β\cdot (1-ρ)\cdot (1-τ)\cdot (1-γρτ)$，预测自愈与自失稳之间的相变。论文提出了三类来源分类法（密码学、制度、上下文绑定）及四个可证伪假设，并设计了一项12周阶梯楔形集群随机试验。
Motivation: 随着AGI提高决策速度而人类验证能力有限，验证成本超过预期效用时理性决策者会陷入不作为的纳什均衡（冻结均衡）。现有治理缺乏量化工具，需要工程化框架。
Method: 受超材料中微观结构产生宏观性质的启发，推导出机构协调的本构定律，引入来源保真度ρ、验证率τ等参数，并建立相变条件。提出三类来源分类法和四个可证伪假设，以及阶梯楔形集群随机试验设计。
Result: 模型预测 $R_{\mathrm{eff}} < 1$ 时系统自愈，$R_{\mathrm{eff}} > 1$ 时自失稳，存在尖锐相变。
Conclusion: 该框架桥接了AI对齐理论与制度设计，为定量测试治理策略提供了基础。

papers.title: TIGER: Traceable Inference with Graph-Based Evidence Routing for Mitigating Hallucinations in Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: We study fact-level repair for multimodal generation, where a fluent output may contain specific facts that are not supported by the input. Existing inference-time repair methods often generate feedback by jointly conditioning on the input and the current output. This design has two limitations: hallucinated claims in the output can bias the model's interpretation of the input, and free-form feedback cannot be ranked or scheduled at the fact level. We present TIGER, an inference-time framework that redesigns feedback for localized repair. TIGER independently extracts an observation graph from the input and a claim graph from the current output, then assigns each claim a graph-conditioned risk score based on support and conflict. The model repairs selected high-risk claims while keeping the backbone frozen. We provide a convergence analysis showing that the expected total risk decreases geometrically to an explicit asymptotic bound under mild assumptions. Experiments across four cross-modal paths, including image-to-text, image+text-to-text, audio-to-text, and video-to-text, show that TIGER reduces unsupported content while preserving task quality. The gains hold across multiple backbones, and a CrisisFACTS case study suggests that the same repair mechanism can improve grounding in multi-source settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TIGER框架，针对多模态生成中的事实级幻觉问题，通过独立提取输入观察图和输出主张图，基于图条件风险分数定位并修复高风险主张，同时保持骨干网络冻结。实验覆盖图像到文本、音频到文本、视频到文本等多种跨模态路径，显示有效减少无依据内容而不牺牲任务质量。
Motivation: 现有推理时修复方法存在两个局限：输出中的幻觉主张会偏误模型对输入的解释，且自由形式反馈无法在事实层面排序调度。
Method: TIGER独立从输入中提取观察图、从输出中提取主张图，根据支持与冲突计算每个主张的图条件风险分数，然后只修复高风险主张，骨干网络冻结不变。
Result: 在图像到文本、图像+文本到文本、音频到文本、视频到文本等多种跨模态路径上，TIGER减少了无依据内容并保持任务质量；多个骨干网络上的增益一致，CrisisFACTS案例研究表明该修复机制可改善多源场景下的grounding。
Conclusion: 通过图基证据路由进行局部修复，可以有效缓解多模态生成中的事实级幻觉，并推广到多源设置。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出TIGER框架，针对多模态生成中的事实级幻觉问题，通过独立提取输入观察图和输出主张图，基于图条件风险分数定位并修复高风险主张，同时保持骨干网络冻结。实验覆盖图像到文本、音频到文本、视频到文本等多种跨模态路径，显示有效减少无依据内容而不牺牲任务质量。

summary_sections.conclusion: 通过图基证据路由进行局部修复，可以有效缓解多模态生成中的事实级幻觉，并推广到多源设置。

papers.title: A Pre-Training Analogue of Grokking in Language Models: Tracing Delayed Grammatical Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Grokking, the phenomenon in which neural networks generalize long after fitting their training data, has been studied in supervised settings on many epochs. LLM pre-training instead involves next-token prediction over an unlabeled corpus, with limited data repetition and no explicit train/validation split. To address this, we propose an exposure-based framework that enables the study of grokking-like dynamics during LLM pre-training. We ground our evaluation in BLiMP minimal pairs, which provide controlled grammatical contrasts. For every BLiMP minimal pair, we identify a critical phrase, the smallest continuous span that captures the grammatical contrast and the phenomenon-relevant context. Examples whose critical phrase appears in the pre-training window are assigned to the proxy-train split; the remaining examples are assigned to the proxy-validation split. Across five grammatical phenomena, we observe delayed generalization. Analyzing pre-training checkpoints before and after generalization shows that grammatical concept vectors become more predictive of grammatical acceptability and occupy a higher-dimensional subspace after generalization. We also find that attention from the critical token to the relevant context token is concentrated in a small number of heads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个暴露框架，用于研究LLM预训练中类似grokking的延迟泛化现象。利用BLiMP最小对和关键短语划分代理训练/验证集，在五种语法现象上观察到延迟泛化。分析显示，泛化后语法概念向量对语法可接受性的预测性更强，且占据更高维子空间，关键标记到相关上下文的注意力集中在少数头上。
Motivation: Grokking通常在监督多轮训练中被研究，而LLM预训练采用下一词预测，数据重复有限且无显式训练/验证划分，缺乏对类似延迟泛化的分析。
Method: 提出暴露框架：对每个BLiMP最小对，识别关键短语（语法对比的最小连续跨度），根据关键短语是否出现在预训练窗口来划分代理训练集和代理验证集。
Result: 在五种语法现象上观察到延迟泛化；泛化后语法概念向量更可预测语法可接受性且占据更高维子空间；从关键标记到相关上下文的注意力集中在少数注意力头上。
Conclusion: 该框架为研究LLM预训练中的延迟泛化提供了实证方法，并揭示了泛化背后的机制特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action
papers.abstract_en: Natural language is a powerful reasoning medium for language and vision-language models, but it is mismatched to the granularity of continuous control. Text and explicit subgoals operate at task-level granularity, whereas vision-language-action (VLA) policies must choose actions at a much finer temporal scale; a single reasoning step can therefore span many action chunks while remaining only weakly coupled to the action needed now. This suggests a different question for VLA: what should play the role of language? We argue that a useful VLA reasoning medium must be shareable across model instances, verifiable through downstream action improvement, and aligned with temporally extended control structure. Based on this view, we propose Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action. Our model first predicts continuous reasoning in the form of a structured set of continuous thoughts, then reuses them as shared context for chunk-structured action generation. Better action prediction alone does not certify good reasoning: if the same internal medium cannot be shared across model instances and independently verified through improved downstream control, the added latent may simply become a model-private shortcut that helps on seen behaviors without supporting generalizable control. We therefore instantiate continuous reasoning as a shared Gaussian latent interface and train it with a self-verification objective in which an exponential-moving-average teacher must successfully consume the student's reasoning when predicting target actions. Empirically, Continuous Reasoning improves LIBERO-PRO robustness and performs strongly on real robots, raising mean subtask success over π0.5 by 40.4% on TX-G2, an AgiBot G2-compatible variant, and 26.3% on HSR. This suggests that reasoning in VLA is less about extra tokens than about a shareable, verifiable internal language for action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续推理（Continuous Reasoning）作为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理媒介，以结构化连续思维代替自然语言子目标，并与块结构动作生成共享上下文。通过自验证训练（EMA教师验证学生推理），提升了机器人控制的鲁棒性和泛化性能。
Motivation: 自然语言的粒度与连续控制不匹配，文本子目标在任务级操作，而VLA策略需要在更细的时间尺度上选择动作，现有推理方式与即时动作耦合弱。
Method: 预测一组连续思维（continuous thoughts）作为高斯共享潜在变量，并与块结构动作生成共享上下文；采用自验证目标，使用指数移动平均教师模型验证学生推理的有效性。
Result: 在LIBERO-PRO上提升鲁棒性；在真实机器人上，TX-G2（AgiBot G2兼容变体）均值子任务成功率相对π0.5提升40.4%，HSR提升26.3%。
Conclusion: VLA中的推理不在于生成额外文本token，而在于构建可跨实例共享、可通过下游动作改进验证的内部动作语言。

papers.title: LithoGRPO: Fast Inverse Lithography via GRPO Reinforced Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: In semiconductor manufacturing, lithography projects circuit layouts onto silicon wafers through an optical mask. As circuit features shrink below the wavelength of light, optical diffraction causes the printed patterns to deviate from their intended layouts. Inverse Lithography Technology (ILT) addresses this challenge by generating optimized masks that enhance the fidelity of pattern transfer onto wafers. While ILT resembles an image synthesis task, its reliance on explicit physical metrics for mask evaluation limits the applicability of existing generative models. We introduce LithoGRPO, an ILT framework that integrates the flow-matching paradigm with GRPO-based reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning, enabling efficient exploration of diverse masks for a given target layout. Unlike purely generative or optimization-based approaches, RL in LithoGRPO exploits the explicitly defined, physics-based reward function of ILT, enabling optimization under complex, process-aware constraints. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework that unifies flow matching and RL for mask optimization. To improve RL sampling efficiency, we propose a fast shot-counting algorithm for manufacturability evaluation, achieving over 130x speedup while preserving the mask ranking of the traditional shot-count metric. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LithoGRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance over both optimization-based and learning-based methods, while maintaining efficient mask generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LithoGRPO，将流匹配 (flow matching) 与基于 GRPO 的强化学习 (RL) 微调相结合，用于逆光刻技术 (ILT) 中的掩模优化。该方法利用 ILT 的物理奖励函数进行优化，并设计了快速 shot-counting 算法实现超过 130 倍的加速。实验表明，LithoGRPO 在掩模生成效率和保真度上均达到最优。
Motivation: 传统逆光刻方法依赖显式物理指标，现有生成模型难以直接应用；优化方法计算开销大，而纯生成方法缺乏物理约束。需要一种既能高效生成掩模又能满足复杂工艺约束的框架。
Method: 采用流匹配生成初始掩模，然后通过 GRPO 强化学习进行微调，利用 ILT 的物理奖励函数指导优化。同时提出快速 shot-counting 算法加速可制造性评估。
Result: 在掩模优化任务上，LithoGRPO 取得优于传统优化方法和学习方法的性能，且快速 shot-counting 算法在保持掩模排序的前提下实现 130 倍以上的加速。
Conclusion: 该框架首次统一流匹配与强化学习用于掩模优化，展示了结合物理奖励和生成模型的潜力。

papers.title: SEMBridge: Tagless-Final Program Semantics with Weakest-Precondition and Bounded-Checking Interpretations
papers.abstract_en: Formal methods provide rigorous accounts of program behavior, but practical software engineering often works through executable libraries, tests, and incremental design. This paper presents SEMBridge, a small tagless-final framework for generating weakest-precondition and bounded-checking interpretations from the same executable object programs. Instead of committing a program semantics to one abstract syntax tree and then writing separate traversals, object programs are written once against a semantic interface and interpreted into multiple meanings: readable code, concrete execution, predicate transformers, bounded counterexample search, and future proof-assistant or SMT back ends. The Python prototype implements a loop-free imperative core with assignments, conditionals, assumptions, and assertions. Across five example programs, the same tagless-final definitions generated executable state transformers and verification conditions that passed bounded checking over domains up to 729 states. The contribution is not a Scala code-generation system or a new verifier, but a compact architecture for keeping executable semantics, weakest-precondition artifacts, and bounded validation synchronized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEMBridge，一个基于 tagless-final 风格的小型框架，能够从同一可执行对象程序生成最弱前置条件和有界检查解释。原型在 Python 中实现了一个无循环命令式核心，包含赋值、条件、假设和断言。在五个示例程序上，相同的 tagless-final 定义生成了可执行状态转换器和验证条件，并通过了域大小达 729 的有界检查。
Motivation: 现有形式化方法通常需要为程序语义固定一棵抽象语法树，然后编写独立的遍历，导致可执行语义、验证条件等不同表示难以同步维护。
Method: 利用 tagless-final 模式定义语义接口，对象程序只需编写一次，然后解释为多种含义：可读代码、具体执行、谓词变换、有界反例搜索以及未来的证明助理或 SMT 后端。
Result: 在五个示例程序上，同一 tagless-final 定义同时生成了可执行状态转换器和验证条件，并通过了有界检查（搜索空间最大 729 个状态）。
Conclusion: 贡献不在于实现新的验证器或代码生成系统，而在于提供一种紧凑的架构，使可执行语义、最弱前置条件产物和有界验证保持同步。

papers.title: 21cmEMUv3: a hybrid diffusion-LSTM emulator of 21cmFAST summary observables
papers.abstract_en: We are witnessing a surge in observations of the cosmic dawn (CD) and epoch of reionisation (EoR), driving an increasing demand for fast and robust theoretical interpretation frameworks. In response, machine learning (ML), and emulation in particular, has emerged as a powerful approach to accelerate and enhance inference pipelines. In this work, we present 21cmEMUv3, an emulator trained on 21cmFASTv3 simulations that model both atomically and molecularly cooling galaxies. 21cmEMUv3 is conditioned on $σ_8$ and ten astrophysical parameters to produce seven summary observables: (i) the cylindrical 21cm power spectrum (PS), emulated for the first time at such high resolution and accuracy across a wide redshift range of $z \sim$ 6--30; (ii) the spherically-averaged 21cm PS; (iii) the mean neutral fraction of the intergalactic medium (IGM); (iv) the mean 21cm spin temperature; (v) the global 21cm signal; (vi) the ultraviolet (UV) luminosity functions (LFs); and (vii) the Thomson scattering optical depth. Notably, the cylindrical 21cm PS is emulated via score-based diffusion, while the remaining six summaries are emulated via long-short term memory (LSTM) networks, all achieving sub-percent median accuracy. We use the emulator to reinterpret current 21cm PS upper limits from HERA, for the first time using state-of-the-art hydrodynamical simulations to inform priors on star formation inside molecularly cooling galaxies. We find that our inferred soft-band X-ray luminosity per unit star formation rate is consistent with extrapolations of high-mass X-ray binaries to the low-metallicity regimes expected in the first galaxies, excluding values below $10^{39.2}$ erg s$^{-1}M^{-1}_\odot \rm{yr}$ at $95\%$ confidence. Finally, we produce forecasts for the detection of the cosmic 21cm PS with the Square Kilometre Array for different array configurations. The 21cmEMU package is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍21cmEMUv3，一个基于混合扩散-LSTM的仿真器，用于模拟宇宙黎明和再电离时期的21cm信号。该仿真器以σ8和10个天体物理参数为条件，输出七种概观可观测值，包括首次以高分辨率和精度模拟的柱状21cm功率谱。所有输出达到亚百分位中位数精度。作者利用该仿真器重新解释HERA的21cm功率谱上限，并预测SKA的检测能力。
Motivation: 随着宇宙黎明和再电离时期观测数据的激增，需要快速且鲁棒的理论解释框架，机器学习仿真成为加速推理管线的有力方法。
Method: 提出21cmEMUv3，使用基于分数的扩散模型仿真柱状21cm功率谱，使用LSTM网络仿真其余六种概观可观测值。
Result: 所有输出达到亚百分位中位数精度。利用仿真器重新解释HERA的21cm功率谱上限，将软波段X射线光度每单位恒星形成率约束在低于10^39.2 erg s^{-1} M_⊙^{-1} yr（95%置信度），并预测SKA的检测能力。
Conclusion: 21cmEMUv3是一个高精度、快速的仿真器，有助于宇宙黎明和再电离时期的解释和预测。代码公开可用。
