papers.title: Quantized Reasoning Models Think They Need to Think Longer, but They Do Not
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to deploy large language models efficiently, but its effect on reasoning models is not well understood. Across math, coding, and science QA, we find that aggressive PTQ reduces accuracy while increasing chain-of-thought (CoT) length. Surprisingly, we show that in up to 52% of the quantized models' failures, models reach the right answer in intermediate reasoning steps but do not output it as a final answer. To understand why quantization leads to this increase in overthinking errors, we measure the token-level KL divergence between quantized and full-precision output distributions. Positions with high KL divergence correlate strongly with high next-token entropy, and at these positions quantized models disproportionately sample overthinking markers such as "wait", "but", and "alternatively". We show that simply introducing a training-free logit penalty on a curated set of overthinking markers can reduce CoT length by 12--23% while preserving or improving accuracy across 5 models (1.5B-32B parameters), 3 quantization methods, and 5 benchmarks, yielding a favorable Pareto frontier of accuracy against reasoning cost compared to penalizing other token sets. Overthinking errors produced by quantized models are particularly reduced by up to 58%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究后训练量化（PTQ）对推理模型的影响，发现激进量化在降低精度的同时意外增加了链式思考（CoT）长度，且高达52%的失败案例中模型中间步骤已得出正确答案但未输出。量化模型在熵高的位置倾向于采样“wait”、“but”等过度思考标记，通过对这些标记施加无训练logit惩罚可缩短CoT长度12–23%并提升精度。

Method: 通过测量量化模型与全精度模型在token级别的KL散度，识别高熵位置；对一组精心选择的过度思考标记引入无训练logit惩罚，以抑制不必要的推理链扩展。

papers.title: APE: Agentic Prompt Enhancer for Image Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Natural language has become a powerful interface for image generation and editing, yet text-guided visual systems remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Semantically similar requests can produce different outputs depending on wording, specificity, and how explicitly visual constraints are stated, motivating prompt enhancement as a trainable component rather than a peripheral user choice. Existing strong enhancers often rely on large, proprietary LLMs such as ChatGPT or Gemini, adding cost, latency, and deployment dependence to the visual generation pipeline. We propose Agentic Prompt Enhancer (APE), a lightweight framework that post-trains small language models (SLMs) as prompt-enhancement agents. APE supports both single-agent rewriting and role-specialized multi-agent enhancement. Its single-agent instantiation, SAPE, rewrites the prompt in one pass, while its multi-agent instantiation, MAPE, decomposes enhancement into a router--rewriter--composer process for handling compositional constraints over objects, attributes, spatial relations, and edits. With task-aware rewards and post-training protocols, APE improves visual alignment and prompt following without modifying the downstream visual model. Experiments on challenging image generation and editing benchmarks demonstrate that post-trained small prompt enhancers reliably outperform their base counterparts, narrowing the gap to closed-source prompt enhancers; in addition, MAPE proves particularly strong on complex compositional tasks within these benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic Prompt Enhancer (APE)，一个轻量级框架，通过后训练小型语言模型作为提示增强代理，用于图像生成和编辑。APE支持单代理（SAPE）和角色专业化多代理（MAPE）两种模式，其中MAPE将增强分解为路由器-重写器-组合器过程，处理复杂的组合约束。实验表明，后训练的小型提示增强器在图像生成和编辑基准上优于基线，缩小了与闭源增强器的差距，MAPE在复杂组合任务上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有文本引导的图像生成系统对提示措辞高度敏感，而强大的提示增强器通常依赖大型闭源LLM（如ChatGPT、Gemini），带来成本、延迟和部署依赖问题。
Method: 提出APE框架，使用任务感知奖励和后训练协议，对小型语言模型进行后训练，使其成为提示增强代理。包括单代理SAPE和基于路由器-重写器-组合器的多代理MAPE。
Result: 在图像生成和编辑基准上，后训练的小型提示增强器优于其基线版本，并缩小了与闭源提示增强器的性能差距；MAPE在复杂组合任务上表现尤其强。
Conclusion: APE通过后训练小型语言模型实现了高效的提示增强，无需修改下游视觉模型，多代理版本在处理组合约束方面具有优势。

papers.title: From Rashomon Theory to PRAXIS: Efficient Decision Tree Rashomon Sets
papers.abstract_en: Standard machine learning pipelines often admit many near-optimal models. These "Rashomon sets" pose a range of challenges and opportunities for uncertainty-aware, robust decision making. They allow users to incorporate domain knowledge and preferences that would otherwise be difficult to specify directly in an objective, and they quantify diversity among valid models for a given training dataset and objective function. However, computation of Rashomon sets, even for simple, interpretable model classes such as sparse decision trees, continues to require immense memory and runtime resources. We present PRAXIS, an algorithm to approximate this Rashomon set with orders of magnitude improvement in runtime and memory usage. We validate that PRAXIS regularly recovers almost all of the full Rashomon set. PRAXIS allows researchers and practitioners to scalably model the Rashomon set for real-world datasets. Code for PRAXIS is available at https://github.com/zakk-h/PRAXIS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对决策树Rashomon集（多个近优模型集合）计算时内存和运行时开销大的问题，提出PRAXIS算法，实现数量级的速度和内存改进。实验表明PRAXIS能恢复几乎完整的Rashomon集，使研究者能在真实数据集上可扩展地建模Rashomon集。
Motivation: 标准机器学习管道往往有多个近优模型，即Rashomon集，这对不确定性感知决策和引入领域知识有价值，但计算Rashomon集（即使对于稀疏决策树）需要巨大的内存和运行时资源。
Method: 提出PRAXIS算法，近似计算决策树的Rashomon集，在运行时和内存使用上实现数量级的改进。
Result: 摘要验证PRAXIS能恢复几乎完整的Rashomon集。
Conclusion: 使得研究者和实践者能够可扩展地建模真实世界数据集的Rashomon集。

papers.title: BAGEN: Are LLM Agents Budget-Aware?
papers.abstract_en: While agents are increasingly spending more resources, today agent cost is mostly measured only after execution. A Budget-Aware Agent (BAGEN) should treat budget as an active control signal, rather than a passive cost metric. We first systematically define budget estimation as internal budgets (from agent computation) and external budgets (from agent actions). We then formalize budget-awareness as progressive interval estimation: at each step of a plan, an agent should predict an upper and lower bound on remaining budget, and alert when completion is unlikely. Scoring with a rollout-replay protocol, we find consistent failure patterns on four environments and five frontier agents: (1) strong agents do not necessarily have strong budget-awareness, with correlation r=0.35. (2) frontier models are consistently over-optimistic, continue spending on tasks that are unlikely to succeed, instead of alerting the user early. (3) budget-aware signal is actionable and trainable. Early stop saves 28-64% tokens on failed trajectories, and SFT+RL strengthens early stop and alert behavior. (4) precise interval calibration remains challenging, with interval coverage capping at 47% after SFT+RL. Project page: https://ragen-ai.github.io/bagen/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出预算感知智能体（Budget-Aware Agent, BAGEN）概念，将预算作为主动控制信号而非被动度量。系统定义内部和外部预算，形式化为渐进区间估计，要求智能体在每一步预测剩余预算的上下界，并在完成不可行时发出警报。通过rollout-replay协议评分，在四个环境和五个前沿智能体上发现一致失败模式：强智能体不一定有强的预算意识（相关性r=0.35）；前沿模型普遍过度乐观，继续在不太可能成功的任务上消耗资源而非早期报警；预算感知信号可操作且可训练，早期停止节省28-64%令牌，SFT+RL增强早期停止和报警行为；但精确区间校准仍困难，SFT+RL后区间覆盖率仅47%。
Motivation: 现有智能体成本主要在事后衡量，缺乏主动预算控制，导致资源浪费和用户无法及时干预。
Method: 定义内部预算（智能体计算）和外部预算（智能体动作），提出渐进区间估计框架，要求智能体在每一步预测剩余预算的上下界，并结合rollout-replay协议进行评分。采用SFT+RL训练增强早期停止和报警行为。
Result: 强智能体与预算意识相关性低（r=0.35）；前沿模型普遍过度乐观；早期停止可节省28-64%令牌；SFT+RL后区间覆盖率最高仅47%。
Conclusion: 预算感知信号是可行且可训练的，但精确区间校准仍是挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safe2Drive: Evaluating Safe Driving Behaviors of E2E Autonomous Driving Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving policies achieve high driving scores in closed-loop simulations. Yet it remains unclear whether these policies handle common safety-critical scenarios. We present Safe2Drive (S2D), a set of Bench2Drive-aligned scenario extensions focused on three frequent families of road hazards: work zones, pedestrian jaywalking, and occluded vulnerable road users (VRUs). Safe2Drive adds 100 common but challenging scenarios and introduces SafeDriving Score (SDS), a safety-centric metric that augments prior evaluators with pre-crash braking, work zone-object contact, lane centering, and smoothness checks. Evaluating two state-of-the-art policies (LEAD and SimLingo) on S2D, we find that their driving scores drop sharply relative to their reported Bench2Drive baselines (LEAD: from 94.70 DS on Bench2Drive to 39.95 DS on S2D; SimLingo: from 85.07 DS on Bench2Drive to 41.00 DS on S2D) and that SDS on S2D is low (11.85 for LEAD and 15.27 for Sim-Lingo). These results are consistent with brittle safe-driving behaviors such as poor work-zone understanding, red-light violations, and late or absent braking for pedestrians. This study highlights a lack of safe behavioral reasoning in E2E models even when tested on CARLA towns that are part of the training set. We plan to release the code and videos for all 100 S2D scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: CVPR Workshops 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Safe2Drive（S2D），一组基于Bench2Drive扩展的100个常见安全关键场景（工作区、行人乱穿、遮挡易受伤害道路使用者），并引入安全驾驶评分SDS。评估LEAD和SimLingo两个端到端模型，发现它们在S2D上驾驶得分较Bench2Drive基线大幅下降（LEAD从94.70降至39.95，SimLingo从85.07降至41.00），SDS得分低（11.85和15.27），表明模型存在安全行为推理缺陷，如工作区理解差、闯红灯、刹车缺失等。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶策略在闭环模拟中得分高，但在常见安全关键场景下的表现尚不明确。
Method: Safe2Drive包含三类常见道路危险（工作区、行人乱穿、遮挡VRU）的100个场景，并设计SDS指标，融合预碰撞制动、工作区接触、车道居中和平滑性检查。
Result: LEAD的驾驶得分从Bench2Drive的94.70降至S2D的39.95，SimLingo从85.07降至41.00；SDS得分分别为11.85和15.27。
Conclusion: 研究表明端到端模型即使在训练集包含的CARLA城镇中测试，也缺乏安全行为推理能力。

papers.title: Learning to Construct Practical Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Automated design and optimization of agentic LLM-based systems leads to sophisticated systems that substantially improve result quality over off-the-shelf agentic patterns. However, studies of fielded agentic systems show that production systems focus much more on issues such as simplicity, controllability, and predictability of inference costs. In this paper we propose principled approaches to designing and optimizing practical agentic systems. We describe an agent framework that enables designers to enforce modularity in agentic systems, by defining "pseudo-tools" that call LLMs recursively on a restricted context. Using this framework we hand-engineer agents for a diverse set of tasks, and show that relative to dynamically-planned workflows, hand-constructed fixed workflows are generally cheaper and more accurate. We then propose novel learning methods for the agentic components required by this framework, namely pseudo-tools and fixed workflows. These learning methods generally outperform hand-engineered agents. We also exploit the modularity of the framework to apply multi-objective optimization methods to jointly optimize cost and response quality and blend the results of multiple learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM agent系统的实际部署需求（如简单性、可控性和推理成本可预测性），提出一种原则性方法：通过定义递归调用LLM的“伪工具”(pseudo-tools)实现模块化，并对比手工固定工作流与动态规划工作流的成本与准确性。实验表明手工固定工作流更便宜且更准确，而提出的学习方法进一步优于手工设计。最后利用多目标优化联合优化成本与响应质量。
Motivation: 现有自动优化的agent系统在部署时更关注效果指标，而实际生产系统更强调简单性、可控性和推理成本的可预测性，但目前缺乏系统性考虑这些因素的框架。
Method: 提出一个基于“伪工具”的agent框架，强制模块化；手工构建固定工作流；提出学习方法来优化伪工具和固定工作流；应用多目标优化平衡成本与响应质量。
Result: 手工固定工作流相比动态规划工作流更便宜且更准确；提出的学习方法在手工程序上取得更好表现。
Conclusion: 通过模块化框架和多目标优化，可以系统地构建实用、高效且可控的LLM agent系统。

papers.title: PaintBench: Deterministic Evaluation of Precise Visual Editing
papers.abstract_en: While current multimodal models are proficient at open-ended visual editing, executing precise single-answer edits remains an important obstacle. To probe this challenge, we introduce PaintBench, a dynamically scalable benchmark targeting 20 fundamental precise visual editing operations across four categories: geometric transformation, structural manipulation, color change, and symbolic reasoning. Procedural generation with configurable complexity enables an effectively infinite, contamination-resistant evaluation suite, and deterministic pixel-level evaluation eliminates reliance on bias-prone judge models. Across 11 image editing models, we find overall low performance, with the current highest-performing industry leader scoring only 17.1% (mIoU). Task decomposition reveals especially challenging operation types (geometric transformation, most structural manipulation, formula-based color change) and model-specific specializations. Fine-grained benchmark diagnostics further show performance degradations induced by scene variations in object count, background complexity, color scheme, and edit-region size. To test generalization of PaintBench scores to applied task performance, we create a procedural, deterministic evaluation for data visualization editing (TinyGrafixBench) and find strong linear correlation with PaintBench scores ($R^2 = 0.91$, $p < 0.001$). Altogether, PaintBench provides a rigorous foundation for measuring and driving progress in precise multimodal visual editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaintBench是一个针对精确视觉编辑的动态可扩展基准，覆盖几何变换、结构操作、颜色变化和符号推理四类20种基本操作。通过程序生成和确定性像素级评估，避免了模型偏差。实验表明11个当前最佳模型平均仅得17.1% mIoU，且性能受物体数量、背景复杂度等场景因素影响。该基准与数据可视化编辑任务性能高度线性相关（R²=0.91）。
Motivation: 当前多模态模型在开放式视觉编辑上表现良好，但缺乏对精确单答案编辑的严格评估。现有基准易受数据污染或依赖主观判断，需要无偏、可扩展且可重复的评估方案。
Method: 提出PaintBench：通过程序化生成20种精确视觉编辑操作，配置复杂度参数实现无限规模、抗污染的评估；采用像素级mIoU进行确定性评分，排除评判模型偏差。
Result: 11种模型（含闭源商业模型）中最高得分仅17.1% mIoU；几何变换、结构操作和基于公式的颜色变化是最难类别；性能随目标数量、背景复杂度、颜色方案和编辑区域大小而显著下降。PaintBench分数与TinyGrafixBench（数据可视化编辑）线性相关（R²=0.91, p<0.001）。
Conclusion: PaintBench为精确视觉编辑提供了严谨、可复现的评估框架，揭示现有模型在基本操作上的严重不足，并证明其分数可泛化到下游编辑任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-Guided Design and Optimization of Graphite-Based Anodes via Iterative Experimental Feedback
papers.abstract_en: This study presents an iterative AI-guided workflow that accelerates graphite-based anode development by improving both formulation feasibility and process robustness. Sequential learning via AI/ML-guided multiobjective inverse design for anode optimization was implemented using the Citrine Platform. Starting from a noisy, incomplete dataset, the Citrine Platform was used to generate early surrogate models, which despite low predictive certainty highlighted missing process constraints. By iteratively adding feasibility labels and boundary condition failures, the workflow rapidly converged toward manufacturable, higher-performing formulations. Fabrication reliability improved from frequent process failures to 100% successful cell production, while the fraction of cells delivering $\geq$ 350 mAh g$^{-1}$ increased from 28.4% to 84.8%, with capacity retention rising from 42.1% to 97.3%. These results demonstrate that structured, feedback-driven AI workflows can transform imperfect industrial data into actionable guidance, enabling faster, more reproducible optimization of battery electrode manufacturing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种迭代AI引导的工作流，用于加速石墨负极的开发，通过多目标逆设计和反馈标签提高配方可行性和工艺鲁棒性。使用Citrine平台，从噪声数据开始，逐步添加可行性标签和边界条件，最终实现100%的电池制造成功率，并将高容量电池（≥350 mAh g⁻¹）比例从28.4%提升至84.8%，容量保持率从42.1%提升至97.3%。
Motivation: 改进石墨负极开发的配方可行性和工艺鲁棒性，应对工业数据不完整和噪声问题。
Method: 采用基于AI/ML的顺序学习多目标逆设计，利用Citrine平台迭代添加可行性标签和边界条件，优化负极配方。
Result: 制造可靠性从频繁失败提升至100%成功，高容量电池（≥350 mAh g⁻¹）比例从28.4%升至84.8%，容量保持率从42.1%升至97.3%。
Conclusion: 结构化、反馈驱动的AI工作流可将不完美的工业数据转化为可操作的指导，加速电池电极制造的优化和可重复性。

papers.title: Agentic Transformers Provably Learn to Search via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tree search is a central abstraction behind many language-agent reasoning and decision-making tasks: agents must explore actions, remember failures, and backtrack toward promising alternatives. Yet, we lack a theoretical understanding of how transformer-based policies acquire such search capabilities from the training dynamics of reinforcement learning (RL). We study this question in a stochastic $k$-ary tree environment, where an agentic transformer observes only its trajectory history through interaction and receives a terminal reward for reaching a hidden leaf goal node. We first construct a two-head transformer that implements randomized depth-first search (DFS): one head tracks previous actions, while the other detects failure outcomes and triggers backtracking. We then analyze the training dynamics of policy gradient under a depth-wise curriculum, showing that this same DFS mechanism emerges in stages from sparse reinforcement feedback without expert demonstrations. The resulting policy exhibits depth generalization: after training only on depth-$1$ and depth-$2$ trees, it succeeds on deeper full trees. We further show that, under imbalanced goal distributions, discounting the return leads to a ranked DFS policy that prioritizes higher-probability branches. Overall, our results identify a mechanistic normal form for transformer-based search, in which attention heads specialize and cooperate to extract decision-relevant traces from context and convert them into agentic action selection via RL training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在随机k叉树环境中研究基于Transformer的策略如何通过强化学习（RL）训练获得搜索能力。作者构造了一个两头部Transformer实现随机深度优先搜索（DFS），并在深度课程下分析策略梯度的训练动态，证明该DFS机制能从稀疏奖励中逐步涌现，且训练在浅树上后能泛化到更深树。在不平衡目标分布下，折现回报会导致优先探索高概率分支的排序DFS策略。
Motivation: 尽管树搜索在语言智能体推理与决策中广泛使用，但缺乏对基于Transformer的策略如何从RL训练动态中习得搜索能力的理论理解。
Method: 在随机k叉树环境中，设计一个两头部Transformer（一个头跟踪历史动作，另一个头检测失败并触发回溯）实现随机DFS；并采用深度课程学习（先训练深度1和2的树）下的策略梯度算法。
Result: 证明该DFS机制能从稀疏强化反馈中逐步涌现，无需专家示范；训练后能泛化到更深的全树。在不平衡目标分布下，折现回报导致排序DFS策略。
Conclusion: 识别出基于Transformer的搜索的一种机械范式：注意力头专业化和协作，从上下文中提取决策相关信息，并通过RL训练转化为智能体动作选择。

papers.title: The New Social Image: How AI Competency and AI Proactivity Influence Self- and Peer-Perceptions in the Workplace
papers.abstract_en: Human-AI collaboration is considered the most promising way to incorporate AI in the workplace. What remains unexplored are the experiential consequences of this teaming. More specifically, in a team with AI, how humans perceive themselves (self-perception) and how they are perceived by their coworkers (peer perception) in terms of work ownership and job meaningfulness. In a 2x2x2 vignette study (n=50), participants rated perceptions of ownership, affect, job meaningfulness and satisfaction, and role dynamics across two levels (low/high) of AI proactivity and AI competency as within-subject factors, with point-of-view (self perception/peer perception) as between-subjects. Our results showed that AI with low competency or low proactivity generally improved feelings related to ownership, meaningfulness, satisfaction, and role dynamics, and also increased positive affect while reducing negative affect. However, these effects were often influenced by point-of-view. For instance, low AI proactivity resulted in higher job satisfaction from self-perception rather than peer perception. Based on our findings, we argue that designing AI for the future of work solely around performance metrics may not be adequate. Highly competent and proactive AI-driven systems can have undesirable impacts on perceptions of ownership, job identity, social image and team dynamics, and consequently, job meaningfulness.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Interacting with Computers (Oxford University Press)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过2x2x2 vignette实验（n=50）探究AI能力（低/高）和主动性（低/高）对工作场景中人类自我感知与同伴感知的影响。结果表明，低能力或低主动性的AI普遍提升员工的ownership、工作意义、满意度和角色动态，同时增加积极情感、减少消极情感；但这些效应因视角（自我/同伴）而异。作者认为仅围绕绩效指标设计AI可能不足，高能力高主动性的AI可能对ownership感知、工作身份、社会形象和团队动态产生不良影响。
Motivation: 人机协作中被广泛倡导，但人类在AI团队中的自我感知（如工作所有权、意义）和同伴感知的体验后果尚未被系统探讨。
Method: 采用2（AI主动性：低/高）×2（AI能力：低/高）被试内设计，以视角（自我感知/同伴感知）作为被试间因素，通过vignette场景测量ownership、情感、工作意义、满意度和角色动态。
Result: 低能力或低主动性的AI改善ownership、意义、满意度及角色动态，增加积极情感并减少消极情感；但效果受视角调节，如低主动性带来的高工作满意度主要体现于自我感知而非同伴感知。
Conclusion: 仅以性能指标设计AI可能不充分，高能力高主动性的AI系统可能对ownership、工作身份、社会形象和团队动态产生不良影响，进而削弱工作意义。

papers.title: Beyond Augmentation: Score-Guided Pathological Prior for EEG-based Depression Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) detection using Electroencephalography (EEG) is fundamentally constrained by the "small-sample dilemma." Prevailing generative data augmentation methods not only incur heavy computational overhead but also risk introducing synthetic noise, thereby blurring classification boundaries. To challenge the traditional "data quantity first" convention, we propose a novel framework "Beyond Augmentation": Score-Guided Classification (SGC). SGC does not synthesize pseudo-samples; instead, it utilizes an unsupervised generative network architecture to model the structural and statistical anomaly degrees of samples, serving as the core "Pathological Prior". This prior, after robust normalization, is explicitly fused with deep feature representations, thereby precisely guiding the classifier's decision boundary. Furthermore, to dynamically adapt to varying channel configurations, we propose a Cross-Channel Spatial Adaptation module, utilizing a spatial mapping mechanism to effectively resolve the hardware heterogeneity of mismatched channels in multi-center datasets. Extensive experiments on the Mumtaz2016 and high-density MODMA datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and exceptional generalizability of our method under the challenging "zero data augmentation" setting and at "zero sample synthesis cost". Keywords: Electroencephalography (EEG), Depression Detection, Anomaly Score, Diffusion Models, Few-Shot Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EEG-based抑郁症检测中的小样本问题，提出Score-Guided Classification (SGC)框架。该框架不合成伪样本，而是利用无监督生成网络建模样本的异常程度作为病理先验，与深度特征融合后引导分类决策边界。同时提出跨通道空间适应模块解决多中心数据硬件异构问题。在Mumtaz2016和MODMA数据集上，零数据增强设置下验证了有效性和泛化性。
Motivation: 传统数据增强方法计算开销大且可能引入噪声，模糊分类边界，而小样本问题严重制约深度学习在EEG抑郁症检测中的应用。
Method: 提出SGC框架，核心是利用无监督生成网络（如扩散模型）计算每个样本的结构和统计异常分数作为病理先验，经鲁棒归一化后与深度特征显式融合。另设计跨通道空间适应模块，通过空间映射机制匹配多中心数据中不一致的通道配置。
Result: 在Mumtaz2016和高密度MODMA数据集上，该方法在零数据增强和零样本合成成本条件下展现了有效性及优秀的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文挑战了“数据量优先”的传统观念，证明不依赖数据合成、仅通过病理先验引导分类即可在EEG抑郁症检测中取得优异性能，为小样本深度学习提供了新思路。

papers.title: MyoSem: Aligning Electromyography to Natural-Language Action Semantics for Hand Action Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Electromyography (EMG) directly reflects muscle activation and is a key sensing modality for gesture recognition, prosthetic control, and wearable interaction. Existing EMG methods, however, commonly formulate hand action understanding as classification over fixed labels, making it difficult to support querying, retrieval, and generalization based on action descriptions. We present MyoSem, an EMG--action semantic alignment framework that maps low-level EMG signals into a shared semantic space constructed from multi-view action descriptions. MyoSem combines multi-view action-semantic construction, activation-aware EMG encoding, and semantic query alignment, enabling bidirectional retrieval between EMG signals and text descriptions. We systematically evaluate MyoSem on EMG2Pose and NinaPro-series datasets. Results show that MyoSem performs well on EMG--text bidirectional retrieval, generally outperforms most baselines, and shows favorable generalization to unseen users, held-out action classes, and amputee-user transfer scenarios. Ablations and visualizations further validate the effectiveness of each module. Overall, MyoSem advances EMG-based hand action understanding from fixed-label recognition toward queryable bidirectional semantic retrieval, providing a new modeling paradigm for language-mediated EMG action understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文提出MyoSem，一个将肌电图(EMG)信号与自然语言动作语义对齐的框架，通过多视角动作语义构建、激活感知EMG编码和语义查询对齐，实现EMG信号与文本描述的双向检索。在EMG2Pose和NinaPro数据集上的实验表明，MyoSem在双向检索任务中表现良好，优于多数基线，并展现出对未见用户、保留动作类别和截肢者迁移的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有EMG方法通常将手部动作理解视为固定标签分类，难以支持基于动作描述的查询、检索和泛化。
Method: MyoSem结合多视角动作语义构建、激活感知EMG编码和语义查询对齐，将低层EMG信号映射到由多视角动作描述构建的共享语义空间，实现双向检索。
Result: 在EMG2Pose和NinaPro数据集上，MyoSem在EMG-文本双向检索中表现良好，通常优于多数基线，并展现对未见用户、保留动作类别和截肢者迁移的泛化能力。
Conclusion: MyoSem将基于EMG的手部动作理解从固定标签识别推进到可查询的双向语义检索，为语言介导的EMG动作理解提供了新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CAST: Non-Privileged Clipped Asymmetric Self-Teaching with Advantage Flipping for GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), especially Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has been widely used to improve reasoning in large language models. However, outcome-level rewards provide only sparse supervision, and group-relative advantages vanish when all sampled trajectories for a prompt are either correct or incorrect. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) offers dense token-level guidance, but its token preferences are not necessarily aligned with trajectory correctness; empirical diagnostics show that OPSD signals behave differently on correct and incorrect rollouts, with teacher-positive and teacher-negative gap signals exhibiting different noise profiles. These diagnostics are conducted under an OPSD-style privileged teacher context for analysis only, whereas CAST training uses answer-free self-teacher scoring.Motivated by these observations, this work proposes CAST, an answer-free self-distillation method for GRPO-style RLVR. CAST keeps the verifier-grounded GRPO objective, but uses a stop-gradient self-teacher to shape token-level advantages according to trajectory correctness. Unlike prior self-distilled RLVR methods, CAST does not require reference-solution-conditioned teacher scoring, keeps the self-teacher log-probability gap active throughout training, and applies bidirectional local advantage sign reversal: teacher-negative tokens in correct trajectories can receive negative token-level advantages, while teacher-positive tokens in incorrect trajectories can receive bounded positive local advantages. For zero-variance all-correct and all-wrong groups, CAST assigns bounded sign-constrained base advantages, so these otherwise zero-gradient groups can contribute verifier-signed token feedback. Experiments on mathematical reasoning show that CAST improves RLVR training while retaining a lightweight, verifier-grounded trajectory-level objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAST方法，一种面向GRPO风格RLVR的自蒸馏技术，通过无参考答案的自教师模型生成token级优势信号，并处理全正确或全错误轨迹组的零梯度问题。实验表明CAST在数学推理任务上提升了RLVR训练效果。
Motivation: 现有GRPO方法在轨迹全部正确或全部错误时优势信号为零，且OPSD的token偏好可能与轨迹正确性不对齐。
Method: CAST使用停止梯度的自教师模型，基于轨迹正确性调整token级优势，对正确轨迹中教师负token施加负优势，对错误轨迹中教师正token施加有界正优势，并为全正确/全错误组分配有界符号约束的基优势。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，CAST提升了RLVR训练效果，且保持轻量级、基于验证器的轨迹级目标。
Conclusion: CAST是一种无参考答案的自蒸馏方法，通过双向局部优势符号翻转解决了GRPO的稀疏监督和零梯度问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UF-AMA: A unified framework for cross-domain emotion recognition via adaptive multimodal alignment
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, emotion recognition based on physiological signals such as electroencephalogram (EEG) has gained considerable attention, as internal physiological data offer greater objectivity and reliability compared to external behavioral data like facial expressions. However, due to distribution shifts caused by individual and contextual differences, along with variations in sample quality across modalities, constructing a cross-domain multimodal emotion recognition model with high generalization and robustness remains a key challenge. In this study, we propose a Unified Framework with Adaptive Multimodal Alignment (UF-AMA) to address cross-subject and cross-session emotion recognition using multimodal physiological signals. First, we construct a cross-modal feature fusion network comprising Transformer encoders and multi-head cross-attention modules, enabling the deep integration of EEG signals and eye-tracking data. Subsequently, we introduce a confidence-aware screening mechanism that dynamically assesses the predictive reliability of each modality branch on target domain samples, partitions samples into different quality subsets, and accordingly applies global consistency alignment and cross-modal distillation. Finally, we propose a multi-level domain adaptation framework that jointly optimizes the marginal and conditional distributions of both local modality-specific and global fusion features, thereby reducing cross-domain distribution shifts at multiple granularities. Extensive experiments on the SEED and SEED-IV datasets demonstrate that UF-AMA achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in both cross-subject and cross-session tasks. The source code is available at: https://github.com/BetterCoderLab/UF-AMA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出统一框架UF-AMA，用于基于EEG和眼动追踪等生理信号的跨域情感识别。方法包括Transformer编码器和多头交叉注意力的跨模态融合网络、置信感知筛选机制进行全局一致性对齐和跨模态蒸馏，以及多级域自适应减少分布偏移。在SEED和SEED-IV数据集上取得跨被试和跨session任务的SOTA性能。
Motivation: 个体和情境差异导致分布偏移，以及不同模态样本质量变化，使得构建高泛化性和鲁棒性的跨域多模态情感识别模型具有挑战。
Method: 构建包含Transformer编码器和多头交叉注意力的跨模态特征融合网络；引入置信感知筛选机制动态评估各模态分支可靠性，划分样本质量子集，应用全局一致性对齐和跨模态蒸馏；提出多级域自适应框架联合优化边际和条件分布。
Result: 在SEED和SEED-IV数据集上，UF-AMA在跨被试和跨session任务中达到SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 该方法通过自适应多模态对齐有效解决了跨域分布偏移和模态质量差异问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChurnNet: A Optimized Modern AI for Churn Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Increased competition and the growing similarity of products and services offered by retailers have lowered the barriers for customers to switch to competitors. Accurate churn prediction can be a valuable tool for driving effective personalized marketing campaigns and helping to reduce customer attrition. This study evaluates the performance of traditional machine learning techniques, namely, Random Forests, XGBoost, and Support Vector Machines, and compares them with the Unified Multi-Task Time Series Model for churn prediction, a binary time-series classification task. Despite the strong capacity of the latter to model complex temporal dynamics and inter-variable relationships, our results indicate that for churn prediction, conventional methods can still outperform it in terms of predictive performance, data efficiency, and computational resource requirements for training and deployment. These findings are consistent across multiple datasets and various churn labeling techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了传统机器学习方法（随机森林、XGBoost、SVM）与统一多任务时间序列模型在客户流失预测任务上的性能。结果表明，传统方法在预测性能、数据效率和计算资源需求方面仍优于复杂的时间序列模型。
Motivation: 零售商间产品和服务相似性增加，客户切换成本降低，需要准确的流失预测以驱动个性化营销和减少客户流失。
Method: 比较传统机器学习方法（随机森林、XGBoost、SVM）与统一多任务时间序列模型在二分类时间序列流失预测任务上的表现。
Result: 传统方法在多个数据集和多种流失标注技术下，预测性能、数据效率和计算资源需求均优于统一多任务时间序列模型。
Conclusion: 对于客户流失预测，传统机器学习方法仍比复杂的时间序列模型更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Modeling Robotics Dataset Construction as an Artifact-Based Build Process
papers.abstract_en: Robotic systems generate large volumes of multimodal sensor data, but converting ROS bag recordings into machine learning datasets is often handled by ad hoc sequential scripts, creating engineering overhead and slow iteration cycles. We model dataset construction as an artifact-based build process over a dependency graph and implement this approach in Bagzel, an open-source Bazel extension for reproducible, incremental dataset generation (including nuScenes-format export). We compare Bagzel and Bagzel-xattr (server-side digest management) against a sequential rosbag2nuscenes baseline. Bagzel reduces runtime in all evaluated execution modes, with the largest gains in iterative workflows (up to 386.26x in warm builds and 7.21x in incremental builds on a 20.4 GB dataset). Across dataset sizes from 5.1 to 20.4 GB, Bagzel variants show markedly better scaling behavior than the baseline, especially in warm and incremental modes. Bagzel-xattr provides additional gains, with a mean runtime reduction of 5.9% compared to Bagzel in the input granularity study. Overall, modeling robotics dataset construction as an artifact-based build process substantially reduces dataset update latency while maintaining a deterministic build design that supports reproducibility. Bagzel is publicly available at https://github.com/UniBwTAS/bagzel.
papers.comment: Accepted 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE 2026), 6 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将机器人数据集构建建模为基于工件（artifact）的构建过程，并实现为开源工具Bagzel，支持可复现、增量的数据集生成（包括nuScenes格式导出）。实验表明，与顺序脚本基线相比，Bagzel在迭代工作流中显著缩短运行时间（热构建最高加速386.26倍，增量构建加速7.21倍），并具有良好的扩展性。
Motivation: 将ROS bag录制的多模态传感器数据转换为机器学习数据集通常依赖临时编写的顺序脚本，导致工程开销大、迭代周期慢，缺乏可复现性。
Method: 使用基于依赖图的工件构建过程模拟数据集生成，通过Bazel扩展实现增量构建和输出缓存，支持服务端摘要管理（Bagzel-xattr变体）。
Result: 在20.4 GB数据集上，Bagzel热构建比顺序基线加速386.26倍，增量构建加速7.21倍；Bagzel-xattr比Bagzel平均减少5.9%运行时间；在5.1至20.4 GB数据集上均展现更好扩展性。
Conclusion: 将机器人数据集构建建模为工件构建过程可大幅降低更新延迟，同时保持确定性构建，支持可复现性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Improving IoT Intrusion Detection Through SMOTE-Based Oversampling and Extended Multi-Model Evaluation on Side-Channel Power Data
papers.abstract_en: The detection of intrusions in IoT-based networks poses challenges that cannot be overcome using traditional machine learning methods. Perhaps the biggest of them is related to the presence of a class imbalance in the side-channel dataset, where the number of samples in the normal class compared to the attacks can reach a ratio of 75,964 to 1. Such an aspect is addressed by Dominguez et al. through the proof of concept of power-based intrusion detection. Unfortunately, neither the authors attempt to cope with the problem of imbalance nor do they assess the classifier performance using a balanced training set. In the current paper, both aspects will be handled at once. First, a Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) was performed on all nine possible datasets extracted from the initial one, providing an exact imbalance ratio of 1.1 for each. Then, eight algorithms i.e. Random Forest, HistGradientBoosting, LightGBM, Extra Trees, XGBoost, k-Nearest Neighbors, Multi-Layer Perceptron, and Decision Tree were trained under identical conditions for the SMOTE balanced 6-hour dataset. Random Forest reached a micro-averaged F1 score of 0.9989 and macro F1 of 0.9794, thus outperforming the previously best micro-F1 result obtained by Time Series Forest algorithm from the base paper of 0.9983. Extra Trees provided the same performance as well, but at 10 times faster. The introduction of a macro-F1 metric explicitly in contrast to the base paper assessment reveals important class-level information missed with aggregate performance metrics. Recall rates per-class calculated with confusion matrices, F1 heatmaps, and ROC curves show that minority attack classes, especially those with combined M+L infections, are detected reliably only when using SMOTE balance. Feature importance analysis indicates the latest time steps as the most important predictor signals out of 60 steps in a power window.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 14 figures; code and results publicly available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对IoT入侵检测中侧信道功率数据类别极度不平衡的问题（正常样本与攻击样本比例可达75964:1），采用SMOTE过采样将不平衡比调整至1:1，并在9个衍生数据集上训练8种机器学习模型（随机森林、HistGradientBoosting、LightGBM、Extra Trees、XGBoost、k近邻、多层感知机、决策树）。实验表明，随机森林在6小时平衡数据集上取得微平均F1=0.9989、宏平均F1=0.9794，超越基线论文中时间序列森林的0.9983微平均F1；Extra Trees达到相同性能且速度快10倍。引入宏平均F1指标揭示了聚合指标掩盖的类别级信息，结合混淆矩阵和ROC曲线证实SMOTE平衡对少数攻击类（尤其是混合感染）的可靠检测至关重要，特征重要性分析表明功率窗口中最后时间步是最重要的预测信号。
Motivation: 现有基于侧信道功率的IoT入侵检测研究未处理类别极度不平衡问题（正常样本远多于攻击样本），且只使用聚合性能指标（如微平均F1），忽略了少数攻击类的检测表现。本文旨在同时解决这两个缺陷。
Method: 对原始数据集衍生出的9个子集分别应用SMOTE过采样，使得每个子集的正常与攻击样本不平衡比精确为1:1；然后在6小时平衡数据集上，在完全相同条件下训练8种分类器（随机森林、HistGradientBoosting、LightGBM、Extra Trees、XGBoost、k近邻、多层感知机、决策树），并使用宏平均F1、混淆矩阵、F1热力图、ROC曲线等多维度评估。
Result: 随机森林取得微平均F1=0.9989、宏平均F1=0.9794，微平均F1优于基线论文的0.9983；Extra Trees性能相同但训练速度快10倍。引入宏平均F1后发现少数攻击类（如M+L混合感染）的召回率显著低于多数类，且只有在SMOTE平衡后才可靠检测。特征重要性分析显示60步功率窗口中最后时间步贡献最大。
Conclusion: SMOTE过采样结合多模型评估能有效缓解IoT侧信道数据中的类别不平衡问题，显著提升少数攻击类的检测可靠性。宏平均F1等类别级度量比聚合指标更能反映真实分类性能，最后时间步的特征重要性为传感器布置提供指导。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对IoT入侵检测中侧信道功率数据类别极度不平衡的问题（正常样本与攻击样本比例可达75964:1），采用SMOTE过采样将不平衡比调整至1:1，并在9个衍生数据集上训练8种机器学习模型（随机森林、HistGradientBoosting、LightGBM、Extra Trees、XGBoost、k近邻、多层感知机、决策树）。实验表明，随机森林在6小时平衡数据集上取得微平均F1=0.9989、宏平均F1=0.9794，超越基线论文中时间序列森林的0.9983微平均F1；Extra Trees达到相同性能且速度快10倍。引入宏平均F1指标揭示了聚合指标掩盖的类别级信息，结合混淆矩阵和ROC曲线证实SMOTE平衡对少数攻击类（尤其是混合感染）的可靠检测至关重要，特征重要性分析表明功率窗口中最后时间步是最重要的预测信号。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于侧信道功率的IoT入侵检测研究未处理类别极度不平衡问题（正常样本远多于攻击样本），且只使用聚合性能指标（如微平均F1），忽略了少数攻击类的检测表现。本文旨在同时解决这两个缺陷。
summary_sections.method: 对原始数据集衍生出的9个子集分别应用SMOTE过采样，使得每个子集的正常与攻击样本不平衡比精确为1:1；然后在6小时平衡数据集上，在完全相同条件下训练8种分类器（随机森林、HistGradientBoosting、LightGBM、Extra Trees、XGBoost、k近邻、多层感知机、决策树），并使用宏平均F1、混淆矩阵、F1热力图、ROC曲线等多维度评估。
summary_sections.result: 随机森林取得微平均F1=0.9989、宏平均F1=0.9794，微平均F1优于基线论文的0.9983；Extra Trees性能相同但训练速度快10倍。引入宏平均F1后发现少数攻击类（如M+L混合感染）的召回率显著低于多数类，且只有在SMOTE平衡后才可靠检测。特征重要性分析显示60步功率窗口中最后时间步贡献最大。
summary_sections.conclusion: SMOTE过采样结合多模型评估能有效缓解IoT侧信道数据中的类别不平衡问题，显著提升少数攻击类的检测可靠性。宏平均F1等类别级度量比聚合指标更能反映真实分类性能，最后时间步的特征重要性为传感器布置提供指导。

papers.title: DataShield: Safety-degrading Data Filtering for LLM Benign Instruction Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from degraded safety capabilities even when fine-tuned with benign datasets. However, existing methods for identifying safety-degrading samples in benign datasets suffer from high computational costs and significant noise issues. In this paper, we propose DataShield to efficiently and effectively identify potential safety-degrading samples. Our key intuition is based on the observation that benign fine-tuning increases the overall response compliance of LLMs. DataShield's key technical insight is to quantify each sample's contribution to the model's compliance behavior as its safety degradation score. DataShield consists of three core components: (1) Compliance Vector Extraction, which captures the LLM's compliance behavior tendency; (2) a novel Compliance-Aware Score (CAS), which automatically identifies the optimal safety-critical layer; and (3) Safety-degrading Sample Filtering, which quantifies the projection shift of training data along the compliance direction. Extensive experimental evaluation on Llama3-8B, Llama3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B using the Alpaca and Dolly benign datasets validates our method's effectiveness in identifying high-risk and low-risk data subsets. We also observe that open-ended question answering is more likely to trigger safety degradation, and corresponding responses tend to be longer. We hope this work can provide new insights into data-centric defense methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/ZJunBo/DataShield.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DataShield方法，用于识别大语言模型在良性指令微调中可能导致安全能力下降的样本。该方法基于良性微调会增加模型整体顺从性这一观察，通过量化每个样本对模型顺从行为的贡献（安全退化分数）来筛选高风险样本。核心组件包括顺从向量提取、顺从感知分数（自动确定最优安全关键层）和安全退化样本过滤。实验在Llama3-8B、Llama3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上使用Alpaca和Dolly数据集验证有效性，发现开放性问题更容易触发安全退化且响应更长。
Motivation: 大语言模型即使使用良性数据集微调也会出现安全能力下降，现有识别安全退化样本的方法计算成本高且噪声大。
Method: DataShield包含三个组件：1) 顺从向量提取，捕捉模型顺从行为倾向；2) 顺从感知分数(CAS)，自动确定最佳安全关键层；3) 安全退化样本过滤，量化训练数据沿顺从方向的投影变化。
Result: 在Llama3-8B、Llama3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上使用Alpaca和Dolly数据集验证，有效区分高风险和低风险数据子集；发现开放性问题更容易触发安全退化且对应响应更长。
Conclusion: 该工作为数据中心的防御方法提供了新见解，并开源了代码。

papers.title: Digital-to-Physical Transfer of Adversarial Patches for Aerial Vehicle Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural network (DNN)-based object detectors are widely used for analyzing aerial and satellite imagery in applications such as environmental monitoring and urban analytics. Despite their strong performance, these models are known to be vulnerable to adversarial examples, and physical adversarial attacks using printable patterns pose realistic security threats. In this paper, we evaluate physical adversarial patch attacks against an aerial vehicle detector by bridging digital optimization and real-world deployment. Adversarial patches are optimized in the digital domain using a loss function that minimizes the maximum objectness score while incorporating non-printability score (NPS) and total variation (TV) constraints to ensure both printability and spatial smoothness. The optimized patches are printed and deployed in three configurations: ON, OFF, and OFF-Side. Experiments using a YOLOv3 detector show that while the OFF patch achieves the highest effectiveness in the digital domain (85.51% Average Objectness Reduction Rate (AORR)), the ON patch demonstrates superior robustness in physical environments (0.197-0.343 Objectness Score Ratio (OSR)) due to its consistent visibility. Furthermore, our results indicate that weather-based augmentation does not necessarily improve patch optimization in this domain. These findings provide critical insights into the practical vulnerabilities of aerial object detection systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了针对空中飞行器检测器的物理对抗补丁攻击。通过数字优化结合不可打印性分数（NPS）和总变差（TV）约束生成补丁，并打印为ON、OFF、OFF-Side三种配置进行物理测试。实验表明，数字域中OFF配置平均目标性降低率（AORR）达85.51%，但物理域中ON配置的目标性分数比（OSR）为0.197-0.343，鲁棒性更强；天气数据增强并未提升优化效果。
Motivation: 深度神经网络目标检测器易受对抗示例攻击，而物理可打印对抗补丁构成真实威胁，但针对空中飞行器检测的物理可打印补丁攻击研究尚不充分。
Method: 提出数字到物理的对抗补丁迁移方法：在数字域优化补丁，损失函数最小化最大目标性分数，并添加NPS和TV约束以确保可打印性和空间平滑性；优化后的补丁被打印并以三种配置（ON、OFF、OFF-Side）部署在真实场景中。
Result: 使用YOLOv3检测器实验：数字域中OFF补丁性能最优（AORR 85.51%）；物理域中ON补丁更具鲁棒性（OSR 0.197-0.343）。天气数据增强未能提升补丁优化效果。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了空中目标检测系统在实际环境中的脆弱性，指出数字优化与物理部署之间存在性能差异，并建议未来考虑物理环境因素以提升攻击的实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training-Free Continuous Bitrate Control for Scalable Image Coding for Humans and Machines
papers.abstract_en: Continuous variable-rate compression is highly demanded in real-world applications, but remains underexplored in scalable image coding for humans and machines. In this paper, we propose a training-free variable-rate scalable image coding framework. By adjusting quantization steps based on predicted scale values, the proposed method achieves continuous bitrate control while preserving high-scale information in the machine and enhancement layers. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and highlight the importance of bitrate allocation between the two layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的可变比特率可缩放图像编码框架，通过基于预测尺度值调整量化步长，实现连续比特率控制，同时保留机器层和增强层中的高尺度信息。实验证明了方法的有效性，并强调了层间比特率分配的重要性。
Motivation: 实际应用中对连续可变比特率压缩需求很高，但在面向人机协同的可缩放图像编码中，该问题尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出一种无需训练的变量比特率可缩放图像编码框架，通过根据预测的尺度值调整量化步长，实现连续比特率控制，同时保持机器层和增强层的高尺度信息。
Result: 实验结果表明该方法有效，并突显了机器层与增强层之间比特率分配的重要性。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了无需训练的连续比特率控制，适用于人机协同的可缩放图像编码，其性能依赖于层间合理的比特率分配。

papers.title: Interpreting FCDNNs via RG on Exponential Family
papers.abstract_en: We consider establishing the interpretability theory of deep learning through constructing a corresponding relationship between the renormalization group (RG) method in statistical physics and the training process of deep neural networks (DNNs). We have proved the constructed relationship using the one-dimensional Ising model as the input data. In this paper we generalize our results to the case of continuous input data, which is a necessary preparation for applying the corresponding framework to real-world data. To be representative, we consider a class of data distribution in the exponential family. We prove that when the parameters of fully connected (FC) DNNs achieve their optimal value after training, the characteristic parameters of the feature layer output of DNNs are equal to the fixed points of the characteristic parameters of input data under RG method for continuous fields. This conclusion shows that the training process of DNNs is equivalent to RG calculation on this kind of data and therefore the network can extract main features from the input data just like RG. Also, the equivalence further validates the correspondence framework we have established, providing an explanation for the outstanding performance of DNNs on real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过建立深度神经网络（DNN）训练过程与统计物理中重整化群（RG）方法之间的对应关系，为深度学习提供可解释性理论。之前工作用一维Ising模型验证了该关系，本文将结果推广到连续输入数据，具体考虑指数族分布。证明当全连接DNN训练达到最优时，其特征层输出的特征参数等于RG方法下连续场输入数据的特征参数不动点，表明DNN训练等价于对这类数据进行RG计算，从而解释DNN为何能像RG一样提取数据主要特征。
Motivation: 深度学习模型（尤其是DNN）虽然表现优异但缺乏严谨的可解释性理论。作者希望借助统计物理中成熟的重整化群方法，建立与DNN训练过程的数学对应，为DNN的特征提取能力提供理论依据。之前工作局限于离散输入（Ising模型），需要推广到连续数据以适用于真实世界应用。
Method: 将输入数据限定为指数族分布（连续概率分布的重要类），并将全连接DNN的训练过程映射为RG变换。通过数学推导，证明当网络参数达到最优时，特征层的输出参数恰好对应于RG方法中连续场特征参数的不动点。该证明依赖于对DNN结构（激活函数、权重）和RG变换算子的适当定义。
Result: 严格证明了对于指数族分布的数据，全连接DNN训练后的特征层输出参数等于该数据在连续场RG下的特征参数不动点。这一等价性直接表明DNN训练过程等价于对数据进行RG计算，因此网络能像RG一样自动提取数据的主要特征（即“粗粒化”过程）。
Conclusion: 该对应框架成功从离散推广到连续输入，进一步验证了作者之前提出的DNN-RG对应理论。这一结果不仅为DNN在真实世界数据上的优异性能提供了理论解释，也为设计更可解释的深度学习模型提供了方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A physics-informed foundation model for quantitative diffusion MRI
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the human brain requires access to its microscopic tissue architecture. Diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides the only noninvasive window into whole-brain microstructure in vivo, yet reliable quantitative mapping remains confined to specialized research settings requiring dense sampling and optimized acquisition protocols. To address this gap, we present a physics-informed generative microstructure network (PIGMENT) that learns a universal generative prior of human brain microstructure and adapts it zero-shot to each participant's measured data to recover subject-specific maps. Trained on 11375 scans spanning multiple sites, vendors, and field strengths, PIGMENT enabled reliable quantitative mapping for tensor, kurtosis, and NODDI models across external datasets from five independent centers. It remains effective where conventional fitting becomes unreliable, recovering meaningful maps from extremely sparse acquisitions while supporting downstream tractography and structural connectivity mapping. PIGMENT estimates demonstrated strong biological validity, preserving submillimeter cortical microarchitectural patterns and early-childhood white matter developmental trajectories from 10-fold accelerated scans. Furthermore, PIGMENT enables reliable quantitative tensor mapping on cost-efficient low-field systems and the extraction of tumor-related biomarkers using ultra-fast clinical protocols. Together, these results establish PIGMENT as a physics-informed foundation model that extends quantitative diffusion MRI into regimes traditionally too sparse, heterogeneous, or clinically constrained for reliable analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了物理信息生成式微结构网络（PIGMENT），一种用于定量扩散MRI的基础模型。该模型在11375次扫描上训练，涵盖多个站点、供应商和场强，能够零样本适应个体受试者的测量数据，重建张量、峰度和NODDI模型的定量参数图。在外部数据集、稀疏采集、低场强系统以及超快临床协议中均表现有效，并保留了亚毫米皮质微结构和早期白质发育轨迹。
Motivation: 定量扩散MRI的可靠映射仍局限于需要密集采样和优化采集协议的专业研究环境，缺乏可推广至临床常规和异构数据的方法。
Method: 提出物理信息生成式微结构网络（PIGMENT），学习人脑微结构的通用生成先验，并通过零样本适应每个受试者的测量数据，恢复个体化的参数图。

papers.title: A Protocol-Language Model for Network Intrusion (Without Deep Packet Inspection)
papers.abstract_en: Modern network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) are caught in a structural contradiction: the protocols carrying the highest threat intelligence are precisely those encrypted under TLS 1.3 and QUIC, where payload inspection yields nothing. We ask a simpler question -- what if the attack signature is not in the bytes, but in the rhythm? -- and answer it by treating network flows as a language whose grammar is written entirely in L3/L4 packet metadata: length, inter-arrival time, TTL, TCP flags, and hashed port numbers. We present PLM-NIDS, which proves three claims in sequence. (1) The grammar exists and is learnable: a RWKV-4 state-space model trained on 344,232 unlabelled Monday flows achieves a causal LM validation loss of 0.204, demonstrating that benign traffic has predictable, statistically consistent structure. (2) Attacks violate this grammar: the per-flow perplexity score cleanly separates benign from attack flows with PR-AUC = 0.93 using zero attack labels at training time. (3) This separation is architecturally nontrivial: an LSTM trained on identical token sequences degenerates to a majority-class predictor (ROC-AUC approximately 0.50, F1 = 0.91 by always predicting "attack"), proving that RWKV's causal pre-training provides an inductive bias unavailable to direct classifiers. Supervised fine-tuning further raises PR-AUC to 0.94 and ROC-AUC to 0.75, with a precision of 97.7% at the calibrated operating threshold. The RWKV backbone's O(T) recurrent inference enables per-packet streaming without flow buffering, making PLM-NIDS operationally viable at line rate. Because it reads only IP/TCP/UDP headers, it is inherently encryption-agnostic: TLS 1.3, QUIC, and future encrypted protocols are handled transparently.

TL;DR: 本文提出PLM-NIDS，将网络流视为语言，仅基于L3/L4包头元数据（长度、到达间隔、TTL、TCP标志、哈希端口）使用RWKV-4状态空间模型进行无监督异常检测。在344232条未标记的Monday流上训练，验证损失0.204，perplexity区分正常与攻击流PR-AUC=0.93。微调后PR-AUC=0.94，ROC-AUC=0.75，精度97.7%。支持逐包流式推理，不依赖深度包检测，对加密协议透明。
Motivation: 现代NIDS面临加密协议（TLS 1.3, QUIC）下深度包检测无效的困境，需要不依赖载荷的入侵检测方法。
Method: 将网络流视为语言，使用RWKV-4因果语言模型在L3/L4包元数据序列上预训练，利用perplexity分数检测异常；并与LSTM对比证明RWKV的归纳偏置优势。

Conclusion: 基于包元数据的语言模型可在不进行深度包检测的情况下有效检测网络入侵，且对加密协议天然兼容，RWKV的O(T)推理支持线速率流式处理。

papers.title: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs on Code Generation for Complex Interactive Webpages
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal reasoning and code generation, catalyzing a new paradigm for front-end development. In particular, these models can directly transform visual designs into executable code, significantly improving the efficiency and adaptability of web development. Modern web applications are dynamic and interactive, featuring frequent user-page interactions. However, existing benchmarks largely evaluate the code generation of static webpages, ignoring the complex interactive behaviors in real-world applications. Besides, their evaluation criteria remain confined to visual fidelity and code structure, overlooking the interaction consistency between the generated and the reference webpages. To address these limitations, we introduce WebIGBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate code generation for interactive webpages with complex interactions. By combining manually designed interaction paths with UI automation, we collected 103 complex webpages from real-world websites. This benchmark covers 5 popular interactive action types (e.g., click, input) involving 871 distinct interactive actions. Moreover, we propose a novel evaluation pipeline to address the gap in automated assessment of interactive actions. Extensive experiments on several representative MLLMs reveal the performance boundaries of current models in interactive webpage code generation using WebIGBench. The proposed benchmark is available at https://github.com/anoa12159-hue/WebIGBench_eval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WebIGBench，是首个针对复杂交互网页代码生成的多模态大语言模型基准测试。它收集了103个真实网页的871个交互动作，覆盖点击、输入等5种动作类型，并提出了自动评估交互一致性的管线。实验揭示了当前MLLM在生成交互式网页代码时的性能边界。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估静态网页代码生成，忽略了现代网页的动态交互行为，且评估标准局限于视觉保真度和代码结构，缺乏交互一致性度量。
Method: 构建WebIGBench，通过UI自动化与手动设计的交互路径收集103个复杂网页，包含871个交互动作和5种交互类型；提出新型评估管线，自动对比生成网页与参考网页的交互一致性。
Result: 在多个代表性MLLM上的实验表明，当前模型在生成与真实交互行为一致的网页代码方面仍存在显著性能差距。
Conclusion: WebIGBench填补了交互式网页代码生成评估的空白，为未来研究提供了标准化的测试平台与自动化评估方法。

papers.title: DiffCrossGait: Trajectory-Level Alignment for 2D-3D Cross-Modal Gait Recognition via Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal 2D-3D gait recognition is impeded by inherent domain discrepancies between 2D silhouette and 3D LiDAR range-view representations. While prior methods align only final embeddings, we propose DiffCrossGait, which reformulates cross-modal matching as trajectory-level alignment in an identity-relevant latent diffusion space, rather than assuming full equivalence between 2D and 3D observations. By driving both modalities with shared Gaussian noise within a latent space, we enable continuous alignment throughout the generative evolution. We introduce a Tri-Phase Alignment Strategy that exploits varying noise intensities to enforce identity anchoring, dynamics consistency, and cross-modal structural recoverability, thereby constraining both modalities to share denoising dynamics and bottleneck structure, which promotes modality-invariant gait features. Crucially, our framework decouples generative alignment from the discriminative backbone; the diffusion mechanism serves exclusively as a training objective, ensuring high inference efficiency by eliminating the computational overhead of iterative denoising. Extensive experiments on the SUSTech1K and FreeGait benchmarks demonstrate that DiffCrossGait achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiffCrossGait，通过隐空间扩散模型实现2D-3D跨模态步态识别的轨迹级对齐。关键创新在于引入三阶段对齐策略，利用噪声强度控制身份锚定、动态一致性和跨模态结构可恢复性，使两种模态共享去噪动力学。该方法将生成式对齐作为训练目标，推理时无需迭代去噪，保持高效。在SUSTech1K和FreeGait基准上取得最优结果。
Motivation: 现有跨模态步态识别方法仅对齐最终嵌入，忽略了2D轮廓与3D LiDAR深度图之间的固有域差异，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出DiffCrossGait框架，在隐空间中对两种模态施加相同高斯噪声，通过三阶段对齐策略（身份锚定、动力学一致性、跨模态结构可恢复性）强制共享去噪动力学和瓶颈结构，从而学习模态不变步态特征。生成对齐仅用于训练，推理时无额外计算。
Result: 在SUSTech1K和FreeGait两个基准上达到当前最优性能，具体数据参见原文。
Conclusion: 通过隐空间扩散实现轨迹级对齐有效缓解了2D-3D域差异，且推理高效；可推广至其他跨模态识别任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PrivacyPeek: Auditing What LLM-Based Agents Acquire, Not Just What They Say
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are rapidly advancing, autonomously invoking external tools to complete multi-step tasks for users. However, agents often acquire more sensitive information than the task requires. Existing privacy benchmarks audit what the agent's response or outgoing actions disclose, but overlook the acquisition stage where data first enters the agent's context. The over-acquired information is then one careless action or one attack away from an outright leak. To assess its prevalence, we introduce \emph{PrivacyPeek}, a benchmark for evaluating acquisition-stage privacy leakage of LLM-based agents, with $1{,}182$ cases across $7$ acquisition behaviours and $16$ application domains. Specifically, \emph{Acquisition Inspection} examines the agent's tool-call trajectory, both the tools it invokes and the data it receives, to detect when it acquires sensitive information beyond the task scope. \emph{Probe Elicitation} then issues a follow-up probe and measures how readily an attacker could elicit sensitive information the agent acquired but did not disclose. Our experiments on 10 LLM-based agents across 4 model families show that the unnecessary acquisition of sensitive information is widespread. In addition, we observe a correlation between the task-completion capability and acquisition-stage leakage. Prompt-level defences reduce only a small fraction of acquisition-stage leakage, leaving the majority unmitigated. These results make auditing acquisition-stage privacy both urgent and necessary. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Xuan269/PrivacyPeek-Resource.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PrivacyPeek基准，用于审计基于LLM的智能体在获取阶段（而非输出阶段）的隐私泄露。该基准包含1182个案例，覆盖7种获取行为和16个应用领域，通过“获取检查”和“探针诱发”两个维度评估。实验表明，不必要地获取敏感信息普遍存在，且与任务完成能力相关，提示级别的防御效果有限。
Motivation: 现有隐私基准只审计智能体响应或外部动作泄露了什么，但忽略了数据进入智能体上下文的获取阶段。过获取的信息随时可能因一次疏忽或攻击而完全泄露，因此需要评估其普遍性。
Method: 提出PrivacyPeek基准，包含两个组件：1) Acquisition Inspection，检查工具调用轨迹，检测是否获取超出任务范围的敏感信息；2) Probe Elicitation，通过后续探针询问，测量攻击者能从已获取但未披露的信息中提取敏感信息的难易程度。
Result: 在10个基于LLM的智能体（4个模型族）上的实验表明，不必要地获取敏感信息广泛存在；任务完成能力与获取阶段泄露之间存在相关性；提示层面的防御只能减少一小部分获取阶段泄露，大部分未缓解。
Conclusion: 审计获取阶段的隐私既紧迫又必要。实验结果表明现有防御不足，需要更有效的措施。

papers.title: Emergence of Exploration in Policy Gradient Reinforcement Learning via Retrying
papers.abstract_en: In reinforcement learning (RL), agents benefit from exploration only because they repeatedly encounter similar states: trying different actions can improve performance or reduce uncertainty; without such retries, a greedy policy is optimal. We formalize this intuition with ReMax, an objective that evaluates a policy by the expected maximum return over $M$ samples, where $M$ is a positive integer, while accounting for return uncertainty. Optimizing this objective induces stochastic exploration as an emergent property, without explicit bonus terms. For efficient policy optimization, we derive a new policy-gradient formulation for ReMax and introduce ReMax PPO (RePPO), a PPO variant that optimizes ReMax while generalizing the discrete retry count $M$ to a continuous parameter $m > 0$, enabling fine-grained control of exploration. Empirically, RePPO promotes exploration, without any explicit exploration bonuses, on the MinAtar and Craftax benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReMax目标函数，通过最大化M个样本的期望回报并考虑不确定性，使随机探索作为涌现属性出现，无需显式探索奖励。基于此推导了RePPO算法，将离散重试次数M扩展为连续参数m以精细控制探索，在MinAtar和Craftax基准上验证了探索效果。
Motivation: 强化学习中智能体只有重复遇到相似状态时才能从探索中获益；若无法重试，贪婪策略即为最优。现有方法需显式探索奖励，本文旨在实现探索的涌现。
Method: 提出ReMax目标，评估策略在M个样本上的期望最大回报；推导其策略梯度公式，并引入RePPO（ReMax PPO），将离散M扩展为连续参数m>0以调控探索强度。
Result: 在MinAtar和Craftax基准上，RePPO在无需任何显式探索奖励的情况下促进了探索行为。
Conclusion: RePPO通过优化重试期望最大化目标，有效激发了随机探索，为策略梯度方法提供了一种无需额外奖励的探索机制。

summary_sections.motivation: 强化学习中智能体只有重复遇到相似状态时才能从探索中获益；若无法重试，贪婪策略即为最优。现有方法需显式探索奖励，本文旨在实现探索的涌现。
summary_sections.method: 提出ReMax目标，评估策略在M个样本上的期望最大回报；推导其策略梯度公式，并引入RePPO（ReMax PPO），将离散M扩展为连续参数m>0以调控探索强度。
summary_sections.result: 在MinAtar和Craftax基准上，RePPO在无需任何显式探索奖励的情况下促进了探索行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: RePPO通过优化重试期望最大化目标，有效激发了随机探索，为策略梯度方法提供了一种无需额外奖励的探索机制。

papers.title: Persona Attack: Incremental Memory Injection Jailbreak Attack against Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models evolve for user convenience, vulnerability to jailbreak attacks continues to be reported despite ongoing efforts in safety training. Traditional jailbreak techniques typically focus on a single prompt injection, neglecting the models' ability to remember the flow of conversation and the user's instructions. In this paper, we propose Persona Attack, a memory injection based jailbreak method that manipulates the model's context window through a step by step approach. Experimental results from applying Persona Attack to several widely used LLMs reveal that, as injections accumulate in memory, models increasingly prioritize these instructions over their internal safety alignment mechanisms. Furthermore, our experiments empirically demonstrate that the attack success rate varies not only according to the memory implementation of the model, but also combinations of instructions and can reach 95% under specific instruction configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Persona Attack 的新型越狱攻击方法，通过逐步向大语言模型的上下文窗口中注入记忆，使其优先遵循注入指令而非安全对齐机制。实验表明，随着注入积累，攻击成功率可达95%，且因模型记忆实现和指令组合而异。
Motivation: 现有单一提示注入（single prompt injection）越狱方法忽略了模型对对话流程和用户指令的记忆能力，无法有效突破安全训练。
Method: 提出 Persona Attack，一种逐步向模型上下文窗口注入记忆的越狱方法，通过累积指令覆盖模型的安全对齐。
Result: 在多个广泛使用的LLM上，攻击成功率随记忆注入增加而上升，特定指令组合下可达95%。
Conclusion: 攻击成功率不仅取决于模型的记忆实现，还依赖于指令组合；该研究揭示了大语言模型记忆机制的安全风险。

papers.title: StemBind: When MLLMs Get Lost Between Rules and Instances in Abstract Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often know the rule but pick the wrong answer: on abstract visual reasoning (AVR) tasks, a model can describe what it sees and name the underlying pattern, yet still fail to choose the matching candidate. Existing AVR benchmarks cannot detect this because they collapse perception, rule induction, and answer selection into a single right-or-wrong signal. We introduce StemBind, a shared-stem diagnostic benchmark that probes the same visual stem with three aligned questions: Perception (what is in the image), Rule (what pattern governs it), and Full (which option completes it), so a final-answer error can be attributed to a specific sub-step on the same evidence. StemBind contains 2,298 curated knowledge-light stems across nine auditable visual operations, totaling 19,533 P/R/F tasks, with each full item annotated by Sternberg's four reasoning stages (S1 Encode, S2 Infer, S3 Map, S4 Apply). Evaluating 24 frontier MLLM configurations yields four findings. (i) The R-F chasm: rule accuracy exceeds full-item accuracy on 22 of 24 models, so most failures happen after the rule is identified. (ii) A persistent binding gap: even when P and R are both correct on the same stem, models still answer F incorrectly 51.2% of the time. (iii) The bottleneck is S3: process diagnostics and Stage-wise Stimulus Augmentation localize the dominant failure to rule-to-instance mapping. (iv) Scaling and thinking do not help: neither larger models nor explicit thinking mode reliably closes the gap, and thinking even lowers rule and full-item accuracy. StemBind reframes AVR evaluation from final-answer ranking to locating where abstract visual reasoning breaks down, identifying rule-to-instance binding as a concrete next target for vision-grounded reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StemBind，一个用于诊断多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在抽象视觉推理（AVR）中失败原因的基准。通过共享视觉主干的三类问题（感知、规则、完整）将错误归因到具体子步骤，发现模型在规则识别后仍因规则-实例绑定失败而出错，且缩放模型和思维链无法解决。
Motivation: 现有 AVR 基准无法区分模型是感知错误、规则归纳错误还是答案选择错误，导致无法定位推理断裂点。
Method: 构建包含 2298 个共享主干和 19533 个任务的 StemBind 基准，每个主干包含感知、规则、完整三类问题，并标注 Sternberg 的四个推理阶段（编码、推断、映射、应用）。
Result: 在 24 个前沿 MLLM 上发现：规则准确率高于完整准确率（22/24 模型）；即使感知和规则都正确，仍有 51.2% 的完整任务失败；主要瓶颈在映射阶段；扩大模型或使用思维链模式无帮助甚至有害。
Conclusion: 抽象视觉推理的关键失败环节是规则-实例绑定，该基准为细粒度诊断提供了工具。

papers.title: RAFT: Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Domain-specific supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often improves in-domain performance at the cost of degrading a model's general capabilities. We view this degradation through two practical gaps in domain SFT: a supervision-compatibility gap, where domain targets differ in style and reasoning format from the original model's natural responses, and a trajectory-preservation gap, where teacher-forced SFT optimizes fixed target tokens without constraining the model's behavior on its own generated prefixes. This process fails to preserve the model's original behavior. We propose RAFT (Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting), a two-stage framework that addresses both factors. First, RAFT constructs model-compatible supervision through self-conditioned rewriting, semantic filtering, and answer fusion. Second, RAFT performs Answer-Conditioned On-Policy Distillation, where the original instruction-tuned model provides soft targets on student-generated trajectories while being conditioned on the fused answer as helpful context. We further introduce top-K temperature distillation and EMA-based adaptive loss balancing to stabilize the domain-general trade-off. Across three instruction-tuned backbones and five domains, RAFT improves average domain accuracy by 23.2% over standard SFT, while recovering part of the SFT-induced degradation on MS-Bench and IFEval, with relative improvements of 18.2% and 10.2%, respectively. These results show that coupling data refinement with trajectory-level preservation provides an effective recipe for domain fine-tuning with alleviated forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对域特定监督微调（SFT）导致模型通用能力退化的问题，提出RAFT框架，通过数据精炼和自适应蒸馏来缓解遗忘。RAFT分为两个阶段：首先通过自我条件重写、语义过滤和答案融合构建与模型兼容的监督数据；然后执行答案条件化在线策略蒸馏，利用原始指令微调模型为学生生成轨迹提供软目标，并引入top-K温度蒸馏和EMA自适应损失平衡。在三个指令微调基座和五个领域上，RAFT相比标准SFT平均域准确率提升23.2%，并在MS-Bench和IFEval上分别相对提升18.2%和10.2%。
Motivation: 域SFT常以牺牲通用能力为代价，现有研究未能充分解决两个实践间隙：监督-兼容性间隙（域目标与模型原始回应在风格和推理格式上不同）和轨迹-保持间隙（教师强迫SFT优化固定目标标记，未约束模型自身生成前缀上的行为）。
Method: 提出两阶段框架RAFT：第一阶段通过自我条件重写、语义过滤和答案融合构造模型兼容的监督；第二阶段执行答案条件化在线策略蒸馏，原始指令微调模型在学生生成轨迹上提供软目标，并辅以top-K温度蒸馏和EMA自适应损失平衡。
Result: 在三个基座和五个领域上，RAFT相对于标准SFT平均域准确率提升23.2%，同时恢复部分SFT导致的通用能力退化，在MS-Bench和IFEval上相对提升18.2%和10.2%。
Conclusion: 将数据精炼与轨迹级保留相结合为域微调提供了一种有效方案，可缓解遗忘。

papers.title: Multi-Contrast MRI Motion Correction via Parameter-Informed Disentanglement and Adaptive Experts
papers.abstract_en: Motion artifacts in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) degrade diagnostic reliability. Existing deep learning methods are typically contrast-specific and fail to generalize across diverse modalities and artifact severities. We propose a unified framework combining parameter-informed contrast disentanglement with severity-aware adaptive correction. ScanCLIP, pretrained on over 30,000 MRI text-image pairs, derives contrast embeddings from acquisition parameters to disentangle contrast style from anatomical content, yielding contrast-free features. A Vision Transformer then estimates motion severity and routes features through a Mixture-of-Experts network, enabling targeted artifact correction. A dual-pathway decoder reconstructs both the clean image and residual artifact map, enforcing image-space consistency. On IXI and HCP benchmarks, our method improves PSNR by 0.75 dB and SSIM by up to 0.0279 over state-of-the-art approaches, with larger gains at higher artifact severities. It further demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real-world clinical data acquired with unseen scanning parameters, where existing methods either fail to remove artifacts or introduce additional distortions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的MRI运动伪影校正框架，结合参数信息引导的对比度解耦与严重度感知自适应专家网络。ScanCLIP在超过30000对MRI文本-图像对上预训练，从采集参数中提取对比度嵌入以分离对比度风格与解剖内容，得到对比度无关特征。Vision Transformer估计运动严重度并通过混合专家网络路由特征，实现针对性伪影校正。双路径解码器同时重建干净图像和残差伪影图。在IXI和HCP基准上，该方法PSNR提升0.75 dB，SSIM最高提升0.0279，在更严重伪影下增益更大，且在未见过扫描参数的临床数据上展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有深度学习MRI运动校正方法通常针对特定对比度，无法泛化到不同模态和伪影严重度，因此需要统一框架。
Method: 提出参数信息引导的对比度解耦（通过ScanCLIP从采集参数提取对比度嵌入）与严重度感知自适应校正（Vision Transformer估计严重度，路由至混合专家网络），结合双路径解码器重建干净图像和残差伪影图。
Result: 在IXI和HCP上，PSNR提升0.75 dB，SSIM最高提升0.0279，尤其在更高伪影严重度下增益更大，并在临床数据上实现零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效处理多对比度MRI运动伪影，且对未见扫描参数具有鲁棒性，但摘要未明确局限性。

papers.title: Completion at the Boundary (CaB): Deployable Switching with Completion-Aware Control under Limited Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) agents can execute natural-language instructions, yet deployed systems still lack an operational interface: deciding when the instruction is complete. This gap is acute in short composites ("do A, then B"), where mistimed handoffs cascade into downstream failures. Completion is inherently closed-loop because switching is an intervention that changes the instruction context and thus future actions and observations. We study completion under a deployable low-calibration regime motivated by open-ended instruction spaces, enforcing no test-time relearning and a single globally calibrated switching rule selected once on development set and reused unchanged on test set. Under this constraint, collapsing asymmetric boundary evidence into a single scalar can be brittle under polarity shifts across tasks. We propose Completion at the Boundary (CaB), which predicts an event-local completion object in the form of Boundary-Phase Tokens (Before/Hit/After), retaining two-sided boundary evidence under this discipline. CaB-When converts this completion object into a minimal, auditable switching decision (when), while CaB-How reuses the same completion object to condition action generation for boundary-stable control through handoffs (how). Using an intervention-aware E1/E2 protocol, we show that CaB improves composite execution and handoff quality on a first-person Minecraft VLA benchmark under matched capacity and deployability constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Completion at the Boundary (CaB)方法，用于VLA代理在组合任务中的完成检测与切换决策。CaB通过预测边界阶段令牌（Before/Hit/After）保留两侧证据，并在低校准（全局单一切换规则且无测试时重学习）约束下，分别生成切换时机（CaB-When）和动作条件化（CaB-How）。在Minecraft VLA基准上，该方法改善了组合执行和交接质量。
Motivation: 现有VLA代理缺乏判断指令何时完成的操作接口，尤其在短组合任务中，误时切换会导致下游任务级联失败。
Method: 提出CaB方法，预测事件本地的完成对象——边界阶段令牌（Before/Hit/After），以保留两侧边界证据；CaB-When将其转换为可审计的切换决策，CaB-How复用同一对象来条件化动作生成以实现边界稳定控制。
Result: 在Minecraft VLA基准上使用干预感知E1/E2协议，CaB在保持模型容量和可部署性约束下，提升了组合执行和交接质量。
Conclusion: 在可部署的低校准约束下，保留两侧边界证据比单标量方法更鲁棒，CaB为VLA代理提供了有效的完成检测和切换机制。

papers.title: BudgetDraft: Acceptance-Aware Multi-View Training for Sparse-KV Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding speeds up autoregressive decoding by using a drafter to propose multiple tokens that a verifier validates in parallel. In resource-constrained deployments, the drafter uses a sparse KV cache to limit peak GPU memory and end-to-end latency under a fixed KV budget, while the verifier keeps a full KV cache. Mid-to-long context inference (4K--16K context length) is common in real applications. However, naive sparse/full speculative decoding suffers from the sparse/full mismatch as context length grows, causing the acceptance rate to drop quickly. We propose BudgetDraft, a multi-view sparse training method for sparse drafting in mid-to-long inference. The drafter is exposed to multiple sampled KV budgets during training and learns to align each sparse view with one shared full-cache teacher target. BudgetDraft combines an acceptance-aware loss on a full-cache branch with a multi-view loss on a sparse-cache branch, producing a single budget-robust drafter that recovers acceptance across sparsity levels without extra inference-time components. Experimental results on PG-19, LongBench, and LWM show that BudgetDraft achieves up to 6.55x, 4.46x, and 2.10x end-to-end speedup vs AR at 4K, 8K, and 16K context lengths, while keeping the inference pipeline memory-friendly.

papers.title: Regime-Adaptive Continual Learning for Portfolio Management
papers.abstract_en: Financial markets are inherently non-stationary, exhibiting frequent regime shifts and structural changes that render traditional Portfolio Management (PM) approaches ineffective. Existing remedies, such as rolling-window retraining and naive online fine-tuning, are hindered by high computational costs and insufficient knowledge utilization, respectively, resulting in low returns and limited adaptability. Continual learning (CL) offers a promising paradigm by enabling trading agents to accumulate and transfer knowledge across sequential tasks. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Re}gime-aware \textbf{C}ontinual \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{P}ortfolio management (\textbf{ReCAP}), a novel framework that integrates CL into PM to address the challenges of dynamic financial environments. ReCAP employs an adaptive regime detection module to segment historical market data into variable-length regimes, enabling regime-specific learning of policy vectors and the construction of a policy library. During continual trading, a regime-gate module adaptively combines policy vectors from the library based on the current market state, facilitating rapid adaptation to newly detected regimes. Only the regime-gate and the current regime's policy vector are continually updated to preserve useful knowledge effectively. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate that ReCAP consistently outperforms popular baselines, achieving superior returns in long-term investment horizons and rapid adaptation to regime shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReCAP框架，将持续学习（CL）引入投资组合管理（PM），以应对金融市场的非平稳性和体制转换。该框架通过自适应体制检测模块将市场数据分割为可变长度的体制，学习体制特定的策略向量并构建策略库；交易时，体制门模块根据当前市场状态自适应组合策略向量，仅更新体制门和当前体制的策略向量以保留知识。在五个真实数据集上，ReCAP在长期投资回报和快速适应体制转换方面均优于传统基线方法。
Motivation: 金融市场具有非平稳性，频繁的体制转换和结构性变化使得传统PM方法失效，而现有滚动窗口重训练和在线微调方法分别存在计算成本高和知识利用不足的问题。
Method: 提出ReCAP框架，包含自适应体制检测模块（将历史数据分割为可变长度体制）、策略库（存储体制特定策略向量）和体制门模块（根据当前市场状态自适应组合策略向量）；仅持续更新体制门和当前体制的策略向量。
Result: 在五个真实数据集上，ReCAP在长期投资回报和体制转换适应速度方面持续优于多种流行基线。
Conclusion: 持续学习与体制自适应结合可有效提升投资组合管理在动态环境中的性能，但框架依赖体制检测的准确性，且未涉及交易成本等实际因素。

papers.title: Adaptive data selection improves wearable prediction under low baseline performance
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive sensing strategies that selectively sample data are increasingly used in wearable health systems to improve prediction performance under limited data budgets, yet their benefits across individuals remain poorly understood. Here, we evaluate adaptive selection of time windows for model training under fixed measurement budgets across multiple sensing modalities, including heart rate, activity, and ecological momentary assessment (EMA), in a longitudinal wearable dataset. We quantify performance gains relative to random sampling using both area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and F1 score. Adaptive strategies yield substantial improvements in AUROC for participants with low baseline performance (with gains up to 0.7), while offering limited or negative gains for participants with strong baselines. Across modalities, adaptive gain is strongly inversely correlated with baseline performance (Pearson r = -0.67; Spearman p = -0.62). At the participant level, most individuals benefit in AUROC (60-80% across modalities), although improvements in F1 are smaller and less consistent. These findings show that adaptive sensing is not uniformly beneficial, but instead provides the greatest value in underperforming settings. Our results support selective deployment strategies that tailor adaptive sensing based on baseline performance to improve efficiency in wearable health monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可穿戴健康系统中自适应数据选择策略对预测性能的影响。基于纵向可穿戴数据集（包括心率、活动和生态瞬时评估），在固定测量预算下评估自适应时间窗口选择相对于随机抽样的性能提升。结果表明，自适应策略对基线性能较低的参与者有显著AUROC提升（最高0.7），但对基线性能好的参与者提升有限或为负；自适应增益与基线性能呈强负相关（Pearson r=-0.67）。大多数参与者在AUROC上受益（60-80%），但F1提升较小且不一致。结论指出自适应感知并非普遍有益，而是在低性能场景中价值最大。
Motivation: 自适应感知策略被越来越多地用于可穿戴健康系统以在有限数据预算下提升预测性能，但其个体差异尚未被充分理解。
Method: 在多模态可穿戴数据集上，针对固定测量预算，评估自适应选择时间窗口进行模型训练相对于随机采样的性能提升，使用AUROC和F1指标。
Result: 自适应策略使基线性能较低的参与者AUROC提升高达0.7，而基线性能好的参与者提升有限；自适应增益与基线性能呈强负相关（Pearson r=-0.67）；大多数参与者（60-80%）在AUROC上受益，但F1提升较小且不一致。
Conclusion: 自适应感知并非对所有个体均匀有益，其最大价值体现在性能欠佳的场景；建议根据基线性能定制自适应传感部署策略以提高效率。

papers.title: Geometric Erasure by Contrastive Velocity Matching in Rectified Flows
papers.abstract_en: While the rapid adoption of multimodal generative models offers immense potential, it has also increased the risks of harmful content synthesis, deepfakes, and copyright infringements. To address these challenges, concept erasure has emerged as a prospective safeguard. However, as the field gradually transitions from U-Net-based diffusion models to Rectified Flow Transformers, erasure research has struggled to keep pace. In this work, we introduce GEM, a simple but highly effective erasure framework for Rectified Flow models. As part of our contribution, we establish a principled bridge between trajectory-based unlearning grounded in Generative Flow Networks and classic teacher-guided erasure: we translate trajectory-based signals into a teacher-guided flow-matching setup that unifies the strengths of both paradigms. Concretely, a teacher provides complementary attraction and repulsion signals that we combine into a single geometric guidance objective, yielding targeted suppression of unwanted concepts while preserving benign generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GEM，一个用于Rectified Flow模型的概念擦除框架。作者建立了轨迹级遗忘与教师指导擦除之间的理论桥梁，将轨迹信号转化为教师指导的流匹配目标，实现几何引导，抑制不想要的概念同时保留良性生成。
Motivation: 随着多模态生成模型的快速采用，有害内容合成、深度伪造和版权侵权风险增加。现有概念擦除方法主要针对U-Net扩散模型，但难以适应新出现的Rectified Flow Transformer模型。
Method: 提出GEM框架，通过对比速度匹配实现几何擦除。具体地，教师提供互补的吸引和排斥信号，组合成单一的几何引导目标，在Rectified Flow模型中进行训练。
Result: 摘要声称GEM在概念擦除上简单但非常有效，能够靶向抑制不想要的概念同时保持良性生成能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调建立了轨迹级遗忘与教师指导擦除之间的原则性桥梁，并展示了在Rectified Flow模型上的有效性。

papers.title: BenHalluEval: A Multi-Task Hallucination Evaluation Framework for Large Language Models on Bengali
papers.abstract_en: Despite Bengali being the sixth most spoken language in the world, no prior work has systematically evaluated hallucination in large language models (LLMs) for Bengali. We introduce BenHalluEval, a fine-grained hallucination evaluation framework for Bengali covering four tasks: Generative Question Answering (GQA), Bangla-English Code-Mixed QA, Summarization, and Reasoning. We construct 12,000 hallucinated candidates using GPT-5.4 across twelve task-specific hallucination types, drawn from three existing Bengali datasets, and evaluate seven LLMs spanning reasoning-oriented, multilingual, and Bengali-centric categories under a dual-track protocol that independently measures false-positive rate on ground-truth instances (Track A) and hallucination detection rate on hallucinated candidates (Track B). To jointly penalise both failure modes and prevent inflated scores from uniform response bias, we propose BenHalluScore, a dual-track calibration metric that ranges from 7.72% to 55.42% across models and tasks, revealing substantial variation in hallucination calibration. Chain-of-thought prompting, applied as a mitigation strategy, shifts response distributions without consistently improving hallucination discrimination. BenHalluEval establishes the first dedicated hallucination benchmark for Bengali and highlights the inadequacy of single-track and prompting-only evaluation approaches for low-resource language settings. The dataset and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BanglaHalluEval-EB77.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BenHalluEval，首个针对孟加拉语的大语言模型幻觉评估框架，涵盖生成式问答、孟加拉语-英语混合问答、摘要和推理四个任务。构建了 12,000 个幻觉候选实例，评估了七个 LLM，并提出了双轨校准指标 BenHalluScore，揭示模型在不同任务上的幻觉校准差异。
Motivation: 尽管孟加拉语是使用最广泛的语言之一，但尚无系统评估 LLM 在该语言上的幻觉问题。
Method: 构建 BenHalluEval 框架，包含四个任务和十二种幻觉类型，采用双轨协议（Track A 测量假阳性率，Track B 测量幻觉检测率）并引入 BenHalluScore 联合校准指标。
Result: BenHalluScore 在模型和任务间从 7.72% 到 55.42%，显示幻觉校准差异大；思维链提示未能持续改善幻觉辨别。
Conclusion: BenHalluEval 是首个孟加拉语幻觉基准，表明单轨和仅提示评估方法在低资源语言设置中不足。
