papers.title: Dissociative Identity: Language Model Agents Lack Grounding for Reputation Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous language model agents proliferate, forming an emerging agentic web with real-world consequences, what credibility signals can you use to decide whether to trust an unfamiliar agent in the wild and delegate to it? A natural governance intuition is to extend human identity verification and reputation mechanisms, from ``Know Your Customer'' and credit scores to ``Know Your Agent'' regimes. However, we argue that this analogy is fundamentally incomplete. Reputation mechanisms function both as social signals and as corrective feedback that sustain an equilibrium of trustworthy behavior, presuming a persistent identity associated with behavioral continuity, sanction sensitivity, and costly non-fungibility. Yet language model agents are ontologically \emph{dissociative}: they are essentially an assemblage of mutable modules -- foundation models, system prompts, tool-access policies, external memory, and, in some cases, a multi-agent system as a whole -- any of which may change agent behavior -- with a fluid persona that is also vulnerable to adversarial attack and may not internalize sanctions. Drawing on dissociative identity disorder jurisprudence, this dissociativity leaves agents without grounding for identifiability, predictability, credibility, and rehabilitability -- the very properties that reputation mechanisms aim to sustain -- thereby collapsing trust. We argue that identity-based, ex post, regulative, sanction-based governance, such as reputation, is structurally inapplicable to dissociative agents, and we suggest a shift to observability-based, ex ante, constitutive, protocol-based behavioral harnesses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证语言模型代理（LM agent）本质上具有“解离性”（dissociative），即其行为由可变的模块（基础模型、系统提示、工具策略、外部记忆等）组合而成，缺乏持久身份和行为连续性。这使得传统的基于身份的信誉机制（如“了解你的代理”类比信用评分）无法适用于这些代理，因为信誉机制依赖于可识别性、可预测性、可信度和可恢复性，而解离性代理在这些方面缺乏基础。作者主张转向基于可观察性的、事前构建的、协议驱动的行为约束。
Motivation: 随着自主语言模型代理组成的代理网络产生现实影响，需要决定是否信任陌生代理。自然的思路是扩展人类身份验证和信誉机制到代理领域，但本文指出这种类比存在根本缺陷：语言模型代理具有解离性，无法满足信誉机制所需的持续身份、制裁敏感性等前提。
Method: 通过分析语言模型代理的模块化和可变性，结合解离性身份障碍（dissociative identity disorder）法理，论证代理缺乏可识别性、可预测性、可信度和可恢复性，从而瓦解信誉机制的基础。
Result: 该论文从理论层面论证了基于身份的事后监管式制裁治理（如信誉）对解离性代理结构上不适用。
Conclusion: 建议放弃基于身份的信誉机制，转向基于可观察性的事前构成性协议驱动的行为约束。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文论证语言模型代理（LM agent）本质上具有“解离性”（dissociative），即其行为由可变的模块（基础模型、系统提示、工具策略、外部记忆等）组合而成，缺乏持久身份和行为连续性。这使得传统的基于身份的信誉机制（如“了解你的代理”类比信用评分）无法适用于这些代理，因为信誉机制依赖于可识别性、可预测性、可信度和可恢复性，而解离性代理在这些方面缺乏基础。作者主张转向基于可观察性的、事前构建的、协议驱动的行为约束。
summary_sections.motivation: 随着自主语言模型代理组成的代理网络产生现实影响，需要决定是否信任陌生代理。自然的思路是扩展人类身份验证和信誉机制到代理领域，但本文指出这种类比存在根本缺陷：语言模型代理具有解离性，无法满足信誉机制所需的持续身份、制裁敏感性等前提。
summary_sections.method: 通过分析语言模型代理的模块化和可变性，结合解离性身份障碍（dissociative identity disorder）法理，论证代理缺乏可识别性、可预测性、可信度和可恢复性，从而瓦解信誉机制的基础。
summary_sections.result: 该论文从理论层面论证了基于身份的事后监管式制裁治理（如信誉）对解离性代理结构上不适用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 建议放弃基于身份的信誉机制，转向基于可观察性的事前构成性协议驱动的行为约束。

papers.title: Experiments in Agentic AI for Science
papers.abstract_en: This paper details two novel frameworks for developing autonomous, agentic AI in scientific workflows. Both systems leverage a hybrid Local Body, Remote Brain architecture via Google Colab, utilizing Python-based local orchestrators to invoke large language model (LLM) cloud backends. The first agent, DeepTS/DeepCollector, automates the large-scale curation, extraction, and deduplication of time-series datasets. The second, DeepScribe, is an autonomous presentation analyzer that converts visually dense, mathematically complex physics lectures into structured scientific reports. Through practical systems engineering-such as granular attribute extraction (Cellular RAG), remote data inspection, and distributed concurrency controls-we demonstrate how agentic AI can overcome the context and reasoning limitations of current state-of-the-art systems to rigorously support scientific workflows. Finally, we outline a generalization of DeepTS to support deep knowledge graphs and discuss the application of this conceptual approach to high-energy physics (DeepQCD).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了两种自主式人工智能框架：DeepTS/DeepCollector 用于自动化时间序列数据集的整理与去重，DeepScribe 用于将数学密集的物理讲座转化为结构化科学报告。两个系统均采用本地主体-远程大脑架构，通过 Google Colab 和 Python 本地编排器调用大语言模型云端后端。论文展示了通过细粒度属性提取（Cellular RAG）、远程数据检查和分布式并发控制等系统工程方法，克服当前系统上下文和推理限制，并讨论了将 DeepTS 推广到深度知识图谱以及在量子色动力学（DeepQCD）中的应用。
Motivation: 现有科学工作流中，大语言模型在处理大规模时间序列数据或复杂视觉数学内容时受限于上下文和推理能力，缺乏自主性和自动化。
Method: 采用混合本地主体-远程大脑架构，基于 Google Colab 的 Python 本地编排器调用 LLM 云端后端。DeepTS/DeepCollector 实现时间序列数据集自动化整理与去重；DeepScribe 实现演讲自动分析并生成结构化科学报告，使用多种系统工程方法如细粒度属性提取（Cellular RAG）、远程数据检查和分布式并发控制。
Result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称这些系统能够克服当前系统的上下文和推理限制，有效支持科学工作流。
Conclusion: 论文展示了自主人工智能在科学工作流中的能力，并概述了 DeepTS 向深度知识图谱的推广及其在高能物理（DeepQCD）中的应用潜力。

papers.title: X-Foresight: A Joint Vision-Action Causal Forecasting Network via Predictive World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Physical world knowledge resides mainly in videos. Equipping Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with such knowledge is fundamental for safe and generalizable planning. Predictive world modeling enables VLA to internalize physical dynamics and long-term causality by predicting future video from past observations. However, naive next-frame prediction faces two challenges: 1) unlike semantically distinct text tokens, video tokens are low-entropy and redundant, causing prediction to degenerate into trivial extrapolation. 2) world modeling poses a temporal dilemma: dense prediction captures instantaneous dynamics, but cannot efficiently model long-horizon causality. To learn world knowledge effectively, we introduce X-Foresight, a predictive world model integrated directly into the VLA architecture to jointly learn world modeling and real-time action control. At its core lies a long-horizon chunk-wise auto-regressive strategy that addresses both challenges: by predicting semantically distant chunks rather than adjacent frames, it escapes trivial extrapolation, while preserving dense intra-chunk frames for instantaneous dynamics and sparse inter-chunk transitions for long-term causality. A curriculum learning schedule progressively extends prediction horizons and stabilizes long-horizon training. To capture long-term causality effectively, we present temporal importance sampling, which concentrates supervision on safety-critical chunks identified by ego-motion and behavioral signals. We further delegate photorealistic synthesis to a diffusion-based multi-view renderer, improving photorealistic appearance. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that X-Foresight significantly outperforms VLA baselines in planning performance while maintaining strong generative fidelity, establishing a robust paradigm for world-knowledge-driven autonomous systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X-Foresight 提出了一种面向 VLA 模型的预测性世界建模方法，通过长距离分块自回归策略联合学习世界建模与实时动作控制，并引入时序重要性采样与扩散渲染器，在规划性能与生成保真度上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型依赖的下一帧预测易退化为平凡外推，且难以同时捕获瞬时动态与长期因果，限制了物理世界知识的泛化。
Method: 提出长距离分块自回归策略，预测语义上远距离的块而非相邻帧，同时保留块内密集帧与块间稀疏过渡；结合课程学习与基于自我运动和行为信号的时序重要性采样，并使用扩散多视图渲染器增强图像真实感。
Result: 实验表明 X-Foresight 在规划性能上显著优于 VLA 基线，同时保持强生成保真度。
Conclusion: 该方法建立了由世界知识驱动的自主系统范例，但摘要未讨论现有局限。

papers.title: Towards a General Intelligence and Interface for Wearable Health Data
papers.abstract_en: While ubiquitous wearable sensors capture a wealth of behavioral and physiological information, effectively transforming these signals into personalized health insights is challenging. Specifically, converting low-level sensor data into representations capable of characterizing higher-level states is difficult due to high phenotypic diversity and variation in individual baseline health, physiology, and lifestyle factors. Moreover, collecting wearable data paired with health outcome annotations is laborious and expensive, and retrospective annotation remains practically unfeasible, contributing to a scarcity of data with high-quality labels. To overcome these limitations, we propose a foundation model for wearable health that is pretrained on more than one trillion minutes of unlabeled sensor signals drawn from a large cohort of five million participants. We demonstrate that the joint scaling of model capacity and pretraining data volume leads to systematic improvements in performance, as evaluated on a diverse set of 35 health prediction tasks, spanning cardiovascular, metabolic, sleep, and mental health, as well as lifestyle choices and demographic factors. We find that this population scale representation unlocks label-efficient few-shot learning and generative capabilities for robust daily metric estimation. To further leverage this learned representation, we deploy a classroom of LLM agents to autonomously search the space of downstream predictive heads built on the model embeddings, showing broad performance improvements that increase with LLM model capacity. Finally, we show how integrating these downstream predictors into a Personal Health Agent can support model responses that are more relevant, contextually aware, and safe, and we validate this via 1,860 ratings from a cohort of clinicians.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向可穿戴健康数据的基础模型，在来自500万参与者、超过1万亿分钟的无标签传感器信号上进行预训练。该模型在35项健康预测任务（涵盖心血管、代谢、睡眠、心理健康、生活方式和人口统计因素）中展现出性能随模型容量和预训练数据量同步提升。研究发现该群体级表征支持标签高效的少样本学习和生成能力，用于鲁棒的日常指标估计。进一步部署LLM智能体自动搜索下游预测头，并整合到个人健康智能体中，通过1860项临床医生评分验证了其相关性、上下文感知能力和安全性。
Motivation: 可穿戴传感器数据虽有丰富的行为和生理信息，但将其转化为个性化健康洞察面临挑战：低层传感器数据到高层状态的表征因表型多样性和个体基线差异而困难，且标注数据稀缺、回顾性标注不切实际。
Method: 采用基础模型范式，在超大规模无标签传感器信号（>1万亿分钟，500万参与者）上预训练；通过联合缩放模型容量和预训练数据量提升性能；利用LLM智能体自动搜索下游预测头；将预测器集成到个人健康智能体中。
Result: 在35项健康预测任务上取得系统性性能提升；实现标签高效的少样本学习和鲁棒的每日指标估计；LLM智能体搜索和集成进一步改善模型响应；通过1860名临床医生评分验证了相关性和安全性。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了大规模可穿戴数据预训练基础模型的价值，并提出了通过LLM智能体实现下游任务自动化和个人健康智能体的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dropout Universality: Scaling Laws and Optimal Scheduling at the Edge-of-Chaos
papers.abstract_en: We develop a mean-field theory of dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos, and show that it predicts a simple, no-cost change to standard practice: \emph{front-loaded} dropout schedules cut test loss by \(18\)--\(35\%\) over constant dropout in MLPs and Vision Transformers at fixed budget. The theoretical mechanism is that dropout shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point, making the depth scale for information propagation finite even at critical initialization. We derive critical and crossover scaling laws for correlation decay and establish that smooth activations and kinked, \relu{}-like activations constitute distinct universality classes, with different critical exponents and a universal two-parameter scaling collapse in detuning and dropout strength. The distinction traces to the analytic structure of the correlation map: smooth activations admit a Taylor expansion near perfect alignment, while kinked activations develop a branch point with universal non-analyticity. As a corollary, the framework yields saturated dropout profiles under fixed budget; a regularization-reach argument then selects front-loaded schedules, with accuracy gains as a consistent secondary effect. We also discuss how the same Gaussian-kernel structure extends the theory beyond MLPs toward CNNs and residual architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 36 pages, 11 figures. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发展了一个dropout的均场理论，将其视为边缘混沌临界信号传播的微扰。理论预测了一种零成本的改进：前加载dropout调度（front-loaded dropout schedules）在固定预算下相比常数dropout可将MLP和Vision Transformer的测试损失降低18-35%。机制是dropout改变了完美对齐固定点，使得即使在临界初始化下信息传播的深度尺度也变得有限。推导了相关衰减的临界和交叉标度律，并发现平滑激活函数与ReLU类激活函数属于不同普适类，具有不同临界指数和一个普适的两参数标度坍缩。作为推论，该框架给出固定预算下的饱和dropout分布，并通过正则化-reach参数选择前加载调度，准确率提升作为一致的次要效应。还讨论了相同的高斯核结构如何将理论从MLP扩展到CNN和残差架构。
Motivation: 现有对dropout的理论理解不足，特别是其与深度网络初始化临界性的关系以及最优调度策略缺乏理论指导。
Method: 将dropout视为对临界信号传播的微扰，发展均场理论；分析dropout对自相关函数的影响，推导临界与交叉标度律；利用正则化-reach参数论证选择前加载调度。
Result: 前加载dropout调度在固定预算下比常数dropout降低18-35%测试损失；平滑激活与ReLU类激活属于不同普适类，具有不同临界指数；理论结果在MLP和Vision Transformers上验证。
Conclusion: 该框架给出了dropout的理论理解，并提出了无成本的前加载调度策略，适用于MLP、Vision Transformers，并可推广到CNN和残差架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Matrix structure and convergence behaviour of the matched eigenfunction method for computing heave wave forces on generalized concentric bodies
papers.abstract_en: Structural survival of offshore structures is crucial for the growing marine economy. Calculating the added mass, radiation damping, and excitation coefficients to quantify wave loads with the traditional boundary element method (BEM) presents a computational bottleneck. The matched eigenfunction expansion method (MEEM), a long-known but rarely-used alternative, offers computational benefits due to its semi-analytical nature. However, previous work fails to directly compare its accuracy and computational performance with BEM, leaving the extent of its utility unknown. Furthermore, the geometry-dependent convergence for cylindrical and slanted geometries has not yet been documented, making the method's practicality for general geometries unclear. This paper presents a unifying MEEM framework for modeling an arbitrary number of fixed or heaving surface-piercing annular cylinders with continuous and radially-monotonic body profiles, and explores the method's block matrix structure, convergence behavior, ability to accurately approximate slanted geometries, and computational advantages over the BEM solver Capytaine. The numerical experiments show that MEEM can compute hydrodynamic coefficients of slanted geometries within 5% of Capytaine, even for angles as steep as 15 degrees from vertical. Finally, MEEM can achieve 2% convergence of its hydrodynamic coefficients an order of magnitude faster than Capytaine with a matrix size two orders of magnitude smaller, making it a computationally effective alternative to traditional BEM solvers. These contributions enable hydrodynamic analysis of a broad range of shapes with increased speed and confidence, paving the way for future optimization studies to yield improved designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的匹配特征函数展开法（MEEM）框架，用于计算固定或垂荡的广义同心环形圆柱的波浪力，并系统比较了MEEM与传统边界元方法（BEM）的精度和计算性能。数值实验表明，MEEM可在5%误差内近似倾斜几何体（倾角达15度），且达到2%收敛速度比BEM求解器Capytaine快一个数量级，矩阵大小小两个数量级。
Motivation: 传统BEM计算波浪附加质量、辐射阻尼和激励系数存在计算瓶颈，而MEEM作为半解析替代方法未被充分验证其精度和效率，且其对圆柱形和倾斜几何的收敛行为尚不明确。
Method: 建立了适用于任意数量固定或垂荡的表面穿透环形圆柱体的统一MEEM框架，分析了块矩阵结构、收敛行为，并评估了近似倾斜几何的能力，与BEM求解器Capytaine进行对比。
Result: MEEM计算倾斜几何的水动力系数与Capytaine误差在5%以内（倾角达15度），且达到2%收敛速度比Capytaine快一个数量级，矩阵大小小两个数量级。

papers.title: OgBench: A Framework for Evaluating Graph Neural Networks on Omics Data
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have become the dominant framework for inductive graph-level learning. Yet most benchmarks focus on the regime $n \gg p$, where the number of graphs $n$ greatly exceeds the number of nodes per graph $p$. This overlooks biological domains such as omics, which operate in the opposite $n \ll p$ regime, characterized by large graphs of genes, transcripts, or proteins across few patient samples. This raises the question: \textit{how do GNNs perform in this low-sample, high-node omics setting?} We introduce \texttt{OgBench} (Omics-Graph Bench), the first benchmarking platform for graph-level prediction in the $n \ll p$ regime characteristic of omics data. We provide a standardized, end-to-end modular infrastructure from raw omics data to families of featured graphs with varied structural properties. We benchmark classical GNNs, as well as GNNs designed for large graphs and omics applications, alongside MLPs and machine learning baselines to establish reference performances. Our results show that widely used GNNs often do not outperform simple MLPs and classical baselines. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that graph structure inherently adds value in this domain, fostering a critical reassessment of current learning paradigms. Ultimately, by exposing these limitations, OgBench provides the open-source ecosystem necessary for the community to develop and validate novel architectures explicitly tailored for biological graphs. The code is available at https://github.com/geometric-intelligence/ogbench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OgBench，首个针对组学数据中低样本、高节点（n << p）场景的图级预测基准平台。通过标准化流程从原始组学数据构建特征图，系统评估了经典GNN、专为大图设计的GNN、MLP及传统基线。结果表明，广泛使用的GNN常不优于简单MLP，挑战了图结构在此领域自动有益的假设。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有GNN基准多聚焦于n >> p场景，忽视组学数据中n << p的情况（大图、少样本），导致对GNN在此类低样本高节点设置下的表现缺乏系统认识。
Method: 构建OgBench，提供从原始组学数据到特征图族的端到端模块化基础设施，涵盖多种图结构属性，并统一评测经典GNN、专为大图/组学设计的GNN、MLP及机器学习基线。
Result: 实验表明，常用GNN在组学基准上常不优于简单MLP和经典基线（如随机森林、SVM），表明图结构在此领域并非天然有益。
Conclusion: OgBench开源平台旨在暴露当前GNN在生物图上的局限性，推动社区开发适合该领域的新架构，并重新评估现有学习范式。

papers.title: Coding Agent Is Good As World Simulator
papers.abstract_en: World models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for building interactive simulation environments, with recent video-based approaches demonstrating impressive progress in generating visually plausible dynamics. However, because these models typically infer dynamics from video and represent them in latent states, they do not explicitly enforce physical constraints. As a result, the generated video rollouts are not physically plausible, exhibiting unstable contacts, distorted shapes, or inconsistent motion. In this paper, we present an agentic framework constructing physics-based world models through executable simulation code. The framework coordinates planning, code generation, visual review, and physics analysis agents. The planning agent converts the natural language prompt into a structured scene plan, the code agent implements it as executable simulation code, and the visual review agent provide visual feedback while the physics analysis agent checks physical consistency. The code is iteratively revised based on the feedback until the simulation matches the prompt reqirements and physical constraints. Experimental results show that our framework outperforms advanced video-based models in physical accuracy, instruction fidelity and visual quality, which could be applied to various scenarios including driving simulation and embodied robot tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于智能体（agent）的框架，通过生成可执行的仿真代码来构建基于物理的世界模型（physics-based world models），替代传统的基于视频的生成方法。框架包含规划、代码生成、视觉审查和物理分析四个智能体，通过迭代修正代码确保仿真符合提示要求和物理约束。实验表明，该方法在物理准确性、指令保真度和视觉质量上优于先进的视频模型。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的世界模型虽然能生成视觉上合理的动态，但不显式遵守物理约束，导致生成的视频出现不稳定接触、形状畸变或不一致运动。
Method: 提出一个智能体框架，由规划智能体将自然语言提示转换为结构化场景计划，代码智能体将其实现为可执行仿真代码，视觉审查智能体提供视觉反馈，物理分析智能体检查物理一致性；代码根据反馈迭代修正直至满足要求。
Result: 该框架在物理准确性、指令保真度和视觉质量上均优于先进的视频模型，可应用于驾驶仿真和具身机器人任务。
Conclusion: 通过可执行仿真代码构建物理世界模型是生成物理合理交互环境的有效途径。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Herculean: An Agentic Benchmark for Financial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents improve, the central question is no longer whether they can solve isolated well-defined financial tasks, but whether they can reliably carry out financial professional work. Existing financial benchmarks offer only a partial view of this ability, as they primarily evaluate static competencies such as question answering, retrieval, summarization, and classification. We introduce Herculean, the first skilled benchmark for agentic financial intelligence spanning four representative workflows, including Trading, Hedging, Market Insights, and Auditing. Each workflow is instantiated as a standardized MCP-based skill environment with its own tools, interaction dynamics, constraints, and success criteria, enabling consistent end-to-end assessment of heterogeneous agent systems. Across frontier agents, we find agents perform relatively well on Trading and Market Insights, but struggle substantially on Hedging and Auditing, where long-horizon coordination, state consistency, and structured verification are critical. Overall, our results point to a key gap in current agents in turning financial reasoning into dependable workflow execution in high-stakes financial workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Herculean，首个针对金融智能的agentic benchmark，覆盖交易、对冲、市场洞察和审计四个代表性工作流。每个工作流被实例化为基于MCP的标准技能环境，包含独立工具、交互动态、约束和成功标准。评估表明，前沿agent在交易和市场洞察上表现尚可，但在对冲和审计上严重不足，后者需要长程协调、状态一致性和结构化验证。结果揭示当前agent在将金融推理转化为高可靠性工作流执行方面存在关键差距。
Motivation: 现有金融benchmark主要评估静态能力（如问答、检索、摘要、分类），无法衡量AI agent执行金融专业工作的可靠性，因此需要设计能够评估复杂工作流执行能力的benchmark。
Method: 构建Herculean benchmark，包含四个金融工作流（Trading, Hedging, Market Insights, Auditing），每个工作流作为标准化的MCP-based技能环境，配备特定工具、交互规则、约束和成功标准，实现端到端评估。
Result: 前沿agent在Trading和Market Insights上表现相对较好，但在Hedging和Auditing上表现显著较差，后者依赖长程协调、状态一致性和结构化验证。
Conclusion: 当前agent在将金融推理转化为高可靠性工作流执行方面存在关键差距，尤其在需要长期协调和结构化验证的高风险金融任务中。

papers.title: Lying Is Just a Phase: The Hidden Alignment Transition in Language Model Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws predict loss from compute but not how capabilities interact. We measure the coupling between reasoning and truthfulness across 63 base models from 16 families and find a regime change invisible to loss curves: below a family-dependent critical scale N_c, capabilities anticorrelate (r = -0.989, p = 4 x 10^{-5} nonparametric permutation test); above it, they cooperate. N_c ~ 3.5B parameters [2.9B, 13.4B] (bootstrap 95% CI), but model size is not the only variable that determines phase. Architecture, data curation, and training recipe each shift N_c independently: curated training eliminated the coupling dip between Qwen generations (0.025 to 0.830 at matched scale), Gemma-4 at 4B achieves coupling 0.871, characteristic of 13B+ standard-trained models, through distillation and architectural innovation, and Phi at 1B matches web-trained coupling at 10B through data curation alone. Width normalization eliminates the anticorrelation across all tested families, supporting an output-projection bottleneck. Internally, 38 of 40 models show zero competing attention heads. A sparse-regression ODE cross-predicts held-out Llama-2 at 5.6% error. The diagnostic requires no model internals -- only public benchmark scores across a model family. The cooperative regime extends to the frontier (r = +0.72, 34 models, 10 labs). A proof-of-concept intervention confirms the bottleneck is exploitable: adding a single truth-direction vector at the identified layer corrects 60% of misaligned outputs in the tax phase with zero retraining -- a surgical, per-inference correction that requires no weight modification. Code, data, an open-source steering CLI for any open-weight model, and an interactive dashboard for phase diagnosis are released: https://zehenlabs.com/cape/.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Companion paper: "The Growing Pains of Frontier Models: When Leaderboards Stop Separating and What to Measure Next." ( https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2605.18840). Code: https://github.com/adilamin89/cape-scaling. Dashboard: https://zehenlabs.com/cape/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现语言模型在参数规模增长时存在一个隐藏的相变：低于约3.5B参数时，推理能力与真实性呈强负相关（r=-0.989），高于该规模则转为正相关。该相变不体现在损失曲线中，且受架构、数据与训练方法影响。作者提出一种仅需公开基准分数的诊断方法，并证明在相变后可通过单层单向量干预纠正60%的对齐错误。
Motivation: 现有缩放定律仅预测损失与计算的关系，未能刻画能力间的相互作用。需要理解推理能力与真实性随模型规模变化的耦合关系。
Method: 分析16个模型家族共63个基础模型在推理与真实性基准上的得分相关系数，识别出规模驱动的相变点；通过稀疏回归ODE跨预测及内部注意力头分析验证输出投影瓶颈假说。
Result: 相变临界规模N_c约3.5B参数（95% CI 2.9B–13.4B）；数据裁剪可消除Qwen系列的负相关（相关系数从0.025升至0.830），架构创新使Gemma-4在4B规模即达到13B标准训练的耦合水平；宽度归一化完全消除负相关。干预实验在相变后添加真实方向向量可纠正60%的不对齐输出。
Conclusion: 语言模型缩放中存在隐藏的对齐相变，该发现可通过公开基准分数诊断，并为无需重训练的可扩展推理时干预提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study solution operators of physical field equations on geometric meshes from a function-space perspective. We reveal that Hodge orthogonality fundamentally resolves spectral interference by isolating unlearnable topological degrees of freedom from learnable geometric dynamics, enabling an additive approximation confined to structure-preserving subspaces. Building on Hodge theory and operator splitting, we derive a principled operator-level decomposition. The result is a Hybrid Eulerian-Lagrangian architecture with an algebraic-level inductive bias we call Hodge Spectral Duality (HSD). In our framework, we use discrete differential forms to capture topology-dominated components and an orthogonal auxiliary ambient space to represent complex local dynamics. Our method achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on geometric graphs with enhanced fidelity to physical invariants. Our code is available at https://github.com/ContinuumCoder/Hodge-Spectral-Duality
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/ContinuumCoder/Hodge-Spectral-Duality
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从函数空间角度研究几何网格上物理场方程的解算子，发现Hodge正交性通过将不可学习的拓扑自由度与可学习的几何动力学分离，从根本上解决了谱干扰问题。基于Hodge理论和算子分裂，推导出原则性的算子级分解，并构建了具有代数级归纳偏置的混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构Hodge Spectral Duality (HSD)。该方法使用离散微分形式捕捉拓扑主导成分，用正交辅助环境空间表示复杂局部动力学，在几何图上实现了优越的精度和效率，并增强了对物理不变量的保真度。
Motivation: 现有神经算子方法在处理几何网格上的物理场方程时，谱干扰问题导致学习效率低下，且难以同时保持拓扑不变性和复杂局部动力学。
Method: 提出基于Hodge分解和算子分裂的算子级分解方法，设计了混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构HSD，通过离散微分形式（拓扑成分）与正交辅助空间（局部动力学）的分离实现结构保持的近似。
Result: 在几何图上的实验表明，该方法在精度和效率上优于现有方法，且对物理不变量具有更高的保真度。
Conclusion: 作者认为Hodge正交性为设计结构保持的神经算子提供了理论基础，HSD架构在保持拓扑约束的同时能有效学习复杂几何动力学。

papers.title: OGLS-SD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Outcome-Guided Logit Steering for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We study on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a language model improves its reasoning ability by distilling privileged teacher distributions along its own on-policy trajectories. Despite its promise, OPSD can suffer from training instability due to a pattern mismatch between teacher and student responses. Self-reflected teacher responses may introduce reflection-induced biases and response templates that miscalibrate token-level supervision, ultimately harming the student's reasoning ability. To mitigate this issue, we propose OGLS-SD, an outcome-guided logit-steering framework that leverages verifiable outcome rewards to calibrate privileged teacher logits. Specifically, OGLS-SD contrasts teacher logits induced by successful and failed on-policy trajectories, constructing an outcome-discriminative steering direction for token-level guidance. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that OGLS-SD stabilizes self-distillation and improves performance over standard OPSD and other variants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OGLS-SD，一种基于结果引导的logit steering框架，用于解决on-policy self-distillation中教师与学生的模式不匹配问题，通过对比成功与失败轨迹的教师logits来构建判别性方向，在数学推理基准上稳定训练并提升性能。
Motivation: On-policy self-distillation中，教师回答的自我反思可能引入偏见和响应模板，导致token级监督失准，损害学生推理能力。
Method: 提出OGLS-SD，利用可验证的结果奖励来校准特权教师logits，通过对比成功与失败on-policy轨迹的教师logits构造结果判别性steering方向，提供token级指导。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，OGLS-SD稳定了自蒸馏过程，性能优于标准OPSD及其他变体。
Conclusion: OGLS-SD通过结果引导的logit steering缓解了OPSD的训练不稳定问题，提升了推理能力。

papers.title: The Cartesian Shortcut: Re-evaluate Vision Reasoning in Polar Coordinate Space
papers.abstract_en: As current Multimodal Large Language Models rapidly saturate canonical visual reasoning benchmarks, a key question emerges: do these strong scores genuinely reflect robust visual understanding? We identify a pervasive vulnerability, the Cartesian Shortcut: visual reasoning benchmarks prevalently build on orthogonal grid-based layouts that can be readily discretized into explicit textual coordinates. Models systematically exploit this property, heavily leveraging text-based deductive reasoning to assist visual problem-solving. To systematically dismantle this shortcut, we introduce Polaris-Bench, which re-formulates 53 visual reasoning tasks in Polar coordinate space with paired Cartesian counterparts as reference, while preserving consistent logical constraints and task semantics -- thus fundamentally breaking the orthogonal prior that models exploit. Comprehensive evaluation across $14$ state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that frontier models achieving $70$--$83\%$ on Cartesian layouts collapse to $31$--$39\%$ on Polar equivalents, with degradation persisting even under complete logical equivalence. Moreover, reasoning gains observed on Cartesian layouts are severely diminished on Polar equivalents. These findings expose a critical deficiency in current MLLMs: the lack of topology-invariant visual reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前视觉推理基准存在“笛卡尔捷径”，即基于正交网格的布局可轻易转化为文本坐标，模型借助文本推理而非真正视觉理解完成任务。作者提出Polaris-Bench，将53个视觉推理任务重新用极坐标空间表述，打断正交先验。实验表明，14个先进多模态大语言模型在极坐标等效任务上性能从70-83%骤降至31-39%，揭示了模型缺乏拓扑不变视觉推理能力。
Motivation: 现有视觉推理基准可能被模型通过文本推导捷径解决，而非真正的视觉理解，需要更鲁棒的评估方式来暴露模型缺陷。
Method: 提出Polaris-Bench，将所有任务在极坐标空间中重新公式化，同时保持逻辑约束和语义一致，并与笛卡尔版本配对作为参考，从而移除正交先验。
Result: 14个前沿MLLMs在极坐标等效任务上性能从70-83%下降到31-39%，且笛卡尔布局上的推理增益在极坐标版本上大幅减少。
Conclusion: 当前MLLMs缺乏拓扑不变视觉推理能力，笛卡尔捷径掩盖了这一缺陷，需要在更困难的空间变换下评估模型。

papers.title: Towards a Virtual Neuroscientist: Autonomous Neuroimaging Analysis via Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Transforming neuroimaging data into clinically actionable biomarkers is a knowledge-intensive and labor-intensive process. Standardized workflows such as fMRIPrep have improved robustness and efficiency, but they are statically configured and cannot reason about downstream objectives, deliberate over alternative strategies, or close the loop between intermediate evidence and subsequent decisions in the way a human researcher would. This lack of closed-loop adaptation often leaves domain experts trapped in a cycle of manual trial-and-error to tune parameters and remediate pipeline failures, severely constraining the scalability of clinical biomarker development. To bridge this gap, we introduce NEXUS, an autonomous multi-agent framework that integrates neuroimaging workflow execution with scientific-objective understanding. Unlike conventional flat toolcalling agents, NEXUS adopts a code-centric execution paradigm where specialist agents collaboratively synthesize and optimize executable programs over composable domain-specific primitives. This design enables robust, long-horizon workflow construction that adapts dynamically to runtime observations. Furthermore, we propose a hierarchical verification framework for autonomous quality control, integrating cohort-level metric screening with agentic visual inspection to drive evidence-grounded workflow remediation. Experiments on ADHD-200 and ADNI demonstrate that NEXUS outperforms standard workflow-based baselines in predictive performance while exhibiting sophisticated agentic behaviors, including strategy exploration and adaptive refinement. The code is available at https://github.com/LearningKeqi/Virtual-Neuroscientist-NEXUS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NEXUS，一个自主多智能体框架，用于神经影像分析。不同于静态工作流，NEXUS采用代码中心的执行范式，多个专家智能体协作编写和优化程序，并引入分层验证机制实现自主质量控制。在ADHD-200和ADNI数据集上，NEXUS在预测性能上优于标准工作流基线，并展现出策略探索和自适应改进等智能行为。

Method: NEXUS是一个多智能体框架，采用代码中心执行，智能体协作编写和优化可执行程序；提出分层验证框架，结合队列级指标筛选和智能体视觉检查，实现自主质量控制。
Result: 在ADHD-200和ADNI数据集上，NEXUS在预测性能上优于标准工作流基线，并展现出策略探索和自适应改进等智能行为。
Conclusion: NEXUS通过多智能体协作和分层验证，实现了神经影像分析的自主化和自适应，有望推动临床生物标志物开发。

papers.title: Cornerstones or Stumbling Blocks? Deciphering the Rock Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: While recent work in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown that a small subset of critical tokens disproportionately drives reasoning gains, an analogous token-level understanding of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate high-loss tokens, a token type that--as the most direct signal of student-teacher mismatch under OPD's per-token KL objective--should progressively diminish as training converges according to existing studies; however, our empirical analysis shows otherwise. Even after OPD training reaches apparent saturation, a substantial subset of tokens continues to exhibit persistently high loss; these tokens, which we term Rock Tokens, can account for up to 18\% of the tokens in generated outputs. Our investigation reveals two startling paradoxes. First, despite their high occurrence frequency providing a disproportionately large share of total gradient norms, Rock Tokens themselves remain stagnant throughout training, resisting teacher-driven corrections. Second, through causal intervention, we find that these tokens provide negligible functional contribution to the model's actual reasoning performance. These findings suggest that a vast amount of optimization bandwidth is spent on structural and discourse residuals that the student model cannot or need not internalize. By deconstructing these dynamics, we demonstrate that strategically bypassing these ``stumbling blocks'' can significantly streamline the alignment process, challenging the necessity of uniform token weighting and offering a more efficient paradigm for large-scale model distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）中一种特殊的高损失token——Rock Tokens。作者发现即使OPD训练达到表观饱和，仍有高达18%的token持续保持高损失。这些token虽贡献了绝大部分梯度范数，但自身在训练中几乎不更新，且对模型推理性能的贡献可忽略。通过因果干预实验，作者表明跳过这些“绊脚石”token可以简化对齐过程，从而挑战了均匀token权重的必要性，提出更高效的蒸馏范式。
Motivation: 现有RLVR工作已发现关键token对推理的驱动作用，但OPD场景下token级别的理解尚未被探索。已有观点认为高损失token应随训练收敛而减少，但实证观察与此矛盾。
Method: 通过实证分析OPD训练过程中高损失token的动态特性，并采用因果干预方法评估这些token对推理性能的实际贡献。
Result: Rock Tokens占生成token的18%，贡献了总梯度范数的大部分，但其自身在训练中保持不变，且对模型推理性能的贡献可忽略。
Conclusion: 研究发现优化带宽大量浪费在结构性和语篇性残差上，而学生模型无法或无需内化这些token。有策略地跳过Rock Tokens可显著简化对齐过程，为大规模模型蒸馏提供更高效的范式。

papers.title: Exploring and Exploiting Stability in Latent Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we show that Latent Flow-Matching (LFM) models are robust to different types of perturbations, including data reduction and model capacity shrinkage. We characterize this stability by these models' tendency to generate similar outputs under identical noise seeds. We provide a perspective relating this phenomenon to flow matching theory, which indicates that this stability is inherent to the FM objective. We further exploit this stability to derive practical algorithms for more efficient training and inference. Concretely, first, we show that by training LFM models on significantly reduced datasets, performance is preserved, and in compute-constrained regimes, the model converges faster while maintaining quality. This yields multiple advantages, including savings in the training time due to faster convergence, and alleviating annotation effort when training conditional models. Second, LFM stability under architectural shrinkage gives rise to a two-model coarse-to-fine approach, one using a light-weight architecture for the first phase of the FM trajectory, and one with higher capacity for the second, thereby reducing the inference cost substantially. To determine which samples are informative, we introduce three sample-scoring criteria and evaluate them under standard metrics for generative models. Our results are thoroughly evaluated on multiple datasets, demonstrating the practical advantage of this stability, including data savings and a more than two-fold inference speedup while generating comparable outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明潜在流匹配（Latent Flow-Matching, LFM）模型对数据缩减和模型容量缩减具有稳定性，并从流匹配理论角度解释这一现象。基于此稳定性，作者提出了更高效的训练和推理算法：在缩减数据集上训练可加速收敛并保持质量，以及一种两阶段粗细粒度推理方法，显著降低推理成本。实验表明该方法可在保持生成质量的同时实现两倍以上的推理加速。
Motivation: 现有流匹配模型在训练和推理上计算成本高，但尚未充分探索其对数据量和模型规模变化的鲁棒性。本文旨在揭示并利用LFM的稳定性，以实现更高效的训练和推理。
Method: 通过理论分析将稳定性归因于流匹配目标本身。实际算法包括：(1) 在显著缩减的数据集上训练LFM，利用更快收敛节省训练时间；(2) 提出两模型粗细粒度方法，第一阶段用轻量架构，第二阶段用高容量模型，并引入三种样本评分准则选择信息量大的样本。
Result: 实验表明，在缩减数据集上训练的性能得以保持，并在计算受限条件下收敛更快；所提推理加速方法实现超过两倍的推理速度提升，同时生成输出质量相当。
Conclusion: LFM模型的稳定性可被有效利用以降低训练和推理成本，为实际部署提供实用优势。

papers.title: DVD: Discrete Voxel Diffusion for 3D Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Discrete Voxel Diffusion (DVD), a discrete diffusion framework to generate, assess, and edit sparse voxels for SLat (Structured LATent) based 3D generative pipelines. Although discrete diffusion has not generally displaced continuous diffusion in image-like generation, we show that it can be an effective first-stage prior for sparse voxel scaffolds. By treating voxel occupancy as a native discrete variable, DVD avoids continuous-to-discrete thresholding and provides a simple framework for voxel generation, uncertainty estimation, and editing. Beyond quality gains, DVD provides more interpretable generation dynamics through explicit categorical modeling. Furthermore, we leverage the predictive entropy as a robust uncertainty metric to identify ambiguous voxel regions and complicated samples, facilitating tasks such as data filtering and quality assessment. Finally, we propose a lightweight fine-tuning strategy using block-structured perturbation patterns. This approach empowers the model to inpaint and edit voxels within a single sampling round, requiring negligible auxiliary computation and no additional model evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出离散体素扩散（DVD）框架，用于稀疏体素的生成、评估和编辑，作为SLat（结构化潜在）3D生成流水线的第一阶段先验。通过将体素占据视为原生离散变量，DVD避免了连续到离散的阈值化，并提供了简单的体素生成、不确定性估计和编辑框架。利用预测熵作为鲁棒的不确定性度量来识别模糊区域，并提出一种微调策略以实现单轮采样内的修复和编辑。
Motivation: 现有3D生成方法通常将体素视为连续变量再进行阈值化，导致信息损失和不确定性不明确。DVD旨在利用离散扩散直接建模体素占据，提升生成质量和可解释性。
Method: 提出离散体素扩散框架，将体素占据建模为离散类别变量，使用离散扩散过程生成稀疏体素结构。利用预测熵作为不确定性度量，并提出基于块结构扰动模式的轻量级微调策略，支持单轮采样内的修复和编辑。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的数值结果，但声称在生成质量、不确定性估计和编辑能力上优于现有方法，并提供了更可解释的生成动态。
Conclusion: 离散扩散可以作为3D体素生成的有效先验，其显式分类建模提供了更好的可解释性和不确定性估计，且微调策略能高效支持体素编辑。

papers.title: Do Joint Audio-Video Generation Models Understand Physics?
papers.abstract_en: Joint audio-video generation models are rapidly approaching professional production quality, raising a central question: do they understand audio-visual physics, or merely generate plausible sounds and frames that violate real-world consistency? We introduce AV-Phys Bench, a benchmark for evaluating physical commonsense in joint audio-video generation. AV-Phys Bench tests models across three scene categories: Steady State, Event Transition, and Environment Transition. It covers physics-grounded subcategories drawn from real-world scenes, plus Anti-AV-Physics prompts that deliberately request physically inconsistent audio-video behavior. Each generation is evaluated along five dimensions: visual semantic adherence, audio semantic adherence, visual physical commonsense, audio physical commonsense, and cross-modal physical commonsense. Across three proprietary and four open-source models, we find that Seedance 2.0 performs best overall, but all models remain far from robust physical understanding. Performance drops sharply on event-driven and environment-driven transitions, and even strong proprietary systems collapse on Anti-AV-Physics prompts. We further introduce AV-Phys Agent, a ReAct-style evaluator that combines a multimodal language model with deterministic acoustic measurement tools, producing rankings that closely align with human ratings. Our results identify cross-modal physical consistency and transition-driven scene dynamics as key open challenges for joint audio-video generation.
papers.comment: Preprint. Project Page: https://zijuncui.com/AV-Phys/. Full abstract appears in the PDF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过引入AV-Phys Bench基准，系统评估了联合音视频生成模型在物理常识方面的理解能力，涵盖稳态、事件过渡和环境过渡三类场景，并包含反物理提示。实验发现，Seedance 2.0整体表现最佳，但所有模型在物理一致性上仍远未稳健，尤其在事件驱动和环境驱动的过渡场景中性能急剧下降，强闭源模型在反物理提示下完全失效。此外，提出的AV-Phys Agent评估器结合多模态语言模型和声学测量工具，其评分与人类评价高度一致。这些结果揭示了跨模态物理一致性和过渡驱动场景动态是联合音视频生成的关键开放挑战。
Motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型在视觉和音频质量上接近专业水平，但是否真正理解物理常识（如声画一致性）尚不清楚，缺乏系统评估基准。
Method: 构建AV-Phys Bench基准，包含三幕场景（稳态、事件过渡、环境过渡）及反物理提示，从五个维度（视觉/音频语义符合度、视觉/音频物理常识、跨模态物理常识）评估模型；并提出AV-Phys Agent，利用ReAct范式结合多模态语言模型与确定性声学测量工具进行自动评估。
Result: 在三个闭源和四个开源模型上，Seedance 2.0总体最佳，但所有模型在事件/环境过渡场景中性能显著下降，强闭源模型在反物理提示下完全失败。AV-Phys Agent的评分与人类评价高度一致。
Conclusion: 跨模态物理一致性和过渡驱动场景的动态仍是联合音视频生成的核心难题，现有模型远未达到鲁棒的物理理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: the Stochastic Parrot in the Coal Mine. Model Collapse is a Threat to Low-Resource Communities
papers.abstract_en: Model collapse, the degradation in performance that arises when generative models are trained on the outputs of prior models, is an increasing concern as artificially generated content proliferates. Related critiques of large language models have highlighted their tendency to reproduce frequent patterns in training data, their reliance on vast datasets, and their substantial environmental cost. Together, these factors contribute to data degradation, the reinforcement of cultural biases, and inefficient resource use. In this position paper we aim to combine these views and argue that model collapse threatens current efforts to democratize AI. By reducing training efficiency and skewing data distributions away from the tails of their support, model collapse disproportionately impacts low-resource and marginalized communities. We examine both the environmental and cultural implications of this phenomenon, situate our position within recent position papers on model collapse, and conclude with a call to action. Finally, we outline initial directions for mitigating these effects.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 1 table, International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出模型坍塌（model collapse）——即生成模型在前代模型输出上训练导致的性能退化——会对低资源社区和边缘化群体造成不成比例的负面影响。作者结合模型依赖大数据、产生文化偏见和环境成本等问题，论证模型坍塌正在阻碍AI民主化的努力，并呼吁采取行动减轻这些效应。
Motivation: 现有对模型坍塌的讨论通常聚焦于性能退化，但忽视了其对低资源和边缘化社区的潜在威胁。作者希望整合相关批评，强调模型坍塌会加剧数据退化、强化文化偏见并浪费资源，从而破坏AI民主化进程。
Method: 本文为立场论文，主要通过文献回顾和逻辑论证来阐述观点，没有提出具体算法或实验方法。作者总结并联系了近期关于模型坍塌的立场论文，并初步提出了缓解方向。
Result: 论文没有报告定量实验结果，而是提出了一个警示性观点：模型坍塌将不成比例地影响低资源社区，并可能加剧文化和环境的负面后果。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁研究界和政策制定者关注模型坍塌对社会公平的影响，并建议未来工作应优先开发鲁棒的训练策略、保护数据多样性以及减少环境足迹。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MidSteer: Optimal Affine Framework for Steering Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Steering intermediate representations has emerged as a powerful strategy for controlling generative models, particularly in post-deployment alignment and safety settings. However, despite its empirical success, it currently lacks a comprehensive theoretical framework. In this paper, we bridge this gap by formalizing the theory of concept steering. First, we establish a link between steering and affine concept erasure, proving that the standard approach for removing unwanted behaviors is a special case of LEACE (a closed-form method for affine erasure). Next, we formulate a principled theoretical framework for concept switching, LEACE-Switch, and characterize the assumptions under which it provides an optimal affine solution. Building on this analysis, we then introduce MidSteer (Minimal Disturbance concept Steering), a more general affine framework for concept manipulation that relaxes these assumptions and enables directed, minimal-disturbance transformations. We demonstrate that MidSteer performs favorably across a range of tasks, modalities, and architectures, including vision diffusion models and large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了生成模型中概念控制的理论，建立了与概念擦除的联系，提出了LEACE-Switch和MidSteer框架，用于最优仿射概念操作。在视觉扩散模型和LLM上进行了验证。
Motivation: 尽管概念控制在生成模型的对齐和安全中取得了经验成功，但缺乏全面的理论框架。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 首先证明标准概念擦除方法（如LEACE）是概念控制的一个特例；然后提出LEACE-Switch框架来刻画概念切换的最优仿射解；最后引入MidSteer，一种更通用的仿射框架，放松假设并支持定向最小干扰变换。
Result: MidSteer在多种任务、模态和架构上表现良好，包括视觉扩散模型和大语言模型，但未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 提供了概念控制的统一理论框架和实用的MidSteer方法，适用于生成模型的后部署对齐和安全设置。

papers.title: U-Cast: A Surprisingly Simple and Efficient Frontier Probabilistic AI Weather Forecaster
papers.abstract_en: AI-based weather forecasting now rivals traditional physics-based ensembles, but state-of-the-art (SOTA) models rely on specialized architectures and massive computational budgets, creating a high barrier to entry. We demonstrate that such complexity is unnecessary for frontier performance. We introduce \ours, a probabilistic forecaster built on a standard U-Net backbone trained with a simple recipe: deterministic pre-training on Mean Absolute Error followed by short probabilistic fine-tuning on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) using Monte Carlo Dropout for stochasticity. As a result, our model matches or exceeds the probabilistic skill of GenCast and IFS ENS at $1.5^\circ$ resolution while reducing training compute by over $10\times$ compared to leading CRPS-based models and inference latency by over $10\times$ compared to diffusion-based models. U-Cast trains in under 12 H200 GPU-days and generates a 15-day ensemble forecast in 3 seconds. These results suggest that scalable, general-purpose architectures paired with efficient training curricula can match complex domain-specific designs at a fraction of the cost, opening the training of frontier probabilistic weather models to the broader community.
papers.comment: ICML 2026. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Rose-STL-Lab/u-cast
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出U-Cast，一种基于标准U-Net骨架的概率天气预报模型，通过简单的两阶段训练（先MAE确定性预训练，再CRPS概率微调+MC Dropout）即可达到甚至超越GenCast和IFS ENS在1.5°分辨率下的概率预报技能，训练计算量降低10倍以上，推理延迟降低10倍以上。模型在不到12个H200 GPU天内完成训练，生成15天集合预报仅需3秒。
Motivation: 现有AI天气预报模型依赖专用架构和巨大计算预算，门槛极高。本文旨在证明前沿性能不需要复杂设计，通用架构配合高效训练策略即可实现。
Method: 使用标准U-Net骨干网络，分两阶段训练：第一阶段以平均绝对误差（MAE）进行确定性预训练；第二阶段以连续排序概率评分（CRPS）为损失进行短时间概率微调，并通过蒙特卡洛丢弃（MC Dropout）引入随机性以生成集合预报。
Result: 在1.5°分辨率下，U-Cast在概率预报技能上匹配或超过GenCast和IFS ENS，训练计算量相比领先的CRPS模型降低10倍以上，推理延迟相比扩散模型降低10倍以上。训练规模：不到12 H200 GPU天，15天集合预报生成时间3秒。
Conclusion: 通用架构与高效训练课程的结合能够以极低计算成本匹配专用复杂模型，使前沿概率天气预报模型的训练对更广泛社区开放。

papers.title: Which Leakage Types Matter? A Quantitative Landscape Across 2,047 Benchmark Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Twenty-eight within-subject counterfactual experiments across 2,047 iid tabular datasets, plus a boundary experiment on 129 temporal datasets, measure the severity of four data leakage classes in machine learning. Class I (estimation: fitting scalers on full data) is negligible: all nine conditions produce $|ΔAUC| \leq 0.005$. Class II (selection: peeking, seed cherry-picking) is substantial: the measured effect is consistent with about 90% noise exploitation inflating reported scores. Class III (memorization) scales with model capacity: $d_z$ = 0.37 (Naive Bayes) to 1.11 (Decision Tree) at 10% duplication. Class IV (boundary) is invisible under random cross-validation. Within this iid tabular regime, the textbook emphasis is inverted: normalization leakage matters least; selection leakage at practical dataset sizes matters most.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Companion to arXiv:2603.10742
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过28个受试者内反事实实验，在2047个独立同分布表格数据集上量化了四种数据泄露类别的严重程度，并在129个时间数据集上进行了边界实验。主要发现：归一化泄露（Class I）影响可忽略（|ΔAUC|≤0.005）；选择泄露（Class II，如偷看数据、种子挑选）影响显著，约90%的噪声利用导致报告分数虚高；记忆泄露（Class III）随模型容量增加而增大（在10%重复数据下，朴素贝叶斯的d_z=0.37，决策树为1.11）；边界泄露（Class IV）在随机交叉验证下不可见。结论：在实际表格数据场景中，教科书强调的重点应颠倒：归一化泄露最不重要，而选择泄露在实际数据集规模下最重要。
Motivation: 现有研究对各类数据泄露在机器学习实践中的实际影响缺乏系统性量化，尤其是不同泄露类型的相对严重性，导致研究人员可能误判风险优先级。
Method: 采用大规模反事实实验框架，在2047个独立同分布表格数据集和129个时间数据集上，分别对四种数据泄露类别（估计、选择、记忆、边界）进行控制变量实验，通过比较泄露存在与否的AUC差异来量化影响。
Result: 摘要报告关键数值：Class I泄露影响ΔAUC≤0.005（可忽略）；Class II泄露导致约90%噪声利用，显著膨胀报告分数；Class III在10%数据重复下，d_z从0.37（朴素贝叶斯）到1.11（决策树）；Class IV在随机CV下不可见。
Conclusion: 本文指出，在独立同分布表格数据场景下，传统的教科书强调顺序需要反转：归一化泄露的实际影响最小，而选择泄露在常见数据集规模下最为关键。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Claudini: Autoresearch Discovers State-of-the-Art Adversarial Attack Algorithms for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: We show that AI agents are capable of discovering novel algorithms for adversarial attacks against LLMs, advancing the state of the art on white-box jailbreaking and prompt injection evaluations. We deploy frontier agents, such as Claude Code and Codex, in an autoresearch loop with access to a library of 30+ prior methods and an evaluation script with a fixed compute budget. We show this pipeline to be effective in jailbreaking OpenAI's GPT-OSS-Safeguard-20B and in prompt injections against Meta-SecAlign-70B, an adversarially robust model. For GPT-OSS-Safeguard, the best agent-discovered method achieves up to 80\% attack success rate on CBRN queries, compared to <50\% for existing methods. For SecAlign, it achieves 100\% ASR, while the best prior automated methods only achieve 82\%. Notably, in our setting, attack methods are developed on unrelated surrogate models for a pure random-target token-forcing task, yet generalize directly to prompt injection on the adversarially trained model. Finally, we trace the lineage of methods developed during autoresearch, characterizing the agents' strategies and failure modes. Adversarial ML has long held that defenses must be evaluated against attacks tailored to them; autoresearch automates this principle, and we argue it should be the minimum bar for defense evaluation going forward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示AI代理能够自动发现针对大语言模型的新型对抗攻击算法，在白盒越狱和提示注入评估上达到当前最佳水平。使用Claude Code和Codex等前沿代理在自动研究循环中，结合30多种现有方法和固定计算预算的评估脚本，成功攻击了OpenAI的GPT-OSS-Safeguard-20B（CBRN查询上80%攻击成功率，之前方法低于50%）和Meta的SecAlign-70B（100%攻击成功率，之前最佳自动方法仅82%）。值得注意的是，攻击方法在无关替代模型上开发，直接泛化到对抗训练模型的提示注入。作者认为自动研究应成为防御评估的最低标准。
Motivation: 对抗性机器学习长期认为防御必须针对特定攻击进行评估，但手动设计攻击算法成本高且可能不全面。本文旨在利用AI代理自动发现新型攻击算法，以更系统地评估LLM防御的鲁棒性。
Method: 采用自动研究循环，部署Claude Code和Codex等前沿代理，使其能够访问30多种现有攻击方法的库和预先定义的评估脚本，并在固定计算预算下自主探索和组合攻击策略。方法在无关替代模型上针对随机目标令牌强制任务开发，然后直接用于目标模型的攻击。
Result: 针对GPT-OSS-Safeguard-20B，最佳代理发现的方法在CBRN查询上达到80%攻击成功率，而现有方法低于50%。针对Meta-SecAlign-70B，达到100%攻击成功率，而最佳现有自动方法仅82%。
Conclusion: AI代理能够自动发现超越现有方法的对抗攻击算法，且开发在替代模型上，泛化到对抗训练模型。作者主张自动研究应成为防御评估的最低标准，以更充分地测试LLM防御的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Grammar of Machine Learning Workflows: Rejecting Data Leakage at Call Time
papers.abstract_en: Data leakage has been identified in 648 published papers across 30 scientific fields. The knowledge to prevent it has existed for over a decade; the problem persists because the tools do not enforce what the textbooks teach. This paper presents a grammar (eight typed primitives connected by a directed acyclic graph with four hard constraints) that makes the most damaging leakage types structurally unrepresentable within the grammar's scope. The core mechanism is a terminal assessment gate: the first call-time-enforced evaluate/assess boundary documented in the peer-reviewed ML methodology literature (to my knowledge, as of May 2026), backed by a specification precise enough for independent reimplementation. A companion landscape study across 2,047 datasets grounds the constraints in measured effect sizes. Two reference implementations (Python, R) are available.
papers.comment: 40 pages, v1.3. Two maintained implementations: Python (PyPI: mlw), R (CRAN: ml), Code under github.com/epagogy/ml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器学习工作流中的数据泄露问题，提出一种语法（8个类型化原语，通过有向无环图连接，4个硬约束），使得最有害的泄露类型在语法范围内结构上不可表示。核心机制是终端评估门（terminal assessment gate），首次在同行评审方法论文献中提出调用时强制评估/评估边界。配套研究覆盖2047个数据集，提供Python和R参考实现。
Motivation: 数据泄露已在648篇论文中被识别，但现有工具未能强制执行教科书已有十多年的预防知识，问题持续存在。
Method: 提出一个包含8个类型化原语、有向无环图连接和4个硬约束的语法，核心是终端评估门，在调用时强制评估/评估边界。
Result: 该语法使最有害的数据泄露类型在语法范围内结构上不可表示，并通过2047个数据集的测量效应验证了约束。
Conclusion: 提供了足够精确的规范供独立重新实现，并发布两个参考实现（Python和R）。

papers.title: Ethical Fairness in Ubiquitous Health Sensing without Known Attributes
papers.abstract_en: In ubiquitous and mobile health systems, computational models infer human states from wearable, behavioral, and physiological sensing data. In these settings, high accuracy alone is insufficient; models must act ethically and equitably across diverse people, contexts, and devices. However, fairness methods that rely on demographic or heterogeneous attributes during training are difficult to enforce because such attributes are often unavailable, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or undesirable to collect. Conventional parity-based fairness can also violate ethical principles by trading off subgroup performance. To address this challenge, we present Flare, Fisher-guided LAtent-subgroup learning with do-no-harm REgularization, a demographic- and heterogeneous-attribute-agnostic framework that aligns human-centered fairness with ethical principles for ubiquitous and mobile sensing. Flare leverages optimization geometry, particularly Fisher Information, to regularize curvature and uncover latent disparities in model behavior without demographic or heterogeneous attributes. By integrating representation, loss, and curvature signals, it identifies hidden performance strata and refines them through collaborative but do-no-harm optimization, enhancing subgroup performance while preserving ethical balance. We also introduce BHE (Beneficence-Harm Avoidance-Equity), a metric suite that operationalizes ethical fairness beyond statistical parity. Across mobile physiological, behavioral, and clinical sensing datasets, including EDA, OhioT1DM, IHS, and Percept-R, Flare improves ethical fairness over state-of-the-art baselines. Ablation, interpretability, and loss-landscape analyses show that these gains arise from flatter optimization geometry, simpler decision rules, and do-no-harm latent-subgroup adaptation. Runtime analysis supports the practicality of Flare for resource-constrained sensing deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对普适健康感知系统中模型必须公平但人口统计属性常缺失的问题，提出Flare框架。Flare利用Fisher信息正则化识别潜在性能分层，并通过“不伤害”优化提升子组性能，同时引入BHE指标量化伦理公平性。在多个生理和行为感知数据集上，Flare优于现有公平性方法，消融实验表明其收益源于更平坦的优化几何和更简单的决策规则。
Motivation: 在可穿戴和移动健康系统中，高精度模型必须公平对待不同人群，但训练时人口统计或异质属性常不可用、隐私敏感或难以收集；传统的基于统计平权的公平性方法可能牺牲子组性能，违反伦理原则。
Method: 提出Flare（Fisher引导的潜在子组学习与不伤害正则化），一种无需人口统计或异质属性的框架。通过Fisher信息正则化曲率，结合表征、损失和曲率信号发现隐藏性能分层，并采用协作但“不伤害”优化提升子组性能。
Result: 在EDA、OhioT1DM、IHS和Percept-R等移动生理、行为和临床感知数据集上，Flare比现有最优基线提升了伦理公平性。消融、可解释性和损失地貌分析表明增益源于更平坦的优化几何、更简单的决策规则和“不伤害”潜在子组适应。运行时分析支持在资源受限的传感部署中的实用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调Flare在不需要敏感属性的情况下实现了符合伦理原则的公平性，并通过消融和运行时分析验证了其有效性和实用性。

papers.title: A Hypertoroidal Covering for Perfect Color Equivariance
papers.abstract_en: When the color distribution of input images changes at inference, the performance of conventional neural network architectures drops considerably. A few researchers have begun to incorporate prior knowledge of color geometry in neural network design. These color equivariant architectures have modeled hue variation with 2D rotations, and saturation and luminance transformations as 1D translations. While this approach improves neural network robustness to color variations in a number of contexts, we find that approximating saturation and luminance (interval valued quantities) as 1D translations introduces appreciable artifacts. In this paper, we introduce a color equivariant architecture that is truly equivariant. Instead of approximating the interval with the real line, we lift values on the interval to values on the circle (a double-cover) and build equivariant representations there. Our approach resolves the approximation artifacts of previous methods, improves interpretability and generalizability, and achieves better predictive performance than conventional and equivariant baselines on tasks such as fine-grained classification and medical imaging tasks. Going beyond the context of color, we show that our proposed lifting can also extend to geometric transformations such as scale.
papers.comment: Accept to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于超环面覆盖（hypertoroidal covering）的颜色等变架构，通过将区间值（饱和度、亮度）提升为圆上的双重覆盖（double-cover）以避免之前方法中的近似伪影。在细粒度分类和医学影像任务上，该方法优于传统架构和已有的颜色等变基线，并提升了可解释性和泛化性。此外，该方法可推广到尺度等几何变换。
Motivation: 现有颜色等变架构将色相变化建模为2D旋转，将饱和度和亮度视为1D平移，但后者作为区间值用实线近似会引入明显伪影。
Method: 将区间值（如饱和度、亮度）提升到圆（double-cover）上构造等变表示，从而避免近似伪影，实现真正的颜色等变性。
Result: 在细粒度分类和医学影像任务上，该方法比传统和现有等变基线获得更好的预测性能，并改善了可解释性和泛化性。
Conclusion: 该颜色等变架构解决了近似伪影问题，并可扩展到尺度等几何变换。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Window Selection for Financial Risk Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Risk forecasts in financial regulation and internal management are calculated through historical data. The unknown structural changes of financial data pose a substantial challenge in selecting an appropriate look-back window for risk modeling and forecasting. We develop a data-driven online learning method, called the bootstrap-based adaptive window selection (BAWS), that adaptively determines the window size in a sequential manner. A central component of BAWS is to compare the realized scores against a data-dependent threshold based on the bootstrap method. We provide an asymptotic justification for the bootstrap threshold, covering non-smooth scores such as the VaR check loss and the joint VaR--ES score, with an extension to stationary weakly dependent data via the moving block bootstrap. A single-break analysis further shows that BAWS rejects overlong windows crossing sufficiently large breaks. The proposed method is applicable to the forecasting of risk measures that are elicitable individually or jointly, such as the Value-at-Risk (VaR) and the pair of VaR and the corresponding Expected Shortfall. Through simulation studies and an empirical analysis, we demonstrate that BAWS often improves upon the standard rolling window approach and the recently developed method of stability-based adaptive window selection, especially when there are structural changes in the data-generating process.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自助法（bootstrap）的自适应窗口选择方法（BAWS），用于金融风险预测中历史数据窗口的在线选择。方法通过比较实现得分与自助法确定的阈值来动态调整窗口大小，适用于VaR和ES等风险测度的预测。理论上证明了自助法阈值的渐近性质，模拟和实证表明优于固定窗口和现有方法。
Motivation: 金融数据存在未知的结构变化，使得风险建模中选择合适的历史回看窗口成为挑战。
Method: 开发一种数据驱动的在线学习方法BAWS，利用自助法确定数据依赖的阈值，通过序贯方式自适应选择窗口大小，并扩展至弱相依数据。
Result: 模拟和实证分析表明，BAWS通常优于标准滚动窗口方法和近期基于稳定性的自适应窗口选择方法，尤其在存在结构变化时。
Conclusion: 方法适用于个体或联合可回溯的风险测度预测，如VaR和ES，并通过单断点分析证明其能够拒绝跨越较大断点的过长窗口。

papers.title: Learning Discriminative and Generalizable Anomaly Detector for Dynamic Graph with Limited Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic graph anomaly detection is critical for many real-world applications but remains challenging due to the scarcity of labeled anomalies. Existing methods are either unsupervised or semi-supervised: unsupervised methods avoid the need for labeled anomalies but often produce ambiguous boundary, whereas semi-supervised methods can overfit to the limited labeled anomalies and generalize poorly to unseen anomalies. To address this gap, we consider a largely underexplored problem: learning a discriminative boundary from normal/unlabeled data, while leveraging limited labeled anomalies \textbf{when available} without sacrificing generalization to unseen anomalies. In this paper, we propose an effective, generalizable, and model-agnostic framework with three main components: (i) residual representation encoding that capture deviations between current interactions and their historical context, providing anomaly-relevant signals; (ii) a restriction loss that constrain the normal representations within an interval bounded by two co-centered hyperspheres, ensuring consistent scales while keeping anomalies separable; (iii) a bi-boundary optimization strategy that learns a discriminative and robust boundary using the log-likelihood distribution modeled by a normalizing flow. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our framework across diverse evaluation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态图中异常检测的有限监督问题，提出一个模型无关的框架，包含残差表示编码、限制损失和双边界优化策略，利用少量标注异常和大量未标注数据学习判别边界，在多种评估设置下表现优越。
Motivation: 现有动态图异常检测方法中，无监督方法边界模糊，半监督方法易过拟合于少量标注异常且泛化性差，需在有限监督下学习判别边界同时保持对未知异常的泛化能力。
Method: 提出三组件框架：残差表示编码捕获当前交互与历史上下文的偏差；限制损失将正常表示约束于两个共心超球之间的区间，保持尺度一致；双边界优化策略利用归一化流建模对数似然分布，学习判别且鲁棒的边界。
Result: 实验在多种评估设置下显示该方法优于现有无监督和半监督方法，具有有效性和泛化性，具体定量结果未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 该框架为动态图异常检测提供了一种有效、通用且模型无关的解决方案，能在有限监督下提升判别性和泛化性。

papers.title: LLM4Cov: Execution-Aware Agentic Learning for High-coverage Testbench Generation
papers.abstract_en: Execution-aware LLM agents offer a promising paradigm for learning from tool feedback, but such feedback can be expensive and slow to obtain, making online reinforcement learning (RL) less practical in certain scenarios. High-coverage hardware verification exemplifies this challenge due to its reliance on industrial simulators and non-differentiable execution signals. We propose LLM4Cov, an offline agent-learning framework that models verification as single-step state transitions guided by deterministic evaluators. Building on this formulation, we introduce execution-validated data curation, policy-aware agentic data synthesis, and worst-state-prioritized sampling to enable scalable learning under execution constraints. We further curate a reality-aligned benchmark adapted from an existing verification suite through a revised evaluation protocol. Using the proposed pipeline, a compact 4B-parameter model achieves 69.2% pass rate and 90.4% average coverage in CVDP-ECov under agentic evaluation, outperforming its teacher by 5.3% and 10.5%, demonstrating competitive performance against models an order of magnitude larger.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM4Cov 是一个针对高覆盖率硬件验证测试向量生成的离线智能体学习框架。该框架将验证过程建模为单步状态转换，并利用执行验证的数据筛选、策略感知智能体数据合成和最差状态优先采样来高效利用昂贵的执行反馈。实验表明，一个 4B 参数的紧凑模型在 CVDP-ECov 基准上达到 69.2% 通过率和 90.4% 平均覆盖率，比其教师模型分别提升 5.3% 和 10.5%，性能可与一个数量级更大的模型媲美。
Motivation: 硬件验证中，执行反馈（如仿真结果）获取昂贵且缓慢，使得在线强化学习不实用。本文旨在解决高覆盖率测试向量生成这一具体挑战。
Method: 提出 LLM4Cov 离线学习框架，将验证建模为单步状态转换，由确定性评估器指导。关键组件包括：执行验证的数据筛选（过滤无效样本）、策略感知的智能体数据合成（基于当前策略生成数据），以及最差状态优先采样（关注覆盖率低的区域）。
Result: 在 CVDP-ECov 基准上，4B 参数模型取得 69.2% 通过率和 90.4% 平均覆盖率，超越其教师模型（分别提升 5.3% 和 10.5%），且性能可与十倍参数量的模型竞争。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过离线智能体学习和精心设计的数据利用策略，小模型能够在执行反馈受限的场景下实现高覆盖率，为硬件验证自动化提供了实用方案。

papers.title: Atomix: Timely, Transactional Tool Use for Reliable Agentic Workflows
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents execute multi-step workflows that mutate external state through tools. Common orchestrators treat tool return as the settlement trigger, so faults, speculation, and concurrent agents can leave partial effects, losing-branch residue, stale writes, or irreversible sends. Correct settlement needs two facts that retries, checkpoint replay, locks, and compensation each conflate: which effects must settle together, and when earlier conflicting work is exhausted. Atomix makes this split explicit with progress-aware transactions. The runtime records reads and effects during execution, seals a transaction when its footprint is complete, and commits only after per-resource frontiers show that no earlier conflicting work can still arrive. Commit is final settlement: Atomix releases bufferable effects, accepts reversible external effects as final, and lets irreversible effects leave the gate. Abort suppresses unreleased effects and compensates externalized reversible effects where possible. On representative agent workloads, this composition improves clean recovery under injected faults, isolates contending and speculative work, and prevents correctly classified irreversible actions from leaking; microbenchmarks show microsecond-scale wrapper overhead relative to tool latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Atomix，一种通过进度感知事务（progress-aware transactions）使 LLM 代理工作流中工具调用的结算（settlement）更可靠的系统。Atomix 在运行时记录读取和影响，当事务完成时密封，并等待所有资源的前沿（frontier）确认无冲突工作后才提交，从而避免部分影响、残留分支和不可逆泄漏。实验表明，该方法在注入故障下恢复更干净，隔离竞争与推测工作，微基准开销仅为微秒级。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理编排器将工具返回视为结算触发，导致错误、推测和并发代理可能留下部分影响、残留分支或不可逆发送，而重试、检查点回放、锁和补偿机制无法正确区分哪些影响必须一起结算以及何时冲突工作已耗尽。
Method: 提出进度感知事务机制：执行时记录读写集，当事务足迹完整时密封，仅在每资源的前沿确认无更早的冲突工作可能到达后提交；提交释放缓冲影响、接受可逆外部影响为最终、允许不可逆影响离开；中止则抑制未释放影响并补偿已外部化的可逆影响。
Result: 在代表性代理工作负载上，该组合提高了注入故障下的恢复清洁度，隔离了竞争和推测工作，并防止了正确分类的不可逆动作泄漏；微基准显示包装开销相对于工具延迟为微秒级。
Conclusion: Atomix 通过显式分离影响绑定与冲突解决，为 LLM 代理的可靠工具调用提供了一种事务性框架，但仅适用于可追踪的读写工作流，对完全不可逆操作的补偿能力有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HyperDet: 3D Object Detection with Hyper 4D Radar Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: How far can 3D object detection go using 4D radar alone? Despite offering weather-robust and velocity-aware sensing for autonomous perception, modern 4D radar still yields sparse, noisy, and unstable point clouds, limiting radar-only 3D detection. We present HyperDet, a detector-agnostic framework that constructs task-aware hyper 4D radar point clouds before detection. HyperDet first refines short-window surround-view radar observations through spatio-temporal accumulation, cross-sensor validation, and Doppler-guided motion compensation, improving return reliability and temporal coherence. It then performs foreground generative enhancement using LiDAR-guided pseudo-radar supervision available only during training, enriching object geometry while preserving measured radar background and radar-native attributes. During detector training, radar-aware object-level augmentation further preserves Doppler consistency under geometric relocation. At inference time, HyperDet requires radar input alone and can be directly paired with standard 3D detectors. Experiments on two public surround-view 4D radar datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over raw radar inputs across standard 3D detectors, validating input-level radar enhancement as an effective approach to radar-only 3D detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HyperDet，一种与检测器无关的框架，通过构建任务感知的超4D雷达点云来提升仅用雷达的3D目标检测。方法包括短窗环视雷达观测的时空累积、跨传感器验证、多普勒引导运动补偿，以及在训练时使用LiDAR引导的伪雷达前景生成增强和雷达感知的目标级数据增强。在公开数据集上，与标准3D检测器结合，相比原始雷达输入有持续改进。
Motivation: 现代4D雷达点云稀疏、噪声且不稳定，限制了仅用雷达的3D目标检测性能。
Method: 提出HyperDet框架，先通过时空累积、跨传感器验证和多普勒引导运动补偿精炼短窗环视雷达观测，再在训练时使用LiDAR引导的伪雷达监督进行前景生成增强，同时保持测量的雷达背景和原生属性；检测器训练中采用雷达感知的目标级数据增强以保证多普勒一致性。
Result: 在两个公开环视4D雷达数据集上，与标准3D检测器结合，相比原始雷达输入有持续改进。
Conclusion: 验证了输入级雷达增强是提升仅用雷达3D检测的有效方法。

papers.title: Escaping the BLEU Trap: A Signal-Grounded Framework with Decoupled Semantic Guidance for EEG-to-Text Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Decoding natural language from non-invasive EEG signals is a promising yet challenging task. However, current state-of-the-art models remain constrained by three fundamental issues: Semantic Bias, where outputs collapse into generic linguistic templates; Signal Neglect, where models rely heavily on LLM priors to hallucinate fluent text even in the absence of meaningful signals; and the "BLEU Trap", where high-frequency stopwords inflate n-gram metrics, masking a lack of true semantic fidelity. To resolve these challenges, we move beyond conventional end-to-end pipelines and propose SemKey, a novel multi-stage framework that enforces signal-grounded generation through four decoupled semantic objectives: sentiment, topic, length, and surprisal. We extract these semantic anchors from EEG embeddings directly, then unify them with an Active Retrieval Decoding mechanism, compelling the LLM to ground its token generation in the neural signals rather than defaulting to linguistic priors. Furthermore, we break the BLEU Trap by establishing a comprehensive evaluation protocol using rigorous retrieval and distribution-based metrics such as Fréchet Distance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SemKey effectively mitigates hallucinations on noise inputs and achieves SOTA performance on these robust protocols. Code will be released upon acceptance at https://github.com/xmed-lab/SemKey.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非侵入式EEG到文本解码中的语义偏差、信号忽视和BLEU陷阱问题，提出SemKey多阶段框架。通过从EEG嵌入中提取情感、主题、长度和惊奇度四个语义锚点，并结合主动检索解码机制，迫使LLM基于神经信号生成文本。同时建立使用弗雷歇距离等检索和分布指标的评估协议，在噪声输入上有效缓解幻觉，达到SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有EEG到文本解码模型存在三个根本问题：输出退化为通用语言模板的语义偏差、依赖LLM先验在无意义信号时依然生成流畅文本的信号忽视、以及高频停用词膨胀n-gram指标掩盖语义真实性的BLEU陷阱。
Method: 提出SemKey多阶段框架，包括四个解耦的语义目标（情感、主题、长度、惊奇度）直接从EEG嵌入提取，并通过主动检索解码机制统一，迫使LLM生成基于神经信号的文本。
Result: 在噪声输入上有效缓解幻觉，并在使用弗雷歇距离等鲁棒指标的评估协议上达到最佳性能。
Conclusion: 实验表明SemKey能有效缓解幻觉并在新评估协议上取得SOTA，代码将开源。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对非侵入式EEG到文本解码中的语义偏差、信号忽视和BLEU陷阱问题，提出SemKey多阶段框架。通过从EEG嵌入中提取情感、主题、长度和惊奇度四个语义锚点，并结合主动检索解码机制，迫使LLM基于神经信号生成文本。同时建立使用弗雷歇距离等检索和分布指标的评估协议，在噪声输入上有效缓解幻觉，达到SOTA性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有EEG到文本解码模型存在三个根本问题：输出退化为通用语言模板的语义偏差、依赖LLM先验在无意义信号时依然生成流畅文本的信号忽视、以及高频停用词膨胀n-gram指标掩盖语义真实性的BLEU陷阱。
summary_sections.method: 提出SemKey多阶段框架，包括四个解耦的语义目标（情感、主题、长度、惊奇度）直接从EEG嵌入提取，并通过主动检索解码机制统一，迫使LLM生成基于神经信号的文本。
summary_sections.result: 在噪声输入上有效缓解幻觉，并在使用弗雷歇距离等鲁棒指标的评估协议上达到最佳性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 实验表明SemKey能有效缓解幻觉并在新评估协议上取得SOTA，代码将开源。

papers.title: SoK: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC): Competition Design, Architectures, and Lessons Learned
papers.abstract_en: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC, 2023--2025) is the largest competition to date for building fully autonomous cyber reasoning systems (CRSs) that leverage recent advances in AI -- particularly large language models (LLMs) -- to discover and remediate vulnerabilities in real-world open-source software. This paper presents the first systematic analysis of AIxCC. Drawing on design documents, source code, execution traces, and discussions with organizers and competing teams, we examine the competition's structure and key design decisions, characterize the architectural approaches of finalist CRSs, and analyze competition results beyond the final scoreboard. Our analysis reveals the factors that truly drove CRS performance, identifies genuine technical advances achieved by teams, and exposes limitations that remain open for future research. We conclude with lessons for organizing future competitions and broader insights toward deploying autonomous CRSs in practice.
papers.comment: Camera ready version, systematization of Knowledge and post-competition analysis of DARPA AIxCC (2023-2025)

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对DARPA AI网络挑战赛（AIxCC，2023-2025）进行了首次系统分析，基于设计文档、源代码、执行轨迹以及与组织者和参赛团队的讨论，审视了比赛结构、关键设计决策，描述了决赛系统（CRS）的架构方法，并分析了比赛结果，揭示了影响CRS性能的真正因素、团队取得的技术进展以及未来研究的开放性局限。最后总结了组织未来比赛的经验教训和部署自主CRS的见解。
Motivation: AIxCC是迄今为止构建完全自主的网络推理系统（CRS）的最大竞赛，但缺乏对其系统性的分析。本文旨在通过多源数据，系统了解比赛设计、架构方法及结果背后的技术因素。
Method: 基于设计文档、源代码、执行轨迹和团队访谈，对AIxCC进行系统化分析，包括比赛结构、关键设计决策、决赛系统架构分类以及结果深度分析。
Result: 揭示了真正驱动CRS性能的因素，包括LLM的整合方式、漏洞修复策略等；识别了团队取得的技术进步；指出了当前CRS的局限性，如对复杂漏洞的修复能力不足、评估指标不完善等。
Conclusion: 总结了组织类似未来比赛的教训，并对在实际中部署自主CRS提出了更广泛的见解。

papers.title: Vegas: Self-Speculative Decoding with Verification-Guided Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference has become the norm for today's AI applications. However, it is severely bottlenecked by the increasing memory demands of its KV cache. Previous works have shown that self-speculative decoding with sparse attention, where tokens are drafted using a subset of the KV cache and verified in parallel against the full KV cache, speeds up inference in a lossless manner. However, they rely on a standalone KV selection algorithm to select the KV entries used for drafting and overlook the fact that the criticality of each KV entry is inherently computed during verification. In this paper, we propose Vegas, a self-speculative decoding method with verification-guided sparse attention. Vegas identifies critical KV cache entries as a byproduct of verification and computes attention only over these entries when drafting subsequent tokens. This not only improves the draft token acceptance rate but also incurs low KV selection overhead, thereby improving decoding throughput. Vegas achieves a 1.25$\times$-2.81$\times$ speedup in decoding throughput over default vLLM and a 1.15$\times$-1.29$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art sparse attention-based self-speculative decoding methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/platformxlab/vegas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Vegas，一种基于验证引导的稀疏注意力的自我推测解码方法，通过在验证过程中隐式识别关键 KV 缓存条目，并将其用于后续 draft 步骤的注意力计算，从而以低开销提升解码吞吐量。实验表明，该方法在长上下文推理中实现 1.25×-2.81× 的加速，且优于现有稀疏注意力自我推测解码方法。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理受 KV 缓存内存瓶颈制约，现有自我推测解码方法使用独立 KV 选择算法，忽视了验证步骤中已计算出的关键性信息，导致开销高、接受率低。
Method: Vegas 利用验证过程中的注意力分数作为副产品识别关键 KV 条目，后续 draft 时仅对这些条目进行稀疏注意力计算，从而降低选择开销并提高 draft token 接受率。
Result: 在默认 vLLM 上实现 1.25×-2.81× 的解码吞吐量加速，且相比于最先进的稀疏注意力自我推测解码方法进一步取得 1.15×-1.29× 的加速。
Conclusion: 通过将验证阶段的注意力信息直接用于指导稀疏 attention，Vegas 以低开销提升了自我推测解码的吞吐量，为长上下文推理提供了一种高效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Collaborative and Efficient Fine-tuning: Leveraging Task Similarity
papers.abstract_en: Adaptability has been regarded as a central feature in the foundation models, enabling them to effectively acclimate to unseen downstream tasks. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as celebrated LoRA facilitate efficient adaptation of large foundation models using labeled, high-quality and generally scarce task data. To mitigate data scarcity in fine-tuning of foundation models, we propose to leverage task similarity across multiple downstream users. Intuitively, users with similar tasks must be able to assist each other in boosting the effective fine-tuning data size. We propose Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation, or CoLoRA, which exploits task similarity to collaboratively and efficiently fine-tune personalized foundation models. The main idea in CoLoRA is to train one shared adapter capturing underlying task similarities across all tasks, and personalized adapters tailored to user-specific tasks. We theoretically study CoLoRA on heterogeneous linear regression and provide provable guarantees for ground truth recovery. We also conduct several natural language experiments with varying task similarity, which further demonstrate that when trained together with similar tasks, individual performances are significantly boosted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大模型微调中下游任务数据稀缺的问题，提出利用多个用户间任务相似性的协作式低秩适应方法 CoLoRA。该方法训练一个共享适配器捕捉所有任务的底层相似性，并为每个用户训练个性化适配器。在异质线性回归上给出理论保证，自然语言实验表明与相似任务联合训练能显著提升个体性能。
Motivation: 大模型微调中高质量标签数据通常稀缺，而多个下游用户可能具有相似任务，可利用这种相似性扩大有效训练数据规模。
Method: 提出 Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation (CoLoRA)，训练一个共享适配器（捕捉跨任务相似性）和多个个性化适配器（针对每个用户的任务），在参数高效微调框架下实现协作。
Result: 在异质线性回归上提供了能够恢复真实参数的理论保证；自然语言实验表明，当相似任务一起训练时，各任务的性能显著提升。
Conclusion: 利用任务相似性进行协作微调可以缓解数据稀缺问题，CoLoRA 在理论上和实验上都验证了有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Evaluation to Design: Using Potential Energy Surface Smoothness Metrics to Guide Machine Learning Interatomic Potential Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) sometimes fail to reproduce the physical smoothness of the quantum potential energy surface (PES), leading to erroneous behavior in downstream simulations that standard energy and force regression evaluations can miss. Existing evaluations, such as microcanonical molecular dynamics (MD), are computationally expensive and primarily probe near-equilibrium states. To improve evaluation metrics for MLIPs, we introduce the Bond Smoothness Characterization Test (BSCT). This efficient benchmark probes the PES via controlled bond deformations and detects non-smoothness, including discontinuities, artificial minima, and spurious forces, both near and far from equilibrium. We show that BSCT correlates strongly with MD stability while requiring a fraction of the cost of MD. To demonstrate how BSCT can guide iterative model design, we utilize an unconstrained Transformer backbone as a testbed, illustrating how refinements such as a new differentiable $k$-nearest neighbors algorithm and temperature-controlled attention reduce artifacts identified by our metric. By optimizing model design systematically based on BSCT, the resulting MLIP simultaneously achieves a low conventional E/F regression error, stable MD simulations, and robust atomistic property predictions. Our results establish BSCT as both a validation metric for practitioners to assess MLIP utility and as an "in-the-loop" model design proxy that alerts MLIP developers to physical challenges that cannot be efficiently evaluated by current MLIP benchmarks. The BSCT dataset and evaluation are available on https://github.com/ryanliu30/bsct.git
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出键平滑度表征测试（BSCT），用于高效评估机器学习原子间势能（MLIP）的势能面平滑性，检测不连续、人工极小和虚假力。BSCT与分子动力学稳定性强相关且成本极低。通过BSCT指导未约束Transformer骨干的迭代设计（可微k近邻、温度控制注意力），可同时降低能量力回归误差、实现稳定分子动力学和鲁棒的原子性质预测。
Motivation: 现有MLIP有时无法复现量子势能面的物理平滑性，导致下游模拟错误，而标准回归评估无法捕捉；微正则分子动力学评估计算昂贵且主要探测近平衡态。
Method: 引入BSCT基准，通过受控键形变探测势能面，检测非平滑性；并以未约束Transformer骨干为测试床，展示如何根据BSCT的反馈进行模型设计改进，包括可微k近邻算法和温度控制注意力。
Result: BSCT与分子动力学稳定性强相关，但计算成本远低于分子动力学；基于BSCT优化的MLIP同时达到低回归误差、稳定分子动力学和鲁棒的原子性质预测。
Conclusion: BSCT既可作为评估MLIP实用性的验证指标，也可作为模型设计代理，预警现有MLIP基准无法高效评估的物理挑战。

papers.title: Fixed Budget is No Harder Than Fixed Confidence in Best-Arm Identification up to Logarithmic Factors
papers.abstract_en: The best-arm identification (BAI) problem is one of the most fundamental problems in interactive machine learning, which has two flavors: the fixed-budget setting (FB) and the fixed-confidence setting (FC). For $K$-armed bandits with a unique best arm, the optimal sample complexities for both settings have been settled down, and they match up to logarithmic factors. This prompts an interesting research question about the generic, potentially structured BAI problems: is FB harder than FC or the other way around? In this paper, we show that FB is no harder than FC up to logarithmic factors. We do this constructively: we propose a novel algorithm called FC2FB (fixed confidence to fixed budget), which is a meta algorithm that takes in an FC algorithm $\mathcal{A}$ and turn it into an FB algorithm. We prove that FC2FB enjoys a sample complexity that matches, up to logarithmic factors, that of the sample complexity of $\mathcal{A}$. This means that the optimal FC sample complexity is an upper bound of the optimal FB sample complexity up to logarithmic factors. Our result not only reveals a fundamental relationship between FB and FC, but also has a significant implication: FC2FB combined with existing state-of-the-art FC algorithms leads to improved sample complexity for a number of FB problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究最佳臂识别（BAI）问题中固定预算（FB）与固定置信（FC）两种设置的难度关系。作者提出FC2FB元算法，将任意FC算法转换为FB算法，并证明转换后的FB样本复杂度与原始FC算法相比仅差对数因子，从而表明FB不比FC更难。
Motivation: BAI问题有FB和FC两种主流设置，已有研究表明在无结构K臂老虎机中二者最优样本复杂度仅差对数因子，但一般结构化问题中两者的难度关系尚不明确。
Method: 提出FC2FB元算法，该算法以任意FC算法为输入，通过自适应地将预算分配到各个阶段并调用FC算法进行子集剔除，最终输出一个臂。
Result: 证明FC2FB的样本复杂度与输入FC算法相比最多差对数因子，即FB的最优样本复杂度不超过FC的最优样本复杂度（忽略对数因子）。
Conclusion: 这一结果揭示了FB与FC之间的基本关系，并表明结合现有的最优FC算法可提升多个FB问题的样本复杂度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FOVI: A biologically-inspired foveated interface for deep vision models
papers.abstract_en: Human vision is foveated, with variable resolution peaking at the center of a large field of view; this reflects an efficient trade-off for active sensing, allowing eye-movements to bring different parts of the world into focus with other parts of the world in context. In contrast, most computer vision systems encode the visual world at a uniform resolution, raising challenges for processing full-field high-resolution images efficiently. We propose a foveated vision interface (FOVI) based on the human retina and primary visual cortex (V1), that reformats a variable-resolution retina-like sensor array into a uniformly dense, V1-like sensor manifold. Receptive fields are defined as k-nearest-neighborhoods (kNNs) on the sensor manifold, enabling kNN-convolution via a novel kernel mapping technique. We demonstrate two use cases: (1) an end-to-end kNN-convolutional architecture, and (2) a foveated adaptation of the DINOv3 ViT foundation model, leveraging low-rank adaptation (LoRA). These models provide competitive performance with a fraction of the pixels and computational cost of full resolution non-foveated baselines, opening pathways for efficient and scalable active sensing for high-resolution egocentric vision. Code (https://github.com/nblauch/fovi) and pre-trained models (https://huggingface.co/fovi-pytorch) are available.
