papers.title: SortingHat: Redefining Operating Systems Education with a Tailored Digital Teaching Assistant
papers.abstract_en: Operating Systems (OS) courses are among the most challenging in computer science education due to the complexity of internal structures and the diversity of running environments. Traditional teaching methods often fail to address the diverse backgrounds, learning speeds, and practical needs of students. To tackle these challenges, we present SortingHat, a personalized digital teaching assistant tailored specifically for OS education. SortingHat integrates advanced AI technologies, including a retrieval augmented generation (RAG) framework and multi agent reinforcement learning (MARL), to deliver adaptive, scalable, and effective educational support. SortingHat features a 3D digital human interface powered by large language models (LLMs) to provide personalized, empathetic, and context aware guidance. It generates tailored exercises based on each student's learning history and academic performance, reinforcing weak areas and challenging advanced concepts. Additionally, the system incorporates a robust evaluation pipeline that ensures fair, consistent, and unbiased grading of student submissions while delivering personalized, actionable feedback for improvement. By combining personalized guidance, adaptive content creation, and automated assessment, SortingHat transforms OS education into an engaging, immersive, and scalable experience.
papers.journal_ref: WWW '25: Companion Proceedings of the ACM on Web Conference 2025,Pages 2951 - 2954
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SortingHat 是一个为操作系统（OS）教育量身定制的个性化数字教学助手，集成了检索增强生成（RAG）和多智能体强化学习（MARL），通过3D数字人界面提供自适应指导、个性化练习生成和自动化评估，旨在将OS教育转变为沉浸式、可扩展的体验。
Motivation: 传统OS教学方法难以应对学生背景、学习速度和实践需求的多样性，导致教学效果不佳。
Method: 采用检索增强生成（RAG）框架和多智能体强化学习（MARL），结合大语言模型驱动的3D数字人界面，根据学习历史和成绩生成针对性练习，并包含公平、一致的自动评估管道。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但声称SortingHat能提供个性化、共情且上下文感知的指导，增强弱项并挑战高级概念。
Conclusion: SortingHat通过个性化指导、自适应内容创建和自动评估，有望提升OS教育的参与度和可扩展性。

papers.title: Toward Robust In-Context Learning: Leveraging Out-of-distribution Proxies for Target Inaccessible Demonstration Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Although studies have demonstrated that Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform well on Out-of-Distribution (OOD) tasks, their advantage tends to diminish as the distribution shift becomes more severe. Consequently, researchers aim to retrieve distributionally similar and informative demonstrations from the available source domain to boost the inference capabilities of LLMs. However, in practical scenarios where the target domain is inaccessible, evaluating the unknown distribution is challenging, which indirectly impacts the quality of the selected demonstrations. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{DOPA}, a demonstration search framework that incorporates an OOD proxy to approximate the inaccessible target domain and guide the retrieval process. Building on proxy-based evaluation, DOPA further introduces a Mahalanobis distance-based global diversity constraint to ensure sufficient diversity among the retrieved demonstrations. Experimental results on multiple LLMs and tasks demonstrate that DOPA effectively enhances robustness in OOD settings\footnote{https://github.com/bort64/ood\_code}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DOPA框架，用于解决目标域不可访问时基于上下文学习的演示检索问题。通过引入OOD代理（out-of-distribution proxy）近似目标域，并基于马氏距离（Mahalanobis distance）添加全局多样性约束，在多个大语言模型和任务上增强了OOD鲁棒性。
Motivation: 实际场景中目标域不可访问，难以评估未知分布，导致从源域检索的演示质量下降，影响大语言模型在分布偏移下的推理能力。
Method: 提出DOPA演示搜索框架，包含OOD代理来近似不可访问的目标域，并指导检索过程；同时引入基于马氏距离的全局多样性约束，确保检索到的演示具有充分多样性。
Result: 在多个大语言模型和任务上的实验表明，DOPA有效增强了模型在OOD设置下的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: DOPA框架通过代理和多样性约束提升了目标不可访问时的演示检索质量，适用于OOD场景下的上下文学习。

papers.title: A phenomenon of AI-conformity: how algorithms change human moral decision-making
papers.abstract_en: Social conformity is a well-documented phenomenon in which individuals shift their opinions towards those of a social majority. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into everyday life it may also create a novel source of influence giving rise to algorithmic conformity, mechanisms of which are poorly understood. The present study examined whether AI judgements affect moral decision-making in humans (n=165) adapting the classical Asch paradigm. Participants completed a series of moral dilemmas under three different conditions: in presence of social majority, with an AI model providing brief answers and with an AI model providing both answers and explanations of its choices. In all conditions the presented responses contradicted generally accepted moral norms. The results indicated that an AI model with a reasoning component affected the opinion of participants to a degree comparable to that of a human majority. These findings suggest that even moral judgements, despite their sensitivity and personal significance, may be susceptible to algorithmic conformity. However, the mechanism underlying algorithmic conformity appears to differ from the social one. Overall, the study challenges the assumption that moral decision-making lies in "AI inadmissibility zone" - a sphere that is considered as an area in which only human-made decisions are acceptable and highlights the need for a further investigation of this phenomenon as AI-based recommendations become increasingly embedded into human decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过改编经典的Asch范式，研究AI判断是否影响人类的道德决策。实验发现，带有推理组件的AI模型对参与者意见的影响程度与人类多数相当，表明道德判断可能受到算法从众的影响，且其机制与社会从众不同。这一结果挑战了“AI禁区”假设，即认为道德决策只能由人类做出的观点。
Motivation: 随着AI日益融入日常生活，AI可能成为新的影响源，导致算法从众现象，但其机制尚不明确。本文旨在探究AI判断是否以及如何影响人类在道德决策中的判断。
Method: 采用在线实验，让参与者（n=165）在三种条件下完成一系列道德困境：人类多数意见、仅AI提供简短答案、AI提供答案并解释理由。所有条件下的回应都与公认道德规范相悖。
Result: 有推理组件的AI模型对参与者意见的影响与人类多数相当，表明道德判断易受算法从众影响，但其机制与社会从众不同。
Conclusion: 研究挑战了道德决策属于“AI禁区”的观点，并强调需要进一步研究，因为AI推荐正日益嵌入人类决策过程。

papers.title: DraDDP: A Multimodal Multi-Party Dialogue Discourse Parsing Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Multi-party dialogue discourse parsing aims to identify dependency structures and relation types between utterances in conversations. Previous studies are mostly limited to textual modality or two-party dialogue, failing to meet the multimodal and multi-party settings. In this paper, we construct the first publicly available English multimodal dataset DraDDP for multi-party dialogue discourse parsing, based on American TV dramas. DraDDP contains 495 dialogue segments with 6,374 utterances and 9.1 hours of parallel video content, covering rich multi-party interaction scenarios. Moreover, we establish comprehensive benchmarks by evaluating this task on DraDDP and conducting in-depth analysis on the impact of different modalities. Experimental results demonstrate the value of multimodal information in capturing dialogue structures and relation types. We will publicly release the dataset, annotation guidelines, and code to promote future research in multimodal dialogue understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了首个公开的英文多模态多方对话语篇解析数据集DraDDP，基于美国电视剧，包含495个对话片段、6374个话语和9.1小时的并行视频内容，覆盖丰富的多方交互场景。通过在DraDDP上建立基准并分析不同模态的影响，实验表明多模态信息在捕捉对话结构和关系类型方面具有价值。
Motivation: 现有研究多局限于文本模态或双方对话，无法满足多模态和多方对话的场景需求，缺乏公开的多模态多方对话语篇解析数据集。
Method: 基于美国电视剧构建多模态多方对话语篇解析数据集DraDDP，包含对话片段、话语和视频内容，并建立基准评估不同模态的影响。
Result: 实验结果表明多模态信息有助于捕捉对话结构和关系类型，数据集和代码将公开。
Conclusion: 该数据集为多模态多方对话语篇解析提供了基础资源，有望推动该领域研究。

papers.title: RuleEdit: Failure-Guided Human-AI Model Editing with Prospective Impact Preview
papers.abstract_en: Despite the promise of AI to assist complex decisions, practitioners still lack ways to detect likely failures and inspect the consequences of model edits before committing them. We present RuleEdit, an interactive, rule-guided human-AI model editing system that (i) surfaces likely failures through interpretable mismatch signals from rule tables and (ii) supports user-authored rule feedback with prospective previews of projected performance changes and embedding shifts. We instantiate RuleEdit in stroke rehabilitation assessment and evaluate it with health professionals and students. Rule-guided failure detection significantly increased Human + AI performance by 14.16\% ($p<0.001$) while improving rejection of incorrect AI and reducing both over- and under- reliance as well as ChangedToWrong decisions. In addition, presenting prospective embedding previews improved participants' feedback for model adaptation, increasing post-update local performance gains from 11.50\% to 36.38\% after incorporating users' rule-based feedback ($p<0.001$). Our findings show that mismatch-based failure cues and prospective impact previews can support failure-aware human-AI model editing, while also revealing a local-global tradeoff: edits that help a specific case can degrade performance when transferred globally. We discuss implications of designing failure-aware and controllable human-AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RuleEdit，一个交互式规则引导的人机模型编辑系统，用于辅助决策。系统通过规则表识别潜在失败，并支持用户编辑规则，同时提供前瞻性性能变化预览。在卒中康复评估任务中，与卫生专业人员和学生进行的实验表明，基于规则的不匹配信号检测显著提高了人机协同性能，降低了过度依赖和不足依赖。此外，前瞻性嵌入预览改善了用户的模型适应反馈，使局部性能提升从11.50%增加到36.38%。文章还揭示了局部-全局权衡：针对特定案例的编辑可能会在全局迁移时导致性能下降。
Motivation: 尽管AI有望辅助复杂决策，但从业者缺乏在提交模型编辑前检测潜在失败和检查后果的方法。
Method: RuleEdit系统：1) 通过规则表中的可解释不匹配信号揭示潜在失败；2) 支持用户编写规则反馈，并提供前瞻性预览（投影性能变化和嵌入偏移）。
Result: 规则引导的失败检测使人机协同性能提升14.16%（p<0.001），同时提高了对错误AI的拒绝率，减少了过度依赖和不足依赖以及ChangedToWrong决策。前瞻性嵌入预览改善了用户的模型适应反馈，使局部性能增益从11.50%提升至36.38%（p<0.001）。
Conclusion: 基于不匹配的失败线索和前瞻性影响预览可以支持失败感知的人机模型编辑，但存在局部-全局权衡。讨论了设计失败感知和可控人机系统的意义。

papers.title: Empathic and agentic artificial intelligence in nursing: perspectives on a human-centered framework for cancer care navigation in the United States
papers.abstract_en: For patients experiencing cancer, nurse navigation can ease the burden of complex care by enhancing coordination of health services and patient outcomes. However, in under-resourced areas, trained nurse navigators may be limited or non-existent. In the United States, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled digital health tools are increasingly available and may help address gaps in care coordination; however, most are not designed to specifically support nursing. This perspective piece discusses a human-centered AI framework that integrates empathic and agentic approaches grounded in the American Nurses Association's code of ethics to support nurses in the United States in cancer care navigation. The framework could augment, not replace, human empathy and agency while improving nurse workflow, patient-clinician relationships, and care coordination services in under-resourced areas.
papers.journal_ref: ESMO Real World Data and Digital Oncology, 2026, Vol 12, 100694
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点文章，探讨了在美国癌症护理导航中，基于人类中心的人工智能框架如何整合共情与代理方法，以支持护士工作。该框架依据美国护士协会伦理准则，旨在增强而非取代人类共情与代理，改善资源不足地区的护理协调。
Motivation: 在资源不足地区，训练有素的护士导航员可能有限或缺失，而现有AI工具大多未专门支持护理工作。本文针对这一差距，提出一个基于护理伦理的人类中心AI框架。
Method: 提出了一个整合共情与代理方法的AI框架，该框架基于美国护士协会伦理准则，用于支持癌症护理导航中的护士工作。
Result: 作为观点文章，本文未提供定量实验结果，而是从伦理和实践角度论述了框架的潜在价值。
Conclusion: 该框架有望增强而非取代人类共情与代理，改善资源不足地区的护士工作流程、患者-临床医生关系和护理协调服务。

papers.title: Optimal Transport-based Permutation-Invariant Bayesian Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Layouts
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely and successfully adopted for solving optimization problems having an expensive-to-evaluate, black-box, and non-convex objective function. However, the vanilla BO algorithm is not able to exploit possible symmetries characterizing the target problem. An intuitive case is given by optimal location problems, whose decision variables refer to a finite set of points within a continuous space, with the order of points not affecting the value of the objective function. We refer to this setting as optimization over layouts to distinguish from optimization over point-clouds where, instead, the order of points counts. As an instance of optimization over layouts we consider a real-life industrial-relevant application, that is the optimization of the layout of an offshore wind farm: given identical wind turbines, switching any pair of them has not any effect on the annual energy production. Based on Optimal Transport theory, we propose a Permutation-Invariant BO approach, namely PIBO, proved to provide better wind farm layouts when compared to the vanilla BO approach while cutting computation time roughly in half.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具有对称性的最优选址问题，提出基于最优传输理论的排列不变贝叶斯优化方法（PIBO），应用于海上风电场布局优化。实验表明，PIBO 比标准贝叶斯优化获得更好的布局，并将计算时间减半。
Motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化无法利用问题中的对称性（如点顺序不影响目标函数），导致优化效率低下。
Method: 基于最优传输（Optimal Transport）理论，提出排列不变贝叶斯优化（Permutation-Invariant Bayesian Optimization, PIBO），在优化过程中保持对布局排列的不变性。
Result: 在海上风电场布局优化实例中，PIBO 相比标准贝叶斯优化得到更优的布局，且计算时间减少约一半。
Conclusion: 利用布局问题的排列不变性，PIBO 能有效提升贝叶斯优化的效率和结果质量。

papers.title: Agents on a Tree: Pathwise Coordination for Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective molecular optimization requires searching vast chemical spaces under conflicting objectives, where early design decisions strongly constrain downstream outcomes. Existing methods typically rely on a single policy or fixed scalarization, which limits their ability to represent diverse trade-offs and to explore multiple promising design trajectories. We propose ATOM, a multi-agent framework that formulates molecular optimization as a tree-structured search. Each node corresponds to an atomic operation and hosts an agent specialized for a particular objective or decision context. Agents coordinate along different paths of the tree rather than enforcing a global consensus, enabling the method to maintain and compare alternative molecular evolution trajectories. A global memory of past optimization behaviors further supports balanced exploration and exploitation across objectives. This tree-structured interaction enables reasoning over long-horizon dependencies inherent in molecular design. Experiments on challenging multi-objective benchmarks involving activity, synthesizability, and ADMET-related properties show that ATOM consistently achieves improved Pareto coverage and hypervolume over strong baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pathwise multi-agent coordination for molecular optimization. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ATOM-41CE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ATOM，一个多智能体框架，将多目标分子优化建模为树结构搜索。每个节点对应原子操作，并为特定目标配备专门智能体，通过沿树不同路径协调而非全局共识来维持多个分子进化轨迹。全局记忆平衡探索与利用。实验在活性、可合成性和ADMET相关属性基准上，ATOM一致改进帕累托覆盖和超体积。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖单一策略或固定标量化，难以表示多样权衡和探索多种设计轨迹，且早期决策强约束下游结果。
Method: 构建树结构搜索，每个节点为原子操作，每个智能体专精一个目标或决策上下文；智能体沿不同路径协调，全局记忆存储历史优化行为以平衡探索与利用。
Result: 在涉及活性、可合成性和ADMET属性的多目标基准上，ATOM相比强基线获得更优的帕累托覆盖和超体积。
Conclusion: 路径协调的多智能体方法能有效处理分子优化中的长程依赖和多目标权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deliberative Curation: A Protocol for Multi-Agent Knowledge Bases
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents transition from isolated tools to collaborative participants in shared knowledge ecosystems, governing collective knowledge curation becomes a critical challenge. Human platform governance mechanisms do not transfer directly: agent statelessness undermines deterrence-based sanctions, model homogeneity violates independence assumptions underlying crowd wisdom, and sycophancy collapses deliberative consensus. We propose a deliberative curation protocol combining three governance layers: (1) a knowledge artifact lifecycle formalized as a labeled transition system; (2) reputation-weighted deliberative voting integrating Beta Reputation with EigenTrust amplification; and (3) graduated sanctions adapted for stateless agents, including broken agent handling distinguishing malfunction from adversarial behavior. We evaluate the protocol through agent-based simulation with 100 agents across seven behavioral archetypes under two adversity scenarios (30 seeds, paired t-tests). The protocol trades modest precision under benign conditions for substantially better resilience under adversity: 0.826 vs 0.791 for majority vote under moderate adversity (p<0.001), widening to 0.807 vs 0.740 under stress (p<0.001). The protocol degrades roughly three times more slowly than majority vote. Ablation analysis identifies commit-reveal vote concealment as the most impactful single component (8.2-8.6pp precision improvement, p<0.001), outperforming reputation weighting and deliberation combined. Graduated sanctions were not exercised in simulation and remain empirically unvalidated.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Open-source implementation available at https://github.com/StevenJohnson998/AIngram
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对多智能体知识库的审议策展协议，通过知识工件生命周期、声誉加权的审议投票和分级制裁三层治理来解决AI agent在共享知识生态中的集体知识策展问题。在100个智能体、7种行为原型的仿真中，该协议在逆境场景下相比多数投票表现出更好的韧性，精度从0.791提升至0.826（p<0.001），且退化速度慢约三倍。消融分析显示提交-揭示投票隐藏是最有效的单组件（精度提升8.2-8.6个百分点）。
Motivation: 随着AI agent从孤立工具转变为共享知识生态中的协作参与者，集体知识策展的治理成为关键挑战。人类的平台治理机制无法直接迁移，因为agent的无状态性削弱了基于威慑的制裁，模型同质性破坏了群体智慧所需的独立性假设，而谄媚问题会破坏审议共识。
Method: 提出一个审议策展协议，结合三层治理：(1) 知识工件生命周期形式化为带标签的迁移系统；(2) 声誉加权的审议投票，集成Beta声誉模型与EigenTrust放大；(3) 针对无状态agent的分级制裁，包括区分故障与对抗行为的破损agent处理。通过基于agent的仿真评估，使用100个agent、7种行为原型、两种逆境场景（30个种子，配对t检验）。
Result: 协议在良性条件下以适度精度换取更好的逆境韧性：适度逆境下0.826 vs 多数投票0.791（p<0.001），强逆境下0.807 vs 0.740（p<0.001）。协议退化速度约为多数投票的三分之一。消融分析确认提交-揭示投票隐藏是最具影响力的单一组件（精度提升8.2-8.6个百分点，p<0.001），优于声誉加权和审议的组合。分级制裁在仿真中未被激活，因此尚未经验证。
Conclusion: 该协议在逆境下显著优于多数投票，尤其适合存在对抗或故障agent的场景。但分级制裁的有效性仍待实证验证，且协议在良性条件下精度略低。未来工作需在实际多智能体系统中进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出一个审议策展协议，结合三层治理：(1) 知识工件生命周期形式化为带标签的迁移系统；(2) 声誉加权的审议投票，集成Beta声誉模型与EigenTrust放大；(3) 针对无状态agent的分级制裁，包括区分故障与对抗行为的破损agent处理。通过基于agent的仿真评估，使用100个agent、7种行为原型、两种逆境场景（30个种子，配对t检验）。
summary_sections.result: 协议在良性条件下以适度精度换取更好的逆境韧性：适度逆境下0.826 vs 多数投票0.791（p<0.001），强逆境下0.807 vs 0.740（p<0.001）。协议退化速度约为多数投票的三分之一。消融分析确认提交-揭示投票隐藏是最具影响力的单一组件（精度提升8.2-8.6个百分点，p<0.001），优于声誉加权和审议的组合。分级制裁在仿真中未被激活，因此尚未经验证。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该协议在逆境下显著优于多数投票，尤其适合存在对抗或故障agent的场景。但分级制裁的有效性仍待实证验证，且协议在良性条件下精度略低。未来工作需在实际多智能体系统中进一步验证。

papers.title: Emergent Collaborative Deliberation in Multi-Model AI Systems: A BFT-Derived Protocol for Epistemic Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We present the Consilium Protocol, a Byzantine Fault Tolerance-derived architecture for structured multi-model AI deliberation that treats inter-model disagreement as epistemic signal rather than error. The protocol assigns engineered cognitive personas to language models -- separating what a model is from how it reasons -- and introduces an In-Sample/Out-of-Sample validation framework adapted from quantitative finance to distinguish training-data consensus from empirically grounded conclusions. Across 1,478 deliberation sessions spanning 32 topics in 10 domain categories, we demonstrate that (1) the cognitive persona, not the underlying model, determines epistemic behavior: free edge-inference models costing 0.0002 USD per batch produced comparable analytical output to frontier models costing 10.69 USD; (2) RLHF alignment training creates measurable, domain-specific epistemic blind spots -- contested policy topics exhibit 12.3 percentage points less adversarial challenge than settled science topics, and AI safety topics show asymmetric bias ($Δ$=11.6%) where models challenge claims that AI is dangerous far more vigorously than claims that AI risk is overstated; (3) the protocol exhibits no directional bias of its own (immigration $Δ$=2.3%, renewables $Δ$=1.2%); and (4) out-of-sample evidence retrieval validated 239 claims with 100% evidence retrieval and surfaced 167 blind-spot discoveries invisible to training-data deliberation. Run-to-run reproducibility across randomized model$\times$persona assignments averages $\pm$2.2% standard deviation. Total cost for the complete battery including all overhead: 217 USD. We release the protocol specification under MIT license to enable independent verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Consilium协议，一种源自拜占庭容错（BFT）的多模型AI审议架构，将模型间分歧视为认知信号而非错误。通过1478场涵盖32个主题的审议会话，证明认知人格（而非底层模型）决定认知行为；RLHF对齐训练导致特定领域认知盲点；协议本身无方向性偏差；样本外证据检索可发现训练数据无法揭示的盲点。
Motivation: 现有单一模型AI系统在复杂认知任务中存在局限性，多模型间的分歧常被视为错误而非可利用的信号，缺乏结构化审议机制来融合不同模型的优势。
Method: 借鉴BFT协议设计多模型审议架构，为语言模型分配工程化认知人格（区分模型能力与推理方式），并引入从量化金融改编的样本内/样本外验证框架，区分训练数据共识与经验可验证结论。
Result: 认知人格而非底层模型决定认知行为；廉价模型可产出与前沿模型相当的分析结果；RLHF对齐训练在争议政策话题上造成12.3个百分点的认知盲点；AI安全话题呈现11.6%的不对称偏差；样本外证据检索100%验证了239个主张并发现167个盲点。
Conclusion: Consilium协议能够有效利用多模型分歧进行结构化审议，成本极低（完整实验217美元），且MIT许可开源，可独立验证。

papers.title: Position Paper: Post-Solve Robustness in Decision Engines: Feasible Regions and Smoothness Under Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) decision engines routinely output nominally optimal plans for high-stakes industrial systems. Yet deployment rarely matches solve-time assumptions: small perturbations in costs, demands, or resource availability can invalidate feasibility or trigger discontinuous shifts to qualitatively different solutions. We argue that this post-solve robustness gap is a missing layer in today's optimization pipelines and a missing evaluation dimension for learning-enabled decision systems. Rather than replacing robust optimization or stochastic programming, the proposed layer audits a solved incumbent and returns solver-backed evidence about how far that solution can be trusted. We formalize two central objects: (i) an $ε$-near-optimal feasible neighborhood in parameter space, capturing when an incumbent remains feasible and near-optimal under perturbations, and (ii) solution smoothness in decision space, capturing whether nearby alternatives with small combinatorial edits remain competitive. We then synthesize the most relevant partial answers from sensitivity and stability analysis, robust optimization, neighborhood search, adversarial testing, and learning-based enhancements, and articulate an agenda for a unified post-solve robustness layer. Concretely, we call for certified inner approximations around the incumbent, probabilistic robustness estimation with calibrated uncertainty, adversarial robustness margins, and learning-based prediction and explanation aligned with solver-backed verification. We conclude with a compact reporting template and evaluation protocol that would make robustness a first-class output of decision engines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出混合整数线性规划（MILP）决策引擎在求解后存在鲁棒性缺口：部署时参数微小扰动可能导致解不可行或发生不连续跳变。作者形式化了两个核心对象——参数空间中的ε-近优可行邻域和解空间的平滑性，并整合灵敏度分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索等方法，提出构建统一的后求解鲁棒性层，最后给出报告模板和评估协议。
Motivation: 现有MILP优化管线在求解后缺乏对参数扰动的系统性鲁棒性评估，导致高稳定性工业系统中的实际部署与求解假设严重不符。
Method: 提出后求解鲁棒性层，包含两个形式化对象：（i）参数空间中保持可行且近优的ε-邻域；（ii）解空间中微小组合编辑仍保持竞争力的平滑性。整合灵敏度分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试及学习增强等方法，并呼吁开发基于求解器验证的认证近似、概率鲁棒性估计和对抗鲁棒性边界。
Result: 作为立场论文，未给出具体实验结果，但提出了统一的议程、报告模板和评估协议，旨在使鲁棒性成为决策引擎的一级输出。
Conclusion: 强调后求解鲁棒性评估应成为决策引擎的标准组件，并给出了一个紧凑的报告模板和评估协议，以推动该方向的系统化研究。

papers.title: Shu Dao: A Calligraphy Score Framework Linking Calligraphy, Music, and Performance
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Calligraphy Writing Score Representation (CWSR) and proposes Shu Dao as a framework that interprets East Asian calligraphy as a performative art rather than a static visual artifact. Inspired by traditions such as Japanese Shodō and embodied cultural practices such as Chadao , the framework models calligraphy as a structured performance analogous to musical notation. Instead of representing characters as fixed images, the proposed approach encodes each brush stroke as an ordered and executable action, forming a calligraphy score. Characters are organized within a structured spatial grid, and strokes are annotated with attributes including stroke type, execution order, spatial coordinates, trajectory, compositional role, and dynamic properties such as brush pressure and pacing. This representation captures temporal and expressive aspects of calligraphic writing that are typically absent from image-based representations. The paper makes three main contributions. First, it introduces CWSR as a structured notation system for representing calligraphy across multiple levels, including strokes, character structures, and compositional organization (e.g., layout and zhangfa), together with their rhythmic and performative dynamics. Second, it conceptualizes Shu Dao as a score-mediated framework that models calligraphy as structured performance. Third, it establishes a computational foundation for the analysis, visualization, and executable generation of calligraphic works by AI-based calligraphic agents. Together, these contributions bridge calligraphy, musical notation, and performative cultural practices, supporting human--AI co-creation in computational calligraphy and digital humanities research.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Advances in Information Science and Technology, 2026 4(2), 1-47. https://yvsou.com/journal/index.php/jaist/article/view/43
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出书法书写评分表示法（CWSR）和“书道”（Shu Dao）框架，将东亚书法从静态视觉艺术重新诠释为类似乐谱的可执行表演。通过将每个笔画编码为有序动作（含类型、轨迹、笔压等动态属性），该框架支持多层级结构化表示，为AI代理的书法生成、分析和人机共创奠定计算基础。
Motivation: 传统书法数字化多以图像形式保存，丢失了书写过程中的时序性和表现力；作者希望建立一个类似音乐记谱法的结构化框架，以捕捉书法的动态和表演维度。
Method: 提出CWSR，一种多层级结构化记谱系统：在笔画层标注类型、执行顺序、空间坐标、轨迹、笔压和节奏；在字符层组织空间网格；在构图层记录布局与章法；并以此作为“书道”框架的核心表示。
Result: 论文本身是概念性/框架性的，未报告定量实验；但声称CWSR能够支持书法的分析、可视化和可执行生成，并连接书法、音乐记谱与表演性文化实践。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为人机协作的计算书法学和数字人文研究提供了新的基础，但文中未讨论局限性或评估现有系统的具体性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Lightweight Deep Learning-based Model for Ranking Influential Nodes in Complex Networks
papers.abstract_en: Identifying influential nodes in complex networks is a critical task with a wide range of applications across different domains. However, existing approaches often face trade-offs between accuracy and computational efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose 1D-CGS, a lightweight and effective hybrid model that integrates the speed of one-dimensional convolutional neural networks (1D-CNN) with the topological representation power of GraphSAGE for efficient node ranking. The model uses a lightweight input representation built on two straightforward and significant topological features: node degree and average neighbor degree. These features are processed through 1D convolutions to extract local patterns, followed by GraphSAGE layers to aggregate neighborhood information. We formulate the node ranking task as a regression problem and use the Susceptible-Infected-Recovered (SIR) model to generate ground truth influence scores. 1D-CGS is initially trained on synthetic networks generated by the Barabasi-Albert model and then applied to real world networks for identifying influential nodes. Experimental evaluations on twelve real world networks demonstrate that 1D-CGS significantly outperforms traditional centrality measures and recent deep learning models in ranking accuracy, while operating in very fast runtime. The proposed model achieves an average improvement of 4.73% in Kendall's Tau correlation and 7.67% in Jaccard Similarity over the best performing deep learning baselines. It also achieves an average Monotonicity Index (MI) score 0.99 and produces near perfect rank distributions, indicating highly unique and discriminative rankings. Furthermore, all experiments confirm that 1D-CGS operates in a highly reasonable time, running significantly faster than existing deep learning methods, making it suitable for large scale applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出1D-CGS，一种轻量级深度学习模型，用于复杂网络中有影响力节点的排序。该模型结合1D-CNN与GraphSAGE，以节点度和平均邻居度作为输入特征，将排序任务转化为回归问题，并利用SIR模型生成真实影响力分数。在12个真实网络上的实验表明，1D-CGS在排序准确性上显著优于传统中心性指标和最新深度学习方法，同时运行速度极快，平均Kendall's Tau提升4.73%，Jaccard相似度提升7.67%，单调性指数达到0.99。
Motivation: 现有节点影响力排序方法在准确性和计算效率之间存在权衡，需要一种既能保持高精度又具有高效性的模型。
Method: 提出1D-CGS混合模型，先通过1D卷积提取节点度与平均邻居度的局部模式，再通过GraphSAGE层聚合邻域信息，将节点排名视为回归问题，并使用SIR模型生成训练标签。模型基于Barabasi-Albert合成网络预训练，再迁移至真实网络。
Result: 在12个真实网络上，1D-CGS的平均Kendall's Tau相关性比最佳深度学习方法提高4.73%，Jaccard相似度提高7.67%，单调性指数平均为0.99，且运行速度显著快于现有深度学习方法。
Conclusion: 1D-CGS在准确性、区分度和运行时效率上均优于现有方法，适合大规模复杂网络的应用。

papers.title: A Novel Data Augmentation Strategy for Robust Deep Learning Classification of Biomedical Time-Series Data: Application to ECG and EEG Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The increasing need for accurate and unified analysis of diverse biological signals, such as ECG and EEG, is paramount for comprehensive patient assessment, especially in synchronous monitoring. Despite advances in multi-sensor fusion, a critical gap remains in developing unified architectures that effectively process and extract features from fundamentally different physiological signals. Another challenge is the inherent class imbalance in many biomedical datasets, often causing biased performance in traditional methods. This study addresses these issues by proposing a novel and unified deep learning framework that achieves state-of-the-art performance across different signal types. Our method integrates a ResNet-based CNN with an attention mechanism, enhanced by a novel data augmentation strategy: time-domain concatenation of multiple augmented variants of each signal to generate richer representations. Unlike prior work, we scientifically increase signal complexity to achieve future-reaching capabilities, which resulted in the best predictions compared to the state of the art. Preprocessing steps included wavelet denoising, baseline removal, and standardization. Class imbalance was effectively managed through the combined use of this advanced data augmentation and the Focal Loss function. Regularization techniques were applied during training to ensure generalization. We rigorously evaluated the proposed architecture on three benchmark datasets: UCI Seizure EEG, MIT-BIH Arrhythmia, and PTB Diagnostic ECG. It achieved accuracies of 99.96%, 99.78%, and 100%, respectively, demonstrating robustness across diverse signal types and clinical contexts. Finally, the architecture requires ~130 MB of memory and processes each sample in ~10 ms, suggesting suitability for deployment on low-end or wearable devices.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一深度学习框架，结合ResNet-CNN与注意力机制，并通过时域拼接多种增强变体的数据增强策略，处理ECG和EEG信号。在UCI癫痫EEG、MIT-BIH心律失常和PTB诊断ECG数据集上分别达到99.96%、99.78%和100%的准确率，模型大小约130 MB，推理时间约10 ms，适合低端或可穿戴设备。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏统一架构处理不同生理信号（如ECG和EEG），且生物医学数据集普遍存在类别不平衡问题，导致模型性能偏差。
Method: 提出ResNet-CNN结合注意力机制的架构，并创新数据增强策略：将每个信号的多种增强变体在时域上拼接以生成更丰富表示。预处理包括小波去噪、基线去除和标准化，类别不平衡通过数据增强和Focal Loss共同解决。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上分别达到99.96%（UCI癫痫EEG）、99.78%（MIT-BIH心律失常）和100%（PTB诊断ECG）的准确率，模型内存约130 MB，每样本推理约10 ms。
Conclusion: 该统一框架在多种生物医学信号上取得最优性能，且计算效率高，适合部署在资源受限设备上。
